The shabby and chaotic space is filled with dust and a foul smell of disinfectant mixed with blood.
The noises and cries from people seem to be separated by a layer, hysterical yet somewhat distant.
You try to feel your body—no pain and no restrains. You are relieved that nothing has been done to you.
Those looking at you from above have already gone.
Hella and Hecate aren't here, but you can sense that they are nearby.
You try to stand up, but just as you tilt your head, you see—
Long gray hair, pale face, and blood-soaked bandages wrapped around bullet holes.
You recognize her. You will never forget this lifeless face. You suddenly recall the memory of your life being threatened, which makes you break out in a cold sweat.
It's the person who wants to kill you. She turns and stares at you.

speaker: Hecate
content: They will try to kill you any way they can.

speaker: Ted
content: The Suspect R you're after is hiding out at the SALVA Hospital on the west of the square—that's a well-known Sinner force.
Hehe... I need to look into it then...
You try to move, but you can't find any strength and your body only feels numb. Your mind is going manic by horror.

speaker: Choice
options: What are you going to do to me?
Where are my companions? What did you do to them?

content: She shoots you a glance before turning her gaze away and staring at the ceiling quietly.

The strong sense of threat from earlier has now disappeared. If it isn't for the familiar and fresh bullet holes in her body, you'd even have mistaken her as someone completely different from the killer you met this morning.
Someone pulls open the curtain and enters in. You close your eyes immediately.
...Luckily, nothing happened.
A hand gently strokes your forehead. You open your eyes slightly and see a woman in SALVA nurse uniform looking at you with concern.

...So much sweat. You must be very anxious.
You're safe now.
She wipes away the sweat from your forehead with a warm, wet towel, then gently comforts you like comforting a baby.

speaker: SALVA Nurse
content: Anne, Dr. Iron needs this person.
Shh! I'll be right there.
The nurse named <color=#fb9259>Anne</color> turned around, then she changed the bandages and medicine on the girl in the next bed gently and crisply while whispering softly.

speaker: Anne
content: Does it still hurt? Good... The morphine has taken effect and the doctor is back soon. She will come to see you later. Don't worry.

speaker: Anne
content: Stop thinking about those horrible things. If you feel anxious, just come to me anytime, okay?

The young girl remains quiet. Instead of getting upset, Anne simply gently pulls up the blanket to cover her arms, then returns to your bedside and reaches out to examine the hanging pale yellow infusion bag.

speaker: Anne
content:
Well, the density is a bit high... No wonder you can't relax.
Iron is often so impatient, which won't be easy on the patients.
She gently holds the infusion bag in her hand. Your heart suddenly skips a beat as you watch the yellow liquid in the infusion bag gradually become clear.
The gentle nurse before you is a Sinner from SALVA—your enemy.

speaker: Anne
content: Sorry for keeping you waiting. Come. Let's take him to Iron.
female_content: Sorry for keeping you waiting. Come. Let's take her to Iron.

speaker: SALVA Nurse
content: Sure! Let me help you push the bed.
You feel a shake, then you feel yourself being pushed away, along with the hospital bed. The ceiling recedes at a fast pace and a door quickly approaches—Where are they taking you?

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: Anne, quick. The medical director is getting impatient. Those two Sinners are so difficult to handle.
*** Let me go!!
A voice sounds from behind the door—it's Hella. She sounds angry. What happened?
Whether you are valuable enough to be a hostage or not, this Sinner next to you will definitely be your enemy. If it is a Sinner, your shackles will...

speaker: Anne
content:
Please don't do that, Mr. ${PlayerName}.
Or you will upset her.
female_content:
Please don't do that, Ms. ${PlayerName}.
Or you will upset her.

content: Bang—! The door slams open. A silver scalpel flies out and plunges into your hospital bed, right next to your hand, which you lifted to use the shackles on Anne.
What do you want to do to my head nurse?

speaker: Anne
content: You scared our patient, Iron. Our patient only just woke up and hasn't done anything.

speaker: Iron
content: But you never push a sleeping patient out of the room. You knew our patient was only pretending to be asleep, Anne.

speaker: Anne
content: Sigh... I tried to walk as quietly as I could.

There is no point in pretending now. You open your eyes. A white-robed doctor with black hair and silver pupils stands in front of a group of SALVA doctors. Your two Sinners are sitting fixedly in the ward chairs.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}! She's a Sinner, the boss of SALVA, the hardcore doctor—Iron.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh, this guy did something to us. I can't feel my body. I can't move!!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Her ability is to manipulate nerves and she's good at using drugs. Rating A, but very difficult to deal with.
Iron waves her hand, then a silver flash occurs, and the two Sinners are released from their chairs and pushed toward you.

speaker: Iron
content: I'm Iron, the head doctor of SALVA, performing my duties in this dump.

speaker: Iron
content: I heard you defeated my colleagues and even tried to attack my head nurse...

speaker: Iron
content: Come on, the new Chief of Minos. Let's see what you're capable of.

speaker: Hella
content: W-we won? What about the SALVA Sinners?

A figure flashes before you. You can't manage to catch up with her white robe. The piercing silver eyes are fastened on you as prey. Iron's hand punches toward your forehead like a swift blade. You reach out your hand unconsiously—
You use all your strength to grab her forearm hitting at you and unleashing the shackles. The red beam tears off her sleeve, but nothing happens.
Her finger strikes your forehead, which sends a tingling sensation through your entire body. You are drained of all your strength and fall to the ground, half-kneeling while she grabs your collar.
A metal prosthesis gleam with cold light. From her shoulders down, her left arm is cold and mechanical, yet more flexible than a flesh limb.

speaker: Iron
content: Your power is very special, but it seems like it requires direct physical contact.

speaker: Hella
content: Dumbass! How did you get caught this easily?

speaker: Iron
content: Don't do anything silly, Sinner. You're not as quick as me.

speaker: Iron
content: What are the results?

speaker: Anne
content: Both Sinners had high M values which increased significantly when they use their abilities, but now...

speaker: Anne
content: Incredible. They are already back to the normal level.

speaker: Anne
content: ...Iron, is this true? Has the Mania actually gone down? Can this person's shackles really control Mania?

speaker: Iron
content: I'll find out.

speaker: SALVA Nurse
content: Dr. Iron! Th-the isolation ward!
Iron stands up with a serious but unsurprised look as she pushes the hospital bed with you lying paralyzed on it.

speaker: Iron
content: Let's go. Come to the emergency surgery with me. I need your ability.

speaker: Ted
content: The hospital underground hides countless corpses of dead soldiers and shady experiments. The medical director, Iron, is crazy about some forbidden surgeries to distort the patients' minds.
Is the so-called emergency surgery the forbidden surgery mentioned by Ted?

speaker: Iron
content: Heh... Surgery to save a patient.
She sneers as if she knows what you were thinking, then drags your hospital bed forward.

After passing through the wards and entering the basement, a heavy door is pushed open. The painful, hysterical groans, the foul odor, and the smell of disinfectant in the isolation ward instantly overwhelm your senses.

speaker: Iron
content: Are all the patients with symptoms here?

speaker: SALVA Nurse
content: Yes. No.728 is close to the threshold.

speaker: Iron
content: Okay. Secure the isolation ward and make sure it's soundproof. Don't let anyone come near.
The door slams shut with a thud. Iron puts on a mask and quickly sterilizes her prostheses, then she nods at you—Now you can move.
It was a small hidden room about 80 square feet big. Dozens of gangsters are lying down twistedly—They are mostly Ted's subordinates.
They are strapped to the hospital bed. Under the influence of Mania, they are laughing and howling monstrously and struggling until their bodies become a bloody mess.
Iron! The SALVA witch! Hand over your men and inheritance, or the boss is gonna kill you!
I'll crash your crappy hospital and kill all your pretentious bastard doctors, and you and that Sinner nurse too—Mmm—Mmmmmm!!!
Iron slaps the gangster on the face and seals his mouth. At this point, the doctors' glares were sharper and colder than a scalpel.

speaker: Iron
content: Shut up, loser. The operating table isn't a place for you to go nuts.

speaker: Iron
content: I'll be in charge of the operation. Everyone, follow my command.

speaker: Iron
content: I'll tamper with 728's nerves and delay the spread of Mania, while you use the shackles on 728, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Iron
content: Sinners, get ready for a fight. All of those isolated here are Maniacs. They could go manic and attack us any time.

speaker: Choice
options: You want to save your enemies?

content: Ted said that SALVA is brainwashing the Syndicans with Mania and an enemy of all the gangs.

speaker: Iron
content: As a doctor, disease and death are my only enemies.
Ted says SALVA is using and after Mania.

speaker: Iron
content: Mania distorts humans, while doctors help to restore their sanity. This is my duty.

speaker: Iron
content: Once a person is infested by Mania, the mutation will only ever worsen and eventually turn them into Corruptors. But you are an exception.

speaker: Iron
content: Those Sinners controlled by your shackles have very stable M values. Their Mania is suppressed completely.

speaker: Iron
content: And you have experienced so many outbreaks of Mania yet still haven't been infected—You are the key to healing Mania.

speaker: Iron
content: Okay. Let's start the operation.

speaker: Iron
content: Sinners, be on your guard. Protect your chief!
Great! Great! I feel great! I can feel the power surging in me. I'm gonna kill them! I'm gonna kill them!!! Hahaha!
You press down 728's arm. Your hand is scorching hot, but this isn't the feeling of shackles. He's different from Sinners.
When binding Sinners, you can always hear some voice from the shackles—a cry from the dark.
Yet you feel nothing but a dangerous mess on 728. Your consciousness seems to be sucked into a swiftly sinking black hole. A turbulent vortex begins to tear your mind.
Don't get in my way! Give me more! Give me more!!
His veins suddenly bulge, and he breaks free from the chains. He then picks up a red vial and crushes it with a hysterical laugh. The red liquid quickly enters his skin.
The man's face quickly distorts, while his smoke-filled mouth jets out to reshape his flesh.
Hahahaha—! I—AM—FREE—! I—
Swoosh—
Before he mutates completely, a cold gleam slides across his hand. He freezes, then tumbles onto the ground and stops moving.

speaker: Iron
content: How dare he touches this stuff in my hospital... What a bunch of lunatics!

speaker: Hecate
content: Is he under control?

speaker: Iron
content: No, it's probably too late.

speaker: Hella
content: Iron, this way! He doesn't look right!
In an unexpected place, an old man is mutating.
He is just an ordinary civilian, trembling and twitching with wide eyes in bed, while his body emits clouds of black smoke.

speaker: Old Man
content: Enough... Why did it happen...

speaker: Old Man
content: ...Jamie is dead ...but we ...did nothing wrong ...Why...

speaker: Iron
content: The collapse of 728 created a massive impact, which now affects some other patients.

speaker: Iron
content: Stop! Stop thinking about that! Calm down!

speaker: Old Man
content: Wh... Why... Roaaahhh—!!
His body swells as he wails and injures the patients around him, eventually turning into a Corruptor before your very eyes.
You eliminate all the Corruptors and end up with only 14 "humans" left, all of whom are shaken to the core.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, are you okay?
You feel dizzy after facing off the Corruptors on the operating table. Your ears ring while conflicting emotions scream in your head, then you finally throw up.

speaker: Hecate
content: Please don't use the shackles on Mania that are going manic next time. The mental burden is way too much for you.
Did your shackles react? Like to the Sinners?
It's Iron. She looks down at you, but you can't read her emotions.

speaker: Choice
options: They are different, but I can't put my finger on the differences.

speaker: Iron
content: ...I see.

speaker: Iron
content: Tell Anne that the operation has failed. The shackles only work on Sinners. We need to find a new treatment plan.

speaker: Iron
content: Let me clear my head for a bit and get ready for the next operation.
She approaches you and raises her mechanical arm. But this time, she simply wipes the bile off the corner of your mouth with a warm wet towel.

speaker: Iron
content: You too, ${PlayerName}, get some rest. I was wrong. Mania can hurt you too.
Her voice sounds stiff but non-hostile. Perhaps you are no longer enemies after going through a failed operation together.
But you have many questions for her.

speaker: Iron
content: ...I see. So she is the reason why SALVA got attacked.

speaker: Iron
content: I don't care where she's from or if she's a Sinner. It's our duty to take in and treat a person covered in wounds, lying in front of the gate of SALVA.

speaker: Iron
content: You can investigate or arrest her. I owe you one, but it will have to be after she wakes up.

speaker: Iron
content: I won't allow anyone to hinder our treatment.

speaker: Iron
content: What else? There must be more reasons for you to treat us as enemies, right?
She turns to you with a cold sneer.

speaker: Iron
content: What did that man tell you?

speaker: Choice
options: You brainwash and control the gangsters.
SALVA collects Corruptors to use Mania...

speaker: Iron
content: And what else?

speaker: Iron
content: Heh... It's always the same stuff.

speaker: Iron
content: Heh... No need to keep quiet. It's always the same stuff.

speaker: Iron
content: And what else?

speaker: Iron
content: Heh... It's always the same stuff.

speaker: Iron
content: Heh... No need to keep quiet. It's always the same stuff.

speaker: Iron
content: Let me tell you. This Mania has nothing to do with Sinners. Until today, no one knows exactly where Mania comes from.

speaker: Iron
content: It has been spreading in Syndicate since many years ago.
She puts a vial containing <color=#fb9259>red liquid</color> into your hand, which looks very similar to the red liquid that triggered 728's mutation.

speaker: Iron
content: <color=#fb9259>Mania crystal</color>. Liquid. Unknown composition. It triggers Mania and accelerates mutation once injected into the human body.

speaker: Iron
content: This is highly sought after in the gangs. They even fought each other for this.

speaker: Iron
content: The <color=#fb9259>power</color> that the Mania mutation brings is what the gangs crave most.

speaker: Iron
content: Is it the same this time, right?

speaker: Iron
content: They thought that Sinner escaped from the Bureau had some "inheritance" to control Mania, so they came to SALVA just like annoying, stinky files.

speaker: Choice
options: What about you? What do you think of this power?

speaker: Iron
content: Me? I'm a doctor, not a gangster. I'm not interested in power.

speaker: Iron
content: ...All I want is for Mania to disappear.
There is a fire in her silver pupils, which makes you quiver.

speaker: Iron
content: I save a dozen lives a day in this dump, give them new arms and legs and strength to stand up straight and live on.

speaker: Iron
content: But I gave them arms and legs to slaughter more frantically. The people I saved rushed in to kill in my hospital.

speaker: Iron
content: Injuries only destroy the body, but Mania destroys their minds, gives them a power of a maniac, and causes countless tragedies. What an evil this is...

speaker: Iron
content: I won't lose to something like this... As a doctor, I will make it disappear.
She does seem more clear-headed than any gangster you've ever met. In fact, the entire SALVA seems incredibly normal and righteous.
But these words alone can't resolve all your doubts.

speaker: Choice
options: Where does the power of Sinners come from?
I have witnessed Sinners manipulating Mania myself

speaker: Iron
content: ...You do have some sense. You're right. Our power comes from Mania, which is even stronger than the Maniacs.

speaker: Iron
content: <color=#fb9259>That girl</color>? ...Yes, that power is the same as Mania. All the power of Sinners comes from Mania.

speaker: Iron
content: But that doesn't mean that's what we want.

speaker: Iron
content: Come. See with your own eyes what <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> really are.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Ah—!!

speaker: Anne
content: Tranquilizer. Quick!

speaker: Anne
content: M value, 1632, 1637... Please stop soon!
Back in the ward at the start, a commotion is happening. Layers of blockades are imposed. The young girl is bound to the hospital bed, struggling in pain.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Ahhhhhhh—!

This is the first time you hear her voice, yet it's constant, hysterical groans. The young girl was being torn by something, tearing up the wounds on her body once again. Blood soaks the hospital bed. The whole scene is appalling.

speaker: Anne
content: Take my hand. Breathe and listen to me. Stay awake. Don't let it take you away. Don't give up.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Ha... ha... ha... Aaahhh—!!

speaker: Anne
content: It was just a nightmare! It's not real! Wake up! I'm here holding your hand right now, waiting for you to come back!

speaker: Iron
content: Don't look away, the Chief of Minos. You must understand Mania, the end of Sinners.
She makes some adjustments to the equipment and watches the data changes.

speaker: Iron
content: <color=#fb9259>Mania</color> isn't power and mutation. It's an <color=#fb9259>irreversible mental breakdown</color>.

speaker: Iron
content: Normal humans can't endure an M value above 200. 98.4% of the infected have a mental breakdown and turn into monsters with "power"—Corruptors.

speaker: Iron
content: But the M values of Sinners are at least 600 when they are found. The reason remains unknown.

speaker: Iron
content: They have endured extreme mutations while retaining their sanity and human form and even gaining stronger power as a result.

speaker: Iron
content: But that doesn't mean they don't suffer.

speaker: Iron
content: Triggers can worsen their Mania, which not only brings stronger power but also deeper fear, sorrow, despair, stubbornness, and madness.

speaker: Iron
content: Until they can no longer endure it and break down like any Maniacs.

speaker: Iron
content: The <color=#fb9259>mental contamination</color> which burst when they get to the threshold is the main cause for the escalation of the plague.

speaker: Iron
content: The closer they get to the threshold, the more they spread fear and madness, which escalates the disaster.

speaker: Iron
content: It has nothing to do with the person's willpower or whether the person is a Sinner.
The young girl starts wailing again, while her wounds start to emit faint black smoke.

speaker: Iron
content: This is a sigh of a breakdown. She has reached her limit.

speaker: Choice
options: Aren't you going to save her?

speaker: Iron
content: I can't. Mania can't be reversed. Besides—someone is monitoring her.

speaker: Iron
content: I've examined her. Something nasty has been implanted into her body.

speaker: Iron
content: You're quite cruel. But what if I said she's been used?

speaker: Iron
content: Something nasty has been implanted into her body.

speaker: Iron
content: A <color=#fb9259>remote-controlled capsule</color> with a safety trigger was attached to the outer wall of her heart, which contains liquid Mania crystal.

speaker: Iron
content: The capsule dissolves when a signal is received or someone tries to disable the device. In her current condition, this dose is enough to transform her into a Corrupt instantly.

speaker: Iron
content:
She has many old wounds, which suggests she has been abused...
and domesticated into a <color=#fb9259>weapon</color>.

speaker: Iron
content: When she almost died, she had no choice but to crawl to the door of SALVA to seek help. Her master doesn't care if she dies.

speaker: Iron
content: Her master doesn't care if she dies.

speaker: Choice
content: How much longer can she last?
options: How much longer can she last?

speaker: Iron
content: I don't know. Based on past cases, this state can last up to six hours, but she has lasted at least three days.

speaker: Iron
content: This has happened many times since she arrives at SALVA, but she has made it through each time.

speaker: Iron
content: She doesn't want to turn into a monster.

speaker: Choice
options: And how did you guys become Sinners?
Why are you telling me this?

content: You instantly regret it as soon as the words come out of your mouth. The answer is right in front of you.
Both of them have been rescuing Maniatics, working in the place closest to danger.

speaker: Iron
content: ...Yeah, Anne has once asked me this too.

speaker: Iron
content: How did we make it through that line, but our patients can't?
You attacked SALVA and even killed her colleagues. There's no reason for her to be honest with you.

speaker: Iron
content: ...The way you looked at Brand was different than the rest of them. You weren't seeing him as an enemy or a monster.

speaker: Iron
content: I know you have thought about saving him, just like I did.
These words are slightly awkward, but as Iron said, the shackles can suppress Mania in Sinners and avoid the disaster. Perhaps this could be a solution...

speaker: Iron
content: Hehe, don't underestimate SALVA. This Mania isn't a pressure for me and Anne at all.

speaker: Iron
content: We chose our own path a long time ago, and the path certainly doesn't lead to your bureau.

speaker: Iron
content: If you interfere, I'll make you live on a top-notch pair of mechanical arms for the rest of your life.
She shows her mechanical arms with a faint smile. The cold gleam gives you chills.
Beep—The equipment rings. Iron quickly extends her mechanical arm and walks towards the young girl.

speaker: Iron
content: Gotta get to work now. If she wakes up this time, ask her the rest of your questions yourself.
She has already calmed down, perhaps she's just enduring the pain or simply too weak to move. Her face was pale, and her hollow eyes stare at the ceiling.
You can ask your questions now. She can no longer pose any threat to you now.

speaker: Choice
options: Why did you want to kill me?

content: It isn't a silence from refusal to answer, but the dead silence and emptiness of someone who has lost everything. This is a soulless look that no Sinner has ever had.
They are dangerous, stubborn, narrow-minded, intimidating, and unpredictable, but never so lifeless.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you willing to be used as a tool?

content: Since she doesn't have her own will and is willing to be a tool, she might as well be in your control. At least there will be one less person to do evil.
She was threatened by Mania. If you use shackles on her, can you free her? Can you save this Sinner?

speaker: Choice
options: Touch her and use the shackles

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't, Chief. Her Mania is already out of control. Even you won't be able to take it.

speaker: Hecate
content: She's beyond saving.
Please don't say that.
Anne lifts the curtain and enters. Despite the dark circles under her eyes, the smile on her face is as gentle as always.

speaker: Anne
content: How can we say such discouraging words when the patient hasn't given up yet?

speaker: Anne
content: In SALVA, both the doctors and patients in this hospital believe Mania will be cured one day.

speaker: Anne
content: This kid is no exception... A person who has lost their hope simply can't endure torture like this, yet she perseveres until now.
Anne holds the girl's lean, frail hand.

speaker: Anne
content: You must have a place you want to go back to, right? Is there someone you cherish there? You must want to see them very much...

speaker: Anne
content: Well done. You'll get better. I'll always be here for you.
Her words are soft and determined, but her shoulders are shaking so slightly.

speaker: Anne
content: This time... I'll save you.
The gray-haired girl remains silent, but her gaze is no longer fixated on the ceiling but on Anne.
The frail hand trembles and holds Anne's hand back.
—Boom!!

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: The hospital is under attack! Those gangsters have returned!!!
Nearly a hundred gangsters emerge from the streets, trying to break through the hospital's defenses. Ted is nowhere to be found in the crowd.

speaker: Iron
content: ...Are they here to save you, Chief?
A grenade explodes above your head. Iron blocks the rubble for you with her prosthesis.

speaker: Iron
content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>It's this bunch of bastards again... They really know nothing apart from fighting and killing... What a waste of time. Let's just chop their brains off, they don't use them anyway...</size></color>

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: Oh, no! Our medical director hates these idiot gangsters the most! She's gonna get angry!

speaker: Anne
content: Doctor? Doctor?

speaker: Iron
content: ...Anne, what's wrong?

speaker: Anne
content: The Maniacs and that kid can't take any more of this. Let me send them to the basement for refuge. Please send any new patients down as well.

speaker: Anne
content: I'll leave it to you here. Protect everyone and yourself.

speaker: Iron
content: Rest assured. I am calm.

speaker: Iron
content: Besides, we have the Chief of Minos with us. It'll be more than enough to handle them.

speaker: Iron
content: SALVA had enough power to fight, but you wiped them out. Shouldn't you make up for it, Chief?

speaker: Options
options: ...Looks like refusing isn't an option for me.

speaker: Iron
content: Heh. Don't worry. I'll pay back the favor I owe you.

speaker: Iron
content: ...I'd never expect you to take our side. They may be your companions here to save you.

speaker: Options
content: I've made my own judgment.

speaker: Iron
content: Have you? Then I look forward to seeing what you can do.

speaker: Hella
content: These guys... aren't so strong, but they really don't know when to stop.

speaker: Iron
content: They're buying time.
Your keen eyes notice a small group of gangsters sneaking away—It's a feint attack. They're trying to sneak around the back. One of them looks very familiar to you.
You didn't wait for Iron's answer before you lead the Sinners away quickly and eventually blocked the prowlers in the alley next to the hospital.

speaker: Ted
content: Haha! I knew the Chief would notice our plan.

speaker: Ted
content: I'm here to save you, Chief.
female_content: I'm here to save you, Ms. Chief.

speaker: Ted
content: I saw very clearly that you guys fought together. Well done, Chief, for gaining the trust of that diehard Iron.

speaker: Ted
content: What have you learned about suspect R and the "inheritance" with her?

speaker: Choice
content: Iron agreed to leave her at my disposal.
options: Iron agreed to leave her at my disposal.

speaker: Ted
content: Really? Where is she now? Get her out, then we'll have accomplished our goal!

speaker: Ted
content: Oh, and find a chance to lock up those two Sinners as well, then this will be the end of SALVA!

speaker: Ted
content: Go, Chief. I'll create opportunities for you.

speaker: Choice
options: I have a question for you.

content: About the young assassin girl, the Mania Crystal inside her, and everything.

speaker: Ted
content: ...I see ...So someone is using her ...In this case, my speculation was right. She was sent by a <color=#fb9259>Sinner rebel group</color> to kill you.

speaker: Ted
content: Don't worry, Chief. She has already fled from me once. She won't dare to attack you again.

speaker: Choice
options: Whatever controls her is the same as the Mania Crystal your men uses.

content: The fight, the assassin, and the fellow gangsters here to the rescue—They were all very timely.
Ted the sharpshooter fired seven shots at the girl, yet none of the shots were fatal.

Then the young girl stopped attacking you, not because she failed her mission and was abandoned. On the contrary, her mission was complete—She sacrificed herself so that her master could get close to you.

speaker: Ted
content: ...Chief. The Public Security Bureau sent me here to assist you. Distrust will only divide the departments.

speaker: Choice
options: So, intel about me was leaked from the Public Security Bureau.

content: This is the last piece of the puzzle—the one who knows about this secret operation besides MBCC—is the Public Security Bureau.
And for a smart person like you, Ted, it won't be difficult to bribe one or two sheriffs, expand your network, and steal intel in a lawless place like Syndicate.

speaker: Ted
content: ...What a shame. When I heard that the Bureau sent someone here, I only planned to lend a hand to get rid of those two SALVA troublemakers.

speaker: Ted
content: What a surprise you are.

speaker: Ted
content: You have such powerful shackles that even the Sinners obey you and their powers are at your disposal. You made me want a <color=#fb9259>companion</color> for the first time.

speaker: Ted
content: If we work together, not only the inheritance—all the Sinners here and the entire Syndicate can be ours.

speaker: Ted
content: Haha... That's right. I sensed that we were very different people, so I had no choice but to have a backup plan.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, there's an ambush.
A bunch of gangsters slowly surround you from behind.

speaker: Ted
content: By the way, Chief, I have a surprise for you too. I'm better at using people than you are. I make the most of each of my pawns.
He grins at you. You suddenly have a bad feeling about this.

speaker: Iron
content: When she almost died, she had no choice but to crawl to the door of SALVA to seek help. Her master doesn't care if she dies.

speaker: Ted
content: I've come up with many plans to take down the SALVA <color=#fb9259>basement</color>.

speaker: Anne
content: The Maniacs and that kid can't take any more of this. Let me send them to the <color=#fb9259>basement</color> for refuge.

speaker: Ted
content: I know them. I know what SALVA wants and what they will do. I know it <color=#fb9259>all</color>, and it's disgusting!

speaker: Choice
options: Wh...?! That Sinner came to SALVA on purpose?!

speaker: Ted
content: Hehe... It's very costly to raise a dog and then destroy it just to earn your trust.
Boom—!! A violent shake comes from underground. She has taken action!

speaker: Ted
content: I'm very grateful, Chief. Thank you for wiping out so many SALVA fighters and giving us more time.

speaker: Ted
content: It'd be too late even for the diehard Iron to escape now. It'd be fantastic if she's already dead.
Ted turns to enter the hospital. You want to chase him, only to be blocked by the elite gangsters.

speaker: Hella
content: Back off! These guys all have Mania!

speaker: Hecate
content: For the sake of power, you even get your men infected by Mania?!

speaker: Ted
content: That's right. I've given everything for this day. There's no stopping me now.

speaker: Hella
content: Huff, puff, finally got rid of those bastards. How much time have we wasted?

speaker: Hecate
content: 22 minutes. Ted's target is also <color=#fb9259>Suspect R</color> in the basement.

speaker: Hella
content: We can't let this bastard have it! The entrance to the basement is just up ahead. Hurry...

speaker: SALVA Nurse
content: Help—!
A Corruptor is attacking a SALVA nurse but gets slammed into the wall by a nightmare.

speaker: Hella
content: What's going on? Why are there monsters here? Did they defeat Iron already?

speaker: SALVA Nurse
content: No... From the basement, the patients in the quarantine area are being—

speaker: Anne
content: The Maniacs and that kid can't take any more of this. Let me send them to the basement for refuge.

speaker: Hella
content: Basement... Did Ted and <color=#fb9259>that guy</color> trigger Mania in the basement?!
Clomp—Clomp—

The iron door leading to the quarantine area in the basement is slammed open. Strange sounds can be heard from the deep darkness, which is coming closer and closer, and finally rushes out of the tiny space.

speaker: Maniac Patient
content: Guahhh!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Shut the door! Block them!

speaker: Hella
content: I know what to do! Stop bossing me around!!!
Bang—With a loud slam, the basement door is tightly shut. After the frantic slamming, the footsteps gradually fade away.

speaker: Hella
content: Are there any other exits this way?

speaker: Nurse
content: No. An-Anne deliberately requested not to have any so as to isolate the Maniatic patients. Nothing has ever gone wrong. But what just happened?

speaker: Nurse
content: Those patients have been treated in the quarantine area. Wh-why did they suddenly...

speaker: Nurse
content: I'm so scared. Anne, Dr. Iron. I'm scared...
The face of the young nurse is pale while her body shivers.

speaker: Nurse
content: ...S-sorry. I know that. Stop... stop thinking...
You hold the girl's hand until her breathing gradually settles down.

speaker: Nurse
content: Ted? I don't know... but I saw a gangster I didn't know who went down after shooting the guard and opening the isolation door.

speaker: Hecate
content: How long ago was that? Has he left?

speaker: Nurse
content: I don't remember, but... he hasn't come out yet. I'm sure. Only monsters came out.

speaker: Hecate
content: Ted's still down there, Chief. We've still got time.
You are about to get up when the nurse grabs your sleeve.

speaker: Nurse
content: Did something happen down there? What happened to Anne? Many doctors went down to help. Will they be fine?

speaker: Nurse
content: And that girl isn't doing well. I'm worried.

speaker: Hecate
content: That Sinner is—

speaker: Hella
content: Don't say anything unnecessary.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't worry, you little SALVA girl. Your head nurse is a very strong Sinner. She will be fine facing those monsters. Besides...

speaker: Hella
content: This idiot-looking Chief is very reliable when troubles come. You can count on him to bring your colleagues and patients back safely.
female_content: This idiot-looking Chief is very reliable when troubles come. You can count on her to bring your colleagues and patients back safely.

content: She pats on her puffed skinny chest and nudges you.

speaker: Nurse
content: ...Okay! I'll take care of the patients up there until you guys get back. I won't let them get any more injuries.

speaker: Nurse
content: Please keep Anne, everyone at SALVA, and the patients safe.
You give her a nod. The Sinners pull open the isolation door. You step in and slam the door shut behind you.

On the other side of the door, a narrow corridor stretches downward to the deep darkness of the unknown. You can hear liquid constantly dripping down the walls like the sound of some non-human living being.

speaker: Hella
content: Urgh... I hate this place. It makes me sick.

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't touch the walls. It'll contaminate your mind.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, Hecate, help me up. Urgh, bastard. Don't dodge away! Blaargh!

speaker: Hecate
content: The contamination is from that Sinner. She has completely gone manic and become the center of Mania. It's right to seal off this place. Any ordinary people would go mad in this environment.

speaker: Choice
content: What about Ted?

speaker: Hecate
content: He isn't a Sinner and doesn't have the shackles. He will only end up the same.
But you don't think that man would do such a stupid thing that would screw himself. He must have some kind of backup plan.
Hecate comes to a halt. A few men appear in front of the stairs.

speaker: Patient
content: Ahh... Mmm... Help...
They wriggle their body closer. Under the dim warning lights, you recognize that several of them are those few Maniacs Iron managed to rescue in that operation.

speaker: Maniac
content: ...Help ...Help... me...
It's only one day ago that they were Ted's subordinates. Now they have turned into dark, sticky sludge, merging into the pollutant underground because of their boss's ambition.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Will we be fine staying in a place like this?

speaker: Hecate
content: That doctor said the Chief's shackles could suppress the Mania in our bodies.

speaker: Hella
content: ...So, what about the others? Forget about that assassin. Anne and our target don't have the shackles, right? Does this mean...

speaker: Hecate
content: Then use the shackles on them before they break down.

speaker: Hecate
content: We've reached the lowest level.
The long corridor has no turnoffs. Another isolation door is at the end. On the other side of the door is SALVA's last isolation ward.

speaker: Hella
content: It's huge and quiet here. Where did all of them go?

speaker: Hecate
content: There's still space behind the wall. This quarantined area is probably divided into many confined wards. They should be in one of them.
A simple desk piled with notebooks sits in the corner. Each notebook contains a detailed log of the Maniac patients in SALVA with a very gentle tone.
Only the oldest book records different things.

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...The college has started to represent the severity of Mania with Mania value. It's not precise enough, but... the head nurse said progress had been made in its research... Hopefully, this is true...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: Jesse's M value had reached 128. He started to lose his memory... It wasn't purely mental change. His muscles had started to change too... He broke my rib this afternoon...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...Jesse has gone missing ...More patients went into the isolation ward ...Their M value exceeded 200, and without exception, they all turned into Corruptors... even those in the same ward too...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...Our measures are far from sufficient in containing Mania... The patient's tissues, secretions, voices, scents, and even their presence, are all possible triggers in spreading Mania...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...The gangs are fighting again. The number of Maniacs has increased significantly. The quarantine area isn't big enough anymore... Ward 3 was hit by stray bullets and the whole quarantine area was destroyed ...And the patients also...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...The head nurse left... We are abandoned...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...Paige cried last night. She doesn't want to die... I stayed with her all night and my M value reached 47 when I woke up... I should have left, but... there's no one left to look after this place...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: I don't want to lose them.... this is terrible. What on earth is Mania... Why is this happening? Why does everyone have to suffer...
Several pages are ripped out.

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...I lost them. My M value has reached 2131... I didn't turn into a Corruptor, but I lost them... I said I would save her...

speaker: Anne's Record
content: ...If this is the power Mania gave me, then... I will save you all... Paige, wait for me...
The notes end abruptly at the painfully crooked handwriting.

speaker: Hella
content: Did she really find a way? But the Maniacs in SALVA are still...

speaker: Hecate
content: The stubbornness of Sinners is also a symptom of Mania.

speaker: Hella
content: ...No one told you to speak.
A browned page is shaken from the notebook, on which is an extremely blurry photo.
<color=#fb9259>N.F. 84.12.22 DisSea Explosion</color>. Confirmed number of Maniatics: <color=#fb9259>87,231</color>
Anne circled the time and the staggering number of victims on the photo.

You only learn later on that this was <color=#fb9259>the earliest officially traceable Mania incident</color>, which led to the formation of FAC. There is very limited information on this crisis left despite its successful suppression.
At the moment, only the image of that <color=#fb9259>huge crimson halo</color> is deeply imprinted in your mind.

speaker: Hecate
content: Someone is here.
A ray of light pierces through. A hidden door is opened in the distance. A SALVA doctor comes out and walks toward you.
On him is an overwhelming smell of blood. You can hear the loud, terrifying screams behind that door.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, fight.

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: Hehe... Haha... It's okay, I'm a doctor... I'm here... to save you...

speaker: Hecate
content: He's beyond recovery. Chief, fight!

speaker: Anne
content: In SALVA, both the doctors and patients in this hospital believe Mania will be cured one day.

For a moment, you regret opening the hidden door. It was originally locked from the inside. The SALVA doctors blocked the way out with their last sanity to cut off the madness from the rest of the place.
The patients who came for refuge and the doctors who came down to help—All of them left this world in the most tragic way.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, are... you okay?

speaker: Hecate
content: We found Ted. He's with Anne and that assassin. Get up, Chief. Don't forget your target.
The nightmare smashes a wall. In the midst of the cloud of dust, you hear a familiar and repulsive sound.

speaker: Ted
content: How persistent, Chief. But what a shame. You're too late.
Anne collapses on the contaminated floor in her blood-soaked white robe.

speaker: Ted
content: Why the long face, Chief? Still haven't found your target yet? I've also been looking for her for a long, long time.

speaker: Ted
content: Why don't you also come and ask the head nurse to hand her over? Then everyone will be happy.
Ted's gun is aimed at Anne. This scene brings back chilling memories. You remember how he tortured Brand, but this time, his bullets are on Anne's body.

speaker: Ted
content: Even with the healing power, you won't last much longer if you don't have enough strength. Hurry up and tell us.

speaker: Hella
content: She just needs to hold out until we finish you off, you bastard!
Hella holds up her weapon and strides forward to start fighting, but then sharp black crystal spikes suddenly stab out of the ground, forming a shield for Ted.
Once again, the gray-haired girl appears with a pale and emotionless face. What's oozing out from her wounds is no longer blood, but some dark crimson residue.

speaker: Hella
content: What?! Dumbass! Do you know how many people you've harmed? He doesn't even see you as a human! Why would you help such a jerk?!

speaker: Ted
content: Heheh... That's because she's my dog. She will listen to my orders even if she's crippled.

speaker: Ted
content: I'm going to look for the suspect. You stay here. Don't let anyone get in my way.

speaker: Ted
content: Kill them all.
Ted turns and leaves. After receiving her final order, the young girl remains silent for a while before she straightens up.
The pollutant on the floor starts to wriggle and squirm up the corpses, forming one after another filthy monster.

speaker: Hecate
content: We must deal with her before we can catch up with Ted.
On the ground, Anne looks at you painfully. She speaks in a soft voice, but you understand what she wants to say:

speaker: Anne
content: Stop that kid, please...

speaker: Anne
content: Cough... I'm fine. Thank you...

speaker: Anne
content: Where's the kid? How is she?

The gray-haired girl is still standing on the path where Ted left, stopping you. Her body is disintegrating, with every cell being extracted, turning into more dense contamination. She shows no intention of giving way.

speaker: Hella
content: She's really determined to stop us. Does she want to fight us herself next?

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, don't hesitate. You have a mission to accomplish. You can't let Ted get there first.

speaker: Anne
content: Wait...
Anne barely manages to hold herself up. The bloodstain on her nurse uniform is spreading quickly.

speaker: Anne
content: I'll fight with you guys. Let me stop that kid.
She picks up a syringe with her shivering hand—the color of the serum has changed. She injects a full tube of the orange liquid into herself then stands up.

speaker: Hecate
content: Is that a booster? She used her ability to change the serum's attributes.

speaker: Hella
content: Hold on! Your injury... You're pushing yourself too hard! It'll kill you!

speaker: Anne
content: Are you worrying about me? Thanks, I'm fine.

speaker: Anne
content: She is the one who's really suffering.

speaker: Anne
content: That kid's body has reached its limit. If she keeps fighting like this, she will soon be consumed by Mania.

speaker: Hecate
content: Nothing will work. She has been domesticated and given up thinking. She only acts on Ted's orders.

speaker: Anne
content: She doesn't want to become a monster. She just... wants to go back.

speaker: Anne
content: I promised to save her.
The gray-haired Sinner collapses and has no strength left to manipulate the black substances, while the filth gradually corrodes her body.

speaker: Hecate
content:
Don't do anything unnecessary, Chief.
The shackles can't suppress her Mania now and will only put you in danger.
You look at the girl at her last breath. Even until now, she is still trying to carry out that "order" but to no avail.

speaker: Choice
options: I have no sympathy for you.

content: All she wants is not to turn into a monster, but Ted uses her and forces such heavy guilt on her. And she still can't escape being controlled even now.
The sad thing is that even though she gave up herself to become a killing machine, she still faces the same fate.

speaker: Options
content: Turn back. Don't repeat the same mistake.
options: Turn back. Don't repeat the same mistake.

speaker: Chief
content: That man exploits everything you have by giving you false hope. He never planned to let you live, even from the moment he started to control you.
She shudders and her eyes sink.
Even if she was coerced, she is responsible for countless tragedies yet unwilling to repent. Her sins are too heavy to be forgiven.
The sarcastic thing is that even though she gave up herself to become a killing machine, she still faces the same fate.

speaker: Options
options: This is what happens when you betray.

speaker: Chief
content: You became his lapdog and betrayed the people who really wanted to save you. You destroyed your hope with your own hands.
She pauses, stares fixedly into your eyes, and says nothing.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, time to go. We need to find Suspect R before Ted does.

speaker: Anne
content: Sorry. I'll stay with this kid. She is my patient, so it's the nurse's job to look after her.

speaker: Anne
content: ...Go, Chief. The man you're looking for is right ahead, in—
Bang, bang—!
Gunshots sound in the dark. Two bullets hit Anne, who tumbles down onto the ground.
Just when you try to hold her, a third shot shatters the gas tank in the cabinet. Unknown smoke quickly jets out and fills the room.

speaker: Hecate
content: Cover your nose and mouth!
You did your best, but most of your strength is still drained. You fall to your knees. Hella and Hecate panic and lose the strength to move.
A cold muzzle pokes out from the passageway ahead, then Ted steps out with a gloomy and twisted look.

speaker: Ted
content: ...I found the secret room, but there was no one in it.

speaker: Ted
content: Head nurse... where did your patient go?

speaker: Anne
content: Heh... Is that so? She escaped...? Great. Now I don't have to worry...

speaker: Ted
content: Are you ***ing with me?!!!
The furious bullets are fired at Anne in quick succession. Because of his agitation, the shots are not fatal but put Anne in worse agony.

speaker: Ted
content: Bastard, where's the inheritance?! Where's that woman?!! I can't go back empty-handed after all this effort! Tell me!! What aren't you saying?!

speaker: Ted
content: Filthy monster! ***! Stinky ***... I'll kill you here and leave a hundred holes on you, then throw you in front of your *** and make her tell me!

speaker: Choice
content: Stop!!
Bang, bang, bang—!!
Ted fires his gun frenetically, but none of the bullets hit Anne.
Several black spikes suddenly burst out from the ground, bouncing off all the bullets. In a moment of silence, you can hear the sound of crystals shattering behind you.
The gray-haired girl's arm is raised, but this time, it is aimed at her "master".

speaker: Ted
content: You... dare to disobey me?
Ted shoots her in the calf. The girl staggers a few steps and keeps herself from falling by leaning on the spikes. She keeps her head down and says nothing.

speaker: Ted
content: A piece of trash, did you act without even thinking? If you rebel again, I'm gonna shoot you.

speaker: Ted
content: Come here! Do what you are supposed to do!
This time, she doesn't follow the orders and slowly looks up at Anne, speaking for the first time.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: You said you would save me... Head nurse... Now, I want to hear the truth...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Can... I still be saved?

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: If there is hope, even if I have to betray you and side with that man... I will do so to live on... they are still... waiting for me...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: But if there isn't, I...
Her voice grows weaker. Debris keeps falling from her body, and the cracks on her body begin to widen.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Tell me the truth... please...
Anne chokes up. The young girl's pleading question has rendered her speechless. You can already tell the answer from her reaction.
The girl is beyond hope. Anne can't bring herself to say it, and you decide to—

speaker: Chief
content: You can. With Anne and Iron here... They can definitely save you.

speaker: Chief
content: You need to hold on. Stop going down the wrong track. Stop being used by that man.
She ignores your answer and continues to stare at Anne, waiting for her answer.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: I don't want well-meaning lies! I don't need it... Please tell me the truth.

speaker: Ted
content: Stop playing tricks! Your life is mine, dead or alive. You must obey my orders! Kill them!
Ted fires again, but the bullets are bounced off with the black windblade. She is stronger, but the backlash on her is also evidently worse.

speaker: Anne
content: No. Stop using power. You are...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: ...Then tell me, Anne... Can I still be saved?

speaker: Anne
content: This kid is no exception... A person who has lost their hope simply can't endure torture like this, yet she perseveres until now.
She needs hope, but where is hope? Is there really a way to save her?

speaker: Iron
content: Once a person is infested by Mania, the mutation will only ever worsen and eventually turn them into Corruptors. But you are an exception.
Smash—! The crystals shatter. You reach out and crush the hard contaminated spike in your hand, which is glowing with crimson beams.

speaker: Chief
content: Come, Sinner. Accept my shackles. I'll suppress your Mania.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, don't.
You know how dangerous this is, but at this point, your determination drives your action. You turn your gaze at the collapsing young girl.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: ...What do you want to do?

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Save me? You can't even protect yourself without Sinners.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Hah, you're lying... The shackles are to control Sinners...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: You are just like him... You covet our power and force us to fight, and are willing to use any means.

speaker: Chief
content: I need help from you guys, but I've never needed slaves.

speaker: Chief
content: I am the one who binds you. I won't make you do evil again or let you become a monster.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: ...You can't guarantee that... Even you can't take it. You're lying!

speaker: Chief
content: Anne hasn't given up. Iron is still here, and so am I. You are not alone in this. As long as someone is reaching for hope, then you have hope too.

speaker: Chief
content: Come, Sinner. You are no one's slave, nor are you a prisoner of Mania.

speaker: Chief
content: You still have somewhere you want to go back to, right?
She looks at you like she's struggling, but her hard shell has begun to disintegrate. Her stiff mask slowly cracks and reveals a vulnerable look.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: ...Is it not too late? Can... I still turn back now...?
You lift your hand being burnt by the shackles and reach out to her. The red beams illuminate the darkness, giving her soulless eyes the first light.
Her fractured body seems to suddenly regain strength. The dark smoke is cleared away. She approaches you, almost trotting and holding out her hand—
Is she... Smiling?
That smile is soon swallowed up in the raging contamination. Ted pushes the button and rips the light in the young girl's eyes apart.

speaker: Anne
content: No—!!

speaker: Ted
content: You are mine! Dead or alive!! You won't escape!

speaker: Chief
content: It's too late. Even if he doesn't do anything, your Mania is already beyond cure. Everyone in SALVA knows it, including you. It's time to accept the reality.

speaker: Anne
content: Chief, no! You can't tell!

speaker: Chief
content:
How much you have given up and how much evil you have done for that false hope?
Don't you want to be human? Then turn back.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: ...Is that so...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Even if I go back now... I'll only give them trouble, right?
Bang, bang—

speaker: Ted
content: What are you waiting for? Kill them! I am the one who has kept you alive! Your life is mine! If you disobey me, you'll... Aaahhhh!
A black windblade strikes Ted and knocks his gun away, then it turns into a black sludge pinning him against the wall.

speaker: Ted
content: Ah... Ah... H-how dare you...

speaker: Ted
content: I placed a safety trigger! If you hurt me, that capsule will...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: The capsule will then be activated and turn me into a monster... I know. I know everything, but none of it matters now...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Since the day you bought me, you've hated me, chained me, locked me in a cage, and beat me. Every one of your men could abuse me how they wanted.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: You tortured me by any means possible and didn't even allow me to speak.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: I know, Ted, that it's because you're <color=#fb9259>terrified</color> of me.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Sinners have ruined your ambition. You hate us and are scared of us, yet you're jealous and covet our power. That's why you humiliate me, control me, and make me your slave.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: What a joke. You... are so weak.

speaker: Ted
content: Shut up! Don't look at me like that! Don't look down on me! You are nothing but a dog! A monster! I am the master! I'll kill you right now! I'll kill you!

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: I have no master.
The black sludge tightens and spreads down from the neck along the skin. The man struggles as he wails in horror.

speaker: Hella
content: ...She's so strong. So this is how strong her power is?

speaker: Hecate
content: But this will only give her a worse backlash of Mania.

speaker: Ted
content: No! Stop!! Stay away from me!!
Crash—
There is the crumbling sound of the mechanical parts on Ted's body, then sludge dissolves. He collapses to the ground, groping his body in panic.

speaker: Ted
content: ...The transmitter ...broke?

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: I'm not interested... in you.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: ...I'm free...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content:
...What ...should I do next...
How much... time do I have left...
As if something that has been supporting her suddenly left, the girl's skin begins to crack and turns into a dark crimson residue.

speaker: Anne
content: This kid is no exception... A person who has lost their hope simply can't endure torture like this, yet she perseveres until now.

speaker: Anne
content: No... I'll save you, and so will Iron. There's still hope. You can come back. Don't give up...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: ...Just tell me the truth ...It's okay ... There's no going back anyway...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: At least I'm able to reclaim some ...something that belongs to me...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Thank you, Anne... You are the only person... who ever gave me hope...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Sorry...
The dark smoke rages as it emits from her body and corrodes her. She can no longer lift up her eyes, but she remains facing you, trying to hold on.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: This body is about to be seized... Before that, the Chief of Minos...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: I want... you to end my life...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content:
Not as a slave to anyone, nor a crazy monster... But as a Sinner... I'll pay for my sins...
I... accept your judgment...

speaker: Chief
content: Tell me your name, Sinner. I will judge your sin, and I won't forget you.
She smiles.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: I... forgot...
The contamination rages on like a hurricane. Her words shatter along with her body, and you fail to catch her last words.

speaker: Deranged Sinner
content: Aaahhh—!!
"Her" wail sounds like a heart-wrenching cry. She continues to struggle, while the gigantic, twisted filth wrapped around her continues to squirm, but her lower body has already begun to fracture.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is the end for Sinners.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Doesn't she want to live on? She clearly still has many wishes.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's too late. Chief, end it all. Dragging it out will only be more painful.

speaker: Deranged Sinner
content: No! Go back, I want to go back!!

speaker: Hecate
content: She's about to explode, Chief. Back off!!!
She pulls you back. At the same time, a white figure rushes past you into the raging contamination.

speaker: Hella
content: Anne?!!
Boom—!!

speaker: Anne
content: ...Made it...

speaker: Anne
content: Great... I'm here... You're alive. See? The drug is working...

speaker: Anne
content: ...You're safe now... I'll save you...
The explosion tore through Anne's uniform. She is severely injured, yet she isn't treating herself. All the serum is used on the Sinner in her arms, whose body is frozen.
But it's only the pale, fractured remains. As if it is burnt to ashes, the body below the chest has shattered to pieces.

speaker: Hecate
content: Let her go, the head nurse. The tissues of the Corruptors will cause massive contamination. Your mental state is already unstable.

speaker: Anne
content: ...She is not a Corruptor. She is my patient.

speaker: Hecate
content: She's dead.

speaker: Anne
content: She'll come back. I can hear her. She says she doesn't want to die... I can hear them...

speaker: Anne
content: ...I promised to save you...

She carefully picks up the girl and slowly stands up. The cracked wall of the secret room reveals the deep space behind, where dozens of Corruptors are dunk in experimental containers, looking at you through the frosty glass.

speaker: Hella
content: Is this...?!

speaker: Hecate
content:
Collecting Corruptors and pollutants, and conducting forbidden research...
Chief, this is an A-class violation.

speaker: Ted
content: Ha—Hahahaha!! I told you! SALVA is collecting monsters. They're crazy! Heresy!

speaker: Ted
content: Accept it! There's no cure for Mania. The dead can never come back to life! You've already gone crazy, and you'll become like her sooner or later!

speaker: Ted
content: Let all Sinners go to hell!!

speaker: Anne
content: ...I will. For the unfulfilled promise and for seeing those I failed to save...
She walks toward the blue, ghostly death space. She needs to stop. She must be stopped!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, don't go there. That place and those things are dangerous.

speaker: Anne
content: ...Chief, leave and continue your mission, will you?

speaker: Anne
content: This Mania isn't over yet. Go find the person you're looking for and stop more tragedies. We all have our duty.

speaker: Anne
content: ...I don't want to fight you here.
Holding broken remains of Corruptors, she disappears among the eerie figures behind the wall. The door slowly closes.

speaker: Hecate
content: Something is here... It's a monster born out of contamination.

speaker: Ted
content: Haha... Hahaha! How timely. It's time for me to go... I still have lots to do...

speaker: Ted
content: I'll let you all die here with these monsters. You deserve it. You're monsters too! Go to hell, all of you! I'm the only one who can survive!
He flees away through the horde of monsters.

speaker: Hella
content: Those monsters didn't attack him... He's holding something in his hand!
This villain, this root of all evil. He plots for his ambitions, covets power, uses Sinners, and abuses others.
He is not a Sinner, yet he is more repulsive than any criminal.

speaker: Choice
options: Hecate, can you bring judgment on him?

speaker: Hecate
content: If that's your order.

speaker: Ted
content: Huff, puff... The exit is right ahead. I've made it out... With so many monsters, they won't be able to catch up...

speaker: Ted
content: Thanks to <color=#fb9259>this</color>... Monsters and Corruptors won't attack me... Haha... but darn it! I still can't find the suspect. What am I gonna say to them?

speaker: Ted
content: They'll kill me... <color=#fb9259>They</color>'ll definitely kill me. It's all because of that bitch. Why didn't she listen to my orders? How dare she betray me... I should've killed that dog earlier!

speaker: Ted
content: I must find that Sinner... Or will I be fine if I kill the people in SALVA? What if I show them the corpse of the Chief?

speaker: Ted
content: Yes! That will work! They hate MBCC. They won't kill me...

speaker: Ted
content:
I'll get out of here first and find a bunch of thugs tonight. I still have the Mania Crystal. I can still fight...
I've made it out!!!

speaker: Iron
content: Hello again, Ted.

speaker: Ted
content: ...How did you get here? How are you still alive?

speaker: Iron
content: The artificial eye I gave you, does it help?

speaker: Ted
content: Stop your crap... It's all thanks to you that I won't be able to touch crystals for the rest of my life.

speaker: Iron
content: But that won't cure you, right?

speaker: Iron
content: You stirred up your men and enslaved Sinners. Now you're destroying my hospital for that so-called inheritance... I finally get it now. You'll never give up on Mania.

speaker: Ted
content: ...You want to kill me?

speaker: Ted
content: You're a doctor, have you ever killed anyone? Stop pretending. Do you actually dare?

speaker: Iron
content: ...Doctors don't kill. I only heal.

speaker: Hella
content: Ted!! Show yourself!!!

speaker: Iron
content: You're too slow...

speaker: Hella
content: What's going on?!
She frees her grip on Ted's collar. The man quietly kneels in front of the doctor with a gentle smile on his face.

Iron stands right in the center of the battlefield. But this battlefield has no casualties. All her enemies around her are on their knees without any pain and resentment on their faces. They are all alive yet as good as dead.

speaker: Iron
content: Emergency neuromodulation completed. Violent impulses and mobility completely removed. Postoperative treatment completed.

speaker: Iron
content: Operation successful. Ted, you're cured.

speaker: Ted
content: Those in SALVA are collecting corpses of the Corruptors and carrying out shady experiments in the hospital basement to gain the power of the Mania.

speaker: Ted
content: <color=#fb9259>The medical director, Iron</color>, is crazy about developing various forbidden surgeries to distort the minds of the Syndicans with Mania to brainwash them.
...The rumors are true.

speaker: Iron

speaker: Iron
content: You're right. It's not Ted, but <color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color> who's ill.

speaker: Iron

speaker: Chief

speaker: Iron

options: I'll let her off this time.

speaker: Chief

speaker: Hella

options: Now is not the time for tantrums

speaker: Hella
content: Humph... humph! Don't talk to me! I'm mad!
She slaps away your hand indignantly, gets up on her own, pats off the dust on her butt, then opens the car door with a pout.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Humph! Help me up, idiot!
She grabs your hand and gets up, rubs the dust on you, then opens the car door while mumbling.

speaker: Hecate
content: That Sinner hasn't caught up with us, and I don't hear any sound from the motorbike.

speaker: Hecate
content: That's weird... She was already very close to us, even if she's been slowed down by the gangsters, she should have caught up with us now, given how strong she is.

speaker: Hella

Hecate puts herself before you. Over her shoulder, you see a horrifying figure at the corner of the alley that looks like a mad beast.

speaker: Sinner with huge sword
content: Shackles... Those are the shackles...

content: Run!

A chilling vroom of engines bursts out from the corner of the alley. A dozen of motorbikes and pickup trucks of different sizes shoot out from there. It's the Legion.

speaker: Hecate

speaker: Hella
content: Ahaha, what an honor to have warranted this many guys from the Legion to welcome us—wait, they're drawing their weapons!

speaker: Hecate
content: Leave it to me from here.

speaker: Hella
content: Are you gonna screw them up? Count me in!

The vehicles have finally stopped. In a daze, you see a huge mob from the Legion arriving.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, hang in there.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...We're surrounded.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...There are only the two of us left.

content: There are too many of them. Chief, stay behind me.

content: Wanna join the Legion? Our boss will like you. You'll have much more freedom than being a running dog for the Bureau.

speaker: Hecate

content: Tsk. Then work hard on your own.

speaker: Hella

options: Are you injured? Can you come over here?

content:
Worry about yourself.
... I'll crawl over to join you guys soon.

speaker: Hella

speaker: Sinner with huge sword

speaker: Hella
content: Don't make me say it again, get away from him!

content: There will be more of them coming, we must get out of here soon.

speaker: Driver
content: Yo. The car I've snatched this time ain't too bad, wanna get in?

speaker: Hella
content: You're... still alive?

speaker: Hella
content: Humph. Way to go.

speaker: Driver
content: As civil servants, I'm sure you've got enough money for the payment. Let's go.
The car shoots off along the desert highway. You turn back to find the pursuer you've left behind and see the woman chasing you straightening up slowly.
Her helmet is split into two halves. Half of it falls off. Her loose white hair is flying amid the flames, and those bloodthirsty red eyes are gazing in the direction you're going.
You hear Hella exclaim softly, her voice filled with shock.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Ninety-nine?
Hella doesn't answer, only stares at the woman in a daze. You don't press further. A different kind of extremely uneasy premonition is clutching your heart now.
You have properly shaken off the pursuer behind you and are heading into the dark desert along the highway, but that doesn't mean you're safe from danger now.

speaker: Hecate
content: Why aren't they coming after us... They've been chasing us for the whole night, why stop now?

The car is belting down the road in the dark, the headlights shining on a small patch of flying sand. You have a feeling that this is not an escape... More like you're constantly approaching something fearsome lurking ahead of you.
You suddenly understand the true meaning of this premonition.
But it's already too late.
A figure suddenly barges into the headlights' range. It's impossible to brake at this distance. You rush into her at high speed, but she doesn't seem to want to dodge at all.
She faces the collision head-on. For a second, you even think... she's smiling.

speaker: Driver
content: No way...
It's her!

At the moment of contact, the woman swings her fist hard at the car's front. Under the intense impact, both the car and you get thrown up in the air. Your vision blackens and you lose consciousness...
...Awake?
This is a closed space, like the inside of a container. The shaking beneath your feet signifies you're moving—this is probably the Legion's truck.
A small bump like that put you to sleep for three hours. Looks like the Bureau didn't give you enough training.

options: This is a rather violent invitation.

content: Haha, haven't you memorized the MBCC's most wanted list, Chief?
You call them your teammates? Doesn't the MBCC always treat Sinners as <color=#fb9259>criminals</color>?
Doesn't suit your title? The new chief of the MBCC?
She knows who you are! You startle and finally make out the face of the dark figure before you.

I'm <color=#fb9259>Zoya</color>, the Legion's commander.
In your terms, I'm the <color=#fb9259>boss</color> of a violent Syndicate gang.

speaker: Zoya
content: The Sinner you're hunting down is one of <color=#fb9259>my guys</color>.

speaker: Zoya
content: Hmm... You're quite calm.

content: She smiles, but there's no warmth in her eyes.

content: First of all, end your chase.

speaker: Zoya
content: No matter from whom and why you've accepted this mission, it's coming to an end.

speaker: Zoya
content: If you can't end it, I will.
She moves her hand to the chair's armrest and squeezes it, crushing the corner of the strong and firm metal piece like plaster, clearly expressing the message, "I'll end you."
Your head throbs. Sitting before you is the head of the most notorious gang in the entire Syndicate, a Sinner so strong that even Ted fears. Destruction and sabotage are her instincts.
You calm yourself. Staring into her eyes, you ask her:

speaker: Zoya
content: <color=#fb9259>You</color>.

speaker: Zoya
content: The Mania has been spreading in Syndicate for so long and the authorities have done nothing. This time around, they're going so far as to violate the Management Regulations they've signed on just to intervene...

speaker: Zoya
content: And they've sent you on such an important mission. A new Chief whose background is entirely unknown.

speaker: Zoya
content: You've led several Sinners to wreck both Ted and SALVA within a day, and even survived that kind of contamination...
She stands up and stamps on the cold chair with one foot.
She leans over and gazes at you with contemptuous eyes, the shadow she casts blocking your sight.

speaker: Zoya
content: I'm curious what kind of lapdog the authorities have gotten for themselves this time, and how they plan to use you.

options: I'm not really special. I rely on Sinners.
You should ask them, not me

content: Calm down. You stare into her eyes. You see no way out of here, you must pick a way to fight.

speaker: Hecate
content: Your shackles are an absolute restraint to Sinners, which means you are their worst enemy.
This woman is a Sinner. Even if she's as strong as a monster, she'll still submit to the shackles. Face her, get closer, and even closer...
This is the best and the final chance. You can touch her if you reach out your hand now.

speaker: Zoya
content: What do you want to do to me? Use your "<color=#fb9259>shackles</color>"?

speaker: Zoya
content: Come on, try me. Let's see if you're fast enough to subdue me before I break off your arm.
This is a real threat. You can't risk it and raise your hand, but you can't back down like this either. The two of you are locked in a stalemate, neither is taking action.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...You're still resisting even now. You seem very confident in your own power.

speaker: Zoya
content: But it's time to face the truth. You're in my territory now. If I run electricity through this chair, you'll soon breathe your last breath.

speaker: Zoya
content: I know you have the ability to control Sinners. Tell me about its effects, how to activate it, how to remove it, and the side effects.

speaker: Zoya
content: I need to know everything about the shackles.
This is her true purpose.

options: I'm sorry, but I don't know everything
If I refuse to talk, are you gonna kill me?

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Stop wasting my time.

speaker: Ringtone
content: Bzzzz...

speaker: Telephone
content: Commander, we've got some answers here.

speaker: Telephone
content: It's a special case. The MBCC probably hasn't completely figured out how the shackles work either.

speaker: Telephone
content: Currently, they mainly control Sinners with these three features of the Shackles: <color=#fb9259>combat ability enhancement</color>, <color=#fb9259>weak sense tracking</color>, and the <color=#fb9259>Forbidden Force</color>.

speaker: Telephone
content: Once the shackles are established, the enabler can sense the shackled Sinner's location and absolutely forbid specific behaviors in the Sinner with clearly worded orders.

speaker: Telephone
content: The shackles must be established through direct physical contact. The removal condition is the death of either the enabler or the shackled Sinner.
Zoya is observing your expression as she's listening, as if trying to confirm what she's hearing.

speaker: Zoya
content: That's why those geezers picked him... He surely makes a good slave.
female_content: That's why those geezers picked her... She surely makes a good slave.

speaker: Telephone
content: Also, that other thing you're concerned about, it's confirmed too.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Go on.

speaker: Telephone
content: Mania intensification will stop completely in a shackled Sinner. Not even contact with contamination will result in corruption.

speaker: Telephone
content: This man can suppress Mania.
female_content: This woman can suppress Mania.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Wrap up the interrogation, Earl. Once we arrive, bring the two Sinners to me.
She straightens up. There seems to be no more need to ask you anything.

options: Did Iron from SALVA tell you that?

speaker: Zoya
content: Ha... She's not gonna talk. She despises me more than lapdogs like you.

speaker: Zoya
content: It's a <color=#fb9259>separate interrogation</color>, the authorities' expertise. The Legion's got other vehicles. My subordinates are interrogating the others there. He did a good job.

options: What did you do to them?!
What exactly do you want from me?

speaker: Zoya
content: Hmm... I see, this is your first reaction.

speaker: Zoya
content: If you've got such little trust in your subordinates, don't expect loyalty from them.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Hmm, that's rather unexpected. Didn't think you'd care so much about them.

speaker: Zoya
content: Relax, you'll get to see them soon.

speaker: Zoya
content: I've told you already, I need your help.
The truck has stopped in the desert on the outskirts of the city. You're taken out from the container and forced to walk on the white sand to a cliff, under which lies a huge crypt.
And from somewhere deeper than the crypt, waves of something even more viscous and evil are crashing.

options: Where are we? What's down there?

speaker: Zoya
content: Oh? You can feel it? I knew I was right to bring you here.

speaker: Zoya
content: My subordinates have come here after leaving SALVA. This is where the inheritance lies.
You estimate that the bottom of the pit is around thirty to forty meters deep. Containers and cranes are scattered down below, making the place look like a secret warehouse or a bizarre maze.
The lightless night and slowly flowing sand provide excellent cover, yet the flickering red light at the bottom of the pit makes the crypt look deep and dangerous.

speaker: Zoya
content: Are you sure it's here?

speaker: Tall and Thin Man
content: Positive. This place is very easily concealed. That's why it took us so long to find the clues.
A lanky man stands behind Zoya. His left leg is making some mechanical operation sound. It's a prosthetic.

speaker: Tall and Thin Man
content: The ambushed party down there is not of a small scale. All the gangsters still alive have probably teamed up and are preparing for the final battle.

speaker: Zoya
content: Just some wounded sidekicks, they're not gonna change anything.

speaker: Tall and Thin Man
content: You should worry about the <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> itself.

speaker: Tall and Thin Man
content: If we're right, where it lies is also the center of the Mania.

speaker: Zoya
content: Quit stressing out, Earl. Look at you, you've got so much white hair you can be the dad of the entire Legion.

speaker: Zoya
content: Don't worry about the contamination. I've taken precautions.
You're dragged before Zoya.

speaker: Ted
content: It's this inheritance that can control Mania and set off this crisis.

speaker: Ted
content: Even the Legion wants it.
The <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color>, the unknown waves of energy crashing in the depths of the earth. It gives you an entirely different sensation than SALVA's underground facility.
All these people chasing after this evil power—Ted, the gangsters, and the commander in front of you—all seem like villains to you.

options: Stop it, you can't tolerate the contamination

speaker: Zoya
content: I know. That's why you're still alive.

options: You want us to go down for you?
I want no part in your gang feuds.

content: She's going to hide in a safe place and let you and the Sinners take the risk —You feel a hint of despise for the fearsome commander for the first time.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Haha, that's the authorities' style. That's not the way the Legion does things.
You resent corrupt, violent cycles like this, and you hate to become their tool.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Haha, I know you're not willing. Even if this place turns into hell, the authorities will never give a damn.
She suddenly grabs your left hand, slamming you onto the truck behind.
As you begin to struggle, your forehead takes a heavy blow, shaking your entire skull. Next thing you know, she presses her forehead to yours, nailing you firmly onto the metal surface.
At that moment, you clearly recognize the burning violence and passion in her eyes. But somewhere deeper, there's an icy flame, a rage that's been frozen to the core for a long time.

speaker: Zoya
content: We're not like you, the Legion never runs away from fights.

speaker: Zoya
content: I will crush every enemy with my own hands, and I will do that by whatever means I can find, including you.

speaker: Zoya
content: Come on, Chief, use your shackles on me.

speaker: Zoya
content: You can suppress contamination, can't you? Then serve me.

speaker: Zoya
content: Suppress my power with your shackles. Otherwise, your wrist is going to get crumbled.
