content: Put me down... Put me down!

speaker: Horo
content: I'm a Legion warrior, not a good-for-nothing! There is something fishy about this inheritance. Let me fight!
As she yelps, Horo hits you repeatedly on the back with her limp fists. She has to stop after a short while to catch her breath before she can start again. Apparently, she is too weak to stand.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't waste your energy. Your only job is to point us the right direction. If your wounds reopen, you'll have to stay a good-for-nothing for another month.

speaker: Hella
content: God, are Legion people all muscle and no brains? The lot of you are just like your boss, a bunch of brainless brutes.

speaker: Horo
content: Don't you dare bad-mouth my commander!
Anger rises inside her, and she starts strangling you again, strength returning to her hands all of a sudden.

speaker: Horo
content: Uh... sorry. I respect my commander, so I can't stand people saying anything bad...
The moment you can drop this act, you're gonna put the shackles on her. She's really doing your head in.

speaker: Hella
content: But she's really... really scary. I guess you can fill up the entire Syndicate with people cursing her behind her back. Don't you think so, ${PlayerName}?
Ouch... Ouch... Ouch... You're seeing stars now.

speaker: Horo
content:
Sorry, I did it again.
You little devil, I'll deal with you as soon as I'm back on my feet.

speaker: Hella
content: Hahaha! We've got a brainless fangirl here. Hahaha! Ouch...
Hecate whacks Hella on the head, who finally gives it a rest.

speaker: Horo
content: The Legion's enemies are numerous. You shouldn't pay any attention to any of those rumors. You've met my boss, you know what she's like.

Another bang comes from the direction of the central elevator. The whole crypt is shaking violently, with rocks and gravel raining down. It reminds you of that woman and her steely look with murderous malice.

speaker: Horo
content: What's the matter? You look terrible.

options: Truth be told, I don't know what she's like.

speaker: Horo
content: Huh! That's a secret of the Legion. I can't just give it away.

speaker: Horo
content: Ha... It's good enough that only those in the Legion know my boss is a decent person.

speaker: Horo
content: Anyway, considering you'll join us sooner or later, I'm gonna give you a taste of what she's like.

speaker: Horo
content: My boss was not among the first to join the Legion. It was not called that name before she joined, and I was not a Sinner.

speaker: Horo
content: We were just a mercenary fleet on the outskirts, away from the urban area, hiding in the desert and surviving on commissions. Because the fleet was afraid of getting involved in battles.

speaker: Horo
content: Whenever we crossed paths with gangsters when they were plundering and looting, we kept our mouths shut and took a detour. When they came for us, all we could do was run away, make compromises, or beg for mercy.

speaker: Horo
content: I was furious and wanted to take them on. But Earl stopped me at every turn. He said battles required strength, which we didn't have.

speaker: Horo
content: So I was not happy when he took Boss Zoya on board, saying that we were to reform the fleet and build up our strength to fight back against the gang.

speaker: Horo
content: That just meant I was not good enough, and I didn't deserve to be on the battlefield!
It appears that she was really infuriated.

speaker: Horo
content: I was so pissed off, I went out to pick fights with gangsters, I came back to challenge her to a duel, all to prove that I was strong, I had what it took, that I could fight... Defeating her would be proof enough.

speaker: Horo
content: It went on for a while, and then I got hit in the arm by a bullet, a Mania bullet. The contamination was spreading so fast that I would have to have my arm amputated. Before the amputation, I challenged her to a duel again.

speaker: Horo
content: I thought that would be my last fight.

speaker: Horo
content: My boss stopped Earl when he tried to intervene, and accepted my challenge. She took it seriously, and she knocked me down without mercy.

speaker: Horo
content: She encouraged me to fight on. A lot of nonsense is happening in this world, but there's one thing that's certain: As long as you still want to shout and hold your head high, you have the right to fight.

speaker: Horo
content: My battle was not over. She was waiting for me to get back on my feet.

options: And you did get back on your feet.

speaker: Horo
content: Yes, I did. I wasn't beaten by the contamination. I became a Sinner. The injury in my arm became my battle mark, and she my beacon.

options: ...I understand you. But do you understand her?

content: What is she thinking? What is she fighting for? Her dogged determination to fight till the very end... is there some explanation for it other than her desire for destruction?

speaker: Horo
content: ...I don't know. There are many things... that my commander won't tell me about.

speaker: Horo
content: But that's not important.

speaker: Horo
content: It's she who showed me that I'm worthy of battlefields. She is my beacon, and for that reason, I'll follow her until the day I die.

speaker: Horo
content: For her, I would do anything.

options: ...But you're putting yourself in great danger.

speaker: Horo
content: Of course you do!

speaker: Horo
content: Our commander is fabulous and cool, isn't she? Whoever lays eyes on her is bound to succumb to her charms.
She reaches over your shoulder and takes your hand, giving it a few shakes with a flourish. A big smile brightens her face.
You've seen the dark side of the Syndicate. For those who've long been trapped in that darkness, a raging fire like Zoya must have proven even more irresistible.
But what is being fed to the fire so that its light can chase that darkness away? What will the fire consume along the way?

speaker: Horo
content: Anyway, I've been having this feeling, and I'm now certain what it is all about... You're exactly the type of person that my boss most appreciates.

speaker: Horo
content: You're weak, but you have the one quality she really admires.

speaker: Horo
content: Oh... You're the envy of me! You're so weak, but... Come back with me to the Legion when the battle is over... my boss will be delighted to see you!
She meant it. But at this very moment, what expression should you put on?

speaker: Chief
content: "I would do anything"?

speaker: Chief
content: You almost lost your life. What if one day one of her battles leads to the destruction of your soul?

speaker: Horo
content: What are you talking about? Our goal has never changed, and it has always been a just cause!
The look in her eyes at this moment is pure and determined, which may make it all the more worrying.
Stubbornly following a stubborn person... Where will this path lead her?

speaker: Horo
content: You have something against my boss, don't you?

speaker: Horo
content: It doesn't matter. People like her are a rare breed. There are plenty of people who don't see eye to eye with her.

speaker: Horo
content: I'm just saying. It's a bit of a shame. You're totally the type of person that my boss would appreciate.

speaker: Horo
content: You're much weaker than me, but there's something about you that she likes... a lot.

speaker: Horo
content: She would be dying to get you on board.
She meant it. But all you can do is to remain silent.
Hehe... Pity that you won't live to see the day...

speaker: Horo
content: Who's there?!
Before you have time to turn your heads, a stink grenade explodes behind you. From the pall of contamination-rich dust emerges several gangsters.

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: Hehe... Lackeys of the Legion, thanks for leading the way...

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: You can die now...

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: Hahaha... That's no use! Here comes my almighty firepower... Mania bullets!

speaker: Horo
content: Mmph! Get down!
Horo brings you down onto the ground, but she is hit by a stray bullet on the shoulder and falls over. The wound is being contaminated rapidly, and the dark mark on her right arm starts burning.

speaker: Hella
content: The gun is embedded with Mania Crystals. The bullet was full of contamination!

speaker: Hecate
content: Not only that. She is overreacting; the contamination is not supposed to spread so fast... Could it be...
Bang... The entire ground is vibrating, like an enormous throbbing heart. At the center of the vibration is none other than the stone altar, from whose patterns sludge is oozing.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... It's that sensation again, that sickening sensation...

speaker: Hecate
content: The inheritance is being activated, and the Mania in its vicinity is being reinforced, so is the contamination inflicted by those weapons.

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: Exactly, that's how it is, that's how things stand... The inheritance is on our side, we are stronger now...

options: You're asking for trouble. You're being corrupted by Mania.

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: No, No, No... I'm very clear-headed, very much indeed...

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: They said as long as we can get rid of you, as long as we are able to protect the inheritance, they will make us more weapons, more crystals, to help us win this battle...

speaker: Chief
content: They know only too well your greed for power. They gave you a couple cases of Mania weapons to trick you into coming here and facing the Legion's firepower.

speaker: Chief
content: You are nothing more than pawns in this battle against the Legion.
...No, not just this battle. The game of violence where gangs fight and winners rule has been a lie through and through since the very beginning.
Power seized through brute force will only be taken away by greater brute force. No gang can be the master of the Syndicate forever; they can't even be the master of their own fates.

The true master has its presence in this crypt, held in the hand of every gang who desires to become the supreme ruler. The true master is the <color=#fb9259>Mania weapon</color> that everyone is after... It is the <color=#fb9259>mystery arms dealer</color> behind the scene.

He uses the phantom prize of supremacy to stir up fights and is ever increasing the price tag on violence. He is putting one overlord after another on the throne, while he himself is the one true master behind the scene.

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: ...Mania weapon is the real master. It decides who gets to rule over Syndicate... Gosh, you have a very good point here... Whoever holds the inheritance has control over everything.

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: Hahaha! Everyone knows that! That's why we took the job!

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: The inheritance is right here, within our reach. It has never been so close to us. Now... now is the best time!

speaker: Hella
content: You wanna steal it? Are you insane? That is the ******* center of Mania. You would be turned into monsters!

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: What if... what if I turn into a Sinner? Power of this magnitude... who can say no to that?!

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: You may ask that shorty with the Legion... what has she come here for? Surely she's come here to get her hand on the inheritance before anyone else does?

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: I understand, I really do. We were born in the Syndicate, and we will die in it. Power is everything, and this holds true for all of us...

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: The energy of the crystals is pouring out. This is the inheritance! I'll kill you, kill the Legion... I can pull this off now.

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: I don't have to take orders from others anymore! The Syndicate is mine to take! Hahahaha!!
The Mania crystals in their hands start burning, and the patterns on the altar are spreading out. The overpowering sound of a thumping heart is shaking the crypt.

speaker: Hella
content: ...I am feeling miserable, so many voices in my head... Ugh... shut up, shut up...

speaker: Hecate
content: Abort the mission and get out of here... The inheritance is penetrating the shackles, and you will...

An excruciating pain assails your head, and you feel as if countless avaricious hands were tearing at your soul. In a trance, you see the gangsters rush towards the stone altar like squirmy dark shapes.
The stone altar, there's something... someone who...
Let me... stop it...

A chill washes over you. Close by your side, a dark blur leaps up and hurls herself into the center of the chaos. The sweeping ax gives out a black energy beam in the shape of a blade and tears apart several enemies in the front.

speaker: Hella
content: Horo?! You...

speaker: Horo
content: Ha...

speaker: Horo
content: You scumbags... You think you can hold the Legion back...?

speaker: Horo
content: I won't let you have your way, not as long as I'm still around... I will not let her fall!

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: Haha... Ahhhhh!

speaker: Horo
content: Get out of here!
Corpses are piling up at her feet. Her fury is blood-curdling.

speaker: Hella
content: Horo is getting more powerful. Is it because... the inheritance is resonating with her?

speaker: Hella
content: I don't understand. Isn't that thing on the side of the gangs?

speaker: Hecate
content: The inheritance is resonating with Mania. It activates the powers of all Maniacs, and in return, Maniacs running wild allows the inheritance to continue its activation.
The crazy scene before you brings on a sudden realization. You now understand why the mystery arms dealer, a calculating creature, would hire gangsters, who have a tendency to betray.
It's impossible that he failed to anticipate the betrayal of these people. Rather, this is exactly what he intended; he tapped into the gangs' greed.
This isn't a bid for the inheritance. This is a trap. He gathered all these people here and used their craziness to feed the inheritance. He's trying to cultivate something...

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: ****... ****... You mad dog from the Legion... Go to hell!
They raise their contamination-infused spears and lunge at Horo, paying little regard to the bodies of their fellows in the front.

speaker: Horo
content: Hahaha... Got you!

Not even bothering to wipe away the blood, she grasps the spear that has pierced her torso with one hand and wields her ax with the other. The blow blasts the two front rows of enemies away to one side.

speaker: Horo
content: My Legion... As long as I'm still standing...
At the center of the storm, the warrior's body takes on a demon-like quality. Contamination is flowing out of her short stature, and only the battle mark on her arm is burning, glowing a blood-red.
You are no stranger to that feeling. A huge shadow enshrouds Horo, malicious insubstantial hands reaching out from the stone altar to touch her, tempt her, and corrupt her...

speaker: Hecate
content: If not suppressed by the shackles, the contamination will overpower a Sinner. Horo is turning into a Corruptor.
No... You can't let this happen again... You're not going to stand aside and watch this time...

options: Catch her, and I'll put the shackles on her!

content: ...Before she's consumed by that thing.

speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
content: She can't hold out much longer. Go! Take her down!

speaker: Horo
content: Ahhhhh!!!
She swings the ax insanely, facing the fierce attack head-on and not backing away a bit.

speaker: Hella
content: Stop it... Stop it!
Clank!

A massive block flies over from behind, clearing anything that stands in its way, and squarely collides with the stone altar before going limp and sliding down. It's a human body, used as a cannonball.
In that instant, the air curdles up. Fear has produced in the enemies a moment of clarity—they are staring at the space behind you, their bodies shuddering.
In dead silence, footsteps draw near, move past you, and continue ahead.
You recognize the figure. You're familiar with the awe-inspiring aura. Mania forms twisted shapes on her body. It's her...

speaker: Gangster
content: ...It's Zoya! Quick! Quick! Don't let her come over here!
As if being jolted out of a reverie, they now turn their guns on her and mount a hysterical last-ditch attack.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, protect the Chief!

speaker: Gangster
content: She's on her last legs. Take them down!

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Bring it on, together.

speaker: Zoya
content: I'm sending you down to hell!

The bloodshed has ended, but that manic bloodlust has not yet dissipated. She steps forwards on shattered blades, covered in blood and looking for her next prey like Death. A fire burns up in her eyes once again.
The fire is getting out of control, burning away, and going wild with the heartbeat in the stone altar.
The inheritance hasn't fallen dormant with the annihilation of those minions; it is still throbbing. Then somewhere deep in your head, a chaotic voice rings...

speaker: Vague Voice
content: ...So powerful... I want it... I want her... Come to me...
This is the bewitchment of the inheritance, of Mania!

options: Zoya, stay away from the stone altar. Don't get yourself contaminated!

content: The response she gives you is one of irrepressible anger.
At this moment, a pair of grubby hands take hold of Zoya.

speaker: Horo
content: Finally... you're here...

speaker: Horo
content: Boss... you... are injured...

speaker: Zoya
content: It's nothing. I'll sleep it off.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Did I make it?

speaker: Horo
content: Right on time... Hehe, I knew you would come...

speaker: Horo
content: ...Kept inside the stone altar is the source of those crystals... the source of those weapons... They want to take it and use it against you.

speaker: Zoya
content: Horo, the Legion will not lose.

speaker: Horo
content: I know, Commander, you're the strongest... You always lead the charge. In every battle, you're always at the head of the group... Legion is what it is today because of you.

speaker: Horo
content: ...That's why I want to... be part of your strength...

speaker: Horo
content: Commander... I've guarded the inheritance. Take it with you.
The murmurs of the chaotic voice come back. This time, you detect the source. It's located at the other end of the shackles. Zoya has heard the bewitchment mingled in Horo's words.
...Come on... This is the power that you desire...

speaker: Horo
content: You need its power... Once you possess it, there will be no need to fear the tricks of those bastards, and there will be no more unnecessary loss of life.

speaker: Horo?
content: Mania Crystals... Powerful weapons... Unstoppable power... They'll be all yours...

speaker: Horo
content: No one can get in our way... Syndicate will change, we are finally able to change it...

speaker: Horo?
content: You were born to wreak destruction, you need stronger power that can destroy everything. Don't you want to destroy everything?

speaker: Horo?
content: <size=44><color=#dg1f1f>Come on! It's here, here!</color></size>
The inheritance is controlling Horo to tempt Zoya!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief...

speaker: Concentration of Contamination
content: Keep out... Keep out...
You instinctively make to stop it, but the filthy sludge ensnares your ankles. It transforms into the shape of Horo slowly and immobilizes all of you.

speaker: Zoya
content: You got yourself all these cuts and bruises... It isn't just about its power, is it?

speaker: Zoya
content: Horo, what do you fear?

speaker: Horo
content: I... Ugh!
Horo coughs up blood after receiving a heavy blow. Zoya's eyes are red with anger. The murmurs of the bewitchment die down, but the red light coming out of the stone altar is growing blighter.

speaker: Horo
content: I fear...

speaker: Horo
content: The moment I saw it, I knew... We can't win... The voice has found its way to my brain. I can't resist all the things it tells me.

speaker: Horo
content: I saw with my own eyes how it turned Sinners into monsters. It only took a second, and the Sinners were gone... This is the source, the source of Mania, the source of us.

speaker: Horo
content: If it falls into the hands of our enemies... if they use it against you... If even you will...

speaker: Zoya
content: Horo...

speaker: Horo
content: I don't want to see that happen! I-I don't want to! If you are defeated, the Legion will be no more! I don't want to see you fall! This time around I'm prepared to do anything to prevent that!

speaker: Horo
content: I don't want to see any of you fall down in front of me anymore!
At the other end of the shackles, Zoya hesitates.
This is a cry from within Horo herself, not something she has been manipulated or bewitched to saying. This is the darkest trap set by the inheritance; Horo's cry has made Zoya waver.
At this moment, a crack runs down the altar, like a hungry gaping mouth. Countless tentacles crawl out of the crack and towards Zoya.

speaker: Hella
content: The inheritance wants to devour them?!

speaker: Hecate
content: No, that thing, it is... craving for Zoya!

speaker: Horo
content: <size=44><color=#dg1f1f>Take it with you!!</color></size>
The red light bounces off Zoya and takes on a hue that is dazzling and frightening. A stubborn consciousness inside you is shouting...
Stop her!
Tens of red beams protrude from Zoya's body, nailing her to the spot. Finally, she looks up at you.

speaker: Zoya
content: You... you are using the shackles on me?

options: Yes. You must resist it. I'll not allow you to succumb to it.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, you can't use the shackles. You've got the bomb inside you!

speaker: Earl
content: If you ever use the Forbidden Force on my commander, threaten her, or confine her... or if she were to die for any reason, I'll detonate the bomb immediately.

options: He will detonate it eventually whether I use the shackles or not.
He won't know. I'll come up with a solution later.

content: You deploy the shackles, but the bomb doesn't detonate, which means it isn't a self-triggered bomb.
That man has to be present to make a judgement and then detonate the bomb himself. Then there's room for maneuver.

speaker: Hella
content: You idiot! How could you put your life on the line like that! You idiot!!

speaker: Zoya
content: Stop me? You?
Zoya plants herself in front of the altar. The shackles are doing nothing to her stance. The red beams are dancing behind her, and only her face is concealed in the shadows.
The shackles are restraining her, but they are shaking. They're lashed by a tremendous force, and you can feel that a chaotic voice is corrupting the other end of the shackles.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f>...He is weak... He can't restrain you!</color>
female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>...She is weak... She can't restrain you!</color>

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Break free from him, destroy him, devour every bit of him... I'll help you break him. I'll make all your wishes a reality...</color>
female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>Break free from her, destroy her, devour every bit of her... I'll help you break her. I'll make all your wishes a reality...</color>

speaker: Zoya
content: You ran away from me like a wimp for dear life, and now you crawl back here to stand in my way...

speaker: Zoya
content: Why? The authorities want the inheritance too? You also want this impure power?

options: There is something that I can't forgive, so I have to fight it.

speaker: Chief
content: Mania has brought about countless misfortunes. No one should be allowed to use it to make bigger disasters. I dread it.

speaker: Chief
content: If destroying your enemies at all costs is your idea of determination, then laugh at my cowardice to your heart's content.

speaker: Chief
content: I won't let you attain the inheritance... I will not let anyone use it!

speaker: Zoya
content: Hahaha! Is that so? Hahaha!

speaker: Zoya
content: I haven't seen people of your ilk for ages. I almost forget that even in a shitty organization like the authorities, there might be someone who doesn't fit in.

speaker: Zoya
content: Tell me your name, Chief of the MBCC.

speaker: Zoya
content: Haha, even that stupid look of bluntness looks familiar.

speaker: Zoya
content: I'll keep that in mind, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, ${PlayerName}, careful! Behind you, something is behind you... Eek!
A mass of black sludge suddenly ensnares her. Before you can say anything, your ankles also fall victim to that sticky substance.
The sticky cold tentacles crawls up quickly and strangles you fiercely. It's contamination in the shape of Horo!

speaker: Horo?
content: Let go... let go of Commander...

speaker: Horo?
content: The inheritance belongs to our commander... Commander... she is our commander!

speaker: Horo?
content: <size=44><color=#dg1f1f>Let go of her, or I'll kill you!</color></size>
You hold on to the shackles tightly, even though the rampant aura is tearing your consciousness into pieces.

speaker: Zoya
content: Your will is stronger than I thought, but you should fight differently.

speaker: Zoya
content: ${PlayerName}, I'll give you a chance to use the shackles on me. Fight through me, but watch your mouth.

speaker: Zoya
content: You don't want to lose to that thing, right?
The black sludge is tightening its hold on you. But strangely, the tighter it gets, the less willing you are to loosen your hands.

speaker: Zoya
content: Very good, then all that's left to say is...

speaker: Zoya & You
content: Don't lose!
The two words come out in unison like an incantation. Bright light erupts from the shackles surrounding Zoya and instantaneously severs the shadows that have been crawling towards her.

She dashes, and the next moment, she is standing before you. She clutches the unconscious Horo with one hand, and with the other, she deals a punch that smashes the filthy human-shaped thing clinging to you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Get your hand off the Chief... Ouch!
Clank! Clank! The creatures clinging to your Sinners are also smashed. Zoya grabs the four of you and leaps out of the contamination mire.

options: I didn't know the Forbidden Force could be used this way.

speaker: Zoya
content: You are shaking so badly. Are you cold?
Zoya is holding you upright with one hand. The last time you were so close, she almost took your life. But this time...

speaker: Zoya
content: Look at you, scared to death, still, you gave up the chance to escape and came back to the battlefield to stop me...

speaker: Zoya
content: ${PlayerName}, That's not cowardice. It's courage, something that's too precious to be found.

speaker: Zoya
content: You are quite something else. Don't die in a place like this.

speaker: Horo?
content: Commander... Come back... Come back...
The real Horo is lying in the crook of her arm, struggling in pain.

speaker: Zoya
content: Horo is fighting. I should help her.

speaker: Horo
content: Ow...
The foul incarnation dissolves; Horo is finally free of the shadows, collapsing into Zoya's embrace.

speaker: Zoya
content: She'll get through this. She got through injuries one hundred times more painful.

speaker: Zoya
content: She will come back from this. She knows we are waiting for her to come back.

speaker: Zoya
content: Now, it's time to deal with it...
She rises to her feet and looks towards the opened altar.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: ...It's gone... It's been taken...
Slowly, the tentacle-shaped shadows retreat to the cracked stone altar.

speaker: Hella
content: Does this mean it is under control?

speaker: Hecate
content: No. The inheritance is more active than ever. And... Watch out!
From where you came appear new pursuers, eyes glowing red and charging like mad in the direction of the stone altar.

speaker: Hella
content: We didn't see this many people when we came down. Where have they been hiding?

speaker: Zoya
content: They were the ones who blocked my way. I beat the shit out of them, and here they are again...

speaker: Zoya
content: They must have been bewitched by something!

speaker: Zoya
content: Get down!
She makes you crouch down with one hand, and with the other, she punches the ground, causing a blast of air that nullifies all the incoming grenades.

speaker: Frenzied Gonzales
content: It is calling me, it is calling me! The inheritance is mine, it has chosen me!

speaker: Frenzied Yagyu
content: **** you! It's me... me! I've heard it. It wants me! ¥#@*&¥!!
The crowd thunders past, howling and pasting themselves onto the stone wall like filthy sludge. They are brawling and stepping on each other.

speaker: Hecate
content: The crystals in the weapons are going manic, and all these gangsters have been contaminated with Mania.

speaker: Hecate
content: Why did the inheritance bewitch them into coming here?
Thousands of black spikes thrust out of the patterns and pierce through the crowd. In the next second, the bodies and spikes, along with all the craziness and fear, are sucked into the coffin.
Silence descends outside the coffin, punctuated only by the slow throbbing of a colossal heart.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Almost there... Ring... Almost there...

speaker: Vague Voice
content: More... I want more...
The coffin opens. At that instant, you hear a twisted voice, and see a withered hand.
The hand rises out of the coffin and points skywards like trembling and threatening death. The familiar scene makes you feel nauseous...

speaker: Zoya
content: ${PlayerName}, wake up!
Her exclamation brings you back to your senses. The hand has disappeared, and in its place, crawling out from under the coffin, is a distorted behemoth of a monster.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>More... Give me more! Roarrrr!!</color></size>

speaker: Hella
content: Urgh...!

speaker: Zoya
content: That's what they were after.

options: Stop it, don't let it get out.

content: If it gets out and goes to the more chaotic Syndicate, it'll definitely...

speaker: Zoya
content: Oh? Are you scared?

speaker: Zoya
content: You went toe to toe with me, and now you're scared of that thing?
She laughs, pats you on the back.

speaker: Zoya
content: Don't worry. I've made plenty of preparations... just so I can eradicate it.

speaker: Zoya
content: And you... are part of the preparations.
She walks straight for the chaotic leviathan.
The contorted being starts disintegrating. Even so, the contamination storm hasn't quite let up.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Die... Die! Ring... Ring... Almost there...</color>

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Give it back, give her back to me...</color>
It crumples up into a ball and jumps up, throwing countless tattered tentacles at Zoya, its burning red core revealed.

speaker: Zoya
content: This is what it really is. For this thing, they...

speaker: Zoya
content: But that's where the story ends! ${PlayerName}, the shackles!
With effort, you ramp up the shackles to stop the contamination from corrupting Zoya.
She strides ahead. From the palm of her clenched right fist flows blinding white light. She then throws her fist at the gaping mouth of the monster, at the red core.

speaker: Zoya
content: Go back to hell!
The white light rips up the giant monster, and the blast of air clears away the filth in the crypt, which is now as bright as in daylight.

speaker: Hecate
content: What is that?
The white beams spin rapidly and collapse in on themselves, locking up the struggling red light.
In the end, all that's left is a white crystal cube hovering above Zoya's open palm. On the facets of the cube are patterns that appear on and off.

options: That's the true form of the inheritance?
That's not one of Zoya's Sinner abilities.

speaker: Hecate
content: No... That's a seal.
The shackles show no reaction whatsoever. She didn't use her Sinner abilities. That white light had nothing to do with her power.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's an external seal.

speaker: Hecate
content: She has used some sort of unknown technique to seal the inheritance along with its Mania.
The area around the altar is in ruins, the contamination has dissipated, and the Mania Crystals all over the place start splintering. The twisted throbbing sound can no longer be heard.
You can hear the approaching footsteps from above now.
He walks towards you all, picks up the unconscious Horo, and walks in Zoya's direction. Meanwhile, his face is deadly solemn.

speaker: Zoya
content: It's all right, Earl. The battle is over.
She tucks away the white cube and looks up at you.

speaker: Zoya
content: Let's go back. We've won.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
content: You are in the temporary base outside the crypt. Using the Legion's communications equipment, you finally get in touch with the MBCC. It has been 47 hours since you lost contact with them.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
content: The MBCC is taken aback by your encounter and analysis. An investigation on the inheritance soon follows, and Nightingale makes rescuing you a priority.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
content: Three hours prior to the agreed meetup time, you step out of the communications vehicle to find Zoya waiting for you outside.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: You done?

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
options: You're not up to something, are you?

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: Don't mention it. You are no longer the enemy of the Legion.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: Haha... You're the one who's up to no good. Did you just call the Bureau to have us arrested?

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: Give it a rest, Chief. We don't have to be at each other's throats anymore.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Chief
content: Then ask that man to be nicer to me.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: Earl?

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
options: He fixed a bomb on me.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: Hahaha... I'm not surprised.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
content: You find it funny?

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: You can rest easy. The bomb goes dead automatically after 24 hours. He probably forgot to explain it to you.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: Horo is still unconscious. Her overprotective brother's mind is on nothing else at the moment.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
content: ...Horo? Earl is her brother?

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: Don't act so surprised in front of Horo. She would read it as "one sibling is so tall while the other is so short," and then get super mad.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
content: Looks like there's a lot of juicy stuff going on in the Legion. But now there's something more important to ask.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: The contamination has been all cleared out, but she is still in a coma. The corruption by the inheritance is more serious than I thought.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: When she wakes up, we can find out how she got the intel about the inheritance.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: ...We have to ferret those guys out.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
options: At least the misunderstanding has been cleared up.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Chief
content: The MBCC now knows Horo has nothing to do with Suspect R, and that this Mania crisis also has nothing to do with the Sinners.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Chief
content: We'll find out the force behind the inheritance. They are the culprit for the disasters in Syndicate.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: ...Someone said something along those lines to me before.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya
content: He said Syndicate's misfortunes are the work of a clique of conspirators and evil elements. He's also looking for them.

scene: It'll be a blaze of fire next time.
speaker: Zoya

content: ...I don't want to fight any more Legion members, and definitely not Horo's brother.
We should've put the shackles on him, even if it meant using some dirty trick or taking some tough measure.
You quicken your pace at the thought. You have so many things to ask him—about the inheritance that's appeared in the square, about the conspiracy behind the negotiation, about Zoya.
A dense crowd of Corruptors, however, blocks your way.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk, why now? Why are there so many of them here?

speaker: Hecate
content: Could it be the FAC machines over there?

It's those towering machines again. There aren't many of them, but they've been deployed strategically around the square, centering on the conference hall. They're casting blue light into the depths of contamination.
Come to think of it, Corruptors along the way seem to have given these FAC machines a wide berth. Could this be the technology the FAC uses to fight Mania contamination?

speaker: Hecate
content: These are the FAC's base stations for contamination shielding. I hear they can excite <color=#fb9259>Hypercubes</color> to produce a force field to protect the city, but the effect is limited.

speaker: Hecate
content: This one seems out of order. We have to make a detour.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait. They're mauling something... Look at the clothes... A Legion member?
Or rather, already a Corruptor. It makes a gurgling hiss, creeping closer to you with the creeping shadows behind it. The Sinners are still under some unknown pressure. A difficult situation overall.
You glance at the silent machines; they haven't come to much damage. If you can find a way to reboot this defense mechanism, things might work in your favor.
You look down at the Legion soldier. His face is deformed, but you recognize it. It's not Earl's. It belongs to someone who didn't even tell you his name in your encounter with him earlier.

After the battle in the crypt, he accosted you. He draped his arm around your shoulders, making a move to be reconciled with you. He pressured you into emptying a big glass, as he babbled away about his dream of changing Syndicate with the Legion.

speaker: Legion soldier
content: Commander... Protect... Commander... Earl... Go... Quick...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Let's put him out of his misery. Hecate, you do it, you're quicker.
Nightmare ends his suffering. It has made quick work of it.

speaker: Hecate
content: Only the supporting machinery can be turned on. There is no response from the main machinery of the base stations.

speaker: Hecate
content: These are not enough to drive all the enemies away. And the commotion is going to draw more Corruptors to us.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...They are coming.
Under the purple light in the background, more deformed creatures are inching their way out of the curtain of dust not so far away.
Judging by what's left of the clothes worn by the Corruptors in the front, they were also once Legion members.

speaker: Hella
content: No... It's the bro who helped me out once; I still owe him a couple bucks...

speaker: Hecate
content: He's a Corruptor now, Hella. Don't back away. We have to fight.

speaker: Hella
content: I know, but I... This is too much... This feeling... it's odd...
Ahhhhhhh!!
A mixture of anger and sadness is pouring out on the other end of the shackles. The lone fighter is howling and struggling, seemingly overcome by the tragic scene before your eyes.
Did Zoya see it through your eyes? Her pain is coming through to you from the other end of the shackles. This has never happened before. What happened in Keylan Square? What happened to Zoya?

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, hang in there. We must fight... I can still fight.

speaker: Hecate
content: I can't... let you...
Bang, bang—

The sound of gunshots... Bullets trailing pale-blue tails penetrate the torsos of a few Corruptors and cause real damage to them. They turn to their attackers, but are hurled into the air before they can mount a counterattack.

A white-armor man hacks his way with his ax to where you are. He is wearing a helmet with a visor that has a chip on the upper right corner that you recognize. He is the leader of the FAC team with which you had a fierce fight not so long ago.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: FAC Special Operations Forces Against Black Rings, captain of team N7, service number <color=#fb9259>036</color>, hereby report to you. We're not your enemy.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Chief ${PlayerName}, our team will assist in protecting you.
He takes off his helmet. You recognize the face...

speaker: Guard Captain
content: Adjutant Nightingale, take Chief away! You've got me here.
I'll explain the details to you later. We have to deal with this crisis at hand first.

My team will take care of the enemies coming from the front and start the main base station. They might attack us from behind; I hope you can intercept them. You can make use of all the <color=#fb9259>supporting machinery</color> here.
And...
He takes out a gadget embedded with a blue crystal, puts it in your palm, and asks you to hold it tightly.

It's a <color=#fb9259>Mania shield</color> for individual use. The force field created by the Hypercubes inside can temporarily alleviate the mental strain the shackles put on you, and at least allow your Sinners to get back in fighting shape.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Captain! The enemies are coming; the nearest ones are twenty meters away!
C formation. Covering fire in seven seconds!
He turns to you to give his final words.
Remember, no matter what happens, don't be swayed by your enemies, and don't worry about us and get distracted.
It's our responsibility to protect you. And your only job is to protect yourself.
Then he picks up his ax, and charges at the crowd of enemies amid a cacophony of gunfire.
As the last Corruptor meets its end, from behind you comes the electrical sound of the equipment being switched on. The main base station puts up a force field.

Blue light cascades over your surroundings, slowly clearing up the heavy, filthy air. You heave a sigh of relief, and your mind, which has been on the verge of a breakdown since you saw the sufferings of the Legion, finally enjoys a brief respite.
The high concentration of contamination has bent space-time and entirely cut off communications. But this area is free of Corruptors for the time being.

options: I thought you were killed in the MBCC riot

content: You were not wrong to have that thought. They always say I have a face that screams death in the line of duty.
But looks like it's quite the contrary. I'm good at surviving death-guaranteed missions.
He smiles, wearing a nonchalant look.
Me too.

After the riot, I was transferred back to DisSea Surveillance Zone. Only yesterday I heard that you, the new Chief of the MBCC, were doing an excellent job, and the headquarters intended to recruit you to help out in the District of DisSea.
I knew I would meet you sooner or later, but I didn't expect so soon.
Not so long ago, I thought you had been kidnapped by the Legion, and your Sinners had all defected. Guess I was wrong.
You tense up for a second. It's true that only a short while back, you conspired with the Legion to fight these guys. 036 probably did want to save you then, but...
All the other FAC soldiers in his team are evidently on their guard. They still look tense with the way they hold their guns, and you can feel their alert gaze on you even through the visors.
Don't worry, I'm not questioning your stance. Your adjutant has since explained the situation to me. I believe in you, Chief. You must have your reasons for doing so.
But we're in a dire situation. If you were forced to take that action for some special reasons, or you have come upon some special intel, please share it with me, don't keep me in the dark.
I'm not your enemy. The FAC won't be fooled into becoming someone's pawn in some political plot if we can help it, and we don't station our troops somewhere just to stand in someone's way.
We came here only because we had received confidential information: An S-Class or above Mania crisis might break out in Keylan Square. And as you and I have seen, this warning is becoming a reality.
What we've seen might only be the beginning. I have to know more; we have to take action.

You remain quiet for a moment. Then you give a brief account of how the Public Security Bureau and the Legion played games with each other, your worries about the inheritance, and the vague premonition you sensed through the shackles.

...So, That Earl guy from the Legion said the inheritance has been moved, but you can sense it's in the square now, and it suddenly appeared in the conference hall before the outbreak of contamination?

options: To be precise, I sense the same aura as the one from the inheritance

content: Is it possible that they tricked you? Maybe Zoya did bring the inheritance into the conference hall and release it when the negotiation broke down, as a means of retaliation?
As you've said, she possesses a technique that allows her to seal the inheritance completely.
...That <color=#fb9259>white cube</color>. This makes sense. Zoya did hide from you her real reason for attending the negotiation.
But even if Zoya did wish to retaliate, you don't think she would use the thing she most hates as a weapon. She'd prefer her own fists.
And you have a vague but even more unsettling premonition that comes to you through the shackles.

options: I have a feeling that Zoya's under the control of the inheritance now

content: That object once devoured a few dozens of maniac gangsters and extracted fearsome power from them. And it has a fervent craving for Zoya.
If it's the inheritance that's corrupting Zoya, I'm afraid that it must have attained much greater power. And that explains why it could bring about such widespread contamination.
Zoya... she is doing everything she can to fight that thing.
That's what you sensed through the shackles?
The FAC team falls silent.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What's wrong? Why getting so serious all of a sudden?

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Captain, what are your orders? We're forever ready. We'll fight alongside you until the very end no matter what.
...I see.
He turns to you.
The information you just gave me is very important.
For that glimmer of hope, we shall continue our fight.
I do. Predicaments faced by the FAC are always beyond easy comprehension, so your contribution is of vital importance.
Thank you for letting us know how dire the situation is, and for giving us the silver lining. And now, for the silver lining, we shall fight to the last man.
Team N7, assemble!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Yes, Chief!
Head for the conference hall immediately and storm the center of contamination. Be prepared to die for the mission. If there's only one man reaching the destination, give him all the firepower.
This is our final mission. Kill Sinner Zoya before the Black Ring breaks out, at all costs.
Risk of a Black Ring outbreak confirmed; risk level upgraded to S+; Ground zero presumed to be Sinner Zoya; troops for deployment in the risk area are Team FAC-BR-N7 and MBCC's Sinner squad.
Go to the conference hall now. Kill Sinner Zoya before the concentration of contamination reaches the threshold level.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Yes, Chief!

options: Hold on. I can't accept this decision!

content: The negotiation's apparently a plot. The Public Security Bureau and the force behind the inheritance are involved. We haven't found out about the truth yet; we can't just declare Zoya the culprit.
...Chief, a disaster is imminent. This is the only possible course of action.

options: The inheritance, not Sinners, is the source of Mania.

content: I saw it happen with my own eyes in the cave. The inheritance, which is used to produce Mania weapons, turned humans into Maniacs and then swallowed them to boost its own power.

I agree with you in that regard. This crisis is far more serious than the FAC expected. 80% of the anti-Black Ring system has been damaged, which is proof enough that the inheritance is much more powerful than we thought.
But when you come down to it, the inheritance is just a catalyst; all this can be traced back to Zoya's mental contamination. We have to eliminate the source to dissolve this crisis.
I understand how you feel, and I'm really sorry, but this is the only way out.
As he says these words, his face is a study in composure. His composure was what earned your trust, but now it chills you.

options: Is this a fact, or some resentful prejudice of yours?

content: Sinners are the source of contamination and disasters... This isn't the first time I've heard this. Ignore a blatant plot, abandon all other solutions, pin everything on Sinners, and problem solved.
This way of thinking can only bring more tragedies. Syndicate can't take it anymore.
Before 036 can respond, another person has come forward.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Blah, Blah, Blah... so annoying. Captain, I'll carry this motormouth with me. Stop wasting our **** time!

speaker: Hella
content: What do you think you're doing?! Get your hands off the Chief!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Take your filthy paws off me!! The DisCity got to where it is today because of you, you thugs, monsters! Get lost!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Tragedies? If you had the slightest idea what real tragedies look like, what we are fighting, you wouldn't think to defend the Sinners!
Clang! The soldier's outcry has stopped; he lets go of you, kneeling on the ground in pain.
Standing behind him is 036, who has just dealt a mighty blow to his subordinate and is withdrawing his hand, but his face is completely devoid of anger.
...Stop it, 702. The depletion of your Hypercubes is speeding up. Don't lose control of your emotions. You don't want to get infected with Mania here, right?
Start mind suppression immediately.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Cough, cough... Sorry, Captain. I'll keep my emotions under control, sorry.
036 says no more. He turns to you, and the two Sinners supporting you become alert.
We didn't mean to antagonize you; we don't hate Sinners. Our only enemy is the imminent catastrophe.

For the purposes of our upcoming task, I hereby, in accordance with Supplemental Clause 74 of the <color=#fb9259>Code of Confidentiality</color>, divulge to you part of the FAC's confidential information, and assume accountability thus incurred.

Everything you see now, from the corruption incidents caused by the contamination to this unsettling turn of events, is just a prelude. The <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>, keep the name in mind... it's the ultimate form of a Mania crisis.
It's an area that causes <color=#fb9259>widespread, severe mental contamination</color>. It appears when a Mania crisis goes beyond its limits; it's a no-go zone of Mania that can not be eliminated.
Information about what's going on inside the Black Ring is extremely rare, since few can get out alive. We've only recorded the damage caused by the Black Ring.

<color=#fb9259>BR-000</color> appeared in N.F. 84, in the wake of the <color=#fb9259>DisSea explosion</color>. The number of direct deaths was 87,231, and up until the appearance of BR-001, more than 200,000 Maniacs had come into being.

<color=#fb9259>BR-001</color> appeared in N.F. 89. More than 30,000 people went missing, with an annual addition of at least 200 people. 3 years later, the contamination spilling out of BR-001 formed the <color=#fb9259>Isolation Belt in the Rust</color>, which we still aren't able to clean up.
Access to data on BR-002 and BR-003 is blocked. <color=#fb9259>BR-004</color> is coming.

options: But no one in the city has ever talked about the existence of the Black Ring

content: Because the FAC has to do its utmost to stop any Black Ring-related information from getting out, in order to prevent secondary disasters, that is, the unpredictable, far-reaching spread of Mania.
Every time a Black Ring appears, the number of mental cases in the city skyrockets.

You don't have to be in contact with contamination to get mentally ill. You might get mentally ill simply by observing a Black Ring, discussing it, or even imagining it. We can't manage the influence of a Black Ring when it's out in the open.

And we humans have no way of eliminating a Black Ring once it has appeared. All we can do is to contain its expansion and lessen its effect by blocking the contamination, Active Camouflage, and information control.

This is why information on the Black Ring is strictly confidential. <color=#fb9259>The Black Ring is the source of Mania</color>, and simply knowing this piece of information might be enough to bring destruction on ourselves.

options: How does that have anything to do with Sinners

content: Misunderstanding caused by information blocking does contribute to Sinners being blamed for causing Mania. But there's a close link between the appearance of a Black Ring and the behavior of a Sinner.

With the exception of BR-000, whose point of origin hasn't yet been determined, we detected a powerful Sinner going manic at the same time when each of the other Black Rings appeared. Such a Sinner is called <color=#fb9259>Black Ring Ground Zero</color>.

The M value of Sinner Zoya is already out of range. Once she is corrupted, a Black Ring will descend on Keylan Square immediately. Then, no one inside the ring will survive, and those outside the ring are not going to emerge unscathed.

The <color=#fb9259>Framework Against Catastrophe</color> is not trying to sit in judgement on Sinners, or improve public morals. We have only one job, and that is to do everything we can to fight Mania, to prevent the ultimate catastrophe that we humans wouldn't be able to survive.
Killing Zoya is the only course of action that can stop this catastrophe. That's what we'll do. And without you, we don't stand a chance of defeating her.

options: This is why you're protecting me?

content: That's right.
...I'm very sorry.
What if I don't agree? Would you force my hand?
His eyes widen, but it's not a reaction to what you've just said.
Enemies! Get down!!

Spikes of contamination are flying your way. A few forms in white are scrambling to stand in front of you. The first one to manage that is the soldier who a moment ago was yelling at you while clutching your collar—Soldier 702. His body has been pierced.
Cough... Captain, ten o'clock... Quick...
036 doesn't say a word. He picks up a gun and starts shooting at that direction. After suppressing the enemy, he picks up his ax.
The battle is over. Hella stares at the defeated attackers blankly. Among them is one in white armor that's filled with contamination.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's the FAC team. Looks like they came here after the contamination outbreak and died here eventually.

speaker: Hella
content: Poor things... How did they end up like this? Didn't they each have a contamination shield?
The contamination shield only provides limited protection. It resists contamination by depleting Hypercubes, and Hypercubes are hard to come by.

036 comes near you. He goes down on one knee, next to Soldier 702, who is lying close to you. Soldier 702's helmet has been shattered, revealing the young face underneath. He detested you, but he didn't think twice before taking a fatal blow for you.
Stop... the Black Ring... Must stop it...
We will.

036 reaches out to pull on a security ring on the inside of Soldier 702's armor, and removes a Hypercube contamination shield from the chest of the armor. As soon as he's done so, Soldier 702 stops breathing.
The pain on his face dissipates, and his pupils start enlarging. His captain closes his eyes.

Physical trauma can affect one's mental state. He was no longer able to resist the mental contamination here. He died in a human form; this way, I could at least recover the Hypercubes inside the Mania shield.
This is valuable.
036 has recovered four blue crystals, which he puts on your palm. He is the sole survivor in his team, but his face is untouched by even a shadow of sadness.

options: ...This is the kind of rationality required by the FAC too?

content: Yes. Mind suppression is fundamental to the FAC's fighting. To resist Mania, you must have an extremely rational mind. Losing control of your emotions only brings contamination.
This can help the MBCC too. It can be trained. It can help you become accustomed to responding to emergencies.

options: Including the death of your fellows?

content: Yes. Deaths are part of the game. If you can't accept this, you don't deserve to fight for the FAC.

options: So that's why you can stay emotionless

content: Yes. I'm a member of an FAC combat unit. To fight Black Rings, I can discard all emotions.
Just now you asked me whether I would force your hand if you refused to get involved in the battle.

If forcing your hand means my success in killing Zoya, then I will. But the problem is, the shackles' power comes from your will, so if you have no desire to fight yourself, there is no point in forcing you to.

We protected you because of that glimmer of hope, that you might be identified with our fight and join us in our endeavor. This is all too sudden, too much for you to handle; then again, one can only hope.
Even if you choose not to join us, we're still moving on with our mission. This is our duty; we must continue, even if it's a losing battle that we're fighting.
He raises his eyes. The conference hall looms ahead, behind which stands the grand Statue of Keylan, overrun with fast-spreading contamination.
The DisCity is spurned for its many sins, but it's our only home nevertheless. Our city was never built on peace.

The world was plagued by Mania calamities back then. Without Hypercubes, humans had no choice but to hole up in refuges, not knowing what tomorrow would bring. The DisCity's prosperity was built by our many ancestors with their wisdom, determination, and even lives.
But that prosperity is very fragile. It can be taken away by a simple Black Ring. And that great man who went into the mire of despair to retrieve the seeds of hope is long gone.
Now, only we can protect this city. It rose amid a hellish landscape, and we will not let it fall without a fight.
The FAC is giving it all it's got, to fight Mania and safeguard the DisCity. So what's your choice?
You don't have a quick answer. As he's said, this is all too sudden, too much for you to handle. But there is one thing you can be sure of.

options: Move along. Go meet with Zoya

content: I'm gonna find the answer myself.
Then... at least we can keep each other company. I'll do whatever it takes to keep you safe.
That's for the sake of that glimmer of hope I cling on to. I hope you'll eventually make up your mind and decide to help us prevent the Black Ring.
As if answering your resolve to march ahead, a multitude of contorted monsters is crawling out of the contamination mist that envelops the conference hall.

This is the entrance to the conference hall. The interior has been trashed, its walls crumbling, its floor dotted with round pits. From the pits grow dense bushes of contamination spikes, inside each of which swirls a pool of dark purple light.

speaker: Hella
content: Well, I've never had a fight here. When this is over, I'm gonna, as per usual, do a bit of graffiti as a memento.
Her voice is slightly tense.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, you okay?
You're not feeling very well. Since you got here, the shackles connected to Zoya have been in a manic state. Something has been continuously tearing at your consciousness.
You're very close to Zoya. It's only normal to be affected. But something is wrong with this place...
The attendees, the guards, and the soldiers who ambushed Zoya... all of them have simply vanished. They didn't turn into Corruptors or end up as corpses.
...They're dead, someone killed them.
036 squats down beside a pit. It seems to be the upshot of a powerful punch, with spiderweb-like cracks radiating from its center. He runs a hand over the cracks, and it comes up with viscous blood.

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhhh!

speaker: Hecate
content: Step back!
Hecate shields you behind her. But pits of death like this have overrun the entire ground, hemming you in.
There's no sign they were mentally contaminated. They were killed at the instant of the contamination outbreak. This is what's left of their remains.
At the other end of the hall is a pile of FAC members' corpses.

speaker: Hecate
content: All those who made it here were also eradicated.

speaker: Hella
content: This is... the power of the inheritance? So brutal...
The Black Ring hasn't formed yet. There's still time. We must stop it before this tragedy is repeated.
...He means that there's still time to kill Zoya.

speaker: Zoya
content: Die...!! Ahhh!!
She is still fighting.
She is ahead of you. Her power is swelling to the utmost, and her feverish emotions are churning—anger, sadness, and hatred, mixed with some irrepressible impulse.
It's not over yet. We still have a chance.
...If that's the case, it'll be great.
You need something to stabilize her, anything that you can use to awaken her. You need more measures at your disposal.

speaker: Hecate
content: No. We're the only ones who've made it here after the outbreak.

speaker: Hella
content: Should we wait for him?
We don't have time.

As if a magnetic field has been turned on, masses of dark purple substance slowly come into being in the air, twisting and transforming. They then land, on their feet—these powerful monsters you've never seen before.
<color=#dg1f1f>It</color> senses you through the shackles, just like you do Zoya.
These monsters that stand in your way are crumbling. But in their wake, a tumultuous, chaotic emotion rushes into your head.
...Kill it, destroy it, smash it, destroy it, destroy it, destroy it...

speaker: Zoya?
content: ...Shut up!!
The thing that's ensnared Zoya also takes hold of you...

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}!! ${PlayerName}, are you all right? Hey, can you hear me? Come on... This is killing me!
The screaming in your head is turning your nerves into a mush. Such mental pain produces severe vertigo in you, and you start vomiting non-stop.

speaker: Hecate
content: The shackles are putting too much strain on the Chief. What should we do?
Stay away. You're connected to him through the shackles. You'd be affected. Let me take care of this.
female_content: Stay away. You're connected to her through the shackles. You'd be affected. Let me take care of this.

content: He produces two Hyperpyramids and presses one against each of your temples. He lowers his head and looks deep into your eyes.
Wake up, ${PlayerName}. Listen to me. It's just you and me here. Focus your mind, then suppress it.
You're strong. You won't be defeated.

You're gasping, straining to hold on to his voice. Slowly, blue light chases away the scarlet mist before your eyes. You clam down and find yourself surrounded by your Sinners, who are looking at you with a worried expression on their faces.
The monsters from just now were the products of Zoya going manic—her mental contamination. Anger, resentment, hatred, and a reckless desire to wreak destruction.
She is extremely dangerous now.

options: ...She's still fighting. Just like us... She hasn't given in!

content: She's connected to me through the shackles. Maybe there's some other way to prevent the Black Ring.
I understand. You see something that I can't. If what you see is hope...
Then go and fight, and I'll protect you.
You'll fight on. You hear her roar coming from the end of the shackles. Zoya is still there. You clutch the shackles that are causing you so much pain, ready to fight to bring her back.

options: Zoya, I'm coming. Can you hear me?

content: From the other end comes a soul-shaking roar. Clenching the Hyperpyramids 036 gave you, you manage to pull yourself upright and head for the closed door, trying to catch up with 036.
...Don't touch me! Don't... order me around!

options: Zoya, hang in there, I'm coming!

content: Get lost...!!

A heavy double door marks the entrance to the hall. It's got stuck in contamination. 036 is pushing it hard with one hand on each door. You come forward, put your hands on one door, and start pushing with him.
The chaotic roar stops short, and the other three voices around you disappear too. Silence descends. You've never felt so clearly the existence of the shackles connected to her.
...I hear it... It's you... It's you...
A voice pipes up in the depths of your consciousness—a dark, twisted, and decadent voice which evokes that familiar sickening feeling...
It's you! You're getting in my way!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!!
Spikes shoot out of the door, and a few of them pierce 036's torso. Hella makes to stop it, but is nailed to the spot. Hecate pushes you aside.

From behind the contamination-spouting door, berserk Polymers crawl out. You can hear the voice behind them more clearly now, a voice similar to the one made by the inheritance, but more frantic and wild.
...She...she is mine!!
You see a crack in the chaotic battlespace. As you make for it, three filthy monsters pounce on you.
Red beams burst out of your right hand. You blow the enemies up with your power, and make a hole in the wall of contamination in front of you.
The side effect of forcing a blast comes shortly. But you have no time for that; you hurry into the conference hall...
Spikes dot Zoya's body, as if she has just gone through a brutal execution. Head hanging low, she shows no reaction whatsoever to your entering.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Don't... touch me... I... I'm not...

She is murmuring. Her eyes are aimless, her voice is hoarse, and her fist that smashed the ground is cracked. Marks of Mania is binding her body and searing her soul. You know she is still fighting, fighting with all her might against the filthy presence that has invaded her consciousness.

speaker: Zoya
content: You don't stand a chance... Not a chance... I will not lose... I will not lose...

options: Zoya, I'm here to fight with you.

content: You reach out for her, trying to awaken her with the shackles.
But right at this moment, Zoya raises her head, purple flames burning in her eyes, and her murderous malice devours you at once.

speaker: Zoya
content: Do not touch me... Go to hell!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!!
You sustain a mighty punch in the chest and are sent flying backwards a few meters. Nightmare catches you, and you spit out blood.
Through your hazy vision, you see a red patch of flesh, moist and mushy, clinging to her right shoulder. The patch of flesh cracks, and a lone eye pops open, staring at you like a black hole.
She is mine... mine... Whatever she wants, I can provide...!
Hahaha... Just like this... Fight, Zoya... Destroy everything in front of you, fight on... This is the source of your power, your true self...
What it craves is you, you in this state...
??:?? Eighteenth floor, Statue of Keylan
The exchange of fire between gangs made a massive breach on the outer wall of the statue, exposing an internal fire escape.
Standing on the ladder is a tall, thin man holding an umbrella. He looks down at the conference hall, as well as the square in general.
Oh, I'm still here. What a magnificent view! It makes my labors all worthwhile.
A long-lost miracle will soon happen. How are you feeling now? Happier?
Haha, my apologies for keeping you waiting. Things change, we must adjust our plan in time. Will you forgive me?
After all, this multi-year project is done, and I've overachieved.
An explosion happens in the conference hall. Purple light and crowds of sharp spikes overturn the roof of the building. The loud boom shakes the floor beneath the man's feet.
Does the noise bother you? We've got a couple of little intruders who are trying to put together an opening act for us.

They call this thing <color=#fb9259>Shackles</color>, right? They've probably modified the technology they had stolen back then and used it to tie up a few lambs. That has brought a little accident to our plan.
Then again, thanks to them, we've found such good seeds.
Syndicate has nurtured the best seeds, so powerful, so pure, so passionate and fearless—the ones who dare to oppose the gods, and are thus favored by them.
It doesn't matter if they've already been marked by others, we just have to snatch them.
He watches the exposed battlefield and the person throwing up blood.
Alas, the pitiful and lovable ones, continue with your hopeless struggle. Such admirable willpower will make an excellent decoration for the <color=#fb9259>Ring</color> too.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief... Are you... all right?
Ashen-faced, Hecate is holding your hand shakily. Hella is also very weak. 036 is left outside, unsure if dead or alive.
The bloody flesh with one eye open is slowly merging into Zoya's body, its evil eye glaring at you. You can feel the strong hatred, jealousy, and mockery in it.

speaker: Zoya?
content: Destroy... End... end all of this!
Using the shackles on Zoya again will only further burden Hella and Hecate. But there's no way back for you. You must fight.
Her battle shouldn't have been like this. You can't let her be taken away.

options: I'm sorry, Hecate. Please lend me your power one more time

speaker: Hecate
content: I will, anytime.

speaker: Hecate
content: Stop her, Chief. Only you can do it.

speaker: Hecate
content: That person is still alive... Chief, you did it.

speaker: Hecate
content: Take some rest. You've just overused your Shackle of power during the fight, your body is almost out of strength.

speaker: Hecate
content: Take some rest. I'll go and bring back Zoya with you.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief? Where are you going?
You walk toward Zoya. Your brain feels heavy but your steps feel light and weak. You feel like falling with each step, but still you make your way to her clumsily.
Zoya is unconscious. The spikes on her body have not disappeared. She's standing with her head dropped low, looking like a prisoner awaiting execution or the tombstone of a dead person.

You tug at the shackles and feel nothing but filthy contamination on the other end. <color=#fb9259>That thing</color> is still there. Its weakness has triggered its survival instinct, causing it to drill deeper into Zoya's soul.

options: Wake up! Think of what you should be doing!

content: You take out all the Hyperpyramids given to you by 036. Like he did, you press your hands on Zoya's temples and hold her head, ordering and pleading.
All the pyramids are being consumed rapidly. The blue crystals dim and shatter quickly, slipping through your hands like sand. Your consciousness soon starts blurring as well.

options: Don't let it lead you away. That's not you

content: Her head is still bowed low, but a contorted hand suddenly raises to strangle your throat.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>It's mine... It's mine...!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare! Ahhh...!!

Hecate doesn't have enough strength left to summon the Nightmare. Because of Zoya, the shackles have become extremely heavy, pressing down on everyone linked to you. Their faces all look absolutely agonized.
Killing Zoya is the only course of action that can stop this catastrophe.
There's a <color=#fb9259>gun</color> in your pocket.
Stop... the Black Ring... Must stop it...
At this distance, even you won't miss.
As if sensing your thought, the surrounding contamination swarm toward your hands. But several blue bullets fly from behind you at the same time, crushing the filth.
${PlayerName}!!
${PlayerName}, do it.
Only you can do it!

From the corner of your eye, you see that Hella is lying unconscious on the ground, Hecate has lost her Nightmare, and 036 is leaning on the wall, covering you with his last bit of strength. Out of bullets, his eyes are almost imploring.
You don't know what the Black Ring is, but you know full well that if it's not stopped, it will crush everyone here.
The force strangling you is becoming stronger. This is a life or death battle between you and that presence. Your hands are finally moving, and your choice is...
You pull out the gun and press it to Zoya's forehead. She lifts her eyes slightly. Time stops at this moment.
You see that last sparkle of light go out. It's become a stranger's eye, full of insanity, fear, hatred, and greed —that hideous thing has taken her over.
...At least I can't let you destroy her heart.
Boom—

A strong blast hits you. She releases her hand, and you get blown to one side, seeing stars. That's not the bullet you shot, but something more powerful and aggressive —<color=#fb9259>a micro-bomb</color>.
You lie down still. Familiar metallic footsteps sound on the cold floor. Someone you know walks into the hall.

speaker: Earl
content: ...Don't touch her.
You...

speaker: Earl
content: F**k off!
036 wants to stop him, but the other man dodges his severely injured body effortlessly and pushes him onto the floor.
Earl's quite badly wounded as well, but compared to the others here, he has the best mobility.

speaker: Earl
content: The Legion's commander is not going to die here. Not in your hands.

speaker: Earl
content: ...You're not worthy enough.
He kicks away your gun with his metallic prosthetic and steps over your immobile body without glancing back, making his way to Zoya.
Not pulling out the gun, you cover her forehead with your hand.
With your power, you could have broken my neck easily. But I'm still alive.
You're here, right, Zoya? Answer me, come back with me.
Stop, you won't be able to stand it! Don't..
You activate the shackles.

speaker: Zoya
content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!

speaker: Zoya??
content: Let her go, let her go! She's mine! I'm gonna kill you, I'm gonna kill you!

The force strangling your neck suddenly strengthens. Your consciousness begins to blur and you can't hear the shouts of others. The shrill loud voices are fading and you can only hold on tight to one thought—<color=#fb9259>you can't let go</color>.
Bang! Bang, bang, bang!
A series of bullets hit the hand strangling you. The arm explodes and breaks off like black gel. Your body gives out and falls back, and your hand moves away from Zoya's body.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!!

Perhaps the hope of survival has granted her power. The torn Nightmare is summoned, and before contamination gathers to form an arm again, the Nightmare wraps itself around you and drags you away from danger.
You lie down still. Familiar metallic footsteps sound on the cold floor. Someone you know walks into the hall.

speaker: Earl
content: ...You are more stubborn than I imagined.

speaker: Earl
content: Your shackles have already failed. Stop trying to get yourself killed for nothing.

speaker: Earl
content: It's not yet time for you to act...

speaker: Earl
content: ...I'll leave Commander to you.
This is his last words to you. The man then steps over you and makes his way to Zoya, to that single bloody eye.
Contamination spills out again, wrapping around his wounded body from the bottom up, only to be met with a sneer from the Legion advisor.

speaker: Earl
content: What a sight, you're so badly injured by that one there... In this condition, you can't descend anymore even if you completely suck the lifeblood of the Commander, can you?

speaker: Zoya??
content: Arghhhhhhhh! Give it to me... give it to me!!
He presses firmly on the scar on her body left by the intruding bloody flesh.

speaker: Earl
content: Leave her alone. I'll help you, take my bones and blood, my soul, my everything. Come to me!

speaker: Zoya??
content: You're not worthy enough, you're not, you...?!
A strange white light leaks out from Earl's hand. The light seems surprisingly familiar.

speaker: Zoya??
content: Ahhh...! It's her! It's her!! Hahahaha, give it to me, give it to me!!
Its power suddenly surges. Sharp black spikes pierce through Earl's body and coil themselves around him like tentacles, dragging him near Zoya.
Stop! Stay away from her. Sinners shouldn't get close to her, or the Black Ring will destroy everything here!

speaker: Earl
content: Haha... So what? This place is not worth her life.

speaker: Earl
content: Come on, the DisCity. Reckoning time has come. Embrace the Black Ring...

speaker: Earl
content: This is what you get from the vile seed you've planted in Syndicate. You deserve it.
The filth growls as it swallows the two and fuses them into one. The spikes shatter the ground and overturn the ceiling. A murky purple light erupts and obliterates everything before your eyes.
The moment you see the luminous red ring, countless dark shadows cling onto your consciousness and drag it into an abyss.
The job is done. We should go before the troublesome spiders crawl here.
You've regained consciousness, but you don't recognize the scene before you at all.

Colossal rusty towers stand in a row before you, chopping up the sky. The iron steel forest looks like it'll collapse down on you any second. The sharp noise of metal breaking sounds like a person's growl.
Right, the Black Ring has already broken out. You couldn't stop it, and your own consciousness has fallen into a bottomless abyss.
Is this the world inside the Ring, or the afterworld? Are you alone?
The two of them are indeed standing behind you, but their faces are blurred and they remain silent. You try, but you can't even talk to them using the shackles. You can't do anything but wait.
Soon, a figure appears in the mist.
Zoya's portrait fades in
You want to move forward, but your legs won't move, as if your consciousness is floating outside your body. Zoya is also just standing, much like those still iron towers.
Gradually, you hear voices coming near from afar, but they also sound like they're coming directly from the depths of your consciousness.

speaker: Faraway Voice
content: The Legion has won again... The three gangs got crushed even though they'd teamed up. Carnivore had it the worst, they're doomed this time... Karma, hahaha, karma...

speaker: Faraway Voice
content: So what? It's just a dogfight among gangs. That rotten Legion must be even worse...

speaker: Faraway Voice
content: Their boss is a monster...
Slowly, a phantom-like figure steps out from the mist and walks toward Zoya.

speaker: Legion Member
content: Boss, we've barged into the police station, but we couldn't save Ayek and the others... They were lynched this morning.

speaker: Legion Member
content: The sheriff who did this took Yagyu's money and blamed the dozens of deaths in the south warehouse last month on us... all on us.

speaker: Legion Member
content: Yes, they don't have proof, but... He's said the fact that you're a Sinner is proof enough.
One after another, they come near, then vanish.

speaker: Aloof Doctor
content: The clinic doesn't need protection by means of violence. I also don't believe you can change anything.

speaker: Aloof Doctor
content: ...This place is not going to change, Commander. What's the point of the battles you've provoked, other than repeating this vicious cycle?

speaker: Hesitant Mercenary
content: I know this weapon, it comes from my blood. They make Sinners fight each other to death, then collect our madness and power to make this crystal.
