content: Remember, you're a senior officer. Ensuring your own safety is your responsibility to them.

speaker: Intelligence Agent
content: Madam! The Corruptors are attacking the Anti-Black Ring Base Station. The FAC's reinforcements cannot arrive in time as they're still cleaning up the remains of the Black Ring in Keylan Square. The Corruptors there have taken up too much of our forces.

speaker: Langley
content: We'll take this chance and make them owe us a favor then. ${PlayerName}, are you coming?

speaker: Langley
content: Think of it as a show. I'll make sure to pile it on in the report to help you gain a few more points from those stubborn geezers in the FAC.

speaker: Choice
options: Don't get overprotective. I'm not that weak.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll prove to you that we're qualified to take the Black Rings head on.
You've temporarily eliminated the enemies around the shields, but the uneasy atmosphere remains.

speaker: Hecate
content: Why did you bring Chief here? He's just faced the Black Ring and been in the cell for so long. His body hasn't recovered yet. Why did you have to take him to such a dangerous place?!
female_content: Why did you bring Chief here? She's just faced the Black Ring and been in the cell for so long. Her body hasn't recovered yet. Why did you have to take her to such a dangerous place?!

speaker: Hecate
content: When Chief goes back, aren't they going to...

speaker: Langley
content: Don't worry, the 9th Agency doesn't need permission from them. We agents are always the ones to give others trouble, it's never the other way round.
Hecate is still wary against Langley, shielding you with her own body, a rare and intense hostility oozing out of her. Langley smiles and glances at you.
You put a hand on Hecate's shoulder.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Are you sure?
You make an OK sign with your hand, then smile and pat her on the head.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm relieved to see that you guys are doing fine.

content: Your gaze falls onto Hella too. You haven't seen her in a while. She seems fine, just a little quiet. She quickly glances away when she feels your gaze, as if troubled by something.

speaker: Langley
content: You have a team of adorable subordinates, very loyal.

speaker: Langley
content: ...Don't push them away.

speaker: Choice
options: I don't understand what you mean.

speaker: Langley
content: It's just a reminder. I'm quite fond of you, as someone who shares similar experiences, I'd like to offer you some advice.

speaker: Langley
content: I mean...

speaker: Langley
content: Don't hold onto your little secrets and lock yourself up.

speaker: Langley
content: You can't shoulder everything yourself, especially when it comes to things like this...
Just when she finishes, as if sensing your conversation, the red luminous ring begins wiggling.
You hear a soft chuckle. A slender black figure comes out from the Black Ring.
I feel it... Special audiences... Different audiences...
Are you... here to watch me dance?
A girl as deep as the night, she has long hair and wears a misty dance costume. Under the red light, the hem of her dress and her long hair are dancing and bouncing animatedly.
Beautiful and frightening.

speaker: Langley
content: What on earth happened here?

speaker: Langley
content: The enchanting muse, <color=#fb9259>Hamel</color>.
She releases the safety of the silver gun in her hand and aims at Hamel.

speaker: Langley
content: Based on the salvaged surveillance footage, at 12:39 on June 27, N.F. 89, Hamel entered the Carnival. At 13:10, it was detected that an S-class Sinner went manic in the Carnival. Simultaneously, the first Black Ring broke out.

speaker: Langley
content: Using your experience as an example, she's the Zoya of this place, <color=#fb9259>ground zero of BR-001</color>, the owner of the Carnival's Black Ring.

The girl raises her arms to her chest, then spreads them to the two sides gracefully. As if summoned by her movement, the Corruptors begin running toward the center of the Black Ring even more frantically.

speaker: Hamel
content: Are you all here to watch me dance?

speaker: Hamel
content: You all love me, don't you?

speaker: Hamel
content: I'm so glad... I love you all dearly too.
Amid the woman's sweet, blissful laughter, the Corruptors crowd around her like pilgrims. But once they get close to her, they immediately let out agonized cries.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Aaahhh...!!
They twist and contort instantly, transform into black shadows, and get devoured by the woman!

speaker: Hamel
content: This way, we can be together forever...

speaker: Langley
content: The Black Ring in the square only existed for a week, this one here is the first <color=#fb9259>secondary Black Ring</color> born 23 years ago. Of course people are in a different state here.
Behind Hecate, the Nightmare seems to be affected as well and is looking very disturbed.
Hamel seems to have noticed you all and gives you a sweet and innocent smile.

speaker: Hamel
content: Are you here to watch the performance too?

speaker: Langley
content: She's the most powerful Catalyst Sinner known to date and possesses a power called <color=#fb9259>Blissful Illusion</color>. The Corruptors in the Rust have all fallen into madness for her.

speaker: Langley
content: But in the past two weeks, this has been happening a bit too often. She can seldom walk out like this.

speaker: Langley
content: If the BR-004 operation report is legit, in order to destroy the Black Ring, we must eliminate Hamel.

Langley raises her gun and shoots without any hesitation. The bullet flies toward Hamel. Right before it hits the target, a mad Corruptor jumps out and takes the bullet for Hamel, vanishing immediately.
But the girl doesn't even glance at it. She only stares at you all curiously, tilting her head.

speaker: Hamel
content: Do you not like Hamel? Why don't you like Hamel?
Perhaps sensing your hostility, like puppets whose strings are pulled, the surrounding Corruptors all turn and start charging at you suddenly!
Hamel tiptoes and lands on the filthy fluid gracefully.

speaker: Hamel
content: They're giving you a warm welcome.

speaker: Hamel
content: Why don't we all have some fun together? It's too dark, too cold here. Why don't we all go to the Carnival together?
Hamel goes through the black mist and walks toward you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't you dare come near him!
female_content: Don't you dare come near her!

content: The Nightmare growls and rushes toward Hamel, attacking her.

speaker: Hamel
content: Argh!

speaker: Hella
content: Did it hit her?!
The attack did hit her. Hamel's chest is hollowed out and her figure is beginning to blur.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Why... Why are you so mean to Hamel?
You hear Hamel's sobs.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Why don't you love Hamel?

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Hamel loves all of you so much... Why do you hate Hamel?
The illusion before you is sobbing indignantly like a little child, wiping the tears on her cheeks with her two hands, as if completely oblivious of the massive hole in her chest.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Sob... Mom... <size=44>Mom...</size>
Crying, the illusion turns and runs behind that enormous curtain and returns into the Black Ring. After that, the mad Corruptors are beginning to disperse.
Everything becomes silent again. The blue light from the base station shines faintly upon the speechless group.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Is something wrong in her head?

speaker: Langley
content: Indeed. She's always been taciturn. And at the peak of Hamel's fame, rumors about her mental issues were rampant online.

speaker: Langley
content: As if validating these rumors, during her last performance, Hamel stood blankly on the grand stage for half an hour and then passed out. After that, she vanished for two years, only reappearing before the public when BR-001 broke out.

speaker: Langley
content: The dance prodigy who hung the moon became a murderous witch. Some say the Black Ring at the Carnival was her revenge on the DisCity...

speaker: Langley
content: What do you think? Sounds like a Mania-themed urban legend, right?

speaker: Langley
content: I can't guarantee that. It happened too long ago, before the 9th Agency was even established. All I can say for sure is that she'll be a very challenging enemy.

speaker: Langley
content: To defeat the real her, the only way is to enter the Black Ring.
Before you can answer, a voice comes in through the speaker on Langley.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Madam, my apologies. This woman insists on speaking to you directly, she...
Before the agent finishes, you hear some background noise. Someone has grabbed the communication device. You hear Nightingale's familiar voice and the uncharacteristic anxiety in it.

speaker: Nightingale
content: What exactly do you want? Where did you take Chief to?

speaker: Langley
content: Relax, Miss Adjutant. Your Chief is right next to me, looking refreshed after his outdoor break.
female_content: Relax, Miss Adjutant. Your Chief is right next to me, looking refreshed after her outdoor break.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm fine. The Sinners are with me too.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I see... That's good...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Please tell me your location and I'll come and pick you up right away. I won't let you go through any more interrogations or let the 9th Agency take you away.

speaker: Langley
content: Are you sure you want to do that? This is your Chief's proposal, after all.

speaker: Langley
content: Your Chief wants to take on the first Black Ring and destroy it. Don't you think this is the best way to clear up all the suspicions?

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're at the Rust?!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, you can't go there. You're still dealing with the after-effects of the Black Ring in the square, and it almost took your life. BR-001 caused over 30 times the casualties done by the Black Ring in the square! It's too dangerous!

speaker: Langley
content: The power behind the Black Rings has begun their action. They won't spare anyone who has damaged a Black Ring.

speaker: Langley
content: Until when can you cover him up? You want him to just sit out this crisis and wait for his death?
female_content: Until when can you cover her up? You want her to just sit out this crisis and wait for her death?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Are you egging him on?
female_content: Are you egging her on?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Listen to me, Chief. The 9th Agency has no right to force you to do anything. I'm already going through the procedures to clarify the facts and clear up any doubts around you. You don't need to risk this.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I understand you may not have faith in me, but please don't put yourself in danger again!
Her voice is sincere but urgent, reminding you of how she risked her own life to protect you when you first met.
But you've already made up your mind.

speaker: Choice
options: Nightingale, it's my own decision to investigate the Black Ring.

speaker: Chief
content: The 9th Agency never forced me, I was the one who proposed it. I'm not doing it to clear up the suspicions around me, but to find out the truth. There are answers I want to look for.
With the little trust you have from the authorities, you don't know if you'll get another chance to approach a Black Ring.

And the closer you get to Black Rings, the firmer your belief becomes—the belief that the confusion the Black Ring has brought you can only be resolved by the Black Ring itself. The mysteries, the enemies, the source—you must search for the truth.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But...

speaker: Choice
options: Trust me, and wait for my return.
This is my own battle, don't hold me back.

content: You cut off the communication.

speaker: Langley
content: Done talking?
You nod. You look toward the two Sinners and see complex expressions on both of their faces.

speaker: Hella
content: ...You must go?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you don't have to follow me. I mean it. I'm a suspect being suspended for investigations. You don't need to listen to my orders.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's my duty to protect you.
She comes next to you. Hella clenches her fists and clicks her tongue impatiently, catching up with you.

speaker: Hella
content: This time your shackles are not linked to that Corpseborne, so I guess the Black Ring won't affect us. Don't touch anything weird once you get in!
The fact that they're willing to come with you makes you both reassured and worried.
Langley gives a gentle smile, watching the three of you.

speaker: Langley
content: Just as I thought, you're an interesting person. If you make it out alive, why don't you transfer to the 9th Agency?

speaker: Hecate
content: He's not leaving the Bureau. ${PlayerName} is our Chief.
female_content: She's not leaving the Bureau. ${PlayerName} is our Chief.

speaker: Langley
content: Haha, you're right. The MBCC people are all so adorable. It'll be a pity if you die here.

speaker: Langley
content: Tell me, what do you need? Other than people, I can get you anything. You see, I must be careful when it comes to my subordinates' lives too.
The mental contamination behind the Black Ring is so overwhelming, that without the shackles, even Sinners can't handle the corruption, let alone ordinary people.

speaker: Chief
content: No need to prepare anything. Regular preparation doesn't do anything to the Black Ring, we can only fight it ourselves.
You hesitate briefly and turn to face Langley. She's freed you—regardless of the reason behind.

speaker: Choice
options: Thank you for giving me this opportunity.

speaker: Chief
content: If you want me to do anything for you, just tell me, and I'll do my best. I don't mind you taking advantage of me.

speaker: Langley
content: Don't worry too much. This is not a mission you can accomplish with a distracted mind, so focus on your objective. What I'm after will come itself.
You nod. As you turn and are about to step out and leave, suddenly, you hear a strange noise.
Clack.
You feel a cold gun barrel pointed to the back of your head.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!
But the intense hostility coming from behind stops any further actions from the Nightmare.

speaker: Langley
content: I don't need you to do anything, but I do have a few words for you.

speaker: Langley
content: I understand you have your own reasons, I pardon your calculations, I let you keep your secrets, and I'm willing to help you achieve your goal.

speaker: Langley
content: In return, I only ask for your <color=#fb9259>loyalty</color>.
You hear a metallic click, an intense rush of power and bloodthirstiness gathering on something hidden deep in the barrel.

speaker: Langley
content: <color=#fb9259>This bullet</color> has been locked onto you. If you dare betray the DisCity... No matter when, no matter where, it can kill you.
You don't turn to look at Langley's gun. You step forward, walking straight toward the red luminous ring.
Where Hamel has disappeared, you touch the edge of the Black Ring for the first time. A white light envelopes you and swallows your consciousness...
The white light fades and you cross the curtain, entering the inside of the Black Ring.
The murky Rust has vanished, together with those mad Corruptors, those menacing black spikes, and that enormous red luminous ring. They have all vanished.
Something is floating down from the sky. You look up and see colorful confetti.
Against the sunny bright sky, a beautiful banner is spread above the amusement park's gate—Welcome to the Carnival.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What? What is this? Why does it look like this inside the Ring?

speaker: Hella
content: Where's the Black Ring? And that Hamel? And all... all those monsters rushing in from the Rust?

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhhh!
She gets hit by something.
Welcome to the land of endless love and joy!
The bunny mascot at the gate is dressed in a ceremonial guard costume and carrying a small drum on its back, beckoning to the visitors.

speaker: Bunny Mascot
content: The <color=#fb9259>Carnival's parade</color> is about to begin! The <color=#fb9259>Carnival's parade</color> is about to begin!
You walk closer to the Carnival's gate, and the bunny mascot freezes for a few seconds. After some cogwheel squeaks, the bunny mascot suddenly reaches out a hand toward you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, watch out!
The three of you are startled, but it only sprinkles a handful of confetti at you, then continues drumming.

speaker: Bunny Mascot
content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome...! Welcome...!

speaker: Hella
content: Phew... That scared me. Is it just a robot?
You give it a squeeze. It's soft, you find no trace of metal.

speaker: Hecate
content: Someone's coming.
To put it precisely, a whole reveling parade is coming. The joyful music, mixed with people's laughter, is crashing near like waves.
On a platform lifted up by mascots and a maneki-neko, a human whose head is replaced by a television is surrounded by flowers. It's announcing something with a microphone.

speaker: Television Person
content: Carnival! Carnival! This is the DisCity's Carnival!

speaker: Television Person
content: Disasters are behind us, paradise is here again! O our great city, pain and fear have passed, hope and joy are the only things to stay!

speaker: People In Parade
content: The great DisCity! <size=33>The great DisCity—!</size>

speaker: Television Person
content: The most wonderful performance is about to begin! Thanks to Hamel! Thanks to Hamel! You give us happiness, you give us love!

speaker: People In Parade
content: <size=44>Hamel—! Hamel—!</size>
Amid the colorful confetti flying in the sky, grand brilliance and ultimate absurdity are intertwined together.

speaker: Hella
content: It doesn't look like this at all from the outside...

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate, have we been teleported somewhere else? Or am I dreaming?

speaker: Hecate
content: This isn't a dream. And we're being surrounded by massive Mania. There's no mistaking it, we're inside the Black Ring.

speaker: Hella
content: But this place is so different from the square. Any street corner in Syndicate seems more intimidating than this place.
You remember it vividly.

Not only that, this place is also different from the basement of SALVA and the Unclaimed Crypt. There aren't any visible contaminations. No frantic, furious monsters. Only a carnival like endless reveries.

speaker: Che
content: This is the Ring born from Zoya. Every rule here, including the laws of physics and spacetime, is governed by her will. This is her realm.
Is it because BR-001's owner has an extraordinarily special mind?
(Transition) Portrait of dark Hamel emerges with laughter
But she doesn't look like someone who's so... cheerful.

speaker: Chief
content: Let's follow the parade and see where it leads us.

speaker: Chief
content: But be careful, I'm afraid this place is not as simple as it appears.
You pass through the amusement park's gate and are about to join the marching parade.
The several mascots closest to you seem to sense something. Their heads turn in unnatural arcs and those big dark eyes are fixed on you.

speaker: Mascots
content: ...Hu...mans? Hahaha, fools!

speaker: Mascots
content: Lost again! Lost again! There are fool who have lost their way again!

speaker: Mascots
content: Send him back, send him back! This is our parade, you shouldn't be here, you don't belong here...
female_content: Send her back, send her back! This is our parade, you shouldn't be here, you don't belong here...

content: They all suddenly turn toward you synchronously. Amid the creepy music, they are swarming in your direction with synchronized footsteps.

speaker: Hella
content: Whoa! We're being attacked, ${PlayerName}, back off, back off...!
No, the mascots are not attacking you. They're only pushing at you, trying to kick you out of the parade.

speaker: Mascots
content: Go back! Go back! This place doesn't belong to you! <size=44>You shouldn't be here...!</size>

speaker: Mascots
content: You won't get to see Hamel—! Hamel won't see you—! <size=44>She won't see you—!</size>

speaker: Hella
content: Are they going nuts?! ${PlayerName}, think of something quick!

speaker: Hella
content: Look, those mascots...!
The defeated mascots reveal their Corruptor appearances for a moment, then transform into colorful foam, melting in the sky and disappearing into the surrounding joy.

speaker: Hella
content: So these guys... were all transformed from Corruptors?

speaker: Hecate
content: Of course this is all an illusion. It's the Sinner Hamel's ability.
This world is real and the Corruptors are real. Invisible contamination and the Black Ring must truly exist too.
But a grander illusion overlays and controls everything, creating a magnificent and colorful delusion.

speaker: Mascots
content: Go back! Go back! This is our parade, you don't belong here!
You've defeated those mascots, but still get pushed to the amusement park's gate by them. The marching crowd has gone back to normal and continues to cheer Hamel's name, marching on.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk, I can't believe they've actually rejected us. Should we try again?
Go back, this is not a place you can wander in.
You hear a voice and turn back to see an old man sitting on some well-concealed steps at the park's entrance.

speaker: Old Man
content: This park doesn't belong to humans... doesn't belong to you.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go back, humans shouldn't step into this park.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...He's human. And he's not an illusion.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go back... No matter how many times you try, you'll never reach her.
You go forward. The old man has white hair and is draped in a tattered colorful flag, leaning on one of the amusement park's flags a little feebly. His consciousness is as murky as his eyes.

speaker: Old Man
content: Yes... Hamel... Beautiful Hamel, gentle Hamel...

speaker: Old Man
content: She can captivate everyone with one single dance... Everyone needs her, everyone chases after her... Everyone loves her...

speaker: Old Man
content: Her dance created the Carnival... Accepting everyone... but me... It doesn't accept humans...

speaker: Old Man
content: This is the Carnival of DisCity, Hamel's Carnival... A paradise created from the most beautiful dance...

speaker: Old Man
content: It's a haven without fear, a sweet dream without pain, a paradise without regrets... An endless carnival...

speaker: Old Man
content: A carnival that rejects humans...

speaker: Old Man
content: I'm here to see her...

speaker: Old Man
content: I want to find Hamel, I want to see her, I want to see it once more... See her dance...

speaker: Old Man
content: But she refuses to see me. I can never enter this world, I can never see her again...
The old man's voice grows lower and lower, repeating the same words blankly.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go away, the park is not for humans, you'll only get lost if you stay...

speaker: Old Man
content: Lost on the way to see her, and you'll never get to see her...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Is this geezer a loony too? He sounds delusional, did he also catch the Mania?

speaker: Hecate
content: Maniacs can't last this long in a Black Ring. He seems to have lingered around here for a long time already, perhaps something unusual has happened to him.

speaker: Hella
content: He looks more like a village chief in a video game who guides you. Makes a good match with that silly mascot at the gate, one to lure you in and the other to scare you away.

speaker: Hella
content: What now? We haven't got any answers and we can't go inside the park. Can we turn back?

speaker: Choice
options: He's said humans don't belong in the Carnival.

content: No matter how well it's concealed by the illusion, this is a parade and paradise for the Corruptors. You still recall vividly, at that moment of discovery, all the Corruptors have their attention on you, not the two Sinners who stepped into the parade first.
Does it make you easier to spot because your M value is constantly low?
If this guess is valid, perhaps there's a way to sneak in. You beckon to the two Sinners.

speaker: Hecate
content: You want us to keep our abilities activated and sneak into the parade?

speaker: Choice
options: I still remember the analysis done by SALVA.

speaker: Anne
content: Both Sinners had high M values which <color=#fb9259>increased significantly when using their abilities</color>.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk, you mean to say we're like monsters, don't you.

speaker: Hella
content: Sigh, whatever, as long as it works. But what are you going to do?

speaker: Choice
options: I'll try to use the shackles, or my power.

content: Strengthening your connection with the Sinners may blur the distinction between you and them.

speaker: Hella
content: ...That doesn't sound like a plan. But anyway, it doesn't hurt to try. The worst case, we get kicked out again. Those guys don't look like they're gonna attack us.
As Hella and Hecate keep their Sinner abilities activated, you walk between the two of them. The three of you sneak into the marching parade again.

speaker: Mascots
content: The performance is about to begin, the performance is about to begin...!

speaker: Mascots
content: Hamel! Hamel! Hamel's performance is about to begin!

speaker: Hella
content: Phew... They don't seem to notice?

speaker: Chief
content: Before that, keep going as far as we can.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, you're sweating buckets, are you alright?

Using the power continuously is quickly exhausting your mental energy. You're beginning to feel worn out and probably can't go on like this for long. You must go as far as possible now and exit the parade before you're completely drained, then find a place to rest.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What a crappy plan you've made, it's clearly not working. Get out, let's get out now, quick...

As she's dragging you out of the parade anxiously, a mascot stumbles by and jostles at Hella. Your formation is disrupted and the mascot happens to fall in front of you, staring into your eyes blankly.

speaker: Mascot
content: Hmm...? Hehe!

speaker: Mascot
content: Lost again! Lost again! <size=44>These fools have lost their way again</size>!

speaker: Hella
content: Oh no!! Again?!

speaker: Choice
options: Get out of the parade now and find somewhere to hide!

content: Finally, before the whole troop of mascots gets to you, you manage to escape the parade and hide behind a candy stall on the roadside.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew... Holy ****, luckily we didn't get thrown out this time. I'd really hate to do that again.

speaker: Choice
options: Let me rest a bit, then we continue.

content: You're still trying to steady your uneven breaths. Hella is watching you gasp for air, her expression growing glum.

speaker: Hella
content: This method totally sucks, it's not working! Stop it now!

speaker: Choice
options: That's the only way to advance.

speaker: Hella
content: I don't care, we're not doing this! Do you want to turn into that horrible thing again?!
She immediately regrets what she said and turns her face away stiffly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I hurt you again, just get rid of me. But it looks like my shackles are safe now, not being connected to the ground zero of the Black Ring.
But it's exactly because you don't get any guidance from the shackles, you've lost your way in the Black Ring's illusory realm like a directionless child.

speaker: Hella
content: **...That's not what I meant.

speaker: Hella
content: In this godforsaken Black Ring, who knows what's going to happen...

speaker: Choice
options: In case of danger, just run.

content: You didn't lie. She grits her teeth and evades your eyes determinedly, sitting down on the other side instead.
You may have imagined it, but ever since stepping into the Black Ring, Hecate has grown even quieter and seemed particularly tense, constantly staying alert to the surroundings.
The shock from BR-004 has not only affected you but also deeply influenced the Sinners who fought alongside you.
You can't read their minds with the shackles. You're unable to clear their confusion, especially when your own problems still remain unsolved.
You've rested enough. The three of you stand up and silently walk into the loud, joyous parade.
Amid cheers and music, the marching crowd grows bigger and bigger.
Being in the crowd makes the bizarreness even more palpable.

speaker: Hella
content: ...These people have terrible fashion taste, they dress worse than penniless Syndicans ten years ago.
You recall the documents about BR-001 you flipped through in the helicopter. The people in the parade are dressed in the same outfits as 23 years ago.

speaker: Television Person
content: Weather Forecast! Weather Forecast! Today is <color=#fb9259>June 27</color>, the weather is sunny! Sunny—!
The sky above the amusement park is indeed bright and clear, without a hint of cloudiness.

speaker: Television Person
content: Let's celebrate the passing of disasters and the reemergence of hope. In the days to come, the weather of the DisCity will keep on being sunny! <size=44>Sunny—!</size>
Time has been turned back to 23 years ago. Or rather, this carnival has been stuck in the day the Black Ring broke out.
You notice a crying clown next to you, the black and red paint all mixed up on his face.

speaker: Weeping Clown
content: There were so many fireworks in the sky... People were blown away by explosions, hahahaha... My dog too, and my family...

speaker: Weeping Clown
content: Hamel, dance, let me see them again, I want to see them again...

speaker: Mascot
content: I'm scared... Hamel, where are you, I'm so scared...

speaker: Mascot
content: I had nightmares again, Hamel, I need to see Hamel...

speaker: Television Person
content: Soothing all pain, bringing love and hope to everyone—

speaker: Television Person
content: Hamel's performance is about to begin! Come join us! Come join us—!

speaker: Television Person
content: New hope—terrible things will never happen again! The DisCity will always stay sunny—!
As Langley said, the Carnival was reopened to rebuild citizens' confidence. You can now genuinely feel the pain the great explosion of DisSea brought to the DisCity.
Because the pain is too excruciating, they long for comfort in imagination, long for Hamel's illusions.
You look toward Hella and Hecate who have been silent for a while, and find that they both look a bit dazed as well.
Hella and Hecate hear your voice, but it takes them a while to respond.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... What just happened? Somehow my brain feels foggy...

speaker: Hecate
content: The illusion has gotten more intense, meaning we're approaching the Carnival's center. If we keep following the parade, we will for sure find Hamel.

speaker: Choice
options: Let's go, I can keep going.

content: Keep... what?
The crowd is slowly moving forward, and a strange white puppet appears between the gap. It doesn't follow the marching crowd and is staring at you quietly.

speaker: Hecate
content: Be careful, this one is different from the other mascots.

speaker: White Puppet
content: Why must you keep going? If you're so scared, why must you keep going?
You feel no hostility from it, but instead you sense sadness in its exposed eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: Who are you?! Are you trying to kick us out too?

speaker: White Puppet
content: My name... is <color=#fb9259>Fear</color>.

speaker: Fear Puppet
content: Conscious human beings should not enter the Carnival, you shouldn't have come here.

speaker: Fear Puppet
content: The <color=#fb9259>Dancer</color> hopes that you can leave.

speaker: Hecate
content: Watch out!

speaker: Hella
content: Did we... win?

speaker: Hecate
content: It's very strong, but it also lacks the desire to attack. Why is this puppet here?

speaker: Fear Puppet
content: Humans can never overcome their own fear, only Hamel can make me forget...

speaker: Fear Puppet
content: I won't let you disturb Hamel...
The Fear Puppet is defeated and vanishes in a cloud of colorful smoke.
The smoke doesn't immediately disperse, but lingers around you.

speaker: Hella
content: Cough, cough... What's this...? Cough...

speaker: Hecate
content: Hold your breath!
The Nightmare fans away the smoke. The stir hasn't drawn more attention from others, and the smoke vanishes.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...It's over. Chief, Hella, are you alright?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Hella?
An ominous feeling is surging from the shackles. Hella lowers her head and her body begins shaking as if she's fallen into a dream, mumbling unconsciously.

speaker: Hella
content: No... That's not true... I'm not... I'm not scared...

speaker: Hella
content: Cough, cough... Where are we now?

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}, Hecate... Where are you?

speaker: Hella
content: This is... Keylan Square. Zoya's Black Ring?

speaker: Hella
content: Why am I back here again?
She stumbles a step backward fearfully.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}, Hecate! Where are you?!

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}!!
Seeing the person she's looking for, Hella is just about to run forward, but the person suddenly growls. Hella halts her steps reflexively.
${PlayerName} raises a hand and keeps punching the person beneath hysterically, one blow after another, as if assaulting an inanimate object.
The usual calmness and kindness are completely gone from ${PlayerName}'s eyes, only fury and violence are left. This unfamiliar and terrifying look is exactly like one of those mad Maniacs.
No, even scarier than them.

speaker: Frenzied Figure
content: You've turned her into a monster!
A punch, then another.

speaker: Frenzied Figure
content: You've twisted everything, you've poisoned Syndicate, you've driven her to this!
036 is being punched like a broken string puppet, blood streaming down onto the filthy ground. Slowly, his voice fades from Hella's ears, and his form becomes indistinguishable in her eyes.

The body is twisted and deformed. Fresh bloodstains cover the spotty ground. Despair and screams are excellent seasoning for the bloodthirsty, fueling the furious monster who is ripping everything apart...
She's seen scenes like this, in that dim lab, in her most detested memories. Hella feels that something is crumbling within her too.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=24>Stop... Stop...</size>

speaker: Frenzied Figure
content: Die!!
036 has been impaled, once again, right before Hella. ${PlayerName} lower his hands. The shackles in his palms have gone out of control, just like red maniac filth.
female_content: 036 has been impaled, once again, right before Hella. ${PlayerName} lower her hands. The shackles in her palms have gone out of control, just like red maniac filth.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}! Stop!
She wants to go forward, but someone suddenly drags her back.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Stay back!

speaker: Hella
content: Ninety-nine, why are you here?!

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Because you're in danger, you need me.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Don't go near him, that's a monster, he'll hurt you. Follow me!
female_content: Don't go near her, that's a monster, she'll hurt you. Follow me!

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName} is not a monster! He's said it before, none of us are monsters! He's not gonna hurt me!
female_content: ${PlayerName} is not a monster! She's said it before, none of us are monsters! She's not gonna hurt me!

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Then why are you so scared?

speaker: Hella
content: I'm... scared?

speaker: Hella
content: ...It's not like that. I've just... never seen him like this.
female_content: ...It's not like that. I've just... never seen her like this.

content: Hella turns toward the person at the distant spot, but he's already come close when she wasn't aware, so close that she can see blood streaming down his face. It's a stranger's face.
female_content: Hella turns toward the person at the distant spot, but she's already come close when she wasn't aware, so close that she can see blood streaming down her face. It's a stranger's face.

speaker: Frenzied Figure
content: ...Hella?
There's no warmth in ${PlayerName}'s eyes. He reaches out a hand to Hella.
female_content: There's no warmth in ${PlayerName}'s eyes. She reaches out a hand to Hella.

content: At that instant, Hella's heart is grabbed by an invisible hand, and her cold body no longer belongs to her.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: No matter how much you treasure him, you can't lie to yourself. You fear this man.
female_content: No matter how much you treasure her, you can't lie to yourself. You fear this woman.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Hella, humans can never overcome their fear.

speaker: (Scene change)
content: Back to the parade

speaker: Mascots
content: <size=44>Hamel! Hamel! The performance is about to begin! Hamel!</size>
The marching crowd is no longer paying any attention to you who stick out like a sore thumb. They're singing and moving forward, pushing you on and separating Hella who's still in a trance from you.
You squeeze your way forward with all your might, trying to grab her, but the reveling crowd is blocking your way.

speaker: Mascots
content: No more fear, no more need to escape, no more nightmares...
You finally make your way forward and grab Hella's hand.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=44>No...!</size>
She shakes off your hand and looks at you with an terrified expression you've never seen. Hella disappears into the crowd, screaming.
Hecate's anxious voice comes from behind. To protect you from getting trampled by the procession, the Nightmare is trying its best to drag you out of the crowd.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella... She's just been captured by the illusion.

speaker: Hecate
content: She didn't mean to do that to you.
You tell yourself.

speaker: Choice
options: Let's go after her and take her back.

content: You can still make it. You must catch up with her.

speaker: Hecate
content: But Chief... Can we still catch up with her?
Da-da-da-da-da!

speaker: Bunny Mascot
content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome! Welcome—!
Confetti is flying in the sky, and the bunny mascot is still beating the drum on its chest mechanically.
The old man draped in the tattered flag is still sitting on the steps at the Carnival's gate.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...We're... back again.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go away, the park is not for humans, you'll only get lost if you stay...

speaker: Old Man
content: Lost on the way to see her, and you'll never get to see her...
This is Hamel's power. This is the <color=#fb9259>Endless Carnival</color>. You can't even get close to her, let alone defeat the Ring's owner.

speaker: Fear Puppet
content: Conscious human beings should not enter the Carnival, you shouldn't have come here... The Dancer hopes that you can leave.
Everywhere touched by the Ring is her realm. Without her permission, you're not even allowed to step inside.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go back... The park doesn't welcome humans, and obsession will only make you lose yourself. She won't see you, she never will...
That's not someone you can reach with your shackles. You can't go inside her heart, you haven't even received a hint of guidance about her whereabouts.

speaker: Hella
content: ...You must go?

speaker: Hella
content: No... That's not true... I'm not... I'm not scared...

speaker: Hella
content: <size=44>No...!</size>

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief... Are you alright?
She pauses, then obligingly places her hand on your stretched out hand. You grip her hand tightly.
You've already lost one companion, you can't lose another.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...You still want to go inside the Carnival?

speaker: Choice
options: The crowd's attention is all on the performance now.

speaker: Chief
content: They've stopped paying attention to me just now. Rather than banishing an intruder like me, they care more about Hamel's upcoming performance.
The one that kicked you out was the white puppet, and you've already maimed it. Now you at least have a chance, Hamel's performance gives you the best chance.
Hella is still inside the illusory realm. She entered the Black Ring to protect you. No matter what, you must find her.
You stand up and walk forward, but the hand you're holding is briefly hesitant. Hecate doesn't follow you immediately. Her head is bowed and you can't see her face.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I'm fine.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'll follow Chief's orders. I'll protect you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Let's go.
She catches up with your footsteps and you walk forward together, the old man's voice fading behind you.

speaker: Old Man
content: You... won't get to see her...

speaker: (Scene change)
content: Parade

speaker: Bunny Mascot
content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome to the Carnival! The performance is about to begin! The performance is about to begin—!

You rejoin the parade. Like it did last time, the bunny mascot reaches out to sprinkle confetti over you. This time, the mascots have fallen into an even deeper mania, no one is aware of the presence of a human being.

But no matter which direction you go, you feel like you're not advancing at all. The buildings on both sides seem to be reappearing in a loop and strange music keeps interrupting your senses, and once you quit the parade, you'll be sent back to the beginning.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is a maze of illusions... We can't find the way forward.

speaker: Choice
options: Then let's focus all our attention on the mascots around us.

content: The mascots around you come and go in waves. You're certain some of them did successfully get to the destination, exit the parade, and get replaced by new ones.

speaker: Hecate
content: I see. Then let's...
Hehehe...

speaker: Hecate
content: Who are you?!
You suddenly notice a creepy little doll sitting on the shoulder of the mascot in front of you.

speaker: Little Doll
content: Are you here for the performance too? How I wish to see Hamel perform too!
The wooden doll wears a fluffy dress and has a winding key on its back. It's staring at you with a smile. Whenever it speaks, its chin twitches mechanically.

speaker: Creepy Doll
content: I know where she is, I know where she is!
The doll hops off the mascot's shoulder.

speaker: Creepy Doll
content: Follow me! Let's go and watch the performance together! Follow me!
The creepy doll's voice keeps luring you, tempting you to follow it into the depths of the amusement park.
It's so different from everything in this park, but somehow you have a vague memory of this feeling...
It's her!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief... What should we do?

speaker: Choice
options: Grab onto me and follow it.

speaker: Creepy Doll
content: We're here! We're here! Come out!
It leads you out of the crowd, this time not to the park's entrance. You see an enormous Ferris wheel you've never seen before.
The marching crowd streams before you like a colorful river. On the other side of the river, you see a strange man clad in black.
The hood of the black raincoat covers his face. He stands out in the park, exuding an extremely ominous aura.

speaker: Creepy Doll
content: The audience are here! The audience are here! I want to perform too, I want to perform too! Let me dance!

speaker: Man In Raincoat
content: ...Your wish... will be granted...

speaker: Man In Raincoat
content: <size=44>I... witness!</size>
He raises his hand to cover his hidden face, crooked tentacles of smoke are seeping out from beneath the hood.
As if scorched by an invisible brand, a fearsome motif is left on the back of the hand. You recognize this motif...
You knew it. This Black Ring has to do with them too?!

The mark begins to burn and spread quickly, devouring his entire body within seconds. Amid the flames, his whole body is cramping, his hands are reaching toward the sky, and finally he lets out an unhuman growl.

speaker: Man In Raincoat
content: Roarrrr...!

speaker: Hecate
content: Those flames are... contamination!!

Within seconds, he is burned to ashes like paper. Yet the black fire does not go out. It spreads to the surrounding marching crowd, creating a gap with its flames. The mascots that have caught fire scream painfully, instantly possessed.
In the center of the black fire, the creepy doll is absorbing everything around it. The fire envelops her body and she's growing bigger, her true form revealed from this nirvana...

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Hahahaha...! We meet again!

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Come on, my dear audience, you want to see Hamel, don't you? Don't you want to see her dance?

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: <size=44>I'll grant your wish!</size>
The mascots have been defeated, but they're still dragging their bodies burning with the black fire and crawling toward Hamel's illusion.

speaker: Mascots
content: Hamel... Hamel...

speaker: Mascots
content: Arghhh...! Hamel! Help me!

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: I will, I will! As long as you love me, and you will always love me, won't you?
Hamel raises her hand, and black flames are spreading from her palm. The surrounding mascots are possessed by her, and are getting devoured by her one after another!

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: What about you?
Hamel turns to look at you, an innocent but cruel smile still on her face.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: What a wonderful performance, do you like it?
She shrieks with innocent and insane laughter.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Hahaha... Of course I'm Hamel, everyone's favorite <size=44>Hamel</size>!
The black flames in her hand begins to surge, spreading in all directions at a faster rate now, devouring the parade and the park, charging at you!
Stop.
Suddenly, a tall puppet emerges before you, driving out the black flames.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: ...It's you?
The tall puppet stands before you, confronting the black illusion.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: I... know you.
A smile shows on her face.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Your name is <color=#fb9259>Misery</color>. Are you here to watch me perform too?

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: ...I'm here to stop you.
The puppet's voice is very sad.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: You shouldn't contaminate the park, and you shouldn't harm the Dancer.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: ...Contaminate? ...Harm? Why would I do that? This is my park, I am your Dancer.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: I've been waiting for you, waiting for you to find me...

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: ...But you've never come to look for me.
The puppet doesn't answer. It reaches out a hand and white mist breaks through the black flames, enveloping the illusion.

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Whom we need is not you...

speaker: Phantom Hamel
content: Ah... Why must you treat me like this... When I... like you so much...
Hamel is forced into a slumber, vanishing with the white mist wrapping around her.
Is this puppet... helping you?
But what just happened confuses you a little.
The puppet named Misery turns to face you, but doesn't answer your question.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: You all should leave too.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!
Once again, white mist is seeping out of Misery.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: Leave this place and go back to your own world. This is the dancer's wish, don't intrude into the park created by her.
This isn't just about you anymore. In order to rescue your companion and to confront the enemies behind everything, you cannot leave.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: ...Why are you so stubborn? Why can't you just let go?

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: Let go, as early as you can, as soon as you can, before you get even more entangled in it. This way, when the day comes that it gets taken away from you, at least you won't feel as painful.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm not going to listen to you.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: You just don't understand, but... someone else does.
Hecate is standing behind you, entangled in the white mist when you weren't aware, her frail body shaking violently.

speaker: Hecate
content: No... I don't feel pain... I've long given up feelings like that.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: Then let go...

speaker: Hecate
content: I won't!
She grips your hand like it's taking all of her strength to do so. The Nightmare charges at it, roaring.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: See, you haven't given it up... It's exactly because you can't give it up... you can't run away from pain...
You shield Hecate with your body, releasing all your power desperately. You've already lost one companion, you can't risk losing all.
The Misery Puppet transforms into a cloud of white smoke and vanishes. You are all once again exiled back to the amusement park's gate.
Back to square one.
You're still gripping Hecate's hand, but she's no longer here.
No matter how many times you call her name, she won't answer.
The shackles can't locate her, and those unfocused eyes can't see you anymore.
She's not here anymore, only the old man's voice is echoing in your ears.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go back...

speaker: Old Man
content: The park is not for humans, you'll only get lost if you stay for too long...

speaker: Old Man
content: Lost on the way to see her, and you'll never get to see her...
He leans onto the stone steps, repeating the Carnival's endless curse.
You're all alone now.

speaker: Bunny Mascot
content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome to the Carnival!

speaker: Bunny Mascot
content: Welcome—! Welcome—!
The bunny mascot is beating the drum cheerfully, as if mocking your overconfidence.
You were too conceited. You thought if you kept on fighting, you could keep advancing. You underestimated the Blissful Illusion, and you underestimated Hamel.
You brought the two of them into the Black Ring, and now you've lost them.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go back, leave this place.

speaker: Old Man
content: You'll only get lost if you stay for too long, lost on the way to see her...

speaker: Old Man
content: This is Hamel's park, if she doesn't want to see you, you'll never get to see her.
The two of them came for you. Enduring fear and pain, just because you asked, they stepped inside the Black Ring again. It was all about you, but you've gotten them into this and put them in danger.
You have no way back, you can't leave. You have to rescue them, you must rescue them. Now that this has happened, it's impossible to stop fighting now. You step forward.

speaker: Old Man
content: What can you do all by yourself?
...You've got nothing to lose, at least.
But as soon as you take a step forward, someone grabs your arm.

speaker: (Transition)
content: Fade in portrait of Hecate with her head bowed

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Don't go... Please...
Hecate mumbles with her trembling voice. You don't know what kind of painful dream she's having, but you're surprised to see that usually expressionless girl become so vulnerable.
You recall that she's also stifled a few comments and forced herself to follow your orders before.
So this is what she's been wanting to say. She's feeling so anxious just because of you.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go back, that's her wish too.
You've been shouldering this alone and been tensed up for so long. In your mind, the Black Ring has never been gone. It weighs down on your everything heavily, distracting you from everything else.
Strangely enough, seeing someone feel so genuinely worried for you and willing to risk their life for you, you feel the weight you've been carrying alone get lifted off you gently.
At the other end of the shackles, in the depths of the mist, someone still cares about you. Just realizing this clears the despair you were feeling about the hopeless plight before you.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Please... Please...
She still refuses to let go. You don't struggle free from her grip, but instead you turn around to hug her gently.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Please....

speaker: Chief
content: The owner of the illusory realm means no harm. I only want to talk to her.

speaker: Chief
content: More importantly, the shackles are still here, still linking you and me together. I'm not fighting alone.

speaker: Chief
content: Thank you for always protecting me.

speaker: Choice
options: Let go... This time, it's my turn to protect you.

content: Hecate's hand is shaking, trying to hold onto you tightly, but the red light gleaming around her collarbones is slowly making that harder for her.
She finally releases her hand. This is the first shackles you've ever given, an absolute order a Sinner cannot defy.
You lead Hecate, who has ceased resisting, to the old man. You stoop down to talk to him while facing him at eye level.

speaker: Old Man
content: Go back... You...

speaker: Choice
options: Sir, I'm going to meet Hamel.

speaker: Chief
content: Could you please look after this child for me? I'm sure she'll be safe next to you.

speaker: Old Man
content: The park doesn't welcome you... Hamel, she's not going to see you...

speaker: Choice
options: That's okay, I'm the one to go see her.

speaker: Old Man
content: ...You're going alone...?

speaker: Choice
options: Yes, I'm going to bring them back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The people I care about the most are trapped in the Carnival, I can't leave them there all alone.

speaker: Old Man
content: ..You care about the most...
In a daze, he lifts his gaze to look at you, seemingly trying to recall something or trying his best to look at your face.

speaker: Old Man
content: ...Me too...

speaker: Old Man
content: I want to... bring her back too...
His voice changes. The old man fishes out a locket from the front of his clothing and opens it. There's a slightly faded photo inside.
In the picture is a beautiful woman with sea-blue hair and rose-red eyes. She is staring into the camera quietly and smiling gently.
The old man doesn't answer your question, but murmuring to himself tremulously.

speaker: Old Man
content: I want to see her again too... I want to watch her dance again...

speaker: Old Man
content: Please... bring her back...

speaker: Heh, it's only been a few years since the Abel incident, and Bernadette still has her sights on the Speaker's position... I don't think the Cavendish family will be able to come back from this ever again.
content: Don't leave her by herself... I didn't want to... leave her all alone...

speaker: Old Man
content: I want to... apologize to her...
He looks up at you, and through those murky eyes, you see rose-red irises resembling the ones in the picture.
You take the old man's locket.
The illusory realm has amplified your senses. You feel the heavy longing the locket carries, as well as a familiar aura—that of a Sinner, that of the illusory realm's owner.

speaker: Choice
options: Shackles, take me where the person in the picture is.

content: Red light glows in your hand gripping the locket, transforming into thorns that meander forward. You follow them.
You pass through the entrance you've returned to countless times, and pass through colorful ribbons flying in the air—
Passing through the parade, the music and cheers slowly fading—
Under the shackles' guidance, you find a tranquil lake and see the woman in the picture.
Amid the dense mist, many photo frames are floating above the lake. At the center of the lake, she's dressed in a white dance costume and leaning against a photo frame, dozing in frozen time.
She opens her eyes slightly.

speaker: Hamel
content: ...The audience is here...

speaker: Hamel
content: I have to start dancing...
The tips of her toes tap the surface of the lake, stirring up ripples. The Dancer has gone onto her stage.
With the clear sky reflected on the lake, it's like the tips of Hamel's toes are tapping the sky when they're tapping the water.

Her movements have an elegant rhythm to them, playing a song on the soundless stage of the lake. The dance has a special charm that makes it impossible for the audience to look away, sweeping away all their depressing thoughts.

The white dress and water-blue long hair stream across each other, and the dense mist flows with their movements, forming a vague illusion gradually, enveloping her. Vaguely, you hear continuous whispers.

speaker: Faint Voice
content: The show has begun... Hamel is dancing for us...

speaker: Faint Voice
content: So beautiful... So warm... Am I home... Am I dreaming?

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Touch me, Hamel... Let me feel that I still exist...
Hamel doesn't answer. Her arms draw beautiful curves, gently caressing the fairies approaching her. The illusions' quivering wails slowly subside.

The chaotic parade, the lurking contamination, and the cruel Black Ring shrouding everything are all gone. Such beauty is just like an all-accepting kindness. It's as if just by staring at her, you can gain eternal happiness.
...So unreal.
Give my companions back to me.
Hamel doesn't respond and keeps twirling. It's as if she can't hear your voice.
You walk forward, treading on the lake like treading on the reflected sky, carrying the rings of ripples as you make your way to the Dancer at the center of the lake.

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Someone's coming... Someone's coming...

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Who are you? Why are you intruding on her stage? Why are you disturbing Hamel?

speaker: Faint Voice
content: ...A human? Are you... a human?
The mist is gradually stirring, gathering to form one mascot after another. They put themselves between you and Hamel, pushing and pulling at you to banish you.

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Go back, human! Don't come near Hamel! Don't you dare harm Hamel!
Refusing to back off, you reach out your hand and prepare to fight using the shackles' power. At the moment the shackles get activated, water splashes up, and two familiar figures emerge before you.
The illusions remain silent. Despite their insubstantial form, they still shield you with their bodies.

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Sobs... It hurts... It... hurts...

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Hamel... Must protect Hamel... We can't let the human hurt Hamel...
You want to fan away what's blocking you, but find yourself passing through it directly. You can't hurt it, but it can't touch you either.
Is that... Sinner's power?

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Hamel... Hamel...
The Dancer at the center of the lake is still twirling, her body radiating a glimmer of light, protecting those illusions.
She doesn't answer, nor does she stop dancing.
You walk toward the center of the lake alone, pass through the white illusions, and arrive before Hamel.
Up close, she looks more mature than the woman in the picture. She's gentle, quiet, free of hostility, and indifferent to your arrival.
You raise your hand.

speaker: Faint Voice
content: No... No... Hamel... Hamel!
Your hand touches her and the shackles are activated, yet your hand only passes through her body, the red light shining onto void.
Hamel doesn't answer. The hem of her dress brushes against you, surprisingly removing all weariness from you.
She's... healing you?
The black Hamel was an illusion, and the Hamel before you is an illusion too. Has the shackles' guidance been wrong? Where is the real her? Where's the owner of the Black Ring?
Give up, you can't disturb her.
Behind you, another unseen puppet emerges. Just as you're about to resist, it raises its hand slightly, and the Sinners' illusions shielding you vanish.
They're merely illusions of your longing formed at the center of the illusory realm, they're not your companions.
This is her stage. We love her deeply and we protect her. On your own, you can't defeat Hamel.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: I'm the Dancer's protector, my name is <color=#fb9259>Void</color>.

speaker: Choice
options: ...Are you here to banish me too?

speaker: Void Puppet
content: There's no need, you can't do anything. Plus, now...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: I'd rather watch her dance quietly. Why don't you join me?
The Void Puppet takes a step forward and stands right beside you, staring at Hamel quietly. You look at it silently. Indeed, you can't do anything, but this one looks like... it's willing to talk.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Beautiful, isn't it? Once you see her dance, your heart regains peace.
Give my companions back to me.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: They're only captured by the trauma in their own hearts. If you promise to leave, I can send you all back.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: But... You're all so sad already, why don't you stay and watch her for a while?

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Hamel comforts everyone and soothes their pain and fear. She does that all the time, leading us out of our trauma.

speaker: Choice
options: By trauma, do you mean DisSea Explosion?

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Maybe. Actually I don't quite remember.
Its gaze is indecipherable.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The Fear Puppet can't forget its fear, so it hides in its shell to escape from its nightmares. The Misery Puppet can't forget its misery, so the only way it can survive is through self-punishment.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: As for me, I don't remember anything, and I just don't find meaning in anything. No matter how you try to escape or struggle free from it, in the face of a massive disaster, all the pride of human beings is ultimately vulnerable.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: If there was indeed a great explosion, then all it left me was a feeling of emptiness...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Those who come to the Carnival all have a dark hollow in their hearts. We just want to forget for a while, trying to fill it with all these confetti, music, and the carnival.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: No, no matter how intense the pleasure, it belongs to others. Once the clamorous music stops, we're left on our own again, feeling even emptier inside.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The carnival cannot stop, we want to keep on reveling, but it can't replace everything we've lost. Fear, pain, emptiness, insanity... All these emotions, constantly surging and surging...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The more we want to forget, the more deeply we get trapped in them... Slowly, we don't even remember ourselves anymore. Only that hollow keeps getting bigger and bigger...
It's contamination, it's Mania. Are they under the influence of the Carnival Black Ring too? Or is that a first sign of a Black Ring eruption?
In any case, although still sentient, this puppet's spirit is already tattered.

speaker: Choice
options: This is only an illusory carnival, it can't save anyone.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: I know, only she can save us...
He looks at Hamel in an infatuated manner.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The most beautiful dancer in the DisCity, a real prodigy, she is art itself, she is the idol everyone pursues.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The most glamorous stage was prepared for her. The most luxurious flowers and wine surrounded her. She's been lifted to the clouds. But even so, she still loves us...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: All our unspeakable sorrow, all our inexpressible pain, she understands everything and empathizes with us, mourning on behalf of us with her dance.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: When the carnival was in full swing, with the sky glowing red, people started carousing and tussling. I saw my body going contorted, and when I thought everything was going to end in this madness... Hamel showed up.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: She said that... she would stay, and that she was willing to dance for us. She's never stopped ever since, she's kept on dancing. She dances for us, healing our fear, pain, and emptiness.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: It's she who ended that red inferno and created the beautiful Carnival.

speaker: Choice
options: ...Does she think so? Do you guys understand her?

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The Dancer doesn't need to be greeted. She only needs to dance. We'll be her audience.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: We praise the park she's created.

speaker: Choice
options: This is only an illusion created by her.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: So what? We've already seen annihilation long ago. There was only insanity in this world. She's taken us out of the abyss, only she can bring us redemption.

You suddenly realize the lakeside has become fully lined with mascots who have returned from the parade. Among them, there are clowns with tear-smudged makeup, mascots gasping for air, and even more people tainted by contamination.

speaker: Audience
content: I'm scared... The nightmares have returned... I'm scared...

speaker: Audience
content: I feel so lonely... I'm all by myself, I feel so lonely...

speaker: Audience
content: I'm lost, I've lost my way home... Help me...

speaker: Audience
content: Dance for me... Hamel... We love you...
Hamel doesn't answer. The ripples produced by the tips of her toes have spread under their feet. Everything around the lake of the illusory realm moves at her command.
The dense mist transforms into fantastical jellyfish which follow her twirling dance and drift to the audience, peeling the grayness off their bodies bit by bit.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: This is the last bit of redemption we have left. Don't take her away...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Otherwise, no matter who it is, I will banish them.
As he speaks, he turns back and takes out his black cane.
A whining mascot barges into the crowd. Black flames have been ignited on his body—the flames of the accomplices behind the plot in the square, those men in black raincoats.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Someone is trying to harm Hamel... Are they your companions?
More and more contaminated mascots coming from the parade are filling up the lakeside.

speaker: Contaminated Mascot
content: Hahaha—! Hamel—! Dance for me, Hamel—!

speaker: Contaminated Mascot
content: Give me joy! Give me sweet dreams! Let me indulge in the Carnival, let everyone indulge in the Carnival—!
They are crossing the lake and contamination is flowing into the water. Hamel's expression turns painful and her movements are becoming heavy, as if something is binding her.
But she doesn't stop dancing. White mist envelopes the contaminated mascots, as if trying to extinguish the black flames contaminating them.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: (Pants) Hamel...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: See, she has healed us and saved us. She won't abandon us.

speaker: Choice
options: I see the contamination expanding, the enemies are right before us.

content: You recognize these black flames, they're brought by the men in black raincoats, brought by the dark Hamel. The two opposing presences in the Carnival have never manifested themselves more vividly.

One wants you to leave, the other is luring you to go deeper inside. One repairs, the other contaminates. Are they the same person? Are they two personas split up by the Black Ring? Or are they conspiring together behind some kind of scheme?
You have no time to play detective. But you're certain the relentless contamination is real and is concealed by the illusion of healing, stopping you from locating the true source behind the mist.

speaker: Choice
options: Make her lift the illusions, so you can find out the enemies!

speaker: Chief
content: Illusions cannot undo the Black Ring. While you're numbing yourselves with delusion, this illusory park is already in tatters.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: No... Hamel will heal everything.

speaker: Choice
content: The one who contaminates the Carnival is the other illusion of Hamel's.
options: The one who contaminates the Carnival is the other illusion of Hamel's.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: No! Hamel will never do such a thing to us, she's protecting us. Something else has brought the contamination, not Hamel!

speaker: Choice
options: Then take me to the real her.

content: Let me talk to the <color=#fb9259>Sinner Hamel</color>.
The Void Puppet falls into an awkward silence.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: ...No, this is Hamel, Hamel is right here.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The park cannot cease. All of us will protect her, protect Hamel's Carnival.
At this point, conversations with it is meaningless. The illusory lake is getting contaminated with every moment, and this illusionary wonderland will fall apart sooner or later.
The Hamel in white dress is gradually getting entangled in the filth. Her dance has changed, expressing a genuine sorrow, her own sorrow, or perhaps the sorrow she's feeling from the mascots.
If she isn't willing to stop... you'll go and look for the source of the contamination.
Hahaha...
From the parade crowd, two familiar faces emerge.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Fear... Misery...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Why are you here? Come back, we need to protect Hamel.

speaker: Fear Puppet & Misery Puppet
content: Protect Hamel... Protect... the Carnival...

speaker: Fear Puppet & Misery Puppet
content: Hamel... wants that man...
female_content: Hamel... wants that woman...

content: You become alert instantly. Which Hamel?
The two puppets point at you and suddenly lose their voices. Their limbs look like they're being pulled by strings, black flames spreading onto their bodies through invisible fine threads.
The other ends of the threads are gripped by the eerie man in raincoat.

speaker: Man in Raincoat
content: Sacrifice... sacrifice everything...!
The black flames on his body keep burning, wreaking havoc and fusing into the puppets' bodies little by little.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: Aaahhh...!

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The mascots... The mascots are multiplying!
The self-immolation of the man in raincoat attracts even more contaminated puppets. They tear apart the white fairies trying to heal them and charge at Hamel!
The three puppets are gradually being contaminated, even the Void Puppet's body is plagued by black flames.

speaker: Choice
options: I'll say this one more time, ask Hamel to lift the illusions!

speaker: Chief
content: Give me back my companions. We can fight, we need to find the real enemy and defeat them!

speaker: Void Puppet
content: No... You can't... You can't crush the illusory realm...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: I will... protect Hamel...

speaker: Choice
options: What can you protect while refusing to see the reality?

content: You're turning a blind eye to the real crisis. The Black Ring is right here, and you're just deceiving yourself if you refuse to wake up from this so-called sweet dream. It's already taken my two companions!

speaker: Void Puppet
content: You can't save them anyway. You're alone, you lack the power to fight and resist.
The black flames travel across the illusory lake and spread onto the Void Puppet's body. Its sanity is beginning to waver, revealing its most primal madness—It's Mania!

speaker: Void Puppet
content: That's right, you should come too... You should join the parade, indulge in the Carnival with us, then you can see them again...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: This is Hamel's mercy. She'll heal you too, she'll save you from loneliness... The park is her wish.
She, healing me?
You look toward the contaminated center of the lake and see Hamel almost kneeling down.

speaker: Choice
options: No, she's always known she can't heal anyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I acknowledge her kindness. She's putting in so much effort to alleviate your pain. It's probably merciful of her, and I can trust this Hamel.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But even she knows that this park is merely an illusion. That's why she keeps banishing me, banishing every human trying to enter the Carnival. She knows she can't offer real redemption.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Shut up... Shut up... What do you know...

speaker: Void Puppet
content: Hamel is dancing for us, we must protect her, we're protecting the Carnival...

speaker: Choice
options: You're only obsessing over the illusory sweet dream.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If this goes on, you'll only fall into hell with this Carnival, taking her kindness with you!
Falling into hell together... Wouldn't that be nice?
Chuckles from the black illusion come from the void.
You grow vigilant and scan the surroundings, but the black illusion is nowhere to be seen.
You don't remember me? It's me, Hamel, I'm Hamel.
Hahaha, you're right, not yet. She won't let me out, she always makes me... go back to sleep...
But I want to dance with her too, I want to share the joy with everyone, I want everyone's love too...
The black flames on the puppets grow even more terrifying with Phantom Hamel's voice.
No worries, I'll be free very soon... My dear, I'll come to you all, I'll love you all, I'll bring you all the true paradise.
I'm omnipresent, I'm the true owner of the Black Ring, this is my carnival...
You decide not to bother with the void voice, and turn to shout at the phantom in the heart of the lake.
Give my Sinners back to me! I must fight!
It's useless. That's only an illusion with preset insistence. Hamel can't watch them suffer, so she'll keep on dancing forever, until the end.

The white Hamel doesn't respond. She's still dancing, although it's almost impossible to completely purify the black flames on the mascots now. The spinning dance costume looks like white flames, about to burn her to ashes on stage.

speaker: Choice
options: Lift the illusions, let me return to reality and fight!

speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
content: Nooo...!
The black energy ball knocks you out. Standing before you are the three puppets completely controlled by the black flames and countless mascots swarming near.

speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
content: This is... our park...

speaker: Mascots
content: Banish him! Banish him!
female_content: Banish her! Banish her!

speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
content: No one can... damage our park...!!

speaker: Mascots
content: Kill him! Kill him!
female_content: Kill her! Kill her!

content: You stand up from the surface of the contaminated illusory lake, power concentrated in your palm.
Does it not hurt? Using this kind of power here must have already exhausted you, no? Can you still see clearly?

Your vision has become blurry and the sounds in your ears keep fading in and out. The glowing blue light radiating from the dancer is trying to lessen your burden, but it soon gets devoured by the contamination too.
You're surrounded by the contaminated crowd. They keep pushing and tearing at you. You're still gripping the shackles tightly, but there is no response from the other end.

options: Wake the power and fight on!

content: Still resisting? Poor thing... You're all by yourself already...
Shivering, Hella is curled up in Ninety-Nine's embrace, covering her eyes wide with fear and trembling all over.
The image of that person covered in blood and reaching out a hand to her is too terrifying. Hella is still unable to shake that deep fear.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: It's okay, Hella... I'm here.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: He can't hurt you... Nobody can hurt you...
female_content: She can't hurt you... Nobody can hurt you...

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Stay here, stay next to me, don't go anywhere...

speaker: Hella
content: Stay here... Don't go... anywhere...?
Where is she? Where did she want to go?

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Don't overthink... You're already spooked out... Don't force yourself to go back.

speaker: Hella
content: Go back... to where...?
Her memories have blurred. Not long ago, she seemed to be going in circles in a super weird amusement park. She didn't like that place, but still she followed someone there.
Because ${PlayerName} wanted to go there. ${PlayerName} said it was important for him. So Hella tagged along.
female_content: Because ${PlayerName} wanted to go there. ${PlayerName} said it was important for her. So Hella tagged along.

content: That person brings too much trouble. I simply had to go and help.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Where is ${PlayerName}?

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: I pushed him away. You know full well too, that one's a monster who will harm you. You've seen the real him.
female_content: I pushed her away. You know full well too, that one's a monster who will harm you. You've seen the real her.

speaker: Hella
content: I'd never seen him like that before... It was so scary...
female_content: I'd never seen her like that before... It was so scary...

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Yes, you don't know him at all. That person is dangerous, we must stay away from him.
female_content: Yes, you don't know her at all. That person is dangerous, we must stay away from her.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Stay here, stay next to me. This is the only place where you don't need to feel any fear.
Phantom Ninety-Nine's arms wrapping around Hella grow firmer, locking her in tightly, wanting to keep her in this illusory realm forever.
Hella squeezes her eyes shut, but her body still hasn't stopped trembling.
...Are you still... worried about him?
female_content: ...Are you still... worried about her?

content: A vague voice suddenly rings in Hella's ears.

speaker: Hella
content: Who? Who's talking?
He's... looking for you too. In order to find you, he's fighting with all his might... alone...
female_content: She's... looking for you too. In order to find you, she's fighting with all her might... alone...

speaker: Hella
content: Is he in trouble?!
female_content: Is she in trouble?!

content: Hella's eyes snap open. She can't find the voice's owner, but sees a hint of light blue glow vanish before her eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! Explain! What happened to ${PlayerName}?!

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Hella, what's the matter?

speaker: Hella
content: I need to go back! I knew it, that idiot has gotten himself in trouble again, I need to go back and save him!
female_content: I need to go back! I knew it, that idiot has gotten herself in trouble again, I need to go back and save her!

content: Ninety-Nine grabs Hella's shoulders hard.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: That's not the ${PlayerName} you know! That's a monster, a monster that will harm you!

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Aren't you scared of him?!
female_content: Aren't you scared of her?!

speaker: Hella
content: I am!

speaker: Hella
content: I get scared when Ninety-Nine go nuts and bite me too. You all do these crazy things all the time. I'll admit I'm not the bravest person in the world, it's normal to feel scared from time to time!
She shouts, all her reactions here genuine and unconcealed in this place.

speaker: Hella
content: I remember it now. ${PlayerName} became like that to save Zoya.

speaker: Hella
content: He looked like a different person at the time not because he'd changed, but because he was being tortured, he'd suffered so much! I'd never seen ${PlayerName} look so agonized, and it was all for saving a friend.
female_content: She looked like a different person at the time not because she'd changed, but because she was being tortured, she'd suffered so much! I'd never seen ${PlayerName} look so agonized, and it was all for saving a friend.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName} has never changed, he's always been that dumb idiot I know! I must go back and save him!
female_content: ${PlayerName} has never changed, she's always been that dumb idiot I know! I must go back and save her!

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: You can't go! Your heart hasn't regained peace. It's confused and nervous, you're feeling scared!
