speaker: Hella
content: I'm just pissed! Pissed that I can't do anything, so pissed!

speaker: Hella
content: That's my friend, you know? I'm all about protecting my friends, like I always protect Ninety-Nine!
She struggles free from the constraint and stands up. Ninety-Nine's figure is beginning to blur.

speaker: Hella
content: I recall now. I recall everything now, about that idiot, about you too. You're definitely not Ninety-Nine.

speaker: Hella
content: Ninety-Nine will never ask me to abandon my friend! Don't ******* pretend to be her and say these disgusting words to me!
Ninety-Nine's illusion falls apart, transforms into a blurred human shape, then turns into foam and vanishes.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew... I feel much better now. You loser, you can't compare to the real her at all. Ninety-Nine is not that weak.

speaker: Hella
content: But I didn't expect they could show up here as well. Are the illusions really that powerful? Or... somehow you're not completely useless?
She lifts her right leg slightly and the red brand emerges faintly on her ankle, the brand of the shackles she's been given.

speaker: Hella
content: Humph, never thought a day would come that I'd have to rely on this thing. Take me to that person, then.

speaker: Hella
content: That idiot has created so many problems, I have to go and save the day. I must go back!
She swings the pipe, and with a blow, she shatters the illusory realm around her!

speaker: Maimed Figure
content: Even so, I...

The illusory realm surrounds Hecate. Before her, ${PlayerName} is fighting the contaminated mascots alone, the power draining his spirit. He falls down time and time again, and gets back up each time.
female_content: The illusory realm surrounds Hecate. Before her, ${PlayerName} is fighting the contaminated mascots alone, the power draining her spirit. She falls down time and time again, and gets back up each time.

content: Hecate is watching this blankly, a blurred illusion standing next to her.

speaker: Hecate
content: I know this is all just an illusion.

speaker: Hecate
content: You're making me see this so I'll feel the same pain you're feeling. But this is pointless, I don't feel any pain.

speaker: Hecate
content: Release me, protecting Chief is my duty. That's the meaning of my existence.

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: I don't cause pain in others, I only rouse their emotions.

speaker: Hecate
content: I've given up all my emotions long ago. I'll say this once more, release me.

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: If you had really given them up, you wouldn't have been here. You chose to stay...
The illusion begins transforming, eventually turning into a duplicate of herself.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief needed to go into the Black Ring, you were supposed to follow him everywhere. His orders are the sole meaning of your existence.
female_content: Chief needed to go into the Black Ring, you were supposed to follow her everywhere. Her orders are the sole meaning of your existence.

speaker: Hecate
content: But you doubted his orders and didn't catch up with him. You halted your steps and stayed still. That was why he had no choice but to go on alone, getting trapped in danger all by himself.
female_content: But you doubted her orders and didn't catch up with her. You halted your steps and stayed still. That was why she had no choice but to go on alone, getting trapped in danger all by herself.

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't you want to protect him? Are you doubting him?
female_content: Don't you want to protect her? Are you doubting her?

content: Hecate doesn't answer. Meanwhile, another illusion tugs at her sleeve.
Hecate turns back and sees a scrawny girl in lab garb who's trembling fretfully.
...That's her too, herself a few years ago.

speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
content: No... No... I didn't doubt the order. I wanted to protect him, even at the cost of my own life, I wanted to protect him.
female_content: No... No... I didn't doubt the order. I wanted to protect her, even at the cost of my own life, I wanted to protect her.

speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
content: But I already knew... If he entered the Black Ring, I wouldn't be able to protect him... Like last time, I couldn't protect him from harm. It's happening again... now.
female_content: But I already knew... If she entered the Black Ring, I wouldn't be able to protect her... Like last time, I couldn't protect her from harm. It's happening again... now.

content: She sees ${PlayerName} fall down again in the illusion and begins trembling all over.

speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
content: Protecting him is the meaning of my existence, but I'm too weak, this is the only thing I can do. I'm sorry...
female_content: Protecting her is the meaning of my existence, but I'm too weak, this is the only thing I can do. I'm sorry...

speaker: Hecate
content: Because you halted your steps, he had to go into danger alone.
female_content: Because you halted your steps, she had to go into danger alone.

speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
content: If I can stop him, he won't face danger.
female_content: If I can stop her, she won't face danger.

speaker: Hecate
content: That's a judgment uncalled for, you only have to follow the orders.

speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
content: Protecting him from harm is an order too... Which order should I follow?
female_content: Protecting her from harm is an order too... Which order should I follow?

speaker: Hecate
content: I can't decide. I don't know what's the right thing to do. I need to protect him, but no one is giving me the correct order.
female_content: I can't decide. I don't know what's the right thing to do. I need to protect her, but no one is giving me the correct order.

speaker: Hecate
content: But what does this have to do with you? No matter how troubled I am, it's all for the orders, I don't have any emotions you can stir.
The Misery Puppet's voice comes from the void.

speaker: Hollow Voice
content: You're wrong. The old you would only obey the order given to you at any moment. If you receive contradictory orders, you would stop your action and wait for the higher-ups to give you a modified, feasible order.

speaker: Hollow Voice
content: But now you're hesitating and struggling.

speaker: Hollow Voice
content: You want to understand his decision and share his pain. You want to stay by his side and support him, but you're worried for him and scared of seeing him get hurt. You're anxious about your incompetence and weakness, eager to find the correct answer.
female_content: You want to understand her decision and share her pain. You want to stay by her side and support her, but you're worried for her and scared of seeing her get hurt. You're anxious about your incompetence and weakness, eager to find the correct answer.

speaker: Hollow Voice
content: These feelings don't come with orders. To you, they're too much, too complex, you who've forgone your emotions have long lost the ability to process them.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...You mean to say... that surgery didn't work...

speaker: Hecate
content: Unnecessary emotions have cropped up within me again, they're hindering me and making me useless...?
Her heart feels like it's been ripped open. She finally realizes she's never lifted her gaze. She's been watching ${PlayerName} get hurt and fall down again and again.
She feels pain.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is no good... This is wrong... I shouldn't waver, I can't hesitate...

speaker: Hecate
content: Help me, if anything unnecessary has reemerged, help me get rid of it again. I must execute the orders, I can't be trapped here.

speaker: Hollow Voice
content: You can't get rid of it... What's trapping you here is your own heart...

speaker: Hecate
content: No... I don't want these, release me, let me go back and protect him! I don't want to be hindered, I can give up all these emotions!
female_content: No... I don't want these, release me, let me go back and protect her! I don't want to be hindered, I can give up all these emotions!

content: She struggles to escape from the illusory realm, but her efforts are in vain. ${PlayerName}'s suffering keeps upsetting her. Hecate closes her eyes painfully.
At that moment, she hears a voice unheard before.
You don't need to give them up...
Hecate, open your eyes, look at him. This is not an illusion.
female_content: Hecate, open your eyes, look at her. This is not an illusion.

content: The voice is loaded with an irresistible charm. Hecate opens her eyes tremulously and looks at ${PlayerName} who's covered in wounds. The light on his hand is dim, but it hasn't gone out.
female_content: The voice is loaded with an irresistible charm. Hecate opens her eyes tremulously and looks at ${PlayerName} who's covered in wounds. The light on her hand is dim, but it hasn't gone out.

content: He lacked power, but he still insisted on entering this place, and he ventured further even after losing you two. He's made the wrong decision, that's why he keeps collapsing over and over again.
female_content: She lacked power, but she still insisted on entering this place, and she ventured further even after losing you two. She's made the wrong decision, that's why she keeps collapsing over and over again.

content: But he always stands back up and keeps on fighting. Is he useless like this? Is he weak?
female_content: But she always stands back up and keeps on fighting. Is she useless like this? Is she weak?

content: Hecate looks at the figure in the illusory realm. The figure coughs a couple times, struggles, grips the shackles, and stands up to fight the many enemies with everything left.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief is not weak, he's always been... very strong.
female_content: Chief is not weak, she's always been... very strong.

content: Do you know... what's keeping him fighting?
female_content: Do you know... what's keeping her fighting?

speaker: (Transition)
content: Show CG of Chief embracing Hecate

speaker: Chief
content: This time, it's my turn to protect you...
Is this also... an unnecessary emotion?

speaker: (Transition)
content: Return

Hecate can no longer hear the voice in the illusion. She's put aside any unnecessary thoughts and lets her body act instinctively. Breaking free from the swamp of darkness and pain, she heads toward where Chief is.

speaker: Hecate's phantoms
content: Stay, you're still carrying unnecessary emotions. It's pointless to go, you'll only...

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare! Beat them!
The two illusions of Hecate vanish together, returning underground.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Who are you? How do you know...
...I only heard the voice of your heart.
Go... Your emotions are no longer trapping you...

The illusory realm is beginning to fall apart, the invisible wall separating Hecate and ${PlayerName} disappearing. What's motivating her to act, whether this is the right thing to do, perhaps one day she'll find the answers to these questions, but not now.
Right now, she just wants to be back to ${PlayerName}'s side as soon as possible.
Has the illusion captured you? You see the Nightmare roaring near behind you, the energy it shoots out obliterating one of the Misery Puppet's arms.
Just as you want to turn back to take another look, a huge shadow suddenly lands right above your head, and you hear a loud roar.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}, you f***ing idiot!
And then you get smashed by the girl who's suddenly appeared and fallen down. You see stars.

speaker: Hella
content: Why can't you just mind your own business?! I see you've gotten beaten up again! I can handle this way better than a weakling like you, why can't you just patiently wait for me to come back?

speaker: Hella
content: I thought you were going to die...!
Hella isn't listening to you at all. She throws herself around your neck and begins yelling and crying.

Is this the side effect of the Fear illusory realm? She can't control her emotions at all, almost having a breakdown at this supposedly touching reunion. You can only act calm and pat her on the back of her head.

speaker: Choice
options: There, there, I'm still alive. I'm fine.

content: The other person comes near you from behind, stooping down beside you.
Hecate touches your wounds with a hand, her lips twitching slightly, as if having difficulty finding the right words to say.

speaker: Choice
options: In the end, you guys had to come and save me, thank you.

speaker: Hecate
content: No, it's not like that... You saved me...

speaker: Hecate
content: The fight hasn't ended yet. This time, I won't let you get hurt again.
The Misery Puppet's arm has slowly grown back.

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: Dance... Our Dancer... Give us love and redemption... Dance for us...

Behind the three puppets, Hamel's dance seems to have entered the climatic finale. As if confronting the contamination, she raises her arms, and they get pressed down heavily. She raises them again, and they get pressed down again.
The illusory realm of the park is no longer able to resist the contamination. She's also suffering immense pain herself, yet the healing illusory realm is still holding up everything on the lake.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's that Sinner's ability. Is she Hamel? She's indeed a terrifying enemy.
But it should end now. The stage has already been corrupted by the contamination, and it may devour her at any moment too.

On the lakeside, more men in black raincoats are emerging. They're shouting bizarre words you can't comprehend, transforming into black flames and spreading into the three puppets' bodies through the lake. They're now completely contaminated.

speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
content: Don't disturb... Don't damage... our Carnival, our revelries...

speaker: Hella
content: Humph, how stupid, a bunch of cowards. I'm not scared of you anymore.

speaker: Hecate
content: Give me your order, Chief. I won't run away anymore.
Then, go back to your original purpose. The Black Ring has given you nightmare. You didn't come here to escape from it, but to face it and defeat it.

speaker: Choice
options: Let it all come to an end. I'm going to the real Black Ring!

speaker: Hella
content: Did we succeed?!

The healing speed can't catch up with the consumption, and the puppets have broken into pieces. The lake looks like it can no longer hold the weight of truth, so with their last breaths, the puppets' wreckage slowly sinks into the water.
The men in black raincoats have disappeared and Phantom Hamel's unsettling laughter is completely gone as well.
On the tainted stage of the lake, only the frail Dancer is still dancing slowly.

speaker: Hella
content: Thought it would be like that time with Zoya, once we destroy her, the Black Ring will shatter. But in the end, we can't even touch her, she's just like a hologram.

speaker: Hella
content: Do we have to find the power supply and unplug it or something to make her stop? To make this fake amusement park disappear?

speaker: Hecate
content: She won't last much longer, it should end very soon.

speaker: Hecate
content: We need to be prepared. Once the illusory realm falls apart, who knows what this place will become, and how many enemies will show up.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Alright, alright, you take care of the preparation then. I'm pooped, I wanna watch the girl dance.

speaker: Hella
content: Just as an illusion... it's actually very enjoyable. I guess we won't get to see this anymore.
Hamel's body is growing more and more transparent, her movements slow and weak, even the hem of her white dress is slowly fading.
You walk toward her once again. Unaware of your presence, she doesn't hear your voice, doesn't see your body. Her brow is slightly furrowed, as if still not freed from the previous pain.

speaker: Choice
options: Only those with souls can feel pain.

content: You're more than just a hollow phantom illusion... Are you here, Hamel?

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The Dancer doesn't need to be greeted. She only needs to dance. We'll be her audience.
Perhaps she's never been greeted before.
She can feel the audience, she can feel the stage, and she experiences the world through the stage as well. The mascots indulged in her illusory realm, just as she indulges in her own dance.
Now, this dance is coming to an end too. You step closer to her. You still wish to talk to the dancer, you still have many things to ask her, perhaps that's the only way...

You take Hamel's hands. At first, her hands keep slipping through your palms, and it feels like they come from another dimension. Gradually, you catch up with the rhythm and understand the emotions in the steps... You are catching up with her.
As the surrounding sounds are slowly fading, you finally grip her hands. After a dazed moment, Hamel's lowered gaze finally lands on you.

You have many questions for her. Where is the real her? How is she related to that black thing? Has she been holding up this illusory realm all by herself? For 23 years, or an even longer, twisted period of time?
Is she... still alive?
But the gradually fading pair of hands is telling you that you're running out of time.
No one needs your protection anymore here.
She doesn't answer. Those clear rose-red eyes are staring at you, asking...

speaker: Chief
content: Me? I don't need protection from the illusory realm.

speaker: Chief
content: Even if there's a dark hollow in my heart, I don't need to fill it with anything. I will carry it and keep on fighting.

speaker: Chief
content: Dance for yourself, Hamel. I don't need you to protect me from hell.
Hamel gives you a gentle, sad smile. You hear her speak for the first time.

speaker: Hamel
content: You can do it... After all, you're different...

speaker: Hamel
content: You... are not alone...

speaker: Hecate
content: This voice... She's the person guiding me in the illusory realm?
Hamel lifts a hand to caress your cheek, healing all your wounds with the last bit of her power, her figure slowly growing transparent.
Until she fades away.

speaker: Hella
content: Hamel has disappeared...
As Hamel's body vanishes completely, the illusory realm is also beginning to shatter.
Like a rotten ceiling, the bright and clear sky is crumbling bit by bit, revealing the true appearance of the Carnival...
Under the cover of the red light, the dark world is filled with fear, pain and evil.

speaker: Carnival Corruptor
content: Aaahhh!

speaker: Carnival Corruptor
content: Pain... Pain... No... Help... Help...

speaker: Carnival Corruptor
content: Ahhh! Die... Die...

Now that Hamel's illusory realm is gone, the whole Carnival looks like it's going through an earthquake. Roars can be heard everywhere and the Corruptors have ripped off their fake skins, losing control completely.

speaker: Old Man
content: Hamel?! Is that you, Hamel?!

speaker: Old Man
content: Has the parade ended? Can I finally see you?!
Staggering, he stands up, crushing the last bit of blue light protecting him. He stumbles toward the flaring amusement park.
On top of the decayed Ferris wheel, the black illusion is peering down at everything below joyfully.

speaker: Black Illusion
content: Hahahaha! I'm free...!

speaker: Black Illusion
content: Come, come to my park, come and find true happiness. Stay with me, love me...!

speaker: Black Illusion
content: Come to the <color=#fb9259>real Endless Carnival</color>!
She spreads her arms to embrace the sky. The enormous red luminous ring overlooks everything. The first Black Ring of the DisCity has finally revealed its original form.

speaker: Communications 04
content: Black Ring BR-001 is confirmed to have gone out of control. Cases of mental abnormalities have occurred in both the East and West Districts, all moving in the direction of BR-001. The isolation belt of the Rust is already being breached!

speaker: Communications 01
content: This hasn't happened in 23 years. Why has it suddenly gone out of control?

speaker: Communications 04
content: It's <color=#fb9259>that person from the MBCC</color>! He violated the regulations and entered BR-001 ten minutes ago, and now this has happened!
female_content: It's <color=#fb9259>that person from the MBCC</color>! She violated the regulations and entered BR-001 ten minutes ago, and now this has happened!

speaker: Communications 04
content: He really is colluding with those people. Their purpose is to sabotage the FAC's defense and free BR-001!
female_content: She really is colluding with those people. Their purpose is to sabotage the FAC's defense and free BR-001!

speaker: Nightingale
content: This accusation is baseless. You don't even have proof that an accident has indeed happened in the Ring. Chief was there to destroy the Black Ring, he must still be fighting.
female_content: This accusation is baseless. You don't even have proof that an accident has indeed happened in the Ring. Chief was there to destroy the Black Ring, she must still be fighting.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Instead of holding it against the MBCC, why don't you do your job? Strengthen the defense at the Rust to prevent affected citizens from entering that area.

speaker: Communications 04
content: You...!

speaker: Communications 01
content: ...Any news from the 9th Agency? That person was sent in there by them, and they're the ones monitoring the power behind the Black Ring. <color=#fb9259>That woman</color> hasn't offered any explanation yet?

speaker: Communications 04
content: ...She's just... declined communications from the meeting.

Langley is standing outside the Black Ring. The dark red light surging in the Black Ring keeps spreading outward. She presses the button to decline the call request and simply throws the device to her subordinate behind her.

speaker: Langley
content: Got no time for that. What's going on at the FAC?

speaker: Intelligence Agent
content: The eavesdropper's sent updates. There have been data irregularities in the BR-001 defense network. Significant fluctuations were observed near both the shielding base stations E1 and E2. Moments ago, someone entered the Black Ring.

speaker: Langley
content: Haha... I knew it. I was busy doing something else last time, I can't miss another chance.
The moth has flown into the web. The Silver Spider takes out her gun.

speaker: Langley
content: Time to meet the old friend...
Heh, quite the talker... just like <color=#fb9259>Victor</color>.
The black flames are burning, and men in black raincoats are forming from the shadow behind him.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: I'll thank you for eliminating this fake illusory realm for me this time. No one can get in my way now, let's get to work.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Let's go and welcome the free <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color>...
Evading the red contamination, he walks into the park illuminated by the Black Ring. This time, no one is banishing him again.
The Black Ring emits red light that strips off the clear skies layer by layer, exposing the Carnival for what it really is.
Dimness, decay, rot... The dilapidated equipment in the park is tangled in hellish tentacles. The maniac Corruptors wake up from their slumbers and let out ear-splitting howls.

speaker: Hella
content: Um... this is how it's supposed to feel like. This is what a Black Ring is supposed to look like.

speaker: Monstrous Mascot
content: I want her back... I want Hamel back, I want the amusement park back... Ahhh...!!
The demon-like bunny doll comes hurtling toward you, its coat decomposing rapidly. When it's in front of you, it raises its drumstick.
<size=44>Phew!</size>
Nightmare deflects the blow, tearing the contamination-infused drumstick into shreds. The filthy entity possessing the doll shows under the torn bunny head.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Argh... Argh... So much pain... So much pain...

speaker: Corruptor
content: Hamel... Hamel... Where are you...

speaker: Hecate
content: She's not here anymore. Wake up and face the music.

speaker: Corruptor
content: <size=44>No...!!</size>
The Corruptor lets out a deafening cry and clutches its own neck before disintegrating into bubbles.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Record what you just said and air it. Then we can stand aside and watch them die before us.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's not that simple.
Hamel is gone, taking the grandiose mirage she created with her. But the parade is still ongoing.
The carousing dolls shed their disguises one after another, returning to their messy, filthy forms. They are coalescing left and right.
The howling army of monsters is crawling out of the dirty Rust, and they are moving as one dark block in the same direction.

speaker: Monsters
content: Bring me comfort! Bring us comfort! We want our revelries back!

The symphony has stopped, and is now replaced by the ebb and flow of the monsters' howling. This is a hellish scene. And the monsters are drawn to the tallest structure in the park—the colossal Ferris wheel.
The wheel lights up and starts turning slowly. Then you hear laughter coming from high above, crisp and all-penetrating. It belongs to that woman.

speaker: Hamel
content: Come... Keep me company... I will bring you comfort, I will bring you joy!

speaker: Hecate
content: She's making the monsters go berserk.

speaker: Hella
content: Is that also Hamel?
You don't have a definite answer. But there's one thing you're sure about.
This is the real Black Ring, not an illusory realm. You need to get ready to fight.

speaker: Hecate
content: There are much more monsters now than when Hamel was here, and they're wilder too. The Corruptors that awakened have also mixed in. And...

speaker: Hecate
content: This is BR-004 all over again. We won't be able to kill them off. It's just a fool's errand.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh... This is a parade. So... can't they just do a bit of pushing and shoving and call it a day?

speaker: Hella
content: We can't fight like this forever. We'll go mad. If we aren't already dead because of exhaustion by then, that is.

speaker: Choice
options: Avoid engaging the monsters. Save your strength for the real enemy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Go to the Ferris wheel and locate Phantom Hamel. Defeating her is the only way to get rid of the Black Ring.
Looking for me?
You hear a voice pipe up right beside your ear. You turn your head and see a dark figure looming over you.

speaker: Hamel
content: Hehe, I want to see you too.

speaker: Hamel
content: I knew it... you do love me!

speaker: Hella
content: Piss off! Who the **** is like you? Stay away from ${PlayerName}!
Phantom Hamel takes a heavy blow. Her form is shattered, but her voice remains. Her laughter is spinning among the monsters, and her now-indistinct figure seems to be doing a jolly dance.

speaker: Hamel
content: This is my amusement park, and everything in it follows my wishes.

speaker: Hamel
content: Me... I hope you love me, your Hamel. Everyone loves Hamel.

speaker: Hecate
content: She has a completely different aura from the person on the lake. Her manner, the nature of her power, her age, the way she dances... Are they really the same person?

speaker: Hella
content: Of course not. The one on the lake was not so full of f**king nonsense.

Chortling, the shapeless phantom starts dancing and twirling. Every inch of ground she covers sprouts dark tentacles, shaking and extending. They envelop the monsters, which are now howling even more desperately.

speaker: Hamel
content: Are you scared? Are you in pain? The holes in your hearts, you can't fill them up, can you?

speaker: Hamel
content: Come to me. I'll give you joy. Come and love me.

speaker: Hamel
content: Be my dance dress, be the hem of my dress...
Before your eyes, the tentacles grow and expand amid the mass of monsters. They snatch up nearby Corruptors and suck out their black life force. They gather and swirl, condensing into a figure.

speaker: Hella
content: Is she absorbing the life force of the Corruptors?
Phantom Hamel reemerges before you, more powerful than before.

speaker: Hamel
content: Hahaha... You won't feel sad anymore now...
Devouring Mania contamination for a power boost... You have seen this happen before.

speaker: Choice
options: In the depths of the unclaimed crypt where the inheritance was awakened for the first time.
|In the black raincoat ritual where black flames were offered.

content: It's more than likely that she has inside her something similar to the inheritance. That something devours Mania to boost its power.
Phantom Hamel is a Corpseborne Sinner too? The core of the Black Ring is an awakened Corpus?

Last time when this place was turned into an illusory realm, men clad in black raincoats sneaked into the carnival and created contamination to feed Phantom Hamel, or the owner of the Black Ring, so that she could be awakened and grow in strength.

You recall the mark on the backs of those raincoat men's hands, the same mark you saw on the man in the Black Ring incident in the square. They're from the same troupe, and they must have come here for the same purpose.

speaker: Hamel
content: You're frowning. Something troubling you too?

speaker: Hamel
content: I see it, your confusion, your loneliness, your pain... hehe, Let me give you comfort too.

speaker: Hamel
content: You're keen on me too, aren't you?

speaker: Choice
options: Yes, there's something I have to get cleared up.

speaker: Hamel
content: Then come... Come to me.
The moment she raises her hand, the Corruptors by her side, as if possessed, turn to you and start charging at you, howling as they do so...

speaker: Hella
content: Argh... Darn it! So many of them. There's no getting close to her!

speaker: Hella
content: You want us to come to you. Let us pass then! Why'd you send this bunch of monsters to stand in my way?
You take a step forward to face that contorted phantom.

speaker: Choice
options: Come on, tell me how I'm supposed to entertain you.

speaker: Hamel
content: Hahaha... You're the best, even better than she ever was!

speaker: Hamel
content: Here I come!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, watch out!
Innumerable dark tentacles extend from the hem of her dress and come rushing at you. Before your Sinners can block them, you reach out and grab some of the tentacles and they consume you.
When you open your eyes again, you're no longer at the crazy carnival.
You don't see the tentacles that were charging at you, nor do you hear the wild howling of monsters in their thousands.
No response. As expected.
But you sense that someone is standing behind you.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: The Black Ring has broken out... And you've failed to stop it...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: I risked my life to save you, and you've failed to stop the Black Ring... All because you couldn't bring yourself to kill that monster...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: The FAC, the DisCity... they mean nothing to you! All you care about is those monsters under your command!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Because you're a monster yourself! The DisCity has become a hellish place, all thanks to you monsters!
Behind him, more instinctive shapes stagger to their feet: Sheriffs, reporters, officials, Syndicate gangsters...
They are marching over to you, zombie-like and full of menace.

speaker: Dying Phantom
content: Detestable monsters, abominable power, a bunch of lunatics...

speaker: Dying Phantom
content: Should've killed you. Special Combat Unit, that's ludicrous... It's a mistake to let you out. The MBCC is a joke!

speaker: Dying Phantom
content: It's you who brought Mania. It's you who brought about the breakout of the Black Ring. You're the tumor that plagues the city!

speaker: Dying Phantom
content: Why so quiet? You can't rebut, because all I'm saying is true!

speaker: Choice
options: No, because I know this is just an illusion.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This isn't the first time I've been inside a Black Ring. I know a thing or two about this kind of mental interference.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Show yourself, owner of the Black Ring. I want to talk to you, not the illusion.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Don't act like this has nothing to do with you! Who killed 036?

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: He fought Black Rings all his life, and how did he die in the end?! He protected you for so long, and how did you treat him?!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Don't you feel repentant? Doesn't it pain you? Huh... Even that can't move you?

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: That's what I figured. See? You don't care about our lives, mine or my brothers'.
He lunges at you, and you raise your arm to defend yourself when the shackles start to burn.
The phantom disintegrates slowly, still staring at you with intense hatred.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Murderer, go to hell... Monsters like you... should be kept in the Black Ring for eternity...

speaker: Choice
options: I'm not gonna be trapped here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm going back to the reality and defeating the Black Ring. That will be my eulogy to you. Now give me the owner of the Black Ring.
The phantom doesn't respond. It disappears. The illusory realm twists and blurs, as dead silence descends around you.
Then you hear the sound of a gun being loaded. The cold muzzle is shoved against the back of your head.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Langley?

speaker: Langley
content: The entire DisCity is in a mess, because you've awakened a dormant Black Ring... Great job.

speaker: Langley
content: I've been waiting for you to show your true colors, traitor. That's why I kept giving you opportunities.

speaker: Langley
content: Your test is now concluded, newbie.
Bang!
Bang!
A bullet pierces through your glabella. It causes no pain. This is just an illusion. No smell of gunpowder is left behind.

speaker: Langley
content: You didn't even bat an eyelid. How brave! Should I applaud you?

speaker: Choice
options: What's so scary about a fake bullet?
I don't need the praise of a phantom.

speaker: Langley
content: How valorous of you! You keep reminding yourself this is just an illusion, all fake, right?
A smile shows on her face.

speaker: Langley
content: You're right. The gun's not real, I'm not real either.

speaker: Langley
content: But you're well aware that I'm telling the truth. You know you've never been truly trusted...
She grabs your shoulder, spins you around, and lifts your chin with the muzzle of the gun. Her eyes are shielded by the bill of her hat, but you know they are searching you.

speaker: Langley
content: Before the Black Ring in the square, you were a tool being ordered around; after that, you were a scapegoat that gets disposed of once you're not useful anymore.

speaker: Langley
content: No one is helping you, protecting you, or feeding you information, no one trusts you... Do you know why?

speaker: Langley
content: Because you're an <color=#fb9259>outlier</color>. No one can be sure of your stand, and no one vouches for an outlier.

speaker: Langley
content: What's your connection with the Black Ring? Why were you able to break it? What's your connection with the inheritance and the forces behind it?

speaker: Langley
content: What are those shackles of yours? Who are you? A human, a Sinner, or a monster?

speaker: Langley
content: Who are you fighting for? Who can vouch for your loyalty?
This is the enemy's trick meant to drive a wedge between the two of you. You pay it no heed, moving ahead, pushing her aside. You need to track down the owner of the Black Ring.
But you're stopped again, by yet another person you know.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You don't want to answer those questions, why?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Can't be bothered? Or... because you don't have the answers yourself?
Her face wears a trace of sadness.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're a Chief. But what does really it mean, a Chief? What's the Chief before you like? And will there will be new Chiefs after you die?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Doesn't that sound like a disposable product to you?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Then why do you want to go back?

speaker: Choice
options: I don't need to explain it to you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Out there, there are no memories, no past, no one you can trust, and no future.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Just stay, stay here, stay here...
Phantoms are multiplying, murmuring something over and over again. Looks like Phantom Hamel's illusion-creating prowess is getting more advanced. You're trying to locate her.
The scarlet glow of your shackles comes to life in the center of the mist. You reach out to your boss and adjutant, who are facing you.

speaker: Choice
options: I don't need to prove my stance to anyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Definitely not to you phantoms.
The phantoms of Langley and Nightingale are gone. But the thick mist shows no sign of letting up.

Access memories, concretize mental images, stoke up emotions... The nature of this dark illusory realm is the same as that of the healing amusement park created by the Hamel on the lake. Both are deep-level mental interference.
She's able to recreate the doubts in your subconscious so vividly. It seems she's reached deep into your psyche. She's bound to appear again.

speaker: Choice
options: Come out and face me. This kind of attack won't hurt me a bit.

content: A familiar voice issues from the mist.
Aren't you... supposed to be powerful?
Then... how come you didn't save me?

speaker: (Transition)
content: (Gray-Haired Maiden's portrait fading in, with ruins in the background)

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: How come you didn't save me?

A blown-up hospital, calls for help amid a cloud of smoke, helpless doctors and nurses... You're back there. The puny maiden is standing before you, her body pockmarked with new bullet holes, on top of old bruises from years of torture.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: You said you could suppress Mania... You said...

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: You said... you... would help me...
Jet-black spikes poke out of her cracked skin as she totters toward you. Each step she takes is accompanied by a cracking sound.

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: But why... you...
She falls down before you. Her tattered body is engulfed in a black miasma.
Because he can't save anyone.
female_content: Because she can't save anyone.

content: Two shadowy forms clad in white walk past you. One of them bends over to pick up the girl covered in contamination.

speaker: Anne
content: So many people died because of him, but it has no effect on him whatsoever. And he's trying to be our savior. How brazen!
female_content: So many people died because of her, but it has no effect on her whatsoever. And she's trying to be our savior. How brazen!

speaker: Iron
content: He's no different than Ted. He holds dear the power in his hands, despite knowing it is evil. He even glorifies what he's doing as an honorable <color=#fb9259>fight</color>.
female_content: She's no different than Ted. She holds dear the power in his hands, despite knowing it is evil. She even glorifies what she's doing as an honorable <color=#fb9259>fight</color>.

content: A machete comes at you.

speaker: Ninety-nine
content: Give Hella back to me!

speaker: Ninety-nine
content: You said you would protect her. Then what? She's been protecting you all the time!

speaker: Ninety-nine
content: You're useless. You can protect no one! Loosen the Goddamn shackles, and <size=44>give her back to me!!</size>
The machete lands on you here and there, but it leaves no mark. The furious phantom runs through your body and reappears as a girl, whose hand takes hold of you.

speaker: Horo
content: Where is my commander...

speaker: Horo
content: And my brother... where is he?

speaker: Horo
content: You're so weak... so useless... How come only you came back...? Why?
The creator of the illusory realm keeps conjuring up phantoms of the victims. Amid all the curses and vengefulness, a Mania-studded right hand alights on your shoulder.
She looks up, surrounded by a black miasma, marks of a Corpseborne giving off an eerie purple light.

speaker: Zoya
content: Cheer up! This is a heart-warming reunion. Don't you have a lot to talk to me?

speaker: Zoya
content: Let's take about this blasted negotiation you brokered. I trusted you, and look where it got the Legion.

speaker: Choice
options: Don't pull these dirty tricks on me. It's the Corpus I'm looking for.

speaker: Chief
content: It's the Corpus that I'm looking for. My enemy is the Black Ring. I'm here to fight, not to reflect on the things I did.

speaker: Zoya
content: Huh, the Corpus, what if you find it? What makes you think that you can take on the Black Ring?!

speaker: Zoya
content: You pulled it off last time only because I let you connect with me through the shackles. You just got lucky.
She sneers, her carbonized skin flaking off as her body moves.

speaker: Zoya
content: You would've died in the last Black Ring. You didn't have the power to defeat us. You're nothing without Sinners.

speaker: Zoya
content: Fight? What difference does your fighting make?

speaker: Zoya
content: The sheriffs are still b***t, and Syndicate is still hell. What can you do about them with you and your shackles?

speaker: Zoya
content: You're not seriously thinking of yourself as a savior, are you? You don't even have the slightest connection with this city!

The black energy of contamination is creeping up on Phantom Zoya. She doesn't resist it. Instead, she stands still. The scene of her going deranged unfolds before your eyes. You know it's just a mirage, but it's still shocking to behold.

speaker: Choice
options: ...You want me to stay here too?

speaker: Zoya
content: Mania comes from Black Rings, we all come from Black Rings. Stay here. Nothing wrong with that.

speaker: Zoya
content: Meaningless fighting brings nothing but loss of lives. It's time to end it. Now is the right time.
She extends her hand. You hesitate, then take it.

speaker: Zoya
content: Aaahhh...!!
The scarlet light chases away the mist almost entirely. Energy floods into your shackles, and they pierce and shatter Phantom Zoya's body.

speaker: Hamel
content: You... you tricked me...! I asked you to stay, and you tricked me!!

speaker: Chief
content: I trust only what I sense through my shackles. And I sense that the persons connected with me through the shackles are not here.

speaker: Chief
content: Enough with this illusory realm. Get out of here with me!

speaker: Hamel
content: Let go of me...!!
The illusory realm crumbles into dust. Vaguely, you feel someone knocking on your head, then you hear the familiar, soothing voices.

speaker: Hella & Hecate
content:
Wake up, you dumbass! 
Chief!

speaker: Hella
content: You scared the hell out of me. Why did you grab those things? You fell asleep as soon as you touched them, and we couldn't wake you up.

speaker: Hella
content: Do you know how long you were out?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Was it an illusory realm?

Your captive is on her knees, nailed to the floor by flame-red thorns that run through the black hem and stop her from dancing. You can't put the shackles on this deranged creature, but you're able to immobilize her with them.

speaker: Hamel
content: It hurts... It's burning hot... Let me out, let me out...

speaker: Choice
options: I have something to ask you, before destroying you.

speaker: Hamel
content: No...

speaker: Hamel
content: I'm Hamel, why pick on Hamel...
She begins to whimper, her voice growing thinner and thinner. It's as if she were a baby.

speaker: Hamel
content: Liar... Liar... You said you'd protect me, you said everybody liked me... Why...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, step back!
Tentacles, this time carrying black flames, roll in again, smashing the shackles that bind her. But that power doesn't seem to have come from her.
A tall, lean figure flits to the scene and swings an open black umbrella to beat your back. He picks up the weeping girl and walks to the side.

speaker: Hella
content: Who are you?!
The man doesn't answer. He shields Phantom Hamel with his umbrella and comforts her with gentle words.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Everything's all right, everything's all right... I'm here now, to protect you, to love you...

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Why are you crying again? Was someone mean to you?

speaker: Hamel
content: It's him. His hand was so burning hot, and he destroyed the illusory realm I gave him! Sob...
female_content: It's her. Her hand was so burning hot, and she destroyed the illusory realm I gave her! Sob...

speaker: Hamel
content: You said everyone loved Hamel. I've already become Hamel. Why would he treat me like that?
female_content: You said everyone loved Hamel. I've already become Hamel. Why would she treat me like that?

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You're Hamel. We love you. So many of us in the amusement park love you.

speaker: Hamel
content: But he didn't want to play with me. And he grabbed my hand like this, and trapped me with a circle of red spikes!
female_content: But she didn't want to play with me. And she grabbed my hand like this, and trapped me with a circle of red spikes!

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Because it's the real you who he's dying to see.
female_content: Because it's the real you who she's dying to see.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You're a phantom, a body double. You forgot that? The real you didn't get hurt. You know that, right?
The man soothes Hamel as if she were a baby. You hear Hella make a gagging noise.

speaker: Hamel
content: Oh... That's right! He didn't hurt me!
female_content: Oh... That's right! She didn't hurt me!

speaker: Hamel
content: Then he definitely likes me. Right?
female_content: Then she definitely likes me. Right?

speaker: Hamel
content: I knew it. He has the same powers as me. He's my companion! He definitely likes me!
female_content: I knew it. She has the same powers as me. She's my companion! She definitely likes me!

content: Hamel seems to live in a world of her own. The man strokes her head affectionately.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Of course. He's here to see you. So what do you say we go back and wait for him?
female_content: Of course. She's here to see you. So what do you say we go back and wait for her?

speaker: Hamel
content: Okay! I'll wait for him, he's my friend. Don't kill him, okay?
female_content: Okay! I'll wait for her, she's my friend. Don't kill her, okay?

content: Phantom Hamel turns to you, excitement writ large on her face.

speaker: Hamel
content: Come and find me! The real me!
You make no response to the invitation. The phantom dissipates there and then, leaving the man behind.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You should've been gentler to her. She's only a kid... A lonely kid.

speaker: Choice
options: You mean a kid who has the blood of so many on her hands?

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Give her a chance to grow. She came to this world all too soon, so soon that we didn't even know she was already here and missed the opportunity to nurture her properly.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: She wandered here all by herself, looking for companionship and love. She grew her power bit by bit and unleashed the Black Ring on her own. Don't you think that's praiseworthy?

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: But someone kept standing in her way.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I see... Those men in black raincoats were not humans. They were let in here as fodder for this evil will.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You let her absorb contamination and sully the other illusory amusement park, so that she could break the restraints put on her by the real Hamel and set herself free.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You intensified Mania by feeding the dark side of human nature to trigger the Black Ring. Did you do the same thing to Zoya?!

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You're smart. But that's not what happened to Zoya.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Oh, tell me something first, Chief. Quid pro quo. Tell me what happened at the top of the statue.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: <color=#fb9259>Who</color> was there besides Zoya? What was she doing up there...? Where did she go after that...? Who destroyed the Black Ring I had painstakingly nurtured?
His face wears an obnoxious grin, his voice grows frigid.

speaker: Choice
options: I have no interest in dealing with people like you.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: The answer is very important to me.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: ...You shall tell me.
The shadows around his feet spread out, leap out of the ground to attack you, but are cut in half by Nightmare. But there's more to come.
A large number of black flame-carrying tentacles flow out of the underside of his umbrella, drop onto the ground, and transmute into men in black raincoats.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: The <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color> here is being awakened. Nothing is going to derail it this time.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! Didn't he promise that black thing he wouldn't kill us? What a scumbag! Promises mean nothing to him.
She probably forgets she's not the honest type either. The same can be said about you.
But now is not a good time for mockery. The raincoat men are more powerful than you expected. The black flame rages on, lashing at all of you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Argh... The contamination here can penetrate Chief's shackles?

speaker: Hella
content: Is this happening again?!

speaker: Choice
options: I won't let it happen again!

content: You brush past the two affected Sinners. And when you reach out your hand, the shackles, powered by your strong will, break the restraints and penetrate the man's chest.
The black flame restraining the Sinners disappears, and the man, now on one knee, coughs up blood, grabbing the red spike that has pieced his chest.

speaker: Hecate
content: The shackles have grown stronger?

speaker: Hella
content: Did it work?!

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: ...Well, well. Now I know what happened... It's you... Quite a feat for a defective like you...
His hand clutching the spike bursts into black flame, which roars as it rushes into your field of vision, a noise so loud that it blocks out all other sounds.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Thank you. I've found the answer.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You saw it, that <color=#fb9259>great existence</color>... right?

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You were supposed to be its food. Instead, you consumed it. It's you who destroyed the Black Ring I had nurtured in the West District...

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Don't worry. I didn't come here for revenge. Unbelievable as it may sound, but you've earned your <color=#fb9259>eligibility</color>.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Today, and maybe for a long time to come, I will not stand in your way. Keep up the good work.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What is a Corpus? What do you mean by it being awakened? Is this Black Ring a result of its awakening? What's in it? Why does it cause Mania?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why did you say I was supposed to its food and I... consumed it instead?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Am I...

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: No no no... Too late, the door for information exchange has closed. I've found my answer without your help, you have to find yours on your own.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You can do this. The answer is right here...
He smiles, his voice close by your ear.

speaker: Parma
content: <color=#fb9259>Parma</color>. Remember the name. We'll meet again, as long as you don't get yourself killed.
A black mist rises, and you're hurled back to reality. The two Sinners grab you. Where the man stood a minute ago, a black ball of fire is all that's been left behind.

speaker: Hella
content: He ran away?

speaker: Hecate
content: Should we give chase?
No... He's no longer here. Even if we caught up with him, he wouldn't give us the answer.
The howling monsters in the park coalesce, and surge into the depths of the Black Ring, in the direction where the phantom, who got burned by your shackles, went.

speaker: Hella
content: You've been held back by the man for quite some time. Phantom Hamel must have absorbed tons of Corruptors. She must have grown huge...

speaker: Choice
options: We'll beat her, we have to.

speaker: Hecate
content: Do you know her actual location?
The shackles have her remembered. You feel a shooting pain that comes with the mental connection. It guides you to look at the tallest structure in the amusement park.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Somewhere where every corner of the park can be clearly seen.

speaker: Hecate
content: The Ferris wheel?

speaker: Hella
content: Are you sure we're on the right track?

The Ferris wheel is lit by colorful lights, with music playing in the background. It turns slowly, bathed in the red light of the Black Ring, surrounded by howling monsters. Dancing black tentacles are vaguely visible.
So showy, so outlandish. It's as if it were beckoning you to come near.

speaker: Hamel
content: Come here, come to me... I understand your pain, your fear, and the emptiness in your heart. I have built you a most beautiful amusement park...
Phantom Hamel's laughter swirls around the park, reaching deep inside everyone present.

speaker: Monsters
content: It's Hamel... Hamel...

speaker: Hamel
content: The party has started. You can have everything you want in this carnival. The only thing I ask in return is your love...

speaker: Monsters
content: Complete me... Save me... I love you... Hamel...
Like pious worshipers, the monsters make their way toward the Ferris wheel, which is giving out wave after wave of eerie light. They are offering themselves up to those hellish tentacles.
They surge toward the owner of the Black Ring, blocking all the paths leading to the Ferris wheel.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is the power of <color=#fb9259>Catalyst Tendency</color>. Catalyst Sinners can inflict much deeper mental interference than other Sinners. In a Black Ring like this, she's more dangerous than Zoya.

speaker: Hecate
content: Everyone in this carnival is under her bewitchment. They're gonna be consumed at the end of the parade.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, you just went through multiple attacks on your psyche, and were hurt by that man's black flame. Can you still carry on?

speaker: Choice
options: I can. We can't wait any longer.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We must act fast, we must remove the Corpus before she becomes too strong for us to take on.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Got it. Hella, get ready to fight.

speaker: Hecate
content: You decide the path we are gonna take, and we'll clear it for you.

The Ferris wheel turns slowly at the end of the procession of monsters. The colorful lights blink, illuminating the gigantic mass of contamination sitting on the frame of the Ferris wheel. From the mass of contamination protrude tentacles left and right, like dancing flames, like carousing crowds.
The rose-red bubble in the heart of contamination stirs. Phantom Hamel is leaning against the bubble. The army of Corruptors comes to her. They lie prone before her and make pitiful appeals.

speaker: Empty Mascot
content: I... I feel so empty, I have nothing... Hamel, I have nothing...

speaker: Hamel
content: What do you want then? Um... you don't seem to remember what you want.

speaker: Hamel
content: All right then... I'll give you money! Money can buy you anything. Come to the dreamworld. I can give you anything you want.

speaker: Empty Mascot
content: Money... That's right. It's money!

speaker: Hamel
content: Are you satisfied now? So... do you love me?
Tentacles rush out from under her dress and run into the Corruptor's mouth and nostrils, sucking the last bit of its life force while it's still in its sweet dream.

speaker: Hamel
content: Hahaha... Next! What do you want?

speaker: Sad Mascot
content: My love... is gone... I can't find my love...

speaker: Hamel
content: What should we do? I don't know what she looks like... Uh, I'll give you good wine and beautiful women.

speaker: Sad Mascot
content: Um, that will make me forget my love... T-This isn't my love...

speaker: Hamel
content: Is it so bad to forget? A new love... isn't that nice? Your new love can make you happy just like your old love did. Be happy again... isn't this the reason you're here?

speaker: Hamel
content: Come now, cheer up. I helped you, now you should love me!
Yet another pathetic offering. The tentacles suck dry all its life force. The rose-red bubble is swelling up, as if something is about to burst out of it.
But Phantom Hamel is tired. She sits slumped, fiddling with her dance dress woven from the life force of Corruptors.

speaker: Hamel
content: How many already?

speaker: Hamel
content: I've waited so long... I'm finally free. All of you have come to keep me company, all of you love me. But why it's still not enough... why...?

speaker: Hamel
content: I've surely become you, but why, why am I still feeling so lonely?

speaker: Hamel
content: In what manner did they used to love you? What is love? What kind of love can fill up the void of loneliness in my heart?

speaker: Hamel
content: What else do I need to become you?
Nightmare assails the Ferris wheel, making a loud bang. Phantom Hamel looks down.
She sees among the mass of monsters, the trio who're not under her control.

speaker: Hamel
content: Ah, I get it now. I need companions. Ones as powerful as me, and as lonely.

speaker: Hamel
content: At long last! you're finally here, ${PlayerName}, my only worthy friend!
The ground gives way and turns into squirmy mud, black tentacles reaching up to drag you under.

speaker: Hamel
content: This time, I won't take no for an answer. Okay?

speaker: Hecate & Hella
content:
Chief!
${PlayerName}, no!
You use your power to free the Sinners from the tentacles. You, on the other hand, are entombed in mud.
You're trapped under the mud. It floods into your nostrils. All your senses stop functioning almost entirely. The only thing you can hear is Phantom Hamel's whispers of enchantment beside your ear.

speaker: Hamel
content: You did come to see me. I'm so happy.

speaker: Hamel
content: And you pushed the other two aside, just so you can be alone with me. You do love me, don't you?

speaker: Choice
options: I was protecting them from you.

speaker: Hamel
content: Hehe, you're lying. You just don't want them to hear what I've got to say to you.
You're bound by black tentacles from head to toe. She taps her finger on your chest where your heart is.

speaker: Hamel
content: I'm Hamel. I can see your heart. You absorbed something you don't even understand, and it's clouded your thinking.

speaker: Hamel
content: You control Sinners, much the same way we control Corruptors. Your shackles are just like Black Rings. And people guard against you, just like how they guard against us.

speaker: Hamel
content: You know it, you know all this. Deep down, you know that Black Ring has never ended. That's why you've been searching, and the search has led you to me.

speaker: Choice
options: What can you tell me then?

speaker: Hamel
content: If anyone can give you the answer you want, it's me. I'm the only one who can understand you, because you and I are in a league of our own; we are the <color=#fb9259>Source</color>. Strong, rare, and lonely.

speaker: Hamel
content: That man called me a <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color>, a <color=#fb9259>Host</color>, a <color=#fb9259>great existence</color> that brings about miracles. He says I am going to wake up everyone. And on the day when we all awake, the <color=#fb9259>Miracle</color> will come.

speaker: Hamel
content: I didn't understand what he meant. No one ever came to me. I wanted only companionship and love. But even Hamel couldn't stay with me forever.

speaker: Hamel
content: Only when your shackles touched me did I realize you were the one I'd been waiting for. You are my kind, you and you alone.

speaker: Hamel
content: You are. You'll see.
Her finger splinters into innumerable smaller hands. As they search around, you have a sensation of being gnawed.

Instinctively, you see your shackles' red light flowing out of the places where the hands have touched you. The red light becomes entangled with the hands, and merges with them... It's happening again!

speaker: Hamel
content: See? We're one and the same, you are me, you have only me. Stay with me, or I'll play hardball.
More and more black hands appear. They wrap themselves around your torso tightly, almost making you into a cocoon. Your shackles are still resisting but are losing the battle.

speaker: Hamel
content: It's useless. Everything inside the Black Ring is at my service. They bring me inexhaustible power. And you... you're not even willing to make use of the few pathetic creatures under your command.

speaker: Choice
options: I will never put their lives at risk!

speaker: Hamel
content: Don't be hung up on them. So annoying. I'm your friend. We're both so lonely, and you...
Her fingers reach deeper inside you. A frenetic roar, a whirlpool that tears at your soul... You fight with all your might, but consciousness is slipping away from you.
Is this the end? Am I going to die here, alone?
In impenetrable darkness, a blue dot of light comes on. As the figure before your eyes fades away, a similar figure comes to your mind. She is dressed all in white, serene and gentle.
Her mouth is moving, as if saying something to you. You remember what she's saying, you won't forget it...

speaker: Hamel
content: Don't forget... You... you're not alone...
Your palm is heating up. Your shackles are burning without you using them.
Someone is approaching! Someone is looking for you!
You clench the shackles. Instantly, a thick column of light penetrates the darkness. A pair of hands grab and tug your arms. The pain is so real. You wake up right away.

speaker: Hella
content: Stop playing the ******* hero by yourself!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, take hold of me!
All the black hands restraining you are cut off. You're dragged out of the mud, shaking off all the shadows.

speaker: Hamel
content: No...! Don't leave me, don't turn your back on me!!
She is howling, but can do nothing to stop the darkness from being shattered. Light comes in and you see her true form.
The huge bubble, from inside which comes the crying of a baby, stirs!

speaker: Corpus
content: Waaahhh... Why? I've become Hamel, why are you treating me like this?!

speaker: Corpus
content: I found my only friend, and he doesn't love me. Why?!
female_content: I found my only friend, and she doesn't love me. Why?!

content: From inside the translucent bubble comes the crying of a baby.

speaker: Chief
content: The real Hamel wouldn't plunder love from other people, or take their lives to assuage her loneliness.

speaker: Chief
content: You're just a <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color>, the source of the Black Ring!

speaker: Corpus
content: What's wrong with that?! I'm special. I can do anything I want. <size=44>What have I done wrong?</size>

speaker: Choice
options: I don't have time to give a lecture about what's right and what's wrong.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You care about nobody except for yourself. I see no point in dragging this whole thing out.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you knew what a friend is, if you knew how to love... you'd understand what I'm saying.

You take a step forward. With your shackles activated, you thrust your hand into the bubble, which is crying as ever, and grab the core. Instantly, the two of you are transported back to the sea of red flowers.

speaker: Corpus
content: Argh... It hurts! Let go of me, let go of me!

speaker: Corpus
content: Are you trying to consume me, your friend, in the way a Corpus does? Are you trying to take my power?

speaker: Choice
options: I'm trying to end my enemy, to end this catastrophe.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not my friend. You hurt my friends. I'll put an end to all the tragedies you're causing here and now.

speaker: Corpus
content: You're turning your back on me. You're turning your back on me... After all this, you still turn your back on me!!

speaker: Corpus
content: We are one and the same! You don't even dare tell them your secret, tell them who you really are!

speaker: Choice
options: I don't know who I am. But I'm sure I'm nothing like you.

speaker: Chief
content: I don't look back, I look forward. Who am I, who are my friends... That's for me to decide.

speaker: Corpus
content: No...!!
You pluck out the core. As soon as you do so, the colossal entity crumbles into dust, which falls onto the sea of red flowers and is taken up like fertilizer.
In your hand is a piece of broken bone, throbbing feebly. It is then disintegrated by your blazing shackles and reabsorbed into you.
The carnival Black Ring, which has trapped nearly 30 thousand people in an illusory realm and has been there for 23 years...
It's now gone forever.
The red ring overhead breaks up into millions of pieces, which turn into ashes that blend with the dark clouds.
A mass of bubbles rises out of nowhere in the park, washing away the blood-redness of the air, dissolving the ruins, and returning the Rust to its former self. Those long-lost years are unveiled.
Supported by Hella and Hecate, one at each side, you make your unsteady way out of the park along a muddy path.

speaker: Hella
content: Holy ****, not even one whole brick can be seen now. That illusory realm was badass.
The park was noisy and chaotic. It is quiet now. The complaining of Hella rings loud and clear in the deserted place.

speaker: Hella
content: So... Hamel is dead?

speaker: Hella
content: The woman from the 9th Agency said, you must kill Hamel if you want to destroy the Black Ring. Now that the Black Ring is gone... I quite liked that beautiful lady in white.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, you said in the final battle, it was a Corpus, not the real Hamel.

speaker: Hecate
content: What made you think that?

speaker: Parma
content: She wandered here all by herself, looking for companionship and love. She grew her power bit by bit and unleashed the Black Ring on her own. Don't you think that's praiseworthy?

speaker: Parma
content: But someone kept standing in her way.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: When the carnival was in full swing, with the sky glowing red, people started carousing and tussling. I saw my body going contorted, and when I thought everything was going to end in this madness... Hamel showed up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A Black Ring is a dark will rooted in its Master, a dark will in its most extreme and purest form, or a dark desire, if you like. This is why it can create an astonishingly powerful field of mental contamination that allows the owner to control everything in the ring.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In the case of the BR-004, the source was Zoya's burning desire to destroy. In the case of this place... the source was that thing's twisted desire for love. No way she was the Hamel we met.
Saying it had a personality would be a stretch. It's more like an imitation of a personality. You could sense nothing human about it.
If she identified with you, it's the unnatural part of you that she identified with, the part that you're not able to control. She saw nothing else but herself.

speaker: Choice
options: Sinner Hamel was not the owner of the Black Ring.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My thinking is the Corpus was already here long ago, and the Black Ring had come into being even before the real Hamel entered the park.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since its appearance, the BR-001 had been in a stable state of low activity for a very long time, probably because Hamel the Sinner created her own illusory realm to offset the effects of the Black Ring and suppress the monsters inside it.

speaker: Hecate
content: But the power of the BR-004 came from an S-Class Sinner going deranged. What about this place?

speaker: Hecate
content: If the real Hamel didn't get inside the Black Ring until after it had appeared, then who provided the mental contamination needed to initiate the BR-001?

speaker: Hella
content: It's them, those sick bastards who held umbrellas on a sunny day and ignited spontaneously?!
<color=#fb9259>Parma</color>... You refrain from bringing up the name of the man Hella detests. The very thought of the man—the things he said and did, makes your stomach churn.

speaker: Choice
options: That's a possibility. They did have the power.

content: The raincoat men penetrated deep into Hamel's illusory realm without being driven out. They couldn't be humans. They had been funneling contamination to the carnival all this time. This is why the Corpus became berserk so fast.

Even without your involvement, the balance between the healing illusory realm and the dark one would've been broken eventually. Those people, beyond doubt, have the power to awaken a Corpus and create a Black Ring.
But... something doesn't add up. If some powerful Sinner other than Hamel was used to feed the Corpus, why is that I didn't sense the will of that Sinner in the Corpus?
If they can create a Black Ring without using a Sinner, then why did they go to such great lengths to get Zoya to that BR-004?

And... if their goal was to awaken the Corpus, why did they do nothing to stop you from foiling their plan? What does the man think of you? What are they going to do next? What should you do in response?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, Let's go back, we can think about all this later. You gave it your all and destroyed the Black Ring. You've delivered on your promise.

speaker: Hecate
content: Look! They came to pick us up.

speaker: Hella
content: Yahoo, they were quick this time.
You hear the roar of helicopters. The FAC ground forces have arrived at where you are at the foot of the Ferris wheel. The captain comes up to you. He looks around, astounded.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: The first Black Ring is finally gone. 23 long years, and barely half a day with you in it, you made it go away. What did you do?

speaker: Hella
content: It wasn't as easy as it seemed. It felt like a ******* lifetime to me. I'm totally spent.

speaker: Choice
options: Space-time within the Ring was bent. We were not that powerful.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: I don't agree. You did destroy the Black Ring. This is the second one you destroyed. It can't be happenstance. We'll have to do a deep analysis, and it's likely we'll have an entirely new take on our strategy against Black Rings.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: The headquarters are expecting your speedy return, to report on every detail of the operation.

speaker: Choice
options: You're gonna lock me up in the interrogation room again?

speaker: FAC Captain
content: You possess some unknown yet formidable power. The FAC has to stay alert at all times. That's our responsibility. But it never crosses the headquarters' mind to do anything out of bounds to you.
And it hits you. It's not the FAC who is going to do the interrogating.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Besides, the Black Ring reached a risk level of S+ at its height, but the FAC suffered no casualties.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Everyone in the FAC is forever ready to die for the city. Still, I feel compelled, for myself and on behalf of every soldier who was stationed here and their families, to express my greatest gratitude to you.
He snaps to attention, salutes you, and bows low.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: We'll take it from here. The Rust is no longer in the grip of the BR-001. We'll tie up any loose ends. You have brought us hope, that there is a way to end Black Rings. One day, the Rust will become vibrant again.
He leaves you. A helicopter has landed behind him. And you spot another familiar face.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Long time no see, Chief. Glad to see you're safe and sound.

speaker: Choice
options: Did it cause any troubles, me acting without authorization?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Rest assured, they've been taken care of, all of them. No interrogation, no harassment. You'll be reinstalled immediately, or you can take some time off if you wish to do so.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I will not let anyone harass you again.

speaker: Nightingale
content: That's what I'm supposed to do.
The two of you have been out of touch since the breakup of the negotiation in the square. It feels somewhat awkward now.

speaker: Nightingale
content: And I... I owe you an apology.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I distrusted your decision and misjudged the situation. Not only that, I also made mistakes regarding the negotiation. You were right not to trust me. I didn't do what I could to support you.

speaker: Birth, aging, sickness, and death are but norms of life, not to mention the pains of facing what we despise, parting from what we cherish, and yearning for what we cannot have. If one fails to find beauty within cruelty and suffering, how are they to navigate this harsh world? Just like her...
content: As it turned out, you were right, you chose the right path, and you had the strength and determination to see it through.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I will never repeat such mistakes. Whatever choice you make in the future, I will not doubt it, and the MBCC will do everything in its power to support you.

speaker: The girl is quick on her feet, but the young Daoist is quicker. His hand closes around her wrist just as she thinks she's slipped free. She sighs, shoulders slumping—there's no dodging the paddling now.
${PlayerName}
content: In that case, the first thing I'm gonna ask of you is to continue to be a clear-headed adjutant, continue to keep me on my toes and give me unbiased advice.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Copy that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Benefit of hindsight, that's all. I had no way of knowing if I took every right step. And you were not there with me, so it was impossible to get a full picture.
Your hands were tied at the time. You couldn't have divulged everything to her.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're so kind... Could I ask you a question?

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Do you... still want to go back to the MBCC?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Or if you have some other plan... I'll do my best to help you with that, as my last task as your adjutant.
You're somewhat surprised to hear that. You look at her, then at the two Sinners.

speaker: Choice
options: This matter had never crossed my mind until you brought it up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Me going back or not, it depends on how well you'll perform in the future. But today, I'll return to the MBCC.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Great. You'll be welcomed.
Right on cue, a call comes through.

speaker: Langley
content: Great job, rookie.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you listening in on me?

speaker: Langley
content: It is a nice surprise. I was just thinking about you too.

speaker: Langley
content: Oh, just a coincidence. Creating coincidences, that's what the 9th Agency does.
You hear the noise of rotor blades spinning on the other end of the line.

speaker: Langley
content: Yeah. I had faith in your proposal from the get-go. I believed your operation would work, and that you would emerge victorious.

speaker: Langley
content: So I'm already back for the celebratory drinks party. Congratulations!
...Bang!

speaker: Hella
content: **** me! Was that party poppers?! Or fireworks?! I want to see it too!!

speaker: Choice
options: What kind of celebratory party leaves out the person being congratulated?

speaker: Langley
content: Sorry... Special agents have a tight schedule. We have to deal with traitors and get rid of the evil forces. Those rats in the gutter have reared their ugly heads again...

speaker: Langley
content: Oh, by the way, you and your MBCC are now officially under the leadership of the 9th Agency, which means, from now on, I'm your boss.

speaker: Langley
content: Enjoy the last bit of your leisure time. Your work ahead won't be easy.
The line is cut off.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I'll smooth this out. No one can force you to do anything you don't want to, not even that woman.
You could be mistaken, but you feel that she didn't sound as confident as before.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Let's get out of here. Though BR-001 has been destroyed, there's still contamination left here. It's going to take a long time to clean it up.

speaker: Choice
options: ...Could you check up on something for me?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Certainly.

speaker: Choice
options: I want to know if there are other survivors.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: An old man, and if we're lucky, maybe a Sinner. They helped me out tremendously.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I'm sorry. The FAC has searched the area affected by the Black Ring. You're the last and only survivor we found in the ruins.

speaker: Choice
options: Could you have them search again, look more closely?

speaker: Nightingale
content: The search they conducted was at the highest level, because they wanted to find you. But there are no other survivors, not even active Corruptors. They're all gone.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Otherwise, we wouldn't have been able to get to you so easily.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When a Black Ring is destroyed, it stops expanding, but the contamination that already exists won't just disappear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You said, the FAC is still in the square taking care of the remaining Corruptors from BR-004. The number of missing people in BR-001 was several dozen times higher than that in BR-004. How could all these Corruptors vanish without a trace?

speaker: Nightingale
content: We don't have an explanation either... In fact, this crisis was a level S+ incident. At its height, it had an estimated risk level higher than the Keylan Square incident.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The FAC took emergency action and dispatched troops to surround the entire Rust, out of concern that when the Black Ring was destroyed, tens of thousands of out-of-control Corruptors might escape the Rust and attack the surrounding area.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But that didn't happen. There are no Corruptors going manic and loss of lives. We wondered if it was because of something you'd done...

speaker: Choice
options: I don't have that kind of power. I did nothing of that sort.

content: But someone did. This person took away every tattered puppet, gave you light in the final battle, and was your comrade in arms.
Tens of thousands of Corruptors gathering together but not going manic. A feat like this... only one person could pull it off.
You set off to look for her.
You return to the lake where you said goodbye to her.
The Black Ring has been destroyed, but the contamination lingers. The taintless phantoms are gone, so are the shifting mist, the glints of light on the water, and the graceful dancer in white.
But under the surface, pinpoints of blue light swirl.

speaker: Hecate
content: Who is down there? There is a source of power in the lake, very strong and... very twisted.

speaker: Hella
content: Is it her?
Hella tries to jump in the lake, only to be hit by something solid. The lake surface, like a colossal mirror, blocks the entry of anything and anyone.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Abnormality detected! Distorted dimension! It's Mania! Focus fire on the target!

speaker: Choice
options: It won't work. Firepower doesn't work on her.
