content: Hecate! Don't just stare! Get me down!

speaker: Hecate
content: She means no harm.

speaker: Hella
content: How would you know? Don't come crying for help if she picks you up like this later, too!

speaker: Crache
content: I promised that "dear Chief" of yours to <color=#fb9259>look after you</color>. I can pick you up and throw you down there any time I want.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...You met Chief?

speaker: Hecate
content: What did he tell you?
female_content: What did she tell you?

content: Hecate's tone is gloomy and somber. Crache glances at her, and tosses Hella next to her like a rag doll.

speaker: Crache
content: Sigh... He said he had to go do something stupid, and didn't want you to get involved. He knew you wouldn't listen to him, so he had to leave secretly.
female_content: Sigh... She said she had to go do something stupid, and didn't want you to get involved. She knew you wouldn't listen to her, so she had to leave secretly.

speaker: Hecate
content: Is he in danger right now?
female_content: Is she in danger right now?

speaker: Crache
content: Who knows. Probably doing better than you two.

speaker: Hecate
content: Then where is Chief...

speaker: Crache
content: Tsk... I don't like passing messages for people, and I certainly don't like doing things for grown-ups. I'm already making an exception right now.

speaker: Crache
content: That guy's really worried about you two, and hopes you can have a safe return. If you care about him so much, you should take good care of yourselves first.
female_content: That lady's really worried about you two, and hopes you can have a safe return. If you care about her so much, you should take good care of yourselves first.

speaker: Crache
content: Syndicate is already in chaos. Don't run around here, and don't get whisked away so easily. This place is rotten to the core. Go back to the Bureau and never come back.

speaker: Hecate
content: I get it now. Chief is still in Syndicate. Where is he?
female_content: I get it now. Chief is still in Syndicate. Where is she?

speaker: Crache
content: ...You little tyke...

speaker: Hecate
content: My mission is to protect Chief. If Chief comes to Syndicate, I will follow him here. If Chief thinks there's still hope for this place, I will be by his side.
female_content: My mission is to protect Chief. If Chief comes to Syndicate, I will follow her here. If Chief thinks there's still hope for this place, I will be by her side.

speaker: Hecate
content: I don't need you to tell me what to do.

speaker: Hella
content: Exactly! Even though I always complain about this place, I don't like it when you say things like that.

speaker: Hella
content: So many people are trying their best to do good things, like the Legion, Rustfire, and also ${PlayerName}. They're all trying to change Syndicate for the better. Who are you to say that it's rotten to the core?

speaker: Hella
content: You're so young but you sound like a grandma. Don't you know that change is coming to Syndicate?
She starts using other people's catchphrases to boast.

speaker: Crache
content: ...All of you are so naive. This is all your <color=#fb9259>Chief</color>'s fault, isn't it. He seems like a daydreamer.
female_content: ...All of you are so naive. This is all your Chief's fault, isn't it. She seems like a daydreamer.

speaker: Crache
content: It's too late for change now.

speaker: Crache
content: No matter what you think, or whether you like it or not, most people here have become habituated to violence. It's their first go-to whenever there's trouble.

speaker: Crache
content: They'll use violence to try to bring change. They'll use violence to achieve their dreams. The easiest and most effective solution in Syndicate is always violence. If there's a coup now, it'll only...

speaker: Crache
content: Forget it. If you really care about him, think of a way to get him out.
female_content: Forget it. If you really care about her, think of a way to get her out.

speaker: Crache
content: Before that raven catches up, I'll let you guys out. Hurry, first...
Boom—
The contamination bursts like a spring, unleashing violent tremors.

speaker: Crache
content: What's going on down there? I thought that monster's already dead. Could it be that the other half is...

speaker: Hecate
content: It's shackles!

speaker: Hecate
content: I feel the shackles down there! Chief is fighting!
Outside of the Executive Committee's secret branch, several teams of Executive Officers are on standby. From time to time, violent tremors can be heard from inside.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: So many Executive Officers have been dispatched. Are they here to help ${PlayerName} fight?

speaker: Taran
content: ...Their movements are so sharp and clean-cut. They're a lot stronger than regular execs. The Executive Committee has never produced such a strong team before.

speaker: Taran
content: Also, ${PlayerName} is supposed to be fighting the monster. Why didn't they go in to help... Kinda weird.

speaker: Taran
content: Tsk, there's no time. In any case, he's not doing well in there. We need to hurry. Let's find a blind spot to break in and find ${PlayerName}.
female_content: Tsk, there's no time. In any case, she's not doing well in there. We need to hurry. Let's find a blind spot to break in and find ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Taran
content: If all goes well, we can bring him back the same way without getting noticed. I suspect these people at the door have other plans... that won't be good for ${PlayerName}.
female_content: If all goes well, we can bring her back the same way without getting noticed. I suspect these people at the door have other plans... that won't be good for ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: All right.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: ...So this is an Executive Committee detention center! Could those imprisoned here be...

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Where did they all go? Did the monster already...

speaker: Taran
content: Calm down! Don't think about the what-ifs right now. The first thing we have to do is find ${PlayerName}. It's too late to think about anything else.
Gritting his teeth and clenching his fists, he strides forward, hoping to concentrate.
After running forward a bit, they hear feeble moans amidst the chaotic sounds. It's coming from a cell nearby.

speaker: Taran
content: Someone's there? This way!

speaker: Taran
content: ${PlayerName}?!

He barges into the cell, only to see a stranger infected with Mania on the ground, tormented by extreme mental pain. Several others rush in behind him, and the most decisive one quickly shoots the infectee to put him out of his misery.

speaker: Taran
content: Is this just a coincidence... It's just one person, yet...

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Taran... Look at these marks, could it be...
The familiar drawing style and Rustfire marks are what the elite team used in training. Taran's pupils dilate. He almost roars out in fury, and uses his last shred of sanity to issue a final warning.
This was a trap. Someone lured him to this room on purpose to make him see what happened to the elite team.
Bang—the cell door suddenly slams shut, cutting them off from their companions and locking them inside. A hologram lights up in the darkness, and a woman's voice begins to speak.

speaker: X
content: Hello.

speaker: X
content: The current situation's not looking good for you. But you have the chance to make a choice.

speaker: X
content: Surrender. Everyone has the chance to make that new choice.

speaker: Taran
content: ...Everyone... Did you also say this to the people locked up in this room?

speaker: X
content: If you're talking about the elite Rustfire combatants, then yes. They got that chance, too.

speaker: X
content: They all surrendered.

speaker: Taran
content: That's impossible! What did you do to them? What happened to them here?!!

They hear a hail of gunfire and screams outside the door, followed by silence. The faces of everyone in the room become as white as paper. Taran's sanity finally snaps. He whips out his gun, trying to find the source of the voice.

speaker: X
content: While everyone gets a fair chance, we don't have much time to convince everyone.

speaker: X
content: So think about your choice, my friends. You are responsible for your own choices.

speaker: Taran
content: ...Kill us, then what...

speaker: Taran
content: We're all tough nuts in Rustfire. As long as Syndicate still exists, there will be those who resist you. The more people you kill, the more people will turn against you.

speaker: Taran
content: Don't think you can trample us under your feet.

speaker: X
content: Actually, I can. I can issue a Purge Order, but it's costly. I had to optimize the plan and borrow your "leader."

speaker: X
content: Your beloved leader is here. The one you trust, depend on, and whose name you've used to recruit so many to join Rustfire. His choices have great appeal.
female_content: Your beloved leader is here. The one you trust, depend on, and whose name you've used to recruit so many to join Rustfire. Her choices have great appeal.

speaker: X
content: All we need is for him to join us, and he will do so soon.
female_content: All we need is for her to join us, and she will do so soon.

speaker: Taran
content: He's not that kind of person! He'll never be corrupted by you!
female_content: She's not that kind of person! She'll never be corrupted by you!

speaker: X
content: Perhaps. But it doesn't really matter what he does.
female_content: Perhaps. But it doesn't really matter what she does.

speaker: X
content: All we need to do is show everyone that he "chose" us. As long as we bring him back to Nirvana, we can publish whatever news we want about what he says and does.
female_content: All we need to do is show everyone that she "chose" us. As long as we bring her back to Nirvana, we can publish whatever news we want about what she says and does.

speaker: X
content: As soon as we send out this news, Rustfire will fracture from the inside. People will start to have doubts and think about other options. They will no longer be united and start to distrust or attack each other.

speaker: X
content: Remember that "leader" who betrayed you eight years ago? He released several public statements of capitulation.

speaker: X
content: Those were all fake. He simply wasn't awake, nor did we need him to wake up to express any statements.

speaker: X
content: Just making you think he betrayed you is enough. After all, that was your leader.
Taran's breathing speeds up, and his bloodshot eyes blur his vision.

speaker: Taran
content: ...It was you. It was all your conspiracy.

speaker: Taran
content: Our demands weren't unreasonable... Yet you chose to massacre us... You think Syndicate deserves to live under your oppression...?

speaker: X
content: Alright. I have no time to convince every single person. Your choice is...

speaker: Taran
content: Go to hell!!!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Taran! Watch out!! Ah...!

<size=30>A hail of gunfire goes off at the same time as the boy's hysterical roar. The rage and despair gets transmitted to the other end of the comms, but does not affect the woman one bit. She goes through the files of all the Rustfire members at the scene, before finally stopping at Taran's file.</size>

speaker: X
content: What a nice young man. Open the door when he's the only one left.

speaker: X
content: He's perfect.
You try to find traces left behind by the Corpus, but it's very difficult. This detention center is smaller than the Drifter Camp, yet the hidden monster still makes one anxious and frightened.

speaker: Armed Executive Officer
content: Where's the monster? Where's the monster?? Give me Hypercubes! Save me! Save me!!

speaker: FAC Elite
content: Chief! Stand behind me. The anti-Mania field's not that strong. We're no match against this monster.

speaker: FAC Elite
content: Retreat first. Wait for troop redeployment.

speaker: Choice
options: It's too late. If we let it escape, it will be hard to find it again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You guys go first...
Bam—!!
Those two get crushed right in front of you. After the vicious attack, the monster swiftly flees. Only its abominable voice lingers in the room.
Something is coming towards you...
The fierce battle eases down, as if the warring sides have distanced themselves from each other. You can't see it, but you feel it everywhere. Suddenly, you hear a voice in your head.

speaker: Corpus
content: You... are the same as her...

speaker: Corpus
content: O holder of the shackles... You have been awakened just like us... Yet you're able to devour us...

Its voice is weak, yet shows an iron will to live. It seems that the closer it is to death, the better it can hide. This perseverance is what made it able to survive for eight years after it got cut in half.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who am I the same as? Who took what from you? Where is she now?

speaker: Corpus
content: Huff...

speaker: Corpus
content: Haha... somewhere. She's waiting...

speaker: Corpus
content: That arrogant devil... When it becomes chaotic, tyrannical, mad, and unrestrained on the surface, she'll come... to finish the reaping, as she always has...

speaker: Corpus
content: Don't worry, very soon... As long as I kill you... I'll have the power to take revenge on her...

speaker: Corpus
content: ...This time... I'm going to kill all of you, one by one!
Something with the suffocating force of another dimension is coming towards you! You try to block it with your shackles, but the moment you cast the shackles—
Space starts to warp. This is no longer the Executive Committee's detention center. As the huge half of the Corpus appears before your eyes, the heavy contamination suffocates you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <size=32>Perhaps due to the Ring Master's power, the two half-bodies, one dead and one alive, are still somehow deeply connected. The living half is out there spreading Mania and devouring humans' spiritual energy. The resulting contamination is transferred to the dead half.</size>
Is this... the dead half of the Corpus at the bottom of BR-002?

No, it's just a blurry apparition. You want to use your shackles to check if your surroundings are real or not, but at that moment, a blue light flashes, and an almost instinctive fear makes you flinch.

speaker: Corpus
content: ...Haha... Haha... Standing there like a fool...

speaker: Corpus
content: So... you get scared, too...

speaker: Corpus
content: You'll be the first one to die here!!

-Chief?
-Chief!
Chief is really down there. I can feel it!
You hear familiar voices. Your shackles clearly feel the presence of two others. It's Hella and Hecate! They followed you here?
No, they're not in the detention center. They're in the mine, above the dead Corpus. The two places are connected via the two halves of the Corpus, and you can sense each other through the shackles.
You see the Nightmare above you cloaked in shadows, desperately trying to penetrate the precipitation pool to find you. Its intrusion is making the Corpseborne panic.

speaker: Corpus
content: Go away! Not again!
A huge amount of contamination rushes toward the Nightmare, while you instinctively make a move at the same time.
Sharp red light zips through the air and shatters the contamination entangling the Nightmare, then blasts through all the barriers above.

Something zips through space and obliterates the contamination, wiping out all the accumulated precipitation. The ground collapses, and Crache barely manages to catch the two Sinners with her shadows.
What has pierced through the abyss is an intense and familiar red light.

speaker: Crache
content: ...What's going on?

speaker: Hecate
content: It's the shackles! Hella, it's Chief!

speaker: Hella
content: Hmm... I see it, and I feel it, but it seems different from his usual one... Hey Hecate, where are you going?!
female_content: Hmm... I see it, and I feel it, but it seems different from her usual one... Hey Hecate, where are you going?!

content: Hecate breaks free from the shadows and jumps down alongside the Nightmare.

Hecate ignores the darkness and contamination falling down alongside her. ${PlayerName} is down there, and all she wants to do is find ${PlayerName}. A black bird swoops down and grabs onto her, but does not take her away.
The black bird escorts her all the way down. When they finally reach the bottom, Hecate hears ${PlayerName}'s voice.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hecate? Why are you here? I clearly...

speaker: Hecate
content: I want to fight for Chief, I want to stay at your side, I promise to get stronger... Please don't abandon me!

speaker: Hecate
content: Where are you, Chief? Please, answer me!

Hecate runs around in the center of the contamination, but fails to find the one she wants. Overcome with emotions, she has lost all reason and judgment, making her more vulnerable than ever. The Nightmare screams, as if about to go on a rampage.
Suddenly, she hears a familiar voice and feels warmth on her collarbone.

speaker: Choice
options: ...I am sorry for making you so worried.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I did some stupid things that I didn't want you to know about. But it's good that you came.
From afar, you hear Hella's voice, Crache's angry roar, as well as the flocking ink-black birds. You know that Raven is nearby. She has kept her promise to protect these children.
After sighing in relief, you tighten your grip on the shackles and speak softly to Hecate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: See that monster with half a body? Defeat it with me. We must win this together. Neither one of us is allowed to die.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I need you, Hecate. I need you to fight for me, and I need you to protect yourself even more.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't fall where I can't see you.
This huge half of the Corpus collapses and dissolves to dust, severing the link between the living and dead halves. The Corpseborne lets out an angry roar, but then slowly leaves the mine.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I did it...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, I did it! I can fight alongside you!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah, thank you. You were a huge help.
The shackles fade away, too. Soon, you won't be able to hear each other, but Hecate has never felt so at ease.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I still have some work to do. I'll finish it soon. Stay with your new friends and wait for me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When I'm done, I'll come pick you up right away.
You see the raging Corpseborne in front of you. It can no longer hide its body. A huge monster with half a body glares down at you.

speaker: Corpus
content: Haha... This again... In that same place...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Was that the place where you were cut in half? Where you were almost devoured, and could only survive by hiding yourself?

speaker: Corpus
content: Ahhhh!! Why?!!

speaker: Corpus
content: I didn't rise from the darkness, break free from chaos, condense into flesh and blood, and unleash all this Mania for you!!

speaker: Corpus
content: We were not born to be your food! I don't accept that!! My flesh, blood, and consciousness belongs to me! Nothing about me belongs to you!

speaker: Corpus
content: I will take back everything you took from me! I will take back my own power!

speaker: Corpus
content: If you want to devour me too, I'll kill and eat you right here, then go find her!!
Anger, hatred, resentment, stubbornness... You feel a plethora of intense emotions through your shackles, many of which are quite familiar.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: This is our mine! It belongs to Syndicate!
The Rustfire members who were devoured...
Its emotions are so similar to theirs. That's why the Corpus of BR-002 was so obsessed with the Drifter Camp and devouring Rustfire.

speaker: Raven
content: Scores of people probably got infected with Mania, but there weren't many reports of them turning into Corruptors. But I imagine quite a few of those infected in Inner Bay became Sinners.

speaker: Raven
content: These were people who mined at the foot of DisSea's Black Ring. They refused to bow their heads even in the face of the great explosion. They had the skills, and they had perseverance. Weren't they cool?

They were the last witnesses of the golden age, and the progenitors of Rustfire's resolve. These were the people who made the Corpus of BR-002 so strong. This is why it showed so much strength and perseverance even when cut in half.
Perhaps monsters born from Mania all love such pure spirits, and yearn to drive them into despair. Whether it's Sinners or crowds... this was why they came out of chaos into existence.

speaker: Choice
options: But you are not them after all.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your flesh and blood belong to human beings, and so do your ideals. You took everything from them to rebel against your own destiny. But likewise, the people you robbed were also not born for you. They're also not your food.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Perhaps Syndicate will still be in chaos, but that's their business. It's not a hunting ground for a monster like you. You should stop right now!

speaker: Corpus
content: Don't get so full of yourself!
It strikes the ground angrily, spewing out contamination with each blow.

speaker: Corpus
content: Ahhh... This again... This again... Those despicable shackles... That despicable f****...!

speaker: Corpus
content: I won't die at your hands for a second time! I'll never... ah!!!
Red light pierces out from the ground, penetrating and binding its limbs as it tries to escape. The weakened monster turns its head to look at its tiny enemy in resentment and fear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm tired of playing hide-and-seek with you.

speaker: Corpus
content: ...Ha... Haha, you want to devour me?

speaker: Corpus
content: Do you dare to use your shackles? You don't! You're totally different. Yours is defective, and not only that, it's also bound and constrained!

speaker: Corpus
content: If you try to devour me with it, you'll get torn apart, too! You'll also... Ahhhh!!!

The blue light reappears and pierces your consciousness the same moment you pierce the Corpus' core. It saps your strength, and you feel as if you're getting torn asunder. This blue light truly strikes fear into your heart.

Where did it come from? The enemy's body? Is it there to protect its core and block your attack? Or does it come from some unknown corner, and belong to some consciousness beyond your control that's countering your actions?
The bone-chilling cold of the blue shackles leaves you no time to think any further. That monster is still struggling and trying to escape, but you're equally persistent...

speaker: Corpus
content: Aaaahhh...!! Why... what did you do to me??

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hehe... Yes, I don't want to die yet... So... I won't devour you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I also don't want you to escape... So I did a little experiment...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You were the first Corpseborne I cast my shackles upon... I didn't make too deep of a mark, but just enough to find you. From now on, we are one. I'll be able to find you wherever you go.

speaker: Corpus
content: D-don't think you can get out of this alive!
It waves with all its strength, hitting you with gusts of wind. Pierced by the blue light, you're powerless to fight against it, and get blown aside like a piece of paper. You finally let go.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Okay... You can go now... Flee as hard as you can... I can't do anything about it...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But in the future, those humans you regard as food will come to deal with you.

Your vision becomes a red blur. Your mind is blacking out, but you can feel it escaping from the other side of the shackles. That weak monster has been brought completely under control, and won't be hard to suppress.

speaker: Corpus
content: That woman will kill you! She'll kill all of you! She's here already!

speaker: Corpus
content: That arrogant devil... When it becomes chaotic, tyrannical, mad, and unrestrained on the surface, she'll come... to finish the reaping, as she always has...
Your mind gradually slackens and relaxes. Wouldn't it be bad if chaos continues to plague West District? Even though your energy is limited, shouldn't you still do something?

After all, Mania and Black Rings are simply endpoints. What a strange city. What a strange era. Disasters seem to all stem from people's hearts. The ills that people want to ignore all eventually erupt into monsters.

speaker: Stumbling Contaminated Creature
content: Grrr... Grrrr... I'll kill you... kill...
Sigh... it still has some tricks up its sleeve for you. What are you going to do? Pierced by the blue shackles, you have no more strength to fight.
And to think you were trying to look tough in front of Hecate and others just now. Now that you're actually on your own, you're really struggling.

speaker: Stumbling Contaminated Creature
content: ...Kill you!! Grrr!!
A sharp wire glowing blue cuts through the monster's gel, making it fall in a heap on the ground. A hand yanks you away from the contamination.

speaker: Taran
content: Huff... Huff... Come with me...

<size=31>Seeing that you're unable to stand, he quickly treats your wounds, and hoists you up with his shoulders. The youth is riddled with wounds. His eyes are bloodshot, and his whole body is quivering uncontrollably. There's blood on his face, which didn't look like his own.</size>

A lot of contamination monsters are approaching. He pelts them with gunfire with one hand. When he runs out of bullets, he tosses the empty gun aside and quickly draws another. You notice he's carrying an unusually large amount of weapons.

speaker: Taran
content: I'm taking you back... You can't die here. I can't let them take you away... Even if I'm the last one standing, I will... take you back...

He doesn't answer your question, and just keeps muttering the same few words over and over again in a trembling voice. He no longer seemed like a battle-hardened Rustfire combatant, but a frightened child left behind on the battlefield.
He staggers and almost falls, but continues to drag you along with stubborn fervor.

speaker: Choice
options: Don't worry, kid. It's okay now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I found that monster. We hold the initiative now.
You raise your hands to cast the shackles on him, but realize you don't have the strength to summon them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's no need to sacrifice so many people. You guys can find a way out. You have time. You don't need to fight so desperately anymore...

speaker: Taran
content: No... They won't give up... That thing has no humanity. It doesn't care about human life... It's not human at all...

speaker: Taran
content: Both eight years ago and now... Its target has always been... Rustfire... No...

speaker: Taran
content: No... All of us... All of Syndicate... It slaughtered us however it liked... That bastard... That bastard...

speaker: Taran
content: It's got its eyes on you. You'll get used, too. It'll use you to destroy everything... You have to go... You must not... fall into their hands...

speaker: Taran
content: I'll... take you away...
You still want a clear answer, but in barges a sudden rumble of footsteps. Taran roars, and gunshots ring out. Soon, both of you get knocked to the ground. You hit your head and lose your vision.
Someone grabs you and drags you along the ground for a distance. Taran's hysterical screams ring in your ears, but you can't make out what he's saying.
Hush wants this one.
Clean everything else up.
Finish the job... quickly...
Bang—you hear someone falling to the ground.
Bang—you hear another person falling to the ground. The footsteps around you become chaotic.

Someone grabs you by the neck and starts pulling you back in panic. Chaotic gunfire erupts all around you. You hear a bloodcurdling roar riddled with anger, despair, and mad persistence, emanating Sinner-like power. Then...
The last thing you remember is something striking you.
DisSea
The black raven on the boat goes into a fit. At the same time, both Hella and Hecate suddenly collapse, as if drained of all energy. Crache looks at them in confusion.

speaker: Crache
content: What's wrong?

speaker: Black Raven
content: Turn around... Turn around... Leave... Leave now...
There's commotion coming from the direction of Inner Bay Shelter. Crache instinctively stops the boat, and looks into the distance vigilantly.

speaker: Hella
content: Ow... My head hurts...

speaker: Hella
content: ...The shackles feel different... What is this...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief... Chief is still alive, but...

speaker: Taran
content: I brought him back.
female_content: I brought her back.

speaker: Taran
content: It would've been a fatal blow, but Raven's poetry book saved him in the end.
female_content: It would've been a fatal blow, but Raven's poetry book saved her in the end.

speaker: Taran
content: He's still alive, but can't wake up.
female_content: She's still alive, but can't wake up.

speaker: Julien
content: Who did this?

speaker: Taran
content: The Executive Officers.

speaker: Taran
content: They will stop at nothing to eliminate Rustfire. The fastest way is to kill the leader. You should know best.

speaker: Taran
content: I can't let them take Chief away.

speaker: Taran
content: The battle isn't over yet. We still need ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Julien
content: Tell me, who did this?

speaker: Taran
content: The execs.

speaker: Taran
content: It must be them.

speaker: Taran
content: The war isn't over yet. Many got infected with Mania, and many more have joined us. There's no backing out now. Julien, light the fire.

speaker: Taran
content: Rustfire needs a leader. Right now, this is the best leader.

speaker: Taran
content: Like you said, we have to take back what we lost.

<size=30>Julien stares at the cold flames in the boy's eyes and listens to the ominous noises from outside. The fleeting spark had been extinguished, and now they are faced with familiar darkness. His clenched, bloodied fist finally relaxes, landing calmly on the wheelchair armrest.</size>
The architect chuckles.

speaker: Julien
content: You're right. There's no backing out now.

speaker: Julien
content: ...There's no backing out now.

speaker: Julien
content: Hold a ceremony for the leader. He can't fight right now, but he can still inspire others.
female_content: Hold a ceremony for the leader. She can't fight right now, but she can still inspire others.

content:
Obituary

To ${PlayerName}... our dear friend, companion, and leader.

Though he fell in the pursuit of justice, 
he won us a great victory and raised our flag.

Many more will follow in his footsteps.
female_content:
Obituary

To ${PlayerName}... our dear friend, companion, and leader.

Though she fell in the pursuit of justice, 
she won us a great victory and raised our flag.

Many more will follow in her footsteps.

content:
We will remember this moment, remember his integrity and sacrifice, 
and remember our own anger and awakening.

Right now, our shared beliefs unite us all.
female_content:
We will remember this moment, remember her integrity and sacrifice, 
and remember our own anger and awakening.

Right now, our shared beliefs unite us all.

speaker: Obituary
content:
We shall inherit his strength and will to fight. 
He is in each and every one of us now.
We shall take his spirit towards the goal he couldn't reach himself.

Come, let us wage war against evil and take back what we have lost!
female_content:
We shall inherit her strength and will to fight. 
She is in each and every one of us now.
We shall take her spirit towards the goal she couldn't reach herself.

Come, let us wage war against evil and take back what we have lost!

speaker: X
content: So, they held a ceremony. News of it must've spread far and wide. A lot of people attended, right?

speaker: X
content: How many new recruits did Rustfire attract? Confirm the numbers, and get the intelligence department to help spread their message.

speaker: X
content: Do they know how to use “shackles” now? Excellent.

speaker: X
content: Confirm the overall M-value data for West District.

speaker: X
content: ...Excellent.

speaker: X
content: Do they have internal disagreements about what to do next? Excellent.

speaker: X
content: Next, withdraw from West District and concentrate our forces on defending the Rust's isolation belt.

speaker: X
content: Give them two mining zones for now. It'll all be over soon.

speaker: X
content: Evacuate the Executive Committee Headquarters in three days. Put the name list I prepared... in a file that they can crack with a bit of effort.

speaker: X
content: My work here is done. I wish you good luck.

After ${PlayerName} fell into a deep coma, Rustfire's thirst for revenge and combat capacity strengthened considerably.

Large numbers of like-minded people from West District joined Rustfire and threw themselves into battle.
People chose counterattacking the Executive Committee over finishing off the Corpus of BR-002 without hesitation.

The battle of vengeance ended in great victory.

On March 23rd, they occupied BR-002.
On March 25th, they defeated the remaining FAC troops and occupied BR-004.
On March 26th, they defeated the main force of Executive Officers and occupied the Executive Committee Headquarters.

On March 26th, a list of spies and large quantities of evidence were found in the Executive Committee Headquarters. The traitors who betrayed and killed ${PlayerName} were exposed. Rustfire began to purge its ranks. The bloodletting has been ongoing for three days now, and the number of deaths...

<size=42>At the first, the snow falls <color=#fb9259>silently</color>

Till the energy buried for years gets <color=#fb9259>awakened</color>

by a <color=#fb9259>wish</color>

or a <color=#fb9259>slogan</color>

or perhaps an <color=#fb9259>emotion</color></size>

<size=42><color=#fb9259>People</color> of all creed and color gather together

Those who were silent, lost, and scared have all found their <color=#fb9259>calling</color>

They <color=#fb9259>fraternize</color> and <color=#fb9259>join hands</color>

to form a <color=#fb9259>brotherhood</color></size>

speaker: Poor Resident
content: Executive Committee, get out of Syndicate!!

speaker: Crowd
content: Executive Committee, get out of Syndicate!! Eastside lapdogs, get out of Syndicate!!

speaker: Tramp
content: We've had enough! Look at what you've done! Get out! Syndicate became this way all because of you!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Syndicate is ours! Rustfire will take back everything that was lost!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Our fires will rage and burn you all to ashes!
At a secret exit of Inner Bay Rail connected to a hidden sewer, three girls are hiding in the dark.

speaker: Hella
content: Huff... huff... We've been away for only a few days... How did Syndicate end up like this?

speaker: Hella
content: The ringleader is obviously a gangster. Aren't gangsters and Rustfire sworn enemies? Who's he trying to fool?

speaker: Crache
content: I don't know... He looks really fanatical. Maybe he's infected with Mania. Stay away from him.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel him...
female_content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel her...

speaker: Black Raven
content: Caw... Soon, soon... ${PlayerName} went back to get help from the MBCC. They're nearby, at...

speaker: Hecate
content: Where is he right now!
female_content: Where is she right now!

speaker: Crache
content: Calm down! Your "shackles" are acting up and they have so much influence over you. If you go out there now and run into trouble, you'll only hold us up even longer.

speaker: Crache
content: Leave things here to us. Hella!

speaker: Hella
content: What?

speaker: Crache
content: Watch over your friend, and take care of yourself. I won't be able to handle things if I'm burdened by you two dipsticks.

speaker: Crache
content: Dumb bird!

speaker: Black Raven
content: Caw... I'm going to find help, find help. I'm going find the MBCC, the FAC, or whomever. ${PlayerName} is there. Once I find help, I'll come pick you up.
It flies away, trying to find its target. But what had been an FAC security station had been completely destroyed by the rioting mob.
The mob surges to and fro, shrieking and trying to prove themselves even when there are no targets around.

Gradually, more people join in. No one cares who the people around them really are. They all drape Rustfire-like cloaks over themselves, and splash Rustfire marks on their faces and clothes. No one cares if the marks are painted wrong.
It finally spots a comms device that's still flashing and dives towards it, only for it to get pelted and destroyed by stones the moment it lands.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Die, DisCity dogs!! Take your trash and get out of Syndicate!!!

<size=42><color=#fb9259>Anyone</color> can join

Regardless of their <color=#fb9259>past</color>

Regardless of their <color=#fb9259>motives</color></size>

<size=42><color=#fb9259>Everyone</color> gets

A brand new <color=#fb9259>name</color>

A brand new <color=#fb9259>identity</color></size>

<size=42>Let them think <color=#fb9259>justice</color> is on their side

Let them think they know <color=#fb9259>the truth</color></size>

<size=42><color=#fb9259>Fan</color> their <color=#fb9259>imaginations</color>

<color=#fb9259>Unbind</color> their <color=#fb9259>shackles</color></size>
<size=42>...And they shall <color=#fb9259>unleash</color> more <color=#fb9259>power</color> than you could ever imagine.</size>

speaker: Crache
content: ...Why hasn't that dumb bird come back yet?
Having waited for the raven for so long to no avail, Crache ushers the two into an abandoned building as a precaution.

speaker: Crache
content: Hella, are you still conscious? Where's Hecate?

content: Uh... I'm fine. It's just that... my head hurts.

content: Hecate is in very bad shape. I put her to sleep, but she still looked really uncomfortable, like she's having a bad dream... Something's also wrong with her Nightmare, so I got her to put it away.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't know what'll happen when she wakes up.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Tsk. Wait here. I'll be back soon.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Our fires will rage! We'll take back everything! Take back... huh?

content: What is this place?! Are you an enemy? An exec?! No, you're just a... little kid! You got a death wish?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Ugh ahhhh! Spare me, please! I'm not a villain! I'm part of Ru-Rustfire, too!

speaker: Crache
content: You mentioned ${PlayerName}. What do you know about him? How is he?
female_content: You mentioned ${PlayerName}. What do you know about her? How is she?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Ugh ahhhh, let go of me! I'm not a bad guy! I'm here to avenge him!
female_content: Ugh ahhhh, let go of me! I'm not a bad guy! I'm here to avenge her!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Those vile execs from Eastside are the real enemies! We have to stay united! We have to avenge ${PlayerName}!

speaker: Crache
content: ...Avenge ${PlayerName}? What happened?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: What I'm trying to say...

speaker: Crache
content: What did you say?!

speaker: Crache
content: ...I'm back. Where's Hella?

speaker: Hecate
content: Where's Chief? Did you get news about Chief?

speaker: Crache
content: ...Yeah. I know where he is now.
female_content: ...Yeah. I know where she is now.

speaker: Hecate
content: Where?! Tell me! I'm going there right now!

speaker: Crache
content: No!

speaker: Crache
content: ...The situation's a bit complicated. He got injured and is receiving treatment at a... clinic.
female_content: ...The situation's a bit complicated. She got injured and is receiving treatment at a... clinic.

speaker: Crache
content: You won't be able to find it. Plus, in your current condition, you'll just be a burden if you go.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...What did you say?
As soon as Nightmare appears, it gets shrouded and immobilized by shadows.

speaker: Crache
content: What I mean is, you should stay here and hone your skills. Right now, you can't even escape these shadows.

speaker: Crache
content: You can start protecting him again once I bring him back.
female_content: You can start protecting her again once I bring her back.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Understood.

speaker: Crache
content: You guys are sure the shackles are still around, right?

speaker: Hecate
content: Of course! If the shackles had disappeared, that means Chief...

speaker: Crache
content: All right, I'll go bring him back. You guys wait here. The Homeless will come pick you up in a bit.
female_content: All right, I'll go bring her back. You guys wait here. The Homeless will come pick you up in a bit.

speaker: Crache
content: Before that happens, stay right here and don't go anywhere. Got it?

<size=42>They have<color=#fb9259> justice</color>

They have <color=#fb9259>the truth</color>

That's why they don't need to think about <color=#fb9259>right or wrong</color>

Or take responsibility for their <color=#fb9259>crimes</color></size>

Another noisy mob passes by downstairs. They smash and set fire to the abandoned building, destroying everything in sight.
The surging energy in the air stings Hecate's nerves.

speaker: Hecate
content: Such energy... There must be Sinners around... and quite a few of them, too!
She struggles up and crawls to the window, trying to hear what the crowd is saying.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Hahaha, so this is the power of the Sinners! How extraordinary! I can still feel it gushing out on the other end! I'm so excited, I can't wait!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: With these shackles, all we have to do is to touch ${PlayerName}! If only we knew it was this simple! Why didn't ${PlayerName} give us this power earlier?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Why did you wait until you died...

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Shh, don't talk nonsense. We got this power to avenge him, didn't we? We must exact justice and take back Syndicate! Take back...
female_content: Shh, don't talk nonsense. We got this power to avenge her, didn't we? We must exact justice and take back Syndicate! Take back...

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Huh... What is this?
A monstrous apparition is floating in mid-air...
It's Nightmare, swelled up to several times its original size, glaring down at the mob below.

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate!! What are you doing?! Right now you can't...
The girl stands in the center of Nightmare's palm. Right now, she has forgotten all her pain, and feels only rage and shock.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...You have shackles?

speaker: Hecate
content: Where did you get them... Where is Chief...

speaker: Hecate
content: Answer me!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: A Sinner? All by herself?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Then what are we afraid of?! There are so many of us! Attack!

speaker: Hecate
content: Answer me! Where's Chief?!

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate!!!

<size=46>Thus they <color=#fb9259>wild</color>

Thus they <color=#fb9259>reckless</color></size>

<size=50><color=#fb9259>Insatiable</color>

And <color=#fb9259>Deviant</color></size>
<size=52>Until they finally <color=#fb9259>cross the line</color></size>
<size=56>And end in <color=#dg1f1f>self-destruction</color></size>

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: H-how is this possible? How did we get beaten by two little girls?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: What did she say just now? "Chief"...?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: I get it now! She's from the higher-ups, those privileged *****! She's here to sabotage Rustfire's mission! She's not worthy of being a Sinner! We are the true Sinners!!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Come! Finish her off and then get more people from the Drifter Camp! We have more than enough people!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Is it the Drifter Camp? Is Chief in the Drifter Camp?

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare!
Nightmare roars and clears a path. Hecate jumps onto its claws and starts heading towards the Drifter Camp.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Stop her!! Kill her!

speaker: Hella
content: What are you screaming about? I'm still around. Where do you scumbags think you're going?
Hella leans against her water pipe, struggling to stand up.
The burden of the shackles proved to be too great. Coupled with attacks from so many "Sinners," she ended up getting injured.

speaker: Hella
content: For **** sake, Hecate, you're way too fast, I can't catch up... Wait up... These wounds are just scratches, they'll heal soon enough...

speaker: Hella
content: **** it hurts so much... Why must these stupid shackles mess up at a time like this... Idiot... Look at what that fool's doing without you around...
The roaring hoodlums run up from behind towards Hecate's direction.

speaker: Hella
content: But... it can't be helped. You're ${PlayerName}, after all... If you're gone for good, Hecate will get locked up in that lab again.

speaker: Hella
content: If you can't stop yourself, I wish you all the best, Hecate... Go bring ${PlayerName} back...

speaker: Hella
content: Don't worry about those hoodlums behind you.

speaker: Hella
content: I... won't let them get in your way!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: That Sinner's an enemy of the Drifter Camp, an enemy of Rustfire, the execs' dog!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: She wants ${PlayerName}! She wants to take away our power!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Stop her! Stop her!

speaker: Hecate
content: Move! Outta my way!

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare!

speaker: Nightmare
content: Roar!!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Mmph...!
Hecate has lost count of how many times she's used her power. Her emotions are surging and her mind is in chaos, causing her to lose control.
Every time she uses her power, the shackles ingrained deep in her consciousness stab her soul like a drill, tearing it apart.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Ouch... this hurts so much... Ch-chief... ${PlayerName}... Where are you...

These aren't ${PlayerName}'s shackles. ${PlayerName}'s shackles were always warm and firm. Whenever she felt fear, doubt, or lost control, the shackles would come to her aid, making sure she knew she had someone by her side.
But the other end of these shackles is pure chaos, resembling rage from a crazed abyss, or... the terrible enemy who had torn her Nightmare apart.

speaker: Hecate
content: You stole Chief's shackles... You touched all of us with Chief's shackles... You took Chief away...

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Look, she's weak! Attack her all at once!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Get rid of her!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Where are you, Chief... Get out of my way... You're the ones who took away Chief! Give him back to me! Give him back to me!!!
female_content: ...Where are you, Chief... Get out of my way... You're the ones who took away Chief! Give her back to me! Give her back to me!!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare!!
Stop it with the Nightmares. You can't hold out any longer.
A figure appears behind her and knocks her Nightmare into the ground with one punch.
The man dons a Rustfire cloak and is carrying something. Hecate can't see clearly right now, but recognizes his face.

speaker: Hecate
content: You... You are the exe...

speaker: Donald
content: ...Extreme dreamboat!

speaker: Donald
content: <size=28>Shh, I'm here to help you. Don't give it away.</size>

speaker: Hecate
content: I... don't need it! Nightmare! Nightmare!!
Nightmare tries to rush forward, but the man holds down its head as it struggles.
This is the first time that someone has cut off her attack. The sudden interruption makes Hecate lose her momentum. She slumps to the ground, totally drained.
Only then does she realize that she has over-exhausted herself. Nightmare dissolves as she musters all her strength to stand up.

speaker: Donald
content: Have a rest, little lady. You really can't keep doing this any longer.

speaker: Hecate
content: Get out of my way... I don't care what happens to me. Let me find Chief. Chief needs me... That's... my mission!

speaker: Donald
content: Is the mission all that matters? What about your own life? Poor girl...

speaker: Donald
content: Then... What about her?
Thud—he drops what he has been carrying on his shoulder in front of Hecate.
It's Hella. This powerful Sinner is riddled with injuries. It'll take her a long, long time to heal. Her pain far outweighs the speed of her recovery.

speaker: Donald
content: When you went on a rampage ignoring everything else, she's the one who stayed behind to hold off your enemies. She doesn't think that your life is worthless.

speaker: Hella
content: There's no mission that orders you to protect me, but you still do so because I'm your friend.

speaker: Hecate
content: There's no such thing.

speaker: Hella
content: Remember, we're Sinners. We have hearts of our own, and that's what gives us strength. No one can control our hearts.

speaker: Hella
content: Once you're able to leave that dark place behind and become the Hecate of your own choosing, you'll be stronger for sure.

speaker: Hecate
content: Ahh...

She suddenly feels searing pain all over her body. Sapped of energy, she tries to move forward, but not a single cell in her body listens to her commands. Hecate slumps to the ground, almost unable to even talk.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm sorry... I'm sorry... I failed again... I'm sorry...

speaker: Donald
content: ...Sigh.

speaker: Donald
content: Little lady, I still have some other things to do. Please take care of the wounded for me.

speaker: Donald
content: Plus, you're still young. No need to keep apologizing. It wasn't a huge mistake. Just say it to your friend when she wakes up.

speaker: Donald
content: This is what you should say to me:
He turns around to face the "Sinners" blocking their path.

speaker: Donald
content: "This is someone I really care about. Please help me. I don't want her to get hurt anymore!"
All those "Rustfire Sinners" got pummeled to a pulp. Donald tears off some of their cloaks—most are wearing gangster clothes underneath.
Beep beep... Beep beep...

speaker: Executive Officer
content: Sergeant Donald, the Headquarters ordered everyone to retreat. Where are you? Did you leave already?

speaker: Donald
content: <size=28>Oh s*** I forgot...</size> Ahem, I'm on my way.

speaker: Executive Officer
content: Which way are you on exactly? How long do you still need? You're heavily injured, why are you still...

speaker: Donald
content: Ooh there's gunfire! I think I hear a grenade! The signal here's not good, you're cutting off! I won't be able to make it back for at least a few days! Hold down the fort for me!

speaker: Executive Officer
content: Sergeant...

speaker: Rustfire" Gangster
content: You're a f***** exec...

speaker: Donald
content: Don't say that. Anyone who wears this cloak belongs to Rustfire, remember?

speaker: Donald
content: I think you should... Get some rest!
Bonk—the man gets knocked unconscious.
A man in tattered clothes walks over. His posture and eyes are dodgy, but he shows no malice.

speaker: Person in Tattered Clothes
content: Is... is it safe to go?
Donald nods, and goes back to the two girls. The manic girl has finally come back to her senses.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm sorry... I'm sorry...

speaker: Donald
content: Sigh... How did those bastards brainwash this little girl...

speaker: Donald
content: It's still a bit slow, but she is healing as quick as she can. Instead of apologizing, you just need to cheer her on.

speaker: Hecate
content: But... Chief is still...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief ran into trouble, yet I'm not by his side... I couldn't find him... couldn't save him...
female_content: Chief ran into trouble, yet I'm not by her side... I couldn't find her... couldn't save her...

speaker: Hecate
content: I couldn't...

speaker: Donald
content: Is that Chief someone really important to you?
Hecate freezes, then nods slowly.

speaker: Donald
content: Then I'll go bring him back. You kids go with this man to a safe place first.
female_content: Then I'll go bring her back. You kids go with this man to a safe place first.

speaker: Donald
content: Stop apologizing. Just remember to thank me when I get back. Then, you can say to your "Chief"... Let me think...

speaker: Donald
content: "Welcome back," or... "You baddy, don't make me so worried about you ever again!"

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Where did that blue-haired kid go?

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: She couldn't have gone far with those injuries! Root her out! How dare she think about snatching ${PlayerName} from right under our noses!
The two gangsters run off into the distance. Cloaked in shadows, Crache hides in mid-air and catches her breath. She's injured.
The situation is even worse than she had imagined. Though she had singlehandedly beaten a big group of Yagyu Executives before, it's a totally different story to fight a bunch of Sinners.
What's more, these Sinners have split into several factions, all attacking each other.

speaker: Crache
content: Should I call them Sinners... or monsters...
She grits her teeth as she treats her wound. She starts moving through the shadows, wondering what's going on.

speaker: Crache
content: Without a doubt, all of this is caused by Mania. Those hyperactive "Sinners" aren't just going wild from gaining a new power. The power itself is the problem.

speaker: Crache
content: This is similar to what happened to Hella and Hecate. Their minds are a lot more chaotic than before, but I don't seem to be affected at all...

speaker: Crache
content: Ha... There are more Sinners here today than all the Sinners that appeared in DisCity in the past ten years...

Guess it's really the "shackles'" fault... I'm not shackled, so I'm not affected. But the folks from the MBCC, as well as those who came to get the "shackles" on their own, are having problems. Those from the MBCC are seeing the strongest symptoms.
Hella said the shackles would be calm and stable when the Chief is around. But now that he's dead, why did they become so malevolent? What's spurring them?
female_content: Hella said the shackles would be calm and stable when the Chief is around. But now that she's dead, why did they become so malevolent? What's spurring them?

content: It can't be a Sinner. It must be something more deeply connected to him...
female_content: It can't be a Sinner. It must be something more deeply connected to her...

content: He wasn't in the mine that time, yet Hecate insisted the shackles were there, and the contamination was indeed shattered from below.
female_content: She wasn't in the mine that time, yet Hecate insisted the shackles were there, and the contamination was indeed shattered from below.

content: Those two kids said there was a powerful bond between the two halves. The shackles used this connection to cross space-time and come to the mine. Does that mean the shackles also have a powerful bond with the Corpus, and that it's still alive?
That makes sense. Their problems arose after we cleared the mine and started heading back. The shelter was also a mess when we arrived. That should be the time things went wrong.
...Was ${PlayerName} killed at that time? After he just defeated that monster? Was it because he was weakened by the battle?
female_content: ...Was ${PlayerName} killed at that time? After she just defeated that monster? Was it because she was weakened by the battle?

content: Who did it?
Rustfire claims the Executive Officers did it. Then how did Rustfire bring the Chief out?
If the culprit is Rustfire, what's their motive? What really happened at that time?

speaker: Crache
content: Ha... no, it doesn't matter anymore...

speaker: Crache
content: His death benefited everyone.
female_content: Her death benefited everyone.

content: Rustfire took up the banner of justice and grew rapidly from a small militia on the brink of annihilation to a force that expelled the Executive Committee and occupied all of West District. Both BR-004 and BR-002 are in their hands now. They've realized their goal.

The gangsters used this chance to whitewash their crimes. They became righteous Rustfire warriors by just shouting a few slogans and throwing on a cloak. Plus, they gained extraordinary powers and became Sinners by just touching the leader. That's a lot better than being a gangster.
As for the Executive Committee...

They haven't necessarily lost yet. They let Rustfire have Syndicate and a couple of Black Rings, but those fools didn't do anything with them. They didn't focus on cultivating Hypercubes, nor did they go hunt down the escaped Corpus.
The first thing they did was to come snatch up the "shackles".

speaker: Crache
content: Ha... Rustfire, take a look at the hoodlums you recruited for your so-called "future." And you wanted Syndicans to rise up and take back their future? Ha...

speaker: Crache
content: Disgusting! Absolutely disgusting!

speaker: Crache
content: How is this any different from gangs and mania weapons? There's no difference at all! From now on, a swarm of "Sinners" will terrorize Syndicate. Things will be exactly the same as before!

speaker: Crache
content: I might as well kill ${PlayerName} and get rid of the shackles for good. The shackles are a new catalyst for violence that must be eradicated before it harms more people!
Her shadow barges into the main hall, slithering along the wall towards where ${PlayerName} is lying.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: A shadow?! It's that blue-haired kid!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Protect the shackles! She's not here to take ${PlayerName} away, she's here to kill!!!! She wants to kill ${PlayerName}!!

speaker: Crache
content: I'm sick of you bastards! Look what you did to Syndicate, you...
As she goes in for the kill, she sees ${PlayerName}'s thin, calm and gentle face.
It's a face that's so out of place with Syndicate and all the filth around.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't make stuff up! ${PlayerName} would never abandon us. He'll have an explanation for this for sure!
female_content: Don't make stuff up! ${PlayerName} would never abandon us. She'll have an explanation for this for sure!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel him...
female_content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel her...

speaker: Crache
content: Everyone says they hate violence, but violence has already been ingrained in their souls. The more you want to realize a dream, the more shortcuts you're willing to take. All these years, the fastest shortcut in Syndicate has always been violence.
In her moment of hesitation, something pierces the left side of her belly.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: What an audacious little tyke... You dare harm our "leader"?

speaker: Crache
content: Ha... What a joke... If you really respected him, return him to the people waiting for him!
female_content: Ha... What a joke... If you really respected her, return her to the people waiting for her!

speaker: Crache Narration
content: Did I lose...

speaker: Crache Narration
content: Lose to these... bastards...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll think about capturing you later. Right now, I have a favor to ask you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As the guardian of children, I want to ask you to protect those two.

She's always tried her best, whether in the mines, the streets, or the Drifter Camp. Her bravery can be traced even earlier, to when the Homeless first formed, and to when she first became a Sinner—Crache had always been fighting to protect others.
Yet as slumps to the ground, the only thing protecting her is her little shadow.

The blurry, distorted figures approach her one by one. They're the "New Syndicans", yet also the same old Syndicans who prey on the weak. They will not show mercy to this little tyke at the bottom of the food chain.
From now on, there will be no one to protect other little tykes.

speaker: Crache
content: Haha... so this is the future...

speaker: Crache
content: Is it still gonna be like this... Nothing changed at all...

speaker: Crache
content: Go eat sh*t...
The shadows stop moving. She has no more strength. She wants to close her eyes and wait for her miserable life to end by the violence she despises most.
Yet in the last moment before losing consciousness, the shadows scattered on the ground shoot out and pierce every "Sinner" around Crache.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: What's happening? She already fainted, but the shadows are still...
A woman speaks up.
Like they say... Ignorance is dangerous... The uneducated will always see black as just black.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Raven from Rustfire... What are you doing here?!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Oh, right! You're here to get ${PlayerName}, too! You...

speaker: Raven
content: We'll talk about that in a bit. Right now, I'm very angry.
Dozens of ravens suddenly break in to attack the crowd, opening up a path.
The poet comes up to her fallen student from the other side of the road and helps her up in front of ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: ...Don't be scared! Don't panic! Her ink will be used up soon! She won't be able to hold out much longer! Call for backup! We have more than enough people!

speaker: Raven
content: The weapon of a poet is her thoughts, which gets conveyed through her writing. I'm quite lazy, so I didn't write that much.

speaker: Raven
content: I happen to run a school around here. I wrote a few dozen textbooks and a couple hundred poems. I finally met a student I liked enough to pass on my work to. But look what you did to her.

speaker: Raven
content: I must... avenge her.
Ink rains down from the roof and bursts into sprouts from the ground, dying the whole space black.
Before opening her eyes, Crache first catches sound of the wind, and feels grains of sand caressing her face. The weather is a bit chilly.

speaker: Black Raven
content: You're awake? Had a nice dream of soaring in the sky?

speaker: Black Raven
content: I know kids all love dreams like that.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Tsk, it's you.

speaker: Crache
content: Where am I? Where's ${PlayerName}?

speaker: Crache
content: I have to take him back. There are people waiting for him.
female_content: I have to take her back. There are people waiting for her.

speaker: Black Raven
content: Leave tedious stuff like that to the grown-ups. In a bit, I'll send you back to your cute little Homeless friends.

speaker: Crache
content: Will the grown-ups be able to handle it? "You guys" are the ones who made Syndicate end up like this.

speaker: Black Raven
content: Ha. Then why don't you try to go on your own?
Crache pouts in dissatisfaction and looks around. The huge raven is flying over the city at least fifty meters high. She finally gives up on trying to leave the bird.

speaker: Black Raven
content: What a pity it is to be stuck here with no way out. But think about it. If you had a broader outlook and greater knowledge, maybe you'd be able to find a way to escape the bird?

speaker: Crache
content: ...Must you lecture me right here and now?

speaker: Black Raven
content: Well, I have a captive audience right now. What a great opportunity. Want me to tell you about the history of DisCity?

speaker: Black Raven
content: It's a story I never heard in Syndicate.

speaker: Black Raven
content: Look. The desert in the distance used to encompass all of DisCity. This entire city-state used to be desert, and after the Perishing Star fell, it also became the center of calamity.

speaker: Black Raven
content: For a long time, people didn't have Hypercubes and were helpless against disasters. They fought each other for pitifully few resources, and had no hope of solving any problems.

speaker: Black Raven
content: Weren't they similar to today's Syndicate? They had even fewer choices than we do today.

speaker: Crache
content: "However, even in such darkness, humanity didn't give up and eventually found hope. They used Hypercubes to withstand the indomitable Apocalypse, and established a great city-state in the middle of a barren wasteland."

speaker: Crache
content: "The very existence of this city stands as a beacon of hope in the sea of darkness."

speaker: Black Raven
content: Oh? Where did you read that, little tyke? I've never encountered any schools in Syndicate other than the one I set up.

speaker: Crache
content: ...In the past, when the Homeless finished their classes, they would bring back their textbooks for me to read.

speaker: Black Raven
content: She finds herself staring into the light, tears falling quietly.

speaker: Crache
content: I already knew everything you said.

speaker: Crache
content: But I don't see it the way you do.

speaker: Crache
content: The way I see it, if Keylan hadn't come back, or if the Perishing Star had simply struck some important person's hometown, none of this would've happened.

speaker: Crache
content: Everything you see today is a fluke. But even with such good fortune, people still turned this place into a mess. Good things happen once in a blue moon. Misfortune and despair are constant.

speaker: Crache
content: I've seen too much to have any optimism. I can't change myself. I'm not a student you can teach to be good, and I don't need anyone to give me any answers.

speaker: Raven
content: ...It's fine, you don't need to change.

speaker: Crache
content: Huh?

speaker: Raven
content: This is a path you worked hard to create yourself. Even if you don't want to move forward at all and feel unhappy with each step you take, it's fine.

speaker: Raven
content: As a teacher, I want to show you a bigger world. I don't need you to believe there's always light ahead. But when you do have to take a step, I hope I can help you see more routes to choose from.

speaker: Raven
content: As a poet, I love the sight of you in pain, and I love how torn your soul is.

speaker: Raven
content: You reject hope, yet you're already the hope of many people. You hate change, yet your presence has changed the world. Only those who can't let go of the light suffer in the dark. I love that light you cling onto in your heart.

speaker: Crache
content: ...What a load of nonsense. This is why no one reads your weird poems.

speaker: Raven
content: Haha. You're still around, aren't you?

speaker: Raven
content: It's almost time for you to go. Today's class was a bit short.

speaker: Raven
content: But, thanks to you, a great poem of mine will get to live on forever. Just think of it as homework and memorize it. In the future, travel wide, and tell it to others.

speaker: Crache
content: ...What do you mean?

speaker: Raven
content: I want more people to see my adorable student.

speaker: Crache
content: I'm not asking about that. Where are you right now?
The big ink bird lets out a caw.
After a burst of gunfire, several holes get blasted into its wings. Crache's face turns blue.

speaker: Crache
content: Where are you, dumb bird? Where did you get all that ink?! Answer me!!
Raven doesn't answer. She just cackles and praises her own poem.

speaker: Raven
content: I'm your friend, they're not. So why do you care more about them than me?

speaker: Raven
content: Indulging in darkness, yet searching for light.

speaker: Raven
content: Writing poems, and becoming a poem.
The giant raven approaches the ground. She can almost see the Homeless kids waving to her. The black bird begins to dissipate, as if to say her mission is complete.
But Crache strangles the bird with her shadow, and uses it as a rein to force it to turn around. The wind whistles past her ears like bullets grazing her hair. She hears shrieks of hysteria.
Outta my way!! Where's ${PlayerName}?! Where did you take ${PlayerName} to?!
Was it that little tyke? Did ${PlayerName} leave with that kid?
Attack! Use up all that ink and those birds will come back!

speaker: Crache
content: Go back to the Drifter Camp! Go, hurry!

speaker: Raven
content: In honor of the flames rekindled amidst the rust,

speaker: Raven
content: the winds howling amidst the forest,

speaker: Raven
content: the birds fluttering their wings in the storm, the flowers blooming in the mud... ugh, no time to come up with any more... emm...

speaker: Raven
content: In honor of dreams...

speaker: Raven
content: In honor of hope...

speaker: Raven
content: In honor of...

speaker: Raven
content: ...the future.

speaker: Crache
content: Raye!!

speaker: Corpus
content: Roar!!! Roar!!!! Ahhhh!!!! Don't come over, stay away!! Don't want these!! Don't want these!!
It had long lost its cover. Though it's hard to make out its figure, its horrifying sounds rumble loudly across the earth. Wherever it goes, contamination flows like molten lava.
Julien sits in his wheelchair alone, observing the monster from a distance. He came not long after ${PlayerName}'s ceremony ended. The Corpus wasn't hard to find now.

speaker: Old Woman
content: A few days ago, everyone was running around trying to hunt down this poor thing. Now, it's here, and no one cares about it anymore.

speaker: Old Woman
content: The Overgrounders are really strange.

speaker: Julien
content: ...Yeah. Incomprehensible.

speaker: Julien
content: The script was practically identical for both times. It's as if someone tailor-made it for us.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Maybe you just never walked out of that same past. It's quite easy to deal with if you tried.

speaker: Old Woman
content: They always use the same trick to test me.

speaker: Julien
content: Was it your doing?

speaker: Old Woman
content: How could it be me? I miss the way it looked when it was first born so much. It was so beautiful, so pure... If I knew it would end up like this, I wouldn't have let it go in the first place.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Look how tragic it is now... To survive, it gorges like a glutton, and is forced to distort. It got so many desires crammed into it and is so bloated from overeating. What a mess. Now, it's even having trouble perpetuating its existence.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Ugh, it's hideous. I'm not interested in it anymore.

speaker: Julien
content: Are you from Parma? Or Nirvana?

speaker: Old Woman
content: I'm from the Underground. The person who wiped you out is from Paradeisos.

speaker: Julien
content: Really... is that so...

speaker: Julien
content: I just want to know who arranged such a fate for us. When we were thrown into the Black Ring, what was the expression on their face? Was our wish really that impermissible?

speaker: Julien
content: In hindsight, it seems... Rustfire and West District are just pawns. Pawns that you use to test each other.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Do you consider yourself unlucky, Overgrounder? Do you feel that fate has treated you unfairly?

speaker: Old Woman
content: Then... let me give you a chance to try.
She gives him a strange crystalline flower. It's red and gives off a faint, ominous glow.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Its consciousness is too chaotic. It needs an anchor to gather everyone. I think you can do it. You're a lot like the people who made it eight years ago.

speaker: Old Woman
content: In any case, I don't want it anymore. You can take it. Let's see what you can do with it.
Julien looks at it for a long time, then stretches out his hand and crushes the flower. Its crystals pierce into his body.

speaker: Julien
content: They're not things for you to pick and choose.
The old woman smiles and walks into a dark alley, where a man in black holds up an umbrella for her respectfully.

speaker: Old Woman
content: If you get the chance to see ${PlayerName} again... say hello for me.
Once again, Julien is alone. He stays there for a long time, then moves the wheelchair in the direction of the roars.
He passes by crumbling walls and ruined neighborhoods. All this destruction was caused by Syndicans themselves.
He gets closer and closer. Voices gradually pour into his mind, burning and stinging him. His senses begin to warp, and a distorted human figure appears before his eyes.

speaker: Distorted Human Figure
content: ...Don't... You shouldn't...
The figure writhes as if it has something to say, but Julien can't hear it clearly. All he feels is irritation. When he passes it, the shadow changes again, but Julien could no longer recognize it.

Everything leaves him behind, like the last bit of reality he experienced and his last clear memory. In the end, he is left only with the despair he's most accustomed to, as well as its corresponding perseverance.
As he gets closer to the target, everything starts to burn. The metal wheelchair melts away in his hands. He can no longer remain sitting. He wants to stand up, but falls to the ground.

speaker: Julien
content: Heh... Ha...

speaker: Cacophonous Voice
content: Alright, alright. With those legs of yours, you should just wait up there.

speaker: Cacophonous Voice
content: Just wait for **** to come back. He'll settle everything.

speaker: Corpus
content: The same taste... the same as eight years ago... she looked for you... she chose you...

speaker: Corpus
content: Oh... because... you're very much like them... you're very much like me... long time no see, my... companion...

speaker: Corpus
content: Come... come to me... tell me your wish...

speaker: Corpus
content: I'll make your wish come true...

speaker: Julien
content: Ha... yes... I do resemble them...

speaker: Julien
content: ...You devoured my companions... and now... you ask me what I wish for...

speaker: Julien
content: ...Are you able to grant my wish, you spiteful monster? Something like you?
Still not reponding?
No. Be careful. Don't get too close to him. You'll be in big trouble if you get contaminated.
female_content: No. Be careful. Don't get too close to her. You'll be in big trouble if you get contaminated.

content: ...Sigh... It's been a couple of months already. When can...

Since November 10, N.F. 113, an unusual surge of activity has been detected in BR-002. The 9th Agency has confirmed that it is the work of the Underground.

The Underground's Shepherd is on the move, and their target is undoubtedly BR-002, the largest and most powerful Secondary Black Ring at present. Paradeisos also has its attention on it.

??-03: Ever since the observation of BR-002's field was lost, we've been unable to track the enemy. Their camouflage sorcery might have advanced further. The risk has expanded to an intolerable extent. We can't let the enemy achieve their goal, or we won't be able to prevent the subsequent disasters.

??-03: This will be the first direct confrontation in nearly thirty years. Paradeisian forces will initiate limited intervention. The joint operation plan has been issued to all departments. Be prepared.
??-03: We must win, by any means and at all costs.

8:38 p.m., November 22, N.F. 113
Fifth Command, West District Reconstruction 
Executive Committee

speaker: Spokesperson
content: The analysis report has been distributed. As you can see, our work in West District is impressive.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: Since the campaign in August, the FAC's BR-002 defense line has been further reinforced. The Black Ring is now well under control. No large-scale contamination leakage has occurred in the past three months, and the wandering Corruptors in West District have been promptly cleaned up.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: The 9th Agency's operations have also achieved significant results. BR-002 is the most effective bait and the battles around it have successfully lured out numerous anti-city-state forces. These underground fanatics who have been lurking and harming West District for years have been consecutively exposed and captured.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: And none of this could have been achieved without the West District Reconstruction Executive Committee's full support!

speaker: Spokesperson
content: We suppressed the March riots, destroyed the remnants of Rustfire, stabilized the order of West District, and received high recognition from Paradeisos. We've performed our governing functions well and received universal respect. Soon, we'll be able to...

A snicker escapes the audience and the spokesperson is instantly humiliated. His already flushed face is now almost purple. He glares angrily in the direction of the sound, and the first person he sees is Sergeant Matilda Cavendish, straight-backed in her seat.
In the spiritless hall, she's the only person sitting upright and looking serious. She stands out as the sole watcher taking this embarrassing farce seriously.
But the spokesperson doesn't appreciate the respect. All he sees in her mirror-clear eyes is his own incompetence. He's annoyed and needs to take it out on someone.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: Ahem... Among all areas of work, the only lackluster part is the census and population management.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: A large number of West District refugees are evading registration and refusing to accept resettlement by the Executive Committee. Instead, they collude with each other while wandering in the contaminated areas, and even engage in Hypercube smuggling.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: Would you care to explain, Sergeant Matilda? This is your department's job. Since your eccentric superior is not here, we shall hear from you instead.

speaker: Matilda
content: That is indeed our job, sir, and I'm glad it's getting your attention. Here is a report about this task and my superior, which I would like you to review.
She connects her device to the conference system. Soon, a shocking field photo emerges on the big screen, making everyone gasp.

It's the last image captured by a damaged security camera: A female Rustfire thug with blue braids is grimacing and flipping her middle finger at the camera overbearingly, her other hand gripping her prey, a male Executive Officer being tortured.

The poor Executive Officer's sunglasses are shattered and his eyes are unfocused. His body is twisted in his disheveled clothes, and his face is covered in insulting patterns painted with blood, under which lies a contorted expression of horror.

The camera quickly moves to some ludicrous graffiti on the wall, but what was shown has already traumatized the Executive Officers. The thought that they could be the next victim makes the attendees restless. They are all whispering now, angry, anxious, and terrified.

speaker: Matilda
content: The Executive Officer who was attacked is my direct superior, Donald. Three weeks ago, Mr. Donald disappeared while on patrol. This is the last clue we found, no doubt a threat and provocation from the other side.

speaker: Matilda
content: The violent attacks by the radicals and the nonviolent resistance of ordinary people... all point to one single reason.

speaker: Matilda
content: Although we have calmed down the Rustfire riots, people's anger remains unresolved. They do not trust the city-state and blame West District's misfortunes on us.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: <size=45>This is pure scaremongering! We are governing West District perfectly!</size>
