But those of you who merely miss the glimmer in the dark and lose your way in the fog, come with me...

speaker: Ica
content: The pitch-black Raven has pitch-black eyes. With them, I shall find the light and return it to you!

speaker: Ica
content: Now, look up and listen closely...

speaker: Ica
content: If winter comes, can spring be far behind?
An ominous echo makes Crache shiver. This is undoubtedly the flamboyant style of the Rustfire poet. She has successfully poisoned the minds of a few Syndican children as she wished.
The sheets are covered in childish, wiggly handwriting. These are the pamphlets the children of the base have spent nights copying. Crache remembers the hundreds of wordless books left by Raven.
The one who always boasted about the tens of thousands of poems she'd written. After that great battle, all she left behind was a room full of blank sheets and the inkless imprints on them.

speaker: Dudu
content: The shackles' contamination has slowed down her body's recovery. When Donald carried her here, it freaked me out, but she's still hanging on.

speaker: Dudu
content: Looking on the bright side, now she's only half-dead, at least she can still pass on messages to Oak Casket. Rustfire's liaison and top spy holds so much valuable information that has proven useful, right?

speaker: Dudu
content: Hmm... Don't worry, she won't die so easily. Oak Casket insists that I wake her up. She finds her too loud and bothersome. As soon as Raven wakes up, we'll ask you to come take her back at once.

speaker: Dudu
content: It may take a while, but once ${PlayerName} wakes up and the problem with the shackles gets sorted out, I suppose everything will be fine...
Thinking of this, Crache's expression dims. She shoves the flyer back into Ica's hand.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Copy as many as you like, but don't spend all day distributing this kind of thing on the streets with the kids. It's dangerous out there.

speaker: Crache
content: The Executive Committee is watching. Besides, given what Rustfire has become, no one believes their words anymore. Distributing these flyers will only make it worse.
Though Ica admires Crache, the boy still can't help but feel a bit indignant. He thought his hard effort at least deserved some praise from his leader.

speaker: Ica
content: But I did bring a lot of people back. Even that Executive Officer lady gave us credit.

speaker: Crache
content: The newcomers were just scared by the rumors of the Purge Order. No one in Syndicate would take the words of a kid seriously.

speaker: Ica
content: But everyone calls you the Guardian out there... What you're saying doesn't even sound convincing...
Crache is speechless. She turns around, finds a medical kit, and throws it to Ica. The boy tries his best to hide his wounds, but nothing escapes his boss.

speaker: Crache
content: I've never managed to protect anything. There is no Guardian in this world. Even if there were... It can die too.

speaker: Crache
content: If you must flaunt the Homeless' name, then be careful out there. Don't put your life at risk for something stupid.
The boy doesn't pick up on the complex emotions in her words, but he does catch the boss's indirect concern for him. He rubs his nose and smiles.

speaker: Ica
content: I'm being careful. I'm not a kid anymore. I can protect myself, and I can do a lot of things now.

speaker: Ica
content: Those guys from the Executive Committee always say West District is rotten and deserves this. They say that Rustfire kidnapped and killed ${PlayerName}. Bunch of liars! It was ${PlayerName} who chose to stay and fight with us, and Rustfire sacrificed an entire squad to save him.
female_content: Those guys from the Executive Committee always say West District is rotten and deserves this. They say that Rustfire kidnapped and killed ${PlayerName}. Bunch of liars! It was ${PlayerName} who chose to stay and fight with us, and Rustfire sacrificed an entire squad to save her.

speaker: Ica
content: But I won't just sit there and sulk anymore. We've taken a lot of photos and videos and posted them online. Eastsiders are seeing them, and finally, some are speaking up for us. The suffering of children attracts more attention, right?

speaker: Ica
content: Those on the other side of the Rust are people too, and some of them must be good. I believe not all of them have the heart to support the Purge Order.

speaker: Ica
content: This is what Raven meant by taking advantage of public opinion, right? Rustfire's work will not be in vain!

speaker: Crache
content: Who knows? Stay alive, and when she wakes up, you can ask her yourself. You two have more in common.
At that moment, the shadow on the ground quivers. Ica distinctly sees the previous dejection vanish from his boss's gaze and her eyes are now sharp as a warrior's.
Immediately, they hear shrill screams from outside. Crache follows the shadow and rushes out.

speaker: Crache
content: ...I'll go, you stay here.

speaker: Ica
content: Hmph, I thought you didn't care.
Ica thinks to himself and follows. He's certain he's glimpsed the real leader of the Homeless in those eyes.

speaker: Ica
content: No, I'm going too!
Meanwhile, the refugee camp's emergency room is in a shambles.

speaker: Greta
content: It's Mania! The newly arrived patient is infected with Mania!
The patients overcome with Mania have already been subdued. Lavina is comforting the others who are still in shock.

speaker: Mania Patient
content: They're lying about the resettlement and getting us away from the Black Ring! Bunch of liars!

speaker: Mania Patient
content: They say we're all just fodder for the Black Ring. They want to throw us into those abandoned satellite towns in WhiteSands, then let us be wiped out by a Tide of Ashes or some natural disaster!

speaker: Mania Patient
content: This is the Purge Order! They're already preparing to purge us!

speaker: Lavina
content: Calm down. That's just a rumor. We've been in touch with the satellite town dwellers. The living conditions are tough, but they still have ways to get supplies and protect themselves.

speaker: Lavina
content: Besides, not even Burns would have dared to implement such an inhumane practice. The authorities would be condemned.
Lavina grabs the patient's hand, giving her a shot of anti-Mania sedative while calming her down.

speaker: Lavina
content: See, we've got enough supplies and help from our Outlander friends here. Don't panic, it'll only exacerbate the Mania. We're all here with you, just relax.

speaker: Mania Patient
content: They say you've found a way out, that we can still survive if we come here. Is that true? Can you escape Paradeisos? Can you escape the Black Ring?

speaker: Ica
content: Of course! None of us have given up yet!
He turns to seek Crache's support only to find his boss gone.
[Scene Change] Corridor

Crache steps out of the ward, sighing. They're already used to seeing Mania patients among the refugees and know how to deal with such an emergency. But in the end, the sheer number of cases still takes a toll on everyone's mood.
With that thought, she hears a sneer next to her. A disheveled refugee is leaning against the corner, his seemingly injured body wrapped in untidy bandages.

speaker: Crache
content: There's still room inside. It would be better to let a doctor take a look.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Haha... Give me a break. I can't stand the nonsense those idiots inside are spouting. You're only here because you think the same, no?
Crache isn't interested in the conversation, so she turns to go, leaving the man to his own ramblings.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Kids will be kids... If there was a way out, would Syndicate have come to this?

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: The Legion and Rustfire have both failed. What can a bunch of refugees do? Nothing will change. There's no escaping this.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Even if they're all just spreading rumors, between a bunch of kids and a group of men in black, even a fool knows who to trust. Conspiracy theories always sell... Goodness!
He looks up to find Crache back to his side again, watching him anxiously.

speaker: Crache
content: ...What conspiracy theories? Who are the men in black?

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Well... Literally a bunch of people dressed in black. Some in raincoats, some carrying black umbrellas. Say they're giving us a kind warning.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Umbrellas?

speaker: Donald
content: Besides the elites from the Executive Committee, the FAC, the 9th Agency, the MBCC, and Paradeisos, there's another group to be wary of... The black rain gear wholesalers who never speak properly and always have a creepy glowing eye stuck on their faces.

speaker: Donald
content: Those are most likely the loonies from the Underground. You see one, you kill one. No second thought.
[Scene Change] Deep inside the maze outside the Ring
Boom! Bang! Ratatatatat...!!

speaker: Human-Shaped Contamination
content: Gurgh...!!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Charge!! Exterminate them!!

The battle inside the maze is fierce, or rather, the FAC soldiers are full of fighting spirit. Faced with the roaring Underground puppets, a group of thirty or so soldiers tear through them like a hot knife through butter.

speaker: Donald
content: Wow... Cool, as expected from the DisSea frontline combatants. No wonder the Executive Committee hates your guys' guts.

speaker: Donald
content: Back in April, they were practically begging the FAC to suppress the riots, but you guys didn't put in your full effort.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Stopping a rampaging crowd is much harder than exterminating monsters. Surely we can't aim these anti-Mania weapons at the citizens.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Didn't you borrow the Propulsion Type 023 in March and take it to the Drifter Camp? You didn't hurt anyone either, right?

speaker: Donald
content: That's because I'm not very skilled... Look, it seems like you have a message on your special communicator. Is it from the 9th Agency?
Donald laughs and changes the subject. The FAC soldier says nothing else and puts the communicator to his ear for a few seconds before handing it to Donald.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The 9th Agency. They're looking for you.

speaker: Rust
content: Alright, Mr. Executive Officer. Don't forget your business.

speaker: Donald
content: I know, I know, I gotta report back to your boss. I'll get it done. I've already confirmed the location, just waiting for you guys to arrive.

He pulls out a telescope and takes one last look at the suspicious spot confirmed just a few minutes ago. That part of the maze still looks strange. It's not the familiar Rustfire mechanism he knows, but something more twisted.
Amid that, he catches sight of a repulsive black umbrella.

speaker: Donald
content: Using the stronghold as the reference, the relative coordinates are (66, 109). I can't calculate it any more precisely, is that enough?

speaker: Rust
content: It's okay. That person has absolute trust in her subordinates.

speaker: Rust
content: Her subordinates will create the conditions for her, and she's now all fired up for it.
As he talks, Donald keeps his gaze on the man in black. As if sensing something, the man turns around.

speaker: Parma
content: Not bad. The news has reached you fast enough.
...Bang!

A gunshot, and the puppets in the front row all suddenly begin to disintegrate, screaming and twisting. Donald can't see the bullet's trajectory clearly, but it's obvious that the guy holding the umbrella on a clear day took the shot calmly and collapsed on the ground in a practiced manner.

speaker: Donald
content: Woah... So that's Causality. How cool is that?
Donald rubs his head. Matilda is already a horrifyingly good sniper, but apparently there are other gifted sharpshooters in the city-state.

speaker: Rust
content: This skill has a long cooldown time, but it should be enough to hold him down. The 9th Agency will get to work soon. I'll leave the maze to you. There isn't much time left, I hope you can seize the chance.

speaker: Rust
content: This Undergrounder is particularly cunning. Please be extra careful.

speaker: Donald
content: Sure thing. Thanks to big shots like you, everything has gone smoothly so far.
His eyes shift and glimpse a hissing filthy worm ready to backstab a soldier. Donald subconsciously raises his hand reflexively to snap his fingers, gathering an arc of electricity...
Shoot! He realizes and puts his hand down to stop his own attack, almost spraining his thumb in the haste.
Fortunately, the soldier is skillful enough. He turns around and fires a shot, then grins at the flustered Executive Officer.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Itching for a real fight finally?

speaker: Donald
content: Yeah, hanging out with the Executive Committee guys all this time, I haven't seen rowdy fellas like you guys in a while. It's hyping me up, I wanna play at being a cool soldier for once. Please protect me when there's real danger though.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: You're being modest. We've heard legends about you during the uprising. The mad Executive Officer who ventured into the Drifter Camp seven times to save refugees. The Executive Committee might laugh at you, but over here, many admire you.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: By the way, the city-state has significantly reduced its restrictions on Sinners. Official military forces, including the FAC, now accept Sinners. As long as they are mentally stable and confirmed safe by the MBCC, they're allowed to participate in combat.

speaker: Donald
content: Hey, hey, don't get your hopes too high on me. I ain't got any superpowers. All I do is let people down.

speaker: Donald
content: It's just that I haven't stepped onto the battlefield with others for a long time. I'm just feeling... a bit nostalgic.
With that, he picks up his spear and throws it hard, impaling two puppets and pinning them onto a wall over a dozen meters away.

speaker: Donald
content: I'll see you in a bit!
Donald strides over the scattered monsters into the depths of the maze. He sees the man in a suit lying on the ground. His umbrella has a hole in it, but his body has vanished.
Donald wanders around to inspect the scene closely. Not far away, the runes on the ground are completely destroyed, as if someone has struggled violently here.
Donald recognizes these are the runes used by the Underground to bind and torture prisoners. Fortunately, the victim has escaped, but it's a shame that he didn't get to meet that person first.

speaker: Donald
content: Impressive. Of course, she's an ally recommended by that person. Now once she finds Samuel and hands him the item, the mission is considered done. Sigh... Hopefully she won't charge too much. I've spent all my money on ${PlayerName} recently, can't afford it.

speaker: Donald
content: The FAC's been a great help. This at least is a silver lining. You're lucky to still have these people on your side, ${PlayerName}. Once you wake up, be sure to keep a good relationship with them.

speaker: Donald
content: After all, I saved your life. Your connections are my connections, haha.

Donald fires a shot into the air, choosing one out of the four rendezvous points. He informs Samuel that the rest is up to him. Donald needs to return to the FAC squad and say a few last words to his bodyguards before sneaking away.
The target has been achieved, but the expressions of the soldiers are far from relaxed.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: He's confirmed to be the target provided by the 9th Agency, Parma, the Underground executive. According to the MBCC Chief's operation report, he fanned the flames of BR-004, BR-001, and even the contamination in the gangs' crypt. He must be behind BR-002's unusual behavior as well.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The contamination is still worsening... Striking him once is not enough. He is likely still alive. Search for this man, and more importantly, destroy all the sorcery.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Our understanding of the Underground's Mania is limited. We may have missed something somewhere. Search carefully! We're running out of time!
Yeah, we're running out of time. I need to go too. I appreciate your help, buddies. If everything goes smoothly, all our problems can be solved. Just don't die before then.
With that thought, Donald smiles and steps forward.

speaker: Donald
content: Alright guys, I've led the way and found the person you were looking for. I just remembered the blanket I left out to dry. If it gets dirty in the dust, I'll have to wash it again.

speaker: Donald
content: I'm heading back then, see ya!
The busy officer pauses to look at Donald.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Please wait. We have a few questions we would like to ask you. The Commander-in-Chief specifically gave me this task.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Wow, should I be proud?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The eccentric Executive Officer, Hush X's informant, or should I say... the former leader of Rustfire who surrendered to Nirvana? You're also in contact with the Underground, right? Your understanding of their sorcery far exceeds what's been officially disclosed.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...Do you know where Chief ${PlayerName} is?
Looks like he can't sneak off easily this time.
Led by Samuel, the two carefully avoid battles and the mechanisms and reach the rendezvous point indicated by Donald's signal, a hidden dead end in the maze.
Samuel shoots a second signal as a response, also conveying the location to Donald's ally and contact person.

speaker: Samuel
content: Next... just wait here. Your Chief will be fine.
Samuel gazes at the other end of the maze. The clamor of battle from Donald's side has stopped, which means the planned operation has ended and the FAC should have achieved their goal.

But the contamination hasn't subsided, and the Hypercube lantern in his hand keeps flickering. Samuel admits he's a coward, and now, his cowardly instinct is warning him. Unexpected danger is quietly approaching.

He takes out a small box and places it at the only opening of the dead end, leading Hecate to retreat two steps. The box automatically opens, revealing a few strands of red smoke. This is a sorcery that allows you to conceal yourself with Mania.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...This is Underground sorcery. Are you related to them? What those Mania fanatics did to Chief...

speaker: Samuel
content: This is just a tool to hide your presence with Mania. We've obtained the Underground's tools and are using them to protect ourselves from Paradeisos and the Underground.

speaker: Samuel
content: I'm not your enemy. I won't hurt you or the people you care about.
Hecate takes a step back. Suspicion rises within her, but her rationality reminds her that his words do make sense.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's true... This kind of camouflage sorcery is also present around the refugee camp... They use it to protect Hella too.

speaker: Samuel
content: Calm down, Hecate.

speaker: Hecate
content: Does it make sense? Can I really trust this man? That female Executive Officer, and the people in the refugee camp too... They all want me to believe them...

speaker: Hecate
content: But Rustfire wanted us to trust them too... Could these people... be planning to betray Chief as well?
Samuel reaches out to check her M-value, though the black mist emitted by the girl's body is already visible.

speaker: Samuel
content: ...The contamination is worsening, contrary to what we expected. You're being affected by the Black Ring.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm being affected... Is that true? All these feelings I'm having... are caused by Mania?
Suspicion and anxiety surge wildly within her, causing Hecate's stomach to twist in pain, making her nauseous.

speaker: Samuel
content: The FAC couldn't control the Mania, so the contamination is intensifying. Perhaps due to the shackles, this Black Ring's influence on you is particularly significant. It's too dangerous to stay here. I'll take you back first.

speaker: Hecate
content: No! I have to find Chief. I can control myself, I can do it.
Looking at her with concern, Samuel wants to say something but suddenly notices a weird sensation. He quickly pulls Hecate into the corner, hiding behind the camouflage sorcery.

At the other end of the maze, a foreboding presence is surging. Black mist rises out of nowhere and keeps spreading. The walls of the maze are slowly corroded into gel-like contamination, pulsating and taking on more familiar forms...

Corruptors. The cloaks, the red eyes, the Rustfire symbol, and... the black spikes protruding from their bodies. They are the "Rustfire Sinners" who went on a rampage after inheriting the shackles following ${PlayerName}'s death. Those who turned into Corruptors after the Black Ring outbreak. They've all ended up here.

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Hehe... Our fires... will rage... Hahaha...

speaker: Hecate
content: Rustfire...
Hecate's breathing is turning shallow. Behind her, Nightmare begins swelling, a sign that she's unconsciously entering attack mode.

speaker: Samuel
content: Calm down. We're not here to fight. Let them go.

speaker: Samuel
content: Just avoid them. We're here waiting for the person who can save your Chief. Don't forget your goal.

The old man holds her back and gives her a sedative shot in time, retreating behind the cover of the sorcery. Corruptors attack humans instinctively, and the Underground sorcery can protect them from being discovered, as long as she doesn't expose herself.
Hecate tries hard to control herself, but the emotions and memories inside her are gradually spiraling out of control.

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Syndicate belongs to us...

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Hahaha, so this is the power of the Sinners! How extraordinary! I can still feel it gushing out on the other end! I'm so excited, I can't wait!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: With these shackles, all we have to do is to touch ${PlayerName}! If only we knew it was this simple! Why didn't ${PlayerName} give us this power earlier?
[Injured Hella CG]

speaker: Hecate
content: Cough, cough!!
Present and past intertwine momentarily. Under the illumination of the Black Ring, Hecate feels dizzy and vomits.

speaker: Samuel
content: Breathe, Hecate, take a deep breath!

speaker: Samuel
content: Get those thoughts out of your head. You're resonating with the Black Ring. It's corroding your hatred and trying to control you in turn!

No matter how hard she tries to control herself, it's futile. Black contamination slowly leaks out of the girl's body. As if noticing their kind, those Corruptors suddenly turn around, see through the sorcery, and spot the hidden humans.

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Intruders... from DisCity... Kill them!
The nightmares haunting her nights overlap with reality. She sees the shackles being defiled and abused, Hella covered in wounds, and her powerless self.

The black spikes slowly grow. The Black Ring reflected in Hecate's eyes gradually expands. Nightmare continues to swell. Without the restraint of the shackles, her willpower is so insignificant under the Black Ring. The Mania inside Hecate is being ignited.

speaker: Hecate
content: Unforgivable... Those who hurt Chief and Hella are... unforgivable...
It's not an intense battle, but it's enough to awaken the madness within her. Hecate is supported by Samuel, but she can barely hear him. All she sees is that detestable symbol of Rustfire.

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Give it back... Give Syndicate back...
The girl stares blankly at the frenzied Corruptors, then glances at the distorted Black Ring in the distance. The conflicting feelings inside her gradually fade, replaced by a more familiar emotion.

speaker: Hecate
content: I... I know this feeling...

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Are you trying to take our home again? To hurt our leader again?

speaker: Hecate
content: Hatred... Anger... Failure... Disappointment...

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: The power is ours. More... more...!

speaker: Hecate
content: You too... That man, and that monster too...

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Give Syndicate back!

speaker: Hecate
content: Me too...

Someone once told her to value her own feelings. Hecate didn't know what it meant to have her own feelings. Now, for the first time, it is tangible to her. She must face it, acknowledge it, and name it.

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Die, DisCity intruders!

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm just like you...

speaker: Hecate
content: I... hate you too...
Beneath the Black Ring, Mania forces her to acknowledge her first emotion. Its name is hatred.

Corruptors swarm toward her like a tide, but she feels no fear now. The shared emotion is assimilating the two sides. This hatred is about to take over her entire being, summoning her to fuse with the Black Ring, to return to the origin with her kind...

speaker: Samuel
content: Hecate! Hecate, don't let it pull you in!
[Scene Change] The hero comes to the rescue
The monsters and chaotic illusions are suddenly severed by rays of white light, and a figure stands in front of them.

speaker: Samuel
content: ...A Sinner from the Underground...

speaker: Samuel
content: No, you're Whitestone's...
The woman has a familiar aura about her that makes Hecate shiver all over. It reminds her of a group of enemies.
[Scene change] Parma, the man in the raincoat, the rune puppet
No, it's more than that. Another scene emerges in her head, with another person with a completely different air...
[Flashback CH6]

speaker: Female Stranger
content: No need to chase after me so eagerly now, take care of yourself first, our lovely Chief. Your path will not be easy from now on.

speaker: Female Stranger
content: ...I'll see you around.

speaker: Hecate
content: You're the one who took Zoya away, aren't you... Are you the person we're looking for?

speaker: Hecate
content: Will you save Chief?
The woman before her doesn't respond. Instead, she takes out a strange object and hands it to Hecate.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...Take this. Leave the rest to me.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Hurry, just go. Go!
The woman turns her back to them, drawing her long sword to face the monsters, radiating a powerful energy. But...

Somehow her voice no longer sounds as carefree as before but is filled with repressed tension and fear. Like a virus, the emotion infects Hecate and sharpens her senses. She picks up on an ominous sensation...
She feels the presence of an Undergrounder somewhere in this maze, different from any enemy from the Underground they've encountered before.

It's a viscous, deep, maniacal, frightening, yet fascinating presence. It's vast and unknown, but Hecate also senses a hint of familiarity, as if it bears some resemblance to someone she knows very well.
Hecate wants to continue exploring, but her consciousness is fading away, her vision dimming.
[Insert an eerie, grand sound effect] The Black Ring flickers for a moment
Inside the partially enclosed, highly contaminated maze, the opposing sides maintain a certain distance.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We were too idealistic. Killing Parma and destroying the sorcery didn't stop the contamination and the Mania keeps worsening. In the worst case, we might have fallen into the Underground's trap. They've set up a decoy to distract us or exhaust our time and energy.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We don't have much time to waste. We must rethink our strategy. There's not much we can do, so I'll be upfront.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Mr. Donald, do you know where Chief ${PlayerName} is?
The FAC soldiers aren't pointing their guns at Donald, but they don't lower them either.

speaker: Donald
content: Are you suspecting me? Hey, don't I have a guarantor from Paradeisos? What, doesn't the FAC trust Hush?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: According to Hush, she's vouched for a powerful S-Class Sinner. These are her words: "Don't worry about him using his power. That man's special ability is the guarantee of his loyalty."

speaker: FAC Officer
content: I don't know what that means exactly, but it's obvious that you've been avoiding using your special ability.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Your position may be precarious, so we won't delve into it. The FAC simply wants to locate ${PlayerName} as soon as possible. If you know something, please tell us. To fight against the Black Ring, we need that Chief's power.

speaker: Donald
content: Hasn't Paradeisos already set out for the search? Why does the FAC have to come to me so urgently... What's the rush?

speaker: Donald
content: Is it because Paradeisos is really preparing for the Purge Order? To prevent the millions from West District from becoming food for the Black Ring and falling into the hands of the Underground?

speaker: Donald
content: That's what the Executive Committee's stupid population management work is for, isn't it?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We won't ask for your trust, and we know that most people in West District don't trust us. That's okay, that's not the FAC's purpose.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We only have one purpose, and it's...

speaker: Donald
content: I know, I know. It's "to fight against Mania and protect the ordinary people." And I never said I don't trust you guys.
Donald waves his hand to interrupt the soldier.

speaker: Donald
content: Your boss's got balls to dare bypass the Executive Committee and come to a shady character like me behind Paradeisos's back. He almost got assassinated in August for building the blockade line to protect West District too, didn't he?

speaker: Donald
content: It's people like you who keep the fantasy of the city-state alive...

speaker: Donald
content: Anyway, enough of that. I've only spoken to that ${PlayerName} once. Hush would have taken him long ago if he'd been with me. I know your time is precious, so go do what needs to be done, and just trust him and wait for him to return.
female_content: Anyway, enough of that. I've only spoken to that ${PlayerName} once. Hush would have taken her long ago if she'd been with me. I know your time is precious, so go do what needs to be done, and just trust her and wait for her to return.

speaker: Donald
content: Look, our appreciation seems to be mutual, so why don't we stop making things difficult for each other? We've all got business here. I won't just run away if you let me go. Here, take my number. I'm sure we'll meet again soon.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...Give us a reason to trust you.

speaker: Donald
content: Here's two for you. First, as long as you continue to protect the safety of innocent civilians, then regardless of our positions, we need each other. Soon enough, we'll be joining hands again. Your Commander-in-Chief knows this, that's why he sent you for me.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...And the second reason?

speaker: Donald
content: Well, the second reason is that... You can't catch up to me!
He raises his hand and a rope shoots out from his sleeve and pulls him up to a high place.

speaker: Donald
content: Since you can't bring yourself to shoot me, let's not waste any more time here. Get going, buddy! I'm an escape expert, few can catch me. See ya!
The FAC is skilled at dealing with Mania but not rogues like that, so they miss the golden chance in that brief moment of hesitation. Once they quickly come to their senses and try to pursue him...
An urgent message suddenly comes in. From a high-level anti-Mania communication channel, no less.

speaker: Paradeisos
content: Attention, this is an important message for the FAC and the 9th Agency's frontline squads.

speaker: Paradeisos
content: We have located the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} from verified intelligence. I repeat, the MBCC's Chief has been located.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: They've found that Chief?
Someone's head suddenly leans onto him.

speaker: Donald
content: Where?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Didn't you run off?
Donald waves his hand to signal him to be quiet, his eyes more focused and tense than ever.

speaker: Paradeisos
content: The vanguard has already set out for rescue. Several Sinners are confirmed to be present at the location. Enemy forces are suspected to have taken the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} and are threatening the city-state's security. Notify all nearby combat units to get ready to aid the mission anytime.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Phew... That's good news. With ${PlayerName} here, there's still hope we can defeat this Black Ring.
Donald furrows his eyebrows.

Protect ${PlayerName}? What a joke. If they'd truly cared about him, they wouldn't have used his death to their advantage! Before the Garden came, Paradeisos had always been the biggest threat to ${PlayerName}.
female_content: Protect ${PlayerName}? What a joke. If they'd truly cared about her, they wouldn't have used her death to their advantage! Before the Garden came, Paradeisos had always been the biggest threat to ${PlayerName}.

content: Moreover, with them present, Paradeisos couldn't possibly find ${PlayerName}, nor would they go to such a place...
female_content: Moreover, with them present, Paradeisos couldn't possibly find ${PlayerName}, nor would they go to such a place...

content: As he thinks that, he poses a different question.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Has Paradeisos found him? Where is he? We should go help them immediately.
female_content: ...Has Paradeisos found her? Where is she? We should go help them immediately.

speaker: Paradeisos
content: The specific location is...

speaker: Donald
content: No, not there. Paradeisos didn't find ${PlayerName}. This is false information!

speaker: Donald
content: Who tipped them off, and for what purpose... The person deceiving Paradeisos is...

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: I'm not joking with you, take him away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.
female_content: I'm not joking with you, take her away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: But since then... the Underground hasn't sent anyone else. Something must be going on. You guys be careful.
A bad premonition hits him suddenly. Donald whips his head around to find Parma slowly rotting on the ground.
It's the Underground who found ${PlayerName}. They saw ${PlayerName} and didn't kill him, but they probably got his biometrics.
female_content: It's the Underground who found ${PlayerName}. They saw ${PlayerName} and didn't kill her, but they probably got her biometrics.

content: Then they used it to mislead Paradeisos. The Underground knows Paradeisos needs ${PlayerName} and would stop at nothing to acquire him. But the Underground gave them false information to lead them to the most densely populated refugee base. That means the Underground has only one goal...
female_content: Then they used it to mislead Paradeisos. The Underground knows Paradeisos needs ${PlayerName} and would stop at nothing to acquire her. But the Underground gave them false information to lead them to the most densely populated refugee base. That means the Underground has only one goal...

content: The "person" lying on the ground lets out a weak laugh. His body is decaying and his lifeless eyes look like they're staring at both Donald and some distant figures.

speaker: Parma
content: You guys did a pretty good job manipulating others last time. What makes you so slow this time?

speaker: Parma
content: Is that Hush gone? Has West District's collective observation ended? Hehehe...

speaker: Parma
content: Well then, we'll be going first...
A roar comes from atop the maze walls.
Stop listening to him, run! You want the Black Ring to devour you?
That man is just a decoy. The Black Ring is all charged up. It's about to explode! Go!

speaker: Donald
content: ...Damn it.

The dots are all connected now. This is Paradeisos. This is the Underground. Donald once thought he could trick both sides and find a way out for ${PlayerName} and West District. But now it seems... he's underestimated those bastards.
At the refugee base, the Paradeisian troops stand in a line. Their faces are armored, but still, their cold, scrutinizing gazes pierce through.
In front of them, a hovering obsidian object speaks for the elite soldiers.

speaker: Schorl
content: Greetings, unregistered inhabitants of West District. I am here on behalf of Paradeisos to investigate the whereabouts of a city-state official.

speaker: Matilda
content: Paradeisos...?!

speaker: Schorl
content: Our time is very limited. Please answer all my questions honestly.

speaker: Schorl
content: Are you holding the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} hostage?
It's that dream again.

speaker: Samuel
content: I'm sorry... Lavina, I didn't bring her back...

speaker: Dying Girl
content: I'm sorry, Mom. I escaped, I didn't get killed by Nirvana...

speaker: Dying Girl
content: I'm back, Mom. You too can...
[Screen flashes as she snaps out of the dream]
She jolts awake and immediately breathes a sigh of relief. She has this dream often, and every time she snaps out of it like this. She's used to it already.
But today seems a bit different.

It's clamorous outside. Lavina isn't sure what's happening. She instinctively checks on Hella next to her. Once she confirms that Hella is alright, she throws on her clothes and heads out, bumping into a running Greta.

speaker: Greta
content: Ahhhh!

speaker: Lavina
content: Greta, it's me! What's going on?

speaker: Greta
content: Lavina? Run, it's the Executive Committee. No, perhaps their higher-ups, some unknown people have broken into the base! Matilda... She's...

speaker: Greta
content: Crache left and hasn't come back.
A chill runs through Lavina, but she quickly steadies herself and checks the surveillance screen.
(Scene change)

speaker: Schorl
content: You're... Executive Officer Matilda Cavendish.

speaker: Schorl
content: The records show that you were kidnapped this week. How do you explain this?

speaker: Matilda
content: I was indeed kidnapped. I heard from my captor that the ${PlayerName} is around here.

speaker: Matilda
content: So I came to verify the information. After confirming that they were all innocent refugees and not harboring any rebels, I decided to carry on with my census and resettlement tasks assigned by the Executive Committee.

speaker: Matilda
content: I've done my job well and gained everyone's trust. I've helped them stock up on relocation supplies. You may ask the refugees.

speaker: Schorl
content: That doesn't concern me. Is ${PlayerName} here?

speaker: Matilda
content: I regret to tell you that he's not here and has never been. I think this is incorrect information, or simply a decoy.
female_content: I regret to tell you that she's not here and has never been. I think this is incorrect information, or simply a decoy.

speaker: Schorl
content: Your judgment is not required. That's the job of the Paradeisian troops. Lead the way, we're going to inspect the infirmary.
(Scene change)

speaker: Greta
content: Are they heading this way? These are all fellow Rustfire members, and many are on the list. What should we do? What should we do?

speaker: Lavina
content: Calm down! Matilda will buy us some time. Now, let's hurry up and move the injured and these documents.

speaker: Lavina
content: These people's intentions are unclear, but just in case.
She has a very bad feeling about this.
(Scene change)

speaker: Schorl
content: Lead the way, we're going to inspect the infirmary.

speaker: Matilda
content: I wouldn't recommend you barge in like this. West District has been isolated for too long, a forceful approach will only stir up panic and distrust.

speaker: Matilda
content: Since you came here on behalf of Paradeisos, please seek dialogue in a more appropriate manner.

speaker: Schorl
content: Such formalities are not important. Lead the way, Matilda Cavendish.

speaker: Schorl
content: Your background check is complete. Do your current actions represent the Cavendish family? Are you going to obstruct an important operation of Paradeisos on behalf of your family?

speaker: Matilda
content: It's a shame, but I can't represent my family. I am a laughable disgrace to the Cavendish family.

speaker: Matilda
content: The only person I can represent is myself...

speaker: Schorl
content: ...Terminating conversation. Proceeding with independent action. Area scan complete. Location of the injured confirmed.
It wants to bypass Matilda and keep advancing, but is stopped by a barrel pointed to it.

speaker: Matilda
content: I am Matilda Cavendish, Executive Officer of the West District Reconstruction Committee. My job is to facilitate the reconstruction of West District, open up conversations, bridge the gap, and explore a new future.

speaker: Matilda
content: If you insist on hurting them, as an adjutant, I must promptly rectify the error of my superior.

speaker: Matilda
content: I will stand against you until the communication is reestablished.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...Judging Matilda Cavendish to be a hostile target. HUSH, remove the obstacle. Now.
Several grotesque humanoids charge over with evident hostility. The refugees let out terrified cries, jostling and fleeing.
Matilda pulls the safety lever, aiming while secretly making calculations.
The Guardian has gone out to receive a new batch of refugees. How long can I hold on before she comes back?
At that moment, the blue-haired gladiator bursts onto the battlefield, her eyes shining with excitement.

speaker: Corso
content: Forces from Paradeisos? That's a good one, leave it to me!

speaker: Corso
content: Tsk, these things sure are strong, but don't they have brains? It's like fighting a bunch of rocks, a little let down.

speaker: Matilda
content: Behind you!
Before she finishes, a white figure lunges over. Matilda fires at them but the figure seems unscathed and crashes hard into Corso, sending her flying.
The new opponent is completely different from the others on the battlefield. No doubt an elite, the figure possesses awe-inspiring power.

speaker: Corso
content: Hehe... Hehehe...

speaker: Corso
content: Ha! Finally! A proper f***ing fight at last!

speaker: Matilda
content: Stay calm, Corso. You can't beat her, be careful!

speaker: Corso
content: I don't care! I'm sick of those lifeless things. This is the real fight worth having!

speaker: Schorl
content: Subdue them. Facilitate the troops' operation.

speaker: White-Cloaked Elite
content: ....Copy that.
The intense battle resumes. The white-clad elite single-handedly holds back Matilda and Corso, even suppressing these two Sinners. Schorl advances toward the infirmary and stirs up waves of panic.
(Scene change)

speaker: Greta
content: There are too many injured patients, Lavina, we can't take everyone. What should we do?

speaker: Lavina
content: Their target is ${PlayerName}, so they are most likely coming after...
Her heart is instantly seized by fear. Lavina picks up Hella and makes for the exit, but a bullet suddenly pierces through her calf. She falls to her knees.

speaker: Greta
content: Lavina!
Hearing the cry, Matilda wants to catch up to them, but she's held back by the white-clad elite.

speaker: Matilda
content: ...To think Paradeisos combat unit are this powerful.

speaker: Matilda
content: They claim this is a rescue mission for the Chief of Minos, yet the squad consists of no MBCC members and uses such an aggressive approach... This isn't a rescue, it's a capture.
The problem is... ${PlayerName} isn't here. What exactly happened?

In the infirmary, the arrival of the intruders brings about mass panic. The wounded are crying and crawling away from the center of the chaos. There, Schorl looks down at Lavina, who is holding onto Hella tightly.

speaker: Schorl
content: A Sinner... Identity confirmed: S-098. ${PlayerName} was indeed carrying out a mission with her before going missing.

speaker: Schorl
content: SHP-13 is indeed here.

speaker: Lavina
content: No! You've got it wrong. ${PlayerName} isn't here. Nobody knows where he is.
female_content: No! You've got it wrong. ${PlayerName} isn't here. Nobody knows where she is.

speaker: Lavina
content: Please let me know if you find him. The poor kid needs ${PlayerName}, many others do too.
female_content: Please let me know if you find her. The poor kid needs ${PlayerName}, many others do too.

content: The Lavina a year ago would never think of speaking to a Paradeisian. But now she is indeed showing her utmost sincerity, all for the unconscious girl in her arms.
But the cold schorl is deaf to her pleading. It's only capable of calculating its own tasks, potential enemies, and risks.

speaker: Schorl
content: Are you hiding our target? Why are you hindering the city-state's plan? What's your relationship with the Underground?

speaker: Schorl
content: Hand over this Sinner. Wake her up and find SHP-13!

speaker: Lavina
content: No!!
Several HUSH humanoids break into the infirmary and pounce on their prey, following their orders. Lavina turns around and shields Hella with her whole body.
At this moment, countless shadows snake near them across the ground, leaping up to impale all the attackers.
The leader of the Homeless, also the source of the shadows, finally arrives. This chaos has clearly ignited her fury.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Get out of my way. Don't make me say it again.

speaker: Crache
content: Do all of you enjoy throwing your power at those weaker than you? Paradeisos and Syndicate are the same in this regard. Both are equally repugnant.

speaker: Schorl
content: You're harboring an S-Class Sinner. This place is clearly a den of the rebels.

speaker: Crache
content: How dare you act so high and mighty after barging into someone's home, calling us rebels... Why don't you teach me what a rebellion really is?
The powerful ones get entangled with each other and neither is willing to back off. On the other hand, the powerless refugees only feel endless fear.

They have never seen a fight like this, which reminds them of the terrifying rumors. Driven by fear that has been suppressed for eight months or even longer, the agitated crowd begin fleeing in utter panic.

speaker: Panicking Refugee
content: They're fighting... That Guardian kid is buying us time. Run! I don't want to die, run... But where else can we go?

speaker: Panicking Refugee
content: Wait. Perhaps it can be explained. Not everyone sent by the city-state is bad, I mean, look at Matilda... Maybe they really just came to search for a missing person. Just do as they say. We can talk it out.

speaker: Matilda
content: Everyone, stay calm! Don't panic!

speaker: Panicking Refugee
content: How can we stay calm? Everyone knows the Executive Committee is pushing that... that Purge Order... Remember those rumors!?
Gradually, indistinct whispers begin spreading among the restless crowd.

speaker: Strange Refugee
content: Yes... That's not a rumor... It's all true...

speaker: Strange Refugee
content: They've always looked down on us and West District... Saying that we brought it upon ourselves and that we deserve to be purged... When they're the ones who humiliate and exploit us...

speaker: Underground Puppet
content: Everything is an excuse... See, the Purge Order is coming. The missing person and rebellion are all excuses. They are going to kill us all!

speaker: Matilda
content: The M-value is rising, what's...

speaker: Lavina
content: Hella!
[Scene change] Sickbed

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cough cough...! Uh...!

speaker: Dudu
content: That's bad! The contamination below suddenly got...
[Scene change] Inside the Maze

speaker: Hecate
content: Mmph!!!

speaker: Samuel
content: Hang in there, Hecate!
Black spikes suddenly pierce through the young girl's body. The pain is not just physical, but also mind-searing.

speaker: Hecate
content: My head hurts... The shackles... The shackles...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief... Something happened to Chief...
(Scene change)

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The Black Ring's activity is surging. The M-value has soared to a dangerous level! The maze is rapidly expanding, and BR-002 itself also...

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...starting to expand outward?!
He grits his teeth, making up his mind.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: This is the first time I've ventured so deep into the contaminated area, and it might also be the last. I can't waste this opportunity. I must continue further and try to get more information.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Those who are willing to follow me, come along!
Donald silently watches them make up their minds. This scene reminds him of a distant past, and he can already imagine what outcome awaits these soldiers if they continue to press on.

speaker: Donald
content: ...You're going the wrong way. If your only goal is to resist Mania and protect the public, then don't rush in and get yourselves killed.

speaker: Donald
content: Go back. The blockade line and the anti-Mania gear and strategies are all useless without someone to operate them. You are all experienced FAC soldiers. Don't waste your precious lives here.

speaker: Donald
content: In this maze, there are still people in danger who need your protection. Take them with you. As for me, I'll stay behind and gather any information this Black Ring has to offer.

speaker: Donald
content: This is an old acquaintance I've known for nine years. If someone must stay, it should be me...
Now... Let's take a gamble, shall we?
He can still buy some time for that person.
Hecate can't remember how many times she blacks out. Now, struggling to open her eyes, she realizes she is wavering in a small alley of the shifting maze.

The maze morphs relentlessly, growing and spreading, as if it is alive, determined to imprison her. Shackles jut from her body, plunging her thoughts into chaos, making her feel as if she is staggering on the crest of raging ocean waves.
...Wait, it's not what she thought. Someone's carrying her, an old, bent man struggling to escape the maze with her on his back.

speaker: Samuel
content: ...The Black Ring's coming to life, worsening the contamination inside you. But don't worry now, just rest for a bit.

speaker: Samuel
content: Got the White Cube. Hang onto it; it'll help you feel better.
She feels a soothing sensation at her chest. Glancing down, she realizes she is clutching something against it—a bizarre, white box.
Around the White Cube, the contamination gently streams into it, settling down once it is absorbed.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is the thing that can save Chief... You've met that person, haven't you? You know Chief's location now, don't you?

speaker: Hecate
content: Then... quick, let's go back... I need to—oof!
She makes a brief attempt to move, causing Samuel to stagger, barely keeping himself from hitting the ground.
Hecate only then realizes, the man's stooped back is deeply stained with contamination. Had he gotten it from carrying her? Her mind reels.
This seems all too familiar. Who had been left behind last time, sacrificing themselves to protect her when she blindly rushed ahead, deceived by Mania? Was Hella awake yet?
Why would you do so much for someone who's a mere stranger to you?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Why... Were you given an order? Did Donald tell you to look out for me?

speaker: Hecate
content: Why else would anyone go this far...
Beneath the Black Ring, for the first time, she can label her feelings: a seething hatred with nowhere to be released.
It is only now that she really understands the true target of her hatred.
It isn't Rustfire she hates; it is herself, for feeling so powerless without Chief, like she can't do anything on her own.

speaker: Samuel
content: Don't overthink it; it's just the Black Ring messing with your mind. No one gave me that kind of order; I choose to do this.

speaker: Hecate
content: Please, stop... My only concern is Chief, just following orders. That's not your job! Don't do this for me... I don't get it, and I don't need to...

speaker: Hecate
content: I can't take it anymore... Put me down, you can move faster alone... Hurry, go...
The roaring of the Corruptors is getting closer. The camouflage sorcery is broken; they have no means left to conceal themselves. Samuel quickly realizes that the two of them can't possibly get far.
After a brief silence, he finds a corner to place Hecate down, averting his eyes, his voice wavering slightly as he speaks.

speaker: Samuel
content: Don't be hard on yourself, Hecate. You haven't done anything wrong. Ever since I led you into this maze, I made a promise to get you out alive. All of this... it's for me, really.

speaker: Samuel
content: I wanted to bring you back with me to make amends for past regrets. I can't bear the thought of repeating my old mistakes. This was all my choice.

speaker: Samuel
content: You've done nothing wrong. You've always stuck to your goals, fighting and not giving up, even when you were battered and scarred... If I were you, I'd be proud of myself.

speaker: Samuel
content: The real cowards... are those who flee from their own fights.
His head droops even lower, his speech growing more labored.

speaker: Samuel
content: The worst kind of mistakes... are those you can't confess, have no one to apologize to, and can never make up for.

speaker: Samuel
content: On your journey, there's still a lot you can accomplish.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Stop talking like that, it's beyond me, and I don't need it...

Clasping Hecate's hand, he encourages her to hold on firmly to the White Cube and the last dose of the sedative. With the Corruptors' howls closing in, the old man finally finds the bravery to gaze into the girl's eyes.

speaker: Samuel
content: I'm leaving now. You stay here for a while, take a moment to calm yourself, and look for the right moment to make your move. The exit is close by.

speaker: Samuel
content: Be extra careful when you are on your own. Make it out alive and return safely to the ones who matter the most to you.

The man leaves Hecate, confused and alone, hidden in a narrow gap. He ventures out, walking far enough to be seen. In a corner in the Corruptors' line of sight, he knocks on the wall, attracting their attention.
If he could just lure them away, she'd be out of danger. She'd definitely find her way back, back to her loved ones.
...Can this act lighten his burden of sin?
The Corruptors, engulfed in contamination, rush at the old man. Their howls shake his tainted mind, awakening a flood of past, dark misdeeds.
[Entering Memory]

speaker: Chaotic Memory
content: ...He is one of the W-31 survivors... wait, no, deserters...

speaker: Chaotic Memory
content: You stood by as heroes fell, escaping by yourself... How can you show your face here again...

speaker: Lavina
content: Really... Sophie bravely fought to the end, never fleeing. She died a hero, a heroic death...

speaker: Lavina
content: So you ran back here... You survived just to break the news of my daughter's death?
[Exit Memory]

speaker: Samuel
content: It's fine, this was long overdue... I should have died... 9 years ago...

He reassures himself, but terror fractures his mind. The maze turns into a trap, with the Corruptors closing in from everywhere, their hands groping through the slim cracks. Samuel collapses, scrabbling on the ground.
He is always the coward, with both humiliating memories and base instincts resurfacing in death's presence.

speaker: Young Samuel
content: It's terrifying... This place, it's terrifying...

speaker: Young Samuel
content: How did we end up like this? I thought we had won the negotiations. Didn't we secure our mines? Weren't we full of hope?

speaker: Young Samuel
content: Why was everyone dead? Why are they all monsters now? It wasn't supposed to be like this; nobody saw this coming.

speaker: Young Samuel
content: No one thought they would die here. If we had any idea about this—

speaker: Samuel
content: ...Shut up, I need to stop being a coward, no more regrets, this is the last chance.

speaker: Young Samuel
content: It's terrifying... We are just normal people, not Sinners, not powerful, not brave.

speaker: Young Samuel
content: I'm sorry, but I don't want to die. I need to go back, I need to see her again. I don't want to die here.

speaker: Young Samuel
content: Please, hero, save me...

speaker: Donald
content: ...I've got this, you're not going to die on my watch.

speaker: Donald
content: Enough with the guilt. You went in the mine because you trusted me, and I definitely can't disappoint you now.

speaker: Donald
content: I'll get us back, all of us. I promise to bring every single one of us back safely.

speaker: Samuel
content: If it hadn't been for people like me... He wouldn't have ended up—

speaker: Corruptor
content: Roarrrr!!!

speaker: Hecate
content: No—!!

speaker: Samuel
content: Ah...

In the nick of time, before the monsters shred him to pieces, the exhausted Nightmare stops all the attacks. Hecate, propped against the wall, wears a look of agony and bewilderment, clearly at a loss as to why she would do such a thing.

speaker: Hecate
content: Please, no more of this; stop being so nice to me. I'm here to finish the job, that's it. I—

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm too weak, I failed to even keep Chief safe. So don't make me care about anyone else!

Death's shadow hasn't lifted yet. Hecate, in her current state, can't rescue anyone. She's weak, but she managed to give Samuel a brief respite, enough for him to understand his own heart before blacking out.

speaker: Samuel
content: It's disgraceful, yet here I am, still clinging to life...
Holding out hope... that a hero shows up...
[Pikachu Lightning]—Time to flaunt some dazzling effects.

speaker: Donald
content: Good heavens, what on earth happened to you two?!
He rummages in a flurry to administer sedatives to both, mumbling complaints under his breath all the while.

speaker: Donald
content: Didn't I tell you not to push yourself? Hey, FAC bro!! Over here!! Over here!!

speaker: Donald
content: Quick, get these two back to safety, please—I owe you, like ten huge favors!

speaker: Hecate
content: That just now... was that your power?

speaker: Hecate
content: I was right, you're a Sinner... an incredibly strong one at that... Donald, you must be able to do anything...
Her hands quiver as she hands the White Cube to Donald.

speaker: Hecate
content: Deliver this... to Chief... save him...
female_content: Deliver this... to Chief... save her...

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm just not fast enough... not strong enough... The things I can't manage, I'm begging you, please take over...

speaker: Donald
content: Sigh... I was this close to saying yes. I'm really sorry, Hecate.

speaker: Donald
content: I'd love to be the hero here, but I just can't pull it off this time. We've got something on our tail, and if I don't hold the fort, nobody's getting out of here.

speaker: Donald
content: That's why I'm counting on you this time.

speaker: Donald
content: The rescue of Chief is in your hands. You've got to find the person who's most important to you. I can't say much here, but I hope that shackle leads you where you need to go.
He hands the White Cube back to Hecate and gives her shoulder a reassuring pat.

speaker: Donald
content: Stop selling yourself short, and forget about needing "someone stronger." You're strong in your own right, and there's plenty out there ready to back you up. You've never been the underdog.

speaker: Donald
content: Go and chase down your dreams by any means necessary. It's up to you now.

speaker: Donald
content: In return, I'll block all the tailgaters here, making sure you've got a clear run.

The maze grows and twists, falling apart at seams, with the Corruptors swarming out like a flood, beyond any containment. FAC soldiers prop up their injured, casting a last look at the Executive Officer.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...We're heading out, back to the defense line. Remember our deal, you will come back, and don't forget to bring ${PlayerName} along.
Without a word or a backward glance, Donald faces the approaching monster wave. He just lifts his left hand in a casual wave, his fingertips sparking with electricity.
He must really believe he's got style doing that.

speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
content:
Top-Secret File: BM-104078Mxc
Security Clearance: Ultra-High
Source of Case: Nirvana
Sinner: Affirmative
Threat Level: S
This case is riddled with anomalies and presents a complicated medical mystery, warranting an in-depth analysis.

speaker: Donald
content: ...I've got this, you're not going to die on my watch.

speaker: Donald
content: I'll get us back, all of us. I promise to bring every single one of us back safely.

speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
content:
Multiple incursions into the Black Ring within a brief span, experiencing over 100 hours of subjective time inside. A sharp spike in the M-value suggests a rise from A to S.

Unusually, the individual has yet to reach the ultimate collapse stage, even without extra safety measures in place—an exceptionally rare occurrence.

Yet, the Black Ring has left an indelible mark on him, manifesting in lasting symptoms such as auditory hallucinations, relentless nightmares, and ongoing post-traumatic stress.

speaker: Donald
content: They're still there... still in the mine...

speaker: Samuel
content: Donald, don't go, you've done this too many times. Your body can't take it anymore...

speaker: Donald
content: No, I have to go. I led them here; it's on me... to bring them back...
His body, pushed to the brink, can't hold up any longer. He falls on the twisty trail, right at the fringe of the tainted area, next to the trap.
Before Samuel can gear up and rush back to the rescue, another squad gets to him first.

speaker: X
content: ...This is the man. According to our observation, he's the most powerful Sinner among the rebel group and the focal point of their spirit.

speaker: X
content: Without his influence, the rebel group in the mine started to waver, shaking the foundations of Rustfire.
Spot-on analysis, X.
Nirvana's got a serious grudge against him, can't wait to see him gone. But you, you've got a different take, right? Let's hear your thoughts.

speaker: X
content: ...Nirvana's approach is way too rough around the edges, making the city-state pay a hefty, unnecessary price. If possible, I'd like to optimize the plan.

speaker: X
content: Since this man is their leader, perhaps I could make use of him... and that would reduce some cost.

speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
content:
In addition to the S-Class Mania from the Ring, his mind has endured a more meticulously orchestrated breakdown.

He is in a state of intense internal conflict, exhibiting severe symptoms of manipulation, dissociation, and deep subconscious conditioning.

Our facility has made several attempts to acquire detailed treatment records, but these requests have consistently been denied.

speaker: Donald
content: What's the latest with Rustfire? Really rough, I guess... Look, Samuel, I can no longer do anything for the crew.

speaker: Donald
content: There's this woman from Paradeisos, slapped a "mark" on me. Goes like this—the more I despise her, the more I fight back, the more strength I use, the tighter her strings pull on me. Ha... sounds like a bad joke, huh?

speaker: Donald
content: But it's no joke... I can't stand up to her. She told me to turn on Rustfire, and I just followed suit. Ha... I once thought I was unbeatable, now I'm too chicken to even try my powers!

speaker: Donald
content: Sorry, Samuel, I'm no hero for Rustfire anymore...

speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
content:
His mind is deeply scarred, his awareness tangled in utter chaos. Apart from these conditions, he's also sunk into a deep pit of self-rejection.

As of now, he's still held in a high-security psychiatric ward. He's utterly confused, can't communicate, mentally unstable, and there's no hint of getting better anytime soon.

speaker: Banyan Medical College Classified Records
content: A comeback looks pretty unlikely—we might as well call it... a miracle, if it ever happens.
Samuel searches far and wide, forever it seems, for just a hint of this miracle—to bring back their leader.
[Entering Memory]

speaker: Donald
content: Stop selling yourself short, and forget about needing "someone stronger." You're strong in your own right, and there's plenty out there ready to back you up. You've never been the underdog.

speaker: Donald
content: Go and chase down your dreams by any means necessary. It's up to you now.

speaker: Donald
content: In return, I'll block all the tailgaters here, making sure you've got a clear run.
[Pikachu discharges! Cut back to reality.

Corruptors, wreaking havoc, are broadly stunned by electric shocks. Lightning coils around Donald, purging the blight and toppling the high walls. It's been ages since he's wielded his powers; this bet, he admits, brings an unexpected thrill.
But in the heat of power's release, that loathsome "Mark" buried in his mind is reawakened, quietly making its presence felt.
Give in, let me be your voice, I will take control. That's the power of the mark. I can free your friends.

speaker: Donald
content: ..Shut it. I don't care what you're after, just don't bother me now.
Under the red light of the Black Ring, a tempest of Mania sweeps him up, pulling him back into his old madness.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: The lightning... the power... our leader, our hero... he's back!

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Why aren't you saving us?!

speaker: Donald
content: Because you're not real! I've embraced the madness, you think this scares me?
He obliterates all the corruption in one swift move. Standing under the Black Ring, confronting the sinister red glow, just like he did nine years ago.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Show yourself, old pal. Nine years apart, you couldn't have forgotten me, right?
A voice, tinged with chaos, slithers out.

speaker: Corpus 002
content: I... I remember...
[Dark Monster Silhouette]

speaker: Corpus 002
content: Heh... It's been ages since I've seen such force... So powerful, capable of wonders, and yet you choose restraint...

speaker: Corpus 002
content: Back then, in the mine, you were the strongest Sinner, the beacon of hope for all... If only it had been you who became Corpseborne, we would never have been beaten by that woman.

speaker: Corpus 002
content: Yet, you chose to be with those cowards, leaving and escaping again and again... Look at yourself now, from once being so bold and spirited, to this sorry state... You've worn yourself down for the sake of the weak...

speaker: Donald
content: Heh heh... If you're that worried about me, then just focus your power on me. I'm still in the midst of my tug-of-war game, let's catch up a bit.
He whips his spear around in a full arc, grounding it with a thud, resonating with a forceful clang.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Weak? What's the real meaning of weakness?

speaker: Donald
content: Is a number-illiterate leader weak? Is a hot-headed vandal who only knows how to wreak havoc weak? Or you, who've been sneaking and quaking in the shadows for nine long years—are you weak?!

speaker: Donald
content: Is there such a thing as absolute strength? Being weak isn't a crime—it's the world that crushes the weak that's truly monstrous! What gives you the right to judge who gets to live?

Channeling every ounce of his strength, he launches his spear directly at the shadow beneath him. In a flash of electric light, the spear shatters the shadow's corrupt exterior in a single, decisive moment.

speaker: Donald
content: And another thing, don't you ever speak to me with that face... Despicable monster, how dare you!!
[Julien CG]

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We've managed to save all the injured civilians. There's still one Sinner out there, fighting alone in the lockdown zone.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: I've got the intel. Everyone, beef up our defenses, reorganize our forces, and get ready to join me in the fray!!

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Also, we've found the MBCC Sinner who went missing. She's in urgent need of medical care. Get in touch with the Bureau, stat!!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Captain! That young Sinner, she's disappeared!

speaker: FAC Officer
content: What are you talking about?
The gravely wounded old man slowly comes to, his gaze lingering in the direction Hecate had departed.

speaker: Samuel
content: Hecate... Come back...
Hecate, on her own, clings to the White Cube as she races, tripping over herself.

speaker: Hecate
content: I broke free from FAC's grip, even though I once obeyed their every command. But why?

speaker: Hecate
content: Did I do this because I trusted someone, believed in someone outside of my mission? Is this really the right choice?

speaker: Samuel
content: Be extra careful when you are on your own. Make it out alive and return safely to the ones who matter the most to you.

speaker: Hecate
content: The one who matters most... Chief! I want to see Chief.

speaker: Hecate
content: But where should I go and what should I do now? Why there is no one giving me a mission? Please, somebody tell me what to do!
Her mind whirls with thoughts, the foremost being Paradeisos's notice. They said they have news regarding Chief, mentioning ${PlayerName} is at the Exiles' Base.

speaker: Hecate
content: Oh right, the base...
The base hadn't exactly been a haven for Hecate, but now she feels an overwhelming urge to return, almost as if it is her only hope for salvation.

speaker: Donald
content: Stop selling yourself short, and forget about needing "someone stronger." You're strong in your own right, and there's plenty out there ready to back you up. You've never been the underdog.

speaker: Matilda
content: You don't need to trust me. But you should find someone you can trust. Don't isolate yourself. You've already pushed your mind to the breaking point.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella is there... Matilda, Lavina, and countless others are there. I've got to find them...

She dashes ahead, her steps as erratic and unsteady as a child lost in thought. Just a few paces in, several figures lunge out of nowhere, tripping her. Hecate, already teetering on the brink of panic, reacts with a startled gasp.

speaker: Fleeing Child
content: Sobbing... Mommy, Daddy... where are you...

speaker: Fleeing Child
content: Missy, please help me. I'm scared. Don't leave me here, I'm really scared...

speaker: Hecate
content: Huff... I wasn't given the mission of helping you. I'm running out of time; I need to save Chief...

Attempting to distance herself from the children, she realizes that this act only heightens their fear, leading to more intense sobbing. This cacophony of cries further muddles Hecate's thoughts, making her feel as though she is facing a mirror image of herself.

speaker: Fleeing Child
content: Sob... What should I do?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...There's no order... for me to follow...
What's the right move here? She's on her own, at a loss for what to do next.

speaker: Hella
content: You've got to decide for yourself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This time, it's my turn to protect you...

speaker: Hecate
content: ... Nightmare!!
Finally, the young girl manages to push the weeping children away. Her body shakes, struggling to catch her breath, and she eventually finds her voice and cries out.

speaker: Hecate
content: Stay Here! Keep them safe!
Nightmare lingers in the wake, soon to be displaced by FAC soldiers coming to whisk the kids away.
Hecate, on her own, sprints down the streets—no Nightmare for protection, no one to lead her way. She tears through Syndicate's alleys.
Just a stone's throw away, another team has recently pulled out of the Exiles' Base, heading in a direction contrary to Hecate's path.

speaker: Schorl
content: We've fallen into a trap. Without the insights of the Second Observatorium, we can't track the evolving group consciousness in the area. Instead, we're being used by the Underground powers to stir up the Mania in the Black Ring. Losing X is a massive setback.

speaker: Schorl
content: The advance team is back at base, reporting erratic movements in the Black Ring. Time to rethink our approach.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...You've had your eyes on the streets; spotted anything unusual?

speaker: Paradeisos Elite
content: ...Hmm.
The elite soldier instantly notices a girl, clearly a Sinner, stumbling and sprinting through the streets, her body emanating unnaturally sharp, black spikes that catch the eye.
(Scene change)

speaker: Matilda
content: Hecate? What brought you back?

speaker: Matilda
content: You're heavily contaminated; you need immediate treatment.

speaker: Hecate
content: Where's Chief?

speaker: Matilda
content: He's not here. This is all a scheme by the Underground, a trap to lure Paradeisos into attacking us and to stir up unrest.
female_content: She's not here. This is all a scheme by the Underground, a trap to lure Paradeisos into attacking us and to stir up unrest.

content: Hecate is briefly overwhelmed and can't take in the information, but the sight of Hella, deep in contamination, hits her hard. Her friend's pain feels almost tangible to her.
She quickly grabs the White Cube and places it on Hella, hoping for a miracle—for a moment, she forgets that it was actually designed to save ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, please, wake up... I'm so sorry, this is all on me, I'm truly sorry...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief... Chief, where are you... I'm begging you... please respond...
Dark spikes of light slowly appear, but this time, a faint, wavering voice drifts out from the turmoil of the contamination.
You know where he's at...
female_content: You know where she's at...

content: Retrieve your shackles; you can sense them...
Find him, he's waiting for you, he relies on you... I'll deal with the obstacles in the way for you...
female_content: Find her, she's waiting for you, she relies on you... I'll deal with the obstacles in the way for you...

speaker: Hecate
content: You are...?
Go... It's all on you now...
The chaos from the other end of the shackles momentarily vanishes, as if someone parted the sea of Mania that drowns everything, at last revealing the truth hidden beneath the chaos.
In that split second, she sees the person at the very end of the shackles.

speaker: Hecate
content: I... I've figured out where Chief is... I want to go. I need to—

speaker: Lavina
content: Go for it! You've got me here. I swear, Hella won't suffer a scratch as long as I'm here.

speaker: Lavina
content: Work as a team, and make sure you bring that person back in one piece. Caution is key!

speaker: Matilda
content: The Black Ring has erupted, marking this path with Corruptors. It's too dangerous out there.

speaker: Matilda
content: I'll come with you.

The pollution in Drifter Camp is far more severe than anywhere else. The wandering Corruptors become wildly aggressive, and the contamination reaches unprecedented levels of activity. It is a hellish zone that everyone avoids at all costs.
Still, Hecate, with help from fellow Sinners, makes it to the depths, returning to the long-lost Romanesque Monument.

speaker: Dudu
content: It's you?

speaker: Hecate
content: Where's Chief? Where is he? I need to save him!
female_content: Where's Chief? Where is she? I need to save her!

speaker: Dudu
content: Stop, don't go any further, you'll get—
—She is immediately struck by the secret weapon in the trap.
[Transition] Coquelic's Portrait

speaker: Schorl
content: The Garden's Mentor? Then ${PlayerName}'s right here. Take her down and reclaim the SHP!

speaker: Coquelic
content: What does it matter if he's here? You think you guys can lay a finger on him?
female_content: What does it matter if she's here? You think you guys can lay a finger on her ?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Taking your sweet time to get here, but now it's worth the wait... I won't have to hunt you down to settle our scores!
The duel of titans endures, intense and unyielding. A tide of Corruptors, blind to risk, converges, as if spellbound by a deeper instinct.
Hecate feels it as well—the sinister allure coming from a secret passage. The mouth of the passage is belching contamination, blatantly hiding a terrifying presence below.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Is it down there? Chief must be underneath. Chief!
She fights her way ahead, darting towards the tunnel now clogged with contamination. Corruptors follow, howling at the girl, only to be completely taken down by distant gunfire.
—It is the Hall Manager of Romanesque who is clearing a path for her.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Go.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: It's all the same in the end...
Hecate can't focus on anything else. She forces open the doors to the basement, now overwhelmed by rampant contamination, and there lies ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!

The shackles are in a heated clash with Mania, and ${PlayerName} is going toe-to-toe with BR-002. Desperately, Hecate slams the White Cube onto ${PlayerName}'s chest, all while suffering burns from the spreading contamination.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, wake up!
The entire defense grid is pushed to its limits, glowing with a pulsating blue light, intermittently shattered by the savage Mania tempests.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The Black Ring pollution is rapidly expanding, hitting a tipping point. The amassed Mania energy is violently bursting forth, causing the edges of the Black Ring to expand at an alarming rate!

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Defense Line!! Crank up the power to the max, we've got to stop it!!

Rusty iron pillars, tainted and crumbling, materialize from above, their oozing contamination sinking into Syndicate's shattered ruins like slow-moving spikes. The crowd is in a panic, screaming and fleeing in every direction, but shadows stand firm, fighting back with all they've got.
Yet, in comparison to its surroundings, the shadows seem strikingly fragile.

speaker: Crache
content: Turn around! Head back now! Find cover underground and stay hidden!!

speaker: Crache
content: Damn it! This is all the shadows I've got... I can't keep all these people safe.

speaker: Greta
content: The Mania inside the injured has spiraled out of control. We've run out of Hypercubes, and even the sedatives aren't working anymore. Lavina! Lavina, where are you? Hurry back!

speaker: Greta
content: Lavina?!
At last, he finds his guardian angel, but the woman who'd been his rock is already down. Black spikes of light pierce through her, but beneath her, she continues to protect a terrified, wounded ally.

speaker: Greta
content: Are these... shackles? How did they get so severe? You've been bearing this burden all along, yet still protecting others even till now...

speaker: Greta
content: Sob... We've got shelters that are still operational, and there are people who can help. I'll get you there, I'll lead everyone to refuge, I... I'll do everything I can...
The Secret Ward Overwhelmed by Contamination

speaker: Hecate
