content: Chief, please, I'm begging you, wake up!
She scrambles to apply the White Cube to ${PlayerName}'s chest, while she keeps getting scorched by the unyielding contamination.

speaker: Hecate
content: Why isn't this working? Wasn't it supposed to stop the contamination, to save people?

speaker: Hecate
content: Is it because I'm not strong enough, or did I mess up something earlier?

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, please, I need you to wake up, or I can't do anything...

speaker: Hecate
content: Please, I'm begging you... come on... wake up...
The contamination creeps onto the girl, slowly fading her into unconsciousness as she slumps in front of ${PlayerName}, engulfed in contamination. The White Cube drops to the floor.
Everything is too late. It couldn't do what it was supposed to.
The maze crafted from contamination is gradually falling apart, melting and reshaping into more recognizable monsters. The man sprawled on the ground quietly observes it all.
His life is drawing to a close, but in this moment, he experiences an unmatched feeling of fulfillment and pride.

speaker: Parma
content: Nurturing of the Black Rings never relied on some Underground sorceries. Mania is the emotion, the Ring is the connection, and naturally, only the human heart can cultivate them.

speaker: Parma
content: Such fertile ground, filled with hate, fear, anger, despair... But more importantly, it's about unleashing all these burgeoning passions. They refuse to be silenced, and thus, they are powerful.

speaker: Parma
content: Here lies both glory and sin, untamed and unbound. This Black Ring is Syndicate itself.

speaker: Parma
content: Thanks for the nudge from Paradeisos. Next up... it's time to race.

His body deteriorates further, his mind growing foggy. The slow, deliberate footsteps from below grow closer. The unmistakable aura of death advances on him. With the last of his energy, Parma manages to muster his iconic smile.

speaker: Parma
content: Ah, yes, I am quite satisfied.

speaker: Parma
content: I have fulfilled my duties, ensnared those destined for demise, and meticulously paved the paths foreordained... I believe it's time for me to end this.

speaker: Parma
content: I am... deeply satisfied.

speaker: Parma
content: The rest is in your hands.
Bang—Bang Bang Bang!
Her silver spear completely obliterates the Underground agent's last physical form. The woman's final rounds sink deep into the earth. Her hat dips low, obscuring her face.

speaker: Langley
content: ...Marta, Red J, Padron, Viper, Azure... your mission's accomplished, nicely done.

speaker: Langley
content: Take a rest, no more late nights for you.

speaker: Langley
content: Next...
She looks toward the boiling Black Ring. There, at the edge, someone else is still battling, about to be swallowed by the widening halo.

speaker: Donald
content: Over here!

A lone figure breaks free from the monsters' suffocating embrace, with erratic bolts of lightning springing from him, boiling, pulsating. They merge into a fierce, blinding golden spear that cleaves the heavens. A cacophony of thunder crashes down, the tempest tearing apart the monsters' tidal onslaught, briefly hindering the Black Ring's advance.

speaker: Donald
content: Stay sharp, this battle isn't done yet—I'm still standing, and ready to take you on!

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: All for the sake of that person, isn't it?

speaker: Donald
content: ...Hmph!
A forest of razor-sharp, rusted rebars erupt from the ground, lunging at Donald, ensnaring him in a makeshift iron cage, trapping his frantic struggles.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: It's all over—the Ring's gained too much power, the White Cube is no match for it now. The entire West District is feeding on its strength. This time, it's unbeatable—not by Paradeisos, not by the Underground, not by that person either, and certainly not by you...

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: It's always the same with you, always a step behind, too late to make a difference.

The Corpseborne inches closer to Donald. The deadly steel rebars constrict, stealing his breath, while filth and rust creep from the iron frame, eating into his flesh. As his awareness blurs, he senses the monster looming over him, about to shred and flatten him any moment now.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: What I failed to do 9 years ago still eludes me today.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: But bear in mind... this time, it was my choice to embrace the Black Ring, and it will surely bring to life... my deepest desire.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Your... desire?

speaker: Donald
content: You are...?
Donald feels a flicker of hope. He lifts his head and sees the Corpseborne, bearing Julien's face, watching him calmly.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Next, it's your turn.
His words are cut short as an overwhelming blast hits him, forcefully ejecting him from the Ring's domain.
(Transition)
You swing open the last gate of the maze, greeted by the sight of that well-known lookout.
No sign of Julien here; it's eerily quiet, with not a soul around. Just a lone wheelchair resting quietly against the lookout's edge, with a mug of lukewarm coffee perched on it.
Off in the distance, the white maze begins to stain a deep red, morphing into the world you're all too familiar with. You can even hear someone frantically calling your name.
The red glow is closing in on you, making you feel like you're just moments away from reaching that other world, and you'll be leaving here. But just before you do—
You take a sip, guessing it's prepared with the architect's beloved ten sugar cubes. It's perfectly sweet, just sweet enough for you to feel a hint of flavor, under the circumstances.
The red halo shatters its bonds, swelling quickly in size. Outside it, the polluted maze contorts, spreading like a starving creature, engulfing everything on its way.

The tower lets out a thunderous boom, resonating with everyone in West District, be they Overground or Underground, commoners or Sinners. After eight months since it resurfaced, the Second Black Ring is finally completely unleashed.
Deep in the secret room beneath Drifter Camp, the girl is entirely unconscious, her limp body gradually slipping off the nursing stand.
—Right when Hecate is on the verge of collapsing to the ground, a hand catches her.

speaker: Schorl
content: The Black Ring is spreading rapidly, its radiation now blanketing the entire West District.

speaker: Schorl
content: We've confirmed the presence of the Underground Shepherd, and she's dangerously close to the Black Ring border. At this rate, there's no way we can stop her from breaching BR-002.

speaker: Schorl
content: She wields tremendous power, stronger than any SHPs we've ever had in the history. We must halt her from consuming BR-002; otherwise, the outcome will be catastrophic.

speaker: Schorl
content: But amidst the failed observation and the disarray within the Ring's temporal field, we can't pinpoint the right moment to launch an attack, and it's equally challenging to trail her into the core of the Black Ring.

speaker: High-Level Channel
content: Actually, we can determine the timing.

speaker: High-Level Channel
content: It will occur precisely when BR-002 engulfs the entire West District's population, reaching its peak in power.

speaker: High-Level Channel
content: The Underground must be anticipating this very moment; it will propel them forward by a great leap, to a point we'll struggle to keep up with.

speaker: High-Level Channel
content: However, we have countermeasures. Firstly, we'll bide our time and confirm the exact moment when the Black Ring is breached. At that instant, the Underground Shepherd will also reveal herself. That's our cue for a focused attack.

speaker: High-Level Channel
content: Next, track down SHP-13. We've confirmed that he's regained consciousness. Locate him. His involvement is key to advancing our next step.
female_content: Next, track down SHP-13. We've confirmed that she's regained consciousness. Locate her. Her involvement is key to advancing our next step.

speaker: High-Level Channel
content: Lastly, calculate the Black Ring's rate of expansion, right before it overtakes the West District...

speaker: High-Level Channel
content: Activate the local Purge Order.
(Scene change)

speaker: Rust
content: We couldn't stop it after all, could we... Employing the Purge Order is the "sensible" option here. You wouldn't want everyone in the West District to end up as her prey.

speaker: Rust
content: But even that won't stop her...
(Scene change)
Crache gazes upon the erupting Black Ring, its ominous shadows engulfing the entire Syndicate beneath the High Tower of Mania.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Haha, is this what they call... the future?
(Scene change)
Oak Casket cradles the unconscious Hecate from another's hold, watching him step into wild pollution and hearing the wails of lost souls.
female_content: Oak Casket cradles the unconscious Hecate from another's hold, watching her step into wild pollution and hearing the wails of lost souls.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: This is the only form of equality you'll ever get.
[Scene Change] Maze Outside the Ring

BR-002's halo begins to expand slowly, radiating outward and gradually engulfing the contaminated areas beyond its ring. It dissolves those towering barriers, and the Corruptors emerge, now endowed with even greater strength.
Above them all, a more formidable presence looms, now unmasked and free to unleash her power.

speaker: Old Lady
content: You, the humble Overgrounder, have... truly given your all. You've not only met but exceeded my expectations.

speaker: Old Lady
content: While other misguided fools attempted to challenge the might of □□□, that Ring you crafted did prove to be a hindrance, quite the headache, I must admit.

speaker: Old Lady
content: But now, it's time.

From the heart of the maze, a wooden staff strikes the ground, reverberating. Through the darkness, a figure presses onward, and with each stride, the towering maze walls on either side collapse. A more immense presence slowly encroaches upon the bottom of the Black Ring.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Feel proud of the grandeur in your humble existence, and then find peace in fading.

speaker: Old Lady
content: You can place your trust in me for everything.
The Black Ring keeps expanding, stretching further, much like a long-neglected flower slowly unfurling itself and greedily soaking up nutrients.
Those nutrients are none other than the people of West District, mired in fear and despair beneath the radiant surface.

Amidst the wreckage, the old time hero stumbles along, his mind clouded, uncertain of his destination, yet persistently taking each arduous step forward, his back to the looming Black Ring, oblivious to where it all leads.
And when he finally falters and falls, another soul reaches out to help him up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You gave it your all, but it was still beyond your control.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is Syndicate's Black Ring, a destiny millions have chosen for decades, set in stone. Neither you nor I can alter its course.

speaker: Donald
content: Not on my watch.
Upon hearing his words, ${PlayerName}'s gaze dims a bit.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well... get ready then.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This isn't the end.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not by a long shot.
Word of the Purge Order is out, casting a shadow of despair over the refugee camps.

speaker: Lavina
content: Let the reports from all the outposts come to me. Stay calm. We have prepared for this. Let's approach this one step at a time.

speaker: Lavina
content: Everything's on track—supplies, pathways, and network connections. But Greta, what's the status on the meds?

speaker: Greta
content: We're swamped with injuries, and our friends from the Outlands just brought in their last batch of supplies. Looks like they won't be able to make it through again.

speaker: Greta
content: I made another journey to SALVA. Nurse Anne really helped us out with a bunch of meds, and Dr. Iron was busy with a ton of emergency prosthetic surgeries. They're pushing their limits, I hope they can keep up.

speaker: Greta
content: And... Lavina, are you sure you're okay?

speaker: Greta
content: The Black Ring's changed completely. Even with the leader back, we couldn't get shackles back to how they were.

speaker: Greta
content: You collapsed due to the pollution a little while ago, and now, with more and more refugees coming in and everyone's on edge. You've got a mountain of tasks weighing on you, you—

speaker: Lavina
content: I'm fine. I handled Drifter Camp, didn't I? I can do the same here.

speaker: Lavina
content: We have only 46 hours left. With so many people in Syndicate, we need to act quickly to mobilize more people.

speaker: Lavina
content: The kids in the camp are pitching in too, copying flyers with Raye's poems. She always knew how to lift spirits, right?

speaker: Lavina
content: The Homeless are trying their best. We'll save as many as we can.
She gives a small, comforting smile to anxious Greta, then heads off to the wounded area.

speaker: Samuel
content: ...Donald... Hecate...
He barely manages to open his eyes, scanning his surroundings, and there it is—a face that is warm and familiar, yet inexplicably daunting.

speaker: Samuel
content: ...Lavina?

speaker: Samuel
content: No... Sorry... I got the wrong person...

speaker: Lavina
content: I know who you are.

speaker: Lavina
content: ...That's all in the past. If you're feeling up to it, we could really use your help; we're stretched thin.
In the quiet that follows, Samuel hands over a map, with a few points in the WhiteSands sketched out, simple but unmistakable.

speaker: Samuel
content: ...Over at Eastside, Quinn has established a few makeshift settlements in WhiteSands, giving us all a place to take shelter.

speaker: Lavina
content: That's a huge relief, thanks. I'll handle the coordination.

speaker: Lavina
content: One more thing.

speaker: Lavina
content: Hecate made it back safely, all thanks to you. You don't owe me any more apologies.

speaker: Lavina
content: <size=30> I... I don't have the right.</size>
She speaks the last few words in a hushed tone, then turns to leave.

The common folks can't endure the surface much longer—the contamination's too intense. Anyone who doesn't find shelter fast enough soon turns into Corruptors. The Homeless have had to quit their street rounds, now only handing out flyers in the limited safe spots left.

speaker: Ica
content: ...Don't worry, every little bit helps. Let's snap some photos and get them up on the web.

speaker: Ica
content: People in Eastside are watching. Someone is—
Suddenly, a man snatches the flyer right out of Ica's hand.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Forget about it. The Executive Officer's severed all our connections. Where are you gonna send it to, huh? And say it does get through, what good are those "good-hearted" Eastsiders? Just a bunch of noise and no action.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Do you actually believe you kids can make a difference? Imagine, if I gave you a thrashing right here—how unfair that'd be. Would anyone bother to intervene?

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Better run while you still can on those two legs. Scram, and fast. You're just a nuisance to look at.

speaker: Ica
content: I won't go! After I see you all off, I'm staying here! I won't just ditch my mom and dad and flee!

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Your folks are long gone! The writer of those pathetic poems too! Only someone as gullible as you would fall for her stuff!!

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: You're just a kid, what impact do you think you can make? Can hugging those worthless poems really turn things around? Can they ever protect you from the Purge Order?!
Clang!

speaker: Horo
content: Excuse me. I'm your ride outta here, one of the convoy crew. A <color=#fb9259>kid</color>.

speaker: Horo
content: If you're terrified and looking for a way out, get your bags and family sorted. Keep your wits about you, form an orderly line, and register here with me.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Haha... So, Zoya's out of the picture, and now you're resorting to a shorty for rescue?

speaker: Horo
content: Yeah, yeah, whatever you say. I'm up to my ears here. If you're not gonna help, at least don't stand in the way.

speaker: Horo
content: You've got a voice that carries; rather than barking at those kids, how about you wash out your mouth and give me a hand hollering for attention?

speaker: Horo
content: Remember the chat we had earlier?

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Ehh...
It is like hitting a nerve for him. He clicks his tongue, clams up, snatches Ica's bag, and just takes off.

speaker: Crache
content: ...You're the shorty from the Legion, huh?
Horo has gotten a bit taller, really, but she doesn't waste time explaining that. She just looks off towards Ica, standing a little ways off.

speaker: Horo
content: That little guy was so riled up that he was nearly in tears. You're not gonna back him up? Isn't he one of your crew?

speaker: Crache
content: Back him up for what? The guy wasn't exactly lying. I'm not naive enough to think a couple of sappy poems mean the world's all sunshine and rainbows.

speaker: Crache
content: And besides, the Homeless aren't under my command; I'm just like them, a bunch of kids without a proper home.

speaker: Crache
content: What about you? Haven't seen your kind around Syndicate for ages. Did the Legion call it quits?

speaker: Horo
content: Of course not! The Legion Commander's right here. The 9th Agency shipped us off, so we found something to do out there. Convoy work is old hat for us.

speaker: Horo
content: Then, this guy, an executive officer, told me to take down a satellite town early. We've got enough of Hypercubes for now. You can stay with us for a while till you all find your way.

speaker: Horo
content: Everyone's counting on me to get you out of here.
Crache sees that Horo is also affected by the shackles, but she looks cool as a cucumber.

speaker: Crache
content: Really? You seem like the right person for it. Those kids are your responsibility now. I've got other stuff to handle.

speaker: Horo
content: You're not leaving with us?

speaker: Crache
content: ...Like I've said before, I'm not one for those naive fairy tales.

speaker: Horo
content: Hmm~ You seem to be in the same camp with that downbeat guy. Oh, and just so you know, he came to me just now. Told me he's caught Mania, doesn't think he's got much time left and isn't planning on leaving.

speaker: Horo
content: He insisted on freeing up his spot in the car for someone else, particularly those kids who've got their whole lives ahead. Urged me to get you out fast, so you don't end up dying here.
...Crache stays silent and just walks off.
Miss Matilda, you have to come back, regardless. It's what your aunt has decided.
The Cavendishes aren't meant to meet their end under the Black Ring.
...Matilda glances over to see Corso brooding nearby. Her spirits have been low ever since their clash with Paradeisos.

speaker: Matilda
content: Corso, we're all set. You can make your move to Eastside.

speaker: Corso
content: What Eastside?

speaker: Matilda
content: Didn't you always ask me to get you to Eastside? Everything's in place now, time for your getaway.
Corso takes a moment to think, and then, with a sudden understanding, gives a derisive chuckle.

speaker: Corso
content: Ha, you think I'm leaving because I'm scared to die? Don't lump me in with those weaklings.
She is visibly irritated, a complete turnaround from how she was before.

speaker: Corso
content: It's these ever-hesitant, spineless wimps I can't stand, and that's why I don't want to be here.

speaker: Corso
content: Sure, those Rustfire guys are single-minded, obsessed with those shackles. But at least they are not all talk—they're willing to fight and actually want to fight.

speaker: Corso
content: Unlike these cowards today. Just looking at them is irritating.
She looks at the people huddled and shivering in the refugee camp, as if they are too scared to live unless they cling together.
Corso never bothers with the weak before, but now, she's inexplicably on edge, their sobs and whimpers driving her up the wall.
Matilda checks her watch.

speaker: Matilda
content: Just 46 hours to go...

speaker: Matilda
content: The blockade has been critically compromised, with BR-002 expanding faster than ever. FAC is desperately trying to rein in the Black Ring to prevent the Purge Order. But they've got a deadline: evacuate the West District within 40 hours.

speaker: Matilda
content: The 9th Agency, along with Paradeisos's elite, are en route to the Black Ring, likely targeting the Underground. This time, they seem ready to pull out all the stops, possibly even breaking into the Black Ring.

speaker: Matilda
content: The Executive Committee remaining here is probably going to carry out the Purge Order.

speaker: Donald
content: Where is Chief?

speaker: Matilda
content: He's taking care of Hecate and Hella. When the Black Ring burst, those two kids were under a lot of stress.
female_content: She's taking care of Hecate and Hella. When the Black Ring burst, those two kids were under a lot of strain.

speaker: Matilda
content: Even if he regains consciousness, the shackles remain contaminated with BR-002's corruption. And ${PlayerName} isn't having a easy time either.
female_content: Even if she regains consciousness, the shackles remain contaminated with BR-002's corruption. And ${PlayerName} isn't having a easy time either.

speaker: Matilda
content: Plus...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not part of Rustfire, not your leader either. I'm not in a position to save anyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, please give me some room.

speaker: Matilda
content: Lavina mentions that ${PlayerName} used to be a warm and gentle person. However, the way he is now gives off a strong sense of aloofness, which is unsettling.
female_content: Lavina mentions that ${PlayerName} used to be a warm and gentle person. However, the way she is now gives off a strong sense of aloofness, which is unsettling.

speaker: Matilda
content: Over the past few months, Chief's psyche has been relentlessly influenced by the Mania. Now that he's awakened... is he still the same person he used to be?
female_content: Over the past few months, Chief's psyche has been relentlessly influenced by the Mania. Now that she's awakened... is she still the same person she used to be?

speaker: Donald
content: ...He's with Hella and Hecate now, so everything should be fine. I'm sure he's still his old self.
female_content: ...She's with Hella and Hecate now, so everything should be fine. I'm sure she's still her old self.

speaker: Donald
content: Since the Black Ring has already erupted, there's no need for him to repay us anymore. Let him take a break.
female_content: Since the Black Ring has already erupted, there's no need for her to repay us anymore. Let her take a break.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: It's all over—the Ring's gained too much power, the White Cube is no match for it now. The entire West District is feeding on its strength. This time, it's unbeatable—not by Paradeisos, not by the Underground, not by that person either, and certainly not by you...

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: It's always the same with you, always a step behind, too late to make a difference.

speaker: Donald
content: When all is said and done, it's me who's always one step behind.
The adjutant attempts to say something, but Donald rises by himself, casually stretching his arms.

speaker: Donald
content: Time to kick off the escape plan! Good thing we're ready for this.

speaker: Donald
content: I've got a line in with a guy at FAC this time. He's going to spot us an exit and pull some strings to keep us all safe.

speaker: Donald
content: At the end of the day, ${PlayerName}'s back. His mere presence is enough to lift spirits. Let's play it like Raven does—leverage his fame for a few catchy slogans, make some ripples in the crowd.
female_content: At the end of the day, ${PlayerName}'s back. Her mere presence is enough to lift spirits. Let's play it like Raven does—leverage her fame for a few catchy slogans, make some ripples in the crowd.

speaker: Donald
content: And then there's you, Matilda Cavendish, our insider in Eastside. In just a year or two, the whole game could change—and you might be the political prodigy who reshapes destiny.

speaker: Donald
content: 46 hours still on the clock. Detail work isn't really my thing. I'm gonna head out, see if I can find some new angles. I'm counting on you to look after the folks here.

speaker: Matilda
content: Absolutely, I'll give it my all.
There lies Hecate in the hospital bed, with ${PlayerName} softly holding her hand at her side.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Really? The shackles still aren't fixed, and Hella's still out... Chief keeps pushing so hard...

speaker: Hecate
content: Did I mess up somehow?

speaker: Hecate
content: The White Cube, painstakingly secured by many, was in my hands, and I couldn't get it to Chief in time.

speaker: Hecate
content: I tripped and fell multiple times, clueless about where to head, wasting precious time...

speaker: Hecate
content: Ran into some strangers but I couldn't push them away. I even left Nightmare behind, I couldn't fight at all as I went back...

speaker: Hecate
content: I got lost, somehow made it back here to the base... because I didn't have enough info, and, well... I was clueless about what to do next, so my gut reaction was to seek help from somebody else...

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm sorry, Chief. If I were stronger, more steadfast, I wouldn't have let us down. Then, you and Hella would have been completely healed by now.

speaker: Hecate
content: The fact that Hella is in this condition... it's my fault too...

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I'm so sorry, I am just too weak...

options: There's no need to say sorry for that, Hecate.

content: If anyone should be apologizing, it's me. Breaking shackles only to let everyone down... I'm the one who should be saying sorry.
Your hand softly clasps hers, feeling the remnants of corruption on Hecate's skin. The weight of shackles is still present.
Forgive me, I wasn't powerful enough to keep you safe. But I refuse to give up, especially against those who've harmed you.
I promise to retrieve the shackles. But before I do, there's something I need from you.
Two hours on, fully prepared, Donald walks solo towards the High Tower.

speaker: Alarm
content: The Purge Order will commence in 43 hours. Attention all personnel, evacuate immediately, evacuate immediately.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Okay, time to perk up and blaze a new trail.
He enters the Black Ring.
Donald slowly descends into a misty, surreal illusion.

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Leader, we're all counting on you.

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: You hit Nirvana hard last time, proving what the Inner Bay workers are made of. We've still got the power, haven't we?

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: We're in a position to talk terms with them, right?

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Help me... You're the strongest, get us out of here...

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Help me... I'm terrified. I can't die now; I've got family. Please, do something...

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Wasn't it you who said... with you around, nothing would go wrong?

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Hero... Leader...

speaker: Inner Bay Worker
content: Damn. Got a 100,000-volt shocker to show off? Sounds way tougher than those Sinners from the gang.

speaker: Inner Bay Worker
content: Took out those thugs single-handedly, huh? Quite the feat! Looks like you've just volunteered for this week's patrol duty, "Mr. Hero." And don't worry, I'll have your back when Margaret comes swinging.

speaker: Inner Bay Worker
content: Haha, you should've seen the look on those Nirvana faces! They turned ashen when they witnessed Doni's abilities!

speaker: Julien
content: Emm! With power like this, we're sure to turn a lot of things around.

speaker: Donald
content: So this is the Black Ring's trickery... Long time, no see...

speaker: Donald
content: Enough of this... These nightmares are old news to me... I escaped your clutches years back, and I can do it again now...

speaker: Donald
content: You can't fool me. I'm the only one here this time, and I won't allow you... I won't let you harm them again... Not on my watch...

speaker: Donald
content: Ouch!
Donald's head reels from a hit. Blinking away the shock, he looks up to find a familiar shape standing before him.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Back with us? You're unusually affected by the Black Ring, it seems.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Oh, what's got you here?

speaker: Steel Muscles Corruptor
content: Creaking—
Rising within the Black Ring, this place is a complex web of gears and mazes, denser than anything outside, all leading up to the High Tower.
Loud echoes, growls, and tremors constantly emanate from the High Tower. A fierce battle rages below. Huge groups of Corruptors keep breaking away from the tower, then cascading down.
Their roars, filled with terror and rage, echo as they're lured by something, rushing past Donald and ${PlayerName} towards the depths.

speaker: Donald
content: Are we not the only ones in this Black Ring? Paradeisos? The Underground? Sounds like a brutal fight.

speaker: Donald
content: Last time, the Underground came out on top, which must have Paradeisos on edge.

...That one below isn't to be taken lightly. The shackles are bound to the Corpus, I can feel everything in this Ring is wary of her, terrified, doing all they can to stop her from moving upwards towards the master of the Ring.
Echoing those words, a sudden red glow flashes from beneath, and the tower subtly shakes. A deep hum resonates through the metal and your very bones, sounding almost like the tower's lament.
Then, after a few seconds, the mournful cries of monsters ascend from below, swirling around like a bloody tempest.
...Like that. We stand no chance against whoever's under us.
But being under the radar has its perks—no one's watching us, which means we can hurry up and head for the top of the tower.
Looks like laying low hasn't dulled Chief's wits or bravery. Donald gives a small laugh before carrying on with the discussion.

speaker: Donald
content: Hey, I'm the one who's carrying you up there.

speaker: Donald
content: Man, you walked in here all high and mighty, had me thinking you were some big shot. And then you barely make it a few steps?

speaker: Donald
content: Have your muscles withered from too much downtime?
...If I'm weighing you down, feel free to drop me.

speaker: Donald
content: What? Weighing me down? I could carry ten like you and still bust out a dance or do some parkour. No sweat at all.
Finally made a joke, but getting zero reaction from Chief is just disheartening.

speaker: Donald
content: I get it; it's because of the shackles.

speaker: Donald
content: Word is, since you came to, the Sinners are doing way better than before, and Hecate's heavy contamination is slowly receding too.

speaker: Donald
content: Let me guess, you're shouldering all that pollution from the Black Ring's outburst, aren't you? That's been hard on you.

speaker: Donald
content: Compared to what you're going through, walking a few steps with you on my back is nothing. I've always been the one to give piggyback rides to my friend, and doing this for you brings back memories.
...Hmm.
${PlayerName} isn't much for words, and it makes Donald think back to their first meeting, just a short while ago.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The contamination here has nothing to do with Drifter Camp. Stop your so-called mission. I know what the Executive Committee is planning.
He was pretty quick-witted back in the day. His silence now, though, makes it impossible to tell what he's thinking.
female_content: She was pretty quick-witted back in the day. Her silence now, though, makes it impossible to tell what she's thinking.

content: I want to find the Corpseborne.
Shackles bind it, and I know where that monster is, but I'm unfamiliar with this terrain, it's like a maze.
Do you know the way?

speaker: Donald
content: Absolutely. This whole area's just a massive version of the Drifter Camp, and I can spot that guy's handiwork a mile away.

speaker: Donald
content: I'm also on the hunt for it, probably like everyone else. But trust me to lead, and we'll outpace the others, no doubt.
As the echo of the words fades, a swarm of Corruptors, each distinct in their own way, clambers towards the team.

speaker: Corrupted Paradeisos Soldier
content: <color=#fb9259>#￥%@…@%@￥%&... shackles...</color>

speaker: Corrupted Underground Puppet
content: <color=#fb9259>#￥%@…@%@￥%&… it's that person... shackles...</color>

speaker: Donald
content: Paradeisos, the Underground... Wow, I was right, they are fighting here.

speaker: Donald
content: Well, this place might just be where everyone gets along.

speaker: Donald
content: It seems they're coming after you. Are you up for a fight?
No, those shackles are still linked to that creature, and it would be pretty uncomfortable for me to use them.
Can you handle a brawl?

speaker: Donald
content: Ha! Of course! I've handled these guys single-handedly before. Think I'm afraid?

speaker: Donald
content: But you've got to help out a bit too.

speaker: Donald
content: ...If I get too carried away in the middle of the fight and lose track of things, just snap me out of it, okay?

speaker: Donald
content: Phew—thankfully, my skills haven't dulled. Even if a few more of them show up, I can still—
A few phantom figures shimmer into existence, but this time, it isn't Paradeisos or the Underground. Donald's body stiffens for a moment.

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Help me... You're the strongest, get us out of here...

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Help me... I'm terrified. I can't die now; I've got family. Please, do something...

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Wasn't it you who said... with you around, nothing would go wrong?

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Hero... Leader...
You notice something's off in his expression, so you pat Donald on the head.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Ahhh!

speaker: Donald
content: Huh? Did I zone out again?
You nod.

speaker: Donald
content: Haha... The Black Ring's impact is huge, especially since we can't use your shackles right now. We're quite the battered duo, aren't we?

speaker: Donald
content: But you being here, it really gives me a sense of security. Thanks for that.

speaker: Donald
content: Let's move. Those groups are quicker than expected, and I'm not planning on lagging behind. You're eager to get this over with as well, aren't you?

The Underground shackles keep pushing forward, with every attack sending shockwaves through the High Tower, shaking everyone inside. But Donald clearly senses the Ring's power intensifying, toughening the tower against the Undergrounder's fierce attacks.
It's a must to prevent the Underground from consuming the Black Ring—the fallout would be catastrophic. However, letting the Black Ring grow stronger is just as unacceptable.

It's becoming clear that an increasing number of people in the West District are caught up in the Black Ring, falling prey to the BR-002 Mania, slowly feeding the monstrous growth. On any battlefield, they're just pawns to be stepped on.
He approaches ${PlayerName} and squats down, ready to carry on, but this time ${PlayerName} doesn't make a move.
The enemy is very strong.

speaker: Max King
content: We'll just have to wing it.
You haven't got a shot at winning.

speaker: Donald
content: Yeah, I know.
So, why did you come here?
Chasing pipe dreams just like Rustfire, leading yourself down a dead-end path again?
I'm aware you were the first Rustfire leader.

speaker: Donald
content: It's come up a lot recently. Do I still resemble them? I thought I'd changed a while back.

speaker: Donald
content: I'm sorry, I realize you've suffered greatly, and the same goes for those dear to you. There's not much I can do to make amends, especially since I have my own agenda on this trip.

speaker: Donald
content: But I'll try my hardest to protect you.

speaker: Donald
content: At least, I'm dead set on surviving this and I've made a promise—to bring you back to that girl.
While talking, he gets to his feet and picks up his weapon.
Suddenly, a figure emerges in front.
It is a Paradeisos elite, severely tainted. Just as you are figuring out whether it is living, a laser beam streaks your way, swiftly parried by Donald.

speaker: Schorl
content: Chief ${PlayerName} of the MBCC, it's time to head back. You're needed at Paradeisos.

speaker: Donald
content: Speak your mind if you're unhappy, Chief. I've got you covered.

speaker: Donald
content: Seems you've got a better sense of direction here than those from the Underground, huh?

speaker: Schorl
content: You're the one marked by X, the Sinner S-012. Clearly, there's a glitch in the marking system.

speaker: Schorl
content: Harnessing powers without furthering assimilation.

speaker: Donald
content: That's because I have ironclad determination. I steered clear of my abilities for nine long years to escape your grip, sculpting my muscles into a powerhouse.

speaker: Schorl
content: Actually, it's more like the original mark is beginning to falter.

speaker: Schorl
content: Donald, as an S-Class Sinner, your feat of keeping your identity intact in the Black Ring is nothing short of astonishing. You're a powerhouse with a potential to make monumental contributions to humankind.

speaker: Schorl
content: It's a shame, though, the Hush who marked you had an untimely exit. If she was still around, she'd have been ideal for reining in your wayward tendencies.

speaker: Donald
content: Really? That Hush's been sidelined, huh... If only you'd told me sooner, I would've thrown caution to the wind.

speaker: Donald
content: Looks like her absence is throwing a wrench in your plans, isn't it?

speaker: Donald
content: So, what happened, got beaten by the Underground again?
Almost as if in reply to his statement, the High Tower trembles again.

speaker: Schorl
content: Don't waste your effort trying to rile me up, Sinner. We embody pure reason.

speaker: Schorl
content: Let's not have a showdown here. You two are already under the heavy strain of the Black Ring. Without the right stuff, you're just burning our time.

speaker: Schorl
content: Our mission is to halt the Underground's advances and break the Black Ring, averting a global crisis. So, move aside.

speaker: Schorl
content: Our aim is ${PlayerName}, all for the greater good of humanity.
As the knight advances, Donald swiftly moves you to the safety behind him.

speaker: Donald
content: Stay safe, ${PlayerName}. This thing might be junk, but the character next to it? Definitely not.

speaker: Donald
content: This knight has waded through contamination to sweep this place clean, just lying in wait for us.

speaker: Schorl
content: I'll say it again: Turn him over to Paradeisos.
female_content: I'll say it again: Turn her over to Paradeisos.

speaker: Donald
content: Telling me a hundred times won't change a thing, beat it!

Amidst the fierce fight, Donald slashes open the knight's armor. The current seizes the chance to infiltrate Paradeisos's tech piece, but the enemy swiftly rips off their arm armor and tosses it aside, baring their arm. In Donald's eyes, there is a peculiar strangeness to this action.

speaker: Donald
content: Hmm? That knight is...?

Just as he is trying to make sense of the eerie sensation, a bunch of Rustfire Corruptors burst forth, latching onto Donald's feet. Instantly, Paradeisos's fighter breaks free from Donald and bolts towards ${PlayerName}. The knight's focus on the target is unwavering throughout.

speaker: Donald
content: Dodge now!!!

speaker: Schorl
content: Catch him!
female_content: Catch her!

content: There's no escape—the warrior clad in white bolts towards you. A surge of mighty force echoes with the surrounding Mania, tipping you off to this person's oddity.
...A Sinner?
The fighter stays silent, charging at you with wounds all over and gripping your neck. You don't have time to struggle, so you let them proceed.
—But you've eyed their exposed arm reaching out to you. Being a Sinner, this gives you a shot at a countermove.
[Release the shackles]
Shackles wrapped in a dark aura instantly subdue your attacker. Donald swoops in, forcing them back, and both sides swiftly part ways, distancing themselves.

speaker: Donald
content: You okay?
There's something off with your shackles. That person is surely a Sinner, but not like any other. Could it be the shackles' corruption causing this sensory skew? Or is the target not quite right?
I'm okay... but that Paradeisian...

Paradeisos's fighter is down on one knee, gasping for air. The corrupted shackles are clearly putting a strain on them. They pull out a Hypercube, struggling to hold it back, but the mechanical command-giver doesn't seem pleased.

speaker: Schorl
content: Are these shackles sapping your strength to fight? What a blunder—never should've touched the SHP directly with your skin.

speaker: Schorl
content: No stepping back, capture him. You're a special Sinner, shackles can't hold you down easily, and they're weakened now.
female_content: No stepping back, capture her. You're an extraordinary Sinner, shackles can't hold you down easily, and they're weakened now.

speaker: Schorl
content: Take control of SHP-13; it's high time—zzzz—zzzz—

Signal interference halts the mechanical voice mid-sentence, pausing the onslaught. Schorl settles into silence, its light ebbing smoothly. It might sound odd, but it's as if it's become someone entirely different.
There was no need for that clash. Let's try a different tack, with someone new, and begin the conversation again.
Hello, Chief ${PlayerName}. I operate the EDGE-01 super-loop Communication Channel and am part of Paradeisos's decision-making team.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: We're both facing significant pressure. Fighting here is just wasting time and wearing each other down. In the end, it's the Black Ring and the Underground who'll gain from this, hurting our city-state.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: So, I'm committing to stop any offensive moves against you and I'm looking for a frank discussion. We're in need of your insight and support.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Don't get pulled into their game.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: Appreciate your understanding. Let's skip the past mix-ups and cut to the chase as time's ticking.
Oddly enough, you don't hear a soul, but these messages infiltrate your thoughts, instantly making sense.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Let's skip the formalities about where we stand. In this fight against Mania, we're both enemies to the Underground.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Fueled by their instigations, BR-002's grown incredibly volatile. The radiation's engulfed 80% of the West District and is creeping towards Eastside.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: We've got 48 hours before everyone's turned, feeding into BR-002's Mania. Beyond that, it becomes unstoppable.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: This is our last shot. We need to cut it down or wipe it out before time's up. Our best bet is the local Purge Order.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Normally, Rules can't breach the Black Ring's effect on those Corpsebornes. But you're a game changer.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Your clashes with Corpus 002 have linked you to it by shackles. Once you accept the Rules and anchor yourself, we can slice through the Black Ring. We're talking about a perfect sync—a direct, pinpoint strike on Corpus 002.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: It's a plan with solid backing. Nirvana's on board too, pledging a decade's worth of Hypercube yield to fuel our strategy.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: We'll pause all operations linked to the Purge Order. And we'll wipe out BR-002's threat to the West District, for good.

options: If it was a walk in the park,

content: you wouldn't be tossing the decision my way.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: That's right. As the bearer of the Rules, you'll be completely destroyed at a 100% sync rate, leaving no chance of survival. 
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: And to make sure you don't bite the dust before Corpus 002, we need a one-hit knockout at a full sync.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: That's the full briefing.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Now, what do you choose?
This is moral blackmail! You're pressuring me to end it all with millions of lives at stake?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Feeling weighed down by the morality of this choice? That just proves X's point—you're a genuinely good and honest person.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Matches up with everything your actions have shown so far.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Don't worry, I'm not about to force your hand. The way things have panned out, no matter what we choose, we've already hit rock bottom as representatives of humanity.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: However, if I were calling the shots, I'd save you in a heartbeat and go ahead with the Purge Order.

options: ...Stop, this is just making me sick.

content: <color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: I figured you'd think that.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: The Purge Order could work. But pushing it too hard, considering how you are, would mean losing your trust for good. It'd also take a heavy toll on your strong mental resilience.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: In that case, everything I've sacrificed to keep you safe would be for nothing.
You hesitate, momentarily caught off guard, then chuckle at the sheer absurdity.

options: Am I that important to Paradeisos?

content: <color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Everyone's perspective varies. On this issue, I can't speak on behalf of Paradeisos.

The High Tower shakes more violently, and the skirmishes below rage on with increasing ferocity. The flow of information between you two also grows increasingly erratic, and one brief distraction leads to your abrupt exit from the previous channel.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: After losing the Second Observatorium, maintaining a stable super-loop communication with BR-002 became a daunting task, and time is running out rapidly. I'm also dealing with enemies that demand my full concentration.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: Regarding BR-002, no matter which option you decide on, the situation can move forward as far as I'm concerned. But for you, it's a matter of life and death.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: That's why I'm leaving the choice in your hands, along with Schorl. Its attack modules are now permanently disabled for you, providing only the "Rules" interface and limited security protection.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: In 27 hours outside the Ring, Paradeisos will promptly enact the Purge Order. This will eradicate all residents in the West District, thwarting their efforts to further strengthen BR-002.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: Before then, you and your friends can do your best to organize a mass exodus, though your efforts may only save a few. The West District is doomed, with millions destined to be erased. If this burden is too much for you to handle...

speaker: EDGE-01
content: Until that time comes, there's an alternative.

speaker: Donald
content: That's enough; he doesn't have to follow the paths you're laying out for him.
female_content: That's enough; she doesn't have to follow the paths you're laying out for her.

content: He pulls you away. The vibrations from below intensify, steadily picking up pace as if in pursuit of something. Yet, Donald stands steadfast.

speaker: Donald
content: Nine long years... and you all haven't changed a bit, still pulling the same stunts. We've got our own mission, our own questions to unravel.

speaker: Donald
content: Those who've never bothered to see us eye to eye have no business bossing us around here!

A sudden, powerful jolt, and chunks of iron pillars fall from the heights, narrowly missing the ground where you stand. At the same time, pollution erupts from below, rushing upwards like a volcanic explosion, rapidly swallowing everything in its path.
In a flash of electricity, Donald deploys a grappling hook, whisking you away from the collapsing floor.

speaker: Donald
content: Are my injuries... gone? Injuries that severe, how is that even...

speaker: Eastside Healthcare
content: What's there to be astonished about? Isn't this completely normal?

speaker: Eastside Healthcare
content: This is Eastside, not that outdated Syndicate.
[White flash]

speaker: Nirvana Executive
content: Heh... The Western District is stuck in its old ways, oblivious to the fact that technology has evolved.

speaker: Nirvana Executive
content: The observation of BR-001 has propelled technological progress. We can now achieve super-loop communication, enabling us to defy the laws of time and space within the Black Ring for communication. The mechanized mining by drones has been a reality for quite some time now.

speaker: Donald
content: Wh-what does it mean?

speaker: Nirvana Executive
content: It means that the skilled technicians you've been looking up to have become a thing of the past.
[White flash]

speaker: Julien
content: This could be a dangerous trip. Are you sure you're alright with that?

speaker: Donald
content: Amidst adversity, this is the courage required. I'll clear a path for you!
[White flash]

speaker: Nirvana Executive
content: Negotiations... A single command could resolve it, and you wouldn't even realize the system update was happening.

speaker: Donald
content: They're working their hearts out on production, dealing with gang harassment every night. They hardly have a moment...
No one is listening to what he's saying.

speaker: Nirvana Executive
content: Hahaha, you're all complete idiots, believing you can negotiate with us... If it weren't for someone pulling the strings in the media, Nirvana wouldn't even waste time on you...

speaker: Nirvana Executive
content: Now, let's take care of those few influencer accounts. I remember there's a Syndican woman behind them.

speaker: Nirvana Executive
content: Seriously, why bother rescuing him... Those Paradeisians are also a headache...
[White flash]

speaker: X
content: Observation has verified that another powerful Mania being has penetrated BR-002, obliterating the anomaly. This resulted in an instant dissipation of over half the energy possessed by the Corpsebornes.

speaker: X
content: That intruder bears a striking resemblance to SHP, no... even more formidable. It must be the only experimental subject taken from the Underground lab of Lone Island in N.F. 103.

speaker: X
content: So, the purpose of the Black Ring in the Underground... can we describe it as "nourishing"? Allowing the Corpseborne to absorb human Mania through the Black Ring, then feeding the strengthened Corpseborne to SHP.

speaker: X
content: The test yielded great success. From BR-002's records, we can roughly infer the Underground's intentions in producing the Black Ring and have a better grasp of SHP's significance. The only downside is that the expenses went beyond my initial estimates.

speaker: Donald
content: What kind of nourishing? What test are you talking about? I thought we were here to negotiate, to talk about the future of the West District. We've put everything on the line, and you're up to what exactly?

speaker: Donald
content: Screw you... Are we nothing more than expenses to you? Is human life just an expense to you?

speaker: Donald
content: What do you take us for?!

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: Leader, we're all counting on you.

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: You hit Nirvana hard last time, proving what the Inner Bay workers are made of. We've still got the power, haven't we?

speaker: Rustfire Revenant
content: We're in a position to talk terms with them, right?

speaker: Donald
content: Absolutely! We've reached this point because of our unwavering conviction. Our dreams will come to fruition. If you ever doubt it, just look to your hero! When have I ever disappointed you?

speaker: Samuel
content: Help me, I came here to follow you, leader. I... I don't want to die...

speaker: Donald
content: Ah... Ah...
[White flash]

speaker: X
content: His strength is remarkable, but mentally, he's teetering on the edge. Rather than defiance, he's overwhelmed by sorrow and regret.

speaker: X
content: I believe the marking won't work. I can't resonate with him, and I can't assimilate his Mania.
Hmm... I can sympathize. This man has spent his entire life trapped in Inner Bay, within Syndicate's confines. He's never experienced a larger world, so this must be quite a shock for him.

Recognizing their gap between us and Eastside highlights his intelligence. He has a broader perspective than his obstinate companions, truly befitting of a leader who doesn't readily succumb to blind animosity.
So, sir, would you kindly consider talking to your friends? We've already spent too much time on ruthless interrogations. Your assistance in this matter would be immensely valuable.

speaker: Donald
content: Damn you all!!!
See this, X? Just like that, we've got him hooked.

The Underground activity at BR-002 is locked, haha... it's mind-blowing, really. To think, even monstrosities like the Black Ring Corpus are just snacks for that thing. What in the world is going on down there?
Anyway, we hit our mark. Now, let's wrap this up and keep the mess to a minimum.
Go ahead and mark him. That's what a Hush is for.
[White flash]

speaker: X
content: I'm sorry for how Nirvana botched the W-31 situation, but we can't let this worsen and affect more people. It's time to put an end to this.

speaker: X
content: Give in, let me be your voice, I will take control. That's the power of the mark. I can free your friends.

speaker: X
content: Your sacrifices won't be meaningless. I'll work with Paradeisos to fine-tune our operation, saving costs along the way.

speaker: X
content: I'll remember you; we're all in this... for the greater good of humanity.
[Fade Out]

speaker: Donald
content: I was in the dark.

speaker: Donald
content: Whether the victory we were so passionately chasing means anything, how far the enemy we thought we could stand up to has evolved... I was totally out of the loop.

speaker: Donald
content: Unaware that the West District's heyday had long gone, blind to my own limitations, yet naively believing I can play the hero to save the world. Ha... how stupid.

speaker: Donald
content: Samuel, it's not your fault, nor anyone else's... It was a blind fool who walked you into that dead end. The real mistake has always been mine...
[White flash]

Mired in a contaminated bog, sinister arms intermittently trying to seize the two of you. Donald wakes up to see ${PlayerName} huffing and puffing, dragging him along. He cracks a smile and then, twisting around, begins to swim him to safety.
female_content: Mired in a contaminated bog, sinister arms intermittently trying to seize the two of you. Donald wakes up to see ${PlayerName} huffing and puffing, dragging him along. He cracks a smile and then, twisting around, begins to swim her to safety.

content: That loathsome Schorl floats right by ${PlayerName}, silent for once, like it is keeping a vow, just waiting for the ultimate choice.

speaker: Donald
content: Tough break, working so tirelessly with such a small frame. Take it easy now. Donald's up and about, and he's got you covered.

speaker: Donald
content: It's great you haven't been taken down by Paradeisos, still got that fight in you.
Right, unlike you, having nightmares again.
...You hanging in there?

speaker: Donald
content: It's nothing. Did a five-six year stint in Banyan Psychiatric Hospital, majored in being a psycho. Nightmares are a nightly thing for me, know them inside out.
With the grappling hook straining under your weight, he inches forward, clutching onto you, every step heavier than the last, while muddled voices invade your thoughts.

speaker: Murky Voice
content: Hero... get us out of here... lead us... to take back what's ours...

speaker: Murky Voice
content: Help me...

speaker: Donald
content: Look away, stay positive. We've got a long road ahead, don't sink into gloom.
Do you really think we can shatter this Black Ring?

speaker: Donald
content: ...Why shouldn't we believe?

speaker: Donald
content: The moment I entered this Black Ring, no... actually, when I first laid eyes on that maze outside, something crossed my mind.

speaker: Donald
content: It's really his handiwork, huh... Was this maze made just to shield those Corpsebornes and block enemies? Is this constantly rising Black Ring High Tower solely for gathering strength for a grand revenge?

speaker: Donald
content: You see, while it blocks our path, it also ensnares monsters and so many of the Corruptors. Unlike other Black Rings that expand and devour endlessly, this one, nourished by the Underground, just grows upward, pushing the epicenter of pollution farther away from people.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: But bear in mind... this time, it was my choice to embrace the Black Ring, and it will surely bring to life... my deepest desire.

speaker: Donald
content: I've always been too trusting, and it's bitten me before. So, I'm putting my faith in you now, ${PlayerName}. Tell me honestly...

speaker: Donald
content: Could Julien still be alive? Does his determination linger in this Black Ring?
...Yes, Julien hasn't thrown in the towel.
Shackles alone couldn't have held back the Black Ring for eight long months. It's his unyielding spirit battling Mania, restraining the Ring.
The Underground had plans to exploit him to harness a more potent and focused Black Ring. However, he flipped the script, snatching a chance to briefly seize control of the Black Ring.
He also steered Hecate to revive my awareness, rescuing me from the clutches of Mania.

speaker: Donald
content: Haha, that's a relief to hear. So, this place is essentially a massive Drifter Camp, and Julien? Still the same old Julien!

speaker: Donald
content: Don't let his constant self-deprecation and his begging around to be a leader fool you. When it all comes crashing down, when Rustfire hits the hardest, he's always the last one standing.

speaker: Donald
content: He's the genius who created this Drifter Camp in a place like Syndicate—complete with mazes, traps, and hidden paths—in this brutal world, he managed to carve out a sanctuary for the homeless and vulnerable.

speaker: Donald
content: I just knew it... This is great! We've got a shot at victory!

speaker: Donald
content: ${PlayerName}. Let's head up and track down Julien. You've got those shackles, right? Time to turn the rotten into miraculous, wake him up, and snatch back the Black Ring.

speaker: Donald
content: He claimed the Black Ring was the key to his wish. I know him so well. He never longed for vengeance. What he's always been harping on about is—

speaker: Donald
content: Being an architect and bringing Syndicate back to its heyday!
...It's impossible.
He's gone now.
Eight months... that's too long for either of us to hold on. We're just humans, small and frail, up against a massive force of Mania.
In the final moments, he nudged me forward, ensuring my escape, while he stayed till the very end.
Ever since the day you first met him, that's just the kind of guy he was.
<color=#fb9259><i>Hehehe... Haha... Coming back to life... Soon...<color=#dg1f1f><i>
<color=#fb9259><i>Give it back to me... Give it all back to me...<color=#dg1f1f><i>
Unable to confront the monster, he just planned to use his mechanisms to delay the inevitable, allowing everyone a chance to flee.

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Syndicate is ours! Rustfire will take back everything that was lost!

speaker: Rustfire Member
content: Our fires will rage and burn you all to ashes!
Lacking the might to halt a gang of madmen, he hopes to exchange himself for control over their zeal, cutting off the roots of this Mania.

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Hehe... Our fires... will rage... Hahaha...

speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
content: Syndicate belongs to us...

Without the strength to annihilate those Corruptors desperate to escape the Black Ring's confines and spread beyond, he creates a maze to ensnare them. He pursues and corks their seething rage, keeping the Corruptors firmly under his control.
[Corpus 002-CG]

Powerless to stop the Black Ring's relentless growth, he channels the burgeoning energy into the High Tower, stretching higher and higher, further from the ground, further from the realm of the living.

He reconstructs his most prized stronghold, cutting off both Paradeisos and the Underground from the outside world. He is determined that those who abuse the West District will never reap what they sow.
[Transition] Cutscene: In a wheelchair, gazing out over the terrace

speaker: Julien
content: I am weak, always have been.

speaker: Julien
content: No sturdy legs to stand on, no formidable power to wield, nor a constantly soaring spirit to fight with.

speaker: Julien
content: So, it's a constant cycle of failure, a never-ending loss for me...

speaker: Julien
content: But, even for someone like me, there are still roles I can fulfill...

Like you mentioned, his dream was simply to be an architect. An architect has no use for the Syndicate's violence. With his determination and skills, he managed to hold off the crisis for a whole eight months.
Both of you... cut from the same cloth... were the most stubborn, the strongest leaders of Rustfire.

speaker: Donald
content: Ah, I see it now...

speaker: Julien
content: Next, it's your turn.

speaker: Donald
content: That's what he meant when he said that...

speaker: Donald
content: You all still think... I'm capable...
Listening to your words, his eyes drift away, movements slow. Gradually, he sinks into the abyss of decay, with numerous small hands emerging from the sludge, as if trying to pull him under.

options: Donald? Come on, snap out of it!

content: Don't get swallowed by the illusion!

You slap him once more, realizing it's going to take a lot longer to bring him back this time. His ties with BR-002 run deep. The willpower that the Black Ring couldn't erode nine years ago now appears to be facing an even bigger challenge.

speaker: Donald
content: I dozed off again, didn't I?

speaker: Donald
content: It's alright, it was a nice dream. Seemed like a lot of old pals dropped by.

speaker: Donald
content: I hate to say it, but part of me thought Julien might have thrown in the towel. He turned to the Black Ring, lost in his own despair, and I just couldn't pull him back when it counted.

speaker: Donald
content: So, I appreciate it. Thanks for letting me know he hasn't changed, still battling to the bitter end.

speaker: Donald
content: It's just a botched plan, no worries, I've become accustomed to setbacks.

speaker: Donald
content: After a setback, just pick yourself up and move forward.
...Still making eloquent speeches, even now?

speaker: Donald
content: It's just the way I am, a remnant of a past era.
He tugs at you once more, hoisting you a bit from the quagmire. Just having that brief respite to breathe is a relief.

speaker: Donald
content: The escape plan is in full swing. Sure, the outside may be tough, but it's not all doom and gloom.

speaker: Donald
content: It's being trapped in Syndicate that's been our agony. We look to the West District from the Inner Bay, and to Eastside from there. So why not step out of Dis and see the bigger picture? Sounds good to me.

speaker: Donald
content: Would that leave you feeling unsatisfied? Oh... you're not like me; you have your own aspirations.
Contamination gradually converges on you, turning into black hands that emit a mournful cry, climbing up Donald's body and pulling him like a million companions thirsting for him to stay.
Donald's footsteps grow heavier, his body sinks deeper, but he only looks at you. After a while of silence, he smiles.

speaker: Donald
content: Well, I'll lend you a hand.

speaker: Donald
content: The shackles of the Sinner, DisCity's Shepherd, the Second Black Ring's envoy, the idol who ignited a craze in Rustfire, the one my closest friend sacrificed his life to save.

speaker: Donald
content: Paradeisos's right, if there's anyone who can change the course of things, it must be you.
Just before plunging back, Donald grabs your hand, and suddenly, a chilly object snaps onto your wrist. That's his hook-lock.
...What do you want to do?
You grab Donald's hand abruptly, a burst of red light erupting, impaling his wrist.
Stop this madness! Go after what you want, but don't rely on me! I don't need your sacrifices, no more risking your lives!
A burst of red light, and your voice directly pierces Donald's mind, turning absolute determination into an absolute command; this is the prohibition, and Sinners can't defy it.

speaker: Donald
content: Is this the prohibition? Just like Margaret's rolling pin, it makes you utterly powerless. Looks like Julien sacrificing lives for your sake really got on your nerves.

speaker: Donald
content: Don't worry, I'm not cut out for this. I can't even meet other people's expectations, so why would I do that to you?

speaker: Donald
content: Good talk, though. "Go after what you want..." You're here for something you want, too, right?

speaker: Donald
content: It's not about Rustfire, nor is it about saving the world... It's about cherishing what matters most to you. You've come to discover the truth and put an end to it all, so you can return to their side, alive and well.

speaker: Donald
content: Well, then, off you go. I'll pave the way for you and do you a solid.

speaker: Donald
content: After it's all said and done, once we're out of here, you'll have to repay me for sure.
Hold it! You must stay alive, you can't—

speaker: Donald
content: As you command, my lord.
female_content: As you command, my lady.

speaker: Donald
content: But from here on out, you'll have to be on your own for a while..

Just before the pollution could capture both of you again, Donald presses the switch on your wrist. With a snap, a grappling hook shoots out and latches onto something high above. You feel a powerful force yank you out of the muck and propel you upward. Just you alone.

speaker: Donald
content: Give me a moment to slack off and catch up with some old pals. Hearing you, I really do miss them...

speaker: Donald
content: I'll catch up with you... later...
With a grin, Donald unleashes a lightning arc, severing the pursuers of ${PlayerName}. Better to leave these old pals behind as company for him.

speaker: Donald
content: ...We're the remnants of a past era.

speaker: Donald
content: In our time, we didn't look down on the weak, and being cruel wasn't a badge of honor. In that era, we didn't mock ideals. I can wholeheartedly say that everything I've done has been driven by love.

speaker: Donald
content: Love for friends, love for ideals, love for every person around us who's fighting to make it, love for this Syndicate, love for all the beauty that's been lost, and the potential that's yet to be realized.

speaker: Donald
content: Time marches on, and maybe our era has already come to an end. The new era has seen its fair share of cruelty and places greater emphasis on power and profit.

speaker: Donald
content: But even this era will eventually become history. What will the next era look like? It will undoubtedly be shaped by those who are currently fighting the fight.

speaker: Donald
content: I can't wait...

speaker: Hella
content: Where... am I? Hecate... dummy...?
Hella gradually opens her eyes, and though the streets of Syndicate are momentarily disorienting, she quickly recognizes the face of the woman driving beside her.

speaker: Lavina
content: You are finally awake! The shackles are much stronger after ${PlayerName} woke up.

speaker: Lavina
content: The Black Ring has already encroached upon the outskirts of Drifter Camp; we need to get out of here.

speaker: Lavina
content: Before that, I'll drive you back to MBCC. Your health is improving, and there's no need to worry about anything else. ${PlayerName} has returned too, everything is going to be okay.

speaker: Lavina
content: I'll ensure you get back—Ugh!!

A fierce impact, and the collapsing wall obstructs their way. Lavina unfastens her seatbelt, assisting Hella in their escape. Her leg injury is far from recovered, and she hasn't taken more than a few steps before the Corruptors catch up. Lavina has to open fire to fend them off.
They eventually take shelter in the gaps amidst the rubble. Lavina tensely retrieves a vial of medicine to tend to Hella's contamination, as she has also suffered many injuries.

speaker: Lavina
content: Huff huff... We're in the clear. Let's rest here for a moment.

speaker: Lavina
content: I can handle these enemies. Just hold on a little longer; I won't let you be in danger again.

speaker: Hella
content: Am I holding you back? I'm sorry...

speaker: Lavina
content: Don't apologize!

speaker: Lavina
content: No need to apologize to me...

speaker: Lavina
content: Just think of me as the one seeking redemption... I'm the one who's guilty...
Painful memories start resurfacing, causing her voice to lower and quiver slightly.

speaker: Lavina
content: In March, after ${PlayerName} returned to Drifter Camp, I, a logistics officer, also picked up a weapon and took to the streets, joining the riot.

speaker: Lavina
content: Matilda says that at that time, the shackles within me had already been corrupted by Corpus, it's the mania that twisted me.

speaker: Lavina
content: But deep down, I know it's not the answer...

speaker: Lavina
content: I've always considered revenge as my only course because those monsters took my daughter away, and I couldn't even have her remains. There hasn't been a single day in all these years that I could forget, nor a night without nightmares.

speaker: Lavina
content: I keep reminding myself: Sophie sacrificed herself for her ideals. Her name is etched on the monument, making her a true hero. She must have been immensely proud of herself, and so am I... proud of my heroic daughter. That's what I've always believed.

speaker: Lavina
content: Until the moment I witnessed ${PlayerName} being brought back to Drifter Camp...
[Remembering Chief's Death]

speaker: Lavina
content: The leader of the Rustfire, a hero... heh...

speaker: Lavina
content: That appearance, where is the hero in that?!

speaker: Lavina
content: His slender frame is full of scars, his clothes stained dark with blood, fingernails split and broken... What pride? What vanity? I can't see these emotions on his face. He is in torment, resisting, not ready to let go of his life!
female_content: Her slender frame is full of scars, her clothes stained dark with blood, fingernails split and broken... What pride? What vanity? I can't see these emotions on her face. She is in torment, resisting, not ready to let go of her life!

speaker: Lavina
content: My daughter had no wish to die when she was murdered! They've endured such agony, perishing in the bleakest spots at the prime of their lives!
Her rage flares up for a fleeting moment, like a toxic wave flooding out of her, but she snaps back to reality, regretting that brief loss of self-control intensely.

speaker: Lavina
content: Since then, whenever I armed myself, I lost control. I had no clue what I had done, no memory of it at all. I had let myself be completely consumed by hatred...

speaker: Lavina
content: I only snapped out of it when I saw one of my "companions" going after a kid, and saw it was you.

speaker: Lavina
content: ...What have we become, doing this to a kid, even younger than Sophie?

speaker: Lavina
content: How did I end up like this, why did things go so far? The same suffering Sophie went through, I made you endure. I'm no better than the devils of Nirvana...

speaker: Lavina
content: I am beyond redemption. I don't deserve your forgiveness...
Hella listened quietly.

speaker: Hella
content: I see now... All of Lavina's actions, they were all for her daughter... It all makes sense now...

speaker: Hella
content: You really had those Rustfire troublemakers eating out of your hand, always on the ball and super efficient. You take care of everyone so thoughtfully, plus... your pancakes taste like the best thing in the world.

speaker: Hella
content: I can still recall... just before I blacked out, ${PlayerName} was gone, and there was Hecate, out on the streets, trying to be a hero.

speaker: Hella
content: There were loads of crazies on the other side. I thought, if I went down fighting for my friends, that would be the bravest thing. Friends have always meant everything to me.

speaker: Hella
content: But at that moment, you showed up.

speaker: Hella
content: As I was nearly at my limit, you fought your way through the crowd, yelling and shoving them aside. When shoving wasn't enough, you dove over me to shield me. You yelled so hard you lost your voice.

speaker: Hella
content: In an instant, my courage just evaporated. I was so scared, I couldn't let go, dared not to even peek outside. All I wanted was to hold onto you tightly.

speaker: Hella
content: It's such a strange feeling... I, the Rat Queen of Syndicate, have always been the one stepping up, looking out for others. Never once did I rely on someone else to protect me. When did I turn so cowardly, so worthless... Lying down for so long, it doesn't make any sense...

speaker: Hella
content: But now I get it...

speaker: Hella
content: The one who stepped in to save me back then was a "mother."

speaker: Hella
content: I had no mom and dad. Before I made any friends, it was just me, making my way through Syndicate. I never really understood what others meant when they talked about a "mother."

speaker: Hella
content: In your embrace, my mind was filled with—

She leaves her sentence hanging, gently wiping the tears off the woman's face. Lavina's arms are a map of scars, and her back must have been worse. At that moment, she clang to Hella, bearing the brunt of a relentless attack for what seems like an eternity.
The embrace feels warm. Hella holds on a bit tighter before softly pushing her away.

speaker: Hella
content: ...But my actual mom left me behind ages ago.

speaker: Hella
content: You aren't my mom.

Hella picks up her battered pipe, presses down on Lavina's hand to rise, and gazes out at the street. The surging Corruptors, howling in the distance, attracted by the shackles, are inevitably coming. She stands and moves outwards.

speaker: Lavina
content: No, you mustn't go! Stay here! Wait for me—

speaker: Hella
content: You aren't as strong as I am, aren't used to being a Sinner, aren't used to the shackles. Not seasoned by the world as I am, nor familiar with the corners of Syndicate. You can't shield me from anything.

speaker: Hella
content: Yet, you've opened my eyes to wonders I never knew existed.

speaker: Hella
content: Stay put, Lavina, you're not the one who can protect me.

speaker: Hella
content: I should be the one protecting you.

She steps forward to confront the raging Corruptors. In the depths of her soul, beyond the shackles, there are no comforting allies, only the Black Ring in her eyes, in her thoughts, the terror that had plagued her sleep for eight months gripping her throat.
And the root of all this? Syndicate, a world where even a "mother" can be twisted into a monster.

speaker: Hella
content: ****... Ninety-nine, Hecate, and...

speaker: Hella
content: That dummy ${PlayerName}...

speaker: Hella
content: I'm really starting to miss you all...

speaker: Hella
content: I wish I was strong like you guys...

speaker: Hella
content: Why am I this weak...
She fights back tears, inhaling deeply to calm her shaking hands.

speaker: Hella
content: Bring it on, you bunch of losers! I can take on all of you!

speaker: Lavina
content: Hella! Please stop! You're hurt, your body—

speaker: Hella
content: I can keep going, I can still...

speaker: Hella
content: Come on, heal already... damn it... I'm supposed to be the top Sinner, right?... Isn't this power supposed to kick in right now, when I need it most?
(Scene change)

Amidst fierce combat, shackles pierce from within her. Horo acutely feels the Black Ring's influence. She bravely protects those escaping, but slowly, she too is affected, stirring up emotions long buried deep within.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Huff... Huff... This is the Black Ring... This is what they were up against that day...

speaker: Horo
content: ...You vile creature! It wasn't enough to take our boss, my brother, and now you have the audacity to appear before me, slaughtering even more?

speaker: Horo
content: Go back to where you came from! I won't let you get away with this!!
(Scene change)

speaker: Ica
content: Crache!! Crache!!! Hold on, I'm here to help you!!!

speaker: Ica
content: Ahhh...!!
The boy tumbles down, his gun useless in his defense. However, a set of rugged, mud-stained hands grasp him—those of the very gloomy man he had just had a big argument with.
He looks panicked and annoyed, almost as if he can't understand his own actions. But the backpack on the man's back comes undone, scattering flyers everywhere.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Ha... Why did I even come back? Must be losing my mind, likely caught Mania, won't last much longer... and here I am, rescuing people like you...

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Hahahaha... I've spent my whole life playing it safe to stay alive, but now that death is near, it's oddly freeing... I want to do something heroic!

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: ...My last act something to remember... Hang tough, kiddo—
Crache extends her hand, and with the final trace of shadow departing from her, she propels those two onto a different floor.

As the final sliver of the sun sinks beneath the horizon, the shadows dissolve into the night. With no support left, Crache plummets downwards, a myriad of leaflets cascading around her, brushing past her hands.

speaker: Crache
content: It's those sappy poems again...

speaker: Crache
content: ...What's written... up there...?

speaker: Crache
content: It's too dark... I can't see it...
(Scene change)

speaker: Old Woman
content: It's been quite a while, and I've had more than my fair share of obstacles.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Still, it's great to see you again, Bai. It reminds me of the day we met; I stumbled upon you and brought you home.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Are you with me again? The ones you turned your back on have mostly paid the ultimate price. Here's your second chance.

speaker: Old Woman
content: Or is it that you really hate me so much?
She pauses before a thicket of deep red crystalline spikes, amidst which lies a woman with a ponytailed hairdo.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Hate? Ha... No way... My life is too valuable to squander on feelings like that...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: If you hadn't shown up to wreck my place, I'd have been content to live and let live.

speaker: Old Woman
content: ...This is what you call home?

speaker: Bai Yi
