content: And even without any say in the matter, the West District's now sitting on a mine, literally. That's leverage we can use against those politicians. The Syndicans have moved past martial arts—now it's all about the verbal art of negotiation.

speaker: Matilda
content: Think about it—just last year, the Syndicans weren't even recognized as DisCitizens. Now, they're back and making heads turn.
Matilda's casual tone suggests tangible progress in their work, making you—someone who only occasionally drops by—seem almost overly concerned.

speaker: Matilda
content: How are things on your end, Chief?

speaker: Matilda
content: I heard that the Underground Mania network has been taken down. Things have been pretty quiet these days, right? And you've been running out of town for missions lately?

speaker: Choice
options: Can't afford to lower my guard.

content: I just can't shake this feeling that if I let my guard down, all those dreadfulness—the Black Rings, the Mania outbreaks, the riots—will come flooding back to haunt me.
She offers a knowing smile, her expression showing she had expected exactly that answer.

speaker: Matilda
content: You've brought peace to the city. Once the new mine is up and running, it will surely bring us a better future. This election's bound to bring changes to many of us.

speaker: Matilda
content: Chief, a new era is dawning—one of stability and progress. We'll all be part of it, and that includes you too.
Even someone as composed as Matilda can't hide the excitement in her voice. The future she envisions must truly be something to look forward to.
Which makes it even harder for you to bring yourself to mention those things lurking in the shadows—the real reasons why you can't find peace of mind.

Throughout the DisMyth elimination operation, significant evidence emerged indicating that the Underground Mania forces had extensively interfered with the N.F. 110 Election, orchestrating numerous instances of assassination, bribery, forgery, and false accusations.

That operation concluded with the successful destruction of the DisMyth network servers. The network's lead developer, the genius programmer serving the Underground, <color=#fb9259>Moore</color>, was declared dead when her shackle connection went dark.

Following that, the 9th Agency initiated a covert investigation into the current Prime Minister and his cabinet, thoroughly probing for possible collusion with the Underground forces while maintaining constant surveillance.
But you know that this isn't the end.
All those mysteries involving that woman, her power, and her hidden motive—is she really dead? Was she truly the sole participant from those unfathomable Underground forces?
Moreover, if those people interfered with the election four years ago, there is no reason to believe they wouldn't attempt something similar now.

speaker: Matilda
content: Chief?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Sorry, I got carried away.
However, these burdens are not to be shared with a friend—she should focus on her own work, the promising picture of the West District.
All the dark premonitions are yours to shoulder alone, with your gaze fixed on the shadows, upholding eternal vigilance.

speaker: Choice
options: Let's work together for a better future.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I, too, am looking forward to this bright new era.
Just as those words escape your lips, the emergency line cuts in with several beeps, interrupting your call with Matilda.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, sorry to interrupt, but there's an emergency that needs your attention.

speaker: 9th
content: Something happened, Chief.

speaker: 9th
content: Can't say for sure; it's not something we're used to seeing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm on my way.
Well, that marks the end of your break.

speaker: Matilda
content: An emergency, right? Go ahead, Chief. I'm sure everything will work out with you in charge.
After several confrontations with the Underground, you deem yourself prepared for whatever may come.
However, five minutes later, events unfold in a way that surpasses even your darkest expectations.

speaker: Female News Anchor
content: Breaking news: Yesterday at 11:58 PM, an explosion rocked the city hall at Building 17, 105th Street, District 3 of Eastside. The blast has resulted in the loss of 26 lives, with 3 individuals currently in critical condition.

speaker: Female News Anchor
content: After <color=#fb9259>Prime Minister Stewart</color> was urgently transported to Eastside Central Hospital, he was pronounced dead at 4:23 AM despite all medical efforts.

speaker: Female News Anchor
content: A one-kilometer perimeter around the site has been cordoned off as multiple government departments launch a joint investigation. Currently, no details have been disclosed to the public. As District 3 has been declared under a state of emergency, Benjamin Carter, Head of the Health Committee, has announced his interim appointment at the council. He will be responsible for overseeing government operations until the Election.

speaker: Female News Anchor
content: Notably, Carter stands eleventh in the line of succession, while all ten senior cabinet officials preceding him <color=#fb9259>fell victim to the explosion</color>.

speaker: 9th
content: The explosion is merely a cover story. Given the approaching election, it's the only viable narrative we can present. It is now up to us to uncover the truth swiftly and discreetly.

speaker: 9th
content: Chief, the 9th Agency and FAC are both in position waiting for you. Let's see what kind of present our little friends from the Underground have left us.

<size=55>This marks the true beginning of the N.F. 114 Eastside Election.
A new era thus announces its dawn.
HERE is where it all starts.</size>

November 28, N.F. 114
City Hall, 105th Street, District 3, Eastside
The 9th Agency, FAC & MBCC Joint Investigation Team

speaker: Nightingale
content: Prime Minister Stewart and his cabinet were in a meeting when it happened. The assassins appeared inside the chamber and struck them instantly. The scene was heavily damaged, and cleanup is underway.

speaker: Nightingale
content: So far, 26 human remains have been recovered, including those of the Prime Minister, 11 cabinet officials and 14 residence guards. In addition, 6 Elite Escort HUSH units were found completely destroyed, along with the remains of 18 Underground puppets.
Based on the images, it seems unlikely that Prime Minister could have been transported to a hospital. Just the process of identification of his remains will take considerable efforts.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I remember the news said three people were injured.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Actually, only <color=#fb9259>one</color> left now.

As the live feed plays out before you, a man is revealed strapped to an operating table. While his contorted face retains traces of familiarity, his piercing screams now carry an unsettling, inhuman nature.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Ahh... No... Stay back... Stay back... Ahh, mmm... Guards, guards... Gua—

speaker: Guillotin
content: Aaahhhhh—!!

It's Guillotin, Chief of the Outland Affairs Bureau. You have collaborated with him extensively on WhiteSands affairs, witnessing his arrogant swagger as well as having a chuckle over his frustrated tantrums.
Yet, you never expected he would meet such a fate.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Mr. Guillotine was found in a closet on the top floor, and his used wine glass was discovered in the adjacent drawing room. It is believed that he did not attend the meeting and was placed in the drawing room instead.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Thanks to that, he avoided the direct attack when it happened. But unfortunately, he suffered severe mental contamination under the extreme conditions.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Banyan Medical College is doing everything it can to save him. Once he regains his faculties, he should be able to provide the investigation team with valuable information.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: That's not gonna happen. Even if a miracle happens, time is not on our side. We just hope he doesn't end up like the other two and turn into a Corruptor.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Chief, we need your assessment at the scene, if you please.
Once again,  several groans penetrate your ears through the communication device, oscillating between human and bestial. Instinctively, you avert your gaze.
(Scene change)

The scene at the site turns out even more nauseating. A mixture of contamination and bloody flesh is smeared across the room with savage abandon. Mutilated bodies hang from spikes, while formal suits soak in pools of putrid fluid. Somehow, witnessing power and death shattered and intertwined like this leaves you with an inexplicable sense of dislocation.
You are led to one of the remaining "assailants."
[Illustration] Monster
This particular type of Underground Puppet is unfamiliar to you. Its "raincoat" fits more tightly than the previous models.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Yes. Its Mania readings are similar to previous models—only the appearance has changed. With reduced defense but more agile, better suited for assassination purposes.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Based on what we have, they infiltrated through the vent in a liquid state, solidified upon entry, and neutralized all targets within minutes. Then they engaged in combat with the responding security force until they were completely eliminated.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: However, when we mock the combat, certain pieces of evidence don't add up. We can't make sense of them.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Chief, you know about these creatures. What do you think?
[Simple Touch Investigation] Interact according to corresponding images
Strange markings are scattered across both the walls and floor. Some exhibit eye-like patterns, while others consist of nothing more than fragmented, incomprehensible lines.
Within the grooves of these marks, peculiar sludge remains writhing—a mixture that appears to be Puppet fluid combined with human flesh and blood.
Setting aside those disordered marks, the sparse bloodstains indicate that all the officials were killed in the same instant.
These Underground Puppets executed their attack with surgical precision—ordinary humans wouldn't be able to react.
The scene underwent a dramatic change only after the HUSH force burst in. Both the contamination-formed spikes and the original furniture were battered in the ensuing battle.
The remaining traces show that the HUSH units had inflicted considerable damage on the Puppets, even managing to gain the upper hand during the combat.
Combining the analysis report provided with your observations, you close your eyes and let your thoughts take shape. The scene of the attack gradually pieces itself together in your mind—
HUSH once had complete dominance. Upon entering the battlefield, they quickly repelled the attackers, destroyed numerous Underground Puppets, and gained control of the situation.
But looking at the scene around you now, this clearly doesn't declare their final victory.
As you crouch down to examine the shattered metal remains of the HUSH units, the FAC soldier hands you a report.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Due to the severe contamination in the Mania field, only one HUSH unit preserved limited data. Here—this is its energy consumption, from emergency activation to its complete destruction.
You take the report and inspect it carefully.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It entered combat right after activation. Energy consumption at a standard level, declines around the 16-minute mark, reasonable. HUSH likely gained the advantage and took control of the situation. Then...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is...?
Around 18-minute, the unit's energy consumption suddenly spiked again despite having exited combat mode, surging far beyond the warning threshold.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: As you see, something happened...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: The battle was not over. The Underground Puppets grew stronger with each passing moment, until every last HUSH unit was worn down and destroyed.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Their combat pattern just makes no sense. And what's even stranger, they didn't retreat after winning, only to be left scrapped here...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Those Underground bastards can't possibly be kind enough to leave us clues, can they?

You examine the enemy remains carefully. They bear no discernible differences from the Puppets you have encountered previously. And given how severely they are damaged, these alone couldn't possibly have decimated Paradeisos's elite HUSH units.
But there's something else that concerns you even more...

speaker: Choice
options: This is not the Underground's M.O.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They prefer working from the shadows, inciting chaos and letting others do the dirty work. Even during the last election, they operated covertly through the dark web, taking extensive measures to cover their tracks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But this time, they chose to make such an entrance, right at this crucial moment...
Is this a deliberate provocation? A smokescreen? Or did something go wrong with their plans?

speaker: 9th
content: The feeds were shut down, and the HUSH units were preset to offline mode—that explains their delayed activation. They couldn't arrive at the scene immediately, nor could they receive precise commands from Paradeisos.

speaker: 9th
content: It was only Prime Minister Stewart himself who had the access to it, and it was not the first time he abused it like this.

speaker: 9th
content: The election wasn't looking good for him—his chances of re-election were slim. These concerns were likely a hot topic during the meeting with his cabinet.

speaker: 9th
content: And as always, their conversation would delve into some sensitive subjects. To keep things under wraps, he had to find a workaround off the record and stop HUSH from syncing data back to Paradeisos.

speaker: 9th
content: We're currently keeping tabs on everyone on our radar—suspected Underground spies, informants, gangs, and potential future targets.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Any progress?

speaker: 9th
content: None of them have made any moves. A thorough investigation will take about a week or two.
You furrow your brow in concern.

speaker: Matilda
content: Once the new mine is up and running, it will surely bring us a better future. This election's bound to bring changes to many of us.
This election is laden with high hopes, as people expect it to pave the way for a better city—thus, it's no surprise that the Underground seeks to meddle and disrupt the proceedings.
However, their methods this time are strikingly uncharacteristic of them.

Judging from their past actions—the chaos in Syndicate, the Ambrosia incident in Eastside, the Belphegor Art Museum, and the Gray Mirror—it's evident that the Underground excels at using others as pawns and inciting the masses behind the scenes.

However, things are different this time—the Underground resorted to brutal violence using puppets instead of powerful Sinners, yet so far, they have made no attempt to sway public opinion, leaving you to feed the people flimsy excuses.
So, this attack wasn't intended to sow public panic. Instead of derailing the election, the enemy wants you to cover up the truth and ensure the election proceeds as planned. Which means...

speaker: Choice
options: This is probably just the beginning.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They want the election to proceed as scheduled, so they're probably planning something even bigger.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Should we consider postponing the election?

speaker: 9th
content: Even with the information blackout, the deaths of the cabinet members have caused quite a stir. I agree that this is only the start.

speaker: 9th
content: But the election must proceed as scheduled, I'm afraid.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't get it. The entire city is fired up about this election. If the Underground were to hit the event site, the casualties would be catastrophic.

speaker: 9th
content: Now it's up to us. We have one month to investigate the truth and eliminate all threats.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is FAC also fine with this?
The soldier remains oddly silent. You see him clutch his weapon before eventually loosening his grip.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: FAC has no authority to interfere with the election. We have to follow our orders.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: We will fortify our patrols and defenses, doing everything we can to ensure civilian safety.
You try to ask more questions, but the agent presses his hand against your shoulder.

speaker: 9th
content: I know you have many concerns about the election, but—

speaker: 9th
content: This case goes beyond just a Mania attack. Everything that has happened here is far more complex than anything you've faced before.

speaker: 9th
content: The impact of the cabinet reshuffle is still within our control, but it cannot escalate further. Too many eyes are watching—the election has to proceed.

speaker: 9th
content: The 9th Agency will keep a close eye on suspicious individuals. We'll power through it.

speaker: 9th
content: Find the truth.
With a smile, he relaxes his grip and gives your shoulder a pat.

speaker: 9th
content: Someone just requested a meeting with you. She claims to have some leads.

speaker: 9th
content: I believe it's someone you know.

speaker: 9th
content: The Municipal Affairs Commissioner and one of the Election candidates, <color=#fb9259>Bernadette Cavendish</color>.
The city hall is enveloped by a deadly silence.
Upon entering the hall, you find only one person seated quietly amidst the vacant chairs—a middle-aged woman of dignified bearing.
She gazes calmly ahead, her eyes seemingly fixed on the empty podium, the state flag behind it, or perhaps on something imperceptible to the eye.
Only when the sound of your footsteps fades does she turn to face you—it's Bernadette Cavendish, the one who requested this meeting.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I didn't find you in the reception room, and was told you came here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you need a moment, I can go back and wait for you.

speaker: Bernadette
content: It's all right. Let's talk here, if you don't mind.

speaker: Bernadette
content: We were scheduled to go over some proposals today. David... sorry, Mr. Stewart, he used to speak from that podium. Now, their absence just made me feel a bit... displaced.

speaker: Bernadette
content: So, let's just talk here. Consider it a way... to honor my departed colleagues.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Chief ${PlayerName} of the MBCC. Thank you for taking the time to meet with me.
(Scene dims)

<color=#fb9259>Bernadette Cavendish</color> works for the council's largest coalition alongside Stewart who was pursuing re-election, and she was also a former pivotal member of Stewart's cabinet, holding significant sway in Eastside.

Earlier this year, however, she stepped down from the cabinet to run as an independent candidate, openly challenging the incumbent. Now, with Stewart's passing, she stands as one of only two remaining candidates—a sign that there's more to her than meets the eye.

speaker: Matilda
content: My aunt is a seasoned politician with years of experience. Last year, she antagonized Prime Minister Stewart and was removed from the cabinet for speaking up for the West District. She's now running as an independent candidate and will surely reach out to you. When that time comes, please keep one thing in mind:

speaker: Matilda
content: Bernadette Cavendish has no loyalty to any organization, sentiment, or principle. She acts purely in her self-interest. Chief, don't ever forget that.
Now, the seasoned politician locks eyes with you, and within this fleeting silence, she has already made her initial assessment of you.

speaker: Choice
options: Nice to meet you, Ms. Cavendish.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've heard that you'd provide clues about the cabinet explosion. I'm interested in what you know and how you came across all this information.

speaker: Bernadette
content: News, public reports, and some insiders of course—that's all. To be frank, this incident has put me in a rather delicate position.

speaker: Bernadette
content: As both his former councilor and his rival, I had my share of disagreements with David, and his passing could have worked in my favor. So naturally, I found myself under suspicion—the 9th Agency questioned me right on the day of the incident.

speaker: Bernadette
content: But thankfully, Langley Blackett cleared me of suspicion. We're old acquaintances—you can verify anything about me with her.

speaker: Bernadette
content: With the election approaching, I'd rather keep my distance from this to steer clear of any controversy. I hope you can understand that, Chief.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I appreciate your help to share in such cases, but there's something I don't quite understand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you're well acquainted with my boss, Langley, why not talk directly to the 9th Agency? Why does it have to be me?
Bernadette gazes at you.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you—I have no direct leads about this case to share with you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ! You are...?
She offers you a faint smile, shifting slightly in her seat to face you directly.

speaker: Bernadette
content: As I explained earlier, I'm keeping my distance from this case, so I know nothing of its details.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Sorry I used it as a pretext for meeting you. I need your help with something—something I believe you'll be inclined to accept.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I want you to protect someone.
As she speaks, she produces a photo and slides it across the table toward you.
The photograph shows a frail young girl, her gaze distant and unfocused before the camera.

speaker: Bernadette
content: The late Prime Minister's out-of-wedlock daughter—<color=#fb9259>Elvira Stewart</color>.
Her words immediately puts you on high alert.

speaker: Choice
options: Will she be the next target?

speaker: Bernadette
content: That's for you to investigate, Chief. As I said, I don't know the details of the case—I've only heard rumors about the girl. Just rumors.
She taps the photo gently.

speaker: Bernadette
content: David Stewart never married. Elvira is his only child, sixteen years old, her mother unknown. No school records, no medical history, no social documentation whatsoever. Even her residential address has been changing constantly.

speaker: Bernadette
content: She's been well hidden during his lifetime—even the Stewart family only recently learned of her existence. That's how cautious he was.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Yet this cautious man, on the night before his death, set aside his pressing election concerns and secretly left his residence. He steered clear of even his most trusted allies and vanished until the following day. Upon his return, he died in the explosion.
A faint smile plays across her lips.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Chief, I couldn't possibly know.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I just happened to hear that the day before the explosion was the girl's sixteenth birthday.

A hidden daughter, her sixteenth birthday, and the Prime Minister vanishing from the council on the same day... Bernadette's words seem to weave a spell, rapidly drawing your thoughts through the possible connections.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you saying she had something to do with the Prime Minister's death?

speaker: Bernadette
content: I didn't say so. Maybe it's just a coincidence, maybe not. No one can prove anything.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you're asking me to protect her. That means you believe she's in danger.

speaker: Bernadette
content: A few precautions won't hurt. In our line of work, no coincidence should be taken lightly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then why not escalate it? There's not just me—the 9th Agency and FAC could also take action, and they will.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Because it's wiser to handle things discreetly while there's no concrete evidence, and also because... someone has already stepped in to offer their "protection."

speaker: Bernadette
content: The <color=#fb9259>Stewart family</color> took her in immediately after the incident. You know how it is—even though they've never met, as <color=#fb9259>blood relatives</color>, they have a more legitimate claim to the orphan than any agency.

That's the highly conservative political dynasty with deep ties to Nirvana. It's hard to fathom that they weren't behind the stringent conservative policies on the West District, immigration, and Outlands trade in recent years.
You never know what the former Prime Minister really thought about his daughter, but... can the "blood relatives" that even he himself kept at arm's length be truly trusted?
Bernadette gives you enough time to collect your thoughts. Then, noticing your growing concern, she draws an exquisite envelope from her handbag.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Tomorrow evening, the Stewart family is holding a memorial service at Viers Mansion. Many important figures will be attending. I was invited too.

speaker: Bernadette
content: They say, the Prime Minister cherished his daughter deeply and held high hopes for her. They shared a close bond—so she might be the person who knows her father best.
You immediately catch her implication.

speaker: Choice
options: That's far too risky, isn't it?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mr. Stewart was just murdered, and now they're presenting his daughter as the "heir to his will and intellect"? That's practically throwing her to the wolves! Even if they want to lure out the enemy, it's far too risky.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Maybe they're out of options. Stewart's influence has been waning since the West District was reconstructed. As the election nears, the stakes for his re-election only grow higher.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Losing the head at this crucial moment is truly devastating. All their allies, enemies, or onlookers even, are desperate for answers.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Perhaps that girl is the only card they could play—that's how I see it.

You came expecting information about the Underground, but this sounds more like a power play from the upper echelons. Such political maneuvering feels foreign to you, who's always been fighting on the front lines.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are the Stewarts involved in this case? What's their official stance? And those enemies and allies you mentioned...

speaker: Bernadette
content: I only know what's been made public. As for any undisclosed information about the case, I know nothing about it, nor can I delve any further.

speaker: Bernadette
content: As for the truth you seek...
She slides the invitation toward you.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Given my status as a suspected former political rival, my presence at the memorial service might cause unwanted tension. I will entrust this invitation to you, Chief. The Cavendish family stands ready to offer any assistance you may require.

speaker: Bernadette
content: In return for your efforts, I trust that you, who are investigating <color=#fb9259>the truth behind the cabinet attack</color>, will know how to leverage this opportunity with that girl.
You take the invitation—gold-embossed, elegant, and luxurious, ostentatiously bearing the Stewart family crest. After reading it, you slip it into your folder and turn your gaze back at Cavendish.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why <color=#fb9259>me</color>?
Another moment of silence passes before she offers a gentle smile.

speaker: Bernadette
content: You think I have ulterior motives? That I'm seizing this chance to approach you, rope you in, and earn your trust to vote for me? That would be undignified, and unnecessary.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Since you don't have a liking for politicians like me, I won't trouble you beyond today. This is just a one-time personal request—to protect a child who has recently lost her loved one.
She lowers her gaze, a momentary veil of sorrow passing over her countenance.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I serve as a politician, but I'm also a woman who once wanted to become a mother. I can't bear to see children suffer.

speaker: Bernadette
content: As for why I chose you, the reason is quite simple: my niece, <color=#fb9259>Matilda Cavendish</color>, thinks very highly of you.

speaker: Bernadette
content: You two are cut from the same cloth. Even caught in the political turmoil, you both cling to your principles, despise the power games, remain unfazed by fame and fortune, and more importantly...

speaker: Bernadette
content: In this game, you fear corruption, dread straying from your path. Even if circumstances pull you into a mire, you'll fight with everything you have to break free—and that is precisely what I admire.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Only people like you have that glimmer of hope... of not being consumed by the maelstrom.
She rises from her seat. When she mentions Matilda's name, for a brief moment, the councilor's expression does remind you of your hard-working friend.
Yet deep down, you can't shake the feeling that they are fundamentally different two people.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Well then, I have a few questioning sessions to attend. I'll take my leave now.

speaker: Bernadette
content: This is farewell, Chief. I wish you good luck.
(CG1)
The meeting ends just like that. It's as if someone pushed open a door just enough for you to catch a glimpse inside, only to slam it shut immediately after.
You make your way back, clutching the invitation that will lead you to an unknown destination. Your footsteps echo through the silent hallway.
Until you find yourself face to face with a "visitor."
Does Paradeisos have any instructions regarding the election?

speaker: Schorl
content: No, Chief. Paradeisos does not interfere in such matters. This falls under the state's own jurisdiction—we're here simply to remind you of this fact.

speaker: Schorl
content: Your interactions with Ms. Cavendish have been impeccable thus far, and your approach to the situation is appropriate. However, you must exercise even greater caution moving forward.

speaker: Schorl
content: This is <color=#fb9259>their</color> election, Chief, with their own set of rules. You need not delve deeper, and should keep your distance unless absolutely necessary—it's for your own sake.

speaker: Schorl
content: Such is the counsel from Paradeisos.
Schorl concludes its message and departs, leaving you alone. Amid the distant toll of a bell, you find yourself momentarily lost in thought.

Raising your gaze, you see the slanting ray of light cutting across the DisCity emblem and the faintly visible EDGE relief above it. On either side of the relief hang portraits of past Prime Ministers, each adorned with a corresponding nameplate.
Stewart, Cavendish, Harrington, Jacknal... Certain surnames keep recurring. While scrutinizing the unfamiliar faces peering down at you, a resemblance somehow starts to emerge among them.
These figures, etched into history, now hang overhead, their collective gaze bearing down upon you. Even the afternoon sunlight takes on a bluish tinge from the shadows.
As you gaze at them, Bernadette's words echo in your mind.
(CG2)

speaker: Bernadette
content: In this game, you fear corruption, dread straying from your path. Even if circumstances pull you into a mire, you'll fight with everything you have to break free—and that is precisely what I admire.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Only people like you have that glimmer of hope... of not being consumed by the maelstrom.
After a long moment, you finally avert your gaze and reach out to Nightingale.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nightingale, I need to attend a memorial service tomorrow. Let's prep for it.
Decision made, you stride forward, leaving behind the silent, shadow-shrouded hallway.
On a street in Eastside, preparations for [Election Focus] are underway. The host finishes framing herself up and starts the show.
[Program Intro]

speaker: Host
content: Breaking news! Last night, a massive explosion rocked the city hall at 105th Street in District 3 of Eastside. It's said that multiple cabinet officials were killed in the blast!

speaker: Host
content: And here's the most shocking part of all: Prime Minister Stewart, who was presiding over the meeting, has passed away after being rushed to the hospital!

speaker: Host
content: Though officials claim it was just an accident, unlike the West District explosion that could be easily brushed aside, this blast happened right in the council hall itself!

speaker: Host
content: Now, let's go live with our special guest, Miss Pine, to hear her takes on this incident.
[Standard Program Transition]

speaker: Host
content: Hello, Miss Pine, thanks for joining us on [Election Focus]. I'm sure you're up to speed on the cabinet explosion. We were just discussing Prime Minister Stewart a few days back.

speaker: Pine
content: Heh, some class, finally, unlike the amateur hour over in the West District.

speaker: Host
content: Do you have anything to say about his death?

speaker: Pine
content: Well... While I do regret his death, perhaps this "timely exit" will actually cement his legacy? Let's face it, his track record while breathing wasn't exactly stellar.

speaker: Host
content: jojo

speaker: Pine
content: Honestly, Stewart's rise to power wasn't easy. For someone from an old second-rate elite family to claw his way to the top... that must've taken some serious effort.

speaker: Pine
content: Apart from those "minor blemishes" like the West District, Nirvana, the Rust, and Sinner management, he was a real workhorse, quite the model of integrity among all the political lapdogs. That should've made the puppet masters behind him pretty happy.

speaker: Host
content: By integrity you mean... he wasn't all that corrupt?

speaker: Pine
content: Take the Eastside District 5 reconstruction bill from a few years back—his peak as a councilor. With a modest budget, he aided Nirvana in building factories, helped real estate groups renovate residential areas, and ultimately even secured loans.

speaker: Pine
content: From just this one bill, everyone got their slice of the pie—except for the District 5 residents, who were all swept out from their homes. And Councilor Stewart? Oh, not a dime lined his pockets, just a smooth ascension to the throne. What a beacon of integrity.

speaker: Host
content: Oh, now things are heating up! Care to spill the beans on the explosion? You must be sitting on a goldmine of information about it!
As the revelations unfold, viewer comments flood the screen at an escalating pace. When it comes to fallen officials, Eastsiders never miss a chance to twist the knife.

speaker: Pine
content: Well, the explosion...
Through the connection, a clear tapping sound can be heard as Pine drums her fingers on the table, muttering to herself with a hint of excitement.

speaker: Pine
content: Everyone thinks this was a black op... but even you folks know that Stewart was already wobbling on thin ice, with slim chances of re-election. His rivals had little incentive to push things to this extreme.

speaker: Pine
content: Moreover, the evidence on-site points to the involvement of mysterious monsters in the blast. They are absolutely not the sort of creatures that any politician could control.
Pine shares several photos. Though grainy and poorly lit, they unmistakably reveal the architectural style of the City Hall.
Strange runes are discernible in the images, hinting at something far more sinister than meets the eye.

speaker: Host
content: Monsters? Ah, I think I've caught wind of that. They say the West District has been dealing with monsters for a while, and now they're showing up in Eastside too because of the dark web.

speaker: Pine
content: The dark web incident was orchestrated by the same group. They used to only operate in the West District, but now they've set their foot in Eastside...

speaker: Host
content: But wait... I heard that the dark web got the axe already, and the crisis in West District was taken care of as well.

speaker: Pine
content: Appeasing a crisis without addressing the root cause only breeds a bigger one. It has happened with the dark web, and the two explosions this time follow the same pattern...

speaker: Host
content: Then, what is this root cause?
While the host leans in with piqued curiosity, Pine's expression grows grave, each word measured and deliberate.

speaker: Pine
content: It's more secretive than the dark web, more dangerous than the Sinners, older than known history, closer to power than the city council itself—something nurtured in the shadows of this city—

speaker: Host
content: Ahhhhh!!! Monsters—!!!
The screen suddenly goes black, but viewers can still hear sounds from the scene.
(Scene change)

speaker: Host
content: Oh, crap... Oh no... What do I do? I knew I shouldn't have chased after this...

speaker: Pine
content: Hey, find a place to hide first. Move to your left, slowly.
Though the video feed is lost, Pine's calm guidance surprisingly helps the host find a hiding spot.

speaker: Host
content: I... I'm hiding, but... those things... they're... they're right in front of me!

speaker: Pine
content: Can you capture what's happening there?
The screen flickers for a moment before a blurry image finally emerges. The footage is exceedingly unsteady, shaking with the host's terror.

speaker: Pine
content: This is rare footage of ground zero. Quick, get a clear shot! What on earth are those attackers?
As the footage stabilizes, it reveals the streets of Eastside where purplish-red, faceless Puppets dart about in a killing spree.

speaker: Pine
content: I knew it! They're just like the monsters in Syndicate! No, wait—these look a lot more advanced!

speaker: Pine
content: Pan the camera to the left. I need a better look!

speaker: Host
content: Are you serious right now?! I could get killed any second, and you're still trying to get a scoop?!!
Although she voices complaints, the host complies with Pine's direction and pans the camera. While awaiting Pine's next instruction, she suddenly realizes that the line has gone dead.

speaker: Host
content: Whaa... That maniac... someone, please... help me... AHHH!!
The monsters persist in their rampage. Perhaps drawn by the host's hushed cries for help, a purple spike suddenly swirls around and shoots straight toward the camera.

The host instinctively shuts her eyes. A sharp crack pierces the air, and through the darkness, a bright blue light flashes before slowly fading away. When she opens her eyes, a familiar figure stands between her and the danger.

speaker: Host
content: P... Pine?

speaker: Pine
content: Come on, it takes time to run over here. What are you mad about? Give me the camera, I'll do it myself.
Pine retrieves the camera, providing viewers with a clear view once again. The purple spike now rests in her hand, while the attacking monsters stand trapped by some peculiar stickers.
The camera slowly zooms in on the monsters as they writhe and contort beneath the stickers.

speaker: Pine
content: Ladies and gentlemen, what you're seeing is raw, uncensored footage from ground zero. Now, let's find out the mystery behind these Mania forces lurking in DisCity's underbelly!
Comments suddenly start flooding the stream. Pine frowns as she notices an unknown substance seeping from beneath the trapped monsters, pooling and reforming itself nearby.
In an instant, blades flash through the air as two reformed faceless Puppets break free from their bonds, materializing before Pine!
Pine darts across the battlefield like a phantom, and in no time at all, every monster is covered in her specially crafted projectiles.

speaker: Host
content: You're... a Sinner?

speaker: Pine
content: Shh, not so loud.
Pine stands before the host, gesturing to the camera in her hand. With a snap of her fingers, the captured monsters erupt into a series of firework-like explosions.
As the smoke disperses, the once-menacing faceless Puppets dissolve into purple liquid, seeping into the ground. All that remains are scattered flyers marked with the hedgehog logo.

speaker: Pine
content: Yeah, I'm a Sinner, but that's nothing compared to the bombshells that are gonna happen next.

speaker: Host
content: There will be something even bigger?!
If all the upcoming stories are going to be of this caliber, the host feels an urgent need to call in sick and request permanent leave from field reporting.

speaker: Pine
content: I'm absolutely certain now. The Underground is behind all those explosion attacks.

speaker: Host
content: The Underground?
With a smile, Pine pulls out stack after stack of paper scraps from her pockets—a mixture of handwritten notes and newspaper clippings, all brimming with intelligence.

<color=#000000><size=40>August 7, N.F. 113 - The Sunken Blossom Incident

Date Unknown - The Wall of Collapse Incident

August 11, N.F. 113 - The Chamber of Silence Incident

Same Night - The Hall of Greed Incident

While these cases seem connected to the aftermath of FAC's Eclipse Operation back in N.F. 103, they are actually part of the Underground's schemes. But... what do they want? Why is the West District under lockdown?
</size></color>
April, N.F. 114 - The Gray Mirror Vote Incident June, N.F. 114 - The Elysiland Incident And behind this string of incidents related to DisCity's dark web, could it also be... The Underground?

speaker: Pine
content: All that old intel was getting stale. Finally, I caught some action in the flesh today.

The host gazes at Pine in utter bewilderment, feeling overwhelmed by the unfolding events. Meanwhile, Pine produces a whiteboard out of thin air and starts sketching on it in front of the camera, muttering to herself.

speaker: Pine
content: Common politicians can't handle the Underground, but the real top dogs of DisCity love using these gutter rats. To some degree, they're birds of a feather.

speaker: Pine
content: Between the **** and the blowhard, that MK guy disgusts me more—always preaching about justice and ideals. But he surely doesn't have what it takes to control the Underground. That leaves us with just one suspect—

speaker: Pine
content: Ms. Bernadette Cavendish, who wants to use the Underground as a smokescreen to purge all the old factions in one single sweep.
Pine turns to the camera, showcasing her whiteboard where she has pinned a freshly created newspaper clipping containing several headlines about recent events.

<color=#000000><size=50>Stewart's Hidden Daughter Exposed: Family Inheritance in Dispute?

Prime Minister's Memorial Service Scheduled for November 29!

Bernadette Cavendish's Absence from the Memorial Service: Excused or Intentional?</size></color>

speaker: Pine
content: The exposé is just getting started. Do you have the guts to stick around?

speaker: Host
content: Uh... You really aren't worried about getting stabbed someday, are you?
Pine's smile widens at the flood of viewer comments. Completely ignoring the host's hushed warning, she points to the hedgehog stickers on the ground and announces with unwavering confidence.

speaker: Pine
content: Alright, buckle up, then! Let's rip off their masks and expose every filthy secret the elites and the Underground are hiding!

18:00, November 29, N.F. 114
Viers Mansion, Eastside District 3
David Stewart Memorial Service
[Elegant, upbeat BGM plays]

speaker: Attendant
content: ...You're sent by the Cavendish family?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. Ms. Cavendish sends her regrets that she cannot attend and has asked me to pay respects.

The attendant scrutinizes you, then glances down at the invitation in his hands, repeating this several times before letting out a derisive snort, either fueled by contempt for a political rival or disdain for your amateurish attire.
Nevertheless, he composes himself and steps aside with a respectful bow. At last, you make your way into the magnificent courtyard of the Viers Mansion in all its opulent splendor.

The ID verification process is meticulous, with security guards positioned along the path in significant numbers. While these measures would crumble against any Underground assault, they are notably thorough by the standards of high society's social gatherings.

speaker: Hecate
content: We have stationed guards in the surrounding blocks. However, the Stewarts rejected our earlier security warning.

speaker: Hecate
content: As Nightingale said, the Stewarts seem strongly opposed to any MBCC involvement. So she's unable to deploy additional personnel.

As the MBCC Chief, you did receive an official invitation. However, to avoid any potential political leverage during the election season, you declined the invitation and instead chose to attend in disguise under Cavendish's invitation name.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now I look perfectly like an unremarkable bodyguard, do I?
A soft chuckle comes through from the other end of the call.

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare is positioned right outside the mansion. I'll provide immediate backup if anything happens.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Got it. Thank you Hecate.
After the exchange with Hecate, you enter the main building of the mansion.

Amidst melodious music and the aroma of fine delicacies and wine, this grand hall exudes magnificence—every detail reflecting the host's status and refined taste. The space bustles with guests exchanging pleasantries and information, all expressing their approval of this gathering.
—It hardly resembles a memorial service, but no one here seems to care anyway.

speaker: Distinguished Guest A
content: Terrible timing, huh? The corporation had just greenlit the funding for him before he kicked the bucket. If only this happened a little sooner or later, we wouldn't be in this mess.

speaker: Distinguished Guest B
content: What about the West District? I heard they're making demands about voting rights again...

speaker: Distinguished Guest A
content: Oh please. If we let them in now, we can kiss the new mine goodbye forever. Even the Stewarts can't keep 'em in check. Who else could possibly—

speaker: Distinguished Guest B
content: What about that MBCC Chief? He wields quite a bit of influence, doesn't he? The Stewarts sent him an invitation as well. If we could rope him in, we might just...
female_content: What about that MBCC Chief? She wields quite a bit of influence, doesn't she? The Stewarts sent her an invitation as well. If we could rope her in, we might just...

content: While these "refined" social elites carry on with their agitated and uninhibited chatter, you stand right behind them, sipping lemonade from a wine glass and adjusting your sunglasses.
Despite your miserably poor disguise, no one has seen through it yet. Apparently, these high-class people don’t care about you as much as they claim.
Or perhaps you should thank some others for attracting the spotlight—after all, even you find your gaze drawn to them.
[Big CG]

Under the dazzling crystal chandeliers and surrounded by the lavishly-dressed crowd, two ladies in black stand close together, captivating all gazes and sparking whispered conversations. Among them, you immediately recognize Elvira Stewart.
Bernadette mentioned she just turned sixteen, but she appears much smaller and frailer than her age would suggest, seemingly even more timid than in her photo.
You focus on the audio feed in your earpiece. After entering, you have carefully selected several targets in the crowd and planted listening devices on them.
As luck would have it, one of your targets is positioned close to Elvira. You tune into the corresponding channel to monitor the situation.
However, what comes through the channel is far from pleasant.

speaker: Leading Man
content: Still no words, huh? Prime Minister's death is a loss, but this isn't over. You owe us the truth.

speaker: Leading Man
content: Your father came to see you the night before it happened. What was that for?
The crowd surrounds her like vultures, their downward gaze oppressive as they press for the girl's answers.

speaker: Leading Man
content: Better be honest with us, young lady. Do you really think the Stewarts can protect you forever?
While the young girl remains silent, the pale-faced woman standing before her steps in.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: Mr. Stewart was so devoted to his duties that he rarely came home. He was a man of discretion and confidentiality, never bringing his work home.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: Thank you for your concern for our young lady.

speaker: Leading Man
content: ...I was asking Miss Stewart.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: The young lady gets distressed whenever speaking of her father. This may not be the most opportune time. We will make sure to pay you a proper visit once she's ready.
Her voice gentle, yet her words carry unmistakable firmness as she subtly positions herself between the girl and the hostile gazes of the crowd.
Meanwhile, another messsage cuts in through your earpiece.

speaker: 9th
content: Chief, we've got some info on that lady. She's a <color=#fb9259>butler</color>, secretly hired by Stewart to look after his daughter.

speaker: 9th
content: Stewart kept them under wraps. So all we've found out for now is her name—<color=#fb9259>Jelena</color>.
That explains the woman's behavior—she's simply carrying out her duties.

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: With such a grand reception tonight, isn't it the Stewarts' wish to introduce their secret young lady? Disregarding your employer's wishes wouldn't be the smartest move, I'm afraid.

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: Don't upset those in charge, miss, or you might be fired. You don't want things to look bad, do you?

speaker: Jelena
content: You are indeed correct. I must exert every effort to retain my job.

speaker: Jelena
content: Mr. Stewart had specified in his will that should anything unexpected occur, he wanted me to continue to care for El as her legal guardian.

speaker: Jelena
content: Therefore, unless directed otherwise by the court, I will uphold an amicable relationship with the Stewarts. I am committed to fulfilling my responsibilities till the end.
The butleress responds with a composed smile, defying the expected submissive demeanor. Her calculated arrogance riles up the crowd, capturing all their attention.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...She's protecting the girl.

speaker: 9th
content: Yes. We've heard that when the Stewarts "picked up" the girl from her residence, they had a brutal clash with the staff there. All the guards were forced to leave, while she was the only one staying by Elvira's side.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Was she injured? 'Cause there's something off about her moving. She's trying to act normal but... is she's trying to hide her wound from the girl?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Truly one of strength she is—resolute and loyal to the core.

speaker: 9th
content: Our radical Prime Minister himself hand-picked her to protect his daughter. She must be very trustworthy.
But apparently, the people behind you hold a different perception of her.

speaker: Bystander Behind
content: I bet she's David Stewart's lover. Heh, a woman with that kind of history, watching over his illegitimate daughter—she's really out of her league here.

speaker: Bystander Behind
content: Quite a looker, though, just the type men would go crazy for. No wonder Stewart kept her under wraps. Seems like our Prime Minister has his own share of dirty laundry... Now that's the story someone should dig into.
You frown, disgust welling up inside you. Yet these vulgar topics quickly capture the interest of the supposedly refined elites.

speaker: Bystander Behind
content: No wonder. Any woman who caught the Prime Minister's eye must be quite something. Surely she won't tell you anything if you ask her straight out, but...

speaker: Bystander Behind
content: If it were me there, I'd play it like this—
While the woman continues, you catch someone in the distance echoing the same venomous words through your earpiece, almost as if on cue.

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: You must really care about Ms. Jelena, right, El? Ah, how sweet to have such an intimate maid. Unfortunately it'll be just the two of you in the future, almost like a widow and her daughter...

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: Would you call her mother when it's just you two, little lady?
The approach proves very effective as Jelena's voice grows evidently heavy with tension.

speaker: Jelena
content: This must be a misunderstanding. Miss Stewart's mother is someone else entirely.

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: Oh, please. You're so caring for Mr. Stewart's daughter, he must've felt so indebted to you... He's not one to trust easily—didn't have a wife yet kept a beauty like you by his side...

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: What happened to him was truly tragic. It's a rare chance we're all here tonight, you can tell us your story. We're so concerned about you and... the girl's mother.

speaker: Jelena
content: Please step back. El's mother was—

speaker: Elvira
content: Jelena is not my mother!
The girl's abrupt outburst plunges the room into a profound silence. Still standing behind Jelena, she struggles to hold back tears, her face flushed with emotion.

speaker: Elvira
content: My mother... She went to heaven... a long, long time ago. I've been waiting for her to come back and see me.

speaker: Elvira
content: Jelena has been with me all the time. She has nothing to do with my father. She promised to stay by my side until Mother comes back.
The guardian places a gentle hand on the frail girl's shoulder. She trembles at the touch, her voice growing softer.

speaker: Elvira
content: Sob... I...

speaker: Elvira
content: I'm not lying! J-Jelena is not my mother! Don't you be mean to her!
There's something off about her demeanor—her words come out disjointed, her expression somewhat unnatural.
After a moment of silence, a clamor erupts in the banquet hall, resonating like a thunderclap.

speaker: Crowd
content: She can't speak. Hey look at her! She can't even speak properly!

speaker: Crowd
content: No wonder David never brought her to the family. Oh, I'm almost feeling sorry for him!
Their blunt laughter of mockery instantly engulfs the two of them. You feel your blood boiling with anger.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Aren’t they the Prime Minister’s family? Isn’t the girl Stewart’s own flesh and blood? What are these people even—
Soon, your eyes find the patriarch of the Stewart family—the late Prime Minister's brother and the host of this service.
His face appears gloomy as he watches everything unfold in silence, yet a twisted smile creeps across his lips.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Bastard... Did he arrange this just to humiliate his brother's child? What a piece of trash.

speaker: 9th
content: Chief, stay put.

speaker: 9th
content: They aren't in any immediate danger. You can't risk exposing yourself. Please keep still.

speaker: 9th
content: The Stewarts aren't like other houses. Though they're waning, their influence still runs deep. Even our superiors have to be cautious dealing with them. Don't confront them directly.
You clench your fists tightly, watching in silence as the crowd grows more restless.

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: Hey, what did your father tell you? Holding high hopes for you, did he? Or was it all just lies? Did he ever love you?

speaker: Elvira
content: D-don't come... Go away...

speaker: Leading Man
content: What are you asking those kinds of questions for?! You’re scaring her; we still need her to cooperate and tell the truth!

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: Truth? From a moron? I say we just ask her who her real mother is!

speaker: Distant Crowd
content: Even in death, he's so pathetic. Stewart's glory days are long gone. His supporters must be crying their eyes out—

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Please stay back.
The butler shields the young girl, visibly struggling to contain her fury.
You know all too well how difficult it is to maintain composure at a time like this.

speaker: 9th
content: Chief, hang in there. We'll find a way to help you. Just a bit more patience, please.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know...
But I'm about to lose it.

speaker: Elvira
content: *Dry heaves.*

The prolonged stress, combined with the overwhelming pressure of the current situation, finally breaks the young girl. She collapses to the ground retching, tears streaming down her face, only to elicit even more vicious mockery from the crowd.

speaker: Onlooker
content: Oh, now she's puking? Look at her, this girl needs a mommy! Anyone who knows how to babysit?

Unable to bear it any longer, you push through the crowd. Your mind races through potential options: evacuate the two in your current disguise as a security guard, demand action from the Stewart family head, or simply pull out your credentials to intimidate these people.
Just then, an unusual disturbance jolts you back from your seething anger.
—A killing intent, and a wave of Mania, fleeting yet formidable. This is...

speaker: Onlooker
content: Ahhh...!

The massive crystal chandelier abruptly comes crashing down, followed by the appearance of several dark figures. Before anyone can make out the situation, the woman who had laughed the loudest has her throat slit.
And the killer turns out to be...

speaker: Onlooker
content: M-monster!!

More Puppets burst in through the windows like a savage pack, sending the noble guests screaming and scattering in all directions. Their blades pierce through anyone in their path, but their true targets are those two—

speaker: Jelena
content: El!
Nightmare crashes through the window wall, its power tearing apart the Puppets lunging at the pair. As the debris rains down, Jelena pulls Elvira into her arms, and then—
Almost instantly, she spots you among the fleeing crowd, her eyes locked with yours.
That woman can see Nightmare, and out of instinct, starts searching for its summoner. Before you can fully grasp the situation, you see the most desperate cry for help in her eyes—

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Save her, please.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Enemy contact! Let's move! Nightmare, follow me to protect the targets!
After taking down the last Puppet advancing through the hall, you can finally approach your targets.
[Jelena's and Elvira's portraits]
When you turn to them, the two visibly tense up, with Elvira flinching further behind Jelena. After a moment's thought, you decide to adopt a cover identity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ms. Bernadette Cavendish holds great respect for the former Prime Minister. She's deeply concerned for the safety of his family and has entrusted me with protecting the two of you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We received some intelligence from Councilor Cavendish, and as a result, the agency sent me to ensure the safety of the Prime Minister's family.
Confusion lingers on the guardian's face—she evidently does not recognize your supposed employer, and this only makes the request seem more suspicious.
But now isn't the time to dwell on such details.
BOOM—!! An explosive noise erupts outside, followed by constant gunshots and screams, a stark reminder that the battle isn't over. You quickly establish contact with Hecate.

speaker: Hecate
content: There's still a sizable group at the east gate—all Underground Puppets of the same type. The sorcery is likely deployed somewhere nearby.

speaker: Hecate
content: Quite a few guests have fled outside the building, some of them already injured. Their situation is dangerous. We've received orders to prioritize their protection at all costs.

Puppets of a new type, VIP protection—these phrases trigger memories of the cabinet massacre, where elite HUSH units were decimated. If your companions outside were to confront such formidable enemies... you don't even dare to entertain that thought.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Tell everyone not to take unnecessary risks. I'll be right there.

You turn to the people behind you—several ladies of status and some civilians who couldn't escape in time. A few others have remained, seemingly in an attempt to protect the vulnerable ones around them.
Looks like some of these dignitaries still have guts, particularly this disheveled but dignified gentleman. You compose yourself and give him a respectful nod.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sir, would you please escort them to safety? The evacuation route is that way, and take a right at the end.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The enemies are all gathering at the east gate. I'll draw their attention away from you. Don't worry; I'll make sure you get out safely.
The man gazes at you for a moment before firmly grasping your hand in a gesture of solemn promise.

speaker: Man in Red
content: I'll get them to safety and wait for your return. You have my word.
...He seems like a genuinely reliable person, but more importantly, one of your listening devices is planted on him. In the event of any mishap, you will be able to react promptly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you, sir.
Before leaving, you want to check on the girl one last time, but someone steps forward to block your way.
Once again, the butler positions herself protectively in front of the young girl. Her eyes meet yours without hostility, yet they are unmistakably filled with dread.
You realize you are not the only one to blame—it's an instinctive response born from years of constant uncertainty. Acknowledging this, you take a step back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's all right now. I'm here to protect you. I won't come closer without your permission, I promise.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I just want to check on Miss Stewart's condition. She's just experienced severe shock and has shown intense physical reactions. Now...

speaker: Jelena
content: ...I will protect her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: From here on, please stay by her side at all times. I'll draw the enemies away while you escort the young lady to safety with the others. Get to shelter as quickly as possible.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: At least you're not alone anymore. There are some people ready to protect you—people who genuinely want to keep you safe.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Thank you.
At last, her tension melts away as she gives you a graceful nod of appreciation.

speaker: Man in Red
content: This way! Hurry!
You wait until everyone disappears down the corridor before steeling yourself and leaving the mansion to embrace the battle ahead.
Outside the mansion, a scene of chaos unfolds. Though casualties are not severe, a majority of the combat forces are still assigned to offer comfort to the distinguished guests in great shock.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, this way.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm fine, and so is everyone else. The enemies are not too hard to deal with, having only caused minimal damage.

speaker: Hecate
content: But they move too fast. With so many civilians on site we need more time to secure the area.
Seeing Hecate's composure puts your mind at ease. Your attention quickly turns to the Puppet pinned to the ground by Nightmare.
The Puppet matches the model of those that attacked the cabinet, but inexplicably, you feel something is amiss.

Since earlier in the mansion, you have noticed that these Puppets only possess limited combat abilities and also lack intelligence. They wouldn't pose much of a threat if there weren't so many civilians to protect here.
Then... how did these unremarkable Puppets manage to take down the elite HUSH units guarding the cabinet?
While you are lost in contemplation, the roar of engines suddenly reverberates through your earpiece.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!
As if triggered by a signal, the Puppets suddenly activate in unison, their heads snapping in the same direction.
A car bursts through the back gate of the mansion, and you see a few familiar faces inside.
We made it out! Still got room in the car. Should we go back for more?

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Sir, they're too far away, and the monsters have already spotted us. We should leave now. Our current passengers' safety should come first.
Alright then. Open the roof, I'll give him a shout!
female_content: Alright then. Open the roof, I'll give her a shout!

content: As the car speeds past, you see the sunroof open and a man in a dark red suit spring up, waving energetically at you.
Hey, bro! I'm gonna take 'em to safety first! Come find us once you've cleaned up this mess. I'll be waitin'!
female_content: Hey, sis! I'm gonna take 'em to safety first! Come find us once you've cleaned up this mess. I'll be waitin'!

content: The name's <color=#fb9259>Max King</color>! Great to meet you, Chief of MBCC!

Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 27th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the primary candidate in this election. I have always held your reputation in high regard and would like to extend my heartfelt greetings and deep respect to you! Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 28th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the leading candidate in this election. I am eagerly anticipating having a discussion with you! Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 29th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I have been closely following your remarkable career, and your achievements never fail to impress me! It's striking how our views align on matters concerning the West District, FAC, and even Paradeisos. We could...
The name suddenly strikes you as familiar—it's the election candidate who has sent you twenty-nine mails.
His speedy exit, while being flashy, has attracted a trail of Underground Puppets hot on his heels, like a pack of wild dogs chasing after a running bone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...That fool! Hecate, after them!

It takes you a few minutes to find a vehicle, and another good amount of time to fight through the horde of enemies. By the time your pursuit finally starts, the car has already built a considerable lead.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm sorry, Chief. Nightmare can't match their speed.

speaker: Hecate
content: But I can break their car with my power.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, Hecate. That would hurt the civilians.
After giving Hecate a reassuring smile, you find Max King's contact number that the agents just sent over and dial it in a fury.

speaker: Refined Aged Voice
content: Hello, this is the Max King Campaign Office.

speaker: Choice
options: And this is the MBCC Chief! Stop the car!

speaker: Refined Aged Voice
content: Oh, Chief. Hi, I'm Mr. King's assistant. My apologies, but I'm currently driving. He has been eager to have a chat with you. Please hold the line.

speaker: Refined Aged Voice
content: Sir, it's the MBCC Chief.

speaker: Max King
content: Oh—coming! One sec!
After a brief commotion of shuffling and fumbling, an overly booming voice finally comes through the terminal.

speaker: Max King
content: I know they were no match for you, Chief ${PlayerName}! No worries, the ladies are in good hands. They've got my King's limousine here, plenty o' room, bulletproof and 100% green!

speaker: Max King
content: Even better, I have a top-notch driver who can shake off any pursuers in no time. You can rest assured without any doubt!
He can barely contain the excitement in his tone, clearly pleased with the present circumstances, which only fuels your rage even further.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pull over immediately! Captain Eugene, intercept them!

speaker: Eugene
content: Copy that! Team A, move in!
Above the streets, a helicopter thunders by, chasing the vehicle below. Three minutes later—

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief, they've gone round us! Target vehicle has turned into a narrow alley!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What??? Wasn't that supposed to be a stretched limo? How did it fit into an alley?

speaker: Max King
content: Phew... My sincerest apologies, Chief, we just got a run-in with some unknown hostiles trying to intercept us. Thankfully, Adrian here is an exceptional driver and managed to slip away in time.

speaker: Refined Aged Voice
content: As a former FAC soldier, I do know a thing or two about driving.

speaker: Max King
content: The team descends along the stairs, venturing deeper into the darkness.

speaker: Adrian
content: He will. He has placed a listening device on you. He can hear everything.
female_content: She will. She has placed a listening device on you. She can hear everything.

speaker: Max King
content: Whoa, brilliant! That's just what I'd expect from him!
female_content: Whoa, brilliant! That's just what I'd expect from her!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, are they bad people?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Nah, just a smart arse.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mr. King, I was the one who's intercepting you. Are you aware that your actions could be considered kidnapping and hostage-taking?

speaker: Max King
content: Kidnapping?! Good heavens, what a huge misunderstanding! I'm here to rescue them—by your words, no less!

speaker: Max King
content: You told me to get them away from danger, don't you remember?

speaker: Choice
options: Now I want you to pull over.

speaker: Max King
content: Yeah I know, I'd love to meet you too! But uh... there are monsters hot on our heels. Too risky to stop now! And that Mania contamination—surely can't let them draw near the kid, right?

speaker: Max King
content: Eh... Here's an idea, Chief: you take care of our pursuers, and I'll turn right back around to meet you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That won't work. Stop the car first, then I'll deal with your pursuers.

speaker: Max King
content: If I stop now, those monsters will be breathing down my neck in no time! Chief, you’re the best in DisCity at handling them—show them how it’s done!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nice try. What if you run away while I'm fighting?

speaker: Max King
content: Run away? Never gonna! The only running I'm interested in is straight to you! I've been eager to meet you for ages—your backing in the election would mean everything to me!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who gives a **** about your election!

speaker: Hecate
content: Ah, that sounds like something Hella would say.

speaker: Max King
content: Ooh... now that's authentic Syndicate slang! Just what I'd expect from the great hero of the West District—talking like a true local!
Right now, you keenly feel the absence of Hella and her legendary sharp tongue, if only she were here to verbally dismantle this guy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is your final warning. If you really want to make acquaintance with me, then right now, STOP—

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Sir!
Before your words could be finished, an unusual tremor shakes the ground. A deafening roar echoes through the communication line, cutting off the voice on the other end abruptly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...What happened?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hey!! Can you hear me?!
You instinctively slam down on the gas, desperate to catch up.
You're almost there—it won't take long before you meet them. However, when you lay eyes on King's limousine, the sight before you is utterly horrifying.
A humanoid creature has torn open the car's roof and is peering inside like a ghoul lifting the lid of a coffin. Only when it catches sight of your approach does it straighten up.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Is that... our reinforcement?

Her clothing is charred by flames, the red glow unveiling a metallic body beneath. She is not from the Underground, not a Puppet—you can't discern what she truly is, but her hostile stance makes one thing clear...
As your attention is fixed on the imminent threat ahead, you abruptly perceive the stealthy approach of another presence.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who's there?!

speaker: Old Man
content: We are not enemies, Chief. I am Adrian Vale, Mr. King's butler.

speaker: Adrian Vale
content: I sincerely apologize for the trouble we've caused, but please understand that it wasn't intentional.
The elderly man standing before you exudes a gentle demeanor, and the person he has been carrying on his back is none other than Max King, the Speaker candidate himself.

speaker: Max King
content: Cough... Wait, those two are still...
Mr. King has fallen unusually quiet. His first exposure to a Mania battlefield has taken a heavy toll on his mind, leaving him uttering incomprehensible words in a daze.

The elderly man gazes with tender concern at his semi-conscious master, then offers you an apologetic look. Despite his gray hair and apparent age of at least sixty, he seems completely unaffected by the Mania contamination in the area.

speaker: Adrian Vale
content: That model... Despite being a decade old, its performance remains outstanding, even by today's standards.

speaker: Adrian Vale
content: She used to be an FAC combat unit. I came across several of them during my years of service—this model, in particular, is quite tough to deal with.
FAC is involved in this? The gravity of the situation may be beyond your imagination.
...However, this isn't the time for such thoughts. You turn your attention back to the cyborg soldier and the vehicle hijacked by her.
Behind you, the pursuing Underground Puppets have caught up, now also set on claiming the intercepted luxury car.
The Underground Puppets surging from behind have finally been eliminated, and there are no more pursuers. But the problem before you remains unsolved.
The humanoid beast remains perched atop the car. Despite sustaining heavy damage in your recent battle, it shows no sign of relenting.

speaker: Hecate
content: The target appears entirely unresponsive and displays no intention of backing down. Even with all possible manpower, it'd still be difficult to ensure the safety of the hostages.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, what should we do?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...We don't know what happened inside the car. Time's not on our side. Let me give it a try.
The "enemy" shows no signs of aggression in her posture—she's simply crouched on the car, fixing you with an unwavering stare.
Meanwhile, you take a step forward.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief...?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Those two are likely injured and need medical attention. If you're with the FAC, we can work together.

speaker: Hecate
content: That's a warning, Chief! Stay back!

speaker: Feeble Female Voice
content: Stop, Sable.
Before the cyborg soldier can launch her assault, someone calls her off.
A woman strains to push the door open. Despite her previous injuries, which have likely been worsened by the pursuit, she still propels herself towards the soldier.

speaker: Feeble Female Voice
content: There's no point in fighting anymore. You've reached your limit, too.

speaker: Feeble Female Voice
content: Let me handle this...

The soldier hesitates, her red glow gradually dimming as she quietly collapses onto her knees. Suddenly, a girl emerges from the car, hurrying forward to tightly embrace the damaged mechanical body, sobbing.
Elvira exerts all her strength just to uphold the metalic body. Sensing that Jelena is about to leave, she frantically seizes the butler's hand.

speaker: Elvira
content: No, don't go... I'm scared, please don't leave...
You cannot discern Jelena's words, but you see her bending down to hold them both in her embrace.

speaker: Jelena
content: I'll be right back.
After these words, Jelena stands up and walks toward you alone.

Some days later, she explains everything to you: S9's true identity, and how she manipulated Max King to drive them away from the mansion amidst the chaos, all in an effort to protect Miss Stewart and facilitate her escape.
But that is all far off in the future—for now, she merely reverts to the flawless, composed expression she exhibited at the memorial service.

speaker: Jelena
content: I apologize for my companion's intense reaction. Since the passing of our master, we have been followed, deceived, and even threatened. They have left us on edge. We can't trust anyone.

speaker: Jelena
content: Miss Stewart has endured a great deal of suffering. Our only wish is to take her away from this place—the further, the better.

speaker: Jelena
content: But what just happend proved that the two of us alone can't protect her.
She forced a smile. Her words carry a bitter undertone.

speaker: Choice
options: I don't mean to harm you.

speaker: Jelena
content: I understand—you protected us, and as a result, we will follow your orders from now on.

speaker: Jelena
content: However, if I may make a humble request...

speaker: Jelena
content: Please, do not hand us over to any other forces—be it the Stewart family, the 9th Agency, or the FAC. Don't let any of them come at her again.

speaker: Jelena
content: If... this exceeds your authority, or someone uses us as leverage against you...

speaker: Jelena
content: Then, as a <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>, I turn myself in to the MBCC.
She extends her hands toward you, wrists up—the universal gesture of surrender.
Before your eyes, several chains float gently around her hands, a clear manifestation of Mania power.

speaker: Jelena
content: Arrest me, Chief, and take them both back to your Bureau. They’re key witnesses in my case, and the MBCC has the authority to detain them.

speaker: Jelena
content: In return, I will disclose everything—Prime Minister Stewart's activities, his connections, and potential suspects in his murder—all that I know.

speaker: Jelena
content: You attended the service in disguise, yet risked exposing yourself to protect us... all because we may still hold some <color=#fb9259>value</color> to you, perhaps?

speaker: Jelena
content: If that's the case, as long as you ensure their safety, I will strive to fulfill all your requirements.

You want to say that you're protecting them out of pure goodwill, but you recall the reason that led you to agree to this request initially. More importantly... you can see in this woman's eyes what kind of answer would convince her more.
Her resolve is unshakeable. She would rather put herself on the bargaining table than settle for promises of mere "kindness."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And for that, I need your insights. In exchange, I will protect both you and those you care about.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can trust me.
As you speak, your companions move up to shield the shaken soldier and the young lady behind Jelena. Meanwhile, you extend your hand towards her outstretched hand.
You stretch out your shackles through the gesture of a handshake, hoping to convey your good intentions. In return, she gives you a gentle yet inscrutable smile.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Thank you. We will be counting on you, Chief.
Program Intro

speaker: Host
content: Just as Miss Pine predicted previously, Prime Minister's memorial service was ambushed by unknown attackers, and his daughter was kidnapped, her whereabouts still remaining a mystery.

speaker: Host
