The Mania levels plummet rapidly. The corrupting Mania loosens its grip on Jelena, and along with it, tears of cyan blood on the faces of the Underground Puppets fade away.
As the controlling power dissipates, the single-eye marks gradually re-emerge on some Puppets' faces. Moving slowly, they advance towards Jelena.

speaker: Schorl
content: Mania concentration is rising near the Rust, Corruptors gathering towards here... The Underground is attempting to reclaim this Sinner?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop them!!
Blue energy converges at Schorl's core as all combat units gather on the scene. What ensues is hours of chaotic combat, with Jelena soon vanishing into the heart of the fray.
The last thing etched in your memory is of her bleeding forehead, her pale face, and that tear on her face melting away with the heavy rain.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Heh... You've grown up... It must hurt so much...

speaker: Jelena
content: ...I'm sorry, El...

December 24, N.F. 114
Live Broadcast
Election Night - Prime Ministerial Debate

As music fills the air, the final round of the debate officially begins. The venue is packed to capacity, teeming with numerous Eastside residents who have congregated to witness this momentous event.

The venue erupts into a storm of cheers and jeers the moment MK steps onto the stage — after all, he missed the second round due to a shooting incident. The host scrambles to regain control and restore order amidst the tumultuous reaction.

speaker: Debate Host
content: Ladies and gentlemen, both present in the venue and tuning in from home, welcome to the last debate leading up to the 22nd DisCity Election.

speaker: Debate Host
content: As we all know, Mr. Max King, who survived a shooting recently, has now returned to the election stage.

speaker: Debate Host
content: Mr. King, could you please tell us how you were feeling during that moment? Many have expressed deep concern for you.
Scattered snickers and jeers echo through the venue. Quite a few spectators direct thumbs-down gestures towards MK, as shouts of "Coward!" and "Deserter!" ripple through the crowd.
The reaction is more than mere mockery but psychological torture for the man standing on stage. Yet MK maintains his silence.
Then, in a measured voice, he begins to speak.

speaker: Max King
content: ...Thinking back to that moment brings me great pain.

speaker: Max King
content: I was met with overwhelming resistance, and my naivete and recklessness were laid bare. I was deluding myself, believing that I could single-handedly challenge the century-old corruption deeply rooted in our city, charging ahead blindly without considering the repercussions.

speaker: Max King
content: And in the end, it was the person I respected and relied on the most who paid the price for it all.

speaker: Max King
content: Those bullets marked my defeat. I was filled with regret and remorse, experiencing genuine pain for the first time in my life.

speaker: Max King
content: But none of that really matters.

Days and nights of investigation, waves of anger and regret, hidden traps, unseen enemies, incomprehensible plays... With the loss of his strongest pillar of support, for the first time in his life, King finally sees his own insignificance.
And he realizes that his personal strength or weakness holds no significance to the city.

speaker: Max King
content: My personal defeat means nothing in this battle. Even if I were completely crushed and unable to rise again, this battle would not end.

speaker: Max King
content: Because in this era, I am not the only one who yearns for change. The leader of the revolution should never be just one person.

speaker: Vale
content: Because your vision shines so bright... It has guided me through the darkest nights, and I want you to go even farther...

speaker: Vale
content: Keep going... my young master... and stay gold.
He lifts his head.

speaker: Max King
content: It's those who witness justice denied and the weak trampled. Countless people have seen their aspirations ground to dust while being repeatedly fed one notion—just surrender, 'cause only those above get to decide fate; just give up,'cause you're powerless to make any change.

speaker: Max King
content: These are the voices of those in power, and they never lack mouthpieces—Councilor Cavendish and Stewart, they are prime examples.

speaker: Max King
content: Likewise, those who dwell in the shadow of power should have the right to choose their own voice.

speaker: Max King
content: If we fail, we rise again. If one becomes corrupt, another can take their place. There will always be someone to carry on this mission.

speaker: Max King
content: Now, I put myself forward as your candidate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If it really holds the value you say... Then please win and prove yourself by making real changes.
He recalls something and breaks into a smile.

speaker: Max King
content: Someone once called me a "bullhead." Guess I’d better live up to the name.
The tension in the venue eases slightly as murmurs of approval rise from the crowd. Max King, attuned to this change, straightens his posture and continues his speech with this newfound support.

speaker: Max King
content: This isn't about Max King, or any king. What I want for this city is to move forward, to embrace change, and to greet a new life. If you share the same desire, speak up. I will listen to every voice, and speak for EVERY one of you.

speaker: Max King
content: —This is the one and only purpose of my return.

speaker: Max King
content: Thank you.
[CG 2]
As his speech concludes, he takes a deep bow. The hall falls into a profound silence... until the first camera flash pierces the stillness.

speaker: Cheering Crowd
content: ...Bravo!! Well said!!

speaker: Cheering Crowd
content: Bring the West District back! Revive our city! Make DisCity great again!

speaker: Cheering Crowd
content: MK! MK! MK—

The hall erupts with a surge of energy. While it's impossible to tell the true supporters from those swept up in the contagious excitement, one thing is certain—these are all signs welcoming his return, their enthusiasm both fervent and uplifting.
Caught off guard by the overwhelming response from the audience, the host momentarily loses control of the proceedings and turns awkwardly to the other candidate.

speaker: Debate Host
content: Ms. Cavendish, would you like to say something?

speaker: Bernadette
content: I have nothing to say. There's no need to continue this debate. We shall end it here.
With a subtle smile playing on her lips, Bernadette takes a moment to study Max King's expression before gracefully turning to leave.
<i>Don't look so troubled, Max. You have done well and lived up to expectations.<i>
<i>Savor this moment.<i>

Pine switches off her TV at home. The televised debate has concluded, and significant strides have been made in the cabinet attack investigation. With less than two days remaining until the vote, she knows the outcome has already been sealed.

speaker: Pine
content: ...Well, suppose that wraps up my task.

However... there's still half of the investigation findings yet to be delivered. Pine clutches these documents close to her chest, unsure what to do with them. Frustration etches across her face as she scratches her head.

speaker: Pine
content: Ugh! Forget it!! I'll just let them handle it!! If they can't even manage this, they're not cut out for anything bigger!!
As she turns to leave with her findings, she finds unexpected visitors at her door.

speaker: Pine
content: You're...?! Mmph—!
[A Few Minutes Later]
A few minutes later, Pine lies motionless on the floor, completely unconscious.
One of the "visitors" bends down to retrieve the photos from Pine's possession and considers for a moment before leaving behind another folder of documents.
This is what you would really want... little newshound.

December 14
The mystery surrounding the cabinet attack was solved, with the perpetrator revealed as an Outland spy. The Fraser city representative initiated contact with the interim cabinet for discussions.

December 15
The FAC's special operation in the DisSea was terminated on an emergency notice. Its major forces were deployed to WhiteSands, with the mission details remaining undisclosed.

December 24
After the third election debate, Max King's approval ratings, which had been steadily climbing since the shooting incident, suddenly skyrocketed. Legal actions and financial probes against him were put on hold, media reports started taking a positive turn, and public opinion completely reversed.

Noon, December 25
Max King had an official meeting with the West District representative, Matilda Cavendish.

Evening, December 25
Cory Stewart, head of the Stewart family and brother of the late Prime Minister, was found dead in his residence. The time of death was estimated to be over a week ago, with the manner of death resembling that of his brother's a month earlier. The possibility of a revenge killing was not yet ruled out.

December 26, Dis Day
The Election concluded at 10:00 PM, with vote tabulation commencing promptly. Max King eventually emerged victorious by a significant margin and was announced as the new Prime Minister. The other ministers would be finalized in the coming days.

At 3:00 AM, Bernadette Cavendish extended her congratulations to Max King.
Discussions for the new cabinet lineup were in progress.

Morning, January 1
Acting Prime Minister Benjamin Carter finalized the handover procedures. Max King officially became the host of the City Hall and was set to deliver a New Year's address as DisCity's 22nd Prime Minister of the City Council.

January 1, N.F. 115
City Hall, Building 17, 105th Street, District 3, Eastside
Prime Minister's New Year's Address

speaker: Max King
content: Dear DisCitizens, Happy New Year.

speaker: Max King
content: One year ago today, I made a bold declaration that I would stand on this stage as DisCity's 22nd Prime Minister, bring real changes, and guide our city towards a new era of hope.

speaker: Max King
content: That marked the beginning of my journey. Since then, I've crossed paths with many people, faced numerous challenges, and glimpsed realities of our world I never knew existed. Through these experiences, I've come to understand more deeply this city where I was born and grew up.

speaker: What's your dream life like?
content: And now, as I stand here true to my declaration, I find myself filled with emotions I never imagined I would experience.
[Cutaway]

speaker: Langley
content: They're quite unhappy about your defeat, saying that all their investment in you has gone to waste.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Heh, even if I had won, their problems wouldn't have magically vanished. Mr. King did have a point there.

speaker: Bernadette
content: The West District would never accept someone like me in power. No matter what approach I took, they would never lower their guard against the established families. The price of upholding control would only grow higher over time.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Instead of trying to quash the matter at a significant expense, it's wiser to opt for a proxy everyone can accept to navigate through the temporary throes... The investors will soon grasp why.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Pull the right strings, and anyone can become a reliable puppet, don't you agree?
[Flashback]

speaker: Vale
content: An assassination plot... a mentally unstable killer... Why are you showing me this? Are you trying to sabotage our rally?

speaker: Bernadette
content: No. I believe you can prevent the attack early enough for your important rally to proceed, but then what? Will you win the election after that?

speaker: Bernadette
content: Surely you understand, Mr. Vale, that Mr. King alone cannot turn the current tides. This shooting plan... will be your final chance.

speaker: Vale
content: Hehe, so you want me to use this to stage a show, turn my master into an almost-victim hero, and help him win public trust?

speaker: Vale
content: Even if we were to fabricate a story and stir up public sentiment, you still control the media and investigation permissions. You could easily discredit it all.

speaker: Vale
content: What you really want is collateral. You are asking me to create evidence of our own guilt and deliver it directly into your hands.

speaker: Bernadette
content: What I want is a commitment, a gesture of trust, and what I offer is the chance to put him in power.

speaker: Vale
content: Even if I go along with this charade, and my master secures his election through it, that won't change the fact of you holding proof it was all staged. The moment he defies any of your decisions in the future, you'll instantly take him down.

speaker: Bernadette
content: That's only the worst-case scenario. We can always prevent it from happening. As long as Max proves himself to be a cooperative partner, my supporters will gladly back him instead.

speaker: Bernadette
content: With the upcoming shooting incident, all related lawsuits will be dropped, financial restrictions lifted, public pressure dissolved, and the media will portray him as a hero. He embodies the persona of a "new-era" leader far more fittingly than I do, living right up to everyone's expectations.

speaker: Bernadette
content: ...As long as you accept this plan.
[Exit Memory]

speaker: Bernadette
content: Anyway, things have settled now. Now that you've come to talk with me, I suppose I've passed the evaluation?

speaker: Langley
content: You're right. Congratulations.

speaker: Langley
content: You did inherit Stewart's legacy, found yourself a perfect puppet, and used him as a stepping stone to reach where you wanted to be.

speaker: Langley
content: But don't forget what I told you before.

speaker: Langley
content: Keep your distance from those old friends of yours.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Heh... Aren't you my ONLY old friend left now?
[EDGE door opens]
That journalist has been taken care of. Bernadette must hold onto such a precious key personally, to use it only when necessary.
Now, Bernadette ascends the steps, walking towards a new height, approaching those who were once far beyond her reach.
It's time for her to claim the spoils of her victory.
[02's portrait appears]

speaker: EDGE-02
content: Welcome, Bernadette Cavendish. Your adept management has upheld the Eastside Council through tumultuous times and effectively quelled the unrest in the West District. Your orchestration has been both well-crafted and innovative. You've demonstrated your capabilities.

speaker: EDGE-02
content: From today onward, the vacant Seat 05 is yours. You will assume the responsibilities that Stewart left unfulfilled. Lead the Eastside Council, and ensure they don't stray too far from the correct path.

speaker: EDGE-02
content: Well then, congratulations on achieving what you desired.

speaker: EDGE-05
content: The honor is mine.
(Scene change)
A hundred years have elapsed... This city has nurtured its true masters, who have permeated into every vein like tumors, commanding its every breath.
The rules of the game grow increasingly sophisticated, old, and bloated, more greedier with each passing day. To protect its own interests, it staunchly opposes any form of change.
Nonetheless, the only constant in this world is change itself. The West District has cast the first stone, sending ripples that spread from top to bottom, inside to outside, from past to future...
[Entering Memory]

speaker: Vale
content: ...I accept it. Of course, I do.

speaker: Vale
content: We've waited so long for an opportunity like this... Thank you for your generosity. I will make the most of this chance. While I regret breaking my master's trust, I know he will make it through.

speaker: Vale
content: It doesn't have to be today. Once he reaches the right position, he will take action and honor his commitment. I look forward to seeing that day come.
[Exit Memory]
A smile plays across Bernadette's face. Time is running short, but she still wants to climb higher, to see broader horizons. And then... to welcome the dawn of revolution.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Happy New Year, young people of DisCity.
[Special Fade Out]

speaker: Max King
content: I now understand this city holds a vastness, depth, and complexity beyond what I ever imagined. This position is never glory—it carries a weight both lighter and heavier than I had anticipated.

speaker: Max King
content: The world is changing, but I'm not the one who ushers in any new era. Time only moves forward, towards each of us, never stopping.

speaker: Max King
content: I will bear the responsibilities that are mine to carry—for those who have supported me, believed in me, and brought me here, and for every citizen who calls this city home alongside me.

speaker: Max King
content: Whether tomorrow brings light or darkness, whether you face it with hope or fear, whether our beliefs align or diverge—this era will embrace us all equally, and I will stand by your side to face it.

speaker: Max King
content: And then... do everything we can to change it.

speaker: Max King
content: Now, it's time to brace ourselves.
[Small CG 1] Death

speaker: Delicate Female Voice
content: A new puppet, a new member, a new year, new troubles and burdens... You almost ruined my plans again.

speaker: Delicate Female Voice
content: If this keeps up, even I will get mad.

speaker: Delicate Female Voice
content: How about you go tell █ █ that this is becoming too much trouble, and maybe we should consider ending our collaboration? Making deals with you annoys me. Go play your games by yourself.
[Small CG 2] Famine

speaker: Elegant Male Voice
content: But you'll help regardless, right? So thank you. Besides, isn't an ending like this... quite intriguing?

speaker: Elegant Male Voice
content: To see DisCity's high-and-mighty election thrown into chaos by an Outlander, and watch a pitiful commoner flip the entire game board... Now that's what I call a worthwhile investment.

speaker: Elegant Male Voice
content: Thanks to our genius programmer setting up the network before going on vacation, I get to watch this show across the calamities, and even see my dear runaway sister.

speaker: Elegant Male Voice
content: Now, the game is on. Let's see when DisCity will be ready for what's coming.
[Small CG 3] War
You came back empty-handed? What happened to that unexpected gift you mentioned?

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: It was stolen, by those... "uninvited" guests.
Haha! What a pity, I was quite excited about meeting him.
female_content: Haha! What a pity, I was quite excited about meeting her.

content: At least that one's got more spine than this old geezer.
[Small CG 4] Commander-in-Chief
Eight years apart, and the FAC has become a pushover, just as expected.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: ...What do you want, coming back now?

speaker: FAC Commander
content: DisCity won't repeat the same mistake. There's no place for you here. Get lost—I don't have time for you.
Oh? Outland spies freely roam your streets, the Underground has infiltrated everywhere, and anyone can walk all over you—Who exactly did you spend your time on?
Too busy being the puppet masters' lapdog?
Step down, you old fool. From now on, this battlefield is mine.
Once again, you find Elvira in the Bureau's underground shooting range.
No one will ever come to take her away. All the targets in the range lie shattered, yet she's still clutching the gun that fired at Jelena.

speaker: Hecate
content: Back then, Elvira held a gun to her head and insisted that I take her there.

speaker: Hecate
content: I think she knew exactly what she's doing. She always did.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're a good shooter.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...No, I tend to miss when it really matters.

speaker: Elvira
content: Sorry I didn't kill her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You just wanted her to break free from that madness and leave...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'll protect you from now on. That's what those two wanted most.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...There's no need. I... no longer need anyone's protection...

speaker: Elvira
content: My father... he told me a lot. Please let me stay, and be of use to you.

speaker: Elvira
content: I... also have things I must do.
[Black Screen]

speaker: Max King
content: The past year, and everything that came in the past, will be consigned to history. A new era has dawned...

speaker: Max King
content: We will face it together.

speaker: Max King
content: ...Happy New Year, DisCity, and my dear citizens.
[Black Screen]
[Scene Change] In a car heading to the satellite town
Jelena slowly opens her eyes. Moonlight spills into the car, and the subtle jolts of the journey sway both her consciousness and her blurred memories.
She can't discern her surroundings, yet in the distance, DisCity fades away on the distant horizon beyond the car window.
And the rain has stopped.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...I'm still alive...

speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
content: Yeah, it was a close call. If I had arrived a few minutes later, you might not have made it back.

speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
content: Where would you like to go now? I'll take you there.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Where to go?

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Heh... Hehe...
Anywhere will suffice. She has already succeeded.
She swayed the election as promised, and kept the child safe, just as she always wished.

A more fitting protector with a more rightful stance has taken her place by the girl's side. Despite shifting times and adversaries to face, that person made a promise—one that will definitely be upheld unwaveringly.
She can finally rest easy now, and there's no longer any reason for her to stay.
Then... why is she still alive?

speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
content: Well... Take your time. We've got a long way to go.

speaker: Cheerful Female Voice
content: As long as you're alive, you'll find the answer one day.
Jelena can no longer hear it. Her laughter grows hollow, eventually dissolving into a fractured tune.
A new era has dawned... Yet I cannot... stay by your side... Don't let it sweep you away... Don't let it crush you... My beloved children... you must...
...Grow up strong...
Under a sky stained Mania-red, the sand screams on the wind as twilight bleeds into the dunes. Monsters lurk within the storm, occasionally rasping like crows circling rotten meat.

In the boundless, unforgiving expanse of the desert, the weary traveler stumbles once again. Exhausted beyond measure, each attempt to rise grows harder. Yet, with the last vestiges of her strength, she finally lifts her head.

speaker: Sibilla
content: Cough cough... cough... blegh...

speaker: Villager in the Dream
content: Sibilla, Sibilla! Where are you going? Are you going alone?

speaker: Sibilla
content: DisCity... how much further...
Amidst the raging sandstorm, the traveler catches fleeting glimpses of DisCity's towering skyline, shimmering like a mirage on the distant horizon.

speaker: Villager in the Dream
content: The Great Expo? What a strange name. What is that?

speaker: Sibilla
content: This is a tradition that has endured throughout human history. People from every region and ethnicity gather to showcase their achievements, exchange new technologies, learn from one another, and move forward together...

speaker: Sibilla
content: ...regardless of how they're divided into nations or today's city-states, settlements, and shelters. The essence of the Great Expo has never changed.

speaker: Sibilla
content: It's a gathering where people come together to push civilization forward. Even the smallest voices will be heard.

The illusion gradually fades, devoured by the swirling sands. Through fleeting breaks in the storm, she glimpses cave dwellings in rock walls, weathered wooden cabins, and the warm glow of campfires. Beside one such fire, the child askes with curiosity.

speaker: Villager in the Dream
content: But it's still a long way from here, and it'll be pretty dangerous, right?

speaker: Sibilla
content: I have to go, no matter how dangerous it is. A whistle is useless if it stays silent...

speaker: Villager in the Dream
content: ...Here! We made this bracelet together. It's a protective charm for you! I learned from my big sister. Each bead represents one of us, to keep you safe.

speaker: Villager in the Dream
content: May the sandstorms never hurt you. May you always have food and warm clothes. May you never feel lonely and despair, and may you find good friends and companions wherever you go!

speaker: Villager in the Dream
content: Safe travels! We'll be here waiting for you!

The sun sinks below the horizon, its last rays slipping from the crimson dunes like a receding tide. The traveler's smile fades with the light as shadows devour the twilight, a silent whisper that time is running out.

speaker: Sibilla
content: There's still a chance... still hope... I must get into DisCity. I have to find that person...

speaker: Sibilla
content: He will listen... He will help us... I must...
female_content: She will listen... She will help us... I must...

content:
May 23, N.F. 115
City-State Security Bureau (Newly Established)

speaker: 9th
content: Six months have passed since the assassination of the Speaker and the cabinet overthrow. The 9th Agency has just completed its third round of citywide screening for Outland spies. Our investigations have covered 2,038 people, resulting in 198 suspects identified and 117 arrests.

speaker: 9th
content: They're all bribed DisCity locals, mostly recruited through the dark web. They know nothing about their employers and only care about pocket change. In other words, the real mastermind stays well hidden.

Lotherlon
Guillotin's successor, Interim Chief of the Outland Affairs Bureau, recently appointed to Max King's Cabinet.

speaker: Lotherlon
content: All Outland ambassadors have been summoned for questioning in connection to suspicious activities during the election. We've also widened the investigation to include all organizations tied to the Outland. Notably, Quinn's president has been detained for allegedly bribing councilors. The full reports have been forwarded to the 9th Agency.

speaker: Lotherlon
content: The borders are now under stricter lockdown, with heightened scrutiny for all entries and exits. So far, no individual or organization has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Lang
Chief of the newly established Eastside Defense Bureau, member of Max King's Cabinet.

speaker: Lang
content: Tch, you expect criminals to willingly confess? Of course they're the ones who killed those people. The Outlanders couldn't wait to reap the benefits from it!

speaker: Lang
content: With a prize like the new mine, Nirvana has been haggling with the Syndicans for over a year, only to stay empty-handed. The Outlands would be fools not to act. Letting DisCity monopolize it is not an option. What's there to fear? War is simply another form of negotiation!

speaker: Lang
content: The FAC has long since shifted its focus to Mania defense. The Black Rings and Corruptors have drained the military budget dry, our soldiers and artillery tied up defending the Broken Frontline. A single Tide of Ashes or a DisSea surge, and they're already stretched thin. If war actually breaks out, how many troops would we even have left?

speaker: Lang
content: Anyone with a brain can see this is the Outlands' best—if not last—chance to cripple DisCity. And yet, here we are, entertaining fantasies of the "Great Expo," rolling out the welcome mat for thousands of them?

speaker: Langley
content: Because this is a peace petition actively proposed by our ally Fraser. An outright refusal would damage DisCity's standing—we can use that as the official position to present.

speaker: Langley
content: What I care about is that, as the only <color=#fb9259>friendly city-state</color> that stood by our side during the last Outland war, Fraser has promised crucial intelligence. Not just about the cabinet attack's true perpetrators, but about the world beyond our walls.
The communicator before the empty seat across the table crackles to life. You know that voice. Your former boss, the Silver Spider. Her tone regarding the Great Expo seems deliberately noncommittal.

speaker: Langley
content: The good old days... The last expo was in N.F. 106. What should have been a peaceful celebration ended with a diplomatic collapse, and we still haven't truly reconciled to this day.

speaker: Langley
content: The widespread disasters have limited war, trade, and transportation, but they've also choked off intelligence networks. For every ten agents we send out, we're lucky to get back a single corpse with half a dying message. That's another kind of isolation.
Through the communicator, you hear her fingernails lightly tapping on the table. It's her habitual gesture when deep in thought.

speaker: Langley
content: We hear blades being sharpened, yet we're still blind in this fog. DisCity needs real intelligence. We must see every threat before it strikes. And if a blade is pressed to our throat? We take it... and follow it straight back to its master.
[Small CG - Jelena's Trio in Fire]
The screen flickers to life, displaying the final image of Sinner Jelena, the Outland spy. The room falls silent as everyone watches, then all eyes turn to you.

speaker: Langley
content: Please, Chief ${PlayerName}, we need first-hand intelligence from the MBCC.
You rise to your feet, gazing at that footage you have watched countless times, and begin stating your "findings" in a perfectly flat tone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sinner Jelena was previously detained by the MBCC, and we had conducted a comprehensive examination of her physiology and Mania status. The results confirmed her as an A-Class Sinner back then, though with underdeveloped powers that hadn't yet manifested into any clearly defined external expressions.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This was inconsistent with the incident where the Underground Puppets were controlled and enhanced to attack the former cabinet. As a result, we initially ruled out Jelena as a suspect, concluding she lacked combat capabilities and wasn't operational personnel.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then...
[Small CG - War image only, no Jelena, 1s] (But no one witnessed this scene, not sure if we should show it here.)
[Small CG - Parting with El at the Hospital]
Your gaze sweeps the meeting room. The Silver Spider remains silent, showing no sign of any input.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No complete report was ever compiled for this attack. Even my own memories of the event have been fragmented and unreliable. When we conducted another comprehensive examination on Jelena, her Mania showed fluctuations but remained within A-Class parameters. Just as before, she showed no signs of developing stable, externally manifested combat capabilities.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nevertheless, we proceeded with extreme caution, increasing surveillance while working to verify our suspicions. What we ultimately discovered about her... surpassed even our wildest imagination.
[Small CG - Before Boss Battle]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: During this full-scale operation, Jelena didn't employ her own power. Instead, she was channeling something else, a force far more powerful.
[Weapon Portrait]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is an Ash Crystal. During that battle, we witnessed the Outland spy resonating with it, unleashing Mania power remarkably similar to that of Calamity Apostles.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's not something an A-Class Sinner can withstand. I believe she must have employed some form of powerful external medium.
At your gesture, a stream of light flows from Schorl beside you. It takes control of the screen signal, further enlarging the image and automatically enhancing the pixelated footage.
[Zoom in on weapon: Aurum Secretum] (Maybe we can use PV here?)

speaker: Schorl
content: The Ring Research Institute has verified Chief ${PlayerName}'s speculation.

speaker: Schorl
content: During the final battle, the decorative metal on the Outland spy's hand activated an unusual resonance trait. It minimized the Mania differential between this Sinner and the Ash Crystal, granting her temporary synchronization with an Apostle of Ashes and access to its immense power.

speaker: Schorl
content: However, this metal is not a natural substance but an artificial, extremely precise cutting-edge creation—technology that DisCity has yet to comprehend.

speaker: Lang
content: ...This doesn't look good. This thing clearly isn't some amateur creation. It must have required massive resources and manpower to develop. Whoever's backing her is no small player.

speaker: Lang
content: Hey, where's that spy now?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She made a desperate final stand, then vanished. Due to Jelena's excessive use of the Apostle's power, her resonance with the Ash Crystal completely altered her original Mania traits.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The shackles have broken. I can no longer track her.

speaker: Lotherlon
content: On the bright side, our enemy hasn't fully mastered this power yet, and that Sinner is already dead. On the more concerning side... we've only exposed one spy, one who infiltrated DisCity years ago. For all we know, our enemy may have already created more soldiers like her.

speaker: Lotherlon
content: You're right. Intelligence is crucial. We need more intel from the Outlands.

speaker: 9th
content: Gathering local intel takes time. While we successfully dismantled the Underground's dark web last August, the operation came at a steep price. Many of our agents in the Outlands were exposed, went missing, or were neutralized, with classified materials leaked in the process.

speaker: 9th
content: Our intelligence network has been severely compromised. Both rebuilding and reactivating it will take considerable time. If we can't afford such a long wait—

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Then let Fraser bring their "intelligence" to us. If they dare attempt anything underhanded, we'll be fully prepared to prevent any incidents.
An FAC officer stands up, salutes the group, and proceeds to take charge of the report.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: First, we'll segregate all Outland delegations entering under the Great Expo banner. Only a select group of high-ranking officials will be permitted inside city embassies as diplomatic envoys, while the rest will be housed in the "Outland quarters" outside the city.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: These "quarters" will be under FAC's close surveillance, ensuring that the majority of their personnel, goods, and information are strictly confined to the designated area outside our borders.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Second, we'll implement targeted countermeasures against the Apostles of Ashes. Now that our enemy has revealed their attack methods, we'll adapt our defenses accordingly. Every lesson learned from fighting the Tide of Ashes will be put to good use.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Third, we'll coordinate with satellite towns and other allied forces to reinforce outskirts patrol routes and alert systems. This will prevent any large-scale force from approaching the city undetected.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Simulations confirm that even if the enemy were to mobilize from the nearest city-state, traversing the calamity-stricken WhiteSands would exhaust their time and resources. Should conflicts erupt during the Great Expo, our existing defensive capabilities are more than adequate to protect our city.
He stands firm, distributing more detailed strategies to each leader in attendance, sparking a serious discussion around the conference table.

speaker: Lotherlon
content: We should accelerate our Expo preparations, then. Can't afford to let them notice anything unusual and gain diplomatic leverage against us.

speaker: Lang
content: Naturally. History's greatest warmongers always draped themselves in peace banners first—the better to lull their enemies into complacency. Time to see who can stand till the end in this game.

speaker: 9th
content: Since Fraser has managed to persuade several minor factions to share intelligence and mend relations, we should capitalize on this opportunity to sort out friends from foes and gain a clearer assessment of the situation.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Looking on the bright side, if nobody causes trouble and the Great Expo proceeds smoothly, this could be exactly what the Hypercube economy needs. Nirvana has been particularly enthusiastic about this prospect.

You notice that the 9th Agency has cut off the communication at some point, and the FAC Commander-in-Chief, who should have been present, is nowhere to be seen. Throughout the entire meeting, he hasn't even called in.
Besides that, there is another absence that catches your attention... You scan the "new cabinet" members gathered around the table, yet their supposed leader is nowhere to be found.

speaker: Option
options: Will Speaker King approve of this?

content: In response to your question, a member of Max King's Cabinet catches it and almost reflexively rolls his eyes.

speaker: Lang
content: The Speaker? Huh, he won't oppose anything. What can he actually accomplish anyway?

speaker: Before you can finish your question, McQueen hops on the MBCC vehicle that's come to your rescue, pulling you on with her. The vehicle revs and speeds away, leaving the fuming building in the dust.

content: The call ends, but Schorl continues to hover in mid-air beside you, showing no intention of leaving.

speaker: Schorl
content: When Jelena was first captured, you appeared quite dejected, but now you're able to view the situation objectively.

options: It's what I'm supposed to do.

speaker: Schorl
content: Your growth in intelligence work is truly remarkable. That being said...

speaker: Schorl
content: MBCC has taken custody of that girl and refused to hand her over to the Stewart family. Have you obtained any information from her?
You glance at Schorl, finding only your own eyes mirrored on its surface. The emotions behind your gaze remain hidden.

options: No leads. The kid doesn't know anything.
Right, I'm also waiting for her to talk.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I should have the right to take her in. Given her connection to Sinner Jelena, she doesn't really have anyone trustworthy left outside.
Schorl falls momentarily silent, eventually conceding to your decision.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll notify you if there's any update?
Schorl's approval of you has increased.

speaker: Schorl
content: After all, she's a highly emotional Sinner with straightforward reasons for joining this conflict. Such individuals are particularly impressionable, and dangerously effective at inciting others. Emotional vulnerability breeds susceptibility to manipulation.

speaker: Schorl
content: However, Chief, if you had experienced it yourself, you would understand that war operates on an entirely different scale from personal feelings. It's not a stage for individual emotions. One cannot survive such conflicts on sentiment alone.

speaker: Schorl
content: The enemy is constantly seeking to overthrow DisCity and upend the existing world order. This is the harsh reality we face, one we must meet with absolute clarity.
[Show Jelena's Flashback]

June 16, N.F. 115
The World Dome (also known as the Cristallia)
Opening Ceremony of the Great Expo

speaker: Newscast
content: Ladies and gentlemen from DisCity, Fraser, and all our partner city-states, and every viewer and listener tuning in from wherever you may be... welcome to the 13th Great Expo!

speaker: Newscast
content: Do you see the banners waving on every street? Do you hear the thunderous crowd? Do you like the breathtaking Cristallia, our crown jewel of this Expo?!

speaker: Newscast
content: And do you recognize the structure sitting just across the street from our spectacular exhibition hall?
[Sudden silence, followed by a wind sound effect]

speaker: Newscast
content: It's Keylan Square, the iconic landmark of DisCity's historic West District!

speaker: Newscast
content: That's right! Back in N.F. 33, DisCity erected the Keylan Square, a monument to one of humanity's most revered figures. Just one year later, history was made when it hosted the first Great Expo, marking the rise of the Hypercube industry. And from that moment, a tradition was born: every four years, regardless of distance, we return here, to explore our path forward together!

speaker: Newscast
content: Through calamities, poverty, and even war, we have kept this tradition alive. Yes, the N.F. 106 Expo ended in disappointment, but today marks a brand-new chapter! Communications have been restored, barriers fallen, and now we stand reunited at this hallowed ground, more determined than ever!

speaker: Newscast
content: Nine long years, my friends! During these years apart, here on this very square, DisCity successfully suppressed the Black Ring for the first time, restored order to Syndicate, witnessed the rise of the new mine, and watched humanity turn the tide against Mania, evolving from fearful retreat to defiant resistance... to ultimate conquest!

speaker: Newscast
content: This grand gathering reflects the rebirth of the West District, the revival of DisCity, and above all, the renaissance of humanity itself! We come together celebrating peace, progress, and civilization, but beyond all these fancy words, what really matters is...

speaker: Newscast
content: <color=#fb9259>WEALTH!</color> That's right—cold, hard <color=#fb9259><size=52>WEALTH!!!</color></size> <color=#fb9259><size=60>OPPORTUNITY AND WEALTH</color></size> that everyone truly wants!!!

speaker: Newscast
content: The new mine is about to go operational! Cutting-edge extraction methods are changing the game!! Hypercube reserves, stagnant for years, are poised to skyrocket. The world now stands ready to welcome a new era of economic prosperity!
[Stock market chart screenshot from PV]

speaker: Newscast
content: The Eastside Stock Exchange is leading this historic rally! Look at those numbers climb! Nirvana! Quinn!! And UniversalTech! This is a full-market explosion with institutional whales and retail investors all charging in together!
[Scene Change: Another Exhibition Hall]

speaker: Newscast
content: Now feast your eyes on the wonders inside the Cristallia! Exotic fruits! Glittering rare minerals! Treasures beyond price! These regional marvels long obscured by calamities will finally enter the public eye, with all top livestreamers poised to bring them straight to your screens!

speaker: Newscast
content: Resources represent VALUE! Trade generates WEALTH! Am I right or am I right? Now, let's turn our cameras to the Outland representative, the visionary who made this Great Expo possible—

speaker: Newscast
content: Our distinguished guest from Fraser City, Mr. <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>!
[Camera Shake, Adelaide's Portrait] 1s

speaker: Adelaide
content: You're most kind, but I'm not really an official representative, merely an advisor accompanying our city-state delegation.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Greetings, I am <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>. Having now set foot on this great land, I must say DisCity's prosperity exceeds all my expectations, truly deserving its reputation as humanity's beacon.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Calamities have constricted humanity's living space, breeding widespread anxiety. We've endured our share of friction—misunderstandings, mutual suspicion, even isolation and harm. Yet ahead lie new possibilities: shipping routes to connect us, treaties to bind us, and investments to uplift us all.

speaker: Adelaide
content: For these ten days, may we lay aside our differences and divisions, devoting ourselves wholly to progress and shared prosperity. Let us move beyond what was, and focus instead on what may yet be. I look forward to seeing a world reconnected, where love and equality find their rightful place once more.

speaker: Newscast
content: Well said!! Go on, we're all with you!

speaker: Adelaide
content: That concludes my remarks. Now, might I suggest you return the camera to our capable reporter and resume your duty...

speaker: Adelaide
content: ...Mr. <color=#fb9259>Max King</color>, our new Speaker of DisCity? And Speaker, if I may, the opening ceremony does await its host, does it not?

speaker: Newscast
content: Oh come now! I was just adding some spark to the occasion! When else do we get moments like this? Rules were made to be bent, and everyone deserves a happy little surprise!
[Camera shakes as Max King's portrait enters the frame. Maybe there's time to add a zoom effect?]

speaker: Max King
content: Ahem! Let's start over.

speaker: Max King
content: Ladies and gentlemen, DisCitizens and distinguished guests from city-states far and wide, welcome to the opening ceremony of the Great Expo!

speaker: Max King
content: This grand gathering will chronicle the West District's rebirth, DisCity's resurgence, and humanity's hard-won renaissance against calamities. Here we stand reunited, to witness together peace, progress, and civilization.

speaker: Max King
content: With great honor, I declare the 13th Great Expo officially opened! Let us all bear witness to history in the making!
The opening performances electrify the atmosphere as the Cristallia gates yawn wide. A tide of bodies surges forward—elbows jab, shoulders collide, and people are inevitably caught in the crush.

speaker: Stylish Woman
content: Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't hurt you, did I? Are you—huh?

speaker: Stylish Woman
content: Wait, how can a little girl like you be here all alone...

speaker: Trembling Girl
content: ...I-I'm fine. Please let go.

speaker: Stylish Woman
content: Hey, a kid like you shouldn't really be wandering alone here...

speaker: Icy Voice
content: Let her go.
Hecate steps up and drives the woman back with her piercing gaze, then silently pulls her trembling companion away.

speaker: Hecate
content: Still not used to crowded places? I'll contact the Bureau and let them take you back. I can handle it by myself.

speaker: Trembling Girl
content: No!
Elvira's head jerks up suddenly. She catches Hecate's rising hand, warning her in a hushed voice.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...I'm fine, but don't use your power. Don't use Nightmare to search.

speaker: Elvira
content: In a place this sensitive, every security department must have agents here. Most people still don't fully trust Sinners, and everyone's already on edge because of the Outlanders. If you use your power without permission and get caught, we'll just end up making everything worse.

speaker: Hecate
content: Then tell me, where exactly should I look? I can sense Chief's nearby through the shackles, but with this crowd, I can't pinpoint his location.
female_content: Then tell me, where exactly should I look? I can sense Chief's nearby through the shackles, but with this crowd, I can't pinpoint her location.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief hasn't been to the Bureau for three days, but the 9th Agency keeps showing up, with lots of encrypted communications passing through. You said yourself there haven't been any Mania incidents these days. Things are strange.

speaker: Hecate
content: I asked Nightingale, but she also evaded my questions and even tried to distract me. This is just like what happened during the election. MBCC could have stayed out of it, but they still chose to put Chief in danger. I don't like it.
Her gaze falls upon the flushed, jubilant Max King on the podium.

speaker: Hecate
content: I know that man. Chief called him a "smart arse," but he said they're friends. And friends should help each other. I'll go ask him.

speaker: Elvira
content: Don't!

As Max King pivots around, greeting the crowd with waves, his gaze sweeps across the entire venue. For a brief moment, both girls are convinced his eyes lock onto theirs—his smile stuttering mid-glow—but the connection snaps as quickly as it came.
Then, with perfect composure, he shifts his gaze away, laughing as he melts into the crowd of well-dressed attendees, as if all below the stage are complete strangers.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...When people climb that high, they always change.
She has only met him in person once, but the Max King before her now seems an entirely different man. Elvira has changed too—the two people who had always been by her side back then are long gone.
Elvira takes a moment to compose herself, carefully choosing her words.

speaker: Elvira
content: In times of real crisis, someone like ${PlayerName} always ends up standing out, given more important roles, moved to higher places you don't know about.

speaker: Elvira
content: I know this makes you uncomfortable, maybe even lonely and anxious. But I think that person won't change so easily. Bonds that have been deepened don't just break. You should know that better than I do.
Noticing Hecate's continued silence, Elvira gathers her courage and presses on.

speaker: Elvira
content: Since the shackles work as a two-way connection, I'm sure he also knows you're here. If ${PlayerName} hasn't come to find you despite knowing that, he must be on some secret mission. And...
female_content: Since the shackles work as a two-way connection, I'm sure she also knows you're here. If ${PlayerName} hasn't come to find you despite knowing that, she must be on some secret mission. And...

speaker: Elvira
content: He must think this mission is quite safe, at least for now. Otherwise, he'd never let you operate alone. Knowing him, he might even be watching you right now from somewhere.
female_content: She must think this mission is quite safe, at least for now. Otherwise, she'd never let you operate alone. Knowing her, she might even be watching you right now from somewhere.

speaker: Elvira
content: For now, just focus on gathering intelligence and learn everything you can about the mission area. By the time you meet up with him, you'll have useful information that can help him.
female_content: For now, just focus on gathering intelligence and learn everything you can about the mission area. By the time you meet up with her, you'll have useful information that can help her.

content: Those final words finally reach the Sinner's heart standing before her.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I see.

speaker: Hecate
content: If it's a secret mission, I shouldn't cause trouble for Chief. Thank you for reminding me. In return...
Hecate reaches out and pulls Elvira's hat lower to conceal her face.

speaker: Hecate
content: You don't need to be afraid. If someone comes after you, I'll stay in disguise and draw them away from you.

speaker: Hecate
content: You're clever, and you always think ahead. You've helped me a lot. So whether it's for the mission or because I want to say thank you, I won't let anyone hurt you.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Thank you.

A twinge of guilt needles Elvira. She was the one who manipulated Hecate into breaking protocol—using the pretext of "tracking Chief" to reach the Great Expo. Now she stands here, hypocritically playing the role of the cautious one while Hecate offers her sincere gratitude.
...But without doing this, she, "the specially detained daughter of the former Speaker," would likely never have the chance to leave the MBCC.
She has grown tired of being protected, of being confined in some safe house. This is a rare opportunity. And she will get what she wants.

speaker: Elvira
content: This is just the area for the public. The Great Expo also has a VIP section where all the important people will be. We should find a way in.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...I want to see these "Outlanders" with my own eyes. See who they really are...
Her gaze skims past the Speaker of DisCity, locking onto the Outland delegation beside him. Without hesitation, she strides forward.
[Scene Change]
The stylish woman watches as the two girls she has just bumped into disappear into the crowd, reflecting on what she has glimpsed during that brief encounter.

speaker: Thalia
content: That girl just now...

speaker: Thalia
content: Her outfit's pretty nice, understated in style but you can tell that fabric's expensive. Definitely custom-made, the kind only rich kids wear. Are those two sisters?

speaker: Thalia
content: Hmm... why would kids from that kind of family be wandering alone instead of being in the VIP section? Lost, maybe? I was thinking about helping contact their family, but too late now that they're gone...

speaker: Thalia
content: Ah, whatever. I'm sure the Expo security's got this covered. No need for me to meddle. I should get to work anyway. Duty calls!

She shakes her head, clearing away the distracting thoughts. With her mask and sunglasses removed, Thalia dabs at her makeup with practiced ease. The moment the camera light blinks on, she meets her audience with a bright smile.

speaker: Thalia
content: Hi there, lovelies! Welcome to Thalia's Great Expo Special! I'll be taking you on a full tour of all the Outland exhibition sections, plus uncovering hidden gems and the most post-worthy spots! Stay close, and don't miss a thing!

speaker: Thalia
content: Aight now, buckle up. We're jumping right into this Great Expo tour! Hit that follow if you haven't already. You're not gonna wanna miss this!

June 16, N.F. 115 at 11:40 AM
The Great Expo

speaker: Thalia
content: Whoa, check this out. There are actually wild vegetables grown in the Outlands. Don't let the rustic look fool you, they're apparently packed with nutrients. Seems perfect for those mindful of their macros or following a low-carb lifestyle.

speaker: Thalia
content: Okay guys, I just saw some ore from the... some shelter mining area! Now... I know it might look a little plain. But who knows? They might find gems in there someday.

speaker: Thalia
content: Oh, look at this! It's a newly unearthed pre-Nightfall organism fossil, one that symbolizes disaster and death. Did you know? DisCity museums used to display complete fossil skeletons as well. I remember seeing them as a child.
Thalia guides her livestream viewers through each Outlands exhibition area, offering explanations and comments about the dazzling array of exhibits on display.

speaker: Thalia
content: Eastia's running a little behind schedule since they've got quite the journey to make, and their venue is still being prepared. Let's all keep our fingers crossed they arrive with time to spare.
At the mention of the Outlands and Eastia, the chat explodes to life, though the tone is far from friendly.

speaker: Thalia
content: Actually, that's not quite right. DisCity and the Outlands have always been deeply connected. During the Nightfall, when DisCity was first established, many Outland forces contributed both people and resources. In fact, some of the most well-known families in Eastside and Paradeisos today can trace their roots back generations to the Outlands. Even my own ancestors...

speaker: Thalia
content: ...So you see, the Outlands have their own rich historical heritage. And our resource exchange with them has been a cornerstone of DisCity's prosperity.

speaker: Thalia
content: Now then, next up—Eek!
The young streamer is startled by the cry of a live sandworm.

speaker: Thalia
content: Oh my! A sandworm? Or a Corruptor?

speaker: Outland Exhibitor
content: @#￥@%&* (Hey there, gorgeous! Want to check out our exhibition?)

speaker: Outland Exhibitor
content: #@￥@%@#@#￥@% (Yes yes. We've also got some amazing tech to share. Come, come! Take a look! You've been turning heads—please help us get some attention! I'll give you something in return!)
The Outlander digs out a brochure and hands it to Thalia, along with a bulky package of Outland gifts, making a determined effort to promote their product.

speaker: Thalia
content: W-wait, hold on—

Thalia instinctively wants to step back, but the product name on the brochure catches her attention. More importantly, her streamer instincts flare: an official Great Expo camera is hidden behind that pillar, following her movements, likely drawn by her popularity.

The thought hits her—millions, or maybe even more, are watching the official broadcast behind that lens. All those potential viewers she's been chasing. Thalia shakes off the last traces of unease, her posture straightening as professional instinct takes over.

speaker: Thalia
content: You're so right! Technological progress and exchange are just as crucial as anything else! Now, my lovely viewers, let your Thalia guide you through these amazing Outland breakthroughs!

speaker: Thalia
content: Look closely here, this is actually a small practical application of Aurum Secretum, a calamity prevention method developed independently by the Outlands.

speaker: Thalia
content: Aurum Secretum exhibits powerful resonance properties. Through harmonization and assimilation with pollutants, Hypercubes, and other substances, it can alter Mania field distribution within a certain time and range, redirecting Mania creatures or mutations away from human-inhabited zones. This helps reduce Hypercube consumption normally required for defensive measures while simultaneously ensuring human safety.

speaker: Thalia
content: Truly remarkable! This Outland representative here wants to tell everyone that they're not just fighting for their survival—they're contributing to humanity's future as well. Let's all do our part to support this important cause, shall we?

speaker: Thalia
content: For those who haven't heard yet, Aurum Secretum is absolutely revolutionizing the tech world right now! Nirvana's been working closely with the Outlands on this, and after their latest breakthrough, their stock prices have been soaring through the roof!

speaker: Thalia
content: This event is simply overflowing with opportunities like this! Have you noticed how the stock market has been thriving throughout the Great Expo? It's precisely because investors are embracing all the new potential it's creating, isn't it?

speaker: Thalia
content: The public exhibition here is just to open everyone's eyes, but the truly important conversations? Those are happening upstairs in the VIP lounge, where deals worth fortunes are being signed as we speak.

speaker: Thalia
content: The stock market is far too volatile for ordinary people. I've always believed in building success the steady way, with both feet on solid ground. However, if you really want my take...

speaker: Thalia
content: ...Surely I'd recommend DisFortune Weekly! They're running this wonderful special series about the Great Expo, and the Parfait's Dinner Invitation column is absolutely helpful for keeping up with upcoming trends!

speaker: Thalia
content: After all, we are talking about none other than the legendary <color=#fb9259>Parfait</color>—the stock market guru with an impeccable eye for opportunity! Any project that earns her attention is simply unmissable!

speaker: Thalia
content: Wanna know Parfait's investment secrets? Then why not follow and subscribe? For just 88.88 DisCoins per year, you'll receive personal guidance from the legendary investor herself! Oh hey, the camera's gone... Well then, my dear friends, see you at the next stop!
[Scene Change] VIP Section, Near the Screen
In the hallway leading to the VIP section, Elvira stops in her tracks, her attention caught by the shot of Thalia in her livestream on the screen.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...That's the person who bumped into me earlier.

It turns out she is a streamer. When they ran into each other, Elvira imagined countless suspicious scenarios and worried about hidden agendas. Thankfully, those paranoid conspiracies are just in her head. Relief floods Elvira's chest.
But Hecate continues to stare at the screen, completely transfixed.

speaker: Elvira
content: Does she seem off to you?
Hecate visibly stiffens, then murmurs as if waking from a trance.

speaker: Hecate
content: No, I just... couldn't stop listening...

speaker: Hecate
content: I've never been outside DisCity, so I don't really know what the Outlands are like. But last year, one of my friends went on an adventure in the WhiteSands. She told me a similar story in her last letter.

speaker: Hecate
content: One about how Outlanders survive using their own technology in places we can't see.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...I see.
Elvira pauses before turning her gaze back to the glowing screen alongside Hecate.

speaker: Thalia
content: Truly remarkable! This Outland representative here wants to tell everyone that they're not just fighting for their survival—they're contributing to humanity's future as well. Let's all do our part to support this important cause, shall we?
The streamer's voice, passionate and sincere, fills the room. Both girls fall silent, each lost in their own thoughts.
Just then, footsteps and boisterous laughter echo from the other end of the hallway.

speaker: Hecate
content: <size=25>Someone's coming, this way!</size>

She grabs the nervous Elvira and yanks her behind a nearby door. Soon after, a few well-dressed adults walk down the hallway and stop beside the screen, right where the girls had stood moments earlier.
Several of them wear Nirvana representative badges, indicating positions of considerable authority.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Heh, that little Eastside streamer is just chasing clout. Look, she even mentioned you—your column in DisFortune.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Mmm... the cover photo does capture essence rather well. As one would expect from the renowned stock market guru. An excellent stylist choice. Is this another gem from your exclusive little black book of contacts? Any chance you could make an introduction?

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: ...That vacant expression isn't helping anyone. No matter how boring this expo is, we have contracts to sign here. The Fraser representatives are waiting at the negotiation table, and those overseas assets won't manage themselves. Can't you at least pretend to care for their sake?
Investments thrive on prudence, and true wealth demands respect before acquisition. Wouldn't you agree, my friend?
Besides, we're all aware these exhibitions are simply theater. The real negotiations never happen in conference rooms. They occur at my dinner table... do they not?
As Elvira recognizes the speaker's identity, she simultaneously notices a faint, unusual fragrance.

speaker: Elvira
content: <size=25>...That's the financier Parfait Medici. But what's that scent on her...?</size>

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Haha, of course. Parfait's Dinner Party—a glimpse into the vision of the renowned stock market guru, the opportunity most financiers would kill for. So tell me, my dear financial guru, might I have the honor to dine with you at the closing gala in ten days?

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: It would be even better if you could share with me what you've got your eye on these days, and your acquisition strategy. You're always so enigmatic about your investments.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Well... Not only has this second Black Ring created a new mine, but I hear it's also worsening disasters in the outer regions. Hypercube's value is guaranteed to soar. With some... strategic market plays, we could acquire premium overseas holdings for pennies.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Oh, and aren't you still building your overseas collection? I hear quite a selection has been brought in for auction this time, though I suspect there won't be that much time before they're gone. Don't hesitate if you wanna snag one or two.

speaker: Parfait
content: Naturally. Though I can't help but notice Nirvana's rather... enthusiastic promotion of Fraser's Aurum Secretum. Shouldn't you be concerned about Hypercube's market position?
The Nirvana representative lets out a contemptuous scoff.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: If it could really replace Hypercube, why would Fraser come begging for cooperation? This "partnership" is just mutual publicity. It's more about trading influence to move markets and stocks than anything else.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Besides, these clowns are just renting Fraser's technology to develop some primitive applications. At least the Fraser representatives know to dress properly. Look at this rabble, dressed like they just stumbled out of a cave. Who would believe they can counter Mania? See? All the viewers are roasting them alive.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Heh, wanna bet they'll have a technical malfunction soon that'll leave them completely humiliated?

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Oh! There it is! Look!
Through the screen, the crowd's screams and monsters' roars rip through the air. Both girls freeze, their breath catching.

speaker: Broadcast
content: Attention please. We are evacuating the public area due to an emergency situation. FAC has secured the site and is guiding the evacuation. Please remain calm, follow all instructions, and move quickly to the nearest exit—

speaker: Parfait
content: Oh, seriously...

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Do relax. This is all part of the demonstration. Nirvana's technical experts will take control of the situation any moment now. The public does love a good "crisis averted" narrative, after all.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Once the publicity of our technical alliance with Fraser is made, Nirvana's valuation will skyrocket. Just casually drop some praise at your dinner party—maybe throw in a flashy investment—and we're golden. People do listen to you, you know.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: Just watch our Nirvana tech elites steal the show—Wait, what?? Who let this outsider jump into the fight?!

speaker: Parfait
content: Oh?
Before Nirvana's experts can arrive, a reassuringly familiar figure appears on the screen.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!

speaker: Security Personnel
content: Situation contained, hostile neutralized, Chief! The area is now secure. Thank you for your assistance!
They look at you with admiration and offer an awkward imitation of an FAC salute.

speaker: Security Personnel
content: Then, we'll get back to work now.

speaker: Security Personnel
content: <size=25>(Whoa... first time seeing the real deal. So that's the MBCC Chief? Way more low-key than I expected. I didn't even notice...)</size>
The security personnel look visibly moved.

speaker: Security Personnel
content: You did all the real work there. Thank you for your efforts! We'll take it from here.

speaker: Security Personnel
content: Roger that!

After the security personnel leave, you turn toward the other side where the Outland exhibitor in charge of the booth huddles like a cornered animal, her face deathly pale as she spews frantic explanations.

speaker: Outland Exhibitor
content: @#@%%......&#*¥%#!! (I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! I swear it wasn't on purpose! We mean no harm to DisCity! We're clueless about what went wrong! Please, believe me, I'm begging you!)

speaker: Option
options: You should go check if you're injured first.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: DisCity always looks out for victims. Everything's alright now. Take all the time you need to recover.

speaker: Outland Exhibitor
content: #¥@#%@*& (*sob*... Thank you so much...)
You calm the startled exhibitors, personally guiding them toward the kindest medics on duty. The smile on your face never wavers until at last the crowd thins.
Then, a faint electronic chime pulses from your coat pocket as a black triangular object quietly pokes its tip out.

speaker: Schorl
content: Nicely managed. This allows us to assess their Mania levels under medical supervision.

speaker: Schorl
content: Any incidents at the Great Expo would impact diplomatic relations, which are particularly delicate right now. We must prevent any escalation into conflict. Chief, you might even have a talent for diplomacy.

speaker: Option
options: Really? Can I apply for a career change then?
I see you've developed a talent for humor.

speaker: Schorl
content: That was just my attempt at humor. EDGE has implanted a new simulation module that adapts to mimic the speech patterns of those around you, which is meant to help you relax occasionally. Please don't take it seriously.

speaker: Schorl
content: A career change for you is impossible. No rational person would allow it. Please continue performing your duties as you always have. You've been doing an excellent job. Ha-ha.
...You make a mental note to file a complaint. Their humor simulation module clearly needs serious work.

speaker: Schorl
content: Yes, EDGE has implanted a new simulation module that adapts to mimic the speech patterns of those around you, which is meant to help you relax occasionally.

speaker: Schorl
content: If you find it amusing, that would be ideal. I will keep gathering feedback for future improvements. Thank you for your encouragement. Kindly consider leaving a positive review on the version experience report. Ha-ha.
Your custom-made Schorl emits an unsettling mechanical "laugh," making you wonder if EDGE's understanding of humor might be somewhat different from the rest of humanity.

speaker: Schorl
content: But in retrospect, the incident doesn't appear to have a significant impact. The undercover FAC agents in the vicinity could have managed it effectively. Even without your involvement, the likelihood of casualties was low. Your exposure in this case has yielded limited advantages with notable costs.

speaker: Schorl
content: Given your high-profile status, we must make adjustments to your initially assigned security mission. You'll have to return to the command center for now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I agree that adjustments are necessary, but... do I really have to go back?

The mechanisms of Aurum Secretum remain unclear, and the monsters' sudden rampage suggests something ominous—a conspiracy, perhaps. Is this truly just an accident caused by unstable Aurum Secretum technology? Or...
Someone has deliberately staged this low-damage "accident," creating a situation with minimal losses, all for one purpose: to force you into the light.
[Outside the Screen]

On the other side of the screen, the Nirvana representative continues to grumble in frustration, while Parfait quietly observes the figure in the frame. After a long moment, she finally turns around and silences her friend with a smile.

speaker: Parfait
content: Patience, my friend. Didn't we agree that everything would be settled at my dinner party?

speaker: Parfait
content: I intend to explore the exhibition in depth over the coming days. Are there any delicacies that particularly tempt your palate? I've secured Chef Alba's exclusive participation this time, and I must admit, Fraser's culinary delights have piqued my curiosity as well.

speaker: Parfait
content: Let's look forward to the feast that awaits us that evening.
[At the Exhibition Hall]
You scan the venue and easily spot a distinctive man standing there, watching. As if he's been there for quite some time.
When he notices your gaze, the man gives a slight bow and smiles at you. Schorl trembles slightly, as if wanting to add something more.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Looks like I can't leave just yet. Someone's clearly inviting me over.
[VIP Lounge]

You follow the directions, stepping through the VIP corridor into the lounge before taking a seat at the negotiation table. Across from you sits the Fraser advisor, Adelaide Campbell. Behind him, a row of Outlands officials stand motionless, their faces obscured.

You're alone, with only the minimalist guard-type Schorl sent by Paradeisos hidden in your coat pocket. Over a dozen cameras watch from the walls, their unblinking lenses feeding live to DisCity Public Security headquarters.
—You know they are aware of all this. This is DisCity's home turf, and Adelaide himself knows it well. His friendly smile never wavers as he gazes at you.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Thank you for your assistance, Chief ${PlayerName}, and please accept my apologies for the trouble our delegation has caused you.

speaker: Adelaide
content: After such extensive travels, their exhaustion was understandable. Combine that with the language barriers, and occasional mishaps became inevitable. Your security intervention was most fortunate. I've long admired your professional reputation and have been looking forward to making your acquaintance.

speaker: Adelaide
content: But you don't seem to trust me.

That's only natural after the 9th Agency recently busted several bribed Eastside councilors who were helping Quinn infiltrate Hypercube transportation networks. Quinn's president, Eirene, turned out to be a Fraser operative hiding her identity, with her full name being <color=#fb9259>Eirene Campbell</color>. You've seen her methods firsthand.
Now, a Fraser advisor from the Campbell family specifically invites you here under the banner of the Great Expo. Clearly, he isn't looking to make friends. Not at a time like this.

speaker: Option
options: And you don't seem you're simply passing by.

speaker: Adelaide
content: I'm merely here as a civilian advisor. The Fraser ambassador is meeting with DisCity's officials, and since I'm not among the invited, I thought I'd take this opportunity to look around.

speaker: Adelaide
content: I understand that explanation may not fully alleviate your concerns. Allow me to be perfectly clear, then.
As he speaks, he draws a photograph from inside his coat and slides it toward you.
You recognize the face in the photograph, and the realization strikes like a fist to the chest.
[Photo of Hella and Hypatia]

speaker: Adelaide
content: Ah, I suppose you recognize the people in this photo? Excellent. That gives us quite a lot to discuss.

speaker: Option
options: ...What do you want to talk about?

content: Schorl emits an imperceptible flash of light, a silent reminder for you to steady yourself. But your breath still quickens, your heart hammering against your chest, each beat echoing through your skull like a war drum.

speaker: Adelaide
content: I'd like to talk about this remarkable girl. She left behind her home and family to journey alone, enduring countless hardships. And despite her youth, she had to stand firm against an Apostle in the very eye of the ash storm.

speaker: Adelaide
content: While it pains me to witness her struggles, I can't help but feel joy knowing how rapidly she has grown with each trial.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Who could have imagined that timid child, always hiding behind her siblings, would grow into the most reliable Aurum Secretum researcher, revered as a true scientific visionary? As her brother, I could not be prouder.

speaker: Adelaide
content: My lovely little sister, <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>, of course.
He points to a face in the photograph—someone you have never seen before. Not Hella, but the blonde girl beside her.

speaker: Adelaide
content: She is the youngest in our family, yet the most conscientious, forever burdened by others' expectations. Our lineage demands she upholds its legacy, refugees look to her for compassion, and these turbulent times require her to wield wisdom, power, and courage... And through it all, she has never faltered. Such dedication, wouldn't you agree?

speaker: Adelaide
content: This marks her first true friendship. See how her face blossoms with joy. Admittedly, I find her bewildered tears and the fearful glances she gives me equally endearing... though I must say, she really should smile more often at her age.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Ah, by the way, my sister's new friend is a Sinner from MBCC. You must be acquainted with her, I presume? Hypa invited her to visit Fraser, and they were likely going to celebrate a birthday together. Regrettably, my DisCity business trip coincides perfectly to make me miss the occasion.

speaker: Adelaide
content: However, this trip does offer one compensation—the opportunity to reunite with another wayward sister of mine. <color=#fb9259>Eirene Campbell</color>, Quinn's president and, as I'm told, another acquaintance of yours?

speaker: Adelaide
content: Eirene seems to hold you in remarkably high regard. Makes me quite envious, frankly. When I paid my visit yesterday, I didn't earn so much as a smile.

speaker: Adelaide
content: By the way, Chief, if I might ask, what DisCity gifts would you suggest for younger siblings? I've been browsing the exhibition, yet I find myself quite indecisive. Let me tell you about their personalities first...
A long time has passed...

speaker: Adelaide
content: Thank you for your thoughtful suggestions. I've taken note of each one. They're most appreciated.

speaker: Adelaide
content: My father is a man of wandering affections who follows his every whim. But because of that, I've been blessed with many siblings, each precious, each deserving of love. And I cherish them dearly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Now I completely understand why your siblings tend to avoid you.
Schorl trembles ever so slightly, and you immediately understand the unspoken message.

speaker: Option
options: But surely an advisor like you wouldn't have invited me here just for casual conversation, right?

speaker: Adelaide
content: Ah, my apologies. I didn't mean to take up your time. It's just you strike me as someone who values family as I do, so I couldn't help but ramble on.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Then let's get back to business.
Adelaide's gaze, smile, and posture remain completely unchanged, yet somehow, everything about him feels different.

speaker: Adelaide
content: My sister Hypatia is an expert in Aurum Secretum research. With Fraser's support, she's pioneering the development of this Mania-resonant metal, hoping to use Aurum Secretum to steer the Apostles of Ashes away from populated areas and shield human settlements from these calamities.

speaker: Adelaide
content: The exhibit of the people you just protected is a practical application of her research. Whenever there's a technological breakthrough, Fraser actively promotes it to all shelters. In today's Hypercube shortage, this helps people find alternative ways to protect themselves.

speaker: Adelaide
content: However, we've recently uncovered a disturbing development: our Aurum Secretum—designed for protection—has been corrupted and weaponized. Someone is now using it to forcibly resonate with the Apostles of Ashes, intending to harness their malevolent power for sinister purposes.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Chief, I can see this matter weighs equally on you. You've been investigating the Outland Sinner who attacked the former Speaker of DisCity, believing the mysterious power the perpetrator used is connected to our Aurum Secretum, correct?

speaker: Adelaide
content: Please, don't hesitate to ask whatever you need. I'm fully aware of the suspicions surrounding Fraser, and you have my word that I'll be as transparent as possible to earn your trust and assist with your investigation. This is to prove our innocence and preserve the peace between our two city-states.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Whenever you're ready.

speaker: Option
options: The connection between Aurum Secretum and the Apostles of Ashes

speaker: ${PlayerName}
