She doesn't answer you directly. In her eyes, you see a flicker of gratitude, a touch of regret, a hint of apology—and unwavering determination.

speaker: Jasmine
content: Thank you for pitying me, for not killing me right when we met, and for letting me take this stage. Now... I must complete my unfinished performance. So please... don't interrupt again.

She pays no more attention to the soldiers writhing in agony, their weapons shattered, their threat extinguished. Her eyes sweep the battlefield before locking onto a distant point—her gaze sharp, unyielding.
In that direction stands the heavily fortified FAC command motorcade.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: What, is she targetting...?!

speaker: FAC Commander
content: She's targeting the Commander-in-Chief!!! Protect him!! Don't let her get close! Aah—!!

It's too late. She moves like a storm—cutting through resistance, closing the distance in seconds. In one fluid motion, she leaps onto the vehicle, her blade carving open the roof. Through the jagged breach, she stares down, unblinking, as if confirming a final memory across years of time.
Then her face twists into a manic grin, a terrifying blend of joy and fury—she found him. Finally found him.

speaker: Jasmine
content: ...It really is you!
Schorl strikes with deadly precision at her flank, driving her into a relentless dance of evasion until she leaps from the roof of the vehicle. The instant her feet touch the ground—

You unleash the prohibition once more, this time at point-blank range. Spikes of light spear through her, shackling her body and will. Before those frenzied blades can claim control, you surge forward, pinning her down, wrestling her wrists, and firmly securing those twin blades. Then—
[Release the shackles]

The shackles drive deep through both your hands, firmly binding them together while also nailing down those blood-soaked blades. Schorl's voice cuts through the chaos yet fails to reach your ears with clarity. Then, like a nightmare given form, corruption crashes against your shackles, forcing you to use all your strength to suppress it.
...Oh right, Jasmine is still pinned down by you and your shackles. You should probably say something to her.

speaker: Option
options: This way there's nothing to worry about.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You've been possessed by these blades. I'll keep both you and your weapon in control.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Letting you back on the battlefield was my mistake. Now, no matter who you're after, it's time to go back to the Bureau.

speaker: Jasmine
content: Don't—let go! It's dangerous!
Jasmine stares at you, her eyes filled with terror—an expression you've never seen on her face before. She struggles to break free from your grip, desperately trying to make you let go.

Meanwhile, the blades in your hands tremble violently, sending pain through your nerves as they unleash a torrent of chaotic hallucinations. Fragments of flesh, thunderous roars, blood, agonized screams, and putrid stench begin to seep into your mind. Amid all the madness, you hear it: an irresistible voice.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: She's an Outland spy... She fooled you... A murderous criminal... Look how many have died because of her, think of how many more she plans to kill.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: This is war. Remember your position. Enemies deserve no mercy. Kill her. Kill her... Kill her...

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Who knows how many times she's wanted to slit your throat!
female_content: ...Kill her, be the last one standing, kill them all... or they'll do the same to you...

content: You hear gunfire and wailing cries, alongside gleeful music and celebration songs. Hell and festivity shatter and merge into one. Every FAC soldier transforms into a pitch-black butcher but also prey to be killed—this is the world one sees when gripping the blades.
In your eyes, Jasmine's face has contorted into something monstrous, her features savage and fierce. You wonder... how does she see you now?
When you both grip the weapon capable of killing each other, when the same deadly enchantment claims you, when your gazes lock in burning intensity—what thoughts break through then?
[Flashback] Display the lap-lying small CG, blank screen for 1 second, then return

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Does our promise... still count?

speaker: Jasmine
content: ...I never forgot...
The murderous glint in her eyes softens. She leans closer, her breath warm against your skin. With deliberate tenderness, she licks the blood from the corner of your eye.

speaker: Jasmine
content: I like our promise a lot, and I'm doing everything I can to keep it. I want to finish this quickly—then go back to your side, and go anywhere with you.

speaker: Jasmine
content: But if I can't make it back, don't blame me, okay? It's war, after all...

speaker: Jasmine
content: The most beautiful promises are always the easiest to break.

speaker: Jasmine
content: ...And I've been trapped for too long.

This is your final moment together, though in reality, it lasts barely a minute. Broken weapons—guns, blades, axes—rain down from above. Before you can even grasp what's happening, Jasmine awakens. And just like that, she's back on the battlefield.

She lets you take her hands—only to hook her legs around your waist in one fluid motion. With a sharp twist of her hips, she flips you effortlessly, hurling you aside. The instant you're clear, a steel rod spears through her calf.

speaker: Jasmine
content: Thank you, ${PlayerName}. Because of you, I can almost believe... that not everyone's blood is cold, that kindness still exists in this world.

You tumble across the ground, the world spinning in a dizzying blur. Before you can regain your footing, a massive metal plate hurtles toward you with terrifying speed, pinning you to the ground. You no longer have the strength to break free.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Now's our chance! Pin her down!! Get Chief back!

speaker: Schorl
content: ...This should keep you safe for now. My priority now is neutralizing the out-of-control Sinner. I'll return as soon as possible.
The battle erupts once more.

The metal plate shields you from stray bullets, but it also steals your vision. All you have now is sound: the relentless staccato of gunfire and the earth-shaking collisions of Mania-fueled powers. Jasmine's laughter is gone, swallowed by the violence. The only way to trace her now is through the fury and agony erupting in her wake.
Before the shackles completely break apart, you hear her final cry.

speaker: Jasmine
content: I have no interest in killing people, but... you're not really human, are you?! You're nothing but DisCity's blade!

speaker: Jasmine
content: So DIE!!

Thanks to thorough security measures taken in advance and detailed intelligence from Fraser regarding Outlands extremists, the attack on the closing ceremony has been promptly contained, with all contingencies effectively addressed. Despite significant losses in weapons and equipment, as well as numerous personnel injuries...

At least DisCity has suffered zero casualties.

On the attackers' side, all assassins have been eliminated. Unfortunately, every captured extremist took their own life on the spot.

Only the Outlands Sinner who posed the greatest threat was successfully subdued through a coordinated effort, bound along with her weapon, and secured.
She will be transported to EDGE as a valuable research specimen.
[CG: Jasmine defeated, with narration as she's carried onto a vehicle]

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: It's over... finally over... medics... quick...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: The enemy can no longer fight. But watch the weapon—the blades must not be separated from her until the restraining device arrives.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Lock her down... Lock her down...
She's hoisted up by armored soldiers, like a fallen one being carried off the battlefield. In that final moment, her hollow eyes lock onto yours.
Until the very moment the door closes, she seems to smile at you.

speaker: Jasmine
content: Our promise... I'm sorry...

speaker: Jasmine
content: ...Don't mind it...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Chief...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'm fine. We'll deal with it after everything is over.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where is the Fraser delegation? Weren't they attacked as well?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What about Adelaide Campbell? If it really was "radical extremists" attacking, wouldn't the Fraser delegation be in danger too? Was only the ambassador killed?

speaker: Schorl
content: Yes. The Outlanders' camp outside the city was hit in a coordinated attack. FAC has since stabilized the situation, and most personnel have been accounted for. However, Advisor Campbell remains missing—initial reports suggest a possible kidnapping.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They gave us the intel ahead of time, but they still took heavy losses...

speaker: Schorl
content: Unfortunately, the enemy has retreated into a storm zone covered by a chaotic Mania field to evade pursuit. However, there is some positive news—the severe sandstorms that persisted for nearly a month have finally weakened, allowing us to enter the storm zone and continue tracking them.

speaker: Schorl
content: Luck favors you, Chief.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Luck...? But I recall that one of Aurum Secretum's functions is to adjust the Mania field on a large scale, guiding the movement of the Tide of Ashes...

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Target area secured! The enemy is cornered in the eastern section of the camp, still heavily armed.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Chief, Advisor Campbell remains in hostile custody, being held hostage by the rebels. We can't risk a direct assault.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Copy that. Please be careful!
The Paradeisos triangle, small and silent, floats through the area, probing every corner to find a path. In moments, it unravels a route that leads deeper inside.

You step inside and find the corpses of several Outlanders strewn across the floor. Their bodies have been ravaged by corruption, the damage so severe that it's impossible to tell whether they were Fraser officials or the extremists who took them hostage.
Amidst the ruins, you at last come face to face with the "kidnapped" representative. He stands unnervingly calm amid the devastation, a faint smile playing on his lips, his garments immaculate.

speaker: Adelaide
content: It's been a while, Chief ${PlayerName}. I heard the commotion at the closing ceremony has been settled. Did you come all this way to rescue me?
You don't answer. Instead, you walk toward him and draw your gun.

speaker: Schorl
content: Chief, stay calm. Let's find out what really happened first.

You draw your gun and fire several shots at him, but before the bullets can find their mark, the contamination at his feet writhes upward. The shots strike nothing but twisting darkness, and Adelaide stands untouched.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: See? This is much faster. Now the real question is—how did this guy pass the Sinner inspection? Where did his power come from?
Schorl performs a quick scan.

speaker: Schorl
content: He is certainly not a Sinner. Even in that moment just now, he did not activate any internal power.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...Could this be some unknown kind of Outland technology? The Mania field is interfering with communications. I can't contact headquarters or synchronize analysis data.
Adelaide doesn't answer. He just smiles at you.

speaker: Adelaide
content: How rare to see you so unsettled, Chief. What troubles you? Wasn't today's victory over the Outland extremists worthy of celebration?

speaker: Adelaide
content: Ah, I see now. This is about that dancer. She went to the closing ceremony, didn't she? Is she dead? Did you personally see to it?
You look directly into his eyes and respond, each word measured and deliberate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You brought her to the Great Expo. She was obsessed with the closing ceremony because she thought FAC was the former DisCity military—the ones who started the war—and she was hellbent on revenge... And you're the one who put it all in her head, aren't you?
He smiles resignedly.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Heh... Chief, surely you of all people understand. You oversaw the treatment plan—you must have known Jasmine was beyond recovery. Years of unrelenting contamination, the ravages of war... her mind was already fractured beyond salvation.

speaker: Adelaide
content: As a civilian, she was never bound by that weapon's influence—no indiscriminate slaughter, no blind obedience. She journeyed alone to WhiteSands, selecting her targets with purpose... Nothing short of a miracle, really. I merely offered my assistance. After all, who wouldn't wish to see such a dream realized?

speaker: Adelaide
content: What a shame. Had there been no war—had DisCity never forged those blades—she might have remained a clever, carefree dancer. You know her far better than I... don't you?

speaker: Schorl
content: Chief, don't debate morality with the enemy. His only intent is to sway you. Stay composed and ready yourself for battle.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I understand... but this bastard has no right to say a word about them to me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Jelena, Jasmine, and all those who attacked the closing ceremony. You knew those people didn't stand a chance. You knew their deaths wouldn't change a thing. But you pushed them toward revenge anyway.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You deliberately fed their information to DisCity, selling them out just to gain DisCity's trust. All for that absurd plan of yours. You'd do anything to get Nirvana's technology, wouldn't you?
You raise your gun.

speaker: Option
options: Both you and Fraser will pay for this.

speaker: Adelaide
content: You seek to hold Fraser accountable? Consider the cost—such a path would bring ruin to both our city-states.

speaker: Adelaide
content: The Fraser delegation arrived with intelligence, Aurum Secretum, and sincere intentions for peace. They have indirectly fueled Eastside's booming stock market, allowing prosperity to spread. Who could doubt the virtue of such an outcome?

speaker: Adelaide
content: Both DisCity and Fraser have their advocates for unification—Nirvana on one side, Fraser's pro-DisCity faction on the other. It is only among the lower classes that hatred obscures reason. The enlightened elites, however, have long transcended such... parochial loyalties.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Consider this: Mutual suspicion breeds only war, while cooperation revitalizes resources—enough to harvest the world itself. Which path do you suppose people will choose? In the end, they will believe what they wish to believe.

speaker: Adelaide
content: The contract shall be signed—Nirvana has no recourse but compliance. Let us celebrate the union of the two great city-states and the dawn of a new era. And now... allow me to present a shared adversary, one to fortify the bonds between you all.
[CG: Handshake]
He extends his hand toward you—this time with his left hand—his face twisted into an abyssal smile, brimming with boundless malice.

speaker: Adelaide
content: I am Adelaide Campbell—collaborator with the Underground, architect of the Outlands' corruption, the hand that twisted Aurum Secretum and delivered sinister power to vengeful souls. And now... I intend to drive a wedge between DisCity and Fraser.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Am I not what you've been seeking all along?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You're a saboteur sent by the Underground?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or are you throwing yourself under the bus just to clear Fraser's name in all this? Like how you sold out those Outlanders who came for revenge?
He flashes an approving smile at you.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Fraser is far too shrewd to risk open war with DisCity. The Senate does not act rashly, nor would they be so careless as to leave you evidence, unless...

speaker: Adelaide
content: DisCity has grown so weak it's no longer a threat. Crushing you would demand so little effort, so... why not indulge?
[Small CG 2]
A bright red mark flares to life on his hand. In the next breath, a gust of contamination surges toward you. With lightning speed, Schorl throws itself in front of you and your squad.

speaker: Schorl
content: Fall back!

It deploys a small barrier field to protect you all, but in doing so, fails to avoid a strange spike hidden within the storm. The spike collides with Schorl's outer shell, emitting an eerie resonance. Then, from within the perfect triangle, you hear a disturbing crackle of rogue electrical currents.

speaker: Schorl
content: ——*%%@#¥&——interference¥#@&——data corrupted——storage damaged————Chi**%¥——ef——maintain... ra**￥#%...tionality...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's wrong?! Answer me!

But this is your final exchange. Like a failing system, its barrier shudders and flickers before collapsing entirely—forced into a desperate reboot. Now, it can barely sustain its most fundamental function: shielding you, and only you, at close range. From this moment onward, the black triangle that has buzzed incessantly at your side for nearly two weeks falls utterly silent.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Signal interference... data corruption... This isn't Aurum Secretum's power. Don't tell me...
[Flash briefly: Moore Small CG]
[Back to Small CG 2]

speaker: Adelaide
content: Your internal vulnerability is plain to see. Competing interests paralyze progress, each faction too busy guarding its own spoils to notice the rot. Why waste bullets when greed is enough to do most of the work? Today's DisCity is truly riddled with flaws—decayed and fragile.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Now then, I'd like to proceed with another test... I'm most curious to witness the true measure of your worth—as DisCity's "secret weapon."
[Power Eruption CG]

The Mania seeping from his left hand suddenly blooms into a flower. The contamination swells, twisting and writhing as it expands, weaving together before finally coalescing into several monstrous abominations. You know this aura—
Constrained by Aurum Secretum devices, they are several ferocious Apostles of Ashes.
This battle drags on without end.

You're no stranger to fighting the Tide of Ashes, and the battle plans have long been prepared with FAC. You've seized the initiative, outmaneuvering and overwhelming the enemy at every turn. Yet despite your efforts, no one expected their sheer numbers—hours of relentless combat, and still, victory remains out of reach.

Though small in scale, the Apostles spill endlessly from the Mania flower in the man's left hand—as if a rift had torn open, bridging this world to hell. Is this the power of the Underground? And how many more of these "flowers" lie waiting?

speaker: Adelaide
content: Not many, rest assured. Even THAT ONE cannot bestow gifts endlessly upon others.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Only four Sages wielding this power would suffice to bring you considerable... inconvenience.

He sees right through your anxiety, answering with effortless calm. A thin crimson barrier divides him from the battlefield, shielding him as he observes the chaos beyond. Yet his gaze lingers on you, strangely alight with admiration.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Hmm... impressive. DisCity's resilience is not yet extinguished, it seems. This will only harden the Senate's resolve.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Nirvana will have their full support—whatever means are required to secure the West District mine. Once the Hypercubes are under their control, a new order will follow.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So if you can't take DisCity by force, you're just going to push this "two-city alliance" instead?

speaker: Adelaide
content: This has always been one of the advised strategies.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Looking at the current securities market, Nirvana's stock price has far outpaced all competitors. They've undeniably become the darling of the market. This plan is nearly complete.

You could gather evidence against them, investigate them, and unravel the conspiracy piece by piece, but you can also imagine the countless obstacles lying in wait. Worse yet, you'd never know what Nirvana might do to the West District mine while you're caught up in that struggle.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Your internal vulnerability is plain to see. Competing interests paralyze progress, each faction too busy guarding its own spoils to notice the rot. Why waste bullets when greed is enough to do most of the work? Today's DisCity is truly riddled with flaws—decayed and fragile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You're right. I'm not that familiar with DisCity's high-society games. If you managed to get that contract signed, my friends and I would definitely be on the back foot.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: From what I've heard, these financial games are all about surprises and thrills... Not really my thing, but maybe someone else can.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As you said, "Competing interests paralyze progress, each faction too busy guarding its own spoils." It's DisCity's flaw... but in a way, maybe that's what keeps it running.
[News]

speaker: Newscast
content: Breaking news rocks the city this hour as terror strikes again. Outlands extremists have launched a brazen attack on today's closing ceremony with hundreds wounded and dozens feared dead. The Commander-in-Chief's motorcade was also targeted.

speaker: Newscast
content: Renowned stock market guru Parfait has vanished under mysterious circumstances, failing to appear at a scheduled high-profile dinner. The unexpected disappearance has directly impacted Nirvana's technology acquisition and West District mine activation plans.

speaker: Newscast
content: What could make her walk away from such a golden opportunity? Was it a loss of confidence in the project? Or is there more to this story? And the bigger question—after disappearing without a trace... where is she now?

speaker: Newscast
content: ...What? Parfait has been found? She's on a helicopter fleeing the city? A deliberate escape—what's really going on here??

speaker: Newscast
content: What?!!! She was harboring an Outlander?
[Transition] (Aerial night view of DisCity)

speaker: Sibilla
content: Th-this is...??

The wind shrieks around the helicopter as it carves through the sky, weaving between skyscrapers before sweeping over WhiteSands. Gritty sand pelts the thundering rotors, the relentless barrage crackling like gunfire.
Sibilla stares wide-eyed at the unfamiliar scene before her, while the woman who whisked her aboard grips the control stick, her face alight with unrestrained excitement.

speaker: Parfait
content: Oh! Don't look so surprised, my friend. I once took helicopter lessons on a private island in West DisCity. Let's be real, what's life without a little thrill?

speaker: Sibilla
content: No, that's not what I meant. Where are we going?

speaker: Parfait
content: Isn't it obvious? Away from DisCity, of course.
<size=36><color=#7683a2>...Run away?</color></size>
The word strikes a powerful chord within her. In an instant, haunting memories flood back—death, fear, loneliness, suffocation—awakened one after another.
[Series of flashbacks with white flashes]

speaker: Adelaide
content: They operate under clever disguises—the Great Expo personnel, merchant caravans, and even Outland refugees—all to infiltrate DisCity, using a calculated blend of truth and lies to cultivate sympathy and trust.

speaker: Sheriff
content: Screw off! Who's got time for beggar trash like you?

speaker: Passerby B
content: Pfft, why'd you stop the act? At least be professional with your sob story. Go on, keep it up.

speaker: Arienna
content: They don't understand our suffering—they can't even imagine it.

speaker: Arienna
content: People living in a different world simply cannot see our pain.

<size=36>...Run?</size>

<size=45>...Run.</size>

<size=52>—RUN!!!</size>
Since the day she set foot on the path of exile, that word has clung to her like a nightmare.
So, she's long since gotten used to it.
The answer is there all along.

She gazes at the boundless expanse of WhiteSands, at the calamities raging on the horizon, and at the battlefield still burning nearby—while her homeland and everyone she knows remain thousands of miles away. Sibilla clutches the protective charm tightly, the same one that has stayed with her through every step of her journey.

speaker: Sibilla
content: I... don't want to run anymore.

speaker: Sibilla
content: I'm not afraid to die, and I don't want to run away. This isn't how it ends. Turn around! We go back! There's still so much left to do. I'm not giving up! There has to be another way! It's not over yet! Let me go back—
The night glass reflects Sibilla's expression, and Parfait watches, satisfaction glinting in her eyes.
Even across vast distances and divergent paths, those of true golden quality will always shine—and DisCity's stock market guru never fails to praise her own eye for talent.

speaker: Parfait
content: Haha, running away? I never said so. I see immense value in you. Why would I ever let that go to waste?
She grips the control stick tightly.

speaker: Parfait
content: Hold on tight, my Outland friend. Now, Parfait Medici is about to put on a grand show.
A swarm of drones has closed in on the helicopter, their loudspeakers blaring relentless messages.

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: We found her! Parfait—!! Are you okay?! Say something if you can hear us! Stock Market Guru—!! Quick, get the cameras on her now! See what's happening inside the helicopter—Huh?!!

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: We've got footage from inside the cockpit. That pilot... It's actually Parfait herself! No kidnapping, no coercion... she's flying the helicopter out of DisCity, ditching her own dinner party and investments. This makes no sense! Why would she do this?!

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: Wait, there's someone else on the aircraft... an Outlander?? And looks like a homeless beggar??

speaker: Thalia
content: I know that Outlander... She showed up at the Great Expo. Could it be...

speaker: Thalia
content: Parfait got some critical information from her?
The longer Thalia contemplates the situation, the more intriguing it seems. A slow, knowing smile curves across her lips.

speaker: Thalia
content: Perfect! Looks like you've finally found the key to getting attention in DisCity. How lucky! Now, let me just... add a little spark to the moment. You better not waste this opportunity!

With a covert flick of her power, her viewer count soars to staggering heights, while explosive comments surge across the screen in an unrelenting tide. No one can throttle the news related to the stock market guru, after all.
[Comments explode across the screen]

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: Huh? Wait—Parfait's standing up. Did she just switch to autopilot?!! Ladies and gentlemen, Parfait has spotted us! She's coming out and she's... she's trying to wave us off?

speaker: Parfait
content: Go away! GO AWAY!! Stop following us!

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: What's happening?! Parfait looks extremely agitated. She's desperately trying to shield that Outlander? It's like... she's hiding something. Could it be...

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: Could that Outlander actually be connected to the Nirvana-Fraser collaboration?! What kind of bombshell does she have that's big enough to make even the stock market guru ditch her own dinner party and investment plans? This can't be just some minor leak... it's got to be massive profits, groundbreaking secrets, market-shaking news—oh my God!!

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: Outlander!! Hey! Say something, Outlander!!
Before Sibilla can even react, Parfait lunges forward to block the camera, shouting loudly.

speaker: Parfait
content: No comment! No interviews!! This has nothing to do with the stock market! She has no connection to Nirvana or Fraser! Go away!!
Parfait's agitation only ignites everyone's curiosity, making them even more convinced of their own suspicions!

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: Aha! Just look at that reaction! I was right—this Outlander is definitely sitting on a huge story!

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: Hey, friend from the Outlands, don't be afraid. We're nothing like Parfait! We're here to help you, and every investor in DisCity has your back! Just tell us what happened—why did she kidnap you?! This is about Nirvana's investments, right?

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: Tell us!! Say it loud!! Everyone's listening!

speaker: Parfait
content: No comment! No interviews!! She's mine, don't follow us! Or I'll attack! I—

speaker: Parfait
content: Ahhh!!
[Money Scattering CG]

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: All... all DisCity investors... you're not seeing things... What we're filming right now... will shock the entire city...

speaker: Pursuing Media
content: <color=#fb9259><size=52>SHE'S RAINING HYPERCUBES!!!! WOAHHHH—</color></size>

speaker: Parfait
content: My private mine—my golden opportunity—all gone—!
Sibilla stares, mouth wide open, as Parfait theatrically beats her chest and stamps her feet. But beneath the dramatic display, she catches a witty gleam in the stock market guru's eyes.
[Flashback] On the helicopter, before the hypercube rain commotion

speaker: Parfait
content: You see, Sibilla, this is what DisCity people want to hear. Understand them well enough, and you'll have their hearts in your grip, just like how you've got that little bit of leverage against me.

speaker: Parfait
content: Look outside. If you can cross such a vast desert, you can certainly breach the walls around people's hearts—you just need the right tricks.

speaker: Parfait
content: People may not share their joys and sorrows, but understanding? That's a two-way street. And the truly clever ones take the first step. After all, isn't that how you steer the game?

speaker: Parfait
content: Now, my Outland friend, think about what kind of story you're going to tell. Don't get lost in telling your story—tell one that captivates all of DisCity.
[Big CG: Smiling Parfait]

Beneath her theatrical demeanor, Parfait lifts her hand slightly, a single half-lidded eye glinting from the shadows. Just as the people of DisCity believe that wealth is measured in currency—which allows her to fabricate "money"—so too can she maintain this fabrication, as long as more come to believe survival itself equals Hypercubes.
It is enough to satisfy the drone cameras. Her gamble has paid off.

speaker: Parfait
content: I've placed my bet—all in on you. Now, my friend, the ball's in your court. Still got enough breath to blow that whistle?

speaker: Sibilla
content: ...Of course. Thank you.
[Black Screen]
Sibilla takes a deep breath, never before having received this much attention.

speaker: Sibilla
content: ...Fraser never developed Aurum Secretum to protect civilians! The whole "partnership" is just a scam to steal Nirvana's Hypercube mining technology!!

speaker: Sibilla
content: They're stealing your technology! To make a Black Ring! To produce their own Hypercubes!!

speaker: Sibilla
content: Yes, Fraser has already built their own Black Ring! They're secretly producing Hypercubes and planning to completely replace you!
The news spreads like wildfire. AI-generated headlines flood the network, their ripple effects surging even faster across every field.
<size=60>"Nirvana Brutally Deceived by Fraser"</size>
<size=60>"Outland Black Ring Returns: Humanity Faces Extinction!"</size>
<size=60>"Crisis and Opportunity for DisCity—New Hypercubes!"</size>
<size=60>"Shocking Revelation: Why Has Investment Guru Parfait Abandoned DisCity!"</size>
<size=60>"Nirvana Stocks in Free Fall: The Shocking Source of Mysterious Short Selling!"</size>
<color=#fb9259><size=80>At 7:48 PM, with only 12 minutes left until market close, Nirvana stocks plummet!!</size></color>
[The Silent Incense]

- So we got played? Fraser had their own mine this whole time and still tried to screw us over for our money and tech?! - I told you from the start. Working with Fraser was like a cure worse than the disease. That intel from the extremists is useless the whole time. - There are Hypercubes out there too? And nobody thought to mention that in any of our meetings? I poured resources into Outland transport for nothing. So what, am I just a joke now? - Relax... Fraser might think they're being smart, but what about their stake in DisCity? You really think they'd cut ties completely? Is that even possible?

- And what about Parfait? She slipped away clean, while we're stuck cleaning up her mess? - That woman definitely knows about this information all along! - She never makes a move unless she's sure. That clean of an escape... She's probably already cut a deal with Campbell to short us together. - Hump, what a "master of credit"! Can anyone still contact Campbell? Whatever it takes, bring her back here!

- You're still arguing? What about the new mine? If we don't force activation now, who will still take Nirvana seriously? - Get your men on PR immediately! Just tell people Nirvana holds a higher-purity Hypercube refining method and Fraser's is just a knockoff that can't handle mass production! - Look, Parfait's gone, stocks are crashing, and the public's going wild. At this point, we'd better start figuring out our explanations.

speaker: Sillage
content: ...Heh... hahahahaha! You really are fearless, aren't you? I like that!

speaker: Sillage
content: While your "believers" hunt for Furor, weave them another story of wealth. Convince them it's real. You've done it before. You'll do it again.

speaker: Sillage
content: Just as I've believed you wouldn't disappoint, and you would keep surprising me. Today proved it delightfully.

speaker: Sillage
content: Now, my dear Campbell friend, what will you do next?
Several people come charging in, kicking open the Executive Committee's door with a single blow.

speaker: Nirvana Representative
content: No! I refuse to accept this!! Parfait would never do such a thing! She must have been taken hostage!! Rescue her first, then we'll talk!

speaker: Max King
content: Be patient, Representative. This is no small matter. In DisCity, Nirvana has more enemies than you realize. For the sake of your corporation, you must endure this.
The new Speaker surveys the room, having to make a conscious effort this time to maintain his composure and hold his smile back.

speaker: Max King
content: It is with profound regret that I must declare the Aurum Secretum collaboration is hereby suspended. The cabinet will oversee and verify all subsequent investigations.

speaker: Max King
content: Chief Lang, Chief Lotherlon, you may proceed.

speaker: Lotherlon
content: No problem!

speaker: Lang
content: ...Hmph, not bad.
Little does anyone know that the Speaker of the City Council still holds a message from ${PlayerName}, delivered to him that night by Miss Stewart.
—An invitation from someone else.

The irrational bubble has overflowed the golden chalice. This time, Parfait's Dinner Party seeks to be more refreshing, to spread happiness to even greater numbers. So... Would you honor me with your presence at this exclusive, grand short-selling soirée?
You're welcome to bring a few friends along, if you'd like.
Even someone like him still has a few friends, and those who hold a grudge against Nirvana are hardly scarce.
[Scene Change] Battlefield
Of course, you wouldn't know about any of this. After all, you don't currently have access to communication networks.
But as Adelaide's expression shifts from focus to surprise, then softens into a sigh as he lowers his gaze, you suspect that your side has claimed victory.
I've got all the time in the world—whether it's here in this fight, or after I take you back and slowly wear down whoever's pulling your strings.
...I will win.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Indeed, you've prevailed. I concede without reservation.

speaker: Adelaide
content: I concede defeat, utterly and without reservation. Your strategy is impeccable: precise intelligence, meticulous preparation, and execution timed to perfection. It is truly an elegant and masterful victory. I knew from the start I never stood a chance.

speaker: Adelaide
content: I must say, I'm rather pleased to have secured this much time.

speaker: Max King
content: In light of recent events, the relevant authorities will be auditing Nirvana stock transactions. Additionally, details regarding the West District mine negotiations are being finalized and will be released shortly.

speaker: Max King
content: This will not impede the mining development process. Moving forward, the new cabinet of DisCity will lead efforts to restart negotiations between Nirvana and the West District Executive Committee, ensuring cooperation is conducted with transparency, fairness, and active engagement.

speaker: Gracelyn
content: Hot damn! Hell yeah! I knew those bastards were up to no good!

speaker: Harry
content: Could it be Parfait... Haha, no way!
[Bureau]
As people around her react with shock or gleeful celebration, Elvira stands in the corner, watching the news.

speaker: Elvira
content: …Is it really over… just like this…?
Adelaide doesn't answer. Instead, from his pocket, he retrieves a pocket watch—delicate gold roses inlaid across its surface. With a deft flick, he opens it, his lips curving into a subtle smile.
15 minutes left.

The Mania barrier shielding him is fracturing, cracks spiderwebbing across its surface, creeping wider with every second. Yet Adelaide doesn't flinch—doesn't even glance up. He remains utterly detached from the chaos beyond, as if your words have lost all meaning.
He shifts to a topic he clearly favors, his words unfolding in a slow, leisurely rhythm. Yet beneath the calm, there's something unsettling in his voice.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Let me tell you more about my siblings.

speaker: Adelaide
content: My family, the Campbells, has many children. For years now, my younger siblings have eyed one another with suspicion, fighting amongst themselves. It grieves me more than I can say.

speaker: Adelaide
content: We are bound by blood, the closest of kin. In this lonely world, we have only each other to light the way. And yet... how did it come to this?

speaker: Adelaide
content: In time, I came to understand my father's design—he seeks the finest heir, and so he pits his children against one another, a crucible of survival. But when he dies... so too will these foolish rules. Love and peace will naturally reclaim their rightful place in the Campbell household.
The Underground cooperator glances at his pocket watch, as if counting down the seconds, unshaken by death, or perhaps...
Everything has been prepared. Even his death won't alter the outcome.
As the realization dawns on you, a chill runs down your spine.

speaker: Option
options: ...Black Triangle, can you still receive orders?

speaker: Schorl
content: Beep—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Contact Paradeisos, EDGE, or that person who talked to me in your place... Codename 02, was it?

speaker: Along the path to the castle, four souls tread, with lightness in their steps.
content: Tell them something's wrong. Round up everyone from Fraser, no exceptions. Forget about diplomatic consequences. Do whatever it takes to get answers, and get them fast!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They've been planning this all along! The Great Expo, Aurum Secretum, Nirvana—none of it matters to them. Success or failure, those are never the real goal!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They've done something else behind our backs... Go now! Get answers!

speaker: Schorl
content: Buzz buzz buzz buzz—
After struggling for a moment, it emits a sound of failure.

speaker: Option
options: If it won't work here, go outside!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry about protecting me! Get out of the storm zone now! Find somewhere you can send a message. Tell EDGE there's something off with the Underground and Fraser!! The Great Expo is just a smokescreen they use to cover up something else. Hurry!
Schorl trembles briefly. It attempts to leave but returns to you. Against all reason, it activates its anti-Mania barrier, shielding you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't need your protection. You—
[Black Screen] 1.5s

EDGE Internal Meeting

In progress for 16 hours

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03</color>: The Mania Flux in the Outland territories are indeed abnormal. What's the Third Observatorium's conclusion? Still unable to confirm the cause of these fluctuations?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07</color>: That's asking too much. The Observatorium can only accurately monitor fields near its own anchor points. Fraser's territory is too far away. Pinpointing the precise location is never possible, especially since we have no auxiliary observation points in the area.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03</color>: What about 04? Nirvana has been vouching for him. We should be getting information by now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05</color>: He likely won't be able to attend. The securities market has collapsed, and Nirvana is in complete disarray.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05</color>: Also, I've heard an interesting piece of news, the same one that blew up Nirvana—
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05</color>: An Outlander vagrant claims that Fraser has orchestrated its own Black Ring.
[Scene Change] Parfait's Helicopter
Parfait continues humming a cheerful tune to celebrate their victory, while Sibilla seems lost in thought.
At some point without her noticing, the protective charm that had safeguarded her journey broke. The colorful beads have all scattered, leaving only a grayish-white thread hanging from her wrist.
In the final three minutes, an elite FAC squad arrives at the MBCC Chief's side under emergency orders to provide protection.
Upon arrival, they still believe everything is already firmly under the Chief's control.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: We've done it! MBCC's Sinner has suppressed them!!
However, the most perceptive Sinner has already sensed something amiss.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...This feeling is... Aargh!!
Intense contamination suddenly erupts, distorting all her senses and plunging her into darkness in an instant.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: What happened?!! The Sinner is under some unknown influence. Containment is failing. Quick, move in and suppress the enemy!
Fortunately, this isn't Hecate's first encounter with such contamination—she can endure it. But unfortunately, she recognizes its source all too well.
It's the same vile resonance she felt at Keylan Square, from the High Tower Black Ring, and when Chief's shackles touched the depths of the abyss that should never have been disturbed.
But... ${PlayerName} is right in front of her, and he clearly hasn't touched anything...
female_content: But... ${PlayerName} is right in front of her, and she clearly hasn't touched anything...

speaker: Hecate
content: No... this is not right... The contamination source isn't here, but somewhere far away... The enemy's goal, that man's target has always been...

speaker: Hecate
content: Hurry, protect Chief!!
[Scene Change]

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: No need to scan the entire area anymore. It's too difficult for the Observatorium and not accurate enough.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: Directly locate the observation points instead.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: Track all Sinners near Fraser whose positions are fixed by SHP-13's shackles. Their provocation of SHP-13 most likely serves this purpose.


<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: No need. It's already too late.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Change of strategy. There's only one priority now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Retrieve SHP-13. Use whatever means necessary to bring him back. I'm counting on all of you.
female_content:
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Change of strategy. There's only one priority now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Retrieve SHP-13. Use whatever means necessary to bring her back. I'm counting on all of you.

content: [Scene Change]
In the final minute, Adelaide's crimson barrier shatters at last. You want to strike—but your body refuses to obey.

You can no longer make out the black triangle or see your companions. Inside you, the shackles spill free in a torrent of unrestrained power. Despite being only steps away, even his face is lost to you now.
—Only his voice, infused with Mania, penetrates through your shackles, piercing deep into your soul.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: You must find this feeling unfamiliar, because you are strong. In the Outlands, I've seen too many people with fate's grip around their throats—way too many. I have grown accustomed to it.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: Don't grieve for Jasmine, nor rage against the people of Fraser. We are all brothers and sisters. Fate wraps its fingers around every throat equally—whether in the Outlands or DisCity, whether good or evil, whether you or I.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: Whether death has meaning is not for us to decide. Even if Fraser never stirred up hatred, those poor souls would still march one after another down the same path. Had you stood there yourself, you would understand—this is a path of sacrifice that cannot be diverted.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: Dear Shepherd, we cannot reclaim the past, nor can we halt the future. So we must find a way... to give meaning to all these inevitable sacrifices.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: We must change something for them, change the rules imposed by DisCity... and I propose we start with you. After all, you've already demonstrated your... unique value to DisCity.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: For the revolution to come, I'm afraid I must ask for your eternal silence.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Sacrifice...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you mean...?

speaker: Adelaide
content: Ah, by the way, my sister's new friend is a Sinner from MBCC. You must be acquainted with her, I presume? Hypa invited her to visit Fraser, and they were likely going to celebrate a birthday together. Regrettably, my DisCity business trip coincides perfectly to make me miss the occasion.

options: Tell me straight! What have you sacrificed?!!

content: [Release the shackles] Are there dark shackles?
The moment the shackles release, the spikes piercing through your body are pitch-black, brimming with contamination instead. But you're beyond caring now.
You must catch him! No matter where he runs, you must catch him!
The spikes slash across Adelaide's cheek, but he neither dodges nor wipes away the blood. He only watches you, his gaze a twisted mix of admiration and pity.
The Mania flower in his hand gradually dims, yet still possesses enough power to slowly coalesce into a massive shadow. The shadow bows before him, inviting him to step onto it.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Regardless, you have always been my purpose for coming here. Even my pursuit of this Great Expo was for you.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Thank you for being so vigilant, brave, and righteous. When you decided to personally come and "punish" me, my purpose was already served.
Adelaide bows to you as the shadow envelops him, while another hand reaches out toward you...
...only to be pierced by the spikes of the shackles. The monster lets out an agonizing roar as it leaps upward, soaring into the sky.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!!
With every ounce of strength you have left, you use the shackles to anchor yourself to the monster taking off.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You're not getting away!
0 second left

<size=80><color=#fb9259>BR-005 OUTBREAK
Time: June 25, N.F. 115
Location: UNKNOWN
Scale: UNKNOWN
Ground Zero: UNKNOWN</size></color>

speaker: Catherine
content: ...Hey, wake up. Why the long face again?
Through the haze, a voice cuts clearly through to your ears. You struggle to open your eyes—
High in the sky, amid howling winds and swirling sands, you first glimpse a figure clad in red—then, an enormous military vehicle soaring through the air.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...It's you...
You recognize this vehicle. There's a gash in the roof—Jasmine's handiwork.
This is the Commander-in-Chief's vehicle from the closing ceremony...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who... are you really...

speaker: Catherine
content: I'm an arms dealer. Naturally, I go wherever there's war.

speaker: Catherine
content: You look like hell though. Did someone turn you into a war trophy? Go ahead—pick your poison. Fraser? Or me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: War trophy...?
The murderous impulse that once contaminated your mind stirs once more.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've got to be kidding... I'm going to find them. All of them. Everyone involved in this...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll kill them all!!
She watches you, and slowly, a smile spreads across her face.

speaker: Catherine
content: This state suits you well.

speaker: Catherine
content: So... time for war!
She draws her blade from her side, and then...
[Dragon Slaying CG]

It's a ferocious battle. Dozens of steel rods skewer the monstrous foe as it thrashes and roars. Nearby, FAC reinforcements clash against an unnatural sandstorm, one that erupted without warning in WhiteSands. In the near future, this would be remembered as the opening salvo of that great war.
But despite being closest to it all, you can no longer hear or see clearly.
[Dragon Slaying CG] 1s darken and turn yellow
You slide off the massive creature's back, falling, until another dragon catches you.
It seems too weak to bear your weight, plummeting down with you. In your daze, a muffled cry reaches you, and instinctively reach out to shield her.
You struggle forward, through the storm, through the slow, relentless tide of Apostles—toward the end of the shackles, the end of filth, hatred, and chaos...
You only want to grasp one voice, one silhouette.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey dummy, just wait for me, alright?
War is often waged in the name of survival, but its spoils are counted in profit.

November, N.F. 114: At Fraser's instigation, numerous extremists from the farlands infiltrated DisCity to surveil its leadership movements and sow chaos.


June, N.F. 115: During the Great Expo held in DisCity, Fraser dispatched a delegation in an attempt to join the joint mining operations in the West District. At the closing ceremony, extremist Adelaide Campbell tried to capture the MBCC Chief but failed and was subsequently detained by DisCity authorities. Simultaneously, BR-005 was successfully detonated within Fraser's jurisdiction, making the shadow of war inevitable.


July, N.F. 115: Euphoria, a facility established by Fraser to infiltrate DisCity's upper echelons, was destroyed. Intelligence reports indicated that the Farland Alliance's war plans had already taken shape.

July 10, N.F. 115: The Tide of Ashes exhibited unusual activity as the "mobile" BR-005, accompanied by numerous Apostles and Aurum Secretum Warriors, swept into WhiteSands and breached multiple Ash defense lines.

August 11: Paradeisos activated BR-003 in an attempt to halt the war's escalation through the use of this catastrophe weapon.

August 21: After several days of ceasefire, the Farland Alliance forces made a desperate final push under Fraser commanders' orders, ignoring the deterrent of BR-003 and once again driving Apostle hordes into DisCity.

August 23: Through the joint efforts of the DisCorps, the FAC, and the MBCC Chief, BR-005 was shattered by the reorganized DisCity army.

In the aftermath, Fraser's military advantage collapsed instantly. The Senate abandoned their frontline commanders and Farland Alliance forces, bringing the Ash Campaign to an abrupt halt.

After the war, the Hypercube mine that should have remained on the battlefield was nowhere to be found, making its whereabouts the primary focus for all factions. However, after each side dispatched search parties for days without success, they grew increasingly pessimistic about the possibility of locating it.

September 15, N.F. 115
10:30 AM
Council Chamber, Fraser Senate

The opulent council chamber is silent but for the relentless tick of the clock counting down to the hour.
As it chimes, an electronic hum fills the air, and one by one, the spectral forms of the attendees shimmer into existence upon the encircling seats.

Their postures are a study in contrast—some ramrod straight, others draped in casual indifference—yet all are united by the golden masks of the Fraser Senate, the ultimate symbol of authority and anonymity.
The moment the last hologram solidifies, the figure at position II raises a hand, breaking the silence.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: Everyone is present except for Adelaide Campbell. Let us begin.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: As you are all aware, Fraser invested immense resources and took extraordinary risks in the Ash Campaign, also known as the Apostle Black Ring plan. Yet the outcome fell short of expectations. We failed to secure DisCity, lost our advantage at the critical moment, and are now compelled to sign a peace treaty... one that will undoubtedly come at significant cost to our interests. Moreover...

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: The repercussions of our defeat are already spreading to the Farland Alliance. Catastrophe intensity triggered by BR-005 continues to escalate, and more members are faltering under the strain. They are filing frequent petitions, claiming that Aurum Secretum, Hypercubes, and labor were diverted to Fraser during the war, that the Hypercubes originally slated for acquisition from DisCity are now unavailable, that... they can no longer sustain themselves and require Fraser's assistance.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: Naturally, our propaganda efforts have never wavered. Refugees from the lesser city-states have harbored deep-seated hatred toward DisCity and placed their unconditional trust in us. They could never learn the truth about Furor. But with the collapse of our blitzkrieg strategy, compounded by DisCity's public exposure of its Black Ring weapon... fear has now begun to overshadow the hatred we so carefully cultivated. War fatigue spreads like a plague, and the hawks in every state are losing ground.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: DisCity has also made its move. They've dispatched their new diplomat—yes, that <color=#fb9259>Margaret</color>. Her "smile diplomacy" may be ineffective in itself, but her proposals to assist in clearing Black Ring contamination and support mine construction have genuinely swayed several of the weaker states... and we cannot yet move openly against her.

speaker: X·Raphael Herbert
content: Useless. Every last one of them. After all the support we provided, they still managed to fail so spectacularly. Forget the sunk costs; we should freeze all further aid and investment immediately. There's no sense in pouring resources into a bottomless pit.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: The issue is not sunk costs. If we abandon the Farland Alliance now, they won't pose any real threat; they'll simply perish in the spreading catastrophes. But without them to keep DisCity distracted, Fraser would face its full, undivided retaliation.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: Do any of you truly believe those wartime records could absolve us completely? That warmonger Augustus has already returned. Her Rancor unit alone could carve through half of WhiteSands. When DisCity comes seeking retribution, I urge you to ask yourselves, honestly: what fate awaits us then?
Murmurs ripple through the chamber.

speaker: X·Raphael Herbert
content: So what you're saying is, we have no choice but to keep propping up those beggars from the Alliance?

speaker: III·Valorian
content: To maintain Fraser's political dominance in the farlands, this is a necessary expense. Of course... if we could immediately locate the BR-005 mineral deposits, all our current troubles would be solved, and the Farland Alliance would obediently fall in line.

speaker: III·Valorian
content: Until then... we should maintain minimal investment, just enough to keep them from rebelling, yet not letting them crumble completely.
[Scene Change: WhiteSands]
Deep Within WhiteSands
Relentless storms scour the desert expanse. Below, a violent Mania field churns, whipping up clouds of dust that cloak the path ahead.

Perched atop a massive boulder, a squad of Aurum Secretum Warriors keeps watch over one such disturbance. Ever since the Black Ring event, the calamities plaguing WhiteSands have only grown in ferocity. Their mission is to patrol these blighted borders, serving as sentinels against the encroaching contamination.
Suddenly, one warrior goes still. Setting aside the weapon he has been meticulously cleaning, he leans forward, his gaze piercing the dusty veil in the distance.

speaker: A.S. Warrior
content: Rats coming.

His teammates track his line of sight. A band of farland refugees is trekking purposefully toward the Mania field's epicenter, armed and ready—though their primitive weaponry seems almost laughable against the advanced Aurum Secretum arsenal.

speaker: A.S. Warrior
content: They're trying to rush a Mania field with that scrap? That's a suicide run.

speaker: A.S. Warrior
content: We found this place first. What's the plan, Saina? Do we move in?

speaker: Saina
content: Quiet. Wait a little longer.
The female warrior throws out an arm, blocking her eager companion from advancing. Her gaze remains locked on the farlanders, analytical and unmoving.

speaker: Farlander A
content: You really think the elders were right? That we might find Hypercubes here, where the Black Ring passed through?

speaker: Farlander B
content: It's a chance, not a promise. Now focus. The things in there are vicious. Is your suit sealed? The second something feels wrong, you run. Understood?

speaker: Farlander A
content: ...And go where?

speaker: Farlander A
content: Our strongholds are bled dry. All the Aurum Secretum and Hypercubes went to the war effort; all our strong backs were sent to the city. Fraser promised beating DisCity would fix everything, but we lost... And since Furor was blasted, the Tide of Ashes just keeps getting worse...

speaker: Farlander A
content: Heh, doesn't matter where we go, we're dead anyway. Might as well roll the dice. Maybe we get lucky and bring something home...

speaker: Farlander B
content: Stop with the doom and gloom! If you're done feeling sorry for yourself, let's move!
Saina watches the last farlander disappear into the swirling chaos. Silently, she begins to count.
Nothing. No one emerges.

speaker: Saina
content: Tch, those idiots! Move out!
On her command, the Aurum Secretum Warriors launch themselves from the boulder, diving headlong into the depths of the Mania field.
[Scene Change]
Inside the Mania field, the farlanders' gear shatters like paper against the monsters' claws.
And their lives are equally fragile.
(Red flash + blade flash, character portraits fall)

speaker: Farlander A
content: Why... Why... WHY WON'T THEY JUST DIE?!
(Red flash + blade flash)

speaker: Farlander A
content: Sob... damn it, DAMN IT!! AAAAAHHH!!!
Arcs of golden light sever the air, and the monsters fall. The farlanders can only stare, stunned, at the Aurum Secretum Warriors who now stand where the monsters had been.

speaker: Saina
content: Three on the left, two on the right, a big one behind. They're mine. The rest of you, stay back!

These Aurum Secretum Warriors are all marked by mutative defects, rejects from the main theater of war. Their exile is the patrol of the WhiteSands Mania fields, where they can manage the contamination but never eliminate it. Their only purpose is to occasionally rescue the foolhardy prospectors who venture in like moths to a flame.
What if I were on that front line, Saina thinks, a familiar bitterness rising, could the tide be turned? Could the farlands actually win?
But history scorns "what ifs." There is only the broken body she must carry forward, transmuting her fury into the slaughter of lesser monsters.
After confirming the absence of Hypercubes or survivors, Saina emerges from the ashes. In silence, she tosses the relics, scavenged from the monsters' maws, at the farlander' feet.
She knows that if she spares them the full, brutal truth, they will only return, lured back to their doom by the faintest glimmer of hope.

speaker: Farlander A
content: But we... we've already... we tried so hard...

speaker: Farlander A
content: Why... why is there ******* nothing?! Not a single damn Hypercube!!
The farlander's heart-wrenching wails are swallowed by the relentless wind. With a grim, practiced silence, the Aurum Secretum Warriors clean and sheathe their weapons.

speaker: Saina
content: You can't fight. Your only purpose here is to become food for the monsters. If you want to live, get out of here. Now.

speaker: Saina
content: Let Fraser handle this. The Luminaris experts will be here soon. There's no need for you to throw your lives away.

speaker: Farlander A
content: ...Will they find anything? They've been searching for months. What have they ever found?

She has no reassurance to offer, and her silence is answer enough. The refugee's face crumbles. Despair curdles into fear, and finally, he sinks to the parched, rocky ground with a hollow, broken laugh.
A long silence stretches, broken only by the moan of the sand-laden wind. When he finally speaks, his voice is little more than a murmur.

speaker: Farlander A
content: Black Rings... Hypercubes... Do you think... the Disians... might know more about them...

speaker: Saina
content: <size=52>Shut your mouth about that ******* city!</size>
(Explodes with rage)

speaker: Saina
content: Who do you think caused all of this?! Who created the Black Ring and all these disasters?! Who's using Hypercubes to bleed us dry?! It's only been a few months; have you forgotten our warriors who died on the front lines?!

speaker: Saina
content: DisCity, <size=43>DisCity</size>, <size=52>DISCITY!! You're so fixated on them. Are you one of their damn spies?! </size><size=60>Should I just kill you now and save us the trouble?!</size>

speaker: Farlander A
content: Nngh!
She seizes the farlander by the collar, hauling him up. Her grip is iron, and the fury in her eyes promises violence.

speaker: Saina
content: If I ever hear that name from your mouth again, <size=60>I will kill you!!</size>
[Scene Change: Council Chamber]
In the council chamber, the meeting progresses into its latter half.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: Neither DisCity nor Furor has discovered traces of the BR-005 mine, and we've already dispatched Aurum Secretum Warriors to search WhiteSands. However, this cannot be accomplished overnight. In the interim, we must employ other means to maintain our relationship with the Farland Alliance.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: For instance, a grand event that rallies around our shared enemy... or perhaps a traitor who conspired with DisCity and leaked our critical secrets.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: The most critical turning point in this war was not the collapse of supply lines, nor the DisCorps joining the conflict. It was during the final phase, when DisCity modified their anti-Mania devices to target the resonance properties of Aurum Secretum, which tore apart our defense line.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: Such a strategy would be impossible to devise without a comprehensive understanding of Aurum Secretum. It must have been someone from Fraser... someone with intimate knowledge who leaked our secrets.

speaker: II·Elliot Baker
content: And we all know who this informant most likely is.
His eyes find the masked woman standing apart in the corner. Not a second is wasted; her response is with an immediate, practiced smile.

speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
content: Of course, esteemed sir. Thank you for raising this point.

speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
content: Rest assured, the traitor who sold out Aurum Secretum technology and Fraser's secrets—<color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>—has already been taken into custody.
[Fraser Hotel] [Heavy Fade to Black]
Boundless darkness fills the room.
Days of isolation, of restricted and drugged meals, have depleted Hypatia's strength to its limit.
Creak.
(Screen turns completely white)
Blinding light floods through the doorway, followed by heavy footsteps. Hypatia raises her head, the sudden glare stinging her eyes, and in its wake, a wave of dizziness overtakes her.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Suspect Hypatia, you stand accused of conspiring with DisCity to detonate the Black Ring, causing widespread catastrophe. I am conducting this interrogation on behalf of the Fraser Senate.

speaker: Interrogator
content: I trust these days of confinement in darkness have helped you see your situation clearly. I expect you have reflected on your actions.
At last.
A beep from a recording device sounds near her ear.

speaker: Interrogator
content: <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>, Chief Aurum Secretum Researcher of the Luminaris Society. You are believed to be directly involved in multiple catastrophic incidents, including the explosion at the Aurum Secretum Research Institute and the detonation of BR-005. Furthermore, you are suspected of treason for selling core Aurum Secretum secrets to DisCity.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Do you confess?
Only silence answers him.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Your silence is futile. We possess irrefutable evidence of your actions.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Prior to the BR-005 detonation, our networks were breached, severing communications between Fraser and the Institute. Among the decrypted tools used by the hacker, the coding methodology bears a resemblance to the programming techniques employed in the Fraser Kardas. One string of code even points directly to you.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Furthermore, after the war broke out, you were repeatedly observed at salons and hotels affiliated with the DisCity ambassador, Margaret Kervoz. Shortly thereafter, DisCity forces obtained detailed intelligence regarding our latest Aurum Secretum technology and BR-005's vulnerabilities. Our analysis confirms that such knowledge could only originate from the Chief Researcher of the Luminaris Society.

speaker: Interrogator
content: How do you explain this? Or do you expect us to believe it is a mere coincidence?

speaker: Interrogator
content: It is an utter disgrace! The hopes of generations within the Farland Alliance... betrayed by you so easily, vanished in an instant. Every sacrifice, wasted for nothing!

speaker: Interrogator
content: What possessed you? Did Margaret Kervoz deceive you with her pretty lies about "peace"? What stories did she feed you?

speaker: Interrogator
content: DisCity has never truly sought peace! Their hands are stained with blood debts dating back to the DisCorps era. Since the control of the Hypercube, they've only shown complete disregard for the farlands' survival, obsessed only with maintaining their monopoly.

speaker: Interrogator
content: When they ravaged the farlands, who provided shelter? Who established the WhiteSands trade routes and painstakingly purchased Hypercubes from DisCity to share with those small states? It was us, Fraser!

speaker: Interrogator
content: And you, a citizen of Fraser, conspired with them, sabotaged our Black Ring project, and show not a shred of remorse!

speaker: Hypatia
content: If...
Hypatia breaks her silence. It is the first time she has spoken since the interrogation began.

speaker: Hypatia
content: If Fraser truly honored its pledge to work for the welfare of the farlands, it would, as I have been, devoted to quelling calamities. It would never permit the farlands to cultivate a Black Ring, much less weaponize it.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The suffering of the farlands stems from calamities, hardships only worsened by the Black Rings. As a researcher, my duty is to study and eliminate them.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I have neither sold their secrets nor betrayed those people.

speaker: Interrogator
content: DisCity was the first to weaponize a Black Ring. The forced detonation of BR-005 and its theft were executed by DisCity's Sinner, Hella. These are the very crimes you denounce. Fraser has always maintained a neutral position, condemning such actions.
The Interrogator speaks with fervent, unshakable conviction, every word ringing with pride. It is a zeal Hypatia recognizes... which mirrors her own from long ago.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Is that so?
She offers a faint, weary smile.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Then I hope the senators can find rest at night, undisturbed by the weeping of the farlands' vengeful spirits.
Afterwards, no matter what the Interrogator asks, Hypatia remains silent.
A long while later, having failed to extract a single word, the interrogator stops the recording with a resentful scowl, storms out of the room, and slams the door hard behind him.
[White light fades, back to the normal room]
Once the interrogator's footsteps fade into the distance, Hypatia quickly rises to her feet.
She knows the Senate's methods all too well. While she endured this round of questioning, the next would be even more cunning and cruel. She must escape, and soon.

She darts to the door and extends a finger. A golden thread seeps from her fingertip, creeping through the narrow gap beneath the tightly shut door. Moments earlier, when the interrogator entered, she had guided a trace of Aurum Secretum into the keyhole, preventing the door from locking fully.

Guided by her will, the golden thread coaxes the heavy iron door open just enough to create a slim opening. Carefully, she unfastens the Campbell brooch from her collar and gently traces the engraved petals. The Aurum Secretum within flows along the patterns, reshaping into a delicate, spider-like form. Then, the little creature scuttles through the gap, its vision now streaming back to her.
This brooch is one of the few items of Aurum Secretum she still retains. The inspectors had dismissed it as a mere "ornament"—a gesture of concession, out of respect for the Campbell family.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Hmm... two guards on patrol. Any blind spots... Difficult, but not impossible. The real question is where to go once I'm out...

The Senate, in the end, did not dare imprison her in a true cell or interrogation block. Instead, they have confined her in a remote, secured hotel, a choice that unwittingly provided her with a far more convenient path to escape.
The Aurum Secretum spider tilts its head upward, its gaze revealing a maintenance hatch set into the ceiling.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Just as I recalled from the architectural archives. Fraser's older structures utilize central air systems with ceiling vents for heat dissipation.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Their requisition was rushed. They wouldn't have had time to seal every auxiliary duct. That oversight is my opportunity.

The Aurum Secretum spider scuttles silently across the ceiling to the air vent. Its slender, needle-like legs make short work of the grating, slicing through the metal. A moment later, a resilient thread unspools from its body, dropping down into the shadows below.
Hypatia stares into the newly opened darkness. The gloom of the passage seems to breathe back at her, and a memory stirs.
(Flashback)

speaker: Hella
content: ...Ahhh fine! I get it!

speaker: Hella
content: Fine, I'll crawl through this stupid pipe!
(End of Flashback)

speaker: Hypatia
content: I never imagined I'd find myself doing something similar now.
Furor... At the very thought, a wave of tenderness washes over her. Those days feel both impossibly distant and startlingly near.
No. She cannot afford this now.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The window is brief. I'll move on the next blind spot in their patrol... I must be quick.
She climbs through the ventilation shaft onto the rooftop. The sky immediately stretches before her, just as the alarm begins to blare.

speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
content: The suspect has escaped! All units, assemble and begin search and capture immediately!

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Discovered sooner than I'd hoped. A pity I have no intention of remaining as your guest. Your time to act has just run out!
She swiftly anchors the Aurum Secretum to a railing on the balcony below and leaps without hesitation.
Her descent accelerates, tempered by the Aurum Secretum and her own power. The ground rushes up to meet her, yet she lands as steadily as a cat.
[Scene Change: Luminaris Society]
Meanwhile, in a room somewhere within the Luminaris Society.

The surveillance footage tightens its focus on the girl who has touched down, capturing her as she darts and leaps across the rooftops, moving with nimble urgency toward the bustling central district.

speaker: X·Raphael Herbert
content: Is this what you call "already under control"? She appears to be moving with considerable freedom to me.

speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
content: Patience, Mr. Herbert. The fact that you came to the Society with me demonstrates your... curiosity about that technology. It would be best to observe with a calm mind.

speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
content: Hypatia Campbell is brilliant and tenacious, yet burdened by an oversensitive conscience and an exaggerated sense of personal duty. She internalizes blame for outcomes she did not cause; merely witnessing suffering is enough to make her shoulder the responsibility.

speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
content: Now, keep your eyes open and watch closely. The magic show is just beginning.
[Scene Change: Fraser Alley or Rooftop]
Twilight deepens as Hypatia races desperately through the maze of alleyways.
Her pursuers are behind her now. One more block, and she will be free.

speaker: Voice in the Wind
content: Hypa, Hypatia...

speaker: Voice in the Wind
content: Traitor!
The girl whirls around, but finds no one behind her. The alley stands utterly empty.
Yet after only a few more steps, the voice returns, and this time, it seems to come from just over her shoulder.

speaker: Voice in the Wind
content: Fool... you think you can outrun your guilt? Escape your duty? You promised you would save us...

speaker: Trembling Voice
content: Hehehe... look at you now! No home, no city-state. You've become just like us!

speaker: Mocking Voice
content: Where do you think you're going? Who would ever take you in now? Without the Campbell name, you're just another lost soul to fade into the WhiteSands!
With those voices, a powerful wave of dizziness floods Hypatia's mind. The ground beneath her feet seems to soften into quicksand. She staggers, misses her footing, and collapses onto the pale sand.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What's happening... My head... ugh...!
A sharp pain pierces the back of her neck. As the vertigo deepens, the hallucinations begin, even more impossible than before.
[Black Screen + Hallucinations]
The undulating sand rises into faces that laugh and shriek at her from below, surging and receding like waves beneath her body.
They are the faces of those from Furor who died violently, of Outland refugees twisted into alchemic beasts, of Fraser warriors fallen in battle.

The faces converge, interweave, and merge, dissolving at last into an indistinct, fluid mass of sand. It grows, spreads, enclosing her world like a restless, membranous womb, until it swallows her vision whole.
<color=#dg1f1f>She is sinking.</color>

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Hypatia... Curse... Duty... Hypatia... Hypa...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Do not go... Do not seek freedom... Do not... Hypatia...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Leave your life here... Surrender everything... You made a promise...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: ————!
(Flashback)

speaker: Youthful Voice
content: I will be forever faithful to my duty, my city, and its people.
(End of Flashback)
Night has fallen. Deep in the alley, two pursuers have found their target.

speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
content: All units, target sighted. Subject is displaying signs of acute mental distress. Requesting authorization for immediate apprehension.

speaker: Intercom
content: Authorization granted. Proceed with capture.
Several soldiers advance swiftly, forming a tightening circle around Hypatia.
[Black Screen + Hallucinations]

The girl is surrounded by the curses of lost souls. Though her rational mind dismisses them as hallucinations, the struggle to breathe becomes a struggle for control. Her efforts to calm down only make it worse.
The chaotic noise persists; her consciousness grows hazy.
And a new torment emerges: her body aches as if beaten. Could this, too, be their revenge...?
(Flashback to oath-taking scene)
You are right. I should never have sought to leave. I swore to give all, and still, I have achieved nothing.
If you despise me so... if you demand my life in return... then if this is my penance...

speaker: Fraser Pursuer B
content: Target subdued. Confirmed unable to resist.

speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
content: Mission accomplished. Let's head back.
Rough hands haul Hypatia to her feet, fumbling for the shackles.
Then, a night breeze sweeps through the alley, cutting the stale air with a shock of pure, sweet lily. All eyes snap to the entrance, where a white figure stands in silhouette.

Golden heels gleam in the dimness. Under the shadow of a jade-green hat, a pearl-adorned glove holds a fan like a silken mask. Nothing shows above its edge but two eyes—twin crescents of amused delight.
To treat a lady with such heavy-handedness... Is this the conduct befitting a city-state that prides itself on civilization?
How regrettable. Might I suggest a more... diplomatic approach?

speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
content: Who are you?! Hands up!
A soft laugh floats down, and with it, several white feathers. The soldiers' eyes follow the gentle descent.
In that instant, the white figure materializes among them. With a delicate tap of the fan against each feather, a silent, rippling wave pulses through the air.
A sudden, profound calm washes over the soldiers. Weapons clatter to the ground in a dull chorus as an irresistible tide of peace stills their limbs.
Released, Hypatia slumps, only to be gathered effortlessly into the arms of the woman in white.
There, there, it's all right now. I won't let them harm you anymore.
Another feather drifts down, coming to rest upon Hypatia. Deep within the chaos of her mind, a point of pure white light appears. It fractures the void, shattering the shrieking noise into silence.
The pressure finally lifts. With a surge of effort, Hypatia pries her eyes open. Through the haze, a form in white resolves into a familiar silhouette.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Ms. ... Margaret...
It is the last thing she sees. As the last of her strength dissolves, the world tilts, softens, and fades to a profound dark again.
Chaos closes around her again—an absolute dark, starless and without end.
Before her, the path is lined with countless figures, their shapes smudged into the gloom. A chill, sharp and inexplicable, pierces her as she faces this tide of shadows.
Every instinct screams to turn back, but there is nowhere to go but into the dark.
The first shadow grasps her.

speaker: Furorian Boy
content: Lady Hypatia... why did you not tell us the truth? Why did you leave us behind?

speaker: Furorian Boy
content: Did you not swear to protect Furor... to protect us?

speaker: Furorian Boy
