content: Why did you keep silent about the inheritance buried below us? Are you no different from those high nobles, treating the people of Furor as sacrifices?!
The shadow wails, chasing her a short distance before its form begins to fray. It unravels into a cloud of black dust, scattering like ashes across the chaotic dreamscape.

speaker: Resentful Voice
content: Hypatia...

A few steps more, and a ring of shadows blocks her path. Their forms are distorted, but the faces are horribly clear. She knows them. They stare back from the ghostly pages of the BR-005 casualty files.

speaker: Victims
content: The kind-hearted lady of the Campbell family, the benevolent lady of the Campbells, the all-powerful Lady Hypatia.

speaker: Victims
content: Why did you not help us, why did you not save us... why did you do nothing at all?

speaker: Victims
content: No. Your kindness, your conscience, your goodwill... all of it is a lie...

speaker: Victims
content: You stood by, watching us die with open eyes... because you are even more hypocritical than your kin! Ptui!
The weeping, cursing souls cling to her as she struggles to break free, yet a deeper despair has already seeped into the very air, a prison with no walls.
In the chaotic dreamscape, directions hold no meaning. Hypatia abandons reason, letting the sound of resentful winds and scouring sands guide her into a vast field of ruins.
There, upon a crumbling stretch of city wall, two girls sit in conversation. Recognition pierces the haze. Without a thought, her feet begin to move toward them.
They turn. No warmth greets her, only the cold, hard edge of anger.

speaker: Hella?
content: Get lost! You traitor! Useless piece of trash! Two-faced bastard!

speaker: Hypatia
content: Hella, it's me. Are we not... friends?

speaker: Hella?
content: Friends? Hah! Now you talk about friendship? You've got some nerve!

speaker: Hella?
content: My friends have my back! And you? Handing out trinkets like candy, but the second things get real, you scurry back to your fancy family and disappear!

speaker: Hella?
content: Where were you when the Furor refugees marched into the Black Ring? Where were you when I was trapped in there? You've got no guts, no spine; you can't get anything done! A coward like you doesn't deserve to be my friend!

speaker: Horo?
content: Hella, save your breath. She's just another Campbell. Another accomplice of those Fraser war criminals.

speaker: Horo?
content: Campbell, we're done. Stay away from us from now on. You'll only bring more trouble.
An explanation rises, then lodges like a stone in her chest.
...She wasn't their savior. She didn't lead the refugees to safety or pull Hella from the wreckage of BR-005. Her contributions were only ever footnotes to their survival.
Horo spares no more words and leads Hella away.

speaker: Gentle Voice
content: Hypatia, my dear sister...

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Adelaide...

speaker: Adelaide?
content: Since when have you stopped calling me brother? That isn't very endearing of you.
The figure draws near. As a hand gently strokes her hair, a long-buried memory surfaces: this is how he comforted her, a lifetime ago.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: This is my little sister...

speaker: Adelaide?
content: We are born into solitude. It is only with family that we can truly walk forward, side by side.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: You possess such extraordinary talent in Aurum Secretum. I wish for you to preserve this purity and excellence, to shine with peerless brilliance in your chosen field.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: Simply devote yourself to your cherished research. Do not trouble yourself with the origins of your materials, nor question how the fruits of your labor will be applied.
His voice holds the elegant depth of a cello and the cold warning of a serpent's hiss. Each syllable flicks against her nerves, chilling her to the bone.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: Those two little girls from DisCity... they sowed seeds of dissent in your heart and drove a wedge between us. You have witnessed the final outcome... those tormented souls... That is the consequence of your defiance.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: But regardless of your transgressions, I will always forgive you. I will help conceal them and make the necessary reparations. After all, we are family, the closest of kin.

speaker: Adelaide?
content: Come back, Hypa. You have wandered alone for far too long. Come back to my side. This is the only path you should choose, the only correct one.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The only path...
A sensation of suffocation, inescapable and cold, claws its way up from the pit of her throat.
She staggers back. The nightmare only looms larger.
Run. Run.
The nightmare flows after her like a living shadow.

speaker: Fraser Noble
content: That Campbell bastard practically runs the house now. How many viable heirs do they even have left? Their decline is only a matter of years.

speaker: A.S. Researcher
content: She's just a child. What could she possibly understand about Aurum Secretum? Let's assign her to some quiet department for busywork. That should satisfy the higher-ups that we've handled it.

speaker: Fraser Shadow Operative
content: Well? Don't just stand there. Since you won't follow Adelaide anymore, why not come with us, my lady? No? Are you really sure about that?
To lose guidance is to lose protection. It does not, however, guarantee that a new path will appear.
So she wanders in darkness, a ghost among phantoms.
Longing for independence but blind to the way forward, she stumbles on, hopelessly lost.
—Just as she is now, trapped in this chaotic dream, condemned to wander its confines with no end in sight.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What... should I do now...

speaker: Hypatia
content: What else can I do... where else can I go...
Hypatia wanders. She follows scattered motes of light through the shattered dreamscape, searching until—
Pleased to meet you, Ms. Hypatia. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Margaret Kervoz, the newly appointed DisCity Outland Affairs Officer.
A snow-white dove flits from the woman's shoulder to Hypatia's head. The bird rustles its wings, scattering a few loose feathers as it finds its perch.
Just another one, she tells herself, another stray shadow from the dream.
She turns to leave. However, a hand closes around her arm. The grip is startlingly solid, painfully real. It is the blonde woman.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What...
This woman... she's not an illusion!
How did she get in here?! Is she trying to lead her out of this chaos?! But can she truly escape...

Before the questions can fully form, the woman's grip answers. It is firm, undeniable pressure. And then, with a tone that dissolves argument, the woman forcefully steps through the boundaries of her dreamscape.

speaker: Margaret
content: If you truly don't know which way to go, then listen to me, Hypatia.

speaker: Margaret
content: Time is running out. Lingering in cycles of self-reproach will change nothing. If you genuinely wish to make a difference, then come with me.

speaker: Margaret
content: I will show you the way, I will bear the responsibility, and I will fulfill what you seek. Because the "peace" I am building already encompasses all you desire.
[Black Screen + Steam]
A gentle warmth cocoons her. Within it, two sensations emerge: the distant murmur of a classical piece entwined with water, and the rich, floral perfume of steam.
Swathed in this quiet luxury, Hypatia's awareness stirs. Slowly, her eyelids part.
[Scene: Luxury Hotel]

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...! Where... where am I...?

speaker: Margaret
content: You're awake, Hypatia.
[CG]
It is her, the woman from the dream. She sits framed by steam, towels and delicate bottles of oil arranged beside her like offerings. Through the scented haze, her smile is a soft, familiar beacon.

Margaret Kervoz. The name carries weight in Fraser, a society she has charmed and navigated with an outsider's grace. Born into DisCity's high society, she has spent years cultivating an image of gentle attentiveness and impeccable diplomacy, accumulating considerable wealth and prestige.

Her empire of influence spans charity, social activism, finance, and art. Her newest title—DisCity's Outland Affairs Officer—marks her as an official "peace ambassador," a role that makes even the Fraser Senate deeply uneasy.

Margaret seems physiologically incapable of anger; her patience is a deep, still lake. Throughout their entire acquaintance, Hypatia has seen that perfect composure break only once. It was at the very nadir of Hypatia's confusion, when Margaret's voice, usually so soft, turned to cold, hammered steel with the command: "Listen to me."

speaker: Hypatia
content: Ms. Margaret...

speaker: Margaret
content: Rest easy. This hotel is my private property. No one will disturb us here.
A warm towel blankets Hypatia's brow. Beside her, Margaret gently wipes away the cold evidence of the nightmare.

speaker: Margaret
content: After you were taken by the Senate, I searched everywhere for you. It was no easy task to learn where they were holding you, and when I finally rushed there, I found you collapsed by the roadside... Thank goodness I was able to bring you out in time.

speaker: Margaret
content: You had multiple injuries and were in severe psychological distress, so I decided to bring you here to tend to your wounds and give you a therapeutic bath.

speaker: Margaret
content: On my recent trip to Eastia, I brought back some local medicinal herbs. They say when used in aromatherapy, they can soothe the mind... How do you feel now? Is your head still hurting?
Belatedly, Hypatia realizes she is immersed in warm water. It cradles her, finding each hurt—first a sharp protest, then a softening release.
Yet, the echoes of her dream cling to her, a lingering tremor of pain and confusion. She lets her eyes fall shut, as if to seal the waking world out.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I'm all right. I apologize; I should have escaped on my own, but for some reason... Though everything went smoothly at first, after leaving the hotel, in that moment I just...

speaker: Margaret
content: This isn't your fault. Physical depletion, psychological torment... these are their standard methods.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Ugh...

speaker: Margaret
content: Look, your left shoulder and knee are dislocated, and there are countless abrasions and contusions... They must have been ordered to torture you without leaving visible marks on your skin.

speaker: Margaret
content: Of course, the most egregious part is...
Margaret hands her a mirror. Hypatia takes it and raises it to her neck. There, on its lower back, is a faint mark she knows was not there before.
[Show Special Portrait: Underground Brand]

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...It appears to be the new invention from the Luminaris Society and the Underground. I never expected it would be used on me so soon.
When had it been branded? She had felt nothing.
Her fingers rise of their own accord, tracing the edges of the still-unhealed mark.
[The mark glows]

speaker: Hypatia
content: Gasp...

speaker: Margaret
content: Silly girl, why would you touch it?

A ladle of warm water pours steadily over her neck. Hypatia feels a warmth that travels not just over her skin, but into the brand itself, as though following its lines. Then, the ache gradually lifts, bleeding away.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Ms. Margaret... what is...

speaker: Margaret
content: My power cannot remove it completely, but it can alleviate its flare-ups to some extent. To eliminate it entirely will require time... and your own willpower.

speaker: Margaret
content: I'm sorry. I failed to protect you, which allowed them to exploit the situation and subject you to this suffering.

speaker: Margaret
content: They falsely accused you of colluding with DisCity, hoping to use your own words to undermine our efforts for peace.

speaker: Margaret
content: But your courage and wisdom far exceeded my expectations. Even when pushed to the limits of mental endurance, you still refused to yield to them.

speaker: Hypatia
content: No, it was nothing...

speaker: Hypatia
content: It's just that... I had intended to resolve this matter myself, but in the end, I still dragged you into it...

speaker: Margaret
content: Don't worry. I have my own methods of negotiation. Dealing with them isn't a challenge for me.
Margaret winks with casual confidence.

speaker: Margaret
content: Fraser plans to hold a victory celebration in a few days to reassure its farland allies. As DisCity's peace ambassador, I will naturally be expected to give a speech.

speaker: Margaret
content: For such an important occasion, they have been remarkably cooperative lately, afraid I might say something I shouldn't.

speaker: Margaret
content: The Senate had no legitimate grounds to arrest you, so they resorted to illegal evidence gathering and untraceable torture methods, hoping to provoke you into violence. Then they could use that as leverage to fabricate charges against you.

speaker: Margaret
content: They need a scapegoat before the celebration, someone to blame for their defeat and to placate the farlands. But they lack the courage to refuse my request, or to openly confront me and take you back.

speaker: Margaret
content: Since that's the case, I simply have to seize the opportunity and make them swallow their loss without a word of complaint.
Despite Margaret's confident tone, Hypatia knows the reality in Fraser is far harsher.

Since the war began, Disians like Margaret have faced open hostility and systemic discrimination. As a prominent figure, Margaret encounters obstacles at every turn. And now, she must spend her dwindling political capital to...

speaker: Margaret
content: Hm?
Margaret notices her concern, leans down, and gives her a gentle hug.

speaker: Margaret
content: Don't worry, Hypatia. When I made this choice, I was fully aware of its cost and its risks.

speaker: Margaret
content: We have long been important collaborators, friends, even comrades... You risked assassination to intercept communications between the research institute and Fraser, then worked tirelessly to decrypt that data. You helped us stop BR-005 just in time, ending the war early and preventing the calamities in the farlands from worsening.

speaker: Margaret
content: Had BR-005 remained active, with Apostles striking DisSea, today's devastation would be far more severe... As a scientist, you understand this better than I do. After what you have done for DisCity and for peace, you deserve everything I am doing for you now.
She rises to her feet and retrieves clean clothes from nearby.
[CG Ends, Black Screen]

speaker: Margaret
content: That's enough for now. Come out and get dressed. Stay in any longer, and the water will grow cold.
[Scene: Hotel]

speaker: Margaret
content: Stay here tonight. Forget the nightmares, forget the worries. They are merely illusions the enemy uses to torment you. Do not let them haunt you.
Margaret takes an ivory comb from a golden tray nearby and gently ties Hypatia's long hair.

speaker: Margaret
content: Tonight, at least, you need not think of anything. Simply rest and regain your strength. Whatever may come, I will be right here by your side.

speaker: Margaret
content: The Senate will not risk a diplomatic incident by barging in here. Besides, I have a capable friend who can keep us safe.

The moment Margaret falls silent, a grey-haired woman enters. Her gaze moves across the room—assessing, swift—and settles on Hypatia. It lingers on the girl's blonde hair and mismatched eyes for several telling seconds before she coolly looks away.

speaker: Helga
content: Ma'am, you asked for me?

speaker: Margaret
content: Allow me to introduce Helga. Officially, she serves as my bodyguard, but in truth, she is a representative of the Farland Alliance, sent to gauge Fraser's stance toward the farlands. She is also a formidable warrior.

speaker: Margaret
content: Helga, this is Hypatia Campbell, whom I've mentioned to you many times, the kindest and strongest girl I've ever met.
Helga's gaze is a blade, sharp and cold. Her weathered face, etched by wind and conflict, is startlingly familiar; it calls to mind the farlanders' shadowy figures from Hypatia's own dream.
Instinctively, Hypatia lowers her head, unable to hold the woman's gray stare.

speaker: Hypatia
content: A pleasure to meet you. I'm Hypatia Campbell... Thank you for your protection.

speaker: Helga
content: Hello, I'm Helga.

In the thick, uncomfortable silence that follows, only Margaret maintains a composed, sweet smile. She appears quietly satisfied, as if the two's frigid first encounter has unfolded exactly to her liking.

speaker: Margaret
content: Look at us, representatives from DisCity, the farlands, and Fraser. Wouldn't it be wonderful if the current political climate could reflect the same spirit of understanding and peaceful coexistence as our little gathering here?
[Room in a Luxurious Manor]

speaker: Advisor
content: Sir, information regarding the <color=#fb9259>Unity Gala</color> has been discreetly channeled to our reliable allies in the farlands. For those leading figures who have shown us steadfast support, we've assured them generous allocations of Hypercube and Aurum Secretum to strengthen their positions.

speaker: Advisor
content: As for those whose loyalties have been... fluid, maintaining covert ties with both DisCity and Ms. Margaret... we are dispatching a diplomatic team to encourage clearer alignment. For the remaining obstinate few, well, the gala's inevitable chaos will provide cover for certain regrettable, yet permanent, resolutions.

speaker: Marcus
content: And DisCity? Any word on <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>?

speaker: Advisor
content: Nothing concrete yet. However, we have confirmed that <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color> has escaped Senate custody and is currently under Ms. Margaret's protection. The Senate is outraged and demands she be branded a traitor and dealt with accordingly.

speaker: Marcus
content: Outraged? Please. This is precisely the outcome those old vultures anticipated. Let them posture.

speaker: Marcus
content: That said, there is someone who has been a persistent nuisance to the Luminaris Society. We will use his identity. Make sure the work's clean. I will not have DisCity holding another scrap of evidence against us.
[Rooftop]

Night falls deep over Fraser. The city's sleepless lights have transformed the sky into a profound wash of gold and purple. Against this dusky canopy, a pitch-black figure darts across the rooftops, a swift shadow closing in on a luxurious villa.
His movements are light as a bat, a silent dance that expertly skirts every security measure. In moments, he reaches the target window. With one fluid motion, he opens it and slips inside.
[Hotel Room]
The assassin approaches the bed, where the soft blankets rise in the gentle shape of a sleeping form. His target.
A flick of his wrist, and a dagger—crimson and dark—appears in his hand. He aims for the center of that shape and drives the blade down.
(Flash of light)
The strike meets not flesh, but metal. Before the shock can register, a piercing alarm shatters the silence, blaring through every corridor of the villa.
The shadowy figure tilts his head, dodging the attack from the darkness. He instantly abandons the decoy in the bed and moves to retreat, only for a rush of air to whistle behind his head.
CLANG!!!
A silver blade meets his black-red dagger in a midair parry. In the flash of light from the collision, both adversaries see each other clearly for the first time.

speaker: Helga
content: The Senate? No, you're not from Fraser. Who are you?
He is a tall, imposing figure, his face obscured by layer upon layer of bandages. Only his eyes are visible, fierce and glaring from the linen depths.
Yet, the strangeness of his visage is secondary. Far more dangerous is the baleful black-red glow that sheathes his blade, a lingering remnant of sorcery from the Underground.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Careful! He's using the Underground sorcery!
The assassin offers no reply. Instead, he snaps the bedsheet into the air, blinding Helga, and uses the bed frame to launch himself straight at Hypatia.

speaker: Assassin
content: Confirm... target... die.
CLAAANG!
Under their combined assault, the assassin is forced back again and again. Yet with each retreat, the black-red glow on his dagger intensifies, its sinister aura searing the very air.
Seeing him gather himself for a final, desperate strike, Helga lunges, fingers outstretched for his throat. But she is a heartbeat too slow.
The necrotic energy animates. It peels from the blade not as light, but as a gouging scythe of solidified malice. It flies past Helga's face and hurtles, unerringly, for Hypatia's neck.
Too close. No time to dodge.
In a flash, a blur of white shoves her aside. The lethal sorcery, meant for her throat, sinks deep into her rescuer's arm with a sickening thud.

speaker: Margaret
content: Um...

speaker: Hypatia
content: Margaret...!

speaker: Helga
content: Tsk, stop there!
Helga reaches for the assassin's cloak, her fingers grasping only air as he twists away. Using the distraction, he hurls himself through the window and is swallowed by the night.
(Scene Brightens)
The flesh around the wound is stained a sickening purple-black by the sorcery's lingering energy. Blood pulses from the grievous injury, refusing to clot.

With frantic precision, Hypatia activates the Aurum Secretum device for emergency treatment. Channeling it at full power, she watches as the ragged edges of the wound finally, slowly, begin to knit together.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...I am so terribly sorry... Ms. Margaret... This is all my fault...

speaker: Margaret
content: It's nothing. You're unharmed. That's what matters.

speaker: Margaret
content: So this is the Underground... the true power hiding behind the Luminaris Society and pushing the Black Ring project.

speaker: Margaret
content: The Senate thought using their proxy instead of a Fraser assassin would distance them. Charming.
Just as Hypatia finishes securing the final bandage, Helga swings back through the window.

speaker: Helga
content: Lost him. His sorcery was like nothing I've seen, burrowing through solid ground. Been in this city for decades and never seen its kind. He's bleeding bad, though. Won't be back soon.
Her gaze instantly locks onto the scene: the two women bent over the fresh dressing.

speaker: Helga
content: So. Assassin's gone, you're cut up, and our trap's sprung. What's the brilliant plan now?

speaker: Margaret
content: Hmm... I had hoped this would give us some leverage against the Senate. A shame.

speaker: Margaret
content: Now they're back in the shadows, and we're exposed. Not the best time to make another move. Helga, I need you to get Hypa out of the city. Keep her safe.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What...
Hypatia's expression tenses as she abruptly rises to her feet.

speaker: Hypatia
content: No. Absolutely not. You are injured, Ms. Margaret. Ms. Helga should stay with you, more than ever.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I... I can leave alone and find somewhere to hide. I've done it before...

speaker: Helga
content: Think it's that simple? You're in the thick of it now, girl. Drop the high-minded act.

speaker: Helga
content: You've no idea the net they've cast. With that sad little disguise of yours, you'd be snatched up before you reached the gate.

speaker: Helga
content: What then? Get dragged back to the Senate so Margaret here has to bleed for you again? Or maybe run headlong into that killer and finish his job for him?

speaker: Margaret
content: That's enough, Helga. Don't frighten her.
Margaret takes Hypatia's hand in her own, patting it softly in a gesture of comfort.

speaker: Margaret
content: We are comrades and friends. Protecting one another—and getting hurt in the process—is what that means. You need not worry about it, nor blame yourself for it.

speaker: Margaret
content: I suggested you leave only for your protection. But if you wish to stay, I will respect your choice.

speaker: Margaret
content: Then we think of another way. The Senate broke their word and sent a killer to my doorstep. I do not take that lightly.
After a moment of pensive silence, Hypatia lifts her head and turns her gaze toward the window.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The answer... lies with that Underground assassin.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The Underground sorcery leaves a unique residue. I can trace it. If he will not return to us, I will go to him.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Finding him could unveil the proof linking Fraser to the Underground. It may expose their agents within our walls, perhaps... even lead us to the mastermind of BR-005.
At the thought of the Undergrounders behind BR-005, a cold fire ignites in her chest.

speaker: Margaret
content: There's my clever Hypa. I see the pieces have already fallen into place for you.
Across from her, Margaret snaps her fan shut with a soft click. A knowing smile plays on her lips as she gestures toward Helga, an open invitation in her eyes.

speaker: Margaret
content: In that case, you’ll require instruction from a professional—on how to move unseen. Otherwise, with that sad little disguise of yours, the Senate would have you the moment you step outside. Don’t you agree, Helga?
The tension lasts only a second longer. Then, Hypatia steps forward with resolve and offers Helga a deep, respectful bow.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Ms. Helga. I am aware of my... deficiencies. But I wish to be of true help to Ms. Margaret. I would be grateful for your guidance.

speaker: Helga
content: Tch. Alright then. Listen close, girl. I'm only saying this once.
To vanish in a bustling city like Fraser, you must master three things: awareness, rhythm, and disguise.

First, awareness: gather intelligence from everything around you. Second, rhythm: move with the logical patterns of the city. Finally, disguise: blend your appearance and actions seamlessly into the lives of others. Master these, and you will disappear.

As night falls, Hypatia cloaks herself in a heavy coat and ascends the lookout tower in the city center. Fraser's warm night breeze lifts gently through her hair. At the edge, she gazes down upon the glittering tapestry of the city.

According to Margaret's intelligence, this is the vantage point. Below, a district of luxury hotels and flagship boutiques is carefully insulated by parks and tree-lined avenues, preserving the seclusion of several private residential enclaves.
From her backpack, Hypatia retrieves a pair of binoculars and a small Aurum Secretum drone fitted with detection gear.
Though hastily assembled, in theory, it can scan for Black Ring energy signatures and identify recent sorcery use within a limited radius.
Back at the institute, building a device this sensitive would take a week. With only a day's preparation, its functionality is unstable at best.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Let's see. I hope it brings back the answer I need.
Focusing her will, she channels it into the Aurum Secretum. The device shivers, its metal shell flowing like liquid before it hovers in the air.
After the command is entered, the Aurum Secretum propeller spins to life.
It glides into the night, descending from the watchtower and hovering above a row of fashion boutiques.
Women linger by the display windows, chatting as they show off newly bought jewelry; a passing girl notices a kitten curled up in front of the door and reaches down to stroke its head.
The alarm does not sound. There is no trace of the Black Ring.
It crosses two more streets and comes to a stop above the central park.
Nobles stroll here with their children, savoring a moment of leisure. One young lord spots the drone and hurls a pebble at it; the drone nimbly slips aside.
No alarm. The wielder of Black Ring sorcery is not here.
The drone moves on, street after street. Along the riverbank, some Fraser stars are filming a new series.
A few drunken extras waiting nearby glance up at the drone, mistake it for a camera meant just for them, and begin slurring their lines to the sky.
Not here either. The person Hypatia is looking for is nowhere to be found.
She searches throughout the city, but the detector remains silent.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Nothing. Has the Aurum Secretum detector failed to meet its theoretical sensitivity, or is the target simply that adept at concealment?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Either way, I was too presumptuous...

Hypatia pushes her frustration down as controlling the Aurum Secretum demands significant focus. With careful precision, she channels her power into the device, attempting to guide the little drone back.

speaker: Hypatia
content: First, recover the Aurum Secretum device. Then think of other methods...

speaker: Aurum Secretum Device
content: Bzzzzz!

At that moment, the rose-patterned Aurum Secretum device convulses violently. It grows searingly hot—so hot that one corner deforms and melts instantly. Hypatia stumbles back, a sharp pain lancing through her focus. Then, the gossamer-thin connection to her sensors snaps.

speaker: Hypatia
content: —?! The connection is severed. Was the probe destroyed?

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...No, that's not it!
She bursts from her hiding place and sprints to a two-story building, her eyes fixing on a point in the east-southeast. The five o'clock position.

That is the last registered location of her Aurum Secretum probe. The brilliant lights of the commercial district shine from behind, bathing the upper floors in stark silhouette and leaving the rooftops in profound, backlit shadow. Against this gloom, the dispersed Aurum Secretum particles glimmer weakly, like faint, fractured stars to guide her.

She traces the trail of light. There, laboriously outlined by the darkness, is a silhouette. From this distance and angle, it is impossible to discern whether it is a statue, a person, or some other deliberate, humanoid shape.

For an instant, she is no longer on the rooftop but back in that laboratory, facing Mania for the first time—before the observational apparatus used to dissect darkness itself. Now, as then, her gaze, her breath, her very heartbeat are seized by that overwhelming, deathly silence. The answer is so close, yet suspended across an infinite void.

Chaos and the unknown terrify humanity. Yet, for a scholar, they exert a fatal attraction. Long before she can see, hear, or understand, a deeper instinct—something beyond the five senses—has already whispered the truth.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Found you.
The moment she takes a step, the shadow explodes into motion. It bursts from the pavilion, vaults over a rooftop billboard, and somersaults into the vast, glittering galaxy of Fraser's nightscape.
The darkness collapses, only to coalesce into the definitive shape of a fleeing human. The unknown is punctured; understanding rushes in. Hypatia snaps back to the present, the spell broken.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Don't run!

speaker: Hypatia
content: S-stop!

Thanks to the Campbells' rigorous training regimens, Hypatia's physical strength and endurance are, by noble standards, quite respectable. But chasing a fugitive across the chaotic rooftops of the civilian district is another matter entirely. Despite her efforts, the gap between her and her prey remains stubbornly open.

The bandaged man, in contrast, moves with infuriating ease. He navigates shantytown alleyways and scrambled paths, using the terrain to obstruct her while casually tracking her position. Just like right now, startling an innocent resident in their path easily forces the refined lady into a breathless apology while running.
But he never drops his guard. This noble researcher has already proven herself dangerously intelligent and unnervingly persistent.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I said... stop!

From the man's blind spot, another Aurum Secretum probe zips into view. He abandons the idea of destroying it this time. Instead, he grabs a plastic basin from a nearby home, traps the device beneath it, and claps an iron pot on top to secure his makeshift prison.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Hah... So many little toys. Did I wander into some spy film fan's daydream?

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Persistent, she is.

Probably within a minute, that little hunter will transform again, twisting into a worm-like shape to bore its way free. Meanwhile, the girl has finally hauled herself over the low wall and resumed her pursuit, her portable Aurum Secretum device humming in her wake, its light cutting golden arcs through the dark.
Staying ahead of her is one thing. Shaking her for good is another...

The man's gaze flicks to the next intersection, where the light and noise of the bustling night beckon. The bandages covering the lower half of his face pull tight, creasing into an eerie, knowing shadow.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: ...Heh. Time to borrow the crowd.

With a nimble leap, he gains a higher rooftop. In two long strides, he dives into the flickering neon sea of the marketplace. The crowd swallows him with barely a ripple; the night is that dense, that packed.
It's some financial company's promotion night. A giant mascot stands at the crowd's center, barking amplified advertisements through a loudspeaker.

speaker: Finance Mascot
content: Earn in Fraser, spend in Fraser! Short on funds? We've got your back! Low-risk, high-reward; it's practically a license to print money!

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Thank you for the assist.

speaker: Finance Mascot
content: Eek?!! Who was that? Who touched me?! What is it?!

speaker: Pedestrian A
content: Ah?!

speaker: Pedestrian B
content: Eh!

speaker: Pedestrian C
content: Huh??

Startled cries ripple through the crowd. People turn, bewildered, after being mysteriously tapped on the shoulder, unable to spot the culprit. Unknowingly, they have become links in a living chain. It's as if the night itself has taken the form of a fish, darting through the human current. Wherever it passes, an irresistible urge compels a hand to reach out and tap the next stranger.

What they cannot see is far more sinister. Where each was touched, a black-red pattern, like creeping vines, begins to bloom beneath their clothes. Mania seeps from these marks, threads of invisible corruption stretching between victims to form a vast, unseen web. Then, as the crowd shifts...

speaker: Pedestrian D
content: Eeeek!! Ouch—

For no apparent reason, people suddenly pitch forward, toppling in a swift, grotesque domino effect. As if orchestrated, Hypatia arrives at this exact stretch of crowd just as the tangle of fallen bodies forms an impassable barricade.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Ugh! To think he actually dares to employ sorcery in the downtown...

speaker: Hypatia
content: That vile Undergrounder! I swear I will—

Just as she tries to push forward in pursuit, her coat is abruptly tugged back. An elderly man has fallen to the ground, clutching his lower back in pain, his hand tangled in her hem as he struggles to call for help.

speaker: Fraser Elder
content: Ah, my back... it hurts really bad... Could someone... help an old man up? Oh my fragile heart...

speaker: Hypatia
content: But I...
Ahead, the villain is vanishing into the chaos. Here, an old man lies helpless on the ground, seconds from being trampled.
Hypatia is torn, but in the space of a heartbeat, the choice is made. She yields, as she always must, to the ancient instinct carved into her soul and written in her blood.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I will not abandon you. Here, take my arm. It is not safe here; I will help you to the side of the road... Ah, careful!

speaker: Fraser Elder
content: Thank you, dear child, bless your kind heart... Just over there, a little further up...

With the old man leaning heavily on her arm, their progress toward the roadside is a slow, halting shuffle. Hypatia struggles to maintain focus, her control over the distant Aurum Secretum probe flickering.

With every forced pause, the thought curdles: her enemy could be a mile away now, his lead stretching with each second she spends here. The anxiety thickens inside her, dense and cloying as Fraser's heavy cream.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I'm sorry... Ms. Margaret. I cannot simply abandon them... I will see this elder to safety, then I will catch up to that Undergrounder. I will not fail you.

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: You possess even more conviction than I imagined, Miss Hypatia Campbell.
Her gaze immediately sweeps the vicinity with heightened vigilance, finding no one. Simultaneously, her Aurum Secretum probe confirms its distant target remains ahead. Then...

A moment of focused analysis reveals the truth: the sound resonates directly within her mind, carrying the distinct psychic signature of Mania. It's a form of Mania sorcery, and its anchor point is the elderly man leaning on her arm.
A perfect two-part gambit: delay the pursuer, then open a direct line of communication.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Show yourself, you coward. Cease using innocent civilians as your Mania conduit and face me directly.

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: Peace, please. It's a modified type with minimal Mania exposure. Harmless; it'll clear after a night's rest, impossible to stand in your way. I only resorted to this desperate measure because your tracking prowess left me few alternatives.

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: The war is over. Must this animosity persist? So... let me offer an apology.

speaker: Eerie Echo
content:
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> ...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> It's all mere conjecture for now. I need to gather more data before we can verify our assumption. It will take time. The MBCC will support me as we further investigate the Sillage Society. We'll get to the bottom of this.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> However... one thing is certain.

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: Might I kindly request you to call off the hunt? At least here, in Fraser. For both our sakes, a public spectacle benefits no one.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What? You believe that is why I pursue you?

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: Is it not? On whose authority, then, do you hunt me so relentlessly?

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: The Luminaris Society, who taught you your craft? The Campbell family, guardians of Fraser's interests? Or perhaps...

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: ...are you another little operative on a special mission?
The words are spoken lightly, yet they stir up a tempest in Hypatia's heart.
[Flashback CG: Underground Incident and Hypatia's Hate]

speaker: Hypatia
content: None of those!

speaker: Fraser Elder
content: Oh, my heart!

The elder's cry in pain is the only chain holding back Hypatia's fury. Every muscle strains—partly to support his weight, partly to keep herself rooted to the spot and not hurtle after the fleeing enemy.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Cease your feigned ignorance, Undergrounder... Your sorcery, the Mania you spread, the Black Ring... I have seen your crimes with my own eyes. The scars you left upon this land are etched in my memory.

speaker: Hypatia
content: So many were led to ruin by your kind. Was secretly orchestrating BR-005 not enough? Now you slither into Fraser... What discord do you seek to sow here? Was your assault on Margaret meant to shatter our peace, to rekindle the war?

speaker: Hypatia
content: I act on no one's orders. I take no one's "side." I act for all those you have broken. To expose you. To end you. I will no longer stand by while you wreak your havoc!

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: Pfft... hah! A champion for the suffering masses, is it? I see now. Such a righteous, pure-hearted soul. Precisely why you should step back now, before the mire claims you too...

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: Tell you what. I'll withdraw the sorcery now. I'll even swear a solemn oath to sever ties with all those... unsavory associates. No more trouble from me. And you...

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: Don't fixate on catching me. Don't rush to settle scores with the Underground. If you truly wish to aid the people of the farlands... there is a better path available to you now.

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: See this man to safety, then go home. To truly help, start with what is before you. And keep yourself safe. Fraser is unsettled. Good souls like you should be wary.

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: Don't wander too deep. Don't stay out too late. It's perilous. Learn to look after yourself first. As I have. Understood?

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...What are you saying? I—

speaker: Eerie Echo
content: The more we talk, the firmer your resolve becomes. So... threat neutralized, long live peace. Farewell?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Wait!

The psychic resonance in her mind shatters. Her hearing snaps back to the ordinary clamor of the city as, around her, the Mania-puppeteered people begin to stir. They rise slowly, muttering in confusion, and are absorbed back into the bustling crowd.
The meaning is unmistakable. He has severed the link. He is gone.

speaker: Fraser Elder
content: Y-young lady? Are you quite alright? You seem pale.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I am well. Please forgive my distraction. This way, mind your step.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Are these your family? I am relieved. Think nothing of it; it was my duty. I must attend to other matters now; please excuse my lack of a proper introduction. I wish you and your family safety and happiness.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Goodbye!
She dashes away like the wind, making her way to higher ground.
The crowd below churns with normalcy, oblivious.

Her Aurum Secretum probe, target lost, settles onto her wrist. Frantic, she sweeps her gaze across the scene. She spots a commotion and launches the probe toward it, then pivots herself to intercept a second suspicious movement.

Her undisguised panic draws stares. After her third bow of apology to a startled civilian she's mistaken for her target, the frantic energy leaves her. She slows to a stop in the river of people, chest heaving.

On the bustling street, no alarm sounds, no answer comes. Every face seems to hold the ghost of a memory—they saw something—yet they move through the night as if it were utterly ordinary, just another unremarkable evening in a string of thousands.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Oh my... where did he go...

speaker: Hypatia
content: An accomplice? Am I walking into a trap? Or... is he in trouble himself? His extreme reaction to the Aurum Secretum device detecting the Black Ring residue... that's what gave him away. It was... visceral. Defensive.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But no malice in the crowd sorcery. During his escape, he impeded, but never attacked. He swore he'd cut ties. So why the midnight attack? Who is he acting for now?
Mid-thought, a dangerous glint of silver flickers at the edge of her vision. She stops dead, the attack whistling past where she'd just been.
The attacker stands revealed on a distant hotel rooftop: a figure in a pitch-black cloak, face swathed in bandages, with only a pair of fierce, blood-red eyes visible.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Who are you?!
The assassin, clad in black, spreads his hands. From his fingertips, the silent, corrupted flames of Underground sorcery ignite, and begin to devour the bandages that mask his face.

speaker: Fraser Assassin
content: ...Are you... looking for me?

speaker: Fraser Assassin
content: The runaway... Campbell... Hypatia Campbell. Perfect...

speaker: Fraser Assassin
content: I will bring you back, alive or otherwise.
The sound of writhing flesh hisses beneath the crimson-black flame. In its light, Hypatia sees the dagger—the one that, not long ago, had missed her neck by half an inch.
If her memory serves her right...

speaker: Fraser Assassin
content: I will bring you back, alive or otherwise.

A cold light flashes, a silver arc stabbing for Hypatia's heart. Her Aurum Secretum intercepts with a piercing metallic shriek. At the same moment, the assassin's lowered hand snaps into a fist, unleashing a torrent of crimson-black sorcery directly at her core.

...The dagger was only a feint. This is the true attack: a deceptively simple, nearly unblockable sorcery. Hypatia forces the Aurum Secretum to expand, attempting to envelop it. A wave of corrosive stench explodes between them.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The Underground, sorcery, contamination resembling the Black Ring... Just like the hotel attacker. I know this signature. It's one of them... it's...

The image of the crimson mark in Adelaide's hand flashes through her mind. She remembers his desperate battle with sorcery against the Aurum Secretum Warriors, back when this power was new to him. And she remembers the terrible price each activation demanded.
Could it be him?!

speaker: Hypatia
content: No. More likely an associate. I was careless.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But it's manageable. I can handle this.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Right. I know this power!

Hypatia sidesteps the dagger, refusing to harden the Aurum Secretum into a shield. Instead, she wills it liquid, pooling the golden substance in her palm. Every physical strike is a feint; each sorcerous cast demands a cooldown. Her only chance is to seal the casting flesh before the sorcery activates.

She baits an opening and seizes it. Her hand snakes out, clamping over the assassin's left just as it tenses to cast the sorcery. The Aurum Secretum responds instantly, flowing from her palm to engulf the unborn sorcery. It extends, seals, and hardens into a transparent, shell-like prison. Within, the gathered crimson energy rots into inert blackness, extinguished.
Triumph surges through Hypatia. She's half-tempted to conjure a team of tiny, applauding Aurum Secretum figurines just to celebrate.

speaker: Fraser Assassin
content: ...Target... uncontrollable... then...
Another attack, but the assassin lunges past Hypatia. His target is no longer her body, but the marble deity statue poised on the roof ridge behind her.

His blade strikes the statue's base. A web of fractures explodes across the marble. The compromised statue groans, tilting precariously on the edge before beginning its deadly teeter toward the crowded street far below.

speaker: Hypatia
content: No! The people—!
The girl throws herself toward the roof's edge, the Aurum Secretum in her hands warping violently as she snags the falling statue.
Yet the marble weight is colossal, ruthlessly pulling her down.

speaker: Fraser Assassin
content: ...Dislocate the limbs, bring her back alive...
With the assassin looming over her, Hypatia strains to lift herself or conjure even a sliver of Aurum Secretum. But the marble weight is absolute, crushing her attempts into nothing.
Her gaze locks on the rising dagger, only to see the assassin jolt violently and fall, his body gone stiff. Over his motionless form, the bandaged man looks back at her, his face finally exposed.
Didn't I mention it was dangerous outside? You really should have gone home.

He raises a hand, and a blade of pure shadow shoots out from his palm. The thunderous explosion of shattering stone erupts beside her, stopping her heart. In the choking cloud of rock dust, the Aurum Secretum net—now free from the target—contracts into a sharp blade in her hand. She has time for one desperate strike before he closes in.

Gritting her teeth, the girl swings her only weapon with everything she has. Untrained, she feels her blade meet only air before her wrist is twisted with effortless force, the weapon torn from her grip.

As the dust settles, the pale bandages fall away, revealing the true face of the visitor from the Underground. His blood-red eyes meet hers, holding a calm gentleness worlds apart from the murderous intent she'd seen in them that night.
A mocking smile touches his lips.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Oh my, careful now, little scholar... A friend of mine is quite fond of this face. If it gets marred, I'll have some difficult explaining to do.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Lower your weapon. Researchers ought to value their lives more. Leave this one to me.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: At the very least, you can believe now that I'm not with these fanatical monsters, yes?
In the aftermath of her narrow escape, the bandaged man makes quick work of the remaining assassins while Hypatia slumps against the stone statue, gasping for breath.
The man, however, seems utterly unruffled. After using a quick, efficient sorcery to "cleanse" the ground of traces, he turns back to Hypatia with a smile.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Thank you.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: First time I've been thanked by a Campbell with such sincerity. You're welcome, miss. I'm simply glad to settle our... disagreement. Clearing up this misunderstanding is a welcome bonus.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Well then, nothing more to dwell on this time, I hope? Do remember to head home early. I wish you the best of luck. Farewell.

His graceful exit is met with neither the reaction he expected nor an uncompromising demand to stay. Instead, Hypatia sinks into a painful crouch, curling around herself as she clutches her side. Blood is already seeping through her fingers.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Ngh... It hurts... so much...

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: ...You're injured? From those assassins?

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: That's not good... Let me see.
He moves forward to check on her, but after only a few steps, his hands are suddenly ensnared by ropes of transformed Aurum Secretum.
Hypatia looks up, her face still pale from blood loss, but her eyes are now clear of any pain, holding only cool, deliberate focus.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Got you.
For a few seconds, they simply stare. Then Rust's expression cracks, and he throws his head back with a laugh of pure admiration.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: I take back my earlier statement. Never releasing your prey once sighted, even leveraging your own wounds... You truly are a Campbell through and through.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: What is the charge, then? Do you still consider me guilty, even now?
His words give Hypatia pause. Her first instinct is to explain—to credit the method to a friend from DisCity, not the Campbell legacy. But what leaves her lips is something else altogether.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...I'm sorry. I don't mean to accuse you of a crime, nor do I wish to repay kindness with betrayal. This is simply... to ensure you don't slip away again.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I regret the necessity, but you are far too adept at vanishing. If I let you go now, I may never catch up. Please, tell me the truth. The circumstances leave me no choice. I must have answers.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What is the nature of that sorcery? What is your connection to those assassins? They attacked my friend and me before. Are they hunting you as well? You said Fraser has grown unsettled. What do you know?
Her questions grow sharper, more urgent, edging into something like a plea.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Tell me everything, please! Do this, and I will release the restraints immediately. Otherwise, they will bind you no matter where you go.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Oh? Aurum Secretum shackles that pursue their target... Like this?
Hypatia glances down at her hands, only to discover that the bandaged man has somehow slipped the handcuffs. Now, her own wrists are locked together, immobilized.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Mmph—you!
Whatever else she might try, her tools have already been confiscated.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: I'll be holding onto these as well. Your little gadgets are quite remarkable. I'll return them once I've made my safe departure.
As he speaks, he casts a series of swift, precise sorceries that lock Hypatia in place. Then, meeting her defiant glare, he sits down casually and reaches for her personal bag.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Please give that back to me!
He draws out a palm-sized photograph. In it, Hypatia stands shoulder-to-shoulder with a girl whose hair is the color of lilac, the blazing sunset of Furor painting the sky behind them.
He lifts the photo to the moonlight, studying it with quiet intensity.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: This is you and your friend, isn't it? Such a radiant bond... it inspires envy.
He stares at it a moment, an unreadable flicker in his eyes. Before Hypatia can parse his expression, he carefully tucks the photo away and returns the bag to her. Then...

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: But not every gift from a friend deserves your unwavering trust. For instance, this—
His hand darts behind her collar, and from the lining of her clothes, he extracts a small bird crafted from Aurum Secretum.

speaker: Hypatia
content: This is...?
Recognition flashes through her: this is the communications network she built with Margaret!

They had used this very technology to beam Aurum Secretum data to DisCity in a split second. But... why would Margaret place it there, inside her collar? When did she have the chance? How could Hypatia have missed it completely...?

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: A listening device, it seems. Or a tracker. Quite fresh, placed very recently... Someone has been quietly monitoring your movements.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Do you know who is responsible, Miss Campbell?
She knows. The name sits on her tongue, but after a faltering breath, she swallows it and chooses silence.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: Unwilling to say? It must be another friend of yours. You refuse to betray a friend. How commendable. I imagine this is the same friend who sent you to find me.

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: You trust her so completely, risking your life on her behalf. But what has she truly offered you in return? For instance... even basic honesty?

speaker: Bandaged Man
content: When she placed this little tracker on you and sent you into danger, was she being honest with you then?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Please, don't speak of her that way. She—
Just then, the small bird begins to vibrate.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: That will be enough, sir. Please refrain from that divisive rhetoric. The girl before you has already endured harsh trials. What she needs now is assurance, not to be pushed into an abyss of doubt and fear. At the very least, I value her trust and am deeply concerned for her safety.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: I believe I still hold some credibility with you, do I not?

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: It has been some time, Agent Rust. And you have worked hard, Hypatia.

speaker: Rust
content: How courteous, DisCity's "Peace Dove." I must admit, I didn't expect our reunion to take place under these circumstances.
They trade barbed remarks like old sparring partners, their words sparking in the space between them. Hypatia watches from the sidelines, utterly bewildered.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...You two... know each other? But Ms. Margaret clearly stated he was from the Underground, that he was...

speaker: Hypatia
content: What is truly happening here?

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: I am sorry, Hypatia. Had I not said that, you would have insisted on remaining by my side to protect me. You have always been such a noble-hearted soul.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: But I wanted you away from that perilous situation more than anything. Only the premise of "neutralizing the assassin completely" would compel you to leave my side, would it not? I hope you can forgive my small deception.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Now, let me correct the record. The man before you is not a hound of the Underground. On the contrary, he was once an intelligence officer of DisCity, a distinguished agent of the 9th Agency, and a formidable soldier both despised and feared by the Underground—a legendary operative codenamed "Rust."

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Now, the reliable Agent Rust will escort you out of Fraser City to a place of greater safety. This will finally allow me to set my mind at ease.
Hypatia shows no hint of joy. Instead, she looks utterly dejected, her expression heavy with defeat.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Are you... still sending me away? Because I am a burden?

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: I wish for you to be removed from immediate danger.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But everyone is in danger now. No one can truly escape it. You are in peril, Ms. Margaret, as is everyone in Fraser and the Farland Alliance. I do not wish to flee from danger; I want to contribute, to help.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Do you believe... I am not qualified?

After a brief silence, the little bird gently alights on the young woman's shoulder and nuzzles her cheek. The voice that emerges from it is warm and smiling, as if Margaret's fond expression is somehow visible through her words.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: You are even stronger than I imagined, Hypatia. But do not misunderstand; I have never doubted your courage.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: I want you away from Fraser's dangers because I need you to address the source of the threat, and it is not here.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...But you said the <color=#fb9259>Unity Gala</color> would be the decisive battleground.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Indeed, because it will gather those who truly hold the power to decide.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: What determines outcomes is not the split-second choice made when weapons are drawn, but the long, subtle influences and preparations that precede any confrontation.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: We require a new mediator, someone who can journey personally into the WhiteSands... into the heart of the calamities.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Go among the people. Understand their hardships, honor their wishes, and bridge their misunderstandings. Only then can we dismantle Fraser's control over them and guide them back to the right side of history.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: I wish I could be that crucial bridge myself. But I was raised in DisCity, and I cannot overcome the historical animosity attached to my identity. They would never open their hearts to me. That is why this vital mission can only be entrusted to you.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Unite the Alliance... me...?
Hypatia had envisioned countless battles—repelling enemies, protecting friends, safeguarding hope. She had even imagined sacrificing her life in combat, refusing to ever stand aside.
But she had never imagined this would be the answer.

speaker: Phantom's Voice
content: Fool... you think you can outrun your guilt? Escape your duty? You promised you would save us...

speaker: Victim's Voices
content: You stood by, watching us die with open eyes... because you are even more hypocritical than your kin! Ptui!

speaker: Hella?
content: Where were you when the Furor refugees marched into the Black Ring? Where were you when I was trapped in there? You've got no guts, no spine; you can't get anything done! A coward like you doesn't deserve to be my friend!

speaker: Hypatia
content: But I...
The Aurum Secretum bird opens its beak to continue, and is abruptly cut off as another voice seizes the conversation.

speaker: Rust
content: Still so good at issuing directives, Ambassador Margaret. Was commanding your own subordinates not enough? Now you're weaving schemes to enlist non-DisCitizens as well?

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: My, my... Hypatia is my treasured friend. It is out of concern for her that I requested your assistance. If you persist in driving a wedge between us, I may truly begin to take offense.
The man gives a faint, dismissive roll of his eyes.

speaker: Rust
content: Heh, sorry for commenting on your friendship with Miss Campbell. But please, refrain from attempting to draft me into your designs as well, won't you?

speaker: Rust
content: How long has it been since you last communicated with your other "friend," Silver Spider? Were you unaware I've long since parted ways with the 9th Agency?

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Thank you for your concern. Our rapport remains as intimate as ever; we are old classmates, after all. Unlike some, who refuse missions from old friends, stubborn as a runaway boy... ah, forgive me, I meant "persistent."

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Nevertheless, through careful observation, I believe I understand you better now. For instance, given your temperament, you wouldn't stand idly by while a kind-hearted girl finds herself in grave peril, would you?

speaker: Rust
content: Heh. There are far too many "kind people" in distress around here. My waiting list is booked solid through next year.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Could you adjust her priority? You know that Hypatia is a Luminaris Society expert and a direct witness to BR-005.

speaker: Rust
content: All I know is that she is a child. And I fundamentally disagree with both you and the Luminaris Society on this point.

speaker: Rust
content: Children like her should be kept far from conflicts from the start, given proper protection. Not dragged onto the "battlefield" to fulfill some abstract notion of "value."
His tone sharpens into ice, met only by the unwavering tenderness in Margaret's voice.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: You underestimate her, sir. Allow me to share something you may not know.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: During the Ash Campaign, while on the run for mere weeks, she independently analyzed and decoded the Aurum Secretum signature data from BR-005, transmitted it to the FAC Broken Frontline in DisCity, and ultimately facilitated the precise targeting and destruction of the Apostles, bringing the war to an early conclusion.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: All of this was accomplished by the "child" before you. Even outside the Luminaris Society, she remains a peerless scholarly talent, rivaling the frontline researchers of the Ring Research Institute.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Now, will you still maintain that condescending view, looking down on Hypatia as a mere "child"? On the path you yourself are desperately seeking, she may have already run ahead, closer than you to the "answer" you desire.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Do you not wish to see for yourself?
He doesn't answer. Instead, he turns toward Hypatia, his gaze resting on her for a long, silent moment.

speaker: Rust
content: You're right. My apologies, Researcher Campbell. You deserve far more respect than I have shown you.
Margaret's tone softens as well, mirroring the shift toward calm.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: She is a precious asset to both Fraser and DisCity. Yet, as you've just witnessed, here her talents are squandered, and her life is not valued. That, I believe, is the true tragedy.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: I believe we both wish to see... what she could truly achieve if allowed to flourish.

speaker: Rust
content: ...Very well. I'll go. But let one thing be clear.

speaker: Rust
content: I promise to ensure Miss Campbell's safety. However, my methods and judgments will not be swayed by you. As you noted, I have my own path to walk. It does not align with yours.

speaker: Rust
content: I suggest you factor that into your calculations, Madam "Peace Dove."
Amusement colors her tone, bright and unmistakable.

speaker: Bird Communicator
content: Thank you for the reminder. I shall keep it in mind.
[Scene Transition: Dove's portrait]

speaker: Margaret
content: Hypatia, I know the shadows of BR-005 still linger within you. Asking you to step forward and face them once more... is perhaps a cruel request.

speaker: Margaret
content: But now... I need you more than ever.
The Aurum Secretum bird lands on Hypatia's shoulder and gently nuzzles against her cheek.

speaker: Margaret
content: The Black Ring has intensified the calamities. War has stripped away what little Aurum Secretum and Hypercubes remained. The farlands stand on the brink of a survival crisis. And yet, even now, Fraser continues to manipulate and exploit their desperation.

speaker: Margaret
content: They know that those who have lost everything are the most susceptible, that people cornered by despair are the easiest to control... Even a false hope becomes a precious treasure when it's all you have left.
Visions of Furor invade her mind, and the memory strikes Hypatia's heart with a physical ache.

speaker: Margaret
content: Use your brilliance and your sincerity to cut through the fog for them. Bring them genuine hope. Do not allow such tragedies to repeat, for their sake, and for ours.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...I understand. If this concerns the future of the Alliance, and the survival of all...

speaker: Hypatia
content: I will give it my all.

speaker: Margaret
content: Good. I'll spare you any more lengthy exhortations. I wish you both a safe journey. I'll be watching through our little friend here and will support you in any way I can.

speaker: Margaret
content: Hypa, Rust, we will meet again soon. And when we do, we shall celebrate peace together.
The farewell given, the display in the air winks out.
The farlands... journey to the farlands, clear up misunderstandings, and become a bridge for peace.

Hypatia turns the words over in her mind. She feels their weight, a cause to which she would gladly dedicate herself. But can these ideals truly be realized? This man standing before her... will he help her make them a reality?

speaker: Rust
content: Then, let's tend to your wounds promptly, and we set out afterward. Your mission will not be simple. We must make thorough preparations.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Yes. Oh wait.
Hypatia gathers herself. With deliberate grace, she takes a step back and performs a deep, formal curtsy.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Thank you for your generosity. I place myself in your care for the journey to the farlands.

speaker: Rust
content: Think nothing of it. We will be relying on each other.
With a smile, Rust extends his hand to Hypatia.
She hesitates for a moment, then finally takes it.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Thank you.
White sand blots out the sun; dark grit dances madly in a wind, threatening to devour the sky whole. Then, a thunderous roar. A rift splits the sandstorm, and a small sand ship explodes through.
Engines screaming at full throttle, the hull shudders under the barrage of swirling sand. Sand beasts scrabble up the ship's sharp tail fins, claws latched deep into the metal.
Finally, they haul themselves onto the deck, only to spring the traps awaiting them.
Golden light flashes, severing limbs at the joint. Then, a violent lurch of the ship hurls the maimed creatures overboard. Their agonized screams trail behind as they fall.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Phew...

speaker: Rust
content: That's the ninth wave since dawn. Still holding together, Miss Campbell?

speaker: Hypatia
content: I am managing. I only hope your navigation hasn't led us astray. Can we truly reach the farlands region you mentioned before nightfall?
A smile touches Rust's lips. If she still has the energy for talking back, then she's going to be alright.

speaker: Rust
content: It won't take nearly that long. Come back and take a nap. By the time you wake, our destination will be in view.
Hypatia closes the comm channel. For a long moment, she stares into the distance, her silence heavy.
The brand on her neck throbs with a dull, undeniable ache—a pain rooted not in illusion, but in the brutal reality laid out before her.

WhiteSands is a different world from not long ago. Massive ashen rifts scar the landscape, their edges weeping pollutants. Sandstorms boil over the horizon in endless waves, and Corruptors stalk within them. Beneath it all, sand beasts writhe, mutating in the poisoned mud, their snarls twisting into shrieks as they turn on one another.
All of it, a cascading disaster born of the BR-005 outbreak.

A gale hurls black grit against her, peppering her skin with a thousand stinging, contaminated cuts. She doesn't flinch. She doesn't shield her eyes. She forces herself to watch, to feel, etching every detail of the devastation into her memory.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...This is your responsibility... Hypatia...

speaker: Hypatia
content: Never forget.
[Scene Change: Inside the Sand Ship]

Back inside the sand ship, Hypatia heads straight for the central purifier. The cool, sterile spray washes the last grains of contaminated grit from her skin and clothes. In the unit's damp chill, she retrieves the communicator from Margaret and places it beneath the cold vent.
Its signal has been weak and intermittent since they entered the WhiteSands, with messages arriving in frustrating, delayed bursts.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Most messages are just routine updates and words of care, but simply hearing Ms. Margaret's voice brings a sense of calm.

speaker: Hypatia
content: She remains in Fraser, negotiating with the elites at great personal risk, fighting for justice for the farland people... I cannot fail her expectations out here.
She turns on the communicator.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Ms. Margaret, it has been some time.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Two days have passed without contact. I hope all is well with you in Fraser, and that the Senate is not proving overly troublesome.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Mr. Rust and I are en route to a farland settlement known as "Crag's Nest." I understand that key leaders from various communities have gathered there for a council, to discuss the future of the farlands in this post-war era.

speaker: Hypatia
content: We should arrive today. I promise I will not disappoint your trust. I will aid them, unite them, and help the people of the farlands overcome this hardship.
[Slowly fade to black, then pause for 2 seconds]

After her time in the cleansing room, Hypatia returns to the cabin and finds him at once: the dashing spy from DisCity, propped against the console. His focus is total, fingers dancing across screens as he navigates the ship through a fractured landscape of hazards.

speaker: Rust
content: We'll enter the target zone in another two hours. Will that be sufficient for you to rest?
Hypatia shakes her head politely.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I'm fine. Don't worry about me.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Since we still have time, I will go to the engine room to check the status of the Aurum Secretum systems...
Rust raises an eyebrow.
Since their journey began, the Campbell girl has been unusually driven. Not only does she spearhead every clash with Corruptors, but she also proposes daily ship upgrades with Aurum Secretum.

Her systematic enhancements—to the engines, the fuel tanks, the wings—have already halved a five-day trek. Watching her work, Rust is convinced: with enough Aurum Secretum, she could fabricate an entire sand ship, resonance-powered and wholly new.

speaker: Rust
content: ...The Campbells and the Luminaris Society truly found a prodigy.
He knows what drives her. Every mark on this broken land seems to sharpen her guilt, a relentless need to make amends through sheer motion.
But there have to be limits.
Rust's hand flashes out, taking the cabin keys from the dashboard before she can react. Hypatia is left clutching at nothing.

speaker: Rust
content: Those shadows under your eyes haven't faded much, Miss Campbell.

speaker: Rust
content: Haste rarely yields greatness. Take your friend Margaret, for instance... she waited in Fraser for over a decade before her current opportunity arose.

speaker: Rust
content: The road ahead is still long. Use this travel time to get some proper rest. You'll need your full strength to perform when we arrive, won't you?

speaker: Hypatia
content: But...
RIIIING—
Just then, a warning light blares to life on the control panel.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Is it Mania-field contamination? I'll go!

speaker: Rust
content: No... not this time.

On the horizon, a massive black sandstorm rages toward the northwest. Its towering wall of shadow churns with clouds of Mania darker than pitch, and the sands within scream with a sound like tortured voices.
This scene of devastation is all too familiar—

speaker: Hypatia
content: "Tide of Ashes"... but that direction is...

speaker: Rust
content: That's the pass we need to traverse to reach our destination. It seems our timing is impeccable.
Rust tosses the sand ship's safety harness to Hypatia.

speaker: Rust
content: Hold on tight. You really don't want to be thrown from the ship.
[Black Screen, lasting more than 2 seconds]
[Scene Change: Rift Valley Encampment] [Ash Effect]
West of WhiteSands, the land dips into a valley, a final barrier between the sand sea and the sprawling farlands.
This rocky cleft has long held back the desolate dunes, its walls cupping precious moisture like a pair of sheltering hands to sustain a modest settlement.
Now, it is a breach point. Endless dark clouds, borne on the storm, have smothered the entire pass. Through the narrow gap, a tide of contamination-twisted sand beasts pours forth.
A dozen Aurum Secretum Warriors move like silver flashes between the rocks, fighting with desperate grace, but they are a dam against a flood.
Old folks and kids, fall back! Everyone who can fight, move up! Support Rael and the others! Don't let those bastards breach the line!
Grab anything that can be used as a weapon and fight! ****... Why now of all times...?
A hoarse female voice echoes off the rock walls. The woman stands on a high ledge of the camp, her face etched by the years, directing the panicked crowd below.
Inside the camp, people rush in a frenzy of pure chaos. The scars of past calamities are branded deep, triggering a primal urge to flee—though there is nowhere left to run.

Suddenly, the grinding crunch of splitting stone erupts from a nearby crevice. The leader of the valley snaps her gaze upward as a small sand ship scrapes violently through the gap between the cliffs.

It carves an ugly arc through the air, tumbles twice, and slams into the boundary marker in the center of camp. From the wreckage, a figure in black steps out with grace, followed closely by someone smaller shrouded in a WhiteSands cloak.

speaker: Rust
content: Hey, Yokna!

In an instant, the legendary spy's usual polish vanishes, replaced by a perfect farland accent. He slips among the locals like he'd never left, as if the suit and the swagger had all been someone else's skin.

speaker: Yokna
content: Rust? Well, I'll be damned. Where the hell have you been hiding?

speaker: Yokna
content: Forget it, no time for catching up. The Apostles of Ashes have gone completely mad lately, the calamity zones keep spreading, and Fraser confiscated our Aurum Secretum for their war, knocking out our guidance systems. If you've got nothing better to do, help hold the line for a bit. I need to patch up the damn roof.
Another explosion, thunderous and deep, rocks the valley to its foundations. The walls shudder violently, raining sand and broken stone.

speaker: Rust
content: That roof won't stop Apostles. Scrap the guidance idea for now. Do you still have those barrier units shipped from Furor a while back?

speaker: Yokna
content: Those? Just a bunch of war trophies. Good for show, useless in a fight. They're all busted, and none of our tinkerers have a clue how to fix 'em!
Rust glances at Hypatia. Her hood conceals her expression, but at the mention of Furor, her fists tighten reflexively.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Where are the Aurum Secretum barriers? I can repair them. Please, take me to them!

speaker: Yokna
content: You? Who are you supposed to be?

speaker: Hypatia
content: I... I'm Mr. Rust's assistant! I can fix Aurum Secretum devices. Please, trust me!
Yokna narrows her eyes, studying the small figure beside Rust. The voice is a young girl's, but her face stays hidden beneath a WhiteSands cloak, her reasons as unclear as her features.

speaker: Yokna
content: Hmph. Don't care who you are if you can be useful. Marco! Take the girl to the barrier units!
Hypatia's eyes light up. Without a word, she follows Yokna's subordinate toward the camp's higher ground.
Rust offers Yokna a knowing smile, a casual wave, and then turns on his heel, walking away from the settlement without looking back.

speaker: Rust
content: Think I'll go lend a hand out there.
On the highest hillside overlooking the farland camp, Hypatia finds a graveyard of old machines.
The equipment is old, obsolete models from decades past, their casings eaten away by sand and time, leaving rusted guts exposed to the wind.

speaker: Young Engineer
content: Donald

speaker: Young Engineer
content: The gear from Furor is much more advanced, but we don't really understand it. We salvaged it, but... if you know how to activate it, miss, that would be awesome...

Before the pitch-black devices, the truth becomes starkly clear. The farland salvagers didn't comprehend the full scope of what they were taking; they saw function, not design, not knowing these machines were only skeletons of a greater whole.
Now, with the Tide of Ashes imminent, their last hope is nothing but an elegant ruin.

speaker: Young Engineer
content: Miss Assistant, is there a way to fix it? Just tell me what you need! I'll find the materials!
Hypatia can't bring herself to tell them the truth. She turns instead, letting her eyes pass over the equipment half-erased by wind and time.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...There is one way.
She raises a hand. From her sleeve, a single filament of gold descends, touching the earth, then spreads in all directions like a rose unfurling across the ground.
Aurum Secretum flows into the old machinery, bathing each dormant piece in a soft, luminous sheen.

Though the machines no longer function, their core materials endure. By harmonizing these components with the Aurum Secretum through resonant alignment, a barrier may yet be formed—one large enough to shield the entire camp.
Dissolution, deformation, reconstruction, and finally, resonance!
BUZZZZZ—
A low, gathering hum swells into a sky-shaking roar as the nearly derelict pile of guardian machinery shudders back to life.

Streams of golden light surge through long-dormant conduits, weaving into radiant bands overhead. They knit together into a vast, shimmering dome that envelops the entire settlement. Even through the battered roof, the storm's howl falls completely silent.
Below, those caught in panic slow to a halt. They stare upward, awestruck by the golden canopy, their fear—for a moment—forgotten.

speaker: Young Engineer
content: This... this is... a miracle...

speaker: Elder Engineer
content: How did she... it was all beyond repair... but...
A stunned silence hangs in the air, then shatters into roaring cheers. The crowd surges toward the platform, voices rising in a tumult of awe and gratitude for Hypatia's miracle.

speaker: Hypatia
content: N-no! It's not like that! I don't have any special power. This is just Aurum Secretum technology, that's all... I merely...
She shakes her head, her gaze flickering nervously across the faces watching her.
[Small CG: Rust in the Crowd]
Rust stands amid the crowd, yet feels worlds apart.
Ash dusts his shoulders, drifting from him like silent snow.
His gaze drops, then lifts again. It's deliberately casual, as if nothing held his eye. A faint smile touches his lips, and he melts back into the throng.
It is Yokna who stills the celebration. She parts the crowd with quiet authority and steps before Hypatia, her expression solemn.

speaker: Yokna
content: You have shielded our camp. Honored guest, what is your name?

speaker: Hypatia
