speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since the moment I decided to face the Black Rings head-on, I've had to rely on the help of the brightest minds. And there was a time when I truly needed all of you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like many in this city, we believe in logic and reason—the fruits of our civilization. We also believe in those who have reached the pinnacle of rationality, who dedicate themselves to the pursuit of truth and knowledge.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Just as I believe humanity can overcome Mania, I want to... believe in all of you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But rationality seems more complicated than I thought. People like you, who stand at its pinnacle, are far beyond my reach. I can't see you clearly anymore, and I don't have the strength to keep trying.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The battle of BR-003 isn't over yet. I am accountable to the people I've made promises to, and I need to eliminate every risk. Until this all comes to an end, until you tell me the truth, I won't be telling you anything more.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I won't treat you as an enemy, not until I have solid evidence.

options: But I won't regard you as a friend anymore either.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The toughest battlefield still lies ahead. I can't rely on someone I don't trust.
Celine stares at you intently. For a moment, you can't tell whether the expression on her face is a smile or something else. Then you hear her speak, softly.

speaker: Celine
content: It's alright, Chief. You were too kind to me before. Let's take this chance to get to know each other all over again.

speaker: Celine
content: Look at me. See right through me. I much prefer the way you look at me now.
end

speaker: Celine
content: The history I record can only reach the truth through eyes like yours.
She raises her hand and touches your eyes, as if also touching what they scrutinize—herself.
[Black Screen]
She sees the guest out and shuts out all the noise. It's time to focus on her research. As the library begins its closing procedures, she prepares to return to the silence of history.
Yet, footsteps echo through the empty library once more.
[Return to background]
Celine recognizes whose footsteps these are. She lifts her head and recovers her smile.

speaker: Celine
content: What brings you here? Your thesis has been accepted. You don't need to burn the midnight oil anymore. You should be getting some proper rest.

speaker: Celine
content: Or did you come to celebrate with me?

speaker: Linda
content: Professor...
Linda's face has never seemed so somber.

speaker: Celine
content: ...What happened?
When you're back at the Bureau, it's still well before dawn. You see a small shadow outside the main gate.
[Schorl] 1s
Before going to meet Celine, you ordered it to stay behind and forbade it from following. So it waited at the gate until now.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: You have not taken any alarming actions. There is no need for surveillance.
You say nothing and simply walk past it, entering through the main gate. Schorl follows.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: However, based on past experience, your current reaction is rather unusual. I believe you did not obtain the answers you wanted from Professor Fabius. That's why you're wandering around alone at night.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Based on past experience and online research, this may be defined as "loneliness." I believe you may need a companion.
You stop and turn back to look at it. It's still the same dull, black body, except now there's a scar on it. Seeing you turn around, it pauses for a moment.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Did I misjudge? Do I need to be recalibrated?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...No, you don't.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But now, I may take an alarming action.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Please state your request. I will assess it.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Calculation completed. Result: This is a high-risk action. Proceed with caution.
For some reason, even though it's still using the same brainwave communication, you can feel the signals becoming heavier.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Follow me.
Isomer detests memories.
They are omnipresent.
[Scene Transition] [Entering Memory]

speaker: Lambert
content: Your paper on deep Mania resonance was praised by someone important. She wants you to join the Observation Hub. Specifically, the super-loop communication research group. I said yes. Consider this a great opportunity.

speaker: Lambert
content: Start preparing the report for the group meeting. EDGE will be sending representatives. I'll deliver the presentation, and you'll back me up. Make sure we have more than enough content.

speaker: Lambert
content: And don't make me lose face in front of those kids.

speaker: Researcher
content: Who are you to take my spot? You've only published one paper. In terms of seniority, publications, and connections... it should've been me. I've been with the professor longer. I should have been the one to stay!

speaker: Researcher
content: Genius this, genius that... Just wait. One day, you'll get kicked down too. Just you wait...!

speaker: Summer
content: Those subjects were sooo boring! My dimensional singularity theory is way more exciting. Oh, there's also Mania matter conversion and energy utilization enhancement... That's right! Just like Prometheus who stole the fire!

speaker: Summer
content: What? Even you don't get it? Oh well...

speaker: Lemma
content: I read all your papers. Finished them in one night. Oh, nothing impressive about that. I just breezed through them. I even drafted several improvement proposals. Have a look and see if you agree?

speaker: Lemma
content: What? You forgot? But these were your projects back before you graduated, right? Don't tell me you've gotten worse over the years.

speaker: Lemma
content: What on earth are you doing?! Isomer!
[Exit Flashback]
Isomer opens her eyes.

May 31, N.F. 116
3:01 AM
BR-003 High-Altitude Observation Hub
A black bipyramid appears before her. It's jet black, with no numbers marked on it, yet Isomer recognizes it instantly like a brainwave connection.

speaker: Isomer
content: ...It's you.

speaker: Schorl
content: Yes. I've come to collect what you promised during your interrogation.

speaker: Schorl
content: I think we both know your collaboration with <color=#fb9259>them</color> will reward you with valuable intelligence. You serve only yourself, and you're quite good at it.

speaker: Schorl
content: You've been sharing the progress of EDGE's dimensional technology with the Sillage Society. You must have gained quite a few things in return.

speaker: Isomer
content: Of course. Is this what you want?
She raises her hand, summoning that chaos cube. This time, its contents shake a little, reflecting several ominous red lines.
A fine, wicker-like pattern, writhing within.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...Sage power. So you really did make contact with their fourth member.
Faint streams of light ripple across Schorl's jet-black surface, sweeping over Isomer's cube. It's running an in-depth analysis. Soon, the other person reaches a preliminary conclusion.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...It still retains some features of organic blood, but the purity of the Mania is high. Based on past cases, this type of "gift" either leads to death, or the birth of powerful Sinners.

speaker: Schorl
content: But your M-value remains within a safe range.

speaker: Isomer
content: I spent six months analyzing it, integrating every anti-Mania theory the kids developed and testing them one by one. In the end, I managed to produce a new model. One that restricts Mania leakage while retaining part of the resonance and its ability to attack and defend.

speaker: Isomer
content: The underlying structure is still chaotic, but I've managed to bring it to a degree of stability.

speaker: Schorl
content: Impressive results. Last time, when tracking the Underground Puppets and rescuing SHP-13, you used the power of this resonance to complete the inverse analysis as well, correct?

speaker: Isomer
content: Yes. I've already deciphered the power code of one of the Underground Sages.

speaker: Isomer
content: There is only one problem. When this power was bestowed upon me, it had bound itself to my consciousness. None of the other EDGE "geniuses" can inherit it, steal it, or analyze it. In other words, I am the <color=#fb9259>sole</color> possessor of this technology. I am <color=#fb9259>irreplaceable</color>.

speaker: Isomer
content: So, what will you do now, ma'am?

speaker: Schorl
content: What will I do?
The bipyramid vibrates slightly, as if laughing.

speaker: Schorl
content: I'll be proud of you, of course, Isomer. Your talent is undeniable.

speaker: Schorl
content: Don't worry. I don't intend to make an issue of your relationship with Sillage, and I won't put you in a difficult position. I know you weren't the one who leaked BR-003's secrets.

speaker: Schorl
content: I already know who the real culprit is. The <color=#fb9259>method</color>, <color=#fb9259>motive</color>, and <color=#fb9259>scope of damage</color> have all been assessed. Initial measures have been taken.

speaker: Schorl
content: I just... didn't expect to discover more secrets within the little secrets of those kids.
Isomer's brow furrows instinctively.

speaker: Isomer
content: What do you mean?

speaker: Schorl
content: No need to concern yourself with that. We'll handle it. What you need to do is continue driving the research forward and deliver results. I'll see that you're rewarded accordingly.

speaker: Schorl
content: For example, tell me, what is it that you want right now?
[Flashback Filter]

speaker: Isomer
content: ...Me? I want to join the Ring Research Institute. If possible, I'd like to work under Professor Lambert. I want to crack the Mania problem and fight against the disasters on the front line.

speaker: Isomer
content: I know I haven't achieved enough yet, but I still want to be a scientist.
[Exit Flashback]

speaker: Isomer
content: What I want has never changed.

speaker: Isomer
content: Give me that vacant EDGE seat. Authority is the only thing I want. As for the projects and data left behind by the former 07, I can't carry them on, nor do I care to.
She turns her gaze toward the black bipyramid.

speaker: Isomer
content: Why don't you come? The amount of data is massive, and it involves highly classified material such as EDGE's core security intelligence. Even the most secure conventional transfer methods carry a risk of leaks or interception...

speaker: Isomer
content: I'd suggest you come in person.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...You want me to leave Paradeisos, come to a location that's already suffered enemy attacks, and expose myself to danger?

speaker: Isomer
content: Yes. Weigh the risks, ma'am. If you don't retrieve this data, it remains in danger all the same.

speaker: Schorl
content: Heh... Persuasive as always.

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#fb9259>Who</color> are you working for right now, Isomer?
It rises slightly higher, hovering above. Scanning. Scrutinizing.
Isomer doesn't flinch. She approaches it.

speaker: Isomer
content: I work for <color=#fb9259>myself</color>. But what about you? All your scheming, all your calculations... it's all because you covet Lemma's <color=#fb9259>unexpected breakthrough</color>, isn't it?

speaker: Isomer
content: EDGE-02.
She speaks firmly, without a hint of hesitation, completely convinced by her own words.

speaker: Schorl
content: Heh... What I covet? You'll find out eventually.

speaker: Schorl
content: For now, let's work together to get you what you want.

speaker: Schorl
content: I accept your proposal. We'll meet at the Observation Hub on the agreed date, Isomer.

Central Library
May 31
The 3rd day after its closure
Celine Fabius reclines in a curved chair by the window.
Memories surge through rapidly in her chronicler mind, while her pen races across the page to record them as fast as possible.

In N.F. 33, Keylan died. The metropoles intensified their infiltration of DisCity, and what had begun as control and development gradually evolved into outright enslavement. In the long era of chaos that followed, rumors of "miracles" and "superhumans" spread throughout DisCity.
The chroniclers cannot determine whether these rumors were truly connected to the Underground, because both Sinners and Mania were taboo subjects during that period. Moreover, verifiable records of Sinners were not confined to DisCity, but scattered across a fractured world divided by the disasters.

speaker: Linda
content: My thesis was submitted and published. I went to the academic forum. I practiced so many times, explained every aspect of my industrial history research, and even brought up the sensitive parts about Nirvana and West District. I had so many questions I wanted to ask.

speaker: Linda
content: History's full of regrets and lessons, but there's plenty we can take away from it. Shouldn't we think about where to go next?

speaker: Linda
content: But... it seemed like... nobody cared...

According to the chroniclers' records, verifiable accounts of the Underground in the early history are exceedingly rare:
N.F. 68: DisCity's Independence Army seized a weapon (or technology) from the Underground at the site of a mysterious ritual. Within DisCity, this "technology" became known as "Reaper." It has since been confirmed that it was adapted from the Underground's advanced Mania sorcery.
N.F. 71: Remnants of the metropoles developed another weapon (or technology) of their own. Today, this technology is widely known as Fraser's "Aurum Secretum."
The metropoles eventually fell. Fraser's reacquisition of this technology bore direct ties to the Underground, thus retroactively linking this historical record to the organization.

speaker: Linda
content: The audience wasn't really paying attention. Many people left halfway through... No one cared to ask questions. They were far more curious about gossip of the big families or Paradeisos conspiracy theories... There was a way larger crowd at the Phantom Entertainment promotional event.

speaker: Linda
content: Professor... I passed my thesis defense so easily. Was that because... the school didn't care either?

speaker: Linda
content: I want to do something meaningful. I don't care about money or fame. I guess... I'm not even scared of getting attacked. It'd be kind of an honor, really. And I've... I've actually practiced how to run away quickly!

speaker: Linda
content: But the truth I worked so hard to restore is just going to rot away in some library archive. It seems like... it doesn't benefit the city in any way.

speaker: Linda
content: Did I get it all wrong? This thing I spent so much time researching, is it really what people need? Or is it just... a product of pedantry in the ivory tower... nothing but self-indulgent entertainment?

speaker: Linda
content: Maybe I should try something else... find a more stable life? Go to the West District, join the Executive Committee, or just be a teacher...

By N.F. 84, the Mania crisis erupted on a massive scale, and the Underground was becoming increasingly active. It was during this period that the organization established the doctrine still recognized today: Mania Insurrectionism.
Over the decades that followed, they openly and covertly orchestrated more than a hundred documented Mania incidents. Though their activity waxed and waned, their objective never changed.

speaker: Linda
content: I'm sorry, Professor... You've put in so much work, and handed me such important material...

speaker: Linda
content: You even said when I graduated, you wanted to pass your research on to me...

speaker: Linda
content: But I don't know... if history still has any value in today's DisCity...

speaker: Celine
content: Linda...
She calls out instinctively, then looks up, only to realize there's no one there.

speaker: Linda
content: I'm afraid I can't pass it on for you... I'm sorry...
She finally stops, letting out a long sigh.

The origins of Rancor and Aurum Secretum have been confirmed. The dark web, on the other hand, emerged sometime after DisCity's independence, the exact time still unknown.

According to the 9th Agency's files, under the influence of a deserter from the Underground, BR-002 became the first documented artificially catalyzed Black Ring.

As for the Mania weapon rumored to have been created by the Laboratory of Parma, its underlying technology was long believed to have originated from Summer, but has since been confirmed that the true source was someone else. In N.F. 111, it was sold to Parma by Laplace of the Ring Research Institute.

speaker: Celine
content: They even call these things "technology." In that case...
Technological breakthroughs always reshape organizations and the way people operate. There must be traces hidden in the corners of history.
According to the newly acquired "rumors," even before N.F. 111... certain groups operating in West District had already...

speaker: Celine
content: ...Found you.
Organizations affiliated with the Sillage Society... Transaction records for Mania weapon raw materials during N.F. 103 to 108...

speaker: Celine
content: ...What's this?
The latest technology leaked from the Ring Research Institute... The source is once again... the Institute's most renowned genius? Summer?
This transaction existed in the past, and it continues today. Another new technology. Another new agent. No, wait, that's not right. The timeline doesn't add up...
From outside the window comes the sharp noise of collisions. Shrill and relentless, like the cries of caged birds kept in the dark.
No, those are indeed bird cries. Celine looks up. A bird has flown into the library, only to be caught by the "net" she installed, shredded into numerous small squares.

speaker: Celine
content: Heh, well, that's...
Has she been a little too "aggressive"?
You are led into an unmarked, low-profile vehicle. The interior is completely covered and sealed. Not even the current time is displayed. It travels in almost complete silence.

The vehicle stops at last in a deserted clearing. You step out. The sky is utterly dark. You can barely make out some straight-lined silhouettes. You are made to walk along walls from time to time, unable to see the sky or hear any voices. Only your own footsteps echo back, as though you've entered a vast forest of derelict buildings.
You gently grip Schorl, letting it guide you forward. After some time, it stops. A door creaks open. You step into darkness once again. The door swings shut behind you. Then the lights come on.
[Scene Transition] Keylan Piano Room
You are brought into an empty room. The first thing you see is another bipyramid, hovering at the center, a ring suspended from its base.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: The former EDGE-07's Schorl. It is under investigation, along with her.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Lemma Herzfeld has been put under special confinement due to the sensitive nature of her position. I cannot bypass the rules to help you reach her. Her Schorl has also been formatted, and its "decorations" have been removed.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: However, Keylan-II is still connected to the brainwave communication channels of several researchers at the Hub. At your request, Chief, I can activate them using a special method.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Thank you.

options: Can you confirm this is all confidential?

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Lemma Herzfeld has lost her permissions, but you are not affected. You're still in charge of BR-003's security, so you have full authority to question the "suspects."

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Under special circumstances such as an unstable connection, the data I record can be stored locally for 48 hours before a <color=#fb9259>delayed upload</color>. During this period, your actions will not be synced to EDGE. Will that work?

options: That's more than enough. Connect me.

content: [Communication]
You finally hear their voices.

speaker: Barrie
content: Director Isomer hasn't come back. She seems very busy. Dinner was delivered quite late too, and no one really had much of an appetite...

speaker: Sarah
content: Lemma... was taken somewhere else. They said it's because her position is special, that she knows more sensitive information...
Sarah tries her best to update you on the situation, but still terrified, she struggles to form sentences.

speaker: Sarah
content: We're the only ones still locked in the quarters. They haven't told us when they'll let us go. They already took all our data and access, but no one explained the situation to us...
Enya has lost her usual energy. She's curled up, voice trembling.

speaker: Enya
content: What will EDGE say... to Mom and Dad?

speaker: Enya
content: Did we fail to meet the expectations? Was it because the verification experiment failed? Do they think we're too incompetent? But...

speaker: Sarah
content: Don't... don't say that! We're the best at what we do... We've accomplished so much. EDGE needs us.

speaker: Sarah
content: There's no way we'll...!
She finally breaks down and begins crying.

speaker: Sarah
content: Sob... sob... What do we do? I... I'm so scared...
You remain silent. All you can do is listen to their muffled sobbing through the channel. You can't even hand them a tissue.
But then you hear the sound of someone drawing tissues from a box.

speaker: Barrie
content: Yes, I'm here, Chief ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Option
options: Have you kept the CDs? The Phanuel ones.

speaker: Barrie
content: They were all confiscated.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you remember how the songs go, don't you? You're all huge fans of Phanuel. You even went to her live events.

speaker: Barrie
content: Mm... I know all of her songs.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's a star who carries your love and hope. An idol who works tirelessly to shine bright on stage and bring smiles to your faces.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even now, I'm sure she can give you strength.

speaker: Barrie
content: ...I understand what you mean. They're all friends I cherish. We're always together, whether we're working on our research or cheering for our favorite idol.

speaker: Barrie
content: I'll try my best to support everyone.

The other end of the line falls silent for a few seconds. Then, a soft breath. Without any accompaniment, Barrie taps the beat along the edge of the desk. In time with the monotonous noise from the ventilation duct, his lowered, trembling voice comes through.
At first, Barrie sings alone softly. When he reaches the chorus, Sarah is the first to join in with her hoarse voice. Then, another faint voice chimes in from the other side.

speaker: Sarah
content: ... Yes, I know how to sing Phanuel's songs.

speaker: Option
options: Yes. These are songs that send people love and courage.

speaker: Enya
content: Yeah, I'm listening too. I know them too...
Their voices gradually harmonize. There's no music in the background. No loudspeakers. Only the youthful determination of these teenagers, dreaming of getting back on their feet once again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You're going to be okay. It's not time to give up yet. None of us should give up.
Another channel comes through from the MBCC, brazenly cutting into your conversation. Or perhaps, someone let it in. You hear a familiar voice.

speaker: Summer
content: I've been waiting for you forever, Chief! I mean, what kind of protagonist shows up late all the time?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My bad. Good thing you're here, Summer. You've become so mature and reliable now.

speaker: Summer
content: Well, I need to make sure we're on the same page before taking action. And believe me when I say I've been holding myself back for a long time!

speaker: Summer
content: You took your time. You'd better have a plan ready, huh?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course. There are certain things I can't pull off without you. Please tell Lemma...

speaker: Option
options: Pull yourself together, genius. People are still counting on you.

content: [Scene Change]
The call ends.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Have you made all the necessary arrangements?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now, leave the rest to me.
You look at your comms device. A new notification from the Observation Hub.
[Schedule Update] [Highly Classified] May 31, N.F. 116, 10:00 PM A top security level experiment will be conducted. Security measures are as follows...
Seeing your focused gaze, Schorl seems to have reached its conclusion.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: I'll arrange your return immediately. The vehicle will arrive in ten minutes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: One last question.
You turn back to look at the eerily empty and spacious room.
There is nothing in the room. Sharp edges cut straight through gray surfaces—or perhaps the walls used to be white, but after years of neglect, they now look gray in poor lighting.
It's completely empty, except for that piano. Pristine as if untouched by time, yet silent like a wordless sage.
...Staring at it, you could almost hear the notes, almost feel... a strange sense of familiarity from it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Whose room is this?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That piano...

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Eventually, you will know. But not yet.
The black bipyramid drifts slowly, dim light flowing across its flawed surface. It illuminates the grayish white space, casts its glow upon you, and seems to bring forth the presence of a stranger.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: I am the assistance you need. Time is running short, Chief. Hurry up and do what you believe is right.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: A tsunami is coming. Before it crashes on the shore, you must find your path... the one you truly believe in.

The special confinement cell in the Observation Hub is too small even for a child. There has been no interrogation or announcement. There isn't even a clock in the room. In complete isolation, she feels forgotten by the world.
The only thing she was allowed to take with her was a copy of DisCity's Golden Age of Science. They made an exception, apparently. Since she got here, she's read it over and over again.

speaker: Celine
content: In the future, I won't be the one who finishes this book. History will find its own echo.

speaker: Celine
content: Would you like to hear it?
Now, the book lies beside her tear-stained pillow.
Lemma has gotten out of bed.
In the locked cell, she sits upright, dips her finger in the tea she was given, and covers the walls with densely packed writing.

May 31, N.F. 116
9:45 PM

BR-003 Observation Hub

The final combat units complete their deployment half a day ahead of schedule. Every defensive Ring Weapon throughout the Hub is now on maximum alert. Entry is prohibited, and the barriers have been fully activated, operating at peak output.

The MBCC is not the only party handling security and defense. An elite unit under Paradeisos's direct command is also here. You've seen what they're capable of, and seeing them here again brings back memories... They appear just as inhuman as before.
Further out, supporting fighter aircraft from the FAC are also on standby.
This is the BR-003 Observation Hub at full combat readiness. If this level of security could become the norm, surely even the Underground wouldn't dare make a move. Of course, that would also mean...
This isn't just some "top security level experiment." The experiment itself doesn't even matter, but rather <color=#fb9259>the person</color> who will conduct it.

speaker: Isomer
content: The data migration will be supervised by EDGE's representative. I'll coordinate all departments of the Observation Hub to support the operation.

speaker: Isomer
content: Security and defense will be jointly handled by the Hush unit from Paradeisos and the MBCC. I'll leave that in your hands.
As she speaks, her aloof gaze sweeps past you. Your eyes meet briefly. You give a stiff nod in return. Both of you look away immediately.
Ever since that night, you've been avoiding each other like strangers. The reason is obvious: You both know exactly what the other person is planning.

21:55. An aircraft convoy of the highest security clearance arrives at the Observation Hub. You can't tell where it's coming from. One moment, it seems to suddenly appear in the air. The next, it descends and lands smoothly.

A white-haired woman, accompanied by Schorl and flanked by layers of guards, disembarks from the aircraft and walks through the long passage. Separated by her own security crew, she maintains a measured distance from you.
At one point, she seems to glance at you casually, then gives you a slight nod.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Greetings from EDGE-02, Chief.

EDGE-02 enters the control room. The door closes behind her. Multiple anti-Mania barriers rise. It's now 22:00, supposedly the time window in which BR-003 is the most stable. How convenient that it falls exactly on the hour.
But you've always known that the real threat isn't out there in the distant Black Ring.

speaker: Progress Report
content: Data migration initiated. Current progress:
Fluctuations of the Black Ring are stabilizing. Field noise diminishes, and optical interference decreases slightly. In the distance, the Black Ring gradually comes into view.
Everyone remains on high alert as the experiment proceeds.
[Sound Effect] Crackle—
A faint, anomalous ripple sweeps through the field. The shackles detect it first.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Copy. Relaying alert now. Initiating location scan. The exact location is...
[Red lights flash, alarms blare]

Multiple strikes hit simultaneously, scraping past the guards. Shrieking alarms tear at your eardrums as every alert goes off. The senior EDGE official has been inside the data center for only eight minutes when multiple impact points appear all at once across the monitoring zones.
You rush out first.

speaker: Option
options:
All ambush teams, get in position! 
It's the Underground!!

content: The battle spreads across the entire Observation Hub in no time. With the adequate preparation, everything is still under control for now. But there's no mistaking it. Judging from the number of invading fissures, their distribution, timing, and attack strategy...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is just the beginning. Their enemy is not holding back this time.
<i>At least the kids aren't here. For a brief moment, the thought brings genuine relief.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Don't worry. EDGE-02 is protected by the elite Hush unit.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: She was expecting this.
It switches on the comms feed. Right in the center of the frame, a Puppet is cleaved in two by a shield-blade.
As the foul mass crumples to the floor, a figure emerges from behind. You see the Hush mask... Is that a person? They walk toward the camera.

speaker: Elite Hush Soldier
content: ...I'll handle things here. Please eliminate the source of the invasion as quickly as possible.
The Hush mask conceals the guard's expression, yet inexplicably, you feel that you can trust her. You give her a nod. A moment later, the feed cuts out, and you both return to your separate battles.
Refocus. Think. What is the enemy's goal?
Assassination? Sabotage? Or... is the assassination attempt just a diversion to scatter our forces, so the Underground can tear open a larger gap to seize the Ring?
Without understanding their true motive, you can only respond passively. But how can you confirm that?
An answer emerges in your mind.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Analyzing now...
After breaking through several diversions, you finally reach the public lounge. However, the place the kids once cherished as their secret hideaway has already been torn apart.
Amid the chaos, Isomer stands in the middle of the flames, head bowed, gently cradling that cube of hers.
At her feet, the cushions, CDs, light signs, posters—everything the kids once held dear—lie trampled and burned, as if someone was determined to destroy everything here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Isomer, you...

speaker: Isomer
content: Hahaha...

speaker: Isomer
content: Your lovely little geniuses have already been kicked out. What are you even doing here?

speaker: Isomer
content: Planning to stop me again, Chief?
She tilts her head and looks at you, a twisted smile spreading across her face.
The young scientists' sanctuary has been reduced to rubble. Amid the flames, you and Isomer stand facing each other, both knowing that this moment was always inevitable.
You speak first.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: EDGE-02 has been attacked. The Observation Hub is in complete chaos. At a critical time like this, why aren't you out there leading the team? You're the one in charge now.

speaker: Isomer
content: Because salvaging the research left behind by those geniuses is more important.
She looks at you, smiling.

speaker: Isomer
content: Don't blame me for leaving my superior to her fate. EDGE-02's murderer will be the Sillage Society, the Underground's sorcerers—not me.

speaker: Isomer
content: She personally ordered the restructuring of the Observation Hub. She wanted the most experienced frontline experts replaced. That was a risk she chose to take. She'll have to face the consequences now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You arranged this experiment. One of EDGE's top three seats was attacked on your watch. You think you can get away with this?

speaker: Isomer
content: Accountable? Heh...

speaker: Isomer
content: Wasn't she the one who said that every EDGE seat should be replaceable? It's simply the logical conclusion of her own principle. If 07 can be replaced, then so can 02. Who knows? Maybe I'll even end up on the bench myself.
Isomer spreads her arms wide, as though a cage that has long held her captive has finally fallen apart. Her wish is fulfilled at last, and she's finally free from all restraint.
...It's almost absurd.

options: Who exactly are you trying to fool?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Underground relies on dimensional fissures to launch their attacks. And to create fissures this clean and precise... That couldn't be achieved without someone inside the Hub who could coordinate every move for them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're burying years of ambitious plotting with your own hands.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've already come this far, burning your bridges along the way... Isomer, what exactly are you after?!

speaker: Isomer
content: Oh, come on, Chief. The Isomer you know is supposed to be a power-hungry schemer. She'd stop at nothing to climb higher.

speaker: Isomer
content: I've already secured the seventh seat. Now that I have this rare opportunity, I must clear out the positions above as well. Don't get in my way.
She looks at you with those predatory eyes, no longer concealing the blood lust in them.

speaker: Isomer
content: If necessary, I can stage another "accident" to get rid of all those who know about the truth.

speaker: Isomer
content: I don't value you the way EDGE does. True, the <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color> is vital to science and our civilization... but I don't share their grand pursuit. And I just so happen to have been in contact with the Underground.

speaker: Isomer
content: I know you're not the <color=#fb9259>sole</color> bearer of the shackles, ${PlayerName}. Be careful. Stand in my way, and this time, you really will die.
Damn it! She knows Schorl is offline too? That means she's going to...
You instinctively release your power. At the same moment, Isomer raises her hand, and a fissure tears open at your waist.
A gaping maw clamps down around you. The shackles you just released strain desperately against it, barely keeping you from being sliced in half.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Middle-Aged Spectator
Schorl rushes over, too eager to save you that it ignores its surroundings. A fissure tears open in its path, and the bipyramid dives straight in and vanishes.
You fight desperately for that sliver of room keeping you alive with your shackles, unable to struggle free. You look toward Isomer...

She surveys the space with an authoritative air, the cube in her hand vibrating with surging energy. The constantly fluctuating Mania field and the shockwaves pulsing in from every direction indicate that fissures are opening up constantly, ushering Underground Puppets in. This isn't the power of a Sinner.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You... you're using that cube... to communicate with the Underground.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're sending the Sages the coordinates for the attacks! You're helping them seize the Black Ring, aren't you?!
She laughs.
Just as before, she's simply made a deal with someone. Even if that "someone" has changed from Chief to the Underground, the nature of it doesn't change.

Isomer looks away from ${PlayerName} and moves past him. An extremely wide Mania fissure slowly gapes open a dozen meters ahead, ripping through the layers of defenses on the other side of the passage.
female_content: Isomer looks away from ${PlayerName} and moves past her. An extremely wide Mania fissure slowly gapes open a dozen meters ahead, ripping through the layers of defenses on the other side of the passage.

content: On the other side, that woman is right ahead. How long has it been? At last, they meet again. Through the chaotic distortion of the fissure, Isomer sees that detestable figure she'll never forget. She continues to step forward.

speaker: Isomer
content: Power is such a marvelous thing. One needs no reason to pursue it.

speaker: Isomer
content: Once you've tasted power, everything else pales in comparison. Talent, ideals... Nothing matters anymore. Climb to the top, and you alone get to define the value of all things.
[Flashback] [N10-6], Night

speaker: Schorl
content: Of course, I can give you the position you desire. I can also give you the truth you seek.

speaker: Schorl
content: Those kids... Do you want to know how many secrets they've hidden in the treasures in their little hideaway? Do you want to know... what those little geniuses will face once it all comes to light?

speaker: Schorl
content: Go ahead and picture it, Isomer. This is your first step toward the future.
[Exit Flashback]
The ashes of the toys are ruthlessly crushed by each footstep. Those cherished items have crumbled into powder, merging with the Mania filling the space.

speaker: Isomer
content: It makes you think you can do whatever you want. Trample over human lives. Brag about your twisted, cruel "hobby" shamelessly.

speaker: Abhorrent Memory
content: This batch of samples is indeed quite charming and representative.

speaker: Abhorrent Memory
content: Pure, and therefore efficient. Proud, and therefore easy to satisfy. Young, and therefore replaceable. Their ambitions are so persistent, so transparent, so predictable. That's what makes their hearts such handy tools.

speaker: Abhorrent Memory
content: Look, they're even obsessed with their adorable little idol.

speaker: Isomer
content: Put a despicable, hollow, ugly soul in a position of power, and people will turn it into an object of worship. How laughable.

speaker: Abhorrent Memory
content: 372 has been selected as a candidate for EDGE-07. She is quite pleased. She seems to look up to me and 01. Hmm... I see. In the field of human consciousness studies, I am indeed a leading figure. I suppose I could be considered... <color=#fb9259>a rare talent</color>.

speaker: Abhorrent Memory
content: What do you think, Director Isomer? You're always the first to spot a genius. Let's have a chat, shall we?

speaker: Isomer
content: And after everything, you want me to be your accomplice?

She steps into the fissure. Mania tears at her consciousness, yet it also allows her to clearly perceive the overlapping eigenspaces. She sees that woman's face with perfect clarity. EDGE-02 lifts her head slightly and looks back at her.
Then she smiles, just as she did back then.

speaker: EDGE-02
content: Tell me, Director... What do you think of me as a <color=#fb9259>scientist</color>?

speaker: Isomer
content: ...Don't make me laugh! You've never sought the light of truth, nor have you ever seen it.

speaker: Isomer
content: You want to know what I'll do with this power? Simple. Something I couldn't do before.

speaker: Isomer
content: To purge the poison from the system. To correct the mistakes. To liberate the potential of science and humanity.

speaker: Isomer
content: I clawed my way to the top for one reason—to take down people like you!
[Major CG - 02's Contempt]

speaker: EDGE-02
content: What a shame. You were so close to passing the test, yet you chose to be disqualified.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: All Ring Weapons in the data center have been contaminated! The coordinates and firewall data have been leaked! The Underground fissures are spreading!!

The struggle between the two sides continues. Fissures open and close incessantly across the isolated aerial battlefield. Parts of the Hub's structure collapse and plummet, only to be intercepted and shattered by the FAC before crashing to the ground.
Until a tremor ripples through the entire field. The Hush soldiers guarding EDGE-02 snap their heads up and stare into the distance.

speaker: Hush
content: The Black Ring...
Isn't the red halo... changing?

Is it twisting? Expanding? Splitting? Have the fissures intensified the Mania field? Or was it because the battle destroyed the Hub's barrier, and now the Black Ring is manifesting its true effect on its surroundings, distorting all perception along its perimeter?

The humanoid weapons attempt to assess the situation. Yet in an instant, a light beam penetrates a crack in the barrier, shearing off a strand of the woman's white hair. The units fall into disarray, unsure if they should prioritize protecting their target or responding to the sudden crisis posed by the Black Ring.
Until a command rings out in their minds.

speaker: EDGE-02
content: Protect the Black Ring. Stop the invasion. This is the top priority.

speaker: EDGE-02
content: The Director has let emotion cloud her judgment. She has even forgotten about the Black Ring... which means she also fails to see that... we're no longer the only two parties on this battlefield.
The Ring Weapons, recently compromised by the contamination, suddenly shut down. An 11x11 Rubik's cube emerges, and then...

speaker: Summer
content: The hero has arrived!
The creator of the Ring Weapon leaps out, reining in her own inventions.
Behind her, dimensional nodes activate, engaging the interference. The Underground's fissures seize up immediately as if shocked by electricity. Several new, thin cracks close up instantly.
And the one coordinating all of this is...
[Scene transition] Another section of the Ring structure

The confinement cell's walls have been blown off. Summer has left two drones to guard the entrance. The three researchers have returned. They've brought back their team leader's assistant and reclaimed their stations.

speaker: Lemma
content: ...Keylan-II. Pull up the historical records. Reboot the three nearest secondary terminals. Hack and take over the security system. Progress: 15%, 18%... Accelerate.

speaker: Lemma
content: Get my lab back.
[Scene Change]
The alarm signaling an authority override finally sounds. Isomer freezes.

speaker: Isomer
content: What...?

speaker: Voice From Behind
content: The young researchers. I brought them back.

Isomer turns around stiffly. While she insisted on confronting 02, ${PlayerName} already broke free. Crimson light from his shackles coils around him, glowing brighter than ever before. The fissures can no longer come near him.
female_content: Isomer turns around stiffly. While she insisted on confronting 02, ${PlayerName} already broke free. Crimson light from her shackles coils around her, glowing brighter than ever before. The fissures can no longer come near her.

content: Has the field generated by the activated Black Ring enhanced his shackles? Or has someone adjusted the rules to adapt to the Mania fissures' traits?
female_content: Has the field generated by the activated Black Ring enhanced her shackles? Or has someone adjusted the rules to adapt to the Mania fissures' traits?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Probably all of the above, I'd say. I don't really understand how it works either. I just listened to the scientists.

options: And with a little bit of acting on top of that, I managed to fool you.

speaker: Isomer
content: It's you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you, Director. You threatened EDGE-02 enough to win them the opportunity to return to the stage.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And we're all quite relieved. We finally understand what you're thinking.

speaker: Option
options: Now then, shall we enjoy their performance together?

content: [Command Room]

speaker: Summer
content: Make way, make way~!
The door the Underground Puppets failed to breach melts under a single blast from Summer's drone, shocking everyone behind it.

speaker: Researcher
content: What are you doing? The Institute's access has been revoked completely. You have no right to...

speaker: Summer
content: That's where you're wrong. I know this isn't my turf. I'm just following our handsome Chief's orders, lending a hand on behalf of the MBCC Sinners.
female_content: That's where you're wrong. I know this isn't my turf. I'm just following our beautiful Chief's orders, lending a hand on behalf of the MBCC Sinners.

speaker: Summer
content: Now then, let us welcome the true heroes of the BR-003 Observation Hub...
The four researchers step back into the control room after three days away, returning to their familiar stations.
Thanks to the chaos, the data transfer progress hasn't even reached 5%. They quickly repair the system, but with only 15% of access rights at their disposal, there's very little they can do.

speaker: Sarah
content: The Mania dimension has entered a deeply entangled state. Certain areas are exhibiting local symmetry. Selecting this area for calculation should reduce the complexity. Confirm?

speaker: Lemma
content: Proceed with it, but don't commit to it completely. Send all collected data to MBCC. Have both groups run parallel analyses.

speaker: Lemma
content: This area has been compromised by Mania. The subjective perception of on-site personnel is likely distorted. A comparison between the internal and external groups will be valuable.
Others try to stop them, but no one can hold back the former Chief Scientist now.

speaker: Lemma
content: Look around you. Stalled calculations. Damaged equipment. Injured personnel. BR-003 could fall into enemy hands at any moment. So tell me, among the people giving you orders, is there anyone who can actually handle this?

speaker: Lemma
content: No one! Then why are you still standing in my way? Move aside. We're taking over. Summer!

speaker: Summer
content: Bingo! Leave defense and data collection to me. I can run some new tests while I'm at it too.

speaker: Summer
content: Aw, this takes me back to five years ago. Hope we haven't gotten rusty. I'll leave the detailed model calculations to you guys!

speaker: Sarah
content: You don't say.

speaker: Enya
content: Model at 82% completion. 328 anomalous data points detected. Barrie!

speaker: Barrie
content: Verifying them. I'll leave the hardest part to you, Lemma. Can you handle it?

She lifts her head and takes in her surroundings. The interrupted calculations. The equipment damage. The casualties. The crumbling environment. Every passing second brings this place closer to total annihilation.

speaker: Lemma
content: ...Of course.

She turns her gaze to the three Schorls hovering nearby. 83% of all access rights are on them. Without reclaiming them, Lemma cannot reverse this crisis. But she also knows exactly how these triangular minds operate.

speaker: Schorl
content: Level 6 warning. Your actions have violated multiple security regulations, including unauthorized intrusion into EDGE jurisdiction and disruption of critical ongoing operations.

speaker: Schorl
content: All your actions have been recorded and submitted for evaluation. Based on the results, we will proceed to implement...

speaker: Lemma
content: Whatever. I'm the one on site, so I'll decide what needs to be done. Once this is over, you can check your data logs and make all the "rational evaluations" and "disciplinary decisions" you want. And one more thing...
She looks at Schorl, meeting the eyes watching and judging her behind it.

speaker: Lemma
content: ...All of you are watching, aren't you? Are you holding a meeting right now? Perfect. I have something to say. Let me join you.

speaker: Schorl
content: You are not authorized to attend this meeting. EDGE-07's authority has been revoked. Your channel has been closed. Return to your cell, Lemma Herzfeld. You will still be given a chance if you...

speaker: Lemma
content: Stop wasting time! ${PlayerName} has already granted me temporary authorization. Now, under SHP-13's authority, I demand immediate access to this meeting!

speaker: Schorl
content: This is...?!

The cracked Schorl that ${PlayerName} has always carried emerges from Lemma's pocket. Having been offline for so long, calculating dimensions and slipping through fissures now have truly pushed it to its limits. The little bipyramid bears several fresh scars.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: Connection re-established. Syncing data now. SHP-13 has an emergency proposal to discuss with everyone.

speaker: Flawed Schorl
content: But SHP-13 is currently engaged in combat. In this state of emergency, former Chief Scientist of the Ring Research Institute, Lemma Herzfeld, will speak on SHP-13's behalf. Request submitted. Awaiting approval.
The communication channel falls silent. Receiving no instructions, the Schorls all appear somewhat confused. Then, a heavily distorted signal cuts in...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02: </color>Approved. This is indeed a state of emergency. Grant her access. Let's hear what she has to say.
[System: SHP-13 [Proxy] has joined the meeting]
[Representatives present: 02, 03, 04, 05, 06] [Absent: 01, 08] [Vacant: 07]

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>This violates the rules. We must...
SHP-13 [Proxy]: <size=45>The only two representatives on-site, 02 and 07, are both scientific experts. Both have determined that the Observation Hub is in a state of emergency. 06 can also supply additional information on the battlefield from the FAC perspective.</size>
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Do any other representatives not currently on-site have other more substantive objections?
...
...
...
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Good. I will now recap the situation.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: I'm sure you're all aware of the severity of the attack and the damage sustained. The Underground's dimensional interference is too intense. We must activate real-time calculations immediately.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: However, among the researchers present on-site, 02 is held in the data center conducting the critical data transfer, and the current Chief Scientist's position is unclear.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: I am the only one here capable of executing this task. I am familiar with the Observation Hub, and I have an experienced team ready to support me. I have also worked with the MBCC Chief in the past.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: As soon as EDGE restores my authority for the Observation Hub system, I will act immediately and resolve this crisis as quickly as I can.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05: </color>A feasible plan. However, we must address an additional concern. Namely, the concept of replaceability established during our previous meeting. Technology is no exception to this rule.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05: </color>EDGE has always been cautious when it comes to revoking its resolutions. Doing so entails considerable additional costs and risks.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04: </color>I agree. Reinstating the former 07 is not our only option. The alternative candidate for 07 is ready to take on the position. This individual has the required scientific expertise, but was simply prevented from boarding the Hub in time by the traitor Isomer. Had this candidate joined the team as scheduled, we would not be facing this predicament now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04: </color>It is not too late. The FAC can still send 06 to the Hub. Better alternative options are still available. There is no need to revoke our resolution.
Lemma closes her eyes. Once, she too argued like this, striving to claim the seat she regarded as the ultimate honor.

The resolve she held then remains unshaken even now. She won't run away. Their ruthless enemy is right here, and she needs to be there on the front line, to witness their difference in strength. With her helpless allies right behind her, she must use her knowledge to show them the way forward. Her talent exists for this very moment!
...But now Lemma understands. These people don't actually care.
But it's alright.
She doesn't need anyone's praise. She doesn't need everyone's approval. She has something she must do... and it can only be done from that position.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: You're right. Making any member irreplaceable could be detrimental to an institution as important as EDGE.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Mania is evolving, and the enemy is growing ever more brutal. Any of us could fall on the front line.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: If anyone was deemed irreplaceable, it would mean the loss of this person could cripple the organization entirely. Humanity cannot entrust the future of our civilization to EDGE if it's so fragile.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: From a rational standpoint, replacements are inevitable. If there is in fact an available substitute for 07, then my personal appeal should indeed be denied.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: However, I am not the only person at this meeting whose reliability must be questioned.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: You've prepared plenty of replacements for me. But what about yourself, <color=#fb9259>02</color>?
SHP-13 [Proxy]: You were the assassination target today. You were the one who could have died. If no one is irreplaceable, where is your replacement?
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Do you have one ready?
Silence. No one refutes her point. Lemma takes a deep breath.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: Now, here's a modification to my proposal.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: I am not merely asking for the seat of 07. I'm asking to be 02's backup while serving as 07. This is the true duty of 07.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: You found a way to produce 07s. But what about your own successors?
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Can those obedient protégés you handpicked grow up to become the next EDGE-02?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: Hahahaha...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: My own replacement? I did prepare one, actually. Designed an elaborate, costly test just for her, with you as the sacrifice... but my plan failed.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: I thought that was unfortunate, but now...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: I suppose I should thank you.
[System: Entering top authority discussion]

speaker: EDGE-02
content: Good, Lemma Herzfeld, very good. You enlisted some rather extraordinary help, but your growth is indeed astonishing. This merits a special exception.

speaker: EDGE-02
content: Now then. Let's transfer the authority and restore your EDGE access rights temporarily. Accept your test...

speaker: EDGE-02
content: The predetermined calamity is imminent. All of humanity must be prepared, and you and I are no exception. You must work toward becoming a candidate for the top three seats. Should anything happen in the future, I wish to entrust this path to you.

speaker: EDGE-02
content: Out of all my research achievements, you're one I'm particularly proud of.

speaker: SHP-13??
content: One day, I will take the seat of EDGE-02, but I will never walk the path you laid out for me.

speaker: SHP-13??
content: You disgust me!
<color=#fb9259>[System: EDGE-07 permissions restored]</color>
[Back to Reality]
A violent surge of brainwaves snaps her back to her former position in an instant. This time, however, she will not waver.

speaker: EDGE-07
content: Effective immediately, <color=#fb9259>EDGE-07</color> will take direct command of the BR-003 Observation Hub. All data, assets, personnel, and computing resources will be under my control.

speaker: EDGE-07
content: Dimensional verification and modal convergence complete. Three eigenspace sets have been solved. All non-computational personnel, give your full support to the MBCC, lock onto the nearest fissure device, reactivate it, and initiate a ten-second countdown.

As if brainwashed, the three Schorls nearby snap into formation, gathering behind Lemma. Together with two other Schorls, they form five computational hubs. With their access rights assembled, data run at top speed, reaching the allies on the front line.

speaker: EDGE-07
content: And now...
She opens up a communication channel, connecting to a chaotic space, into their ruined hideaway. Isomer and ${PlayerName} are there. Lemma takes a deep breath and shouts.

speaker: EDGE-07
content: Isomer!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She had plenty of ways to deal with you guys, but... she never used them. She always tries to keep the door closed, to keep all the most difficult problems locked outside. She wants to handle them all by herself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I think she loves the view on the other side. She's just forgotten how to open the door.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Help her find her conscience again, Lemma.

speaker: EDGE-07
content: I know everything you've done! How could you let yourself be fooled by someone like that? You've twisted EDGE's purpose, forgotten a scientist's mission, and squandered your time and talent on something completely worthless.

speaker: EDGE-07
content: You idiot! Open your eyes! If you still can't see the truth, then look at me!

speaker: EDGE-07
content: I'll show you what a real EDGE-07 looks like!
[Background shakes and turns blue]
In an instant, every disabled node reboots and reconnects, forming a vast network that covers the Observation Hub's Mania field once more, like a sturdy skeleton holding up the collapsing space.
A figure gradually emerges within the fissure.

speaker: Isomer
content: ...I see. You let me go after that woman on purpose...

speaker: Option
options: Yes, you opened up a real path.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry for setting you up. Like Lemma said, I wasn't exactly playing fair. Just like you, I'm calculating and shrewd.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I'm not alone, Isomer. What about you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You still have a chance to say it aloud. Tell them what you really think.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You fought so hard to reach the top, but what you really want is in fact...

speaker: Isomer
content: If you're still asking that question... then you're not as cunning as you think you are, Chief.

speaker: Isomer
content: You're just as naive as her.
An unfamiliar rush of Mania shoots out without warning, hitting your shoulder and slamming you into the wall behind.

speaker: Lemma
content: That Mania is...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That power isn't clean. Don't use it! If you succumb to it, there's no turning back!
Turning back? Isomer hears the words and almost laughs.
Even now, you still don't get it. That woman isn't testing her candidate's competence, but whether they can always make the most "rational" decision.
Someone who swears to secure their place in EDGE yet still hesitates to wipe away a stain is bound to fail the test.
Now, she's become the test. But what matters more is...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Isomer, drop it! We're not here to crush you! Everyone's waiting for you to come back!!
Your shouts fall on deaf ears. She merely watches, as if gazing at the people standing behind you.
A long moment passes. Then, a soft sigh.

speaker: Isomer
content: There's no place left for me here anymore...
[Enter CG]

The chaos cube is unleashed completely, releasing all the crimson threads coiling within. The power of death wraps around Isomer as the Mania field begins to change drastically. Every port under her command succumbs to total corruption.

The Ring Weapons are contaminated. Puppets are running rampant. The system is paralyzed, and the barriers are shattered. And at the center of the stage emerges a newly born S-Class Sinner. What a perfect curtain call.

speaker: Isomer
content: From this moment on, I'm a Sillage Society spy. This is the kind of pressure an invasion from the Underground should bring.

speaker: Isomer
content: Beating that woman won't be easy. You need to try harder, all of you. Come on. Time for a test.

speaker: Isomer
content: Let these "geniuses" prove their worth!

speaker: Keylan-II
content: It worked, Lemma.

speaker: Lemma
content: Where is she? Where did she go?! ${PlayerName}, bring Isomer back, please!

speaker: Celine
content: ...I see. ${PlayerName} pulled it off.

speaker: Celine
content: If only you'd come back and share it with me. That kind of material's so hard to come by.
What a shame... Looks like it's too late.
All around her lie piles of destroyed Underground Puppets. Before her, new enemies emerge endlessly from the jagged fissure.
They're acting in such an abnormal manner...
BR-003 is just another decoy. The real target lies here... and they're trying hard to hide that.

speaker: Celine
content: Guess I should thank the Underground... for proving me right.
[Scene Change]
Gravely wounded, Isomer is brought back to the Sillage Society by the Puppets. Evelleon treats her injuries.
[Address silencing Celine]

speaker: Evelleon
content: Don't look at me like that. I don't intend to kill you.

speaker: Evelleon
content: It's not time yet to seize the Ring. Besides, you've already bought us enough time as agreed. That will suffice for now. As for the remaining little games... I'm sure she won't mind.

speaker: Evelleon
content: Someone with your talent deserves a place here.

speaker: Isomer
content: ...Don't need it. I've already reserved a place for myself. I know where I'm going...

speaker: Isomer
content: One last thing...
She struggles to raise her arm, readying herself for battle.

speaker: Evelleon
content: ...I see. Then, let me give you a proper send-off.

Less than a year after BR-003's emergence, the first large-scale conflict broke out. Fortunately, the defenders held their ground. Once stability was achieved through dimensional analyses, the Black Ring was once again concealed.
DisCity's skies are as azure as ever, and history continues to march on.
Yet somewhere beyond everyone's sight, some may remain trapped in the same place forever.

speaker: Nurse
content: Professor Celine was already severely wounded when she was found. Numerous Mania creatures infiltrated the library, and that night she was there alone... She doesn't remember anything now.

speaker: Nurse
content: Her special power is the Maniafication of memories. All the memories she retains due to her hyperthymesia, all the information she's ever absorbed, can be converted into power, which will be consumed if she wields it. There were too many monsters that night. She exhausted everything, and still she couldn't save the library.

speaker: Nurse
content: ...Why? Why did the enemy target her? What truth was destroyed? Why did she evacuate the library and stay there alone... Did she know it was coming?

speaker: Nurse
content: And what's the point? She gave it her all, and still couldn't save anything...

speaker: Linda
content: It's all my fault... If I hadn't said those things that day, if I'd stayed with her... Those were what she treasured most...

speaker: Linda
content: Can she still be cured...? Is there anything I can do for her?
[Transition 1s]

speaker: Hella
content: What? The library got burned down overnight? What the hell... I finally found a place that made reading more tolerable...

speaker: Hella
content: That lady with the super long hair seems really trustworthy. Does that mean she can move into the Bureau now? I really enjoyed the lessons she gave me!

speaker: Hella
content: When's she coming?
[Transition 1s]

speaker: Hecate

You step into the hospital room and see... a familiar sight.

speaker: Celine
content: "Time stops for no soul, as the river will not linger."

speaker: Celine
content: "And when you wake, the fleeting light of bygone days drifts away like a dream..."

speaker: Celine
content: Then please tell me something about the past. This time... I'll remember it properly.

content: What happened? How did this happen?! Aren't you a chronicler? The one who records history?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then why is it that when it comes to your own story...

With Lemma's technical support, the MBCC tracks down the physical location of the Sillage Society's pool club and raids it. However, every traceable suspect turns out to be suffering from some kind of memory loss, and no valuable intelligence can be extracted from the evidence seized.

While you're occupied with BR-003, Daniel Horston is found dead unexpectedly despite having been placed under witness protection. You and the 9th Agency conduct multiple rounds of investigation into the cause of his death, but still fail to uncover the truth. All you can do is continue broadening the range of investigation.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> During the last conflict, we made some interesting discoveries.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> The prevailing theory has been that the Underground remains untraceable because their Mania dimension technology far surpasses that of EDGE. This is a fair hypothesis. After all, they would need technology of that caliber to conceal the location of their base and the size of their population.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> However, we made an unexpected observation during the recent invasion.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> We analyzed the traces left by the Underground's fissures at the site and discovered that their technology is, in essence, a derivative of our own. It was most likely developed from research materials stolen by the traitor Isomer. She truly is a genius in this field.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Conversely, even during the height of the battle, the Underground never deployed any dimension technology demonstrably superior to our own. Instead, they relied on Isomer's insider knowledge to mislead and disrupt our operations, buying themselves time.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Which makes the situation... very intriguing...

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Perhaps they were purposely concealing their true capabilities, willing to endure enormous losses rather than reveal them to us.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Or perhaps... that substantial technological gap never existed at all. They spied on our research progress through Isomer and deployed comparable dimension technology in attacks to reinforce our assumptions, making us believe that dimension technology is the key. But what if this was all just a <color=#fb9259>misdirection</color>?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> They've led us to the conclusion that the Underground conceals itself with dimension technology, tricking us into pouring our resources into the wrong areas, all to mask the true nature of their existence.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> What's your take, 07? After all, it was all thanks to you that we made this discovery.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> ...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> It's all mere conjecture for now. I need to gather more data before we can verify our assumption. It will take time. The MBCC will support me as we further investigate the Sillage Society. We'll get to the bottom of this.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> However... one thing is certain.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> If dimension technology was really just a misdirection tactic from them, then... we've been deceived for far too long. Which means, we may already be far behind on the real battlefield.

speaker: Lemma
content: Me? I can handle it.
Lemma gently puts the book she's clutching on the desk. When Celine wakes and sees this new edition of DisCity's Golden Age of Science, perhaps she may remember something.

Now that the Chief Scientist has returned to her own lab, she has taken on the tasks of repairing the damage of BR-003 and solving issues caused by inadequate staff. She has even requested to take over the "Heterogeneous Trial." Apparently, the higher-ups have approved.
Given the current situation, she often has to borrow Summer from you, let alone spare the time to help out at the MBCC. The two of you can only catch up from time to time.

speaker: Lemma
content: The search-and-rescue operations are still ongoing. I trust you and the 9th Agency, and I have everyone here with me too. The evaluation has exposed quite a few suspicious details. The Underground must still be hiding something. I need to keep a closer eye on them, which means you and I will be working even more closely.

speaker: Lemma
content: ...I said I'd set an example, so I need to follow through and do what I'm supposed to do. I have to show her.
[The 9th Agency, Maximum Security Cell]
Back in the "sickroom," Adelaide receives an unexpected visitor.

speaker: Visitor
content: Those injuries look pretty bad. Just got grilled by someone?

speaker: Adelaide
content: No, these are old. They're taking some time to heal, but it's fine. Don't worry about it.
He looks toward the visitor. It's a face that feels both strange and familiar to him.

speaker: Adelaide
content: After all these years... I'm truly glad that you're willing to come see me.

speaker: Adelaide
content: Did those DisCity agents send you? Unfortunately, if you're here to ask about the whereabouts of the Underground's higher-ups, even I no longer know where they are.
The visitor shakes her head and speaks sincerely.

speaker: Visitor
content: Heh, no one sent me. I came because I wanted to.

speaker: Visitor
content: I met with one of your "friends" in this city... She's interesting enough, but unfortunately, she refused to say more about you. So I had no choice but to come talk to you in person.

speaker: Visitor
content: How did you end up here? Who did you reach out to back then? And... who gave you this special power? Where is she now? Come on, tell me about... that Shepherd from the Underground.
With this, the visitor takes Adelaide's hand and gently brushes over the red mark. She can't hold back her smile any longer.

speaker: Eirene
content: You know, I worry about you sometimes... dear brother.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You fought so hard to reach the top, but what is it that you really want?

speaker: Isomer
content: ...What do I want?

speaker: Isomer
content: I'm... never satisfied, always dreaming of things... that will never belong to me.
[Small CG - Maverick]

speaker: Isomer
content: ...True geniuses fear neither the limits of their talent nor the sordid games others play.

speaker: Isomer
content: Even when they're oppressed or exploited, when all calculations lead nowhere, when every experiment proves futile, when they're discouraged by hardships... they still press forward. They pursue it as though it were a faith—almost blindly.

speaker: Isomer
content: True geniuses are capable of that...

speaker: Echo in the Dream
content: Over here! Geez...Where'd you run off to?

speaker: Echo in the Dream
content: Director... You're late!

speaker: Echo in the Dream
content: Look, I worked out the answer first! What about you?

speaker: Isomer
content: She did it.

speaker: Isomer
content: But I can't...

speaker: Isomer
content: I lost sight of the truth long ago...

speaker: Isomer
content: I'm just a mediocre fool, trapped by my own obsessions...
DisCity Central Library
How long... has it been going on?
The flames burn out. The last standing clock has collapsed. She can no longer tell the time.
Celine struggles through the burning bookshelves. Corruptors, Puppets, and contamination sorcery come at her in endless waves, and she resists them all.
All around her, the fallen Underground Puppets lie scattered everywhere.
She opens the book in her hands and glances at the table of contents. Ah, she's lost another batch of memories.
Now I've even forgotten everything from my favorite book from my childhood.
Memory Maniafication... What an inconvenient ability...
Why must the guardian of the truth gain her power from forgetting?
The Puppets' attacks are almost too reckless, too brutal. Of course, they're here to kill her. But...

Several streams of light spill from the book's pages. The instant they touch the Puppets, those filthy bodies shatter and dissipate like melting wax. Looks like she still has enough power left to tackle them.
This time, she'll use the name <color=#fb9259>Celine Fabius</color>, along with everything tied to it.
She's already exhausted all the expendable memories... All that's left are the precious ones. She must choose carefully. One wrong choice, and that memory will be gone forever.
She can't bear to lose them.
<i>She can't bear to lose them.
The blazing flames warp the air. Through the distortion, she can see the fissures tearing through her precious books.
Someone has told her that this is the enemy's dimension technology, and that it was stolen from the Ring Research Institute.
Even now, they need to kill with someone else's knife. How very discreet these assassins are.
<i>Think carefully... Which ones have already made it into the books...?
<i>Think carefully... Which ones have already made it into the books...?
[Kill more] Coordinated with action sequence
Her analysis of the Sillage Society, her investigations into every suspicious activity, all her records, and even her reasoning process had all been uploaded before the lockdown.
The network was cut off soon after, but those fragments should be enough to raise suspicion. Those experts will notice something and follow the clues.
<i>Which ones have already been entrusted to others?
<i>Which ones have already been entrusted to others?
[Kill one] Coordinated with action sequence
She's already explained the rise of the industrial sector to the "teacher" across the Rust, and she's passed her fieldwork records to the Chief. As for that voice recorder...
Her student should have it by now. That way, the distorted records can be set straight, and her own misdeeds will be exposed.
<i>And be careful... Some things must always remain unspoken. They must stay buried in her heart forever.
<i>Just a little longer... She isn't ready to let go... Not yet.

speaker: Academic Chronicler
content: The future is yours now!

speaker: Military Chronicler
content: Take it... Get it out... We can't let those guys win... You... must... get it... out...

speaker: Commerce-Politics Chronicler
content: I've had enough of this... Take it, and do whatever you want with it...
They came bearing hope, endured hardship, and trudged through despair.
Many more left in solitude.
Fortunately, some still kept their faith. Some chose to wait. And some passed the records down to her...

speaker: Miner Chronicler
content: I believe it all still means something. And I'm willing to believe in you, too... Go on. It's in your hands now...
She did well, didn't she? Whether driven by duty or simply by passion, she filled in so many gaps, corrected so many errors.
The truth was so fascinating. She was mesmerized by it, always delighted to share her findings.
She wanted to do the same as her predecessors. To pass it on.
In hindsight, perhaps she'd been too absorbed in the past, always forgetting to look ahead.
[CG: Linda reaches out her hand]

speaker: Linda
content: Professor! Professor! Professor, I have another question... What is the truth? Can I see it too?

speaker: Linda
content: I'm sorry, Professor...

speaker: Linda
content: I don't know... if history still has any value in today's DisCity...

speaker: Linda
content: I'm afraid I can't pass it on for you...
If only I hadn't been so consumed by the past. If only I'd spent more time embracing the future...

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: What are you apologizing for? Silly girl. Only those with true passion face this kind of frustration. I should thank you... for devoting your best years to this lonely path.

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: I'm afraid I'll soon become a burden to you, keeping you from leaving for quite a while.

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: So why not stick around on this path for just a little longer? You might discover a different kind of joy, as I did.

speaker: Raven
content: You want to talk about Rustfire? Ah, you really know your stuff! I've composed 108 new epic poems celebrating this radiant era! Not just my own hand, mind you, but collaborative works with the future blossoms of West District! You must include them all in your history book!

speaker: Hella
content: Ooh, ooh, me too! I know stuff about outside the city, way, way farther than WhiteSands! I just got back, in fact! Oh, and I can tell you all about my adventures too!

speaker: Lemma
content: The road they once walked alone has become a glorious legacy. Now it's been passed down into my hands. I love it. I've always loved it. I... I want to be like them too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like many in this city, we believe in logic and reason—the fruits of our civilization. We also believe in those who have reached the pinnacle of rationality, who dedicate themselves to the pursuit of truth and knowledge.

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: Like a gold panner by the riverbank, not seeking to turn the current, but to step into time itself, stand firm in the mud, and pick out a few precious grains from the dirt.

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: Then wash and polish them, string them together, and offer them to those deserving of the gift. Plant a dream in a budding scientist. Point the way for those standing at the crossroads of change.

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: We may not change the river's course, but who knows where those who walk beside us will one day end up? Who says they can't make new waves?

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: So, let's look forward to it. After all, we're all part of the same great river, moving ever onward.
[Back to the burning library]
At last, she sees the black bipyramid hovering in the shadows. Motionless, it is watching in silence.
Of course. The assassins are here. To lull them into lowering their guard, we must make them believe they've successfully silenced their target. Just as they once deceived us.
[Transition to flashback in place, normal library] [No black-and-white transition, direct fade in/fade out 17]

speaker: Schorl
content: This is a special power. Please preserve truths that cannot exist in official history, and seek out the records that were purposely erased. Pass them to those you trust.

speaker: Schorl
content: When you can no longer protect it, I will come to retrieve it. I will collect your memories by reading your Mania.

speaker: Schorl
content: And then, when your successor appears, I will pass it on once more.
[Burning library background] [Same, no black-and-white transition]
So it came... Could have at least said hello. It would have spared her the long wait.
She's done enough. At last, what she's been waiting for is here.
All history needs is a witness.
[Celine's Final Battle]
Her memories are ablaze, as pages dance wildly amid the flames.
The nameless chronicler unleashes all her power on the battlefield that will be remembered by no one.
