speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: Does history still have any value in today's DisCity? The enemy has already answered that question for me. As for what power the truth really holds, tonight will be the proof.

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: Let this towering blaze crown the silent pages.
[Black Screen]

speaker: Nameless Chronicler
content: As for me...
All the lies she's told, all the facts she's twisted... Someone will recognize her hidden motives, take apart her point of view, and expose the chronicler's little scheme...
Let them see through her. Then, through her eyes, let them witness the truth she's preserved.
And then... let them carry her will forward.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: All historical data recovered. Risk eliminated. Thank you for your contribution, Celine Fabius. Your hypothesis was deeply insightful. I believe it was probably correct.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: In that case... the greatest variable will soon descend upon us. Time is running short.

speaker: EDGE-01
content: Begin the calculations...

speaker: Evelleon
content: She completely destroyed the sorcery deployed in BR-003... The Director was determined to drive us out.

speaker: Evelleon
content: ...She was a remarkable scientist. What a shame.

speaker: Evelleon
content: That being the case, I have no choice but to borrow your power.

speaker: Evelleon
content: ...Can I? Do you...

speaker: Frail Voice
content: Yes...

speaker: Frail Voice
content: Please, allow me. I'm very glad to be able to help...

speaker: Frail Voice
content: ...I, too, hope to meet that person again...
[CD Mini-CG] [Play idol song violin version from a distance, add the idol song itself underneath (low volume, emphasize violin?) Music brief, 3-5 seconds is enough, after playing cut to black screen]
[Nightmare CG3]

speaker: Strange Voice
content: Hehehe... Want me to spoil you? You can tell we're related, can't you? Now then, try to guess...
[Small CG Sister reaches out to choke Chief]
[Black Screen]

speaker: Strange Voice
content: If I've been... a <color=#fb9259>good sister</color> to you?
It's that dream again...
Who's... that?
[ED]

June 1
Chief's Office
Your communication screen has been flashing non-stop with incoming messages for a while now.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color>Chief... Would you mind coming over? We've got a situation here! QAQ

<color=#fb9259>Eugene:</color>...Chief, help me out, please! If this doesn't stop now, I'm gonna lose my life savings!

<color=#fb9259>Eugene:</color>Help, Chief!!!

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color>Chief!! Chief!!! Check your phone, I beg you!!! TAT
When you see the SOS messages, you rush to the scene at once.
You arrive to find a particularly tiny figure laughing smugly, arms akimbo.
She's surrounded by staff with agonized expressions alongside heaps of trophies. The moment they see you, the two city arrest team members dash to you as if they're grabbing a lifeline.

speaker: Wynn
content: Boohoo, Chief, here you are finally! You have no idea what I've just been through!

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief... Does this count as a workplace injury?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hehe, one more round, one more round! Roulecca isn't done yet!
Feeling the tiny figure's attention turning toward you lot, the two immediately hide behind you fearfully.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Is it you, Roulecca?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Of course it's me, you idiot, Chief! Don't tell me just because I've shrunk a little, you don't recognize Roulecca, the cutest girl in the world?
What happened to you?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm, I couldn't resist and ate a piece of Summer's cake this morning, and suddenly I turned into a child... I think some others ate that cake too!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Anyway, enough with that small matter... Roulecca just wants to keep playing!
The tiny Roulecca claps her hands to signal the start of another round of the game. The people around her immediately cover their pockets and beg you for help with their eyes.

speaker: Chief
content: Um, Roulecca, you know, they can't just ignore their tasks and play with you all day...

speaker: Roulecca
content: I don't care, it's Day of Youth today! Endless sweets and endless games, hehe, the privilege of being a child!

speaker: Roulecca
content: I won't stop unless... I win my dream prize!
Watching her sulk like a little kid, you come up with an idea.
Let them go, I'll play with you. And whether you win or lose, I'll gift you a teddy bear.
You take out the toy Faye has purchased for Day of Youth and wave it in front of Roulecca.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...A teddy bear!
You manage to impress the girl with the plush teddy bear. She goes on to announce cheerfully.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Alrighty, then let's play... Cookie Guess!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Wow... Who'd have thought, Chief is actually not bad at this game! You got so many boxes right!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Roulecca is no cheater. Here, take these gifts as your rewards!
Roulecca shoves all the gifts she's looted from the staff into your arms. You're not sure what to do with them.

speaker: Chief
content: You gave me all your gifts. Don't you wanna pick a favorite and keep it?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hehe, but Roulecca's already got her favorite gift!

speaker: Roulecca
content: I'm dressed in my childhood clothes and I've won so many gifts... The Roulecca now has become so much stronger than the little Roulecca...

speaker: Roulecca
content: If the guys from Four-leaf Clover see how badass Roulecca has become and how many friends Roulecca has made, they must be so proud!

speaker: Chief
content: No doubt they will. You'll always be the pride of Four-leaf Clover.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hehe, for sure! Let's keep playing! Roulecca's not done with the game yet! More cookies!

speaker: Chief
content: Ahem, we can keep on playing, but no more cookies for me. I'm too full...

The night has settled in, but you remain immersed in your work at the office. EMP and Hella had vowed to stick around until you wrapped up. Yet, they casually tune into the radio, seemingly oblivious to how it might distract you.

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: Hey there! A big shoutout to all our listeners. I've got some juicy updates for you—wait, scratch that, I mean news!

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: You know, there's this Ghost Call going around Eastside. Word is, in the dead of the night, when everyone is sound asleep, some ghost lady might ring you up.

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: But, trust me, you don't wanna pick up. Because if you do, she's gonna... well, you get the idea. Heh heh.

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: So, what's the ghost gonna do? Give a cheeky chuckle like "hehehe"?
A phone's abrupt ringtone cuts through the airwaves, instantly hushing the captivated audience.

speaker: Hella
content: Who's calling this late?

speaker: EMP
content: Uhh... It's not that spooky Ghost Call we just heard about on the radio, right?
The phone keeps on ringing relentlessly, but the two sitting nearby don't seem inclined to pick it up.
You ask Hella to pick up the phone, but it is evident she has something else in mind.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? I was hoping to keep listening to DeadLover Radio. EMP, you get it.

speaker: EMP
content: What the—why me?! What if it's some creepy ghost on the line? You're literally right next to the phone!
The two engage in a heated back-and-forth... Ultimately, you step in and answer the phone yourself.
You ask EMP to pick up the phone, but she immediately appears disheartened.

speaker: EMP
content: Ugh, no can do. My stomach's suddenly killing me; I can't take the call... Ohhhh, it's so painful...
Fed up with EMP's dramatic display on the couch, you decide to answer the phone yourself.
You signal to Hella to turn down the radio, then grab the phone off the table.
...It's merely a procedural call from FAC about Corruptor in the Rust—nothing pressing.
As you set the phone down, you sense Hella stealthily drawing nearer from behind.

speaker: Hella
content: Heh, about that Call at 3 AM? I caught some spicy gossip just now!

speaker: Hella
content: On the radio, they were saying if you get a call from a ghostly lady, she'll challenge you to guess her name. She'd go like—

speaker: Hella
content: "Hey... Is this ${PlayerName}?... Try and guess my name... You've got three shots..."

speaker: Hella
content: "That's not it... Nope, that's not my name, either... One last shot... And still, you're off..."

speaker: Hella
content: "All three guesses are gone... Well, I'll let you in on it, my name is—"
Hella imitates the eerie voice of the ghostly lady, whispering ever so close to your ear.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=50>Wahhhhhh!</size>

speaker: Hella
content: HAHAHA, gotcha, didn't I?
Man, that's seriously creepy. You really caught me off guard there.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk, you don't look scared at all. You're just pulling my leg...
I don't know why, but I can't help but smirk.

speaker: Hella
content: Seriously, can't you just humor me for once?
Hella gives you a playful punch on the arm, but out of the corner of your eye, you notice EMP on the sofa. She looks a little ghostly pale.
EMP, are you okay?

speaker: EMP
content: Ha! You think Hella's little stunt can spook someone like me? I was just reminded of some online urban legends.

speaker: EMP
content: Rumor has it, if you dial certain numbers, you'll hear the ghostly lady's voice! Tons of these numbers are floating around the web!
Is that so...

speaker: Hella
content: Whoa there, don't tell me you're diving into another investigation? Can't you take a break from your workaholic ways for once?
You're about to have a rare, yet short-lived break, but the notion of midnight Ghost Call is hard to shake off.
Could this be another one of those Mania events? If I've got some time to spare, might as well dig up some clues online and see where it leads.
Chief's Office.
After returning from a work trip lasting several days, you lock yourself in the office to tackle the backlog of reports.
Going through this month's financial statement left you dazed. After a brief pause, you reached out and grabbed the comms device.

<size=40><color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color></size>: Wynn, why are this month's expenses double last month's?

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Wynn</color></size>: Eh, did you forget, Chief?

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Wynn</color></size>: You were worried that Sinners would get bored in the Bureau, so you suggested we organize some events. Many are quite enthusiastic about this.

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Wynn</color></size>: Sinners wanted to hold a gala, and they bought a lot of things for their performances.

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Wynn</color></size>: I did show you the program and the shopping list. You approved them! QAQ
You scroll up through the conversation history and indeed find the lists among the files.
You, who was fretting about West District redevelopment at the time, simply replied,, <color=#7683a2>"As long as they don't buy any dangerous or prohibited items."</color>

<size=40><color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color></size>: ...I did forget. How's the gala preparation going?

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Wynn</color></size>: Everyone knows you're busy, so we've been moving forward on our own!

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Wynn</color></size>: The gala will be held in the activity area. You should come and join us if you have time!
You put away the device. Worried about more surprises, you decide to check out the activity area.
The activity area is much livelier than usual. Through the tightly closed glass doors of the small rooms, you catch the sounds of electric guitars and suonas, along with loud rap and rock music.

A mix of laughter and screams is heard everywhere. Walking past one glass door after another and accustoming yourself to the sight of Sinners busily engaged in their practices, you can't help but smile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well, just a bit of funding. It's good they are having fun.

speaker: Roulecca
content: No, this doll is supposed to be Chief. It should wear a trench coat, not a dress... Ugh, how did an idiot like you even survive in Syndicate?!
Hearing the mention of your name, your gaze shifts to the small stage being set up in the hall.

speaker: EMP
content: Tsk, what do kids know about mix and match? This is how Syndicans dress!

speaker: EMP
content: Trust me, this will make your performance stand out at the gala.

speaker: OwO
content: No, it's ugly!

speaker: OwO
content: Little clapper is the male lead in OwO's script, but this doll the blondie made doesn't look anything like him!
female_content: Little clapper is the female lead in OwO's script, but this doll the blondie made doesn't look anything like her!

content: Approaching, you see Roulecca and OwO trying to snatch something from EMP's tight grasp. EMP is resisting defiantly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's the matter?

speaker: OwO
content: Oh, little clapper!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Chief!
Seeing you, Roulecca's eyes light up as she runs over and shoves something soft into your hands.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You came at the right time, Chief! Come help Roulecca prepare the doll theater!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Blondie sucks and the dolls she made don't match the characters in the script at all. We need to redo all of them! At this rate, our doll theater won't be ready when the gala starts!

speaker: EMP
content: Shut your big m...

speaker: OwO
content: But! If little clapper help us, I'm sure we can perfectly recreate the characters OwO needs!

speaker: OwO
content: It's settled then, you'll help make the dolls for our theater, little clapper!
You look at the doll in your hand. It has a crooked pink wig on its head and is dressed in a white robe in Hecate's style, but also wears a familiar pair of glasses.
You shoot a doubtful glance at the doll that EMP, who's been pushed aside, is holding. There's certainly not a trace of resemblance to yourself.

speaker: EMP
content: D-don't look at me like that! I was trying to give you a makeover.

You've grasped the situation now. Thinking about the pile of unfinished work, you are inclined to refuse them. But then you see Roulecca and OwO grabbing your arms, looking up at you with their hopeful little faces.

speaker: OwO
content: Little clapper, you're the main character in OwO's script this time. You must be looking forward to it too!

speaker: OwO
content: If we use the doll made by blondie, no one will recognize it's you, and OwO's story will go to waste!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Please, Chief, Roulecca has put a lot of effort and money into this show. You wouldn't want all that effort squandered, right?
...Indeed.
Looking at the two starry-eyed kids and hearing the other Sinners busily preparing their shows, you're unable to utter the refusal.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Alright, I'll help you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Really?

speaker: OwO
content: Yay! Little clapper is the best! OwO will give you a treasured item as a reward!
Watching the two lively kids, you smile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, my job is to create dolls needed in your play based on my impressions, right?

speaker: OwO
content: Exactly! Here's the list of characters.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I knew Chief needed no hand-holding. You're so smart!

speaker: OwO
content: Not like blondie... Huh? Where did blondie go?
Not far away, trying to sneak away on tiptoe, EMP stops in her tracks.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hey! Don't you dare sneak away, blondie! You gotta help Roulecca with the theater stage as well!

speaker: EMP
content: Isn't Chief helping you? I've got other things to take care of. Bye!

speaker: OwO
content: Liar! I took you in because you didn't have your own show. You can't leave!
OwO and Roulecca chase after EMP until they disappear at the end of the corridor. You can't help but chuckle, shaking your head as you pick up the list and approach the scattered doll parts nearby.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then, let's get to work.

speaker: EMP
content: Oh... I'm exhausted... Finally...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Finally, all done!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Just like in my memory...

speaker: OwO
content: Wow, it looks amazing! Hey blondie, you can be useful sometimes!

speaker: OwO
content: Little clapper, come and take a look!
Hearing OwO's call, you walk over with the dolls in your hands.
The stage before you is surprisingly exquisite. Seeing your expression, OwO lifts her chin proudly, arms akimbo.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe, so? I'm pretty talented, aren't I?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Impressive, indeed. I didn't expect you to pull it off so well.

speaker: EMP
content: It was all my work. Stop taking the credit!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ah, you're done with your dolls too, Chief!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Great job, Chief! They are just perfect. Our little theater will sure be a smash hit at the gala! It'll win the audience's hearts!

speaker: OwO
content: Oh! A smash hit! Win the audience's hearts!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Look forward to it, Chief!
OwO and Roulecca drag the slumped EMP onto the stage energetically and start planning with the dolls. Their happiness is infectious, and you find yourself smiling too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
The alarm in the Bureau blares, and the ground trembles slightly.

speaker: Alarm
content: Warning: Fluctuations in the M-value have been detected within the Bureau. Please identify the source of the fluctuations...
The broadcast is cut off mid-sentence, drowned out by a louder rumbling noise.
The trembling continues for a while before stopping. You open the office door, hoping to see what exactly happened in the Bureau.
Just then, countless beautifully packaged gift boxes flood into your office. It seems they are the cause of the disturbance.
Driven by curiosity, you unwrap the gift and take out what's inside.
Option
Did something go wrong with the Supply Office? Why else would so many chocolates appear out of nowhere?
You rush to the Supply Office and find that a considerable number of Sinners and staff are already there, all confused about the situation.

speaker: Logistics Staff A
content: So many chocolates. I won't ever have to worry about food again...

speaker: Logistics Staff B
content: ...You'll get high blood sugar if you finish all that.
Attention to everyone in the Bureau, I believe you all must have received a significant amount of chocolate by now.
A mysterious voice comes through from the broadcast, drawing the attention of everyone.
Of course, this is just the beginning... You must collect as much chocolate as possible, and by the end of today, <color=#fb9259>whoever has the most chocolate will be the winner.</color>
And the prize for the winner is...
<color=#fb9259>A week alone with the MBCC Chief!</color>

Like a stone thrown into a pond, the announcement creates ripples throughout the Bureau—some are doubtful, some are thrilled, and you just feel a headache brewing. When did Sinners become bold enough to plot something targeting you?

speaker: EMP
content: Hey! How do we know you're not bluffing?
If I manage to fill the Bureau with chocolate, I most certainly have the means to let you spend a week with him.
female_content: If I manage to fill the Bureau with chocolate, I most certainly have the means to let you spend a week with her.

speaker: Ariel
content: Alone...?
Quite a few naive Sinners seem to have taken the bait.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I have questions!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Can we only pick up chocolates? Can Roulecca defeat others and then take their chocolates?
Of course you can, but to make the game fair, you must all follow the <color=#fb9259>Chocolate War</color> Rules.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Chocolate War Rules?
Simply put, during a duel, <color=#fb9259>the side with more chocolates will get all of the chocolates from their opponent.</color>
<color=#fb9259>And you can't use your abilities during the duel.</color>
As you listen to these absurd rules, your urge to find this troublemaking Sinner only grows stronger.
Oh, the prize wants to play as well?
You can't control me, I am also a member of the MBCC, and...
All Sinners in the MBCC are equally important to me.
Interesting. Let me add one more rule then.
<color=#fb9259>If you want the MBCC Chief to win, then give him your chocolates.</color>
female_content: <color=#fb9259>If you want the MBCC Chief to win, then give her your chocolates.</color>

content: Well, that's about all the rules, now... let the Chocolate War begin!
As the PA system falls silent, marking the beginning of the competition, many interested Sinners spring into action.
In order to restore the Bureau to its original state, you also begin searching for the mysterious Sinner in the broadcast.
After dueling with many Sinners and winning their chocolates, you finally catch a glimpse of the mastermind behind this.
What's the matter, Chief? Have you reached your limit?
She's not wearing her usual outfit. Her eyes sparkle with a strange red light, exuding a dangerous aura.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Stop? What are you talking about?

speaker: Macchiato
content: Watching everyone desperately fighting for one thing, that's what I live for!
Macchiato's power surges, and colorful gift boxes dance wildly on the ground.
It seems Mania has taken control of her mind. Her actions have become unpredictable.
You reach out your hand, trying to restrain her with the shackles.

speaker: Macchiato
content: What's the hurry, Chief?
She dodges the shackles with a swift movement, then picks up a piece of chocolate and places it in your mouth.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Come on, open up. This is a reward for your hard work... let's enjoy it together.

speaker: Macchiato
content: You're so tense. Relax. I will take everyone to the peak of ecstasy at just the right moment...

speaker: Macchiato
content: Your shackles are useless against me. In this Chocolate War, I am the rules.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Unless you can beat me within my rules.
The bittersweet taste of chocolate melts in your mouth.
To contain the spread of Mania and prevent Macchiato from losing control, you approach her without hesitation.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We have identified the reason for Sinner Macchiato going berserk. According to her, it's due to her heavy workload at the Bureau recently.

speaker: Nightingale
content: This includes paperwork, dispatch work, and supervisory duties...

speaker: Nightingale
content: She doesn't remember what exactly she did yesterday, only that she had a rather thrilling dream.
No wonder she kept talking about "relax." It seems we need to reconsider the workload for Sinners.

speaker: Nightingale
content: There were no casualties in this incident. However, as punishment, Miss Macchiato will be responsible for cleaning the Bureau for the next week.

speaker: Choice
options: That turned out okay, I guess...

content: You sigh and look towards the office that has been overrun by gift boxes.
One day in Chief's Office, MBCC
The Bureau is as tense and busy as always today. After a long day, you're finally about to wrap up the tasks in the office and get to catch your breath.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Once I'm done with these tasks at hand, this week's work is settled.

speaker: EMP
content: Chief! Chief! A raid at the Bureau!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's not the first time the Bureau has been raided. Even if the alarm goes off now, I can probably stay calm...

speaker: Announcement
content: Warning! Warning! The underground area of the Bureau has been breached by external forces! Combat force, proceed to the area immediately!

speaker: EMP
content: Holy ****, Chief! You just predicted the future! Is that mouth of yours this magical?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'll take that as a compliment. Anyway, let's go see what's going on.
The Bureau's Underground Corridor

speaker: EMP
content: Like I've told you, when I passed by the Supply Office earlier, I felt like those ducks were acting weird. Talk about being observant! That's the Archer Queen of Syndicate for you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The ducks? But surely they can't get armored and start blasting bullets everywhere within the Bureau, can they?

speaker: Berserk Duck?
content: Quack! Quack quack! Quack quack! Quack quack quack!

speaker: EMP
content: Wow! Sick. Since when has the Bureau been equipping mascots with guns?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Quit joking around. It's seen us. We need to get it under control!
The duck's firepower is unbelievably strong! Your attack seems unable to crack its defense no matter how hard you try. It's almost as if it's using some kind of cheat code.

speaker: EMP
content: It's locked its HP?! That's cheating! Are you serious?!

speaker: Berserk Duck
content: Quack quack quack! (Duck spin kick!)

speaker: EMP
content: Damn it... It hit me twice! Even Hella wouldn't dare to do this to me...

speaker: Berserk Duck
content: Quack, quack quack quack... (Hesitation is defeat...)
The Bureau's Underground Confinement Room
Chief, Chief! Can you hear me? Is everything okay?
You wake up to a voice from the comms and find yourself and EMP locked in a pitch-dark room. That's Nightingale's voice from the communication device you carry.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm fine. EMP is conscious too and looks okay. How's the situation now?

speaker: Nightingale
content: That's good. From what we understand, the ducks at the Supply Office have acquired mecha armor and weapons through unknown means, and they've launched an attack on the Bureau.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I've closed all internal passageways in the Bureau and activated the internal alert. But while trying to isolate the ducks in the underground storage area, it seems I've also trapped you there.

You look around and find that aside from a locked door, there's indeed no other way out. With the room being filled with cardboard boxes, EMP's ability could cause a fire and is thus unusable. You must find a way to open the door from the outside.
You hear the movement of mecha armor outside the door and realize that the storage outside is full of patrolling mecha ducks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you just say they launched the attack after acquiring the mecha armor?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So... if we can make them lose their mecha armor unknowingly, we'd have a chance to strike back?

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Got it. I'll arrange for competent Sinners to infiltrate the underground storage. Please help them pinpoint the energy reaction coordinates of the ducks' mecha armor!
Hehe, silly Chief! I knew you couldn't do anything without me! And look how pathetic this Syndicate's disgrace has become now!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hella? They sent you?

speaker: EMP
content: Damn it, have I really fallen so low that I must rely on Minos's trash to save me?! Chief, can't you ask for someone else?!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! I'm literally risking my life to come and check on you guys. You better appreciate it! Don't forget to thank me when you get out!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: According to Adjutant Nightingale's intel, there's a reaction signal right ahead of us. It likely comes from a set of mecha armor kept in the storage by the ducks.

speaker: Hella
content: Is my job considered done if I just remove the power source from that mecha armor?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's one way to do it. Hella, we're counting on you.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe, easy-peasy! Hella's back safe and sound!

speaker: EMP
content: Goodness, that's actually quite impressive. Did you sneak out to get some secret training or something?

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph, with Syndicate's cleverest and cutest little mouse Hella on the job, nothing is impossible!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't let your guard down. There are still a few more left.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's the last signal reaction in front of us. This is the most guarded area, so proceed with great caution.

speaker: Hella
content: Relax. The Bureau is my home. I've wandered in every last corner, whether I'm allowed or not.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What?

speaker: Hella
content: Ahem, I mean... With my intelligence, I can easily handle ten more of them, hehe.
With Hella's assistance, you are safely rescued.

speaker: Berserk Duck?
content: Quack quack quack quack! Quack quack quack quack quack! (Foolish humans! How dare you come out again!)

speaker: EMP
content: Let's settle this once and for all! I won't lose this time!

speaker: Berserk Duck?
content: Quack! Quack quack quack quack! (Idiot! Don't you know I'm using a cheat code?)

speaker: Berserk Duck?
content: Quack quack quack?! Quack quack quack quack! (Quackdam Freedom! Why aren't you moving?!)

speaker: EMP
content: Hehe, Chief, we've just taken apart a Quackdam with our bare hands. Doesn't that feel awesome?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That I can't say for sure, but I'm sure all cheating behaviors deserve to be punished.

speaker: Duck
content: Quack! Quack quack quack! (Darn it! I'll be back!)

Peace is finally restored. According to the evaluation done by the analysis team on the substances of the mecha armor, the ducks likely started the riot after coming into contact with the Mania-tainted weapons.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It seems the Bureau needs to be stricter with the handling of evidence contaminated by Mania.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Not only that, Chief...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hmm?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Luckily, the riot didn't cause significant damage, but the data room was the first place the ducks attacked, and none of your work today had been backed up. In other words, I'm afraid you'll need to redo everything you've done today over the weekend.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: NOOO!
Turning back the clock to when Hella was still at the Bureau.
(Scene change)

speaker: Hella
content: Hey Hecate, what are we even supposed to be looking for here? We've been all over Area C and haven't found anything special.

speaker: Hecate
content: Shh, keep your voice down. People are reading here.

speaker: Hella
content: Blah blah blah. Hecate's lecture again...

From the shelf, Hecate removes a book titled A Study on the Impact and Spillover Effects of Mining Robots on Corporate Hypercube Production so Hella can see Quinn's President elegantly browsing through books in the reading area.
As if sensing something, the lady in red slowly looks up toward Area C. Hella immediately presses herself flat against the bookshelf.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=28> ****... Ahem... Maybe we should check out the other shelves? Ahaha... </size>Ouch!
Barely holding herself together, Hella stumbles and knocks even more books off the shelf, with one of them landing right on her head.
Just as she's about to act up, Hecate quickly picks up the book from Hella's head.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is the series I'm looking for.

speaker: Hecate
content: BOOKS so gripping, they pull you into their world. Welcome to Project: Dark Episodes.

speaker: Hella
content: Why did you say BOOKS like that?

speaker: Hecate
content: Simply because the book is only one of its forms of existence...
Hecate turns the book open, and a blinding white light engulfs the library.

<size=55>Incoming! 
The Slacking Ducks!</size>

speaker: Hella
content: Whoa, that's amazing... We just got inside the book like that? You know what, this place is actually pretty cool.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's not a book. This is a <color=#fb9259>Hologram</color>.
A round and chubby Hella is talking to the equally round and chubby Hecate next to her.

speaker: Hecate
content: These are our virtual avatars, like the one Nino uses.

speaker: Hecate
content: And everything here is just a projection. They've got nothing to do with our original world.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh...? So you're saying I can do whatever I want here without consequences?

speaker: Hecate
content: Theoretically speaking, yes.

speaker: Hella
content: Then it's decided! I'm going to defeat the strongest enemy in this world of projection!

speaker: Hecate
content: That's an admirable goal, but we should deal with our current situation first.
The two look around to find themselves surrounded by a ring of ducks, all quacking nonstop.

speaker: Duck
content: Quack... Sinner Hecate detected. Initiating detention.

speaker: Hella
content: What the... Why are they coming after Sinners even in Project: Dark?! And why are you their first target again?!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Stories often take inspiration from reality and surpass reality.

speaker: Duck
content: Quack... All unauthorized individuals, please stand back. Do not interfere with law enforcement!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! I'm a Sinner too! I'm not just some unauthorized individual!

speaker: Hella
content: ...You just avoided my eyes, didn't you? Do you think I'm not good enough to be a Sinner?
Seeing the duck avert its eyes, Hella's grip around the pipe tightens.

speaker: Duck
content: Quack quack! Proceed with detention! Ignore this chatterbox—she can't even make it out of the detention room! Quack!

People sometimes appear unusually calm before they erupt in anger. 
Uncharacteristically, Hella turns to Hecate and asks a question—this time, with surprising patience.

speaker: Hella
content: So... we can do anything we want here, right? After all, this is just a <color=#fb9259>Hologram</color>, right?

speaker: Hecate
content: That's correct.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! I'm gonna give these ******* ducks a hundred bumps on their heads!

speaker: Hella
content: Now talk! Who's the unauthorized individual now?

speaker: Duck
content: Quack... Q-quack... I am...
Hella grabs the duck with one hand and draws it close to her face.

speaker: Hella
content: And remind me, who the hell am I?

speaker: Duck
content: Quack... You're Sinner No. 98...

speaker: Hella
content: Good, you've done your research... Now say it again. I couldn't hear you!

speaker: Duck
content: You're Sinner No. 98! A legend of Syndicate! The right hand of the great MBCC Chief!

speaker: Hella
content: Spot on! Now that you've offended someone as famous and powerful as me, shouldn't you offer some compensation? That dummy Chief hasn't bought me any new clothes lately, hehe...

speaker: Duck
content: Quack quack! Don't push your duck too far!

speaker: Hella
content: Then buff me and Hecate's stats! You know, make us deal 999,999 damage with one hit!

speaker: Duck
content: Quack... What kind of clothes do you want again?
Before the conversation can finish, the ground suddenly trembles with a violent quake. A deafening roar erupts, sending the ducks scattering in a frenzy of flapping wings and panicked quacks.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What's going on?!

speaker: Duck
content: Quack! This is bad—A Sinner has broken free!

speaker: Hecate
content: Oh.
Hecate nods but continues to walk further away.

speaker: Duck
content: Don't go, quack! If you guys leave, she'll tear this whole hologram apart! Please save us!
The ducks flop down in a pleading attempt to block their path, making it clear they won’t take no for an answer.

<size=55>Clash! 
The Billboard Skirmish!</size>
The fierce battle has severely damaged the ground, scattering shattered rocks and debris.
In the heart of the ruins, a dark figure is muttering alone.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait... that purple outfit... and the Legion's emblem...

speaker: Hecate
content: Power level... 50, 500, 5000... Incalculable.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's a projection of the Legion Commander Zoya.

speaker: Hella
content: No way, that looks nothing like her! That silly portrait and design could be of anyone but her!

speaker: Hecate
content: This is just a simulation of the Sinner created by Project: Dark. While the projections may act out of character or behave strangely, they still retain the original Sinner’s power.

speaker: Hecate
content: Well... go on, Hella. I’ve got your back.

speaker: Hella
content: ...For real? You want me to deal with Zoya?
With Hecate's encouragement, Hella inches closer to Zoya, who sits slumped on the ground. Hella reaches out, hoping to touch Zoya and break whatever that's binding her.

speaker: Zoya
content: Don't you dare...

speaker: Hella
content: Whoa, Zoya, please calm down! We're just trying to help you!

speaker: Zoya
content: You want my spot? Hah, you'll have to beat me first!

speaker: Zoya
content: I, am... the app icon!

speaker: Hella
content: ...I thought you are the Legion?! This is definitely not Zoya!

speaker: Hecate
content: That's a good one, Hella.

speaker: Zoya
content: Hmph, I'll admit, you're quite something to have pushed me this far.

speaker: Zoya
content: Well then, I'll leave the rest to you, brave challengers.
As the battle ends, "Zoya" slowly fades away.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew, that was close... We almost got pulverized back there. Luckily, it was just Zoya's projection.

speaker: Hecate
content: It seems this world has some sort of nerfing mechanism in place. Otherwise, we would never have survived that.

speaker: Hella
content: By the way... now that Zoya's gone, what will become of the Project: Dark app icon...

speaker: Hecate
content: I think my portrait looks better—at least I’m not sticking my tongue out.

speaker: Hella
content: What do you know? It's totally #Quirky! Everyone's digging this vibe right now!

speaker: Hecate
content: I'd say everyone's more into... #Kuudere.

<size=55>Begone! 
Banner Blackhole!</size>

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate, what am I looking at...?
In the void, a huge mural was silently suspended in mid-air, like a creation of the gods.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is the distribution center for Hypercubes, a place where wishes are born and granted, and also a breeding ground for vice and temptation.

speaker: Hella
content: Speak English, okay?

speaker: Hecate
content: It's the gacha interface.

speaker: Hella
content: The ga... what?

speaker: Hecate
content: The gacha interface. You and EMP's lot only play offline games, so I guess you haven't seen this before.

speaker: Hecate
content: Here you can spend Hypercubes to obtain the most powerful S-Class Sinners.

speaker: Hella
content: O-kay...? But isn't that pretty cool? All you need to do is spend some Hypercubes and you get powerful Sinners.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's not that easy. Luck rules this place. Some people get exactly what they want with just one tap, using a free Warrant they earned as a reward.

speaker: Hecate
content: While others still have their hands empty after eighty pulls.

speaker: Hella
content: Well, when it comes to luck... I guess... everyone has their unlucky moments, right?

speaker: Hecate
content: By the way, Hella, you're just a B-Class Sinner in Project: Dark. People sometimes get nine copies of you in ten pulls.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! Hecate, let's smash these stupid buttons to pieces!
After smashing the buttons with her pipe and melting them with laser beams, Hella suddenly looks pensive.
With a turn of the page, she got transported into a world both foreign and familiar.
Everything is absurd and puzzling here, and perhaps she's wasting her precious time in the Bureau...
But it's fun. Adventures with friends are always fun.
Where should she go next? What other surprises await her in this pixelated version of DisCity?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...It's coming.

speaker: Hella
content: What?

speaker: Hecate
content: The source of all evil, and the very foundation this world is built upon.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's there, waiting for us.

speaker: Hella
content: Hold on, hold on... There should be tons of other fun places to explore in this world, right?

speaker: Hella
content: Like the Erica Villa in Eastside, or the Council in Paradeisos! I never get to visit these places in the real DisCity. Let's check them out while we're here!

speaker: Hecate
content: Those places don't exist here.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh?

speaker: Hella
content: ...Oh, maybe we can only unlock these areas after defeating the final boss? Or do we need to finish exploring the current area first? That's how these games usually work, right?

speaker: Hecate
content: No, I heard they didn't have the budget to build them.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh.

<size=55>Obliterate! 
Where It All Started!</size>

speaker: Hella
content: Uhh... So...

speaker: Hella
content: The source of all evil... is that...
The two look up—and up—at an indescribably towering building...

speaker: Hecate
content: Yes. Unlike the Bureau in reality, the Bureau here has a different name here...

speaker: Hella
content: AIS... what?

speaker: Hecate
content: Such is the rule of this world. I cannot speak its full name.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What crap!

speaker: Hella
content: I can't accept this both mentally and physically! What were those ducks thinking when they built this world?!

speaker: Hella
content: Look at this Bureau building—who came up with this awful design?! I’ve seen Corruptors that look better than this!

speaker: Hecate
content: I think it's not too bad, at least it's better looking than most of the Corruptors.

speaker: Hella
content: How is this not too bad?! Look at those gross spinning eyeballs! Calling them frog eyes would be a compliment!

speaker: Hecate
content: Watch out, those are laser guns.
Hecate shoves Hella down as a laser beam sweeps over her head.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk, what a pain... Even here, the Bureau's defense is just as annoying as ever.

speaker: Hella
content: But... this all ends now! This world doesn't need any more weird Sinners, and it definitely doesn't need such a hideous Bureau!

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate, now!
Hella called out to Hecate after taking down all the "Sinners" in her way.

speaker: Hecate
content: This isn't working. I need a specific target.

speaker: Hella
content: That mouth! Blast it with the lasers! Don't let it spit out any more "Sinners"!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Why are you lying on the ground? Get up and keep fighting.

speaker: Hella
content: I... I can only attack in a cross range. There's no way I can reach it from here.
Boom—
As the ammo depot detonates, towering flames engulf the ”Bureau“, obliterating everything.

speaker: Hella
content: (Pants) Is it... is it finally all over?
Not by a long shot.
No one is going anywhere until you pay for the repairs.

<size=55>What? 
A Villain with Manners!</size>
No one is going anywhere until you pay for the repairs.

speaker: Hella
content: Pay for the repairs? Hecate, isn't this just a hologram? Since when do holograms need repairs?

speaker: Hecate
content: "Please note that certain reparations will be required if excessive damage has been caused to the world."
Hecate produces a manual and points to the fine print at the very bottom for Hella to see.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh come on, that's so not fair! Who can even read text that tiny?!
A rule is a rule. If you use our product, you must honor the terms of service.
According to my rough estimation, repairs will cost 100 million DisCoins.

speaker: Hella
content: 100 million?! You might as well rob us at gunpoint!

Your destruction has caused immeasurable damage to this product of Enterprise A. The hundred million is only a rough estimate, the number of critical bugs your rampage has triggered is beyond calculation.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, don't blame us for your shoddy work! If you hadn't made everything so ridiculous here, we wouldn't have had to blow the Bureau to smithereens!
In the face of Hella's accusations, the man who claimed to be from Enterprise A paced slowly, revealing his true colors.

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: No further talk is needed. What's done is done. You must take responsibility.

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: If you're currently experiencing financial difficulties, we offer an installment plan. You'll only need to pay 100,000 DisCoins per installment, with an annual interest rate of...

speaker: Hella
content: (Gasps) We won’t be able to pay it off until our next life!

speaker: Hecate
content: But sounds like the remedial classes have really paid off. You've gotten so much better at math.

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: I see you're not thrilled about the payment plan. Fortunately, we have an alternative proposition.

speaker: Hella
content: What kind of proposition?

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: After I defeat you, you'll fix everything you broke in Project: Dark and get rid of all the bugs before you leave!

speaker: Hella
content: Can you do that again? Yeah, that.

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: Our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience! We'll assign more staff to fix the bugs right away!
The Enterprise A representative drops to his knees, bowing until his forehead nearly touches the ground.

speaker: Hecate
content: Lower. I've seen other Syndicate gangsters do that better.

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: Our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience! The server maintenance compensation has been sent to your inbox. Please note that the email expires in seven days. Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

speaker: Hella
content: ...What is he going on about?

speaker: Hecate
content: No idea. Probably just survival instinct kicking in.

speaker: Hella
content: So... do we still have to pay?

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: No, no... Please keep playing our games once we’ve fixed the bugs—that’s all we ask!

speaker: Hella
content: Sounds good. So when are you going to add Eastside and Paradeisos to this world, anyway?

speaker: Enterprise A Rep
content: Um… Well, we’re working hard to improve our capacity. We sincerely apologize!
The Enterprise A representative's forehead meets the ground again with an audible thud.

<size=55>Holy Moly! 
Frenemy Unlikely!</size>

speaker: Hella
content: Looks like we're pretty much invincible now.

speaker: Hecate
content: Agreed, but...

speaker: Hella
content: Oh well, even Zoya and the Bureau are no match for us now. I'm sure we've pretty much beat Project: Dark!
While Hella stands with her arms crossed like an invincible hero, Hecate is quietly tapping away nearby.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... Can no one fight here? There's barely even a scratch on my pipe...
Before Hella finishes her sentence, a figure in a gray coat appears before her.

speaker: Hella
content: W-w-wait a sec... Chi... What's that idiot doing here?!

speaker: Hecate
content: <color=#fb9259>Trench Coat Boss</color> projection complete.

speaker: Hecate
content: Since we both wanted a stronger opponent, I used the console left by that Enterprise A rep to unlock the hidden boss.

speaker: Hecate
content: This should be challenging enough, right, Hella?

speaker: Hella
content: Are you serious?! When did I ever say that?

speaker: Hecate
content: You said it yourself, in the ninth paragraph of Chapter 1.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't remember that kind of thing so clearly!! Aaaaaahhhhh we're doomed!!!! The shackles are coming!!!
Just as the red shackles are about to reach Hella and Hecate, the spikes vanish completely.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is...?

speaker: Chief
content: The lunch break’s nearly over—take a moment to relax before class starts.

speaker: Chief
content: It may look this way in the game, but... I'm never your enemy. I'll let you guys enjoy it this time, but don't play for too long.
The Chief of Minos sighs and vanishes before their eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: Ha... ha... It might've been just a projection of that dummy, but damn if it wasn't just as intimidating as the real person.

speaker: Hecate
content: Good thing Chief stayed in character, or the shackles would have tied us up like pretzels.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew... It's kind of a shame, but I'd say our Project: Dark adventure was a success, wasn't it?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...It's too soon to draw a conclusion yet.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh...?

speaker: Hecate
content: Have you heard of the "plus one" law?

speaker: Hella
content: Yeah... I think I have...

speaker: Hecate
content: There's always an extra boss, meaning in a six-stage design, there must be a seventh boss.

speaker: Hella
content: A seventh boss? That's not possible. We've searched every nook and cranny of this map!

speaker: Hecate
content: Logically, after beating all the enemies, a portal should appear to take us out of here... but we haven't seen one yet.

speaker: Hecate
content: Perhaps... what we're looking for... is right in front of us?
In this vast, empty world of Project: Dark, only two people remain.
Hecate and Hella exchange a glance.

speaker: Hella
content: Can't believe you actually sent me to fight Zoya! Did you want to see me dead?
After a brief silence, the two are entangled in a scuffle.

speaker: Hecate
content: You were basically having a picnic while I was laser-bombing the MBCC building.

speaker: Hella
content: I call that strategic resting! I'm making good use of the DPS stats!

speaker: Hecate
content: In that case, let's have a fair friendly match.

speaker: Hella
content: As your friend, I'll give it everything I've got.

speaker: Hella
content: But don't you dare tell that dummy about any of this!

speaker: Hecate
content: Deal.

<size=55>Farewell, 
My BFF!</size>
(CG1)

speaker: Hella
content: What the... whaaat-t... Ahh...

speaker: Hella
content: What are you doing?! Who does that! Stop it. Let go, let go of me... Someone's got to be watching. This is embarrassing!
(CG2)

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't worry. No one is watching.

speaker: Hecate
content: I understand. I understand why you want to become stronger so that you can protect what is close to your heart.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is what you taught me. When I was lost, it was you who reached out to me, let me know I was not alone; you are the reason I'm back at Chief's side.

speaker: Hecate
content: So, it's only fair that I should give you my support when you need it. Go for it, Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: What about your mission?

speaker: Hecate
content: You mean the task of supervising you? It's okay, I don't want to fulfill it anymore. Chief will help me sort it out; you're more important than those tasks.
(CG3)

speaker: Hecate
content: Because Hella is my friend, the first friend I chose for myself.

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't forget to visit us often. I'll miss you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Yeah...

speaker: Choice
options: What's the title of this book?

speaker: Hecate
content: Best Friend Forever.

<size=55>Hidden Episode
An Unexpected Exit!

speaker: Hella
content: Agh... I died! I was this close to beating that boss!

speaker: Hecate
content: It's alright. This hologram simulation is just a mini-game anyway.

speaker: Hecate
content: Players just want their rewards, so... you'll still get something even if you don't beat the boss.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? Why didn't you tell me earlier?!

speaker: Hella
content: Hold up! If that's the case, why can't I just get all the rewards now?!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, Hecate, wait! You haven't answered my question!
Chief's Office

speaker: Dudu
content: BOOOSS...
You close your weary and sore eyes, rubbing them to avoid the longing gaze from across the desk.

speaker: Dudu
content: BOOOSS... Oh, pretty please, give it another thought, won't you? Why rush to say no so soon?

Apparently, your effort proves futile. You sigh and look again at the blueprint that Dudu claimed to have meticulously drawn throughout the night. It resembles a peculiar house, with skewed lines and revised numbers filling the page...

speaker: Dudu
content: You see, I just need... eh, seven... 720 more pieces of candy to bring this candy house blueprint to life! Pleeeeeeaaaase~~~

speaker: Dudu
content: Hehe, once you approve it, I'll swiftly put in a request to the Supply Office! The house will be standing by tonight!

options: Building a house within a house?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hold your horses... Let's not even talk about whether Faye can get hold of that many pieces of candy in one go...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: MBCC probably doesn't have the space for such a big candy house.

speaker: Dudu
content: Wait, you think this is big, boss? It's not big at all!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's beside the point... What I'm wondering is, why the sudden interest in a candy house?

speaker: Dudu
content: Well, just think about it for a second—a grand candy house at MBCC! How stunning would that be? Plus, I'll deck it out with colorful lights and bells...

speaker: Dudu
content: Whenever you swing open that door, hehe, the sweet candy house will definitely lift your spirits and send you off to dreamland on a high note!

"Sweet candy house," "colorful lights," "bells"... You suddenly recall walking past Dudu's room last night, when you overheard Mess and Etti enthusiastically recounting a story from a picture book to Dudu.
She must have created that blueprint based on the picture book—upon this realization, you break into a smile.

speaker: Dudu
content: Hehe, I've noticed how hard you've been working lately, so I thought I could help you relax a bit.

speaker: Dudu
content: According to the picture book, you can sleep soundly and have the sweetest dreams in a candy house... It's the best idea I could come up with...

With your hectic schedule these days, you have indeed been continuously on the go for many days, severely sleep-deprived and never getting proper rest. It appears that Dudu has been closely observing your state.

speaker: Dudu
content: Besides, you played with Mess and Etti for a long time last year. This year, I just have this tiny little request, and you can't say yes?
She can't contain her excitement, leaning closer to you. You reach out with a smile... and give her forehead a gentle flick.

speaker: Dudu
content: Ouch! Are you really gonna say no?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I appreciate the thought... but about the candy house, I'll have to say no. Those picture book tales all tend to exaggerate things...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But if you want, I can buy some sweets, and we could all enjoy them together, just to unwind.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...How about this? I still have a few documents to take care of. Once I'm done, we can head out together to get them. How does that sound?
Your indirect comfort evidently fails to dampen Dudu's enthusiasm.

speaker: Dudu
content: No, I'll figure out a way! Wait for me, boss!
Dudu gives you a resolute look before turning to dart away.
In the distance, you hear a barrage of suona sounds resounding intensely in the corridor, as if the musician is fervently encouraging herself.
The ceiling light in your office suddenly flickers, and you feel a growing sense of suspicion, unsure of what intentions she might have in mind.
At night...
A brief, crisp sound of bells softly rings in your ears, coaxing you to open your eyes.
Uncertain if it's a dream, you find yourself enveloped by mist.
The ground is carpeted with thorns, and in the dense forest ahead, creatures appear to be stirring. Night owls and bats with glowing eyes lurk in the darkness, signaling an impending sense of danger.
Raising your gaze, you notice a blood moon hanging above the highest branch. A person sits there, her form obscured by the thick mist. Swinging her legs, she seems to be in a cheerful mood.
Hey, bo—oh, wandering servant, are you the gift those villagers sent my way?

speaker: Dudu
content: It's the Great Witch. Calling me by my name is so not cool...

speaker: Dudu
content: Ahem, moving on, tonight marks the blood moon, and the villagers living below the mountain should be sending an innocent servant to serve me, the Great Witch. So, looks like you're the lucky one, ${PlayerName}!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Witch, villagers, servant... What are you talking about, and where am I?

speaker: Dudu
content: Oh, a servant full of questions, I see.
Dudu, or rather, the Great Witch, grins mischievously, lifts the suona in her hand, and begins playing a little tune to herself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Does a witch also play suona?

The discordant melody sounds strangely familiar to you. Before you can think further, the thorns beneath your feet begin to wildly grow, and a white floating figure suddenly glides past in the depths of the forest. You cautiously step back.

speaker: Dudu
content: Scared?

speaker: Dudu
content: Don't fret. I'm quite nice to my servants. The tasks I'll need your help with are few, in fact, just one...
She blinks, her eyes gleaming with mischief.

speaker: Dudu
content: I need you to collect a basket full of candy, so much that it's almost overflowing—!

speaker: Dudu
content: Then, we'll build a fragrant, sweet, and golden candy house!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why does Dudu want to build a candy house so badly... Wasn't she supposed to help me relax? Collecting candy sounds like a lot of work...
In a heartbeat, all the thorns and the white floating figure surge towards you.

speaker: Dudu
content: Oh, by the way, my little pet loves candy too, so you better not let it catch you, or all your efforts will be in vain...

speaker: Dudu
content: You've got this! My candy house is all on you!

speaker: Dudu
content: Congratulations, you've made it through the first round! Keep it up!
Brushing the sweat from your forehead, you steal a glance back at the relentless white ghost still chasing you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Dudu, are these enough?
The ghost draws near while Dudu the Witch leisurely counts the candy pieces in the basket.

speaker: Dudu
content: I told you, call me Great Witch!

speaker: Dudu
content: Sigh, you're still far from done. Keep going!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wait a minute, did you just say... "first round"?

speaker: Dudu
content: Uh-huh.

speaker: Ghost
content: (Whoosh)
Before you can even react, the white ghost catches up to you with a whoosh.
It wraps one of its pale ghost hand around your hands, while the other hand is poised to reach into your candy basket...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: H-hold on!
Summoning strength into your hands, you throw yourself in front of the candy basket, obstructing the little ghost's advance. You and the ghost are now locked in a stalemate...
Until the sound of a suona breaks it.

speaker: Dudu
content: Ahem, stop!
The white ghost's hands freeze mid-air as both you and the ghost look up at Dudu the Witch.

speaker: Dudu
content: Since ${PlayerName} is guarding the candy so valiantly, let's not snatch it away by force. How about we play a little game instead?

speaker: Dudu
content: If you win, not only will you not have to give any of your candy to my little pet, but I, the Great Witch, will bestow a reward upon you!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...So, when you talked about not letting it catch up with me, were you just trying to scare me?

speaker: Dudu
content: Oh, come on, it was to sharpen your vigilance!
Feeling weary, you take a seat beside the thorns to recuperate your strength while the ghost is distracted elsewhere.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The theme of this year's candy contest is witches and candy houses, huh...
The night is still young, yet the candy basket in your hand is empty—this won't do.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well... Since this is a magical world, can't I use some magic to save the situation from being a complete bust?
You start to concentrate, trying to devise a strategy.
After a brief moment, peculiar sounds emanate from the thorns, making you hold your breath.
A duck dressed in servant attire struggles out of the thorns and deftly tosses a handful of candy into your basket.
Having finished its task, the duck adjusts its robe, scans the surroundings, and then quietly retreats, vanishing into the thorns.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is this a magic I created out of my wish...?
The white ghost ceases its pursuit. Meanwhile, Dudu the Witch leaps down from the branch and walks towards you.

speaker: Dudu
content: Watching you run for so long makes me wanna join  the fun, too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You mean you want to collect candy with me?
Dudu the Witch bursts into hearty laughter, nearly dropping the suona in her hand.

speaker: Dudu
content: You expect a witch like me to do such thing?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then what you...

speaker: Dudu
content: Well... Now, it's my turn to play with you instead of my little pet!
MBCC Chief's Office
Your aching body wakes you up, and in your grogginess, you seem to really catch sight of a "candy house."

speaker: Dudu
content: Boss! You're awake!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Dudu?

speaker: Dudu
content: Well, I don't know what you dreamt about last night, but you kept kicking the blanket, so I had to stay up all night watching over you.

speaker: Dudu
content: But that's not important. Look over here, boss! Here!
Dudu, with dark circles under her eyes from another sleepless night, gestures towards something...
It's a candy house ornament on the table, decorated with colorful pieces of candy that appear dazzling under the glow of the vibrant lights.
Dudu claps her hands, a hint of pride in her tone.

speaker: Dudu
content: This is the candy house I promised to make for you! What do you think? Isn't it just so impressive and gorgeous?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eh...? Didn't you say you needed 720 pieces of candy to build a super big candy house?
Dudu appears momentarily perplexed, and you both exchange glances.
After a brief moment of silence, Dudu suddenly comprehends the situation and then appears slightly embarrassed, scratching her head.

speaker: Dudu
content: W-well... I must have made a mistake after all those revisions. The paper was a mess, and I might have wrote an extra zero...

speaker: Dudu
content: No wonder you said no! Hahaha...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Now, it all makes sense.
You gently pick up the candy house, glued together in a haphazard manner. Despite the rough craftsmanship, Dudu has meticulously carved out the doors, windows, and chimney with a small knife.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you, Dudu.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I love it.

speaker: Dudu
content: Boss, check this!
As Dudu opens the door to the candy house, the bell on it jingles.

speaker: Dudu
content: It's all made of candy! I wanted to make it feel like a real home...
You see a tiny Dudu witch in a hood, a little white ghost, and a little you inside the candy house.
...Isn't this the dream from last night?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you do all of this last night after I fell asleep? Right here?

speaker: Dudu
content: Yeah. What do you think? Aren't they so cute?

speaker: Dudu
content: These are characters from the picture book, like the witch and the little ghost... I designed the witch to resemble myself, hehe... Doesn't it look very like me?
...You must have glimpsed the little ornaments before fully falling asleep and dreamt about them... You smile, recalling the peculiar dream.
Dudu continues to talk excitedly.

speaker: Dudu
content: So, boss, whenever you open the door of the candy house and see us, it'll lift your spirits.

speaker: Dudu
content: Speaking of which, did you have a good dream last night?

options: I can't remember, but I'm still tired.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Uh... yes... and no...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Actually, I guess I did.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I thought you didn't have any candy. Where did you get these from?
Dudu seems to be dodging your gaze.

speaker: Dudu
content: Um... Well...
Suddenly, a commotion erupts from the end of the corridor, with one voice audibly gritting her teeth, closely followed by another voice.

speaker: Mess
content: Where is the candy I saved from last year...? Did any of you see my candy?

speaker: Etti
content: Wait, mine is gone, too!

speaker: Dudu
content: Ahaha, boss, I got a thing to do somewhere else, so I'll be off!

She scurries out of your room. You gaze down at the candy house, its colorful lights casting a soft glow on your face. The sweet scent wafts through the room, and despite the candy showing signs of melting, you feel reluctant to put it down.
Dudu doesn't go far before poking her head back in through the open door, beaming at you.

speaker: Dudu
content: By the way...!

speaker: Dudu
content: Boss, not just tonight, but I hope you have sweet dreams every night from now on!
RAWR—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Damn it!!
A terrifying behemoth opens its massive jaws, unleashing a deafening roar that threatens to shatter the entire cavern—it's the Dread Dragon, the final boss you must defeat.

Etti didn't even add a save function to this game!!! Good grief... After trudging through this endless dungeon and slaying monsters left and right, you finally reach the last stage. At this point, both you and the boss are running low on HP. You mustn't get defeated here!
Otherwise, the mountain of paperwork at the Bureau tomorrow will be just like this cursed dragon, ready to sink its claws into you when you least expect it—

speaker: Dread Dragon
content: Roarrrr—!
The cunning Dread Dragon lunges at you as you hesitate—

options: Swing your sword at the dragon

content: Before the Dread Dragon can strike with its claws, your sword slashes away its final ounce of HP. With one last furious roar, the massive beast comes crashing down.
Ding dong—
"Congratulations! You've defeated the epic final boss Dread Dragon and cleared the level."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Phew... finally cleared that level. All that monster-slaying and leveling up didn't go to waste.
"Rewards unlocked: [Dreadlord Etti's Commemorative Coin] [Dreadlord Etti's Crown] [Etti's Wishing Bottle]..."
[Wishing Bottle]... [Commemorative Coin]... You can't help but notice that these rewards are all just Etti merchandise. This boss certainly has a big ego...
What's that little paper head of yours thinking, Chief?
A familiar voice rings out as pink smoke fills the cave. Your vision becomes obscured, and all you can hear are the dragon cries echoing from within the narrow cavern.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Etti?
A bone-chilling roar pierces the air as a pink and black figure streaks toward you like lightning, giving you no time to dodge...

speaker: Etti
content: Ta-da!
The smoke instantly clears, revealing a triumphant Etti. Having shed her fearsome dragon form, she now bounces around cheerfully in her adorable chibi appearance.

speaker: Etti
content: Congratulations on clearing the level, Chief! Your rewards will be personally presented by none other than the Dread Dragon Etti herself. But... It seems one treasure has already found its way to your feet!
Etti giggles as you freeze in surprise. Looking down, you find a plump, pink little dragon coiled around your leg, staring into your puzzled eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What the...

speaker: Etti
content: This is my companion, Drakeling. By beating the game, you've proven yourself worthy of our dragon clan's friendship. From now on, this little one will also be your loyal companion! Now, Drakeling, be good to Chief!

speaker: Drakeling
content: Purr...

speaker: Etti
content: Now then, let's open your next grand prize! What could it be... An endless supply of gold coins? A legendary traveler's journal? Or perhaps a rare dragon bloodstone?
Etti savors the moment, visibly delighted as she draws out the suspense before finally lifting the treasure chest's lid. In the next instant, she freezes in place.

speaker: Etti
content: It's gone?! How could this...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Etti, look over there, isn't that...

Hearing your words, Etti spins around to look. Dashing away at full speed is a duckling in bizarre armor. Its fluffy bottom wiggles as it waddles off, somehow managing to carry a massive treasure chest brimming with gold coins!

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack, quack quack quack! 
(Oh no, I've been spotted!)

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack! 
(Quick, let's make a run for it with the treasures!)

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Uh... What were they quacking about?

speaker: Etti
content: Aaaah—Those little rascals, how dare they steal MY treasures! Chief, try to make Drakeling fly! We have to catch up to them! We must get back the treasure they stole!!!
You and Drakeling crash into an obstacle and tumble to the ground. Gold coins shower down like rain, while the ducks below scatter in all directions.

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack quack quack quack quack! 
(What's happening?!)

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack! 
(Ah! They've fallen down! Quick, let's run!)
The ducks are surprisingly quick on their feet, leaving you both far behind in mere moments before vanishing at the end of the path. Watching their retreating figures, Etti lets out a frustrated cry.

speaker: Etti
content: Ughh—There are so many obstacles, and those troublemakers are such a pain to deal with. Dammit!

speaker: Etti
content: Get back here, you naughty ducks! Just wait till I catch you! I'll teach y'all a lesson—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But... they've gotten so far ahead. How are we going to catch up? Should we try flying with Drakeling again?
A glimmer flashes in Etti's eyes. With an "aha," her dejected expression vanishes as a playful smirk spreads across her face.

speaker: Etti
content: Hehe, have you forgotten who created this game world? The great creator cannot allow such violations of the game rules to occur. So, I shall now unleash the most fundamental power of all—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wait, you're not gonna...?
Etti flashes a mysterious smile. Suddenly, a soft crackling sound echoes through the air. The world before you begins to rewind and overlap at dizzying speed.
When you open your eyes, you find yourself back at the entrance of the cave where the treasures were first stolen.
And of course, the ducks who had made their daring escape not long ago are back as well, quacking in the confused chaos.

speaker: Ducks
content:
Quack quack quack quack quack quack quack quack! 
(What in the world just happened?!)

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The most fundamental power... Hey, if you can reset the game, why not reset it to before the ducks stole anything? You just wanted to play the chase game, didn't you, Etti...
Etti completely ignores your comment and points outside the cave with a grin. There, the ducks huddle together with the treasure chests, chattering helplessly in confusion.

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack quack quack quack? 
(Is this the dragon's cave?)

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack! 
(What's happening? Why are we back here again?!)

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack quack quack—
(Never mind, let's just run with the chests! We can't run into that dragon again—)

speaker: Etti
content: Hehehe—Tremble, you miscreants! The almighty Etti and the great Dragon Knight ${PlayerName} shall bring you to justice. Surrender now!
Etti's paper avatar thrusts out her tiny but determined hands.

speaker: Etti
content: Now's our chance! One more time—we won't let them escape this time!!!!!
BOOM—The bomb hits the last fleeing duck carrying a treasure chest. You've successfully recovered all the stolen treasures.

speaker: Duck
content:
Quack quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack... 
(Sob... We'll never steal again! We'll return all the treasures, please spare us...)
Though you can't understand what they're saying, the pleading looks in their tearful little eyes speak volumes. You can't help but pity them.

speaker: Etti
content: Hmph, I haven't even punished you for upsetting the balance of my game world yet... But I've had my fun, so I suppose I can let you off for now—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But why did they steal the treasures in the first place?
As you ponder this question, a mob of townspeople suddenly rush out with pots and pans. You and Etti are caught off guard, and before you can react, they form a protective circle around the ducks.

speaker: Townsperson A
content: Who do you think you are?! Leave them alone!

speaker: Townsperson B
content: So that's why our poor ducks kept coming home crying—it was you! You monsters, I'm reporting you to the authorities!
You find yourselves completely surrounded by the seething crowd. The townspeople are furious, determined to seek justice for their beloved ducks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: (Whispers) What do we do now?

speaker: Etti
content: (Whispers) I didn't expect giving the NPCs more behavioral autonomy would backfire like this... Hmm, let me think...
Etti clears her throat.

speaker: Etti
content: Ahem! These ducks snuck into my cave and stole my treasures. I'm simply here to take back what's mine. Are you really going to harbor thieves?
A brief silence falls over the crowd. Then, they begin to whisper to each other.

speaker: Townsperson A
content: Stealing treasures... Could they be...

speaker: Etti
content: What?

speaker: Townsperson B
content: A few days ago, we saw these poor ducks huddling around a few matches for warmth on the street. They were nearly freezing to death, so we took them in. Though we couldn't understand their language, they showed real intelligence—they've been helping us with our work, as if trying to repay our kindness.

speaker: Townsperson B
content: In years past when harvests were good, our village would gather as families around the hearth for a feast, filling children's stockings with sweets and presents. But this year... everyone is sick with worry. We can barely afford enough food, let alone gifts for the children.

speaker: Townsperson B
content: They must have understood what was happening. When they disappeared for days, we thought they'd been kidnapped by criminals... But now I get it—they were trying to repay our kindness by stealing the dragon's treasures from the mountain.

You watch as the townspeople cradle the sniffing ducks in their arms. You can't help but chuckle at their bruised, pitiful state. But... after hearing their story, you find yourself not only reluctant to take back the treasures, but actually wanting to help both the poor ducks and the townspeople.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: (Whispers) Let them keep the treasures. I know they're just characters in your game, but I still want them and the ducks to have a warm and happy holiday together. Can you use [Etti's Wish Bottle]—the reward for clearing the level—to grant this wish for me, Etti?
Etti glances at you with a resigned smile.

speaker: Etti
content: What kind of evil overlord do you take me for? Of course I'll grant such a simple wish...
She extends her hand, and countless gold coins gather at her command. Their golden radiance bathes the shivering villagers in the cold night with warm light.

speaker: Etti
content: After all, everyone here is part of my favorite game world!

As her words fade, dusk settles and streetlights flicker to life. Snowflakes begin to fall across the town as empty dinner tables fill with steaming dishes. The hearth fires burn bright and warm as the townspeople join hands with the ducks to welcome an evening of joy with family and friends.

From that day forth, a legend spread through the town: when night falls on that special evening, a miraculous mage will descend from heaven—adorned with dragon horns and a beautiful gown. Together with a dragon rider, they scatter coins of good fortune over every home, blessing all with happiness.
One night in the Bureau's corridors, MBCC
After a long day, you walk down the hallway back to your office. You let out a long sigh as you flip through a new schedule you just received.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Great, another week without weekends. Why do these tedious meetings always have to be scheduled during off hours...

Suddenly, a loud crash echoes from the end of the corridor, and the lighting system instantly fails. Emergency red lights on the walls flash incessantly, and the Bureau's alarm system immediately blares to life.

speaker: Announcement
content: Warning! Warning! Attack from an abnormal source detected in the Bureau's underground area! Relevant department personnel, proceed to the area immediately!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well... here we go again...
Just then, a familiar figure grows larger in your field of vision, stumbling and panicking as they frantically rush toward you.

speaker: EMP
content: Chief! Help me, something terrible has happened!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What did you do this time?

speaker: EMP
content: No, no! This time it really isn't my fault! Eek—!
Before the words leave her lips, an electric arrow grazes over both your heads and strikes the flashing warning light with pinpoint accuracy.
The attacker's burly, rotund silhouette emerges from the darkness, gradually approaching you. In the chaos, you notice that it just used EMP's ability.

speaker: Sovereign Duck
content: Quack quack quack quack, quack, quack quack quack quack... (The one-year term is up... I am no longer who I once was...)

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What happened?

speaker: EMP
content: I-I-I don't know either! I just saw the ducks looking a bit down after finishing their work in the Depot, so I shared a novel I'd just bought with them. I had no idea they'd turn out like this after reading it!

speaker: EMP
content: It even copied my Syndicate the Grim Reaper ultimate technique... Chief, you don't think that novel could actually be some kind of martial arts manual, do you? I didn't even have the chance to read it myself!

speaker: Sovereign Duck
content: Quack! Quack quack quack quack! (Today! I will reclaim everything that belongs to me!)

Strange cards flutter around the duck, and with each one it throws, it unleashes a Sinner's ability—blazing flames, ice crystals, butterflies, and mushrooms appearing one after another in endless succession.
The confrontation reaches a temporary stalemate. If the duck gains the upper hand before reinforcements arrive, the Bureau's operations could be disrupted for days to come.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The duck clearly came prepared. The two of us probably can't hold it off!

speaker: EMP
content: Huh? Really? I feel like I can still give it a little more effort...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll hold it off by myself. EMP, you go find Nightingale first. Once we've restricted its range of movement, we can take our time and carefully plan our counterattack.

speaker: EMP
content: What are you talking about, Chief! I won't just ditch you like that. I can still fight. If you still insist on making me leave...

Her voice sounds like it's coming from somewhere far behind you. When you look back, EMP, who was fighting alongside you just moments ago, has already sprinted dozens of meters away without looking back.

speaker: EMP
content: I'm going, Chief! Just hang in there—I'll bring help and come back for you!

After sending EMP away, you turn to face Sovereign Duck once more. Accompanied by the sounds of cards brushing against each other, it pulls out another thick stack of cards and flashes you a crooked smile.

speaker: Sovereign Duck
