content: It's... it's getting closer again... ain't it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry. We're here with you.
You move closer and give the boy's hair an affectionate ruffle before passing him the wooden plank once more. Your words seem to lift his spirits. He gives a resolute nod and turns back to his task.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Good thing they showed up to help on their own. Those clouds are moving fast... Looks like it won't be long before the whole town's swallowed up.

speaker: Yao
content: Yes. That's why I couldn't bring myself to send them away.

speaker: Yao
content: After all... if they had no will to act, no fire of their own, only empty prayers...
Yao gestures toward the little bird that keeps bouncing about at the residents' side.

The creature bears little resemblance to the round, downy ball it once was. Now it perches steady on three legs, its wings flared open to reveal sharply defined feathers, each one stretching nearly the length of her forearm.

speaker: Yao
content: Look. Its wings have grown strong, full and ready. It's time...

speaker: Yao
content: ...that it learns to spread its wings and fly.

speaker: Boy
content: Left! Little more left! Ah, too far! Back right a bit!
The final rooftop ornament rises slowly to the tower's peak. Once it rests where it belongs, the long labor reaches its end.
You and Yao leave the boy to guide the placement of that last piece. Following his steady direction, the rooftop beast sinks at last into its rightful seat.

speaker: Boy
content: Perfect! It's perfect! Goddess! Quick, you gotta get up your tower and see for yourself!
Rumble!!!
Yet just as the tower nears its final form, the dark clouds press inward—hunters ringing their quarry—and threaten to swallow the town whole.
Yao spares no breath to answer the boy's invitation. Side by side with you, she herds the townsfolk back toward the safety of their doors.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Listen, stay inside your homes. Don't leave until we say so, got it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And get word to anyone keeping watch on the mountain. Tell them to come down now. Head home if they can make it; if not, find somewhere safe and hunker down.
Flustered and unsure, the boy lingers where he stands. When he finally moves to go, he discovers his fingers have been clutching the hem of Yao's robe all along, refusing to release their grip.

speaker: Yao
content: Don't be afraid. Trust in us. We promised we would keep you safe.

speaker: Yao
content: And besides... this tower does not belong to me alone.
Yao gently eases the boy's grip free from her robe and taps the back of his hand.

speaker: Yao
content: It belongs to all of us. It's... our tower.
A dense pall of storm clouds smothers the sky, erasing all distinction between night and day. Behind that churning veil, crimson lightning writhes and flickers, poised to lash down at any breath.
Gale-force winds tear around you as you and Yao stand upon the crown of the newly finished tower, your gazes locked on the roiling heavens.
The townsfolk rest safe behind shuttered doors. You have sent word to the watchers on the mountain. One task alone remains: to break this calamity and clear the path home for every waiting family.
Rumble!!!
As if in direct reply to your determination, crimson bolts begin to pour from the clouds. They shatter trees and set them ablaze with fire. They scar the earth with blackened, smoking wounds.
Then a denser barrage comes for you—lightning heavy with Mania, slashing past and caging you in a prison of searing light.

speaker: Yao
content: Chief... please lend us your strength!
Yao steps forward without flinching, cutting through the gale and the storm of lightning.
Her hand lifts. From her fingertips, golden light streams forth and gathers, forming a blazing orb of radiance.
The dark shies back from that glow, seizing still for a single heartbeat. Then, in the next breath, a thicker fury of lightning erupts on every side.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We're not backing down. No matter what!
...Next time, you can just give me the gift directly.
From within that dawn-like fire, a pair of vast wings unfurls with a thunderous rush! They row slowly through the tempest, and the great sweep of air drives back the lightning on all sides.

A cry, pure and clarion, pierces the firmament. Out of the radiance steps a great bird of blazing crimson-orange, launching itself at the black vault of heaven—sunlight made flesh, tearing through the shadow.
And in its wake, an endless stream of colorful ribbons follows, twisting and spiraling into the sky.

speaker: Yao
content: Go now! Set the sky ablaze with light!

speaker: Sun Crow
content: Skreeee!

Colorful ribbons swirl in a great gyre around the Sun Crow, spiraling upward at its side. Through the darkness, the prayers woven into those ribbons echo and surge with tremendous strength, carried by Yao's power.
The storm clouds stall in their advance, and the crimson lightning flickers and wanes, as though it has misjudged the depth of human resolve and now shrinks before the weight of their prayers.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now!

speaker: Yao
content: Drive them back!
Yao channels all her power and joins in perfect resonance with the Sun Crow. The great bird folds its wings in, slow and deliberate, then flings them wide once more.
From its heart, a wave of crimson-orange light blooms outward, hurling the black clouds and red lightning back in surge after surge until they dissolve into nothing.
Above you, unveiled at last, spreads the true night sky, alive with endless stars.
Time holds its breath. Nothing moves but the high, thin ring in your ears, repeating its silent assurance that all of this has truly come to pass.

speaker: Child
content: Mom! Dad! You... you came back!!
A bright, clear child's voice cuts through the stillness of that breath-held moment. The people stir and awaken from their daze. The Sun Crow Goddess has once more stood between them and ruin.

speaker: Townsfolk
content: Thank you! Thank you, Sun Crow Goddess!

speaker: Townsfolk
content: Goddess above, bless you! My boy... my boy's home safe!

speaker: Townsfolk
content: I finished my grasshopper... and my brother came back as he promised! This year... this year we're really all together!
One candle winks into being, then a lantern glows. The town that only heartbeats ago lies drowned in black now blooms with countless points of light.
People spill into the streets, sharing blessings and rejoicing in a New Year found safe and together.
High atop the tower, gazing down upon the sea of lights, Yao releases a shaky breath and sways backward, her strength spent. You rush forward and catch her before she falls.

speaker: Yao
content: It's finished... The little bird's wish... all their wishes... they came true.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've worked hard. You did a great job.

speaker: Yao
content: I... I truly didn't do much at all.
Yao opens her hand, and a few soft orange light orbs drift up from her palm like tiny bubbles. Round and plump, they bear an unmistakable resemblance to a certain chubby little bird.

speaker: Yao
content: The people... they stood guard at the mountain passes. Held back Mania with their own hands. And those who stayed behind... they offered up everything in their hearts.

speaker: Yao
content: This peace... this warmth... they earned it themselves. Every bit of it.
Yao sweeps her hand through the air, and the little orbs drift swiftly skyward. With a crisp, sharp pop, they shatter into dazzling sprays of fireworks.

speaker: Yao
content: May...
May every storm soften to sweet rain, and may peace find you in every quiet moment.
May... whether within this tale or beyond its pages, joy and abundance follow you, year after year.

speaker: Yugu
content: "And thus... the Sun Crow Goddess vanished once more from mortal sight, never again to tread upon this earth."

speaker: Yugu
content: "Yet within the hearts of the people, her memory burned ever bright. Reverence and prayer endure, undimmed by the passing years. For they hold this truth close: so long as faith remains, the world shall know peace eternal."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Okay, okay, you can stop now. Keep this up, and you're gonna roast the whole Bureau.
Yugu leafs lazily through the pages, reading aloud the final ending in her own unhurried rhythm. Beside her, Yao shifts and fidgets without disguise, her ears blazing a vivid red.

speaker: Yao
content: ...Just knowing they're safe. That they still believe... that is more than enough.
Yao rises and inclines herself in a deep, grateful bow to Yugu, then makes her way toward the cafeteria.
Evening settles in again, and clusters of people gather over their dinners, their talk already drifting toward the coming holiday.
The little bird has returned to its source, and all the prayers laid upon it fold back into one.
Gazing out at the people, Yao asks you quietly.

speaker: Yao
content: Their wishes will come true, won't they?

speaker: Yao
content: Whether it's reunion they long for... or freedom.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah. Prayers have power, no question. But what really matters is that they believe they have the strength to make it happen themselves.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Just as you believe they'll find happiness, they believe it too... I'm sure of it.

speaker: Black Screen
content: So believe. Believe that in the year to come, happiness will find you, joy will stay with you, and every worry that weighs on you now will let you go.
Bureau Corridor

A hush finally settles over the Bureau's corridor after a long day of activity. As your work is wrapping up, you exhale the day's tension and set your sights on the Recreation Area for some well-earned rest.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Finally managed to carve out a few days off. Now, how to spend them... Something low-key? A nature escape? Honestly, just crashing at home for three days straight sounds like a solid recharge plan. I'm definitely keeping that on the table.
At that moment, a soft voice curls around the corner at the corridor's end, almost as if it has heard your unspoken thoughts and is answering back.

Spring is in full bloom. Why not let your heart take a little trip? Good evening, dear listeners, and welcome to your personal late-night sanctuary. With the holidays upon us, have you made any travel plans yet?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hm?

speaker: Eleven
content: Perhaps a quiet stroll through the city streets, letting the rhythm of everyday life wash over you. Or a walk through the hills, where you can breathe in the scent of fresh earth and open air. Or maybe just nestling in at home with your loved ones. All of them are beautiful ways to slow down and savor a rare, unhurried moment.

speaker: Eleven
content: Our new feature, "Come Away With Me," has been blessed with so many heartfelt letters from devoted listeners. You've shared such thoughtful tips and hidden gems with us. Today, I'd love to introduce a nature spot that truly deserves a place on your list.

speaker: Eleven
content: This little treasure sits just on the city's edge. It's not only a breathtaking garden in its own right, but also the real-life inspiration behind The Enchanted Garden, the illustrated fairy tale book that's taken Eastside by storm.

speaker: Eleven
content: I'm sure many of you have already read the book. Whether you fell in love with the charming little animals, the winding paths, the wildflowers, or those shafts of light dancing through the leaves, you'll find every last detail waiting for you here, alive and real.

speaker: Eleven
content: So... that's the end of it. What do you all think?
Eleven lowers the script with a touch of reluctance, her read-through complete, and turns her gaze to the little ones she's roped in as test listeners for her new feature.

speaker: EMP
content: That was sooo good! Bravo!!!

speaker: Hella
content: Whoa! Eleven, you sound so pretty and, like, super fancy! Hey, can you write my essay for tomorrow's exam? If I have to copy off EMP, I'm totally screwed...

speaker: Hecate
content: Your voice is gentle. It pulls you in... I think your listeners will really like it.

speaker: Hypatia
content: It was lovely. Though... does DisCity actually have a place like that? Since I arrived, I've only ever seen the urban landscape. Nothing quite like what you described.

speaker: EMP
content: Oh, you asked the right person! This picture book went crazy viral online, and the location totally blew up with it! So many people have already been there. Sooo... what if we sneak out tomorrow and go check it out ourselves?

speaker: Hecate
content: We can't... There's an exam at the Syndicate Academy tomorrow, and I need to make sure Hella studies. If she fails again, they'll call Chief in. We shouldn't make more trouble for Chief.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh, it's just a dumb exam! I get the same grade no matter what anyway! You know who I am? I'm the mighty Hella! You really think some stupid test can hold me down? I'm skipping it, end of sto—OW!

Her grand declaration barely out of her mouth, a flick lands squarely on her forehead. Hella winces from the sting and looks up, only to find the culprit—you—staring back at her with a perfectly blank expression.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Slacking off on your studies and now you want to skip exams too?

speaker: Hella
content: I-I just wanna go out and do something fun, okay?! The weather's so nice outside. Of course I wanna go see it!
At the sight of the group tumbling into a mess of laughter, a giggle escapes Hypa despite herself, and she glances over at Eleven.

speaker: Hypatia
content: And what about you? If you really had the chance, would you want to go see it?

speaker: Eleven
content: ...I would. Talking about these places on air, sharing them with everyone, but never having seen them with my own eyes... I always worry the feeling behind the words isn't quite real.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If it bothers you that much, why not go see it for yourself?
Everyone turns to look at you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come on. Eleven, Hypa, you too. Let me show you what DisCity looks like this time of year.

speaker: Hella
content: Then... I'm coming too!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't you have an exam tomorrow? What's this, O mighty Lady Hella, planning to bring home another big fat zero?
Hella puffs up her cheeks, brimming with sulky displeasure.

speaker: Hella
content: You big dummy! Won't even let me have one day off for a trip. You're no fun at all!
You raise an eyebrow at her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Oh, I was going to say... if you guys pass tomorrow, I'd bring you along as a reward. But since I'm such a big no-fun dummy, never mind then...

speaker: Hella
content: Huh—wha—wait!! What did you just say?! Hold on, hold on, hold on—don't walk away! You mean it?! Hey! A grown-up can't just say something and take it back—!
But... the renowned garden that greets you upon arrival is a far cry from anything you had pictured.

Gone is the jewel-bright lake from the fairy tale book. In its place sprawls a bog of blackened water, its stench thick and clinging as its viscous pollution oozes into every corner of the forest clearing.
Plants lie dead in wide, rotting patches; animals have fled in droves... You meet the eyes of the two Sinners, each face mirroring the same grim realization: Mania.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What on earth happened here?

speaker: Eleven
content: I remember... some of the listener letters mentioned that The Enchanted Garden used to have a very special quality to it. Quiet, and warm. People really loved that feeling.

speaker: Eleven
content: But recently, some listeners have been saying the picture book has changed. The art has grown rough, and the stories feel hollow... Now it all makes sense. The scenery here was being corrupted all along.

speaker: Eleven
content: No wonder the listeners were in such low spirits those days. They must have been affected by Mania as well. But I... I didn't know how to comfort them back then.
Eleven lets out a sigh. Hypatia, however, wears a look of earnest contemplation, as if something in Eleven's words has sparked a flicker of inspiration.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Perhaps... this is connected to the garden's current state. It could be that people's negative emotions were projected outward, triggering a Mania overflow. One that not only corrupted the picture book, but bled further into reality.
You're still mulling over her analysis when a startled cry from Hypatia breaks the silence.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Chief, look! Over there—

You follow her gaze. The undergrowth is being steadily corroded by waves of Mania corruption surging forth, and the source spewing all that contamination outward is a fairy-tale picture book, radiating an eerie, unsettling aura.
Quack—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What is that?!

Was that... a duck quacking? You eye the book with suspicion. Just as you crouch down to examine it more closely, a pink ball comes rocketing out from its pages at tremendous speed and hits you square in the forehead.
The world spins wildly, and then everything goes dark.
As consciousness slowly seeps back, the crisp sound of quacking reaches your ears. A jolt runs through you. You can actually understand what the duck is saying?
...Quack... Quack quack quack... (Oh no, did I just knock all three of them out?)
This has to be a dream... how else could I understand a duck? You close your eyes and try to slip back into the dream.
Quack quack quack quack... Quack quack quack... (Why won't they wake up... Maybe I should try bonking them again...)
Before the duckling can take another shot at your forehead, you struggle to your feet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay. It's okay. I'm perfectly capable of waking up on my own, thank you.
You brush the dust from your clothes, rise to your feet, and take in your surroundings. The world has transformed into the pages of a living picture book.

Overhead stretches a sky of soft blue drawing paper, dotted with cotton-ball clouds. The trees are lush with the saturated greens of watercolor brushstrokes, and the windmills carry the folded creases of origami... but at your feet, the flowers lie wilted and shriveled, a stark note of decay in an otherwise painted paradise.

Before you stands, prim and proper, a... duck fairy? Its wings flutter as it quacks at you with great insistence. Your companions groan back to consciousness beside you, and before long, the three of you are locked in a bewildered staring contest with a very determined duck.

speaker: Eleven
content: Where are we? Why do we look like cartoon characters? And this little duck...

speaker: Hypatia
content: Our whole style has changed. We look just like cartoon characters from a book... Could it be that we've fallen into that corrupted picture book?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Was it this duck's doing?
Realizing it's under suspicion, the duck hurriedly lets out a flurry of quacks to proclaim its innocence.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Easy now. I don't think it means any harm. It's just talking a mile a minute. We can barely catch a word... Slow down a little. Something about... the garden? And... picture book?
Thrilled that you can actually understand it, the duck grows even more excited. It strains to drag out a hefty book and, using its flat little bill, flips it open before you page by page.

<i><b>Once upon a time, there was a picture book called The Enchanted Garden. Every child who read it and gazed upon its illustrations couldn't help but say: "I wish I could play in that garden someday!" Quack!

<i><b>And from those very wishes, quack—the little duck fairy was born. The more kindhearted wishes people made, the stronger its magic grew. It watched over the world inside the book, and it watched over the real garden too, helping every living thing bloom brighter and more beautiful. Quack!

<i><b>But one day, a book was tainted by something called Mania. The corruption seeped slowly into the fairy tale world. Plants withered and died in great numbers, and worst of all, quack... the little duck fairy's magic began to fade, little by little.

<i><b>It could no longer nurture the flowers, nor bring forth the spring. The garden would never again be what it once was, with every bloom unfurled in full splendor. The readers who came found only disappointment, and little by little, the Mania, driven by that disappointment and malice, fed on their despair and grew ever stronger. Quack...

<i><b>If the Mania at the heart of the fairy tale world cannot be purged, the corruption will spill over and destroy the garden in reality as well. And people may... lose the garden's spring forever. Quack.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So that's why you knocked us into the book? You want us to help you purge the corruption from the fairy tale world?
The duck fairy bobs its head in an eager flurry of nods, its beady little eyes shimmering with a watery, pleading light as they meet yours.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Alright. For the sake of the real world, I'll do everything I can to help you purge the Mania from this storybook.

speaker: Duck Fairy
content: Quack! (Thank you!!!)

speaker: Duck Fairy
content: Quack quack, quack quack quack... Quack quack quack!!! (The corruption is gone, the flowers are blooming... our fairy tale book is back to the way it was!!! It's like magic!)
The little duck fairy raises a wand wrapped by fresh flowers, beats its wings, and lifts into the air. With a gentle wave of the wand, you sense something unusual gathering in the air around it.

speaker: Duck Fairy
content: Quack quack, quack, quack quack, quack quack quack! (Thank you, humans. And now, it's time to show you what the duck fairy's magic can do!)

With a light tap against the paper-like sky, the duck fairy traces a vast magic circle out of thin air. A warm radiance washes over you and your companions, and your consciousness begins to blur at the edges.
You know it's time to say goodbye.
Your consciousness slowly returns. The whispers of grass and trees ride in on the breeze, mingling with the gentle sway of wind chimes and the light, airy calls of birds.

Sunlight spills across the lake, setting the water aglitter. Eleven stretches lazily, her eyes still closed, then she opens them, and the sight before her stops her short. Taken aback, she raises a hand to her lips.

speaker: Eleven
content: ...It's breathtaking. Like some kind of spring magic.
Eleven gazes out at the breathtaking lake and the spring scenery, and something seems to stir in her memory.

speaker: Eleven
content: I must have dozed off just now, and I had the most wonderful dream... a dream about magic.

speaker: Eleven
content: You were there, and so was little Hypa. We went to a fairy tale world together and helped the people there save the flowers, bring back the spring... The spring there looked just like this.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What a coincidence... sounds like we had the same dream. Did you have a good time there?

speaker: Eleven
content: Very much so. Making flowers bloom with your own hands... it felt just like having magic.
You can't help but smile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's because you do have magic. You've always had it.

speaker: Eleven
content: Me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You do. If you share the story of how this garden was brought back to life with your listeners, who knows? It just might work a little magic of its own and lift their spirits.
Eleven's eyes go wide.

speaker: Eleven
content: I see... The listeners would be overjoyed to hear this. I'm sure it'll make their hard-earned holiday all the brighter. Right, I'll add this part to the script at once.
Perhaps it's the magic at work. Eleven, who has been walking around with a furrowed brow these past few days, now has a smile softening her features. Just then, you hear Hypatia's voice.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Has a certain Chief perhaps forgotten? There's still a whole group of people waiting on that magic of yours.
You turn around to find Hypatia holding up her terminal toward you. On the other end of the call, a noisy little mouse with purple fur is squeaking and bouncing about as if the world were on fire.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! Chief, they just handed back the exam papers, and I passed! I'm already here, Chief, so where are you guys? Hypa, come get me! Hypa—

Her bubbly voice fills the air, and you find yourself meeting Hypatia's gaze. A smile passes between you, and in each other's eyes you find the same quiet reassurance: if the one on the other end of that call is happy, then everything you did today was worth it.
You give a soft cough to clear your throat.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You might not believe this, but I found magic here...

speaker: Hella
content: What? ...Magic?
You shoot Hypa a meaningful look, then deliberately keep Hella in suspense with a teasing pause.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As for what kind of magic, well... you'll just have to come see for yourself.

speaker: Hella
content: What the heck?! You totally dodged my question! You're the worst! Hypa, you too! Ugh, I'm done with you both... Just you wait, I'm on my way!
Hella's indignant voice crackles through the call, and you and Hypatia can't help but burst into laughter.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Eleven really got it right with that line... "Spring is in full bloom. Why not let your heart take a little trip?" Walking quietly by the water here... it feels like something inside you has been washed clean.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Come on, let's go get her! The flowers are in full bloom. Piling into the car with friends for a spring outing is something I've always wanted to try.
Sunlight ripples across your shoulders like liquid gold, and a breeze stirs the storybook left beside the bench.
With a soft, papery sigh, its fragile pages flutter open and come to rest at the very end, where the storybook's words offered to spring await.
<i><b>Spring returns to the land. The withered fields grow green again, blossoms push through the soil, and hope takes root in every heart. They all hold this truth close: spring will always come.
<i><b>And everything they share in the season of spring... that, they call magic.
After frantically opening your eyes, a white desert comes into focus. You are squeezed and pushed forth by the surging crowd.
Yet... no footprints are left behind you.
In the blink of an eye, the massive sandstorm blanketed the sky with an ear-splitting roar, slamming into you from all sides.
One by one, countless figures are disintegrated into tiny specks of dust across the infinite desert. Only one figure stands firm in the midst of the storm, extending a helping hand towards you.
Echoes from the abyss keep murmuring in your ears...

speaker: Echo in Dream
content: Come, come to where I am...

speaker: Echo in Dream
content: This... is where you truly belong...

You jolt awake from the sandstorm, greeted by the familiar ceiling of your sleeping quarters. Lately you've been dreaming the same eerie scenes over and over again. You've lost track of how many times these dreams have recurred.

The tasks you have at hand are numerous but trivial in nature. There hasn't been any major trouble from the Sinners in the Bureau, and your health report shows that all is well. Thus, there can only be one reason for this abnormal situation...
You look at the surveillance feed from the lab.
A dull, grayish-white crystal sits inside a sealed chamber. The lasers scan it repeatedly, but the values shown by the device remain flat... It is clear that it has long lost its reactivity.
This is the "special crystal" that the FAC sent over for analysis not long ago, the Ash Crystal, which also marks the beginning of your strange dreams.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're awake. Chief Guillotin of the <color=#fb9259>Outland Affairs Bureau</color> is requesting internal communications access.

speaker: Nightingale
content: He wants to discuss the "special crystal" with you. He also has a cooperation proposal.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Hello, MBCC Chief. I'm Guillotin, Chief of Outland Affairs Bureau.

The Outland Affairs Bureau, officially the <color=#fb9259>DisCity Outland Affairs Management Bureau</color>, is responsible for coordinating and managing matters pertaining to the city's external relations, such as trade, diplomacy, and immigration.

speaker: Guillotin
content: I hear that the analysis assigned to your office has not progressed at all. I am very concerned that this will affect our next collaboration... A very important one.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Do you remember the <color=#fb9259>WhiteSands Crisis Cooperation Proposal</color> submitted by the Outland Affairs Bureau? FAC has approved it and sent the application to the 9th Agency with the decision that MBCC would join alongside in battle.

speaker: Chief
content: I certainly remember. However, the FAC's instructions were to prioritize the analysis of the Ash Crystal.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Hmph. It is precisely because nothing came of your analysis, and we can only give you a new combat mission!

speaker: Guillotin
content: As you know, we now hold the only strategic resource that can withstand the Apocalypse—Hypercubes. Thus, we have repeatedly surmounted the barriers of WhiteSands navigation and pilotage.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Thanks to years of endless toil by the Outland Affairs Bureau, DisCity has been able to build a huge trade network in WhiteSands, negotiate with the Outlands by using Hypercubes as leverage, and become the center of the world and the beacon of human renaissance.

speaker: Guillotin
content: But recently, a horde of bandits appeared in WhiteSands and tried to rob our resources!
Raising his plump chin, the Outland Affairs Chief fishes out a letter with a grunt.
Nightingale opens the mail, revealing a panoramic map of WhiteSands.
The infinite white desert is almost identical to the pure white realm of your dreams.

After the Perishing Star struck, the Nightfall Apocalypse swept across the world. A special white desert emerged from the heart of the desert as a result, gradually radiating and expanding outward. By now, the entire desert surrounding DisCity has transformed into a sea of white sand.

The heart of WhiteSands has long been ravaged by a mega-sandstorm known as the Tide of Ashes, which hinders DisCity from continuing to expand its transport routes and brings about a plethora of deadly secondary disasters.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Three months ago, WhiteSands' sandstorm and secondary disasters suddenly became active. The gun-toting desert bandits seized the opportunity to repeatedly raid our trade routes and rob our Hypercubes.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It was not until a week ago that these anomalies caught the attention of the FAC, who then allocated manpower for an emergency clean-up mission. During the battle, the FAC witnessed a desert bandit wielding an unknown crystal, from which he obtained some kind of mysterious power similar to Sinners. We believe this is why the bandits acted as though they were invincible.

speaker: Nightingale
content: After comparing residual energy waveforms, the unidentified crystal matched the Ash Crystal that EDGE obtained from the Tide of Ashes many years ago.

speaker: Chief
content: Yes. And that's why they gave us the crystal to analyze.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Yet your analysis has produced nothing so far.

speaker: Choice
options: Would you like to give it a try?

speaker: Chief
content: In that case, esteemed Outland Affairs Bureau Chief, would you like to try analyzing it yourself?

speaker: Chief
content: Under your magnanimous leadership, perhaps it will spring to life and share with you its story.

speaker: Guillotin
content: You...!
You ignore Guillotin's outburst and continue to read the letter with Nightingale.

speaker: Nightingale
content: This week, the FAC provided even more personnel to support the Outland Affairs Bureau, stretching its manpower capacity to the limit. Thus, it no longer has sufficient manpower to investigate the relationship between the desert bandits and the crystals in WhiteSands.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Therefore, we need the MBCC to discreetly probe the source of the desert bandits' power. If it's indeed related to Sinners, arrest them immediately! This shall be a critical battle!

speaker: Guillotin
content: Those greedy, despicable Outlanders will use all sorts of dirty tricks to rob our Hypercubes! Do you know how many vital trade routes they've sabotaged? How much business, resources and money we've lost?
Guillotin is hysterical with anger on the other end of the comms, grinding his teeth ferociously as he speaks.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Anyway, that's the situation! I'm only giving you these confidential clues because the FAC repeatedly requested for the Outland Affairs Bureau to share intelligence... Here is a record of the desert bandits' actions in the past three months. Use it well.
The desert bandits have been rampant for nearly three months, and still have not been brought under control. They hid their activity so well that even the FAC learned about it only a week ago.

It seems that Chief Guillotin didn't take the desert bandits seriously at first. Only when the official trading posts and sandstorm shelters were sacked, and the Hypercubes sustaining transport were stolen, did he realize the severity of the matter and began to seek help left and right.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Be careful, Chief ${PlayerName}. You are now dabbling with DisCity's lifeline. Under normal circumstances, you wouldn't have this privilege.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Don't try anything funny and don't let us down, MBCC Chief.
Guillotin stops here and hangs up the comms.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, this may not be the most pleasant mission, but the FAC really has no time to wait for the sample's analysis results. They want you to leave right away.

You stare at the panoramic map. The recurring dream and the voice calling out to you surface in your mind once more. This operation... is not just any mission. Perhaps... you can also discover the truth behind the dream.

<color=#fb9259>DisCity's Port 12</color> is not the city's main port, but the trade volume is still impressive. In the early morning, hundreds of sand ships of all shapes and sizes are moored at the maintenance dock. They shall travel through the Apocalypse, delivering cargo and linking the scattered remains of civilization to the new beacon of humanity.
However, even though the shipping containers pile as high as a grand fortress, this magnificent port is humbled by the vast WhiteSands before it.

speaker: Hella
content: Ptui ptui! After standing here for just two minutes, the amount of sand in my mouth has already outnumbered every grain of rice I ever ate!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey Chief, lend me a hiding spot! My face is going to become weathered like sandpaper in this climate.

Even though you are wearing outfits specially designed for WhiteSands, you still struggle to withstand the power of the sandstorm. The port is still at least a few kilometers away from the sandstorm, yet the ground is already shaking from its mighty roar.
Sand ships must have sufficient weight and technical support, or else they would disintegrate into sand like the boulders by the edge of the storm.
Here and now, the glorious vessels mooring at the port suddenly appear frail and piteous before the storm.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is the huge sandstorm that Nightingale spoke of... the <color=#fb9259>Tide of Ashes</color>.

speaker: Hella
content: They call it a special mission, but no one's here to greet us! Does that old fart from the Outland Affairs Bureau want us to dive into WhiteSands wrapped in cloaks?

According to the mission guidelines, you are to escort the Ash Crystal to Port 12 and wait for the greeting party there. Yet now, one can only imagine what kind of "greeting party" will be strong enough to withstand such a fearsome sandstorm.
The sandstorm from your dreams is surfacing before your eyes. Perhaps instead of the desert bandits, WhiteSands is your greatest enemy, hiding the biggest and darkest secrets.
O guest from a land far, far away... a look of bewilderment lingers on your face. Would you like some help?
An ethereal voice echoes from behind you. You turn around to see a woman donning exotic garb standing behind you... You don't know how long she has been there.

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: Yes, you are a guest to WhiteSands. You have your reasons for going there, and answers you wish to seek.

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: However, you don't know where to begin. After all, you have found neither a way to enter, nor anyone to guide you.

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: Hehe... a guest of WhiteSands is a guest of mine. I can guide you along the path ahead and answer your innermost questions.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I forgot to introduce myself. I am Stargazer of WhiteSands. Would you like a prediction from me? Or perhaps...
She takes out a translucent crystal ball. Your image is reflected inside, with the twinkling starlight seemingly trying to bewitch you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Would you like me to... interpret some dreams you don't understand?
Your prompt refusal does not upset her. On the contrary, a faint smile spreads across her alluring face, half hidden by the brim of her hat.

speaker: Stargazer
content: No worries... No worries at all. Simply regard my offer as a blessing from WhiteSands.
Though you weren't interested before, you change your mind when the woman mentions "dream."

speaker: Stargazer
content: It seems you already know what you want to ask.
She takes your hand and places it onto the crystal ball. For a moment, the whistling sand seems to halt, and the world falls into silence. All you hear is the voice of the woman before you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ahead of you, the raging gale brings destruction and the mighty earth trembles without end. The ends of the world shall be shaken, and so shall the abyss.

speaker: Stargazer
content: And you... ignorance shall bring about your fall and fear shall bring about your collapse. You shall be taken away from your past to face the chaos of the unknown.

speaker: Stargazer
content: But there is no need to turn back. There is someone ahead to tread the path for you; someone to block the gale for you. As long as you march on, you have a chance to reach the true...
The face of the woman in front of you becomes a blur. Her smiling words dissipate mid-air.

speaker: Choice
options: Who? How can they help me to reach there?

content: You cannot wait to ask more, but you don't get any answers. A loud siren blasts across the port, pulling you out of the thick, shrouded air.

A magnificent ship approaches from the air, the blue light atop its bridge flickering through the whirling sand. As it slowly lands before you, Hella lets out an excited cry and pushes you and Hecate toward it.

speaker: Hecate
content: That's a Hypercube force field that weakens the Apocalypse and protects the sand ship as it travels through the Tide of Ashes.

speaker: Hecate
content: Looks like the FAC's greeting party has arrived. This will be our ship.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew! Help has arrived! And in a super cool luxury cruise ship, too!

speaker: Hella
content: Come on, all aboard! Maiden voyage out of DisCity by Team Hella of the MBCC Special Combat Force, setting sail now!
Hella's excitement completely usurps her initial fear and demurral. In front of this steely giant, she is jumping up and down like a starry-eyed schoolgirl on a field trip.
You, however, still have your mind on the encounter just now.

Does the ship's arrival mean that the prophecy has been fulfilled? Or is it just a bluffing ploy? You turn to look at the narrow path behind you. The woman who divined for you has vanished, as if she never existed.
Only the interrupted prophecy lingers in your ears.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Go on... someone ahead will light up the stars for you and take you back to where you truly belong...
Once you step into the cockpit, a mechanical female voice rings out from the broadcasting system like an emotionless news anchor.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Friends from the MBCC, welcome aboard. This is the <color=#fb9259>V-710 Central Management System</color>. On behalf of Quinn, I would like to extend our warmest welcome.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Quinn has learned that for several months, the notorious desert bandits have been seriously destabilizing WhiteSands, which brought noticeable disruptions to DisCity.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: In response, Quinn CEO Ms. Eirene established the WhiteSands Development Foundation to do everything possible to support WhiteSands on its path to prosperity.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Recently, we learned that the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control will participate in WhiteSands' counter-bandit operation. With the blessing of the Outland Affairs Bureau, we acquired the latest <color=#fb9259>Sand Ship V-710</color> for you to show our support.

speaker: Choice
options: Thank you for your support. We look forward to working with you.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}, how are you so calm? It's Quinn we're talking about! That super loaded corporation in Eastside! Their CEO Eirene is not only a ravishing beauty, but also a genius businesswoman!

speaker: Hella
content: Her corporation Quinn formed only eight years ago, yet managed to totally sideline all the old money in Eastside! Those old farts are so bitter that they launch smear campaigns against her in the media every day!

speaker: Hella
content: Too bad for them, because Quinn earned a solid reputation by splurging on Eastside charities every year, so not many people believe their slander. Alas, I love seeing those **** waste money and effort but end up getting defeated! It's my daily source of joy!
A low, cold grunt heralds the appearance of Chief Guillotin on the comms screen.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Chief, how unsurprising that someone under your command has been bought off by Quinn's cheap tricks.

speaker: Choice
options: You're the one who has been bought off.

speaker: Hella
content: Yeah! Don't you love sheering their wool, too? You even got this great big ship!

speaker: Guillotin
content: What do you know, little brat! It's called reasonable access to commercial information!

speaker: Guillotin
content: The Outland Affairs Bureau has no qualms about Quinn's business expansion in Eastside. We are just concerned about the powerful forces behind the company.

speaker: Guillotin
content: For a company to emerge from nowhere and grow so large in such a short time... no way am I believing that the Outlands aren't involved.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Everyone wants to bribe the Outland Affairs Bureau, Chief, even the FAC. They just need the opportunity.

speaker: Guillotin
content: But I will not give Quinn this chance. They are propped up by dirty forces who I suspect are linked to the Outlands.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfff... don't you love taking advantage of them, too? You even got them to buy you this great big ship!

speaker: Guillotin
content: Hmph! Let me give you a word of advice... Never feel indebted to Quinn. They did what they're supposed to do. Don't forget your mission.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Also, the Ash Crystal in your possession will be placed in a special vault built by the Outland Affairs Bureau. Be careful... You cannot afford to bear the consequences of losing it.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Go meet the navigator of the V-710. He is the one who will truly support you.
Guillotin's comms avatar flickers for a few moments before disappearing. It seems that although the sand ship is a Quinn asset, it is completely under the control of the Outland Affairs Bureau.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: The V-710's navigator, Mr. Kawa-kawa, is also an exceptional <color=#fb9259>WhiteSands explorer</color>.

speaker: Hecate
content: I hear that WhiteSands explorers are extremely rare, often appearing in the most dangerous parts of the desert. They are the ones most familiar with this desert.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, we should go see him first.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Mmm... This smells so good! How can there be something so soft? And this... ahhh... so spicy! So satisfying!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: V-710! The food you prepared is so delicious! It's so much better than my usual meals of grilled scorpions and lizards!

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Thank you for your praise, Mr. Kawa-kawa. There are also other dishes available on the V-710. Would you like to sample them, too?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: There's more?!! I... burp—hehehe, next time, next time... I'm full! I mustn't waste food!

speaker: Hella
content: This... this little kid is our navigator...?!
Hella stares at the burping boy in disbelief.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: WhiteSands was once a forbidding no-man's land. Today's trade routes are forged by countless explorers who, despite the hardships and risks, chose to enter the sandstorm to collect data and chart the area.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: As one of the explorers, Mr. Kawa-kawa is qualified to be the V-710's navigator.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I'm not that great. I owe everything to my predecessors. I simply cannot compare with them.

speaker: Chief
content: Hello, Mr. Navigator. I'm the MBCC Chief, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Cough cough! Chief?! Wow... So I'm navigating for such an important guy!
Kawa-kawa wipes his hands on himself before grabbing you.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: So, uh... if you face any problems, let me know. I'll do my best to help.
Hella looks at Kawa-kawa, who still has oil smeared across his lips. She edges close to you and whispers in your ear.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey... is this kid really up for the job? He gets nervous even around you! If we encounter desert bandits...
Boom boom! Boom boom boom! Boom!
Just as she finishes speaking, the V-710 veers sharply to the left. You hear a loud explosion from the starboard side of the ship.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's an attack.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, do you need us to...

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Ah no worries! This is a part of my plan for the V-710!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: The V-710 was originally a battleship, but we disguised it as a Hypercube freighter to lure in the desert bandits!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: When they bite the bait, I'll lead them to the quicksand trap in WhiteSands and wipe them out!

speaker: Hella
content: Ptui ptui! There's sand and dust everywhere! I can't see a thing! Can you really run and hide at the same time?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Hehe, leave it to me! I know WhiteSands like the back of my hands!
Kawa-kawa goes to the bridge and turns the V-710 around to advance against the wind. The bridge's Hypercube force field deflects the billowing sand, opening up a safe combat zone for you in the rear.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Go on deck right now!
When you arrive on deck, you can clearly feel that the sandstorm has weakened.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: V-710, go around the sand dune ahead.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Command received. Reminder, this is an uncharted route, so unknown incidents are likely to occur. Please focus and respond carefully.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Don't worry, I take this route often! I can guarantee your safety!

The V-710 obeys Kawa-kawa's command and swerves behind the dune, which blocks the desert bandits' gunfire. The bandits' bullets stir up a haze of white sand, obscuring their vision and disrupting their flotilla formation.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, the desert bandits have changed their attack strategy. There are several guerrilla boats approaching.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph! Let's show them what we've got! It's time for the V-710 to become a battleship again!

speaker: Hella
content: Good going, Kawa-kawa! You've got guts!

speaker: Hella
content: I hereby declare, you are now the fourth member of Team Hella of the MBCC Special Combat Force!
Kawa-kawa wipes his nose and smiles bashfully.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: My ambition is to follow my predecessors, finish charting WhiteSands and find the safest route! It's just the basics of navigation! Think nothing of it!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: My whole purpose here is to protect you guys and lead the way, so I'm happy whenever I can be of help!

speaker: Hecate
content: We can't relax just yet! The desert bandit attack hasn't stopped yet.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: You can count on me to have your backs! Go and fight them without worry!

speaker: Hella
content: Team Hella has snatched its first victory! And the MVP is... Captain Hella!

speaker: Hella
content: Damn, why did they turn around? They can't beat us so they flee like cowards! We can't let them get away!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Understood! V-710, enable auxiliary aim and fire mode.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Command successfully received. Automatically searching for enemy targets. Targets within range locked. Ready to fire.
Boom boom! Boom boom boom! Boom!
The V-710 chases after the fleeing guerrilla boats and shoots them down one by one. The desert bandits fall from the ships like flies, trapped by Hecate's Nightmare.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, all targets have been defeated. Attention, the desert bandits' fleet is retreating.
This victory is too easy.You gaze at the fleeing enemies, wondering to yourself. How did these easily beatable desert bandits make so much trouble for DisCity?

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, if we stop chasing them now, the target fleet will escape.

speaker: Hella
content: What are you hesitating for, dummy? Even if we get ambushed by more desert bandits, they would be no match for the V-710.

Information and knowledge on WhiteSands in DisCity is limited. The files given to you by the Outland Affairs Bureau also have no conclusive data about the desert bandits. You cannot guarantee a victory if you continue the chase.

speaker: Chief
content: Kawa-kawa, is the direction in which they flee a safe route?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Let me see... huh? This direction seems to have no existing routes!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Let's not make any rash moves. The first priority of navigating WhiteSands is to make sure the route is safe! V-710, retrieve satellite imagery of the area that the desert bandits are fleeing towards.
Satellite imagery appear before your eyes. The scenes depicted make all of you gulp and shudder.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... What are those disgusting worms? Oh gosh, I'm getting goosebumps all over...

speaker: Hecate
content: Those are sandworms. They are the most commonly found creatures in WhiteSands and usually live underground.

speaker: Hella
content: Then why did they come to the surface? Just taking some fresh air?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Oh no! According to my grandpa's records, when sandworms show signs of mass agitation, it means the Tide of Ashes is going to arrive!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: We'd better find shelter now and hide from the Tide of Ashes. Otherwise, if we are caught in the storm, everyone's life will be in grave danger.
Kawa-kawa leads everyone back into the cockpit, opens the map and searches for the nearest shelter. He then charts a safe route to venture through.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, is that tide thing really that scary? Even the V-710 can't withstand it? Didn't you say this ship could protect us?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: The V-710's Hypercube force field can indeed protect us while navigating through sandstorms. However...
Kawa-kawa pauses and raises his head. His childlike face is twisted into a frown, causing everyone to worry.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: If we run into the Tide of Ashes... then it's a whole different story.

speaker: Hella
content: Isn't that just a big sandstorm? What's the difference?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: In the depths of the Tide of Ashes... there is an unknown horror...

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: The Apostle of Ashes...
Kawa-kawa flips open his notebook and shows you a pencil sketch.

The black and gray pencil marks scrawled all over the paper are so oppressive that it makes one hard to breathe... several colossal silhouettes loom in the suffocating darkness, squeezed one next to another, surging forward...

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: No one has ever seen what the Apostle of Ashes looks like, but those who narrowly escaped death from the Tide of Ashes have seen huge, ominous black shadows wandering in its depths.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: The survivors describe them like this: "They are like messengers of the gods searching for lost followers, leading them to their deaths in the tide." This explains the origin of the name "Apostle of Ashes"...
Kawa-kawa gazes into the distance, scratching his head awkwardly.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: But actually, I've always wanted to see the heart of the Tide of Ashes, but... it would be too dangerous for you.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I have no way of ensuring everyone's safety.

speaker: Guillotin
content: I hope this kind of fictitious urban legend isn't discouraging anyone from the MBCC?

speaker: Hella
content: Gosh... Where did you come from? You know in that kind of atmosphere just now, you could scare someone to death by popping out like that!
Guillotin raises his eyebrows in displeasure at Hella's outburst.

speaker: Guillotin
content: It is the responsibility and duty of the Outland Affairs Bureau to discipline those who desert their posts in the face of battle, regardless of time or place.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh?! Who are you accusing of desertion?

speaker: Guillotin
content: The enemies that have been plaguing DisCity are within reach. This is the best chance to wipe out the desert bandits once and for all. If you give up the chase now because of a mere Tide of Ashes, it would be hard for the Outland Affairs Bureau to not be suspicious...
Guillotin pauses for a moment, his eyes darting through the group before finally fixing his gaze on Kawa-kawa.

speaker: Guillotin
content: First you arranged the ship, then you arranged the crew, and now you're letting go of the best chance to catch the enemy... It's obvious! Quinn is behind this conspiracy!

speaker: Guillotin
content: I have all the evidence I need! They are the treacherous traitors who colluded with the Outlands and desert bandits to sabotage state-sponsored Hypercube trade!

speaker: Hella
content: Huh?! What the hell are you talking about, old man?! Put your money where your mouth is and come chase them with us!

speaker: Guillotin
content: This is your mission. Not mine.

speaker: Guillotin
content: In any case! Quitting this chase is not an option! We want to see results from your mission immediately!
He spits out this vicious warning before hanging up the comms.
Now that the V-710's freighter disguise has been exposed, the desert bandits won't come near it again. This is indeed the only chance to approach the bandits.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Chief, it's too dangerous! Are you sure?

speaker: Chief
content: As long as we wipe out the desert bandits before the Tide of Ashes arrives, we'll be fine.

speaker: Chief
content: Kawa-kawa, please do everything you can to help us.
Sensing that your mind is made up, Kawa-kawa pats you on the shoulder and laughs.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: My father once told me, "The most dangerous thing in the world is not taking risks." You're a gutsy one, and I love that!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: V-710, stay on course and chase them down!

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Understood.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I will try my best to avoid the sandworms and keep everyone safe!
A huge sand dune looms ahead, completely blocking the desert bandits' path.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph! Finally, they hit a dead end! These guys are too good at fleeing!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, time is running out.

A sky-high wall of sand has already risen in the horizon. You immediately order Kawa-kawa to prepare fire support to eliminate the desert bandits in one swoop. But to your surprise, several desert bandits came out from a nearby boat to sneer at you.

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: Hahaha! Did you have fun chasing us, you "DisGusting" lackeys? Did you think we were dead and can't escape?

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: It's a pity that the ones dying here today... are you!
You watch as the sneering desert bandit takes out a blood-red, teardrop-shaped crystal and places it into a strange device.
Instantly, a massive spurt of suffocating energy shoots out from the device, enveloping the area.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, the thing in his hand appears to be... an Ash Crystal!

speaker: Hella
content: Good! We can see what this Ash Crystal can do! Ahhh!!
The hull of the V-710 suddenly shakes violently, flinging you all to the ground.

speaker: Hecate
content: The sand is rolling! Chief... there is something underground.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: It's the sandworms! They are moving underground, and heading toward us!

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? Why? Didn't we steer clear of them just now?

speaker: Hecate
content: It seems... that the desert bandits are controlling the sandworms with the Ash Crystal.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Controlling sandworms? I've never heard of anyone who can control sandworms.

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: Oh? So you actually guessed what this is used for? That's fine... soon, I'll go back to being the only one in the world who knows! Hahahaha! Come, my monsters, come play with these brats!
Boom! Many giant sandworms swarm out from underground and surge towards you...

speaker: Hella
content: Ptui! Ptui! Ahhhhh!
Hella wipes the mucus off her face with disgust, her mouth puckered way up.

speaker: Hella
content: These disgusting sandworms are everywhere! We can't drive them away fast enough!

speaker: Hecate
content: We cannot break through the encirclement. Chief, it's a trap. We're stuck.

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhh! These desert bandits are just as despicable as the sandworms! Come fight me one on one if you have the gall!

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: Hehe, your Syndican cursing won't help you now, wench! Too bad... I won't respond to your provocations.

speaker: Desert Bandit
content: Boss, you're truly the ****! You knew right away that something was off about this ship.

speaker: Desert Bandit
content: We must've made the DisCity bigwigs lose their minds from anger! They're now even resorting to dirty tactics like disguising a battleship as a Hypercube freighter! They even hired Syndican thugs, too!

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: Hmph, DisCity has been living large from the Hypercubes for too long. It's time for them to face the truth... Without their precious Hypercubes, they are nothing!
Upon hearing their boss's riveting declaration, the desert bandits cackle wildly. Some even hoist up their victory flag.
You know the desert bandits are trying to provoke you to deplete the V-710's reserves so that you become completely defenseless.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: Power and navigation systems normal; Hypercube force field status: activated; ammunition reserves: 90%.

speaker: Hella
content: If it weren't for these sandworms, we'd have enough ammunition to blast those desert bandits many times over! Damn it!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, Kawa-kawa! You know WhiteSands better than any of us! Is there any way we can lose those disgusting sandworms and directly fight the bandits?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Actually, there is a way... but even if we can get past the controlled sandworms, the biggest problem now is that we've been held up for too long! "It" is coming!
You all follow Kawa-kawa's gaze into the distance.
Across the vast and boundless WhiteSands, the roaring gale has whipped up sand waves ten thousand feet high. As the sandstorm pounces towards you, the gray behemoth behind it comes into view.

speaker: Hella
content: Is that... The Tide of Ashes?!

speaker: Hella
content: So they want to use the Tide of Ashes to kill us??
Yes, that's the desert bandits' plan... They want to eliminate a "bigwig" from DisCity to showcase their power.
They want DisCity to not only overlook their previous Hypercube heists, but to share Hypercube resources with DisCity from now on.
The buzzing in your ears grows ever more shrill as the Tide of Ashes prepares to overwhelm you.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Ac... activate the Hypercube force field! At least try to avoid the incoming—
It's too late! With a few roaring shots, the desert bandits' cannons strike the V-710's anti-Apocalypse equipment.
The Hypercube force field disappears in an instance. The Tide of Ashes surges forward and swallows everything!

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: Oh arrogant DisCitizens, have a taste of the wrath we have felt towards you for so long! You who monopolize all the resources and look down upon us Outlanders...

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: Experience your ignorance and faults in endless pain! Soon, death shall be your only relief! Hahaha!

speaker: Desert Bandit
content: Boss, there's a new target. The scouting team has identified a Hypercube freighter.

speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
content: Great! Take the Ash Crystal. We need it to escape the Tide of Ashes. All attention and head out!

The roaring wind sweeps up countless white sand, relentlessly pummeling everything around you. You half-kneel on the deck, grasping the railing without the ability to move. You can only watch as the desert bandits disappear into the distance.
${PlayerName}, come over here!
You look towards the direction of the voice and see a slender beacon emitting warm yellow light, projecting a hemispherical shield.
At the center of the shield is Kawa-kawa, who is extending his hand and anxiously calling out to you.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Chief, come to the beacon!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: This is only the edge of the Tide of Ashes. My shield can still withstand it.
Shield...?
You have no time to ponder about it right now. You must bring Hella and Hecate to Kawa-kawa.

speaker: Hella
content: I can't! The wind is too strong, I can't reach you... help me!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, use the shackles! Strengthen the Nightmare... let it... take us...

speaker: Choice
content: Use the shackles
The enhanced Nightmare drags you towards Kawa-kawa inch by inch.
But just as you are about to reach the shield, a swarm of sandworms surge out from the ground. You instinctively push Hella and Hecate into the shield.

speaker: Hecate & Hella
content: Chief!!!
You feel yourself fall.
It's as if someone is guiding you from behind, pushing you into the endless silence.
For some reason, before you completely lose consciousness, the indecipherable prophecy emerges from the depths of your memory.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ahead of you, the raging gale brings destruction and the mighty earth trembles without end. The ends of the world shall be shaken, and so shall the abyss.

speaker: Stargazer
content: And you... ignorance shall bring about your fall and fear shall bring about your collapse. You shall be taken away from your past to face the chaos of the unknown.

speaker: Stargazer
content: But there is no need to turn back. There is someone ahead to tread the path for you; someone to block the gale for you. As long as you march on, you have a chance to reach the true...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Go on... someone ahead will light up the stars for you and take you back to where you truly belong...
Did the mysterious Stargazer also foresee everything that is happening?
Darkness envelops everything around you... Your consciousness surges as if a vortex has spun it a million times. The overwhelming nausea forces you awake.
You have no idea how long you've been swallowed by the Tide of Ashes. Space and time seem to have lost their meaning in this manic realm.
You try to call out for Hecate and Hella, but the sounds from your mouth are torn to pieces... Then they twist and reorganize into bizarre syllables.
(Rustling...)
In the midst of the gray haze, something is moving. It seems to be invisible and intangible, but it definitely is there.
(Rustling...)
It, no, they, are slowly moving and stopping. Wherever they pass, they leave behind their horrifying sound and presence.

Yet you can't see their true faces. No matter how much you concentrate, only hazy black shadows appear before your eyes. So you simply stand among them quietly, like an outsider that doesn't fit in, but also like something to be swallowed and assimilated.
You remember the terrifying figure mentioned by Kawa-kawa... the Apostle of Ashes.
Nearby, the storm rages on, yet you are caught in the eye of dead silence and isolation, facing these nebulous but deadly... apostles.
It's fine, you reassure yourself... Though your mind is tense, you know that your link with Hecate has not been broken. At least... they are still alive, and perhaps... you are also still alive, too.
(Rustling...)

Amidst the dead silence, even your breathing becomes tense and cautious. You want to concentrate and figure out a way to escape, but somehow, as if caught in a magnetic field, your thoughts slowly lapse...
...Chief... (Rustling...)
A subtle sound different from the constant rustling breaks through the dead silence.
The huge black shadows surrounding you seem to sense something and turn in unison towards the sound!

speaker: Chief
content: Is... is that...?!
Alarm bells are going off in your head! Hecate and the others must have found help, but the rescue crew is surely doomed!

The black shadows around you laugh shrilly. By the time you react, a fleet of ships in your vision has been swallowed up by the black shadows. You hear bloodcurdling shrieks and wails, distorted by the sandstorm.
Yet the ships at the back haven't stopped, still cruising at normal speed towards your direction.

speaker: Chief
content: Stay away!
Roarrrr!!

Howls echo from a lifeboat near you, and several Manic rescue crew members jump out from it. Their eyes are pitch-black, as if walking corpses with their souls drained from them. They run wildly towards you.

<size=50>Run!</size> 
Your mind is preoccupied with this one thought, and your body starts to instinctively run away.

speaker: Corruptor in WhiteSands
content: <size=50>Roarrrr...!! Roarrrr!!</size>

The wind begins to lash about wildly in the disrupted silent zone, trying to push you back to the deadly realm. The desert sand wraps around your fleeing feet like quicksand, engulfing your body bit by bit. "It" wants to keep you in the Tide of Ashes forever.

speaker: Chief
content: I will not... and cannot, die here!
I never said you'd die here...
Bzzz bzzz... the roar of an engine rings in your ears as someone pulls you forcefully by the collar and yanks you out of the quicksand.

The rescue crew members who had been swallowed up and transformed into Corruptors all seem to sense the quicksand. They bypass the area and lunge towards you, their faces snarling and their bodies twisting wildly.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
You hear a few delicate metallic chimes ahead of you. The limbo chaos is suddenly split by an invisible force, revealing the blinding light of the outside world.
You see someone treading the sandstorm towards you. She hums a strange tune that dispels the frightful roar.

speaker: Chief
content: It's... you... Stargazer?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Poor child... let me help you?
She speaks softly to you as countless black shadows spread out from the crystal ball in her hand. They wrap tightly around the pursuing Corruptors, stretching from their ankles to their necks.
The suffocating sensation makes the Corruptors tremble, and their eyes almost pop out of their sockets.
You hold your breath and your heartbeat quickens, as if you are also tightly entangled by these dark shadows.
...Is this her power?
You can feel it, she has not tried to hide it at all... It is the power of the Sinners, a power stemming from Mania.

speaker: Chief
content: You're also a Sinner.
A playful smile spreads across Stargazer's face as she spins the crystal ball in her hand to call back the black shadows.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You don't seem to be afraid?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Let alone the Sinners... many people who witness my ability will faint on the spot.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm someone with the guts to go deep into WhiteSands. Surely I'm not that fragile.
You look around and decide to continue hiding your identity from Stargazer, although you're unsure if she already knows.
But as things stand now, even though the Corruptors have all been eliminated, the Apostles of Ashes still lingers nearby. You still need her help to escape.
You watch quietly as she approaches, not averting your gaze.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Do you fear me?
You shake your head.

speaker: Chief
content: No. You helped me twice. I have no reason to fear you. What I fear is... the Apostles of Ashes.
You watch the eerie black shadows loom closer and closer. You know very well that once they devour you, you will be reduced to a monster without a soul.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Fear is a prayer of pessimism, and the "Apostles" will answer that call. My dear guest, if you want this place to become Heaven, your heart must become Heaven first.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Sigh... it seems you still do not understand. Do I need to phrase it differently for you to comprehend?

Stargazer cups your face, turning your gaze away from the Apostles of Ashes and towards herself. 
You are mesmerized by her vivid purple eyes, and can no longer look away.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Poor dear, you look awful... seems like you are truly frightened.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Don't worry, with me by your side, you will be safe... lean on me as much as you wish.
No... Just as you blurt out your protest, the shell encasing the void and dead silence passes through you and Stargazer, before fading away into the whirling sands.
You look at Stargazer in mild disbelief.

speaker: Stargazer
content: As I said, fear has power. It attracts and drives the Apostles of Ashes.
Stargazer gently caresses your face, as if teaching a child who knows nothing about the world.

speaker: Stargazer
content: The humans of DisCity think they understand WhiteSands. Yet whether it's WhiteSands or the world at large, there's too much that they're ignorant of.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ignorance breeds arrogance, and likewise fear. Over the years, the Apostles of Ashes have accumulated immeasurable power from fear.

speaker: Stargazer
content: This is why DisCitizens keep perishing in WhiteSands despite wielding Hypercubes.

speaker: Stargazer
content: They perish from the power of their own fear.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Thank you for saving me again just now.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You saved yourself. I just gave you a bit of guidance.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You have the power to resist against fear; you are just a bit lost. When the confusion dissipates, you shall become more resilient than others.
You start to say something, but Stargazer spins the crystal ball in her hand. The shapeless black mist inside diffuses, revealing your reflection.

speaker: Stargazer
content: As for now... I think you need new strength and a new companion. That person shall be the one to show you the way forward.

You stare at Stargazer... You don't know whether her words count as "prophecy" or "guidance," but it is undeniable that she is a powerful Sinner. More importantly, she has knowledge and wisdom that even WhiteSands explorers can't match.
No matter what, you decide to try.

speaker: Choice
options: Try in the name of Quinn

speaker: Chief
content: Have you heard of Quinn?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ah, Quinn... guests from Quinn have indeed sought my divination before. They pay quite generously.

speaker: Chief
content: My trip to WhiteSands was initiated by Quinn's sponsorship. The intention was to further develop trade relations between WhiteSands and DisCity, but we were unexpectedly ambushed by desert bandits. If you continue to help me, I will apply for a substantial sum of funds to compensate your help.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Mm hmm... sounds tempting... however...

speaker: Chief
content: New strength, a new companion... I think I see that right in front of me.

speaker: Chief
content: Miss Stargazer, are you willing to join my... fleet, and continue to help me?

speaker: Chief
content: Afterwards, I will apply for a substantial sum of funds to compensate your help.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You know, the first half of what you said... is a lot like the vows exchanged by lovers at a wedding in DisCity.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Regardless of what you said in the second half, at least the first half makes me feel quite satisfied... however...
Stargazer squints her eyes, as if waiting for you to profess some more vows to sweeten the deal.

speaker: Stargazer
content: How about this. You promise to do one thing for me, and I'll agree to this "deal."

speaker: Stargazer
content: I'll tell you what you need to do later. Don't be nervous, it's nothing difficult.
Before you can answer, Stargazer boards the hovercraft and extends a hand towards you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Have you made up your mind? Will you come with me?
You seem to have no other choice.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll come with you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I admire your decisiveness.
Before you can think things through, Stargazer yanks you onto the hovercraft.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It's time to get out of here.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Brace yourself for the real WhiteSands.
After some violent turbulence, the hovercraft begins using the air currents as its course to weave through the gaps of the sandstorm.
You never thought that one could navigate through a sandstorm without a Hypercube force field. Exposed to the sands, you instinctively worry about your well-being.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Don't be afraid. The desert approves of you.
Stargazer's nonchalant words echo in your ears. Before you have a chance to ponder the meaning of her words, you see her calmly maneuvering the hovercraft towards a huge wall of sand.

speaker: Chief
content: Be careful!
As soon as you say that, the strong pressure you had been encountering abruptly disappears.

speaker: Stargazer
content: There. I have completed your request.
You sit in the back of the hovercraft, floating gently across the white desert. The sandy winds around you gradually weaken, and the harsh whistling sound fades from your ears.
We... escaped?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Escape? Hmm... I suppose for you, the word "escape" is indeed fitting.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Let me think. There should be a shelter around here...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ah yes... this way...
Stargazer raises her finger and casually points to the distance. You squint your eyes, spotting a small black dot resembling a building in the distance.
However, when you get closer, you encounter some unwanted guests—sandworms.

The Tide of Ashes has receded, but spurred by its aftereffects, the sandworms are still in a state of frenzy. They frantically thrash against the shelter's Hypercube force field, trying to attack all the lifeforms they can sense.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ahhhh... I had wanted to take you to the shelter to sort things out, but now...

speaker: Stargazer
content: The shelter is in an even stickier situation than us!

speaker: Stargazer
content: You've suffered from the sandworms before, yet you still have the courage to face them again. You've got guts.

speaker: Chief
content: There are innocent people in the shelter. I can't just sit back and do nothing.

speaker: Chief
content: And... with you around, these sandworms shouldn't be too much of a problem.

speaker: Stargazer
content: But right now there are only two of us. It's a bit hard to deal with frenzied sandworms while also trying to protect the shelter at the same time. The best solution in this situation is to lure them away from the shelter without any direct conflict.

speaker: Chief
content: Right now, their attention is entirely on the living beings inside the shelter. How do we...

speaker: Stargazer
content: I have a way to lure them away, but they need to calm down first. It looks like they'll be in a frenzied state for quite some time.
Cracks have already formed on the shelter's force field. If no action is taken, it will only be a matter of time before the sandworms break through.

speaker: Chief
content: We can't wait any longer. I'll find a way to calm them down... or at least distract them from the shelter.
You hop off the hovercraft and run towards the shelter.
Since the power of the Ash Crystals is related to the power of Mania, could the power of your shackles have some effect on the sandworms? You grit your teeth and decide to give it a try.
The red light in your palm dissipates, and the sandworms in front of you stop their attack... They back away little by little, as if afraid of something.
Stargazer pilots the hovercraft over and looks at you for a long time.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Good job. Worthy of admiration.
Stargazer waves her hand, and thin rays of twinkling light descend from mid-air. The sandworms, who had frozen in their tracks, notice these light rays and begin chasing them away from the shelter.
The sandworms depart into the distance, whipping up a breeze. You smell a strange fragrance.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It's a special spice that the sandworms love.

speaker: Chief
content: ...The sandworms can be lured away this easily?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Little one, WhiteSands and all its creatures have never sought to take anyone's life. The humans are the ones who ignore the preexisting rules of WhiteSands and presume to establish their own order.

speaker: Stargazer
content: They sacrifice their companions for the sake of power and put all the blame on WhiteSands so that they can be at peace with themselves. Humans are such hypocrites.

speaker: Stargazer
content: See, like that.
Not far away, you see a few desert bandit teams hiding underground hurry away because they notice the sandworms leaving.

speaker: Desert Bandit
content: Crap, we have to go back and tell the captain! The plan failed!

speaker: Stargazer
content: Those who drive the sandworms to attack humans are humans themselves... Don't you find it absurd?

speaker: Chief
content: Yes, such people do exist among humans, but... aside from them, the rest will not sit idly by and let this happen.
Stargazer smiles and shakes her head. She leans on her boat without refuting your words.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It's time for us to go to the shelter. My Ferotti needs a good rest and refueling.
You immediately tail behind Stargazer, and accidentally hear her murmur something. Unfortunately, her words are inaudible in the wind.
What did she say...?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Can we who have superhuman powers and knowledge ever be accepted by human society?

speaker: Stargazer
