content: No. Humans will see us as heretics and monsters. They want to expel us, imprison us, and destroy us.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Because... nothing arouses the most primitive fear in the human heart more than the unknown.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Little one, we're here. This is the WhiteSands Shelter.
Stargazer leads you inside the shelter.

All of a sudden, all the whispering around you stops. People in the shelter gather on opposite sides, with their heads bowed, seemingly unwilling to communicate with you. They sneak glances at you, but once you meet their eyes, they avert their gaze.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Yes, they're afraid.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Perhaps if you announce your affiliation with Quinn, they will be welcoming towards you. After all, Quinn's generosity is well-known in this area.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Too bad you're with me.

speaker: Chief
content: What does that mean?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Haha... what does that mean...

speaker: Stargazer
content: It means you are affiliated with heresy.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Dispelling sandworms, traveling through sandstorms, and returning alive from the Tide of Ashes...

speaker: Stargazer
content: There's no one who wouldn't fear such a... monster.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't say that. I don't think you're a monster.
Upon hearing your words, Stargazer chuckles.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I'm glad you are willing to speak out on my behalf.

speaker: Stargazer
content: However, did you ever stop to think... that perhaps you think this way because...

speaker: Stargazer
content: You're a monster, too?
Stargazer comes up to your ear and answers you in a hushed tone that only you can hear.
Her warm breath is laced with that exotic fragrance. It encircles your ears, causing you to tremble.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Haha, don't worry. I never care what those people think of me.
Stargazer smiles unconcernedly and turns to walk out of the shelter.
You turn to follow her, but a gush of whispers from the crowd stops you in your tracks.

speaker: Refugee in Shelter
content: Do you see that? The monsters from WhiteSands really listen to her...

speaker: Refugee in Shelter
content: The monsters don't kill her. Does that mean... she's a monster, too?

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: Cough cough, watch your mouth. People are listening.
Stargazer is right. These people regard her as a "heretic."

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: Judging from your attire, you must be from DisCity.
An old man in rags blocks your path.

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: You're the first and only person I've ever met who speaks to the great Stargazer. Are you not afraid of her?

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: She's often accompanied by the monsters from WhiteSands, and can even control those monsters!

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: And her eyes are so strange! Some say that when you look into her eyes, she will bewitch and control you!

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: Oh! And that crystal ball she always carries around! Even though her prophecies are never good...

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: Foreseeing the future is not something anyone can do!

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: Many say that she turns those who approach her into the monsters in WhiteSands!

speaker: Refugee in Shelter
content: Hmph! So she's on the side of the monsters! She's the one who brought the Tide of Ashes!

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: Watch your mouth! Don't poke trouble with your careless words!

speaker: Old Man in Shelter
content: DisCitizen, take my advice. Don't get too close to Stargazer, or else you might also turn into a soulless monster!

speaker: Chief
content: Thank you for your... kind advice.

speaker: Chief
content: But I hope you get to know Miss Stargazer yourself before passing judgement.
The old man looks at you and sighs. Realizing that he can't convince you to stay away from Stargazer, he waves his hand to disperse the crowd.
The shelter returns to its usual calm. You rush to catch up with Stargazer.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You're back? Heard what you wanted to hear?
These somewhat frosty words burrow into your ears. Stargazer is still smiling, but you feel that she is now a bit guarded towards you.

speaker: Chief
content: I just heard a few things about you, like how much you seem to like WhiteSands.

speaker: Stargazer
content: That's right.

speaker: Chief
content: I often had a recurring dream before coming to WhiteSands.

speaker: Chief
content: In that dream, I stand in the middle of a white desert, caught in a sandstorm. But I don't feel afraid because at the end of the dream, a pair of hands always rescues me from the sandstorm.

speaker: Chief
content: Hence... when the corporation wanted someone to explore WhiteSands for business opportunities, I volunteered to take up the job.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Hestia pats that little battered messenger bag she carries.

speaker: Stargazer
content: ...Though you are beloved by WhiteSands, will you choose it in return? Will you leave the human world?
You have no immediate answer, and sink deep into thought.
The sound of heavy cannon fire abruptly snaps you back to your senses. Not far away, the fleeing desert bandits has reassembled and are launching another attack on the shelter.
Countless bullets and shells rain down. You subconsciously step in front of Stargazer to protect her.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Little one, are you trying to protect me? There is no need to be afraid of them at all, we will be fine...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Because, your companions shall come save you.
As soon as her voice falls, a black shadow zips before your eyes, destroying the desert bandits' ship.

speaker: Chief
content: Nightmare?! It's Hecate!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! And me!
A familiar sand ship comes into view. A petite figure leaps from it, knocking out the desert bandit trying to approach you.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}, don't just stand there! Get ready to beat the crap out of these desert bandits with me!
After cleaning up the battlefield, Hella and Hecate wave at you from the entrance of the V-710.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, it's time for us to get on board.
You freeze upon hearing Hecate call you "Chief." You spin around to look at Stargazer... Her half-smile makes your hair stand on end.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Chief... this doesn't sound like the title of a Quinn businessman.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Let me guess. You're with the DisCity authorities.

speaker: Chief
content: Sorry for hiding this from you... I was sent by the authorities to eliminate the desert bandits.

speaker: Chief
content: Although I lied about my identity, the promise I made still stands.
Stargazer shakes her head, and pushes you gently from behind.

speaker: Stargazer
content: No matter who you are, I have already finished your request. Get on board. It's time to part ways.
You turn your head back. Stargazer is back on the Ferotti, riding sidesaddle into the desert sunset, like a painting printed on a tarot card.

You do not want to part with her here... She is powerful yet calm, with a plethora of knowledge about WhiteSands. These are all qualities that are indispensable for eliminating the desert bandits. Moreover, she is a Sinner...
With this in mind, you immediately turn back to walk towards Stargazer.

speaker: Chief
content: If I offer to hire you as an advisor for this mission on behalf of the DisCity authorities, will you accept?

speaker: Stargazer
content: I have already completed your request.

speaker: Chief
content: Then... what if I invite you as the MBCC Chief?
You stretch out your hand to her, revealing the power of the shackles in your palm.

speaker: Chief
content: I can help you... and I also need you.

speaker: Chief
content: Your wisdom can help me defeat the desert bandits. I promise, I won't let them hurt you.
Stargazer doesn't accept or refuse. She simply flashes a knowing smile.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Lead the way, Chief.

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: "New personnel data entry in progress... Facial recognition for Stargazer successful... Welcome aboard the V-710."
As you step into the cockpit, your three companions look towards you in unison... and gawk at Stargazer behind you.

speaker: Chief
content: When I was trapped in the Tide of Ashes, Stargazer saved me and brought me to the shelter.

speaker: Chief
content: She excels at dealing with various crises in WhiteSands, so I invited her to be our special advisor. If we run into trouble, she'll help us.
You do not forget the existence of the Outland Affairs Bureau, and deliberately omit Stargazer's Sinner identity in your introduction to avoid unnecessary repercussions.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: You mean not only did she go inside the Tide of Ashes all by herself, she also got you out, too?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: That's incredible! It's almost impossible to tell where you're going inside the Tide of Ashes... how did you do it? Oh yeah! Did you see an Apostle of Ashes? If you saw one, can you tell me about... mmm—!
A long, slender finger presses against Kawa-kawa's lips.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Shhh... you ask so many questions. Where shall I start?
Kawa-kawa's face blushes bright red. He hurriedly takes a few steps back, looking embarrassed.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft! Look at how bashful Kawa-kawa has become! He's even at a loss for words!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: ...I'm not!
You can't help but smile as you watch Hella tease Kawa-kawa.
But Stargazer does not partake in the scene. Her distant and detached disposition reminds you that even though you have revealed your true identity, there is still a barrier between you two.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Your name is Kawa-kawa, right? It's true that it's impossible to pinpoint directions in the Tide of Ashes. However, there are countless air currents, and one can leave by simply following the direction of the currents.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: But there's a lot of turbulence in the Tide of Ashes. Even if you follow the currents, there's a high chance of getting caught in the turbulence.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Once caught in the turbulence, it is theoretically impossible to get out alive...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Yes. This relies on the experience of the pilot.

speaker: Stargazer
content: However, there is another foolproof way, and that is to use an Ash Crystal.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It can drive away sandworms and pierce through ashes, for it is a creation born from the Tide of Ashes, and the infallible treasure of the desert bandits.
Kawa-kawa looks down and ponders for a moment before showing an epiphany.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I understand now!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: No wonder the people of DisCity tell me that they cannot explore other routes. Because DisCity's Ash Crystal died.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Once an Ash Crystal dies, it becomes useless. You cannot use it to deal with the desert bandits.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Unless... you find a way to reactivate it.
Stargazer's words plunged the room into silence. The power of the Ash Crystal is related to Mania, and your shackles also seem to be able to affect the sandworms.
...That's certainly a possibility. There may be a chance to reactivate a dead Ash Crystal.

speaker: Chief
content: If I give you our dead Ash Crystal, would you be able to find a way to reactivate it?
For the first time, you see Stargazer fall into silence. Everyone else looks doubtful.
But out of trust and respect for you, no one questions your suggestion, except...

speaker: Guillotin
content: I cannot believe what I just heard. You want to give the Ash Crystal to some unknown woman?

speaker: Guillotin
content: I will never allow this under my watch!

speaker: Guillotin
content: At first, I turned a blind eye to the fact that you invited someone who is not part of the mission to participate without permission.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Now it seems that the Outland Affairs Bureau will have to reassess the security clearance of this individual.

speaker: Guillotin
content: V-710, I order you to immediately re—
The Outland Affairs Bureau's comms abruptly cuts off. The screen flashes the words "abnormal disruption."

speaker: V-710 Central System
content: "Warning! Warning! The V-710 is under attack by an unidentified source. Temporary defense mode has been activated. Hypercube force field is in effect."

speaker: Hella
content: What's happening?

speaker: Hecate
content: The desert bandits haven't given up... They seem to have used the Ash Crystal to command the sandworms to attack the shelter again.

speaker: Hella
content: Damn it! We defeated the desert bandits, but why are these sandworms still around?

speaker: Stargazer
content: With your level of power, it is impossible to defeat the sandworms, let alone ones controlled by an Ash Crystal.

speaker: Stargazer
content: The only way to tame them is to go along with their nature.

speaker: Hella
content: Easy for you to say! What do we do now?
An exotic fragrance seeps out from the container in Stargazer's hand... The spice the sandworms love.

speaker: Stargazer
content: The battle back there tired out the sandworms. Now, they need to soothe their spirits.
With a brush of her hand, the spice powder scatters to the wind and drifts toward the fleet of desert bandits.

speaker: Hecate
content: The sandworms stopped attacking.

speaker: Hella
content: Wow! It really worked!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief is right. Stargazer is really good at dealing with crises in WhiteSands.

speaker: Hecate
content: If the Chief insists, I think it's okay for her to try to reactivate the Ash Crystal.

speaker: Hella
content: It's a dead crystal anyway. We can't possibly damage it further, so why not give it a shot?

speaker: Hella
content: Instead of letting it rot away in the vault, we should take the gamble. I also support letting Stargazer try.

speaker: Hella
content: If that annoying old man starts blabbing again, we'll just cut the comms!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...No need to cut the comms. We'll just ignore him.
Stargazer has fully proven her abilities in battle. Your companions have accepted her as part of the team, and are now much friendlier to this fellow traveler.
Someone has already taken the first step towards establishing trust. You are confident that if Stargazer also takes a step forward, everyone will get along just fine.
The scene from the shelter will not repeat itself.
You look towards Stargazer, but she is still gazing in the direction of the desert bandits.

speaker: Choice
options: Ask Stargazer what she is doing

speaker: Chief
content: Why do you keep staring in that direction?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Chief, to achieve something grand, one must be repeatedly tested.

speaker: Stargazer
content: When old crises are resolved, new ones shall come.

speaker: Chief
content: Crises?
The desert bandits who have fled are now back again.

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: The desert bandits who had fled are now back again!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: So, my underlings failed to finish you off. You want to face me again, eh? Hmph! You can escape from the Tide of Ashes once, but can you do it a second or third time?
The desert bandit boss appears, holding the Ash Crystal while murmuring something under his breath.

speaker: Hella
content: What the heck is that old fart murmuring about? He's not calling the sandworms back again, is he?

speaker: Hecate
content: It sounds like he wants us to enter the Tide of Ashes again.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? How is that possible? It's not like it's some magic lamp that we'd go in and out of whenever he wants... ahhhh—!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: Hehe... mwahaha...
Serenaded by the desert bandit boss's hysterical laughter, the wind begins to blow and the ground begins to shudder. Distant plumes of sand engulf the horizon at lightning speed.
The Tide of Ashes... is coming again.

speaker: Hella
content: Holy ****! Is the Tide of Ashes that basic? It comes at the drop of a hat?!

speaker: Hecate
content: I don't think this Tide of Ashes formed naturally.
You follow the direction of Hecate's finger. Aboard the desert bandit ship, the desert bandit boss is holding up the red-glowing crystal, as if conducting some ritual.

speaker: Hella
content: The Ash Crystal... can form a Tide of Ashes?!

speaker: Chief
content: We can ponder the mechanics of it later. If we want to get out of here alive or stop the Ash Crystal, we must seize their Ash Crystal first!
After analyzing the map with Kawa-kawa, you order the rest of the V-710 crew to encircle the battlefield from both sides, aiming to corner the desert bandit ship.

speaker: Hecate
content: The opponents can't be difficult to deal with.

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: Hahahahaha!
However, the desert bandit boss is unfazed by the siege. He roars at you with bloodshot eyes.

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: You think I'm afraid of you DisCity lapdogs?! You know very well what the people of WhiteSands have been through!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: You monopolized Hypercubes to reap vast fortunes from WhiteSands, but you don't give a damn whether the people of WhiteSands live or die!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: It was me! I brought together all the persecuted people of WhiteSands, bestowed upon them Hypercubes and gave them the hope to live!

speaker: Chief
content: What lies!

speaker: Chief
content: Your actions are clearly pushing unarmed civilians into the abyss!

speaker: Chief
content: You think DisCity doesn't know about your plot?

speaker: Chief
content: You want to stir up trouble and sow discord, plunging more WhiteSands civilians into misery! You want DisCity to build more shelters!

speaker: Chief
content: After all, it's much easier to raid civilian shelters than Hypercube freighters with formidable defenses!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: Shut up! Shut your filthy pie-hole!
The enraged desert bandit boss swings his sword at you, only to be blocked by Hella. The savage clash of metal sets off fiery sparks.

speaker: Hella
content: Crap crap crap! My hand is numb! What kind of sword is that?!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: Hehehe... did you think I had no chance of winning?
The desert bandit's strength troubles you... He is not Manic, yet he has enough power to fight Sinners in a way that no ordinary person could.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella! Be careful!

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhh! Thank goodness I dodged quickly! That speed and strength is incredible!

speaker: Hella
content: Are you sure that guy isn't a Sinner or Corruptor? Hecate and I couldn't beat him with our combined strength!

speaker: Stargazer
content: Not right now, but he will become one.

speaker: Stargazer
content: He prayed to the Ash Crystal for power and received an answer. He has been bestowed the power of limbo, plunging him into paranoia and rage.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Just like the shadowy figures whose souls have been devoured by the Tide of Ashes, it is only a matter of time before he becomes a Corruptor.

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: You dare... compare me to those lowly monsters...?!

speaker: Hella
content: Aww, Miss Stargazer, your words really shattered his little heart!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: Soon you won't dare to speak with such insolence... hehehe...

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: I shall use the power bestowed upon me by the Ash Crystal to smite you, to smite DisCity, and obtain all the Hypercubes...

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: By then, I shall control everything in WhiteSands! I shall become the master of WhiteSands!

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: Hahahahaha... ahhhh...!
His arrogant cackles suddenly become pained whimpers as Stargazer looms before the desert bandit boss.

speaker: Stargazer
content: How humans hate and kill each other is of no consequence to me at all.

speaker: Stargazer
content: But if you presume to use your tedious barbarism to mistreat and desecrate WhiteSands... That is unforgivable.

speaker: Stargazer
content: O desecrator of WhiteSands, the only place your soul deserves to be is Hell.
The desert bandit boss locks his glare onto Stargazer.

speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
content: If... I... die... then... you... shall... also...
Black shadows entangle and smite the desert bandit boss, who stops breathing before he can spit out his last words.

With a flick of her hand, Stargazer flings the desert bandit who had been jeering arrogantly just moments ago like a rag doll into the desert. The white sands devour him immediately, leaving not even a single bone behind.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, we didn't find any Ash Crystals on the ship. They must have been moved.

speaker: Hecate
content: The Tide of Ashes is approaching the shelter. We need to retreat to the V-710.

As soon as you return to the V-710, you receive word that the Outland Affairs Bureau has learned of the desert bandit boss's death. They also know the Ash Crystal is still at large, and demand you to immediately continue pursuing the remaining desert bandits to retrieve it.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Can't we wait a little longer? There are still a lot of people in the shelter who haven't had the chance to board.

speaker: Guillotin
content: So what? Your mission is to chase down the desert bandits and retrieve the Ash Crystal! Not wasting time on rescue efforts!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I can't turn a blind eye to those in need.

speaker: Guillotin
content: Pfff, you say this because you want to obstruct the mission, don't you?! Only a Quinn lackey would give such a ridiculous reason!

speaker: Guillotin
content: You're just a navigator. You're not qualified to engage in our talks.

speaker: Guillotin
content: MBCC Chief, you're a smart cookie who knows what you need to do, right?

speaker: Chief
content: Did the Outland Affairs Bureau activate an emergency response to deal with the impending Tide of Ashes at the shelter? Are rescue measures being taken?

speaker: Guillotin
content: Are you trying to teach me what measures to take?

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not trying to teach you. I'm asking you.

speaker: Chief
content: Or does the Chief of the Outland Affairs Bureau regard the lives and property of Outland civilians in WhiteSands as of little concern?

speaker: Guillotin
content: You...!

speaker: Chief
content: If you indeed hold these views, I don't think there is any need to listen to your comms anymore.
You shut off the comms.

speaker: Hella
content: Wow, ${PlayerName}, that was so cool! See, Hecate, I told you not to stop me! No one can handle listening to that old fart!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: ...Impressive! So this is the real Chief?

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, what shall we do now?

speaker: Chief
content: Hecate, arrange for those in the shelter to board the ship. Hella, do a head count and make sure no one is left behind.

speaker: Chief
content: Kawa-kawa, monitor the movement of the Tide of Ashes and report any updates.

speaker: Chief
content: No matter what happens, our priority is to save lives! All consequences...

speaker: Stargazer
content: There's no time.
After uttering these icy words, Stargazer turns to the raging Tide of Ashes.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: At this speed... there's no time! There's simply no time to evacuate them!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: If we don't leave now, we'll get caught up in it too...

speaker: Hella
content: The desert bandits who took the Ash Crystal must be back. They don't intend to spare anyone here!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, shall we leave?
Leave? After issuing such a riveting speech, how can you watch these innocent people perish because of your actions?

speaker: Stargazer
content: However, there is another foolproof way, and that is to use an Ash Crystal.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It can drive away sandworms and pierce through ashes, for it is a creation born from the Tide of Ashes, and the infallible treasure of the desert bandits.
You remember the dead Ash Crystal.

speaker: Chief
content: Kawa-kawa, open the vault.
You change your mind. The mission must be completed, but the people must be saved, too. You are ready to trust your decision and trust... Stargazer.
You decide to gamble on the abilities and wisdom of Stargazer to open a path for you. Even if you are condemned as a "heretic" afterwards, you are willing to bet that she will be on your side.

speaker: Choice
options: Give the Ash Crystal to Stargazer

speaker: Chief
content: Try and see if you can reactivate it.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I was right about you. You are indeed a brave one.
Stargazer flashes an inscrutable smile and takes the Ash Crystal from your hand. However, she does not let go of your hand, leading you onto the deck with her.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Stay with me, MBCC Chief. I need you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Use your shackles to help me.
You obey her words and begin casting the power of the shackles into the dead crystal alongside her. Thanks to your efforts, the dull gray crystal begins to glow with luster.

speaker: Hella
content: Did... did we succeed?
Stargazer's hands glow red as she guides you to raise up the Ash Crystal, her gaze reverent, as if whispering to the stars...

speaker: Stargazer
content: "Scatter, depart, wallow, don't look back, don't look back..."
The moment the Tide of Ashes touches you, it dissolves into starry patches of light, scattering to the wind across WhiteSands.

speaker: Hella
content: I can't believe it... this actually made the Tide of Ashes disappear!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, the obstacle has been removed. It's time to close the net.
With the help of Stargazer, you easily track down the remaining desert bandits.
—The bunch of feral stragglers who have mutated beyond human recognition. One of these creatures is slicing open its companion's belly in a vain attempt to hide the Ash Crystal.
Bloody innards spill all over the ground, intermingling with the eerie red glow of the crystal.

speaker: Stargazer
content: These are the humans you trust...
Stargazer spits out these words to no one in particular, picks up the soggy Ash Crystal and tosses it into your hands.
All the desert bandit remnants have been caught, and the crystal is back in your hands. Now it's time to face the consequences...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, the Outland Affairs Bureau has issued an urgent communications request.
Your previous actions must have greatly offended the Outland Affairs Bureau. You must address them properly.
After you assign Hecate to interrogate the desert bandits, you rush to the cockpit.
Since you successfully recovered two Ash Crystals and wiped out all the desert bandits, the Outland Affairs Bureau could only verbally admonish you for your unauthorized actions.
After you hang up the comms, Hecate walks into the cockpit. It seems the interrogation has made some findings.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, this is the desert bandits' interrogation record.

Hecate turns on the security footage and begins to replay the interrogation. You see the desert bandits, now deprived of the Ash Crystal, begging for mercy under the pressure of Hecate's Nightmare, spewing out everything they know.
You catch a key term in their jumble of words, Filthflower.

speaker: Hecate
content: The desert bandit said that their crystal came from a creature trapped in the depths of the Tide of Ashes called the "Filthflower."

speaker: Hecate
content: When the desert bandits attained the crystal, they not only gained the power to control sandworms, but also used it to summon the Tide of Ashes.
There are living creatures in the depths of the Tide of Ashes?
You try to recall the scene around you inside the Tide of Ashes, but you can't remember anything other than the oppressive and suffocating Apostles of Ashes.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It's... the source of the Tide of Ashes.
Stargazer, who has been silent all this time, comes up to you and gently swipes the screen, replaying one of the desert bandits' "confession."

speaker: Stargazer
content: It's the place where the Apostles of Ashes want to take you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: No one knows what that place is, nor does anyone know what the Filthflower and its intentions are.

speaker: Chief
content: But if it's the source of the Tide of Ashes, then I guess we'll have to make the trip.

speaker: Hecate
content: Well, theoretically, if you find the “Filthflower”, you may find a way to end the Tide of Ashes.

speaker: Hecate
content: WhiteSands... will regain its tranquility.
With the disclosure of information about the Ash Crystal, the conspiracy of the rampaging desert bandits has finally been unveiled. It is time for you to embark on a new journey.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey you workaholics, are you done with the report yet?

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate, I told you to bring ${PlayerName} over to the celebratory party as soon as you drop off the record, but I waited all day and neither of you came back!

speaker: Hecate
content: Yes, the shelter arranged it... to show their gratitude.

speaker: Hella
content: Let's go already! Kawa-kawa is already there!

speaker: Hella
content: Here's to our adventure! Cheers!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, why are you being such a party pooper? It's time to wine and dine and party all night! Right, Kawa-kawa?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Yes... mmmm... This is delicious! Another one, please!

speaker: Hella
content: Yuck! Swallow before you talk!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Hehe, I just feel so happy to have met you guys and joined in the mission!

speaker: Hella
content: Uhhhh... so corny... are you babbling nonsense because you're drunk? Who would be happy to meet a Sinner?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I didn't drink. These are my true feelings.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: We even found new Ash Crystals! Maybe we'll be able to break through the Tide of Ashes and chart a perfect WhiteSands route.
The bonfire burns brightly, illuminating Kawa-kawa's blushing face and bright eyes.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Of course, it's all thanks to Chief and Miss Stargazer!

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Ah... what a pity that she did not come to the party. I still have a lot of questions for her...

speaker: Hella
content: Maybe Miss Stargazer didn't come because she doesn't want to be pestered by you.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Am I really that annoying? Sob... I'm sorry.

speaker: Hecate
content: Yes. Chief, do you want to take her along for tomorrow's operation?

speaker: Chief
content: The decision is really up to her. You guys continue. I'll go find her.
You stand up to leave the celebratory party.
You want to find Stargazer, but you realize after leaving the noisy party that you don't know where she is.

The huge full moon glows brightly in the night sky. For some reason, you remember the recurring dream you had countless times before, where you follow the full moon forward step by step, just like you're doing now.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
The crisp clinking of metal arises from behind a low sand dune.

speaker: Chief
content: Hmm? Is someone there?

Under the full moon, Stargazer is dancing.
...No, it is not simply a dance.
It is... a language. You've never witnessed it before, but you're sure of it.
As she turns to you with her strange dance steps, you see that her eyes are gently closed, immersed in some kind of silent music.
You are awestruck by this earnest and pious side of the mysterious and inscrutable Stargazer.
You hold your breath, but she still senses you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You came?

speaker: Stargazer
content: To ask me to stay.
She's not posing a rhetorical question. She has simply read your mind.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You asked a strange question. Let me answer you this way... I know everything about you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I already completed your requests. I should be leaving anyways.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Why are you asking me to stay?

speaker: Chief
content: You're also a Sinner.

speaker: Stargazer
content: So? You want to arrest me?

speaker: Stargazer
content: I never hid anything about myself from you. Yet you've been feeding me lies all this time. You keep more secrets than anyone.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry, considering the mission back then...

speaker: Stargazer
content: No need to apologize. It's up to you to decide who to share your true self with.

speaker: Chief
content: Let me reintroduce myself. I am the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. I have the power of "Shackles," which... is similar to the power of Ash Crystals, and can inhibit Sinner's Mania.

speaker: Chief
content: I hope that I can help you curb your Mania, and that you can continue to accept my requests, and use the power of the crystal to help us find the location of this mysterious lifeform.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You didn't answer my question, Chief.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Why do you insist that I stay? Just because of... the mission?

speaker: Chief
content: You asked me before...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Dreams are the projection of reality. You are indeed special, and beloved by WhiteSands.

speaker: Stargazer
content: ...Though you are beloved by WhiteSands, will you choose it in return? Will you leave the human world?
Your decision is...

speaker: Chief
content: I will not give up WhiteSands.

speaker: Chief
content: You says it loves me, then more the reason for me to explore its deepest secrets.

speaker: Chief
content: I want to know why it made me have such a dream?
Stargazer chuckles. Her voice is cold and crisp, like the metal sequins of her skirt clinking against each other under the pale moonlight.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Even if this leads you to danger and deception, to a path of no return, or even death...?

speaker: Chief
content: Even so.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You are indeed... unique. I knew that from the moment I set eyes on you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Words are like quicksand, slipping through one's fingers.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I hid the diamond between the sands, yet you are blind to it.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It's about the truth... regarding you and me.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You and I, we are both "others" in this world. Monsters.

speaker: Chief
content: Isn't it lonely to exclude yourself from everyone else?

speaker: Chief
content: Perhaps I understand why you linger in WhiteSands. The world beyond WhiteSands is filled with humans blinded to the truth. They make you take the journey alone.

speaker: Chief
content: But you still have companions in this world.

speaker: Chief
content: It's like the dream I had about WhiteSands. I could sense its sadness, so I wanted to understand it, and discover the source of its melancholy.

speaker: Chief
content: Hence, even if we are in different worlds, our mutual understanding and compassion is genuine.
The moon cloaks Stargazer's face in misty moonlight, blurring her expression from you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: From the day I became aware of my power, to the day I was condemned as a heretic, till now, I have never felt alone.

speaker: Stargazer
content: No, the power of prophecy. Divining for others has a special meaning for me.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It was the first time I encountered that world, and felt "its" power. "It" allowed me to see... the omen.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I became obsessed, intent on using the omens to catch a glimpse of the end of the world.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Back in reality, everything I prophesied came true one by one. For a while, I became a deity in everyone's eyes.
Stargazer tilts her head. The pale light cascades into her eyes, fusing into glimmers of sadness.

speaker: Stargazer
content: But more than admiration, humans feared this power... My people treated me as a deviant in league with the devil. I was constantly shunned and chased away.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I became a monster to the world... From then on, I've been wading against the crowd in pursuit of the truth that belongs to me. I've also been waiting... for my true companion.

speaker: Stargazer
content: The crystal ball told me that the answers to my questions lie inside the Tide of Ashes. So I left my people and ventured into the Tide of Ashes alone.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Yes. I almost died in that sandstorm. "It," who hails from the "other world," saved me, and bestowed me... an eternal life of a different kind.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I finally felt the kindness of a "companion."

speaker: Stargazer
content: I will never forget the kindness from my "companion." Thus I'm certain, that even if separated by language and thought, there are more of my kind in this world.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Thank you for choosing to understand me no matter what. It makes me very happy... so, I choose to help you again.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You little monster who wants to understand monsters.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ah, look. The full moon has risen to the middle of the sky.
<color=white>The moonlight blankets the desert in a dream-like hue.</color>
<color=white>Stargazer dances amidst this "dream."</color>
<color=white>No one wants to shift their gaze.</color>
<color=white>She dances so movingly.</color>
<color=white>Such beauty can only be expressed by someone who believes in "dreams."</color>
The next day, you command the V-710 to leave the shelter and head for the Tide of Ashes.
The closer you get to that gloomy black tempest, the heavier everyone's breathing becomes. Everyone instinctively wants to avoid that place... that unknown, horrific realm of death.
Everyone except Stargazer.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, the Tide of Ashes is ahead.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I... I have the crystals ready...

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Go, Chief, go! I... I believe we can do it!
You nod towards everyone and hand the two crystals to Stargazer once more.
Stargazer takes the crystals and leaps lightly onto the bow railing, perching on her toes.
She holds the crystals in her hands, letting the sand lash her hair and clothes...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Chief... go and experience that dangerous path you're determined to take.

speaker: Chief
content: What do you m—
The howling sandstorm suddenly strengthens, and you struggle to keep your eyes open. Amidst the dust shrouding the sky, you suddenly perceive something...

speaker: Chief
content: Hecate! Hella!
The wind subsides, and the dust disperses. Stargazer has long disappeared from the bow railing. In front of the sand ship are several sandworms with gaping mouths.
One ferocious sandworm prostrates obediently before Stargazer, as if welcoming her return.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Are you happy for "it" too? The two "hearts" lost to the mortal world are finally back.

speaker: Stargazer
content: But... there are constantly pesky people in the way. What can be done?
Stargazer asks this in a teasing tone, squinting her eyes. It is a rhetorical question, practically a taunt.
A few black shadows reappear from her crystal ball, severing the only path between Stargazer and the rest of you.
For a split second, you feel as if you're dreaming a nightmare.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! Give the Ash Crystals back! They're ours! Damn, what the **** are those black things! How dare they block my path!

speaker: Stargazer
content: Haha... it's true they don't belong to me, but they are certainly not yours.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It, they, and of course, me... we all belong to WhiteSands... to the Dreamflower. Filthflower? What a horrible slur that tarnishes its real name...

speaker: Stargazer
content: I've been waiting for this moment ever since you set foot in WhiteSands.

speaker: Hella
content: So you've been deceiving us from the beginning?!

speaker: Stargazer
content: "Deceive"...? We each took what we needed from each other.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I needed the Ash Crystals held by you and the desert bandits. You needed me to help you defeat the desert bandits. It's a win-win...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Now it is time for me to collect my payment.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Farewell. It is time to end this ridiculous game of companionship.
Stargazer hops on a sandworm and departs before your eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: Yeah I heard you... but these shadows... how the **** do we get rid of them?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, the more we struggle and fight, the more fiercely these dark shadows attack and bind us.
Upon hearing Hecate's description, you sense that these dark shadows bear a striking similarity to that mysterious, horrific entity.
If these shadows are also powered by sensing the emotions of the target...

speaker: Choice
options: Order Hecate and Hella to stand down

speaker: Chief
content: Hecate, Hella, stop your attacks.

speaker: Chief
content: Now, focus on thinking about what we want to do! We want to go forward and find Stargazer!
The dark shadows halt their attacks when you stop to think. They remain frozen in place, then begin to dash in one direction as if suddenly injected with consciousness!

speaker: Hecate
content: Let's follow.
You pilot the sand ship hot on the shadows' tails and soon catch up to Stargazer.
A furious Hella grabs a water pipe and throws it at Stargazer...

speaker: Hella
content: Come down, you witch!

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ah... you remembered what I told you well, Chief... seems like you're really into me...
Stargazer recalls the dark shadows into the crystal ball and gazes at you with amusement.

speaker: Chief
content: Why are you doing this? Is it because you don't trust us enough?

speaker: Chief
content: We won't harm any creature in WhiteSands, nor do we seek to conquer it. As soon as the Tide of Ashes is gone and trade across WhiteSands returns to normal, we will leave.

speaker: Stargazer
content: No, Chief. I approached you simply for the Ash Crystals.
You don't understand. After she helped you in the Tide of Ashes, and your heart-to-heart talk under the moonlight... Is it still not enough for you to be her companion?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Haha... still don't get it? Ever since "it" saved me, I knew I belonged to WhiteSands... to this other world.

speaker: Stargazer
content: As for mankind? An identity built upon a world of lies is naturally also a lie.

speaker: Chief
content: If everything you did was just for the Ash Crystals, then why did you save me?

speaker: Stargazer
content: I don't know... maybe out of... amusement?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Because for me, whether I want to save or kill someone, it's only a split second decision.

speaker: Choice
options: You really don't want to become my companion?

speaker: Chief
content: It doesn't matter whether I'm your true choice or not.

speaker: Chief
content: The important thing is... though we may not have the same goal, we can benefit from the same end result.

speaker: Chief
content: Yet what you are doing now is clearly...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Betrayal? Haha... you think this is betrayal?

speaker: Stargazer
content: No matter who you make a deal with, there's a gamble you must take, my good Chief.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You should've looked closely to see if I'm a good sword to use, or a... double-edged sword.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Moreover, my dear Chief, this isn't betrayal. It's revenge.
Stargazer enunciates the word "revenge" in an eerily calm tone.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Humanity must pay the price for what they did to WhiteSands and the Dreamflower.
Before you can ponder the meaning of these words, Stargazer speaks again.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Chief, remember when you promised that you would do something for me?

speaker: Stargazer
content: How about this. You promise to do one thing for me, and I'll agree to this "deal."

speaker: Stargazer
content: I'll tell you what you need to do later. Don't be nervous, it's nothing difficult.

speaker: Chief
content: I remember. You also said you won't make it difficult for me.

speaker: Stargazer
content: That's right. Now it's time to make good on that promise. Leave and go back to DisCity.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Learn to accept parting ways. Give up your pursuit of the unknown. Go now and leave it be.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Although you always want me to stay, this time... you can't use any more tricks to make me.
A sudden gust of sand begins to swirl around Stargazer. You instinctively step forward to pursue her, but your companions pull you back.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, Stargazer summoned the Tide of Ashes. We don't have any Ash Crystals. You mustn't make any risky moves.

speaker: Hecate
content: Moreover...

speaker: Hella
content: If we chase her, we have to fight these sandworms first!
The sandworms gradually retreat, and Stargazer has vanished, completely out of sight. Yet you've been caught up here for too long, and the Tide of Ashes surrounds you once more.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, we can't go any further.

speaker: Hecate
content: Out of safety concerns, we should stop the pursuit and return to the V-710.

speaker: Hella
content: I agree! ${PlayerName}, it's too dangerous to keep chasing.
You understand the perils before you, but you are not willing to leave. The answers you want can be found in the storm... Whether it's regarding Stargazer, the Dreamflower or the Tide of Ashes.

speaker: Chief
content: Hecate, Hella, you two go back. I'm going after Stargazer alone.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh?! You moron, do you have any idea what you're saying? Or are you having an aneurysm again?

speaker: Hecate
content: I don't agree either.

speaker: Chief
content: I know you two are worried about my safety, but... I know how to find Stargazer.

speaker: Hecate
content: But...

speaker: Chief
content: You guys go back to V-710 and find me with reinforcement.

speaker: Hecate
content: Is that an order?

speaker: Chief
content: Okay.

speaker: Hecate
content: Oh... alright, Chief. Please be careful. We will come to your aid as soon as possible.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! Hecate! Why are you being as dumb as this moron? Hecate—mmm!
Hecate uses her Nightmare to bind and toss Hella into the back seat of the hovercraft. She then stands before you, gazing at you for a long time.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, I'll be waiting for your return.
You smile at Hecate and nod.
From the depths of the Tide of Ashes, a huge and horrible dark shadow is emerging. Upon spotting it, you immediately send Hecate back to the V-710 in the hovercraft.
You face the arrival of the Apostles of Ashes with inner peace.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Fear is a prayer of pessimism, and the "Apostles" will answer that call. My dear guest, if you want this place to become Heaven, your heart must become Heaven first.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Fear has power. It attracts and drives the Apostles of Ashes.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Ignorance breeds arrogance, and likewise fear. Over the years, the Apostles of Ashes have accumulated immeasurable power from fear.

speaker: Stargazer
content: They perish from the power of their own fear.

speaker: Chief
content: The unknown breeds fear...
This is the second time you face the Apostles of Ashes. Stargazer may have deceived you, but what you have experienced will not.

Stargazer thinks she belongs to the Dreamflower, which is the source of the Tide of Ashes. Thus when the Apostle, who is also born from the Tide of Ashes, stops sensing fear, it may return to the Dreamflower.
You hop on the hovercraft and follow the roaming Apostles of Ashes.

speaker: Ash Echoes
content: Come, come to where I am...
It's the voice in your dreams! When you try harder to listen, dead silence returns to your ears.

speaker: Ash Echoes
content: ...This... is... home...
The call echoes again. The direction the sound is coming from seems to be where the Apostles are heading.
After God knows how long, the Apostles of Ashes finally halt and stand in silence. Before them is a wall of sand that dwarfs even their size.
Is this the end point? You look up at everything around you.
The hovercraft continues forward, rushing towards the wall of sand whipped up by the gale before the Apostles.
Amid a strong lurch of turbulence, you squeeze your eyes shut and let the currents sweep the hovercraft towards the wall of sand...
Behind the wall of sand, under broad daylight, a realm that has been silent for many years finally greets a new visitor.

speaker: Chief
content: What is this place...?
Fossilized sandworm carcasses half-buried in white sand are strewn as far as the eye can see. A few meters away, you spot the ruins of an old wall.
You search all over the place, and a dilapidated palace catches your attention.
You pick up the lighting equipment and step inside...
Ruined palace, first floor of the main hall.
The main gates of the palace have already collapsed. Someone seems to have smashed a hole in the side wall.
There is no sunlight within these walls. A faint gloom permeates the air, and blinding darkness stretches as far as the eye can see.
No one has visited the main hall for a long time. Dust and sand blankets every corner of the room.

speaker: Chief
content: These are...?
A trail of footprints meanders across the sand-covered ground. Clearly, someone has been here before you.
As you follow the footprints, you catch a faint whiff of fragrance unique to the Ferotti.
...It's Stargazer!
You quicken your pace, only to trip over the bottles and jars scattered across the floor.

speaker: Chief
content: Are those... lab equipment?
Those are clearly things that should not appear here.
You hastily raise the lighting equipment to scout around. The place is divided into several different areas, and the floor is scattered with thick wires.
You check one area after another. To your surprise, you find a playback device that still works.
Tsss tsss tsss... after a long buzz of static noise, you hear the rustle of flipping pages.
"Day 3 of the Usum Experiment. Small desert worms used for small-scale experimentation. Number used: 5."

"Test subjects reacted vehemently and mutated when placed in close proximity to the target. Mutations include, but are not limited to, enlarged body size, thickened bones, and the growth of sharp fangs."
"Moreover, the test subject and the target clearly established communications, or rather, the specimen unilaterally controlled the subject."
"...Tsss tsss... Day 10 of the Usum Experiment. Sexually mature Homo sapiens used as test subjects for experimentation. Number used: 10."

"Two-thirds of the test subjects showcased signs of intense stress when placed in close proximity to the target. Reactions include, but are not limited to, shrieking, mental breakdowns, hallucinations, self-harm or attacks against each other."

...Moreover, after exhibiting such symptoms for 17 to 20 hours, the subjects each died and produced a strange lifeform with strong magnetic interference. Or rather... we're not sure if it can be called a 'lifeform'...
These recordings suggest that an unknown group was conducting some kind of test on their so-called target.

"Day 28 of the Usum Experiment. We have confirmed that the target has a high dimensional level of cognition and is capable of deconstructing, analyzing, and guiding the consciousness of all living organisms."
"This type of guidance is not simply consciousness manipulation. It is more like a powerful, immutable rule that is placed on the test subject."
Tsss.... according to... tsss... remaining one-third of test subjects... tsss... became dependent, awestruck and spiritually devoted towards the target.
"...The research team defined the target's description as... understanding and empathy."
"The core crystals in the target's body are the source of its power. However, our experimentation has so far failed to determine the source of the target."
The human voice in the playback device suddenly pauses, leaving only the hum of static.
"Could it really be... as the mural depicts..."
This last phrase seems to be a murmur of self-reflection on the part of the recorder. You pick up a key word... Mural.

You return to the ruins outside the palace, raising the light in your hand to scrutinize the carvings on the wall... Sure enough, the seemingly irregular shapes and symbols actually form a grand mural.
The mural depicts the sun, moon and stars falling from the sky. Upon reaching the mortal world, they transform into a flower that lands before a kneeling crowd of worshippers.
This doesn't seem to be a depiction of history, but more like humans' deification of an unknown lifeform.

"Day 44 of the Usum Experiment. The research team detected unidentified dark shadows while searching for test subjects. We speculate that frequent experimentation on the target has affected lifeforms in a higher dimension."
"Day 45 of the Usum Experiment... Tsss... A multitude of dark shadows is approaching the research site. To be safe, once... tsss... is in place, the ceremony shall commence immediately."
The sound in the device cuts off at this point.
An unknown group, experimentation, sandworms, core crystals, dark shadows, the ceremony...
You feel like you've peeked into a secret corner of this realm. Once you grasp the clues scattered across WhiteSands, the hidden truth shall emerge.
Boom!!!
You are suddenly plunged into darkness, and your ears begin to ring with countless voices.
Crashing, roaring, screaming... the cacophony is like a drum pounding in your ears, causing you unbearable pain.
You force yourself up, pushing through the sharp pain. Then, you find yourself in familiar dead silence.
"Day 45 of the Usum Experiment... Tsss... A multitude of dark shadows is approaching the research site. To be safe, once... tsss... is in place, the ceremony shall commence immediately."
Are the black shadows referring to... the Apostles of Ashes?
A chill runs down your spine. The rustling sounds around you give you goosebumps.

As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you discover that things are grimmer than you expected... Countless Corruptors, whose souls have been devoured by the Tide of Ashes, are waiting for you along the edges of the darkness.

speaker: Chief
content: Hoo... hoo...
The corridors inside the palace are intricate and complex. You barge your way through, losing some of your pursuers.

speaker: Manic Desert Bandit
content: Roarrrr...!! Roarrrr!!
It's useless to keep running. There's a constant stream of desert bandits. You're bound to get caught by them at some point. Send a signal to Hecate now!
Beep—

speaker: Manic Desert Bandit
content: Roarrrr...!! Roarrrr!!
You look around and find no suitable weapons to defend yourself against the attacks. There is only a long, unknown path behind you.
You decide to keep running. With a bit of luck, you might be able to lose these desert bandits inside the maze-like palace.
The desert bandits detect your location and rush toward you.
Endless corrosion by time and sand has rendered the palace floors brittle and fragile, incapable of sustaining such commotion.
A single fissure splits across the floor, followed by countless cracks criss-crossing into one another. Finally, a gaping hole opens up as the floor crumbles beneath your feet!
You and the Manic monsters fall together into the endless abyss...
Ruined palace, underground.
A sharp pain sears your back as you struggle to get up. You realize you've fallen on a man-made platform... It's almost as if its job is to catch you.
The ground around you is littered with fragments of the monsters' limbs.
So you've come. Missed me that much?
That familiar voice, that familiar tone... You look up frantically...
She perches lightly on a stone nearby, just like she did before when running away from you. She is smiling, but her eyes are filled with pity and derision.
Just as you open your mouth to say something, you suddenly discover that nestled behind Stargazer is... A gigantic monster!

A tangle of vines twist and entwine each other, dripping sticky liquid like putrid flesh rotting off a corpse. At the top of the suffocating cluster is an organism that looks both like a blooming flower and a human face, heaving quietly as if it is breathing.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Little one, this is... the Dreamflower.
The Dreamflower lashes about its countless tentacles. You finally see that by its roots, the Dreamflower is pierced and confined by countless shackles of light.
This is the "ceremony" mentioned in the recording.
A hail of broken stones rain down all around, threatening to strike you at the slightest misstep. You carefully dodge the falling rocks and edge closer to Stargazer.

speaker: Stargazer
content: What a tough journey it must've been for you to follow me all the way here.

speaker: Stargazer
content: What do you want out of all this effort and energy?

speaker: Choice
options: I want to know the truth.

speaker: Stargazer
content: The truth... you must've encountered the recordings in the main hall already. Is there not enough information there?

speaker: Chief
content: Not just about the Dreamflower... I want to know about you...

speaker: Stargazer
content: About me...
Stargazer disregards the surrounding rubble and stands between you and the Dreamflower, as if to protect it.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You should know by now that the Dreamflower does not belong to this world. It hails from a higher dimension beyond this world of lies.

speaker: Stargazer
content: It descended from the Realm of Truth and bestowed its power upon each human being who prayed to it, so as to try to understand the rules and meaning of this world.

speaker: Choice
options: You mean the two Ash Crystals?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Three.

speaker: Stargazer
content: The first was bestowed upon a brave soul who dreamed of traversing WhiteSands. The second became the heart of a maiden who fled from humanity in search of a home. The third was brutally robbed by ignorant fools.

speaker: Stargazer
content: The Dreamflower is rampaging because it has now "understood."

speaker: Stargazer
content: Greed, ignorance, cowardice, indifference... After gaining power, humanity repaid the Dreamflower with all these sins. Thus, the Dreamflower has come to believe that this is not a place worthy of existing...

speaker: Stargazer
content: The Tide of Ashes is retribution against mankind for daring to desecrate the Dreamflower.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Now that the three crystals have returned to the sacred flower, it's time to put an end to this world of lies and return the Dreamflower to the Realm of Truth...!

speaker: Chief
content: There are three, but you only have two...
As you look at Stargazer with the Dreamflower behind her, you suddenly grasp the meaning of her words. "The maiden who fled from humanity in search of a home"... that was herself.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Do you get it now?

speaker: Chief
content: From beginning to end, you were acting on behalf of the Dreamflower.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Without the Dreamflower, I wouldn't be who I am today.

speaker: Chief
content: You became a Sinner because of the Dreamflower?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Not only that, but after so long, the crystal has almost completely replaced my heart.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Like I said, ever since "it" saved me, I knew I belonged to WhiteSands... to this other world.
No wonder you've always felt that she's been keeping you and the world at arm's length.
Obscured from sight, blocked from understanding.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Of these three hearts, one has been depleted, one has been contaminated by greed and cruelty, and one... has no compassion left for humanity.

speaker: Stargazer
content: When we return them to the Dreamflower, and free it from this ugly, binding ceremony, the apocalyptic Tide of Ashes shall engulf all of DisCity, no?
Stargazer strokes a branch of the Dreamflower and looks at you with a winning smile.

speaker: Stargazer
content: If you still care about your life, and the lives of your companions, leave this realm as soon as possible.
You watch as Stargazer takes out the two Ash Crystals and slowly approaches the Dreamflower.
From the beginning, she's been trying to return the three hearts to their original place. Then... what about the one inside her?

speaker: Chief
content: If you return the third heart, then you...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Does this require any hesitation?
Stargazer cuts off your question with a swift response.

speaker: Stargazer
content: My death is a given in this world. What I want to do now is regain its freedom.
As Stargazer steps into the ceremonial pit, thin arcs of black light wrap around the diviner's legs and seep throughout her body in the blink of an eye.
Slowly, she fuses and becomes one with the Dreamflower.
Scarlet-white light radiates from her, chipping away the ceremony entrapping the Dreamflower.
The curled tentacles of the Dreamflower gradually flattens out like a pure white flower in bloom.
One by one, the crystals return to their original positions. The Dreamflower begins to recover its power.
The scarlet-white light grows more and more blinding. A tentacle-like branch suddenly tightens and contracts in front of you, then pierces into the body of Stargazer!

speaker: Chief
content: Stargazer!!!

speaker: Stargazer
content: Go... go now...

speaker: Stargazer
content: Go... return... leave this place...
Crimson liquid trickles down the Dreamflower's branch. The branch that pierced Stargazer's body seems to have fused with her, quivering gently to her heartbeat.
Suddenly, someone grabs and pulls your arm from behind.

speaker: Hella
content: You moron! Do you have a death wish? This place will collapse any minute!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, please leave with us at once.
As the ground shudders violently, Hella and Hecate rush in and help you out.

speaker: Hella
content: We're practically half-dead from following your tracks to this place!

speaker: Hella
content: For the rest of the day, I don't want to hear anything about the damn stars or the damn moon or the damn flower!

speaker: Hella
content: You can only save others if you're alive yourself!
When you get back to the higher floor, a familiar melody echoes from the depths of the Dreamflower, as soft and gentle as the moonlight sprinkled on the white sand.
You see another mural upon the ruins by the light of the Dreamflower... A maiden is singing and dancing under the moon, while a huge flower quietly closes its petals.

speaker: Chief
content: No... there's still a chance... she's not completely disappointed in the world!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief?

speaker: Choice
options: I'm going to stop the disaster.

speaker: Hella
content: What? You still want to save the person who betrayed us? Did the Tide of Ashes clog your brain with sand?

speaker: Hella
content: How can you be so stupid?
You recount the whole story of how Stargazer returned the three hearts of the Dreamflower at the expense of her life, and how the Tide of Ashes will engulf DisCity afterwards.

speaker: Chief
content: If we save her, we can stop this disaster.

speaker: Chief
content: And... consider it wishful thinking on my part, but I feel... she wants me to rescue her.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry, I know it's dangerous, but I hope you two can... help me out.

speaker: Hecate
content: Whatever the Chief commands.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... I thought this mission would be like a vacation... you'll have to treat me and Ninety-Nine with scrumptious meals all week after we go back!

speaker: Hella
content: What kind of disaster could possibly be worse than what's happening now?
You recount the whole story of how Stargazer returned the three hearts of the Dreamflower at the expense of her life, and how the Tide of Ashes will engulf DisCity afterwards.

speaker: Hecate
content: If that's the case, it'd be useless even if we escape this place.

speaker: Hecate
content: Do you have any plans, Chief?
You decide to control the Dreamflower, and then... build a connection with it like the mural.

speaker: Hella
content: This weird thing seems to have stopped moving.
The tentacles are still twitching like a heart. The Dreamflower will indeed not die from your attacks.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's still alive. We can't kill it. We can only continue to restrain it for the time being.
You are not fighting to kill it. In fact, it must live.
If what Stargazer said is true, the Dreamflower gave its power to humans in order to "understand" the world.
So, if you link to Stargazer with your shackles... will the Dreamflower recognize your consciousness, thoughts, and desires...?

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief? What are you going to do? It's dangerous there.
Hecate grabs you as you try to walk over to the Dreamflower.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm going to stop the Dreamflower

speaker: Chief
content: It is inevitable for the Dreamflower to regain its freedom.

speaker: Chief
content: Stargazer has returned the three hearts to the Dreamflower, but none of them truly understands humanity.

speaker: Chief
content: To stop the Dreamflower from destroying DisCity after gaining freedom, I must personally contact it and help it to understand humanity.

speaker: Hecate
content: Understood. I'll wait for you here until you return.

speaker: Hella
content: Come back soon or we'll storm in to find you!
You think about persuading them to leave, but you swallow your words after seeing the determination in their eyes.
Now, whether it's for DisCity, or for your companions, or for yourself, you must stand firm in your convictions.
You stride towards the Dreamflower, unleashing your shackles and embedding them inside the flower. You let its tentacles wrap around your body and envelop you.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
A familiar tinkling sound rings about, calling out to you to open your eyes.
You look around... no one is there.

speaker: Chief
content: This is...
You sense that you've entered the Dreamflower's consciousness. This space is exactly like your previous Mirage.
A sandstorm begins to howl. You are caught amidst the dust, just like in the Mirage.

speaker: Echo in dream
content: Come, come to where I am...
There is a familiar figure from where the voice emanates from.
Could it be Stargazer?
But when you look up, the figure has disappeared. What instead appear before your eyes are the three Dreamflower hearts.
One dull and lightless, one chaotic and restless... and one emitting a faint ember glow.

speaker: Chief
content: I apologize for storming in like this.

speaker: Chief
content: I hope... you can try to understand humans... who are different from the ones you've met...
You walk over slowly and cautiously touch the chaotic crystal.
It belongs to the Tide of Ashes. The shrill whine of the Apostles of Ashes instantly sweeps across your brain. Your eyes are bloodshot, and you feel warm liquid gushing out from your nose and ears.

speaker: Chief
content: It seems like... I still need your help, Stargazer.

speaker: Chief
content: Stargazer, you must be here too, right?

speaker: Chief
content: If you also want to restore the Dreamflower to its original form, please help me... as my companion.
You look at the faintly glowing crystal and think of the dance under the moonlight.

speaker: Chief
content: Even though you said you were deceiving me from the beginning...

speaker: Chief
content: I believe that from the moment you saved my life, there is no "deception" between us.
A red glow bursts out from your palm again. You reach out to touch the starry crystal.
The faint starry glow suddenly becomes blindingly bright. Stargazer's heart is responding to your wish to save the Dreamflower and herself!
The dazzling white light gradually envelops the other two crystals, soothing the chaotic heart and injecting light into the depleted heart.
The three hearts converge, beaming arcs of light at times while falling into rest at others. The convulsions grow more and more frequent, before finally transforming the hearts into a dazzling star.
The sandstorm gradually disperses. The vanished figure reappears before you.
It's Stargazer. She stands there quietly, with a gentle smile you've never seen before.

speaker: Chief
content: You are not Stargazer.

speaker: Chief
content: You are the... Dreamflower？
The Dreamflower simply stands there, gazing at you with teary eyes, as if waiting for you to speak.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm here to stop the disaster

speaker: Chief
content: I'm here to save Stargazer...
The Dreamflower shakes her head, walks over to you and takes your hand.
Is this... Stargazer's past?

speaker: Young Stargazer
content: It's not a curse... I'm not a monster.

speaker: Young Stargazer
content: You're only afraid because you don't have my power! You... are just jealous!

speaker: Frantic Tribesman
content: Our tribe has been blessed with the power of the gods since the dawn of time! These godly blessings have allowed us to survive this long migration!

speaker: Frantic Tribesman
content: But you are different! Your power comes from a monster, from a curse! You peer into the future and presume to change the trajectory set out by the gods!

speaker: Frantic Tribesman
content: You heretic! Expel her! We refuse to have nightmares any longer! Go back to your monster!

speaker: Frantic Tribesman
content: Get out! Go die!
Stargazer flees deep into the desert, trying to shake off the ferocious "companions" shooting at her from behind.

speaker: Young Stargazer
content: ...Flower...? Is it true? I can gain freedom and companionship by coming to your side?
The small figure runs unfalteringly towards the Tide of Ashes and is swallowed up by the wind and sand.
When you leave Stargazer's memory, the Dreamflower is still standing quietly in front of you.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you trying to tell me through this memory that Stargazer is sick of humans, so she should be with you and follow you back to that... Realm of Truth?

speaker: Chief
content: If that's the case, why... did she respond me? Why... did she sing that song at the end?

speaker: Chief
content: This is why I came here to see you.

speaker: Chief
content: It's to tell you that she is asking me for help... that she still wants to stay in this world... and that she doesn't belong to you.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry that you've endured so much malice from mankind.

speaker: Chief
content: I was indeed angry when she chose to make use of my trust. But I knew that she respected you, and wanted to protect your consciousness.

speaker: Chief
content: But since she made me dream of you... and listen to that song at the end...

speaker: Chief
content: She still has some last yearnings for this world left in her.

speaker: Chief
content: I will work with her to get you back to the way you were... but... you can't take her.
From behind the Dreamflower, a figure walks calmly towards you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Happy? It's a reunion after a brief separation, little one.

speaker: Stargazer
content: That little injury by the power of the Dreamflower... it's nothing.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Moreover... I'm a Sinner.

speaker: Chief
content: Yes... you're a Sinner, so perhaps my shackles can help support your heart, and...
Stargazer chuckles and shakes her head.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Your shackles have already replaced the Dreamflower's heart as my heart.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I no longer need to rely on the power of the Dreamflower to survive.

speaker: Stargazer
content: You have bound me to your side forever... oh, what shall I do?
Stargazer gently twirls a strand of your hair and steps forward to kiss it.

speaker: Stargazer
content: From now on, this world of lies has two monsters.
Stargazer turned by the Dreamflower begins to dissolve bit by bit, gradually morphing back into a huge, lurid flower.
It sways and trembles, as if communicating with Stargazer.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Really? Yes, it's time to go... the passage to the Holy Realm has been waiting for you for a long time.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Me...? Oh... I will not give up my pursuit of truth, my dear companion.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I think, perhaps someday, I'll come with him... and meet you again.
female_content: I think, perhaps someday, I'll come with her... and meet you again.

content: The Dreamflower doesn't respond. It simply folds its petals and dissolves into specks of glittering light.
The starry sparkles dance in the air, cloaking you in light. They seem to want to take you somewhere...

speaker: Chief
content: This is... a sea of flowers?

speaker: Chief
content: I've seen...

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: You finally woke up!
Seeing that you've awakened, Kawa-kawa lets out a sigh of relief.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: This area has just been hit by an earthquake. Coupled with the collapse of the ruins, there are now quicksand zones everywhere.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Come with me now! Otherwise, when the ruins completely collapse, it will be almost impossible to move.
You help yourself up. You see Hella and Hecate by your side, but Stargazer is missing.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, who are you looking for?

speaker: Stargazer
content: Are you looking for me? I'm here to see you, little one.
You spin around the moment you hear that voice. Stargazer stands unscathed from the highest point of the sinking ruins, smiling and gazing down at you.

speaker: Stargazer
content: I didn't expect to be alive either. Maybe the heavens heard my prayer.
Stargazer seems to recall a certain scene and flashes an even brighter smile.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Little one, remember not to give out your heart so easily in the future. Beware of being tricked into foolishly sacrificing your life to save someone else... Not to mention someone who betrayed you.
"Betrayed"... If she hadn't brought it up, you almost forgot.

speaker: Chief
content: I didn't do it just to save you. The fact is, you used trickery to steal our crystals, regardless of what your motive is...

speaker: Chief
content: I have to take you back to MBCC for interrogations.
You get ready to cast your shackles. Suddenly, several sandworms leap up from beneath the sand.

speaker: Stargazer
content: Sorry, little one. I can't go with you yet.
The sandworms carry Stargazer towards the depths of the ruins at lightning speed. The countless plots of quicksand make it impossible for you to give chase.
You can only watch as she disappears into the vast WhiteSands.

speaker: Stargazer
content: "Someday, the stars will shine upon the high tower, and I will return to you."

speaker: Stargazer
content: “We will go together to the Realm of Truth.”

speaker: Black Screen
content:
In N.F. 112, the MBCC and Outland Affairs Bureau jointly completed WhiteSands' counter-bandit operation.
The mission report is as follows:
During the mission, the team encountered an S-Class Sinner, Stargazer. Unfortunately, she escaped.
When the team presented Quinn with a warrant to investigate Sinner Kawa-kawa, they were told that his current whereabouts are unknown.
The team discovered and neutralized the Dreamflower, a Mania source that can cause apocalyptic natural disasters.
...
The team successfully vanquished the rampaging desert bandits, recovering 83% of the Hypercubes that had been stolen in the past three months.
The Tide of Ashes has returned to its regular, low-level frequency. Trade in WhiteSands has gradually normalized.
The charges against Quinn's dealings with the Outlands have been temporarily dropped, but there is no guarantee that they will not resurface in the future.
...

speaker: Eirene
content: To think that I got all this by simply gifting a sand ship...
On top of the desk, several stacks of files lay out detailed information on the captured desert bandits, including Hypercube smuggling routes and channels, sources of goods, customer relations...

speaker: Eirene
content: And, there's even a windfall...
Eirene's fingertip glides across the face in the photo.

speaker: Eirene
content: Shackles? Interesting.

speaker: Eirene
content: Good job, V-710. I wonder if he'll be an interesting opponent...
female_content: Good job, V-710. I wonder if she'll be an interesting opponent...

content:
September 29, 9:20 PM
Eastside District 14 - Bar

speaker: Disheveled Middle-aged Man
content: ...Snore... ugh... pfff...
Deep at night, in one of Eastside's many bars, a man slumbers away on a long table, mumbling to himself...

speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
content: Hahahaha, out and about town in this condition? You're making a fool of yourself! Hey, wake up! Inspector! Didn't you receive an award on TV just last year?

speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
content: Pioneer of justice... Inspector of courage... Wholeheartedly serving the public... Hey, why don't you show us... just how noble you were back then? Hmm? Hahaha...

speaker: Icebreaker Douchebag
content: Hey, quit mocking him already. His wife ran away and his career went bust. Go comfort him, ahahaha!
The sluggish "inspector" gets pushed a few times, but he doesn't wake up.
The radio nearby begins to broadcast.

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: Hey hey! Thanks for tuning in to DeadLover Radio! Today, we're bringing you a jaw-dropping urban legend from across the Rust! That's right! From the dazzling, glamorous East-side...!

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: In wealthy, idyllic Eastside, where there is no Mania nor unrest, there have been recent sightings of weirdos known as the Sleepwalkers...

speaker: Inspector
content: ...Huh? Sleepwalk...?

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: These dazed Sleepwalkers are like walking oil wells, vomiting black goo as they walk. The goo they spew then turns into hideous monsters...

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: You can't burn them or beat them. The black goo will haunt you forever... They won't awaken or stop. The Sleepwalkers just spew black goo without end...

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: Listen... They're catching up with you... In the lovers' park, at the thronging markets, on the secluded path back home...

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: Hey... Control yourself. People are calling to complain.

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: Ahahah... In any case, if you've ever encountered "that sort of thing", give us a call right away! Love is looking forward to your fun... no, spectacular story!

speaker: DeadLover Radio
content: ——Buzz——Buzz——

speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
content: Hehe... Good show. Who knew there'd be such entertaining DJs in a dump like Syndicate.

speaker: Inspector
content: ...Sleepwalkers... My case... I have to crack this case...

speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
content: What a killjoy. What case? Just listen to the show! You were demoted last week. You're not an inspector anymore.

speaker: Inspector
content: I... I'm what?

speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
content: Oh, you're awake?...Argh!

speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
content: Argh!
Before he can finish, a punch lands square in his face. His head slams on the table, sending him into terrified silence.

speaker: Inspector
content: What did you say I am?

speaker: Icebreaker Douchebag
content: Hey, calm down, calm down.

speaker: Inspector
content: **** you... That's... That's my... Humph. MY case... Why aren't I allowed to investigate? I'm the incredible inspector... I... I'm going to crack the case... After I solve it, I...
