content: I'll immediately notify the FAC for a harm and mitigation analysis. The City Council keeps a tight grip over Eastside, but with enough bargaining chips, the FAC can also gain greater authority to act.
Roulecca's sobs still echo in your ears. How many more people will be ensnared by the supplier's Ambrosia as you wait? How many more hearts will break because of it...?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Ambrosia has already caused serious damage to your mind. Please consider your own safety first.
Serious damage? No. In fact, maybe it's just the opposite...
...The inspector is investigating the source of Ambrosia. Hella went with him.
Hecate emerges from the kitchen and hands you a warm drink.

speaker: Hecate
content: Before he went out, he taught me how to make this hangover drink. It's his wife's secret recipe. It'll make you feel better. You'll focus on the investigation better after drinking it and regaining your energy.
You're surprised to discover that he has a kind side, and gulp down the drink down gratefully.
Then, you retch from the inexplicable smell, sapping the last bit of energy out of you.

speaker: Hecate
content: He says the door is locked, and that forcibly breaking it would cause a lot of trouble. He wants you to patiently wait for him to return.

speaker: Hecate
content: If you're bored, there are lots of incident reports here. He says you can read whatever you like.
You have no choice but to surrender to their efforts.
You want to see more things, but a familiar voice is already outside the door.

speaker: Hella
content: You okay, old man? You lost the argument with me, and now your legs are failing, too? You agreed that the loser has to call the winner Daddy. Come on...

speaker: Hella
content: Call... me... Daddy...
Accompanied by a string of curses, Doyle slams open the door, his head wrapped in bandages. Both of you are startled when you see each other.

speaker: Doyle & You
content: You...

speaker: Doyle
content: You woke up, you little ****? Why not sleep till next year? Bug off and get some exercise. Your weak **** is dragging me down!

speaker: Hecate
content: He's really worried about you.
...When did Hecate learn to interpret like this? You no longer trust her gentle messages.

speaker: Choice
options: How did you get hurt so badly?

speaker: Doyle
content: Oh you... Don't make a fuss. I'm perfectly fine. That bastard Gandall just wanted to make me look funny.
He tears off the bandages and tosses you a bottle. When you open it, you are overwhelmed by the familiar sweet smell. You look closely, and see Ambrosia swirling inside the opaque bottle.

speaker: Doyle
content: This is what you got spiked with yesterday, right? I found it from the place, what was it called... Oh, "<color=#fb9259>Candi-bar</color>."

speaker: Doyle
content: This is Ambrosia. Remember, don't let anyone else... Hey, what the ****!
The three others panic upon seeing you take a swig of Ambrosia. Doyle slams down the bottle with one hand and slaps you on the head with the other.

speaker: Doyle
content: Have you lost your ******* mind? This thing will knock you out with one gulp. Who'll come wipe your *** if you start Sleepwalking again?
You smile, put the cap back on, and slip the bottle of Ambrosia into your coat pocket. You're trying to confirm one thing—just what kind of "damage" will Ambrosia cause you.

Actually, nothing. After gulping down Ambrosia, your memory is clear and your mind is coherent. You neither succumb to bewitching dreams nor vomit black goo. You just get a bit dizzy, and also a bit hungry.
Ambrosia cannot create a dream of your own, but it can share with you someone else's and drag you deep into their subconscious. How interesting, plus...

speaker: Doyle
content: Plus, I know where to find the Ambrosia supplier.

speaker: Choice
options: The purple-haired woman from the bar two nights ago?

speaker: Doyle
content: Oh? How did you know that?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She told me herself. I'm sure that place sells Ambrosia, and the staff there knows her. Roulecca also got her Ambrosia from her.

speaker: Doyle
content: Pfft... Just odds and ends here and there.

speaker: Doyle
content: Her name is <color=#fb9259>Mess</color>, and she's a self-proclaimed weaponsmith who makes and sells blades. She came to District 14 to sell Ambrosia just two weeks ago. She may not necessarily be the only supplier, but she has basically monopolized the market for affordable Ambrosia.

speaker: Doyle
content: Mess keeps moving her base around, but I've pinpointed her current location. Pack up and get ready to go. Let's not let her run away.
Doyle rummages through a few drawers before finally finding a pistol and tucking it into his belt. He goes on to look for something else, but suddenly freezes, his gaze fixing on a framed photo.

speaker: Hella
content: Wow! What a pretty girl! Who's that guy next to her? He looks familiar. He's no hottie, but he looks pretty smart and energetic!

speaker: Hella
content: Yeah, completely different from some grumpy old men we know. Why do you think that is, Doyle?
Hella really knows how to make a friend.
Doyle snatches the photo. He doesn't lose his temper. He just wipes the frame silently with his cuff, then stuffs it into the drawer half-covered. He then lowers his head and sneers at you.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...I let you review the files to get to know the case. I didn't permit you to touch anything else. Mind your hands.

speaker: Doyle
content: Go.
Three minutes later, Doyle opens the trunk of his beat-up car in front of you. You see a familiar face in the back seat, tied up and with a black eye.

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Sob... I'll tell you everything... I'll take you to Mess... Please don't hit me!

speaker: Hecate
content: Is this the waiter from that suspicious bar?

speaker: Doyle
content: Yeah. Vital clue. Watch and learn.

speaker: Choice
options: Truly an incredible inspector. A lot savvier than me.
Pffft, this is what you came up with?

speaker: Doyle
content: Great minds my ***! Quit bragging.

speaker: Doyle
content: Hmph. Remember, you have to take some liberties in an investigation!
You get slapped in the back of the head again.
He seems to be in a better mood. He asks the two Sinners to watch the "POW" in the backseat, and opens the driver's door himself.
Before taking the wheel, he seems to remember something. After a pause, he turns to you.

speaker: Doyle
content: Oh, that reminds me. What happened last night was similar to an old case I took on a few years ago. It has been deleted from the Public Security Bureau archives. I only remember a codename—<color=#fb9259>Marv</color>.

speaker: Doyle
content: This case was one of a series. The victim was addicted to a certain drink. He claimed it gave him happy dreams and helped him escape from suffering. He became more and more dependent on it... Sounds familiar?

speaker: Doyle
content: The man later got sapped dry by the "happy dreams." He had a mental breakdown while sleeping, and turned into a terrifying monster. He was handed over to the FAC and became a topic I'm "not supposed to ask about."

speaker: Doyle
content: It's been a few years since the incident. There's no proof that it has anything to do with this current incident, but my intuition tells me that "Sleepwalking" is by no means harmless.

speaker: Doyle
content: What I'm trying to say is... A newbie like you must be extra careful handling a case like this.
You freeze for a moment, not because you are scared, but because... Doyle is worried about you.
Compared to the cases you've handled, "Marv" is nothing out of the ordinary. But since the FAC censored it, ordinary people like Doyle should not get involved.
The streets of Eastside are prosperous and peaceful. Unlike in Syndicate, the people here lead normal lives. Mania isn't a part of their lives. Nor should it be a part of Doyle's.
If possible, you don't want to ruin his life.

speaker: Choice
options: You're right. Leave the rest to me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The investigation wouldn't have gone so smoothly without you. You're an Eastsider, yet you readily accepted me and the Sinners and gave us so much help. You have my gratitude.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But what's coming up next is a battle between Sinners. None of us can predict what will happen. I cannot guarantee your safety.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you get infected by Mania, you will be banished from Eastside forever even if you survive. I don't want this to happen.

speaker: Doyle
content: Hey newbie, I'm the inspector. It's my job to investigate. Don't think too much.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...What about her? Get in the car!
He gets in the car and slams the door somewhat angrily. You sigh, send out a secret help request to the 9th Agency, and get into the front passenger seat.
The roar of the engine is accompanied by a long silence. Only after passing countless traffic lights does Doyle speak again.

speaker: Doyle
content: Back when I was the "incredible inspector," I solved more cases in one month than the rest of the bureau for the whole year. I personally caught dozens of vicious scumbags and brought them to court.

speaker: Doyle
content: But what I truly got out of it was not some bullshit medal, or any sense of pride or justice.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...I got to see through the vile bastards behind each case. I got to see how rotten-to-the-core their souls were behind their human facades.

speaker: Doyle
content:
By comparison, your girls are model citizens. The worst they do is brag, slack off from studying, and run their mouths at me...
Haha... If I had kids, they'd probably be this rebellious, too.

speaker: Doyle
content: If something goes wrong in West District, you can blame it on Mania. But there is no Mania in Eastside. All the crimes I dealt with were committed by "normal people." The only things rotten were their souls.

speaker: Choice
options: The wicked are few, but you had to deal with them all.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You still uphold your duties and sense of justice even after witnessing so much evil, to the point that you're tormented by it. You are a good inspector and a respectable human being. You deserve a happy life.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...Haha. See, this is why you're a newbie. You don't know **** about people.

speaker: Doyle
content: What kind of a person is Doyle? A vain, emotionally out-of-control, tongue-tied, short-tempered ******* who everyone hates...

speaker: Doyle
content: Gandall is right. Being around scoundrels for too long made me a scoundrel myself. No one respects me, nor do I deserve any respect.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You should talk to a therapist, family member, friend, or anyone who loves you... You need counseling and support.

speaker: Doyle
content: Haha, well, I had someone like that. She was always by my side and gave me unconditional support. But I ruined everything with my own hands.

speaker: Doyle
content: I yelled at her and neglected her. All I did when I got home was lose my temper. I broke the vows I gave at my wedding and made her life terrible. Even on the day she left, I couldn't muster up a decent apology.

speaker: Choice
options: Then find her and apologize to her.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...No need. She was right to leave. It's all for the best, both for her and me.
His gaze changes from despair to conviction, laced with a suffocating stubbornness.

speaker: Doyle
content: People can't always make excuses for themselves. I screwed up, so I have to own up to it. I have to keep doing the only thing I'm good at: Being a good "inspector." Whenever I find a scumbag, I'll fight them to the end.

speaker: Hella
content: Pffft. Are you proud of that monologue?

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... Who's the one moaning on and on about his wife every time he drinks? So embarrassing. Aren't you too old to act like some lovesick teenager? I'm gonna retch. Blargh...

speaker: Doyle
content: Ahem. Cough. Kids should shut up when the adults are talking... Wait, hold on, I've got a message.
Doyle's phone lights up. He checks it purposefully to change the subject, but the moment he sees the screen, he freezes and slams on the brakes. Everyone in the car yelps in shock.
When the car comes to a full stop, you see him staring at his phone in shock. After making a few calls, his hands tremble and his face turns ashen.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...She was attacked by a Sleepwalker... She just got into the ICU. I can't get ahold of her, she...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are still many things you can do. Don't have any regrets.
Cursing violently, he grabs his gun out and stuffs it into your hand. Then he rams open the car door and rushes out. This is the first time you've seen him so passionate.

speaker: Doyle
content: Then, you guys go first! Call me if anything happens! I promise I'll be back! Call me anytime!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't come back. We can handle it on our own...
Doyle flags down a taxi on the road and leaves. You wave at him as you connect to a call from the 9th Agency.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Are you happy with our arrangement, Chief ${PlayerName}?

speaker: Choice
options: The inspector's wife isn't actually hurt, is she?

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Of course not. We asked a hospital to cooperate with us, then temporarily jammed the inspector's wife's communications. Everything's played out like a soap opera.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Fortunately, Inspector Doyle got so worried that he didn't notice any flaws... He won't be able to return in a short time.
...But hope Doyle doesn't skin you alive when he finds out the truth.

speaker: Choice
options: Thank you. In exchange, I have some special intel.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In addition to the suppliers who have been rounded up, I also discovered Ambrosia at another place—the Midsummer Night's Club. An "entertainer" tried to trick me into drinking it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She was employed by Quinn as well. Their president also knew of my identity in advance. If you are interested, you can go check up on her details.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: ...Haha, of course. We are always interested in intelligence about Quinn. It's a pleasure working with you.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Hope we are both successful in our endeavors.
You hang up. Speaking of which, that performer's "little trick" was quite interesting. You turn to the tied-up waiter, swishing the Ambrosia you got from Doyle.

speaker: Bar Staff
content: What... what are you going to do? I already brought you where you wanted to go! And I told you the place already!

speaker: Bar Staff
content: I'm just an ordinary guy! I have my life too, just like Doyle! I don't want to get involved with Sinners! You should let me go, too!

speaker: Choice
options: But I still need some help from you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Selling Ambrosia can either be a serious or petty crime. I can say a few good words on your behalf...

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Huh...? Sob... are you the devil...

October 3, 11:49 AM
Border of Districts 13, 14, 15 - Abandoned apartment
This is the first time you are participating in one of the Bureau's arrest operations. The Bureau's arrest team is already at the scene.

speaker: Hella
content: Wow! This is the first time I'm actually on the cops' side. I used to always get chased, but now I'm the one chasing others... How come I feel like a snitch?

speaker: Hella
content: Since we're doing this... ${PlayerName}, can you give me a Bureau uniform? I haven't tried out this style yet. It's pretty exciting!

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, be serious. We lack experience working with the arrest team, and we also face a lot of obstacles operating in Eastside. Our opponent is not weak.
Since Nightingale stayed behind to look after the Bureau, the captain of the city arrest team is in charge of the field. He comes over to report to you.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: We have completely surrounded the target area. There are many homeless people here, so we could not immediately pinpoint the target's precise location. She really excels at hiding her tracks.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: Chief, should we attack, or try to collect more intelligence?
According to Doyle's notes, "Mess" is an escape expert and a master of hiding. She might have set up an ambush or have accomplices. For ordinary arrest team members, Ambrosia is also a threat.
But you're also prepared. You're going to use a familiar "flexible" strategy that will neither tip her off nor waste this rare opportunity.

speaker: Bar Staff
content: ...Wh-what are you looking at me for? I did everything you asked me to. What else do you want?

speaker: Choice
options: I still need... A little bit of help from you...

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Y-you... No...!!

October 3, 7:00 PM
Border of Districts 13, 14, 15 - Abandoned apartment

Mess finally returns, humming a little tune. She still has the big patched bear on her back, and her purple braids sway from side to side as she skips. She is shocked when she sees the waiter squatting alone on the side of the street waiting for her.

speaker: Mess
content: ...How did you find me here? I never told you...

speaker: Bar Staff
content: I came here by myself... After your little scene last night, officials came and confiscated all the Ambrosia in our bar... The boss can't wait until the next delivery day...

speaker: Bar Staff
content: So... Can you, maybe sell us a bit of stock reserved for other buyers? I... I'll get you new games next time...

speaker: Mess
content: Sure, sure... Hey. That's what friends are for. Come with me!
She suddenly puts on a smile, wraps her arm around the waiter's neck, and leads him into the abandoned building. You and the Sinners follow them quietly from a distance.
After passing dust, gravel, broken furniture, and homeless people sprawled out on the ground, you finally arrive at a repair mezzanine.

speaker: Hecate
content: <size=30><color=#7683a2>There's no one else here. It's her private base.</size> </color>
You nod and brief the arrest team outside. They will act soon. Right now, everything is up to the waiter.

speaker: Mess
content: Sit. Don't be so nervous. I'll get you something nice to eat.

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Mmm...
Mess rummages through her messy wooden boxes, leaving the waiter to fidget by himself.

speaker: Mess
content: How did you find me here? I only moved here a few days ago, and I've been changing the pickup spot.

speaker: Mess
content: Ha... Were you following me?

speaker: Bar Staff
content: No, no... Actually, I...

speaker: Mess
content: You're not in love with me, are you?

speaker: Mess
content: Haha, I'm just messing with you. Don't be so nervous. Here's some water to drink and something to eat. Or wanna play a game? The game you gave me a while ago is really fun!

speaker: Hella
content: My, my. I'm starting to sympathize with that boy.
She gives him some water and cookies, and stares at him with mysterious eyes.

speaker: Mess
content: Actually, I just decided to move tonight because the cops got their eyes on this place, too. I really don't know who snitched on me... Sigh, I was just starting to like it here.

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Cough cough!

speaker: Mess
content: I made too much of a commotion last night. Sorry for getting you into trouble. As an apology, feel free to make yourself at home. Didn't you say you wanted to see my base?

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Mmm... Yeah... Mmm...

speaker: Mess
content: Haha, you're usually quite the silver-tongued talker. But now that you're actually in a girl's home, you can't even string a sentence together? What are you so nervous about?
She squats down in front of him and stares into his eyes as she caresses his head. The waiter instantly freezes.

speaker: Mess
content: Are you scared because you found out I'm a Sinner? Or is it because the three new friends outside bullied you?

speaker: Mess
content: Or maybe... You were the one who led them here in the first place?

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Ahhhhh, no!! Help me! I don't want to get killed by a Sinner!

speaker: Hella
content: What the...? that idiot spilled everything just like that?!
Mess bellows with laughter. She presses down on the waiter's face, muffling his screams. She then turns her head and stops the incoming Hella.

speaker: Mess
content: Do not come over! I just started to have some fun. Don't get in my way.

speaker: Hecate
content: Just give up. He has no value as a hostage. We don't care about him.

speaker: Mess
content: I care about him. He's my baby. I never viewed him as a hostage.
She walks behind him as she speaks, her hand still on his face, muffling his words. She rubs his frightened eyes playfully, as if she's enjoying the whole situation.

speaker: Mess
content: You said I'm your friend. You came to me pleading for stock, yet in the end, you stalked me, betrayed me, and stabbed me in the back. Let me guess why you're doing this...

speaker: Mess
content: You want to get rid of me as the middleman and take all the Ambrosia and cash for yourself, right?

speaker: Mess
content: You went to them on your own, right? Even though they beat you up, it's worth it to get rid of me, right?

speaker: Bar Staff
content: Mm! Mmmmm!!

speaker: Mess
content: Hahahahaha! Great job! I love villains like you! Evil yet dumb! You're really awesome!

speaker: Mess
content: Hand over all your malice!
A beam of powerful energy bursts from her palm. She pulls back her hand, extracting a mass of dark substance from him. The waiter lets out a scream, then slumps to the ground unconscious.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! You killed him?!

speaker: Mess
content: I'm not a villain. I don't kill people. It just took a little bit of spiritual energy from him.

speaker: Mess
content: Don't worry, malice is a renewable resource. Villains like him will recover quickly.
She admires the twisted substance in her hands. She speaks as if she's explaining something, but also talking to herself.

speaker: Mess
content: I knew that one day, you'd become its captive, get infected by its malice, and become its lackey...

speaker: Mess
content: I have to do my best. After all, I am the only one who dares to face it, and only I can forge a sword that can destroy it...
As she speaks, she takes out the cast of a sword and injects it with the black energy in her hand. The cast quickly turns red, melts, expands, and transforms into a long, golden-red sword.

speaker: Hecate
content: That weapon has become stronger! This Sinner's power is...

speaker: Mess
content: Forging of Malice.

speaker: Mess
content: I am the spirit-forger Mess. I extract malice from people's hearts to forge weapons. The evil thoughts of hurting others will become the power of this sword.
With one swing, the sword shatters half the wall, blocking the arrest team that had just arrived.
They are no match against this Sinner. You have to try your best to divert Mess's attention.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is this why you spread Ambrosia and collect "black goo"?

speaker: Mess
content: Yes, the "black goo" is a precious raw material for me. Though its purity isn't high, there's always something usable. Plus, I don't need to activate my power and set off the alarms when using Ambrosia.

speaker: Mess
content: Those who drink Ambrosia get sweet dreams, and I get the malice I need to forge swords. It's safe, environmentally friendly and it's a win-win for all. Isn't it wonderful?

speaker: Choice
options: You just claimed to be a reseller.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then who's your supplier? Who gave you the Ambrosia? Who made it? What's their goal?

speaker: Mess
content: Sigh, you're so boring. Ambrosia is just a tool. What I want is malice, so that I can forge a good sword to defeat that monster.

speaker: Mess
content: He's getting stronger and stronger. If no one stops him, all of mankind will be contaminated by malice, and the whole world will be destroyed...
You become vigilant. The spread of Ambrosia, the new strain of Mania, the strange zeal in Mess's eyes... You recall the 9th Agency's hints, and the "Marv" case recounted by Doyle...
Does all of this point to some great conspiracy?

speaker: Mess
content: Him? You don't know? You've never seen him?
Mess looks at you and smiles. Countless possible answers flash through your mind, each one making you sweat.

speaker: Mess
content: Hahaha, you know who he is. We all know. He is the source of all malice, the culprit who defiles people's hearts, and the most terrifying monster in the world...

speaker: Mess
content: <size=40><color=#fb9259>The Master Dreadlord</color></size>!

speaker: Mess
content: Only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness. Only sorcery can defeat sorcery.

speaker: Mess
content: Only with a sacred sword forged from malice can we defeat the source of all evil—the Great Dreadlord!

speaker: Mess
content: Oh, he has many. Draco, Satan, Diablo... Everyone knows him, but no one dares to call him by his name, so people gave him thousands of aliases.

speaker: Hella
content: These names all sound familiar...

speaker: Mess
content: Like... a dragon, a great big dragon... With ears like this, and a long, long tail... Oh, and he breathes fire! Let me see. Does he have three heads or just one...

speaker: Hella
content: Oh, I remember! It's the dumb monster from an old game EMP likes to play!

speaker: Mess
content: Hehe, tricking you? No, it's what I dedicated my life to! Unlike people like you who only know how to escape, I will forge a sacred sword strong enough to defeat it. I will destroy it with its own malice.

speaker: Mess
content: But this amount of malice isn't enough... Not enough to defeat it...
She looks at you with madness blazing in her eyes. Hecate and Hella immediately stand guard in front of you.

speaker: Mess
content: Are you just a boring nice guy? You drank so much Ambrosia but didn't spit out anything useful.

speaker: Mess
content: But those beside you are different. They are my kind.

speaker: Mess
content: If I did something to you, will your companions produce malice towards me?

speaker: Hella & Hecate
content:
In your ******* dreams!
Don't even think about coming close to him!
female_content:
In your ******* dreams!
Don't even think about coming close to her!

content: Mess cackles with laughter. She cuts the shelf next to her with her blade, sending the bottles and jars on it crashing to the ground. Berserk black goo spill out from the broken containers.
Hella and Hecate become instantly ensnared. Amidst the chaos, Mess disappears from your sight. When she reappears, she grabs you by the collar and pushes you against the wall.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!

speaker: Mess
content: Caught you for the second time... You really need to work out more.

speaker: Mess
content: What are you going to do to me? Are you going to kill me?

speaker: Choice
options: No. I have a surprise for you.

content: You take out the bottle of Ambrosia that Doyle gave you from your coat pocket and smash it to the ground. Blue mist spreads like flames, overwhelming both of you at the same time.

speaker: Mess
content: That smell... Ambrosia?!

speaker: Bartender
content: I know the trick you're talking about. It's an effervescent tablet that's quite popular recently. Throw a tablet into the water, seal it and shake it. Once you open it again, it will spray mist. Useful for startling people.

speaker: Bartender
content: Wait a minute... Why? You're not thinking of making me go buy some, are you?!

speaker: Mess
content: ...Cough, you... tricked me?! From the very beginning...

speaker: Choice
options: Just a gift in return for what you did a couple days ago.

content: Mess loosens her grip on your neck in panic. She scrambles to cover her mouth and nose, but it's too late.

speaker: Mess
content: Ha, you idiot... By doing this... You... can't... run... away... either...
You don't need to run away. You know where you'll be going.
Standing in the blue mist, you watch Mess collapse and close her eyes. Eerie music and distant roars echo in your ears. You recite the rules again:

<color=#fb9259>Shackles are rendered useless</color>, <color=#fb9259>the owner's subconscious creates everything</color>, <color=#fb9259>break the happiness created by Ambrosia to break the dream</color>... You are ready to enter Mess's dream.
All the questions she refuses to answer... All her crazy words that are true and false... You will find the answers to them in this dream that doesn't lie.
This is the subconscious world. Here, she won't lie. But as you think this, the scene that gradually unfolds before you makes you unable to believe your eyes.
A massive shadow obscures your view. It's so grotesque, so incongruous, that it seems to refute everything you know. It doesn't abide by the laws of reason...
Grrr... Grumble... Destroy...

speaker: Mess
content: Like... a dragon, a great big dragon... With ears like this, and a long, long tail... Oh, and he breathes fire! Let me see. Does he have three heads or just one...
Is this... the dragon? The monster before you is...

speaker: Roaring Dragon
content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!
The giant dragon opens his humongous, pixelated bloody mouth, and tries his best to repeat the 32nd performance:

speaker: Roaring Dragon
content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!

speaker: Roaring Dragon
content: I'll... destroy... Huh?!
You swing your fist, but even though you don't expend much strength, this behemoth gets knocked into the air. It hits a pitch-black gable and falls to the ground.
This paper-like "dragon" defies all your fears. You finally remember where you've seen this striking style—In a game from EMP's second-hand retro game console.
It's not surprising for a mischievous fun-seeker like Mess to have such a dream. But unlike Roulecca, she doesn't appear in her own dream.
No response. Instead, the dragon climbs up again, blocking your way. You can't find a way to beat it completely.

speaker: Roaring Dragon
content: Grrr... Grr... Destroy—arghhh!!
At that moment, an angelic light shines through the darkness. A tall figure strides forward, and a righteous voice fills the cartoonish cavern...
Stop, <color=#fb9259>Draco</color>—Don't hurt the villagers of Ladatom! Your true enemy is the Hero!
So it really is Draco... Villager? Is the voice talking about you? Is this jagged <color=#fb9259>Hero</color> going to save you from the claws of the paper-like Dreadlord?

speaker: Frightened Dragon
content: O Hero... Are you holding... the <color=#fb9259>Sacred Sword</color>?!
The Hero draws the sword from its sheath. The dazzling light instantly blinds your eyes.

speaker: Hero
content: The evil Dreadlord has awakened. He is spreading darkness and corrupting hearts. But justice will triumph, because the Sacred Sword that will defeat Draco is here...

speaker: Hero
content: This is the final battle! O Sacred Sword, stand by me to defeat the Dreadlord and save the world!

speaker: Frightened Dragon
content: Nooo...!!!
The weak but unbeatable dragon is finally defeated this time! Its body begins to break up as cartoonish music plays in the background. The cracks spread into the world, reaching you.
The only thing that is not torn apart by the light is the Sacred Sword and the Hero in the center of the light. Is this world going to be destroyed?!
Draco...　has been defeated!
<size=100>Level cleared!</size>
Replay game?
Replay game?
Replay game?
...Why are you so boring?
Here's another chance for you. Hurry up!
The game is about to restart!
The evil Dreadlord has awakened. He is spreading darkness and corrupting hearts. But justice will triumph, because the Sacred Sword that will defeat Draco is here...
<size=60>—Tap anywhere to start the game—</size>
Before you is an uninhabited village, drawn in the same rough, odd style. You are still in Mess's dream, in the "beautiful world" constructed by her subconscious.

The streets are deserted, and the village only has a few basic wooden signs. Though both Mess and Roulecca are mischievous kids, Mess's dream seems so basic and empty compared to the lively, cheerful seacoast of Roulecca's dream.
At that moment, a red headscarf sweeps into view. A tall figure strides forward, and a righteous voice fills the village streets...

speaker: Hero
content:
Go to Ladatom Village, find the Blacksmith, clear the Legend of the Sacred Sword, defeat the Dreadlord Draco...
Go to Ladatom Village, find the Blacksmith, clear the Legend of the Sacred Sword, defeat the Dreadlord Draco...

speaker: Hero
content: Huh? There's a hidden character in the second playthrough? Are you the village mayor? That's not mentioned in the mission manual.

speaker: Choice
options: It's me. O mighty Hero, are you looking for the Blacksmith?

speaker: Hero
content: Yeah! It's the main story mission! I'm going to get the Sacred Sword from the Blacksmith and defeat Draco!

speaker: Choice
options: Do you know where the Blacksmith is?

speaker: Hero
content: Yeah! The Blacksmith is a super cute girl who works su-per hard to forge weapons. Loud, sonorous clangs will lead me to her... The mission manual said so.

With that, he steps through the gate of the village. Sure enough, loud, sonorous clangs of <color=#fb9259>iron forging</color> can be heard from the depths of the village, and smoke can be seen rising from a distant chimney.

It seems that the main story mission's refresh requirement is for the Hero to enter the village. The character in front of you with the word <color=#fb9259>Hero</color> above his head is the <color=#fb9259>main character</color> of the game. He will push forward the development of this world.
Then...

speaker: Choice
options: O mighty Hero, the Blacksmith is not in the village.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She is being chased by Draco, and has fled to Lato, La... Lalala Forest. She asked me to deliver this message:

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Are you the famous Hero? I need your help!"

speaker: Hero
content: Huh? Is this a new mission? But you don't have an exclamation mark over your head... Could it be a hidden storyline? But the main story rewards are more enticing...

speaker: Choice
options: Complete this mission and get 1800 Hypercubes.
No more acting. Give me the title of the Hero.

speaker: Hero
content: I accept! O Blacksmith of Lalala Forest, I'm coming to save you...
The Hero rushes away like the wind. You turn around, cross the deserted streets towards the smoke and sound of iron-casting, and enter the only open blacksmith forge.
The clangs of iron forging are rhythmic and powerful. The flickering fire illuminates the various weapons hanging on the wall, as well as the half-meter clay dolls on the ground.

The clay dolls look distorted. It is impossible to tell what kind of creatures they're supposed to be. Only the texture of the pitch-black clay feels familiar. Some kinds of strong emotions seem to be sealed within them.

In their midst, you spot the "super cute" Blacksmith as described by the Hero. Her animation style is normal enough, but unlike the little prankster in the real world, this Mess seems like quite the slacker. She lifts her head and peers at you lazily.

speaker: Mess
content: Are you this playthrough's Hero?

speaker: Mess
content: ...I feel like something's missing. You look so unprofessional. Draco is quite strong. Are you sure you can handle him?

speaker: Choice
options: I've defeated Draco 32 times with my bare hands...

speaker: Mess
content: Quit bragging. Only the Sacred Sword can defeat Draco. It's common sense. You don't even know that? You're really...

speaker: Mess
content: Sigh, never mind. It doesn't matter who's the Hero. My Sacred Sword is what defeats Draco anyways. As long as you can pick up the <color=#fb9259>Sacred Sword</color>, then you are the Hero and my only companion.

speaker: Mess
content: Wait here. I'll cast the sword for you now.
She climbs a ladder to retrieve a glass bottle from the top shelf. The contents of the bottle shine radiantly. It's the all-too-familiar <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color> coveted by countless souls.

speaker: Mess
content: The raw materials for making a sword. The raw materials for making a Sacred Sword are even more special.
As she speaks, she picks up a clay doll and immerses it in the Ambrosia. Soon, the clay doll starts making strange noises. Black substance oozes from its surface. You realize that it's...
It's the black goo spewed out by Sleepwalkers!
Yet its appearance is only fleeting. The black goo quickly fades and turns into a beautiful golden fluid. Mess takes the flowing gold and begins hammering away.

speaker: Mess
content: Here you go. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.

speaker: Choice
options: I'll go fight the Dreadlord once you tell me the source of Ambrosia.

speaker: Mess
content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.
Her gaze freezes at this point, and your conversation enters into an endless loop. It seems that you can't get any new information without continuing the main story.

You have no choice but to accept the golden Sacred Sword. Though you don't sense any powers from it, you feel pulled in by some kind of force when you spot a row of light-colored triangular arrows on the ground.
You leave Mess's forge and the village, and return to the cavern.
The Dreadlord Draco is here. Having forgotten that you beat him 32 times, he slowly rises and props himself up with his huge wings.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can we try to get along? If the Sacred Sword accidentally slays you, the level will be cleared immediately. I don't want to end this playthrough.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is there any other way to advance the story? I just want Mess to be able to say something else. Can you fool her by playing dead?
Draco opens his huge pixelated bloody mouth and greets you with a warm reply...

speaker: Draco
content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!
Before he has a chance to react, you grab the "Hero" sign from his head and punch him in the noggin. The nameless dude yelps and falls unconscious to the ground.
Everything in this sweet dream is as weak as Draco. You place the "Hero" title over your own head.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All right. Let's go find the Blacksmith.
Satisfied, you return to the village, cross the deserted streets towards the smoke and sound of iron-casting, and enter the only open blacksmith forge.
The clangs of iron forging are rhythmic and powerful. The flickering fire illuminates the various weapons hanging on the wall, as well as the ugly, half-meter clay dolls on the ground.

The clay dolls look so hideously distorted that you find it impossible to tell what kind of creatures they're supposed to be. Only the texture of the pitch-black clay feels familiar. Some kinds of strong emotions seem to be sealed within them.
In their midst, you spot the "super cute" Blacksmith as described by the Hero. Her animation style is normal enough. When she sees you, or rather the "Hero" title above your head, she stops working.

speaker: Mess
content: Hero? You're so slow! Wait here. I'll cast the Sacred Sword for you so you can go defeat Draco right away.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do I have to fight the Dreadlord right away? I'm not ready yet.

speaker: Mess
content: That's fine. You don't need to prepare anything. My Sacred Sword is what defeats Draco anyways. All you have to do is swing it at the Dreadlord to defeat him.

speaker: Mess
content: The Sacred Sword has been born. The Dreadlord's death is near. This world is about to be saved.
She goes inside and fetches out a small iron container, the contents of which shine radiantly. Upon closer inspection, it's the all-too-familiar Ambrosia coveted by countless souls.

speaker: Mess
content: The raw materials for making a sword. The raw materials for making a Sacred Sword are even more special.

It's the black goo spewed out by Sleepwalkers!

speaker: Mess
content: Here you go. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.

speaker: Choice
options: I'll go fight the Dreadlord once you tell me the source of Ambrosia.

Draco opens his huge pixelated bloody mouth and greets you with a warm reply...

speaker: Draco
content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!

speaker: Defeated Draco
content: O Hero... So what you are holding is... the Sacred Sword?!

speaker: Defeated Draco
content: Nooo!!

speaker: Choice
options: No need to repeat your deathbed lines. I don't want to kill you.

content: You stick the Sacred Sword into the ground in front of him, then sit down before the huddled dragon.

This dream is far too hollow. The enclosed time and space, the flimsy little village, the ice-cold blacksmith forge, the preprogrammed Hero NPC, and the lonely spirit-forger who makes swords day in and day out.
There's no enchanting scenery, no heart-wrenching sentiment. Even the Blacksmith in the dream is different from the havoc-seeking Sinner Mess in real life.

speaker: Mess
content: I am the spirit-forger Mess. I extract malice from people's hearts to forge weapons. The evil thoughts of hurting others will become the power of this sword.
The key to understanding this world already lies in everything before you. The core of this dream is the endlessly repeating storyline, and the eternal slaying of Draco by the Sacred Sword.

speaker: Draco
content: You're not the Hero... What do you want?

speaker: Choice
options: I want to understand this world.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: To Mess... To the Blacksmith, what are you? What is the Sacred Sword? Why does her dream look like this?

speaker: Draco
content: Who is Mess... Who is the Blacksmith... Grrr... I don't care about them...

speaker: Draco
content: I am Draco, the ruler of darkness, the source of all evil. Everyone in this world fears me because I am the most powerful. I am unbeatable... I shall destroy everything...!
Mess is the only real "person" in this world. Does Mess think of him as the most powerful and unbeatable in her heart?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even without the Sacred Sword, I can tip you over with one finger.
Draco roars.

speaker: Draco
content: That's because my true power has been stolen! My ☐☐!

He roars, and some of his words turn into gibberish that you're not able to understand. Before you get the chance to ask what ☐☐ is, Draco is already bellowing as if his mouth is full of firecrackers.

speaker: Draco
content: I was originally the source of all ☐☐! I planted ☐☐ in people's hearts, and the ☐☐ became my strength! That's the way it should be!

speaker: Draco
content: But someone feared me for being powerful. She feared ☐☐, so this world stole my power! I don't have any ☐☐ anymore! And All the ☐☐ in this world has been taken away!

speaker: Mess
content: He is the source of all malice, the culprit who defiles people's hearts, and the most terrifying monster in the world...

speaker: Choice
options: Does ☐☐ mean the malice in people's hearts?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When you say ☐☐, do you mean the ☐☐ in people's hearts?
You realize your words have been censored after they leave your mouth. This world expels all "malice," or rather, Ambrosia expels all <color=#fb9259>malice</color>.
To create the perfect dream for Mess, it must expel everything that might upset her, which includes the concept of "malice." That's why Draco has lost his power, just like the Sacred Sword.

speaker: Mess
content: Only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness. Only sorcery can defeat sorcery.

speaker: Mess
content: Only with a sacred sword forged from malice can we defeat the source of all evil—the Great Dreadlord!
You stand up, pull out the shining golden Sacred Sword that's supposed to be invincible and save the world, and smash it hard onto the ground...
Snap!
The sword breaks and emits dazzling light, just like what happened to Draco the first time. It's not some great power, but just a super big lightbulb that the Ambrosia conjured up to please Mess.

speaker: Draco
content: Ahhh... You... Why?

speaker: Choice
options: I'm here to seek the truth, to find out how to advance the storyline.

content: Forging the Sacred Sword consumes Ambrosia, while the Sacred Sword itself can be destroyed. If the Blacksmith becomes unable to forge the Sacred Sword anymore...
Maybe the hidden mission will be activated, and the storyline will progress without clearing the level.
You return to Mess's blacksmith forge. Most everything is the same as before. The deserted shop, the ugly clay dolls... but the Ambrosia in the bottle looks a bit less than before.

speaker: Mess
content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.
She doesn't recite her set lines from the first encounter. In her eyes, the Hero is in possession of the Sacred Sword... but you plan to change all that.

speaker: Choice
options: O Blacksmith, the Sacred Sword is broken...

speaker: Mess
content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the... What did you say?!
As if suddenly electrocuted, she jumps up and shakes you by the collar.

speaker: Mess
content: That Sacred Sword was my flesh and blood! It was the key to defeating the Dreadlord! The Sacred Sword is invincible. How can it be broken?!

speaker: Mess
content: What kind of useless Hero are you?!

speaker: Choice
options: Maybe it was a glitch in the program.
Draco's too strong. He broke the Sacred Sword.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Without the Sacred Sword, I have no way to defeat Draco.

speaker: Mess
content: ...Sob... My poor Sacred Sword... Sob... You have to have the key item. I must forge another one for you. Wait here... Sob...

speaker: Mess
content: Here you go. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.

content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.
She doesn't recite her set lines from the first encounter. In her eyes, the Hero is in possession of the Sacred Sword... but you plan to change all that.

speaker: Choice
options: O Blacksmith, the Sacred Sword is broken...

speaker: Mess
content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the... What did you say?!
As if suddenly electrocuted, she jumps up and shakes you by the collar.

speaker: Mess
content: That Sacred Sword was my flesh and blood! It was the key to defeating the Dreadlord! The Sacred Sword is invincible. How can it be broken?!

speaker: Mess
content: What kind of useless Hero are you?!

speaker: Choice
options: Maybe it was a glitch in the program.
Draco's too strong. He broke the Sacred Sword.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Without the Sacred Sword, I have no way to defeat Draco.

speaker: Mess
content: ... My poor Sacred Sword... Sob... You have to have the key item. I must forge another one for you. Wait here... Sob...
She fetches the bottle of Ambrosia from the top shelf again, and repeats all the steps. After some more toil, she comes to you with a second Sacred Sword.

speaker: Mess
content: Here you go. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.
You smile and accept the Sacred Sword. After making sure the amount of Ambrosia in the glass bottle has lessened, you leave the forge and venture out of Mess's sight.
Snap!
When you came back this time, she didn't even have time to put away the Ambrosia. All she can do is stare blankly at you.

speaker: Choice
options: O Blacksmith, the Sacred Sword is broken...

speaker: Mess
content: ...My poor Sacred Sword!!!

speaker: Mess
content: Sob... My poor Sacred Sword...

This is the seventh time that Mess is forging the Sacred Sword for you. Her programming seems to have gotten used to your cycle of ill-intentioned actions. Even her complaints and sobs are coming out calmly.
The Ambrosia in the bottle is also dwindling, and will soon bottom out. You sit patiently next to her and watch her repeat the monotonous labor.
Only when she is forging can she escape from the preprogrammed lines and chat with you a bit.

speaker: Choice
options: You really like forging swords, huh?

speaker: Mess
content: Yeah. Humans are small and weak, but my weapons can make them strong and powerful.

speaker: Mess
content: I feel very accomplished when I arm someone small and weak to defeat the Great Dreadlord.

speaker: Choice
options: Why don't you go yourself, then?

speaker: Mess
content: Because I'm not the Hero. You are. Only the Hero can defeat Draco with the Sacred Sword.
You recall the complaints of the power-deprived Dreadlord.

speaker: Draco
content: But someone feared me for being powerful. She feared ☐☐, so this world stole my power! Without my ☐☐, all the ☐☐ in this world has been taken away!

speaker: Choice
options: Do you fear Draco? Are you afraid to face him?

speaker: Mess
content: Of course not! Sigh... I'm definitely not afraid of him. I just... want to fight him in my own way. Yeah!

speaker: Mess
content: Yes, I'm quite clear that I have to defeat him. Forging the Sacred Sword is my way of fighting.

speaker: Mess
content: You're the Hero. I forge the Sacred Sword for you. When you defeat Draco with the sword I forged, the victory is also mine.
Though Mess deserves a good beating in real life, she cannot lie in her subconscious world. At this moment, the young spirit-forger seems sincere and determined—adorable, even.

speaker: Choice
options: I've met someone who's a lot like you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She can extract ma... dark substance from people's hearts, and then turn it into spiritual energy to strengthen her weapons.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She says that only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness. To defeat her Dreadlord, she even picked up the enemy's sword. Defeating the Dreadlord with the Dreadlord's power is crazy, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But it looks like she's full of passion.

speaker: Mess
content: Are you implicitly criticizing me? Hmph! I'm full of passion when I'm working, too!

speaker: Mess
content: Enough. I'm crafting this sword for you, Hero. Come help!

You didn't expect such an invitation from her. You freeze for a moment, then take the bottle of Ambrosia from her hands with a smile. Like a blacksmith's apprentice, you help her pour it over the clay doll...
Then, with a shudder of your hands, you spill the remaining Ambrosia all over the floor.

speaker: Mess
content: Hey! I told you to pour it slowly! I didn't ask you to pour everything, you dumb Hero!
Smiling gleefully, you hold the empty bottle upside down.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do we do? The Ambrosia is all used up, but the sword hasn't been forged. Will someone come to replenish the supply?

speaker: Mess
content: Yeah, but...
The sky swiftly becomes dark. With a creak, the door to the back room opens. A woman drawn in the same jagged style walks out, but you still recognize her instantly.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Good evening, little Mess.
She turns around and walks towards you, but ignores you completely. She just gently stabilizes the glass bottle in your hand, as if you're just a table for putting things on.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: ...Come out, "Marv"...
As she calls out the name "Marv," the woman summons an empty crystal bottle. She tips it gently toward the container in your hand, as if pouring something invisible.
She then squeezes hard, and a powerful force stimulates the bottle in her hand. You hear a strange, bloodcurdling scream coming from inside the bottle.
At the same time, Ambrosia gradually condenses in the empty bottle. Shining radiantly, it slowly flows out and fills the glass container in your hand.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: There you go. Thanks to you, many more will be blessed with sweet dreams, happiness and smiles tonight. We all want to thank you, little Mess.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: I also look forward to the day you try Ambrosia yourself. Hope you can escape the dark night and embrace a sweet dream.
She bows to you gently like a curtain call. Blue smoke rises, and the woman disappears. The sky clears up again.

speaker: Mess
content: ...Hey!

speaker: Mess
content: Hehe, your eyes are about to pop out. Is she your type?

speaker: Mess
content: Too bad she's not real. She repeats the same set of lines every time she comes, like a puppet. She's just data, like all the other preprogrammed NPCs.
... She still remembers the concept of game programming.

You know very well that the woman is a hallucination constructed by Mess's subconscious. She's also Mess's supplier, the maker of Ambrosia, and someone who is involved with the "Marv" case. It doesn't seem that Mess likes her.
This dream has given you more than enough intelligence. You must return to reality and take action.

speaker: Mess
content: The sword is ready. Here, take it. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord Draco.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My Draco isn't here. Nor is this the world I need to say.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I need to go save my own world now.
Mess's eyes widen.

speaker: Mess
content: What nonsense are you talking about?! If you leave, who's gonna defeat Draco?

speaker: Choice
options: No one. He's not your vicious dragon either.

speaker: Mess
content: What?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come with me, Mess. I'll show you the truth about this world. Let's leave together.

speaker: Mess
content: Ahhhh how can you tie up the Blacksmith? Let go of me! I want to go back to Ladatom! I don't want to meet Draco...!
After wrestling with Mess for some time, you finally tie her up and take her to Draco's cavern on a wooden cart.
It's funny. In the real world, she can easily knock you to the ground, but here she can't defeat "you." Does she subconsciously view herself as someone weak because of her fear of Draco?
Still, when you force her to go meet Draco, she doesn't regard you as an enemy and tries to expel you from the dream like Roulecca did. She doesn't seem to dislike you that much.

speaker: Mess
content: You're not the Hero! You're just a big jerk!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's no Hero. This is your dream. You've always feared the Dreadlord of Darkness. The dream creates a Hero to face him on your behalf.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Here, there's no Sacred Sword. Nor is there Draco.
You stop the cart. Draco is right in front of you. It's been a few hours, and Draco has forgotten the shame of being beaten by you again. He has regained the confidence of the Great Dreadlord.

speaker: Draco
content: Roar... It's you again! And the Blacksmith who makes swords!

speaker: Draco
content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!

speaker: Mess
content: Ahhhhh Sacred Sword! Sacred Sword!! Where's the Sacred Sword?!

speaker: Choice
options: The Sacred Sword is in my hand.

speaker: Mess
content: O mighty Hero! Please, slay him! The Sacred Sword is in your hand! You can do it!!

speaker: Choice
options: Smash the Sacred Sword in front of her

speaker: Mess
content: Ahhhhhh my poor Sacred Sword! What are you doing, you stupid Hero?! I don't want to die with you! It's over! We're going to die!!

speaker: Choice
options: Defeat Draco with your bare hands

speaker: Draco
content: Arghhh...!

speaker: Mess
content:
Helpppp!
...Huh?

speaker: Mess
content: You just... Huh??

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's the 33rd time I defeated Draco with my bare hands, and the 7th time I smashed your invincible Sacred Sword.

speaker: Mess
content: ...Huh?

speaker: Mess
content: Is this... what the Hero is supposed to be like? Is this... the Hero's power?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm much weaker than you in real life, but I can easily break the Sacred Sword and slay the Dreadlord because they are even weaker than me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is this really the weapon you've devoted your entire life to forging? Is he really the enemy you need to fight with all your strength?

speaker: Mess
content: ...That's... so weird... It shouldn't be like this...

speaker: Choice
options: This is just a specious dream.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You said before that "Only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness." Likewise, only willpower seasoned by fear can become courage.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But Ambrosia filters out all your darkness and fears, weaving a sweet dream that is just a façade. This is a fake Sacred Sword slaying a fake dragon. It takes away the meaning of your sword-making.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you forge swords just to play this kind of childish game?

speaker: Mess
content: No... Of course not... The enemy I need to defeat can't be this weak...

speaker: Mess
content: It's the most terrifying monster in the world. Not only is it evil, but it also makes those around it evil... It brings malice to everyone...

speaker: Mess
content: The world wasn't this messed up before. People shouldn't be hurting others... It's all its fault...

Your words are starting to have their intended effect. Mess mumbles to herself with her head down. At the same time, the ground, the pillars, and even Draco's body start to show cracks. The world created by Ambrosia is collapsing.
But unlike in Roulecca's dream, terrifying black smoke pours out of Draco's body as the dream collapses. In this half-conscious half-dreaming state, the shocking black goo is remolding its body.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: I want weapons... The best weapons... I want them to disappear...

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Kill him, torture him, make him disappear, hehehe, come, give me weapons, help me...
This is malice... Is this the darkness in Mess's heart that had been kept out of the dream?

speaker: Draco
content: ...My strength... My strength is coming back to me... My malice... is back!!

speaker: Mess
content: Yes, this is more like it... The world isn't that innocent. Everyone wants to hurt others. Everyone has been corrupted by malice... This is the world I know...
You try to pull Mess behind you, but she shakes off your hand and steps forward.

speaker: Mess
content: There's no one by my side. No one is going to be my Hero... The real me has always been alone, fighting against Draco's malice all by myself. Hahaha...

speaker: Berserk Monster
content: Become my malice or perish! Your...

speaker: Mess
content: Hahahahaha!! I'm really incredible!!

Before Draco finishes roaring, the girl lets out a hysterical laugh. Her eyes are bright and her spirit is burning, it's as if she has been given a new life. She smacks Draco's forehead and slams it to the ground.

speaker: Mess
content: This is what I want to slay! This is the malice I want!
Blinding light emits from her palm. Mess extracts a huge amount of dark substance from between Draco's brows, forming a pitch-black sword.

speaker: Mess
content: There are no heroes in this world. I am my own Hero! I forge my own Sacred Sword!

speaker: Mess
content: I'm going to defeat you with your own malice!

speaker: Mess
content: Hahahaha! What kind of trash is Ambrosia? This is more like it! This is the hardship and pain I want!

speaker: *Pant*...
content: This is what makes victory sweet!
She laughs gleefully. The Sacred Sword in her hand shatters along with the dream, dissolving into dark smoke. From the smoke, you hear strange sounds.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Are you crying? You dare cry? Shut your mouth!

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: You useless, good-for-nothing imbecile! You shouldn't have been born!

speaker: Mess
content: What's wrong with you? Why do you look so stunned? Are you shocked by my true strength?

speaker: I can't lead them to where there are people... That would only get innocent people killed!!
content: Haha, isn't this kind of malice awesome? Don't I look dashing when fighting with it?

speaker: Mess
content: Even though it's a fake Dreadlord, it still feels satisfying enough. Come, let's celebrate! Let's take a selfie together.
The whispers from the smoke still pester her, but the girl flashes you a wide, odd and bright smile. Intrigued by the darkness, she coexists with the filth as if it's nothing.
Maybe she just wants to keep walking into the abyss alone after all of this is over...

speaker: Choice
options: Mess, come with me after you wake up.

speaker: Mess
content: ...Huh?

speaker: Mess
content: Why so cheesy all of a sudden? Didn't you just lie to me, bully me, and attack me for your own motives? I still remember how much you tricked me in the dream!

speaker: Choice
options: That was the past. Let's look to the future.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I like the swords you forge, and I like your courage.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come with me, little Hero. Let's go fight the Great Dreadlord together.

speaker: Mess
content: ...Hmph. So you didn't bully me on purpose. I thought you were a wolf in sheep's clothing. I wanted to uncover your evil intentions, but you turned out to be a goody two-shoes. How disappointing.

speaker: Choice
options: Sorry, I am just a goody two-shoes.
I mean, I guess I can be bad if you want me to.

content: She makes an exaggerated vomiting expression, thinks for a moment, then giggles.

speaker: Mess
content: But I liked the dream with you. Even though you're a goody two-shoes, you're the most fun goody two-shoes.

speaker: Choice
options: Let's go. The dream's over. Back to our world.

content: You stretch out your hand to Mess, who is surrounded by black smoke. She smiles and walks toward you...
Then, she suddenly stumbles.

speaker: Mess
content: Mmm! You are?
Radiant, transparent liquid seeps out from the cracks in the space, quickly soaking and ensnaring Mess's body. It's Ambrosia?!
A hand covers Mess's mouth from behind. A figure walks out from behind Mess, who passes out before getting a chance to struggle.
After the dream has shattered, you regain the power of the shackles. Your shackles shoot out towards the two, but instantly get dispelled upon touching the Ambrosia.
The figure becomes clearer, grasping the unconscious Mess from behind. To your shock, it's that soulless hallucination!

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: It wasn't easy for my friend to get here and find her sweet dreams. Could you... please leave us alone?

speaker: Choice
options: The dream has already ended. Why are you still...
Who are you? How come you can defy her will?

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Good evening, my dear. I'm the one who helped her create her dream. I'm the one who gave her happiness...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mess doesn't need false dreams. Her courage and strength lie in the real world. She yearns to face reality!

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Ha. How much of her reality do you know of to make this decision for her?

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content:
O dreamless one... You've never tasted a sweet dream, so you assume that no one else wants it, either...
You only have reality in your grasp, so you assert that everyone needs reality...

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: You truly are arrogant and cruel.
The ground beneath your feet suddenly splinters, and a huge force expels you from this world...

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Go back! If you don't want to stay, then never come back! Don't ruin the beautiful dreams I created for them!
Your consciousness gets practically hurled out of the dream, slamming heavily back into your body.
You awaken inside an MBCC rescue vehicle parked near Mess's base.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! You woke up pretty quickly this time. Seems like knocking your head worked.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, do you feel uncomfortable anywhere? I prepared some of Mr. Doyle's hangover drink...
You shake your head. To avoid Hecate's "miracle drink," you quickly get up to show that you're okay.
Maybe because you didn't directly consume too much Ambrosia, or maybe because your Ambrosia tolerance improved... Either way, you don't feel as terrible as the last time you were in a "dream."
The time is 9:57 PM on October 3rd... It has barely been 3 hours since the mission began.

speaker: Hecate
content: You mean that Sinner? The arrest team brought her back to the Bureau.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I'm sorry, Chief. I made this decision on my own.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Sinner Mess is in a highly unstable state. Soon after both of you ingested Ambrosia, she entered a deep Sleepwalking state, spewing huge amounts of extremely dangerous spiritual contamination.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Compared to S-666, the contamination from Sinner Mess is greater in volume, higher in concentration, and overall more aggressive and destructive. It's even more dangerous than herself. It took us a long time to bring the situation under control.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Because we didn't know when you'd wake up, I decided to take Mess to the Bureau for detainment first, then wait for you to cast your shackles on her when you return.
Is Mess's situation even worse than Roulecca's? Her dream was so empty, yet the negative spiritual energy she discharged was so powerful... What has that girl gone through?

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: How much of her reality do you know of to make this decision for her?
You close your eyes to filter out all your pointless, distracting thoughts. These aren't what you should be thinking about right now.

speaker: Nightingale
content: She hasn't woken up yet, but she is no longer Sleepwalking. Her physiological functions have returned to normal, and the contaminants discharged from her Sleepwalking state have also disappeared. She has been transferred to a regular ward for observation.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Don't worry. She's just in a deep sleep. Nothing out of the ordinary.
You let out a sigh of relief. Though the woman took away Mess's consciousness, at least the girl's Sleepwalking phase is over. You're confident that she won't get trapped again.

speaker: Choice
options: I'll be back to the scene to investigate. There are things I need to confirm.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I knew you'd say that.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Go ahead. The scene is the same as it was. We'll wait to hear from you.
You've already searched the entire room, and have learned everything you need to know. There are huge claw marks tearing apart the walls and floor near where you and Mess ingested Ambrosia.
This is the "black goo" that Mess spat out. It's what the silly dragon Draco should actually look like. You still know nothing about her battles and experiences in real life.
You only know that Mess chose to come back herself.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: I heard that you woke up, Chief.
female_content: I heard that you woke up, Ma'am.

content: What quick timing.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Mr. Doyle has already discovered the truth. He's really quite sharp. It took him no time at all to see through our little plan. He threw a huge tantrum, and demands to settle accounts with you.

options: Can you help me out with this? Or maybe transfer him away?

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Haha, no need. Inspector Doyle is highly productive. We acquired a lot of interesting information about Quinn from him.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: It's been a long time since I've seen him so motivated. I think the inspector regained his passion thanks to you.

You're surprised to hear this, but you also feel... comforted. If Doyle can get his life back together, then it's great news. As long as he is well-protected, he can lend you the wisdom of an incredible inspector.

speaker: Choice
options: Guess we have to seek help from the incredible inspector.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A decisive battle is coming soon. It's not something that can be settled by just dealing with a Sinner kid. Please update him with the latest intel. I still need to rely on his wisdom.
You update the 9th Agency on Mess's investigation results, and start writing an email to Doyle.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: What fruitful results... Sleepwalking has greatly increased among civilians recently. With this transaction record, the investigation can finally make a breakthrough. Thank you so much.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: As for your target, the woman who is Mess's supplier and the maker of Ambrosia... I guess we found some interesting info about her, too.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: The woman calls herself <color=#fb9259>Serpent</color>. She's a freelance entertainer and circus performer who is somewhat famous in Eastside's high-class salons.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Two weeks ago, she signed a contract with Quinn to perform regularly at the Midsummer Night's Club. We found nothing suspicious about this, nor did it trigger the Mania alarm.

speaker: Choice
options: But I'm certain she's a Sinner.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Either she's extremely careful, or someone powerful is protecting her.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: I think probably both. At least in this case, her employer is highly suspicious.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: That's right. The shadow of Outland capital has always lurked behind Quinn. Plus, they show a strong interest in the Hypercube industry. The Outland Affairs Bureau is keeping an eye on them for the security of our city-state.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: But Inspector Doyle discovered other interesting things... The M-value detection network in District 14 has been tampered with, and there is a hidden escape door near the Midsummer Night's Club.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Further investigation found that Miss Eirene, the President of Quinn and a rising star in Eastside's business world, privately met with multiples Sinners at the Midsummer Night's Club.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Perhaps she built the secret escape door to cover up her plan to exploit the Sinners. If I dare to make an even bolder guess, perhaps... she's a Sinner herself?

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Haha, I'm going off-topic. We need more evidence to confirm Quinn's actual involvement in this incident. But at least it is certain that Sinner Serpent is the mastermind behind this series of events.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: She accepted Quinn's employment offer and hid in the club to mask the M-value fluctuations of her powers when she made Ambrosia.

speaker: Choice
options: That's why she used Mess to spread Ambrosia out there.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: That's right. Sinner Mess brought Ambrosia to mass consumers, while the Midsummer Night's Club catered to Ambrosia's high-end clientele. If her direct motive is to spread Ambrosia and create Sleepwalkers...

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: The 9th Agency predicts that Serpent will do something big at the Midsummer Night's Club's opening ceremony two days from now.

speaker: Choice
options: Sounds like it'll be tough to handle.

content: You tell the 9th Agency about the information on <color=#fb9259>Marv</color>.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: ...If it's related to that serious case many years ago, then it makes matters even worse. We will contact the FAC as soon as possible to obtain the dossier.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: In this case, Inspector Doyle's experience is indispensable. He's the incredible inspector who had come into contact with the Marv case.
Ring ring...
A call comes in. You see that it's from Doyle.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Speak of the devil. Please answer it, but be prepared to get yelled at.
You really don't want to get yelled at by Doyle... You look at the phone and reluctantly pick up.

speaker: Doyle
content: Hey... Hey... Noms... You new... Don't do anything rash... Wait for me... Wait till I come back... I'll take you...

speaker: Doyle
content: Na... Nasha... I'm here... I'm... coming...
After a load of confusing drivel, you hear the call hang up.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: He called to yell at you?

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: My apologies. Apologize to him when it's all over. He'll forgive you.
...That crafty plan had been the 9th Agency's idea in the first place.
But Doyle's voice didn't sound angry on the phone. It even sounded a bit... sweet and nauseating. Maybe things are going unexpectedly well on his side, too.
Maybe your crafty plan unexpectedly... helped him?

speaker: Choice
options: Go meet up first. Better to talk about the plan details face-to-face.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll update the inspector on the intel first.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: All right. We will meet you soon to discuss the plan.

October 3, N.F. 112, 9:44 PM
Eastside - Doyle's home
Doyle lies on the sofa like a dead man. All the lights in the room are turned off. He checks the phone in his hand every few minutes.

13:59:12
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: I'm fine. I didn't message you.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Really? But the hospital contacted me and said you got into a car accident. I couldn't get ahold of you, either.
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: Maybe it was a prank.
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: My phone wasn't working for a while this afternoon. Focus on your work.
You've always... been busy.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: ...I'm glad you're okay.

14:04:22
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: ...Nasha, maybe you don't want to see me anymore, but I still want to tell you...
If you run into trouble, don't bear it alone. I'm always here for you.

16:27:42
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: Go back, Doyle. Move on.
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: We all need to move on.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...It's over. I should've known... I'm so stupid. What was I hoping for...

speaker: Doyle
content: Think about something else, Doyle... You're an inspector...
The phone vibrates again. He opens it glumly to take a look. The message isn't from Nasha, but from the rookie detective from the 9th Agency... Or rather, the mysterious MBCC Chief.

speaker: Doyle
content: You've the audacity to pop up after tricking me so bad...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Inspector, I discovered some interesting things. I'm reporting them to you right away, so please forgive me!

speaker: Doyle
content: ...What a hot-headed rookie. All right, then. I'm the senior one, after all.
In reality, he really needs this to distract himself. The inspector gradually immerses himself in the case again, forgetting the suffocating anguish just now.

speaker: Doyle
content: So it's related to the "Marv" case after all... This complicates things...

speaker: Doyle
content: The maker of Ambrosia can spy on the dreams of the Sleepwalkers, as well as separate and filter consciousness... What the heck does that mean? I want some more solid intelligence...

speaker: Doyle
content: Ah, here. A photo of the suspect. A performer for Quinn? Hehe, I was going to check out the company's latest hires anyway... Let's see who it is...
He opens the newly sent photo. The woman in it is smiling sweetly. Doyle freezes.

speaker: Doyle
content: So this is... Serpent? I've seen this woman...

speaker: Doyle
content: Not at the club, but at... that bar?!
His nerves immediately tense up, and his brain starts racing.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...According to that rookie's intel, she's extremely cautious and almost never leaves the club. She even conducts her Ambrosia sales through middlemen.

speaker: Doyle
content: Then why did she go out that night to somewhere so far away...?

speaker: Woman in Shadow
content: It's such a lovely evening. Why don't I cheer you up with something sweet? Here, my treat.

speaker: Doyle
content: She came specifically to find me and make me drink Ambrosia... She knew I was handling the case, so I was targeted...

speaker: Woman in Shadow
content: Even though there's only a bit left, I promise you'll like it...

speaker: Doyle
content: But she controlled the dosage to ensure that I don't Sleepwalk... She wanted me to remain conscious... Why...

speaker: MBCC Chief
content: The maker of Ambrosia can spy on the dreams of the Sleepwalkers.
He immediately stops reading any more messages from the MBCC and shuts his phone. An indescribable chill grips him. He'd forget everything if he could, or at least knock himself out.
Not only can she spy on dreams, but everything that Ambrosia touches! This woman has been spying on the authorities through the eyes of the "incredible inspector" Doyle himself!
She knows everything. Fighting her is futile. The sly vixen has already prepared for it. ${PlayerName}'s plan will become a trap for themselves. They must be notified right away...

speaker: Doyle
content: There's no time. I have to leave a message, quick... ****, we don't have any shared secret signals or codewords... Ugh, that won't work anyways. She'll deal with that too.
The woman is coming. She knows that Doyle knows everything. She won't spare him.

speaker: Doyle
content: Phone... Phone phone phone...
He dials ${PlayerName}'s number as quickly as he can.

speaker: Telephone
content: ...The number you are dialing is busy. Please wait and try again...

speaker: Doyle
content: ****! A message! A note! Anything, and...

speaker: Doyle
content: My gun! Where's my gun?!
He wants to leave a clue that he was attacked, so that ${PlayerName} can take it as a warning. But Doyle had given his gun to ${PlayerName} before rushing off to find Nasha.
As he frenziedly taps into his messaging app to send a voice message, his phone vibrates. A new message notification appears at the top of the screen. Sender: "Nasha."
Doyle feels his whole body freeze.
As the voice message prompt continues to repeat itself, he taps the notification with a trembling finger to check the message.

22:26:25
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: You're always like this... Stop thinking about work. Think about me.
The light shines through the glass window, illuminating a ring suspended in the air, and the silhouette of the woman swaying inside it.
Doyle stiffens and turns around slowly, this is the second time he saw her. She was holding Nasha's phone with a sweet smile on her face.

speaker: Serpent
content: I came to see you, darling.

speaker: MBCC Chief
content: Inspector?

The blue-haired girl gently hugs the inspector, who vomits black goo and falls into a deep sleep. She picks up the phone, holds it to his mouth to deliver his last words, then gently presses the end call button.

speaker: Serpent
content: ...Now, enjoy your sweet dream.

speaker: Serpent
content: You don't have to be sad anymore...

October 4, N.F. 112, 9:00 PM
MBCC Command Center

speaker: Nightingale
content: A Mania crisis has broken out at the Midsummer Night's Club! All surveillance points have gone silent! The M-value range has expanded, affecting 33% of District 14. Mania crisis level: B+... A... A+... It's still increasing!

speaker: Nightingale
content: What's happening at the scene?!

speaker: Nightingale
content: This M-value... It's an S-Class Sinner energy crisis...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief ${PlayerName}!

October 4, N.F. 112, 8:23 PM
Eastside - Midsummer Night's Club

It happened in an instant. Before the impact, you and the 9th Agency agent were still observing the situation at the surveillance point outside the Midsummer Night's Club. The investigation team was on standby nearby. The operation had not yet started, and the streets were teeming with people.
