content: I'm here.
Labyrinth breaks the silence, calling out the light blue guide.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Question. Is there a mistake in the museum map?

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Enfer designed the map herself. There can't be anything wrong with it.

speaker: Sasha
content: Huh...? By the way, do you know where all the people went?

speaker: Sasha
content: That Enfer said there are many people here, but I haven't seen any other living person!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Presume. The visitors, have turned into Corruptors.

speaker: Sasha
content: Ahhhhh... No way?!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Joke, that was. There's no trace, of any humans here.

speaker: Hecate
content: They must be trapped somewhere... Or, like Ambrosia... they are unconscious.

speaker: Sasha
content: Huh? The drink that used to be all the rage in Eastside? I remember it just disappeared one day. What was up with that?
As if finding something valuable, Sasha excitedly approaches the two Sinners.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...No, no, it's not something you should know.

speaker: Sasha
content: Tsk, boring. You Sinners, can't you tell me something interesting...? Nothing I've filmed so far is viral material...

speaker: Sasha
content: And... Are we going the wrong way again?
Looking at the familiar dead end, the livestreamer voices her doubts.

speaker: His breath hitches, then turns to ragged panting. With a surge of fury, he hurls the papers aside, seizes Jabara by the collar, and hauls him violently to his feet.
content: Answer, yes. And this is the 12th time.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...My ability is disturbed, and even the Nightmare can't see the real path.
The spiral corridor is like an endless maze, trapping the group in this section. And the howling of Corruptors is still messing with Hecate's thoughts.
Even with the navigator, the team still struggles to move through the museum.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Proposal. How about letting the excellent tool, Labyrinth, lead the way?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: At least, it won't make everyone, so anxious.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'll trust the <color=#fb9259>robot</color> once, but only this once.
Hecate backs down. Finding the Chief is her most important goal, after all.

speaker: Wait, wait! Let me explain! These are old, I swear! Nothing since that day! My dealings with DisCity ended then, I promise!
content: No, you should trust <color=#fb9259>tools</color>.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: A tool has no feelings and will not be swayed by emotional thinking. We only follow... data.
With that, the team comes to a fork in the road again.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Analyzing. In the previous 12 attempts, a pattern is suspected for this type of fork in the road.
Data streams flow through Labyrinth's pupils, showing her calculating.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: There is an 83.3% probability of meeting a dead end on the side with the marker, and... the marker seems to be luring people in.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: So, the side without the marker should be chosen.
Completing her analysis, Labyrinth starts to stride forward.

speaker: Sasha
content: Woah! You are right!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Proud. As a tool, Labyrinth, is more outstanding.

speaker: Sasha
content: But what the hell is going on with these monsters... Ahhhh!
The situation inside the museum is too complicated. Even with Labyrinth's calculations, they still inevitably run into monsters.

speaker: Sasha
content: Hey... Everyone!

speaker: Sasha
content: My name is Sasha, and I'm exploring the museum accompanied by two mighty... Sinners!

speaker: Sasha
content: But for various reasons, they are having a hard time finding the way ahead.

speaker: Sasha
content: Dear audience, let's cheer for them. Type 1 to wish for them to find the way forward, and type 2 to wish for them to get lost a little longer...

speaker: Sasha
content: Let's see... Which side has more people?

speaker: Sasha
content: Uh... Hey... What are you doing?!
Hecate and the Nightmare walk together toward Sasha, and the sudden move scares her so much that she's losing grip on her selfie stick.
But she only passes Sasha and toward the real target of her conversation behind, Labyrinth.
Looking at the maid examining the surroundings with a carefree expression, Hecate's face slightly changes.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Proud. You can't control your feelings and have repeatedly made irrational judgments.
Not surprised to see Hecate approaching her, Labyrinth continues her statement.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Without Master, you can't even carry out the instructions successfully, and are not half as good as who you call a "robot."

speaker: Hecate
content: ...The old me would think that too. But it doesn't matter anymore.

speaker: Hecate
content: In the illusory realm, the Chief saved me with his feelings.
female_content: In the illusory realm, the Chief saved me with her feelings.

speaker: Hecate
content: My feelings are not redundant, and I will protect the Chief.

speaker: Hecate
content: If you see this rescue as only instructions... Be quiet and find your Master.

speaker: Sasha
content: Oh? Are there actually robot Sinners? And she doesn't have feelings...

speaker: Sasha
content: So that's why she said "tool"... This makes it interesting!

speaker: Sasha
content: And... it's strange! I never thought Sinners would argue with each other... I wonder if others will be interested in this.
Looking at Sasha, who's actually excited that they're fighting. Labyrinth sighs. This is not the "efficiency" she wants.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Agreed. If this is what you think of me, I shall complete the mission as soon as I can so we can part ways.
Hecate doesn't respond to Labyrinth's words and walks off.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Repeat. The redundant feelings will bring you harm.

speaker: Sasha
content: Hey... Why are you both so quiet?

speaker: Sasha
content: Was that a real fight?
Nobody answers her. The Sinners walk forward in silence, leaving Sasha behind.

speaker: Sasha
content: Huh? Why?! This is so boring... even more boring than before...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Attempt failed. The 31st attempt.
Walking behind her, Hecate also marks the wrong route in her sketchbook.

speaker: Sasha
content: Hey!!! This painting... looks really strange!
Walking in the front, Sasha examines a blank painting and waves to the two behind her.
Hecate just glances at her and continues on her way. Finding the Chief as soon as possible is the most important thing to her.
Until Labyrinth walks past that painting.
The blank painting suddenly seems to come alive and starts painting itself.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Confused. Is this an AI painting?
Labyrinth looks at the finished painting with a puzzled look. It's a portrait of a cat and its owner and what looks like robot parts in shadowy corners.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: This is titled Loss.
Enfer's voice starts talking as if answering Labyrinth's question or referring to something else.
Labyrinth pays little attention to the navigator. She just wants to get the mission done as soon as possible.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Now, Master is still waiting for me. A.I. Maid III will follow instructions. Unless, the mission target is confirmed dead.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: What a heartless robot.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Don't you think?
With a sigh from the AI, the painting begins to change.
Meow—
The cat's purring stops Labyrinth in her tracks, but... she doesn't know why herself.
Meow—
Labyrinth turns around and witnesses something impossible...
A cat is struggling to climb out of the painting.
The scene should feel incredibly strange... but it's weirdly familiar to her.
It was a night... a night when she lost everything.

speaker: Sasha
content: Hey! What are you looking at? The painting?

speaker: Sasha
content: Oh, the kitten is so adorable! Look at how soft and cuddly it looks...
The scene is too interesting for Sasha to miss, and she darts in with her selfie stick raised.

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't touch it!
Unfortunately, Sasha's hand is quicker. As she touches the painting, a dense black mist erupts.
Broken people, crazed cat, and crippled robot... They burrow out of the painting one by one, making their way to the team.
Pulses suddenly keep coming from deep within the art museum.

speaker: Hecate
content: This painting... the strong power... Why...

speaker: Hecate
content: Like... it's reading my soul...
They're dead, they're dead, they're dead, they're dead...
Hecate covers her forehead in pain.
Give up... Give up... You can't...

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: It's a painting of fear. It will awaken the fear in people's hearts.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: This painting calls for the fear of losing where one belongs. Everyone... sees different things.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Like... she does.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Battle mode... Battle mode... Battle mode...

speaker: Hecate
content: Labyrinth! What's the matter with you?!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...! Did the painting...
The shadows are all defeated, but the museum doesn't return to normal as expected.
Instead, it becomes more violent.
A tiny sound crawls into Labyrinth's mind.
Only a tiny one.
You're here.
I thought that you had forgotten about me long ago.
Haha... You can actually remember that name?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Mary... Mary?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Who... are you? And who... am I?
Scenes start flashing in Labyrinth's mind.
There was a pleasant aroma in the restaurant in the afternoon.
Gang, chaos, fights, fear, mobs.
Didn't have the time to act... or apologize.
Because of her, yes, it was all because of her.

speaker: Mary
content: You're... a liar who has forgotten everything, a liar who can't keep her word, Labyrinth.

speaker: Mary
content: It's been a long time, so I'll give you one more chance... if you destroy all the enemies here.

speaker: Mary
content: This is an order from your master... Mary.

speaker: Hecate
content: There's no Mary here... Wake up!
Bearing with her headache, Hecate tries to approach Labyrinth.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Preparing to activate, preparing to activate.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Battle mode activated.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Not enough... Not enough at all...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Not enough to destroy them, not at all.
Labyrinth's body crackles as her Sinner energy surges uncontrollably.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Preparing to switch to overload mode, preparing to switch to overload mode.

speaker: Sasha
content: Woah, so sick! This is what a Sinner should look like! She's glowing red all over!

speaker: Hecate
content: Get out of the way!
The Nightmare pushes Sasha away and takes several solid hits from Labyrinth.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Eliminate... Eliminate... Eliminate all Mary's enemies.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I won't let you people hurt Mary anymore!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: It's my responsibility... to protect Mary!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Overload mode activated!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Ah! Ahhhhh... Ah!

speaker: Hecate
content: Labyrinth, stop!

speaker: Hecate
content: I am Hecate! I am on your side!
Labyrinth turns her entire body into a weapon, attacking everything in front of her.
Paintings, monsters, and people.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I won't let anyone near you again... ever...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I will clean up... Clean up all evil people in this world!

speaker: Hecate
content: She can't hear me. I need to stop her first.

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare, attack from the front and upset her balance.
The dark Nightmare dashes forward, intending to knock Labyrinth off her feet.
Thud!
The plan doesn't work. Labyrinth's power has surged with the overload mode, and she blocks the Nightmare.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Another filthy creature... time to clean up...
The blades on her arms are incredibly sharp, and she makes several attacks on the Nightmare within seconds.
And the Nightmare can barely keep up with her.

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare, get back here!
The situation takes a direct turn for the worse. Hecate can only order the Nightmare to retreat and wait for the next opportunity to attack.
After all, Labyrinth sees everything in sight as her enemies, not just Hecate.

speaker: Sasha
content: Is... Is there something wrong with her?

speaker: Sasha
content: And there are more monsters here...

speaker: Hecate
content: It's time for you to leave. This fight is only for Sinners.

speaker: Sasha
content: No... No! If I leave now, all I've done before will be in vain!

speaker: Hecate
content: You will die.
Sasha clings to her equipment and tries to calm herself down. But from her whitening knuckles, it's clear that she's approaching her limit.

speaker: Sasha
content: No... No... I want to be popular, I want followers! I want people to watch my videos, and now is the best chance! I can't go now, I can't!

speaker: Sasha
content: You're... You're a Sinner... You will protect me, right?!
Sasha trembles, and the strange painting is pulling her in little by little.

speaker: Sasha
content: Something is... pulling me...

speaker: Sasha
content: Help me... Help...!

speaker: Hecate
content: No, Nightmare, pull her back!
The Nightmare rushes toward Sasha with all its strength.

speaker: Sasha
content: Ahhh...
Sasha reaches out, but she's pulled into the painting the next second, leaving a long wail. The Nightmare isn't fast enough.
As if having gulped down a delicious offering, it gets louder in the museum, and the Corruptors seem more agitated.
Hecate looks around. She finally realizes why so many visitors are missing.
What shocks her even more is how many people have been turned into paintings because of their fear.
But she doesn't have time to dwell on the shocking realization. Labyrinth is what she should be worried about.

speaker: Hecate
content: What... should I do... ${PlayerName}, how do I stop a robot?

speaker: Hecate
content: This looks like... a malfunctioning program... but I have no experience repairing robots.

speaker: Hecate
content: If only... Chief were here...

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Is this really a malfunctioning program?

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Only humans can have such pure and strong feelings.

speaker: Hecate
content: She is... human. She's a... Sinner.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: <color=#fb9259>Human</color>? There is a complete human nervous system in my body. Is this considered human?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I don't know.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I am curious. You and I are very similar. Are you waiting for commands too?

speaker: Hecate
content: We are different.

speaker: Hecate
content: What if... we are the same? What if her feelings are just restrained like mine were...
Hecate falls silent. She tries to understand Labyrinth's feelings.
She must have lost the person... called <color=#fb9259>Mary</color>. Was that someone important to her?
Like the Chief is to her?
If she were to lose the Chief, would she be the same as Labyrinth?

speaker: Hecate
content: Maybe... this is not an overload... She's just sad and not familiar with the feeling, but I am!
She summons the Nightmare and starts moving without hesitation.

speaker: Hecate
content: Labyrinth is reliving her fear... of losing someone important to her.
Hecate clenches her fists and feels as if the Chief were at her side.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm going to use reality... to break down the fear that surrounds her.

speaker: Hecate
content: With what we, you and me, cherish the most and don't want to lose.
Hecate mumbles a name and reaches out to Labyrinth.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Ahhhhhhh...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Ahhh...

speaker: Mary
content: You said you would always protect me.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Yes, I did... I said that.

speaker: Mary
content: You said you would always make me delicious food.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Yes, I did... I said that.

speaker: Mary
content: You said we were going to run the restaurant here.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: That's right... That's right...

speaker: Mary
content: You... have failed again. Even here, you can't do it.

speaker: Mary
content: But... Thank you, Labyrinth.

speaker: Mary
content: Thank you... for protecting me... one last time...
The dark shadow fades away, and her words drift away in the air.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: It's all my fault. It's all my fault. I'm not powerful enough. I couldn't protect you...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I'm a useless robot. I'm a useless maid.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I can't even do... this.

speaker: Hecate
content: No, you're really great.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: You are...
Labyrinth looks at the person in front of her and seems to be searching through her memories.

speaker: Hecate
content: You have protected your current master well.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: But, I...

speaker: Hecate
content: We need to move forward together.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: No, no! The Chief... He is in danger! I can't lose someone important again!
female_content: No, no! The Chief... She is in danger! I can't lose someone important again!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: It was hard enough to lose Mary! I don't want to lose the Chief!

speaker: Hecate
content: The Chief is really tough. He must be waiting for us.
female_content: The Chief is really tough. She must be waiting for us.

speaker: Hecate
content: Trust your master one more time.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Can I...? Do I... still have a chance...?
Hecate holds the cat up and puts it in Labyrinth's arms.

speaker: Hecate
content: There will be a chance. Definitely.
The cat in the painting seems to agree with Hecate.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Phew, feels like I had a long and embarrassing dream.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: But, I don't think anyone remembers it.

speaker: Hecate
content: If possible, I don't want to remember it either...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Hehe, it's the connection between excellent tools.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Warning. Do not tell other Sinners. And do not talk about it with the Chief.

speaker: Hecate
content: I promise you.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Brilliant. Brilliant.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: I didn't expect you to overcome your weakness so quickly. You're good.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Mutations are coming from the Gate of Hell ahead. It will project the fear within you guys.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Be careful not to become its captive if you want to move forward.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Do you still want to move forward?

speaker: Labyrinth & Hecate
content: Yes, the Chief must be there.
A magnificent sculpture, or rather, a dark gate, shows up before the Sinners. It seems bottomless and leads to another world.
The gateposts on either side are carved with people struggling in pain. The way to the abyss is crowded with them, wailing and crying out in fear.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: <color=#fb9259>The Gate of Hell</color>. It was Enfer's most famous work in her early years.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Born in N.F. 109, it was the beginning of the sculptor's transitions. Enfer began to search for a unique artistic style.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: And according to more widely circulated rumors, the Gate of Hell reflects the deepest fear within everyone's heart.
Something is rampaging before the Gate of Hell. Its face is blurred, but the halo around its head shows that it's anything but human. It must be another phantom born during the bizarre night.
But its shape is unmistakably familiar, ad the red light flashing on its hand—shackles. It's the power unique to that person.
...Surrender...
Surrender... to the shackles...

speaker: Lisa
content: Another phantom of fear. Even the Gate of Hell has been affected by the mutation...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Shackles? But that's no human. He's not Labyrinth's Master.
female_content: Shackles? But that's no human. She's not Labyrinth's Master.

content: The Gate of Hell's commotion draws all Sinners here, leading to an unexpected reunion.

speaker: Hella
content: What took you guys so long?! Where have you been all this time?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Keep your voice down. You're attracting the attention of the enemy.

speaker: Lisa
content: Geez... The brainless creatures I was hoping not to run into.

speaker: EMP
content: Look ahead! Look ahead!!
Surrender to me!!!
There's no time to revel in the joy of the reunion. Something shoots down from the sky, cracking the ground. For the first time, they are attacked by the shackles!

speaker: EMP
content: Ahhhh, help! Chief, stop this. It's me, EMP! Ah!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Keep your head clear. That's not the Chief. It's just a phantom born from fear.

speaker: Hella
content: What fear phantom? Which one of you idiots is scared again? Who is afraid of that numbnut?!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Scan complete. Master is nearby, but there is too much obstruction. Clean-up mode immediately activated, set at highest tier three.

speaker: Lisa
content: These are artworks, and your shorted-out processor is the most significant obstruction... Stop it!

speaker: EMP
content: The next attack is coming... Chief!! Help!!!
Don't be afraid! That's not something you should fear!

A powerful energy bursts out of the darkness, repelling the raging <color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>. It's also the shackles, but instead of the constricting force that overwhelmed them, it feels warm and familiar.
A familiar figure emerges from the darkness on the other side of the corridor, with redness burning in his hands.
female_content: A familiar figure emerges from the darkness on the other side of the corridor, with redness burning in her hands.

speaker: Hecate & Hella
content:
Chief!
What took you so long?!
...It has been a while indeed. Seeing them again, you unconsciously start to smile.

options: I've been waiting for you too.
The protagonist always shows up at final critical moments.

content: The fear vanishes, and the shackles finally return to the Sinners.

speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
content: Shackles... Shackles...

speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
content: You know... nothing yet...
Before the remaining phantom finishes, Hella swings her pipe and breaks it apart.

speaker: Hella
content: A mere impostor, and you want me, Hella, to be scared?! I'm not even afraid of the real thing!
She turns to you and surveys you as if making sure you're real. It takes a while before she pounces on you with a scream.

speaker: Hella
content: You troublemaking ************! I'm so angry! Don't ever run off without me again!
She taps your head and whines. At that moment, a yellow-haired girl charges at you and hugs your waist.

speaker: EMP
content: Oh—Ch—ief...!!!

speaker: EMP
content: I'm so glad you're fine, do you know how worried I was, don't run off again, I'll protect you, don't leave me again ahhhhhh!!!

speaker: Lisa
content: Hmph, her mouth is the first part of her that recovers. This would have been much easier if the Archer Queen's arrows were as powerful as her words.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Sigh. It doesn't matter. What matters is that Master is not hurt.
She walks up and takes your hand. Her cold mechanical body is actually trembling, and there's a rare warmth in her tone.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Thank you. You're still here...
What happened to the artificial maid? You are about to ask when you look up and see Hecate's smiling face.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, it's time for us to get on board.

options: ...Thank you for coming to get me.

content: What a touching reunion, but don't forget that the Witching Hour isn't over yet.
Don't stay too long near the Gate of Hell. It's dangerous...

speaker: Lisa
content: The voice... Are you...?
A woman comes from the darkness with a delicate hammer. She swings it at the dark Gate of Hell...
The gate shatters with a bang, and light shines in, illuminating the woman in blue.

speaker: Lisa
content: ...Why did you destroy it? Isn't that the work you're proud of?

speaker: Lisa
content: Enfer?
The woman in blue turns back with a smile.
Obsidian pieces fall, and the light shines through the broken Gate of Hell, revealing a deeper space.

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes. I created every piece here, and I'm the only one who can put them to rest. And...

speaker: Enfer
content: As Sinners, there's no way for us to fight the shackles, right?
She turns to you, and in the crowd's astonishment, gently interlocks her fingers with yours. Between your palms, the shackles faintly resonate.

speaker: Enfer
content: All right. Please follow me. The culprit is behind this gate, and I have opened the way for you.

speaker: Enfer
content: You defeated my masterpiece and put me in shackles. I will have to fulfill your wish and end the Witching Hour.
A whole glass window shatters, and a rusty metal pipe tumbles in the shards before silence returns to the museum.
Two figures leap through the broken hole and land steadily on the marble floor in the hall.

speaker: EMP
content: It's really dark in here...

speaker: Hella
content: What? Are you scared already? It's still not too late for you to run.
Hella picks up her pipe and shakes the shards off, playfully raising an eyebrow at EMP.

speaker: EMP
content: Hey, who are you looking down at! I was worried you'd feel pressured if I acted too brave, okay?

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph! Keep telling yourself that.
The two bicker while carefully stepping over the broken stone pillars on the marble floor and the fallen fences, heading toward the center of the exhibition hall.

speaker: EMP
content: What's this? A monster from some third-rate horror movie? Not even toddler will be scared by this...

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Dear visitors, welcome to the <color=#fb9259>sculpture section</color> of the Witching Hour art exhibition...

speaker: EMP
content: Ah! <size=40>Ah!</size> <size=45>Ah!!!</size>
EMP jumps straight on Hella's back.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Hello there, don't be nervous. I am Enfer, who's in charge of commentary and guidance. I've introduced myself before.

speaker: Hella
content: It's humiliating that you're scared by this thing... Get off!
Noticing that the voice is coming from her pocket, EMP lets go of Hella and touches the back of her neck, looking embarrassed. She argues loudly.

speaker: EMP
content: Who, who's nervous?! I'm just being vigilant, right, vigilant!

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft... Look at your wimpy face. Is that also to ease my pressure?

speaker: EMP
content: Shut up! You Minos rat!
Hella lets out ridicule without mercy while the navigator continues to speak calmly as if not hearing anything.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: The theme of this section is <color=#fb9259>Breaking the Cocoon</color>. Through expressionism, surrealism, and deconstructionism, I intend to tear the self-bound cocoon and expose the bloody reality to force people to face their deepest fear of harm.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Please be careful and keep your belongings safe, as there are a large flow of visitors here currently. Finally, I wish you a pleasant and meaningful trip to the exhibition.
The unemotional voice echoes in the quiet exhibition hall, adding a bit more eerie to the already spooky atmosphere.
After a long pause, Hella slowly speaks to EMP next to her.

speaker: Hella
content: Did you understand what she was saying?

speaker: EMP
content: Of course...

speaker: EMP
content: Not.

speaker: EMP
content: I don't know what those crap-isms are, but "a large flow of visitors"? Is she serious? I don't see a single soul here. Is this AI broken?

speaker: Hella
content: Who knows? Isn't this museum known as the most wicked place in Eastside? And that radio program said... no one who went in could come out? I'd say they were probably exaggerating, though.

speaker: EMP
content: Yeah, the story is too corny, right? A show like DeadLover Radio should at least think of something new. How can they scare people with that...
Hahaha...

speaker: EMP
content: ...AHHH!!!
A sorrowful laugh sounds, fluttering close but then falling silent, leaving only shivers on the back of their necks.
Hella turns around and swings her pipe in the air.

speaker: Hella
content: WHO is it! Who's playing tricks on us there?! Come out and face me! Only a coward would sneak around!
She suddenly pauses and stares forward in disbelief.

speaker: Hella
content: The glass... is put back...
EMP looks back and freezes. The window that was broken looks brand new, and even the shards on the ground have disappeared.

speaker: EMP
content: How... How is this possible?!
She rushes to the window, grabs a small statue, and throws it. The statue breaks into pieces, but the glass doesn't even crack.
Confused, she reaches out to touch it...

speaker: EMP
content: <size=40>Ah!!!</size>
Countless dark palms slap on the glass, and the palm prints make her hair stand on end!
She withdraws her hand lightning fast and stumbles several steps backward before regaining her footing.

speaker: EMP
content: W-w-w-what are those?! They must be friendly hands here to welcome us... They are not gonna attack us, are they?!
As if in response to her words, the hands actually pass through the glass and stretch their slender fingers toward the two.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! Did you have to jinx it?!

speaker: EMP
content: I didn't mean it! Ah...! These things are too creepy. Stay away!! I have trypophobia!!!
The defeated dark hands turn into broken sculptures and fall onto the ground.

speaker: EMP
content: Huh? This is weird...

speaker: Hella
content: Yes?
Hella turns around and finds EMP crouching on the ground, fiddling with the plaster pieces.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey! When did you become a scavenger?

speaker: EMP
content: Enough of your trash talk. Come and check this out.
EMP rolls her eyes and points to the broken pieces.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... It's just pieces left by those monsters. What's there to see?

speaker: EMP
content: Take a closer look!

speaker: Hella
content: Ah... Huh? They are in a different shape?!
That's when the navigator starts to talk again.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: The sculpture is called <color=#fb9259>Abyss</color> and has the shape of a teenager being dragged into the abyss by thirteen hands. I intended to satirize those who think ignorance is bliss and therefore hurt themselves.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: The abyss is not a place you can return from. People who blindly pursue thrill, sneer at or even toy with danger and the unknown, will eventually be swallowed. It's their deserved retribution.

speaker: EMP
content: Things here do seem distorted for some reason...

speaker: Hella
content: Is it some kind of spiritual contamination? They cover the works and create illusions to confuse the intruders?

speaker: EMP
content: Ahhh... You need to stop all the wicked talk now. It's giving me chills...
Wrong! Can't be further from... Ouch!
A curly-haired man strides out from behind a statue. He tries to strike a cool pose but slips and falls on his face.
But he quickly rises from the ground covered by broken glass and plaster, and continues to talk excitedly.

This is the hunting ground of various horrific monsters from urban legends. Anyone who enters here will be devoured, which is why they never return. Now that is a story worthy of the spooky atmosphere of Witching Hour!

speaker: EMP
content: Huh? Then the Chief...

speaker: Hella
content: Bah! What are you trying to say?! There's no way the Chief was eaten by these things!

speaker: Hella
content: And more importantly...
Hella raises her pipe and points at the stranger.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Who are you?

speaker: Josh
content: Ahaha, I'm <color=#fb9259>Josh</color>, the famous ur... um, a staff member of the art museum.

speaker: Hella
content: The famous... staff?

speaker: Josh
content: Yeah. Is there something wrong with that?
The guy claiming to be Josh says this while flicking his work permit that was flung behind his back to the front.

speaker: Josh
content: If I'm not mistaken, you two are FAC agents sent here to investigate the case, right? You are super lucky to have run into me today.

speaker: Josh
content: I know this museum better than my own home. Even with my eyes closed, I can lead you guys out. Hah, I'm in a good mood today, so I will be kind and let you two tag along.

speaker: Josh
content: What are you waiting for? Come on! You can even witness my heroic adventure. It's now or never!
He struts forward arrogantly while not forgetting to let out a loud, unpleasant, gargling laugh.

speaker: Hella
content: Nut case...

speaker: EMP
content: He doesn't look very reliable, but he works here. And he said he knows the way. How about we... follow him?

speaker: Hella
content: Why are you not moving?

speaker: EMP
content: You aren't moving, either.

speaker: Hella
content: Why should I lead the way? Are you afraid?

speaker: EMP
content: Huh, Why would I be afraid? You'd be pissing your pants, and I wouldn't be afraid!

speaker: Hella
content: Then why are you talking nonsense instead of walking?! He'll be long gone if we don't keep up!

speaker: EMP
content: Talking nonsense? Me? You're the one who keeps blabbering...

speaker: EMP
content: Forget it. There's no point in arguing with you! I'm going. Who's scared now?

speaker: Hella
content: What are you doing looking back? Missing those creepy hands already?

speaker: EMP
content: Speak for yourself. But do you not feel that something's off?

speaker: Hella
content: Something's off?

speaker: EMP
content: I keep getting goosebumps on the back of my neck. It's like... something has been following us.

speaker: Hella
content: Really?
She looks back carefully, but the corridor is empty and quiet. There are only reliefs on the walls, display boards, and a statue standing in the corner.

speaker: Hella
content: There's nothing. Are you so scared that you're imagining things?

speaker: EMP
content: Hmph, they call me the brave EMP, and I can watch horror anime all night without hitting pause. How could I be afraid of some art museum?

speaker: Hella
content: Oh, really? I thought I heard someone screaming "Oh" and "ahh" and "stay away"...

speaker: EMP
content: Impossible! You must have heard wrong...

speaker: EMP
content: Oh, I know what's off!
EMP points to the statue ten meters away and stares in disbelief.

speaker: EMP
content: I think it moved. It wasn't like that a moment ago...
Hella follows her finger and focuses her eyes on the statue.
It's a woman with slender limbs. She's leaning back at a bizarre angle, revealing a thin and long neck. Her arms are also bent backward in a way that's against human anatomy.
The statue's posture looks weird and distorted, but it's standing completely still. Even the sharpest eyes can't catch the slightest sign of movement.

speaker: Hella
content: You must have got it wrong...
Outside the window, clouds suddenly cover the moon, and the whole corridor instantly falls into complete darkness.
No one says anything. They all stand utterly still in place, listening to each other's heavy breathing and heartbeats.
After the longest few minutes, the clouds finally part. Bright moonlight shines into the windows again, illuminating the smooth marble floor.

speaker: EMP
content: Oh no, oh no. If we're in a horror movie... after this scene...

speaker: Hella
content: I swear, EMP, if you say one more word, I'll pull the plug out right before you finish a game every time from now on!

speaker: EMP
content: What the ****... That's so mean...
But Hella's words can't stop what's about to happen...
The first thing they see is the statue's head hanging low five or six meters away, with the thick, long hair covering its entire face.
Then there are the bony shoulders, the hands on both sides of her body, and the legs with distorted knees.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! It's actually moving?!

speaker: EMP
content: AHHHH! See?! I told you!

speaker: Josh
content: Is this the legendary <color=#fb9259>Stone Shadow</color>? I can't believe it actually exists!

speaker: EMP
content: Stone Shadow? What's that?

speaker: Josh
content: Are you kidding? You've never heard of the Stone Shadow? It's the hottest horror legend nowadays!

speaker: Josh
content: They are no different from rocks when you look at them, but when you turn your head or even blink, they'll move swiftly, like, swish! Swish!!

speaker: Josh
content: Not only that, they will keep getting faster, faster, and... Click-clack! They snap your neck before you can react.

speaker: EMP
content: What kind of art museum staff knows so much nonsense?!

speaker: Josh
content: I guess there's no need to hide it now. I'm no ordinary museum staff, but an urban legend investigator.

speaker: Josh
content: I'm here to investigate the Witching Hour event and write down the heroic stories of me facing the horrible monsters...

speaker: Hella
content: Enough with your crap! Who the **** cares about what you do now?!
As they argue, the sky starts to get dark again.

speaker: EMP
content: No!
Darkness envelops the corridor again. EMP discharges in all directions in panic, and blinding electric sparks splash on the floor, walls, and ceiling.
5 meters away, the statue marches with her arm stretching forward. Her hair and the corners of her clothes are fluttering up.
3 meters away, the eagle-like hands are raised above her head, and the broken fingers are bent downward. The hideous face lurks out from the gaps in her hair.
She's centimeters away, mouth split open to her ears, showing pointy teeth. There's a spiteful look in the hollow stone eyes, and her sharp nails are closing in on the human eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: *****************! Whatever the hell you are, smashing you into pieces has to work!

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: This sculpture, titled <color=#fb9259>Hidden Arrows</color>, initially took the form of a young woman shot in the back by arrows, implying the fear of hurtful words from others.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: So what do you think of this work, everyone?
Immersed in his own world, Josh completely ignores everything around him. Hella and EMP look at each other, and shrug at the same time.
Silence. A dead silence falls in Belphegor Art Museum.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: ...Looks like you don't have perspectives you'd like to share. I won't keep disturbing your tour, then.
Clap!
Josh suddenly claps his hands, and the sound explodes in the silent museum. EMP jumps to hide behind Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: *****! Damn it, what do you want now?!

speaker: Josh
content: That was so exciting! I never thought I would one day be able to face a stone shadow! And according to previous records, I must also be the first person to survive AND defeat one!

speaker: EMP
content: Wow! No one has ever been able to beat it before? Oh, right, remember how I shot that last arrow? Straight to the head! That was so cool!
EMP jumps out from behind Hella excitedly.

speaker: Josh
content: The urban legend society will be abuzz for me! If we could meet more thrilling monsters here...

speaker: EMP
content: Then they will all taste the arrows of the Archer Queen of Syndicate!

speaker: Josh
content: Hahaha! Urban legends, come to me!

speaker: EMP
content: Hahaha!

speaker: Hella
content: Stop laughing!
Bearing with the ear-piercing laughter for a while, Hella finally snaps.

speaker: Hella
content: **** you, EMP! Stop laughing like that crazy nerd!

speaker: Hella
content: I should smash your heads open and see what kind of crap is inside!

speaker: EMP
content: Hey, don't push me! Get your hands off!

speaker: EMP
content: Don't piss me off, or I won't hesitate to whoop your ass!

speaker: Hella
content: I pushed you? Did you catch his stupidity? Use your teeny-tiny brain! How can I push you when I'm walking in front of you?

speaker: EMP
content: Then who the **** is pushing me? It can't be the statue, right? The only moving one has been smashed to pieces by us. All the other ones are stuck to the wall with no legs...
They stop in their way, suddenly realizing something.

speaker: EMP
content: Wait... Only statues standing on the ground can move, right...?
Hella rushes to cover EMP's mouth, but it's too late. Only empty panels are left on the bleak white walls, and the reliefs have somehow gathered and surrounded them.
One of them wearing a hood has even put her hand on EMP's shoulder.

speaker: EMP
content: A-a-are these the broken one's friends and family...? What should we do?!
EMP cries out, her voice shaking. Hella grumpily scratches her hair.

speaker: Hella
content: I gotta find something to stuff into your mouth!

speaker: EMP
content: W-what should we do now...? So many of them...

speaker: Hella
content: Is there another way out? Grab your bow!

speaker: Hella
content: We'll smash them all! What's so scary about a bunch of stones?
After shattering the last relief, EMP leans against the wall, out of breath.

speaker: EMP
content: Phew... Phew... Give me a second...
Hella is also a little shaken, but when she sees EMP panting heavily against the wall, she pulls herself together.

speaker: Hella
content: What's wrong with you? Too afraid to move? It's a disgrace for Syndicate to have a wimp like you.

speaker: EMP
content: But those stone shadows were terrifying! And there were so many of them! They came out of nowhere and jumped on all together!

speaker: EMP
content: Scared the hell out of me... M-my legs are still shaking...

speaker: Hella
content: You... Sigh...
EMP's chest rises and falls violently, and her pale cheeks are covered with sweat. Hella looks at the other frightened girl, and without realizing it, her tone softens.
She hesitates for a moment and pats EMP's shoulder somewhat awkwardly.

speaker: Hella
content: ...All right, okay. I won't make fun of you anymore.

speaker: Hella
content: But we have to pick up the pace, ${PlayerName} is still waiting for us. After we find him, we can work together to discover the truth about these mutations and catch the person behind them!
female_content: But we have to pick up the pace, ${PlayerName} is still waiting for us. After we find her, we can work together to discover the truth about these mutations and catch the person behind them!

content: EMP stands up straight and takes a few steps forward, but then she hears the gloating voice of Josh.

speaker: Josh
content: You know, Stone Shadows are the less frightening monsters in urban legends. What do you think is waiting for you behind that door ahead?

speaker: Josh
content: Is it an absorbing monster that sucks you in and turns you into a face on its back, a shadow-eating giant worm from another dimension, or a parasite that grows on you once it touches your skin?

speaker: Josh
content: But whatever it is, it must be thousands of times more frightening than the stone shadows here, right?

speaker: Josh
content: Look at you. You are too scared to stand straight already. Can you really go forward? Tsk, I don't know how a coward like you became a FAC agent.
After hearing his words, EMP's face grows paler and paler. She clenches her fists but can't say a word.
Instead, Hella charges straight up and pulls EMP behind her, desperately suppressing her anger.

speaker: Hella
content: What do you know, you brain-dead, self-centered moron? Don't ever talk to her like that!

speaker: Hella
content: Say something like that again, and you can bug off on your own!

speaker: Hella
content: Disgusting!
Finishing her fierce speech, Hella strides away, pulling EMP with her.

speaker: Hella
content: He's really not following us? That's strange...

speaker: EMP
content: Shh! Listen...
They pause, hold their breath and listen. And there are small clicking noises coming from behind them.
It sounds like broken porcelain tiles or some other hard objects scratching and moving across the floor.

speaker: Hella
content: Hiss... I got goosebumps again. It's not a good sign...
The two exchange a nervous glance and slowly turn back...
Only to see a few severed stone limbs covering Josh's mouth and pressing him against the floor.

speaker: Josh
content: Mm... Mmmmm...
At the same time, directly above him, the rest of the pieces are rapidly converging into something unusually bizarre.
Slender tentacles reach out from the center, with fractured shapes embedded like a giant octopus reconstructed from various sculptures.

speaker: EMP
content: Woah! A weird and gross combo monster, like the ones in legends!

speaker: Hella
content: Really? This is ridiculous! And this... It's the most disgusting thing I've ever seen!

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: It is indeed not artistic at all. Not my design.
The navigator speaks calmly, and there's actually a hint of contempt in her voice.

speaker: EMP
content: Wait!
EMP, Hella, and Josh reach the end of the long corridor. Hella reaches out to push the door but is stopped by EMP.

speaker: Hella
content: What's wrong?

speaker: EMP
content: I... I feel that there's something wrong ahead.

speaker: Hella
content: It would be strange to feel something RIGHT in this hellhole, okay? And this is not the first time you've said this.

speaker: EMP
content: It's different this time. I'm serious! I feel like something terrible will happen if we enter this door...

speaker: EMP
content: Ahhh!
EMP suddenly shrieks and hurriedly grabs Hella's arm.

speaker: EMP
content: And this time? Did you feel that?!

speaker: Hella
content: I can feel the shackles! B-but it feels strange. What's going on?

speaker: EMP
content: Oh no. Did something really happen to the Chief...?

speaker: Hella
content: Impossible! The Chief wouldn't fail here!

speaker: Hella
content: But he must be in a very dangerous situation now, we need to find him quickly!
female_content: But she must be in a very dangerous situation now, we need to find her quickly!

content: Worried about the safety of the Chief, the two can't be bothered with anything else. They charge together through the door with intricate carvings.

On the other side of the door is a smaller room with a little girl sitting on a bench in the center. She has her back to the three, her head hanging low, her thin shoulders shrugging, making sobbing sounds.
EMP exchanges a puzzled look with Hella, then forces herself to the little girl's side. She bends down and gently pats the girl's shoulder.

speaker: EMP
content: Hey, why are you here alone?

speaker: Little Girl
content: Sob... I, I can't find my mom. I'm so scared...
She buries her face in the shadow cast by her bangs, and it's impossible to see her expression. But the panic and helplessness in her voice make people feel sorry for her.

speaker: EMP
content: Don't be afraid. Come with us. We'll take you out.

speaker: Little Girl
content: But Mom told me not to leave.

speaker: EMP
content: Your mom is probably waiting for you outside, and we'll help you find her.

speaker: Little Girl
content: Really? Then you will protect me, right?

speaker: EMP
content: That's right.

speaker: Little Girl
content: You will stay with me, won't you?

speaker: EMP
content: What?

speaker: Little Girl
content: Hehehe...
The little girl slowly raises her head, and under her bangs is actually a distorted face. She pulls the crooked corner of her mouth and shows a grim smile.

speaker: EMP
content: AHHH!!! H-her face...
EMP screams and falls back, but the little girl also turns around, keeping her resentful gaze on the three. The statue in Josh's hands falls to the ground and rolls away.

speaker: Little Girl
content: You've promised. There's no turning back now.
As soon as the words leave her mouth, there are some strange movements on her, as if there's something alive and wriggling under her clothes.
The next second, several streams of smoke emerge from her collar and surround the three.
At the same time, the whole room comes alive, and shadows wind down along the pillars from the ceiling like snakes.
This wave of monsters is more dangerous than the previous ones. Although EMP and Hella manage to repel them, they are inevitably left with various wounds.

speaker: Hella
content: So... So much for that...
Hella wipes away the blood on her face with her sleeve. Her face is still pale, but she's bluffing to cover her fear.
However, EMP has been completely scared out of her wits. She holds her head in her hands and curls into a ball. Her eyes have no focus, and she's shivering and muttering.

speaker: EMP
content: Almost... Its tentacles almost poked through my neck...

speaker: Josh
content: It should have done just that!
Josh suddenly pushes EMP to the ground, and she lets out a muffled grunt.

speaker: Josh
content: Hahaha, look at you. One push, and you're on the ground. You're ruining the reputation of FAC!
He looks down at EMP and lets out a domineering laugh.

speaker: Josh
content: A little girl scared the crap out of you. You're dragging us down, you coward.

speaker: Josh
content: For real, you only bring us misfortune with that big mouth of yours. You should be left to feed the monsters.

speaker: It's fine, no worries! I'm just surprised you actually showed up! And you know Miss Cabernet so well, too!
content: **** you! Shut the hell up!
Hella has finally had enough of this. She flips him to the ground with her pipe, throwing him five meters away. She then crouches in front of EMP and holds her shoulders.

speaker: Hella
content: EMP!!! Don't listen to him! Snap out of it!

speaker: EMP
content: But I am a coward! This place... It's more frightening than Syndicate gangsters. I can't talk to the monsters, and all my self-protecting posturing and fawning doesn't work!
EMP shouts out and then slowly looks up at Hella. There's no amount of pride left on her face, and she even looks a bit pitiful.

speaker: EMP
content: He's not wrong... Let's go back... Don't keep going... We really will die here...

speaker: Hella
content: ...What are you talking about? I, the invincible Hella, is still here, and no one can hurt you!

speaker: Hella
content: Besides, even if you are a coward in the Syndicate. You survived, became a Sinner, and some kind of Backstreet Overlord, didn't you?!

speaker: Hella
content: Doesn't the Syndicate believe the law of t-the jingle or something? We both survived until now in the hellholes, and it's because we have our own powers!

speaker: Hella
content: We may look like cowards, but we are the strong! We are survivors, winners of the Syndicate!

speaker: EMP
content: Well... You have a point, but... but...

speaker: Hella
content: There's no but! You can have all your buts after we find the Chief!
Hella reaches out and pulls Emp up from the ground.

speaker: EMP
content: Well, o-okay...

speaker: Josh
content: I-is this a joke...? You two are... Sinners?!
Josh stands behind Hella and EMP, looking horrified and helpless.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh no... Nightingale said we should keep our identities a secret...

speaker: EMP
content: Don't be afraid... Listen to me...
EMP raises her hands and tries to approach Josh, but he backs into a corner and starts swinging a sculpture piece he found on the ground.

speaker: Josh
content: Stay away!!! Monsters! You, get away from me!!!

speaker: Hella
content: What the hell? Look who's the coward now? Think about it. When have we ever tried to harm you, all this way?

speaker: Josh
content: You... You are working with the monsters here, aren't you?!
Hella tries to calm him down, but Josh is too frightened to hear any of it. He howls hysterically, teetering on the brink of an emotional breakdown.

speaker: Josh
content: Argh!

speaker: Josh
content: Don't touch me! Don't touch me! Go and hunt someone else! Please! Let me go!

speaker: Hella
content: No... We have to control him, or it's going to cause a scene...
Maybe Hella's words aroused his instinct for self-defense under extreme fear, Josh throws the plaster piece toward Hella and EMP.

speaker: Josh
content: I said stay away!!!
The two dodge out of the way, only to see a heavily mutated arm reaching out from the shadows behind them and grabbing the piece.
The sharp claw grips hard, and the plaster crumbles into powder.

speaker: EMP
content: That... That's...
Several Corruptor monsters roam out of the shadows, baring their fangs. EMP is so shocked she falls onto the ground again.

speaker: EMP
content: Argh!!! Corrupted Sinners this time!! We're so dead!!

speaker: Hella
content: Stop howling! What's so scary about these guys?! I got you! A-and we can go to ${PlayerName}!

speaker: Hella
content: Get up! We are not fighting alone in the Syndicate anymore. Let's go get him!
female_content: Get up! We are not fighting alone in the Syndicate anymore. Let's go get her!

speaker: EMP
content: You're right... Ahhhhhh!! That monster is c-c-closing in, argh!!!
EMP cries out, raises her bow, and shoots the leader Corruptor Sinner down with one blow.

speaker: EMP
content: Where are you, Chief! Help!!!
Perhaps since they regained confidence, this battle goes more smoothly than the previous ones.
After putting her bow and arrows away, EMP sees Josh standing motionless with his head down in the corner.

speaker: EMP
content: Hey, why are you still standing there? Let's go! The monsters are all defeated...

speaker: EMP
content: Ah!!
EMP reaches out to pull him, but the cold and strange feeling makes her yelp and retract her hand.
Josh stumbles straight to the ground, making a crisp crashing sound.

speaker: EMP
content: What the hell is this?!! I-I-I didn't do anything...
Hella gulps and gathers enough courage to check. She pokes Josh's arm.

speaker: Hella
content: It's stone... He... He turned into a statue.

speaker: EMP
content: A statue?!
EMP turns Josh over... he has turned into a cold gray statue. Only the wide-open eyes tell the fear he experienced minutes ago.
As the duo gape at each other, the navigator, who has been silent for a long time, opens her mouth again.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: I see. I think I have worked out the truth of Witching Hour.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Based on the Corrupted Sinners just now, and Josh, who has been turned into a statue, I suspect that Witching Hour has the power to visualize the visitors' fear and turn them into part of the exhibition when they're extremely frightened.

speaker: Hella
content: So the reason EMP felt something wrong...

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Ah, she felt something wrong, not because of someone else's fear, but because the next room houses the Gate of Hell.

speaker: EMP
content: The Gate of Hell?

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Yes, the Gate of Hell. It was the work I was most proud of, before Sosia was born.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: The little girl you defeated earlier didn't turn into a broken statue like the other monsters, probably because it was created by the awakening of the Gate of Hell.

speaker: EMP
content: The thing can be awakened? That doesn't sound good...

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Correct, and I think it has something to do with the Chief you are looking for.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! So he's right ahead?! Finally!
female_content: ****! So she's right ahead?! Finally!

content: The navigator doesn't deny it but continues to speak calmly after a short pause.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: The road ahead will only get more dangerous. Are you sure you want to keep going?

speaker: Hella
content: Of course! We can't let that idiot ${PlayerName} get bullied!

speaker: EMP
content: Ahhhh I can't stand this place anymore!!! I wanna latch onto the Chief right now!!!
A magnificent sculpture, or rather, a dark gate, shows up before the Sinners. It seems bottomless and leads to another world.
The gateposts on either side are carved with people struggling in pain. The way to the abyss is crowded with them, wailing and crying out in fear.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What on earth is that thing?

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: <color=#fb9259>The Gate of Hell</color>. It was Enfer's most famous work in her early years.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Born in N.F. 109, it was the beginning of the sculptor's transitions. Enfer began to search for a unique artistic style.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: And according to more widely circulated rumors, the Gate of Hell reflects the deepest fear within everyone's heart.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft, stupid AI. I can't understand what you're talking about. I was asking about that thing! The thing in front of the gate!
Something is rampaging before the Gate of Hell. Its face is blurred, but the halo around its head shows that it's anything but human. It must be another phantom born during the bizarre night.
But its shape is unmistakably familiar, ad the red light flashing on its hand—shackles. It's the power unique to that person.
...Surrender...
Surrender... to the shackles...

speaker: Lisa
content: Another phantom of fear. Even the Gate of Hell has been affected by the mutation...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Shackles? But that's no human. He's not Labyrinth's Master.
female_content: Shackles? But that's no human. She's not Labyrinth's Master.

content: The Gate of Hell's commotion draws all Sinners here, leading to an unexpected reunion.

speaker: Hella
content: What took you guys so long?! Where have you been all this time?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Keep your voice down. You're attracting the attention of the enemy.

speaker: Lisa
content: Geez... The brainless creatures I was hoping not to run into.

speaker: EMP
content: Look ahead! Look ahead!!
Surrender to me!!!
There's no time to revel in the joy of the reunion. Something shoots down from the sky, cracking the ground. For the first time, they are attacked by the shackles!

speaker: EMP
content: Ahhhh, help! Chief, stop this. It's me, EMP! Ah!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Keep your head clear. That's not Chief. It's just a phantom born from fear.

speaker: Hella
content: What fear phantom? Which one of you idiots is scared again? Who is afraid of that numbnut?!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Scan complete. Master is nearby, but there is too much obstruction. Clean-up mode immediately activated, set at highest tier three.

speaker: Lisa
content: These are artworks, and your shorted-out processor is the most significant obstruction... Stop it!

speaker: EMP
content: The next attack is coming... Chief!! Help!!!
Don't be afraid! That's not something you should fear!

speaker: Perhaps because she's been with the toys for too long, she seems surprised and flustered at such sincere and frank compliments. You seize the opportunity to offer her your hand.

content: A powerful energy bursts out of the darkness, repelling the raging <color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>. It's also the shackles, but instead of the constricting force that overwhelmed them, it feels warm and familiar.
A familiar figure emerges from the darkness on the other side of the corridor, with redness burning in his hands.
female_content: A familiar figure emerges from the darkness on the other side of the corridor, with redness burning in her hands.

speaker: Hecate & Hella
content:
Chief!
What took you so long?!
...It has been a while indeed. Seeing them again, you unconsciously start to smile.

options: I've been waiting for you too.
The protagonist always shows up at final critical moments.

content: The fear vanishes, and the shackles finally return to the Sinners.

speaker: Lisa
content: "Beautiful Female Artist," "Witching Hour Adventure Live"...
Lisa peels off the ads disgustedly. Her power turns into butterflies, and she crushes the pieces of paper.

speaker: Lisa
content: Such distasteful ads under Belphegor Art Museum. I haven't been back in Eastside for months, and it's still as irritating as ever.

Lisa looks around with dissatisfaction at the staff tunnel. It's cold, boring, artificial, devoid of artistic ambiance, and has a high M-value... She would have preferred to enter through the main entrance if not to avoid the noisy brats.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: I see you've stopped in your tracks. Have you encountered any trouble during the exhibition?

speaker: Lisa
content: It's not more of a hassle than wasting precious time to deal with Mania instead of enjoying the exhibition, but... I noticed that trouble has been following me...
Special lights gather and fly toward the back of a concrete pillar.
Please don't do this, Miss Lisa.
Someone dashes out from behind the pillar, nimbly avoiding the attack.

speaker: Lisa
content: You know me?

Hahaha, the once-famous painter who had her right hand injured in an accident and became Eastside's sharpest art critic. I've heard your name in other strange stories, but you rarely show up. It's an honor to meet you here.

speaker: Lisa
content: I'm also honored to have run into someone as suspicious as you in this stinky underground parking lot.
Hahaha, you've really got a personality like the rumors say, Miss Lisa.

speaker: Lisa
content: What? You were hiding behind a pillar, sneaking around and eavesdropping. Should I have invited you to come out politely?

Please excuse my rudeness, Miss Lisa. It's just that seeing how familiar you are with this place, I was impressed by your charms of personality, your confidence. I got intrigued and forgot to introduce myself...

speaker: Lisa
content: Stop it! I have urgent business to attend to and don't have time for your hypocritical nonsense.

speaker: Lisa
content: So, why are you following me in the underground parking lot instead of viewing the exhibition upstairs?

speaker: Lisa
content: You are holding the pair of antique letter openers sold at an amazing price in Eastside a few years ago, and your shirt is silk taffeta. Your glasses, brooch, and belt are all worth a lot...
Lisa eyes the person up and down with some disdain.

speaker: Lisa
content: Don't tell me you're here to show off your luxury items to the concrete pillars.
You see right through me, Miss Lisa. In that case, I won't beat around the bush with you.

speaker: McQueen
content: I'm <color=#fb9259>McQueen</color>, an art agent who got lost in Witching Hour. I would like to make a deal with you, Miss Lisa.

speaker: McQueen
content: Take me out of here, Miss Lisa, and I'll help you deal with them...

speaker: Lisa
content: Them?
Before Lisa finishes her sentence, a dark shadow springs out from behind the suspicious woman claiming to be an agent and lunges at them with a scream...

speaker: Lisa
content: You're a Sinner?

speaker: McQueen
content: Sinner, what a distant name. It's just some troublesome powers I got a few years ago. Since we're about to travel together, just call me McQueen.

speaker: Lisa
content: Don't flatter yourself. When did I promise to take you with me?

speaker: McQueen
content: But you do need me, Miss, don't you?

speaker: McQueen
content: There are countless monsters here, and getting out with just yourself, Miss Lisa, and an audio navigator, it won't be easy.

speaker: McQueen
content: My special power is more aggressive than yours, and I can help you destroy them. You know the layout of this place and can take me out... I'd like to think that fate brought us together.
The agent lowers her voice and approaches Lisa. She takes Lisa's right hand and bends down, trying to prove her sincerity by kissing Lisa's hand.
But Lisa jerks her hand away and almost slaps the agent in the face.

speaker: Lisa
content: More like fate sent you to test me...

speaker: Lisa
content: Let's get this straight: I'm not interested in your deal. I'll take you on the side, but if you hold me back, I won't hesitate to ditch you.

speaker: McQueen
content: So... is that a yes?

speaker: Lisa
content: Because we're heading the same way! And I also have conditions: first, don't use such a disgusting tone to get close to me. I'm not one of those superficial lords and ladies in Eastside. I don't buy that.

speaker: Lisa
content: Second... remember to keep more than five meters away from me, and don't touch me. It's nauseating.
Ignoring McQueen's stunned face, Lisa finishes and dusts off her right hand with a frown, bypassing McQueen and heading off on her own.

speaker: McQueen
content: Disgusting? Nauseating?
When McQueen comes back to her senses, Lisa is already quite far away, without the slightest intention of waiting for her new partner.
Looking at her eccentric guide, McQueen shrugs and smiles, patting the forged invitation that she prepared in her pocket.

speaker: McQueen
content: She's a bit more innocent than rumored, so it looks like I won't have to use you today.

speaker: McQueen
content: But I wonder if the guests from MBCC will bring any changes to the plan...
McQueen catches up with Lisa, who is busy moving forward and completely ignoring her.

speaker: McQueen
content: Do you really have nothing to ask me?

speaker: McQueen
content: Whether it's the truth about the art museum eating people, or about the creation of these shadow monsters. As a thank you for leading the way, I can tell you anything you'd like to know, Miss Lisa.

speaker: McQueen
content: Gathering information is the most basic skill of an art agent, and believe me, I know more than the audio guide.
McQueen follows Lisa, keeping a distance of precisely five meters.

speaker: Lisa
content: Not everyone does everything for profit like you. I told you, it's just we're heading the same way.

speaker: Lisa
content: Also... the thing that makes people different from audio guides is not the info they hold. There's this thing above your neck, called the brain.

speaker: McQueen
content: So, you've figured out the mystery of the museum with your wits already, Miss Lisa?

speaker: Lisa
content: Figure out the mystery? That's an exaggeration of what this is.

speaker: Lisa
content: You are from Eastside and should know about the <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia incident</color> that happened not long ago in District 14. The shadows in the museum and the black goo at that time are similar in principle. They are both manifestations of extreme emotions.

Lisa doesn't mention a word about the new Mania or the Chief, partly because of the confidential nature of the MBCC and partly because she really doesn't care much about the Chief compared to the exhibition.

speaker: McQueen
content: Extreme emotions... that explains it.

speaker: McQueen
content: All the exhibits in this exhibition focus on the same theme, <color=#fb9259>fear</color>. With just one glance, the paintings and sculptures inspire the most instinctive imaginings of fear.
In a rare moment of seriousness, McQueen even shows a trace of respect when mentioning Enfer's work.

speaker: Lisa
content: Correct, the shadows we encountered came from the fear of the guests after viewing the exhibition.

speaker: Lisa
content: These idiotic Eastsiders get trapped by their imagined fears, spread rumors of the museum eating people, and then get drawn here because of the rumors... Hmph, ridiculous.

speaker: McQueen
content: Arrogant, profit-oriented, vulgar, chasing excitement and popularity... Haven't they always been like this? This exhibition is perhaps the witch's punishment for them.
Lisa pauses with some surprise.

speaker: Lisa
content: I never thought an art agent would hate the "art circle" too. Isn't it conflicting with your job?

speaker: McQueen
content: Hah, I could be one of those people too, Miss Lisa. You don't know...
McQueen says this with mockery and a bit of frustration, and the attitude makes it surprisingly difficult for Lisa to tell she's telling the truth.

speaker: McQueen
content: You already have answers about the art museum and the shadows. So, what about me? Is there really nothing you want to ask about me?

speaker: McQueen
content: Am I really that unattractive to you?
The sincere expression just now seemed like Lisa's illusion, and McQueen returns to her slick normalcy in a flash.

speaker: Lisa
content: I shouldn't have expected anything from you... Don't forget. First, don't use such a disgusting tone to get close to me.

speaker: McQueen
content: Of course I remember... second, keep five meters from you, and no touching.

speaker: McQueen
content: Not only do I remember, but I'm also going to violate the second one.
McQueen steps forward and pulls Lisa behind her.

speaker: Lisa
content: What are you doing?!

speaker: McQueen
content: Shhh...
The letter openers are unsheathed, and they draw a fancy circle in McQueen's hands.

speaker: McQueen
content: Be careful. The shadows of fear are coming.

speaker: McQueen
content: Hmm...

speaker: Lisa
content: Don't force yourself. Leave the rest of the monsters to me.

speaker: McQueen
content: No way. Your delicate hands are not meant for that, Miss Lisa.
With a few swings of her knives, the last few shadows turn into smoke, but McQueen's face gets a little paler.

speaker: Lisa
content: You...

speaker: McQueen
content: Okay, okay, save the caring words. This doesn't suit your character.

speaker: McQueen
content: As I said, the mutation of this exhibition may be the punishment of the witch to us greedy Eastsiders. You don't need to deal with them, Miss Lisa.

speaker: McQueen
content: Besides, we've made a deal. You help me find the exit, and I'll escort you out, right?

speaker: Lisa
content: I never agreed to any deal, so don't try to trick me into anything.

speaker: McQueen
content: Oh, my good lady, keeping my word is the only thing I try not to stop doing. Just let me have this, okay?

speaker: Lisa
content: Tsk, what deal... Getting bullied by weak little monsters like that... I don't trust you to escort me.
Lisa complains but doesn't keep arguing, even taking into account McQueen's condition and slowing down her pace.

speaker: McQueen
content: Weak? ...They're really coming for me, it's not time to let Lisa deal with them yet...

speaker: Lisa
content: What are you muttering about?

speaker: McQueen
content: Nothing... Didn't you ask to keep a five-meter distance Miss Lisa? Why are you getting closer?

speaker: McQueen
content: I see, you can't resist my charm after all...

speaker: McQueen
content: Hey... <size=44>Wait! Don't speed up! Miss Lisa!</size>...

speaker: Lisa
content: *sign* There's no end to it.
Lisa and McQueen hide behind a stone pillar, not daring to venture in. Another group of shadows blocks the road, and this time, even Lisa can sense how powerful they are.

speaker: McQueen
content: It seems that we are also trapped, like in the stories. As long as there is a source of fear, the monsters will keep popping up.

speaker: Lisa
content: Think about how we can eliminate the source if you have time to blabber. Who is this person, and what are their fears...?
Lisa peeks at the shadows winding closer to the stone pillar, feeling an inexplicable familiarity.

speaker: Lisa
content: Do you remember the forgery exhibited at the Belphegor in N.F. 107...

speaker: McQueen
content: Impressive, Miss Lisa. You're still in the mood to talk about art history now.

speaker: Lisa
content: This is not small talk, don't interrupt!

speaker: Lisa
content: The painting is called <color=#fb9259>Judy on the Blue Couch</color> and depicts a heroine named Judy from ancient legends ending her own life in disgrace on a blue couch.

speaker: McQueen
content: I've heard about it, too. It claimed to be an ancient original found in the underground of DisCity, but actually, it's just a poorly restored forgery based on historical data...

speaker: Lisa
content: On the contrary, I think the forgery is not only superior to the original but even has more artistic value.

speaker: McQueen
content: Hmm? ...The forgery is more valuable?

speaker: Lisa
content: Don't get me wrong. I'm not trying to praise the commercial practice of falsification. It's just that... rather than the original work, which truthfully illustrates the legend, the forgery gives me more of a sense of the soul from the creator.

speaker: Lisa
content: Ignoring the traces left to make the painting look old, the artist's use of crimson scarlet and sapphire blue is even more dramatic and bold. The contrast is intense and highly saturated, making Judy's vitality before this moment and her resignation even more vivid.

speaker: Lisa
content: As an art agent, you should know very well that having your own expression and thinking, like Enfer, is an irreplaceable asset for DisCity nowadays.

speaker: McQueen
content: Yes, no one knows better than I do... Unfortunately, the forger failed to replicate Enfer's myth and disappeared as a nobody. The museum later destroyed the forgery as a scandal, so Judy on the Blue Couch no longer exists in the world.

speaker: Lisa
content: Isn't Judy the source of fear? Then why... does the shadow give me the same feeling as when I first laid eyes on the forgery?

speaker: Lisa
content: Resigned, humiliated... She seems to want to say something to us.
Lisa peeks out from behind the pillar. McQueen isn't quick enough to pull her back and can only watch as Lisa is drawn by the familiarity.

speaker: Lisa
content: How exactly are you connected to the painting? Whose fear are you, and what exactly is this fear?

speaker: Monster
content: Uh... Ah... Give me... my dreams, my ideals back... No... I don't want to paint these...
The shadow squirms and lets out broken howls, but it doesn't seem to have any intention of attacking Lisa.

speaker: Lisa
content: Dreams? Don't want to paint? What does that mean...?

speaker: Lisa
content: Their Mania Value is stronger than the previous shadows, and they even have some consciousness, but they are not attacking me.

speaker: McQueen
content: Probably because they didn't see you as an enemy in the first place, Miss Lisa.
McQueen interrupts Lisa's thoughts with a smile.
She steps out from behind the pillar, looking down at her hands and shaking her head with a bitter smile.

speaker: McQueen
content: You are right. One has to eliminate the source of fear. Either destroy the things that inspire negative emotions, or... face and conquer the fear by themselves.

speaker: McQueen
content: Unfortunately, the painting no longer exists, and I'm just a mediocre agent now. Without the help of other Sinners, I can't defeat my fear.
Just as McQueen shows up, the shadow lunges at her as if suddenly stimulated.

speaker: Monster
content: You can't forget... Your filthy hands, filthy past...

speaker: Monster
content: Embrace your fear!
The monster drags its broken body forward, turning into smoke while reluctantly trying to grab McQueen.
McQueen just quietly watches the howling shadow, neither attacking nor dodging out of the way.

speaker: Lisa
content: What are you waiting for?!
Lisa pulls McQueen back in time, and her violet butterflies crush the shadow's remaining arm.

speaker: McQueen
content: I'm not waiting for anything. I trust that you'll help me defeat them, Miss Lisa...

speaker: Lisa
content: I didn't encounter any shadows before I met you. You were never lost. You had the whole thing planned from the beginning!

speaker: McQueen
content: That's right. From the moment I saw you crushing the ads with your butterflies. I knew that with your determination, you could help me defeat the shadows.

speaker: McQueen
content: Butterflies... Right, Miss Lisa became famous because of your work, <color=#fb9259>Butterfly</color>. To you, it is the most important symbolization of your artistic ideal, right?

speaker: McQueen
content: You can no longer paint, but butterflies are still a part of your special power!

speaker: McQueen
content: Judy on the Blue Couch? Hah, haven't heard that name for a long time. Unlike you, my special power is to copy.
McQueen smiles and takes a few steps back, actively keeping a distance from Lisa.

speaker: Lisa
content: Other than that, do you have nothing else to explain for yourself?

speaker: Lisa
content: Why did you come to the art museum when you knew the place would stir up unpleasant memories?

speaker: Lisa
content: Your special power to copy, you didn't want to see the exhibition but showed up in the staff tunnel, the forgery, your dream, and your past...

speaker: Lisa
content: What exactly do you want?

speaker: McQueen
content: Isn't it too late to suspect me now?

speaker: Lisa
content: No, I want to help you.

speaker: McQueen
content: Yes?

speaker: Lisa
content: I trust my feelings. You tried to reveal the truth to me along the way. Your fear being here means you regret going astray. I think the painter who added her own touch to the forgery is still there.

speaker: Lisa
content: I don't mind you using my power as long as it doesn't go against the heart of creation. I prefer to believe what I feel rather than what's shown on the surface.

speaker: McQueen
content: Haha... Hahahaha...
Like she heard something hilarious, McQueen's burst of laughter echoes in the cold concrete-built space.

speaker: McQueen
content: They say that Lisa the critic is mean and aloof, but I find you rather innocent and adorable.

speaker: McQueen
content: You won't find any heart of creation left in me, but I can try to keep my promise and escort you out.
The letter openers spin back and forth nimbly between her fingers.

speaker: McQueen
content: The final layer of fear is the strong mutation from the <color=#fb9259>Gate of Hell</color>. Care to join me for this one?
The last shadow disappears. Without the monsters, Lisa finally gets a clear look at the Gate of Hell.
Saying that, Lisa turns back, but the one wearing blue is no longer within five meters.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: If you are looking for the visitor named McQueen, she has already left.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Now please let me continue to introduce you to the collection of this exhibition. The Gate of Hell was designed to reflect people's deepest fear and was one of my favorite works when I was young...
Lisa doesn't talk back to the machine calling herself a beautiful artist this time. She just stands in place as if waiting for something to happen after the navigator finishes her speech.
But no one will show up to pitch a deal to her this time. She stands in front of the gate, examining the carving patterns and feeling the artist's thoughts and struggles.

speaker: Lisa
content: Ouch... What?
Just as Lisa is in thought, a tingle pulls her back. Familiar red spikes appear in her palm.

speaker: Lisa
content: Shackles? Good timing as always.
It would be nice to study the work, but Lisa knows she has wasted too much time.
She reaches out and finally pushes open the ice-cold Gate of Hell.

speaker: McQueen
content: So that MBCC Chief is really here... It's bad enough that the <color=#fb9259>forgery project</color> almost got exposed. I don't want any more trouble.
In the corner of the underground parking lot, McQueen sits in the driver's seat of a pickup truck and watches Lisa disappear behind the Gate in the reflection.

speaker: McQueen
content: Sorry, Miss Lisa. I'll have to leave without saying goodbye.

speaker: McQueen
content: It's a pity I didn't get a chance to copy <color=#fb9259>Sosia</color>, but today... was worth it.
McQueen steps on the gas, and the truck rolls away carrying a variety of convincing artworks.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: You are leaving Belphegor Art Museum.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Thank you for visiting Witching Hour.

An hour ago
Belphegor Art Museum - Gate of Hell
You finally find a... "human" in the depths of the museum.
A thin, blue-clad woman leans her back against the dark gate with her eyes closed, like she's pondering something.
Hearing your footsteps, she opens her eyes to meet yours, not yet able to adjust the stony expression on her face.
