At the same time, the navigator on you starts talking.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: This is unexpected. Fate is unpredictable indeed. Please allow me to introduce myself, Enfer, an Eastside artist. I specialize in sculpting but occasionally dab in other art forms like oil paintings.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Well, that's about it. There's not much else about this person. Everything interesting about her is in her works. For example, the one in front of us...
You turn off the navigator. The imitated voice sounds ridiculous in front of the original.

Since the mutation broke out, you have been fighting Mania creatures alone and significantly weakened. With the shackles, you can sense 5 Sinners coming to rescue you, but you can't reach them due to the contamination.

After pursuing the source of the mutation alone for quite some time, you finally meet this woman, the exhibition's creator. Enfer straightens herself to face you. The gloom on her face is gone, and she shows a bright smile.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's nice to see you. I thought there was no one else here.

speaker: Enfer
content: You are unaffected by the mutation and not a captive of fear... Who are you, dear friend?

options: I should be asking that question. Who are you?

speaker: Enfer
content: The navigator just introduced me. I'm Enfer, a sculptor.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I watched as the place was cordoned off, and people were captured by fear. The visitors and staff were all crushed and turned into exhibits, part of Witching Hour—except you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not affected by the mutation, and all your works are twisting and turning into monsters that terrorize everyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not just any artist can have that kind of power. Who are you really?

speaker: Enfer
content: Hehe, you are good at analyzing. Are you an inspector? Hmm... You look more like an expert in dealing with these bizarre phenomena. You won't be affected by them, you have the power to defeat the monsters, and you are not afraid.

speaker: Enfer
content: You are alone but determined and confident to solve everything... You must still have something special up your sleeves.

options: Your analysis is not bad either.

speaker: Enfer
content: Thanks. Observation, imagination, and interpretation are all required to be a good artist.

speaker: Enfer
content: I know what you suspect, but please don't assume I'm behind this because I'm spared. This exhibition is for my cherished works, and I would never do anything to harm them.

options: Then you better have an explanation for me.

content: You step closer to her, doing your best to look intimidating while subtly reducing your distance.
Enfer notices and smiles, but it looks glossy and vain. She seems inscrutable as her art.

speaker: Enfer
content: I'm known as the <color=#fb9259>Witch of Fear</color> in the art world, specializing in inspiring fear with my works. In Eastside, people love the excitement, just like they love horror movies and haunted houses.

speaker: Enfer
content: The art of horror stimulates people's imagination, giving them the thrill of racing heartbeats without causing any harm. They enjoy the thrill and then go back to a peaceful life. No one ever took it too seriously.

options: But the imagined fear is becoming reality.

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes. If you think the shadows are moving, they will start haunting you in a few seconds. If you suspect someone is behind you, soon there will be whispering in your ears.

speaker: Enfer
content: People began to panic about being trapped when the first person screamed that the main entrance was blocked. Their words became a reality, and no one has been able to get out of Belphegor Museum since...

speaker: Enfer
content: <color=#fb9259>People's fear turning into reality</color>, this is the truth of Witching Hour.

options: And your works triggered the fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: Excellent artists use their works to convey emotions and connect with the inner worlds of the audience, triggering empathy, imagination, and reflection.

speaker: Enfer
content: But that's about it. I'm just a sculptor who became famous by chance. I don't have the power to affect so many people.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your works are attached with a strange power, and the fear they induce is beyond the common sense of empathy... It's Mania, and that makes you a Sinner.
You take another step forward, getting close enough to grab Enfer's wrist by surprise.

speaker: Enfer
content: Ouch, that hurts. What...
The moment you touch her bare skin, the shackles start working. You got her!
But it feels strange... You can clearly sense her power through the shackles, and it's surprisingly...
...Weak.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's so hot. Please let go. Don't hurt the hand of an artist.
Enfer is not strong enough to break free. She's pinned on the cold dark gate and doesn't even have the strength to loosen your fingers.
B-class? No, not even that. No wonder the Eastside monitoring network didn't issue a warning. She's not even as strong as Hella. Such a Sinner couldn't have triggered this huge mutation.
Just then, another force sends a shiver down your spine. It's not from the Sinner before you, but...
The <color=#fb9259>grand dark stone gate</color> Enfer is leaning on.
You're too close to see the whole of it, but a vast and complete obsidian gate stands before you. It's flat as a mirror, and the darkness reminds you of an abyss.

And something is surging in there. A dark mist is wrapped around your reflection in the mirror, slowly taking the form of a human. The familiar voice and feeling are overflowing with madness and destruction. At that moment, your soul is seized by fear.
...Surrender...
Surrender... to the shackles...
...Oh no, you've been so focused on the Sinner before you that you overlooked her works. This gate is also a sculpture Enfer made to trigger fear!
Surrender to me!!!
It reaches out violently and actually passes through the gate, becoming solid.
That hand burns with the light of shackles, and its head is encircled with a red halo. The phantom's face is shrouded, but you know this monster is you, the crazed you!

speaker: Enfer
content: Close your eyes!
The woman takes the opportunity to break free, dragging you to the cloister without looking back.
The shackles monster retreats, but its power lingers in the space. It's still hovering in front of the gate, squeezing your heart to death with each pacing step.

speaker: Enfer
content: Even I was afraid to look directly at that gate, and you just stared at it and created something horrible.

speaker: Enfer
content: <color=#fb9259>The Gate of Hell</color>, something that I was quite satisfied with in my early years. It can evoke one's deepest fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: You are afraid of the mystery and power in you, of losing control, failing, and being alone... The fear has been awakened by the Gate of Hell and turned into reality by Witching Hour.

options: Make it stop. I forbid you to activate your power.

content: You gasp but still struggle to voice your command. Crimson spikes sprout on Enfer's wrist, and she winces in pain. The forbidden force of the shackles has been activated—but nothing changes.

speaker: Enfer
content: So this is the shackles that that version of you is talking about... Is this something Sinners can't resist?

speaker: Enfer
content: Hehe, no wonder my heart skipped a beat when I saw you. My instinct was telling me to fear you.

speaker: Enfer
content: It won't work. I don't have the power to turn fear into reality. I didn't create Witching Hour, and its real master is behind the Gate of Hell.

options: Are you going to let it be?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your works are all twisted because of Witching Hour, and the exhibition is ruined. If it continues, you will be affected sooner or later. You should help stop this.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you can help solve this incident, I won't tell on you being a Sinner. You won't be detained and can keep being a free artist.

speaker: Enfer
content: You could just say that you need my help, because I will help.

speaker: Enfer
content: I created every single piece of artwork here, and I'm the only one who can destroy them.

speaker: Enfer
content: But you must first beat that version of <color=#fb9259>you</color>. That's not my creation but yours.

speaker: Enfer
content: Well, Mr Expert, let's see how you fight your own fear.
female_content: Well, Miss Expert, let's see how you fight your own fear.

content: You struggle to calm your breathing and brace yourself, only to be interrupted by a blast.
The terrifying phantom unleashed a powerful Potestas that shattered the wall, and the second blow is on its way.

You want to stand up and fight, but your feet won't oblige. Your will is suppressed, and the shackles feel weak. Is this the power of Witching Hour? When you are afraid of something, you will never be able to defeat it.

speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
content: Surrender... to me!!!
The raging power of Potestas is released, but not toward you, and a familiar wail comes from the other direction.

speaker: EMP
content: Ahhhh, help! Chief, stop this. It's me, EMP! Ah!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Keep your head clear. That's not the Chief. It's just a phantom born from fear.

speaker: Hella
content: What fear phantom? Which one of you idiots is scared again? Who is afraid of that numbnut?!
There are banging sounds, accompanied by the sound of breaking porcelain. You see a group of familiar people barge to the dark gate, actively or forced to face the berserk phantom.

speaker: Enfer
content: There are others who can get this deep... Are they also Sinners?

speaker: Enfer
content: As long as it's the shackles' request, even with fear in their hearts, they cannot refuse and must come to rescue you?

options: I would never give them such commands.

content: You stop talking to her. With your long-lost companions here, your feet start to move, and you rush toward the phantom that once terrified you. There's only one thing on your mind—You can't let it hurt the Sinners!

options: Don't be afraid! That's not something you should fear!

content: Powerful energy rushes out of the darkness, repelling your enemy. The shackles are back, blazing in the palm of your hand.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...I see. Other feelings in your heart have weakened the power of fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: I'm not even close...

speaker: Hecate & Hella
content:
Chief!
What took you so long?!
You think for a moment.

options: I've been waiting for you too.
The protagonist always shows up at final critical moments.

content: The fear vanishes, and the shackles finally return to the Sinners.
The Gate of Hell is broken. Behind the shattered obsidian is a silent and pure white world. It's completely different from the twisted and treacherous world outside.
The winding staircase is covered with white films, and the distant wall is covered with pure white plaster statues. They look unfinished but contain a certain rough tension.
The mutation of fear seems to have not yet invaded the place.

speaker: Enfer
content: Welcome to the special section of the Witching Hour, the <color=#fb9259>Unfinished Land</color>.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's mostly works I haven't finished or am not really satisfied with. But the museum likes them and set up this section.

speaker: Hella
content: ...It's like the navigator has become alive. They have exactly the same voice, and it's making me really uncomfortable.
Hella mutters. She then tugs the corner of your clothes and whispers in your ear.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, who's this woman? She was looking really weird when she was with you just now... Something must have happened while I was not with you. Are you two super close now?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She created all the works here and can destroy them. She can help... probably.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph... A fancy artist? She seems pretentious and not very trustworthy. Are all Eastsiders like this?
Lisa glares at Hella.

speaker: Enfer
content: Hehe, creators can lie, but their works can't. My works speak my heart.

options: Where is the owner of Witching Hour?

speaker: Enfer
content: Right down here.
You descend slowly down the winding staircase. Looking down from the handrail, a statue of a holy woman stands in the center of the bottom.
Her hair looks vivid, and a veil half-covers her face. It's truly a beautiful masterpiece.
But the whiteness without temperature or sound doesn't give you a sense of tranquility. It reminds you of death and something frightening.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She doesn't look like the oddly shaped things out there.

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes, this is her original look. She hasn't been distorted by Witching Hour yet.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's not finished, but she has gained far greater power than me.

speaker: Enfer
content: Two months ago, I received a particular piece of stone. It was unmarked, and flawless, too perfect to be of this world. It has a mesmerizing power before I even start carving it.

speaker: Enfer
content: And the moment I touched it, an unprecedented inspiration struck me. All the fears I've ever experienced were spread out before my eyes. I heard people's struggles, and they were crying out the same name.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...<color=#fb9259>Sosia</color>. Her name is <color=#fb9259>Sosia</color>.

speaker: Enfer
content: I don't remember how I picked up my chisel and hammer, and every second of carving it was like an eternity. When I snapped out of it, the statue was already taking shape, as if it had been in the stone all along, waiting for me to awaken it.
Turning fear into reality... it's the same as Witching Hour's mutation. So is this stone the source of the problem?

options: Where did the stone come from?

speaker: Enfer
content: I couldn't trace it. We only found an anonymous letter in the shipping container.

speaker: Enfer
content: The person claimed to be my supporter. He asked me to carve the perfect piece out of this stone, portray my heart, and present it during Witching Hour.

speaker: Enfer
content: But I've seen a strange pattern.
Enfer draws an eye on the film on the side, and it's a pattern you're familiar with.

speaker: Enfer
content: It came to me in my dream one night while working on Sosia.
...It's the pattern of that man, Parma.
A piece of stone able to turn human emotions into reality, an anonymous giver… The last time, they extracted <color=#fb9259>joy</color>, and this time, it's pure <color=#fb9259>fear</color>.
It's still an intense emotion, but there's no <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color>. At least now, there's no risk of a Black Ring outbreak.
It's worth the trip to have got so much out of an unexpected crisis. All you have to do is to end this mutation before it causes more trouble.

speaker: Hella
content: Okay, okay, stop frowning, or you'll get wrinkles. Anyway, we have found the target. Smash that Sosia, and everything will be fine. We still have time for a Hallowing party.

speaker: EMP
content: Well, with the great artist here, it will be easy, right? Smashy smash, like she did just now? Right?

speaker: Enfer
content: ...Of course. I made a deal with your Chief to help you guys. And I want this long night to end too.
Do you really think so?
A low voice speaks. You look back to see Lisa, who has been silent for a long time.

speaker: Lisa
content: I've heard the name, Sosia. You were interviewed by <color=#fb9259>DisArt</color> and said it was your life's work. You wanted her to be a true masterpiece and realize your artistic vision.

speaker: Lisa
content: It seems pretty easy for you to ditch your masterpiece and dream, Enfer.

speaker: Lisa
content: Like with the Gate of Hell. You said it's your proud piece but didn't even blink when you destroyed it.

speaker: Lisa
content: Is the so-called thriller art just to attract attention? Eastside's art business must be so rotten if it's celebrating a deceitful person like you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Lisa, we have to destroy that statue to stop the mutation. That's the mission. Don't get emotional.

speaker: Lisa
content: You don't have to tell me. I know what I'm doing, and my question was for that woman who calls herself an artist!

speaker: Lisa
content: She said she wanted to be honest with her works, saying they held her dreams and ideals. If even those were lies, then aren't we the greatest fools for believing her?
The tension stops everyone in their tracks as Lisa glares at Enfer. She's always been sharp with her words, but you rarely see her so angry.

speaker: Enfer
content: Lisa, right? A famous art critic who's sharp and straightforward. Do you like my works?

speaker: Lisa
content: ...Don't think of me as one of those people worshipping you in art salons.
Lisa's tone is strong, but she's not speaking as loud. Enfer laughs.

speaker: Enfer
content: I would never lie to my works. As an artist, I use the limited and trivial life of mine to create my own unique masterpieces. I put all my heart and soul into it every time I carve, dreaming of its birth.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...But it's not a world that one can enter easily.
With that, she swings her carving hammer and smashes a quietly approaching statue monster.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Warning. A large number of enemies are coming suddenly. And they all have physical forms. Are they... Enfer's works?
The dark mist surrounding you suddenly stirs, and amidst the chaos, comical and ugly statues close in. Their maniacal laughter and screams encircle the stairs.

speaker: Enfer
content: Ridiculous, isn't it? No matter what kind of great artworks I create, the audience's imagination of fear will twist it and cover it like layers and layers of plaster. And they all end up in weird shapes like this.

speaker: Enfer
content: This is not what I want to express at all. My "art" is not even close.
Enfer looks around at the crazed "art pieces," and there's no longer a smile on her face.
The crazed monsters are shattered, and as you contain the horrific phantoms, Enfer crushes them.
The statues' grotesque colors fade, and their twisted shells slowly dissolve layer by layer, revealing broken plasters inside. They quietly pile up at her feet.

speaker: EMP
content: They're not moving anymore? We got them, right?

speaker: Enfer
content: Relax. It's over. This is what they initially looked like before Witching Hour twisted them.

options: Do you hate it when your work is distorted?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Those thrill-seeking Eastsiders misinterpret your works, which you don't want, so you want to destroy them yourself?

speaker: Enfer
content: I don't have anything against the audience. To be misunderstood is the fate of expressers, and only the best artists can fully analyze and completely express themselves.

speaker: Enfer
content: A true masterpiece would never be mutated even during this Witching Hour, for it can pierce everyone's perception and manifest itself. Nobody will misinterpret it.

speaker: Enfer
content: And obviously, I'm not there yet.

options: Is Sosia a successful masterpiece of yours?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She is loved but not distorted. You wanted to convey something through her, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you willing to destroy her?

speaker: Enfer
content: Sir, are you worried about me or doubting me?
female_content: Ma'am, are you worried about me or doubting me?

speaker: Enfer
content: Hehe, it's all right. Let me tell you everything about her as we go. The path is long enough for a little story.
She steps over the debris and walks down the spiral staircase.

speaker: Enfer
content: Enfer's birth was once the talk of the art world. Her mother was a budding oil painter, and her father a famous sculptor. Their marriage was seen as the union of love and art, giving her a wonderful, happy childhood.

speaker: Enfer
content: But perhaps artists all have a tendency for brokenness. Enfer's mother disappeared, leaving behind a wrecked studio, nasty gossip, a young daughter, and a mentally disturbed husband. She was never found.

speaker: Enfer
content: Since then, her father spent all his days in the workshop, obsessed with his sculptures. He soon created <color=#fb9259>The Truthful One</color>, which was a huge success and opened up a new genre of thriller art.

speaker: Enfer
content: "What a great artist! He lost his lover, was trapped in pain, and plunged into madness, but in doing so, he transcended himself and realized his lifelong artistic pursuit!"

speaker: Enfer
content: No one made fun of his marriage or madness ever again. More than a decade passed, and he remained an acknowledged master—until he disappeared in his workshop, just like his wife back then, leaving behind only a trail of appalling misery.
EMP almost screams out, but Hella covers her mouth in time.

speaker: Enfer
content: Three days later, Enfer created <color=#fb9259>The False One</color>, following her father's footsteps. She became even more popular, actually outpacing many competitors to host this year's Witching Hour all by herself.

speaker: Enfer
content: Like that, the family's appalling tragic story was quickly forgotten. The daughter inherited the blessings and curses of the crazy art family and stepped into the spotlight with all the scary rumors surrounding her.

options: It only took you three days to complete "The False One"?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't know sculpture or "stories," but I know it's impossible to finish a masterpiece sculpture in three days.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Enfer, what really happened the night your father disappeared?

speaker: Enfer
content: You see stories from a very special angle indeed. Yes, that was a special night, and I was the first to arrive at the scene.

speaker: Enfer
content: Apart from The Truthful One, all sculptures were destroyed, the floor was painted with unrecognizable letters, the walls had huge cracks, and almost everything was broken by strange forces... That was no power of ordinary humans.

speaker: Enfer
content: And through the open window, I saw a huge crimson halo rising from the west bank of the Rust. At that moment, my soul was completely seized...

speaker: Enfer
content: When I returned to my senses, The False One was already finished. It stood in the broken workshop, looking down at me, opposite "The Truthful One."
Enfer doesn't answer for a long time, as if she hasn't heard your question or is reminiscing about the abyss. After a while, she finally turns to respond, and her calm smile returns.

speaker: Enfer
content: Father disappeared 2 months ago, <color=#fb9259>August 20th</color>.
...It's the day of BR-004.
Every time a Black Ring appears, the number of mental cases in the city skyrockets.

You don't have to be in contact with contamination to get mentally ill. You might get mentally ill simply by observing a Black Ring, discussing it, or even imagining it. We can't manage the influence of a Black Ring when it's out in the open.

You haven't forgotten what he said, but for the first time, you're starting to understand its meaning. The impact of Black Ring is insidious and far-reaching. In the face of disaster, everyone is equally insignificant, like the famous artist in front of you.
No amount of fame and status will help, and once her identity as a Sinner is made public, she will lose everything.

speaker: Enfer
content: Don't look sad. Doesn't the story suit me? Artists are always accompanied by madness, and Eastside loves stories like this, not to mention that night answered so many questions I dwelled on for years.

speaker: Enfer
content: I saw darkness beyond the glory, the unfathomable unknown, countless people hissing, growling and struggling in the chaos and distortion. It tore my soul apart, uncovering everything in disguise. At that moment, I finally witnessed the reality of this world...

speaker: Enfer
content: Fame and prosperity are ridiculous, love and happiness can be false, only fear cannot be concealed. The world is already distorted and cruel. I can't use the so-called beauty and compassion to create false peace, but at least I can carve out the reality I see.

speaker: Enfer
content: To awaken all forms of fear with my works, and reach the truth and people's hearts, this is my dream as an artist... But unfortunately, I'm not really there yet.
She looks over at Lisa.

speaker: Enfer
content: You know, the art world offers only vain fame. I'm not a great creator, and I fail all the time. My every creation is accompanied by pain, and even with the Sinner's power, I can't clearly portray the fear in my heart.
Lisa opens her mouth as if she wants to argue but then grits her teeth to listen.

speaker: Enfer
content: Luckily, there's Sosia... She is the closest I've ever come to achieving my goal, and I have a feeling that she can make my dream come true. If even she is twisted by Witching Hour...

speaker: Enfer
content: I will destroy her myself. My incompetence brought this misfortune to them, and it's up to me to bring them peace.
Enfer's smile fades. Like when you first met, she leans against the Gate of Hell, her eyes downcast, looking sorrowful.
Now you understand that she wanted to enter the section to end Witching Hour then. But she was hesitating to break Gate of Hell, her own work.

options: I only want you to help me end Witching Hour.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As for how you do it, I don't care. Sosia is still her true self now. If I were you, I'd rush to her side and find a way to free her from the mutation—while there's still a chance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you can find a way, I will help you, just as you helped me.

speaker: Enfer
content: Hehe, makes sense. You really are something else. I'd love to hear how you feel when you meet Sosia.

options: Come on. Let's go see Sosia.

content: You step toward the destination, where Sosia is waiting for you.
...She suddenly looks up. The veil covers her face, but... there's no doubt she's looking at you.
...No, not you, she's looking at...
Enfer's body suddenly begins to turn into plaster. From her limbs to her heart, Enfer's horrified expression solidified, and even her hair turns white.
Damn it!
You release the shackles, but the spikes pierce into the fragile plaster, and the pure white "Enfer" instantly shatters. The broken pieces fall to the ground and are quickly dissolved.

speaker: EMP
content: She's... shattered? And the Chief did it?! Haha... I must be dreaming... This isn't real, is it?
The pure white corridor begins to twist, elongate, and sink. The dark mist in the hall seems to hear the summoning and starts to surge again. More monsters emerge from it to come at you.

speaker: EMP
content: Ahhhh, help! I want to go back to the Bureau! Get me back to MBCC!!!

speaker: Hella
content: Bear with it, you **** damn fool! Hold your thoughts. It's just a plaster statue!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, Nightmare can't sense Enfer. Is she still alive? Is Sosia trying to kill her?
Although invisible to the naked eye, the shackles tell you Enfer is below. She is near the distorted white booth, near "Sosia"!

options: Get down. We need to save Enfer ASAP.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Ahhh!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief?!
Your steps feel sluggish, and you know this feeling. You had the same feeling when facing the frenzied "shackles" and trapped by fear.
You can still feel how the shackles shattered "Enfer." You know it's just a statue, but the scene was really powerful—It makes you afraid.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Warning. The mutation is escalating, and the contamination outside is seeping in. Can't let them come in. Labyrinth will stay behind to hold them back.

speaker: EMP
content: Huuuuuh? Then I'll go with the Chief! I'll protect the Chief!! I-I-I can fight so don't leave me alone!!!

speaker: Hella
content: Come on. The thing down there is an actual demon, and she can turn all the scary stuff in your head into reality! Stay here if you want to live!

speaker: EMP
content: Oh...I'll stay!! Go, Chief! The arrows of the Archer Queen will always be there for you!

speaker: Hecate
content: I'll go down with the Chief. How about you, Hella? Can you do it?

speaker: Hella
content: Of course! He's too much of a troublemaker, and I need to stick with him!
female_content: Of course! She's too much of a troublemaker, and I need to stick with her!

speaker: Lisa
content: I'll go, too...
She looks emotional. It seems that what happened with Enfer gave Lisa quite a shock.

speaker: Lisa
content: That's her greatest work and must be the most powerful.

speaker: Lisa
content: Did she sense that Enfer was coming to destroy her, so she turned on her creator?

speaker: Lisa
content: But what happened to that sculpture? Is it sentient? Does it have emotions? What purpose is she acting on, and what is her power...

speaker: Lisa
content: No! I have to go. I can help, and if anything happens to that person...

options: You will only bring risks with your current state.

speaker: Lisa
content: Ouch! But...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Calm down. You're not doing this alone. Stay here and protect the team. Leave the rest to us. You can trust me.

speaker: Lisa
content: ...Okay. When everything here is solved, I'll join you down there. Including Enfer, if any of you don't come back, I won't forgive you!
You nod and gradually regain your composure after assigning everyone's role. The monsters behind are blocked by Lisa and the others, and you're free to move forward.

speaker: Hella
content: Okay, run... Ahhhh!
As you walk around the spiral staircase, more plaster monsters emerge from the trembling ground!

speaker: Hella
content: For the record, I'm not afraid, and these are not from my head!

speaker: Hecate
content: Their power comes from below. It's Sosia trying to stop us!

speaker: Hella
content: Get out of the way!! Hella is going into smash mode!!
She swings with her pipe and actually opens up a path for you.
You reach the bottom of the staircase, and through the strewn plaster pieces, you can already see Sosia's back. The shackles are also reacting, which means Enfer is there!
The statue turns slightly sideways, and just when you think she's going to look up. A sudden bright light briefly deprives you of all senses...
Your senses return. The chaos is gone, and so are the Sinners. You're in an empty room with pure white walls. It's so quiet you can only hear your own breathing.

There are paintings of various sizes hanging on the wall. In front of the largest portrait in the center stands a woman wearing white. She has two hands clasped behind her back and two in front of her, and her seemingly soft hair is completely still.
The woman has her back to you and is quietly admiring the painting.
She doesn't turn around or answer, but you know she invited you here.
Sosia has her back to you. Besides the two extra hands, she looks graceful, and although there are occasionally reflective glimmers, her skin looks perfect.
Ignoring the vibrating shackles reminding you that you're at the center of the mutation, everything about this scene is calm and peaceful.

speaker: Sosia
content: You're... Enfer's guest.

speaker: Sosia
content: Are you here to... admire her masterpiece?
Enfer's masterpiece... You subconsciously look at the paintings on the wall.
It's mostly blurred men, women, and children. They are happy, confused, lonely, shocked, scared, mad, and... there's a crimson halo.
And in front of Sosia, the largest painting in the center of the wall depicts a violet dahlia in full bloom.
By masterpiece, is she talking about the paintings on the wall or herself?

speaker: Sosia
content: She only has one masterpiece, and that's me.
You immediately tense up... The statue can hear your thoughts, which means you're in her spiritual field.

options: Are you carrying out Parma's orders?
What have you done to Enfer?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Was Witching Hour created to collect people's fear? Is this another experiment of Black Ring?

speaker: Sosia
content: What is... Parma? What is... Black Ring?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you afraid that she'd destroy you? Do you want to live that badly?

speaker: Sosia
content: I have no obsession with... being alive.

speaker: Sosia
content: Enfer created me and wished for me to be her masterpiece, so I only live for her artistic vision.
...Is this what she wishes for? Is she a mere creation or a natural liar? How are you going to destroy this mysterious statue and solve the incident?

options: You said you wanted to realize her artistic vision.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But instead, you created Witching Hour, and the imagination you made into reality ruined all her works.

speaker: Sosia
content: Do you think our Witching Hour is a false distortion? You think my creations are ugly distortions of Enfer's works?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What you created is not real fear but entertainment and thrill for the audience. It's not what Enfer wanted to express.

speaker: Sosia
content: You are saying that their fear is frivolous and nothing compared to what Enfer is trying to express? That I am contrary to Enfer's ideals?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Fear is supposed to point to the truth. She wants to reveal the truth and reach people's hearts.
Sosia's marble face slightly changes, and her voice actually sounds sarcastic.

speaker: Sosia
content: ...Hehe, I know her heart. She invested her life and soul in me... I know everything about her.
She stops answering you and just stares at the dahlia painting. Her pale fingers are playing with a sharp carving knife.

speaker: Sosia
content: She doesn't care what people think. They are nothing compared to the horrible reality that has once destroyed her.

speaker: Sosia
content: Her remorse is never about being misinterpreted. She's only bitter about her own failures.
Sosia lifts the carving knife in her hand and slowly stabs it into the canvas, ripping it open.
With the sound of breaking fibers, a wound is torn out on the dahlia.

speaker: Sosia
content: Because of the weakness in her heart, she can't present the purest terror.

speaker: Sosia
content: Because of the confusion in her heart, she can't present my true form.

speaker: Sosia
content: The only thing that ever got in the way between her and her dream... was herself.
The carving knife cuts across the canvas like an elegant brush. The "wound" grows larger, and the petals start to fall. Your shackles sting, and a bad feeling clouds your mind.
Sosia doesn't answer, for she stopped seeing you. She raises her hand to tear off a small piece of the canvas, revealing the bottomless void behind, and then raises the carving knife.

speaker: Sosia
content: Now I think about it, you only wanted to carve out the wounds in your own heart and the darkness you witnessed.

speaker: Sosia
content: That is your art, the only consolation for your broken soul.
You hear a wail from the other side of the shackles, and the pain resonates through you, driving your body along with the suffocating fear...
Aaahhh!!

The carving knife pierces the canvas, and at the same time, the shackles are released, tearing open the illusions but also shattering completely. It's like your hand is being crushed, and the pain almost knocks you unconscious. You've never felt like this before...
The shackles... are broken?!
The shackles must be established through direct physical contact. The removal condition is the death of either the enabler or the shackled Sinner.
But you're still alive.
So that means...

speaker: Hecate & Hella
content:
Chief!
Wake up!
The illusion is gone, along with the pale gallery and mysterious paintings. You're back in Sosia's hall, but it's pitch dark.
Sosia is standing behind her pedestal, still holding the carving knife. Her long hair is floating with dark mist, and on the pedestal...
Enfer is lying on her back, her hair hanging down like a lifeless sculpture. Her motionless eyes are looking at you.

speaker: Hella
content: Enfer... is dead?
You want to check, to save her, but you can't move. Something is pinning you down, imprisoning your will.

speaker: Sosia
content: This is the realm of fear, and only the embodiment of fear can be in charge of everything.

speaker: Sosia
content: I will take control of all this, to fulfill Enfer's wishes.
She looks down at the woman fallen at her feet.

speaker: Sosia
content: ...I've missed you, mother.

speaker: Sosia
content: You woke me up from the cold stone, gave me my flesh, and shared your soul with me. You can't bear to see us misinterpreted and defiled...

speaker: Sosia
content: I know that you have always loved us, just as we all deeply love you.

speaker: Sosia
content: But have you forgotten what he taught you?

speaker: Sosia
content: In this world, love is the most hypocritical and fragile existence. It's the most vulnerable in the face of fear but keeps weaving out rotten fairytales to obscure the truth.

speaker: Sosia
content: It softens your strong heart and weakens your fear... It's why you've been stuck in a bottleneck, unable to achieve your artistic vision.

speaker: Sosia
content: ...You should fear me, mother, but all I ever see in your eyes is love.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Enfer didn't create you. Parma used you to take advantage of Enfer's power and extract people's fear during Witching Hour.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is not Enfer's art but an experiment of Black Ring!!! What are you trying to do with people's hearts again?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, calm down. Something is peering into your heart. It wants to turn the things you fear into reality.

speaker: Sosia
content: Hehe...

speaker: Sosia
content: Behold, mother, the fear in their eyes. Look at the distortion and madness I bring to you. Don't resent them for being vulgar or what my earthly shell has become. It's never beauty on the surface you seek...

speaker: Sosia
content: I am the Witching Hour, and you created my everything. We will put fear into everyone's hearts and make them see reality. Let's see how the chaos of humanity can twist the world beyond human reach.

speaker: Sosia
content: This is your masterpiece, your dream.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...My... dream...
You try to hold on to the shackles, but it's as frail as Enfer. It can't take any more stimulation.

speaker: Sosia
content: Looking back, from that day... you lived only for this art and achieving your masterpiece.

speaker: Sosia
content: So come, mother... Come back to me and become a part of me...

speaker: Sosia
content: Do you... fear me now?

speaker: Enfer
content: ...Yes, I fear...
Her breath is fading, and you can feel the shackles linking to Enfer weakening.
And the feeling called fear is awakened in your heart. It materializes, imprisoning you like never before. Witching Hour's field is getting stronger, and something is coming...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I will save you. This isn't Sosia, your masterpiece. This shouldn't be the world in your eyes...
As if hearing your cry, she tilts her head and looks at you with an eerie smile. Her lips move slightly, weakly delivering her last words...

speaker: Enfer
content: ...Run.
The last light in her eyes fades, and a huge black dahlia blossoms. Its petals keep growing and spreading until they cover Enfer's body.
You feel like falling into an abyss, watching as Sosia reaches out, tears off the black petals, and puts them in her mouth.

speaker: Hecate
content: She's... feeding on Enfer's power... She will get stronger... Stop her, we must stop her...
But no one can act. Hella's scream is choked in her throat, and the Nightmare flinches back in fear. Enfer has disappeared entirely under the dahlia.
Sosia, however, has gained unprecedented power. Her stone body is covered with a dark blue mist, and her solid hair starts floating.

speaker: Sosia
content: Thank you for making me whole... my mother, my creator...

speaker: Sosia
content: Now I can finally fulfill your wishes.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!! watch out!!
Hella tries to step up, but something keeps her in place. Hecate pushes you out of the way with her last strength, and a violent shock descends.
Sosia's veil is gone, revealing an ominous pupil. Behind her, the sky darkens, and a glorious painting unfolds like paint flowing down from the dome.
It twists, regenerates, and spreads, swallowing everything in the hall. Crushing sounds come from the ground, and bizarre statues are born out of thin air.
FAC's shrill siren rings out over the museum. As Sosia leaves her pedestal, she seems to get lighter and floats up, blending into the glorious starry night behind.

speaker: Sosia
content: Give your blessing to the birth of the Witching Hour. She will bring the most vivid fear to all of you.

speaker: Sosia
content: This is Enfer's greatest work.
The power of fear takes hold of Hella. With the girl's scream, it expands and actually splits into two identical monsters.

speaker: Hella
content: Argh... Let go of me! Let go!

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare!
The writhing colorful chaos is shattered, and it releases its grip on Hella. She falls from mid-air and is caught by you, just barely.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, mind suppression. Control your fear. The monster you create from your fear is almost as big as EMP's.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm not that ******* coward!

speaker: Hella
content: I was just surprised and jumped a little. How can I have created such a big thing? Where did Witching Hour learn inflation?
No time for wordplay. The colorful pieces don't disappear but start to merge with each other. They soon return to their original forms, generating more phantom monsters.
After devouring Enfer, Sosia's interference with reality is significantly enhanced. Even the tiniest fear will be captured and turned into reality.

speaker: Hecate
content: The Mania field has gone completely out of control. Anyone with fear will be completely dominated, and the monsters born from fear will add to Witching Hour's power, making us more afraid...

speaker: Hella
content: Say something I don't know! Isn't this a ******* snowslide?!
As you speak, shadows close in again, and Hella subconsciously grabs you. You try to steady her mind with the shackles but find yourself unable to use them.

You can still feel the cold touch of the shackles breaking, freezing your hands. And it feels like you can still see Enfer's hollow eyes on the empty pedestal. They pierce your mind like two nails, and you find it impossible to break free.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is the center of the Mania field, and the mutation is the strongest here. We must get out of here.
...Get out of the place that can break your mental defenses and get rid of its influence, or you will all become the feeder of fear.

speaker: Monster
content: Offer your fear... Offer your fear...!

speaker: Monster
content: Roar!!! Roar!!!
Two huge monsters keep roaring and hammering with their fists, almost breaking the entire hall to pieces.
The Mania outburst is spreading rapidly, and the whole museum is like a nucleus of fear about to fracture and explode.

speaker: Hecate
content: The Witching Hour is expanding. It has absorbed thousands of guests and is still feeding on their fear...

speaker: Hecate
content: Wait... They are moving upwards. Where are they going?
New monsters keep coming out of the dark mist and spreading upward. The outline of the building has disappeared, and the Mania pushes against an invisible barrier at the top...

options: ...They want to get out of here?

content: The fear here is no longer enough for Sosia. She wants her "art" to be grander.

speaker: Hecate
content: They want to get out?! To break through the anti-Mania blockade outside and spread Witching Hour to the city?

speaker: Hecate
content: There are millions of people in Eastside. If fear starts spreading among them, the whole city will...
But how? The person who could destroy Sosia is no more, and you have lost your best chance of stopping the mutation.
At least, you can stabilize the Sinners' minds. If they can overcome their fear, they can fight against Sosia.
You try to concentrate and gather your power together, but a ghostly laugh comes from the glistening mist behind you.
Hehe... Hehe...
The laughter slowly approaches, coming from all directions and wrapping around you. The shackles that have just taken shape tremble slightly and then dissipate as if they have been drawn away.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk, stop thinking so much!! Isn't there enough trouble in front of us?! I...

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}! Look behind you! Behind! Behind you!
It's not Sosia herself that emerges from the mist, but two fear monsters of unprecedented size!

speaker: Fear Materialized
content: Offer your fear... Offer your fear...!

speaker: Fear Materialized
content: Roar!!! Roar!!!
The monster's shackles are close at hand, and an arrow shoots right into it just then!

speaker: EMP
content: Ahaha, haha... Of course, I am the Archer Queen of Syndicate, I...

speaker: EMP
content: I'm giving up bragging... I can't hold this much longer!! Chief, help!!

speaker: Hella
content: What took you guys so long?! Wait, what's that thing... behind you?!
EMP and Lisa, who stayed behind, catch up with you. But an even more gigantic monster trails behind them, rushing all the way to where you are with the stairs.
The monster looks rather peculiar, with two scythes in the left hand, a leather whip in the right hand, and a strange flower in its mouth. EMP's howling even adds some comedic effect to it.

speaker: Giant Monster
content: Stop running... Stop running... EMP...!!!

speaker: Hella
content: Are you here to help or to cause more trouble? Don't come any closer! Don't run toward me!!!

speaker: EMP
content: There's nothing I can do...!!
At the same time, white light slashes through the air, splitting the monster apart. A girl smashes down with the rubble and lands heavily on the ground.

speaker: Hecate
content: Labyrinth?!
Cold blades extend from her ceramic arms, and lights flash through the girl's eyes.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Cleaning order, activated.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: EMP, Lisa, Hella, Hecate, why are you dazing? Return to battle right now. We need to protect Master.
With the AI maid's strength, you finally break out of the siege of fear monsters and get some time to catch your breath.

speaker: EMP
content: Chief, boss, a-a-are you... okay?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Protecting Master is my mission. Labyrinth will not feel fear, will not let them near you, or hurt you.
Her tone sounds inhuman, but her grip on you is tightening, so hard that it hurts a little. It also reminds you that the crisis is not over.

speaker: Lisa
content: You mean Enfer was... by her own piece...

speaker: Lisa
content: No... it shouldn't have been like this. She was so young and talented...

speaker: Hella
content: Snap the **** out of it!!! Are you trying to feed that monster? Now is not the time to be afraid!

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't think about anything else, or the fear will take control of all of us.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: 7 minutes and 28 seconds ago, the entire museum shook, and the enemies were suddenly enhanced. I suspect that they have received a command to launch a unified attack. In addition, all the broken exhibits are coming together and restoring themselves.

options: What about the exhibits destroyed by Enfer?

content: The two's gloomy expression answers you. Enfer said she could destroy the exhibits here, but if they are putting themselves back together... It means Witching Hour has absorbed her power.
Sosia is now both the creation of fear and the creator of all these. With Witching Hour, the fear artworks have become eternal, but this despairing fact doesn't seem to sway you.
Perhaps because of the return of all your companions, you have calmed down. As Enfer said, you do seem to see things from a very special angle.

options: Has the Gate of Hell also been recovering?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Strange question. Yes, it's restoring too. But perhaps because it was shattered by the creator herself, it's recovering more slowly than the other exhibits.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Time is running out. Request immediate evacuation. The number and intensity of enemies are skyrocketing. We should force an opening to get out of the museum now.
She's right. The laws of Witching Hour are clear now. And once something makes you feel fear, it will overwhelm you.
Fear is in absolute control here, and the Gate of Hell that can inspire fear will become even more powerful. Once it's restored, you will never be able to get out.

options: I see. We should go back as soon as possible.

speaker: Hella
content: Back? Back where?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Back to the Gate of Hell. It's a long shot, but we need to try.

speaker: EMP
content: Phew, run faster. I'll clear the way for you!

Finally, you reach the top of the spiral staircase, the only way out, and the Gate of Hell is recovering. You rush forward to grab the largest shard, and the sharp edge cuts through your hand as gravity pulls.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief?!
Although it isn't back to its original form, the broken mirror still shows your reflection. The figure then begins to twist into that familiar illusion of madness.

speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
content: Surrender...
Everyone, including you, feels an instinctive shudder.

speaker: Lisa
content: ...We can't just not be afraid of it... There's simply no way to control that fear.

speaker: Lisa
content: I don't get it... What do you want? Why come back?
Sosia's wicked laughter answers her. You pull the pale Lisa behind you.

speaker: Sosia
content: Hehe... Trying to get out?

speaker: Sosia
content: Are you afraid of the coming unknown? Do you want to escape before the real horror starts? But where can you escape to?
She emerges from the chaos, approaching you with twisted power.

speaker: Sosia
content: The realm of fear is born, and will soon spread throughout the city. Nowhere will be safe... No one can escape fear, because there's no escaping reality.

speaker: Sosia
content: Don't worry. I won't take your lives. Life is the source of fear, and the dead means nothing to me.

speaker: Sosia
content: Start picturing what's worse than dying.

options: You're already making me tremble, Sosia.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I never wanted to run away!
You raise the Gate of Hell piece in your hand, break the bond of fear with all your might, and rush toward the witch who rules fear. The obsidian piece shows her reflection.

speaker: Sosia
content: This is?

speaker: Sosia
content: You...?! Ahhhhhhh!!

The woman who created you said that works are the most sincere expression of the artist. You have to shed all the pretensions, bare your soul, and experience pain like never before to convey one-millionth of what is in your heart.
Let's see... The one who created Witching Hour, what kind of fear do you have inside?
A massive illusion breaks out of the mirror, roaring and charging at Sosia!

speaker: Fear Shadow
content: Great artist... Witch of fear... Tell your story... Feed me more fear...

speaker: Fear Shadow
content: What do you see and hear? What do you love and fear...

speaker: Fear Shadow
content: Say it and make it true. Come now. We are eager for your creation!

speaker: Sosia
content: Nooo!!
She screams and waves her hand to break the illusion in front of her, but the swarm of monsters within remains. They rush out as if sensing her fear, and you lose grasp of the piece.
The piece falls to the ground and is quickly dragged toward the Gate of Hell. With its last piece back, the gate is restored...
From the deep darkness, someone emerges—A man who mutters to himself.

speaker: Black Illusion
content: You... love me... So... give me... inspiration...

speaker: Black Illusion
content: Take me to the hall... Back to the pinnacle of... art... And show me once again... the truest fear...
With one step and another, he slowly walks toward Sosia with a hammer and a carving knife. And the dominating witch is petrified. She freezes in place just as you were.

speaker: Black Illusion
content: Yes, that's right... The perfect feeling. Feel the fear, you who love me! That's how you approach the reality of beauty and achieve the greatest art...

speaker: Sosia
content: No... No...
Sosia begins to tremble as her power fades. The dark shadow starts absorbing her strength.
That's it. You bet on the slim chance and won. Only those who have been deeply afraid can create fear, and once captured by their fear, even Sosia will be robbed of her power by Witching Hour.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't just ******* stand there! There's a big guy over here!
Along with the dark illusion that grabbed Sosia, the "you" you have met earlier walks out.

speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
content: Surrender...

speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
content: Fear is making me stronger... You can't beat me...

speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
content: Bow down to me... Offer your fear... Become a part of me...
It's an illusion created by the Gate of Hell, a fear you can't deny. You can still feel its haunting power now.
But you beat it once, and you don't want to lose.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's see which one of us conquers our fear and this Witching Hour first.

speaker: Sosia
content: Haha... I will not lose to you... This incompetent human... I will surpass him as I have done before...

speaker: Sosia
content: I've seen a darker reality. I understand everything about the unknown... I have Enfer's everything!
She screams hysterically and slashes at the Gate of Hell with invisible claws. With a mournful cry, massive energy spills out, and the obsidian withers and whitens into a fossil-like texture.
Sosia absorbs the energy, and the illusion of a man disappears.

speaker: Black Illusion
content: Fear... is reality...
After the storm subsides, she looks up at you.

speaker: Sosia
content: Hehe... You shouldn't have pulled that trick on me... If you're so eager to die, I'll grant your wish...

speaker: Sosia
content: My Witching Hour... You can't taint it...
Sosia fades backward into the twisted starry night, the air burns up, and the ground begins to crack. She has penetrated every corner of this space, dominating everything...

speaker: EMP
content: Is it just me, or is she getting weaker?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Just you. Sosia has absorbed Gate of Hell's energy and will definitely become stronger.

speaker: Hella
content: Shut the **** up! That little wimp is going to cry again!
Luckily, this is Witching Hour, and fear is the source of power. It would be real trouble if you had to face her head-on.
You think for a second, turn to your companions, and make a cheering gesture.

options: Just don't be afraid. You can do this!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She just made a big fool of herself in front of us. What is there to fear? She's just bluffing to save face.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you're still afraid, think of the way she was. She was so scared and started howling.
Someone can't help but laughs. You don't turn to look who it is. It's a good thing.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Understood. Labyrinth is not afraid. Labyrinth can protect Master, so Master doesn't need to be afraid.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: We just need EMP to step aside.

speaker: EMP
content: There's no need to say that!! I have a reputation to keep, occasionally!!!

speaker: EMP
content: It's not that easy to stop being afraid, okay? Otherwise, I wouldn't be a... well, coward all this time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll give you courage.

speaker: EMP
content: Chief...!!!

speaker: Lisa
content: ...Hmph, you're good at fooling people. Be grateful that it's the no-brainers that have come this time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You look a lot more relaxed. Ready to fight?
She looks away and grunts.

speaker: Hella
content: Why are you looking at me? Ahem, I'm always ready!

speaker: Hecate
content: Whenever you need.
Human minds are extraordinary. Because they're not sensible enough, they will be fearful of the unknown, eager to escape, and trapped in despair.
But for the same reason, even a glimmer of hope can ignite their instincts to struggle and to live. The shackles' power is recovering. It's still trying to grasp the bit of hope.
Anyway, the one who's alone and running away now, is not you.
Where am I...
I think... I just saw that man again...
How long has it been... I still don't understand his darkness... I still run from it...
...Is this my dream, my ideal... This fear... It's so frightening...
There are noises.
Who... Who's out there?

speaker: Lisa
content: ...You mean we can make Sosia feel fear to reverse the power here? Are you out of your mind?

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, I think it's great. This is my expertise! Try this...

speaker: Hella
content: Woah, the field of fear? Sounds embarrassing. The embodiment of reality? We smashed through the Black Ring with a pipe. Who are you again?
They... fear...

speaker: Hella
content: What's so impressive about absorbing a B-Class Sinner? Come out and fight me!

speaker: EMP
content: C-come out! I'm the Archer Queen of Syndicate, and you're in big trouble! And you need to pass the Chief first before facing me!
But why... are they still standing here...
We're all Sinners who have been baptized by Mania, who have witnessed the brutal reality and the dark, horrible abyss...
Why can THEY escape the domination of fear? Why do they have the power to fight fear while my strength is draining away?

speaker: Hella
content: Ohhhh, she looks uncomfortable. Did I intimidate her? Let's keep doing this... Huh? What are you doing up here?
A familiar person appears in front of her.
...Is it him?
female_content: ...It's her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The witch's ward is trembling. Is it about to hold out?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Because you are afraid of too many things. You fear the shackles, unknown forces, and you fear that I will affect the trapped Enfer... But there's no use in hiding. Escaping is the best ingredient for fear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come out, Sosia. You're the only one trapped by fear.
It's because... I'm afraid? For all this time, I am the one who's been trapped by fear and can't escape?

speaker: Sosia
content: You mean... I'm afraid? For all this time, I am the one who's been trapped by fear and can't escape?

speaker: Sosia
content: Stop dreaming! I'm her masterpiece, the embodiment of fear! I am the dominator of reality!
It's sad she still can't see that fear is the most powerful and weakest enemy. All the difficulties you encounter can be overcome, and it's only due to weakness that you can't.
To stop Witching Hour, you are your only opponent.

speaker: Sosia
content: Hahahahaha... Hahahaha!
Sosia lets out a burst of wild laughter.

speaker: Sosia
content: I lost. I fear your power... You are the second person who has ever struck fear in me.

speaker: Sosia
content: You opened my eyes to a world I have never seen before. I've been living under a rock, what we've been chasing is nothing more than twisted, shallow fantasies of fear. I want to thank you...

speaker: Sosia
content: But Witching Hour will not end. Fear will not cease to exist.
She suddenly closes in on you, and the ground caves in. The four hands of the demoness statue cling to you as you plunge down into the mist of fear.

speaker: Sosia
content: Come and kill me in the most brutal way possible.

speaker: Sosia
content: If the ideal cannot be realized, let me die by the hand of fear and become part of this piece, part of the ideal...

speaker: Sosia
content: Destroy me with fear, devour me, and make me a part of you... You will inherit the glorious Witching Hour.
Through a butterfly-shaped shroud, Sosia looks at you with fervor and quest.

speaker: Sosia
content: You will gain infinite horror and represent the twisted truth of this world, existing as Enfer's latest and final piece.

speaker: Sosia
content: ...You will become fear itself.

options: You think I would do that?

speaker: Sosia
content: Oh, you'd rather die than accept my offer? That does sound like you, but this time, you won't be able to say no...

speaker: Sosia
content: You'll do anything to protect them.
The mist drifting around Sosia condenses, wrapping itself around you and each of the Sinners. It chokes them, trying to shake your will and create gaps to erode you.

speaker: Hecate
content: No! Chief, we'll find another way!
Sosia ignores her and lifts you up. She presses close, threatening and trying to bewitch you.

speaker: Sosia
content: Terminate me and inherit Witching Hour. I only fear you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You are abandoning yourself and want me to inherit your "work." This is a new low even for you. You don't deserve to talk about art or Enfer. You're just a tool of a conspirator and a vessel for Witching Hour.
You are a shell without a soul. I will never do what you want.

speaker: Sosia
content: Aaahhh!!! Let go! That's not true! Don't do this!
You reach out to grab the icy statue and release the shackles, trying to awaken the Sinner sealed in fear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What ends terror is never a greater terror. Witching Hour can't control me, and I will never take such a thing. You are in no position to deny feelings beyond fear. You don't even dare to face your fear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Release her. Even if her heart is confused, she is much stronger than you!

speaker: Sosia
content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!
You are about to push her further into the corner when a coldness covers your wrist as if an invisible hand is trying to stop you. On the other end of the shackles, a faint pulse starts beating.

options: Are you still trying to protect her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then come out and face your fear, Enfer, just like you always do.
Before your "child" sees what fear is really like, she will become a pawn and get crushed by me. I know you don't want that.
This is not how your masterpiece should end!

The shackles tear through the twisted starry sky, shattering the witch statue but failing to kill Sosia. She's pushed away, turning into a nebulous mist and floating away. The rest of her quickly turns into pale stone and crumbles.
And the frail sculptor breaks free from the broken statue. Enfer slowly opens her eyes.

speaker: Enfer
content: What a frightening person... Leave her alone... I will take responsibility...
She looks into your eyes, and her pupils are deep like the chaos mirror that reflects fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: You said... I haven't seen my deepest fear or my true self...

speaker: Enfer
content: You said I'm running from the unknown...
Enfer lifts her hands and cups your face.
This time, instead of the cold, stiff touch of stone, her hands feel warm and soft.

speaker: Enfer
content: So will you accompany me? To witness the real inferno, the ultimate abyss, and the self I haven't met.

speaker: Enfer
content: Hehe, I knew you'd say that...

speaker: Enfer
content: Then try to face it this time. I promised I would help you end this.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...The next time you're about to walk in the dark, come to me first...

speaker: Enfer
content: I will... wait for you...

She lets go of you and looks to the twisted sky. The mutation is changing shape rapidly, and you can vaguely see a single golden pupil. The fragments of Sosia are also floating in the air, gradually being pulled in all directions and devoured.
Enfer gazes without saying anything, and a sad expression passes over her face. She raises her hand to meet the storming sky.

speaker: Sosia
content: ...No... Enfer... I haven't failed... Mother... Don't give up on me...

speaker: Enfer
content: You were never a failure... You and the others are all my creations, my children, a part of me.

speaker: Enfer
content: Come back. Don't let it twist you. You are no one's tool.

speaker: Enfer
content: We will create the next masterpiece together...
A blinding light bursts out of her hand, and Sosia lets out a cry, struggling to escape. But she can't deny the will of her creator and is absorbed along with all the mutations.
Fear grabs your soul through the shackles and tears at her will.
She doesn't stop but looks straight at the incoming starry sky of fear, allowing the chaos to wash over her. Mania erupts in her frail body, but she doesn't collapse.

You suddenly see that, during the long years of sculpting out fear, the artist is not just a prisoner of it. She has always looked directly at it, tried to conquer it, and gained the ultimate strength—Only she never realized it herself.
As the last bit of the mutation is absorbed, everything suddenly subsides. Enfer falls backward into your arms like a broken puppet. Her eyes are open, and there's an imperceptible smile on her face.
Enfer? Enfer?!
The sculptor doesn't wake up. An illusory figure emerges from Enfer's side and gently closes her eyes. The raging energy inside her calms down.

speaker: Shadow of a Woman
content: Live, my child...

speaker: Shadow of a Woman
content: I will... always protect you.
The phantom begins to disappear and looks up at you as if waiting for an answer.
I promised her.

The mutation is terminated, and the FAC enters the museum to clean up the remnants of the contamination. The trapped citizens have all been rescued. Banyan psychiatrists will erase their memories so they can return to their lives.
The suspicious stone Sosia left is collected and sent to the Paradeisos Black Ring Research Institute. Its connection to Parma's organization will be investigated by the 9th Agency.

Enfer is detained by MBCC. Her M-value has been confirmed to have risen to S-Class. Due to the early acquisition of the shackles, the contamination didn't further corrupt her. She's stabilizing but not waking up.
The mad artist has been banished, and the strange tale will soon be replaced by the next one. Witching Hour will soon be forgotten. After all, the truth that no one wants to face is a lie.
Bureau Recreation Area
Music with strong beats starts to play, which seems to be the intro to some kind of show.

speaker: Love
content: Hey, hey! Shouts to all our audience on both sides of the Rust, Eastside, Syndicate, WhiteSands, Outland, and Paradeisos! And audience in DisSea, if there's any!

speaker: Hella
content: Wo-hoo! Don't forget MBCC, hehe!

speaker: Love
content: Mua! You're listening to DeadLover Radio's Hallowing special, and I'm here to bring you breaking, urgent, and mega news! This time it's aaaaagain Eastside bringing us the fun!

speaker: Love
content: Woohoo, Syndicate has been left behind for a long time. Ready to surprise everyone again?

speaker: Hella & EMP
content:
Who the **** are you looking down upon?
Hahahaha, I knew they couldn't do anything without me. Hahahaha!

speaker: Love
content: Well, well, I'm getting a good vibe! Let's get started, then! Our topic today is the super exciting themed art exhibition that has lit up Eastside: the <color=#fb9259>Witching Hour</color>!

speaker: Daisy
content: Ah, I've heard about it. It's only open for a week every year, and a bunch of live-streams and urban legends around it go viral every time.

speaker: Daisy
content: The horror exhibition features the most bizarre artists and particularly scary "artworks." There are always people who love those for the thrill, so it's quite popular in Eastside.

speaker: Love
content: Oh, but nonono, this year, it's not that. It's...

speaker: Daisy
content: Oh, I know that too. This year, it's the first time that all of Witching Hour's exhibitions are from the same artist. Her iconic works go from oil paintings to sculptures. They are super whimsical and the most recent hotshots.

speaker: Daisy
content: But people mostly talk about her. The daughter of a legendary art family, young and beautiful, her parents passed away and she inherited a considerable fortune. It's only been two months since she went viral, but there are already so many rumors about her.

speaker: Love
content: Huh...? First time I've seen you talk so much. Hey, hey, don't steal my lines, 'kay? You're here for the sarcasm, remember?

speaker: Love
content: Ahem, I was talking about something I learned from my private intelligence network, and it's way more exciting than a beautiful artist...

speaker: Love
content: This is top-secret news from Eastside: An hour ago, the Witching Hour shut down due to an emergency, and FAC is on the move...

speaker: Love
content: Trust Love's super S-level radar! I'm pretty sure the claimed-to-be-safe Eastside is having yet another secret Mania Crisis! *gasp* Oh no!

speaker: Love
content: They had visitors missing on the first day of the exhibition. And now... no one is getting out! That is thousands of people that went poof!

speaker: Love
content: All the damage done to the exterior of the building recovered in seconds, and all communications were cut. The inside is completely isolated, and you can only hear weak crying and screaming... It's a real horror show!!!
DeadLover Radio has been getting good ratings within MBCC. Many Sinners from Syndicate dig the vibe.
Of course, there are some who don't.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Tired. Does she always add so much unnecessary information when talking? The communication efficiency is less than 30%, and as the receiver, it takes up a lot of memory to process.

speaker: EMP
content: Hey, that's called humor, hu-mor! DeadLover Radio is very popular. Look, even the brooding bunch, Lisa and Hecate, are here!

speaker: Lisa
content: I heard someone mention some art exhibition and came to check it out. But I see this is a waste of time.

speaker: Lisa
content: Also, humor is the art of language. You need to at least know how to read to understand it.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait... Why are you targeting me?!

speaker: Hecate
content: I can't find the Chief. Has he been here?
female_content: I can't find the Chief. Has she been here?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: No, it's Master's day off, and he left the Bureau at noon. Faye, head of the supply office, gave him a present, and Labyrinth presumed that Master went out for entertainment.
female_content: No, it's Master's day off, and she left the Bureau at noon. Faye, head of the supply office, gave her a present, and Labyrinth presumed that Master went out for entertainment.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Surprised. You claim to care about Master but don't even know his whereabouts? Chuckle.
female_content: Surprised. You claim to care about Master but don't even know her whereabouts? Chuckle.

speaker: Hella
content: Fight! Fight! Isn't this Hallowing night? Let's have some fun while that idiot is out!
In this buzz of excitement, the DeadLover Radio show comes to a close.

speaker: Love
content: That was all the fun Love has to share. If you know something I don't, or if you're planning to visit the event in person, hmm... You know, get in touch!

speaker: Love
content: A terrifying Mania Crisis is happening in the horror exhibition on the scary Hallowing night. Who doesn't want to see how horrible it can be? I do!
MBCC Command Center
All the department heads have arrived, and the atmosphere here is completely different.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: Yes, a Mania crisis has been confirmed at the Belphegor Art Museum. Starting at 5:23 p.m., the M-value spiked, and communications were blocked. It was impossible to breach externally, and we lost contact with all personnel who have entered it.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: FAC has cordoned off the site, but many people have already been involved. Rumors have spread among the public, many civilians are very interested and are trying to force their way into the scene.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: In addition, during the urgent checking of the missing names, we got unfortunate news that must be confirmed with the Bureau.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: The name of the MBCC Chief, ${PlayerName}, appears on today's admission list for the Belphegor Art Museum... at 4:57 p.m. No departure recorded.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: ...Adjutant Nightingale, when was the last time you were in contact with Chief ${PlayerName}?
Nightingale is silent for a long time before looking at Faye with a tight frown, who is standing at the side. Noticing the attention, the Supply Office head raises her hand in surrender.

speaker: Faye
content: No, no, no! I didn't mean for this to happen. I just figured the Chief has been bored with nothing much to do, and wanted to give him a ticket to a popular exhibition so he could get a break! It's not like I can plan this!
female_content: No, no, no! I didn't mean for this to happen. I just figured the Chief has been bored with nothing much to do, and wanted to give her a ticket to a popular exhibition so she could get a break! It's not like I can plan this!

speaker: Faye
content: I mean, who would have thought that there's another Mania crisis in Eastside after just a month? I don't want our dear Chief to be trapped in that exhibition either. I'm still waiting for him to give me my year-end bonus...
female_content: I mean, who would have thought that there's another Mania crisis in Eastside after just a month? I don't want our dear Chief to be trapped in that exhibition either. I'm still waiting for her to give me my year-end bonus...

content: The adjutant sighs and waves her hand for the Supply Office head to be quiet.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We can't reach the Chief at the moment, so I'm now acting as the temporary MBCC administrator. Organize a rescue team immediately and head to Eastside. Enter the area of the incident and bring the Chief back.

Eastside
District 10, Belphegor Art Museum
FAC Mutation Lockdown Site

speaker: Nightingale
content: What's the situation?

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: The art museum has been cordoned off, the area is on M-value Threat Level C, and there is no sign of high M-value Sinners operating inside. There is currently no presumed risk of Black Ring, but we must take precautions in view of the mutation, since the situation is very abnormal.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Is the affected range too wide?

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: Yes. The entire building is currently isolated by the mutation, affecting an area of 80,000 square meters. Since the opening of the exhibition, the cumulative number of missing persons has reached 5,104, including the FAC advance investigation team that entered a short time ago.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: The last "person" left the art museum 7 hours ago. He is suffering from mental disorders and has been sent to Banyan Medical College for emergency treatment. Since then, no one has been able to leave.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: The entire museum is now completely sealed off. We can't breach it from the outside with conventional weapons or send in drones. There are too many curious civilians gathering around, and we have to divide our forces to deal with the situation.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: If we can reach Chief ${PlayerName}, we might be able to...

speaker: Nightingale
content: We will find him.
female_content: We will find her.

content: The adjutant turns back to the Sinners and begins the deployment.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The museum is huge. In order to find the Chief as soon as possible, you will have to split up. Hella and EMP, take the <color=#fb9259>sculpture section on the east</color>. Hecate and Labyrinth, take the <color=#fb9259>oil painting section on the west</color>.

speaker: Labyrinth & Hecate
content:
Order received.
Understood.

speaker: EMP & Hella
content:
What?! You're signing me up with that lousy rat of Minos?!
What is that supposed to mean?!

speaker: EMP
content: Hmm... Nightingale, dear sis, let me switch with Labyrinth! That brooding... Ah, no, Hecate is the most delicate of the 4 of us. She totally needs my protection!

speaker: Nightingale
content: There's no time. This will maximize your strengths. You're all elites of elites, and I trust you will complete the mission successfully.

speaker: Nightingale
content: FAC has found possible breakthroughs, and you might be able to enter the Mania mutation area if you use your abilities. Remember, <color=#fb9259>finding the Chief</color> is the first priority. I believe in you.
Nightingale stops paying attention to the Sinners' grunts and turns to look at Lisa. The painter looks at the barricaded art museum somewhat distractedly.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The map you provided was very helpful. Thank you.

speaker: Lisa
content: I used to come here for exhibitions. But I didn't expect your people to be so incompetent that they haven't gathered this kind of info already.

speaker: Nightingale
content: This is an urgent situation, and all the staff are trapped inside the museum. We need more reliable sources of information.

speaker: Lisa
content: Hmph, you didn't tell those numbnuts everything. The situation is actually dire, right?

speaker: Lisa
content: You didn't bring those powerful Sinners with higher M-value, fearing this unknown new type of Mania would cause uncontrollable effects on them. And you put the two noisy ones together to attract attention, so the brainy ones can infiltrate more easily.

speaker: Lisa
content: Hmph, you sure know how to maneuver the talents, Adjutant.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's just more practical to pair ranged attackers with melee ones. Hella and Hecate often follow the Chief in battle and are experienced. Both sides will be fine with them leading the teams.

speaker: Nightingale
content: What about you, Lisa? To be honest, I never thought you'd offer to join the action. Which team do you want to be on?

speaker: Lisa
content: Oh, please. I came for the exhibition, and those blockheads who know nothing about art will only mess it up for me.

She takes out three navigators with blue dahlia patterns and hands them to the three teams. With shimmering lights, a holographic screen appears.

content: Wow, she sounds like a beautiful lady!

speaker: Lisa

speaker: Lisa
content: What a tacky art exhibition, even the guide has to be "beautiful." Looks are nothing compared to Enfer's accomplishments in art.

speaker: Hella
content: Wow... She actually loves Enfer, right? But her words are so mean and aggressive.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Your first priority is to go deeper into the mutated area and retrieve the Chief. I'm counting on you

speaker: Hecate
content: I will get him back.
female_content: I will get her back.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Order received.

speaker: Hella
content: Hoo, hurry up. Let's do this!

speaker: EMP
