speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No one can tell you what to do. It's your story. You decide when it ends.

speaker: OwO
content: You think I'm a dummy? I don't need you to comfort me...

speaker: OwO
content: The DisCars are so lame. My Best Cool Car has better things to do. So does the Lion Dancing Queen...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What about the sad things? Let it out. Don't hold back. You have me by your side, Lion Dancing Queen.

speaker: OwO
content: ... You're so annoying... I was the one covering for you all this time. Acting all tough now that you've become a full-time hire? You big numskull!

speaker: Option
options: Hey, don't talk in the language I don't understand.

speaker: OwO
content: I can say whatever I want! You dimwit, you nitwit, you great big nincompoop!

speaker: Option
options: Seems like you have a knack for remembering fancy insults.

speaker: OwO
content: Why do you talk so much? Let me finish! I'll be fine by tomorrow. I already have a home and people who love me. Plus, I'm really awesome myself!

speaker: Option
options: Okay. I won't say any more.

content: You stop talking, and reach out to wipe her tears. Her eyes are bright red from crying non-stop. You can't wipe away the tears fast enough. They keep streaming down like a waterfall, splashing onto the lion head's colorful fabric.
Her head lowered, she chokes and shudders, no longer able to string together a full sentence.

speaker: OwO
content: I-I only saw them six times. I only remember, six times... I almost can't remember what they look like anymore...

speaker: OwO
content: They wouldn't let me learn their language... They wouldn't let me t-touch the lion head... But when I danced, they w-were happier than anyone else...

speaker: OwO
content: I know I'm different from the people here... OwO is from the Outlands. I look different, I eat different food, and I used to speak a different language.

speaker: OwO
content: DisCity is so huge, and there are bad people who hate me. They always mock and bully me because I'm different. Because I'm all alone.

speaker: OwO
content: Ha, I'm not afraid of them. I beat them all up.

speaker: OwO
content: So what if I'm an Outlander? The folks who gave me the lion's head told me that the kids in Goldionville are all majestic lions. No matter where I go, the lions will find me. I won't let them down.

speaker: OwO
content: I'm already a majestic Lion Dancing Queen, and I want them to see that. If they can't come to me, I'll find a way to go back to them.

speaker: OwO
content: When I meet them again, they'll praise me for being so hardworking and impressive! They'll be proud of me, I'm sure of it!

speaker: Option
options: Yes. You're indeed very hardworking and impressive.

content: You bring her into your arms.
In that moment, OwO's forced smile finally collapses. In an unlit corner of the night, the girl bursts into sobs.

speaker: OwO
content: Sob... I can't go back to Goldionville... I don't have a homeland anymore...

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief... We've detected activity from the Apostle's main body again. The FAC headquarters have drawn up a battle plan. Let me send it to you. You...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Request for simultaneous combat. Stella is indeed different from the other clones. With Stella around, there are other ways to defeat the Apostle of Ashes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: OwO has made her own decision. My Best Cool Car... has gotten a <color=#fb9259>new script</color>.

speaker: Timecop
content:
<size=32>Quack! Quack quack quack quack, quack quack! Quack quack quack!!
(All members of Operation Stella Hunt have arrived at the center of the distortion field! Reappearance of destructive high-energy singularity confirmed! We've caught up with it!)</size>

speaker: Timecop
content:
Quack... Quack quack quack... Quack quack quack quack
 quack!!!
(But... but it's stronger than last time!)

<size=32>At the edge of WhiteSands, a lavish, eerie theater rises out of the mirage. The Apostle S.T. perches atop it, having already healed from its injuries. It's even stronger after ravaging Dillywood and the DisCars, and now the entire area is saturated in manic delusion.</size>

speaker: Timecop
content:
Quack quack... Quack quack quack quack... Quack quack. Quuuuaaaack...
(How did this happen? We suffered such heavy losses to injure it, but now everything is back to square one!)

speaker: Timecop
content:
Quuuuaaaack...?!
(Were our efforts all meaningless and in vain?)

speaker: Rabbo
content:
Quack.
(There's no such thing as a meaningless battle. Our enemy interferes with mind and matter, and we are born from the will to fight it.)

speaker: Rabbo
content:
Quack.
(As long as our spirit carries on and the battle continues, even if our bodies die, there will be others to take up our quarrel with the foe!)

speaker: Rabbo
content:
Quack!
(Come! Onwards to the final battle!)

speaker: Timecop
content:
Quack...
(Commander...)

speaker: Timecop
content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack... 
(Sounds like you stole someone else's lines. You gotta stick to the character design...)

speaker: Timecop
content:
Quack quack! Quack quack quack! Quack quack!
(Commander! That small singularity has appeared with its companion!)

Swoosh... A dusty, medium-sized van swerves through the streets of Dillywood. It dodges many strange creatures that have concretized, but at the last minute, it fails to brake in time and slams into the jelly monster enveloping the whole theater.
Before the vehicle gets completely gobbled up by the jelly, someone kicks open the door.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Here again. It's really addicted to the glamor of Dillywood.

${PlayerName} turns around to take out a bunch of strange, blue luminous triangles from the car, then pins them all over OwO's vest and hair. Finally, one in each of her palms, and makes her clench them tightly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: These are talismans that will protect you. Don't let go of them. When you feel unwell, clench down on them tighter. We don't know what it's like inside. Follow me and don't get lost!

speaker: OwO
content: Okay.
OwO puts Stella to her waist and grabs the hem of ${PlayerName}'s clothes, following him into the theater.
female_content: OwO puts Stella to her waist and grabs the hem of ${PlayerName}'s clothes, following her into the theater.

content: <size=32>Inside, the little theater has become a vast, illusory space. Giant, eerie things like telephone booths, buses, and clock towers float about, while something is constantly condensing and dissolving in the air. Someone's fantasy is gradually taking form.</size>
Underneath their feet, a long staircase extends out into the depths, leading to the flaming nova at the center of the illusion.

speaker: os (unshown)
content: This is the power of Stella's family... They have the power to turn fantasy into reality...

speaker: os
content: If Lynn was there, how would she capture this on camera? Wouldn't it be cool if we could film it chasing us with one long shot?

speaker: [Transition]
content: Monster roars

speaker: os
content: What impressive sound effects! It's coming from all directions.

speaker: os
content: Is this the Dooby 18 surround sound that Love was talking about? I don't just hear it in my ears. It's practically vibrating my heart!

speaker: os
content: The background music is also very exciting. Very fitting for an action scene. Will Lil Daisy use this kind of music, too?

speaker: os
content: So much dazzling fantasy! It'd be really awesome if this got filmed. Stella's family is so cool. They're truly great mascots for my studio.
She looks at ${PlayerName}'s back in front of her. ${PlayerName} has a very serious expression right now, looking not at all like the usual little clapper.

speaker: os
content: Is this the makeup that ${PlayerName} put on specially for today? Is it to look cooler and more serious for the "final climax"?

speaker: os
content: Haha, what a hard worker. OwO will satisfy him, then.
female_content: Haha, what a hard worker. OwO will satisfy her, then.

speaker: os
content: What am I thinking... I'm not making a film anymore. I'm only here to send Stella home...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: OwO?!!!

speaker: OwO
content: Huh?
Woosh!!!
After losing focus for just a moment, purple tentacles that OwO had never seen before wrap around her waist and pull her away from the narrow staircase.
OwO loses her grip on ${PlayerName} and gets transported to a small planet. Stella jumps in front of her and bears its teeth at the enemies, yet the little critter looks so small in comparison.

OwO instinctively throws her lion head over to protect Stella. Huge purple jelly monsters surround her, staring and wielding their tentacles. They warp and remold reality into bizarre forms wherever they go. OwO senses that something's very wrong.

speaker: os
content: These purple monsters... aren't Stella's family. They're something else. I have to break through their encirclement. Come on, OwO, you can do it! You have to do it.

speaker: os
content: You promised to bring Stella home. I have to make it happen while it's still possible. I must try harder and think of a way...

speaker: Director" D
content: A story can't be smooth sailing all the time. A movie without ups and downs will put people to sleep. Dreams will always clash with reality. There will always be one obstacle after the next, and an unbridgeable gulf before us.

speaker: Director" D
content: In movies, the hero will try their best to overcome the gulf and realize their dream. This is what the audience wants to see.

speaker: Director" D
content: The climax of the story is when their dream finally comes true, bringing everyone to the perfect ending.

speaker: os
content: But...

speaker: OwO
content: What do I have to do... to reach the perfect ending?
Uh! Duck down!
A sharp shout suddenly rings out, startling OwO. She instinctively squats down and covers her head with her hands.
Then, a laser jet pierces through a jelly tentacle. Soon, jets of blazing light sweep across the room, pulverizing all the jelly monsters surrounding OwO.

speaker: OwO
content: Are those laser jets from... Lynn?
A few seconds later, a bumpy little spaceship chugs along and lands in front of OwO. The cabin door is wide open, and Lynn, Love, and Daisy are crammed in the single-pilot cockpit.

speaker: Lynn
content: Huff... Huff... Oh good, I caught up...

speaker: OwO
content: ...How come you guys are here? Why...

speaker: Love
content: To make a movie, of course!
She jumps down, picks up OwO by the armpits and puts her into the cockpit as she brags loudly.

speaker: Love
content: Oh! We robbed... ahhh no, I mean, we accepted this spaceship as a gift from the Timecops. They're counting on My Best Cool Car to resolve this crisis!

speaker: Love
content: It's too crowded for us to all be in it, but it's perfect for you... practically tailor-made! From this point onwards, we'll leave everything to you!

speaker: Love
content: Send Stella home, and give the happiest ending for My Best Cool Car's movie!

speaker: OwO
content: Huh?

speaker: Daisy
content: Sigh...<size=28> You've done so much radio, yet you still sound so wooden...</size>

speaker: Daisy
content: OwO, promises have to be kept. You promised to give us a movie filled with fun, but it's not done yet.

speaker: Daisy
content: Go finish it. We had a great time watching it. We want to see the ending.

speaker: OwO
content: But... ahhh!

<size=32>The spaceship goes into the air, carrying OwO, Stella, and the lion head. The shadows in the night sky begin to stir once more, gathering around the small planet. The fidgeting blonde girl finally can't hold herself back, and starts shouting her feelings to OwO.</size>

speaker: Lynn
content: I can't memorize that many lines, but I got my courage from you, so I hope you can realize your own wish!

speaker: Lynn
content: Send Stella home!! We'll be watching you!
The spaceship sets off amidst OwO's protests, barely breaking through the blockade. The shadows devour the small planet and the three figures on it, then chase after the rickety little spaceship.

speaker: OwO
content: Ah... no... no!! Stop quacking, stupid duck ship! Go back and help them!!

She slaps the control panel in panic. The spaceship shudders, entangled by purple shadows from the void. Stella the Starbeast glows all over, wielding its claws at the shadows. But this time, it can't repel their attack.
The spaceship gets slowly dragged towards the purple void behind it...

speaker: OwO
content: Huh... What are these... red... spikes...?
The red shackles dispel the shadows. Growing out like branches, they attach to OwO's little spaceship and slowly pull it back to the staircase.
A familiar person opens the cockpit door and takes OwO out.

speaker: OwO
content: ...${PlayerName}...

speaker: OwO
content: ...Stella's family didn't listen at all. They were so angry...

speaker: OwO
content: What do I do... Lynn, Love and Lil Daisy have all been taken away...
${PlayerName} doesn't respond right away, but reaches out to wipe away OwO's tears.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since when did the world's best Lion Dancing Queen become a little crybaby?

speaker: OwO
content: Wh-what are you talking about! Look! Those shadows are coming again. They devoured everyone. We're next!

speaker: OwO
content: Will sending Stella home really end all this? Maybe I was wrong. If this keeps up...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: OwO.
${PlayerName} interrupts her and clasps her cheeks with both hands, squeezing a somewhat comical expression out of her somber face.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They weren't devoured. They stayed behind to clear up this misunderstanding with Stella's family. I'll go help them as soon as I plow open a path for you.

speaker: OwO
content: ...What does "plow" mean?
${PlayerName} chuckles. He raises his hand and casts the red light again, scattering the creatures surging towards them.
female_content: ${PlayerName} chuckles. She raises her hand and casts the red light again, scattering the creatures surging towards them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not wrong. Stella has been lost for so long that its family members have grown crazy from worry. That's why they're like this now. These dark shadows are their anxious feelings.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Go, send Stella home. That way, they won't be mad anymore, and everyone will come back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is the climax of the movie. You're the hero, so you must stay true to your goal. We don't need any awards. My Best Cool Car just wants to witness OwO's story.

speaker: OwO
content: My story?

${PlayerName} picks up the lion's head, puts it on OwO's head, then turns her around by the shoulder. In front of OwO, the broken staircase has been repaired, leading all the way to where the stars are gathered.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your story doesn't need that lame award podium.

speaker: Option
options: Soar beyond the DisCars. Soar to the world.

content: You are the pride of My Best Cool Car.
He pushes OwO to take the first step.
female_content: She pushes OwO to take the first step.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Run! I'll take care of things back here. You have to keep moving forward. The big happy ending is just ahead! Run...
His voice gets instantly drowned out.
female_content: Her voice gets instantly drowned out.

content: The shadows don't catch up from behind. OwO dashes forward with Stella at her waist and the lion's head on her head, panting and choking back tears.

speaker: OwO
content: Sob... Sob... Waaah!!!

speaker: OwO
content: You liar! This isn't a movie set! There aren't any cameras around here! You're a big liar, ${PlayerName}! A great dummy liar!
A few purple jelly monsters try to block the path and stop OwO. They seem to be murmuring some strange words amidst the chaos...

speaker: Purple Jelly Monster
content: Slow down... It's not time yet, wait a bit longer... Wait for them to get here... We need them to all be together...

speaker: OwO
content: Move aside! Owoooo!!!
With a roar, she rolls forward with her lion's head and knocks the jelly monsters off the staircase.

OwO runs faster and faster. No one can hold her back now. The little golden lion zips down the path like a meteor. She finally reaches the end of the stairs, coming face to face with the humongous Starbeast.

speaker: OwO
content: I don't know if you're Stella's mom or dad or grandma or grandpa, but I've brought Stella back! Stop being angry already!

speaker: Apostle of Ashes S.T.
content: Woosh... Woosh...

speaker: OwO
content: I know you're angry and sad because you can't find Stella. I also lost my homeland. I know how you feel!

speaker: OwO
content: But you can't just keep throwing tantrums and bullying my friends! They're all good people who risked their lives to bring us here, but ended up losing themselves along the way! Go ask Stella if you don't believe me!

speaker: OwO
content: Now that Stella is back, you have to behave, too!

The Apostle can't be reasoned with at all. With a swing of its claw, S.T. destroys the stair that OwO is standing on. Disregarding any family ties, it slams the little blue critter, the girl and her lion's head into the debris with its claw.
The stairs gradually crumble. The Apostle keeps holding down its claw for a few seconds, as if affirming its own victory—then suddenly lifts it up again like a scalded creature.

speaker: Apostle of Ashes S.T.
content: Awoo?
Amidst the cracks is a mirage of a lion's head. Its surroundings begin to burn, emitting blinding light.
But OwO isn't there. S.T. shudders and lifts its head to see a little golden figure in the night sky, soaring like the scorching sun.

speaker: OwO
content: How... rude!!

speaker: OwO
content: It's bad enough that you're mean to me, but how dare you do that to Stella! I'm going to teach you a lesson!

speaker: Stella
content: Squeak!!!

OwO takes a most splendiferous leap and deals a louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning blow to the center of the huge Apostle's forehead. The manic power makes it numb from head to toe, and the girl shrieks louder than a thunderstorm.

speaker: OwO
content: Give me back My Best Cool Car!
The Apostle falls backwards. Beaten up and humiliated by a little girl, it roars in fury and struggles to make a comeback.

The little lion that beat up the Apostle is floating in the void. She's not used to her power yet. Her body aches all over, and her skull tremors each time the giant beast roars, as if something inside her is resonating with it.

speaker: OwO
content: ...Phew... I'm... so awesome...

speaker: OwO
content: So being a hero is this powerful. I practically set off a little supernova! No wonder happy endings are so common...

speaker: OwO
content: ...It's a bit sudden... but since it actually happened to me, the audience should be able to believe it...

speaker: OwO
content: ...If I knew I had this in me, I would've used it a lot sooner...

speaker: Stella
content: Squeak... Squeak squeak...

Eyes brimming with tears, Stella looks back and forth between OwO and the main body that is quickly recovering itself. The little critter clings onto OwO's clothes and nibbles on her wrist, trying to keep her awake.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe... Don't worry, Stella. I won't hurt it. I know it's your family. I just want it to come back to its senses... I want it to know that you're back...

speaker: OwO
content: Stella, you must really miss home. You always look into the distance whenever you glow... I know you've been calling out to them all this time...

speaker: OwO
content: I don't want you to experience the heartbreak that I've felt...

speaker: OwO
content: All right, next up... an awesome lion dance...
A huge boulder floats over and OwO climbs onto it. She takes a deep breath and springs toward the Apostle that's a thousand times her size. Her golden lion's head shimmering across the sea of stars.

S.T. recovers quickly. There are too many clones all over Dillywood and DisCity. Burgeoning desire gives it strength. The Apostle yearns to return to DisSea, and its perseverance will make it stronger.

speaker: Stella
content: Squeak!!!
The little clone wants to push OwO away, but it's powerless to stop this mighty, newborn Sinner. It yelps tearfully at the Apostle of Ashes, but the Apostle turns a deaf ear.

They were so close. In her mind's eye, OwO sees the hands of all those who have pushed her forward, yet ultimately left her: the crew of My Best Cool Car, the kind neighbors who raised her, and the compatriots from the homeland she never knew.

This long yet short-lived journey has finally reached its end. After sending Stella home, everything will go back to the way it was. She'd return to that lonely terrace to lion dance and gaze afar alone. OwO sniffles.

speaker: OwO
content: Everything's fine... I'm great already. It's fine if I don't get a DisCar, and it's fine if there's no big happy ending. They'd be proud of me nonetheless.

speaker: OwO
content: Just like ${PlayerName} said, I'm someone they'd be proud of...
The humongous Apostle roars, condensing energy into a violent gale that hurtles toward OwO. The vortex of Mania blurs the girl's vision.

speaker: OwO
content: Stella, let me send you home...

speaker: Apostle of Ashes S.T.
content: Roar...!
Purple shadows strangle the Apostle's neck and body. Some similar but opposing energies cancel each other out, completely restraining its movement. The Apostle's chilling voice echoes from the void.
...Cut... It's not the climax yet... This won't do...
OwO senses something coming up from behind, catching her before she loses her last ounce of strength.
It's a warm, familiar scent that instantly brings tears to her eyes. OwO turns around...

speaker: OwO
content: Lion heads... Just like mine... You are...
The lion in lead nods and gives her faltering body a push, helping her complete the final step across the stars.
Stella is desperately leaning forward in OwO's arms. The girl holds the little critter out with her hands, sending it off for the final time.
The little blue critter's cries echo across the entire space. Bathed in light, it leaps from OwO's hands onto the manic Apostle's forehead and merges into it.
Dazzling light floods the realm. When OwO opens her eyes again, the manic behemoth had quieted down, and is emitting the same glow as Stella.

speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
content: I... cannot... control... too dangerous... to stay... must go...

speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
content: The dummy... in my place... protect...

speaker: OwO
content: You're... Stella?

A massive fissure opens up behind the Apostle, revealing a huge unknown realm. OwO shudders. She instinctively reaches out for Stella, but the person in the black lion's head grabs her and holds her tightly.

She wanted to struggle, but the beast comes forward and presses against her forehead. The manic energy runs wild in its body, yet culminates with flowers blooming from its head, which fall and land on OwO.

speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
content: ...Gave me back... family... thank you...

speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
content: I'm... going back...

speaker: OwO
content: Wait... Ahhh!
"Stella" backs up into the fissure, returning to the chaos from which it was born. The realm overflows with flowers scattered across the sky like meteors, giving a grand finale to Stella's journey.

speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
content: Squeak...

speaker: OwO
content: Ahh...

speaker: OwO
content: ...Goodbye, Stella... Goodbye...

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: The effects of the Apostle S.T. are confirmed to have stopped. Before that, a second center had appeared in the Mania field and engulfed the original center, merging into a new, highly unstable Mania field.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: It was a struggle for power following the return of the clones. We speculate that interactions with humans may have altered the consciousness of certain clones, which led to conflict with the main body.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: Fortunately, we not only avoided heavy casualties this time, but also discovered some of the Apostle's secret characteristics. We are one step closer to uncovering the truth about the Apocalypse outside DisCity. However...

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: Why did that last Apostle choose to leave? Originally, its main body didn't hesitate to barge into DisCity and suffer heavy injuries to get to DisSea...
Sob sob...
A string of sobs comes from the MBCC agent's side.

speaker: MBCC Intelligence Agent
content: Let's just say... The Apostle's family is no longer angry after finding their lost child. They reunited and went back to their homeland together.
The Apostle that turns fantasy into reality is gone, but the sea of stars has not yet vanished. A small stage gradually forms from the hail of flowers left behind by Stella.
After battles and separations of life and death, the lions are back together.

speaker: OwO
content: ...Lions?

speaker: OwO
content: ...Whoa!

Before she can finish talking, someone hammers her head, bringing tears to her eyes. The one who beat her is the dark red lion, who is the largest of the bunch. It swings a blow without even taking off its lion's head.

speaker: OwO
content: Whoa whoa whoa! Why you bullying me!
The black and gold lions stare blankly for a while. The dark red lion turns and leaves without saying a word.

speaker: OwO
content: Ahh, wait... Oof!
OwO wants to catch up, but she slips and falls into the red lion's arms. She takes off her lion's head, revealing the unique but familiar clothes underneath.

speaker: Red Lion
content: Hey! You're dressed up like a lion, too! Are you also from Goldionville, kid?

speaker: Red Lion
content: It brings tears to my eyes to meet a fellow lion! We've sailed all the way across the sea to DisCity from Gold... uh, Gold-lions-ville!

speaker: OwO
content: Goldionville...? But they said that Goldionville already...

speaker: Red Lion
content: <size=28>Oh right, it's Goldionville...</size> Ahem! My naive child! Folks from Goldionville are all gifted geniuses! If we could bring you all the way here in the first place, of course we can also flee the Apocalypse! O ho ho!

speaker: Red Lion
content: But let's talk about that later. I see you're hungry. How about a red bean bun?

speaker: OwO
content: Huh?

Dazed by the red lion's rambling, OwO gets a bun stuffed into her mouth before she gets a chance to respond. It's not a red bean bun, but it tastes exactly like another kind of bun that she had eaten as a child.
You mean BBQ pork bun. <size=28>Sigh... You had so few lines yet you still messed them up.</size>
A green lion walks over with a couple of bamboo steamers in her hands.

speaker: Green Lion
content: We also have chicken, beef, and many other dim sum dishes... all fresh steamed. We also brought chopsticks, if you know how to use them.

speaker: OwO
content:
Ooo... Ooooo?
(You know how to make Goldionville dim sum?)

speaker: Green Lion
content: I don't cook... These are from DisCity.

speaker: Green Lion
content: <size=30>We ordered take-out from a famous restaurant in Eastside called Fulong. It's really popular, and it even got featured by the famous food blog "Creme Brulee." Supposedly it's a family business that had been passed down for many generations. Its founder is also an Outlander.</size>

speaker: Green Lion
content: Just like you.
Behind them, a girl's scattered mumbles can be heard.
<size=28>I really like your movie... I wanted to... meet you...</size>

speaker: OwO
content: Lynn?
Ahhh! No no, you've got the wrong person! I-I'm also just someone passing by DisCity.
She covers her face with the envelope, then hands the envelope to OwO with trembling hands.

speaker: Pink Lion
content: ...Someone asked me to tell you... that after his granny watched your vlog, she thought of her own granny... That granny really wants to meet you... She...

speaker: Pink Lion
content: Th-this is really the first time meeting you. I'm not good at memoriz... I mean, talking. But people really did watch your vlog and see your lion dance!

speaker: OwO
content: ...Mmm... Ah, got it!
OwO doesn't ask any more questions, but just flashes a big smile to everyone.

speaker: OwO
content: Thank you for coming so far to see me, and for telling me so many interesting things. I'm really, really happy!

speaker: OwO
content: Um, can you tell me more about Goldionville? I want to hear everything!

speaker: Pink Lion
content: Oh... sure! I'll tell you everything I know!

They tell her about everything... about the steamers of delicious food, about the different decorations on their clothes, about the hardworking immigrants scattered across this city, and about the fragmented memories of their distant homeland.

<size=30>The three lions talk nonstop, at times making vivid descriptions, but also blurring the details sometimes, as if there are gaping holes in their memories. OwO, however, listens to everything with relish. All her pain is gone, and now she is giggling the whole way through.</size>
The dark red lion sits alone in a quiet corner and looks at its hidden watch. Time really flies. It's been 102 minutes since the reunion started.
Things are about to end. As it gets ready to leave, the girl suddenly hugs it from behind.

speaker: OwO
content: I caught you!

speaker: OwO
content: What, want to beat me up again? Hehe, I'm full from yummy food now! You can't catch me anymore! Plus, everyone told me that you were just throwing a tantrum because you're mad at yourself!

speaker: OwO
content: You wanted to be in the final battle with me, but then couldn't keep up with my speed on the way there. You saw me going ahead to challenge Stella's family alone and got frustrated.

speaker: OwO
content: Don't be mad. I ran fast because my mighty lion's soul awakened. I was amazing! Don't worry, I won with flying colors! I didn't embarrass you at all. Praise me, praise me...
The dark red lion doesn't want to argue, so it just pats her on the head. She snuggles its palm happily.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe... Also, I heard that the most authentic lion dance in Goldionville requires two people to perform together, but I've always been doing it alone.

speaker: OwO
content: Can you teach me?
The dark red lion pauses, then picks up OwO by the armpits and holds her up. The girl giggles.

speaker: OwO
content: Hahahaha, that was terrible! No no, let's try it again! Hee-yah...
She gets lifted up again, and laughs even more gleefully. Out of the corner of her eye, she notices a row of uniformed ducks on the other side of the stars looking back at her.
They give a salute and vanish.

speaker: OwO
content: Ahh...
The dark red lion also saw them. It puts OwO down and takes a few breaths, as if wanting to say something. OwO hurriedly grabs the corner of its clothes.

speaker: OwO
content: ...Don't go, I still have a wish. The last one...

speaker: OwO
content: It took you so long to get here. Chat with me for a bit, okay?

speaker: OwO
content: I made an awesome movie. The hero went through many hardships and dangers, but finally succeeds thanks to everyone's help and gets a big happy ending.

speaker: OwO
content: Though it won't get a DisCar, it helped me bring my friend home. I realized my wish. I really love this movie, and I've been wanting to show it to you guys.

speaker: OwO
content: Can you stay with me to watch the ending?
The dark red lion goes quiet for a while. Time is running out. But the girl is pleading so earnestly, so in the end...
You sit down.
The bright stars begin to fade, and the gleeful chatter gradually dissipates. The vast void slowly dims, the lights come on, and you return to a quiet theater.
At last, the dark red lion's head also vanishes. OwO sees your face, but isn't surprised at all.

speaker: OwO
content: It's fine... It's fine...

speaker: OwO
content: It's a movie, after all... I knew it was fake all along. But... why do I still like it so much? I know it's all fake, yet I still believe everything!

speaker: OwO
content: I believe that all the lions are super powerful and invincible against the Apocalypse. I believe that I still have compatriots around me, and that some of them have seen me and my lion dance!

speaker: OwO
content: I don't believe that my hometown is gone anymore. Even after the movie ends, Goldionville must still be around. Someday, I will go back to find it.

speaker: OwO
content: I'm so happy that my movie got the best ending ever!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is exactly the kind of movie I wanted to watch. What is it called again? The thing you like most...

speaker: OwO
content: ...Dazzling fantasy!
...Mmm, let's end it here.

speaker: [Black Out]
content: The camera holder reviews her work and is about to turn off the camera when someone walks into the frame in front of her.
...Huh? How come you're here?
Look... A Sinner was just born here, and a really strong one at that. So quit bothering me and go do your work, MBCC Chief.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Isn't there an outstanding Sinner here, too?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <size=30>To have the same kind of power as the Apostle... Creating mutations on such a large scale, neutralizing the Mania field, producing illusions so powerful that the real is indistinguishable from the fake, and even constraining the Apostle of Ashes... This is S-Class power.</size>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're still good at concealing yourself as usual.
Hehe, you want to catch me? Even the Dillywood paparazzi can't do that. I suggest you give up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'm here to thank you, Director Deren.

speaker: Deren
content: Tracy
female_content: ...You're welcome, Miss Clapper. Your acting was good, too.

speaker: Option
options: The brilliant script is written by Director Deren, after all.

content: I also got personal, night-long instruction from you... The filming equipment for My Best Cool Car and all that Dillywood press coverage were your doing too, right? Only you would and can do those things.

speaker: Deren
content: Hehe... You're right. I had to secretly pull all those all-nighters instructing you while doing Outland research. That really tired me out.

speaker: Deren
content: I gotta hit the road now. My disguise for the past couple of years has been busted. I don't want those Dillywood people coming after me again.

speaker: Deren
content: I'll hand over what I've filmed to you. Though I can't add in my "special effects," all the most precious things are in there. It's more than enough to win a small prize and make a child happy.
You take over the cellphone that had been recording the vlogs all this time. You don't need to look at it to know that it's filled with the girl's happy, smiling face.

speaker: Option
options: She'd be happier if she could thank you in person.

speaker: Deren
content: ...I should be the one saying thanks.

speaker: Deren
content: It's been a long time since I've picked up a camera. I was finally able to film an interesting movie that I myself wanted to make.
She turns to leave.

speaker: Deren
content: It's alright. The director should be someone who works behind the scenes.

speaker: Deren
content: Next time you have a good plan, I'll be back.

After the whole ordeal, the 41st DisCars Awards Ceremony was postponed but ultimately held.
However, media coverage about the disappearance of Director Deren overshadowed the ceremony itself. After being pursued by multiple parties for breach of contract fees, the Dean of DisCity Film Academy finally resigned from the pressure.

It has been confirmed that during the battle against the Apostle of Ashes, OwO awakened as an S-Class Sinner. At the behest of Chief ${PlayerName}, OwO agreed to return to the Bureau, and was picked up by a Bureau vehicle disguised as a filming car.
However, after receiving a letter from the Outlands, the Sinner escaped from the vehicle and disappeared after leaving a message.

"The folks from Goldionville wrote to me! They saw me! I'm gonna go home right now and read their letter. Be back in a jiffy! ${PlayerName}, I'm leaving the film's post-production and distribution work to you. You're My Best Cool Car's trusty clapper, after all!"

speaker: OwO
content: Owooo... What shall I do...
The little girl sighs on a street corner of Syndicate.

speaker: OwO
content: I can't believe that I can't find a single person who knows how to use a camera in all of Syndicate!

speaker: OwO
content: Same with that dummy clapper, who clearly made a promised to me with so much confidence, "I'll take care of it all."

speaker: OwO
content: But now I only get this... Hmph!
Disgruntled, the girl takes out an old door lock from her pocket.

speaker: OwO
content: I knew it! The adorable OwO has to personally take the reins!

speaker: OwO
content: It's just a photographer! Watch me conjure one up right here... woosh!
Please...
The long, drawn-out voice drifts into her ears.

speaker: OwO
content: Huh? What's that sound?
Please... move... aside!
A mysterious helmeted figure rushes towards her at full speed.
Thud!
With a loud thud, the two of them roll quite a distance across the ground before stopping, their belongings scattered all over.

speaker: OwO
content: Owooo... ouch, ouch... It hurts... Something hard hit me...
I... I'm sorry... If you're hurting real bad... I'll call an ambulance for you...

speaker: OwO
content: Whoa! The Helmet Girl with the helmet is talking!

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: I... I'm not Helmet Girl! It was... an emergency... I had something really urgent... I'm very sorry for bumping into you...

speaker: OwO
content: All right... Since you apologized so earnestly, I'll forgive you this time! Don't do something so dangerous again!

speaker: OwO
content: But... Can you tell me what the emergency was? Maybe I can use it as inspiration for my film...
Helmet Girl cuts OwO off halfway through her sentence.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Um... it's... Someone is chasing me...

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: If I get caught... I'll...

speaker: Sheriff
content: Don't let her escape! Catch her!

speaker: Sheriff
content: Catching the "Eastside Cyclops" will be a great accomplishment!
That voice is all too familiar to OwO. Having been in Syndicate for a while, she knows that aside from the gangsters, the only ones who'd shout so loudly are the sheriffs.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: They... they're here! I'm leaving now!

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Um... I'm really really sorry for crashing into you!
Helmet Girl bows deeply to OwO, then flees towards the abandoned industrial zone in the distance.

speaker: OwO
content: Hey! Where are you going... That way goes to the sewers!

speaker: OwO
content: And you left your photos behind...

speaker: OwO
content: Huh?! Photos?
OwO snatches up the photos from the ground and observes them carefully. They're mostly landscape photos, while very few featured people and animals.
Judging from the image quality, the photographer didn't use a fancy camera. Yet the photos have quite a tasteful ambiance.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... Not bad! I've decided. I'm going to recruit Helmet Girl!
OwO dusts herself off and heads towards the sewers.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... What to do about the sheriffs?

speaker: OwO
content: Of course! Leave them to the dummy clapper!
A tattered helmet pokes out of the sewer opening.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Ha... They should be gone by now... right?

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: I didn't expect that it'd be the same even in Syndicate...

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: When can I escape this kind of life...

speaker: OwO
content: Huh? Escape what kind of life? A perpetually helmeted life?

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: The same kind as the one I had in Eastside... Aaah!

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: You! W-why are you here?! I... I already apologized...

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Don't hurt me...
Helmet Girl tries to run away again, but a paw firmly grabs her right hand.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Eek!
Moreover, the other paw is holding up a photo in front of her.
It's a landscape photo of Syndicate on a gilded afternoon.
It flutters freely in the wind, as if beckoning to Helmet Girl.

speaker: OwO
content: This picture, and those too. Did you take all of these?
OwO points to the other photos. One of them shows a sunset in the Drifter Camp, while others feature cute pets.
Realizing that OwO is only interested in her photos, Helmet Girl becomes a lot more relieved.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Uh... Y-yes...

speaker: OwO
content: Since you know how to snap pictures with that snappy camera, you should become the photographer for my great movies!

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Huh? But... I just took these photos randomly for fun...

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: If you suddenly ask me to help make a movie or something... I'm really not up for the job...

speaker: OwO
content: Don't worry! I have a sharp eye for talent! Helmet Girl, your photos are awesome, so your filming skills must be great, too!

speaker: OwO
content: Back where I come from, there's a saying... the apple... the apple... What happens to the apple again? Oh, the apple doesn't fall far from the tree! Wait... that's not right...

speaker: OwO
content: Oh well, doesn't matter! Just hurry up and join my crew! Let's shake up DisCity's film industry together! Hahaha!

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: But... but...
Helmet Girl backs up a few steps from OwO's scorching gaze.

speaker: OwO
content: My script, plus your camera skills! Our movie will definitely be a big hit in DisCity!

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Don't... don't come over... ahhh!
Seeing that Helmet Girl is about to flee again, OwO has no choice but to use her trump card.

speaker: OwO
content: There's more! If you join my crew, I'll make custom scripts just for you!

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe! OwO's incredible scripts are like no other!

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: I... really couldn't tell...
Though Helmet Girl doesn't say it out loud, the confident, chest-thumping OwO has elicited her curiosity.

speaker: OwO
content: My scripts are S-Class scripts! As long as we get a cast, we'll be sure to go down in cinematic history!

speaker: OwO
content: Come come... Sit down, Helmet Girl. Ahem, let me tell you about my vision!

speaker: OwO
content: Even if you don't want to join now, you'll definitely change your mind after hearing about my incredible script!
OwOs pats the cement pipe beside her, motioning for Helmet Girl to sit next to her.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: R-really?
Helmet Girl warily sits down next to OwO.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Then... What is the script about...?

speaker: OwO
content: I've decided to make a movie about "courage"!

speaker: OwO
content: What's your name, by the way?

speaker: OwO
content: The protagonist has got to have a name.
OwO takes out a storyboard from her lion's head, then looks at Helmet Girl as if she suddenly remembered something.

speaker: Lynn
content: Lynn. My name is Lynn.

speaker: OwO
content: In the beautiful fairy tale world, there lived the super powerful OwO! She's super strong and brave and she can do anything! She's coming to find Lynn...

speaker: Lynn
content: But OwO is really scary. If someone stares into her eyes for more than two seconds, she'll lose all her courage and cry non-stop...

speaker: Lynn
content: Everyone in the village calls her "OwO the Archdemon."

speaker: Lynn
content: To avoid staring into OwO's eyes, everyone put on helmets.

speaker: Lynn
content: Everyone gets scared whenever OwO the Archdemon sends her minions to attack the village.

speaker: OwO
content: What are you talking about? This isn't how the story goes! You secretly changed my script!

speaker: Lynn
content: Um, but... You really are quite scary...

speaker: OwO
content: Sigh... All right then. I'll make an exception and let you co-author this with me!

speaker: OwO
content: It's fine to be scared of OwO the Archdemon. But this is a story about courage.

speaker: OwO
content: What do you want to happen next?

speaker: Lynn
content: Then... how about this?

speaker: Lynn
content: In this world... th-there might be something known as the "candy of courage"!

speaker: Lynn
content: If I eat a piece of it, I'll be able to defeat the Archdemon for sure!

speaker: OwO
content: So OwO the Archdemon sends her minions to attack the village again...

speaker: OwO
content: But this time, it's on a much larger scale. The villagers are no match against their attack.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe, what are you going to do now? Will you come to their rescue, or will you flee?

speaker: OwO
content: Brave heroine?

speaker: Villager
content: Don't mind us, Lynn! Go find the candy! You must take care of yourself!

speaker: Lynn
content: B-but...

speaker: Villager
content: Go! You must find the candy of courage! You are our hope!

speaker: Villager
content: You can do it, Lynn!

speaker: Villager
content: We're all depending on you!

speaker: Lynn
content: ... I... I will! I'll definitely find the candy!

speaker: Lynn
content: I promise to come back and save everyone!
As the last flame of hope, Lynn leaves the village on a quest to find a way to defeat OwO the Archdemon.

speaker: OwO
content: After fleeing, you encounter a mysterious cave. Inside the cave, there are the cries of the villagers, and also the Archdemon's shrieks.

speaker: Lynn
content: What happened to everyone? Did the Archdemon...

speaker: OwO
content: Are you going to go rescue them, brave heroine?
After a fierce battle, Lynn is almost out of energy. Yet the voice of OwO the Archdemon is still beyond reach.

speaker: Villager
content: Lynn? Is that you? Lynn!

speaker: Villager
content: Don't mind us! Go find the candy... You can't defeat her now! You have to keep safe!
The voices of the villagers echoed weakly from the cave.

speaker: Lynn
content: Sob... I'm sorry, everyone...
Lynn gives up on trying to enter the cave and continues to look for the candy of courage.
She treks through the steep cliffs and icy mountains.
Then crosses the boundless plains and winding rivers.
After overcoming endless dangers, Lynn finally finds the candy of courage. This is the moment where her wish can come true—she can finally gain courage.
In this moment, the candy that can save the world sits quietly in Lynn's palm, but she can't eat it.
It's because tears are uncontrollably pouring out of her eyes.

speaker: Lynn
content: It's too late... Even if I gain courage now, it's useless...

speaker: Lynn
content: I looked for excuses every time... Even this candy is an excuse...

speaker: Lynn
content: I know full well... that I'm just scared to face the Archdemon...

speaker: Lynn
content: Everyone has been encouraging me and trying to help me flee, even if it meant sacrificing themselves... Yet I...

speaker: Villager
content: Don't mind us, Lynn! Go find the candy! You must take care of yourself!

speaker: Villager
content: You can do it, Lynn!

speaker: Villager
content: Go! You must find the candy of courage! You are our hope!

speaker: Villager
content: We're all depending on you!

speaker: Lynn
content: Even if I gain courage and defeat the Archdemon... What's the point...
As Lynn wallows in sorrow, a dark shadow sneaks up on her.
By the time she notices it, it's too late. The dark shadow had already snatched the candy of courage from her hand in one swipe.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe! Oh brave heroine, now's not the time to be sad!

speaker: OwO
content: All your courage belongs to me now!

speaker: Lynn
content: You... How did you...

speaker: OwO
content: Following you all this time was worth it! Now I can get rid of my only threat, and that's—you!

speaker: OwO
content: Owoo.
The Archdemon swallows the candy in one gulp.
As if the whole ordeal had been too easy, the Archdemon shifts her nonchalant gaze to the villagers.

speaker: OwO
content: As punishment for you running away, I'm now going to eat all the villagers!
OwO the Archdemon cackles arrogantly. It's a familiar scene all over again.
Time after time of being helpless. Time after time of failing.
The best chances have all been lost to cowardice.

speaker: OwO
content: Hahahaha! Without the candy of courage, how are you going to defeat me?
The Archdemon taunts the girl, trying to crush her last ray of hope...
The girl doesn't flinch. She wipes away her tears and stares directly at the so-called "Archdemon" in front of her.
She finally made her decision—to challenge what she fears most.

speaker: Lynn
content: I won't let you...

speaker: Lynn
content: I won't let you harm the villagers anymore!

speaker: Lynn
content: I've fled too many times already... This time, I won't flee again!
She didn't have the "candy of courage" that can save the world and defeat the Archdemon.
But for the first time, she mustered the courage to face the Archdemon.

speaker: OwO
content: Owoo... This is a trick... It's just a normal piece of candy... Owoo...
With the defeat of OwO the Archdemon, the villagers gained their freedom.
And thus, the fairy tale world restored its former tranquility.
Of course, we can't forget about the heroine who saved everyone.
Even though she didn't eat the candy of courage, everyone now says...
That once cowardly girl gained true courage.
OwO the director begins to roll around on the ground.

speaker: OwO
content: Ahhh... That doesn't count! Doesn't count, doesn't count, doesn't count!

speaker: OwO
content: It should be me who won!

speaker: OwO
content: The candy of courage is so powerful, so of course whoever ate it should be the winner!

speaker: OwO
content: Plus, I'm the Archdemon! There's no way that I can lose with the double buffs!

speaker: Lynn
content: Then... maybe... we can make a sequel...

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph. But overall, this movie ain't bad. I like it a lot.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... Since you gained courage...

speaker: OwO
content: Time to take this off!

speaker: Lynn
content: No no no no, please don't! That was just in the movie...
OwO reaches out to take off Lynn's helmet, but Lynn covers her head tightly with her arms.

speaker: Lynn
content: I'll... I'll go make movies with you, all right? Sob...

speaker: OwO
content: Why are you like this? You seem so unwilling.

speaker: OwO
content: You don't like it? I don't want to force you...

speaker: OwO
content: Sigh... It's a pity if such a great script goes to waste... Don't you think?
OwO turns around, but still peeks at Lynn's reaction from time to time.

speaker: Lynn
content: Ah, um...

speaker: Lynn
content: Actually... Actually... I...

speaker: Lynn
content: I... I like the script... I like the movie you described...

speaker: OwO
content: Oh! So you do like it!

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe! I knew it! How can anyone reject OwO's script?

speaker: OwO
content: Since you liked it, join me and let's start filming right away!

speaker: Lynn
content: R-right now? I-I'm not mentally prepared yet...
OwO tries to pull a terrified Lynn out of the sewers.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe, you gave me your word already. Too late to back out now! Come be my signature camerawoman. Let's conquer DisCity's film world together!

speaker: Lynn
content: Oh... All right...

speaker: OwO
content: Oh right, take this! I have to go now. The dummy clapper will come and brief you on the details.

speaker: Lynn
content: Huh?
Lynn looks down at what was given to her. It's the candy that she didn't get to eat in the story.

speaker: Lynn
content: Hehe... That's so nice.
Lynn smiles knowingly, and also steps out of the sewers. The sun shines on her for the first time.

speaker: OwO
content: Is this thing on? Okay.

speaker: OwO
content: Ahem, I'm OwO.

speaker: OwO
content: We've come to Syndicate to recruit! If you're in Syndicate and see this video, don't dilly-dally and come join us right away! The spots are filling up fast!

speaker: OwO
content: Also, they always say that Syndicate has a lot of gangs...

speaker: OwO
content: I always hear that gangster movies are really popular. Movies from this genre have won a lot of awards.

speaker: OwO
content: But I haven't seen any gangs yet. I don't know where they've run off to... Hey, dummy clapper, what do they look like?

speaker: OwO
content: We welcome any talents from Syndicate who dream of joining the film industry to sign up!

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Cough cough cough... I can't breathe.
A girl with flamboyant pink hair jumps out of the thick smoke, and starts yelling at a nearby van.

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Open the door!

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: We lost them?

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: I set the record room on fire, and umm... Yep, now there's smoke everywhere in the building. They won't be able to get out for a while.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: That equipment and those videotapes... were the fruits of many years of our labor...

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Oh, what are you afraid of? There's new fun in DisCity every day. As long as the two of us are still here, we'll definitely make even better shows in the future.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: ...Mmm.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: Those of you over there should leave, too. The people in this building are from the Gonzales family. They don't have good tempers.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: When they come out and can't find the culprits, they'll probably take it out on you...

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Huh? There are still people here.
The pink-haired girl looks over towards you. A few seconds later, OwO seems to see her eyes light up.

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Hey y'all, wanna go have some fun together?

speaker: OwO
content: Fun? What kind of fun?

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Something amusing and enjoyable that makes everyone happy.

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: You must like that, too!

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: How about it? Want to join us?

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe... How can I miss out on anything happy?

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: All right, get in the van, then!
The pink-haired girl grabs all of you and jumps into the van.

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Let's go!

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: I know. Don't rush me.

speaker: Voice outside the van
content: There they are!

speaker: Voice outside the van
content: Don't run!

speaker: Voice outside the van
content: Give our boss's son back!
A dozen burly men armed with guns rush out of the smoky building, cursing as they run towards the van.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: Hold on tight.
Fortunately, the engine starts at the most crucial moment. The van rushes out at rocket-like speed, its tires screeching against the ground and whirling up dust.
Ten minutes later.

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Phew... We finally lost them.
The van speeds down Syndicate's long-neglected roads. The pursuers behind them had long disappeared. They park the van at a place considered peaceful by Syndicate standards.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: Do you know these people?

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: No.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: Huh?

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: They were standing outside stupidly, so I brought them along.

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: So... you just randomly got a few passers-by to tag along on our getaway?

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Not just randomly... Look, they have cameras. Hasn't our "DisCars Special" been delayed for half a month? We can get them to help us film.

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: And can't you tell that these people look really fun? How could I just leave them behind?

speaker: Gloomy Girl
content: ...Whatever, up to you. At least it's better than leaving them behind to get beat up by the Gonzales thugs.

speaker: OwO
content: Wait, you... You you you you you...

speaker: OwO
content: Could you be... that... What were the names again...

speaker: Pink-Haired Girl
content: Haha, you have a good eye! I'm Love. The driver is Lil Daisy.

speaker: Love
content: We're the hosts of Syndicate's most awesome radio show, DeadLover Radio!

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: She didn't even say our names yet...

speaker: OwO
content: Oh oh oh! So you're superstars?

speaker: Love
content: That's right! We're superstars!

speaker: OwO
content: Hi there, superstar! I'm OwO. This is my entourage.

speaker: OwO
content: I just got to Syndicate. We came to make a movie, and we're recruiting the crew along the way...

speaker: Love
content: Crew? You're making a movie? What kind? Is it fun?

speaker: OwO
content: Of course it's fun! I'm planning to make a gangster film.

speaker: Love
content: Gangsters? I couldn't be more familiar with them! Lil Daisy and I have been dealing with them for many years. The people coming after us just now were gangsters, too.

speaker: OwO
content: So that's what gangsters look like. But why were they coming after you? Aren't you superstars?

speaker: Love
content: Who knows? I don't want to talk about it. Going back to your movie, what exactly are you planning to film?

speaker: OwO
content: I haven't decided yet. I already have several ideas. Do you want to...

speaker: Love
content: Count me in! Also Lil Daisy and everyone who works for DeadLover Radio!

speaker: Love
content: We'll be where the fun is! That's what DeadLover Radio is all about!
Lil Daisy, who had been quiet for a while, pokes her head out somewhat awkwardly.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Can you not make decisions for me...

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Also, I have to remind you, because we've been getting hunted down these past couple of days, all of our staff have fled.

speaker: Love
content: Huh? So we've become kings with no armies?

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: ...You're spot on.

speaker: Love
content: Oh well. If worse comes to worst, we'll switch to the film industry. I'm so excited, Daisy! This is my first time making a movie.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: I just don't know how capable this crew is...

speaker: OwO
content: We're extremely capable! We'll make a blockbuster for sure! We'll win a DisCars and everyone will watch it!

speaker: Love
content: That's great, then! Without further ado, let's get started!

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: I must remind you, there are still people trying to hunt us down.

speaker: OwO
content: Fear not, I've got you covered! No one can mess with my crew! Just focus on helping me make my film.

speaker: Love
content: Roger that, Commander!

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Back to the main issue...

speaker: Love
content: Oh right, the main issue!

speaker: Love
content: So little boss, what exactly is this movie that we're making?
OwO shifts her eyes around.

speaker: OwO
content: The coolest, hottest, and most fun movie that'll ever get made, of course!

speaker: Love
content: Oh wow wow! That's great. What are we waiting for? Let's start shooting!

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: ...What I meant by "main issue" is how are we going to lose those guys who are chasing us...

speaker: Love
content: Ugh, what are you panicking for, Daisy? They won't find us here anytime soon.

speaker: OwO
content: Don't worry. I've already figured out how to deal with them.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: How?

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe, I've got a plan that'll both help us make our movie and solve the problem of getting hunted down.

speaker: Love
content: Really? We can get rid of them while making a movie? Can I be the lead actress?

speaker: OwO
content: No problem! You're Love the superstar. The lead role is naturally yours.

speaker: OwO
content: Come, come. I have the script already. This is the plan...

speaker: Narration
content: In chaotic, violent Syndicate, there are two ancient clans. They have feuded for generations, each harboring intense hatred for the other...

speaker: Narration
content: However, the Rumeo clan's youngest son fell in love with the Chocoliet clan's daughter. The two eloped and ran away.

speaker: Narration
content: The wicked patriarch of the Rumeo clan would never allow something that brings dishonor to the clan like this to happen.

speaker: Narration
content: He led his clan members to the manor where the couple meets, intending to tear the poor girl to shreds...

speaker: Narration
content: But when they rushed into the manor, they realized they had made a huge mistake!

speaker: Gang Member A
content: "Boss, it's a trap!"

speaker: Gang Member B
content: "Her firepower is too much! We can't hold out against her!"

speaker: Scarface Love
content: "Hmph, didn't expect that, did you? I'm not some damsel in distress who eloped for love. I'm a femme fatale who kidnapped the Rumeo boy to lure you here and catch you all!"

speaker: Narration
content: The Rumeo thugs got pummeled. Only when the smoke cleared from her muzzle did they see her face.

speaker: Narration
content: She is... "Scarface," Love!

speaker: Love
content: Haha, didn't expect that, did you? I'm not some damsel in distress who eloped... hey hey hey! Dude!

speaker: Love
content: Th-they're not supposed to be doing that! I haven't finished my lines yet!

speaker: OwO
content: Ugh... The extras are really bad quality. I guess it can't be helped.

speaker: Love
content: What do we do now?

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: My suggestion is...

speaker: OwO & Lil Daisy
content: Run!

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: We can't run away forever. I have to find a chance to talk to them.

speaker: Love
content: Daisy, you're crazy. It's not like you've been in Syndicate for only a year or two. You know what the gangsters are like, right?

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Even gangsters can be reasoned with.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: At least we have to figure out what they mean by "the boss's son."

speaker: OwO
content: Now that you mention it! I know a lot about negotiations.

speaker: OwO
content: In movies, the characters always stay in a dark room while clad in their best clothing. They look really intimidating!

speaker: OwO
content: Any normal person would be intimidated by your aura and think twice about laying a finger on you. This puts you at an advantage. By then, they'll do whatever you say.

speaker: Love
content: Daisy, what she says makes sense.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Are you serious?

speaker: Love
content: It's not stage fright, is it?

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: All right... I'll act it out...

speaker: Godmother" Daisy
content: "Bonasalad, Bonasalad..."

speaker: Godmother" Daisy
content: "Tell me, who is that boy? What did he do to make you disrespect me so much?"

speaker: Godmother" Daisy
content: "This is not a threat, but a piece of advice, Bonasalad. Tell me your answer, or else..."

speaker: Godmother" Daisy
content: "I'll make you an offer you can't refuse."

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: "I-I'll make you a-an offer you can't r-refuse."

speaker: Gang Member
content: Pfff...

speaker: Gang Member
content: Pwahahaha, the hell is this girl sayin...
The gangster passes out halfway through his sentence. Upon closer observation, OwO realizes Love had thrown a prop gun at the gangster, which struck him between the eyebrows.

speaker: Love
content: Sigh, still doesn't work, eh? Tsk tsk, Daisy, Daisy, Daisy. You really don't have the talent for this. Look at me. It took me only two tries to get the hang of it.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: If I knew how to act, I wouldn't have run away from Eastside in the first place.

speaker: OwO
content: Seems like Daisy really isn't cut out for acting. Turns out that not everyone is as talented as Love...

speaker: Love
content: Let's go. We can't hide here any longer.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: It's all because of that "boss's son"...

speaker: Love
content: Huh?

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: If it wasn't for him, I wouldn't have suffered such great humiliation... I must capture him, and then...
A sound from behind the desk drawer interrupts Daisy's thoughts.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: What's that sound?! Who's hiding there? Come out!
Ahh! D-don't kill me!
The boy frantically gets up. The posters in his hands scatter all over the floor.

speaker: Narration
content: In the dark bar, three figures are interrogating a poor boy. Judging from their fearsome looks, they aren't people you should mess with.

speaker: Scarface Love
content: "Don't assume that DeadLover Radio folks are easy to deal with... If you don't spill the beans, I'll kill you!"

speaker: Narration
content: Scarface flashes a cruel smile on her ferocious face. She grills the boy on why he followed them.

speaker: Narration
content: The boy is terrified by the interrogation. In the end, he spills everything.

speaker: Narration
content: It turns out the boy's father is Francisco Gonzales, the patriarch of the Gonzales family. But the boy devoted himself to pursuing his filmmaking dream, causing a rift between him and his father.

speaker: Young Diego
content: "I wanted to convince Dad... But, but... Do you think someone like me has a chance of realizing my dream in a place like Syndicate?"

speaker: Narration
content: They were all moved by the boy's story. No matter where in the world, love and dreams should have a chance of coming true.

speaker: Narration
content: They decide to help the boy realize his dream. The first thing to do is to "get rid of" Francisco.
As soon as OwO finishes talking, the door gets kicked open.
As a pitch-black figure glides through the door, everyone realizes that things are about to get heated.

speaker: Diego
content: We... won?

speaker: Love
content: Didn't expect that, did you! The big boss of the Gonzales family getting captured by DeadLover Radio!

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Tell your people not to mess with us again, or else...

speaker: Love
content: Or else, we'll let everyone in Syndicate know that you got caught by us! Your family will lose its reputation forever!

speaker: OwO
content: Love is so awesome! Wait, no. This kind of monologue sounds too much like a villain.

speaker: OwO
content: And shouldn't we be helping Diego realize his filmmaking dream?

speaker: Love
content: Then how should it be done?

speaker: OwO
content: The plot should go like this...

speaker: Narration
content: Seeing his aging father admit defeat for the first time, Diego also feels very sad.

speaker: Narration
content: He tenderly explains his dream to his father, and the efforts he had made over the years to make it come true.

speaker: Narration
content: Now, he has finally met like-minded companions. He must seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, for the DisCars are within reach!

speaker: Young Diego
content: "Father, I wish you can be proud of me, even if it's just once..."

speaker: Narration
content: In the face of his son's sincerity, the baddy daddy falls silent.

speaker: Narration
content: Though he's a baddy daddy, he still loves his son. He just doesn't want him to get hurt. But he realizes that his son is a big boy now. It's time to let go.

speaker: Narration
content: He turns to leave, but stops by the door.

speaker: Baddy Francisco
content: "Go do what you want. I won't stop you anymore. Just... If things get too tough, you can always come home."

speaker: Love
content: Sob, how touching!

speaker: OwO
content: Right? You think so, too, don't you, Love?

speaker: OwO
content: Hey old man, be more open-minded. Quit trying to stop Diego from pursuing his dreams.

speaker: Francisco
content: What the hell are you talking about? Kill or maim me if you want, but don't ******* disgust me with this nonsense!

speaker: Francisco
content: He sits at home and does nothing but listens to your ******* radio show. After a while, he doesn't even stay at home anymore. He goes to squat in front of your door all day.

speaker: Francisco
content: This little bastard really has issues. I just want to get him home so he doesn't embarrass me outside.

speaker: Francisco
content: Keep him if you want. I won't stick around anymore. But I'll definitely get my revenge for what happened today! Just you wait!

speaker: Narration
content: Before everyone's stunned gazes, Francisco breaks free from the rope around his body and flees.

speaker: Diego
content: I... I can explain...

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: No need...

speaker: OwO
content: Disgusting.

speaker: Love
content: Hey, don't be so judgmental. It's normal for a radio show as popular as ours to have a few crazy fans.

speaker: Love
content: But since you love our show so much, why don't you... work for us?

speaker: Yanyan
content: You know, because of your dad, several dozen of our staff all fled.

speaker: Love
content: From now on, you can cover all their shifts!
After this eccentric adventure, everyone returns to the "filming studio" they had come to earlier.

speaker: Love
content: The Gonzales people are gone now... They won't come back, will they?

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Hard to say...
Lil Daisy casts a glance at Diego next to her.

speaker: Love
content: Oh well, no matter. In any case, the crisis has been temporarily resolved. Though we met many dangers along the way, we're lucky to have Love's incredible courage, which finally drove away Francisco the baddy daddy...

speaker: OwO
content: Indeed, indeed! DeadLover Radio is the best!

speaker: Love
content: Hahahahaha, I knew that my charm is unparalleled! Even kids can't resist it.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: ..Don't be a bad influence on the kid. We didn't do anything worthwhile this whole time.

speaker: OwO
content: Who says you didn't do anything worthwhile?

speaker: OwO
content: Syndicate is so chaotic and terrifying, and you were being hunted down by a bunch of baddies.

speaker: OwO
content: Yet you remained cheerful and never complained. Not only were you happy yourselves, but you also shared that happiness with others.

speaker: OwO
content: I want my movie to be like that, too! You guys are my idols!

speaker: Love
content: ...Hehe, oh shucks, I feel embarrassed now. We're not that great...

speaker: OwO
content: You are! Love, you're the best! I'm your number one fan now!

speaker: OwO
content: Daisy... Daisy is... Daisy is the third best. OwO is the second best.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: ...Okay.

speaker: Love
content: By the way, OwO, are you still recruiting people for your crew?

speaker: OwO
content: Yeah! Wanna come, too, Love?

speaker: Love
content: Of course! The movie we're making is so fun. There's nothing more fun in all of Syndicate!

speaker: Love
content: Sticking to the principle of being wherever's most fun, I'm gonna stay with you no matter what.

speaker: OwO
content: Yeah! That's great!

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: What about the radio station? The building burned down, and all our staff ran away. It'll take a lot to rebuild.

speaker: Love
content: No worries. Having fun in the present is more important! We can think about rebuilding the radio station later.

speaker: Love
content: Plus, we were going to make a "DisCars Special" anyways. We're getting the best materials out of this.

speaker: Love
content: When OwO finishes making her fun movie, we'll go onstage at the DisCars together, and I'll announce...

speaker: Love
content: OwO has not only made the best ******* movie in all of DisCity, but she is also an honorary employee of DeadLover Radio and Love's number one fan. What do you think? It's gonna be super fun.

speaker: OwO
content: No problem! I've got things covered!
As the two get more and more excited as they chat, Daisy starts getting a headache.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: The Gonzales henchmen are still... Never mind.
Lil Daisy looks at OwO, then at Love.

speaker: Lil Daisy
content: Maybe it's safer to stay with you... So be it...

speaker: OwO
content: La la la la la... Hum hum hum hum...
Having come up with a new idea for a movie, the girl skips happily back to the filming car.

speaker: OwO
content: Phew... I'm in a good mood today. Shall I give that dummy clapper a promotion?

speaker: OwO
content: I wonder if he's getting along better with Stella... Um, what are they doing?
female_content: I wonder if she's getting along better with Stella... Um, what are they doing?

content: Spotting you and the little critter, OwO quickly hides behind a tree to observe.

speaker: OwO
content: (Staring)

speaker: Stella
content: Purr... purr?
You look around. The girl has temporarily left your sight. Now's a good time to catch the Apostle of Ashes.
You tiptoe towards the little critter, set yourself at the right distance, then pounce forward with all your might...

speaker: Stella
content: Purr!
You lose your balance and almost fall to the ground. The little critter nimbly jumps up, steps over your back, and leaps into the girl's arms.
You decide to take a detour, using various obstacles to create blind spots as you quietly approach the little critter...

speaker: Stella
content: Purr!
You almost succeeded! But the little creature still slipped through your fingers at the last minute and dashed into the girl's arms.

speaker: OwO
content: Hey hey hey, you're not allowed to bully Stella!
The girl stands before you with her hands on her hips, ready to uphold justice.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ahem, I was just playing with Stella.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph, I don't believe you. You were clearly bullying Stella!

speaker: OwO
content: Right, Stella?

speaker: Stella
content: Purr, purr...

speaker: OwO
content: See, Stella agrees!
The little critter curls up in the girl's arms and whimpers piteously, but you clearly see it wagging its tail in triumph, and even secretly wink at you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think that exotic animals of unknown origin are best left to the care of professionals. Why don't...

speaker: OwO
content: No its not! Come to think of it... the only person of unknown origin is you, dummy clapper!

speaker: Stella
content: Purr, purr...

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph! You disobey the director's orders and repeatedly disrupt the team! How should I punish you?

speaker: Stella
content: Purr! Purr!

speaker: OwO
content: Seeing how hard you've worked for me, I'll spare you this time!

speaker: OwO
content: But I still want to test your mettle... Write me a movie script in one day!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Clearly it's because you're too lazy to write it yourself...

speaker: OwO
content: What... Don't you dare insult OwO! A test is a test! Come on, Stella, let's go.
The girl skips away with the little critter in her arms.
The comms panel is flickering. You got a message. You quickly go to the side to check it out.

speaker: MBCC Clerk
content:
Wynn: Ah! Looks like you got my message, Chief ${PlayerName}! I'm the clerk for the city arrest team. My code name is "Wynn"! ('·ω·')

Wynn: How is the plan to capture the Apostle of Ashes coming along? (.・ω・.)
The clerk of the city arrest team? Her name sounds quite familiar. You wrack your brain, trying to remember.
You remember your first day at the Bureau.
So it's her. She's already in charge of matters related to the Apostle of Ashes? The scope of the city arrest team's work is really extensive.

speaker: MBCC Clerk
content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Everything's fine.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color>Everything's fine? Wow, that's great to hear! (/·ω·)/

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> I knew it! With ${PlayerName} personally taking the reins, everything is sure to be fine! (。>ω<)/

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Why did you go quiet of all a sudden, ${PlayerName}? Is something wrong? (。OωO。)

speaker: MBCC Clerk
content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Things are tough.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Things are tough? Let me guess... It's because of that kid named OwO. ('·ω·')


<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Are you afraid that she'll be sad if you take away the Apostle of Ashes? Tsk tsk. ${PlayerName}, you really are a kind soul. (/TAT)/
<size=40>You brief her on the situation.</size>

speaker: MBCC Clerk
content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color>Got any suggestions?


<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Well, I do have some experience when it comes to dealing with kids. ('·ω·')

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> What annoys kids the most is when adults lecture and talk down to them. (¯¯-¯¯o)


<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Maybe you can turn what you want to tell her into a story? (>□<)b

speaker: MBCC Clerk
content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Hmm...
Wynn: You can do it, Chief! I believe in you! (。OvO。)

Wynn: I've got a feeling that you're a great storyteller! (。>ω<)b
Thus, you pour all your energy and concentration into writing a script. By the time you finish, it's already night.

speaker: OwO
content: Ah... Why did you call me over? I'm sleepy, aha...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Didn't you want to test me? I just finished my script. Why don't I tell you about it now?

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm? A bedtime story? I'm not a little kid who needs to listen to stories anymore. I just want to sleep right now...
The girl has already forgotten that she wanted to test you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you forget that you wanted to test my mettle?

speaker: OwO
content: Test? Test what... Oh! I remember now! I-I didn't forget at all! This is part of the test, too! Hmph...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All right, then. Let me tell you the story of "Super Lion."

speaker: OwO
content: A superhero lion? I love lions!

speaker: OwO
content: Stella, come listen with me...

speaker: Stella
content: Purr...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Once upon a time, there was a peaceful city that suddenly came under attack by a mysterious monster! This monster wreaked havoc everywhere, plunging the whole city into chaos.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The monster had dark blue hair, and when it got angry, it emitted an eerie light. People called it... "Starzilla."

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... Feels like I've seen this monster somewhere before.

speaker: Little Critter
content: Purr! Purr!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But in this critical moment, a hero rose up to save the city. Her name is... Super Lion!

speaker: OwO
content: Wow! Super Lion is so awesome!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's right! Super Lion upholds justice and would never let any villain get away!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The monster was a fierce and cunning opponent who pushed Super Lion to the brink every time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But at the last minute, Super Lion always uses her Ultimate "Lion Light Cannon" to turn the tide of battle!

speaker: OwO
content: "Lion Light Cannon" to the rescue! Pew... pew... pew...

speaker: OwO
content: Hey, you got hit by the Lion Light Cannon. Fall down quickly...
You pretend to get knocked down by the Lion Light Cannon. The girl giggles in glee.
You ignore the girl's childish antics. OwO looks at you and pouts, disgruntled.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Finally, after a life-and-death battle, the seriously wounded monster disappears.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Super Lion thought she had restored peace forever.

speaker: OwO
content: But obviously the monster didn't actually get defeated, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's right. But what people didn't know is, that Super Lion's real identity was actually a little girl.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Whenever the monsters appeared and the city needed to be saved, the girl would take out her transformation device and turn into Super Lion.

speaker: OwO
content: Swish... OwO!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...What's that?

speaker: OwO
content: The sound of the girl transforming into Super Lion. Isn't it cool?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Very cool.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph...
