After watching OwO perform the transformation sound, you continue telling her about your script.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not long after the big battle, Super Lion found a small animal on her way home from school. The critter was badly injured and appeared to be dying.

speaker: OwO
content: The poor thing... Super Lion will definitely help it!

speaker: Stella
content: Purr!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. Super Lion is very kind, so she took good care of the little creature.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Soon, they became close friends.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe, Super Lion finally got her own little sidekick!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But what Super Lion didn't expect was that the little creature's real identity was "Starzilla"!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It fooled Super Lion, pretending to be an innocent creature during the day, but at night, when Super Lion fell asleep, it would turn into a monster and wreak havoc!

speaker: OwO
content: Wow! What a plot twist!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Finally, Super Lion discovers the true identity of Starzilla, and asks why it deceived her when she clearly treated it as a friend.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "I'm sorry, Super Lion, but this is my nature. I was born to wreak havoc."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Super Lion was heartbroken, but for the whole city's sake, she finally mustered the resolve to fight the monster one last time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Super Lion, this is the final battle."

speaker: OwO
content: "Surrender, Starzilla! I don't want to hurt my friend!"

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Super Lion, today is your doomsday!"

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "The plan to destroy Super Lion will be realized today!"

speaker: OwO
content: "Bring it on! I'm the guardian of this city!"

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Show me all you've got, my friend."

speaker: OwO
content: "I won't go easy on you this time."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "How naive! Taste my cosmic wrath! Million Starbeam Laser!!!!!"

speaker: OwO
content: "I won't surrender! Lion Light Cannon!!!!!"

speaker: OwO
content: Swoosh... Clash... Crash...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Finally, justice defeated evil. Super Lion defeated the beast, and purged this scourge from the city once and for all...

speaker: OwO
content: Stop, stop! Cut, cut!

speaker: OwO
content: How can it end like that? I don't want this ending!

speaker: OwO
content: The ending of the story should be like this...

speaker: OwO
content: After defeating Starzilla, Super Lion reaches out to it again.

speaker: OwO
content: "Will you be my friend once more, and guard the city together with me?"

speaker: Stella
content: Purr! Purr!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But the real ending should be that Super Lion destroyed the beast...

speaker: OwO
content: No no no! My ending is better! Super Lion and Starzilla are still friends!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, the ending should be...
You notice the girl hugging the little critter in frustration, her eyes tearing up a bit.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well, even though your ending is nicer... it might be really hard to achieve.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's now a cute critter is destined to become a big, uncontrollable monster.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: By then, it'll be too late.
The girl in front of you falls into silence.

speaker: OwO
content: Hey, dummy clapper?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes?

speaker: OwO
content: I know the beast you're talking about is Stella... Do you hate Stella because it's always causing trouble for you?

speaker: OwO
content: I know that Stella is always naughty. But it's my fault... I didn't... I didn't keep a close enough eye on it.
The girl thinks for a moment.

speaker: OwO
content: But Stella is still young and got lost from its family. Stella is naughty because nobody taught it any better.

speaker: OwO
content: From now on, OwO is Stella's family. I'll always be by its side, I will teach Stella to be good, and I will protect Stella.

speaker: Stella
content: Purr, purr...

speaker: OwO
content: I promise that Stella won't become a monster. Don't stay angry at Stella, please... please?

speaker: OwO
content: Th-thank you! I'll tell Stella not to make trouble for you anymore.

speaker: OwO
content: Stella, you're not allowed to be naughty and cause trouble for our little clapper ${PlayerName} anymore. You're both part of the film crew, so learn to get along.

speaker: Stella
content: Purr...

speaker: OwO
content: All right, Stella already apologized to you. I'm going to bed now. Yawn. So sleepy!
The girl walks off sleepily with the little critter in her arms. You gaze at them and wonder if you can really keep such a promise.

speaker: OwO
content: Mhmm... Let me see, are all the crew members here?

speaker: OwO
content: Roll call!

speaker: OwO
content: Camerawoman... Lynn!

speaker: Lynn
content: Here...

speaker: OwO
content: Sound engineers... Love and Daisy!

speaker: Love
content: Hehe, here!

speaker: Daisy
content: Is it really necessary to take attendance like this...

speaker: OwO
content: Ahem, the director is speaking. Others should keep quiet.

speaker: OwO
content: And lastly, our dummy clapper... ${PlayerName}!

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe, good enthusiasm! Keep it up and maybe I'll promote you to be an official employee!

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm? Why do you sound so out of energy? Don't you want to make a name for yourself and get the job?

speaker: Stella
content: Purr purr...

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe... I almost forgot about you. Our big star... Stella!

speaker: Love
content: Uh... who?
The girl picks up the little creature, rocking it gently.

speaker: OwO
content: Stella comes from far, far away, and is the most amazing animal ever!

speaker: OwO
content: But it got separated from its family. We have to bring Stella back to its family!

speaker: OwO
content: This touching story is the theme of our movie! I hereby announce—the making of the great Stella movie officially begins!

speaker: Love
content: All right!

speaker: Stella
content: Purr! Purr!
Those at the scene give some scattered applause.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm? Why is the clapping sound so weak? Someone is slacking off!
I think the script needs some plot twists and climaxes.
Otherwise, with no clear beginning or end, the movie would be boring. The audience won't like it.

speaker: OwO
content: Huh? What plot twists? Tell me, dummy clapper!
For example, Stella looks like a harmless creature, but it is actually a dangerous space spy.
And maybe, um, some Timecops will arrest it!

speaker: OwO
content: Timecops? What kind of Timecops?
They're a bunch of ducks in space gear. They keep the balance of the multiverse and what not.

speaker: Daisy
content: Those are the characters you came up with? You're really not cut out to be a screenwriter...

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... Lemme think... Hey, dummy clapper, that's an interesting idea!
The girl jumps in front of you.

speaker: OwO
content: It'd be even better if some characters tried to catch Stella! That way, not only will our movie have villains, but also conflict! It'll be exciting for sure! The script can go like this...
As OwO goes on and on about how the Timecop ducks catch the little critter, you notice Stella staring at you and shaking its ears in contempt.
Meanwhile, on the other side of Dillywood.
A dazzling light illuminates a back alley in Dillywood, as if space and time are getting torn apart. Several portals appear out of thin air.
Strange ducks waddle out of the portal one after another, strapped with all sorts of gear and quacking to each other.

content:
Quack quack quack, quack quack! Quack quack quack!

content:

content:
Quack!

content:

content:
Quack!

content:

content:

content:

Quack quack!

speaker: Rabbo
content:
Quack quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack.

content:
Quack quack quack quack! Quack quack!

content: Obsessed with scavenging for treasures in Syndicate, OwO eventually ends up near the Rust. She suddenly spots several ominous shadows lurking in the distance.

content: OwO gets chased by the uncooperative "extras" for several blocks. In her panic, she slips and falls to the ground with a "splat," losing consciousness immediately.

speaker: Narration
content: While her consciousness is in a haze, OwO sees countless monsters clawing and roaring in the darkness. As she shudders in fright, a pair of gentle hands brushes away the hazy horrors.
There there, everything's fine now...

speaker: Narration
content: OwO opens her eyes, discovering that there aren't any Corruptors chasing after her. Instead, she's lying in the warm embrace of a beautiful lady.

speaker: Narration
content: She didn't know the lady, but perhaps because of how warm her hands are, OwO snuggles deeper into her embrace, rubbing her little face against the lady's comforting palms.

speaker: OwO
content: Owoo... There are monsters...
Don't be scared. The monsters are gone now. It's safe here.

speaker: Narration
content: The lady wipes away her cold sweat, and feels her forehead with concern.
Hmm, you should be fine now. Do you still feel pain or discomfort anywhere on your body?
If you feel unwell at all, make sure to let me know.

speaker: OwO
content: Ohhh... Thank you, miss... I'm fine. I'm feeling much better!
Hmm... Do you know why you fainted, sweetie?

speaker: OwO
content: Fainted? Ahh... I must've been too tired! After all, I'm preparing to make an epic horror blockbuster!

speaker: OwO
content: I want to film the kind of haunted hospital that rattles in the wind. One filled with people-eating monsters wrapped in bloody bandages...

speaker: OwO
content: Oh right! There's also the crazy head nurse who tames others with her syringe! She's the main character!

speaker: OwO
content: So as a filmmaker, I just had to go deep into Syndicate to find the perfect cast and props!

speaker: OwO
content: Sigh, if those Corruptors had cooperated and become my extras instead of chasing me... I would've shot some super cool scenes!

speaker: Narration
content: As OwO proudly boasts about her "feats," she doesn't notice the lady's face darkening.

content: Though the lady's tone is still gentle, OwO starts to feel cold sweat all over her body.

speaker: Narration
content: The lady gently strokes the back of OwO's neck. OwO's back becomes ice-cold, and her hairs stand on end.

content: Actually, I'm a head nurse myself. Do you think I'd be good as the main character in your horror film?

speaker: OwO
content: Meh...

speaker: Head Nurse
content: Little kids shouldn't run around everywhere, especially in a dangerous place like Syndicate. It's not good for your own safety.

speaker: Head Nurse
content: You were lucky this time. If those monsters had caught you... they would've done "this", then they would do "that" until they turn you into "this" too... Is that what you want?

speaker: Narration
content: OwO looks at the smiling lady in front of her, and tears start streaming down her face.

speaker: OwO
content: Waaaaahhh... I don't want that... I won't do that again...

speaker: Head Nurse
content: That's more like it. Will you do it again next time? Are you going to be a good kid?

speaker: OwO
content: I-I-I'll be a good kid! I swear I won't come to Syndicate alone ever again! Waaaaahhhh...

content: OwO promises without a second thought as she clutches the head nurse's clothes and bawls her eyes out.

content: You're still young. As long as you grow up safe and sound, you'll get to eat all the yummy food and make all the movies you like. But if the Corruptors get you...

content: There, there... If you correct your mistakes, you're still a good kid. Shhh... It's all right. Just sleep on it and everything will be fine when you wake up.

content: Seeing OwO's earnest apology, the head nurse stops exuding her terrifying aura. She pats OwO gently on the back, softly coaxing her to sleep.

content: As OwO sobs, she secretly lifts her gaze for a peek. She sees dark circles under the nurse's eyes, and immense fatigue from her expression. She doesn't seem to have rested well at all.

speaker: Narration
content: OwO feels a pang of guilt. The head nurses in the movies are always very busy. She feels embarrassed that this nurse still has to look after her at such a late hour...

speaker: Head Nurse
content: Emm, sure.

content: There's a gazebo over there. Go take cover from the rain. I'll come find you after I pack this up.

content: Wow... How pretty... Are you a fairy?

content: Yeah...

speaker: OwO
content: Yeah...

content: Do you know who brought this umbrella to my side?

content: You were the only one I saw when I got here... So... I don't know who brought you the umbrella...

content: Thank you for your kindness, it's okay... no need for the hassle.

content: OwO, what are you looking at? I called you several times, but you ignored me.

content: Oh my gosh! I-I just met a fairy! She's so beautiful! She should really be the heroine of my film!

content: OwO...

Chief's Office
10:00 a.m., February 23, N.F. 113
You hear a commotion. A gaggle of Sinners addicted to board games has gathered outside your office, clamoring to play with you. Nightingale spreads her arms to keep them from bursting in.

You take out a thick envelope of documents with your left hand and place it on the desk, then a second one, and a third one. At last, you pull out a huge cardboard box from under the chair with one hand.
These are the files you will be dealing with today.
Two hours later, your work in the morning is finally done. You flip open a routine report of the Supervision Terminal and read it leisurely.
A tiny brown card drops out of the report. Then another, and another. A few dozen cards shower down on the desk.
What could they be? You wonder.
"Chief, come and play the new modle of Dragon & Isle of Sky with us!" Hella

"Chief, we're one player short. We've decided on our characters, and we're waiting for you to lead us in our adventure." 
EMP

"Dear Chief, may I... May I invite you to join us...?" 
Victoria

"I have a game recommendation for you." 
Mess
Each card carries a message written by a Sinner. Hella's spelling is off again. You're sure she's been skipping her classes because she's all hooked on board games.
You shake your head and gather up the cards. They make for good keepsakes, even if you have no time to play the game with them.
How they've managed to sneak the cards in under Nightingale's watchful eyes is beyond you. You'd very much like to learn the trick from them, frankly.
You stack the cards together and set them aside. A floral scent suddenly spreads in the office, and the message cards gather to form an old-fashioned invitation in the air.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2>At long last, I've been waiting for you! You're the number one player on our friends invite list and the most popular <color=#fb9259>new player</color> we've had!</color>
What's the meaning of this?!

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: Hehe! Invitation accepted. Contract established. The game is to begin now. Welcome to the grand adventure of Dragon & Isle of Sky!
Before you can say anything, the floral scent thickens and that voice seems to draw your consciousness out of your body, throwing it into an unknown void.
The scene as huge as a movie screen fades out right before your eyes. You find yourself fallen on a white ice field.
The wind screeches and icy snowflakes fall on you, melting instantly. The snow under your feet is slightly dented, squeaking with each step you take.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2>How's that? That's a dope opening scene, isn't it?</color>
Pink petals drop onto your shoulders with the snow. The Game Master's voice rings in your heart.
Telepathy? She can hear your thoughts? ...Is this <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color> power?
The shackles don't respond to that voice or anything in the surroundings. You can't detect the source of the voice, and your power is even being restrained.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2>No cheating in my <color=#fb9259>game</color>! You must follow the rules. Play your role, find your friends, and complete the adventure!</color>
You quickly fumble for your communication device only to realize you've already changed into an entirely different outfit. You pat yourself down and find nothing...
Clank.
A white <color=#fb9259>six-sided dice</color> falls on the snow.
The pattern on the dice is clearly visible. Apparently, you haven't been teleported to some forgotten corner of the real world, but into a highly realistic <color=#fb9259>fantasy world</color>.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2>Don't lose that, it's important. It's proof that you're </color><color=#fb9259>the Chosen One</color>.
What on earth is this place? What does she mean by the Chosen One? As you process all this, the dice on the ground suddenly appears in your palm. When it stops rolling, the four is on top.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2><size=44>Ta ta ta tum! Let's pass a trial first.</color></size>

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2>To your northwest is the High Watch that blocks the chilly winds. To your southwest is Sky Land where the ancestors first landed. Judging from that, you're now around the Celestial Well!</color>

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2>As for your goal... Well, of course, it's no other than <color=#fb9259>saving the world</color>! Didn't you pay attention to the opening scene? The world is in peril, and only you, <color=#fb9259>the Chosen One</color>, can salvage it!</color>

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: <color=#7683a2>Now... Let the Chosen One's grand adventure begin! Which <color=#fb9259>ally<color=#7683a2> will you meet first...<color=#7683a2>
The girl has just finished her cheesy line when a small ice storm formed not far from you. The storm sweeps up icicles and rocks, blasting in your direction furiously.
The storm gains powerful velocity in mere seconds. Several shattered icy rocks dart at you at a speed inestimable by the bare eye.
This must be the Game Master's warm welcome for you. If you guess right, what comes next should be...
Get out of here!
A shadow emerges from the storm. With a white flash, the icy rocks flying at you are crushed in the blink of an eye.
The shadow halts. A pink-haired swordswoman appears before you, her whole body covered in ice and frost, melting in the hot steam.
The game can't go on if you die. She must be the NPC whose job is to save your life... The Chosen One's ally?
Seeing your stunned face, the swordswoman hammered your head once with the hilt of her sword.

speaker: Swordswoman
content: This is no wandering ground for a novice adventurer like you.
Your head hurts quite a bit. She's your savior in the first chapter of the game. Perhaps she's mad because you didn't say thank you...

speaker: Swordswoman
content: What rotten luck...
As you think that, the dark-purple ice storm is already right next to you. The young swordswoman shakes her head and knocks you down with the hilt.
The whole world blurs. It's the familiar dizziness again... If the first hit was for your impoliteness, then what was the second one for?!
(Scene change)
When you awake, you smell a hint of roast meat aroma. The swordswoman squats not far from you, staring at you intently.
Though you already know she means no harm, you somehow get the feeling that the Game Master is secretly enjoying that part of the plot where you got knocked out.

speaker: Choice
options: Why did you knock me out?

speaker: Swordswoman
content: Well... The situation called for it.
An awkward smile emerging on her face, the girl clarifies it to you urgently. You've only blacked out for a while, but her attitude seems to have taken a 180.

speaker: Swordswoman
content: We had to leave immediately, and I noticed that you were lost in thought. So... I... piggybacked you out of there. Oh, by the way, my name is Tetya, and I am honored to serve you, <color=#fb9259>the Chosen One</color>.
The Chosen One again... Is this some kinda trope in this world?

speaker: Choice
options: What does the Chosen One actually mean?

content: The swordswoman opened her rucksack and passed the white dice inside to you reverently.

speaker: Tetya
content: Here. This thing you were carrying, this is the <color=#fb9259>Fate Dice</color> in the legends.

speaker: Tetya
content: "When the Chosen One descends from outside the sky, the Fate Dice will guide the world to its redemption."
The swordswoman stares at you intently with almost religious anticipation and reverence.

speaker: Tetya
content: My lord, from now on, I'll protect you and follow you until the world finds salvation.
Watching the NPC's sincere face and the snow-covered wreckage left by the disaster behind her, you can't help but lapse into silence.

Dragonberg's top hall is shrouded by a mysterious energy. An enormous, intricate mechanical clock floats in the air, while the maniac who's rumored to have let the Ice Plague into the Isle of Sky stands right before it.
Darkness veils Cyrus's face. A huge two-headed beast crouches beside him, guarding him like a loyal pet dog. This appears to be the Dragon of Calamity the castellan has told you about.

speaker: Tetya
content: Cyrus, hand over the <color=#fb9259>power source</color> that controls the Ice Plague!
The maniac's cold, hysterical gaze passes over the crew. He seems well-adapted to this kind of scenario.

speaker: Cyrus
content: You're a fraud who claims to be the Chosen One. Do you intend to challenge the marvelous Cyrus?
The man waves his hand, and the two-headed dragon who's half machinery and half flesh follows his gesture and soars into the sky, casting an enormous shadow over you all.

speaker: Cyrus
content: Weaklings, tremble under the power of the Dragon of Genesis!
The mechanical dragon lies paralyzed on the floor, thick steam leaking out of the various machine parts all over its body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hand over the power source, Cyrus. You've lost.
Held at sword point by Tetya, Cyrus is unable to fight, and you've wrecked all his creations. It seems that you're about to complete the first step of saving the world.

speaker: Cyrus
content: <size=44>Impossible! Impossible! You runts! Weaklings! You think you can stop me?!</size>
His face twisted, Cyrus yells hysterically, just like the useless, raging villain he is. Suddenly, you hear a sarcastic chuckle.
With that chuckle, Tetya takes a step forward and aims the tip of her sword at Cyrus.

speaker: Tetya
content: You've lost! Hand it over if you want a chance to live!
Cyrus looks up at the sky as if watching something. When he lowers his head, you find that his expression has become even more insane.
(Transition)

speaker: Cyrus
content: You don't understand! <color=#fb9259>The Dragon of Genesis</color> no longer exists!

speaker: Cyrus
content: I'm the new Dragon of Genesis! I'm the one who's been chosen to save the world!
The dark-blue power source emerges near Cyrus's chest. A loud mechanical rumbling starts behind him. The clock begins turning rapidly around the power source.
The legendary mechanical dragon who brings about the calamities is only a ploy Cyrus made up. The power source causing the Ice Plague has always been on him.

The clock flashes an ominous red light. Under its influence, everything around you seems to slow down, and a heavy pressure forms in the air. Tetya looks terrified, the sword in her hand inching forward carefully.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2><size=44>Stop, stop, stop!</color></size>
The berserk Cyrus is suddenly frozen. The self-destruction he's about to launch is put on pause with everything in this world.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>It's all your fault! You've broken it!</color>
A cold finger emerges out of nowhere and taps your forehead. You feel your body changing rapidly, a black coat appearing on you.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>Those who fail the challenge will become <color=#fb9259>NPCs</color>. Though you broke Cyrus, I'm quite satisfied with your performance as a noob. I'll reward you by making you the next <color=#fb9259>Cyrus</color>!</color>

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>Aren't you happy about that?</color>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's... cheating...
The particles forming your body tremble ceaselessly. Arduously, you protest.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>That's not cheating. It's just how the world works. It happened to the guy in front of you as well!</color>
If you fail the game, you'll get turned into an NPC by the Game Master. Cyrus hasn't always been this fraudulent, soulless villain. He was once a <color=#fb9259>player</color> too.

speaker: Cyrus
content: It's me... I'm the new Dragon of Genesis... I'm supposed to be the Chosen One to save the world!

He has been designed to be the avatar of the Ice Plague and the Evil Dragon who brings the Calamity. But deep down, he still wants to save the world, he wants to clear the game that he could never clear again.
Still frozen, Cyrus vanishes bit by bit before your eyes while you turn into him. The bitterness, the anger, and the sad cries... You seem to be able to hear his thoughts now that you've transformed.

speaker: Tetya
content: No... No way!
In the still world, you heard a crackling, shattering sound, like an iceberg crumbling slowly into the sea.
The blade pierces into the void in front of you, hitting that invisible figure manipulating your transformation.
It's Tetya. She's defied her creator, although she doesn't quite know what she's attacking, or what consequence will follow.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>Ohh my, I'm only scaring him a little. Don't get so worked up!</color>
female_content: <color=#7683a2>Ohh my, I'm only scaring her a little. Don't get so worked up!</color>

content: Somehow, you sense that the invisible gaze is fixating at Tetya. Her voice didn't give away any anger of being betrayed by an NPC, but Tetya's body is disintegrating little by little.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>Hmm... That's a good twist, fits her character too. I've gotta note it down and make it a playable route in Tetya's storyline.</color>

Attacking the Game Master has resulted in retaliation by the rules. Tetya's body is trembling in the dark, but she doesn't seem to hear the Game Master's voice, and neither is she aware that her body is vanishing. She only stares at you intently.

speaker: Tetya
content:
Promise...
Till... the world is saved...
Transition, long black screen
You're in the pitch-black void.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>Alright, the next adventure begins now. Let's set off again!</color>
The cold finger taps your forehead, and you once again return to the game world.
You're momentarily lost on the boundless ice field. Afar, a just-formed ice storm is swarming toward you like in the last round, even faster and more intensely this time.
The name almost escapes your lips as you realize the reassuring presence of the swordswoman is already gone. Has she disappeared from this world for good?
The brilliant flash of the sword has long dimmed. Only the screeching cold wind accompanies you now. Watching your warm breaths turn white in the air, you can't help but shiver again.
How annoying.
Tetya's gone. You don't just stand around and wait like last time, but start running along the track you remember.
You could have just thought of this as a game, but...
The Game Master's snicker creeps into your mind.
(Transition)

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>Those who fail the challenge will become <color=#fb9259>NPCs</color>. Though you broke Cyrus, I'm quite satisfied with your performance as a noob. I'll reward you by making you the next <color=#fb9259>Cyrus</color>!</color>

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>Aren't you happy about that?</color>
Clearly, Cyrus isn't the answer to the world's salvation. He's only a villain played by a player. Your true opponent is the Dragon of Genesis who manipulates the fate of everything.
...Who's also the <color=#fb9259>Game Master</color> of this game.
Yes, you want to clear this game and teach this arrogant Game Master a lesson.
Clack!
You hear a loud, crisp noise. It sounds like something breaking. You whip your head around immediately.
Bang—
The still ice field begins quaking all of a sudden. Since you've dodged the ice storm, the Game Master now wants to take it a notch up and triggers a whole avalanche.
Shoving away the distracting thoughts, you start dashing at full speed. But this is nothing but useless resistance to the furious waves of silvery white snow.
The second before getting devoured by the snow, you remember that NPC who risked her life to save you. Indeed, she doesn't show up this time.
(Transition)

speaker: Tetya
content:
Promise...
Till... the world is saved...
(Scene change)
Oh my, how embarrassing...
Look at you... I've gotta dig you out...
And they say you're the Chosen One...?
All I see is just... <size=44>a giant carrot</size>... buried in the snow...
The bandit you've met once before is brushing snow off you. She pulls you out of the pile of snow.

speaker: Female Bandit
content: Hey, are you awake now, Chosen One?
She paces around you, occasionally running her hands all over you.

speaker: Female Bandit
content: Limp muscles, strengthless limbs, weak pulses... You plan to save the world with a body like that? I thought you were gonna launch an ultimate in the avalanche or something, turns out you're just a giant carrot that needs my rescue.

speaker: Female Bandit
content: Haha, got a sense of humor? How about this... You wanna come with me? Erwin's assigned me to help you.
Is she your ally in <color=#fb9259>this round</color>? You nod and let her guide you to the distant destination.
You rush to Wing City. Just as you've seen on the way, the Ice Plague has crossed the Forbidden Wall and is threatening the east.

The city gate was bustling in the last round. But now, Wing City's gate is completely frozen. Even the city's entire west side suffers the same fate. In between the two sides, a smaller version of the Forbidden Wall is being constructed.
You see Hella in a glamorous outfit tweaking machine parts. She seems highly concentrated and serious, like a real castellan.
A familiar figure follows Hella around. It's Tetya. Due to the sudden threat of the Ice Plague, the young swordswoman has sheathed her sword and is working together with Wing City's people.
Good. She didn't really die.
You draw in a deep breath and look at your allies in this round.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What can we do?

speaker: Tierney
content: Give them the <color=#fb9259>Dragonstones</color> we've stolen. Hold out for as long as possible.

speaker: Erwin
content: With the current severity of the Ice Plague, 100,000 Dragonstones can only last us 36 hours.

speaker: Tierney
content: I know, but it's better than nothing.

speaker: Erwin
content: We should go to <color=#fb9259>Cyrus</color> of Dragonberg. The worsening of the Ice Plague must have something to do with him.
Erwin neglects the Chosen One's influence on the Ice Plague. This means Cyrus must have done something... Or, he's simply trying to guide you to the right path of the storyline.
<size=40>Ignorant Dragon's Children, the great Dragon of Genesis has descended!</color>
<size=40>Sacrifice your blood and become one with the marvelous Cyrus!</color>
With the thunderous mechanical rumbling, the dark shadow looms in the sky over Wing City. Cyrus has come directly to Wing City in this round.
The monster attacks the city. Hmm, the Game Master sure likes clichés. If she didn't manipulate the plot, why would Cyrus strike Wing City at this juncture?
What's the thing that was absent in Wing City before, but is present now?

Wing City seems well prepared for the massive flying beast's ambush. Mechanical cannons are stationed on the east side and troops of Wing City soldiers rise into the sky with the help of flying robots.

speaker: Tierney
content: Let's show them what we've got, Chosen One!
Tierney calls out to you heroically, but amid the dragon's roars and the wailing wind, you seem to hear something else.

speaker: Tierney
content: This big guy has more parts than all the Dragonstones we've hoarded. Strip it down and sell them, and we'll never have to work a day for the rest of our lives!
The mechanical dragon falls from the sky. Cyrus standing on its head tumbles clumsily outside the city's wall, now a mere tiny black dot on the ground.
The intimidating final boss in the last round seems like a mob now. Before he even gets a chance to launch a self-destruction, he's dropped to the ground idiotically.
Watching Cyrus gasp for his last breaths, you finally get a chance to question him.

speaker: Choice
options: Where's the real Dragon of Genesis?

speaker: Cyrus
content: Hahahaha!
As if he's just heard the funniest joke of the century, Cyrus cackles uncontrollably.

speaker: Cyrus
content: Dragon of Genesis? Dragon of Genesis! Look at you, you want to find it? In your dreams!
Even when defeated, Cyrus becomes animated when he talks about the Dragon of Genesis.

speaker: Tierney
content: Is something wrong in his head? Let's move on, it may screw up your brain if you talk to him for too long.
Nodding along on the side, Erwin points to the power source on Cyrus's chest and explains to you.

speaker: Erwin
content: We only need this fragment with the power of the Dragon of Genesis stored inside. Don't mind this pathetic pawn of fate.
You want to ask him something else, but the fighters who fought in the battle are gathering around you. Cheers echo through the entire city, as if you're the savior of this world.
Something feels off. Victory came too easily. The mechanical dragon's power seemed a lot weaker than before too.
The two turn their gazes at you, as if waiting for your decision.

speaker: Choice
options: Hold on for a bit longer.

speaker: Etti
content: <color=#7683a2>Tick, tock, tick, tock. You can keep waiting, but they can't wait any longer.</color>
Once the joy of victory passes, Wing City resumes its construction of the small Forbidden Wall. No one outside your crew knows that this wall can only hold up for 36 hours.
Very soon, under the castellan's order, the soldiers remove from Cyrus the power source supporting the mechanical dragon and bring it to you.

speaker: Erwin
content: The Dragon of Genesis is located... on the land where everything is frozen by ice and snow.
Sensing the power source's fluctuations, Erwin looks below the Isle of Sky.

speaker: Tierney
content: Finally, we get a chance to pilot a skyraft! I hope you're not prone to motion sickness, Chosen One?
Tierney looks at you with a smile, producing several pills from her clothes.

speaker: Tierney
content: Just a heads up, if you start feeling seasick, let me know, okay? I tend to drive pretty fast.
The skyraft consumes all the remaining Dragonstones at last. The crew has no choice but to get off and continue moving toward the target with the Prism Light's aid.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've been wondering, why do you all dress so lightly? Shouldn't you wear protective clothing?
You've had this question in your mind since early on, but you only ask it now to ease the somewhat heavy mood among the crew.

speaker: Tierney
content: You think I get cold this easily? Remember who dug you out of the avalanche?
Tierney shifts out of the Prism Light's protection and grabs the ice flakes flying in the sky. Even the extreme cold doesn't slow her down.
The ice flakes gather in her hands to form an icicle so deep blue it's almost inky. Tierney gestures to you with it.

speaker: Tierney
content: Can... you... feel... it?
Her voice sounds dragged, the drawl streaming into your ears slowly. Then, she throws the dark-blue icicle outside unhurriedly.
You feel slightly helpless, but you can't stop Tierney.

speaker: Tierney
content: Have you been to Welkin City? It was the largest city on the Isle of Sky. That's where you found the newest inventions and the most exciting stuff.
You shake your head, unsure why Tierney suddenly brings up the ruins of Welkin City. Staring at the Blessing Sun, she seems to lapse into a certain memory.

speaker: Tierney
content: Everything from children's toys to armor used for mining minerals, you could find the best models in Welkin City. They even had a plan to raise Welkin City right under the Blessing Sun so that it could be rid of the Ice Plague's threat forever.

speaker: Tierney
content: But it was all ruined when the Ice Plague suddenly struck the city.

speaker: Tierney
content: <size=32>The machines and buildings were frozen. So were the people. Some survived with the power in their blood as the Dragon's Children, but that's the most unfortunate ending. If frozen by the Ice Plague, their minds and actions became a thousand time slower.</size>

speaker: Choice
options: Is that worse than being buried under snow?

speaker: Tierney
content: Ha! How are the two things comparable?
Tierney rolls her eyes and continues seriously.

speaker: Tierney
content: To those people, their lives were forever frozen on the day of the disaster. "It's finally here." "Run." "What just happened?"

speaker: Tierney
content: They may have only reached the end of these thoughts today.
Tierney looks around in the darkness. Somehow, you can hear a low whimper in the howling snow.

speaker: Tierney
content: Listen. The ancestors' blood was even stronger. They say these calls from the abyss are the ancestors' greetings to those who risk coming down to the earth, like us.

speaker: Tierney
content: What are they saying? Are they warning us to leave or crying out for help?

speaker: Choice
options: Telling you to hurry up with the journey.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I were your ancestor, I would tell you to hurry up with the journey and find the Dragon of Genesis instead of wasting your precious energy on spooky tales.

speaker: Tierney
content: Tsk, you just ruined the mood...
(Scene change)
The long journey continues.
The Prism Light flickers, interrupted continuously by the ever-present dark-blue chill. Now you understand that this is no simple snow, but some kind of fatal, special magical power.
The two of you trudge on arduously in the snow. Tierney's breaths become very shallow, something you can tell easily now that her words are also scarce.
On the other hand, the power of your shackles becomes more active in this kind of environment, so you're able to persevere for a bit longer.

speaker: Choice
options: We're not gonna find it if we keep on like this.

speaker: Tierney
content: Shut... Shut your big mouth... Turn up the light, I can't ******* see the way ahead.

speaker: Choice
options: This is already the maximum brightness.

speaker: Tierney
content: Stop... lying...
Tierney reached out a hand, likely to snatch the Prism Light from your hand. But she staggered and fell.
You run over to grab her hand, trying to pull her up.
She's clearly out of strength, yet she still forces herself to go on to guide the way for you.

speaker: Tierney
content: Don't... do that. Don't... waste your power. You've got... more important things to do.
Tierney's hands seem long frozen that she can't even make a small gesture with them. Throughout the journey in this round, you've never seen Tierney this affected by the Ice Plague.
The long darkness seems to have no end. The shackles' power is becoming more active.

A crack appears on the Prism Light's surface, and the white light leaves its constraints like a dancing fairy. The utterly intensified Ice Plague power invades your muscles, bones, and blood, reaching your hearts.

Perhaps with the shackles, you can temporarily stop the Ice Plague from corroding Tierney further, but when you think of the Game Master's sudden intrusion in the last round, you struggle to make a prompt decision.

If Tierney was a puppet or avatar of that Sinner, then perhaps the shackles could reach her through this connection. But if like you, Tierney was only a previous player, then the shackles' effect on her would be hard to foresee.

This is only a test. If you choose wrong this time, you can choose again next time. Isn't this how a game works? You can keep on saving and loading, until you find the only correct solution. Tetya is still alive too, isn't she?

speaker: Tierney
content: Chosen One, it looks like I can't go on further with you... If you can keep going, don't give up.
Her body is already corroded by the snow, her voice slowing down and dragging out. If you have to make a choice, now is your final chance.
You reach out a hand and extend the shackles' power to the core of her heart.

speaker: Tierney
content: Yes... This is my fate... Our fate.
A dark-blue liquid oozing out of her eyes, she's completely corroded by the Ice Plague. The shackles can't stop the Ice Plague from corroding her, but instead provokes that power further.
She's going to die in this round.
[Scene Change]
The dying spirit shrouds your entire world like a thick black mist. Your consciousness staggers on in the mist and finally ends up in an unfamiliar room.
An old fireplace. Stacks of books. A box of tidily organized dice. There's also a sandbox made of paper at the center of the table. You seem to have seen this place.
You reach out to touch the dice on the table tentatively but get pushed away by a mysterious force.
<size=44>Ah!</size>
Startled, you turn to look for the owner of the voice and find her behind the pile of books and sheets.

speaker: Little Girl
content: Let's have one of these, then add one of those. Hahaha, this design is just too fun! Nothing tops this!
A young and small figure squats among a pile of thick rulebooks. She's reading a book while doodling on cardboard, so immersed in her own world that she doesn't notice your presence.
But as she talks, the little girl's voice suddenly dwindles. Staring at the dim light bulb above her head, she mumbles to herself.

speaker: Little Girl
content: When's Grandpa coming back? He promised to play DisChess with me last time. Now even the fifth extension pack is out.
She glimpses at the paper box on the side and draws a small mark on it.

speaker: Little Girl
content: The tenth extension pack. The letter says when the tenth extension pack comes out, he'll be back. Hehe, he'll know nothing by then, I can destroy him in seconds.

speaker: Little Girl
content: Of course, I won't forget about the Isles of Aesthia!
The little girl turns to the sandbox on the table and cackles.

speaker: Little Girl
content: Hehe, rest assured! You'll all appear in Aesthia! Every single one of you!
The girl gently touches the figurines and buildings made out of cardboard and a fine dragon made of metal.

speaker: Choice
options: Is she the creator of this world?

content: An answer emerges in your heart.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But... a kid so young, how can she...

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>How can she? I think you underestimate her.</color>
You hear the Game Master's voice genuinely this time. Not in your heart, but from behind you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you cheating again?
You turn and finally see her in person for the first time.

speaker: Game Master
content: Oh? But this time... It looks like you're the one cheating instead...

speaker: Game Master
content: Anyway, it doesn't matter. If you can make it here, it means you're different from those other boring players.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What is this place?

speaker: Game Master
content: Is that a question for me? Hehe, take a guess. If you get it right, I'll give you a reward of the hidden route.
She's indeed very childish.

speaker: Choice
options: This is where the world is born.

content: You look at the sandbox in the little girl's hands, watching it change bit by bit. The islands are pieced together. Blue and white paper bits are sprinkled over the sandbox like icing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cyrus is just a ploy. You're the ultimate villain in this game, the legendary Dragon of Genesis.

speaker: Game Master
content: You guessed it right, but you also guessed it wrong. In this case, I can only let you take a glimpse of the reward.
She throws out a dark-purple dice. This space made up of memories begins to blur and vanish as the dice spins...
Transition, cut to CG

speaker: Game Master
content: Alright, be it a success or failure, my dear Chosen One, the final game begins now!
The girl's hand reaches down from the sky. You see the whole world rearrange under her touch.
Every rock and every person in this world goes back to their original state under her fingers, except for the dark-blue snow. It covers even more areas now.
This is the final round of the game. You don't have much time left to clear it.

<size=32>Indeed, the Dragon of Genesis has never appeared in this world, but everyone you've met during your journey has been the Dragon of Genesis. It's the power the Game Master uses to run this world, connecting to every place and turning every cog.</size>
And now, the power has lost its balance, so the ice and snow begin plaguing the continent. Whether it's for waking up the real Dragon of Genesis or for killing her...
You need to gather those crucial power fragments and gain enough power to fight against her, something in that room...
The icy, chilly wind blows in your face. You stand in a square where the cold wind almost freezes you, the white dice chafing your hand like an ice cube.

The city is entirely covered in ice. All the NPCs you know and don't know have turned into ice sculptures. An even bigger storm is approaching from afar. You recognize the city gate. You're in Wing City.
Each time the Chosen One reincarnates, the world is pushed closer toward its doom. But this time, you're not only the Chosen One. You're a gambler who challenges fate.

speaker: Tetya
content: This way! There's someone alive!
As written in the script, you see those three familiar figures. The two tall ones run in two other directions while Erwin walks toward you with the broken Prism Light.

speaker: Erwin
content: The Forbidden Wall has been breached. The residents must keep retreating...
The two of you are close enough for you to see that tiny bits of ice have already grown on the side of his face.

speaker: Erwin
content: We have 24 hours left until the ice storm sweeps across the entire Isle of Sky... Please retreat as far as possible.
You see Tetya wielding her sword at the completely solidified storm, Hella raising her scepter on the frozen Forbidden Wall, and Tierney piercing her icicle-like longsword into the sky.
As for Erwin, the Prism Light in his hand only flickers occasionally, barely maintaining the protective barrier.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You guys are not leaving?

speaker: Erwin
content: ...Even if the apocalypse is inevitable, we should do our best. Not to mention...

speaker: Erwin
content: The Chosen One hasn't given up either. We must not flee our own battlefield.
The white dice in your hand is warming up. This is an item from Etti, a legacy of the Dragon of Genesis.

The room you saw in that vision told you the truth about this world. If it's really just the projection of the little girl's imagination, then that reward she revealed must exist in this sandbox too, in a place you're very familiar with.
You turn down Erwin's help politely. You know where to go. Your battlefield awaits you.
24 hours, that's your wager. In the final game, you win or you lose, there's no second chance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Sigh. Who knows I'll be saving the world in a game too.

speaker: Cyrus
content: Who's here to challenge the marvelous Cyrus?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Player Cyrus has already been kicked out... You're just a regular NPC now.

speaker: Cyrus
content: Watch your tongue! Chosen One, do you intend to challenge the marvelous Cyrus?
Cyrus ignores your metagaming remark and goes on spouting the same nonsense in the script. Still the same maniacal, arrogant, lofty clichés of a stereotypical final boss.
Why must they make the final boss the villain?
The hero wants to save the world with his power. The final boss wants to rule the world with his power. The two ideas are not fundamentally contradictory.
The more stereotypical the plot, the easier it is to deconstruct and twist it. It just so happens that you're excellent at spotting the loopholes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Challenge? Of course not. I'm here to help you, Cyrus.
You take out a white dice from the pocket and gently place it on your palm.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is the Chosen One's token. It carries a great deal of the Dragon of Genesis' power. Outside the curtain of the world, the Game Master decides all our actions with this dice.
Cyrus stares at you in confusion, his previous pretentiousness suddenly all gone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A final boss unchallenged by the hero is worthless. Even though it's your goal to become the Dragon of Genesis, you can't just waste your time in this castle until doomsday.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But don't worry, open your mind a little. Who says there is only one dice representing fate and only one the Chosen One?
You gently turn the dice in your hand, but somehow feel obstructed by some invisible force.
Cyrus stares at the white dice and produces the power source from his chest hesitantly.
The shell unfolds to reveal a similar twenty-sided dark-purple dice inside.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who says a boss must be a villain? As long as one has the power to change the world, one can become the protagonist of the story.

speaker: Cyrus
content: The protagonist?
The invisible strings binding the dice loosen. You apply more strength with your hand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The protagonist is the winner who beats all the challenges. We both have a piece of the Dragon of Genesis' power fragments. Why fight when we can team up? I'll give you the white one, but you'll come with me. Let's resurrect the Dragon of Genesis.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: After all, we have the same final goal in this game. To clear it.

speaker: Cyrus
content: ...To clear it? ...To clear it. Right, I must clear the game!
Suddenly, you hear a tearing sound from the void. The strings have been broken.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's challenge fate! Cyrus, welcome to the player's team.
The dice spin. With a white flash, the dark-purple and white dice fall to the ground quietly.
<color=#fb9259>Critical Success</color>. It looks like even the Game Master can't dispute this.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2><size=44>You! You're cheating!</color></size>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Does the rulebook forbid the hero from teaming up with the final boss? It's an unconventional approach, indeed. But with only 24 hours left, we're in hell mode, gotta take a few shortcuts, okay?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's go. Time to rewrite the script.
It's two hours before complete corrosion by the Ice Plague. You finally arrive at the place where the Dragon of Genesis' power is hidden.
Relentless blizzards cover the sky like flying white sand, ready to engulf the entire world.

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>In the core of the chill, amid the howling wind, an enormous figure crouches. A rumbling rises and falls slowly like low breaths.</color>

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>The figure in the gap of the storm is blurry and tremulous. At any second, it may be devoured, it may leave again and never come back.</color>

speaker: Game Master
content: <color=#7683a2>You know that's the long-missing Dragon of Genesis. The Chosen One has gathered all the legacies. According to the rules written by the Creator God, you're qualified to stand before it and decide the fate of this world.</color>
You hear the familiar voice in your heart again, but it also sounds like it comes from ahead. Taking two steps in the snowstorm, you find the girl you've met once before by the dragon's claws.
The troublemaker Sinner. The Game Master who created this game. She stares up blankly at the huge dragon, slowly raising a hand to stroke its massive but contorting body.

speaker: Game Master
content: It's been a while... I forgot... what you looked like...

speaker: Choice
options: That's not the only thing you forgot, Etti.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The power you use for your creations is the extremely dangerous Mania power. Overusing it will only wear out your mind.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your mind is already in peril, and the world you've created will soon be annihilated too. The people trapped here by you...

speaker: Etti
content: Are you fearing death?

speaker: Etti
content: Don't worry, when I finally break down, you'll all be automatically kicked out. You had a chance to experience such an amazing game, make sure you leave a good review and recommend it to all your friends.

speaker: Etti
content: Oops... You've distracted me. No one talks like that in the game.
Etti rises slowly, flying toward the top of the dragon's head. She turns to peer down at you. An invisible barrier expands and spreads to block out the storm, marking out a clear stage around you.

speaker: Etti
content: ...No one has ever intruded into the very root of Aesthia. No one has ever... dared disturb the Dragon of Genesis' rest.

speaker: Etti
content: Who are you? Who dares challenge the truth of this world? Who gave you the courage?!
You feel a weight around your waist. A weapon has appeared aptly. Etti gazes down at you pompously. She looks slightly clumsy blocking the snow, but the anticipation in her eyes is barely concealed.
This is the end of the game. She is truly looking forward to the ending you're going to write.
You adopt a pose and slowly draw the sword on your waist, piercing the chilly air to point it at the dragon and the girl on top of it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm the Chosen One who holds the Fate Dice! My friends have cleared the way for me and lent me the courage to face you here!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You wrote the start of this world, and now I'm taking its ending!
She snorts loudly.

speaker: Etti
content: Hmph! Very well! Come on then! Let's see how you'll decide!

speaker: Etti
content: Will you pray to the Dragon of Genesis to end the Ice Plague and bring redemption? Or will you raise your blade, slice through the root, and let destruction descend?
Then, she spreads her arms as the dragon spreads its wings, facing you, the minuscule challenger.
The Dragon of Genesis' power fuses into her frail body, waking the dragon blood inside. The scattered ice and snow gather around her to forge a tough dragon armor.
As she transforms into the Dragon of Delusion and becomes enveloped by the ice armor, you see it clearly...
Etti can't help but beam with a brilliant smile.
With a wail of the Dragon of Genesis, the barrier blocking the snowstorm shatters and white blizzards sweep near again.

speaker: Etti
content: Ah... He cleared it...
female_content: Ah... She cleared it...

speaker: Etti
content: The difficulty level hasn't been lowered, has it? Perhaps it was mere luck with the dice and a Critical Success was rolled. Sigh, I waited so long for someone to come, I was having so much fun...

speaker: Etti
content: Well, it's not like I can change the rules now...
Whiteness gradually drowns Etti. She watches the world get overthrown.

speaker: Etti
content: ...The Chosen One defeats the Dragon of Genesis... and goes home... with all the adventurers from Otherworld.

speaker: Etti
content: They'll remember the adventures in Aesthia, remember this journey... remember...
Her vision slowly whitens.
Transition, white flash
Etti, you don't like going out to play? Then... I'll take you on an adventure somewhere else...

speaker: Etti
content: ...Who's that?
She's back to that fireplace that feels both strange and familiar, flames flickering within. In front of a small, sketchy sandbox, two shadows shake slightly. She hears the voices.
Long, long ago... There was a huge ocean on which countless islands floated...

speaker: Etti
content: Islands?
Islands... Hmm, remember your favorite biscuit? A round biscuit floating on milk is like the land beneath us. When you break it up into many pieces, those become islands.

speaker: Etti
content: I get it! Islands are broken biscuits!
Yes... Hahaha!

speaker: Etti
content: Can islands fly? Can they?
Huh? Umm... Yes, let's make them fly. This was a world created by a soaring dragon, so it didn't float on the sea but among the clouds.
There were dragons and magic on the islands... And Etti's favorite glittering weapons. Right there, on the islands...

speaker: Etti
content: These are all the things you can't find in DisCity!
Yes, you can't find them in DisCity. You want to go there?

speaker: Etti
content: Yes! Tell me more!

speaker: Etti
content: Wow! What's next?

speaker: Etti
content: Oh gosh, I want more! More adventures please, Grandpa!
Let's continue tomorrow... Grandpa is old, so I must go to bed early. We'll go on with our adventures when we wake up, alright?
(Transition)

speaker: Etti
content: Grandpa, Grandpa! I went on an adventure on my own! That river in the west, I snuck into it and got really close. I saw the monsters!

speaker: Etti
content: But that place is scary, it's different from the adventures you told me about... I prefer Aesthia...

speaker: Etti
content: Let's go back to Aesthia! Take me to Storm City, to the Skyport, and to the Fluffball we didn't defeat last time! Our adventure is not over yet, wake up, Grandpa!

speaker: Etti
content: ...Grandpa?
(Transition)
The fireplace goes out. The girl sits alone in the pitch-dark room.

speaker: Etti
content: ...The Dragon of Genesis is gone, but... the adventures in Aesthia are not over yet...
She catches the rulebook falling off the old man's hand and clutches it to her chest, sitting down before the sandbox. After that, time flies.

speaker: Etti
content: The Isles of Aesthia form a new continent, floating high in the sky.

speaker: Etti
content: The world created by the Dragon of Genesis will not disappear. It still has to... welcome even more adventurers.
The small sandbox begins stirring, a tiny yet magnificent port emerging in it. Next, Storm City, and the Fluffball...

Referring to her memories, she recreates the magnificent world she's heard about, in this small room, in this tiny square sandbox. Month after month, year after year, she pours all her energy into capturing every detail narrated by him.
(Transition)

speaker: Etti
content: The port, Storm City, the Fluffball... What else did he talk about...

speaker: Etti
content: Who... is he?
It's snowing in Aesthia.
The snow covers the whole world gradually, but Etti is not buried in it. An enormous wing shields her from the snowstorm, despite being wounded and scarred itself.

speaker: Etti
content: ...Dragon of Genesis?

speaker: Etti
content: I'm sorry, I... still can't remember what you looked like.
She suddenly laughs.

speaker: Etti
content: But I did create Aesthia, and others come here for adventures now. Do you see that?

speaker: Etti
content: He must have had a lot of fun, just like I once did.
female_content: She must have had a lot of fun, just like I once did.

speaker: Etti
content: That makes you happy too, right?

speaker: Choice
options: Yes, I had a lot of fun.
Fun? You gave me so much trouble.

content: Hearing the unexpected voice, Etti only realizes now that someone else is standing outside the curtain.

speaker: Etti
content: ...It's you? I thought you left? According to the rules...

speaker: Choice
options: Didn't you say that this is the freest game?

content: (Scene change)

You haven't left this world. You're seeing Etti after she's inherited the Dragon of Genesis' power. This is the last legacy, the last Memory Fragment. You'll receive the real power that created this world.

Light spills out in all directions. The Dragon of Genesis' power peels away from the Dragon of Delusion, flowing into the sun in the sky. The girl floats in the air. This world's constraints on you have been lifted.
But somehow the shackles' mark has suddenly appeared on her. Following the mark, you come behind the curtain.
(Transition)

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mania will not corrupt you further. I know where you are... We'll go look for you soon, the real you.

speaker: Etti
content: ...Alright, come and find me then.

speaker: Etti
content: Let's go on adventures together. Play a more interesting game with me. I'll create an even better world while I wait for you.

speaker: Etti
content: Don't keep me waiting though... I'll feel... very lonely...
[Transition and fade out]
Lonely, huh?

<size=32>You recall the last scene you saw. The dragon beside her fades and turns into a swordswoman, a female bandit, a mechanic, and faces you have and haven't seen in the game. At last, it turns into an old man in modern clothing you've never met before.</size>
That ray of light born from the heart of the Dragon of Genesis has in fact always protected everyone in this world, including this cold, lonely little dragon.
Artificial sunlight filters through the window onto your desk, forming several luminous paths. In the outside world, spring is already here...
The adventure in Dragon & Isle of Sky has come to an end. There are no new players in Etti's world at the moment.
Apparently, in the third edition, the Ice Plague in Aesthia has become a harmless force.
On the thawed earth, Tetya eventually becomes a regular messenger.
Tierney goes to learn the violin and becomes a renowned bard in the entire Aesthia.
Things don't go as well for Erwin. He's been sent to a children's school, though he does way better than the other students.
Oh, about Cyrus. He seems to be in symbiosis with his creation and has turned into a "two-headed" dragon with only one head.
As for the other Cyrus, he still hasn't gotten over that failed game. "What kind of game is this? I'm sure I had the correct guide!"
In the Bureau, the Sinners haven't left the Recreation Room for days. "I'm the castellan! I'm the castellan! You all must listen to me!"
On a street in Eastside, a certain Sinner peeks at this peculiar board game shop through his glasses. "...Why does it feel so familiar?"
Etti in the shop is jolly. She's just spent several days developing a new racing board game. "DisChess' tenth extension pack shall be designed by me!"
This is the end of the observation record of this event. In the dark, a clear paper-tearing noise can be heard.

<color=#fb9259>Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]</color>: Yes, <color=#fb9259>"that"</color> must be it. The long-lost antagonist of that urban legend is back...
<size=40>...<color=#fb9259>The Mad Shears of the Foggy Night</color> is coming to hunt again...</size>
A maze of dark alleys... Tonight's prey is running, desperately trying to flee the rolling fog creeping up from behind, and the terrifying voice ringing out from within...
Snap... snap...

The sound of footsteps... no, the sound of snapping shears... echoes from the depths of the fog.



No matter where the prey flees, it follows like a shadow, snapping rhythmically as it closes in on the prey.
If at this moment, you dare to turn your head, and peek at the true face of that ghastly shadow...
The man being chased suddenly looks back, yet what can he see in the thick fog?

content: Interference noises keep crackling from the comms device in his hand. He can vaguely hear a woman calling for him, but he doesn't dare answer. Panting heavily, he remains on high alert.
female_content: Interference noises keep crackling from the comms device in her hand. She can vaguely hear a woman calling her, but she doesn't dare answer. Panting heavily, she remains on high alert.

content: The sound of snapping shears can still be heard. That "person" is still nearby. Can't stop, keep running! Hurry! Must escape from here.

How can it be seen? It's <color=#fb9259>Mad Shears</color>, after all.



No one knows who it is, what it is, why it attacks, or what strange powers it has.

Mad Shears has been unleashing attacks in Eastside for several years now. Even after being followed and tracked for so long, no clues were ever found.
...Then, why is it that no one can find clues about Mad Shears?
The fog is still all around, but suddenly, the heavy chimes of a clock tower echo through the misty depths, reaching that poor wretch's ears. He's almost at the edge of the fog. He's saved!
female_content: The fog is still all around, but suddenly, the heavy chimes of a clock tower echo through the misty depths, reaching that poor wretch's ears. She's almost at the edge of the fog. She's saved!

content: The runner takes a deep breath and tries to make a last sprint.
But it's too late.
Of course, it can't be found because...
The fog envelops the poor escapee. Something presses intimately against his back.
female_content: The fog envelops the poor escapee. Something presses intimately against her back.

content:
<size=38>Everyone <color=#fb9259>it</color> targets...</size>

<size=40>Everyone who targets <color=#fb9259>it</color>...</size>



Yes, myself included...
The man whips out a gun, but before he can aim it, the barrel gets sliced off.

content: <size=44>Our **** have all been cut out by <color=#fb9259>Mad Shears</color>...</size>
The hunter is within reach. Yet what the prey sees first is a long, cold blade swinging forth, accompanied by an icy, murderous grin...
... It's not time to surrender yet!

content: Chief!!!

The impact severely impairs your consciousness. Amidst the chaos, you're spurred on only by raw instinct. You struggle and try to crawl out of the fog and dark alley with all your might.
But all the strength in your body disappears alongside the shackles in your palms, and your vision gradually blurs.
Who is that...
You don't even have the strength to lift up your head. You can barely make out the voice of the person who came. All signals you pick up are immediately shattered by your collapsing consciousness.
...What... happened to you...
You open your mouth to say something, but forget what you're saying. As that person leans toward you...
Your last bit of consciousness gets swallowed up by the fog.
