█ File: Eastside Contamination Monitoring Log

*Entry I:

The M-value of DisCity began to fluctuate once more, and Mania incidents reappeared. To fight the contamination, the City Council passed a motion to activate rainmaking machines that produce blue rain.

While the city's M-value was brought under control, <color=#fb9259>strange fog</color> began to appear in various parts of the city.
All 26 cases of fog occurred at night, and each did not exceed three hours.

*Entry II:
 
The thick fog might be a side effect of blue rain purification, but it might also be from an unidentified Mania incident.
The FAC has dispatched an inspector to Sloane Street to investigate.
*Annex V — Incident Aftermath:

On the day of the investigation, Sloane Street was once again overtaken by dense fog. Rescue efforts failed and the mission was aborted.

<color=#fb9259>Contact was lost, and the inspector's whereabouts remain unknown.</color>
You're running in a dark alley, with no beginning and no end.
Amidst the heavy shadows, something ensnares you in your tracks, tearing open the dream...
A light, fuzzy blanket is draped over your body. It feels soft but unfamiliar, and the fabric exudes a reassuring fragrance.
You're lying on a soft bed. The light blanket falls to the floor from your movement.
The clean, gentle fragrance in the room reminds you of sunlit flowers and freshly baked bread... There's also a faint whiff of gel spray.
You're alone in the room, but it has clearly been tidied up by someone else.
You look in the mirror. You seem to have been tidied up, too. The clothes on your body are clean and dry, and they smell the same as the room.
As you turn around carefully, your fingers touch something—a comms device with a broken screen.
It flickers, then lights up meekly. The screen is stuck on a strange-looking website.
[DISMYTH] [Chat Room] [Mad Shears is here? The fog is spreading... the horrific urban legend might come true!!]
Hmm...
It's a strange chat room on a website you've never seen before. You have no recollection of the text there.
There's a note under a glass of water on the table next to the sofa.

"Morning.

I didn't wake you up before I left because of how late things dragged out last night. You should catch up on your sleep.

Though I didn't have time to make you breakfast, I left some bread and jam on the table for you to nibble on.

I'm going to work now. Rest well and wait for me to come home."
The note also smells familiar. Your memory wavers. You don't seem to remember anything, yet feel oddly at peace. You vaguely feel that there's nothing unusual about this situation.
Better eat and tidy up first before going out. Even if you are to investigate, you should start with this little house.
The chiming of clock bells echoes through the streets as you walk past the next alley.
Ding... Dong... The clock continues to chime. You pass by a few residents as you silently count the number of chimes.
One, two, three... nine, ten, eleven...
Twelve, thirteen...?
The chimes end abruptly on this odd number. At the same time, you hear a bloodcurdling scream from not far away.

speaker: Resident
content: Ahhh...?!!
A gust of cold, damp air brushes past you. It came from behind you, from the end of the alley.

speaker: Resident
content: W-what's that?
An ominous gray mist is spreading, with eerie strand-like creatures squirming from inside.
They wriggle and coil before finally standing upright one by one, transforming into strange monsters!
Roarrrr... Roarrrr...!!
They stretch out their "hands" and drag screaming passers-by into the mist. The next second, the thick fog engulfs the sky, and night falls upon the entire street.
Terror and mist soon envelops everything, catching everyone off guard. Only a few sources of light remain in the distance.
Someone falls. The monsters will not miss this chance.

speaker: Resident
content: Mad Shears?! St-stay, stay back!
However, the monsters are clearly stronger. The next second, the girl is dragged into the fog, leaving only the image of a terrified face imprinted on your retinas.
The next second, the girl is dragged into the fog, leaving only the image of a terrified face imprinted on your retinas.
As the girl gets dragged away, you catch a glimpse of what's wrapped around her body: long, dark and agile strands, brimming with eerie life.
...It was the shine of human hair.
Visibility doesn't exceed ten meters right now. The monsters are prowling in the thick fog, ready to devour their next victim.

speaker: %u
content: Ha... ha...
You stumble and fall into a dark, narrow alley, merging into its shadows.
The monsters in the alley don't attack you. Instead, they back away rather fearfully.
Upon seeing your movement, they back away a bit more in disgust. They appear to acting out of intelligence, but also out of instinct—for some unknown or forgotten reason, they're avoiding you.

options: Find a safe place to hide.

content: The monsters back away, allowing you to retreat further down the alley. The fog here is damp and cold, making the alley seem even more dark and sinister.
...However, this dark alley feels familiar to you.
Suddenly...
...Snap...
...Snap, snap...
The cold, familiar feeling spreads swiftly along your spine to the back of your head. The sound is coming from the depths of the fog, but also from the depths of your memory.
You've been here before. You fought someone here.
Alongside your headache, fragments of memory are stirring in your mind. The dark alley, the thick fog, the clock bells, and the incessant... snapping sounds?

speaker: Resident
content: Mad Shears?! St-stay, stay back!
Snap.
Memories overlap with reality as the snapping sound of shears edges closer.

There's a figure in the depths of the fog. Obscured by mist, its limbs appear slender and fragile. At the same time, that giant pair of shears is scraping against the wall, emitting hungry crunching sounds.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: I found...

speaker: Mad Shears
content: I found you!
Snip, snip, snip...
Snip, snip, snip...
The sound is hard on your heels like a bloodhound. You've been fumbling around in the dark, walled in by thick fog, for God knows how long, but still can't find an exit.
It is getting ever closer. At any minute, you expect to look up and see the mysterious being behind the sound reveal itself in front of you.
Snip, snip, snip...
You now find yourself in a narrow alley, with nowhere to hide.
Everything is coming to a head...
You feel a tap on your shoulder.
It's a tap on your shoulder, you're sure.
Quick... this way...
You turn around. You see ahead of you a patch of light bobbing along in the fog.
It stops, as if waiting for you to catch up.
You don't know if it bodes well or ill. But one thing is certain; it's able to move freely in the fog.
You decide to risk it. Who knows? Maybe you'll be able to get out of this hellish place by following the light.
Snip, snip, snip...
With the snipping sound still behind you, you quicken your pace to catch up with the light.
You could use some company, if nothing else.
The light seems to prefer to keep you at a distance.
Every time you get too close, or try to reach out and touch it, it flickers and vanishes, only to reappear a short distance ahead.
Its behavior brings to mind the ghost story that has been going around in this town.
It's rumored that the town is haunted by an evil phantom that wanders in the dark and plays tricks on innocent passers-by.
Still, in comparison to the mysterious being behind you, whoever or whatever is controlling the light seems much less menacing.
It might prove to be the lesser of two evils.
You hold your breath and cautiously follow the bobbing light while keeping constant track of the snipping sound.
At least the light is moving away from the wall of fog behind you.
It's... getting brighter...
The light stops moving. It's a lantern, and you finally have a chance to see who or what is holding it.
By the light of the lantern, all you can see is a fuzzy shadow figure.
Snip, snip, snip...
The familiar yet haunting sound is approaching fast.
The shadow figure leaps into the air and breaks open the wall of fog in front of you. You follow it out of the fog.
You finally break out of the fog. The light that guided you flickers twice inside the fog, then leaps into a blind zone.
The sound of shears continues to linger in the fog, refusing to give up the chase.

speaker: Lantern
content: Here... Over here! Hurry...
Street lights still illuminate the main road, making it still possible to tell the direction.
As you try to hide, you catch sight of a strange tricolor "street light" out of the corner of your eye.
Yet in that moment of distraction, you get knocked to the ground by the monster. With a flash of cold light, the shears pin down your collar.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: My shears... My shears...

speaker: Mad Shears
content: It's was you... You took my shears...
It twists and wriggles, as if trying to break free from some kind of pain. The shear blades carve deep crevices into the ground alongside its movements.

options: I don't remember doing something like that!

speaker: %u
content: I don't remember you at all!

speaker: Mad Shears
content: ...You don't remember?

speaker: Mad Shears
content: You don't remember?!! How can you not remember?!! I can't forget any of it... how can you?! Ahhh how can you?!

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Just as I thought, you have my shears. You stole them from me. You freed yourself, but what about me?!

speaker: Mad Shears
content: I'm still entangled. I can't cut it off no matter what. It's all your fault!
You start to get angry at all the false accusations.

speaker: %u
content: Look at what's in your hands! And you've the gall to demand things from an empty-handed person like me?

speaker: Mad Shears
content: The shears in my hand recognize you! The shears say it's you!
More slashes come your way. It's completely ignoring your words, eyes brimming with resentment and madness. It's pointless to try to talk to it. You can only dodge and pray for the best.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Where'd you hide it? Where'd you hide it?

speaker: Mad Shears
content: In your stomach? In your head? Let me slice them open! I know you have it!
It roars and rushes at you, but when you instinctively raise up your hand towards it, the crazed maniac stops in its tracks.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: What? (*Gasps)
Its sudden frightened expression emboldens you.
Nothing happened. Your hand is suspended awkwardly in mid-air. You're not sure why you did this. The other party is also a bit surprised.

speaker: %u
content: I told you already... I don't remember anything...
After a brief silence, you spring into action before the she does.
You yell and point behind it, then turn and dash the other way.
But you barely take one step before tripping and falling to the ground. In the darkness, a strange strand of hair has wrapped itself around your ankle.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: You can't escape! You're no different! You can't escape, either!! Ahhhh...
Ting-a-ling...
The light behind you suddenly lights up.
You slowly open your eyes. The fog is rapidly fading away. The bizarre hair creatures are scattering in all directions, like insects fleeing the light.
Mad Shears is no exception. It shrieks angrily and vanishes with the fog.
Someone opens the door of the shop behind you. The melodious sound of copper chimes rings in your ears.
...Why are you here?
Didn't I tell you to rest at home and wait for me to get off work?
What a familiar voice. A faint fragrance soothes your panicked breathing.
The woman has already walked up to you. She reaches out to stroke your disheveled hair, her voice holds a trace of sympathy.
...You made a big mess of yourself again. You can't go back looking like this...
Come, give me your hand. Let me fix you up before going home.
She leads you to the shop with the tricolor light, pushes open the door, and steps into its warm glow from the dark night.
It's a small hair salon. On the side of the door, where employee nameplates are meant to be hung, there's only one small metal nameplate engraved with a cursive signature:

speaker: Gentle Woman
content: Yes, I'm here.

The woman named Adela looks back at you. You study her face carefully. You don't recognize it, yet it seems familiar at the same time. You're certain that she must exist in some corner of your shattered memories.

speaker: Adela
content: Ha, what a funny thing to say. You make it sound as if you've forgotten who I am. This is the <color=#fb9259>second time</color> you've fallen in front of me.

speaker: Adela
content: <color=#fb9259>Last night</color> I brought you home, and today I brought you into my salon. You keep making a big mess of yourself... and I have to work overtime to tidy you up.
She reaches out and strokes your hair, which had been completely messed up by the monster. She then fixes your crumpled shirt.

speaker: Adela
content: At least you didn't pass out this time. You can change into clean clothes on your own.

speaker: Adela
content: That was the hardest thing for me last night.
She chuckles. You blush, trying not to imagine her changing your clothes.

Now that she mentioned it, the clothes you have on right now are indeed similar to Adela's in style and color. You're a foot away from her, yet totally enveloped by that familiar and reassuring fragrance.
—So the fragrance turned out to be hers. It dispelled your nightmare this morning, and now it's soothing your panic.

You think of the warm water by the bed, the meticulously treated wounds, the hasty but fulfilling breakfast, the washed clothes, and the fact that such a slender girl carried your unconscious body all the way home from the back alley...

options: You're the one who saved me.

speaker: %u
content: Thank you. Sorry for troubling you.

speaker: Adela
content: No worries. I'm good at taking care of others. The most important thing was to get you to sleep well.

speaker: Adela
content: Now that you came to my little salon, you're my "customer."

As she says this, she brings you to a leather recliner to sit, then puts her hands on your shoulders and slowly presses you to lie down. She does this very gently, yet firmly enough that you can't refuse.
You lie down flat, your head hanging over the small sink. Adela goes to the other side of the sink. She gently supports your head with her soft hands and gazes down into your eyes.

speaker: Adela
content: Let's rinse first. Your nerves are too wound up. You need to relax.

speaker: Adela
content: Tell me whatever you want to say. Take your time. I always satisfy my customers' needs.

speaker: Adela
content: All right, close your eyes. Don't let the bubbles get in them.
The warm water flows over your head, gently seeping through your hair before forming a downflowing stream.

speaker: Adela
content: How's the water temperature?

speaker: Adela
content: That's good.

speaker: Adela
content: Sorry. How about now?
The water becomes a bit warmer.

speaker: Adela
content: Sorry. How about now?
The water becomes a bit warmer.

speaker: Adela
content: If I turn up the temperature even more, you might get scalded. Are you sure?
She asks this as softly as ever, all the while keeping one hand behind your head to feel the water temperature.

options: Yeah, it is a bit too hot.

speaker: Adela
content: All right, then... Oh my, your scalp turned red and a lot of your hair fell out.
You instinctively sit up and look back anxiously at the sink behind you—there's nothing there. You only feel a cold, tingling pain as your scalp readjusts to room temperature.
The woman looks at you with a smile. Her hands are a bit red, but she doesn't seem upset at your mischief at all.

speaker: Adela
content: It's alright, let me adjust the water to a suitable temperature. Leave it to me, I'll take good care of your hair...

speaker: Adela
content: Sorry. How about now?
The water becomes a bit cooler.

speaker: Adela
content: Sorry. How about now?
The water becomes a bit cooler.

speaker: Adela
content: I have to add some ice, then. Are you sure about this?
She asks this as softly as ever, all the while keeping one hand behind your head to feel the water temperature.

options: Yeah, it is a bit too cold.

content: You really want to say that, but your teeth are already chattering, and not a word comes out.
She helps you up with a smile and hands you a cup of warm tea. Her hands are a bit blue, but she doesn't seem upset at your mischief at all.

speaker: Adela
content: It's alright, let me adjust the water to a suitable temperature. I wouldn't want you to catch a cold...
The water flows down your hair to the back of your head. Her soft hands caress your roots with just the right amount of pressure, gradually relaxing your tense and numb scalp.
You hear her soothing voice, as light and bubbly as the foam around your ears. Even the darkness before your eyes starts to mellow out. You have to remind yourself not to fall asleep as you listen.

speaker: Adela
content: I saw you around <color=#fb9259>10:30</color> last night.

speaker: Adela
content: On my way home from work, I saw that fog had gathered by the <color=#fb9259>clock tower</color>. There was also a strange red light. So, I went to take a look.

speaker: Adela
content: As soon as I got to the alley, I saw you on the ground, struggling to crawl out, as if trying to escape the dense fog behind you.

options: I remember seeing someone coming over to help me.

speaker: Adela
content: Yeah, you did see me. Your mouth was also moving, as if you wanted to tell me something.

speaker: Adela
content: What did you want to tell me?

speaker: Adela
content: You don't remember?

speaker: Adela
content: Ha, judging from how your lips moved, that wasn't what you said. Seems like you forgot.

speaker: %u
content: My memories are jumbled. I can't remember anything from the past.

speaker: %u
content: Everything here is unfamiliar to me. I can't go out and ask for help, nor do I know who to ask for help.

speaker: %u
content: I don't even remember who I am.

speaker: Adela
content: An inspector, perhaps?
You open your eyes to see her smiling at you.

speaker: Adela
content: It's just a guess.

speaker: Adela
content: The uniform you changed out of was quite unique. The <color=#fb9259>Minos Bureau of Crisis Control</color>... seems like some kind of secret agency.

speaker: Adela
content: I heard from the neighbors that this strange fog elicited quite a bit of attention from the higher-ups, who sent an inspector to investigate. Only an inspector would dare venture into the fog. Plus...

speaker: Adela
content: You couldn't even wait for me to get off work before going off to chase the fog... Isn't this the temperament of an inspector?

options: That sounds about right. I'm kinda cool.
Sorry... I made trouble for you again.

speaker: Adela
content: I think so, too. "The Great Inspector Who Caught the Mysterious Culprit" is a fitting title for you.

speaker: Adela
content: Don't worry about it. I think "The Great Inspector Who Caught the Mysterious Culprit" is a fitting title for you.

speaker: Adela
content: The wash is done. Come, sit here. Let me trim this a bit for you.

<size=31>This time, she ushers you before a mirror, puts you in a barber's chair, then blow-dries your hair. From the reflection, you watch her stare at your hair as she combs it carefully, as if designing a new hairstyle in her mind. Her warm fingertips brush against your ears and neck from time to time.</size>

speaker: Adela
content: Feel free to keep asking, Mr. Inspector. There's an inquisitive passion in your eyes.
female_content: Feel free to keep asking, Ms. Inspector. There's an inquisitive passion in your eyes.

content: How did she know you were looking at her? Was it a woman's intuition? You decide to cast aside your personal questions and ask something more formal.

options: Ask about the mysterious fog that blocked off the street.
Ask about the hair monster in the fog.
Ask about the mysterious lantern in the fog.

speaker: Adela
content: The fog in this street has been around long before I moved here.

speaker: Adela
content: Usually, it appears only once in a while. I heard that all signals die in there, and people will also lose their way. No one inside the fog can get out, and no one outside can get in.

speaker: Adela
content: But it never lasts long. In one or two hours, or even less, the fog will dissipate and everything will go back to normal.

speaker: Adela
content: But to last more than a day and night without end, and to surround the entire street... Something like this has never happened before.

options: Ask about the hair monster in the fog.
Ask about the mysterious lantern in the fog.

content: You tell her about the rumors you've heard and the battles you've encountered. Adela flashes a puzzled look.

speaker: Adela
content: A monster made of hair? Did it appear in the fog?

speaker: Adela
content: I haven't heard of anything like that before... I did hear that "Mad Shears" would appear alongside the fog. But in all the stories, Mad Shears looks like a <color=#fb9259>person</color>, not a monster made of hair...
It must be something that appeared just recently... maybe even <color=#fb9259>today</color>.

options: Ask about the mysterious lantern in the fog.

speaker: Adela
content: The neighbors mentioned it before. Seems to be a "new urban legend" that appeared just recently.

speaker: Adela
content: I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but others around here have. You can ask around tomorrow. If it led you all the way to me...

speaker: Adela
content: Then at least it wasn't "Mad Shears." Maybe it's a kind and cute little fella.

Your jumbled thoughts are also sorted out little by little. You can clearly see the clues converging to the key questions.

options: The one who attacked me two nights in a row...

speaker: %u
content: Could it be the <color=#fb9259>Mad Shears of the Foggy Night</color>?
...Snap.

The sound of scraping metal grinds sharply from behind your ears. A cold, numbing sensation spreads from the back of your ears to your neck, collarbone, and whole body. You shudder and look instinctively at the mirror...
Those petite barber shears are still dancing lightly, neither sticking to your skin, nor suddenly expanding and piercing towards your throat.
Adela lowers her eyes, smiling gently as she strokes your hair with her left fingertips.

speaker: Adela
content: That's a possibility.

speaker: Adela
content: Did you remember something, Mr. Inspector?
female_content: Did you remember something, Ms. Inspector?

speaker: %u
content: On the first night, I forgot everything that happened before I saw you. And tonight, I was so distracted by those hairs that I didn't see what it looked like.

speaker: %u
content: But I do remember that pair of <color=#fb9259>shears</color>.

speaker: %u
content: They were long and freezing cold. I remember that its sound really makes one's skin crawl.

speaker: Adela
content: Sounds like an eerie urban legend. You like urban legends too, Mr. Inspector?
female_content: Sounds like an eerie urban legend. You like urban legends too, Ms. Inspector?

content: She chuckles.
The barber shears hang less than two centimeters above your neck. This distance is quite intimate.
The cuts are small and the movements are light, clipping away at your hair and tugging at your tense nerves.
Your gaze is completely fixed on the shears in the reflection.

speaker: Adela
content: Mr. Inspector, do you know what the residents of this street say about Mad Shears?
female_content: Ms. Inspector, do you know what the residents of this street say about Mad Shears?

speaker: Adela
content: They say that Mad Shears doesn't hurt the prey's body. It only harvests the prey's soul.

speaker: Adela
content: No one knows its true appearance. Mad Shears never misses a target, so it never needs to come back for a retry... Oh, except for you, of course. You're quite special indeed.
The barber shears move faster and faster. You feel its cold gleam edging closer, as if it's going to cut your exposed skin the next second.
The cold, sharp touch feels so real. Every cell is screaming, but you can't tell if they're screaming for you to flee or embrace its approach. Then...
The shears suddenly stop two centimeters from your neck, half-open and gleaming coldly. You glance up and see Adela looking at you in the mirror.

speaker: Adela
content: It'll probably still try to come to you amidst the thick fog. Just like <color=#fb9259>tonight</color>.
Clank...!!
You instantly jump up and grab her hand that's holding the shears. By the time you realize what you did, the two of you are frozen face to face before the mirror.
Adela looks at you without struggling. Her gaze grows softer.

speaker: Adela
content: ...You had the same expression last night.

speaker: Adela
content: Sorry, I didn't realize how much those shears traumatized you. I'm always quite the dullard.

speaker: Adela
content: Forgetting the past makes you quite uneasy, doesn't it? Rest assured, you're not a weakling.
She gently caresses your face with her empty left hand.

speaker: Adela
content: You're strong enough to be its match. That's why you got injured all over. No matter what happened in the fog last night, Mad Shears didn't dare to keep chasing you after you left the fog. Nor did it dare to attack you when you were unconscious.

speaker: Adela
content: No, it fled before I came. I'm sure of it. Last night was your victory.

speaker: Adela
content: You're very strong. It's just that you can't remember—but that doesn't change who you are.
She gently straightens your shoulders and motions for you to look in the mirror.
Your haircut is done. Adela didn't make any drastic changes. She just trimmed it a little, hiding the gaping cuts made by "Mad Shears" with clever layering. You look quite spruced up.
The terrible snapping hallucinations gradually subside from your ears. You see your familiar old self in the mirror, even though you still can't remember a lot of things from the past.
After calming down, you make up your mind... Whatever your suspicions, this hair stylist just saved you right in front of "Mad Shears". It's a fact that she's not the same person as that monster.
Your tense muscles finally relax. Only then do you remember to let go of her hand. Gazing at her calm face, you actually come to admire this woman a bit.

speaker: %u
content: Everyone was freaking out after the street got blocked off, but you stayed as calm as ever.

speaker: %u
content: You know full well of Mad Shears' existence, yet you still dared to venture out at night alone and save me from the fog. This isn't just an urban legend. You could've gotten hurt.

speaker: Adela
content: Yeah. I also lost something in the fog.

options: Do you want to go find it?

speaker: Adela
content: Do you think I should worry about it?
She smiles faintly.
Adela ponders for a moment.

speaker: Adela
content: No need. Things are fine the way they are.

speaker: Adela
content: My life is as peaceful as always. I'm content. It should continue like this.

speaker: Adela
content: I have work tomorrow, so I can't help you. But you can explore the neighborhood after the sun comes up. The neighbors are all quite kind. Maybe someone has seen you before and can give you some clues.
She sweeps the hair on the floor and tidies up everything swiftly.

speaker: Adela
content: All right, go home now. You should get some rest. You're welcome to stay with me until you regain your memory.

speaker: Adela
content: Just relax now. The fog will clear up. You shouldn't worry about it.
You awaken to a familiar touch and fragrance.
No response.
Yesterday's hair-raising encounter almost seemed like an illusion, but your memories are still missing. The reason why Mad Shears attacked you remains unclear.
The breakfast and the note on the table brings you back to reality.
The note is still in the same place as yesterday, but the breakfast has changed from meager to grand.
The eggs have been fried to a golden hue, boasting crispy outer layers and soft yolks that flow out as you bite into them. The bread is toasted in butter, giving off a rich, mouthwatering aroma.

"The fog got heavier. Don't go out.
I'll try to come home from work as early as possible."

"...Even if I say so, you'll probably still go out to seek the truth.
 Go ahead, then. Just be careful not to end up in the fog. It's dangerous."

"The neighbors are all very nice people. You can ask them for help.
I'll be at the salon the whole day. You're welcome to come if you need anything.
Here's the spare key.

—Adela "
You see some ink seeping through the paper. There are more words on the back.
"Remember to eat breakfast."
The sausages and bacon are rich in fat. The unique satiety of meat not only fills your stomach, but also lifts your spirit.
You really feel recharged after the meal.
You clear the table gratefully and plan out your next steps as you wash the dishes: retrieve your lost memories, then get to the bottom of this fog and the bizarre person in it.
Finally, you pick up the key she prepared for you and set off.
You find yourself back in the Fog Alley, where you were attacked yesterday.
The only difference is that you're no longer surrounded by thick fog. And there are a couple of townies chatting nearby. You listen in on their conversation.

speaker: Townie A
content: Oh, have you folks encountered a talking lantern lately? It pauses mid-sentence randomly when it's speaking.

speaker: Townie A
content: Rumors about this spooky lantern are running wild. "The Lantern Ghost of Sloane Street," they call it.

speaker: Townie C
content: Hey! Why the hell did you bring that up? And in the middle of the night... It gives me the creeps just thinking about it.

speaker: Townie B
content: No, i-it's real. A friend of mine saw it. According to him, this freaking lantern just leaped out of nowhere and even asked him to play games with it.
The other two listen to the tale with their hearts in their mouths.

speaker: Townie B
content: He came out of the fog alive by following the light. But not so long ago, he was admitted to a mental hospital. It was very sudden.
The storyteller has turned ashen-faced.

speaker: Townie C
content: Stay away from dark alleys. Avoid them at all costs. Don't respond to any voice you hear in thick fog. Just run as fast as you can!

speaker: Townie A
content: Damn... is it that bad?

speaker: Townie C
content: If you don't run fast enough and get caught, you'll be tormented. Have you seen any of those videos posted online?

speaker: Townie B
content: That's right. If you're trapped in thick fog, you'll hear hysterical laughter and approaching footsteps, it'll keep tormenting you, until...

speaker: Townie A
content: Eehh!

The more they talked, the more evil the lantern became. It sounds like this fabled phantom is an evil thing that is haunting the town. Looks like you have gotten off easy. It saved your life, after all.
You want to share your story with the townies. You make to approach them, but stop in your tracks when you notice an antique lantern on the ground.
You pick it up and come up to them. The light from the lantern illuminates where they're standing.
You're about to say something when the lantern preempts you.
Hello... everyone...
The lantern frees itself from your grip and floats in the air. It starts talking, pausing mid-sentence randomly. It's the voice you heard in the fog just the other day.
Is there... anyone here... who wants to...

speaker: Townie A
content: Th-this is...

speaker: Townie C
content: Holy ****! Stop standing still! Run for it! Run!!!

speaker: Townie B
content: Don't look back! Or you'll be trapped forever!
The townspeople all ran and disappeared into the night.
The floating lantern turns, and then stops, as if to face you.
It's... you?
Excellent!
Looks like it recognizes you.
Do you... want to play a game... with me?
After issuing the invitation, it starts circling slowly around you, as if sizing you up.

options: I've got other things to deal with now.

content: You still haven't solved the mystery of the Foggy Night. It's no time to play games, not to mention with a ghost that's the subject of a horror story.
What if... what if...

speaker: Your question hangs in the air, unanswered. She's already pacing, already pulling out an array of curious objects, already lost in her own excited murmurings. To her, you've ceased to exist.
content: I gave you... money? Would you play with me then?
Still a no?
But my dad told me... there's no problem in this world that money can't solve...
The ghost doesn't strike you as horrifying. Isn't this suppose to attack you and make you end up in a mental hospital?
And it must know something about Mad Shears, considering it can move freely in thick fog.

options: Do you know anything about that strange person I saw yesterday?

content: Strange person?
The lantern does a little shake when it realizes who you're talking about.
Oh, you mean the lady carrying a big pair of scissors? She's, um, very special.
I wouldn't call her strange though.
You were right. It does know something.
It's strange to hear a lantern telling you what is strange and what is not.

speaker: Lantern
content: Hooray! I've got myself a new playmate.

speaker: Chief
content: On one condition—that you tell me everything you know about Mad Shears.

speaker: Lantern
content: Hehe, will do, but only after our game.
The lighter flickers. A black mass flies out and molds itself into a shadow figure.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Let's play hide-and-seek! But you win only if you catch me.
Yesterday's chasing game all over again? You decide to give it your best shot, since there's no other way to get the information you want.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: On the count of five... Are you ready?
You nod. You get set, ready to sprint.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: One...

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Two...

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Five!
With a flash of light from the lantern, the shadow figure has put a measurable distance between the two of you. After the initial surprise, you start chasing it.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Hehe, I'm over here. Come and get me!

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Come on, you can do this. You're way better than the servants in my home.
You've been running around for almost twenty minutes. Every inch of your body is screaming in pain. You feel sore all over.
The shadow figure doesn't even bother to hide. It just stands on the roadside, waiting for you to get closer.
It vanishes right before you touch it. That's your fourteenth failed attempt.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Oh, that was quite close. Better luck next time.
It vanishes whenever you're about to touch it, just like what happened yesterday.

options: Get it into a confined space

content: It's nimble on its feet. If you can get it into a confined space, you stand a better chance of catching it.
You plan out a route in your head and chase it to a narrow street lined with shops. It seems a little surprised but doesn't suspect anything.
For some reason, it's moving somewhat slower in this shopping street.
Now you see it again. It's flattened itself against the display window of a toy shop, with the lantern tied behind it.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Wow! An action figure of Chiyo.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: What a creative design. Gotta get Daddy to buy it for me.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Ahhh! There's more of them. How I wish I could take them all home!
The shadow figure is distracted by the toys behind the display window. You reach out to touch it.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Huh! A sneak attack?

speaker: Black Shadow
content: That's so much fun! Much more fun than playing with the servants. They're all worried about hurting me by accident. Let's continue! Come and get me!
It runs, and you give chase. Eventually, you drive it into a dead-end alley.
You proclaim triumphantly, as you approach the cornered shadow figure.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Not so fast. Hehe, you haven't really caught me yet.
It waves at you. You lunge forward, with your hand reached out.
Before you can touch it, it merges into and passes through the wall.
Thump!
The only thing you catch is the sound of you hitting the concrete wall.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Haha, better luck next time~
You hear its voice coming from the other side of the wall.
You run your hand over the surface of the wall. It's definitely not a prop.
You look down and see a round object on the ground where the shadow figure disappeared a minute ago.
You pick it up. It's a wind-up toy, probably from one of the toy shops on the street, with a funny-looking face.
It likes this kind of toy?
While you were chasing it in the shopping street, you did notice how it was easily distracted by the toys behind display windows.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: What a creative design. Gotta get Daddy to buy it for me.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Ahhh! There's more of them. How I wish I could take them all home!
You're fairly certain that the shadow figure saw something it liked in the shopping street. Judging by its behavior, it should be drawn to collect novel things and new experiences.
An idea comes to you. But you're not sure if it'll work.
You decide to go ahead with it anyway, since there seems no better option at this point.
You're going to set a special trap for this playful ghost.
Having set the trap, you wait for it to walk into it.
You check your watch. It's been half an hour since you stopped chasing it. It must have grown bored and impatient.
You sit back on the bench, making a great show of being exhausted.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Hey... are you giving up?
You feel a tap on your right shoulder. It is walking into your trap.
It's voice lost that brightness from earlier. No longer sound excited. It sounds like a sad kid who has no friend to play with.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: It took me so long... to finally find someone who is willing to play with me...

speaker: Black Shadow
content: You haven't come to me for a long time... Was it because I was going too fast? I promise I can slow down a bit this time...
The shadow figure inches toward you while saying words of encouragement.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Ah! So you were just pretending! You weren't really tired. I can't believe you played dirty again!

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Is that what you wanted to hear? Hehe, that's too bad.
You lunge at it. Another failed attempt...

speaker: Black Shadow
content: No one at home can ever catch me! So, maybe you should just give up!
It's leaning against the wall, gloating over your failure.
The real opportunity to catch it has finally presented itself.
With great effort, you make another lunge for it.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Hehe, I told you it won't work...
It talks and moves back at the same time, it passes through the wall and unknowingly walks into your trap.
You've successfully carried out your plan. Now all you have to do is wait and see if the trap will work.

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Ahhhhhhhh!
A sharp cry comes from the other side of the wall.
Looks like the trap is working. You rush over to the other side, ready to reap the reward.

speaker: Teenage Girl
content: Ahhhh! I can't... I can't believe it!

speaker: Teenage Girl
content: The Dancing Lion! The one Daddy said he'd buy me.

speaker: Teenage Girl
content: Ah... and this one is...

speaker: Teenage Girl
content: A limited-edition EDGO set! I've always wanted this. If I have this case of building blocks, I'll be able to build a new castle in my bedroom.

speaker: Teenage Girl
content: Wait a second, is this real?

speaker: Teenage Girl
content: A Duck plushie! Also a limited edition. They made only 24 of these.

speaker: Teenage Girl
content: Ahh... Am I in heaven?

When you're on the other side of the wall, you find a teenage girl drowned in a sea of toys. She picks up one toy after another to examine, pinching her own cheek every now and again as if to make sure she's not dreaming.
So this is the true form of the ghost that has inspired so much dread, you think to yourself as you watch the overjoyed girl.
She's just a harmless girl who loves to play and cute toys.

speaker: Toy-loving Girl
content: Ah... hehe... Ducky plushie...
She doesn't notice your approach, too engrossed in her personal paradise. For all you know, you may have purchased all of the limited-edition toys in the entire shopping street.
You take her by the hand and pull her out of the mountain of toys.

options: I won. Now let's pick up where we left off.

speaker: Toy-loving Girl
content: Ehh? What?! Since.. Since when?

speaker: Toy-loving Girl
content: Oh no... does it mean... our game is already over...

speaker: Toy-loving Girl
content: But I... I haven't had enough fun yet.
She looks sad. She surely doesn't want the game to end so soon.

speaker: Chief
content: Listen, if you keep your word and tell me everything you know about that mysterious lady, I promise you I'll find time to play with you again.

speaker: Letta
content: Really?
Her eyes brighten up.

speaker: Letta
content: Fantastic! Of course I'll tell you what I know about her. I'm a person of my word. But you're not lying about playing with me again, are you?

speaker: Chief
content: Of course not.

speaker: Letta
content: Emm.. that's right!

speaker: Letta
content: She's a human, but she's also a pair of shears without self-control.

speaker: Letta
content: It's not so hard to understand. She's a troubled person. You'll see that if you get a chance to observe her behavior.

speaker: Letta
content: It's like she's trapped or entangled by something, kind of like... a compulsive obsession taking over?

speaker: Letta
content: She can't keep herself from cutting things. You don't find this behavior special?

speaker: Chief
content: Why is it that she doesn't attack you?

speaker: Letta
content: Hehe, why don't you take a guess?
She blinks her bright eyes, waiting for your answer.

speaker: Letta
content: Bingo! No one can catch me in thick fog. Well, no one but you.

speaker: Letta
content: Sigh. Are you a dummy? She doesn't attack me, because she can't catch me.
Somehow, you don't feel that's the real reason.
According to the lantern girl, who is called Letta, Mad Shears attacks people burdened with worries and troubles.
And yet, she leaves Letta alone. Does that mean Letta is completely worry-free?
Very likely. The girl in front of you does look like she doesn't have a care in the world; she's now rubbing her cheek with a fluffy toy.
So if you're unburdened by any unpleasant thoughts, Mad Shears will leave you alone?
If that's the case, the residents getting trapped in thick fog can't be helpful.
Who wouldn't feel stressed and troubled if they were stuck in a foggy maze looking fruitlessly for an exit?

speaker: Letta
content: Ahem, I'm telling you all this, not because you caught me.

speaker: Letta
content: It's because I had a good time thanks to you. I can't remember the last time I had so much fun.

speaker: Letta
content: Oh! I'm taking this one with me by the way.
She snatches up the limited-edition Duck plushie, the most expensive in that pile of toys.
You reach out to stop her from leaving. She vanishes with a flash of light, and then reappears.

speaker: Letta
content: I had a really good time today. See you!
Who would've thought the much-dreaded Lantern Ghost of Sloane Street is a teenage girl with a weakness for wind-up toys and stuffed animals?

speaker: Letta
content: Oh, one more thing...
The girl seems to have remembered something important. She glides over to stand in front of you.

speaker: Letta
content: Make sure you never, ever, ever go up up that bell tower! No matter what.

speaker: Letta
content: Understood?

speaker: Letta
content: Sigh. I knew I'd be wasting my breath.

speaker: Letta
content: Even If I were to tell you that "Ah! it's extremely dangerous, please don't go! It's even more dangerous than the Fog Alley!"

speaker: Letta
content: You'd still go there, wouldn't you?

speaker: Chief
content: And I have my reasons.

speaker: Letta
content: Sigh. I knew you'd say that.

speaker: Letta
content: If you're ever in trouble, look for the light.
She's harmless, you're now sure. She's just a teenage girl looking for someone to play with...
Even though the way she does it can be problematic.

speaker: Letta
content: Oh wait, what time is it now?
The girl tenses up visibly.

speaker: Letta
content: Oh no! My dad is coming home at ten. I'm gonna be in a lot of trouble if he comes home and I'm not in. I've got to go now!

speaker: Letta
content: Promise me that you will remember! I just found a great playmate, I don't want to lose you.

speaker: Letta
content: And don't forget that you said you'll play games with me again!
The girl lets out a long sigh when she's done talking and transforms into a black mass that blends in with the night.

speaker: Adela
content: I was just thinking when you'd come through this door again... Speak of the devil.

speaker: Adela
content: Who did you hear from this time?

options: The investigation is done. I asked everyone on the street.

speaker: %u
content: I'm really exhausted. Can I lie on the couch for a bit? I'll leave right away if any customers come. I won't disturb your business...

speaker: Adela
content: Don't worry. It's a foggy day so not many people dare to go out. I'm quite free right now.
You dodder over to the couch in the waiting area and collapse onto it.

speaker: Adela
content: But since you're so tired, why didn't you go home and get a full night's sleep? Did you forget the key?
You take out the spare key and wave it in front of her.

speaker: %u
content: The best place is where you are. Chatting with you is really relaxing.
You hear her chuckle lightly.

speaker: Adela
content: Thank you for your kind feedback. It's my pleasure to listen to you. Here, have some black tea. Careful, it's hot.
As she speaks, she hands you a cup of freshly brewed black tea.
The warm aroma of tea blends with her unique fragrance, soothing your jumbled mind. Now you can rearrange the information obtained from your investigation.

options: The monster are somehow connected to several townspeople.

speaker: %u
content: ...A girl with an ill-stricken mother, a workaholic salaryman, a shy boy who avoids his lover, and a former Syndican who hides her identity... The items dropped by the monsters all represent their worries.

speaker: %u
content: These aren't coincidences. The townspeople's <color=#fb9259>worries</color> have turned into monsters wrapped in hair, which continue to haunt their owners. This is the truth about the monsters.

speaker: Adela
content: You mean, things that only existed in people's minds have become reality?

speaker: Adela
content: Mmm... like in novels?

speaker: %u
content: Adela, have you heard of Mania?
She shakes her head.

speaker: %u
content: It has been spreading in West District for a long time, and is now affecting Eastside. In essence, it's the concretization of human spiritual energy, along with all the mutations it triggers.

speaker: %u
content: It's undoubtedly responsible for the fog that blocked off the street and the hair monsters inside—anything that defies the laws of science can be chalked up to Mania. After all, reality has been distorted.

speaker: %u
content: Mania is very dangerous. You should stay away from it. If you encounter anything that might seem like Mania, call the police right away.

speaker: Adela
content: Hehe, you sure know a lot, Inspector. Even after losing your memory, your mind is still working quite well.

speaker: %u
content: I got entangled by those weird things in the street before. How should I put it... I seem to have some sort of special connection with them. Whenever I see them, I remember bits and pieces.
You're referring to the bits and pieces of information that you vaguely recall after encountering the strange "shadow people".
But having said that, the fog and Mad Shears have been around for a long time, yet the hair monsters only started appearing yesterday. If you're not mistaken, the Mania here is increasing.
The culprit of all this is...

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Just as I thought, you have my shears. You stole them from me. You freed yourself, but what about me?!

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Where'd you hide it? Where'd you hide it?
Did Mad Shears grow stronger all of a sudden? Or did something affect it, making it lose control? You can't tell.
The mystery of the foggy night is linked to Mad Shears, while the mystery of Mad Shears is linked to...

options: The night you lost your memory.

content: <size=31>That night, deep in that foggy alley behind the clock tower, something must have happened between you and Mad Shears that resulted in this series of upheavals. As for what it did to you, and what happened to it... you can only find out by going back to the scene.</size>
...But in your current state, the risk is simply too great.

You hear the light clinking of porcelain. You look up to see Adela putting a cup of freshly brewed black tea before you. Only then did you realize that you had been silently lost in your own thoughts for a long time.

speaker: Adela
content: Are you that worried? The tea has gotten cold. Let me pour you a new cup.
You hurriedly thank her and take the cup. This time, the temperature is just right. You take a sip and relax a little. Adela looks at you smilingly the whole time.
What an incredible woman. It must be extremely dangerous for a frail person like her to venture out alone in the middle of the night, but you never saw her lose her cool.
In these two short days, her calming aura has become something you rely on.

options: Are you worried about anything, Adela?

speaker: Adela
content: Why do you ask that?

speaker: %u
content: That fellow seems to be constantly chasing people's worries. Whether it created them in the first place, or is just trying to rob the energy from them, people's worries are all its prey.

speaker: %u
content: I don't want you to get hurt.

speaker: Adela
content: ...Thank you. Don't worry, nothing's worrying me.

speaker: Adela
content: Because of this job, many people like to tell me their worries.

speaker: Adela
content: Neighbors and customers alike... Everyone is bound to encounter dilemmas and troubles that are unresolvable and hard to shake off.

speaker: Adela
content: I know exactly what it's like to feel worried, but I don't feel that way myself.

speaker: Adela
content: I moved many times before finally finding this place—a little home where I can sleep peacefully, a job that I can excel at, and the opportunity to gain trust and give back. Every problem has its solution.

speaker: Adela
content: Every moment of my life brings me peace and stability. There's nothing that I can't bear or want to get rid of. I cherish these peaceful times and hope they can last forever.

options: Then I must be the one giving you worries, no?

speaker: %u
content: I suddenly crashed into your life, forcing you to take care of me.
She smiles, amused.

speaker: Adela
content: I've always loved taking care of people. If my "service" can alleviate worries and bring about a happy smile, it's all worth it.

options: You've done a great job already.

speaker: %u
content: This cup of black tea alone cheered me up. I don't feel so depressed when I think of other things now.
You smile and toast her in thanks. She looks at you in silence for a long time, then speaks up.

speaker: Adela
content: I really like you.
You almost spit out your tea, yet Adela's expression remains unchanged. She didn't seem to mean anything special, and continues to talk calmly.

speaker: Adela
content: I want to thank Mad Shears for making us meet. It took away your worries, while you gave me a great time.

options: Thank it for taking away my worries...?

speaker: %u
content: ...I can't bring myself to thank it. I really want to know what my "worries" were.
For example, those two little things that keep bugging you.

speaker: %u
content: Maybe not all of them are worries that can't be shaken off. Maybe some of those worries are actually, um... precious things that I can't let go of no matter how worrisome they are.

speaker: %u
content: Besides, Mad Shears is just a bandit who robbed me of my memories. The kind soul who really offloaded my worries is a gentle hairdresser. You're the one I should thank, Adela.

speaker: Adela
content: ...I'm honored. Although...
Before she can finish her sentence, a string of screams ring out from outside.
You jump up from the couch and run to the window to look towards the square.

You can't see a thing. The thick fog has blanketed the entire street. Eerie shadows run amok—maybe they're frightened residents, maybe they're monsters, or maybe it's Mad Shears... The situation has really deteriorated.

speaker: %u
content: I'm going back to the alley to find the truth and stop Mad Shears. You stay here. I'll come pick you up when it's all over.

speaker: Adela
content: It will probably try to attack you again.
There's a hint of worry in her voice.

speaker: %u
content: Didn't you say that I've beaten it before? That I'm very strong?

speaker: %u
content: Plus, just like you've done so much for me, I want to give back to you. I will solve this mystery and restore peace to the town.

speaker: %u
content: I'm leaving now. Maybe I can resolve everything quickly and come meet you when you get off work.
Adela looks at you silently for a long time before speaking up again.

speaker: Adela
content: ...All right. Please be careful.
You leave her little salon, shutting the door behind you. You're confronted by thick fog, and strange noises echoing from inside it.

The thick fog rolls and surges. The uninvited guests in the fog approach to the tune of the chiming clock. Sure enough, things have gotten worse, and you aren't quite sure if you can defend yourself. However...

speaker: Adela
content: I cherish these peaceful times and hope they can last forever.
...You can't let it run loose any longer.
Letta warned you to never go near the clock tower.
You look up and try to see the clock tower through the glass, but the towering spire is engulfed in thick fog, making it impossible to see its outline.
Snip!
The familiar sound of shears rings out again. You see that frightening figure once more.
Mad Shears lurches through the alley, dragging its blades and mumbling to itself.

speaker: Resident
content: Eek! No, stay away!!
The shears land mercilessly.
But they don't cause any cuts.

Instead, the blade glides across the resident's body, spewing forth an equally familiar patch of dark contamination. It wriggles a bit and transforms into a familiar form—a terrifying monster made of tangled hair.
The root of all mysteries still lies with Mad Shears. It vanishes into the fog, heading towards the clock tower by the dark alley where you were attacked.
Near the clock tower.
You get closer and closer to the alley, and can faintly hear Mad Shears in the fog.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: ...I picked it up here... This must be the place... The other one must be here, too...
You quickly slip into the fog to hide. The residents who have been robbed of their worries are in a daze, while Mad Shears is still mumbling to itself.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Can't cut it off... So much hair... Hair's so long... Stop growing, stop growing... I can't cut it off...

speaker: Mad Shears
content: ...Why... Where are my shears... Where is it?!
Mad Shears looms at the end of the alley, frantically cutting its own hair, repeating the same things over and over again.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Where are my shears?! Where are the shears that can chop off all this hair?!!
The severed hairs fall to the ground, turning into hideous monsters.
...It looks past the monsters and spots you.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: You're here! It's you!!
You dodge Mad Shears' sudden attack, but the hair monsters it created block your path. But now...
You flaunt your faint red mark. Its power is still quite weak, but judging from its fearsome performance last night, it can still scare off others.

speaker: %u
content: How did you become so weak? Weren't you so powerful that night? The shears you're obsessed with don't like you anymore?

speaker: %u
content: How about giving them to me? Someone once said I'm a lot stronger than you.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: You? Stronger than me? Ahhhhh shut up!! I've nothing to envy, nothing at all!!! Shut your mouth!!!!
Its hair grows rapidly again, and attacks you.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Go away! Be gone from my world!! I don't want to see you again!!
The red light in your palm gets brighter, illuminating Mad Shears' terrified face. It backs away with its hair-tangled shears.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: No! Stay back! Don't touch my shears!

speaker: %u
content: You've all lost control! Let it go!

speaker: Mad Shears
content: No!!
You rush forward and snatch that pair of giant, stained shears.
The red shackles tear through the contamination on the surface of the shears. The hair entangling it instantly dissolves, revealing its true appearance underneath. You're stunned...
The gigantic pair of cold and lavish shears had been halved. Only one shear remains in your hands.
You look at "Mad Shears," who is sitting on the ground like a lost soul after losing its shears. The Mania on its body has subsided, revealing a weak and cowering face.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: ...Where is this... Why am I here... Who are you... The shear you're holding is...

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Right, I'm here to find you... <color=#fb9259>Mr. Mad Shears of the Foggy Night</color>...
female_content: Right, I'm here to find you... <color=#fb9259>Ms. Mad Shears of the Foggy Night</color>...

content: You deny in confusion, but in that moment, your hand that's holding the shear becomes scorching hot. Your head suddenly hurts, and countless hairs coil into your vision.

speaker: %u
content: ...What the...
<color=#7683a2>...It’s the hair... all this cursed hair... hair that people can't get rid of on their own...</color>
Hair suddenly slithers toward you from every corner of the street, sprouting from every townsfolk. They seem to have crawled into your mind, bringing forth countless chaotic murmurs.

speaker: Chaotic Murmurs
content: ...I tried my best. How would I know why she's angry? Besides, why must we go to that kind of place for our date? It's suffocatingly crowded... She's getting hit on again. How dare those men look at me that way...

speaker: Chaotic Murmurs
content: Yeah, she'll get tired of me sooner or later... I'm not cut out to date... I can't stand it, it's unbearable... Instead of dragging things out, it's better to just break up now... It's more liberating to be single...

speaker: Painful Murmurs
content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>I wish I didn't do all those rotten things back then... No... If I could be as heartless as the "majority" of Syndicans, I wouldn't be suffering...</color></i >

speaker: Painful Murmurs
content: Ha, what a joke! Those heartless bastards are all living in style. Only a halfwit like me is suffering!

speaker: Frenzied Murmurs
content: What a crappy company full of morons!! Nagging me every day... What kind of crap can come out of all that nagging?! Am I here to make crap?! Am I working this hard to make crap?!!

speaker: Tired Murmurs
content: She's been sick for so long... My savings have bottomed out, my job is gone, and in the end, Mom is still suffering... Wonder drug... ha, a wonder drug from God knows how long ago... even the doctor has given up, why am I still holding out...

speaker: Tired Murmurs
content: Every day when I wake up and go to the hospital, the first thing that pops into my mind is... is she dead yet...

speaker: Tired Murmurs
content: I've had enough... Maybe she's better off dead? She should just die then, it'll be a relief for everyone...

speaker: Ferocious Murmurs
content: ...What are you smirking about? I don't want black tea! I don't want food, either!! You think these will make me happy?! I'll be happy if you're gone! I was happy before I gave birth to you! I could've had a great life! It's your fault I ended up like this!

speaker: Ferocious Murmurs
content: Go away, you burdensome brat! I don't want to see you!
You try to cover your ears, but your body doesn't cooperate. The surging hair approaches and entangles you. Someone walks towards you—it's the woman called "Mad Shears".
Her body changes again. Her hair grows visibly longer as she sullenly approaches you with a begging look on her face.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: I'm really worried... I've been worried for a long time... I try so hard, but I still can't catch up... I don't want to think about it anymore... but I can't break free...

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Help, I can't do it on my own. I can't get rid of it... Help me cut it off, please...
Her hair keeps growing, sprouting from every part of her body. The wriggling locks reach the ground and snake towards you as if alive.
The shear starts to heat up, and the hand that's holding it starts to move uncontrollably.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Help me! Cut off this hair!! Ahhh...

She pounces at you. You instinctively swing the shear to chop her thick hair. The shear lands with a thud—you fail to cut through anything, but a slimy creature is born out of it. It's a hair monster like the ones you've seen in the fog!
It turns around and pounces at the woman, who screams in terror.
But all you hear right now are the incessant whispers of the single shear in your hand.

speaker: Single Shear
content: <color=#7683a2>When there's only one-half of the shears, its power is halved. One chop will bring worries into reality...</color>

speaker: Single Shear
content: <color=#7683a2>When the shears are a complete pair, its full power is restored. One chop will sever hair and disperse all worries...</color>
The other's hair wraps around you. Strange hair sprouts from your body as you suffer a head-splitting headache.
Some sort of madness is invading your consciousness. You must fight it with all your strength. The truth of the Mad Shears of the Foggy Night is right in front of you. You must give your all...

speaker: %u
content: You're the one controlling her... You use these illusions to control anyone who holds you. Whenever you slash someone, worries... no, spiritual energy... will come to life and transform into hair monsters...

speaker: %u
content: You're the real Mad Shears of the Foggy Night...!
That is the truth. But what's the use of knowing it?
You want to cast aside the cold, cursed shear in your hand, yet you clutch onto this metal monster with all your strength, as if scared of letting this hard-caught culprit slip away.
The monster's voice doesn't stop, but gets louder and louder. You gradually lose control of your body.

speaker: Single Shear
content: <color=#7683a2>The other half of the shears... is hidden in the fog... Bring it back... You're strong enough... to bring it back...</color>

options: Don't think you can control me!

content: But when you open your eyes again, you're at the top of the clock tower.
When and how did you come up here? You don't know the answer, but you can see dense hair surging from all directions, swishing and wriggling and making strange sounds.

It's not your hair, yet it wraps around your hand and drags you towards the clock dial—the frozen clock hand on it looks the same as the blade in your hand. That clock hand is precisely the other shear.
The red light in your palm becomes brighter and brighter. Your shattered memory fragments gradually reawaken.
Found you, Mad Shears! No... Sinner!
Put down your weapon! It's completely stained with Mania. You've caused way too much damage already. The MBCC will not allow this madness to continue!
This is your own voice. You suddenly remember that you're here to track down the dangerous culprit behind a series of Mania incidents.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't think you can trap me with this fog. Mad Shears of the Foggy Night, your end has come. Your identity will be exposed sooner or later. You can't escape!
Foggy night, clock chimes, inside the dark alley.
Your shackles clash violently with the blades of the shears. The shackles break, and the shears also snap into two.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ugh... I've been careless... They were all minor cases... I never expected that the culprit would be... an <color=#fb9259>S-Class Sinner</color>. If I had known, I should have... cough cough! !

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ha... it doesn't matter. The shears broke. It's a tie... You're also surprised. You fear the shackles...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...It's not over yet... I swear...

Alongside the chaotic murmurs and the townspeople's screams, your shattered memories return to you bit by bit. You want to grab them, yet you feel fear—but either way, your march towards the clock dial is unstoppable.
Let go... Let go of me...
The last bit of memory wafts back into your brain.
You try desperately to crawl out. The alley is just ahead. You hear someone walking towards you, but your memory keeps dissipating.
...It's you... I know you... I...
You see yourself reaching out to the other shear on the dial...
The moment before you touch it, someone hugs you from behind.
Enough... You already have too many worries...
You smell a familiar fragrance... a soft, gentle breath.
Or is it... Mad Shears?

speaker: Adela
content: Don't force yourself. This isn't something you can withstand.

speaker: Adela
content: Leave it to me. It's my job to begin with...
She puts her hands on your trembling hands, trying to take away the shears, but you hold on tightly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This pair of shears is the source of Mania... Don't touch them. They'll control you and bombard you with illusions... You'll turn into Mad Shears...

speaker: Adela
content: Don't worry. They belong to me in the first place. I lost them, that's all. These are <color=#fb9259>my shears</color>.

speaker: Adela
content: These aren't illusions that you see. They're real... Heavy locks of burdensome hair.
What is she saying? You have a head-splitting headache. You hear the sounds of struggle from the outside world. The fog suffocates you, and you can't see Adela clearly.

speaker: Adela
content: More and more hair grew... It was my job to cut them, but I broke the shears and didn't retrieve them in time.

speaker: Adela
content: A single shear can only tug and scrape hair, but it can't sever worries. The person who picked it up suffered a lot. Everyone suffered a lot. Even you saw such ghastly things.

speaker: Adela
content: Sorry... Thank you for finding the other shear for me. Leave the rest to me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Have you been... deceiving me all along?
She pauses, but finally leaves the question unanswered. She just silently takes back both shear blades and gently presses them together. Click...
The moment the two shears conjoin, a powerful force floods the entire clock tower. You feel a familiar and terrifying force behind you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop, Adela, don't...

speaker: Adela
content: It's time for work. When I come back, and all this is over, you'll be happy...
With a swipe of the sharp blade, Adela disappears, leaving behind only the all-consuming fog.
The fog in the street gradually dissipates, but the gloomy weather remains suffocating.

speaker: Resident
content: Wh-who's there? Shears, st-stay away! Ahhhh!

speaker: Resident
content: No, I beg you... No!!!!
In the darkness of night, you hear bloodcurdling screams all over the alley—people are begging the real Mad Shears to stop.
It's too late. As the shears gleam, the monsters made of worries disappear, and so does Adela. Yet you bump into another woman head-on.
She stands in the middle of the street in a daze. You've seen her before. It's the "Mad Shears" who had been controlled by the shears. The cursed hair entangling her had disappeared without a trace.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: ...It's you? Why are you here.
She now has an eerie, nonchalant smile on her face.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: I get it, I get it. You're better than me, braver and stronger and more hardworking... You're all awesome. Everyone's better than me.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Hehe... It doesn't matter. Even so, I have nothing to envy. Nothing at all.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Mad Shears made my wish come true. Mad Shears severed all my worries. I won't worry anymore. I don't need to try anymore. I'm worthless, yay...
You look up and see a flickering lantern not far away. It seems a bit scared, hanging back but still close by.

options: ...I still have urgent matters to attend to.

speaker: %u
content: When this is all over, I'll come back to see you. Take care.

speaker: Mad Shears
content: Hehe, why work so hard... I was so stupid back then, hehe... so stupid...
Another scream rings out in the distance.
You run towards it.
You dash to the middle of the square. The fog is still there, but the people you talked to are nowhere to be found.
Only Hannah, who didn't have her "worries severed," runs back home to her mother's side, sobbing all the way. She's still the most important person to her, and the person she needs most.
If Adela gets to Hannah first, what will happen to Hannah's mother? And what will happen to those whose "worries" have already been severed by her?
You shudder in anxiety and fear at the thought of all those blank and dazed faces.
Stop letting the shears control you! Stop! Come back!!
Isn't this the street you cherish?! Aren't these the people you care about? Don't hurt them! You shouldn't do this!
The thick fog devours even your echoes. You get no response. You want to run, but there's nowhere to run to.
Who else is there? Who else would she attack? Who else on Sloane Street...
...Yeah... Isn't the answer the obvious?
Realizing this, your legs go weak and you slump to the ground.
The surroundings have completely quieted down. No more strange hair, no more Mad Shears, and no more hysterical screams for help.
That's right. Adela has "severed" everyone here.

Unable to shake off her past, Andrea abandons her conscience. Socially awkward Ritz dumps his troublesome lover, and idealistic Kentor quits his job. All of them are no longer pestered by their past worries.
Plus that extreme worrywart of a woman whom you don't know and who had been controlled by the shears.

The clock chimes ten times through the fog. Adela said that she usually leaves work at around 10 o'clock. No wonder she hasn't come for you yet... She's probably cleaning up her salon right now. She likes to stick to her schedule.
You had planned to go pick her up. Now, she'll be coming to find you soon, with that crazy pair of shears.
How will you deal with her now?
With your missing power?
With your incomplete memory?
With...
Just yourself alone?

Are the shears controlling Adela, too? Or is that a lie, too? If she knew the truth from the beginning, what went on in her mind when she watched you rush around these few days doing your investigation?
She was once your only confidante, but now, she's your only worry. Other than that, you have nothing.
Something suddenly slams you in the back, then jumps and hangs onto your neck.

speaker: Short Shadow Girl
content: Big... bad... dummy... gimme... pocket... money—!

speaker: %u
content: ...Is this what you were like before, too? Pestering others when they have important things to do?

speaker: Short Shadow Girl
content: Important things? What important things? Who gives a damn about that!

speaker: Short Shadow Girl
content: Pocket money pocket money pocket money pocket money!!
She totally disregards your worries, hanging and swinging from your neck with a playful smile. You can't help but sigh.

speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
content: You feel tired, Chief? Are we bothering you?

speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
content: I see... I couldn't help Chief, and became a burden instead. My very existence is a burden to Chief. I'm sorry...

speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
content: Can Mad Shears completely get rid of people's worries? If it severs me, will Chief be able to stop worrying about me?

speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
content: Then I'll go find Mad Shears right now...
She grabs the short shadow and tries to leave, but you grab both of them.

speaker: Short Shadow Girl
content: Pocket money pocket money gimme pocket money you big dummy!!

speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
content: Can't let Chief worry, can't let Chief worry...
How can I forget about you two little troublemakers...
As you say that, you give the two of them a big hug.

Amidst all the pesky, tiresome and infuriating "worries", there are some that one wants to hold on to no matter how annoying they are. It's not that one can't get rid of them, but because they are treasures that one can't bear to part with.

options: Thank you for keep pestering me.

speaker: %u
content: Come back to me, my "worries"...

In your embrace, the two apparitions dissolve into specks of red light and return to your palm, gradually restoring your memories and clearing your dazed mind. You can feel that there are those who care about you on the other side of the shackles.
Now, it's time to go on a date with Adela.
The only person in the quiet salon is the hairdresser herself. She's washing her hands, as if she had just finished a long, busy day.

How many people's "worries" did those hands sever? In other words, how many cherished relationships did those hands break off? Only God knows. Her face is still so calm and tranquil as she looks at you.

speaker: Adela
content: ...I didn't expect you to come find me on your own. And still looking so disheveled.
Those coldly gleaming shears have been put aside. You shift your gaze and look back into her eyes.

options: Do I actually look that bad?

speaker: Adela
content: Yeah. You're full of worries, and your hair is so long.

speaker: Adela
content: Want me to give you a trim?

options: Before that, I'd like a more basic service.

content: You ruffle your bangs.

speaker: %u
content: I messed up my hair again. Can I ask <color=#fb9259>hairdresser</color> Adela to fix it for me?

speaker: Adela
content: ...Of course. Whatever you need.
She smiles and pulls back the barber chair. You saunter up to it and sit down quietly.
Like some unspoken ritual, the two of you return to this spot, intimate yet wary.
It's as if you're a regular customer of hers.

speaker: %u
content: Like you always do.

speaker: Adela
content: What do you want to chat about?

speaker: %u
content: I'll listen to whatever you want to tell me. Just like what you did for me before.
The corners of her mouth twitch, as if she wants to give you a smile, but in the end she doesn't. After pondering for a moment, Adela speaks up again.

speaker: Adela
content: ...I don't have anything in particular that I want to talk about. I'll just pick a topic that you would be interested in.

speaker: And Miss Campbell, she's gone too...
content: ...It's about the story of <color=#fb9259>"Mad Shears"</color>.

Her fingers brush behind your ears as she gently fixes your hair. The shears return to that intimate distance. One snip after another, your hair tips fly amidst the gleams again, but this time, you don't shudder.

speaker: Adela
content: A long time ago, there was a lucky little girl who didn't have any worries. She lived a peaceful life and liked it very much. She thought everyone was like her.

speaker: Adela
content: But that wasn't the case. Life was not good for everyone, and slowly, the people she loved sprouted long, long hair. Hair that could not be cut off. Hair that suffocated the soul.

speaker: Adela
content: Everyone lived in pain, and could only vent their discontent through words.

speaker: Adela
content: The girl wanted to help. She listened to them, took care of them, and did all that she could. Sometimes, their symptoms could be soothed by a cup of black tea, and other times by tears. But ultimately, there was no cure.

speaker: Adela
content: The girl finally realized she could do so little. Those were other people's worries, which they can't let go of so long as they remember them.

speaker: Adela
content: So the girl prayed to gain the power to help people forget, and was bestowed a pair of <color=#fb9259>magical shears</color>.

speaker: She just ran down there... Damn it! Hella? Hella, where are you?!
content: Worrisome hairs are condensed and severed with each cut, vanishing forever into the ether. The people she loved no longer wallowed in resentment. They forgot everything that worried them, and regained their joyful smiles.

speaker: Adela
content: The girl's wish came true. She thanked the magical shears, and vowed to protect everyone forever.

speaker: Adela
content: ...That's the story of Mad Shears. Everyone lived happily ever after.
The shears halt. She gently brushes aside your fallen hair, and locks eyes with you in the mirror.

speaker: Adela
content: All finished. How do you like this haircut?

options: Thank you, I like it very much.

speaker: %u
content: I look exactly the same as the old me.

speaker: Adela
content: You remember now? Then do you remember what you said to me on that first night?

speaker: %u
content: I remember.
That night, in the depths of the foggy alley, you watched her walk up to you. The last words you uttered before your memory was completely shattered were...

speaker: Adela
content: Correct.

The cold gleam of the shears flashes by, shattering all the mirrors at once. Everything goes back to square one, back to the unfinished battle between "Mad Shears" and the investigator on that first night.
The incredible might of this S-Class Sinner forces you to back up step by step. The threat that the shears pose to your shackles constrains you.

options: It's not time to admit defeat yet.

speaker: Adela
content: It's no use. I've seen this power already. You won't give me any more surprises.
The spikes of red light bursting from your palm flood the whole room, but Adela is even faster. She knocks you to the ground with a heavy blow and holds you down.
The night wind is ice-cold, and the dim light illuminates the hairdresser holding you down.

speaker: Adela
content: A for effort. Are these called shackles? They really are quite powerful... Usually, whatever I sever is completely forgotten. You're the first person to ever regain something I've severed.

speaker: Adela
content: Why get these shackles back? A power that condemns you to loneliness, suffocating responsibilities, endless dilemmas, unavoidable battles and an unknown fate...

speaker: Adela
content: It's the saddest thing I've ever encountered. I see that you're sprouting long, long hair again.

speaker: Adela
content: Shall I cut it for you? You're such a good person. You deserve a simple, happy life.
You try to push her off, but she doesn't budge, so you give up struggling and try to think of a response as you lie flat on your back.

options: Really? I think it's fine to have hair like that.

speaker: %u
content: Don't I look cool with my bright smile shining through those hairs of worry?
A smile shows on her face.

speaker: Adela
content: You look cool right now, but what about the future?

speaker: Adela
content: You've touched my shears before. You know what those scenes look like. They aren't just illusions.

speaker: Adela
content: That kind of hair grows like madness. You can't get rid of it, nor can you make it stop. It's bound to crush you one day.
