With her huge sword, she picks up a dead Corruptor and tosses it at the Liaison Officer. The second the Paradeisos man grabs Shalom's arm, he gets knocked off forcefully. Frightened, the others retreat a few steps.
The spilled contamination spatters onto the hem of Shalom's skirt. She turns back to glimpse at her attacked companions, then replaces her gaze on Rahu expressionlessly.

speaker: Shalom
content: That won't do it. Violence is not enough to get the answer you want. I'll show you how.
She turns to Garofano who's on her last breath beneath Rahu.

speaker: Shalom
content: The Sinner under your feet is wanted by Paradeisos. I need her to complete something important.

speaker: Shalom
content: You can threaten me with her life, then threaten the higher-ups with mine. That way, Paradeisos may spare you a glance.
She spoke these words with a smile. As Rahu watched, memories of scrolling intelligence and data flashed in her mind, and her vision gradually blurred with a reddish haze.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...You were never their disposable pawn. You're one of them. You are Paradeisos. You...

speaker: Shalom
content: Hate alone gets you nothing. Do it, Rahu. Either to her or to me. What's stopping you?

speaker: Shalom
content: You've chosen to be the most resolute avenger. Then hesitation is your worst enemy.

speaker: Shalom
content: Or do you suddenly regret hurting her? You want to protect her now? Because you're an FAC soldier?

Shalom steps closer, slowly but directly making her way to Rahu, followed only by that floating Schorl triangle. She walks over those Corruptor remains trembling in the heavy Blue Rain, unbothered by the dead bodies.
Rahu's temple throbs rapidly and the harder it is to control the sword in her hand. It threatens to crush Shalom's statue-like icy smile.

speaker: Rahu
content: Enough... Stop trying to manipulate me with your words. What did you do in DisSea? What exactly did you do ten years ago?!

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't you know the answer already? Why ask? What do you want to hear from me?

speaker: Rahu
content: Answer my question! Are you...

speaker: Shalom
content: I am.
Shalom stops where she can be easily struck once the huge sword is swung. Her smile is ice-cold, denying all burning emotions.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm the user of channel 05257885.

speaker: Shalom
content: What are you going to do?

Icy rain drenched her from head to toe. The world seemed to freeze in an instant, everything before her becoming crystal clear. Each raindrop stood out distinctly, slowly sinking along with a decade of smoldering hatred—making her truly calm for the first time.

Rahu saw lies in this wax-figure-like woman. But she has also glimpsed the sliver of truth behind those lies, amongst the cracks of the façade. A heavy curtain of secrecy slowly descended between them, yet for the first time, it was so close to Rahu, almost within reach.
Her anger is extinguished, replaced by a profound, crystal-clear determination. Rahu reaches out—
How dare you step on my flower?

Something interrupted her. On the other side of the garden, a white streak of light slowly traced its way, faint yet visible, slithering like a snake into the darkness. Not far off, the white light connected with several security officers, and the first scream echoed.
Garofano quivers once. The dark substance spilling everywhere is not blood, but bright red petals. They bloom out of the human body and instantly gather into strange spikes aiming at her.
Rahu saw it and raised her shield to intercept, blocking them all. Then, a few more flew in, grazing past Rahu, missing their mark.
...No, they didn't miss. This round of attack is aimed at...
More spikes break through the Blue Rain and soar past Rahu, aiming at Shalom with deadly force.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Finally.

Blue beams strafe across the field all of a sudden, wrecking everything with the cutting cold light. When silence falls again, in the incessant Blue Rain, an object floats in the air quietly, pitch-black as the night. The Schorl that's been following Shalom.
Where Rahu was standing is now empty. Garofano has been taken away. Only a strip of cut-off white lace lies on the ground. The enemies are already gone.
But it doesn't matter. The program ran smoothly and the threat has been removed. The Schorl is switched back on standby mode and hovers back to Shalom.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Yes, I saw her. It's okay. If she showed up tonight, she'll show up again.

speaker: Shalom
content: And even if I want to chase after her now, I can't.
Rahu props herself up above her. Her back is deeply pierced by several red crystal spikes, that unknown Sinner's power. These spikes are sapping Rahu's life, but the deeper wounds are in front.
Her stomach and shoulders are shot through by the beams, the heat hurting her internal organs. The culprit of these wounds is Shalom's Schorl, which is now staring coldly at this like a dark phantom.

speaker: Shalom
content: Fatal wounds... It must hurt a lot. You moved too fast, I couldn't stop it in time.

speaker: Shalom
content: I didn't think you'd go that far... Why, Rahu...
She gently touches Rahu's wounds, then she reaches out to take off that menacing face mask. A pool of blood pours down from the face mask, wetting Shalom's chest.

Beneath the mask, the soldier is losing her vitality rapidly, she is struggling to hang on. Shalom gently wiped Rahu's cheek, calmly clearing away the blood, and waiting for her to voice her final resolve.

speaker: Rahu
content: Because... you were lying... You were provoking me on purpose, I could tell...

speaker: Rahu
content: Why? Who were you harboring... What were you covering up... Tell me... the truth...

speaker: Shalom
content: ...You got me. I was so close... Fine, I'll tell you.
Shalom sits up and wraps the incapacitated warrior in her arms. Under the Schorl's gaze, her soft voice flows into Rahu's ear.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm the user of that channel, but not the 052 you're looking for. I was her replacement in the Eclipse Operation. When she became unavailable, I took her place. That's what we were, tools.

speaker: Shalom
content: But had I been there, I would have done the same. So rest easy, you didn't miss your chance for revenge or hate the wrong person.

speaker: Shalom
content: If we're talking about the people you should hate, there are way too many...
Rahu could barely hear her words, her body collapsing is making her consciousness fade, but as it did, that very resolve became even clearer.

speaker: Rahu
content: Was that... a test too? Betraying me, provoking me, mocking me... All of this just to...

speaker: Rahu
content: See if I make a good tool...?

speaker: Shalom
content: The tool test was over long ago. You'd already failed the moment everyone saw you return. You're not cut out to be a tool. You're destined to be free, unlike me.

speaker: Shalom
content: So if I were to take you to Paradeisos, I must do it another way.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your rationality may not defeat all madness, but your loyalty can. Loyalty beats all your irrational thoughts and guides you to the truth. It's the most invincible, reliable, and everlasting thing.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're the best knight there is. No tools can compare. Paradeisos will want you, and only one step remains. I'll get you there. I'll help you gain their absolute trust.
The soft words eat away at Rahu's consciousness, until she senses a strange existence enveloping her body quietly, all premonitions of pain, numbness, and death fading.

speaker: Rahu
content: What... is this...
Behind Shalom, in a realm so distant yet so near, a flickering existence appears quietly. Colossal and ice-cold, it extends countless tentacles of light, touching every corner of Rahu's soul.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Is this your ability? What are you doing to me?

speaker: Shalom
content: You've suffered fatal injuries. You're dying. That's the reality. The only thing that can bend reality is Mania. I'll guide you through it.

speaker: Shalom
content: I don't have the power to fight in real battles, but I can touch everyone's Mania and guide it to realize their will. As long as you want to live, with my power, reality can't kill you.

speaker: Shalom
content: And after that, our minds will be inseparable. The more you use your power, the more you'll submit to my orders. This way, Paradeisos will be completely reassured too.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...You want to control me?

speaker: Shalom
content: You're free to refuse. Your soul is way stronger than I imagined. You can still make your own choice. You may choose death and forgo all your freedom and duties... but I hope you can live.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're the most impressive exception in my plans and the biggest surprise. Don't die, Rahu.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'd hate that.

speaker: Rahu
content: Ha... Haha...

speaker: Rahu
content: Do it. Use your power... And I'll use mine.

speaker: Rahu
content: Let's see if I can kill you before you dominate me...

Shalom smiles. She places her hand on Rahu's shoulder. The pain eases. Rahu wants to go ahead and end everything, but fails to sense the result of her action, as if suddenly stranded in a wilderness in the mind. Darkness falls, and a chasm splits the wilderness open.

Countless lights peeked through the gaps, as if someone was spying, entwining her, draining her. Memories surged like a torrential river. Images embraced her, only to be devoured and fragmented. Familiar faces approached, melting away to be replaced by the visages of others.

Rahu reached out, trying to grasp something, but it slipped through her fingers like a fleeting memory. She looked at her empty palm, then forward into the vast darkness, where even the stars seemed bottomless. The only thing left in her ears was a singular voice.
Keep running, Rahu. Keeping running, that's the meaning of life.
Finally, the world quieted down, everything dissolving. Rahu took a step, venturing into the depths of the dark. From that moment on, there was no more confusion.

speaker: Schorl
content: You've spent more time than expected. Your physical condition is unstable too.

speaker: Schorl
content: Did you use your ability?

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes. I'd planned to crush her with hatred at first, but I failed. She's stronger than I thought. <color=#fb9259>Subduing</color> her has cost more than I expected... But it's worth it.

speaker: Shalom
content: She was loyal to me in the first place. It filled in the gap in the plan. She is no longer a risk factor.

speaker: Shalom
content: With the current state of affairs, I can't just rely on my existing power. I need a strong and loyal protector. Paradeisos needs more reliable Sinners, something more reliable than the MBCC.

speaker: Shalom
content: The Underground power previously lurking in Eastside has probably already relocated to West District. The measures they've left to hinder us are sketchy and the intelligence is full of discrepancies.

speaker: Shalom
content: These bland recent attacks were likely just smoke and mirrors for two possible purposes.

speaker: Shalom
content: Either the 9th agency has pressured them enough in West District that they must fight for their survival, or the Underground has a more serious plan and they must distract us.

speaker: Schorl
content: Are you going back to West District? The FAC is plotting large-scale warfare in August and could use some support.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm heading there now. Now that I have her, at least I won't need extra replacements. The sooner I'm done with that, the sooner I can be back.

speaker: Shalom
content: There's still something here that interests me.
A loud voice breaks into the mansion, and next the already broken door is kicked into pieces. A petite figure dashes in.
Shalom!!!
The intruder grabs Shalom by her waist.

speaker: Blonde Girl
content: I heard you got attacked, are you alright, does it hurt, when, where, who's this bastard, why did they do that, and did you catch them?

speaker: Blonde Girl
content: Arghh!! You're bleeding so much on your chest!!

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm fine, my little detective. Look closely, it's not my blood.

speaker: Blonde Girl
content: ...Oh, oh, you're right. Anyone who's lost this much blood won't be standing.

speaker: Blonde Girl
content: Ahhhh.... I'm being silly again! But you must tell me if you're in danger! So many bad guys are after you. When I think of what they might do to you, I feel like my head's gonna explode. I've sworn not to let you get hurt again!

Shalom smiles and gently combs the ginger girl's hair with her fingers. The girl's eyes brim with worry, but she can't conceal her joy from Shalom's caring gesture. She doesn't try to hide her admiration for Shalom.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't worry, Christina. Someone protected me.

speaker: Christina
content: Who?! Someone other than me?
The ginger girl suddenly gets vigilant. The little detective follows Shalom's gaze and finally notices the tall, silent warrior standing on the side.
The warrior looks at her expressionlessly, but the shield in her hand has turned into a huge sword, waiting to be swung the second she senses something wrong.

speaker: Shalom
content: Her name is Rahu. She's an FAC warrior, just like your family.

speaker: Christina
content: ...You're an FAC soldier too?

speaker: Christina
content: The wounds on your body, did you get them from protecting others... protecting Shalom?
The girl's voice softens. She studies the scars and blood stains all over Rahu, concern and admiration glinting in her eyes.
Rahu turns her face to the side and lowers her weapon. Took a step back and remained silent.

speaker: Shalom
content: She's honorable and reliable, a true knight, just like you. I depend on you both.

speaker: Shalom
content: Chris, an extremely important and arduous mission is coming up. I'll need your power.

speaker: Shalom
content: Can I expect help from our famous detective?

speaker: Christina
content: ...Of course. Of course! You don't need to ask!
Shalom smiles. The car rumbles outside the house. She turns and walks outside. The rain has stopped, but the person next to the car still puts Shalom's jacket over her shoulders deftly.

speaker: Shalom
content: The group that provokes Paradeisos is known as <color=#fb9259>the Garden</color>. They were once a Sinner assassin group reared by the Underground.

speaker: Shalom
content: They may have severed ties with the Underground, or they may still be in touch. Doesn't matter. What matters is that someone in the group must know the entrance to the Underground.

speaker: Shalom
content: Find their boss, or prepare for her arrival.

09:00, August 8, N.F. 113
FAC Memorial Cemetery
West District Combat Casualty Memorial Service

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: Today, we gather here to honor our 1423 warriors, friends, and fellow citizens.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: In the March catastrophe, they selflessly rushed to the West District, sacrificing their lives to combat the sudden outbreak of Mania.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: Now that the disaster has been contained, the call to counterattack is ready to sound, and FAC can finally return them to their loved ones.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: Thank you for coming, to bid our heroes their final farewell.

speaker: Mourner
content: My child, did you come alone? Where is your family? Ah... I shouldn't have asked...

speaker: Mourner
content: I'm sorry, it must be hard for you... Sigh...

speaker: Christina
content: Thank you... I'm here on behalf of someone else, it's okay.

speaker: Christina
content: I'll be strong.

speaker: Voice in the Memory
content: A memorial? Heh, it's enough that you go. Aren't you also their "daughter"? Even if you're adopted, they loved you more.

speaker: Voice in the Memory
content: I won't go.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: This era is riddled with scars, the nights are long, and the path is unclear. But there are always those who believe, who stand and fight for the city-state they deeply love, and sacrifice for the future they firmly believe in.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: They are the heroes who guard the light in darkness, the warriors who reclaim hope in despair. We will never forget.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: And for you, our heroes have returned.

speaker: Voice in the Memory
content: ...What... do you want to comfort me? Or is it... you want my comfort?

speaker: Voice in the Memory
content: Just because my parents died, you think we're finally the same, that we can sympathize with each other?

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: This cemetery was built for you and also for them. They hope you will come because they long to see their loved ones safe.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: Please visit them often. Seeing you safe and sound is the greatest meaning of every FAC battle.

speaker: Miserable Girl
content: Get lost! I'm not like you, I don't buy into FAC's crap, I don't recognize these kinds of heroes!

speaker: Miserable Girl
content: They're dead, that's all there is to it. They left me behind, made me an orphan too! What kind of heroes are they?!

speaker: Miserable Girl
content: Sob... screw light and justice... dying for these nonsensical ideas... You're all idiots, all of you...

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: ...Thank you for coming.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: May our city-state be free from suffering, may our fellow citizens be forever safe.
A soft Blue Rain falls. The FAC memorial service always has this apt atmosphere, both to purify the BR-002 contamination that has spread throughout the city and to mourn the fallen heroes.
Christina leaves the cemetery, finds a secluded spot, puts away her umbrella, and looks up at the sky.
Blue Rain hits her face, gathering in streaks, mixing with tears sliding down her cheeks, tracing the marks of Mania stress. How she wishes this pain could bring her clarity.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Hold onto light... believe... in justice...

speaker: Christina
content: I will... I'm strong...
The ring of her phone suddenly interrupts. She absent-mindedly takes out her mobile, but as she recognizes the familiar melody, her dull eyes suddenly light up. She jumps in an instant.

speaker: Christina
content: Shalom! You're back!

speaker: Christina
content: Oh... you've been so busy... I thought...

speaker: Christina
content: What?! Those Underground guys are causing trouble again? Another series of attacks by Garden Assassins? Despicable! They can't win on the battlefield, so they resort to dirty tricks behind our backs.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Huh? You want me to be a special investigator?! Really?!

speaker: Christina
content: Yes, yes, of course I'll do it! I will do my best to complete the mission that you gave me. I swear on the name of the <size=25><color=#7683a2>future</color></size> great detective Christina, I will set off right now!
She hangs up the call and starts to dash. She leaps three feet high after taking a few steps.

speaker: Christina
content: Shalom is counting on me! For light and justice!

On August 8, N.F. 113, FAC Commander-in-Chief leaves the West District combat frontline and returns to Eastside, formally submitting the <color=#fb9259>"BR-002 Black Ring Blockade Operation"</color> authorization application to the City Council. The intention is to build a counter-Mania shield around BR-002 to limit the spread of Black Ring contamination and completely stabilize the West District environment.


The establishment of FAC is to protect DisCity. The West District is a part of Dis, and the people of the West District are DisCitizens who should be protected.


They should not be abandoned.

The operation has initially gained the support of Paradeisos. The specifics of funding, manpower, organizational authority, and other matters will be jointly evaluated by representatives including Nirvana, and the final review will be completed on <color=#fb9259>August 15</color>.

speaker: News
content: Recently, several key figures in Eastside have received anonymous threat letters, and attacks have been happening.

speaker: News
content: The incidents occurred just as the situation in the West District was getting under control, making the timing of these events quite intriguing. Although there have been no fatalities so far, inside sources reveal that these series of incidents are closely linked to the serial assassination incidents from three weeks ago.

speaker: News
content: If the mastermind behind these incidents isn't caught soon, the number of cases of harm could escalate, having a detrimental impact on society.

speaker: Christina
content: ...It's already escalating.

16:00, August 8, N.F. 113
Eastside Central Park, Bloom Courtyard
"Sunken Blossom" crime scene

speaker: Christina
content: These are sensitive times. If this scene gets captured by the press and gets out, not only will the public opinion explode, but it'll also cause panic among the people, and...

speaker: Christina
content: Unlike the previous attacks, the scene has been meticulously arranged with no intent to hide the motive—this isn't a covert assassination, but an overtly flaunted ritual.

speaker: Christina
content: Hmph, what a show-off, you've caught my attention.

speaker: Christina
content: According to <size=25><color=#7683a2>Shalom's</color></size> inside information, these series of incidents are the work of a Sinner, and there's a high chance that the scene is contaminated with <color=#fb9259>Mania</color>. Everyone, please step back!
Everyone is taken aback, and those near the scene have already retreated out of fear.

speaker: Christina
content: Although Sinner incidents are under MBCC jurisdiction, they've been under a lot of pressure recently, and their Chief is missing. Until he returns, I'll take over. I've studied their case files thoroughly.
female_content: Although Sinner incidents are under MBCC jurisdiction, they've been under a lot of pressure recently, and their Chief is missing. Until she returns, I'll take over. I've studied their case files thoroughly.

content: She pulls at her gloves with a serious expression.

speaker: Christina
content: Detective Christina will definitely overcome the danger and bring the truth to light!
It unlocked. Christina quickly checks the messages inside the phone. Among a pile of irrelevant high society life, she finds a text message worth noting.

<color=#fb9259>Tel: 043176889</color> 

Hi, Anania, remember me? Heh, I bet you do, your phone number hasn't changed. Neither have I. I'm a bit short on money recently, and you were the first one I thought of.
I still remember the <color=#fb9259>incident from ten years ago</color>, yes, at that little pond. It's our little secret, you wouldn't want me to lose it, would you?
<color=#fb9259>See you at 11 pm tomorrow at Central Park.</color>
If you don't come... something else might come to you.

23:12, August 6, N.F. 113

speaker: Christina
content: This is it! The victim rushed here because of this message and then met her fate. This is a message from the murderer!

speaker: Christina
content: Hmph, even left a phone number, what an arrogant culprit. Have no respect for lives and even declare war on us. I'll find out who you are right now!

speaker: Christina
content: Log into the system, apply to search the owner of this number... and information about the victim. The victim's name is... Anania...
Christina is fully focused on operating the security intranet, waiting for the response, completely unaware of a large shadow cast over her.

speaker: Unpleasant Man
content: ...Where did this brat come from? Who are you? Why did you barge into the crime scene?

speaker: Christina
content: Hmm? Crisp shirt but messy shoes and socks. Your wife must have carefully ironed that for you but ran out of time, and you just slipped on any shoes. And the only guy in the precinct who's been flaunting wedding gifts recently is...

speaker: Christina
content: You must be Inspector Dole, the person in charge of this case! I am the <size=25><color=#7683a2>future</color></size> famous detective Christina, here to...

speaker: Christina
content: Ouuuch!

speaker: Christina
content: My name is <color=#fb9259>Christina</color>, a freshman at the City Security Academy, doing a summer internship at the Eastside local security precinct. I'm assigned to assist with the investigation. I'm sorry I didn't immediately report to the person in charge of the scene.

speaker: Dole
content: Who let a freshman intern on the scene? What if you spoil the evidence? Get lost!

speaker: Sheriff
content: Inspector, actually she...
After hearing a few whispers, the inspector's expression changes from grumpy to surprised, then to indifferent and disgusted.

speaker: Dole
content: So you know the higher-ups... Humph, got quite a strong backer. Can't you build your resume somewhere else?

speaker: Christina
content: Sir, I'm not here for my resume, I'm here for the truth. I can do it, just like believing in the everlasting existence of justice and light, please give me a chance!
As she speaks, her pocket vibrates, a message has arrived on her communication terminal. Christina pulls it out and looks at it, even more excited.

speaker: Christina
content: Look, I've found the first suspect! The owner of this suspicious phone number is a 48-year-old male called <color=#fb9259>Nathan</color>. The file says he's an Eastsider, but his past is very suspicious. Please allow me to keep investigating!
The girl's impassioned speech is met with silence. Eventually, the inspector sighs.

speaker: Dole
content: I just can't get rid of you, can I? Fine, stay over there and watch, don't interfere with the investigation. Now, hand me the victim's phone.

speaker: Christina
content: Oh... Here, sir...
She hands over the phone with a regretful look on her face, moving as slowly as if she were holding a 100kg dumbbell, clearly reluctant. But just then...
The victim's phone suddenly rings, the incoming call display shows [043176889].

speaker: Dole
content: <size=28><color=#7683a2>Hand signal</color></size> Speaker...
Christina nods and presses the speaker button. A strange male voice comes from the other end of the phone.

speaker: Strange Male Voice
content: Hello there, rookie detective. Enjoying your little detective game?

speaker: Christina
content: You're Nathan?! Show yourself, murderer!

speaker: Strange Male Voice
content: That's not quite right. Anania is still alive, the flowers are her life. They're still blooming brilliantly.

speaker: Strange Male Voice
content: Don't move, if you crush those flowers, you'll become the murderer.
Christina quickly looks down. Indeed, when she was hopping around nervously, she almost stepped into the pool.

speaker: Christina
content: ...You jerk, just you wait, I'm checking the communication location now, and everyone who's making a call. I will search the entire city to find you!
...Wait.
How did he know <color=#fb9259>I was about to step on the flowers</color>?
Christina jumps up abruptly, her head swinging like a rattle drum, scanning the surroundings in a 360-degree panorama. A telescope, a disguise, anything will do.

speaker: Christina
content: <color=#fb9259>He can see me</color>! The murderer is nearby! Wherever he is, he can see me, so look for anyone making a call. Go quickly!

speaker: Dole
content: Keep it down, you're startling him! Over there!
The inspector raises his gun and fires a shot, aiming at a sheriff who is guarding the blockade. It's a good shot, but the sheriff deflects it with a wave of her hand.
The "sheriff" presses down her hat and turns to run towards the crowd, causing a wave of screams wherever she goes.

speaker: Dole
content: Of course it's a Sinner. Everyone listen to me, immediately—

speaker: Christina
content: Leave it to me, I will catch the murderer and uncover the truth!

The inspector stretches out his hand to grab Christina, but is pulled by her brute strength, then he stumbles and falls to the ground. When he looks up again, the ginger girl has already run off like a runaway horse.
The "sheriff" who fled is exceptionally agile, quickly shaking off the majority of the pursuers by several streets and darting into a small alley.

It's a dead-end, but she easily climbs over a wall more than 4 meters high using a nearby crate with elegant posture. She looks back with a rather proud look, the only one who has kept up with her is the intern detective Christina.

speaker: Suspect
content: So you are the Sinner specially recruited by the investigation team, huh... Your speed and stamina are not bad, but your movements are clumsy.

speaker: Suspect
content: Hey~ Can you even climb up?

speaker: Christina
content: No need!
She grabs her cane and swings it forcefully, it breaks through the entire wall like a hammer. The suspect is instantly swallowed up by the smoke and dust from the collapse.

speaker: Christina
content: Phew... I didn't expect you'd be a woman. You used a voice changer, didn't you?

speaker: Suspect
content: How hurtful, didn't you notice after chasing me for so long? It's so obvious.
Her voice comes from above and behind her, Christina quickly turns around to see that the woman has already jumped onto the fire escape 2-story high, looking down at her from above.

speaker: Suspect
content: Look, my graceful movements, top-notch figure, and you didn't notice... Are you still a kid, or just stupid?

As she speaks, she sizes Christina up, curling her lip in disdain. Then, with one hand on her hip and her chest lifted, she reveals her perfect figure, raising her other hand elegantly and lightly pressing her chest.

speaker: Suspect
content: Want me to teach you some toning techniques, cu-tie de-tec-tive?

speaker: Christina
content: No thanks! I'm in great shape!
A brief pause in the skirmish reveals Christina's numerous injuries, yet she hasn't even managed to touch the woman's hair. The enemy's strength far exceeds expectations.
She watches Christina, who is now panting heavily.

speaker: Suspect
content: I thought a specially dispatched Sinner detective would be more capable. You're quite the disappointment, young missy.

speaker: Christina
content: Hmph, I couldn't care less about your opinion.
While talking tough, Christina secretly observes the weapon in the woman's hand.
It's a crimson crystallized dagger, drawn from thin air, adorned with a few strange flowers—the same as the Mania Flower found on the victim, Anania.

speaker: Christina
content: I knew it was you. Must be my lucky day to catch the real culprit so quickly.

speaker: Christina
content: You left the crime scene in such an extravagant state, flaunting your Mania abilities. Were you taunting us? Or were you hoping to be praised by others?

speaker: Christina
content: Ha, you're a show-off and a narcissist, thinking everyone in the world will dance to your tune. You were fooling us over the phone while admiring your own performance art up close... Hmph, too bad you ran into me!

speaker: Christina
content: Let me, the <size=25><color=#7683a2>future</color></size> great detective Christina, show you what a real setback looks like.

speaker: Suspect
content: Heh, did they teach you profiling in your first year of school? That answer is passable, I guess.

speaker: Suspect
content: But you're a bit slow, silly girl. I've been giving you clues since my first sentence to you.

speaker: Suspect
content: Hello there, rookie detective.

speaker: Suspect
content: The experienced inspector knew the scene was being watched the moment he heard that. He searched for suspects carefully and discreetly without causing a stir. And you? You were 47 seconds late and shouting like an imbecile.

speaker: Christina
content: Well... I don't need you lecturing me! Come with me, confess everything, tell us how and why you committed these crimes, and whether you had accomplices.

speaker: Christina
content: You said Anania isn't dead, that you turned her into a flower. Can she still be saved?

speaker: Christina
content: Remove your ability! Right now, you're only guilty of assault and will be supervised in MBCC. But if you cross that line, you'll be a murderer, and trampling on life is an unforgivable crime! You—

speaker: Suspect
content: Hahahaha!

speaker: Suspect
content: Ha... nothing, just thought of something funny. It's been a while since I've seen someone like you...
Without blinking, Christina watches as the woman disappears before her eyes. Then, the woman's voice sounds from behind her.

speaker: Suspect
content: ...Such an overly righteous fool.

Christina doesn't have time to react. The woman's hand is already around her neck from behind. Her fingertips lightly touch Christina's chin, tracing the curve of her throat downwards. Suddenly, Christina feels a strange numbness as something is drawn out from within her.

speaker: Suspect
content: You dare to insult me, thinking I'm as useless as you, a complete novice?

speaker: Suspect
content: ...The word "murderer" can't define me, detective. The "life" and "justice" we see are different.
Her hand continues to move outwards, pulling out a budding crimson flower. The bud bursts out from Christina's chest, slowly stretching upwards.

speaker: Suspect
content: Look, people can <color=#fb9259>bloom</color>. This is your flower, take good care of it. Hurting it is the same as hurting yourself.

speaker: Suspect
content: I believe life is precious. Even the most ugly and despicable person can bloom beautiful flowers. The body and soul will become nutrients, nourishing the flower until it blooms. Only then is it a truly pure <color=#fb9259>life</color>.

speaker: Suspect
content: Yours looks like a naive and cute little flower. A sunflower? Or a daisy?

The crimson bud sprouts, slowly unfolding. A wave of nausea rises within Christina as if her blood is being drawn from the ends of her vessels. She musters all her strength to squeeze out a question through her teeth.

speaker: Christina
content: What... happens when the flower... fully blooms?

speaker: Suspect
content: It will keep going, blooming more and more flowers, just like the woman in the water, until she can't bear any more.

speaker: Suspect
content: Life is powerful, the stronger the person, the more they can bear. I've seen someone bloom an entire Garden.

speaker: Christina
content: I asked... what happens to those who have <color=#fb9259>"bloomed"</color>, after their life has been drained?

speaker: Suspect
content: Oh, that's what you meant.
A smile shows on her face.

speaker: Suspect
content: When you're admiring a flower, do you care about the mud under your feet?

speaker: Christina
content: You bastard!!

Fury surges within Christina, her hatred overcoming her fear and allowing her to reclaim control of her body. Ignoring the threat, she spins around and swings at the woman, who easily dodges. Christina then throws her cane towards where the woman retreated.
Boom—!!

speaker: Christina
content: That's someone's life, what right do you have to distort and trample it?!
The wall is shattered by the thrown cane, dust fills the alley. The punctured sheriff's hat falls pathetically, the woman's figure vaguely visible through the dust.
Her long hair floats around her, a deep red flower in her hand. She seems very pleased.

speaker: Suspect
content: You got mad, huh? Hahaha, I'd say this is much more beautiful than your boring "justice."

Christina's cane is still stuck in the wall behind the enemy. The strength she used in that strike has left her drained, or perhaps—having her "flower" plucked has indeed robbed her of some life force. It's now very difficult for her to move, she grits her teeth in fury.

speaker: Christina
content: Shut up, bastard. I remember now.

speaker: Christina
content: July, at Erica Villa, the sheriffs had their lives drained by a Sinner. Rahu said that a <color=#fb9259>crimson thorn</color> was left at the scene.

speaker: Christina
content: You're the one who attacked Erica Villa, who attacked Shalom! You're the leader of the Garden Sinners, the <color=#fb9259>Mentor</color> of assassins!
The "Mentor" laughs even more.

speaker: Suspect
content: Shalom, huh... Are you really that fond of her? Hehe...

speaker: Suspect
content: Perfect, then you should play with <color=#fb9259>me</color> too.

speaker: Christina
content: I don't have time to play with you, I'm going to—ahhh!
A white blade plunges straight into Christina's left leg. She kneels in pain, completely losing the ability to move.
Upon removal, the white blade turns out to be just an ordinary note. There are a few lines of small characters inside.

In garden deep, where spring blossoms dive, 
emerald waters their whispers abide.
On a night of rains, fireflies glide; 
by fractured walls, shadows of ruins reside.

In autumn's prime, wine and meat gleam. 
Gold and silver set the festive scene.
As year's end nears, vast and wide, 
over dried-up wells, I alone stride.

speaker: Christina
content: Where spring blossoms dive... Could this be... <color=#fb9259>an assassination warning</color>? So this isn't the only case, are you planning to...!!

speaker: Suspect
content: Mm-hmm, this is just the beginning. I made a promise for a grand bloom, and I will keep my word.

speaker: Suspect
content: When and where the next flower will bloom, and for what reason... Why don't you deduce? The future great detective Christina, treat it like your favorite detective game.

speaker: Suspect
content: If you can solve my riddles, I'll accept a commission from you. Any person you want me to kill, save, or spare, I'll listen to you. But if you can't solve them...

speaker: Suspect
content: You, your Shalom, the ones you love, many people will turn into blooming flowers, to decorate my <color=#fb9259>Garden</color>.

speaker: Christina
content: You—?!

speaker: Suspect
content: Alright, alright, get moving. If you have time to be angry with me here, the second flower might have already bloomed.

speaker: Christina
content: The second... Could it be?!

speaker: Christina
content: Look, I've found the first suspect! The owner of this suspicious phone number is a 48-year-old male called <color=#fb9259>Nathan</color>. The file says he's an Eastsider, but his past is very suspicious. Please allow me to keep investigating!

The woman takes a luxurious phone out of her pocket, waves it around, and throws it at Christina's face. Christina quickly catches it. The phone screen is already shattered, and her intuition tells her that this is Nathan's phone.

speaker: Suspect
content: Figure it out yourself, it's best to bring more people, your talk of justice alone can't stop me.

speaker: Suspect
content: By the way, here you go, little detective. This is your flower.
She gently lets go, and the flower pulled out from Christina's body falls to the ground. It's a tender flower that looks like a daisy or a sunflower, Christina couldn't recognize it.

speaker: Suspect
content: Marigold isn't known to be sunny, so don't force yourself to play the role of a justice hero. Challenge me with your true self, then I might be able to expect something from you.

speaker: Suspect
content: This is a blooming period that has been brewing for <color=#fb9259>10 years</color>. I've lowered the difficulty for you, you better win.

speaker: Christina
content: 10 years... what does that mean... What happened in <color=#fb9259>103</color>?

She doesn't respond, laughing loudly as she turns around and leaves. Christina wants to chase after her, but her body is blooming and injured, no longer listening to her commands. All she can do is yell at the figure that's leaving.

speaker: Christina
content: Don't run!! You bastard, what did that mean just now?!

speaker: Christina
content: What does the case have to do with N.F. 103?
The further investigation of the case quickly yields results.

Intelligence Department: Regarding the other "flowers that shouldn't have been present" at the scene, we understand the reason for their presence. Central Park doesn't have <color=#fb9259>Daisies</color>, which only bloom in spring. The Intelligence Department has searched the entire Eastside and finally found something interesting.


Intelligence Department: Back in the <color=#fb9259>spring of N.F. 104</color>, a woman drowned here. The investigation ruled out homicide, but the photos from the crime scene at that time are quite interesting.

Christina: The posture, layout, and daisies at the scene are very similar to the Anania case. What's the connection between these two people?


Intelligence Department: There's no concrete evidence yet, but they're definitely related to one thing.


Intelligence Department: The famous FAC <color=#fb9259>debacle</color> in N.F. 103.

Intelligence Department: The deceased is named Ophelia, originally from the FAC Communications Department, and had participated in supporting a major operation in N.F. 103.


Intelligence Department: We haven't yet applied for enough permissions to query the details, but we do know that the operation seems to have suffered a major defeat, with heavy casualties. This triggered a series of chain reactions, including several people in charge, and the then commander of FAC, taking the blame and resigning. The former commander died of illness soon after.


Intelligence Department: Although Ophelia was not in a high position, she also left the FAC at the beginning of N.F. 104 due to physical and mental illness. Three months later, she was found drowned in a pond.

Intelligence Department: As for Anania, she was not a member of FAC. But she was in charge of handling the <color=#fb9259>internal publicity crisis of FAC</color> in N.F. 103, and the several articles she published stated that the defeat in N.F. 103 was due to the internal intelligence and communications personnel, which involved Ophelia.


Intelligence Department: This caused quite a stir at the time...

speaker: Dole
content: ****, why on earth are you still here?!

A marker lands on Christina's forehead. She yelps, finally shifting her gaze from the detective handbook, meeting the gaze of all the people in the investigation team. Her overthinking just now leaves her momentarily disoriented.
The inspector blushes at his own words, but feels a sense of relief when he realizes that Christina didn't hear them.

speaker: Dole
content: Get out of here. You're so badly injured, I won't be able to explain it to your higher-ups later. If the suspect is the leader of the Garden, there's no place for a rookie like you.

speaker: Christina
content: I'm fine! That woman treats lives as a joke and she will do even worse things. She's targeting me and the people important to me, I must stop her.

speaker: Christina
content: And I... I've solved many cases related to the Sinners. I have experience, I can help!

speaker: Dole
content: All you've done is catch thieves and handle lost and found cases, can you compare those to a murder case like this?

speaker: Christina
content: Um... I'm not afraid, I...

speaker: Dole
content: This case is more complicated than we imagined, I don't know how deeply it's connected to the case in N.F. 103 or the FAC, but no matter what, you shouldn't get yourself involved.

speaker: Dole
content: I know about your situation, your father was with the FAC, he died in N.F. 103. You've never dealt with a murder case, and you have a history of mental instability.

speaker: Dole
content: I won't delve into the connection behind this, nor care about the reason why you were assigned here. But now that the Garden has targeted you, and I've seen that you're easy to provoke, I'm determining that you're not suitable for this case after assessing the risk.

speaker: Christina
content: ...I... It's okay. I'm not that fragile. And... this is a job entrusted to me by a very important person.

speaker: Dole
content: I don't care how important that big shot is, this isn't something an intern should get involved in! I can't be held responsible if you lose your life! Go back and rest, don't hang around here with us.
Christina clenches her fists, staying up all night makes her both excited and defeated, her emotions are suppressed with nowhere to vent.
Just then, a familiar and unique ringtone rings. Christina jumps up, her eyes gleaming.

speaker: Christina
content: Wait, it's an important call! I have to pick it up! We'll talk when I come back!

speaker: Dole
content: Hey!
She runs as if she's flying, all the way to the ladies' room, then catches her breath, swallows her saliva. With unease and excitement, she presses the answer key.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Shalom?

speaker: Encrypted Comms
content: It's me.

speaker: Christina
content: Ah, Rahu...

speaker: Christina
content: Is Shalom okay? Are you guys coming back?

speaker: Rahu
content: No. The situation is more complicated than expected, the mission needs more time. But Shalom is worried about your situation, and asked me to check on you.
"So she knows that I failed." Christina is a bit annoyed.

speaker: Christina
content: I'm sorry, I was inexperienced and hot-headed. I let the criminal escape, and made you guys worry.

speaker: Christina
content: Compared to me, Shalom's task is a hundred times more difficult, and the enemies she faces are a hundred times more dangerous. In the end, she has to be distracted by my matters.

speaker: Rahu
content: Say that to her yourself. Shalom asked me to contact you to provide information. I've dealt with a few assassins from the Garden, they're not psychopaths who kill for fun.

speaker: Rahu
content: Apart from accepting commissions, the Garden's actions are usually highly purposeful and very much driven by sentiment.

speaker: Rahu
content: From the series of cases you've taken over, the Garden intentionally connected several isolated incidents to create a sense of ritual. This sense of ritual has a purpose, Shalom hopes that you can figure it out.

speaker: Rahu
content: They rarely act so ostentatiously, this is an opportunity. We have already sent people to track down the <color=#fb9259>Garden's base</color>.

speaker: Christina
content: Strong connections... I think I have an idea.

speaker: Rahu
content: And there's one last thing she asked me to convey.

speaker: Rahu
content: Shalom says she'll be there for you whenever you need her, but she believes you can do it.

speaker: Christina
content: ...O-okay! Thank you for the clues you gave me, thank you, Shalom! I know what to do now!

speaker: Christina
content: These guys, having ties with the Underground forces and still insisting on causing trouble at the most critical moment of the battle... I won't let them off.

speaker: Christina
content: When I'm not around, you have to protect her. Special force Rahu, I'm counting on you.

speaker: Rahu
content: Of course, I won't let her die. That's the order given to me.
After hanging up the phone, Christina slaps her face hard... Clap!

speaker: Christina
content: Alright! I'm fully charged! To live up to everyone's expectations, the famous great detective will continue to shine and illuminate the darkness!
She doesn't return to the investigation team, but heads straight to the next investigation site...
The Public Security Bureau has investigated Nathan's file. It can be confirmed that he was smuggled into Eastside from Syndicate ten years ago. His experiences before that are a blank slate.

Not long after he smuggled into Eastside, he opened a large construction company and took on many projects. But the company's performance was not ideal, and it has been losing money for the past ten years.

Under these circumstances, large amounts of unexplained funds have been constantly flowing into Nathan's personal account. Although these funds are well-managed and no discrepancies can be found, this itself is enough to prove that there's something wrong with Nathan.
Christina arrives at Nathan's house. Just like his file, Nathan's house is also cleaned very "neatly," nothing out of the ordinary...
Except for a handwritten phone book, which has Anania's number. The corresponding name is written in code.
Christina follows up and checks a few other numbers in the phone book. Most of these contacts are wealthy businessmen engaged in charity work, and there's also a high-ranking official in Eastside.
Perhaps, like Anania, they were all potential blackmail targets chosen by Nathan.

Christina discovers that Anania did some online searches about Nathan after receiving his "text message." However, according to the records, her searches focused on Nathan's construction company, not Nathan himself.
Following her search records, Christina finds that Anania was indeed purposefully collecting information.
Nathan's construction company often gets involved in disputes related to the quality of the project, and these disputes all end up being minimized or dismissed in the end.

The most recent project record is a demolition project of a building ruin on the east bank of the Rust, but for some reason, it has been in a state of suspension... Online rumors say that the place is haunted, and no workers would dare to go.
Christina does some checking and finds that this building was originally built by Nathan's company, but it was abruptly halted midway, which is why it became a ruin.
From construction to suspension, from the decision to demolish it to another suspension, so many questions regarding this ten-year-long project...

speaker: Christina
content: On a night of rains, fireflies glide; by fractured walls, shadows of ruins reside.
Ruins... ruins...

She unfolds the map and carefully searches around the Rust, corresponding to the "construction project" sites that Nathan once took on. Some of them have been completed, some have long been demolished. The only one left is an unfinished broken wall, like an urban legend that can't be demolished...

speaker: Christina
content: Found it!
Beep... beep... click!

speaker: Dole
content: Hello? Who's this? I'm busy here!

speaker: Christina
content: Inspector, Inspector, I know where Nathan is! I'm sending you the location, it may not be correct, I'll go ahead and scout first!

speaker: Dole
content: Huh? No! It's dangerous, kid! Wait for us to go together—

speaker: Christina
content: There's no time!
She jumps down from a pile of garbage, her foot twists and she rolls down head over heels. Before she has time to cry out in pain, she gets up with her hands and feet and runs.

speaker: Christina
content: The criminal did catch Nathan first, but she didn't immediately kill him. According to the second sentence of the Flowery Scroll, Nathan should be the second person to "bloom" according to the criminal's plan.

speaker: Christina
content: What if there's still a chance, what if I can make it in time! If I make it, he doesn't have to die!

speaker: Dole
content: But if the murderer is at the scene—
She better be, Christina has a lot to say to the Mentor. Even if she doesn't bump into her here, she will definitely catch up, she must find that white-haired Sinner.

speaker: Christina
content: I found it!
Holding the phone, her hand is shaking violently. She's shocked by the scene in front of her, and her heart is being shaken by regret, powerlessness, and deeper anger.

speaker: Dole
content: Hey! Hello? Are you okay? Speak up!

speaker: Christina
content: Inspector... I found the scene. Sorry, I'm too late.

17:36, August 9, N.F. 113
East Bank of the Rust
"Wall of Collapse" crime scene

speaker: Christina
content: There are lots of flowers blooming. It's very dangerous around here too. Make sure everyone wears protection, and it's best to call FAC.

speaker: Christina
content: Before you arrive, I will do a preliminary investigation of the scene...

After hanging up the phone, Christina takes a deep breath. The dazzling Mania flowers are messing with her senses, stirring up past chaotic memories. Christina must control any potential physiological reactions. She must overcome obstacles; she can't fall here.
The dead cannot be brought back, she failed to save one person's life. What she can do now is to find the truth.

Squatting on the pile of debris, Christina takes a breath, and sends back the known information to the Public Security Bureau. This case is much more serious than Anania's, she hopes to get more support and investigate the scene more thoroughly.
She quickly receives a reply, but it details the results of the further investigation into Nathan by the Bureau during the day.
Nathan, a smuggler from Syndicate, was involved in illegal activities like usury in Eastside. He suddenly went legit in N.F. 104, and started a construction business.
Before he quit, Nathan had harassed some families of the FAC victims. Some suspected that he helped deal with these troublemakers, but due to lack of evidence, he was quickly released on bail.

Some also accused him of getting rid of corpses in the Rust, but during that time, the Rust isolation belt wasn't easy to approach. If he really did it, the FAC outpost monitoring the east bank would swallow him alive.
Upon careful examination of Nathan's account transaction records, all of his investments in construction failed, yet his account still had a large amount of cash.

It seems that this former Syndicate gangster had done some shady business after coming to Eastside, no wonder someone sought revenge on him in... such a brutal way. Now she knows the killer's motive. Another common point between the two cases is...

speaker: Christina
content: It's <color=#fb9259>N.F. 103</color> again.
Could it be a coincidence? Her heart is pounding fiercely, but she restrains herself and returns to the case at hand.

Both crime scenes correspond to the two haiku because both of the victims were killed by "blooming." Since they are both related to the N.F. 103 FAC event, the killer could be seeking vengeance. If the last two lines of the poem are also going to be crime scenes, they are likely to be similar to these two cases.
I must find out the truth behind these cases to stop her... No matter how grand the revenge, it's not justice.
She gets up, staring intently at the broken wall covered in Mania flowers, as if she could find new clues by looking a bit longer.
I must uncover the truth behind these cases, and stop her...

speaker: Christina
content: No...

Christina's eyes widen, a terrifying idea suddenly seizing her train of thought. In front of her is a solid wall, not particularly tall but unusually thick. Nathan's clothing is suspended in mid-air, clinging to the flowers of Mania.

The ground is cluttered with debris, and behind them are dark, jagged plants climbing and twisting, seemingly an inadvertent disguise or a definitive hint. The image of Anania's pond surfaces in her mind.
Like Ophelia, she died in the pond of Central Park, intentionally decorated with flowers that were not originally there, just to match the scene from the spring of N.F. 104.
Stepping over the discarded debris, Christina carefully removes "Nathan" from the wall. Apart from the flowers, Nathan's body has completely disappeared from this world, leaving nothing behind.
Many other "plants" are clinging to this abandoned wall. They aren't Mania flowers blooming from Nathan, but rather, they resemble some kind of lichen or moss, a withered existence.
But Christina can't help but feel they are similar. These are not natural plants, they carry a specific scent, the smell of life and death of a human.
She needs a way to prove her speculation. And coincidentally, someone has prepared a "tool" for her.

Returning to the mysterious bucket, Christina takes a newly plucked jimsonweed and soaks it in the liquid. The moment the flower touches the liquid, the Mania flower ignites in terrifying red and blue flames.

The flames quickly extinguished, but the intense luminescence on the flower lingers for a long time. Christina recognizes this reaction, it's the same when she's out in the Blue Rain; it's how the Blue Rain reacts to a Sinner. Someone specially prepared this bucket of "Blue Rain" for her.
A fire suddenly ignites in Christina's heart, growing bigger and bigger, driving her to pick up the bucket and approach the flowerless wall.
Christina uses all her strength to clear the junk. As the sun sets and the shadows cast by the sun quickly lengthen, she is finally swallowed by them.
Just before the last ray of light disappears, Christina grits her teeth and throws all her strength into splashing the bucket of Blue Rain against the mud wall...

Christina continues to splash in different directions, until there is not a drop of water left in the bucket. The roaring flames burn on the mud wall, illuminating the detective's terrified face. She wants to close her eyes but can't. She must watch.

The flames gradually die out, the mud wall is thoroughly soaked, leaving mottled spots of red fluorescence on the wet wall. They are scattered, but also show several noticeable spots, indicating the location of the objects buried in the concrete.

speaker: Mentor
content: People can <color=#fb9259>bloom</color>... The body and soul will become nutrients, nourishing the flower until it blooms.
So what are these "Mania plants" that can't bloom? What nourishes them? And why can't they bloom?
Why are they clinging to this wall?
What else is inside this wall?

speaker: Dole
content: Hello? Kid, are you still at the scene? FAC detected some contaminated creatures around the area, did something happen over there?

speaker: Dole
content: Find a place to hide first, wait for us to come over.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Understood. Before that...

speaker: Christina
content: I want to confirm something...
Christina swings her cane at the mud wall with all her strength, hitting it over and over. Her eyes are getting redder.

speaker: Dole
content: Hey? What are you doing? What happened? Get out of there now!!!

Not far away, some attracted contaminants begin to peek their heads out and gradually approach. But Christina is completely oblivious, her obsession with the truth makes her ignore everything around her.
The wall cracks, then crumbles. Amid the smoke and cement blocks, an unrecognizable object fell out from the spot that was originally flashing with light, rolling straight to Christina's feet.
...That is an unknown number of "lives" that have been sealed for who knows how long, that have already withered and can no longer bloom.
It's Nathan! Even in the darkness, Christina clearly sees everything Nathan had ever done. Under the luminescence, the remnants of those lives are exposed in front of her eyes.

speaker: Christina
content: Aaahhh—!!

The M-value alarm on her wrist bursts into a sharp sound, Christina screams and kneels on the ground, clutching her head, swept up by the crazy memories buried in the past. The monsters that have gradually gathered around seize the opportunity to pounce.
When the detectives and the assisting combatants from FAC arrived at the scene, Christina has disappeared. All that is left is a destroyed broken wall and traces of a fierce battle.

speaker: Sheriff
content: Why can't we find her anywhere? Could it be that the kid has been taken by the Corruptors...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: She's an A-Class Sinner after all, she should be quite capable, unless... something happened that made her lose control of her emotions.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: We are now lacking the most effective means to stabilize the Sinners. If their M-value is unstable, it may also attract nearby Mania creatures.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: That would be very dangerous...

The inspector doesn't dare to venture into the contamination, he takes a look from afar. He flips through Christina's last sent detailed on-site investigation clues, confirms the multiple remains sealed in the concrete for many years. He frowns.

The FAC finds a shattered Hypercube near the broken wall, the Corruptors were smashed to pieces, and Christina's cloak was torn off. Even without getting close, one can tell that the battle here was very intense and chaotic not long ago.
The intern's struggle was very fierce, she probably lost control.

speaker: Dole
content: That kid has psychological trauma. If she was the one who smashed this wall and saw what was inside...
One day ago...

speaker: Dole
content: Psychological trauma? Why didn't you say so earlier?! And you put her on our team??

speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
content: ...This task was originally recommended by the higher-ups, no one expected it would cause this much trouble. I can only ask you to take care of her.

speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
content: That child's father is a FAC instructor. The soldiers who were good to her family, and the whole team died in a secret operation. Yes, in <color=#fb9259>N.F. 103</color>...

speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
content: There were too many rumors about FAC in those years, and many people involved would think negatively. Her mother later died from excessive worry. Christina was hit hard and caused a lot of trouble.

speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
content: A kind family adopted her. Christina herself is trying to recover. She's very motivated, and she even got into the police academy. But there's always a fear of the unexpected.

speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
content: Her parents were also FAC combatants who recently fell in the West District operation. That child always tries to act tough... I don't know if she can keep it up...

speaker: Dole
content: Tsk, N.F. 103 again. I should've gotten rid of her sooner... And she shouldn't have come alone!

speaker: Dole
content: Chris—! Where are you? Answer me! Chris—!
He yells anxiously, walking farther and farther under the night sky, when suddenly a faint noise comes from the debris nearby. The inspector immediately draws his gun and takes aim...

speaker: Dole
content: ...! You are...
When Christina wakes up, she is surrounded by pitch blackness. The silent darkness finally frees her from the violent chaos of her nightmare.

speaker: Christina
content: It's a dream... Not real... I'm on a case... I...
You finally woke up.
You were screaming so terribly just now. Having a nightmare, were you? Don't worry, I've mercifully drawn out all the contamination from your body.
Christina tries to sit up but fails. Blood clogs her mouth, making breathing difficult. The surroundings are dark, or perhaps she hasn't regained her vision yet.

She only sees black, shattered marigolds at her hand—no, Mania contamination in the shape of marigolds. This reminds her of the fight in her nightmare, under the broken wall, where she battled many Corruptors and was contaminated.
But now, aside from the intermittent pain, her body doesn't seem to have that chaotic feeling anymore. Who helped handle the contamination in her body? In this... <color=#fb9259>blooming</color> way?
She only hears a familiar voice in the darkness, someone scrutinizing her.
The floor is hard, isn't it? Sorry about that. I should have offered a pillow to the injured, but with your whole body wounded, it would dirty my clothes. You'll have to bear with it.
Unlike the foul, bloody smell on her, she detects a fragrance of flowers and the sound of flowing water in her surroundings.

speaker: Christina
content: What is this place?
This is my <color=#fb9259>Garden</color>. You're in the enemy's headquarters, little detective.
Do you remember me?

speaker: Christina
content: ...I remember, murderer.

speaker: Mentor
content: Heh, with a doll-like face like yours, you should say something cute and pleasing. Come, call my name, <color=#fb9259>Coquelic</color>.
Christina is not in the mood to respond to her. Her consciousness, like her body, is heavy. She only wants to hold onto the most important thing.

speaker: Christina
content: Your cases, they are all acts of <color=#fb9259>vengeance</color> against what happened ten years ago, identical vengeance...

speaker: Christina
content: But that's not your goal...

speaker: Christina
content: Through these cases, you want me to investigate something; to expose something that happened ten years ago...

speaker: Christina
content: Why didn't you just let me investigate directly? Why keep me in the dark? And the two lines of poetry, and the two people, just stop it here. I can investigate what you want, just stop...
Coquelic interrupts Christina.

speaker: Coquelic
content: The Garden is a place to enjoy life, can we not talk about boring work stuff?

speaker: Christina
content: Then why did you bring me here? To kill me? To interrogate me?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Let me think... Oh, someone recommended you to join the Garden.

speaker: Christina
content: Huh?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hehe, such a cute reaction.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Since you're also a pitiful child of FAC, why don't you greet the little friends here?

speaker: Christina
content: "Also"?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Over the years, so many people from FAC have died, wouldn't it be normal for a few children who share your plight to join the Garden? They quite like you.
...To join the Garden for revenge? Christina immediately understands this sentiment, her fists clenched.

speaker: Christina
content: It's not the same... Even if I was treated unfairly, I don't want to harm others, I believe in justice...

speaker: Coquelic
content: What's so different? Didn't you go to Nirvana by yourself eight years ago and stab a Paradeisos representative?

Christina's breath catches. Her reaction seems to greatly satisfy Coquelic. Mentor rises from the water, covered in water marks. The surrounding "assassins" gather to drape her in a thin veil, escorting her out of the bath, all the while laughing merrily.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You're quite the oddball, I say. You spout nonsense about justice and truth, yet your blossoming is pathetically dark. Even when bound and brought to my Garden, you're not surprised...

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's because you're so used to it, aren't you? Your heart has been trapped in the dark all along.

Coquelic comes over to Christina, bending down to admire her prey. Her long white hair falls, brushing Christina's face. The water is cold, and Christina wants to dodge but can't move. She can only stare into Coquelic's bright red eyes.

speaker: Coquelic
content: What happened back then that infuriated you to the point of committing such a serious act at such a young age?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Did the assassination succeed? Did you kill the person you hated to the bone?
Christina avoids her gaze, grits her teeth. She struggles to squeeze out an answer.

speaker: Christina
content: ...It wasn't like that, and it has nothing to do with you. I won't tell you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: So, the assassination failed. What a pity. You clearly have talent. You even became a Sinner.

speaker: Coquelic
content: As an assassin, an avenger, a person ignited by rage and burning everything. You have a talent for violence and destruction, just like the flowers here, that's why that woman kept you by her side.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Give up on your talk of justice, it's just a lie concocted by your Shalom, a chain she uses to bind you. Doesn't the case at hand prove this?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Anania, a shallow and vain woman, stands on moral high ground to denounce others. After hurting others, she got scared out of her wits, but in a few days, she whitewashed herself and returned to the high ground.

speaker: Coquelic
content: That Nathan, a dirty Syndicate dog, attaches himself to a morally corrupt councilor and has countless deaths on his hands. Ten years have passed, if it weren't for me, would anyone have penalized him? Where is your justice then?
The weak detective remains silent for a moment, then looks back into Coquelic's eyes.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Heh... You're not the first person to say that to me. "Because the world is so dark, justice doesn't exist, so it's okay for us to cross the line."

speaker: Christina
content: It's just an excuse to cover up your own misdeeds... I've read all the Garden's files...

speaker: Christina
content: You keep talking about vengeance, but what you're really doing is spreading Mania with prohibited weapons. You contaminate a dozen civilians by killing one target. There are several cases of indiscriminate attacks on the FAC, all to undermine the anti-Mania efforts.

speaker: Christina
content: Because the world is a mess, your own evil deeds don't matter? Bullshit! Don't gloss over the bad things you've done, you're just as immoral! You're part of the evil!

speaker: Christina
content: How many civilians in the city-state turn pale at the mention of the Garden? How many vile criminals imitate its actions to harm the innocent? Are you in total oblivion?
Coquelic looks at her with a smirk, suddenly sighs, and theatrically shakes her head.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Sigh... hear that, Thistle? This is the "kindred spirit" you fought so hard to save.

The light comes on, revealing an injured assassin behind the screen. She's about the same age as Christina, covered in wounds, her face alternating between pale and bruised, the stains on her body eerily similar to Christina's.

speaker: Christina
content: What...?
But Coquelic doesn't answer any more of Christina's questions. Instead, she turns to look at Thistle, her face full of mockery.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You went to great lengths to pull her out of the pile of Corruptors, thinking that shared experiences would breed empathy. But in her eyes, you're just a bastard. Your kindness is misplaced.

speaker: Coquelic
content: If she knew how you're so infatuated, would a few shed tears and kind words from her make you hand over everything about the Garden in a crying mess?
Thistle doesn't dare look at Coquelic, she just glares at Christina, her eyes filled with anger, shame, and regret.

speaker: Thistle
content: I'm sorry... Mentor... forgive me...
But the apology only makes the Mentor even angrier.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Pathetic! I've told you before, stop caring about others so much. Now what are you crying and whining for? Do you want me to say "oh, it's okay, I forgive you" so you can feel better?

speaker: Coquelic
content: You act on your own, break my rules, bring the enemy into our base, and expect me to care about your feelings? Am I your mommy?

speaker: Coquelic
content: What a pain! What little time I have for rest has been ruined by you and the dirty thing you brought back. Solitary confinement! You're not allowed out until I cool down.

speaker: Christina
content: Wait...
Christina struggles to yell, not at Coquelic, but at the Garden's assassin who's about to cry.
She stops in her tracks and turns around sharply. Christina suddenly doesn't know what to say.
Did you save me? Thank you? Is your family also with the FAC? I'm sorry, I didn't mean that? You shouldn't stay with this kind of woman? I'll take you away?
Before she can figure it out, the assassin speaks first.

speaker: Thistle
content: ...You should have died there, you domesticated scum!
Thistle leaves. Leaving Christina collapsed on the floor, with Coquelic standing by, taking pleasure in her misfortune.

speaker: Coquelic
content: See, she's also a family member of the FAC, and also lost everything in N.F. 103. But she didn't have your connections. When she sought help from so-called justice, she only received resounding slaps in the face. So, she came to me.

speaker: Christina
content: And then... you took advantage of her.

speaker: Christina
content: It started with the Underground, and then you... you all deceive and exploit these wounded people under the guise of vengeance. You turn them into weapons that harm others when they have nothing left.

speaker: Christina
content: Even if her original life was destroyed, people are resilient. She could have slowly recovered, slowly returned to normal. But you lured her into darkness, and she can never go back!

As soon as she finishes speaking, Coquelic kicks Christina hard in the stomach. The injured detective crashes into a door pillar. Several sharp objects pierce Christina's body, and her consciousness immediately becomes chaotic.
She only feels something pressing against her head, squeezing hard.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Stop yapping. Is what the Hush gave you some kind of noble justice, and what I give is brainwashing with hatred? Who are you looking down on?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I know exactly what kind of person you are. You don't have the ability to take revenge on this world on your own, so you cling to the most hollow things as a lifeline.

speaker: Coquelic
content: People like you are the easiest to deceive, the dumbest, and the weakest. If it weren't for the need to give that idiot Thistle a dose of reality, I wouldn't even bother to look at you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: The Garden won't believe your righteous talk, it won't believe any of you. Everything that demands submission in the name of love and nobility is a filthy lie. All sacrifices made for these extraneous things are proof of ignorance.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Those who dare to harm us must be punished by our own hands. This is the only way to personally take back what they took from me.

speaker: Christina
content: So... what is this now? This series of cases, who are you taking revenge on?

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...I've personally settled my deep hatred and grudge a long time ago. I'm free, and everything I do now is what I enjoy.

speaker: Coquelic
content: As for what I'm going to do? Pass the message to your owner, let her play with me. That must be why she sent you here.

speaker: Coquelic
content: After all... it's not like anyone really expects you to solve the case.
Several thin needles suddenly fly out, piercing Christina's body.

speaker: Christina
content: Mmph...!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Relax, this is just a little body recovery agent, with a little bit of a stimulant to help with your state of mind; to help you escape from here. As long as you don't remember the way back, I won't take your life.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Run, don't die on the way. The show's not over yet, I'm waiting for you to help raise the curtain.
My father was a hero. He said justice and light are eternal, and he fought for them.
But many, many heroes, died easily on a journey ten years ago. Their deaths were meaningless.

speaker: News
content: In N.F. 103, the FAC's large-scale battle ended in total failure. The number of deaths is not disclosed, with no further explanation. According to leaked information, the destination was the DisSea, with survival odds at zero.

The FAC was widely criticized, its status plummeted to a point where the City Council and Nirvana could manipulate it. My father also became a laughing stock. People called him a hero, but in their hearts, they called him a "wronged soul."
I asked, "father and his mates... all fought for justice and died defending the city-state. Why did it end like this? Doesn't everyone want justice?”
They respond with silence, mockery, or by turning their faces away in disgust. Eventually, someone speaks up, claiming that these "wronged souls" never saw the truth... that justice is a lie...

And they said, In this era, one can be randomly stripped of their rights, and evil can go unpunished. Reality is filled with fog and conspiracy, with interests, hatred, and desire all towering above justice. Blindly believing in it is foolish, and those who die for it... deserve to.

I wanted to argue back, but I choked. Whenever I begin to doubt, bad things always happen. I started to develop a terrible intuition that everything was going downhill, and what's worse... most of the time, it was right.
If justice exists, where is it now? Why doesn't it show itself? The world is falling apart, creating such a massive black hole... why is it being ignored? Why isn't anyone filling it?

speaker: News
content: In N.F. 104, Nirvana withdrew from the West District. A major explosion occurs in mine W-31, causing over ten thousand deaths. The organization claimed it was an accident, and after an investigation conducted by Paradeisos's investigators, this explanation was accepted...
The black hole grows larger, and I can't escape it. I have to do something. I can't just watch as my world collapses with it... I have to do something, I...

speaker: Coquelic
content: The Garden won't believe your righteous talk, it won't believe any of you. Everything that demands submission in the name of love and nobility is a filthy lie. All sacrifices made for these extraneous things are proof of ignorance.

W-31 was not an accident, it was planned. I checked their asset transfers, they're all riddled with irregularities. My intuition tells me this is evil, the same evil that my father and the others faced. If no one will bring them to justice, then I will. I must go!

When someone from Paradeisos went to Nirvana, I lay in wait near Nirvana's headquarters. I got shot at; many people came to hit me, to catch me, labeling me a Sinner. I didn't care—I fought back and managed to stab one of them.
...But it was she who protected me amidst the hail of bullets.
...Is that so? You came here to prove the justice in your heart...
You must be reaching your limit, to resort to such drastic measures...
There's no need for this... It's not time yet, you have a long way to go... Listen to me...
Justice exists, without a doubt. I've seen it with my own eyes.
In another pure, real world... where every facet of the human heart is laid bare... there, I saw justice... and it exists forever...
Right now, someone is standing up for you. Once you grow up, it will be your turn to fight for them...
In this way, what you believe in will surely...
...Christina...

speaker: Shalom
content: Did you have a nightmare?

speaker: Christina
content: ...Shalom...?

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, it's me. I'm sorry, I'm late.
She doesn't say anything else, but reaches out to hold Christina's hand. Both of their hands are icy cold.

Christina's vision gradually clears, the nightmares are gone, there's no more bloodshed, no more killing. The little detective, covered in wounds, stares blankly at Shalom, as if she hasn't yet woken from the nightmare, tears rolling uncontrollably down her cheeks.

speaker: Christina
content: Sob... I'm sorry... I'm sorry...

speaker: Christina
content: I stabbed you... I mistook you for a bad guy, I even wanted to kill you...

speaker: Christina
content: I'm just like them, a jerk who hurts others... I'm sorry...
The girl's emotions pour out, and Shalom just watches. After a while, she finally lifts her hand and pulls the girl into her arms.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't say that. You didn't hurt anyone, you're the one who got hurt.
Her forehead rests against Christina's, constantly comforting her.

speaker: Shalom
content: Justice is always there, it's already in your hands, you've grown.

speaker: Shalom
content: You've been doing very well.

speaker: Christina
content: Sob... Waaaah...

15:25, August 10, N.F. 113
Eastside, Banyan Medical College,
First Affiliated Hospital,
Special Ward.

Christina doesn't remember how long she cried for. It's been so long since she's seen Shalom, her tears just flow. In the distant future, when she thinks back on this event, she feels a little embarrassed.
But now, the future great detective faces another serious trial.
