content: Don't let Milly keep living in those romantic fairy tales of hers. Be realistic. Stay alive...

speaker: Cassian
content: You think you're saying this for her sake?
He looks at Sallie.

speaker: Cassian
content: But now... you look like the one who gave up on yourself a long time ago.
Sallie let out a dry laugh. Give up? She was a fool to ever have hope in the first place.

Fleeing back to Eastside wouldn't save her. That's where she fell, where she was betrayed. Going back wouldn't change anything. The nightmare would just repeat itself. It's no different from here. The only reason she'd fantasize about escaping was because she was infected by delusions of love, because...
...she'd really believed... that where Theodore was, there might be hope.
Cassian sees her dry, bloodshot eyes, her colorless lips. This stubborn woman, like all the others trapped here for too long, has been hollowed out by despair, her spirit draining away.

speaker: Cassian
content: That escape route I mentioned wasn't prepared just for you. It was always my plan.

speaker: Cassian
content: The opportunity is rare, so I moved it up. A few modifications, and it could fit one more person.
He pauses, then speaks slowly.

speaker: Cassian
content: If you want to leave, come find me tomorrow. If not, then stay. Stay here for the rest of your life.
Cassian leaves. Cold light from the hallway filters through the crack in the door, thinning, until it too is swallowed by the darkness.
The patrol ship cuts through the WhiteSands. With the increasingly frequent attacks, the alert level aboard keeps rising. Everyone knows: they're closing in on their cunning quarry.
Iron Mask stands at the bow, facing the wind. His hand never leaves his weapon.
The wind howls, brewing a sandstorm, and beneath it, one can hear the whimpering of monsters.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: Unknown biological entity detected! Dead ahead, one o'clock, in the sandstorm!

speaker: Black Shadow
content: Roarrrr...!
In the span of a few words, the dark shadow bursts from the sandstorm.
[Begin Battle]
The soldiers make short work of the abomination, but there is no relief in their victory. The thing quickly ceases to twitch, leaving only the heavy stench of blood.
Its form is more grotesque than any of them could have imagined. Once the corpse is laid out, the soldiers fall silent. They form a loose circle around it, unsure whether to step back or move closer.

speaker: Iron Mask
content: This isn't one of the Corruptors of the WhiteSands. What exactly is this thing...?
A deteriorated Sinner.
[Unsteady footsteps]
A man in gray staggers out from the warship. His face is pale, his steps unsteady. He can barely stand without help.
female_content: A woman in gray staggers out from the warship. Her face is pale, her steps unsteady. She can barely stand without help.

content: It's the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. Contamination from BR-005 is eating away at his body through the shackles, but the man overpowers the corruption with his will.
female_content: It's the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. Contamination from BR-005 is eating away at her body through the shackles, but the woman overpowers the corruption with her will.

speaker: Doctor
content: What are you doing out here? The sand, the contamination... your body can't take it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's nothing. There's work to be done. You said it yourself, you need my experience to assess the contamination.
Fighting the pain from the Mania, you crouch down to inspect the bizarre corpse.

Parts of the creature's skin have crystallized, forming a broken, warped texture. The face is beginning to collapse. You stare at the twisted features, not quite human, not quite beast, your brow furrowed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not a sand beast, nor an Apostle of Ashes...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The M-value is too high. Never received any protection. They overused their abilities, and became completely deteriorated.
You search through the mangled remains. They're still wearing human clothes. You reach into the pockets and find something.
[Insert story item: Euphoria crest]
You pull out a metal object shaped like a ship's anchor, with a black serpent coiled around it.
It's the crest of a ship.
Everything clicks into place.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...They were abandoned here on purpose. Even after they became a Corruptor, they were provoked into attacking people who came close.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Someone is using them. Forcing the dead to stand guard, keeping anyone from entering this area.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Looks like that mysterious cruise ship is nearby.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...This is Farland's foothold in DisCity, the place where they make connections, trade intel, and engage in dirty deals. They're even using Mania to protect themselves, exploiting Sinners like this...
You finally let go of the corpse's hand and struggle to your feet. The doctor reaches out to steady you, but you decline her help.
You stand on your own, your gaze sweeping over the faces around you. When you speak, your voice is low but firm.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If they've learned how to create Sinners, this will be dangerous. We're in for a fight. The good news is, an encounter like this means we're close to their base. The bad news...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The enemy is on high alert. If we tip our hand, they might relocate at once.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My job is to handle hostile Sinners. I may not be able to fight alongside you, but I have the experience you need. That's why your leader asked for me, isn't it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then let's not hesitate. We move now, and bring down every one of those bastards.
The doctor raises an eyebrow and gives you a cryptic smile.

speaker: Doctor
content: ...Understood. Though I do hope you follow doctor's orders during the operation, Chief. We can't let our esteemed consultant come to any harm, can we?
Euphoria, Mr. E's Office

The room is dimly lit. On the projection screen, an unfamiliar warship is crossing the WhiteSands, stark and militaristic. In the bottom corner, a real-time monitoring window flashes with a silent update: "Units lost: +6."

Mr. E sits calmly in his office chair, slowly turning the ring on his finger. His gaze is fixed on the approaching ship, his expression impassive. He speaks into the comms, his tone casual as he arranges his next moves.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Turn on the sandstorm generators. Give our guests a proper welcome.

speaker: Mr. E
content: And get ready to evacuate. No, there aren't many. As for the others... I'll make arrangements.
He ends the call and goes over his prized assets one last time.

Recordings? Videos? Proof of transactions? No, of course not. He respects his guests' privacy. They are absolutely secure while indulging in their pleasures. Anyone who threatens Euphoria must vanish from this world... as is the case now.

What he needs is simpler: a passenger manifest. For every voyage, he ferries his guests across the WhiteSands to this secret paradise in the most exclusive, most discreet of private vessels. The boarding records and travel documentation for every guest are securely in his possession. That is enough.
Once they leave, every name on that list will become their "associate." Their fates will be his to command... and to offer up to those who are truly worthy.
The man turns coolly to face a mysterious silhouette in the shadows.

speaker: Frail Voice
content: I hear that person is coming. Won't that be a problem?

speaker: Mr. E
content: They're moving faster than I expected. But judging from their course, they're still some distance away. Our cover is sufficient, and the traps have been laid. That should buy us plenty of time.

speaker: Mr. E
content: I've notified the guests to evacuate. All intelligence has been secured. Anything we can't take will be destroyed.

speaker: Mr. E
content: As for Eastside... the Sillage Society will take care of things. Nothing will be leaked. Rest assured.

speaker: Frail Voice
content: Hehe. You misunderstand me. I'm just worried for that poor dear's frail body. If he were to die out here... his sister would be heartbroken.
female_content: Hehe. You misunderstand me. I'm just worried for that poor dear's frail body. If she were to die out here... her sister would be heartbroken.

speaker: Frail Voice
content: I have complete faith in you, of course. This place has never been my concern. You have a leash on every guest. They obey your every word. You've always been so wonderfully thorough. I've never cared for the details.

speaker: Frail Voice
content: But when you said nothing would be leaked... you're not just talking about the guests, are you?
Mr. E smiles.

speaker: Mr. E
content: My employees will be just as discreet, of course. Their fate was sealed the moment they stepped on board.

speaker: Mr. E
content: They will take the secrets to their graves. Rest assured.
The room falls silent. Only a faint fragrance coils through the air, emanating from the frail figure. It carries the scent of death.

speaker: Frail Voice
content: I thought you were fond of those little toys of yours. You picked them so carefully, comforted them so gently... only to cast them aside so casually. You're such a cruel, cold-blooded man.

speaker: Mr. E
content: You flatter me, ma'am. As your servant, it is my duty to meet your expectations. However, if you find it a waste, I've made arrangements...

speaker: Mr. E
content: For Euphoria's final performance, I've prepared a grand finale. Your favorite kind.
She finally laughs. A woman materializes, half-hidden by the violet smoke.

speaker: Frail Voice
content: In that case, I do hope I get to choose my favorite lead. May I?

speaker: Mr. E
content: Of course. Anything to please you, My Lady.
What a dreadful title. The woman waves a dismissive hand.

speaker: Frail Voice
content: Call me <color=#fb9259>Evelleon</color>.
Tonight, Euphoria is unusually quiet. Deep in the cabins, the lights are out. The air in the corridors is cold and damp, as if time itself has stopped.
Milly walks barefoot across the metal deck, her steps so light they're nearly soundless, yet slow, as if her feet were cast in lead.
She has no direction, no destination. Like an empty doll, she wanders through the silence, until her feet carry her to the door of the detention room.
This is Euphoria's darkest pit, yet she approaches it like returning to a nest she'd never left. Through the door's crack seeps the scent of old wood and a quiet that shuts out the world.

She pushes the door open, and darkness rushes to meet her as she steps inside. Milly knows this place like the back of her hand. She could find that table with her eyes closed. The one stained with her blood; the one that once held the photograph of her beloved.
She opens the drawer, takes out the photo, and lights a candle.
[Insert CG: Too Grieved to Speak]
Only a small stub of wax remains. Its flame is weak; a single breath could snuff it out. The trembling halo of light barely illuminates the faded figure in the yellowed photograph.
It occurs to her that it has been a long, long time since she last saw ${PlayerName}. She wonders if she would even remember his face if she didn't look at this picture every day.
female_content: It occurs to her that it has been a long, long time since she last saw ${PlayerName}. She wonders if she would even remember her face if she didn't look at this picture every day.

speaker: Sallie
content: What you love is nothing more than a fantasy. You love the fairy tale where you're saved, and the idea of yourself, waiting faithfully for your savior. The person you confide in, the person you adore... it's always been a delusion living in your head. And here you need to help me elope, just to prove your "true love conquers all" bullshit?

speaker: Sallie
content: We've fallen this far, and you think you can just plug your ears, shut your eyes, and find happiness by believing in love? Well, good for you. Go on, keep it up!

Tonight, the portholes are pitch black, clogged, sealed. No moonlight shines through. The trembling candle flame slowly burns through the wick until it, along with the light in her eyes, flickers and dies.
Then, she hears a frail voice.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: You poor thing. So much misery, yet you still shed no tears.
Milly doesn't turn around. Another hand, slender and covered in scars, reaches out from the shadows, passing over her shoulder to rest gently on the photograph.
With it comes a strange fragrance. A familiar perfume. Mr. E? Or one of his guests? Milly doesn't remember.
She doesn't care. Silently, she brushes the hand away from the photo. A soft laugh comes from behind.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: I know you've always loved him. That's what I liked about you from the start. And why I brought you aboard.
female_content: I know you've always loved her. That's what I liked about you from the start. And why I brought you aboard.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Your friend was too harsh... There's nothing wrong with loving someone. Love doesn't have to mean losing yourself or getting hurt. Everything you've done has been for your own happiness.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: If he makes you happy, isn't it only natural to want his attention? To want him? To possess him, and make him fulfill your desires? You know exactly what you want, and you never give up. How admirable.
female_content: If she makes you happy, isn't it only natural to want her attention? To want her? To possess her, and make her fulfill your desires? You know exactly what you want, and you never give up. How admirable.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: You're helping Sallie for your own sake, aren't you?

The person wraps her arms around Milly gently, whispering in her ear. The voice, like the fragrance, feels comforting, beguiling. She seems to know how innocent, how easily deceived this girl is. And so she speaks without restraint.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: If she gets out, she can send a message to him. Your <color=#fb9259>beloved</color> will know what a great person you are. He will come to save you. And when he does, you'll have a thousand ways to make him love you, make him forever yours. You know you have that power.
female_content: If she gets out, she can send a message to her. Your <color=#fb9259>beloved</color> will know what a great person you are. She will come to save you. And when she does, you'll have a thousand ways to make her love you, make her forever yours. You know you have that power.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Unfortunately, we're out of time.
This finally gets a response. Milly sits up straight and turns to face the figure in the shadows.

speaker: Milly
content: ...What do you mean?

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: We've been discovered. This paradise of ours will soon be destroyed.

speaker: Milly
content: Can't we escape?

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Of course. There's still time.

speaker: Milly
content: Then...

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Have you forgotten what Mr. E said? He said...
She whispers the words into Milly's ear. Milly's eyes go wide. Her reaction pleases the woman, yet also moves her to pity. She rises slightly and cups Milly's vacant face in her hands.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: It's alright. You have me. I'm quite fond of you, and I'm willing to take you away, to fulfill your wishes, to bring you to your beloved... I can give you so much more.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Show me how strong your love is. Prove to me it can be your strength. I believe you can. Because you saw the truth a long time ago...

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Death has shrouded everything. Love is the only light.

The strange fragrance turns into smoke, weaving into threads that coil around Milly's limbs. It is a familiar, gentle sensation, the same one she felt every time she passed out under the gangsters' fists or Mr. E's blade, every time she suffocated in this room. It is the breath of death.
She lets death hold her, her eyes staring blankly into the endless darkness. After a long moment, Milly smiles again. As if what awaits in the abyss is not fear or emptiness.
...but her light.

speaker: Milly
content: Yes... Death has shrouded everything. Love... is the only light.

Evelleon covers Milly's eyes. A twisted crimson pattern blooms across her back, blood seeping from the sign, thickening into honey, falling from the void into Milly's palm. It fuses with her flesh, turning into a bee-shaped ornament.
A form most fitting for Milly. The Sage of the Underground smiles with satisfaction. She removes her hand.
The light fades, returning everything to tranquil darkness.
Traveled through the sandstorm, only to find an eerie spot of calm in the center of it all.

What appeared before the patrol ship was a luxury cruise liner that seemed to materialize out of thin air. Its outline was subtly distorted, nearly impossible to capture in its true form even through radar and visual systems. Only at extremely close range would traces of its existence become detectable.

Optical camouflage, a mobile cruise ship, Mania creatures lying in wait... and now an unnatural ash storm. These bastards have pulled out all the stops to hide their tracks. No wonder they've managed to stay off the grid.

speaker: Doctor
content: No wonder we couldn't find them. Using a Mania storm as cover... impressive tech.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's no Apostle of Ashes activity nearby. An apocalyptic sandstorm like this shouldn't be possible.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Expand the search radius. There has to be something unusual nearby.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: Over here!

Deep in a dune behind the cruise ship's stern, chains are tethered to a strange metal device. A strangely colored metal flows inside the black and gold apparatus, solidifying into a bizarre pattern in the center.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: What is this thing...?
You've seen a design like this before... at the Great Expo.

speaker: Chief
content: This is...

options: An Aurum Secretum device from the Outlands.
Aurum Secretum runes from the Underground.

speaker: Chief
content: Those bastards... they're close by...
You bypass the main entrance, pry open a hatch on the southwest, and slip quietly into the cruise's lower cargo hold.
You've only taken a few steps when the floor shudders beneath you.
BOOM!
The squad members are instantly alert, quickly adjusting into a defensive formation. The next second, a wrenching wave of Mania erupts through the cracks in the metal floor. Your heart sinks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's an ambush. Be careful.
The lights flicker as the floor splits open with a thunderous roar. More than a dozen puppets, covered in sorcery runes, lurch from the shadows, their joints twisting with metallic clicks.
They aren't security robots used for patrol. You know exactly what they are.
There's no mistaking them. These inhuman things are killing machines crafted using sorcery by the Underground!

speaker: Chief
content: <color=#fb9259>Underground puppets!</color>
Not built for defense or deterrence, these are sorcery weapons designed for slaughter! It means they never intended to let anyone get out alive.
The doctor steps in front of you. Her briefcase snaps open, metal clasps sparking as her weapon returns to her hand. A brutal fight is inevitable.

A muffled boom rumbles from outside the ship, followed by a distant tremor. An instant later, a piercing alarm blares throughout the entire vessel. Emergency lights flash on one by one, bathing the cabin in an ominous, blood-red glow.
The lounge is empty of guests, occupied only by idle staff. Not knowing what's happening, they scramble about like headless chickens.

speaker: Host
content: What's going on? A sandstorm? Desert bandits?! Isn't anyone coming to protect us?
He shoves his microphone into his jacket, dropping his trembling voice to a fearful whisper as he glances wildly around.

speaker: Host
content: L-look over there! The flashing lights... is the main control down?!

speaker: Lighting Technician
content: Forget it! Whatever it is, run!

speaker: Dancer
content: Run? Where to...? Ah!!
Cassian doesn't pause. He expertly dries the last crystal glass in his hand, places it back on the rack, and wipes the bar top clean. Only then does he tap his comms, dialing Mr. E's private line.
The only reply is a cold, mechanical tone. He quickly switches channels to call the security team.

speaker: Cassian
content: What happened? Where is Mr. E?

speaker: Security Guard
content: Desert bandits! Mr. E is already dealing with them. Don't run off. Stay at your posts.
Bandit attacks aren't new. But Mr. E has never been unreachable during a crisis, and he'd never issue an order like that. Cassian doesn't have all the details, but one thing is clear.
This is his chance.
He walks briskly away from the bar.

speaker: Cassian
content: Where's Sallie?
[Event]
Cassian jogs through the corridor, stopping at the dressing room door to catch his breath. The dancers are gathered inside, lost and confused.

speaker: Cassian
content: What did they tell you over the comms?

speaker: Selene
content: To wait here for further instructions.

speaker: Cassian
content: Run.

speaker: Selene
content: What?

speaker: Cassian
content: Get out of here. This is your last chance.
He doesn't have time to explain. His eyes scan the room and land on Sallie, huddled in a corner. He strides over to her and grabs her wrist.

speaker: Cassian
content: Come with me. Now.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...What? I already told you, there's no way out.
She wrenches her hand free, her voice tired.

speaker: Sallie
content: Mr. E is powerful. He has so many Sinners. He'll get rid of the bandits in no time. Then, he'll hunt down every last one of us who ran.

speaker: Sallie
content: It's pointless. I see that now.

speaker: Cassian
content: Euphoria is under attack. It's the perfect cover. We can get to the lifeboats...

The situation is dire. This is no simple raid. The hallways are quiet. All the masked, high-ranking attendants and guests have vanished, while the low-level staff are left behind, completely in the dark.
The artificial ash storm, the manic Sinner guards abandoned outside, Mr. E's secret arts... No ordinary bandits could handle that.
Which means whoever's attacking now is a genuine threat to him. And when that man feels threatened, he will only...
Cassian's breathing quickens. He lowers his voice to give Sallie one final warning...

speaker: Cassian
content: He's not defending. He's cleaning house.

speaker: Cassian
content: They've abandoned the ship. We're left behind. On purpose.
And Mr. E would have considered the risk of leaving witnesses alive. He—
Is that what you think?
The sudden voice cuts through Cassian's thoughts. He whirls around to find Mr. E standing in the doorway, wearing his usual pleasant smile.

speaker: Mr. E
content: I heard you were looking for me, Cassian.
Cassian struggles to keep his composure. He still has the will to fight. He's been preparing for this, ready to face the most terrifying of enemies.
But when he sees the figure behind Mr. E, Cassian is still shocked.
[Fade in Milly's Portrait from Black] Style 18 for 2s

speaker: Sallie
content: Why...

speaker: Sallie
content: Milly?
[Milly's portrait brightens]
Milly stares at her former friends, expressionless. At her side stands the master of Euphoria.
Mr. E ignores Sallie. He smiles at Cassian, saying nothing... but death needs no forewarning. The prey always knows.
Cold sweat trickles down Cassian's forehead, over his eyelids, down his cheeks, before finally dripping to the floor, insignificant. But he has to try something.

speaker: Cassian
content: ...The situation onboard is dire, sir. Sallie and I were looking for stray guests. We need to ensure their safety.

speaker: Cassian
content: It's the job you gave me.
Mr. E watches him, his smile deepening.
He lets the silence draw out, long enough to strangle his prey, before finally speaking in a soft voice, almost polite.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Time is running short. No need to put on an act. Let's have an honest goodbye. I've always known about your little games, Cassian.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Guests, dancers... you've been watching everyone here. Fishing for information, winning people over. You even had the patience to play the loyal servant to my face while selling my secrets behind my back.

speaker: Mr. E
content: I know you, just as I know every single person on this ship.
Cold sweat soaks Cassian's shirt, clinging it to his skin. He tenses his body, searching for an opening, a chance to strike. But, as if to prove Mr. E's words...

speaker: Cassian
content: I... Ugh!

speaker: Sallie
content: Cassian!
He tries to activate his ability, but two forces clamp down on his shoulders from either side, forcing him to his knees, then pinning him face-down against the floor.
Sallie tries to run to him, but she's held down by one of Mr. E's eerie minions, unable to move.
These things aren't Sinners; they aren't even human. They are black puppets pulled from some kind of abyss. Cassian feels his unused power being siphoned away, his mind being disrupted.
The sight of his friend's plight quells his fear. Cassian grits his teeth and glares up at the "master" looming over him.

speaker: Cassian
content: I know what these are... Underground puppets. You really are one of them... Are you going to use these to kill us all?

speaker: Cassian
content: You fool. This will leave a trail. You don't have time to clean up the scene. They'll find out, they'll investigate. You're in a hurry to get away because they're closing in on you, aren't you?!

speaker: Cassian
content: Hiding for so long, doing all your dirty work in the shadows... and you still slip up in the end! Your enemies will find you! Your scheme will fall apart!
Mr. E listens to his rage, watches him struggle, his smile full of appreciation.

speaker: Mr. E
content: How thoughtful. You always think of everything. If only you were still willing to work for me. Like Milly here. Like you used to. I could give you what you want.

speaker: Mr. E
content: But unfortunately, your revenge seems to be over. I can no longer help you, nor can I keep you. You won't be bound by this ship anymore... such a shame.

speaker: Cassian
content: You never...

speaker: Mr. E
content: But don't worry, I won't let the puppets harm anyone. Not just for the reasons you mentioned, but also because...

speaker: Mr. E
content: You've all worked for me. You deserve a kinder end.
Mr. E turns around.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Go on, Milly. Make it easier for your friend.
Expressionless, Milly steps forward. Liquid seeps from her fingertips. Where golden honey once flowed, there is now only a corrupted, viscous black ichor.

speaker: Cassian
content: ...What are you doing? Stay back! Don't...
Cassian struggles against the puppets' grip, straining to get the words out, but Milly pays him no mind. She comes closer, a smile slowly spreading across her face.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't be afraid. Even the deepest suffering can be redeemed by love... Let me take you to them.

speaker: Sallie
content: Milly! No!!
Her hand cradles Cassian's face, black ooze streaming between her fingers, down his chin, his neck. Cassian's eyes begin to lose focus.

Painful memories buried deep in his heart are dredged up without mercy: the ruthless enemies, his shattered home, sleepless nights torn apart by fear... and the smiling faces of his beloved family, lost again, and again, and again...
The boy covers his face as blood streams down his cheeks. Then, his hands begin to bleed, fingers breaking apart like toy blocks, never to be pieced back together again...

speaker: Milly
content: ...Do you see them?
Milly's smile is gentle, full of pity. She leans close to Cassian's ear.

speaker: Milly
content: Everyone you ever loved is long dead. Your parents, your family, your kin... not a single one remains. Only you are still alive.

speaker: Milly
content: There's no one for you to love, and no one to love you back. Your life has lost all possibility of love...

speaker: Milly
content: So what's the point in living?

speaker: Milly
content: Wouldn't it be better to die with the ship? To be with your loved ones again. You'd be so much happier.
Her voice is sweet as honey, her smile bright as the sun, but the man in her grasp can no longer perceive it.
Cassian's face is pale, his expression vacant as he mutters incoherent words.

speaker: Cassian
content: ...Can I? Can I see them again...?

speaker: Cassian
content: Then I...

speaker: Sallie
content: Cassian! What's wrong? Wake up!!
Sallie shouts desperately, but Cassian gives no sign of hearing her. She watches helplessly as his eyes turn cloudy and lifeless, as if his heart has been hollowed out.

How could this happen? Didn't Milly's ability just make people lovesick? Didn't she use it just to protect herself? But what she's doing to Cassian is nothing like what she did to the guests. He's tormented... helpless... completely at her mercy. Her power... has it changed?

speaker: Milly
content: This way, there's no trace left behind.

speaker: Milly
content: Slowly, slowly... they will sink into their most painful memories. And then, they will turn into monsters.
She looks back at Mr. E with a smile, as if waiting for his praise. He gives her an approving nod. For she has awakened a new power, one that is still growing... She has not disappointed the Sage.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Well done, Milly. Once you've dealt with the rest of them, come back to me. I'll take you to see your lover.

speaker: Mr. E
content: There's no one worth taking from this ship except you.
Mr. E looks at the dazed Cassian.

speaker: Mr. E
content: You were kept alive because the ship needed you. Now, the ship is sinking. You should show your gratitude... and give it a proper send-off.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Finish your last job. Disappear cleanly.

He departs, leaving two puppets with Milly. A noise comes from a nearby closet; someone is hiding inside. The puppets drop the now-useless Cassian and gleefully scuttle over, dragging a poor, wailing attendant from his hiding place.
Milly walks over with a beaming smile, stepping over Sallie to get to her new prey. Those horrific screams pierce Sallie's heart, finally awakening her primal fear.
No... I can't die here... not like this! I have to get out of here!

Another blast rocks the ship violently. The lights flicker, and the puppet's grip on her loosens. Seizing the chance, Sallie kicks hard at her captor. Her hands are nearly wrested out of their joints, but she manages to break free.
She scrambles to her feet and lunges toward Cassian, the puppet close at her heels.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...Leave him alone!
Another tremor sends the puppet stumbling. Sallie throws herself to the floor and clutches her friend to her chest.
Seizing her last chance, she kicks over a nearby clothes rack. Dresses and metal poles crash to the floor, creating a momentary barrier. Sallie slaps Cassian hard across his face.

speaker: Sallie
content: Wake up! You said we were going to escape together!

His cheeks are red from the whacks, but he gives no response. Glancing back, she sees Milly regaining her footing and turning her head toward them. Sallie curses, hoists the dazed Cassian over her shoulder, and dashes for the door.
As one final boom echoes through the ship, they race out of the backstage area and into the chaos of the main hall.
You fight through the ambush and storm into the ship, only to find the entire deck empty, save for a few puppets.
No sign of the suspect. No sign of the victim who sent the distress signal. Barely any documents left. Only the red emergency lights flash across hollow, gaudy halls.
Did they get tipped off? Had they prepared for this? Something feels wrong. You need to find someone, anyone, to answer your questions. And then you hear a voice...

speaker: Panicked Guest
content: Who the hell are you?! I said that no one was to enter without my permission!
The patrol team kicks down every VIP room door until they finally discover two living souls who can still speak.

One is clutching a lamp to shield himself, scared out of his wits. The other, scantily clad in expensive robes, quickly regains his composure after the initial shock and begins barking orders. Apparently, he'd been having such a good time that he didn't even notice he'd been left behind.

speaker: Doctor
content: Hehe... This one's got serious issues.
The doctor snickers at the comedic scene. A DisCorps soldier, taking the cue, steps forward and restrains the man.

speaker: Panicked Guest
content: What do you think you're doing? Get off me! My father is—
The soldier, tired of his whining, pulls out his gun and fires a shot into the floor by the man's feet. The noble captive suddenly remembers his manners and meekly raises both hands.
Another soldier throws a towel around the man hugging the lamp, and brings the pair before you.
Both shake their heads frantically.
One continues shaking his head, but the other misses the beat and accidentally nods.

speaker: Chief
content: Who are you delivering intel to? Who's your handler?! What does Farland want from you?!

speaker: Panicked Guest
content: I don't know! They... I think they all left! Said they were ending the voyage early.

A few more rounds of interrogation don't come up with anything. The one who talks is screaming his head off, the other's jaw is chattering so hard he can't form words. Both have wet themselves. They don't seem to be lying.

The interrogation leaves you breathless. The contamination ravages your body, making it hard to do the job you've done so many times. Worse, you can see the soldiers running out of patience. A few more stupid remarks from these two pathetic fools, and their brains might end up on the carpet. You wave a hand, dismissing the two sorry specimens.
Just as you thought, the masterminds are cautious. The moment they smell trouble, they abandon their operations and escape.
...Or is it the case?

Intel confirmed suspicious passenger ships sneaking into the sandstorm zone just yesterday, likely bringing new guests to the cruise. Which means that up until yesterday, Euphoria was still in business.
Was this place cleared out overnight? All those people, all the documents, all the evidence that might have been left... How long would that take? How many hands? And where did they all go?

The soldiers are still combing through the ship. It will take time, but your intuition is telling you: they won't find anything. You're starting to see the true purpose of this conspicuous, trap-filled vessel that appeared so suddenly...
[Screen shakes, storm intensifies]

speaker: Chief
content: Cough, cough!
The storm intensifies unnaturally, triggering a violent coughing fit. You spit out a mouthful of contaminated blood.

This isn't just the effect of the Tide of Ashes... You sense a power gathering nearby, awakening, jumbling your mind into chaos. But you vaguely latch onto that feeling. Or rather, you're determined to catch it...

speaker: Adelaide
content: Only four Sages wielding this power would suffice to bring you considerable... inconvenience.
Of course... it's them... Subtly different, yet strikingly similar. You've unexpectedly gotten close to one of your targets. Between coughs, you can't help but smile.
That's right. Why bother taking away the evidence? Destroying it on site works just as well. You need to hurry up.

speaker: Chief
content: Leave a squad here. Search the area and keep watch. Stay safe. Everyone else, follow me. We're turning back for a thorough search. The real culprits are hidden deeper. Camouflage, sandstorms, wherever they are hiding... we're digging them out. Judging by the two clowns they left behind, they can't be far from here.

speaker: Chief
content: Those bastards are hiding nearby... Find them... Catch them alive!
Your words stir something, and the atmosphere on the ship changes. Silently, the soldiers move to support you, ready to head out at once.
As you pass the two captives, they timidly speak up.

speaker: Confused Guest
content: Er... I think there was someone else. He was here just now... said he had something to do, needed to come back to find someone...

speaker: Panicked Guest
content: I bet he was trying to sneak off with a dancer he fancied. After all, Mr. E never lets anyone take the girls off the ship.

speaker: Chief
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Mr. E</color>...?
[Begin Battle]
The alarm keeps blaring through the hallways, the nerve-wracking booms sounding like countdowns from the depths of the WhiteSands.

Milly walks down the corridor with a beaming smile. The golden cords of her dress sways with each step, like ominous signs trailing in Death's wake. Each click of her heels against the floor meets the beat of the alarm, creating a strange, ritualistic rhythm.
The guests are gone, leaving only panicked staff members and performers. When they spot Milly, the dancers rush toward her, desperate to know what's happening.

speaker: Snow
content: Milly! What's going on? Where are we supposed to go? Are we evacuating?!

speaker: Milly
content: Shh... keep it down. The show's not over yet.
She puts a finger to her lips in a playful shushing gesture.

speaker: Milly
content: No one is coming for you. The ship is going down. Where would you go?
Sensing something off, Snow uses her ability the moment Milly draws near, blasting snow and ice shards before turning to run. But it's too late.
Milly's puppets move like shadows, tackling Snow to the ground before she can turn.

speaker: Snow
content: Milly! You...!
Milly extends her finger, lightly touching its honey to the dancer's forehead. Snow's pupils contract, and her body goes limp.

speaker: Milly
content: You can't escape on your own. I'm just making it easier for you.
The dancer lies motionless on the floor, her eyes vacant. The others, finally realizing something is wrong, scramble to flee, screaming and banging against doors.
But the puppets have already surrounded them silently, blocking every exit. There is no slaughter, only their silent, menacing advance.

speaker: Milly
content: No need to rush. Let's do it one at a time. Next, please...

speaker: Milly
content: And where have my two friends gone?
The golden cord in her hand sways rhythmically, no longer a beautiful ornament, but the noose of Death.
Click... clack... clack...
Through a crack in the door, Sallie watches the massacre, eyes wide with horror. She clamps a hand over her mouth, terrified of making a single sound.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...Who is that?
The blonde woman's smile is radiant. She hums a cheerful tune, but her performance brings her audience nothing but pain and despair.

speaker: Sallie
content: That's not Milly! I don't know who that is!
She trembles and backs away, turning to shake Cassian. He's curled up in agony, head in his hands. Sweat soaks his temples, and only muffled groans escape his lips.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...We can't stay here. Cassian! Are you okay? Can you run?!

She throws herself at him, shaking his shoulders. Maybe her efforts do work, or perhaps Milly's influence has waned, for Cassian's eyes begin to focus as he comes to his senses, though he's still covered in cold sweat.

speaker: Cassian
content: Sallie...
Cassian rasps her name, beckoning her closer.

speaker: Cassian
content: Listen. You can't stop her. No one can. If this continues... she'll kill everyone.

speaker: Sallie
content: No, there's still a chance, we can...
Cassian manages a weak smile and nods.

speaker: Cassian
content: There is. But you'll have to go alone. Take this...
He presses something into her hand. A key, and the communicator that nearly got them killed. He had hidden it away. His body has almost given out; he can only lean against the wall for support.

speaker: Cassian
content: I told you before, I prepared an escape route for myself. There's a small boat hidden at the end.

speaker: Cassian
content: The guests' boats are gone by now. Mr. E will make sure the lifeboats are all destroyed...

speaker: Cassian
content: Don't worry. Mine's disguised. You'll find it.

speaker: Cassian
content: Run. Get help. Live...
Sallie starts to protest, but the screams from the corridor are death knells, each sending a jolt through their nerves.
Cassian pushes her toward the hidden door with all his strength.

speaker: Cassian
content: There's a corridor outside. Keep running, go to the fifth floor...

speaker: Sallie
content: How could I possibly escape... I...

Cassian looks at her. He's seen that look countless times before, on faces that were once innocent, or angry, or filled with want... faces once so full of life, slowly hollowed out by this hell until they became the same mask. He's seen it so many times he thought he'd gone numb.
But this time... is it because he's seen the ghosts of his loved ones, because he knows his own end is near? This time, Cassian wants to do something.
For once, he forces an unfamiliar smile for Sallie.

speaker: Cassian
content: If you've lost the will to escape for yourself, then do it as a favor to me.

speaker: Cassian
content: Get out of here for me. Show the world the truth about this place, its darkness. That will be my revenge...

speaker: Cassian
content: Go. I still have some strength left. I can buy you time.
Click... clack... The sound of heels is getting closer.
Without hesitating, Cassian pries Sallie's fingers from the door. He slams it shut and locks it from his side, silencing her cries.
Behind the hidden door, tears stream down Sallie's face.

Through the wood, she hears the click-clack of heels stop where Cassian had been. A familiar laugh rings out. Sallie grits her teeth, forces herself up on trembling legs, and staggers down the dark passage.
The passage is narrow, suffocating. She can't tell if anyone's chasing her; all she hears is the pounding of her own heartbeat.

speaker: Sallie
content: Run... Run...
She gasps for air. Is it a lack of oxygen, or is the world twisting around her? Black ichor begins to ooze from the ceiling, walls, and floor, almost like blood.
She doesn't see Milly, but she can hear that familiar laugh. Soft and sweet, wrapped around a feverish edge.

speaker: Sallie
content: Who... who's going to stop her?!
She clutches the communicator, sending one distress message after another. But there's no signal. Just a glaring exclamation mark next to each failed attempt.

speaker: Sallie
content: Damn it!
Ignoring the terrifying sounds behind her, she sticks to Cassian's escape route, racing through corridor after corridor. At last, she reaches the fifth level and dashes out of the passage...

...to the surface of the WhiteSands? It dawns on her: most of the ship is buried beneath the sand, carefully concealed. How long have they been trapped here in this sunless tomb? Like they were already pronounced dead.

Sallie steels herself. No time for shock. The sandstorm howls outside. She searches the deck and finds the small boat Cassian hid behind a stack of wine barrels. She activates the crane, lowering the boat toward the sand, and jumps in when it's near the surface.
The key. Right, the key! She fumbles for it with trembling hands. As she goes to start the engine, she glances up to confirm her escape route.
But in that one glance, Sallie sees something that makes her freeze. That split second of distraction costs her everything.

speaker: Puppet
content: Chief
The underground puppet leaps onto the boat, pinning her down. The key slips from her grasp.
The key Cassian entrusted to her glints once before hitting the sand. In the blink of an eye, it vanishes into the quicksand, as if it had never existed at all.
The puppet grabs Sallie and hurls her back onto the cruise ship. A figure steps into view, and once again, she hears that sweet, terrifying voice.

speaker: Milly
content: Why the hesitation? You can't escape those things if you're that slow.
She gently pushes the puppet aside and straightens Sallie's clothes, like she's helping a friend.

speaker: Sallie
content: Milly...
Before she can utter a plea, Sallie sees it—a metal chain caught on the tattered hem of Milly's dress. It's Cassian's, and it's stained with blood.
Sallie's mind goes blank.

speaker: Sallie
content: What did you do to Cassian...?

speaker: Milly
content: Take a guess?
Such an offhand reply. Her smile is so harsh it hurts. Now, even fear feels insignificant.

speaker: Sallie
content: Wasn't he your friend? We supported each other in this hellhole. Weren't we friends?

speaker: Milly
content: Supporting each other? No, we each had our own pillars. He wanted revenge, I wanted my love. Isn't that what you said? People can only find happiness by looking out for themselves.

speaker: Sallie
content: That's not the same! You're not like this!
Milly bursts into laughter.

speaker: Milly
content: Then what am I like? Unschooled, brainwashed, naive, stupid. A girl who'd run after anyone who dangled love as the bait... You saw right through me, didn't you? What else did you expect? You barely even knew me, and you decided that I was a good person...

speaker: Milly
content: You can't even trust the one you love. Where did all that rational cynicism go?
She leans in closer, her eyes glowing with an uncanny light. Her power has grown stronger.

speaker: Milly
content: Why did you stop just now? What made you hesitate? You were so close to getting away... Did you see something? Oh, don't tell me...

speaker: Milly
content: You saw that other boat, didn't you?
Milly's eyes dart toward the boat that had distracted Sallie.

speaker: Milly
content: Looks expensive. No doubt a rich person's toy. But what does that have to do with you? Let me guess... You recognize the owner. You know who the boat belongs to... Is it your darling Theodore?

speaker: Milly
content: "Theodore didn't leave by boat, he's still here..." Is that what made you hesitate?

speaker: Milly
content: Worried he'd be trapped here and die, and you couldn't bear it? Or did you think he came back to save you? Were you touched? Did you start believing he loves you again?
The words strike home, and Sallie has no comeback. Milly leans down and cups her face.

speaker: Milly
content: Hahaha, oh, Sallie. You're so cute. All those lessons you preached to me... have you forgotten them all when it's your turn? Is love really so magical it can make even you lose your head? Well, then, let's take a little trip down memory lane.

speaker: Sallie
content: No... Don't...
Milly laughs and laughs, honey oozing from her fingertips. She dips it in Sallie's fear and smears it across her terrified face, as happy as a girl applying makeup to her best friend.

speaker: Milly
content: Think back... and don't forget what you told me... Love is the dumbest joke there is. True love and destiny are lies. Hormones, stories, every flutter of the heart... they're all lies.

speaker: Milly
content: There's no such thing as perfect love. No one is coming to save you. And the one you love is never, ever to be trusted...
The woman's voice distorts, fading into the distance. Sallie's consciousness slips.

In her daze, through a break in the sandstorm, she sees a few boats trying desperately to pull away. The people on board... something glitters on them. Right... stage costumes. So not everyone was killed... some still managed to escape...

But as she thinks this, the storm surges. The white sand begins to churn, forming a massive whirlpool with the ship at its center. Black contamination spills from the vortex, slowly spreading, chasing the boats... pushing further...
At the end of their escape route, a twisted black barrier rises, blocking the way. She watches as the whirlpool pulls the boats back, dragging them toward this hopeless abyss. Sallie's vision blurs.
In the darkness, she sees Theodore. Shy, timid, frightened Theodore... Did he escape? Would he be foolish enough to come back for her? What they had... was it really love?
...I never expected perfect love from him. I never expected him to save me. Because from the very beginning, I knew... he was a coward.
He's an introverted man. He was dragged into the bar by his dandy friends, too scared to speak or move. He didn't fit in but didn't have the guts to say no.

He's an insecure man. When he asked her out, his hands shook so badly he could barely hold the flowers. He'd write pages of notes for what to say on their date. He was always too scared to clear up misunderstandings. And after blocking that bottle for her, he was so terrified he grabbed her hand and ran several blocks.

He's a powerless man. He couldn't put on airs, but was forced into high society. He tried to start his own business, but his family smashed his shop and dragged him back. He fell in love, but was terrified that their relationship would be found out and she'd be humiliated. He didn't want to inherit the family business and dirty his hands, but every attempt to rebel ended in failure, until he finally lost the will to fight.
Yes, she always knew he couldn't save her. He couldn't even save himself. So why would she still...

speaker: Theodore
content: I've always been a coward. That's why I admire you, and respect you...

speaker: Theodore
content: You're the bravest, proudest person I've ever met. You never back down, never give in. You shine brighter than any of the wealthy and noble people I've known. Just watching you gives me the courage to face my own miserable life.

speaker: Theodore
content: I'm sorry, Sallie. I'm not the best partner, nor the richest, the strongest, or the one who understands you most. The things I try hard to give you might not amount to anything. But I want to do my best to make you happy, even if it's just to thank you...

speaker: Theodore
content: ...Thank you for coming into my life.
Tears fall down her face.
...Me too.

I never understood your weakness. What does a privileged boy have to worry about? What could you possibly see in me besides vanity and looks? Everyone else was walking over me, but you said you admired and respected me. Such a spoiled brat who didn't know anything... Stupid, dumb idiot...

I cursed everyone, but you were so dumb I couldn't even get mad at you. So pathetic I couldn't keep my guard up. You asked me to trust you. Well, when I was with you, for just a little while... I wanted to live an easier life. I wanted to try trusting someone.
Was that a lie, too? Or did I lose my head in anger and push you away myself? Why did you come here? Why couldn't you look at me? Oh... I should've stayed calm. What if I got it all wrong...?

speaker: Sallie
content: Milly was right... No matter how awful things looked, I should have talked to you first...
In her delirium, that familiar figure appears again. Sallie reaches out a trembling hand, trying to touch the face of her beloved in the hallucination.

speaker: Sallie
content: For in this goddamned world... it was you who made me forget how to hate...
Her vision slowly clears. Theodore's face morphs into Milly's, smeared with blood.
Is it because Sallie's dying? Milly doesn't look so frightening anymore.

speaker: Milly
content: It's not too late, you know.
She's wearing her usual, silly smile.

speaker: Milly
content: It's not too late, Sallie. See what's in your heart, and you'll never lose.
Sallie tries to ask what she means, but doesn't get the chance. Gunshots crack the air, and then...
In the distance, bullets hit Theodore's boat. The fuel tank explodes in a pillar of flames, drawing the puppets' attention for a second.
In that instant, a figure bursts through the smoke and fire, charging toward them.
Aaaahhh! LET HER GO!!!
The sudden blow catches Milly on the temple. She's flung to the side, tumbling across the floor, and doesn't get up for a moment. But that surprise attack is the only effective hit he lands.

Two puppets quickly recover from the explosion and pounce at Theodore. The frail young man is forced to abandon his plan of grabbing Sallie and running. He turns around, wildly brandishing a rifle he'd snatched from some guard. The bullets bounce off the puppets like mosquitoes off a window pane.

He screams and lunges forward, ramming the rifle sideways against the inhuman monsters. Theodore's lost his mind. He can't even get the words out to tell Sallie to run; he just shrieks to steel himself, all blood drained from his face. After taking a dozen heavy blows, he's seized and hurled aside like a ragdoll.

speaker: Sallie
content: Theodore?!
The sight jolts Sallie awake. She scrambles over to Theodore's side. Blood and foam are bubbling from his mouth.
The puppets have shattered his body, and terror has crushed his mind. In this hard-won reunion, he can't manage a coherent sentence. Only confused mumbles escape his lips.

speaker: Theodore
content: Run... Sallie... run...

speaker: Theodore
content: I'm sorry...
Sallie's throat tightens, and she pulls him protectively into her arms.

speaker: Sallie
content: You idiot! If you're going to be a coward, be a coward all the way! Why play the hero now?! You—

speaker: Sallie
content: Stay back!

She snatches Theodore's rifle and points it at the approaching puppets. Hatred drives away her fear, consuming her, filling her with a strength she's never felt. She glares at the monsters she was running from just moments before.

speaker: Sallie
content: I said, stay back! You bastards!!
She fires without hesitation. The puppets try to dodge, but strangely, they seem to be moving in slow motion in her eyes. Sallie adjusts her aim and fires again, blasting a hole in one puppet's head.
The vile thing stutters, then straightens its neck with both hands and attacks again. Sallie's out of bullets. She grabs the barrel and swings the rifle like a club.

speaker: Sallie
content: Die, you monster—!

speaker: Puppet
content: SCREEEEEE!!!
Before the stock connects, the puppet's body convulses. Several slimy spikes burst from its torso. It shrieks and rolls away.
That, of course, isn't Sallie's doing. As the puppet collapses, she sees someone standing behind it. He's holding another monster by the neck and glowering at her with a grim expression.

speaker: Cassian
content: ...Is that how you use a gun?

speaker: Sallie
content: Cassian?! You're alive!

speaker: Sallie
content: When did your power get so...
Wait, it's the same with her. The same gun, the same bullets. Useless when Theodore fired it, but in her hands, they actually did damage... What happened? Is this her power?
No... She feels something warm on her face. She wipes a hand across her cheek—it's honey. The black is fading away, turning into a brilliant gold.

speaker: Cassian
content: This isn't my power...

speaker: Cassian
content: I was never this fast. Nor this strong. After you made me watch... that stuff, something's been wrong with me.
He says no more, his eyes fixed on the Sinner behind the puppet as she slowly pushes herself up.
Milly's temple is split, blood smearing her glove as she presses her hand against the wound. Theodore's hit has done serious damage.
Yet this witch, who just tormented everyone, is smiling. Cassian doesn't dare lower his guard, but he's genuinely perplexed.

speaker: Cassian
content: ...Was this your doing?

speaker: Cassian
content: What did you do to me? Where did this power come from? What exactly are you planning?

speaker: Milly
content: Don't be so mad. I'm sorry I didn't tell you. But the <color=#fb9259>Raincoat</color> was watching my every move. I'm a dumb girl, and this was the only way I could think of to help everyone. I'm so glad it worked!

speaker: Milly
content: You two are the last ones. I've given everyone the blessing of love. Now you're all stronger. You can make it out of here. Hurry, before the big monster wakes up.

speaker: Cassian
content: What are you talking about? You know that man won't let anyone escape. The sorcery has been activated. They're sealing off the ship. These B-Class Sinners can't possibly...
Milly doesn't answer. She turns her gaze to the others fleeing in the distance.
The honey she shared gave them strength, enough to fight off the puppets and strive for freedom. It rekindled their long-lost hope: to leave this place, to fight, to live.

Mr. E must have anticipated their little struggle. He would have prepared a backup plan. The sorcery at the ship's base is activating, the maelstrom of Mania expanding and pulling at everyone trying to escape like a bog. At Euphoria's end, the barrier of corruption is growing thicker, blocking the sky, mocking anyone who dares to hope.
Milly understands this, yet she shows no fear. She never seems to know what it means to be afraid.

speaker: Milly
content: How will we know if we don't try? I've awakened the love in your hearts. You must believe that love can create miracles.

speaker: Cassian
content: Why are you still saying these things? That alone won't—
Boom—

The impact sends ripples across the rising Mania barrier. On the other side, several patrol ships are pushing doggedly against the quicksand. On the deck of the lead vessel, a weak figure clutches the railing, fighting to stay on the front line.

The Mania is causing the contamination within him to roil out of control. The violent ash storm blocks his vision and jams the navigation systems. He strains his eyes but can barely see what lies ahead.
female_content: The Mania is causing the contamination within her to roil out of control. The violent ash storm blocks her vision and jams the navigation systems. She strains her eyes but can barely see what lies ahead.

speaker: Chief
content: Hehe... Just as I thought. That cruise ship was just a decoy. Their real hideout is here, buried deep.

speaker: Chief
content: How dare they use Mania contamination so brazenly... A desperate move after being exposed. Trying to destroy all evidence? Not a chance!
You close your eyes and concentrate. The contamination within you is boiling. Something massive out there is resonating with it, activating it. Endure, and then... catch it...

speaker: Chief
content: Found it!

options: Three o'clock! Breach that position! Fire!

content: More impacts hit. Not strong enough to tear through the Mania barricade, but the ripples are a clear signal of hope, an affirmation from fate that their rebellion was not in vain.

The long-oppressed find their strength. Empowered by the golden blessing, they focus their attack on that single point of weakness in the barrier. Slowly but surely, they tear open a crack in Euphoria's darkness.
[Scene Change]
Sallie clutches the unconscious Theodore, tears welling in her eyes. At last, the weight of repression is lifted, and the world opens up before her. She turns eagerly to her friends.

speaker: Sallie
content: We're getting out of here, Cassian! Milly!
Milly is also gazing at the crack. Bathed in a soft golden light, she looks dazed, but deeply satisfied.

speaker: Milly
content: See? When we have love in our hearts, when we fight for that love, miracles will happen.

A chill runs down Sallie's spine. The black filth on Milly's body has turned into golden honey, but beneath the sweet glaze, Sallie can see red patterns spreading across the Sinner's skin, clinging to her like veins... like some kind of parasitic vine.
Cassian recognizes it. His eyes widen in disbelief.

speaker: Cassian
content: It wasn't that man... Your power comes from the one behind him. The master of those puppets...

speaker: Cassian
content: What did you trade? Don't tell me—
A violent tremor cuts him off. From the belly of the ship, from the depths of the swirling vortex, comes a low, twisted growl.

Something has awakened. Mania contamination erupts from below, and nearby Corruptors and sand beasts shriek in response. The sandstorm intensifies, cutting off their paths. He can only hear Milly's soft reply through the honey.

speaker: Milly
content: I told you, a monster's about to wake up. If you don't go now, you'll be eaten before anyone can save you. I'm the only one who can stop it now. Leave it to me.

speaker: Milly
content: It looks like ${PlayerName} has a lot of enemies here. Please, help me get word to him. And don't die, okay? Everyone here is my friend.
female_content: It looks like ${PlayerName} has a lot of enemies here. Please, help me get word to her. And don't die, okay? Everyone here is my friend.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't just stand there. The blessing of love has a time limit. Finally, there's a chance to get out of here alive. You have to seize it. Sometimes you only get one shot to change your fate.

speaker: Milly
content: If you really think of us as your little sisters, then at least save one of us. Don't make the same mistake again.
Cassian hesitates, watching the white sand flowing faster beneath his feet and the Mania pulsing from the ship's hull. Finally, he grits his teeth and makes up his mind.

speaker: Cassian
content: ...Damn it!
He grabs Sallie and the unconscious Theodore and jumps onto the boat. The vessel, built only for two, pitches and rolls, barely landing upright on the sand.
The key he gave Sallie is long gone. Cassian morphs his blood into a key, a shape he's known by heart. Without hesitation, he turns the key and starts the engine.

speaker: Sallie
content: Cassian? What are you doing? What about Milly?

speaker: Cassian
content: ...If you want to help her, we need to get out of here and find someone who can. We can't do anything now. We'd only be a burden.

speaker: Sallie
content: What do you mean? She's not coming with us? Milly!

speaker: Sallie
content: Milly!
At the heart of the Mania contamination, the crimson vines are crawling over Milly's body, carving into her skin. The backlash is corrupting her flesh, but it can't take the smile from her face.

speaker: Cassian
content: What did you trade? Don't tell me—
On the other side, in a departing boat far from the battle, a man is holding a black umbrella, sheltering the weak Sage against the storm.

speaker: Evelleon
content: What do you suppose she had to give me? Poor girl. No power, no money, no one to look after her. All alone, barely strong enough to protect herself. To make a deal with me, she could only offer her life.

speaker: Evelleon
content: But I have a soft spot for her kind. As the bells toll for the end of the world, I find a special fondness for those who still choose to live with such innocence.
So wretched, yet so fortunate. So foolish, yet so prudent. Always clutching that fragile, unwavering passion... People like her are rare these days. It's a pity, Evelleon thinks.
From the wound she cut for Milly, blood begins to boil. Crimson patterns grow and spread, channeling the fiery life force from another into the Sage's ashen body.

speaker: Evelleon
content: You've taken more than enough of my power. Now, it's time to give me back your most fervent love. And death.
Sallie has never felt such panic. She struggles desperately, trying to break free from Cassian's grip, to jump from the boat, grab that idiot and scream some sense into her.

speaker: Sallie
content: You dummy! Are you playing hero for your Chief?!

speaker: Milly
content: That's right! I just love him that much. What can I say? I'm an idiot.
female_content: That's right! I just love her that much. What can I say? I'm an idiot.

content: Yet there she is, with that same, infuriatingly stubborn smile. Even with her body covered in scars and corruption, she is still smiling like a silly sun in the dark night.

speaker: Milly
content: Stop lecturing me already. I won't listen anyway! Let's just make up while we can.

speaker: Milly
content: That was the first time I've fought with a friend. I'm not good with words, so I couldn't argue back yesterday. But the more I thought about it, the madder I got, so I couldn't help messing with you just now. I was just trying to scare you. Don't be mad at me, okay?

speaker: Milly
content: When we get out of here, let's meet up and tell each other our little secrets about love.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't worry, I'm not going to die. I still need to see the one I love!
In an instant, the Mania surges, and the storm swallows Euphoria whole.
Focus the attacks. Keep pushing. With forces converging from inside and out, the barrier is torn open. You see scores of Sinners escaping, and command your squad to get them to safety.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: We've tracked down the signal. They're mostly imprisoned Sinners and staff on the ship.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: We've brought them under protection. Awaiting further orders.
The doctor supports you, clearly intending to get you back to the cabin. Releasing the shackles helped you find the right direction, but it also exacerbated the corruption. Your head is ringing.
But a sharper unease hammers at you.

speaker: Chief
content: You stay here and help with the rescue. I need a few people to go in with me. I...

speaker: Chief
content: We can't stop here. There's more to this...

You force your weakened body to stand, watching as Euphoria is being consumed by Mania in the distance. You realize it's some kind of self-destruct protocol. Somewhere you can't see, the enemy is making their final move.
You have to go there. Now. You can't say why. To salvage intel? To hunt down the mastermind? No, it's more than that...
Your temples throb. In the rising contamination, your intuition tells you that something else is there. An immense power. An S-class Sinner? An Apostle? Underground sorcery? Or maybe...
Beep...
A message comes through the comms. Same source as before, but much closer this time.
The comms officer quickly decrypts the code and patches the message to you.

speaker: Chief
content: This is...!
To the MBCC Chief, or whoever gets this:
HURRY! PLEASE! SAVE HER!! Only you can save her. Please, I'm begging you!
Sallie frantically mashes the keys, repeating the same words over and over as tears splatter onto her hands and the console.

Cassian's boat struggles against the quicksand, straining under the weight of three people. There's no telling how long it'll take to break through the barrier and reach rescue teams. She can only hope this signal can get through the sandstorm and reach someone—anyone—a little sooner.

speaker: Sallie
content: Sob... Sob... please... just a little faster, please...

Step by step, Milly walks down the wrecked corridor, through the sunless cage that has been her home for years. The power inside her surges through the space, draining her even as it guides her to her destination.
Corruptor contamination blocks her path, and she's taken a few hits. But she's happy that everyone else has left. Milly's in such a good mood, she starts to hum a tune.

speaker: Milly
content: Is our Sallie crying right now? We had so little time, I couldn't explain anything properly. Maybe we'll get another chance someday.

speaker: Milly
content: I know I told you I wouldn't listen, but you really did teach me so much. You've gone to school, seen the world... You're smarter and more level-headed than I am. And you even got to be with the one you love. I envy you.

speaker: Milly
content: You showed me that love isn't always sweet, that there won't always be perfect understanding. That the ones we love aren't necessarily strong and perfect; maybe we don't really understand each other. Maybe someday, we'll drift apart.

speaker: Milly
content: I learned how terrifying it is to give your heart to someone. Love makes you vulnerable. I suppose I've never truly experienced love, since I've never worried about that.

speaker: Milly
content: But what it gave me was more than enough.

speaker: Milly
content: Just thinking of that person, remembering a single moment, brings me joy and makes my heart race. My whole world changed. Whether in Syndicate or here, the night no longer strangled me with its grip. I had sweet dreams instead of nightmares.

speaker: Milly
content: I could imagine happiness again. I could look forward to tomorrow. I became so much braver. Things I never thought I could do, I now have the courage to try. I can feel kindness again, and I want to embrace the world, to love everyone around me, even if they push me away.

speaker: Milly
content: If this is the power of hormones and dopamine that scared you so much, then I want to thank it. It's incredible! An illogical, devastating force. It must be life's gift to all of us.

speaker: Milly
content: You must have felt it too, right? You didn't hesitate to shoot that terrifying raincoat monster. Even your timid Theodore found the courage to charge out and fight me.

speaker: Milly
content: Love can turn us into fools, but it can also make us blessed heroes. I've seen how strong you are, Sallie. This awful world shouldn't scare you at all. Even if Theodore really is a scumbag, there's nothing to be afraid of.

speaker: Milly
content: I hope we can all be free to love whoever we want to love.

The long road comes to an end. She's back on the stage. It no longer shines with its usual splendor. The magnificent curtains are torn apart, the tiles shattered to pieces. Electric sparks dance among the ruins.
Someone is waiting for her.

speaker: Mr. E
content: ...You still haven't learned your lesson, Milly. Didn't that Chief tell you, back in Syndicate?

speaker: Mr. E
content: "Stay where you are, and protect yourself. He will come back for you." If only you'd listened and waited there like a good girl. Why did you have to run out after him?
female_content: "Stay where you are, and protect yourself. She will come back for you." If only you'd listened and waited there like a good girl. Why did you have to run out after her?

speaker: Mr. E
content: If you hadn't run out, the bad guys would never have caught you and sold you to me. Your love story could've had a happy ending.

speaker: Milly
content: Hehe, who knew he was so amazing? It was chaos out there, and I was worried. It was the first time I'd ever loved someone. I didn't know what was the right thing to do.
female_content: Hehe, who knew she was so amazing? It was chaos out there, and I was worried. It was the first time I'd ever loved someone. I didn't know what was the right thing to do.

content: She walks onto the stage, smoothing her dress like she always does. It's a gown her boss had custom-made for her, exquisitely adorned. Before every show, she would gratefully adjust it to perfection.

speaker: Milly
content: You were very kind to me, Mr. E. No one in Syndicate was ever that good to me. I loved those beautiful stories you told me. "True love conquers all." So romantic. But, sir, what you said and what you did were two different things. All you wanted was to crush love under your feet.

speaker: Milly
content: The chaotic voice rises from the void, slowly engulfing the entire street.
Mr. E watches her with his usual loving, gentle smile. Black ichor flows from his hands, coalescing into an umbrella, which he opens gracefully.

speaker: Mr. E
content: True. But you can no longer do that.

speaker: Mr. E
content: You made a pact with the Sage. Your power comes from the Underground, and you must surrender everything to death.
As if summoned by the black umbrella, Mania writhes toward them from all directions, slithering onto the stage.

Half of it converges at their feet, forming a sinister rune circle from which massive, dark figures begin to take shape. The other half crawls up Milly's body, tearing and pulling, trying to rip her to shreds with her golden gown.
Milly watches with an unflinching gaze. After a long moment, she smiles.

speaker: Milly
content: You're wrong. Love gave me this power, and I'll give everything I have for love.
She walks to the center of the stage and casts away the extravagant gown, the costume that adorned her, betrayed her, and shackled her.
She'll never need it again.
[Insert Video] Try muting the video audio and adding background music from the asset table to ensure continuity with the following sequence
[Blank Screen 1s] See whether black or white screen provides better transition
Such relief. Such liberation. The monsters, the vines entangling her, the power that burns so brilliantly only to fade... none of it is to be feared.
This is Euphoria's final performance. The band in her head begins to play; her dancers have gone ahead to the new world, and as for the audience...
She'll just pretend her beloved ${PlayerName} is sitting in the front row.

I'm sorry, my dear ${PlayerName}. I took the liberty of imagining you as the hero who would come and take me away. Even minutes ago, when I sensed people arriving, I still dreamed you were among them.
On second thought, that's still me waiting for you to save me. A bit pathetic, isn't it?
[Scene Change] Chief's Side
Through the rift, a boat is heading toward the heart of the vortex, against the tide of people fleeing.

speaker: Doctor
content: Slow down! The contamination there is no joke. I'm not about to let you die.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Mania is retreating, pulled inward... Is something gathering power? But it's not steadily rising.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The contamination levels at the center are fluctuating violently, with sharp, frequent dips... Someone's weakening it. Someone's still down there, fighting the Mania.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...We need to hurry. We must get there fast.
It's been a long, long time since that day. So long, I almost forgot what you looked like. Sallie had to tell me before I realized... I want to know the real you.

Behind all those legendary stories and great titles, what kind of person is the real ${PlayerName}? What do you like? What do you dislike? Do you ever feel afraid or lonely? What are the things you're good at? What about the ones you struggle with?
I want to meet your friends, too, and learn about your work. Oh! I wonder if you already have someone special?
Would it be a burden to be loved by someone you've only met once...? Then maybe I'll just hide my feelings so you don't find out. Don't worry, I'm a great actress!
But it would be better if I could candidly tell you how I feel.

: Investigation team has reached the Mania epicenter. Contamination levels are high, forming a physical barrier. Cannot proceed further or remain for long. : The high-density Mania field is interfering with our systems. We cannot pinpoint your coordinates from the outside. A remote strike would likely hit your position. Support is not possible.
: Evacuate immediately. Prioritize ${PlayerName}'s safety. : Repeat, support cannot reach your position. Evacuate immediately.
From the audience, inside a hidden boat, Evelleon watches the man holding the umbrella beside her.
Mr. E's face twists, contorts, and ruptures, as if under attack by an invisible assailant, before finally melting into a puddle of sludge.
The color has returned to Evelleon's arm. The ritual is over. A spot of good luck, but a shame all the same.
She waves a hand. The boat turns and sails into the void.
It's amazing how those unseen futures make my heart race. I long for the stories we might share, yearn for you to enter my world. Meeting you has given me so many feelings.
[CG - Redemption 1]
[CG - Redemption 2]
You give me joy and sorrow. You move me, change me, set me ablaze. We'll go on an adventure unlike any other. Even if it's fleeting, I can't wait.
This is the passion you give me, the feeling I call love. If it is wrong and false...
...then show me what's right! Show me who you truly are!
That's what I wish for so fervently... to see you again.
[CRASH!]
A massive steel beam smashes through the ceiling from above. The fatal blow from the lion-faced figure misses Milly's head. She staggers, looking up in a daze.
A gaping hole is torn in the sealed roof. Light and sand pour in, blinding her. It hurts so much, and she's so tired, but...
Is this a dream? She thinks she hears someone calling her. Milly turns her head...

speaker: Milly
content: Ah...

speaker: Milly
content: I knew it...
Miracles do happen.
After all, even in a world like this... one can still find love...

You can't pinpoint the center of this Mania field, but you do have the precise locations of the Aurum Secretum devices destroyed earlier. Their peculiar arrangement gives you an idea. You immediately extract the central coordinates and report them to Nirvana. Reinforcements finally arrives.

Almost at the same time the strike hits, a phenomenal energy erupts from inside the ship, like a coordinated pincer attack. An explosion blasts through the vessel. The region's M-value spikes to an extreme high before plummeting. More than half of the cruise liner is blown apart, and with it, goes most of the accumulated contamination.

After the Aurum Secretum devices cease functioning, the Mania field gradually settles. The sandstorm enveloping the fleet finally recedes, and regular communications are restored, confirming all squad operations were successful. A cool breeze blows through the now-open cabin, clearing your head.

speaker: Doctor
content: Well now... Even though it was an enemy stronghold, I never imagined contamination could reach this level. You don't think they're hiding a bigger fish here, do you?

speaker: Communications Officer
content: The ambient M-value has returned to normal levels. Based on the Mania fluctuations recorded before the explosion, an S-Class Sinner was present at the epicenter.

speaker: Communications Officer
content: Another monster was also detected in the same area. We believe that the S-Class Sinner deliberately triggered the explosion. The blast eliminated the monster and incinerated the Corruptors and Apostles it had drawn in.

speaker: Doctor
content: Oh my, did they get so scared they killed themselves before we even got a chance to fight them? That was an easy victory, Mr. ${PlayerName}.
female_content: Oh my, did they get so scared they killed themselves before we even got a chance to fight them? That was an easy victory, Ms. ${PlayerName}.

content: She smiles and pats your shoulder. But the Communications Officer's expression is grim.

speaker: Communications Officer
content: ...There's something that requires your attention.

speaker: Communications Officer
content: Someone's still at the center of the contamination.

You pass through long corridors and arrive at a wide, open ruin. It might have once been a dance floor, or a grand ballroom; it's hard to tell now. The blast has obliterated almost everything, leaving only melted flecks of gold dust scattered about, shimmering in the sun like a thin carpet.
This place must have been magnificent once.
Beyond the golden carpet, at the epicenter of the explosion, is a cleared, circular space that almost looks like a stage.
And at its center, something gold lies shattered on the floor.
It's a woman with golden hair. She's smiling, her eyes half-open, staring at the sky, yet blind to your approach.

The doctor holds you back. She walks forward in silence, puts on her contamination gear with practiced speed, and tries to wake the woman, to revive her... but in the end, she sighs and switches to a simple examination before returning to your side.

speaker: Doctor
content: ...She's an S-Class Sinner with extraordinary power. There's no doubt she's the one who leveled the place and wiped out the contamination and Corruptors. The outburst was remarkable. And fatal.

speaker: Doctor
