content: She overused her power. That, combined with an abnormally deep contamination, has burned out her body and mind. This level of deterioration is... irreversible.
You stare, stunned. You move toward the woman on the ground, almost by instinct, and reach out a hand.
But you stop yourself. Your shackles are filled with contamination; they cannot stabilize anyone. You cannot touch her with such power. There's nothing you can do now to help her.

speaker: Doctor
content: There's very little we can do, Chief. It's too late...

speaker: Chief
content: ...She won't die.
You let go of your companion's hand and move forward, step by step, until you can kneel beside her. You take her scarred hand in yours.
At her wrist, you feel a pulse. It's faint, slow, but still beating, warm and steadfast.
Her eyes, vacant and unfocused, still refuse to close, longing for one last look at the sky.
And so you look at her, and hold her hand tight.

speaker: Chief
content: Everyone who made it out of here is strong. They fought with all their might to live.

speaker: Chief
content: You were the one who bought them time.

speaker: Chief
content: Fighting the enemy alone, weakening the Mania... without you, things would've ended much worse.

speaker: Chief
content: Thank you...

speaker: Chief
content: Rest now, have a sweet dream. And then... wake up soon.

speaker: Chief
content: Many people will want to meet you, to hear your name and your story. I'm one of them.

speaker: Chief
content: ...There's a whole world waiting for you. Wake up soon.
The dust settles, and birds return to the sky. The cage is finally shattered. The clouds part, and sunlight falls upon her for the first time in a long while, melting into her golden hair.
Is she celebrating victory or freedom? She closes her eyes, a smile on her face.
Like honey infused with light.

speaker: Milly
content: I won't die...

speaker: Milly
content: I still need to see... the one I love...

The investigation into corruption and infiltration crimes continues to deepen.

By an extraordinary coincidence, the patrol discovered what appears to be the largest Farland intelligence outpost deep in the high seas.
The original site of Euphoria was completely destroyed by abnormal Mania, but evidence of bribery, wiretapping, collusion, and treason has been partially recovered.

?? ??, N.F. 11?

Outskirts of Furor, Farlands
Bathed in moonlight, the sandstone lies deathly still.

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: Pant... pant... cough cough cough...
The injured merchant staggers forward, dragging his broken body across the barren expanse. Behind him, the caravan's sand ship lies wrecked against the rocks, its hull devoured by roaring flames.

He clutches his side, fingers slick with blood, but it still seeps through—crimson spreading along his clothes, falling in heavy drops. Each step falters; each footprint stains the stone beneath him, leaving a trail of fading life behind.

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: Who the hell attacked us... Desert bandits? But we made sure to avoid the trade route... Dammit...

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: At least... I need to get what Sibilla entrusted to me... to DisCity...
The man groans as he fights to lift his head, only to meet the cold glint of steel in the darkness.

A blade pierces through his shoulder, and pain erupts like fire, searing through his nerves as the force slams him into the sand. His agonized cries tear through the night, followed by footsteps approaching from behind.
Oh, don't run away yet. Our little game was just getting to the good part.
I'll admit, you've got some skill to make it this far... Shame you heard things you shouldn't have, helped when you shouldn't have.
Blood seeps between the merchant's fingers, turning the sand beneath his palm to mud. His vision swims, but through the haze, he catches the glint of a metal insignia on his attacker's clothes.

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: You're... with the Campbells? So all this time... you've been watching Furor? Afraid your dirty secrets would slip out...?
So, you do know what you've walked into, don't you? Good, that just makes things way easier.
Come on, tell me, which one of your little Furor friends put you up to this? Give me a name, and maybe I'll let you walk away.
The merchant collapses to his knees, blood bubbling at his lips, his voice a ragged whisper.

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: Sorry to disappoint... cough cough... you're too late...
Oh?
Gasping, he mutters something unintelligible—just enough to make his pursuer crouch low, ear tilted toward him in curiosity.

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: ...Go to hell, you noble's pet!!
The merchant's surprise attack is futile. His fist barely grazes the assassin's face, only managing to dislodge her mask.
For a moment, half of her features are exposed beneath the skewed disguise.

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: You?! No, this can't be... The <color=#fb9259>hero</color> working for the Campbells...?!
She adjusts the mask, sliding it back into place with practiced ease.

speaker: Hero
content: Oops, you recognized me? That's bad... They specifically said to keep this face a secret...

speaker: Hero
content: Well, since you've seen my face, I'm afraid there's only one way this ends. Don't take this personally, I don't love this part of the job either. But my dear "master" has a thing about meddlers... and well, you were just about to go and spoil his grand reveal...
Before he can react, the cold edge of her blade finds his throat, silencing any further resistance.

speaker: Hero
content: Now I'll have to make sure you never speak of this again.
The woman's knife hangs poised in the air, then freezes. In the sudden stillness, the merchant hears it: the distant growl of engines cutting through the night, punctuated by loud shouts in Disian.
Someone is coming, and they're from DisCity. In moments, they will see this scene of bloodshed.

speaker: Injured Merchant
content: Nnghh...!
The merchant has no strength left to scream, but his fingers twitch toward the silver line of hope. If he could just call for help. If he could just hold on...!
(Red flash + blood sound effect)
But he could never make another sound.

speaker: Hero
content: Oh dear, we can't have that now, can we? If I let you scream, what would people say about my professionalism?

speaker: Hero
content: But I'll leave your body in one piece. Wouldn't want to spoil the surprise for those DisCity folks arriving shortly.

speaker: Hero
content: Honestly, I'm being unusually generous today. After all...

speaker: Hero
content: It's so much more interesting this way.

June 22, N.F. 115

Outskirts of Fraser City, Farlands

A sand ship glides smoothly across the endless dunes. The WhiteSands lie unusually still, calm but for the faintest whisper of wind. By the window, a lone figure reclines, watching the serene expanse with contentment.

speaker: Synex
content: Brilliant sunshine, gentle breeze... Funny how even these endless, monotonous sands can look almost beautiful—when you're not on the job.

speaker: Synex
content: Ah, why do happy little vacations always vanish so fast?

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, what's with the gloomy looks? Take in the scenery while you can. You won't see this much beautiful sand once we're back in Fraser.
No one responds, not a single soul. The passengers sit in silent complicity, united in their refusal to acknowledge the voice buzzing in their ears.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Seriously, do we really have to share a ship with her all the way to Fraser?

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...We've only got two hours left on this trip. Just bear with it a little longer.
That voice nags at her ear again. Hella turns her gaze toward the source—

Synex, Campbell Shadow Operative Appearance and allegiance unknown, Synex seems to delight in chaos and disruption. Once acting as Fraser's enforcer in Furor, she forced its people to transport Aurum Secretum through storms, yet when the time came, she stayed behind to help defeat the Apostle of Ashes.
Hella isn't sure if she's still an enemy, but...

speaker: Synex
content: So you're Hella? I thought you were just some fragile dummy, but you've got more wits than I gave you credit for. Strays are always welcome at my place, and I treat my pets very well. Consider the offer, will ya?

speaker: Hella
content: Aaahhhh! Gross! She's totally grossing me out!

Another wave of irritation prickles up Hella's spine as she glares at Synex, her gaze sharp enough to scorch through steel. Synex, utterly unfazed, just leans closer to Hypatia, her smirk lazy with indifference.

speaker: Synex
content: Hypa? My lady? Oh great Lady Hypatia? It's been so long since we saw each other! Come now, won't you spare a moment for little old me?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Silence. Another word, and I'll have you tossed overboard.

speaker: Synex
content: Ohhh, boo-hoo. I knew it. You've tossed aside your poor old friend for some shiny new toys. My heart's absolutely shattered...

Synex clutches her chest in a theatric flourish, her wounded expression collapsing into melodrama as she sinks to the ground. Hella shoots a glance at Hypatia—who, predictably, responds with nothing more than a weary sigh.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Just two more hours. C'mon, I got this! Push through and it'll all be over!
The vessel cuts across the desert, skimming over smooth sand and kicking up plumes of dust in its wake. Inside, its passengers continue their bickering as they race northwest.
As for what caused all this farce...
[Flashback: Before Departure, Underground Furor - Post-Battle]

Inside Furor, Farlands

24 Hours Ago

speaker: Hella
content: So what's the deal? Any chance you can fix that thing up there?
Hypatia shakes her head. Above her, the barrier that once shielded Furor's skies has dwindled to a handful of flickering points—the last remnants still clinging to life.
The town lies in ruins after the battle. The rock caves that once served as dwellings have collapsed, and the infrastructure is now little more than unrecognizable wreckage.

The Fraser delegation has already departed, and gone is Synex as well—her whereabouts now a mystery. Under Hypatia's direction, the people have cleared a space in the devastation, but they can't stay much longer.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh, we worked our butts off to take down that Apostle, and now we just have to leave? That's so unfair...

speaker: Hypatia
content: It's okay. Our situation now is far better than we initially expected.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The storms, the disasters, the Apostle of Ashes... any one of them would have been beyond my strength to face alone. Hella, it was only because of you and your companions that the people of Furor survived unharmed.

speaker: Hypatia
content: A town can always be rebuilt. As long as its people endure, hope will never die.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Thank you. You not only saved my life, but the lives of everyone in Furor as well. I'm truly in your debt.

speaker: Hella
content: Whoa, why so serious?! You're totally making me blush here...

speaker: Hella
content: A-anyway! So, uh... got any idea where you're going next?
Hella catches the flicker of hesitation in Hypatia's expression.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Our first priority must be securing proper medical facilities. Many of the wounded are suffering from infected injuries exacerbated by Mania. With Furor's medical infrastructure compromised, Fraser appears to be our most viable option.

speaker: Hypatia
content: My brother and the delegation have already departed. While he did arrange an escort for our return, I...
Hypatia pauses, and a chill runs down Hella's spine.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait, don't tell me the person you're talking about is—

speaker: Synex
content: Yoo-hoo! Did you miss me, little Hella?
A sudden force crashes into Hella from behind as someone hooks an arm around her neck, their full weight leaning into her.

speaker: Synex
content: That's right, darling. Yours truly gets the honor of escorting the lady and all the Furor folks back to Fraser, and... delivering a special little package along the way.
Synex raises her hand, pointing into the distance. The others turn as one, their gazes locking onto—
—An Apostle. The monstrous figure writhes inside a colossal cage forged from Aurum Secretum, its breaths shallow and ragged.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What? That Apostle's still kicking?!

speaker: Synex
content: Oh yes, I had to rough it up just enough to keep it breathing. Such a hassle, honestly.
Horo yanks Hella protectively behind her, her gaze sharp with suspicion, while Synex spreads her hands in a mock display of innocence.

speaker: Horo
content: That thing is dangerous... What are you going to do with it this time?

speaker: Synex
content: Ha, I know that look—"These bad guys must be up to no good," am I right? But take a real good look, darling. I'm the one mopping up your little disaster.

speaker: Synex
content: Do you see those things on its body?
Hella follows the line of her pointed finger. The Apostle crouches at the base of the cage, its body a tapestry of wounds, utterly immobilized by the Aurum Secretum shackles.
Around its faintly heaving body, countless black particles drift—flecks of darkness that glimmer like distant stars when touched by the light.

speaker: Synex
content: That's Aurum Secretum.

speaker: Synex
content: To be precise, that's raw, unprocessed Aurum Secretum. This semi-physical, semi-spiritual material originates from the Apostle around Furor. It's unstable, but has excellent natural resonance properties.

speaker: Synex
content: Of course, you can't just scoop it up and call it a day. Gotta extract it properly from the Apostles, process and refine it... then it becomes the real deal.

speaker: Synex
content: And guess what? Your Furor friends cut a deal with Fraser. Food and shelter in exchange for helping the institute gather fragments and mine Aurum Secretum like good little laborers.

speaker: Hella
content: ...! So Furor isn't just an experiment site, but a massive mine too?!
Faced with the accusation, Synex shrugs with feigned resignation.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh yes. Since the miners aren't working anymore, we can't just leave the lovely mine unattended. Might as well take everything back with us.

speaker: Synex
content: The Apostles are the source of Aurum Secretum and the key to advancing Aurum Secretum technology. Catching one alive is certainly the crown jewel of this whole operation.

speaker: Synex
content: As for you two...

speaker: Hella
content: ...What are you plotting this time?!

speaker: Synex
content: Ohhh, such distrust! But I promise you, this one's gonna be wonderful.

speaker: Synex
content: My dearest master, Adelaide Campbell, extends his most cordial invitation to our esteemed guests from DisCity. After all your contribution to Furor, he'd love to show you <color=#fb9259>the final results of this Aurum Secretum experiment</color> in Fraser.

speaker: Synex
content: Well? Would you two like to come with us?

Outskirts of Fraser City, Farlands

Present
Hella stomps back to her seat, cheeks puffed, and plops down beside Horo.

speaker: Horo
content: Where's that horned woman?

speaker: Hella
content: After Hypatia blew her off, that freak started talking about going fishing, and then she actually jumped off the ship! And she took my binoculars! The ones I brought all the way from DisCity!

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh, I never should've agreed to come with her! Horo, there's gotta be another way to keep investigating, right?

speaker: Horo
content: No. Putting that woman aside, this is a good opportunity.

speaker: Horo
content: Fraser's a major city with tight security. Going in officially under their invitation is our smoothest path in—better than gambling on some backdoor route.

speaker: Horo
content: Besides...

speaker: Horo
content: I found something underground, and this is a good chance to consult the expert.

The Furor disaster buried the trail of the inheritance photo, along with any hope of tracing its sender. Whatever secrets lay underground are now entombed in rubble, leaving the investigation stranded. Without a new lead, the truth might never surface.

Horo didn't find the inheritance, but she uncovered something else there: a brief transcript of Aurum Secretum experiment logs. Fraser, Aurum Secretum, Apostles of Ashes... Are the secrets underground tied to the inheritance? She can't be sure, but the transcript points her toward a new path.
Perhaps... <color=#fb9259>they</color> would know what this photo holds.
"Project Leaders: <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>, <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>"
Horo's gaze lifts to the poised Campbell noble sitting across from her.

speaker: Horo
content: We've been through life and death together. If Hella calls you a friend, then I'll trust you, for now.

speaker: Horo
content: Campbell, do you know what this is?
[Image of Inheritance]

speaker: Horo
content: So you do recognize it.
Hypatia's fingers dart out, pressing the photograph down. Her gaze sweeps the cabin—with Synex gone, only the three of them remain. Only after confirming they're truly alone does she finally speak.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Hide this photograph, or better yet, burn it. Let no one else lay eyes on it. What it reveals is far too dangerous... mere knowledge of it could get you killed.

speaker: Hypatia
content: How... did this come into your possession?

speaker: Horo
content: We recovered it recently from the wreckage of a WhiteSands merchant caravan. No survivors, just debris and corpses scattered around. The photo was sealed inside an envelope, hidden among the cargo.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I see... Then Sibilla must have already...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Sibilla?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Before you, a Furorian also came to me with this photo.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...At the time, I felt only shame—shame that I could do nothing to help her. The experiment was decreed by the Senate, the collective will of our city. All I could do was let her go... and pray she would successfully voice the truth.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But now that the photograph is in your hands, she must have already...
Silence settles over the cabin. Everyone knows the dangers of WhiteSands. How long could an unequipped refugee possibly last?
Hypatia shakes her head, as if dispelling distractions, or perhaps solidifying a decision.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What I'm about to tell you... I've never spoken of this to anyone. But you're right. I do know what it is.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Before I took charge of Furor, the researchers stationed there were conducting projects related to it. I can confirm it was physically present within Furor, and the experimental data it left behind is nothing short of horrifying.

speaker: Hypatia
content: It was far too dangerous. I tried to delve deeper myself, but...
Hypatia pulls up a report on her terminal and points to one of the lines.

[Test Sample IV-001] - ████ ███████. ██████████████. ██████████. Aurum Secretum was devoured by the sample during the experiment. Sample activation proved extremely dangerous. Further operation forbidden.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I eventually abandoned the project. Instead, I petitioned to redirect our research toward developing a resonant mesh defense system—what you now know as the Fraser Kardas.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The Senate approved my proposal. They withdrew all materials and personnel connected to it from Furor, relocating everything back to Fraser.

speaker: Hypatia
content: However, I've still caught traces of it in some reports afterward. I suspect the research continued at headquarters, but that... is speculation beyond even my clearance.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait, so you're telling me Fraser's been researching the inheritance this whole time?! Then that means...
Hella and Horo exchange glances, both their expressions equally grim.

speaker: Horo
content: The inheritance isn't just about Aurum Secretum; it's also the key to <color=#fb9259>detonating the Black Ring</color>...

speaker: Horo
content: Those Fraser people have probably been working with those Underground rats from the start.
Hypatia takes a deep breath, her body trembling slightly.

speaker: Hypatia
content: So it is true... My suspicions weren't just paranoia after all...

speaker: Hypatia
content: While reviewing Black Ring documents related to DisCity, I came across some data-based inferences. I once had my suspicions about the physical form of the "inheritance," but never found definitive proof.

speaker: Hypatia
content: This goes far beyond what any small team should confront. Wherever it's kept will be protected by layers of danger even I can't anticipate. Hella... are you absolutely certain you want to keep pursuing this?
Silence falls once again. After a moment, Hella begins to speak.

speaker: Hella
content: Honestly, all this talk about danger and whether we should keep going is making my head spin. But here's what I know—

speaker: Hella
content: Those jerks behind it have already hurt loads of people in Syndicate, and they'll mess up even more people out there unless someone stops them! Every time this stupid thing appears? Nothing but trouble follows it!

speaker: Horo
content: Someone has to stop them. The Legion didn't leave the city just to turn away now. We face threats head-on. That's who we are.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Very well.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Then please allow me to join you.

speaker: Hypatia
content: You're from DisCity, after all. You'll face considerable limitations navigating Fraser's circles. My presence could provide access where yours cannot.

speaker: Hypatia
content: This city raised me. I cherish it deeply. But... some lines cannot be crossed, and I will not stand by again while others come to harm.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe, no sweat! We're basically pros at handling this by now. Consider it already fixed!

speaker: Hella
content: Besides...

speaker: Hella
content: We're already in this deep. Can't exactly bail out now, right?
Boom!!

As if in answer to Hella's words, a massive force slams into the ship, hurling everyone aboard violently. Passengers stagger through the cabin, struggling to stay upright. Hella braces herself against the wall before gripping the window frame to peer outside.
[Synex's Portrait]

speaker: Synex
content: Yoo-hoo, little Hella— Come out! I've hooked a big fish—
A horde of sand beasts surges toward the port side. At their forefront—a lone figure, sprinting just ahead of the onslaught. And she's grinning up at Hella with wild, exhilarated eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: "Fish"? You call these ******* "fish"????

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, just some little bugs to get the blood flowing.

Synex skids to a halt and spins toward the creatures, launching herself straight at the lead beast. In one fluid motion, she flips onto its back, seizes its jagged horns, and with a vicious twist, tears them clean off.
The beast's agonized howl splits the air, drowned out only by Synex's ringing laughter, brighter and fiercer than before.

speaker: Synex
content: Since I'm heading home anyway, might as well bring back a few trophies!
[WhiteSands Background]

speaker: Hella
content: Trophy my ass! You got a death wish or something?!

speaker: Hypatia
content: Both of you... that's enough. We'll be arriving shortly, and a bit of quiet would do us all good.
Horo drags Hella to the cabin where the Furorians are lodged, while Hypatia forces Synex into confinement within her quarters.
At last, peace settles over the ship. Through the chaos, the ill-fated sand vessel barely trembles, never straying from its path.
It continues to dutifully carry its passengers—a noble researcher, DisCity Sinners, refugees, an Apostle of Ashes, and an Aurum Secretum envoy—straight toward their destined arrival.
[Background - Outside Refugee Camp]
Soon, a silhouette that doesn't belong to the desert appears on the distant horizon.

As the sand ship draws nearer, the platinum-colored buildings sharpen into view, their towering spires ablaze with golden light. Beneath this gleaming skyline, clusters of small, dark dwellings cling together like shadows.

speaker: Hella
content: That's... Fraser?

speaker: Hypatia
content: To clarify, this is merely a research facility on the outskirts of Fraser. The actual city is still a hundred kilometers away.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The <color=#fb9259>Luminaris Society</color>—Fraser's foremost academic institution established this facility as their primary Aurum Secretum research center. Most simply refer to it as the Aurum Secretum Research Institute.
A head suddenly pops up beside Hella, its owner cutting in with a mischievous grin.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, it's practically exile. While all the proper noble lords are wining and dining in the city, only our saintly Lady Hypa would graciously stoop to visit such a wretched place... and mingle with the likes of us.

speaker: Synex
content: We're pretty much neighbors with other farland cities here. When disasters strike, those poor doomed souls have nowhere to flee but our hospitable doorstep. You see those sprawling settlements? Don't mistake them for some rustic countryside—

speaker: Synex
content: That's a sea of <color=#fb9259>refugee camps</color>.

The vessel glides past a low hill, its course steadily drawing it toward the sprawling complex of structures ahead. From the deck of the sand ship, Hella surveys the makeshift camps lining the path—clusters of tents and rickety bungalows made of wooden planks strewn across the land.
As the ship drifts by, the refugees raise their heads in slow, mechanical unison. Their hollow eyes, dull with exhaustion, betray no spark of hope.
Beneath their sun-scorched faces, their bodies tell the same story—wracked by hunger, sickness, and the relentless toll of survival.

speaker: Horo
content: All these people crowded outside the city... Don't the people inside do anything about it?

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, they do. The institute hands out meals and beds like charity, and even special care for the poor, infected folks. Honestly? They're living like kings compared to the wretches wandering in the WhiteSands.

speaker: Synex
content: Get cured, and who knows? They might even earn a shiny little job at the institute and become true Fraser citizens—imagine that! A real life of comfort and prosperity!

speaker: Synex
content: Out there, with all those disasters and bandits, it's just pure survival. But here? Fraser welcomes them, gives them a shelter, and even plays "doctor"...

speaker: Synex
content: For them, isn't this a land of hope after all?
The next moment, as if recognizing someone on the deck, a wave of joyous commotion erupts among the refugees.

speaker: Refugee
content: ...Synex? That's Synex!

speaker: Refugee
content: Synex is back! Our <color=#fb9259>hero</color> has returned!
They shout and cheer, surging toward the path's edge, arms outstretched toward Synex above.

speaker: Refugee
content: Synex! Bless me—I want to be chosen next time!

speaker: Refugee
content: Go, Synex! I-I'll work hard too! One day... I'll be an Aurum Secretum Warrior, just like you!

speaker: Hella
content: What... what's going on here?

speaker: Synex
content: Didn't I just tell you? Lucky refugees might even secure a job at the institute and live a real life of comfort and prosperity.
With a sweeping gesture, Synex commands the air—Aurum Secretum spills from her, trailing her movements in a radiant arc of gold. The refugees' frenzy intensifies, their voices rising in fervor.

speaker: Synex
content: After treatment, some are able to resonate with Aurum Secretum, becoming <color=#fb9259>Aurum Secretum Warriors</color> who serve Fraser...

speaker: Synex
content: And I just happen to be the luckiest one of them all.
[Scene Transition - Fraser Institute Exterior]
In mere minutes, the sand ship glides past the bustling refugee camp and grinds to a halt before the institute's plaza.
A group of white-coated researchers stands waiting, led by a young man who barely has time to open his mouth—before Synex crashes into him with a gleeful tackle.

speaker: Synex
content: Little Saffar! It's been so long!
Before the young man can react, Synex seizes him by the hair and gives it a rough, playful tousle.

speaker: Saffar
content: ...Let go of me!

speaker: Synex
content: Hahaha, don't be shy! Everyone, this is Saffar, an Aurum Secretum Warrior just like me. Though someone decided he's too capable... so now they stick him with paperwork, reception, and all those thrilling little chores—

The young man wrenches free from Synex's grasp at last. As he raises his hand, Hella's keen gaze locks onto the faint shimmer of Aurum Secretum particles escaping from between his fingers and sleeve. There's no doubt now—his power mirrors Synex's own.

speaker: Saffar
content: ...I sincerely apologize for my unprofessional behavior in front of you all.

speaker: Saffar
content: As mentioned, I'm Saffar, assistant to Director Hermis of the Aurum Secretum Research Institute here.

speaker: Saffar
content: Following Mr. Adelaide's instructions, we've prepared guest rooms and meals for all of you. However, before that... the director has requested a meeting with the two distinguished guests from DisCity.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? Just us? What about Hypatia?
Saffar offers Hypatia a respectful, slight bow.

speaker: Saffar
content: Mr. Adelaide hopes you'll return home at your earliest convenience, and the Senate is eager to hear your report. That said, please don't concern yourself with Furor's residents. We've already arranged full medical support for them, and their recovery will be well underway.
Hella opens her mouth to speak, but Hypatia cuts her off with a silent gesture.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Very well. If those are my brother's wishes, I shall comply.

speaker: Hella
content: But we haven't even—

speaker: Hypatia
content: Don't worry, I haven't forgotten our agreement. Once my affairs are settled, I'll come back to you.
Hella blinks, reading Hypatia's gaze in an instant—the plan has changed. They'll have to split up.

speaker: Hella
content: Hypatia... you're really going back alone?

speaker: Hypatia
content: It's just that Fraser is quite far away, and the communications would be difficult, so I prepared a parting gift for you.
She opens her palm, letting an exquisitely crafted Aurum Secretum communication device slip into Hella's hand.

speaker: Hella
content: This is... for me?

speaker: Hypatia
content: I broke the little doll you saw before, so I made a new one.

speaker: Hypatia
content: This is an Aurum Secretum communicator. Barring targeted interference, it can technically maintain stable one-to-one contact even across the distance to DisCity.
Hella examines the communicator, eyes gleaming with excitement as she rotates it between her fingers.

speaker: Horo
content: Hey now, no need to get so worked up. MBCC has plenty of these, right?

speaker: Hella
content: I only got to hold these when on field missions with ${PlayerName}, and he'd be all like "Phones rot your brain, kid!" and snatch it back the second we finished! This is literally MY first communicator ever!
female_content: I only got to hold these when on field missions with ${PlayerName}, and she'd be all like "Phones rot your brain, kid!" and snatch it back the second we finished! This is literally MY first communicator ever!

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe, and it's not just any communicator—it's a souped-up special edition! Now I can spam people with messages even when I'm knee-deep in the field!

speaker: Hypatia
content: I'm glad you like it. If you run into any problems, just send me a message.
The sandship's horn echoes once more as Hypatia takes her leave. After the farewells, only a single person stands unassigned.

speaker: Synex
content: How sweeeet! Not even I've gotten gifts from the young lady. Someone's getting special treatment—

It is hard to tell how much sincerity there is in Synex's voice. Hella presses her lips together, poised to retort, only to find Synex already striding toward the colossal Aurum Secretum cage that imprisons the Apostle.
Before Hella can process her actions, the white-robed young man walks up, motioning for them to follow.

speaker: Saffar
content: Synex is the most exceptional Aurum Secretum Warrior. She'll be overseeing the Apostle of Ashes' transfer to the detention facility.

speaker: Saffar
content: For you both, the Director is expecting your arrival. If you'd please follow me.
[Fraser Institute - Corridor]
The institute's corridor is bathed in bright, even sunlight, its polished floors gleaming with refracted jade-like hues. At the far end, the head of the institute stands waiting for his guests.
Hella's gaze is drawn to the man's face—his brow and eyes concealed behind an unusual mask, rendering his expression unreadable.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Welcome. I am Director Hermis of the Fraser Aurum Secretum Research Institute.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: There's no need to be nervous. I simply have a few academic questions, and I thought this would be a good opportunity for a casual discussion with both of you.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh, sweet! Just a chill chat— Wait, huh? Academic??

speaker: Horo
content: What do you want to know?

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Nothing too demanding, I assure you. Here, take a look.
Hella peers through the corridor window and spots Synex in the plaza below, escorting the Apostle.

Aurum Secretum particles burst from the Apostle's body, a swirling storm of dark mist only to be shredded by Synex's claws. In one fluid motion, she wrenches the Apostle's shackles and yanks the shrieking creature into a giant door in the ground.
BOOM. The massive door crashes shut, cutting off Hella's gaze and silencing the howls.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: What do you think of Synex?
Hella and Horo exchange uncertain glances before Horo finally speaks up cautiously.

speaker: Horo
content: She's strong. By DisCity's standards, she would qualify as at least an S-Class Sinner.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Indeed.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: For generations, the farland cities have lived under the threat of the Apostles of Ashes. However, Aurum Secretum's unique <color=#fb9259>resonance</color> properties allow us to divert their paths, providing our cities with crucial defense against the calamities.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Yet ordinary citizens... cannot wield Aurum Secretum. After decades of research, we've found only a rare few can endure its resonance. These exceptional individuals become "Aurum Secretum Warriors"—our defense against the Apostles and the protectors of our cities.

speaker: Horo
content: Hmph, a rare few? We've already run into two of them just on our way here.
As if oblivious to the sarcastic tone in Horo's voice, the man continues.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Synex embodies the apex of Fraser's Aurum Secretum technology. While her power is unmatched, her flaws are equally evident—that <color=#fb9259>untamed, aberrant, and uncontrollable</color> nature.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: She isn't our first Aurum Secretum Warrior. Previous candidates successfully achieved resonance, but without exception, they all fell to its corrupting influence—descending into madness and ultimately, destruction.
His words are laced with regret and pity.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: I've heard that DisCity has a Chief named ${PlayerName}, and he possesses a method for controlling Mania. Something called... <color=#fb9259>shackles</color>, if I'm not mistaken?
female_content: I've heard that DisCity has a Chief named ${PlayerName}, and she possesses a method for controlling Mania. Something called... <color=#fb9259>shackles</color>, if I'm not mistaken?

speaker: Hella
content: Hey—what's this about?! What are you gonna do to ${PlayerName}?!

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Please, don't misunderstand. I intend no harm. If we could harness this technique, warriors like Synex might avoid their tragic fate, and countless lives in the farlands could be saved from the calamities...

speaker: Director Hermis
content: What are your thoughts?
Hella nearly leaps up, ready to retort, but Horo snatches her arm, holding her back.

speaker: Horo
content: You want intel on the shackles? Fine. But this isn't a charity. What's your offer?

speaker: Hella
content: Yeah! You'd better trade us some Aurum Secretum secrets for it! No way we're getting scammed on this deal!

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Of course, that was precisely what I had in mind. Synex.
He gestures toward the far end of the corridor. Somehow, Synex has already ascended the stairs and now stands there, offering them a graceful bow.

speaker: Director Hermis
content: Synex will be your guide for today's tour of our institute. Feel free to ask any questions. She's authorized to share all aspects of Aurum Secretum technology with you.

speaker: Synex
content: As you wish, sir.
After a brief exchange of hollow pleasantries, the director finally takes his leave. The moment his figure disappears, Synex's posture visibly slackens, even stretching with a lazy yawn.

speaker: Synex
content: Mmmgh...

speaker: Synex
content: Well then, my precious little VIPs, what would you like? The director's orders mean I'm all yours today. Sightseeing? Demos? Or... other services? —Pfft!
Hella pulls back the kick she has just started to deliver.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... I really wanna bail on her, but... wouldn't that make things obvious?

speaker: Horo
content: We're out of options. For now, we'll get what intel we can from her and work out the rest tonight.
So... where should they start digging?

options: Tell us about this research institute
Tell us about the current Aurum Secretum technology

speaker: Synex
content: Oh? The research institute... Where shall we begin?

speaker: Horo
content: Staff numbers, facility layout, research scope, historical data, and all Aurum Secretum project ties and developments.

speaker: Synex
content: Looks like someone's done her homework! Oh... could it be you're actually thinking of storming this place? Too bad, the only humans here are frail little researchers. All the real fun is with our thousands of combat machines. And trust me... they're such a hassle to deal with.

speaker: Horo
content: The director said we're free to ask whatever questions we want.

speaker: Synex
content: Hahaha! As you wish. This way.
Jump

speaker: Horo
content: Tell us about the development of Aurum Secretum technology and what you're currently using it for.

speaker: Horo
content: Of course, it'd be even better if we could enter the research labs.

speaker: Synex
content: Haha, that's quite a massive subject.

speaker: Synex
content: But since you've asked, follow me.
[Plaza]

Back at the plaza, Hella's gaze flickers to the spot where the Apostle was hurled down. The stone door has sealed shut, but a frigid draft seeps through the cracks, whispering against her skin. A shiver races down her spine, and she can't help but swallow hard.

speaker: Synex
content: This is the institute's little hall of fame—promotional fluff and dusty old records. Do watch your step. Fall into the wrong corner, and... well, even I might not be able to fish you out.

speaker: Hella
content: F-fall?

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, absolutely. The underground isn't just home to our dear Apostle. There are plenty of other dangerous things sealed away that should never see the light of day...

speaker: Synex
content: So, wanna see them? Why don't you beg? If you ask nicely, I might just take you down for a peek.

speaker: Hella
content: ...?? Dream on! Now hurry up and show us those history records, or whatever it was Horo was talking about. Chop chop!
With a silent smile, Synex simply points toward the towering record monuments encircling the plaza.

speaker: Synex
content: Those hold the most complete records of the institute's history and Aurum Secretum technology in existence. If you want all the details, you won't find them anywhere else.
Hella steps forward, skeptical, yet there they are: towering stone monuments, easily several times human height, their surfaces completely covered in dense text.

<size=44>In N.F. 104, the Senate ratified the founding of the <color=#fb9259>Fraser Aurum Secretum Research Institute</color>.

Operating under the auspices of the Luminaris Society, the institute spanned approximately 240 acres and was equipped to accommodate the daily operations of more than 5,000 researchers.

Initially, its work centered on investigating "Hypercube alternative resources."
That same year, the institute designated "Aurum Secretum substance derived from Apostles of Ashes" as its principal research focus, laying the groundwork for analytical frameworks and prototype production systems tailored to Aurum Secretum.

<size=44>From N.F. 106 onward, the institute secured successive rounds of funding from the Campbell family, the Senate, and other benefactors, enabling the establishment of experimental facilities outside the city. That same year, after extensive compositional trials and crystal restructuring, researchers successfully isolated the first batch of Aurum Secretum samples. Yet due to their impracticality, further progress stalled.

The following year, Hypatia Campbell, hailed as a "genius scholar," joined the institute. She swiftly devised a groundbreaking "resonance" refinement protocol—a potential revolution in Aurum Secretum applications—and was promptly assigned to lead research at a facility outside the city, reigniting the institute's pursuit of the technology.

<size=44>In N.F. 112, after six years of arduous research, Aurum Secretum production technology finally reached maturity. Concurrently, development began on various devices utilizing the material.
As the most advanced experimental base, Furor—under Hypatia Campbell's leadership—became the primary testing site for most Aurum Secretum-based weapons and equipment.

Shortly afterward, the Aurum Secretum guards she developed entirely replaced human personnel.
The institute now ensures every researcher is assisted by at least three Aurum Secretum guards in their work.

<size=44>In N.F. 115, Aurum Secretum application devices achieved widespread technological maturity.
To share these advancements with our allies, Fraser proposed reviving the Great Expo tradition.
The upcoming 13th Great Expo in DisCity will feature our crowning achievement: the revolutionary Fraser Kardas device, demonstrating measurable suppression of Mania fields.

The long night is ending.
When dawn breaks, Aurum Secretum will lead us all into a glorious new era.

speaker: Hella
content: Hypatia... I had no idea she was such a big deal...

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, absolutely. The institute's darling little prodigy—without her, Aurum Secretum would still be scraping by in the dark ages. But that soft heart of hers? Heh, all that stern-faced posturing, like she's not just a scared kid playing dress-up in someone else's resolve.

speaker: Synex
content: This time, she actually caught an Apostle. Should be bragging to the higher-ups, soaking up the praise, but look at that face! Like a puppy who just chewed the wrong slipper. Tell me I'm wrong, little Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft! That's called having class! Unlike someone who'd brag about breathing if she could!

speaker: Hella
content: It's just one Apostle of Ashes! I've beaten up tons of them in DisCity!

speaker: Synex
content: Oh no no no, darling. This Furor border Apostle is quite special. All Aurum Secretum research revolves around it, but until now we've only been able to observe from a distance, never investigate up close.

speaker: Synex
content: Thanks to your enthusiastic assistance, this little specimen will complete our grand puzzle. Soon, Aurum Secretum will finally fulfill its original purpose—"to shield the world from calamity and spread prosperity to all farlands."
Synex bows with exaggerated elegance, appearing so solemn that one might almost believe she's sincere.

speaker: Synex
content: I simply must thank you on behalf of all the farland people.
Finding no desire to continue speaking with someone so shameless, Hella shifts her attention to Horo, only to discover her already deep in thought, examining the stone monuments around the plaza.

speaker: Hella
content: Horo, what she said sounds good and all, but something feels off about this... Horo?

speaker: Horo
content: ...Yeah. Something's definitely not right here.

speaker: Horo
content: I had my doubts before, but now I'm sure: The pieces don't fit. There's no clear origin, no logical progression to how Aurum Secretum was found and developed.

speaker: Hella
content: What... what logical progression?

speaker: Horo
content: All technology follows a logical progression, but these records are full of holes. Who discovered it? What breakthroughs made it possible? The crucial steps are missing... almost like someone erased them on purpose.

speaker: Horo
content: Before Hypatia's involvement, its development wasn't scientifically sound. It's like... some invisible strings were pulling everything forward.

speaker: Hella
content: You mean... those Underground creeps?!

speaker: Horo
content: It's just a theory for now, no hard evidence. But it's definitely worth investigating.

speaker: Horo
content: We've secured the institute's floor plans and guard deployments. Now we need to find a way underground. We'll move after nightfall.

speaker: Synex
content: Hey, what are you two kiddies whispering about? Where to next, hm?

speaker: Hella
content: Uh, let me think... hmmm...
Needing a quick excuse, Hella's mind races as she latches onto the first idea that pops into her head.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh right, I'm starving! Do you have, like, a cafeteria here?
[Background - Fraser Institute Corridor - Night]

June 22, N.F. 115
Late Night

Inside the Aurum Secretum Institute, Outskirts of Fraser
The night is thick, the institute's corridors swallowed by silence. A handful of researchers move swiftly through the hallway, their destination clear—the massive Aurum Secretum door at the far end.

speaker: Researcher A
content: Are you sure you heard strange noises underground?

speaker: Researcher B
content: Hard to say, but we just brought in the Apostle of Ashes today... Better safe than sorry.
Just as they round the corner—
Chaos erupts from the darkness. Several arms lash out, seizing the researchers in a vice-like grip. A flurry of brutal strikes follows. Within seconds, their bodies slump to the floor, motionless.
The unconscious figures are hauled into the shadows. And once more, the corridor lies still.

speaker: Legion Member
content: Got it, Horo. Keys are on them. Just like we figured, this is the entrance to the underground.

Hella presses close to Horo's side. The research institute is a hollow shell at night, its corridors swallowed by a darkness so thick it feels alive—gnawing at the edges of their vision, prickling Hella's skin with unease.

speaker: Hella
content: Jeez... with nobody around, this place is way too creepy at night...

speaker: Horo
content: Shh. No talking. This way.

The group moves in silence, creeping toward the massive metal door. Horo pulls out the key that's freshly taken from one of the researchers. With the verification complete, the door groans open, revealing a yawning spiral staircase, its steps vanishing into the darkness below.
Horo's brow furrows. She knows these stairs. She has seen their twin in Furor.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Stay sharp, everyone. I'll take point. A few can stay to watch our rear.

speaker: Horo
content: Alright. Let's see what kind of "treasures" you've been hoarding down here.
[Fade Out to Switch Scene: Background - Underground Tunnel]
The team descends along the stairs, venturing deeper into the darkness.

At first, the distant sounds from the entrance still reach them. But as they venture further, the outside world fades, swallowed by silence. Soon, the only noises left are the shuffle of boots and the relentless thud-thud of their own heartbeats, each pulse hammering against ribs clenched tight with unease.
Then, the stairs finally level out, only to split into branching paths. Unwilling to let the team separate, Horo has no choice but to carve marks with her dagger at each intersection.

The darkness presses closer with every step. Time warps—minutes stretch into hours, and Hella swears she's spent half her life trudging through this damned tunnel. When she lifts her flashlight, the beam cuts through the black, revealing only more emptiness, an endless void waiting ahead.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, Horo...
Her whisper is too loud, sharp in the suffocating silence. The echo bounces back, distorted, and Hella flinches at the sound of her own voice.

speaker: Hella
content: We've been walking forever... Where even is the end? You don't think Synex was messing with us, do you?
Horo's brow furrows deeper as her sense of foreboding tightens like a noose. The path stretches far longer than she anticipated, far longer than it should.
Another fork looms ahead. As her flashlight sweeps across the jagged rock wall, the beam catches on a familiar carving—her own mark, left not long ago. They've circled back?!

speaker: Horo
content: Wait, everyone, stop. Something's wrong—
Hella halts mid-step, but something snags her ankle. She stumbles forward, crashing into the person ahead. The impact sends them both sprawling, tumbling down a couple of steps.
The world whirls around her as Hella struggles to push herself up. Her palm lands on what should be that person's clothes—but instead, her fingers sink into something rough, hard, wrong.
The texture is granular like stone, yet it moves, squirming beneath her touch. Her breath hitches. Slowly, dread coiling in her gut, she lifts her head—
And there, inches from her face, a monstrous visage gazes back at her—twisted, patterned, and horrifyingly alive.

speaker: Hella
content: —AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!

The instant its disguise fails, the monster unleashes a shriek that pierces eardrums. A heartbeat later, the entire tunnel trembles as countless hidden beings howl in unison, their cries merging into a deafening tide of madness.
The silence had been a lie. They've been surrounded by predators all along.

speaker: Horo
content: Weapons ready!! We're breaking through!!!
The battle rages without end. Monsters surge from every branching tunnel, wave after wave, their howls echoing as they lunge forward.

speaker: Horo
content: ...There are too many of them...!
The air churns with Mania—that sickening, familiar sensation that coils in Horo's gut.

speaker: Horo
content: Don't tell me this is...!
A cold dread shoots up her spine. A terrible suspicion flares in her mind, one she doesn't want to believe, yet can't ignore. She has to confirm it.

Gritting her teeth, she channels every shred of strength into her arms and brings her blade down in a brutal arc. Foul blood sprays, shattered flesh flies, and there, amidst the carnage, she glimpses the source of the Mania. It is—

Before she can get a closer look, a blade buries itself into the ground beside her, missing her by inches. Her breath catches. No alchemic beast wields weapons like this. Someone is hiding in the horde, hunting her.

speaker: Horo
content: Who's there?!
The beast tide writhes in chaos, making it impossible to track the attacker. Strikes come from nowhere, each one carving fresh wounds into the Legion's members.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! Are these mutts sniffing us out or something? Why do they keep multiplying?!
Nearby, Hella barely deflects a lunge from a small alchemic beast. She stumbles back, colliding against Horo's back.

speaker: Hella
content: Horo! What do we do now?

speaker: Horo
content: No matter what, don't stop fighting!

speaker: Horo
content: These monsters have <color=#fb9259>Underground marks</color>! The inheritance, Aurum Secretum's breakthrough development, and those "Aurum Secretum Warriors" meant to replace Sinners—

speaker: Horo
content: Damn it, they're trying to create a Black Ring?!

speaker: Hella
content: What?! **** them, but—
—Who could be the Corpseborne?!
The image of a blonde figure flashes through Hella's mind.

speaker: Hella
content: No freaking way—?!

speaker: Horo
content: Hella! Where's the communicator Campbell gave you?!
Hella's hands scramble frantically through her clothes, taking out the special communicator, but all that answers her is the relentless buzz of a busy signal.

speaker: Hella
content: Dammit, it's useless! Can't get a single bar. Gotta be a jammer screwing with us! No signals in or out!

speaker: Hella
content: ...Ahhh!

In that split second of distraction, a snarling beast erupts from the shadows. The force of its lunge slams into her, sending her staggering backward. Losing her balance, she crashes straight into a seething pack of monsters.

speaker: Horo
content: ...?! Quick, give me your hand!

Through the writhing mass of claws and teeth, Hella catches a glimpse of Horo's outstretched hand. Fighting through searing pain, she stretches her arm toward Horo—almost there, just a little farther—
Clang! Another strike cleaves the air. Hella's body jerks, her movement stuttering for half a heartbeat.

speaker: Horo
content: Hella—?!
The horde surges forward in a frenzied tide, ripping them apart. Darkness swallows them whole, dragging each into its own twisting, suffocating path.
Hella sprints for her life through the tunnel.
The sounds of her pursuer echo from all directions—sometimes near, sometimes far—like a cat toying with a cornered mouse, savoring the chase.
Again, she twists aside just in time, narrowly avoiding another strike. This time, she hears it—a breathy, exhilarated laugh, ringing from the shadows.
Heh... I did warn you not to come out after dark. Now why didn't you listen, hm?
Hella recognizes that mocking laughter. She whips her head around and finally catches a glimpse of her pursuer's face—

speaker: Hella
content: ...Synex?!!!
The figure steps forward, unhurried, as if emerging from the darkness itself.

Monsters prowl at her side, their growls rumbling like distant thunder. Heavy Aurum Secretum chains coil around their necks, clenched tightly in Synex's grip as she urges them forward, herding Hella toward a dead end.
Amid the beasts, Synex stands, as if she were always one of them.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh darling, I did warn you about the "dangerous things underground." But you just had to ignore me, didn't you?

speaker: Synex
content: Such a shame... I liked you. Really, I did. I was even hoping to keep you around, just a little more fun before the end. But no... you didn't give me a choice.
Before the last word even leaves her lips, her wrist flicks. Chains snap taut, and the monsters surge forward with ear-splitting howls.

speaker: Synex
content: Come, say hello to my dear brothers and sisters.
Surrounded and attacked from all sides, Hella is driven back, step by step, pressed deeper into the maze's heart.

speaker: Hella
content: If this keeps up, she's gonna catch me for sure...

speaker: Hella
content: Think, THINK! There's gotta be another way!
At the next narrow turn, she explodes into motion. Her silhouette blurs, vanishing around the corner in an instant.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh?
With the prey out of sight, the hunter hesitates momentarily before momentum carries her around the corner.
CLANG—! Metal rings out as fragments scatter in all directions.
The strike comes from the blind spot. Hella, coiled in the shadows of the inner corner, lashes out. Her weapon meets Synex's mask with a shattering impact. But she can't press closer.

speaker: Synex
content: Haha... Hahahaha!! Well done!
Beneath the broken mask, a pair of eyes gleam—wild, unhinged, alight with manic delight.

speaker: Hella
content: You did this on purpose... You knew we'd come if you told us about this place... Just like what happened to the last person who found that photo...

speaker: Hella
content: Everyone else who found out the truth was killed by you people!

speaker: Synex
content: Oops, looks like I missed a spot. Was it that little runaway? Did she actually make it to DisCity?

speaker: Synex
content: Ah, but who cares? The real fun part is... you all took the bait.
As if satisfied with Hella's expression, Synex's smile grows even more taunting.

speaker: Synex
content: Ah, <color=#fb9259>Hypercubes</color>... For years, DisCity's kept its precious Mania-resistance resource under lock and key. How it's made? How it's mined? Nobody knows. Most poor souls waste their lives scrambling for scraps.

speaker: Synex
content: Fraser slaved away at that research for ages—right up until this little project was about to crumble... Then along came some very special guests.

speaker: Synex
content: They brought secrets of the <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>.

speaker: Hella
content: So, Fraser is really working with the Underground! Do you all have a death wish?!
Synex gives no definitive answer, laughing with uninhibited delight.

speaker: Synex
content: We just can't let a few squeaking little rats ruin a big plan like this, you know. So the Shadow Operatives have to... clean up the loose ends.
The woman lifts Hella's chin with one finger, her voice laced with something almost like tenderness.

speaker: Synex
content: However...

speaker: Synex
content: I've just found you, my precious little prey... Wouldn't it be such a shame to cut our game short?

speaker: Synex
content: Honestly, I don't really care about Hypercubes, DisCity, or Fraser... If they actually got what they wanted, it'd be so boring.

speaker: Synex
content: So, I have a different plan, something much more fun. Would you play with me instead, little Hella?
Hella speaks very softly, prompting Synex to instinctively lean in closer to hear.

speaker: Synex
content: Hmm?
Slap—!!!

A sharp, resounding slap splits the air as Hella drives her palm across Synex's face with every ounce of strength she has. The force of the blow catches Synex off guard, just enough for Hella to wrench herself free from her captor's grip.

speaker: Hella
content: Go **** yourself!

speaker: Hella
content: You really think you can buy me that easy? Couldn't con me into talking about the shackles during the day, so now you're pulling this shady night-time bullshit?

speaker: Hella
content: That slap was your lesson! Remember to ask nicely before trying to haggle in your next life!
Quickly dropping low, Hella rolls across the rough ground, fingers clawing for gravel. In one fluid motion, she flings the jagged stones straight for Synex's eyes. The moment Synex dodges—
Hella bolts away without a backward glance. Behind her, only chaos remains, and Synex, fingertips brushing the livid mark staining her cheek.

speaker: Synex
content: Ouch... still got that fiery temper.
[Fade Out to Switch Scene]
After running for a while, Hella sprints past a junction. Close behind her—like relentless shadows—come the guttural growls of beasts and the ever-nearing laughter of her pursuer.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, Hella, sweetheart—are you going to keep running? I'm getting bored with this game—
Another sharp turn! Hella, gasping for air, stumbles into the junction, only for her heart to drop like a stone.
Before her looms a solid wall. A dead end.
Behind her, the chaotic footsteps of her hunters and Synex's mocking laughter are just a breath away—no time to turn back now.

speaker: Synex
content: Without Legion or Hypatia to help you, where do you think you're running? Or maybe... you'd like to crawl into a hole again, like last time?

speaker: Synex
content: Too bad for you, my nose never misses a scent. I'll find you... no matter how deep you dig...
"Into a hole"...?
Then, an idea flashes through her mind. Hella drops to her knees, frantically scraping her hands across the ground—until her fingers brush against something small, cold, and unmistakably metallic.

speaker: Hella
content: Come on, come on... There's no time left!
Click. A familiar mechanical whirr, and the wall splits open, revealing a hidden passage.
The shadows of her pursuers round the corner. With no time to hesitate, Hella grits her teeth, tucks her body tight, and hurls herself inside—

speaker: Hella
content: —WAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
The moment she leaps, her feet find nothing but air as she plummets down a smooth, steep tunnel, swallowed whole by the darkness below.
[Background - Refugee Camp]
After sliding down the passage for who knows how long, a thoroughly dizzy and disoriented Hella is finally spat out by the pipe with a wet plop.
Then... SPLASH! She plunges into a pool of water.

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... Where am I... blegh...

Gasping, she thrashes wildly, limbs heavy with exhaustion. With one final heave, she drags herself onto solid ground and collapses, chest heaving. But before she can even catch her breath, she hears something rustling nearby.
Her head snaps up. Against the dim light filtering from above, bizarre, jagged shadows slither into view, encircling her.
More pursuers? Every muscle in her body coils tight, ready to strike—until one shadow detaches itself from the rest. A figure steps forward.
You are...?
[Refugee Camp - Night]

Outside Aurum Secretum Research Institute, Fraser Outskirts
Refugee Camp
Moments Earlier

speaker: Thani
content: Okay, don't rush... don't rush... Just like what I saw at the research institute, wait for all the gunk to settle down first, then slowly add this...
With extreme caution, the girl carefully releases the liquid from her pipette into the test tube. A sudden, sharp hiss pierces the air—faint but electric.

Then, tiny golden particles emerge, peeling away from the rough surface like flecks of sunlight. One by one, they drift downward in a slow, glittering descent. As she watches, the tension in her shoulders eases, and she lets out a long sigh of relief.

speaker: Thani
content: Ahh... I knew it! How could I mess up twenty times in a row? This time, for sure—
BOOM—!

speaker: Refugee
content: Sigh... it's just not enough. How can this alone be enough...
The man sighs as he weighs the bag in his hand, containing nothing more than a tiny pinch of fine golden fragments.

speaker: Refugee
content: What's the situation at the pool?

speaker: Refugee
content: Not good. This month, we'll all have to stretch what little we have... And if our supplies are low, they'll just push the price down even more...

speaker: Thani
content: Then if we add these in, there won't be any problem, right?

speaker: Thani
content: Guys, look what I got today! This whole huge bag full! Hmm... plus all those Aurum Secretum pieces I took while cleaning at the institute. Let's see... how much was it again...
The girl counts earnestly on her fingers, bending them back and forth, but after a moment, she sighs and gives up.

speaker: Thani
content: Well, it's definitely more than what we had! Tomorrow I'll take all this to the institute and trade it for supplies and medicine!
The crowd erupts in joy, voices clamoring, buzzing with anticipation and relief as they discuss the soon-to-arrive resources.

speaker: Refugee
content: Thank you, Thani... We wouldn't have made it this far without you...

speaker: Thani
content: Oh, don't say that! I'm nothing special at all! I just... kinda have this little ability that helps sometimes, that's all...

speaker: Refugee
content: Oh Thani... Without you, us old bones would've starved long before the screening officer came. Look at you, working yourself to the bone just to put food in our mouths. Come here, let me fix you up...
The three-armed woman picks up a towel and gently wipes the grime from the girl's face.

speaker: Refugee
content: But... how'd you get so many Aurum Secretum bits today? Normally you only come back with a little pouch...

speaker: Thani
content: Ehehe! Guess what? I found this whole trail of Aurum Secretum shards today! Like, every few steps, another huge chunk was just waiting for me!

speaker: Refugee
content: Really?! Since when does luck just come knocking at our door?

speaker: Thani
content: Actually, these Aurum Secretum bits all fell off that Apostle Lady Synex caught! I just followed behind and scooped up all the pieces when nobody was looking!
Thani keeps quiet about the risks of her scavenging expedition, unwilling to burden the others with worry.

speaker: Refugee
content: So it was Lady Synex. I knew she hadn't forgotten about us...

speaker: Refugee
content: I know about that Apostle! Heard it took everything—Lady Hypatia, all those Furorians, even the whole town's Aurum Secretum weapons—plus Synex just to barely take it down!

speaker: Refugee
content: Still... Synex must've done most of the heavy lifting, right? Why else would Lady Hypatia get left out of the victory parade?

speaker: Refugee
content: Oh! That reminds me. Sandra, don't you have some cousin or something in the Furor? What's his name... Taric, was it?
The woman sits motionless at the edge of the crowd, her gaze vacant. Even when called by name, she shows no response.

speaker: Refugee
content: You forgot? She's been walking dead ever since they took her kid to the institute... Tsk, lucky family. Brother getting to mine Aurum Secretum while her kid gets treatment at the institute...

speaker: Refugee
content: Exactly... Heard those Furorians just went right into the institute soon as they got here. Meanwhile, the rest of us? Still waiting our turn for the screening like always...
Thani watches the arguments unfold with quiet contentment. In the refugee camp, having both the energy to speak and the spirit to argue is proof of vitality—a sign that life persists even here.

speaker: Uriel
content: Psst, Thani? Come here, just for a sec.
A man stands in the corner, beckoning with secrecy.

speaker: Thani
content: Mm? What's up?

speaker: Uriel
content: Well... that "pool" you mentioned, out by the institute's edge? Doesn't it sometimes cough up Aurum Secretum bits?

speaker: Thani
content: Hey, Uncle Uriel! Didn't I tell you guys to stay away from that place? That's not a normal water pool; it's a sewage pipe! What if you get infected?!

speaker: Uriel
content: C'mon, in times like these, who's got the luxury to be picky? Besides...

speaker: Thani
content: Besides...?
He glances around to make sure no one else is watching before leaning in close to Thani.

speaker: Uriel
content: This time it wasn't Aurum Secretum that came out; it was a living, breathing person!
Hella eyes the refugees warily. Their grotesquely deformed limbs, barely concealed by tattered robes, twitch unnaturally in the dim light.

speaker: Hella
content: Haha... am I seeing things... why is everyone so...?

speaker: Thani
content: ...! Don't judge them just because they look a little weird! They... they only ended up like this because they got infected. They're all really nice, I promise!
The girl flinches, as if suddenly aware of her outburst, and swiftly steers the conversation back on course.

speaker: Thani
content: Um, hey, don't be scared, okay? This is... Zone III on the outskirts of the research institute. I'm Thani. I-I work at the Fraser Institute, as a janitor.

speaker: Thani
content: Um... that place you came out of... it's an Aurum Secretum pipe that's super important to us. How'd you even get in there?
As Thani speaks, she suddenly tilts her head, studying Hella's face. The longer she looks, the more familiar it seems.

speaker: Thani
content: ...Wait, you look... Do I know you from somewhere? That's weird...

speaker: Hella
content: I'm Hella! I'm from... Furor! Just got here yesterday. Maybe you saw me at the research institute? Yeah, that's gotta be it!

speaker: Hella
content: The institute's so big... I got all turned around and lost my friends. I kept running and running, and then... I just fell right into this horrible hole!

speaker: Hella
content: It was so dark... and gross... and there were m-monsters everywhere! I-I really thought I was gonna die down there... Sob...
Hella does her best to look like a terrified, hungry, and exhausted refugee. For extra authenticity, she even feigns a few sniffles, as if she's caught a cold.
Her acting skills must be improving. Hella clearly sees the pity and sympathy in Thani's eyes.

speaker: Thani
content: Don't worry! We're all just folks who ended up at Fraser trying to get by, just like you!

speaker: Thani
content: Come with us to our camp! The institute sends us food and blankets pretty often. You'll get your share too.
With that, Thani turns and strides toward the nearby glow of the tents. Meanwhile, the nearby refugees gather around Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: H-hey, what're you— I can walk by myself! Just let me— AAAAAH why are you all putting your hands on me?!

speaker: Thani
content: You've been sitting in that stinky water for so long. We gotta get you cleaned up first!

After being surrounded by people who clean the grime off her body, Hella is ushered into a tent. The interior is stark—almost barren—with nothing but a threadbare blanket serving as a bed. Yet what unsettles her most isn't the emptiness, but...

speaker: Hella
content: —Why the hell do you have HER picture hanging by the bed?!
And she's totally posing to look all cool! Gross, it's so gross!

speaker: Thani
content: Oh! I forgot to tell you, this tent was actually little Yuri's. He passed the screening last week, so you can stay here now.

speaker: Thani
content: He's a huge fan of Synex, always going, "I wanna be brave and amazing like her!" He even put up that poster to keep himself motivated.
Synex? A role model? Brave? Amazing?

speaker: Hella
content: Ahahaha... Synex... I mean, she's impressive in a way, but "brave and amazing"? None of them fit her at all!

speaker: Thani
content: Well... I haven't really met her much myself, but everyone around here totally admires her.

speaker: Thani
content: You know, she didn't rely on anybody. Just her own smarts and hard work got her into the research institute. And now she's living a good life, and she's the strongest Aurum Secretum Warrior protecting everybody.

speaker: Thani
content: It's only with such an amazing role model that everyone in the camp knows what to work toward.

speaker: Hella
content: I guess you have a point... but...

Hella lets out a long sigh, deciding not to argue with Thani. After all, don't bite the hand that feeds you. If she keeps contradicting them, she'll likely end up right back in that stinking ditch she crawled out of.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Okay, fine. Maybe I... didn't have the whole story. Thanks for sharing all this with me. I... I think I understand Synex a bit better now!
Every muscle in Hella's body tenses as she fights back her revulsion, choking out words so false they taste bitter on her tongue.

speaker: Thani
content: Hehe... I knew it! Nobody from Furor could ever be bad.

speaker: Thani
content: Oh! If you like Synex, Yuri actually hid some more posters here...

speaker: Hella
content: No, no, no, no thanks! I've been busting my butt all day and I'm wiped! How about we talk more tomorrow?

speaker: Thani
content: Um... alright... And just so you know, this tent's a bit drafty, so use an extra blanket when you sleep!

speaker: Hella
content: Alright, alright, I'll keep that in mind!
The moment Thani steps out, Hella lunges for her bag. Too impatient to rummage through it, she upends the whole thing, sending its contents clattering to the ground.

speaker: Hella
content: ...It's still here. Thank goodness.
Fraser and Synex have played them all for fools. No more delays—she has to get this intel out, now.
She jabs at the communicator, redialing again and again. A dozen attempts later, all she gets is the same infuriating static.

speaker: Hella
content: Damn it... How is this happening...
The static crackles once again. Completely frustrated, Hella hurls the device to the ground.
It bounces a few times before skidding to a stop near the tent entrance.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Ugh, that was a gift from my friend! What am I even thinking...
Letting out another sigh, Hella bends down to pick up the communicator, but as she does, her gaze flickers up through the gap in the flap. And there, in the darkness, an eerie face looms—

speaker: Thani
content: ...Still awake?

speaker: Hella
content: Eeeek—A ghost—!

speaker: Thani
content: Um... sorry... I heard some rustling and got worried something was wrong, but I didn't mean to...

speaker: Hella
content: I'm fine.

speaker: Thani
content: That's not fine at all! Look how big this bump is on your head!
Hella has no comeback and can only turn her head away.

speaker: Thani
content: I'm really sorry! Um... maybe I can do something to help? I'll do anything!

speaker: Hella
content: ...Unless...

speaker: Thani
content: Unless?

speaker: Raven
content: Ahem, you know some DisCity people came with us yesterday, right? Do you know where they are?

speaker: Thani
content: The DisCity people? Hmm... I know they're staying in the northwest part of Zone II. It's the most out-of-the-way spot.

speaker: Thani
content: Most folks around here get all huffy about DisCity people. But personally, I don't think it's a big deal. We're not that different...
Perfect, the fish took the bait. Hella rubs her eyes, her face crumpling as if she's about to burst into tears.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Look, I know most DisCity jerks suck, but this crew actually got us here safe from Furor. And they were pretty nice to us the whole way, so I just want to send them a message to say thank you.

speaker: Hella
content: I was planning to go myself, but it's so late now... I'm injured all over, and I just hit my head...

speaker: Thani
content: ...!! I know these parts pretty well! Let me go for you!

speaker: Hella
content: That's wonderful! You're such an amazing person!
All according to plan. Hella didn't expect her to take the bait so fast... She's even made Thani blush with that flattery.

speaker: Thani
content: Aww... hehe... I'm really not that great... Do you need to write a letter or something? Should I get you some paper and a pen?

speaker: Hella
content: Nah, just tell them—

speaker: Hella
content: "Found the thing. Hurry back home and report"!

June 23, N.F. 115
9:07 AM

Senate Reception Room, Fraser City
In the reception room, the blonde noble struggles to contain her fury.

speaker: Hypatia
content: What?! Both of them have gone missing?!

speaker: Senate Assistant
content: Yes. The institute is still doing everything possible to locate them. However, given the highly sensitive nature of the disappearance site, I advise preparing for the worst-case scenario.

speaker: Senate Assistant
content: Should the search prove unsuccessful, we will initiate a formal inquiry into DisCity on the grounds of suspected espionage.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...?! Wait! This must be a misunderstanding! They were instrumental in resolving the Furor incident. I explicitly detailed their contributions in my report to the Senate!

speaker: Senate Assistant
content: It's possible that DisCity deployed these two to Furor with the express purpose of gathering detailed intelligence on the Apostle of Ashes and Aurum Secretum.

speaker: Hypatia
content: You...!

speaker: Senate Assistant
content: Miss Hypatia, while I understand your concerns, I must caution you. That statement alone could warrant your imprisonment and trial alongside them.
Rage nearly overwhelms her. The girl closes her eyes momentarily, quickly regaining control of her emotions.
...Too long away. She has almost forgotten how to navigate their games.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Mr. Shayne, are you questioning my integrity, or that of my family? If you truly intend to press these baseless allegations against Campbell, then by all means, proceed.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Though I do wonder if you have properly considered the repercussions.

speaker: Senate Assistant
content: ...My apologies for the impropriety. I only meant to advise caution. Certain statements could inadvertently place you in a vulnerable position.

speaker: Hypatia
content: My standing in this matter hasn't been favorable from the start.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The Furor Aurum Secretum was under my oversight, and those two "spies" were Campbell's officially invited guests. Before presuming to act unilaterally, did it not occur to you to seek my counsel—or at the very least, extend me the courtesy of notification?

speaker: Hypatia
content: I will be speaking with the Senators directly. They owe me a full accounting of these proceedings.

speaker: Senate Assistant
content: Regrettable timing, I'm afraid. The Senate is currently preoccupied with pressing affairs. You should anticipate a delay of several days before they can accommodate your request.

speaker: Hypatia
content: How many days?

speaker: Senate Assistant
content: Rest assured, the guards arranged by Mr. Adelaide will arrive this afternoon to accompany you back to Campbell Manor. Until their arrival, we would appreciate your patience in this waiting room.
Without another word, the assistant offers an elegant bow and slips out of the reception room.
Silence settles once more. Hypatia retrieves her communicator and tries the call again, only to be met with the same infuriating busy signal.
Still no response... Is the signal being blocked? Or has something truly happened to them...?
Her eyes drift to the exhibition cabinets lining the room, their polished surfaces displaying the most prized Aurum Secretum research.
This is where the Senate parades its achievements for outsiders, a carefully curated showcase. And, for security, one perpetually locked within a powerful Mania-blocking field.
Aurum Secretum devices are useless here... whether for contacting Hella or attempting to force her way out.
The Senate refuses my meeting request, and my brother's operatives will be here by afternoon... This can't be a coincidence. They must have planned this all along.
How? Did I give myself away somehow, or...?
She rests her chin in her palm, mind racing.
The priority now is clear: find a way out of this deadlock, and uncover the truth behind the inheritance and the Black Ring.
All the research data is in the system. If I can find a terminal with access to the internal network... Once I'm back home and truly trapped, it'll be over...

speaker: Hypatia
content: I have to act... And it has to be now!
With her mind made up, Hypatia rises and strides to the door. The heavy entrance is securely locked, but that won't stop her.
From her person, she retrieves a small, delicate "accessory." With her movement, the Aurum Secretum within stirs to life, its form shifting fluidly until it elongates into the keyhole.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I never thought Aurum Secretum could be used for something like this...
With a soft click, the door lock springs open.

speaker: Hypatia
content: No one around... Perfect.
Without hesitation, Hypatia slips into the corridor, her footsteps swift and silent as she melts into the distance.

June 23, N.F. 115
10:24 AM

Refugee Settlement, Outside the Aurum Secretum Institute

A cold morning mist clings to the refugee camp. Beneath the frayed tents, people huddle together, their silence thick with exhaustion. The air reeks of filth and decay—even the wind seems burdened, carrying the stale breath of sickness and despair. Until...
