Within the frenzy, there's something else lurking: chaotic wills. They coil gently around the girl, a paradoxical force both protecting and corrupting her, holding her in a delicate balance.
What's protecting her are other "people"—those departed souls.

speaker: Synex
content: You see, but you don't understand... This Black Ring will never allow anyone to lay a finger on her.
She is smugly chewing another berry when someone brushes past behind her, their robe whispering against her tail. Synex jolts with a shiver.
A relatively young officer enters the barracks. He isn't from the Campbell family, but she recalls seeing him alongside someone...

speaker: Fraser Officer
content: If the Black Ring wants her, so be it. Adelaide always said to respect wills beyond our understanding.
Young, yet surprisingly resolute. Then it clicks. Adelaide's lackey.

speaker: Fraser Officer
content: But against our true enemy, the Black Ring and we are not opposed. Synex, get the advisors back to camp.

speaker: Synex
content: Yes... sir—
She maintains a facade of courteous respect until the very moment she departs, keenly aware of the young officer's gaze. She must leave now; a moment longer, and he would surely see through her.
Only once Synex has vanished from sight does the young Fraser officer turn to consider the truly crucial person.

speaker: Fraser Officer
content: As for those tracking shackles... I'll find a way to deal with them...
A familiar warmth brushes against you, pulling you back from the haziness. You open your eyes to see Hecate dabbing sweat from your brow, her face etched with concern.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, are you alright?
Using the shackles to sense the Black Ring has left you deeply fatigued; you must have dozed off while reviewing battle reports.
Yet, the success is its own reward. Your plan to track the Black Ring is progressing perfectly. A satisfied smile touches your lips in answer to her worry.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My plan works. Augustus's troop will find the Black Ring, and Hella will come back. Don't worry. Look—
As you look up, you see the shadow of "Hella" floating above you, her posture one of clear contentment.

speaker: Hella
content: Heehee...

speaker: Option
options: We won, and Hella's happy about it too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can you hear her talking?
Hecate shakes her head.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay. I can't fully understand her either, but I've found a way to communicate with her. Look.
You shuffle through the documents cluttering your desk. Scattered among the battle reports are the letters and trinkets Hella has sent from her travels.

The shadow swoops in the instant she spots them, flailing her arms with excitement. When you point to a photograph or a particular letter, she bounces in a joyful dance. Her gestures become increasingly animated, as if showing frustration that these static, small tokens could never capture the full breadth of her adventures.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is a... cowboy town? Closest one to us, right in WhiteSands. It was her first stop.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Seems like a fun place, full of... scammers? Haha, Hella says she's really mad at them, but looks like she had a lot of fun.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is a big canyon, where their car gave out, right? I heard she got jumped by bandits and ended up robbing them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Look how far they've traveled, all the way into the Outlanders' territory. And she even made friends with the Outlanders. A lot of them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Haha... Listen to us, talking about mobilization and war... and Hella's out there actually helping people. Getting along with the Outlanders better than any diplomat we've got.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She never should've gone through all this. We're bringing her home. We have to.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Yeah.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella will be alright. The real her is waiting for you. And she would want you to stay safe. You need to get some rest.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We will win.
The phantom of Hella floats down, a gentle wisp upon the air. Though her features remain a blurred portrait, an unusual tenderness radiates from her as she bends to gather you both into a quiet hold.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, we've got news!
You rush immediately to the command console.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is Minos. Do you copy? What's your status? Have you reached the location?

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Broken Blade Squad 3... copy. ████... we've reached... the designated location. The Tide of Ashes and... Black Ring readings... are both extremely intense......... ██...
You anxiously grip the communication device.

speaker: Option
options: Can you send a live feed?

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Interference is severe, visibility zero... ██...can only transmit... sensor readings but... ███...transmission is difficult...

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Ground... ██...shaking, something underground... ████...could be... Aurum Secretum device...██...

speaker: Option
options: Wait, this could be an ambush.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Give us some time to investigate. Stay put—

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Will miss... opportunity... We must proceed...

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Please don't worry about us. This is...████... your order...██... We... will...██... complete the mission...

speaker: Lieutenant
content: ██...██ Broken Blade Squad 3...██... over...
The communication ends abruptly.
On the battlefield far away from the city, the military troop conducts a final check of their weapons, magazines clicking home into receivers.

Before them, BR-005 lies unsettlingly still. The path is clear—no ash storms, no Apostles lurking—just a wide, exposed road promising an easy victory. Yet a cold dread settles in the veterans' bones. They sense it...
At the end of the open road, a solitary guardian lies in wait. Its master seems confident this true monster is all it will take to crush the warriors foolish enough to take the bait.

speaker: Lieutenant
content: ██...████...Broken Blade Squad 3 to Minos, do you copy? Broken Blade Squad 3... to Minos... do you██... copy...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you all okay?

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Operation was a success. There's...██... no need for concern... The Aurum Secretum core has been destroyed. We also have a lead...████... on the other objective...

speaker: Lieutenant
content: ...██ attempting to transmit visual feed now...████...

A Mania scan, riddled with static and digital corruption, unfolds across the main screen, causing everyone to draw a sharp breath. Through the shaking footage, beyond the interference and the raging sandstorm, past the grotesque forms of the Apostles and corrupted beasts, every gaze locks onto a single twisted, chaotic silhouette at the storm's heart.

The Black Ring's signature red halo is burned deep into its shell, spreading cross-shaped patterns that look like both gaping wounds and bloody shackles. The figure moves with a slow, alternating gait—hand, foot, hand, foot. What should be an apparition too horrific to behold feels disturbingly familiar—

It's a "human," one that has just reclaimed towering skeletal remains. Contamination seeps outward like regenerating necrotic flesh, and at the core, the convergence of the Black Ring's crimson light forms a pulsating "heart." Through the electronic display, you can almost feel each beat reverberate through the ground.

Your own heart begins to hammer wildly against your ribs. Your mouth falls open, and a smile spreads unbidden across your face. Despite the screen and the hundreds of miles between you, a call echoes deep within your skull—a voice both profound and gentle, beckoning you to step through the image and meet it face to face.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: ...Is this... an Apostle of Ashes?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...No, that's... BR-005.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hecate, we found her... Hella is there... The real Hella is there... we found her...

The shadow of "Hella" wraps around your neck, pulling you forward as she dances in frantic excitement. You feel like you've never been closer to her. And even the stinging, corrosive sensation spreading through your body does nothing to dampen the shared, euphoric joy.

speaker: Schorl
content: This footage is remarkably clear. It visually confirms the Black Ring has merged with an Apostle of Ashes, which explains the unusual phenomena we've been tracking.

speaker: Schorl
content: Initiating data transfer and real-time updates now. You've done excellent work, Chief. The Ring Research Institute is very grateful.
Their gratitude means little to you as there are far more important matters weighing on your mind.
ROAAAR—
With a deafening roar, the already faltering feed cuts abruptly to black.

speaker: Lieutenant
content: We've been spotted. The Apostle is...████... amplifying the Tide of Ashes...██... Some Rancors are losing control. The Mania readings... are off the chart...██...

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Do we continue the investigation? Please...███... give the order...████...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are there any Aurum Secretum Warriors in the vicinity? Any Outlanders?

speaker: Lieutenant
content: Negative. Besides us, there are no...██... human signatures...
The truth dawns on you at that moment.

speaker: Option
options: It's a trap! Get out of there now!

content: Buzz— Buzz—
The other end falls silent. Now, the channel carries only a faint, intermittent static that underscores a deeper, more absolute silence.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I know their location. Let's move now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They're already at the foot of the Black Ring. Hella's right there. We'll link up with Broken Blade Squad 3 and finish this together.
Hecate frantically grabs your arm, trying to stop you from leaving.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, no! You can't go! The contamination on you is getting worse. Please, don't go!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They walked into a trap because of my orders! I have to go!

speaker: Augustus
content: I'm sure Squad 3 would be touched to hear that. Their previous commanders understood that some losses are necessary to complete the objective, yet you're willing to put your little Hella on hold for their lives.

speaker: Augustus
content: But that's not your call to make. Leave the rescue to my team. Your duty is in the command room. Do not do anything reckless.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even with my shackles contaminated, there's still plenty I can do. I gave the order, and I'm not leaving them behind.

speaker: Augustus
content: Hahaha, this isn't just an MBCC squad operation. It's a full battlefield. And your team is not the only group of soldiers on it. A commander who can't delegate is a liability. Right now, that means accepting there is someone more suited for this extraction than you.

speaker: Augustus
content: And forget the guilt. Squad 3 moved on your order because they trusted your judgment. They secured vital intel under your command. Even if it costs them their lives, they'll believe you will make that sacrifice count.

speaker: Augustus
content: So now it's up to you to give meaning to their efforts. The real fight is just beginning.
A smile spreads across Augustus's face. She strolls to the sand table, plucks a single piece from the board, and holds it before you.

speaker: Augustus
content: Our enemy isn't foolish. Those Outlanders dared to use the Black Ring as bait and successfully diverted DisCity's entire attention... Do you truly believe their endgame was a single investigation team?

speaker: Augustus
content: Think like them. If you held that advantage, wouldn't you press it to strike a decisive blow?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You mean... Could it be...?!
[Alarm Blaring]

speaker: Siglinde
content: Attention all combat personnel, this is FAC. We've detected Apostle of Ashes signatures inside DisCity. I repeat, we've detected Apostle of Ashes signatures inside DisCity. The city is under attack. All combat personnel to battle stations, immediately!

speaker: Siglinde
content: West District Outpost W34 is reporting multiple scattered contacts. We also have eyes on the suspicious entities west of the city, using the sandstorm as cover while advancing steadily. ETA to the urban area is one hour.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Could their objective be...

speaker: Schorl
content: The farlands used BR-005 and the large-scale Apostle catastrophe to divert our attention, pulling our defenses toward FAC's major anti-catastrophe barriers. That diversion allowed them to deploy elite units like you and infiltrate past our lines. Their primary target appears to be the West District.

speaker: Augustus
content: ...They've got some nerve, I'll give them that.
The wild dogs that once hid behind the Apostles and catastrophes now dare to bare their teeth. It appears a measure of cunning has finally overcome their foolishness.

speaker: Augustus
content: Time to move, Chief of Minos. The "Hero of DisCity" has a choice to make. Your city is under attack, and I don't have your sentimental attachment to it. Your people need you, not me.

speaker: Augustus
content: So, what's it going to be? Chase the Black Ring to save your Hella, or do your duty and defend your headquarters?
You grind your teeth.

An ash storm of this magnitude will inevitably cause resonance in DisSea—a hard battle awaiting FAC. Compounding the crisis, the shackles have left MBCC in a semi-paralyzed state. Even if you could leave the city to chase the Black Ring, you have no one to turn to except Augustus, but clearly, she has other plans for you.
You have no choice but to accept this arrangement. If you don't confront this crisis head-on, Hella won't be the only one to suffer. You understand this truth all too well.
(Hangs up and calls someone else)

Beneath the scorching sun, golden sands roll in endless waves. Augustus grips the wheel with one hand, guiding her vehicle as it carves a path over shattered stone, churning a thick plume of dust in its violent wake.

speaker: Augustus
content: Hey, how's that mark on your neck doing, Uris?

speaker: Augustus
content: Yes, we've pinpointed the Black Ring. Steer clear of it. I don't want it affecting you. The last thing we need is the Underground using this chaos to snatch you back.

speaker: Augustus
content: I'll handle Squad 3.
She ends the call just as a boulder tears through the air ahead, its whistle culminating in a crash aimed directly at her car.
Augustus's gaze doesn't even waver. She merely twitches her fingers, and violent, concentrated energy ripples in the air around her.
Shards of rock scatter in a hail against the car's roof and windows. Expression utterly impassive, Augustus never slows, and the vehicle races through the choking plume of dust.
[Scene Change] Any District Battlefield

The city no longer recognizes frontlines or safe zones. Ash drifts like a tide, swirling into plazas on the wind, sifting through the gaps between buildings and the husks of crumbling ruins. Familiar districts are suddenly plunged into chaos, pulsing with panic and unrest.

Soldiers charging forward brush past terrified residents in flight. Gunfire can erupt from any alley without warning. War has swept through every corner like a squall—screams, pounding footsteps, and desperate shouts rise and fall across the city as disorder and fear spread unchecked.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Liaison Officer, watch out!!

A figure darts forward. An FAC soldier shoves Siglinde aside and closes with the assailant. In one fluid motion, he slams the stock of his rifle toward the opponent's neck, and he freezes. This isn't a Corruptor. The attacker is dressed up like a Syndican.
—But around their hand glints a weapon of Aurum Secretum. An Outlander.

speaker: Siglinde
content: Don't hesitate. Strike now!

Too late. In that sliver of time, it's killing instinct that decides who lives. The Outlander's weapon slices clean through the FAC soldier's carotid artery. A heartbeat later, Siglinde's piercing barrier rips through the attacker.
She doesn't hesitate to deliver the finishing blow before rushing to the soldier's side. The wound is grotesque, edges forced outward, blood surging in ragged, rhythmic bursts.

speaker: Siglinde
content: Hang in there!

Siglinde's shout is desperate, but they both know it's too late. Blood-flecked foam bubbles at the soldier's lips, choking each attempt at speech. With a final, convulsive effort, he seizes a ragged breath and forces the words out, loud enough to be heard.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Evacuate... the civilians... nearby... get them out...
His voice cuts off abruptly as his body slumps against her, then goes rigid.
Siglinde holds him for a long, silent moment before gently lowering him to the ground. From memory, her fingers find a gap in his bloodied armor and retrieve a small, cold metal tag.
Name: James Walker FAC-5471-3892 Date of Birth: July 12, N.F. 90 "For my wife and daughter, and the city-state"
So FAC uses them too. The style was nearly identical to the old army tags, just like the pair her own parents left behind.

speaker: Siglinde
content: ...If you knew how to kill, you wouldn't be dead now.

speaker: Siglinde
content: The FAC soldiers really are amateurs...
As she says this, Siglinde carefully tucks away the dog tag and closes the soldier's eyes.
The fallen soldier's communication device rings. Siglinde recognizes the encryption key as one from FAC headquarters, so she answers it.

speaker: Siglinde
content: Area 282 is clear. I request... permission to return to HQ and deliver my report.
[Scene Change] Corridor

speaker: Nightingale
content: The situation in the West District is critical. A shortage of Hypercubes has forced Syndicate to prioritize securing the new mine over protecting civilian facilities. To make matters worse, the contaminated shackles also have an impact on them...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Many Sinners, including Matilda, have registered at the Bureau and been connected to the shackles. Now they're all affected by BR-005's contamination, struggling with their basic duties, let alone defending anyone.
[Scene Change] Communications, FAC Front Line

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: Who are you?
Siglinde steps forward and salutes, her face a mask of powder-stained dust.

speaker: Siglinde
content: Sir, I'm Siglinde, Senior Wartime Liaison Officer from the Eighth Division of DisCorps. General Augustus assigned me to assist with your battle operations.

speaker: Siglinde
content: I've finished visiting all FAC forward positions to provide comms upgrade assistance. Now, I request permission to deliver my report on personnel casualties across the board directly to you. Do you have some time now?

speaker: Siglinde
content: I should warn you, sir, the details are extensive.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: ...Go ahead. I'm listening.
[Scene Change]

speaker: Newscast
content: The Tide of Ashes continues to expand its reach, now consuming over seventy percent of the West District. The surge is poised to cross the Rust at any moment, putting the entire Eastside in imminent danger. The number of affected civilians is climbing by the hour. Dozens of underground shelters have now reached capacity, and emergency crews are scrambling to coordinate relocations.

speaker: Newscast
content: In the midst of this chaos, we've seen violent incidents break out in several overcrowded areas, with Outland immigrants reportedly being targeted. Speaker Max King was also caught in one of these altercations while organizing an evacuation and sustained minor injuries.
[Scene Change] Syndicate Streets

speaker: Panicked Civilian
content: My brother's in there! He's still under the rubble! Somebody, please! Help him, I'm begging you!!

speaker: Panicked Civilian
content: It hurts... It's burning hot... Help me...

speaker: Panicked Civilian
content: Why is this happening... hnngh... WAAAHH—
