After these long days, the arcane patterns of the telegraph codes have become strangely familiar. You lean in, your eyes narrowing to decipher the text materializing at her fingertips:

speaker: Chief
content: Material components: zinc, iron, tin, cotton... Doesn't seem like information worth concealing.

speaker: Hilda
content: The quantity and depth of intelligence I gather depend on how long I use my power.

speaker: Hilda
content: And not everyone's mind is easily readable. Those with special training can conceal their consciousness in deeper layers, requiring more time from me to uncover.
So this was her plan all along: this gathering, this manor—all a carefully staged scenario to buy herself enough time in close contact to interrogate every suspect.

With no one to guide her, she was forced to forge her own path. She endured the searing pain and dangerous backlash, time and again, pushing herself to master a power that constantly threatened to consume her.
Her progress came at a terrible cost. Though she achieved remarkable results, each success left her balancing on the razor's edge, both mentally and physically shattered.
Fortunately, she found you. In you, she found an anchor, the one thing strong enough to keep her from being torn apart by the Mania or swallowed by the encroaching madness.

speaker: Hilda
content: ${PlayerName}, you helped me many times at the manor, even saved my life. I'll always remember this debt.

speaker: Hilda
content: Of course, I'll also always remember how you manipulated me and took my code strip.

speaker: Hilda
content: Only when I'm with you... do I unconsciously find confidence in the future...

speaker: Hilda
content: Only then do I realize I'm not fighting this battle alone.
Her words are spiraling into a dangerous place, and you can't stay silent. With your safe escape so close within reach, you refuse to let her surrender to despair.

speaker: Chief
content: Even when I'm not by your side, you can still believe you're not fighting alone.
She offers a faint, almost imperceptible smile.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...${PlayerName}, if in the end you're the only one who makes it out alive, remember to come back for my body.

options: Don't talk like that. You're making it out alive too.

speaker: Hilda
content: Remember, come back for my body.

speaker: Hilda
content: Rather than fantasizing about both of us surviving, we should prepare for when things go wrong.
(Paths converge)
A knowing smile touches her lips as she taps a finger against her temple in the dim light. Catching your look of disbelief, she allows a flicker of satisfaction to show in her eyes.

speaker: Hilda
content: Because the real Monolith is right here.

speaker: Hilda
content: I prepared two contingency plans. One is the machine you saw, large, conspicuous, almost shouting to everyone who sees it, "I am the Monolith, come destroy me." It's real, of course, but primarily serves as bait.

speaker: Hilda
content: The other was "preserving only the core data." Using my power, I materialized and deconstructed its core data, storing it in my mind. I believe extracting it won't be difficult for you.
Her words are soft, each one spoken like a line from a last testament.

speaker: Option
options: We're definitely getting out of here.

speaker: Chief
content: We're not at our last resort yet, so let's not speak so lightly of life and death.

speaker: Chief
content: Remember, we survived an almost certainly fatal explosion, then crawled with all our might from sealed ruins. Even a real nuclear bomb would think twice before taking us on.

speaker: Chief
content: Our mission is to bring the truth we've uncovered here to the outside world and expose it to the public.

Though it will be several decades later than she hopes, the chance will come. As long as she's willing to "wake up," she will witness the day the truth is revealed. Then, she can at least secure her own defense and, at long last, restore her parents' honor.

speaker: Chief
content: What we need to do... is survive.

speaker: Chief
content: Let me tell you a secret: that "poison pill" you found suspicious earlier was just candy I snuck in. Here, have some too. We should conserve our energy while we wait for rescue.
You retrieve the candy from your collar, only to find it has weathered the chaos into a fine powder.
Without ceremony, you tip half of the sweet dust into Hilda's mouth and pour the rest onto your own tongue.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...Mmph.
Surprise flashes in her widened eyes. The sudden burst of sugar dissolves on her tongue, a vibrant, shocking spark against the gloom. The taste of being alive.
And then, slowly, surely, a smile touches her lips.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...To think I was actually fooled by such a crude piece of candy from the very beginning.

speaker: Hilda
content: Well then... I'll hold on a little longer...
With that, she presses the transmitter's button. A small light winks on, and you can almost feel its rhythmic pulse beating skyward into the silence.
For a long moment, there is nothing. Then, a faint, muffled sound drifts down from above.
Whump... whump... whump... It grows steadily closer until the familiar, unmistakable rhythm of rotor blades fills the space around you.

speaker: Chief
content: It's a helicopter! Hilda, listen!

speaker: Hilda
content: Looks like... the rescue has arrived.

speaker: Chief
content: Your distress signal worked! Quick, let's find a way out of here—
The strength you've been conserving surges forth, meeting its moment. With the help of Hilda's Mania, you heave against the debris-blocked cellar door. With a final, splintering groan, it gives way.
You scramble out.
[Exterior]
The manor is a skeleton of its former self, shattered by the explosion.
Above, the relentless, corrupting rain of black Mania falls, a shroud steadily consuming what remains.
Two helicopters circle like vultures in the pitch-black sky, their searchlights scouring the ruins in a desperate rhythm.
The promise of escape is finally within reach. Board one, and you can get Hilda out of this nightmare.
With a surge of excitement, you take her hand.

speaker: Chief
content: Come on, Hilda, let's head toward the searchlights.
But her hand is limp in yours. She doesn't move, her gaze locked on the distant aircraft, lost in a thought you cannot share.

speaker: Hilda
content: Wait, ${PlayerName}. Please... let me say what I need to say before we step out there.
You turn. A wave of foreboding hits you. You can only stare, the two of you standing isolated in the hall as violent Mania surges around you like a rising tide.

speaker: Hilda
content: I've been thinking... If we really want to change the metropoles, simply escaping won't be enough.

speaker: Hilda
content: A real way out requires a deadly gambit. Whether it's DisCity or the metropoles, they'll both demand proof. A pledge of loyalty that burns all bridges.
Her voice drops to a haunting whisper, the words curling like smoke in the air as if she were divulging a cursed secret.

speaker: Hilda
content: I am a loyal hound of the metropoles. That is both my liability and my value. The liability is that DisCity will never believe I've turned. The value is... if you use me, you can earn their trust.

speaker: Hilda
content: So... I've decided to leave you two things.

speaker: Hilda
content: One is my corpse. The other is the Monolith in my mind. And you must use them separately.

speaker: Chief
content: What's this nonsense all of a sudden?
But as you try to pull away, her hand shoots out and grips you firmly, holding you in place. In the surrounding darkness, a faint light glimmers in her gray-red eyes.

speaker: Hilda
content: Don't rush to conclusions. I'm not doing this out of despair or disappointment. It's simply that this plan requires my death to succeed.

speaker: Hilda
content: I want you to betray me to DisCity. Tell them the truth about Operation Raider, and earn their trust. Without the Monolith's encryption, I'm certain DisCity's intelligence department can verify the information.

speaker: Hilda
content: Then... you must find a way to kill me, extract the Monolith from my mind, and take it back to the metropoles.

speaker: Hilda
content: Tell them I defected, but that you recovered the Monolith. Explain that your long absence was due to escaping DisCity's grasp.

speaker: Hilda
content: With these two feats, you'll have a foothold on both sides. That's when you can reveal the truth—lance the festering wound. I know you can do it right.
She closes the distance between you. Taking your hand, she guides your fingertips to her temple. Beneath the delicate skin, you feel the frantic, rhythmic pulse of her blood.

speaker: Hilda
content: Understand? The Monolith is right here... How to extract it... that's up to you, "anomalous power expert."

speaker: Hilda
content: I knew you'd refuse if I told you earlier. I'm sorry for waiting until now.

speaker: Hilda
content: I'm sorry to ask something so cruel of you... but I believe you and I share the same vision...

speaker: Hilda
content: You know everything that happened here, where the Monolith is hidden... and with your clean record and prestigious position, you are the most suitable person to leave this place alive, "Officer."

speaker: Chief
content: ...No one would care about that...

speaker: Chief
content: No one would care! We can both get out of here! We can face this together, change things together, if you just come with me!
She smiles once more, leaning in so close her lips graze your ear. Her whisper comes on a warm, moist breath.

speaker: Hilda
content: It's... <size=28>impossible for me to leave now.</size>

speaker: Hilda
content: I cannot betray my homeland... yet I cannot stand by as it commits evil. Nor can I ignore the suffering of the oppressed. My only choice is to become a key, one that opens two doors for you at once.
Her hand slips slowly from yours as she takes a small, reluctant step back. Then, she presses a brooch into your palm.

You look down. The brooch is shaped like a key, or perhaps an ear of wheat, or a coiled blueprint. You recognize it as the symbol of the Sevael Republic, a piece Hilda has always kept with her. Though it has been handled countless times, it remains pristine.

speaker: Hilda
content: I haven't returned home in many years. ${PlayerName}, after you get out...

speaker: Hilda
content: Please... go see the cornflowers of my homeland for me. When they bloom along the field ridges, they look just like stars fallen to earth.
[Long Shot CG: Suicide]
Before her final word fades, a violent surge of Mania erupts from within her, swallowing her whole.
From the chaotic energy, a shard of glass materializes in her hand. She presses it to her throat, and there—where the cold edge meets her skin—the Mania coalesces. The symbol it forms is also a key.
It is the very shape of the self she always wished to be, and the silhouette of the homeland she forever loves.

speaker: The ash clears with the coming of sunset. Beneath the dome of shimmering light, people move with the weariness of the wounded. However, their toasts are loud, their drinks splashing over battered hands as they laugh through the pain.
content: Now go, ${PlayerName}. Pretend you sent the signal. Surrender to DisCity, and let them protect you and take you away from here...

speaker: Hilda
content: ...Do not look back.

speaker: Chief
content: If we leave, we leave together. If we stay, we stay together.
With a surge of anger, you lunge forward to grab the sharp glass. The bandages rip, reopening the wound beneath, but you feel nothing.

speaker: Chief
content: I won't leave you behind! We're getting out of here together!

The thrum of helicopters grows louder outside; they've spotted movement in the ruins. Their beams cut through the darkness, sweeping back and forth with a blinding intensity that forces you to squint.
In the rhythmic strobe, Hilda's face flashes between light and shadow.

speaker: Hilda
content: <i><size=28>...It's... too late...</size><i>
Amid the deafening roar of gunfire, a storm of cipher strips erupts from her sleeves. They interlock with impossible speed, forming a shield before you.
The protective wall of strips whirls and dances as it's shredded by bullets. With every impact, Hilda flinches, her form growing visibly more frail.
The violent backlash of her Mania crawls up her limbs like black ivy, cracking her skin with searing darkness. Her defense wavers, a fragile dam about to break.
Then, the paper shield disintegrates in an instant. The world dissolves into searing pain as the devastating firepower tears through you.

speaker: Hilda
content: ${PlayerName}!!!
Her head whips around, a desperate hand flying out to grab you. But her fingers close on nothing, passing through the dissolving fragments of what you once were.
(A high-pitched ring, effects of extreme situations)

Hilda stares, uncomprehending, at the space where you stood. Then, from the shadows, countless tendrils of pitch-black sludge slither forth, pulling the last fragments of your existence into nothingness.
Her arm reaches out, trembling. Her fingers brush only the air, left chillingly and irrevocably empty.

speaker: Hilda
content: <i><size=28>...I told you...</size><i>

speaker: Hilda
content: <i><size=28>...you should just leave...</size><i>

The sound of a woman's wailing rips her from her thoughts. Her eyes snap to the shattered manor gates just in time to see a figure, unmistakably a high-ranking DisCity official, storm through with a large contingent of troops flooding in behind.

speaker: Helicopter
content: Targets suppressed. Deploying ground units for clearance immediately.

speaker: DisCity Official
content: Darling! My dear, are you alright?!

speaker: DisCity Official
content: It's over now. I'm here, calm down... I'll protect you, everything will be fine...

The man holds the sobbing Helene in a lover's embrace, but she is inconsolable. She tears herself from his shoulder only to point a trembling finger at the inferno, her screams lost to the roar of the flames and the churning Mania.

speaker: Helene
content: Help them! Please, you have to help them!
<i><size=28>Help? She wants these DisCity people to help them?</size><i>

speaker: Hilda
content: ...How ironic.
The soldiers' footsteps draw closer.

speaker: Hilda
content: Manphist sold our city-state to Fraser, Helene betrayed us to DisCity. Marlo went to hell, and Nolaine paid the price with her life...

speaker: Hilda
content: In the end... you're the only one who stayed with me...
Soldiers quickly swarm the manor hall. From a distance, Hilda can already see the glint of their gun barrels aimed directly at her.
[Throat-Slitting CG]
In response, she presses the glass fragment horizontally against her throat. Its edge is sharp and cold, a promise of a quick, final end.

speaker: DisCity Agent
content: Stop her! Command wants her alive!

speaker: Hilda
content: Dream on, you DisCity hyenas.

speaker: Hilda
content: I will never let you lay hands on my intelligence.
Before the DisCity agents can take another step, she drags the glass across her neck.
A torrent of Mania explodes from the wound. The code strips dissolve, transforming into a tidal wave of black sludge that surges over the entire mountainside.
You jolt back to consciousness inside the chamber, violently coughing up a mouthful of black sludge.
Hypercube-powered mechanical arms whir to life around you, removing contamination, suppressing stress hormones, and pumping stabilizing fluids into your veins.
The LINK connection has been exceptionally deep this time. Your mind still hums with the ghost of it.

speaker: Schorl
content: Welcome back, Chief. The results of this LINK session appear to be satisfactory on all fronts. You have successfully retrieved the Monolith, and the data concerning the metropoles and the Ash Crystals constitutes entirely new intelligence for us.

speaker: Schorl
content: We will now begin analyzing Hilda's brain to extract the "Monolith" within. Please rest here for the moment; you may review the findings once you have recovered.
Schorl completes two final, thorough scans. Once your stability is confirmed, it drifts leisurely away.
You watch as it glides to Hilda's tank, adjusting instruments with precision. A specific frequency activates, and a concentrated point of Mania shimmers into view.
There it is: the "Monolith" Hilda protected with her dying breath. But surrounding it...
You see it again. The familiar code.
The symbols form a sequence on a code strip of Mania, encircling the Monolith like ethereal planetary rings. With a soft, rhythmic light, they pulse as if alive.
You freeze. Without conscious thought, your mind instinctively engages, beginning to decipher the code.

${PlayerName}, by the time you read this, you must have found a way to retrieve the Monolith. You may still be wrestling with the choice we faced at the end. For that, I ask your forgiveness, for my stubbornness, and for the conflict I could not resolve. I was never able to fully betray my city-state, yet neither could I remain a mere instrument, blindly following orders. When this war finally ends, the history books will be filled with the names of heroes and traitors... While those of us who hesitated, who were torn between sides, will be scorned by all. But, nevertheless— I still, shamefully, love every flawed inch of my homeland. I cling to the memory of the light it once held, and I cling to the hope... that one day, it will find its way back to that light.

Loyalty defined me. Conscience broke me. It was only when you showed up that I finally saw a path forward. You were right. What one person cannot achieve alone might just be possible with two. So I am entrusting that hope to you. A soul torn in two has no future. But at least I can be a stepping stone for yours.
And now, I find myself eagerly awaiting death. I am waiting for the moment you still my breath with your own hand. It will mean we have each, in our own way, taken one step closer to our ideals.
Just as you finish reading the message, Schorl completes the analysis of the Monolith.

speaker: Schorl
content: The Monolith has been successfully extracted, Chief. Our operation can be considered accomplished.

speaker: Schorl
content: Whether to proceed further and awaken her is now entirely your decision.
Your eyes are drawn to Hilda, her form still suspended within the containment tank.
[Containment Tank CG]
There is no sign of wakefulness. Her mind is sinking deeper into the boundless Mania, and with every second, it slips further away, soon to be gone completely.
You decide to...

speaker: Schorl
content: Understood. As you wish, Chief.
Schorl processes your command with its usual factual demeanor. Then, a brief pause follows as it seems to have detected a shift in your emotional state. Without preamble, it voices a question.

speaker: Schorl
content: Are you feeling angry, Chief?

options: I just feel sad for her.

content: You have every right to this anger. You fought so carefully in the LINK, planning every strategic step. You were this close to winning, to bringing her out. And she chose to stay. She chose to sacrifice herself, to give you a future instead.

All she had ever wanted was a city-state worthy of her loyalty, a form of justice that left her hands clean of innocent blood. Yet such ideals, in any era, remain forever out of reach. Her entire life had been spent in pursuit of a phantom.
(Paths converge)
You still want to bring her back. You cannot stand by and let the Mania consume her entirely.
But before that, she must know the full truth. She deserves the right to choose her own fate.
To grant her that, you need to visit a certain place.
[Archives]
Schorl accompanies you into the archives, taking the lead through the labyrinth of shelves.

speaker: Schorl
content: You have full access to all materials here, Chief. Please inform me which specific files you wish to retrieve.

speaker: Chief
content: Help me locate information on the metropoles' "Operation Raider" from the late stages of the Independence War, with particular focus on the Sevael Republic.

speaker: Schorl
content: Certainly. The documents you require are stored in cabinets B-5, H-22, and G-311.
Following Schorl's guidance, you pull a file of yellowed pages from its rest. As you open it, the story of a city-state that once stood at the pinnacle of the world unfolds before you.

[Metropole - Sevael Republic] The Sevael Republic was one of the five major metropoles after the Nightfall, renowned for its expansive territory, numerous affiliated satellite towns, and its commitment to inclusivity, openness, and vast knowledge. Alongside Fraser, it occupied a strategic bridgehead position. [DisCity War of Independence Excerpt - Darkness Before Dawn] During Operation Skyfall, the Metropole Alliance temporarily lost their battlefield advantage when confronted with an organized attack by DisCity Sinners (formerly known as anomalous power wielders). In a desperate gambit, the Alliance devised "Operation Raider," publicly described as a strategy to achieve lightning strikes through flexible troop deployment using disaster-resistant covert communications. However, in the autumn of N.F. 71, the operation was forcibly suspended following the disappearance of its key technology, Monolith, and its developer.

However, factual archives released by Fraser after the war revealed that the true objective of the so-called Operation Raider was to deploy an array of nuclear weapons, with the expected impact zone covering a vast area tens of kilometers wide, including DisCity and regions east of WhiteSands.

Due to the plan's brutality and insanity, all operations were advanced under extreme secrecy. Many participants remained unaware of the full scope of the project they were involved in. In post-war interviews, some still believed they had been contributing to peace efforts for all humanity.

speaker: Schorl
content: After their defeat in the war against DisCity, the metropoles fell into further decline, ultimately leading to their fragmentation. The Sevael Republic, having been the most deeply involved and sacrificed the most in the war, was virtually hollowed out by the conflict. It was the first to crumble following the defeat, with half of its territory annexed by Fraser and the other half lost to WhiteSands.

speaker: Schorl
content: As for Hilda herself, she endured extensive interrogation after her capture. Yet she never disclosed even the slightest piece of intelligence. Eventually, she attempted to erase her own consciousness using Mania, which led to her being forcibly placed in suspended animation, remaining in the Restricted Area for decades.

speaker: Schorl
content: What a pitiable and tragic woman. She remains completely unaware that <color=#fb9259>her homeland was destroyed long ago</color>.
[Summary Page]

■ Eliminated Outlands spies: Nolaine, Manphis Gesso, Helene Meiser

■ Hilda Hartlein committed suicide

■ Acquired <color=#fb9259><size=52><u>Monolith</color></size></u>

Keys Obtained: <color=#fb9259><size=52><u>4</color></size></u>


Consciousness Restoration: <color=#fb9259><size=52><u>80%</color></size></u>

Unresolved Matter:

□ Where is the final key that keeps Hilda locked?
While you're still reviewing the metropole files in the archives, Schorl suddenly emits a sharp alert.

speaker: Chief
content: What's happening?
Schorl flashes twice in place.

speaker: Schorl
content: Chief, Hilda's Mania is spiraling out of control. I'm afraid further LINK sessions with her will no longer be possible.
[Empty Room]
You burst into the Deep Restricted Area laboratory to find researchers scrambling around Hilda's containment tank.
Inside, countless streams of pitch-black Mania seethe from her body, violently churning until they nearly fill the entire container. A nearby monitor flashes with bright red warnings.

speaker: Schorl
content: We've identified the cause.

speaker: Schorl
content: After prolonged confinement in a contaminated environment, Hilda's consciousness and memories were already fragmented. Because you continuously input new memory segments during the LINK process, her cognitive functions have begun to show signs of confusion.

speaker: Schorl
content: She mistakenly believes that the "memories" you constructed for her are her actual past, that you truly rescued her and took all her hopes away from that place.

speaker: Schorl
content: On this foundation, her mind has reconstructed memories spanning decades. In her perception, she has been waiting for you to return and fulfill your promise ever since the day you left, but <color=#fb9259>her wait has yielded nothing but silence</color>.

speaker: Schorl
content: Mania is a mutation of the mind, and memory is the vessel of consciousness. Decades of accumulated despair and breakdown erupted in an instant, causing the Mania within her to spiral completely out of control.
A cold dread grips your heart. The thought has never even crossed your mind—that your LINK sessions, the very tool meant to help, have become the very cause of her breakdown.

speaker: Schorl
content: But there's no need for concern. The Deep Restricted Area has the highest level of protection. This magnitude of Mania eruption cannot even damage the containment tank. The only outcome will be that she herself is consumed and dissolved by Mania.

speaker: Chief
content: If I enter her consciousness now to suppress the Mania outbreak, can LINK guarantee my mind's safety?
Schorl remains silent for a long moment.

speaker: Schorl
content: If you can limit the duration, then yes, it's possible. I would not recommend exceeding 45 minutes.

speaker: Chief
content: That's enough.
You approach the LINK device.
The world is a maelstrom. The rain doesn't just fall; it tries to scour the earth and sky clean, a deluge threatening to drown creation itself.
Through the pitch-black curtain, the silhouette of the once-grand architecture twists and writhes, warping into the skeletal remains of a dying leviathan.

The air is thick with contamination, and each breath is a struggle. A deep, bone-chilling cold seeps into you. All around, countless chaotic phantoms drift freely, wailing under the Mania's influence as if they are the true masters here.

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: ...Failed... failed... He never came... He betrayed you... Your plan was doomed from the start...
female_content: ...Failed... failed... She never came... She betrayed you... Your plan was doomed from the start...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: You've waited for years! Time to wake to reality!!

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: ...Born in the wrong place, chose the wrong side... embrace the darkness, or just die...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Turn back now...? Keep dreaming!
Your shackles flare with a sudden crimson light. The spectral shadows shriek and scatter from the blaze, but emboldened by the Mania-tainted rain, they only regroup with greater frenzy.

Among the horde, you see familiar faces. Manphist, Shane, Helene... Their features melt into a sea of unidentifiable visages, twisting into grotesque masses that chant those cursed words, rampaging and tearing the world asunder.
This Mania, accumulated over decades, is eager to claim its final trophy. Like you, it searches frantically for the last tiny fragment of her consciousness.
But now you know where to go. Through the oppressive darkness, a faint point of light shimmers into being, guiding your path forward just as it did before.
[Interaction Point]
You stumble forward, assailed by twisted phantoms and the deafening echoes of their curses. Each step is a battle, your feet dragging as if through a swamp of congealed shadows.
[Interaction Point]
The shadows sense your purpose. A chorus of piercing shrieks erupts as they swarm you, a tide of vengeful spirits.
You unleash your shackles, driving back the grasping darkness, and with a sickening pull, wrench your legs from the viscous Mania mire. Every inch forward is a desperate victory.
[Interaction Point]
Slowly, the ground firms beneath your feet. The oppressive weight of decay and madness begins to lift.
Ahead in the gloom, a figure moves, its back to you, an indistinct silhouette marching steadily onward.
You quicken your pace, a spark of hope igniting within you.
[Interaction Point]
The glowing speck of consciousness trembles ever so slightly in the darkness. You reach out, your fingers nearly brushing her fading silhouette.
Suddenly, a rift tears open beneath your feet. A pure, blinding light, fierce as a breaking dawn, pours over you in a downpour. You fall.
Then, your eyes snap open. A withered field stretches to the horizon. Broken rice straw shudders in the wind, like the forgotten corpses of a dead age.

speaker: Chief
content: Is this place... also part of Hilda's consciousness?
You take a few cautious steps. The ground is indeed solid, not that consuming mud of pure Mania.

But the field ahead is a barren wasteland, locked in a deathly silence. The soil is a grim amalgam of pitch-black gravel and pale ash, like a grave for countless souls, all of it glistening with an ominous dark light. This is a dead land, incapable of sustaining any life.
A deep sense of foreboding tightens your chest. As your eyes sweep the horizon, a thunderous roar tears through the wind—

speaker: Shane
content: Open your eyes! Look! This is the land your metropoles swore to protect with their Hypercubes! Look at it! Where are they?! Where's our protection now?!

On a nearby clearing, a grotesque assembly of spectral figures has gathered. Their forms are twisted, their clothes little more than tatters, and their faces shattered. Yet from the fractures, their eyes burn with a unified, hellish red, one of hatred and rage. In their clutches are contaminated, makeshift weapons, all thrust menacingly toward the captive huddled at their center.
Beneath the skeletal branches of a pitch-black dead tree, a single figure kneels. A crudely sharpened branch has pierced through her shoulder blade, pinning her in a macabre crucifixion.
Her blood traces a slow, dark path down the dead wood, feeding the parched and cracked earth beneath.

And then, Shane's voice erupts. He seems to merge with the horde, a single consciousness shouting with the force of a legion. His words land not as speech, but as a thunderclap that shakes the very air.

speaker: Shane
content: This is the true face of your metropoles! You've sucked us dry, left us with nothing! Now you'll get the same mercy you showed us!
At this moment, someone notices your presence.

speaker: Villager A
content: ...Who are you? Are you another lapdog of the metropoles?
Before you can answer, another voice speaks up.

speaker: Shane
content: Wait... this one's different from the metropole scum... I know that scent... DisCity! You're from DisCity!
A sea of eyes locks onto you, their collective gaze a physical pressure. It's a volatile mix of naked suspicion, sharp scrutiny, and beneath it all... a disquieting flicker of expectation.

speaker: Shane
content: Then you must hate them as much as we do. You had the guts to stand up to all the metropoles. You know the blood on their hands better than anyone!
With a sweeping gesture, he points at Hilda.

speaker: Shane
content: She's one of them! She stands with the bloodsuckers, and in her veins flows the life they stole from our land! The sweat and blood of your people and mine!

speaker: Shane
content: Now, she pays her debt!
A hunched shadow trembles in the gloom, offering you a short hoe caked in bloody mud.

speaker: Villager B
content: You hate them too, don't you? Here! Take it! Make her feel our suffering! Avenge us! Avenge yourself!

speaker: Crowd
content:
Yeah! Revenge! Revenge!
That's right! Revenge!
We have to have revenge!

speaker: Crowd
content:
You're with us! We're the same!
Yes! The same!

speaker: Crowd
content: Make her atone! Make her pay!

More and more eyes are now turning toward you. The crowd's initial hostility has melted away, replaced by a frenzied, expectant acceptance. More crude weapons are thrust into your line of sight, their rough surfaces gleaming in the dim light.
More crude weapons are thrust into your line of sight, awaiting your choice. You remain still, your eyes drifting over the proffered tools before finally coming to rest on Hilda's pallid face.

She feels the weight of your gaze. Her previously unfocused eyes struggle to find yours, holding their concentration for a single, lucid moment. In them, you see no fear, only a profound and weary guilt—and beneath it, a calm that borders on relief.
It is a silent plea, as clear as if she had spoken aloud: This is what I deserve. Please, go ahead.

speaker: Shane
content: What are you waiting for?! Don't tell me you don't hate her! Hate her! Hate her like we do! Let it out!
Every voice, every gaze, crushes down upon you.
The coppery stench of blood, the venom of their accusations, the shadows contorting into demons... it all converges, forcing a choice. Do you join this tide of hatred, or...
You take a step back and shake your head.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I understand your pain. I respect your anger. But I will not be controlled by hatred.
The frenzied shouting cuts off abruptly, leaving a silence so profound that it grips your heart. In the void, the spectral figures fix you with a glare, their eyes burning with cold fury.

speaker: Shane
content: So you stand with her? You would protect one of them against us?!
His voice distorts into a monstrous howl, a signal that sends him and the demonic shadows at his back charging forward in a blind rage, armed with whatever they could seize.
(Red Flash)
Your shackles manage to stop the first wave closing in on you, yet they only serve as intimidation, not a genuine threat.
You cannot bring yourself to attack these people. After the horrors they have endured, what right do you have to judge their rage? Their hatred is a pain you have no right to punish.
But your mercy is a fuel to their fury. More shadows swarm forth, and this time, the weapons they raise glint with a cold, murderous intent.

speaker: Crowd
content: No peace! No compromise! Only your death or ours!

speaker: Crowd
content: Tear her apart! Rip the hypocrite to shreds! If you're not with us, you're against us!
(Red Flash)
Your shackles were never meant for defense. The flimsy barrier shatters instantly.

You stagger back to Hilda's side, throwing your body in front of hers as a shield. A storm of projectiles rains down—jagged stones, crude clubs, and rusted sickles. You endure the impacts, but it's a futile defense.
You can't... hold them back any longer.
(White Flash)
You brace for the searing pain, eyes wide open, but it never comes. The phantoms pass through you like smoke, their vengeance striking Hilda instead.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...Your anger... your pain...
Amidst sprays of blood and inconsolable wailing, her body gradually breaks apart.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...I accept... it all...

The last of your resolve hardens. Your shackles shatter the constraints with a surge of will, and weapons of solidified Mania slice into you, their touch like white-hot iron. Bright, searing wounds bloom across your body, each one a fresh fire.
Though they are mere illusions, the agony is devastatingly real, buckling your knees and screaming through your nerves.
But it doesn't matter.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know you're burdened by regret. I know it's painful. I know a part of you wants nothing more than to die here.
Throwing yourself in front of Hilda, you take the brunt of the attack, your teeth gritted against the impact.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But don't let it consume you. Let me bear this with you. I came back for you, so you can live on!

speaker: Hilda
content: ...Live on...?

speaker: Hilda
content: Do I... deserve to live on?
The moment her eyes meet yours, the howling Mania recedes like a dying tide.
The scorching air cools, soothed by a sudden downpour, and a film of moisture blurs your vision.

A cold droplet falls on your forehead, sharp with the scent of disinfectant. Harsh incandescent lights sting your eyes. You try to move, but your limbs are locked down, firmly strapped to a hospital bed.
You wrench your head to the side. The room before you is less an operating theater and more a morgue.
The floor is a chaotic sprawl of white body bags, too many to count. And in the center, restrained on a dissection table, is Hilda. She is surrounded by specters—formless, nameless things.

speaker: Approaching Mania
content: Liar... Liar! You stole our future with your lies... and now you dare try to take our only hope!

They weep and scream, their fingernails elongated into surgical scalpels. They shred everything around them, then turn on themselves and each other, gouging out organs, trading hearts for hearts and blood for blood, only to reassemble in an instant. A perpetual, self-inflicted hell.
Of Hilda, not a single part remains intact.

And then you see her, Nolaine's face, adrift in the chaos. The girl's once-unyielding, earnest gaze has been honed into the sharpest of blades. It carves directly into the deepest recesses of the heart of the person she once admired most.

speaker: Nolaine
content: I hate you, Hilda. I hate you for making us believe...

speaker: Nolaine
content: I followed you. I admired you. I swore I would dedicate my life to the city-state, just like you.

speaker: Nolaine
content: And now you tell us it was all wrong? That the metropoles are corrupt, that my loyalty was pledged to evil, that it was all meaningless?!

speaker: Nolaine
content: You built the foundation of our faith, and now you want to shatter it with your own hands?! Don't you dare!!
Don't you dare!!
Their voices—a chorus of profound resentment, agonizing pain, and burning rage—echo through the empty room.

They surge toward you in a snarling wave, pushing your bed until it jars to a halt beside the cold dissection table. Claws, sharp and gleaming, point accusingly at you, while their burning gazes turn to interrogate the silent Hilda.

speaker: Ghosts
content: You brought this outsider here to do what? To turn back now? To fix your mistakes? After you led us this far? After so many were sacrificed?

speaker: Ghosts
content: Do you think this is salvation? No! This is annihilation! You want to destroy everything, and save only yourself!

speaker: Ghosts
content: We died for you!! And now you call us "wrong"?!

speaker: Ghosts
content: Are you trying to make fools of us?!!
With a collective roar, they carve open their own chests with vicious blades. They tear out their deceived hearts and hurl the still-beating organs at you and Hilda.

speaker: Ghosts
content: Look! Look at our hearts! You defiled them! You betrayed us!
The shapeless, bloody masses slam into you, bursting apart and splattering your bodies with pitch-black Mania. The corrupting energy immediately seeps into your skin like a cold, invasive poison.
You stand transfixed before these young, blindly devoted souls.

They once lived convinced of their righteous path, sacrificing themselves for the glory of the metropoles, only to have that conviction shattered in death. Now, in a final, futile gesture, they carve out their own hearts, seeking answers they can no longer hold.
They advance, a haunting procession. In one hand, they hold their bleeding hearts like sacred offerings. In the other, they level their blades squarely at Hilda's chest.

speaker: Ghosts
content: Cut it out! See her heart! See her true face! See if it's as pure and spotless as she claims! CUT IT OUT!!
They drive their blades into Hilda's chest, opening a wound.
She does not struggle, allowing the ghosts to lift her heart from its cradle.
In that moment, even the ghosts fall silent. Their angry shrieks and agonized wails die away. They simply stare, as you do, transfixed.
It is a heart of neither pure white nor wicked black—but mottled gray, caught in the eternal struggle between right and wrong, light and darkness.
It is a landscape of cracks, as though torn apart countless times, each fissure overlaid with the scar tissue of its own desperate repairs.
It is neither pure nor perfect—a thing shattered and remade, as full of weakness as it is of scars.
It is, ultimately, not what anyone has hoped to see.
When you look back at Hilda, her eyes are closed, as if she has finally, after a long and weary battle, found her peace.
The late autumn cold—a bone-deep chill unique to the season—seeps into you as you stagger through the garden. Icy rain needles down through the crumbling dome above.

Every step is a battle against your own failing body, the Mania's corruption a persistent venom in your veins, gnawing at the edges of your mind. Yet, a pull stronger than the fatigue draws you forward. You can feel it. You are getting closer to the heart of this place, closer to Hilda.
You only hope both you and Hilda can hold on. Just a little longer.

In the depths of the garden, the outline of a dilapidated lecture hall materializes. Moss creeps over the stone steps like a green shroud, and the heavy doors stand half-open, as if waiting for your arrival.
(Scene Change: Auditorium)
You push the door open and step inside. The air is thick and still, heavy with the scent of decaying wood and the ghost of old paper.

This is a university lecture hall, once a place of learning. Now, traces of Mania crawl like diseased ivy across the walls and floor. On the lone blackboard, faded cryptographic formulas and city-state slogans linger like forgotten memories.

And there, at the far end of the hall, an enormous spectral shadow is merged with the very architecture. It is so massive that it seems part of the wall, until you enter. Slowly, deliberately, it raises its head.

speaker: Manphist
content: Oh... Look what the cat dragged in... Have you come to witness the lesson for my most disappointing pupil?

speaker: Manphist
content: Hilda. My brightest star... and my greatest fool!
The Corruptor that Manphist has become lets out a pained, mocking sound. It toys with Hilda's bowed head, its fingers moving over her like a merchant coldly tallying beads on an abacus.

speaker: Manphist
content: A position at the very heart of the Cryptography Department... something countless souls would kill for! The influence, the secrets, the power at your fingertips... and you cast it all aside like trash. For what? To run off to this festering swamp called DisCity to "prove" a point?
Foolish! Utterly, completely foolish!
Discordant whispers slither through the air, each one feeling like an ice-cold abacus bead clicking against another.

speaker: Manphist
content: Was it the investigation that spooked you? Or was it the shame of your traitorous parents?
A harsh, grating sneer escapes it. Its fingers dig into Hilda's skull as it forces her head down, slamming her forehead against the stone table again and again.
She takes the abuse like a doll, her body limp, offering not even a flicker of resistance.

speaker: Manphist
content: An interrogation is a cost of doing business! A compromised identity is a manageable risk! Everyone in this game has skeletons. Every successful spy keeps a set of false ledgers! <i><color=#dg1f1f>Did you truly believe you could walk this path and keep your hands perfectly clean?!<i></color>
With a furious roar, it straightens its decaying body. Its rotting arms fly wide in a grotesque, exaggerated gesture of utter incomprehension.

speaker: Manphist
content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>They just dangled a few doubts to shake your precious "faith," and you reacted like a scolded child, so desperate to prove you're still the teacher's pet.<i></color>

speaker: Manphist
content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>Ideals and loyalty are worthless currency! Yet you cling to them, willing to be someone's loyal hound, staking your entire being on a lost cause!<i></color>

speaker: Manphist
content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>You have no conception of the machine you serve! All that brilliant talent, wasted on solving the wrong equations!<i></color>

speaker: Manphist
content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>The greatest tragedy isn't weakness, but unshakable conviction in the wrong place! Your resolve is your folly! Your talent, your original sin!<i></color>
It spreads its arms wide, as if welcoming this hopeless conclusion.
With its stomps, the floor explodes. A foul, Mania-tainted sludge boils upward through the cracks, revealing a gaping maw that leads to the abyss itself.
From that void, countless ghostly shadows surge forth. They howl with a singular purpose, twisting and coiling around Hilda's body.
Admit it. This path was never for you. Your very existence is an error. Your failure was preordained. You deserve to be consumed... to settle the debt for your misguided life!
The world gives way. The ground shatters, and the two of you teeter on the edge of the abyss—

options: This is the price she must pay.

content: You don't think. You don't calculate the crumbling rifts underfoot or the threat of Manphist's attack.
You simply run for her.
The moment your fingers close around Hilda's ice-cold sleeve, it's like grasping a truth you've always known.
Her wrist is terrifyingly thin, a brittle twig in your grip, and you're afraid it will turn to dust if you hold any tighter.
...No. This is no illusion.
Her very existence has worn thin, fraying at the edges, ready to dissipate into the charged air.
Let go! LET GO! She chose this path! She belongs here! She belongs to ME!!
The ghostly shadows shriek in a greater frenzy as the rifts yawn wider.
A monstrous force pulls at you, a riptide of darkness trying to claim both your souls.
She cannot escape! She is a failure! Her destiny is to die here! She is MINE!
THIS IS HER CHOICE TOO!!!
You left her behind once! Don't offer hollow hope now! All she desires is ME!! Only DEATH!!

options: Refuse to let go, no matter what

content: You have already braced yourself for this.
Your teeth grind together as your fingers lock around Hilda's wrist, pulling with every ounce of your strength in a desperate attempt to rip her back from the abyss of fate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop letting them torment you, Hilda.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you want redemption... if you really want to change something, then you have to live. Walk out of here and do what matters. Letting the Mania consume you in this place changes nothing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is your mind. You are its master. As long as you don't give up, these phantoms can never truly break you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's why I came back... to help you!
Crimson shackles erupt from your palm, shearing through the void-like Mania to pierce both your hands. They bind you together—a bond that, for now, defies all forces in this world or any other.
The ghostly shadows within the sludge recoil as if scorched, their advance broken. Now, they can only writhe at a distance, their forms twisting with helpless, mournful wails.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...So this is... your...

speaker: Hilda
content: ..."<color=#fb9259>shackles</color>"...
She lifts her head, a faint smile gracing her features. Her voice, distant as an echo, carries not just relief, but a fragile note of joy.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...You really... weren't lying...
The roars of Mania fade, becoming hollow and muffled, suppressed by an immense, unseen force.
A mist begins to coil through the air, blurring your sight. Within it, her form slowly unravels, until all that remains is the cold, unyielding chill at the other end of your shackles.
The world grinds to an absolute halt. In the same instant, every code strip plummets, scattering across the ground like so much worthless trash.
Seizing the opportunity, chaotic spectral shadows surge forward. They pour through the fracture in a cacophony of sharp, distorted whispers, a crushing tide that slams into you and Hilda.

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Your plan has failed... You've been abandoned... ${PlayerName} has betrayed you... Your ideals are doomed...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: You took the wrong path... And you think you can just turn back...? No one will allow it...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: You have always failed... of course you fail again this time...
With a shrill, piercing screech, the contamination and Mania return. It bores into her, twisting and tearing her apart from the inside.
She doesn't even try to fight it this time.

A sludge-like wave of Mania seizes your legs, crawling up your body with terrifying speed. Your shout is swallowed by the chaos, but you fight through it, grabbing her shoulders and screaming her name with every ounce of your strength.

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Futile, futile... I am her true destiny...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: SHE IS MINE...!!!
[Shackles Red Flash]

A crimson flare from the shackles cuts through the horde of wailing shadows. Their forms scatter and dissolve into shrieks as the world itself comes apart. The sky shatters, and the ground crumbles into nothing. Together, you are plunged into the waiting void.
[Scene: Meadow]

speaker: Young Hilda
content: The city-state is like a giant bonfire, burning bright to keep every home warm and every belly full! It's not just big walls and tall lighthouses... it's hope for everyone!

speaker: Young Hilda
content: One day, I'll add my own little spark to that fire. I'll shine my light for others to see.

speaker: Young Hilda
content: You will too, right?

speaker: Young Hilda
content: You're me from the future, all grown up! Can you answer my question now?

speaker: Young Hilda
content: Did you become a light for everyone? Did you make other people's lives brighter?

speaker: Hilda
content: ...I got lost on the wrong path... and walked it for a very long time.

speaker: Hilda
content: I thought I was protecting something precious, but in the end, I only caused ruin... I failed the people who believed in me.

speaker: Young Hilda
content: Really? That's quite sad!

speaker: Young Hilda
content: But you'll get back up again, right? If one path leads to a dead end, you just find another! If that one's no good either, then try the next one! If you try every single path, you're sure to find the right one!
With a smile, she steps forward, her hand closing around yours, and pulls you into a run down one of the waiting paths.
But the ground itself is alive with deception. The paths beneath her feet branch and weave like veins, each one promising light while secretly leading into a deeper, more profound darkness.
So where did the corruption begin?
Which of these forking, illusory roads is the true one? Where do you go?

speaker: Marlo
content: You, an undercover agent? Don't make me laugh. You don't have the stomach for the killing it takes.

speaker: Marlo
content: We had a deal. I handle the wetwork, you handle the codes. Let's keep it that way.

speaker: Marlo
content: Don't you ever kill anyone, Hilda. You'll regret it. I'm telling you, no matter what happens, keep your hands clean.

speaker: Manphist
content: Will you join me, Hilda? The war is all but over. The metropoles' defeat is inevitable.

speaker: Manphist
content: My allegiance to Fraser was never about loyalty, but utility. Self-interest is the only constant.

speaker: Manphist
content: You're my most gifted student. You could have access to far more intelligence than you do now. You could be shaping policy from the top, not wasting your talent in this grinding stalemate, going down with a corpse of a city-state!

speaker: Hartleins
content: I'm sorry, my dear, but we can't bring you. DisCity is too dangerous. We can't let you face that.

speaker: Hartleins
content: Stay here. Leave the ciphers behind. Forget the war. Give up on your ideals. Just live an ordinary life.

speaker: Hartleins
content: Wait for us to end this... I promise we will come back for you.

speaker: Crowd
content: DisCity won! We've won the war! To hell with those metropole bastards! Hahahaha!!

speaker: Crowd
content: Purge the defeatists! Purge the opportunists! Purge the spies! Make every traitor pay!

speaker: Crowd
content: Root them all out!! Root them all out!!
(All options completed)

speaker: Sinister Voice
content: Hahahahahahaha! This is who you are. Always choosing the wrong path.

speaker: Sinister Voice
content: Betrayed by allies, abandoned by the times, your efforts wasted, every choice mocked by fate.

speaker: Sinister Voice
content: Your ideals were never realized. They never will be.
[Manor Exterior]
The vision shatters, leaving you stranded once more in the familiar grounds of the manor. But the bone-chilling rain has warped the estate into a distorted reflection of itself.
She stands bewildered at the far end of the eaves, her gaze tracing the countless wrong paths that coil and twist beneath her feet like serpents.
Then, cutting through the drum of the rain, you hear a soft, disbelieving laugh.

speaker: Hilda
content: You knew all along? Is that why you've been giving me that look?! Because you think I'm pitiful? That I'm pathetic?

speaker: Hilda
content: Did you come just to witness my disgrace...?

Decades spent in the shadows, enduring for this single moment. She marshaled every ounce of her strength, launched an all-out attack, and found the one weakness she sought—yet now, at the moment of her triumph, it all crumbles into dust.
She has lost to time, or rather... to fate.
The rain obscures your sight, yet it cannot hide the profound despair and sorrow drowning her eyes.

Around you, the tide of Mania roars, swallowing the manor whole. The ground beneath your feet is the last bastion, a crumbling precipice poised to plunge into the swirling swamp of madness at any second.
Her rampage is absolute. Nothing now can calm the storm but your shackles.
And so, you step through the tempest, closing the final distance between you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: At first, my only goal was to extract information. I fabricated an identity, entered your mind, deceived you, protected you, grew close to you, all for the mission.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I planned to take what I needed and leave. But I found you weren't just a spy. Your torment came from your conscience. You struggled because you couldn't forget the sacrifices. You were always searching for another way, even when you took the wrong turns.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When you gave me the Monolith... I truly wanted to help you.

Had this not been a memory washed by rain, but a page from true history, you might have truly helped her. You could have helped her complete the infiltration and stand in defiance against the metropoles.
Whatever the outcome, her story would have found a different end.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Because you can still hear the echo deep within your heart, calling you to a new path.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As long as you can hear it, you are not truly lost.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I believe a soul like yours deserves another chance. You can still choose your path again.
(Paths converge)

speaker: Hilda
content: ...Again? What's the point?
Her words are a low whisper, barely audible over the sudden roar of the Mania flood. A wave of pure darkness crashes into you, its force threatening to sweep you away.

speaker: Hilda
content: Can someone like me really have another chance?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That choice is yours.
Every force in the space conspires to hold you back, yet with every step, your determination only grows stronger.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Today, DisCity walks the same path the metropoles once did. During the military regime, countless satellite towns were crushed, and countless Outlanders died by DisCorps's hand. If accomplices share guilt, then I bear it too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No one can promise they will never make the wrong choice.

You finally manage to grasp her, but she is a statue, yielding yet distant. Uncontrolled Mania flows from her like a wound, crystallizing into cruel barbs that pierce through her own flesh. The black essence drips steadily, feeding the contamination pooling at her feet.

Your shackles instinctively reach out to calm her Mania, only to be met by an invisible, iron resistance—the sheer force of her despair. Recognizing this is a battle of wills, you take her hand and press it firmly to your brow.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know you don't believe me... So come, see for yourself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your power won't lie to you. Look into my memories and judge my words for yourself.
At your invitation, deeper memories unfold before her.
[The Rust]
Within them lies a poignant sorrow.
[Syndicate]
A rage born of desperation.
[West District]
A rising, unified resolve.
[Undercurrent] (or event story image, with multiple characters)
Darkness that lurks beneath the surface.
And the throes of the world.
Her gaze lingers on the diverse faces within your memories.
In essence, they are no different from people of the past—strong yet vulnerable, foolish yet brilliant—all chasing their own ideals in the corners of the city-state.
Yet the same shadows... now loom like colossal beasts emerging from behind DisCity itself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Independence War is over. History has already passed its judgment. We don't have to remain enemies because of the sides our city-states were on.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So this isn't about serving another's mission. It's about following your own conviction. Ask yourself, were you truly devoted to the "metropole," or to that ideal city-state in your heart?
These memories, raw and razor-sharp, pierce through her nearly numb senses.
Is this the "future"? Not the "past," not the "present"?

She once believed her loyalty was to the metropole itself. Now, a doubt pierces her: was it ever the city-state? Or was it the gleaming ideal of what it could be, not the rotting carcass it had become?

speaker: Hilda
content: ...You really are a kind person, but...
Her hand trembles as she reaches for you—
As if to obstruct the moment, a cacophonous tide surges from behind, violently slamming you both into the pitch-black Mania swamp.
[Black Screen]
The moment you sink into the mire, your mind is invaded by a cacophony of frenzied whispers and shrieks.
These howling forms surge toward you, scattering in panic when your shackles blast them back, only to coalesce and attack again with renewed fury.
You fight them off, forcing your eyes to stay open against the oppressive tide, as you search desperately for any trace of Hilda.
Finally, you see a single code strip, drifting just out of reach. You lunge for it, only to find it too far away.
(Shackles)

Your shackles snap forward, snagging the strip. You clutch it in your hand, a tangible anchor in the chaos, and with a final, desperate effort, you swim with all your might toward the abyssal depths where she vanished.
[Scene Change: Black Background with Light]
Swaying, rocking... "her" consciousness is carried deeper into the abyss.
The cause worth fighting for is gone. The future worth believing in has vanished. What reason is left to struggle? Perhaps to simply cease... is the only peace left.
But then, through the chaos, someone, stubborn and relentless, keeps running toward her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I understand your pain. I respect your anger. But I will not be controlled by hatred.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Some truths don't need to be laid bare to be understood. I've told you before, I'm not the kind of interrogator who has to uncover every truth at any cost.

options: Pulling her out of the mire

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you want redemption... if you really want to change something, then you have to live. Walk out of here and do what matters. Letting the Mania consume you in this place changes nothing.
He has seen through your torn heart and despair, your ugliness and hypocrisy, yet still, he offers his hand.
female_content: She has seen through your torn heart and despair, your ugliness and hypocrisy, yet still, she offers her hand.

content: Those are his memories, his future, the ones he loves who never yield. And now, he wishes to share them with you.
female_content: Those are her memories, her future, the ones she loves who never yield. And now, she wishes to share them with you.

content: In that future, one you have never reached, you finally see a glimmer of a light worth chasing.
If... If that is so...
Then what does it matter if this body is already scarred by a thousand wounds? Let it burn one last time.
Even if, in the end, only ashes remain.

speaker: Distant Voice
content: <size=52>DON'T LET THEM WIN! HILDA!!</size>
[Black Background with Light]
If anything remains for her to believe in now...
Perhaps it is nothing more, and nothing less, than the person standing before her.
(CG: Hand Reaching Out)
She reaches for you with a desperate, trembling hand, her eyes holding the hope of one in hell gazing up at a single spider's thread.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...Can I... really...?
She offers no resistance. A soft, crimson glow kindles in her palm—its former sharpness gone, the threat dissipated.
From the other end of the shackles, you feel the turbulent Mania within her gradually still.
[Background - Black Ark]
You haul yourself from the churning sludge, Hilda in your arms.
Above, a torrential downpour of black, Mania-saturated rain threatens to scour the world clean, swelling into an apocalyptic flood.
The small manor stands as the last ark, but its walls are already groaning, being swallowed by the encroaching Mania.
The wooden door panel you've claimed as a raft groans in protest, its splintering frame barely keeping you afloat in the muck.

Then, the waves themselves begin to change. The tide of Mania coalesces into physical nightmares, howling as they rise from the depths. Their voices are all too clear, a cacophony of piercing whispers that claw at your mind and throb behind your eyes.
They surge forward, tearing across the water's surface, walking atop the pitch-black splashes as if the waves were solid ground.
[Shackles Red Glow]
Gritting your teeth, you drag Hilda fully onto the unstable platform. The door lurches violently, and for a heart-stopping moment, you teeter on the brink of falling back into the abyss.

Suddenly, a code strip whips out, wrapping around your torso and yanking you back to relative safety. Hilda, now conscious, wipes the stinging rainwater from her eyes and binds the strip tightly around both your wrists.

speaker: Hilda
content: Let me handle it.
She pivots to confront the colossal wave of Mania.
Monsters are caught in the surge, their snarls swallowed as countless souls churn and compress within Mania. They merge together, coalescing into a towering, vaguely "human" form.
It faces Hilda, and a massive maw splits open, revealing a writhing, nightmarish pit filled with countless lashing tongues.

speaker: Howling Whisper
content: Don't think you're accepted! He's just using you! He'll discard you like trash when he's done!
female_content: Don't think you're accepted! She's just using you! She'll discard you like trash when she's done!

speaker: Bewildered Whisper
content: Just like how you used us!! You made our ideals and beliefs utterly worthless!

speaker: Cursing Whisper
content: Don't think your blood is now clean. Every life you've taken will haunt you to the ends of the earth.

speaker: Resounding Whisper
content: WE WILL NEVER FORGIVE!
Hilda stands in silence, a still point in the storm. She lets them scream, lets them wail, allowing their endless hatred and rage to exhaust itself against her calm.
Her code strip whips through the wind, like a red line slashing the dark. It wraps the giant beast in a searing embrace.

speaker: Hilda
content: I don't need your forgiveness. I don't care if I'm being used. If there is a chance, I will take it.

speaker: Hilda
content: I've never found the right path anyway. The worst that can happen is being fooled again, losing myself once more. But I'm used to it now. I'm not afraid anymore.
Her voice cuts softly through the storm, yet it rings with unmistakable clarity. The giant beast thrashes with renewed desperation, as if it can feel its impending doom.
The code strip pulls taut in this desperate tug-of-war. It's a race against annihilation. Will the beast be shredded first, or will Hilda's power shatter under the strain?
Just as Hilda presses her hand against the scar on her throat, ready to break her own limits—
Your hand closes over hers.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't face this alone. We made a promise to leave this place together.
A red glow erupts from your shackles, merging with Hilda's power to form a colossal net that strikes the beast, ensnaring it completely.

speaker: Hilda
content: I want to see the new DisCity... see the new Fraser... see what has become of my ruined homeland...

speaker: Hilda
content: I still wish to pursue that ideal... for all of us.

The code strip lashes out, tearing faint traces of memory from the souls. The fragments flicker like dying embers before surging back into Hilda. She shudders slightly, her body jolting like a piece of driftwood struck by a wave.

speaker: Hilda
content: I accept every one of your curses. Your rage and resentment... I will carry them all.

speaker: Hilda
content: I have nothing left. Before I leave... it is fitting that you provide me with this burden to bear.

speaker: Hilda
content: I will carry the weight of the past... but I swear... I will not be crushed by it again.

speaker: Hilda
content: And now, if you still stand in my way, I understand why, but I will not yield!
The code strip snaps taut. Empowered by your shackles, it explodes outward, slicing the massive beast apart in an instant. The monstrosity collapses like a felled mountain.
The fragments scatter. Some howl toward you in a vengeful tide. Others flee, wounded, into the distance. The rest simply vanish on the wind.
The cacophony of battle dims, from a roar to a whisper, from a whisper to a murmur, and then into deep, profound silence.
The last few fragments stagger forth in a stubborn, final charge, but the moment they touch Hilda, they transform into harmless motes of flowing light, extinguished against her unwavering presence.
(Small CG - Clearing Skies)
The sky clears at last.
Strength utterly spent, you both collapse to the ground, unable to stand.
Hilda tilts her face toward the sun, a stranger after so long. The light filters through the dissipating clouds, warm and gentle on her skin.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...It was always raining at the manor. I'd nearly forgotten... what a clear sky looked like.

speaker: Hilda
content: So... when it clears, the clouds do part.
Sunlight pierces the dark veil, bathing the rain-soaked ruins in a soft, golden glow. The distant sea grows still, its surface calming as if the raging Mania had never been.
...No. Some traces remain.
Her gaze falls to your hands, still bound by the code strip. Quietly, she loosens the knot.
[Laboratory]
(CG: Tank - Eyes Closed)
The liquid in the tank stirs with a soft current.
(CG: Tank - Eyes Open)
She opens her eyes, and her tender gaze finds yours.
With sound trapped by the barrier between you, she raises her hand. Her fingertips press against the glass and begin to move, tracing the familiar patterns of a code she once taught you.

speaker: Hilda
content: ...Good morning, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Hilda
content: Is the sky clear today?
Option A - Tell the truth

speaker: Hilda
content: MBCC... sounds like just another one of DisCity's attack dogs.

speaker: Hilda
content: But I'm afraid you've wasted your effort. There's nothing left for you here.
Without warning, an invisible force slams into your chest, driving the air from your lungs and forcing you to your knees.

Across from you, Hilda's form shudders. In response, the surrounding Mania—now a thick, oily sludge—heaves into motion. It lashes out like a living thing, wrapping around your limbs and coiling around your throat with shocking speed.
(Scene continues to dim)

speaker: Hilda
content: From the moment I was caught, my only purpose was to die cleanly. On my own terms.

speaker: Hilda
content: What you've captured is just a hollowed-out "shell."
(Red Flash)

speaker: Hilda
content: ...This is for the best... A clean end is all I wanted.

speaker: Hilda
content: Now, goodbye. Don't even bother. I'd rather die than be DisCity's new dog.
In an instant, you are submerged in the choking, black tide. Your lungs scream for air that doesn't come.

Your frantic struggles are useless against the sludge's grip. Your vision sparks with violent, chaotic colors, and the iron taste of blood fills your mouth. As the last of your strength ebbs, your movements become weak, uncoordinated twitches. The darkness at the edge of your sight swells, consuming everything, until finally, your body goes still.

speaker: Schorl
content: Chief, I regret to inform you that you've just "died" during the LINK process.

speaker: Schorl
content: There is no cause for alarm, though. This was simply the subject's consciousness rejecting your presence. You were forcibly disconnected, not actually harmed.

speaker: Schorl
content: As you've now experienced, the mindscape can be quite perilous. The slightest misstep can lead to "failure," which is why <color=#fb9259>every decision</color> must be made with care.

speaker: Schorl
content: I will assist you by analyzing each action and its consequences, generating memory nodes, and outlining potential paths forward.

speaker: Schorl
content: Let us try again when you are ready.
It seems logical to hide among spies by claiming to be one of them.
However—

speaker: Johnson
content: I have the roster of every deep-cover asset within DisCity. I can say with absolute certainty your name is not on it.

speaker: Johnson
content: I'm afraid you have it backwards. You aren't infiltrating them. You are one of them.
Under the collective, hardening gazes of the room, you realize your critical error.
Hilda lets out a soft, almost disappointed sigh.

speaker: Hilda
content: What a shame.

speaker: Hilda
content: I don't know how you found this place, but you've walked into a brutal slaughterhouse. This is no place for an unaffiliated journalist or a lost soul to go snooping.

speaker: Hilda
content: Please escort this gentleman out.
female_content: Please escort this lady out.

content: Before you can speak, two guards seize you by the arms, hauling you roughly from the hall.
[Manor Exterior]
The massive doors boom shut, and in that same instant, pitch-black rain comes pouring down.
You reach out, only to find it is no rain but a torrent of pitch-black sludge, reeking of potent Mania.

It twists in your palm. It is alive. It swells and squirms against your skin, while what has already fallen slithers and pools at your feet. It climbs, coiling up your legs like insidious vines, exactly as it did within Hilda's consciousness.
[Fade to super black]

The realization strikes you, and the world dissolves in its wake. Everything blurs, turning void and distant. You are back. Back in that vast, lightless expanse of consciousness, where all sense of direction is swallowed by an endless, suffocating dark.
You wrench your leg free, stumbling back. Horne's frantic breaths hitch, and his face contorts, features dissolving into something monstrous.

speaker: Horne
content: Unbelievable... This is just unbelievable! I was only gathering intelligence... and this is how you all treat me...
His furious roar is swallowed by a wave of violent Mania. Pitch-black, sludge-like energy erupts from his core, consuming him in an instant.

speaker: Horne
content: How dare you all corner me... I never meant for this... Such rotten luck... I just wanted to see it for myself... Have something to boast about when I get back...

speaker: Horne
content: Why can't I leave... I'm NOT a traitor! Let me go... just let me go...

speaker: Marlo
content: Holy ****, what the hell is that thing?!
Marlo doesn't think. Pure, primal instinct takes over. He raises his pistol and fires.

speaker: Chief
content: Wait—!
Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang!
(Screen blur + ringing sound effect)
Your proximity to Horne has placed you directly in the line of fire—both from Marlo's frantic barrage and the Corruptor's twisting waves of Mania.

A warm trickle of blood snakes down your temple. A deep, pervasive cold begins to seep into your limbs, and the chaotic screams around you melt into a distant, muffled hum. Your vision blurs, only making out shapes of people scrambling and fleeing the monstrous form the Corruptor has become.
Through the high-pitched ringing dominating your hearing, a voice fights its way through. Someone is at your side, shaking you and calling your name with panic...

speaker: Edward
content: ${PlayerName}! Officer! Officer, stay with me! What am I supposed to do if you die—
As the last of your consciousness bleeds away, a final, ironic thought flickers: of all the possible faces to see at the end... it just had to be Edward's...
You choose Nolaine. Against all odds, the person who seems the most detached, the most unlikely to be involved, is the correct answer.

speaker: Hilda
content: If that's your take, I'll keep it in mind.

speaker: Hilda
content: That will be all for today. Thank you for your cooperation, Mr. ${PlayerName}. You're free to go now.
female_content: That will be all for today. Thank you for your cooperation, Ms. ${PlayerName}. You're free to go now.

content: You step back into the corridor, drawing a deep breath to steady your nerves after the conversation with Hilda.
The corridor is silent and empty now. Through the window, a gentle rain mists the glass, carrying the sweet, petrichor scent of damp earth into the still air.

speaker: Edward
content: Officer ${PlayerName}! How did it go? I hope Hilda didn't give you a hard time.
...It seems you're not alone after all.

speaker: Chief
content: She just apologized for startling me. It was fine... Where is everyone else?

speaker: Edward
content: After what happened, no one wanted to stay in the hall. They've all moved to the dining hall in the annex. Here, let me take you there.

options: Were you waiting here for me?
No need, I can find my way there.

speaker: Edward
content: Of course I was. I was really worried about you, Officer.

speaker: Edward
content: Hilda's room is—gkkt. A place where people tend to lose their heads.

speaker: Edward
content: She calls it "questioning," but let's be honest, it's an interrogation. Rumor has it her closet doesn't hold clothes, but a full set of... professional tools.

speaker: Edward
content: Most people are terrified of being summoned there. It's a genuine relief to see you come out in one piece.

speaker: Option
options: You really don't need to act this way with me.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not some high-ranking official. I don't have the kind of power you might think.

speaker: Edward
content: Please, don't say that! In my eyes, you're the most capable and reasonable person I've ever met. My admiration is sincere.

speaker: Edward
content: Once I'm done here, I'm going to request a transfer from this backwater DisCity. I want to return to the metropoles and apply to join your Mania Countermeasure Center. When the time comes, maybe you could... mention my name?

speaker: Edward
content: I don't want to be a spy anymore. I want a job where I can be proud of who I am!
The raw sincerity on his face catches you off guard, leaving you almost lost for words.

speaker: Chief
content: Like I said, my influence is limited... but I'll remember what you've asked. If I get the chance, I'll put in a word for you.

speaker: Chief
content: But if you never wanted this life, why become a spy in the first place...?

speaker: Edward
content: Haha... Well, I've always been... unremarkable. To most people, I was practically invisible. Teachers would skip my name during roll call. I was always the one overlooked. For a long time, I thought that was just my lot in life.

speaker: Edward
content: Then one day, Mr. Manphist came to our school. And he... he picked me. Can you imagine what that feels like? For someone who's always been invisible to finally be seen? It was incredible. So I followed him to the agent academy and became a spy.

speaker: Edward
content: Mr. Manphist said I was a natural. That people just look right through me. I can be practically standing right next to them, eavesdropping, and they'd never know I was there. It let me accomplish things others couldn't.
In your mind, something suddenly clicks into place.
(The three photos flash past.)

<color=#fb9259>I was a natural. That people just look right through me. I can be practically standing right next to them, eavesdropping, and they'd never know I was there. It let me accomplish things others couldn't.</color>
You stare at Edward, frozen. He meets your gaze with a smile.
But it's all wrong. Gone is the humble, meek man from before.
Bam!
A nearby door crashes open. You try to run, but Edward slams into you from behind, driving the air from your lungs as you hit the floor.

speaker: Edward
content: Since you've seen through me... I suppose I have no choice left.
Something thin and sharp—a fishing line—whips around your neck. He yanks from behind, and it instantly slices into your flesh.
You thrash, but every movement only tightens the garrote. Your breath comes in ragged, useless gasps. You claw blindly behind you, reaching for Edward's arms, but your strength is already failing.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you... the mole...?

speaker: Edward
content: Oh, no. You've got it all wrong. I'm not the mole...
Edward pauses for a single, terrifying moment. Then he pulls harder. You can even hear a soft, sickening crunch in your throat.

speaker: Edward
content: But it told me I could be!
Warmth floods your neck. Blood.
The world grays out, details dissolving into a smear of nothing. Your final, gurgling pleas are a small, pathetic sound, lost against the corridor's chill and the rain's steady, mocking hiss.
Darkness takes you.
ENDING 6
Option B: No need, I can find my way there.

speaker: Edward
content: Oh... I see... My apologies, that was overstepping.

speaker: Edward
content: Of course, Officer ${PlayerName}. You're welcome to go on ahead...
He retreats half a step, a flicker of disappointment in his eyes, yet his polite smile remains.
But the moment you pass him, a sudden rush of air whips past the back of your head.
(Black Screen)
Thud!

speaker: Edward
content: ...Tch. Putting on airs, are we? You should have taken the easy way when offered.

speaker: Edward
content: Hand you over to those DisCity people, and I'm home free.
Your legs buckle. The ground rushes up to meet you, and as your vision tunnels into nothing, someone grips your ankles, pulling you into a dark, cold corner.
You want to escape. But your face has already given you away.
She remains perfectly still, a statue observing your desperation as you throw yourself toward the door. The handle refuses to turn; the room is a sealed tomb.
When you turn, she is already there, having closed the distance without a sound.
The cold sting of a needle pierces your skin. A foreign liquid floods your veins.
The sharp pain is instantly swallowed by a leaden drowsiness. Your temples pulse; your vision blurs. Memories, real and imagined, surge and shatter like broken glass. The present melts into the past.
