In the next instant, the Butcher drops into a fighting stance, muscles bulging in both arms as his massive ax whistles through the air.

A flash of steel, and the crouching figure in the field doesn't even have time to cry out before tumbling out of the grass. The pistol in their hand falls to the ground with a clatter. Then, before your eyes, both weapon and body melt away like candles, disappearing completely.

You're totally speechless. Was that a player? Or a villager? Perhaps they were planning to attack you, and you suppose they could be resurrected from death, but the way Clay brought down that ax showed not even a moment's hesitation.

Clay straightens up as blood drips from his ax blade onto the ground. His face and arms are splattered with crimson. He casually wipes some away, then tilts his head to study the spot where the figure had fallen, his brow furrowing slightly.
<color=#fb9259>Not this one either</color>. You hear him mutter.
A strange aura radiates from him. This player, who entered the game with you, has already been contaminated by Mania.

options: Wait and see how things unfold

content: You attempt to use the shackles, but before the red light can appear, your hands are violently seized. You feel an inhuman strength from the Butcher's grip, almost crushing your hands.

speaker: Butcher
content: What are you trying to do?
The Butcher looms closer with an eerie calm, gradually increasing the pressure on your hands.

speaker: Butcher
content: Don't think you're safe just because I've already killed you once. You may not be the Witch, but that strange trick of yours gives me the creeps. You understand? Don't you dare use it in front of me!
With those words, he releases your hands and tightens his grip on his ax once more.
During the ritual in the last round, your shackles made the Butcher mistake you for the Witch, and he ended up killing you and sending you back to the respawn point. Better not provoke him again.
Right now, this man's mind is consumed by his assigned mission in the story: Kill the Witch.

speaker: Butcher
content: Strange things are happening all over this town because the <color=#fb9259>Witch</color> is hiding among the people. Only I can see through the deception. Only I can protect everyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is killing others really your idea of protection? You're just slaughtering innocent people!
Not only is his action illogical, but it's also immoral.

speaker: Butcher
content: Hey, hey, watch what you're saying... The ax chose me. It shows me the truth. It guides me to do what must be done.
Seeing your hesitation, he assumes you're afraid of the Witch's threat. His demeanor suddenly shifts as he cheerfully claps his large hand on your shoulder.

speaker: Butcher
content: Are you scared? That's normal. With me here, you don't need to be afraid.

speaker: Butcher
content: I'll protect you. From now on, you'll stay within my sight.
And with that, he clamps his hand around yours and drags you toward the village.

The Butcher moves like a relentless warrior, continuously "clearing out" those he thinks may be the Witch. You manage to prevent some killings, but for the most part, you can only watch the victims turn to wax and vanish before your eyes.
As the most perilous hour around midnight passes, the town finally grows quiet. He returns to the shed behind his butcher shop.
You scan your surroundings, surprised that a player could have such an established identity within the story, even possessing their own "base."

speaker: Butcher
content: Whether it's here or there... why are there always people interfering with others' work...

speaker: Butcher
content: I was working so hard, barely getting any sleep every night, and yet my boss said he was going to fire me...

speaker: Butcher
content: No, I can't make any mistakes this time. I've worked so hard to secure this position... I have to do my job properly... I just need to kill the Witch, and everything will be fine...

In the pitch-dark shed, lit only by a single candelabra and faint moonlight, the Butcher sits dejectedly by the window. He pulls the glimmering name tag from his pocket, cradling it in his hands like a prize, stroking it over and over.

speaker: Butcher
content: I've killed so many... but the calamity hasn't stopped... No, none of them was her... What am I supposed to do now...

His name tag is glowing much more brightly than when he first received it, like a precious prize. In contrast, yours remains unchanged, still just a metal plate inscribed with the word "Voyager" and your goal.
You sense that his transformation is inextricably linked to that name tag. The Butcher tucks it away and begins to slowly sharpen his ax.

speaker: Butcher
content: The ax just isn't sharp enough yet. That's it. The ax will tell me... It will show me the real Witch...

speaker: Butcher
content: Next time, I will not fail.
Whatever his original intentions might have been, the indiscriminate murders won't help you get out of here. It only risks causing chaos. You also won't gain any useful intelligence.
It's time to get out of here.
Just as you carefully edge toward the door, the Butcher suddenly whips his head around, fixing you with a wide, chilling grin!

speaker: Butcher
content: Testing them one by one takes too long. Want to... join me?
The Butcher moves closer to you, his voice dropping to a lower, more broken whisper.

speaker: Butcher
content: Those glowing spikes of yours... can they kill the Witch? Show me again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I don't know what you're talking about. That ability can't help you identify the Witch.

speaker: Butcher
content: You don't get it?
You're about to keep denying it when the words die in your throat. The Butcher raises his ax, his lips splitting into a bone-chilling grin.

speaker: Butcher
content: Do you get it now?
After that, you die many times.
[Red Flash]

speaker: Butcher
content: Have you made your decision?
The town square, the back alley, the flagstone path under the streetlight, the muddy forest swamp. Each time before you fall, you see the shadow of his ax reaching your own shadow first.
[Red Flash]

speaker: Butcher
content: Don't run away. I'm serious about teaming up.
[Red Flash] Outside the Hot Spring Inn

speaker: Butcher
content: Stop wasting your energy. I'm the type who never backs down once I've set my mind to something.
Thwack...

The locations of your "deaths" are getting closer to the respawn point. From the street corner, to the inn's entrance, to the metal bell at the front desk. Each time, he intercepts you a little closer.

speaker: Butcher
content: Still haven't given up? To be honest, my arm is getting a bit sore.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Snap out of it! You've killed me so many times already. If I were the Witch, I would've been dead already!
[Red Flash] Inside the Hot Spring Inn
You don't immediately get up, but instead lie on your back in the warm pool, questioning your entire existence.
Come to think of it, you came here to wind down, didn't you? You finally managed to take some time off when Faye shoved the ticket into your hand, claiming you could "have fun and chill," correct?
How did things end up like this??

Another circle of small wax figurines resembling you has appeared at your feet. The newest one even has an obvious gash cleaved by an ax on its neck. They're growing in number, and looking more and more like you...
[Insert CG - Peaceful Wax Figures] Players can click here three times; each click generates more wax figures

You casually pick one up, its face helplessly resigned, much like your current state after being repeatedly hacked down by the Butcher. You can only manage a bitter smile. At least its poker face game is strong.
Heavy footsteps echo from outside the hot spring. You need to get out of here.
[End CG] Screen shake effect, followed by blade flash

A long ax whistles through the air with a piercing shriek, barely missing your shoulder. The blade catches the wax figurine in your hand, slicing it in two, before slamming into the floorboards with a thunderous thwack, sending splinters flying.

speaker: Butcher
content: You can't run away!
The Butcher yanks his ax free and lunges again. You sidestep his attack, gritting your teeth and inwardly cursing. Seriously? Catching me at the respawn point?!

speaker: Butcher
content: It chose me. The ax chose me! Only I can see the real Witch. Only I can do it!
While the Butcher struggles to pull his ax free, you take the opportunity to put distance between you.
You can't dodge forever. You'll have to subdue him or...
You steel yourself. Time to give him a taste of the hot spring bath!
The Butcher frantically points his ax at you, then lunges forward with frightening speed. As the ax comes down, you prepare to roll away, but he seizes your ankle and hurls you against the wall!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ah!!
Thud! Your back slams against the wall as darkness flashes across your vision. A piercing pain shoots through your ribs.
[Flashback] [Dark Silhouette of Witch Portrait Flashes]
Shh...

The heavy blow leaves your vision blurred. Through the haze, you see the Witch's figure materialize beside the Butcher. The ax lying on the ground pulses with an increasingly intense, eerie glow, wreathed in a familiar black aura.

speaker: Butcher
content: This time, I WILL SUCCEED!

options: That's the source of the Mania.

content: The shackles might not work on the Butcher, but on the ax itself...

You hesitate no longer, lunging forward toward the ax. The Butcher's heavy fist immediately crashes toward your face. You raise both arms to block, hearing a horrifying crack as bone meets crushing force.
Your bones are likely fractured, but you don't stop. Gritting your teeth, you summon every ounce of strength to kick the Butcher away, then dart to his side and release your shackles to seize the ax.
Dark crimson spikes coil around the ax, shaking it violently before wrenching it free from the ruined floor and landing obediently in your palm.
As you grip the ax handle, the Butcher's face before you contorts and melts... transforming into the Witch's face with its mocking smile.

speaker: Mad Echoes
content: Look!! You found her!! You did it!!
You feel a ravenous power attempting to seize control of you, wanting to turn your hands into another murderous tool.
But you're used to dealing with Mania. You take a deep breath, focusing your consciousness on your shackles—not submission, but control!

speaker: Butcher
content: How is this possible... That's my ax... Only I can wield it...

speaker: Butcher
content: Give it back!!
The Butcher loses all sanity, screaming as he charges toward you. Without a moment's hesitation, you deliver a horizontal slash.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now go back to the <color=#fb9259><size=44>respawn point!!</color></size>
[Add special effects + sound effects]

speaker: Butcher
content: Ngh... Argh!
The Butcher staggers backward, blood pouring from his chest.
Thump, thump... your heart pounds like a drum. The world before you is twisting with madness. You can't hear the wind or feel any pain in your body, only deranged whispers corrupting your mind.
[Flashback]

speaker: Mad Echoes
content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Kill him... Kill the Witch... It's him...<i></color>
female_content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Kill her... Kill the Witch... It's her...<i></color>

speaker: Mad Echoes
content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Don't you crave power? Don't you want to protect everyone? Do it now... What are you waiting for?<i></color>

So this is how the world looks through the Butcher's eyes? Whether it's you who caught his attention because of the shackles, or Prima who willingly sacrificed herself to protect you, in his eyes, everyone bears the face of that Witch.
Thud!

The sound of something heavy hitting the floor snaps you back to reality. As the Butcher collapses, the Witch's illusion recedes from his face like an ebbing tide, leaving only the wretched expression of an ordinary man.
His body begins to melt like a candle. The approach of death seems to break some invisible restraint, briefly freeing him from his obsessive character.

speaker: Butcher
content: ...What? It's... you? I thought... it was the Witch...

speaker: Butcher
content: Did I... get it wrong again... I'm sorry. I'm still so useless... Hope I didn't hurt you...
The unemployed man pleads with pitiful humility, forcing an exhausted yet apologetic smile on his perpetually tense face.

speaker: Butcher
content: When I come back, please... return the ax to me... I beg you...

speaker: Butcher
content: Next time, I'll do it right... I promise...
As his body melts away completely, his name tag drops to the ground. You pick it up.
This is a name tag with the word "Butcher" written on it. When you flip it over, besides a mission that reads "Kill the Witch," a line labeled "Skill" catches your attention.
Skill: Unstoppable Force Description: No one can stand in your way!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So some name tags have "skills" attached to them...
This explains why the Butcher was so terrifyingly powerful. If his skill was Unstoppable Force, what skills might the others have? And you? What skill will you eventually acquire?

When you're done reading the name tag, it spontaneously bursts into flames. The ashes transform into a worn auxiliary officer badge from the Eastside Public Security Bureau, dropping to the ground with a small tap.
Perhaps, in the beginning, he only wanted to use this powerful ax to protect things he couldn't protect in reality... But in the end, he was consumed by that very power.
Oh my god!!!
A startled cry comes from the stairway, filled with the excited relief of someone who has just escaped danger.
Eleanor bounds down from the stairway, as eager as a student bolting out of class immediately after it ends. The Clergyman follows behind her. Clearly, they both had quite a fright from the Butcher.

speaker: Eleanor
content: That guy has gone completely insane! He was just attacking people randomly! So scary... I mean, you could do that?

speaker: Eleanor
content: He claimed to be protecting us, but I bet he was the Witch's minion all along! I'm sealing off the respawn point now, so he can't come back to harm anyone else!

You look up to see Eleanor hammering away at wooden planks she's procured from somewhere. She even passes some boards to you. Working together, it doesn't take long before you've completely sealed off the hot spring bath with wooden planks.
You exhale deeply with relief. Whatever else happens, at least this guy won't be chasing you with his ax anymore.
Just then, someone approaches and stands beside you. So close, yet you didn't notice their presence until now.
He picks up the Butcher's badge from the ground, handling it with reverence as though it were really left behind by a deceased person.
Then he produces a pale flower from his robe, places it on the ground, and makes a praying gesture with both hands before his body.

speaker: Clergyman
content: May you... find peace and redemption.
Then he turns to face you and gives a formal bow, just like a real clergyman would.

speaker: Clergyman
content: It's okay now. You did well. Now, you can move on.

speaker: Clergyman
content: There is no more danger here. Let go of whatever is troubling you...

His voice is calm, but as he speaks, his name tag emits a faint white glow. In that moment, even your frantic heartbeat seems to steady under his influence. Yet this imposed calm somehow makes you a little uncomfortable.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you have a special skill too?
And it's the kind derived from Mania energy.

The Clergyman nods noncommittally, then volunteers to show you his name tag. You see that the front identifies him as the Clergyman, while the back describes his skill. Supreme Affinity: You can heal all wounds and bring people together.
The town basks in perfect tranquility during the day, as no one except you and your fellow players knows about the madness from the previous round, thanks to the restart.
Besides the Clergyman, no one mourns for the Butcher.

speaker: Timid Child
content: ...Sir, Mom told me to thank you for getting rid of that scary Butcher. He was a bad guy, right?
female_content: ...Ma'am, Mom told me to thank you for getting rid of that scary Butcher. He was a bad guy, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you think he was?

speaker: Timid Child
content: I don't know... Mom and Dad both say so.

speaker: Timid Child
content: He even saved me once. How could this happen... Was it all the Witch's fault?
Everyone congratulates you for heroically defeating "the Witch's minion." But you remember the moment when the Butcher vanished, he transformed back into just an ordinary guy.
The one responsible for this transformation is the mastermind behind this murder mystery game. She shows up from time to time, as if toying with everyone.
You clench your fist silently, vowing to expose her as quickly as possible.
[Insert footstep sound effect]

speaker: Clergyman
content: Still shaking? Here, drink something warm.
The Clergyman hands you a cup of warm water. The man's voice is gentle and calm, as if attentively soothing your unease.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thanks. No need to use your skill on me. I'm fine.
You shrug at the Clergyman. His skill is like some low-cost passive ability that activates automatically from time to time.
Though it certainly makes you feel better, you're repulsed by the idea of being healed by Mania.

speaker: Clergyman
content: This is just a game.

speaker: Clergyman
content: The physical seal can only delay the Butcher's respawn briefly. He seems to have lost control already. This way... is better for everyone.
You look up, taking the opportunity to study the Clergyman carefully. Since entering this game, he's remained consistently unfazed, calmly accepting every unexpected development.
At the end of the first round, you think you saw him leave the scene early. Could he have known in advance how things would turn out?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Neither you nor the Butcher is a first-time player, are you?
You're testing him, uncertain of his true purpose or if he'll answer your questions. But right now, he seems to be your only potential source of information.

The Clergyman stands in the shadow of the Witch's statue in the square, not immediately answering you. He crouches down and gently wipes away dirt from the statue with his fingers. Unlike the joy and fervor surrounding him, he appears strangely indifferent and serene.

speaker: Clergyman
content: This isn't a good place to talk.

speaker: Clergyman
content: I work at the church. There's hardly anyone around when I'm organizing the archives.

speaker: Clergyman
content: If you have any questions... come find me at the church.
The church is located near the square. Villagers come here to pray and confess their troubles and sins to the Clergyman.
As you enter the church, you grow cautious, realizing that this Clergyman, just like the Butcher, has established his own "base" within the village.
There are few people at this hour. Only the Clergyman is standing in the spacious church. Unlike the foggy outdoors, the light here seems exceptionally soft and bright.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think you're smart, so I'll cut to the chase. This isn't just a normal game.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You know that sealing the hot spring could delay the Butcher's resurrection, and you know that taking away his ax would subdue him. You seem to know quite a lot about this bizarre game.
The Clergyman doesn't deny it. He pushes his glasses up, his voice soft, as if deliberately drawing your attention to his words.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Perhaps... you would like to hear the Butcher's story in another world?

speaker: Clergyman
content: I'm not excusing his actions. I just want you to understand... how he became the way he is.

options: Could you tell me about it?
That's exactly what I came here for.

content: [Insert special portrait - Old sheriff's badge]

speaker: Clergyman
content: In that world, he was once a worthless auxiliary officer. He maintained order, wrote reports, patrolled at night, sometimes even helped look for lost cats, and walked dogs. Because of his background, he wasn't even given a permanent position.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Later, he lost his job and had no choice but to work as a security guard at a store.

speaker: Clergyman
content: During the war, some hooligans vandalized and robbed the store. His boss berated him for failing his duty and fired him. Once again, he had nowhere to go.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Heh, who knows if it was just an excuse to cut costs during that post-war period? But the Butcher didn't understand that. He only saw himself as a discarded object, unable to hold even a regular security guard job.

speaker: Clergyman
content: In the post-war economy, the only "job" he could find was probably this role in the game of the Witch.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Even if it's just a role in a story, a "Butcher" who protects the villagers and hunts down the Witch. As long as someone still needs him and believes in him, he will pour his entire heart into it, desperately trying to prove his worth.
[Insert Flashback]

speaker: Butcher
content: Ha! The mightiest butcher, the Protector of Cirrenfold, is setting out!
[Flashback]

speaker: Butcher
content: Are you scared? That's normal. With me here, you don't need to be afraid.
[End of Flashback]
You recall that before the Butcher became insane, he indeed always talked about "protecting" others.

Perhaps the Witch targeted the Butcher precisely because of his unfulfilled urge to do his job well and protect others. This obsession was exploited by the Witch, allowing Mania to take advantage of his vulnerability and take control.

The master of this illusion has planted an undetectable "Mania bomb" in Eastside's busiest district. You have no idea when it might detonate. If left unchecked, there will always be the next "Butcher."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you truly pity and empathize with everyone, then surely you've witnessed people slaughtering each other in every round, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This loop of agony needs to end. I don't believe you're someone who enjoys killing and madness. Otherwise, you wouldn't have left flowers for the Butcher or shared his story with me.

speaker: Clergyman
content: This is just a game.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This isn't just a game. They've used special methods to make it "real." You know there's an actual supernatural Witch here. Someone dangerous and arrogant, who blesses everyone with the name tags while simultaneously toying with them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you're truly the Butcher's friend, then you should think about what's best for him!
You withhold crucial information about Mania while cautiously extending an olive branch to the Clergyman. He remains silent for a moment, seemingly contemplating the speech you just delivered.

speaker: Clergyman
content: No wonder you managed to defeat the Butcher and walk away with his ax without a scratch.

speaker: Clergyman
content: So this game is truly that dangerous. I always thought something was off... The rules of this world seemed too detached from reality. I had no idea there were such secrets behind it all.
You nod, your gaze toward the Clergyman more sincere now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Whether it's the Butcher, you, or me, none of us should be killing each other. Our true enemy is that Witch hiding within the story, manipulating everyone's minds.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Otherwise, there will always be another Butcher, another player driven to madness.
The Clergyman fiddles with his collar, lowering his head with a smile.

speaker: Clergyman
content: I was right about you. You really are different from everyone else.

speaker: Clergyman
content: No wonder you managed to snatch the Butcher's ax. From that moment, I've been certain you must possess a different kind of power.

speaker: Clergyman
content: ...So the goal is to destroy this story. I understand now. I'll help you.
(Scene change)
Outside the church, Eleanor is waiting for you both. You exchange a glance with the Clergyman before sharing your theories about the main quest with her.

speaker: Eleanor
content: An alliance?! Capture the evil Witch?!

speaker: Eleanor
content: I thought the Witch was just some background lore in this story. So she's a real person? Oh, I love this plot twist! Count me in!
[Hourglass Effect]
The massive golden hourglass that symbolizes the rules of this world begins to move once more. You've lost count of how many times this has happened in this round, but it's reminding you to hurry up.
With Eleanor's hot spring inn guest list in hand, you quickly identify all residents with unconfirmed identities. The Clergyman crosses out the final name, a faint crease forming between his brows.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Verification done. All registered guests have been confirmed.
All of them? Really? You stare silently at the page covered with crossed-out names.
After Eleanor leaves, you approach the Clergyman, whose brow is tightly furrowed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Everything that's happened today has at least made me certain of one thing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When the game restarts, everyone revives, whether they're NPCs or players. If we include the Butcher currently sealed in the hot spring bath, that would indeed account for <color=#fb9259>everyone</color> you mentioned.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Except for one person. She has never appeared. No, perhaps you're deliberately avoiding mentioning her.
The Clergyman remains silent, fixing his gaze somewhere past your shoulder rather than meeting your eyes. Seeing his refusal to respond, you change your approach.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You once told me the Butcher's story, and explained how the Witch captures people's hearts.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: After the investigation into all players, I've come to understand something. The more deeply someone embraces their role in the story, the more meaning they find in their existence here. The roles the Witch creates for them are projections of what they desperately desire but cannot obtain in reality.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But Eleanor and I are different. We've only just entered this story and haven't yet found our roles. That's why we remain Voyagers, or Adventurers.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've come to understand all this thanks to your assistance. You are clear-headed and wise. These detailed records have helped me clarify crucial information, and I'm sincerely grateful to you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yet for this very reason, I'm all the more confused about your true thoughts...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <color=#fb9259>...Despite knowing the deceptive nature of this world, you don't seem anxious or eager to find a way out.</color>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've earned the "Clergyman" identity and play the role perfectly. Do you truly reject this world?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or... have you also been captured by this game?
The Clergyman lowers his head and reaches up to loosen his tie. His shoulders relax, as if a heavy burden he's carried for a long time has finally been lifted.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Yes... I am playing a role, and I'm enjoying it.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Let me tell you another story, of someone else... In an office, he had no real name, only a nickname.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Can you imagine? He had indeed chosen a convenient nickname, but five years later, all anyone ever said to him was still... "Hey, um, what's your name again? Glasses, come give us a hand."

speaker: Clergyman
content: They never remember he existed. They called him over when they needed him, then ignored him when they didn't... Well, that's modern society for you. Everyone's busy enough with their own lives. No point in burdening each other with expectations.

speaker: Clergyman
content: So he learned to be cold, just like everyone else. He hid his emotions and gave up trying to express himself. No one cared about him, so he stopped caring about anyone in return.

speaker: Clergyman
content: But here, it's different. People come to confess to him, address him as the Clergyman, look up to him, and depend on him. Even though it's all just fictional, it's the first time he's ever felt... that he matters.
He glances at you and adds candidly.

speaker: Clergyman
content: ...You're right. Even knowing this is all just a game, I still want to stay.
You exhale slowly. Your extensive interrogation experience tells you the Clergyman isn't lying, so you decide to be honest in return.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ${PlayerName}. That's my real name. I'm the Chief of the MBCC, and this looping game we're in isn't just some immersive experience. It's a <color=#fb9259>Mania</color> incident caused by a <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I believe this entire scenario was constructed by the Witch using her Mania power. From the moment we stepped into that hot spring, we've entered her story. She created your Clergyman character to keep you tethered to this illusory satisfaction, just like the Butcher was controlled by his own ax. Everything we see is the Witch's doing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's tried to control me too. I can feel her watching me. Behind the terrifying illusions, between my countless deaths, her shadow has always been there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Perhaps she's enjoying all this carnage, watching people go mad and slaughter each other. Hiding outside the narrative, mocking everything. But we won't let her have her way.
You take a deep breath.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I need you. Not the Clergyman from the story, but the real you!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've calmed my anxieties and offered support without being asked to. You've sensed my tension, and even empathized with the Butcher's inner struggles. A kind person like you deserves to be valued wherever you are. You've always been needed.
The Clergyman's shoulders tremble almost imperceptibly, and for the first time, a glimmer of light appears in his otherwise vacant eyes.

speaker: Clergyman
content: "Kind"... Such a simple yet sincere compliment. It's been a long time since I've heard words like that. Thank you.

speaker: Clergyman
content: All right... I'll take you to find her.
You've been away from town for some time now. Deep in the forest, the fog grows thicker.

You walk side by side with the Clergyman, who remains attentive and thoughtful, guiding you around the countless dangers lurking in the forest. Along the way, he even shares some of the fairy tales that circulate within this story world.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How did you find a place like this?

speaker: Clergyman
content: After coming here so many times, I've already figured out the boundaries of this world. Even the NPCs seldom reach here.
After walking for a short while, a black cottage appears before you, starkly different from the village houses. Beside it stands only a single menacing tree with a crooked trunk.
Then again, it shouldn't surprise you that a cottage or a staircase can appear out of nowhere in this kind of story.

speaker: Clergyman
content: We're here.
The Clergyman pulls open the cottage door and you step inside. The interior is pitch black. Certainly an ideal hideout.
There's a soft click, but the Clergyman's footsteps never follow. Instead, a cold gust of wind rushes from behind, shoving you deeper into the cottage!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hey!

The moment you enter, the space seems to be split apart and rearranged by an invisible hand. The black room is rapidly compressed into something resembling a black hole. Though you're standing on level ground, you feel yourself plummeting at terrifying speed.
At last, you glimpse the light reflecting off the Clergyman's glasses, shrinking further and further away...
The darkness envelops you like a sodden, heavy blanket, smothering your mouth and nose. Each breath feels thick and viscous, as if you're drowning in air.
You struggle desperately, but an invisible force pins your limbs in place. You can't move even a fingertip.
[Release the shackles]
It's useless. The dark red glow barely flickers to life before going out like a short-circuiting current. Refusing to give up, you try once more.
[Release the shackles]
Still doesn't work. This place is even capable of suppressing your power.
Even your last weapon has been disarmed, leaving you to experience nothing but complete darkness and isolation. No light exists here. Sound barely travels. Even time itself feels like dried tar.
You've been double-crossed by the Clergyman!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Clergyman! Answer me! I know you're there!

Bang, bang, bang. The tiny sealed space shudders with your pounding, but you're unsure if the noise can reach the Clergyman. Fortunately, a voice finally comes through from the other side of the darkness.

speaker: Clergyman
content: This is a "jail" made by the creator, situated within a rift completely isolated from this world. The Witch fears you, so she's using these extreme measures to keep you contained.

speaker: Clergyman
content: But don't worry, I won't let any harm come to you. The jail only functions while the game is running, and there's not much time left.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Once her cycle reaches its end and the Witch fulfills her wish, you'll be able to leave safely. I promise you that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Clergyman, don't tell me you...
A string of familiar laughter rings out from outside, coming from right beside the Clergyman.
You can almost visualize it. Just as the Witch's shadow once appeared beside the Butcher, right now, an identical shadow must be standing right next to the Clergyman!

As the Witch draws near, the air around you begins to warp. The Mania, imperceptible to you before, now becomes almost tangible. The door separating you from the Clergyman vanishes, leaving only darkness. Objects in the room break free from gravity and float in the air, including you. Is she going to kill you?
But another voice stops her.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Don't harm him. Once the cycle ends, let him go. That was our deal.
female_content: Don't harm her. Once the cycle ends, let her go. That was our deal.

content: The Witch's laughter ceases abruptly. She doesn't respond, but the force restraining you loosens, and the Mania in the jail gradually subsides.
You realize it was the Clergyman who came to your defense. He's just on the other side of this darkness, perhaps watching you right now.

speaker: Clergyman
content: I'm sorry, Chief. I never wanted to betray you like this. Being seen by you, being considered your friend... That truly means a lot to me. I really wanted to help you.

speaker: Clergyman
content: But, sorry... Someone had already reached out to me before you did, offering me a friendship I treasure deeply. That's why I must prioritize her wish over yours.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You mean that Witch? That Sinner who controls Mania?

speaker: Clergyman
content: No, I mean that girl who smiles as she guides every newcomer into Cirrenfold.
[Flashback: First Meeting & Worship]

speaker: Prima
content: Oh, I see. You're feeling homesick, aren't you?

speaker: Prima
content: Don't worry. Soon, the Witch will be found.
[End of Flashback]

speaker: Clergyman
content: Indeed, I know nothing about Sinners or Mania. I can't be certain she's being completely honest with me.

speaker: Clergyman
content: But I know exactly what an "insincere smile" looks like. Because that's how I smile.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Day after day, endlessly putting on the same practiced, fake smile for my colleagues, clients, and people who forget each other the moment they part ways... I know that all too well, which is why I treasure the time she gives me.
...But is anything truly sincere in this fictional town filled with fictional identities and fictional values?
You resist the urge to contradict him outright, focusing instead on thinking through the situation.
You thought the Clergyman would be more reasonable than the Butcher, but he turns out to be far more delusional than you could have imagined.
At least the Butcher was only controlled by the Witch's shadow, but the Clergyman has a real "witch" right by his side.
You can't break out of this dark jail alone. No matter how difficult, winning over the Clergyman remains your only viable option.
But the owner of the jail seems to sense your internal conflict and interrupts with a smile.

speaker: Prima??
content: You're so convinced that you alone are his true friend, constantly claiming you need him, trust him, want to break the Witch's lies and bring him back to reality...

speaker: Prima??
content: So... do you still remember the real name of this Clergyman?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Shut up... Stop speaking through someone else's body!
[Flashback] Hot Spring Pool

speaker: Female Student
content: Since they put us in the same room, we might end up as a team! Let's introduce ourselves. I'm <color=#fb9259>Eleanor</color>, freshman at Eastside University! What about you all?
You hesitate for a moment before answering.
The shadow across from you tuts incredulously, seemingly surprised that you still remember despite having "died" so many times.
You had always called him Clergyman up until now.

speaker: Prima??
content: Wrong answer! Hahaha! Look, Ezra, he doesn't even remember your name. How can he still claim to be your friend?
female_content: Wrong answer! Hahaha! Look, Ezra, she doesn't even remember your name. How can she still claim to be your friend?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wait! Ezra!
Ezra seems neither annoyed nor resentful.

speaker: Clergyman
content: It's alright, Chief. Clergyman or Glasses, call me whatever you like. What matters is not my name. You've already given me enough recognition and shared with me something truly precious—your care and friendship.

speaker: Clergyman
content: If you still want me as your companion, why not trust me one more time?
The presence of Mania grows heavier as the Clergyman's voice grows unstable, triggering waves of echoes within your skull.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: After everything that's happened, how can you still say that...
Before you can make a decision, the Witch's laughter cuts in.

speaker: Prima??
content: The sand in the hourglass is almost running out, and so is time!

speaker: Prima??
content: Those who yearn to break free from the cycle must pass the Witch's Trial. That is my duty, the eternal cycle of this world.

speaker: Prima??
content: You'll help me, won't you?

speaker: Clergyman
content: Of course. I've found my friends here, and I want them all to fulfill their wishes.
As the Witch speaks, pitch-black Mania compresses the already cramped space, pressing down on you until even remaining upright becomes a struggle.

speaker: Prima??
content: Just a moment. It won't take long...
She raises her hand, altering the spatial structure linking you. In an instant, you're thrust far away, sinking into palpable darkness...
You unleash your shackles, shooting out crimson spikes of light, but they touch nothing. The darkness seems to be adapting to your power, infinitely expanding and evading your every strike.
She has created an almost infinite darkness just for you. Even her laughter will soon fade away as she forsakes you in this boundless, deathly silence.
No matter how you rage and scream, they are determined to keep you imprisoned here.
[Screen Shakes + Blade Flash Effect]
Boom! A flash of steel splits your closing field of vision as blood-red moonlight pours in. The heavy door explodes into splinters, shooting like darts toward the Clergyman!
The splinters of wood pierce his back and arms sharply. Blood gushes out instantly.

speaker: Clergyman
content: Mmph!
[Insert special effects and sound effects]
You see before you hear the ax. The blade sweeps past the Clergyman's body, spraying blood everywhere in the confined space.

speaker: Eleanor
content: What an exciting turn of events, and you left me out again? That is so unfair!
Bathed in moonlight, Eleanor appears at the doorway, wielding that long ax you once abandoned. Without waiting for the Clergyman's reaction, she fiercely swings for a second strike!
Slash...!
The Witch's shadow dissolves like foam next to the Clergyman as a deep, long gash opens across his back. He crashes heavily to the ground.
Eleanor seems utterly unbothered by what she's done and breaks into raucous laughter.

speaker: Eleanor
content: Aha! I get it now! So this is how you play the game! You've got these... skills. You just need to find your own role first...

speaker: Eleanor
content: I want a role too! I want the Witch's guidance! But not just something boring...

speaker: Eleanor
content: <color=#dg1f1f>I want to... <size=44>become the Witch</size>!</color>
Eleanor clutches the long ax as tendrils of Mania snake up her arm from the weapon. In the pool of blood at her feet, the Clergyman's gaze grows unfocused as he trembles, reaching a hand toward you.

speaker: Clergyman
content: No...
Eleanor swings the ax, its blade carving an arc in the air before crashing down with a loud clang! The Clergyman's body rapidly transforms into wax and vanishes.
Eleanor curiously examines the spot where the Witch's shadow disappeared. Nothing remains.

speaker: Eleanor
content: Isn't she supposed to be the Witch? Why isn't anything happening? Did my strike not land properly?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Eleanor, stop!
You finally find your voice again and desperately pound against the transparent barrier, but your shouts are swallowed by the jail.
Only then does Eleanor finally notice you, trapped in darkness with a look of shock on your face.

speaker: Eleanor
content: Oh my god, how did you get locked up in there? Don't worry! I'll get you out!

She swings the ax, and the jail's seal shatters instantly. You tumble forward onto the ground, your palms sinking into something sticky and red. You look up to find yourself staring into those same gray, cloudy eyes that once met yours confidently, now vacant and lifeless.
She grips your wrist tightly, her eyes gleaming with wild excitement.

speaker: Eleanor
content: You have a special power, don't you? I saw it... When you killed the Butcher, did those spikes come out of your hand?

speaker: Eleanor
content: Hehe, do you think... I can become the Witch if I kill her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Put down the ax. The Mania has gotten into you!

speaker: Eleanor
content: Exactly! If I had the Witch's power, I wouldn't have to play this boring looping game anymore! You want to kill the Witch too, don't you? This is perfect!

speaker: Eleanor
content: Let's go kill the real Witch, and then... I'll take her place!
Eleanor is now completely controlled by Mania. She won't listen to anything you say. Her eyes show nothing but madness and ambition.

speaker: Eleanor
content: I promise I'll do what you say. Let's play for 24 hours... No! 72 hours! Once I've had enough fun, I'll leave! What's graduation and job hunting compared to this? This is way more fun!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleanor, don't let the Mania take control! This isn't the real you. Remember why you came here in the first place!

speaker: Eleanor
content: Why I came...? I came for a thrilling game! Right, this is... all just a game, silly. Just do whatever pleases you!

speaker: Eleanor
content: Are you not enjoying yourself? If you're suffering so much... how about I send you back with a swing of my ax?
[Insert special portrait - Schoolgirl nameplate change]
The name tag on Eleanor's chest is glowing faintly. The text on it twists and distorts, erased by an invisible force. It's changed from "Adventurer" into Witch's "Devotee."
Sensing the eerie transformation happening in her, her face flushes with excitement like a burning sunset, revealing a bone-chilling madness.

speaker: Eleanor
content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>What is this feeling...? Have I finally... passed the "Witch's Trial"?<i></color>

speaker: Eleanor
content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>Are you there? Witch... you're summoning me, aren't you? You can grant my wishes, right?<i></color>
As if sensing something, Eleanor releases you. She narrows her eyes, her gaze piercing the misty forest and the eerie town, searching for something in the distance.

speaker: Eleanor
content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>She's waiting for me... I must find her...<i></color>
Where is she going? Does she know where the Witch is?

You reach out to grab Eleanor's arm, but she shakes you off without even looking back. Dragging her ax, she rushes excitedly out of the room, chasing after what she senses in her mind—the location of the Witch!
You follow closely behind her.
[Change background to forest. Add footstep sounds and shadow effects]

Some things are becoming clear now. In this game, the name tags are very important. Once a participant gets a role, they gain their own exclusive <color=#fb9259>skill</color>, enhancing their experience and allowing them to adventure freely.

The Butcher wants to protect others, so he needs great strength. That's why his skill is Unstoppable Force. The Clergyman craves others' respect and recognition, so he needs to be excellent at communication. That's why his skill is Supreme Affinity.
As for Eleanor, who had been playing as herself, she has finally found the role and power she desires. She's become the Witch's Devotee, which means her skill will guide her straight to the Witch!
You sprint through the pitch-black forest, struggling to keep up with Eleanor's unnaturally fast pace.
Dark silhouettes emerge from the shadows, swarming around you. Blood-red moonlight filters through the branches as the Witch's laughter follows you like a shadow, surrounding you in stereo.

speaker: Witch's Shadow
content: Hehe... Angry, are you?

speaker: Witch's Shadow
content: Leaving so soon? The story isn't over yet.
[Hourglass Effect]
The hourglass's illusion flashes past your vision. The cycle is about to reset.
You know that once everything restarts, the square will again fill with people, and the sacrificial ritual will play out once more... And this time, who will stand on the circular platform?
When that happens, all the stubborn players will come back to life. The Butcher, the Clergyman, Eleanor... They'll do everything in their power to stop you!
The rage burning in your heart isn't directed at any single person, but at this absurd game, at the rules that treat humans as pawns and lives as mere playthings!
At this very moment, a searing pain throbs in your chest. It's the name tag. It's burning and transforming too.

When the Butcher swung his ax, when the Clergyman comforted you, and when Eleanor found her new role... Their nametags all glowed when they acted weird. Clearly, embracing a role means surrendering yourself to this story!
You tear off your name tag, its text distorting and shaking as it heats up. Before it can affect you, you hurl it to the ground.
You will never let these rules control you.
[Cycle through several town street and square backgrounds, with the Witch's shadowed portrait floating left and right to show movement between locations]
After running for a long time, passing the town's flagstone streets and the misty forest, you discover Eleanor's destination is actually the starting point of your journey—the hot spring inn.
Prima isn't a player, so she shouldn't be able to respawn in the hot spring bath like the rest of you. Then why... would she be here?
But then you remember her damp hair and that familiar fragrance during your first meeting, and everything suddenly makes sense.
She plays the role of an innocent girl, helping new players immerse themselves in the game quickly. She journeys alongside you, extracts information from you, and probes the emptiness in your heart.
When she finally discovers what you are seeking here, that's when she begins tailoring the story for you, entrapping you...
[Scene Transition] Hot Spring Inn Lobby
You climb the steps, pass through the garden, and enter the lobby. Someone is sitting on that familiar red velvet sofa.
[Prima's portrait appears, eyes squinting as she smiles]
Her hair clings wetly to her neck, while Rumina stands silently behind her, gently patting it dry with a towel.

Seeing you arrive, Rumina immediately stops, stepping aside while tucking the towel away. Unlike before, Seon doesn't greet you cheerfully, but instead hides behind Rumina's hair as if caught doing something bad.
As for Eleanor, she has set down her ax and lies prostrated at the Witch's feet, just like a true devotee.
Prima appears just as she did when you first met, tilting her head innocently in a simple white dress, as if she can't understand why you've burst in so angrily.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Found you finally, Prima. Or should I call you... <color=#fb9259>Witch</color>.
[Release Shackles] Special Effect

Expecting her to dodge, you're ready to redirect your shackles quickly. But she doesn't evade or resist. She even raises her hand to stop the eager Eleanor, and with an almost welcoming posture, deliberately offers herself to the piercing light of your shackles.
The crimson light pierces directly through her chest, tearing her body apart and ripping open a black fissure.
[Insert CG] kv-Creation-ClosedEyes-AnimatedCG
A figure is <color=#fb9259>born</color> from the fissure.
She has appeared in your every dying moment, her gaze licking along your spine from the darkness.
Ahhh...
In an instant, gold, red, and green light erupts. Instead of diffusing outward, it stretches open the space aggressively, creating a magnificent yet unsettling scene.
At the center of this otherworldly radiance, the legendary Witch smiles, a barely perceptible curve of her lips that is overwhelmingly commanding.
The true <color=#fb9259>Witch of Rewind</color> manifests herself amid your burning rage.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: The brave Voyager, walked on and on, luggage getting lighter along the way.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: He cut down the Butcher who only knew violence, abandoned the Clergyman who wished to protect his friends. Even the Adventurer left him to become a mere Witch's Devotee.
female_content: She cut down the Butcher who only knew violence, abandoned the Clergyman who wished to protect his friends. Even the Adventurer left her to become a mere Witch's Devotee.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Oh, what a storyteller you are. Heh, perhaps if I lent you my pen, you might write a more interesting plot twist?
The Witch's voice drifts ethereally, carrying a hypnotic rhythm that leaves you slightly intoxicated.
Between sobriety and confusion, you only register a cool yet soft sensation on your lips. Her index finger is gently pressing against them with some kind of secret approval.
She hovers toward you like a swaying flower, a smile playing on her lips. Your eyes meet hers for just a moment, and you find yourself unable to look away.
Her fingertips reach for the back of your hanging hand, where a faint triangular mark remains. When you got it, she was still Prima. With a delicate touch, she reclaims it.
Then her fingers climb up your arm, gliding to your shoulder, applying barely any pressure, just the ghost of her fingertips tracing the contours of your neck.

As you reach out to push her away, she touches your wrist with her fingertips, suddenly retreats, then approaches from another angle. Her warm breath flutters toward your face, carrying the distinctive incense fragrance of a hot spring inn.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Thirty minutes until the story ends, my guest. Why the hurry?
[Footsteps, Witch's portrait]
In an instant, everything falls silent. The dripping water and the sound of the wind have all vanished. The entire world seems to contain nothing but the unhurried footsteps of the approaching Witch.

The shadow that has been haunting you finally reveals its true form. She embodies every fairy tale's dark witch—flowing, gradient grayish purple hair like seaweed, a dress as dark as night, pitch-black eyes flecked with gold, and a face full of cunning.
She extends her hand languidly. Dangling from her fingertips is the familiar golden hourglass you've seen each time you've died.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: My dear guest, you've damaged the theater setup and repeatedly vandalized the props, ruining the experience for other guests... I have no choice but to isolate you for the time being.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Just calm down. If you have any concerns, please discuss them with our staff, all right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Finally. It's taken long enough for the lead actress of this play to come onstage. Tell me your name, Sinner.
Throughout your encounter, you've developed nothing but distaste for her. The Witch covers her mouth as she chuckles, then performs an elegant curtsy.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: You may call me <color=#fb9259>Irrheia</color>, the weaver and keeper of this little world.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Of course, you may also address me by my role in this story: the Witch of Rewind.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We're clearly in an illusion, yet I don't feel a trace of Mania. Sorry, but MBCC cannot allow a Sinner as powerful as you to remain at large.
The Witch blinks.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: In a story, one must follow its rules. Some things simply cannot be mentioned here.
But you're speaking of facts, not stories. Is she stalling for time? Or trying to shirk her responsibility? Either way, you're not falling for it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The game should have been long over. Stop trying to distract me with your excuses.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've created an illusion so realistic yet independent from the rules of reality... You're no ordinary Sinner. What's the true purpose behind this "looping story"?
The Witch chuckles, running her fingertips softly in the air, as if plucking at invisible strings. Her tone is gentle, yet meaningful.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Oh, that's a little exaggerated, isn't it?

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: I've never coerced anyone. I merely answered the deepest desires in their hearts. As long as everyone enjoys themselves, that's what matters, right? As for how it all works... is it really necessary to get into every trivial detail?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You indulge and twist their desires. I have reason to suspect you're provoking the darkest parts of people's minds on purpose, turning them into your puppets to feed Mania.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: "Puppets"? "Feed"? What imaginative vocabulary. Your life is clearly far more fascinating than any script I've written.

She handles your questioning effortlessly, completely dismissing your accusations. Somehow, she's even made it seem like you're the one being needlessly critical, ruining everyone's fictional adventure.
You step forward, crimson shackle energy pulsing around your body, making an invisible but palpable threat. Only then does the Witch's mocking smile fade as she spreads her hands in surrender.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: With power like that, no wonder you don't get along with the others. It's really not fair to the other guests, is it?

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Sigh... I bet even I can't withstand the power of those "shackles" of yours. You must have encountered many highly destructive Sinners to be so sensitive to Mania.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: But... I'm really just an ordinary employee who wants to keep my job here. What would it take for you to spare me, spare this story, and everyone in it?
She lowers her head and casts her eyes downward, her voice softening a little pleadingly.
[Switch back to Prima's portrait, her feigned innocent and pitiful expression floating around like a Ghost]

speaker: Prima
content: Mr. Voyager, don't you remember how kind you were to me when we first met? We explored the world together and went on such thrilling adventures!
female_content: Miss Voyager, don't you remember how kind you were to me when we first met? We explored the world together and went on such thrilling adventures!

speaker: Prima
content: Because you're just a very kind person, aren't you?
[Release the shackles in frustrated rage]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't bother testing me with that face.
[Switch back to Witch's portrait]

After using the shackles multiple times, your body is starting to give out. Such a feeble attack isn't enough to defeat the Witch, only forcing her to put her real face back on. The Witch steps back with momentary surprise, then a smile blooms on her face.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Are you angry? I thought you'd prefer Prima's innocent and bubbly persona... It's refreshing, compared to that of someone who has been worn down by life, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't mind discussing my likes and dislikes with you after we end this farce. But I'll pick the location. How about the interrogation room at the MBCC?
[Insert special item - Notebook]

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: I've never quite found the right role for you, until now... I finally know what you are.
The Witch's lips curl into a smile as the notebook she was holding begins to float in midair.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: The Sinner captor... <color=#fb9259>Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, ${PlayerName}</color>. Or perhaps...
[Insert Chief's ID badge - "Anomaly"]
With a flourish, a crooked name tag appears in her hand. It's the very one you threw away.
The metal plate unfolds before you. The word "Voyager" has been erased, and a new word slowly brands itself onto the surface: <color=#fb9259>Anomaly</color>. The mission on the back also changes.
The hero who shreds the evil script and defends reality...?
You're unperturbed by this blatant mockery, simply focusing on the new skill that has appeared below the mission text.
Skill: Anomaly Description: Unknowable, invisible, and uncontrollable. Everything is variable.

options: A skill is a skill. It may come in handy.
A skill from the Witch? No thanks.

content: If it were any other skill, you would certainly refuse it. But since it says "uncontrollable," you reach out, grab the name tag, and tuck it into your shirt pocket.
Just as you're about to withdraw your hand, the name tag darts automatically into your sleeve and slides along your clothes until it reaches your chest, where it firmly attaches itself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You...!
The Witch continues to smile sweetly, seemingly very satisfied with the role she has assigned to you.
She appreciates unpredictability and is even looking forward to what comes next.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've had a terrible experience here so far. Once this is over, I will be filing a formal complaint with the Consumer Protection Bureau.

Seeing your serious expression, the Witch's smile fades as she taps her cheek twice with her fingertip. With a casual wave of her hand, the golden hourglass constrained by you begins turning again, your power falters, and you stumble backward.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Sigh, I see... You must make a scene, mustn't you? Very well then.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Let's continue your story and see, in the end, which one of us will catch the other.
[Insert effect: Hourglass reversing and shattering]
[Insert CG - You're Awake - Duo]

Like a butterfly flapping its wings, the script turns to a new page as a pen scribbles on it. The story is being rearranged, and words are reorganizing themselves on the paper. The entire world's rules are transforming with each small stroke.
In a small grid, in the dim hot spring inn, in the sky directly above Eastside, the Witch waves her fingers, and these words can change the world just like that.
[CG: Three quick flashes of the Sacrifice scene]
The scene before your eyes shifts continuously, as you're swept away by a torrent of words in between pages, unable to open your eyes.

Every scene you've witnessed here rewinds in your mind, the horrifying images replaying constantly. In this cycle, who is the offering trapped in an endless sacrificial ritual, Prima or the Witch? Or perhaps they have always been the same person.

Mania spreads as people transform into Mania-corrupted monsters. Space tears apart and reconstructs itself. Countless fractured scenes are pieced together. You can no longer distinguish whether you're in reality or inside the script.

Boom. Finally, Mania sweeps away the fragile cardboard scenery and spreads across the sky of Eastside. With a violent tremor, your surroundings suddenly open up. Beyond the walls lie none other than the familiar streets of Eastside!
[Screen shakes several times] Scene transition to Eastside streets

speaker: Passerby
content: W-What's happening?! Am I seeing things? I feel a little... dizzy? I just got these new glasses.

speaker: Passerby
content: What the ****? There's a huge crack in the building? An earthquake? Hey everyone, I'm live right here to broadcast the situation in real time! Don't switch channels!

speaker: Passerby
content: Wait, can you see that? What is that in the sky?!
[Insert effect: Hourglass flowing sand + Mania]
A golden hourglass appears in the sky above the city, slowly emitting intertwined streams of gold and black light.
[Scene Change] Hot Spring Inn Entrance + Special Effects

speaker: Rumina
content: The sky... is ripping apart.

speaker: Rumina
content: Please don't destroy Rumina's home...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can't believe a Mania bomb like this has been planted in downtown Eastside for so long... I need to contact the Bureau immediately.

You push against the crowd to return to the locker to retrieve your comms device, rescuing several participants attacked by Mania-corrupted monsters on the way. To avoid alerting the Witch, you don't initiate a call, but quickly and quietly write a message to your colleagues at the Bureau.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn</color>: Chief, aren't you supposed to be off today? Is the murder mystery game over? How was it?

<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>: Wynn, there's a Mania outbreak at the murder mystery game place. We have an unidentified Sinner named Irrheia, who claims to be a staff member. Estimated threat level is S-Class. I need you to find her real identity for me.

<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>: I've had a confrontation with this Sinner during the game. Mania has now spread to the streets of Eastside. Inform Nightingale, and contact the FAC immediately to secure the surrounding blocks, evacuate civilians, deploy anti-Mania devices, and prevent further contamination.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn</color>: Okay, on it now. Please stay safe, Chief!

<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>: Eugene, deploy a squad immediately and rendezvous with me for a raid to capture this Sinner! Take precautions. The suspect likely possesses an <color=#fb9259>Aurum Secretum weapon</color> that can alter spatio-temporal rules within her illusions. Stay alert at all times.

<color=#fb9259>Eugene</color>: Yes, Chief! Be there with the squad shortly.

The chaotic streets of Eastside seem to be gradually returning to order, and the Mania monsters that fled from the venue have mostly been contained. Your anxiety eases a little. You decide to contact Nightingale again to confirm the situation.
Buzz... Buzz... Signal lost.

<color=#fb9259>Eugene</color>: Chief, squad is ready. I'm heading to your position now.
<color=#fb9259>Eugene</color>: Chief... Chief?

Your hands are seized by Mania monsters emerging out of nowhere. Your device nearly falls to the ground but is caught just in time by two slender fingers. It's the Witch. Her finger swipes across the screen as she examines your messages with Wynn and Eugene, and she even begins commenting on them.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: So, a big shot like you is interested in these things? You could have just asked me directly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why did you pull me into this illusion? What's your goal? My squad will be here any minute. If you stop now, we can still negotiate. Put away your weapon. Abusing its power will only harm you in the end.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Hehe, don't be so tense. Why can't you believe this is just a chance encounter?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Would an ordinary person possess an Aurum Secretum weapon? This Aurum Secretum hourglass can manipulate the physical rules inside illusions. Its power is immense, capable of causing widespread destruction... I'd believe it if you told me you're an Outland spy.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Well, this hourglass... is just a gift from another chance encounter. It adds a realistic touch to my scripts, that's all. On the streets of Eastside, one can always find interesting trinkets, wouldn't you agree?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You expect me to believe you caused all this chaos with an Aurum Secretum weapon just to improve customer satisfaction?

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: The KPIs are stressing me out. You must know how it is, right? Sometimes you have to get creative to handle the boss's capricious ideas.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: ... Is the truth too uneventful to satisfy your expectations? Would you be more convinced by some elaborate conspiracy than a simple true event?
With unhurried composure, she turns over the hourglass in her hand and offers you a new story.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: I once met an injured soldier from the Outlands on a street in Eastside. She... would be what you call a Sinner, I guess?
The Witch lowers her gaze. Traces of sorrow appear on her pale face as she gently brushes her fingers over the hourglass.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: This hourglass was her weapon, and also her last remaining belonging. I don't know anything about her past or her true identity.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: She came to DisCity seeking a glorious finale, and ultimately died in my arms, entrusting this hourglass to me... asking me to complete her unfinished mission.
Her cold, detached manner from earlier has completely transformed. Lost in memories, her voice softens noticeably, revealing a trace of nostalgia. But you're clearly not so easily convinced.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yet you're using this important object as a prop to play the role of an employee stressing about KPIs.

The Witch blinks, apparently surprised you caught the inconsistency in her story immediately. She seems to have hastily concocted an explanation to placate you, but this only makes you feel as if she's fooling you.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Well, you're rather hard to please. I suppose there's only one way left to put it, then...
Once again, she turns the hourglass over. Another new story begins.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: I could be your Outland spy or Mania conspirator. But to tell you the truth, I'm just a mad woman who delights in toying with people's emotions while obsessively pursuing my evil agenda. Just like those Sinners in the urban legends, right? That's what you want me to be. That's why you've been interrogating me like a criminal from the start.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Well, I shouldn't disappoint you, in that case. I'd better play the villainess role properly.

She squints her eyes as she smiles, her latest story clearly even more far-fetched than the previous ones. You've dealt with plenty of dishonest Sinners before, but you certainly don't see someone who can spin a new tale every few seconds like her every day.
You feel the veins on your forehead throbbing with anger. All you want now is to rush over and drag this Sinner with her non-stop stream of lies back to the MBCC for a proper interrogation.

The Witch suddenly drifts further away from you, leaving behind only echoes of mocking laughter. You barely take two steps after her when the ground beneath your feet suddenly softens, mysteriously transformed into a pool of sand.
A familiar figure scrambles out of the sand, lunges forward with outstretched arms, and grabs hold of your legs.

speaker: Eleanor
content: <color=#fb9259>The Witch... The Witch's power flows through me now! Heehee...</color>

speaker: Eleanor
content: <color=#fb9259>Hey, I've just started a brand new script. Don't leave... Play with me...</color>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleanor?!

Eleanor appears completely taken over by Mania, and communication proves impossible. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind it all, the Witch, is hovering above the rooftop, shrugging innocently in your direction.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You just don't quit!

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Because this is what you want, isn't it?
As you feel the soft and yielding texture underfoot, a wall of golden sand obscures your vision.

You look up to find the sky has narrowed. Frosted glass surrounds you on all sides while fine sand cascades from above, forming a golden path, suffocating you. It seems Eleanor has dragged you into flowing sand. Is it the hourglass?
Outside, gunfire tears the sky apart, but bullets and heavy shells only create silent ripples against the glass walls, unable to leave even the slightest crack.

speaker: Wynn
content: What is this glass even made of?! Why can't we blast it open?! We can't get in, and Chief can't get out. What are we supposed to do?! Think of something, Eugene! Chief is being buried alive in there!

speaker: Eugene
content: I'm working on it. Chief is still in there, and there might be innocent civilians too, so we can't use heavy weaponry. Let's try other methods.

The Witch hovers in the air like she's watching a spectacle. You can see the anxious faces of Wynn and Eugene through the glass wall. With a casual flick of her index finger, the Aurum Secretum hourglass flips once more, erasing their recent victory and resetting your rescuers' progress to zero.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is this... your ability?!

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: After all, I am the Witch of Rewind. To me, time is merely an endless loop. You should be used to it by now, Chief, after playing this game for so long.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Let them busy themselves for a while longer. Now, shall we have a peaceful talk?
She turns to face you, her gaze gentle. Meanwhile, sand fills your nose and throat, making each breath a desperate struggle.
With a delicate wave of her sleeve, she brushes the sand off your face, then cups your cheeks and lifts your face to meet her gaze.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Chief, you've really been through quite a few extraordinary things. You spend every day wrestling with Mania and Corruptors, dealing with the various factions, protecting the fragile peace amid DisCity's dark currents... You bear the weighty responsibility of an entire city's fate.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: "Sinner Detention Expert," "Owner of the Absolute Power," "West District's Liberator," "Black Ring Terminator"... These titles are proof of your journey so far. And you'll only collect even more in the future, won't you?

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: But most people's lives are more like an hourglass. Day after day, from one end to another, rinse and repeat. There's rarely ever anything special.
Her smile fades slightly as she lowers her voice, a faint trace of pity in her tone.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: ...Your life is forever colorful, filled with grand adventures. You're brave and resolute. It's in your nature to press forward through storms and achieve one brilliant victory after another. It's truly remarkable.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: But it's precisely because of this that you might struggle to fully understand the daily lives of ordinary people... That's an entirely different feeling, one you may not be familiar with.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: For them, life is the repetitive daily commute, the darkness greeting them when they finally get off long hours of work, the jaded loneliness and resignation they can tell no one... These must all sound trivial to you, right? But during those quiet hours every night, the emptiness in their hearts grows ever larger.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: With so many people trusting you, depending on you, loving you, it's only natural that you cannot comprehend this kind of loneliness... You and most ordinary people have never been on the same path.
She dissects your past, laying it bare on the sand to be scorched mercilessly by the blazing sun. Yet her tone is ever so gentle, her eyes seemingly filled with admiration for you.
Her hand travels downward, gliding past your neck to your chest. Her fingertips tap on your name tag through the thin fabric, the crisp clink quickening your heartbeat.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Clay doesn't lead a happy life, and he wants strength and security. Ezra lacks emotional connections with others, and he wants a friend who understands him. That young girl, Eleanor, despite her carefree life, craves excitement and novelty beyond the everyday routine.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: You see, what keeps everyone here isn't <color=#fb9259>Mania</color>, but those small yet genuine wishes that haven't been fully extinguished by their draining, repetitive lives.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: To tell you the truth, I quite enjoy seeing you immersing yourself fully in my script.
Why is she so fixated on helping people escape their ordinary real lives? To the point of fabricating a personalized story for each of them?

options: Is making up stories your own form of escapism?
Are you glorifying Mania? Is this just another lie to deceive me?

content: Your question makes her hand freeze, the smile at the corners of her mouth slowly fading away. Did you strike a nerve?
Doubted by you, she closes her eyes and sighs, giving you a resigned smile as she withdraws her hand from you.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Anyway, since you reject this story, your journey should end here.

The conversation reaches an impasse, but more pressing now is your predicament. The sand continues to pour relentlessly from above, already covering your waist, then your chest, gradually piling up to your neck.
Perhaps she's waiting for you to panic, to beg for mercy, to be completely submerged by the sand. Then, you'll become just another NPC in her looping script, forgetting who you truly are in reality.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...If what you say is true, that <color=#fb9259>the Witch's story</color> captivates people by "fulfilling their desires," then this shouldn't be how it ends.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My days of chasing troublemakers like you may seem exciting to you. But for me, that life is filled with stress and fear. The ordinary existence you find so empty and boring is exactly what I dream of, and what so many people fight for.
You fix a defiant gaze on the Witch.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Today I came here wishing to experience a peaceful, ordinary life, but instead your god-awful story has dragged me right back into work mode.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When this is over, I'm definitely giving you a one-star review.
Surprise flickers in the Witch's eyes. Seizing this momentary opening, you wrench one arm free and cast your shackles on her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Besides, you haven't fulfilled <color=#fb9259>everyone else's</color> wishes either!

Your "Anomaly" name tag is searing your chest through the pocket. You could have refused this tag, but if it truly represents an unknowable, invisible, and uncontrollable role, then now is the time to try your luck with this random ability.

Boom! As if responding to your words, several beams of white light suddenly unfold around you, followed immediately by a massive figure leaping out of the radiance, cleaving through the sand trapping you with an ax.

speaker: Butcher
content: Raaah!

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: It's you?!
Air rushes back into your lungs, making you cough violently. But the sand quickly reforms into arms, striking at you with howling wind.

The Butcher charges forward, swinging his ax again and again. But the sand quickly gathers, impossible to cut down completely... He's already panting, yet has managed to create an escape route for you.

speaker: Butcher
content: I was blinded by my ax and made the wrong judgment... Just killing the Witch might not be enough.

Finally, he sprints and smashes his ax against the hourglass wall. Empowered by the skill the Witch herself has granted him, the previously invincible glass surface finally starts to crack. The glass shatters, reversing the swirl of the sand.

speaker: Butcher
content: But... saving someone can never be wrong, can it?

The Witch is about to raise her hand when she discovers something clinging to her left arm. A candle hand. It shakes urgently, its flame and wax anxiously swaying and splashing, conveying the desperate state of its owner.
It's Rumina. Through the hourglass wall, she silently calls out to the Witch.
The Witch is about to raise her hand when a pale yet firm hand suddenly emerges from the sand at her feet, gripping her ankle.

speaker: Witch of Rewind
content: Ezra! Why?

speaker: Clergyman
content: I'm staying here, hoping to fulfill my friend's wish.
The real wish...
Ezra struggles to lift his head. He speaks slowly, yet each word is hammered into the echo of the hourglass like a nail.

The Witch is momentarily distracted, causing Eleanor's grip on you to loosen. A pair of strong arms grabs you by the collar, yanks you out of the sand, and hurls you toward the gap! You're getting closer and closer to the exit! You lift your heavy legs and run with all your might.

The Witch quickly regains her focus. The sand gathers into an extended arm that slams the Butcher against the surface. Even the Clergyman, who's finally gotten half of his body out, is covered by sand once more, unable to reach the Witch again.
Having lost his ax, the Butcher fights the sand with bare hands. Eleanor, now the Witch's Devotee, tries to stop you, but the Butcher grabs her firmly, dragging her into the swirling sand with him.

speaker: Butcher
content: Killed you a few times. Sorry about that.

speaker: Butcher
content: Good luck, Chief. When you win, don't forget to give me some credit.
The Butcher sinks deeper and deeper. First his legs, then his body, and finally his head. Looking in your direction, he grins widely, points at you, then makes a fist and proudly thumps his chest.
The sand closes in, completely swallowing him. This man finally fulfills his promise at the last moment. He has protected you.
Meanwhile, Wynn and Eugene have lost contact with you and are frantic with worry.

speaker: Wynn
content: Oh no, oh no! We've lost Chief's signal! We should have joined him for the second run instead of letting him go alone. What if there's an emergency and no one's there to help him?
female_content: Oh no, oh no! We've lost Chief's signal! We should have joined her for the second run instead of letting her go alone. What if there's an emergency and no one's there to help her?

speaker: Eugene
