content: I'm drawing a chattering little sparrow getting squashed by the rear of the tiger you're drawing.
When Shuang'er crawls back indignantly to take a look, there's nothing in the snow but footprints.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Where's the sparrow? I need to smudge it!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Haha, I was only pretending. You're so weak and tiny. I don't even bother drawing your little sparrow.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: You, you... I, I...!
[Small CG: Trio]
You sigh and step forward to separate the two of them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All right, tone it down a bit...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're the mountain lord of White Tiger Mountain, after all. Have some dignity and stop bickering with a little girl, will you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, you both drew really well...
Amid the squabble, the tense suspicion and wariness from these past few days somehow seem to be fading.
The bright snow in the courtyard feels serene, and even the howling wind no longer sounds so harsh.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: So, feeling better now?

speaker: Chief
content: About what?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Mm... nothing. As long as you seem fine.
She smiles and gazes toward the far end of the courtyard. Shuang'er has also perked up, bouncing around in the snow and waving at you.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Hey! I built a snowman! Come and look!
When you go over to look, you see only a few lopsided white lumps in the snow, the shapes barely recognizable.

speaker: Chief
content: What is this supposed to be?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Can't you tell? But they're so lifelike! Here's a mangy tiger that's as fat as a pig. You're walking her on a leash while I ride on her head. You're looking at Master Shuang'er's trio!

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Once we leave this manor, we'll travel all around Eastia like this! So what if we can't become martial arts masters? We'll just set the tiger loose to bite our enemies!

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Who needs secret codices or fancy titles? We can still wander the world and help people along the way with our swords!
You stare at the messy pile of snow on the ground wordlessly. Your "young hero" persona is nothing but a false identity. You can't make her such a promise.
But someone else voices an objection before you can.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Not interested. Once I get out of here, I'm going straight back to my den to lounge around, eat meat, and drink wine. I'm done with all this martial world nonsense.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Who says we're taking you? That's Meowy I made.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Then I'm turning down the offer on Meowy's behalf too.
At some point, Xiaofeng has already climbed onto the roof. She scoops up a handful of snow and hurls it down, completely ruining Shuang'er's "masterpiece."

speaker: Chief
content: ...Here we go again.
You sigh as Shuang'er shouts and grabs her wooden stick, chasing after her.
But of course Shuang'er can't catch up with Xiaofeng, who's fast like a gust of wind. She can only stop in the corridor, gasping for air.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: You mangy tiger, slow down... Ha... I... I...
Panting, her voice gradually dwindles. Fine beads of cold sweat appear on her forehead, and her body involuntarily hunches over.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: No... I can't go back like this... I'll get noticed...
One hand grips the corridor railing tightly, barely supporting her weakening body, while the other reaches tremulously for the bag at her waist.
But her fingertips won't obey, and several small medicine bottles drop to the ground, rolling away.
She hurriedly bends down to pick them up, but her vision suddenly goes black. It's the residual "Purple Haze" poison in her body. It's flaring up again.

Shuang'er endures the excruciating pain in her internal organs, crouching on the ground and stretching her arm toward the nearest porcelain bottle. Under the moonlight, a rough straw sandal appears suddenly and steps on the bottle.
I never had a chance to take a proper look at you, young miss... Your complexion doesn't seem very healthy, does it?
A gaunt, malevolent face leans down, his viper-like gaze fixed upon her. Shuang'er props herself up and lifts her face, forcing out a cold laugh.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Doctor Yin? I remember... your room is not in this part of the manor, is it?

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Heh, care to guess why this old man would seek you out here? I caught a whiff of medicinal fragrance just now... Century ginseng roots, snowridge lingzhi powder, turtle shell paste...
As he speaks, the renowned healer steps closer and closer.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: How could a little beggar from Ping'an Town possibly come by such precious medicine? Miss Shuang'er, could it be... you have another name you haven't yet told this old man?
The words have barely left his mouth before his walking stick swings toward Shuang'er's head.
[Town at the mountain's foot]

speaker: Child A
content: Brrr—my hands are like ice! With all this snow, I can't even see the top... And Shuang'er still hasn't sent any word.

speaker: Child B
content: Hey! Stop looking at the mountain! Your mom's running all over the village looking for you! The snow's gonna make the shed roof fall down. Come help!
A light tap lands on the back of her head. It's not hard, just a quick thump from the other child, but it's enough to break the spell as she stares, mesmerized, at the mountaintop.

speaker: Child A
content: But... aren't you worried about her?

speaker: Child B
content: It's Shuang'er we're talking about! She said she'd come back and tell us all the cool stuff from up there, so she will! You should worry more about your mom. When she hears you talking about that martial world stuff again... ooh, you're gonna get spanked!

speaker: Child A
content: My mom won't! She just says stories can't keep you warm.
As the child speaks, she hugs her thin jacket tight and crouches to fuss with the snow at her feet, working to smooth out the messy footprints.

speaker: Child A
content: Hey... those heroes who go up the mountain... they're not cold, right? 'Cause they have... inner power! Yeah! They just move it around inside and then, poof! They're all warm! Snow probably just melts when it gets near them! They're like... like warm stoves! So cool!

speaker: Child B
content: Yeah! Shuang'er's probably doing all that right now! Punching and kicking with them. So awesome!

The two children grin at each other, hoisting bundles of firewood nearly as tall as themselves onto their backs. They trudge unsteadily through the snow, laughing and chattering as they head toward the dimly glowing lights of home, their paths carving two jagged lines behind them in the knee-deep white.

The blizzard howls, swallowing their voices whole. This endless expanse of white lies like silver shackles, strangling the life from the mountain villages. Roads have vanished under the drifts, icicles hang like fangs from every eave, and between heaven and earth, nothing exists but the shrieking wind and swirling snow—not another soul stirs.
[Cave]

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Ugh... Ngh...
Shuang'er braces herself against the stone wall, her knuckles whitening as she grips the rock, forcing herself toward the entrance of the manor's hidden chamber.

Wave after wave of familiar, twisting pain tears through her chest. She knows neither the lingering poison nor Yin Yansheng could have driven her to such desperate straits. This agony is all too familiar. It's the chronic illness that has shadowed her since birth, now counting down the final moments of her life.

speaker: Doctor
content: Are you out of your mind?! Even your parents couldn't cure what's inside you, and you're gambling with the time you have left?
This isn't a gamble. I've made my choice. Some things in this world... simply can't be tolerated.

speaker: Doctor
content: Stubborn as a mule... You were a headstrong little terror as a child, and now you're marching yourself straight into a den of wolves...

speaker: Doctor
content: I've failed them... Your parents trusted me to keep you safe, and I couldn't even talk sense into you. So if you're set on this, if this is truly your path, then please, at least, take care of yourself.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: If the doctor could see me now... he'd probably be so furious he'd tear out every last strand of that white hair of his...
Shuang'er presses her forehead against the cold stone door, using it to keep her failing body from collapsing.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: The children... they are still waiting for me to come back with the incredible stories from Northsnow Manor...

speaker: Shuang'er
content: This world... what's real and what's not... the dark and the light...

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I promised I'd tell them... with my own voice...

Only once she has pushed through the door and hidden herself in the dark chamber does she finally release a long-held breath. She empties her inner pouch of all its medicine bottles and swallows every last pill.
Then, sitting cross-legged, she closes her eyes and steadies her breathing.
[Guest Room, Day]

The entire night passes as you wait, but Shuang'er never appears. You search every accessible corner of the manor—the corridors, the courtyards, even the area around the kitchen stove—yet find no sign of her.
Defeated, you return to the guest room, torn by two fears: that some terrible fate has befallen her, or that she might return and, not finding you there, you will miss each other again.
But just as the first light of dawn begins to creep across the sky, a knock sounds on the guest room door.
Forgive the early hour, young friend. An urgent matter has arisen. Might I have a word?
The visitor's attitude seems fairly gentle.

speaker: Chief
content: Lady Ji? What's the matter?

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Ah, you're already awake. That simplifies things.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: We... may have uncovered a lead on the culprit for these recent attacks. We were hoping you might join us to discuss it.

speaker: Chief
content: The culprit?
Bang! Before you can even think, the door beside you is violently kicked open by a tremendous force. Yin Yansheng brazenly barges into your guest room.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Discuss?! Lady Ji, what is there to discuss with one who harbors a murderer?! The moment I came closer, I sensed it! This room... It reeks of misfortune! The shadow of bloodshed lurks here. There is evil afoot!!

speaker: Chief
content: So this is your idea of "discussion"?
In an instant, the small guest room fills with people. A wheelchair blocks the main doorway, while the Immortal Healer and Young Master Brocade take their positions on either side.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Still playing dumb? I'm talking about that little wretch who always clings to you. That beggar girl, Shuang'er. Where have you stashed her? Hand her over, now!

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Please. I haven't yet explained the situation to our young friend.
The Princess steadies the two men flanking her, especially the disheveled and furious doctor, before taking another step closer to you.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: I fear you've been kept in the dark, young friend. Miss Shuang'er attempted to assassinate Doctor Yin under the cover of darkness... If he hadn't witnessed it himself last night, we never would have known that child possessed such... remarkable skills.

speaker: Chief
content: Shuang'er? But Doctor Yin is standing right here, perfectly unharmed. In fact, he seems to have had plenty of energy left over to break down my door.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Precisely. The attempt failed. Having exposed herself, she wouldn't dare show her face again. If I'm not mistaken... Miss Shuang'er never returned last night, did she?
Her meaningful tone reveals she knows more than she lets on. Still, you do not take the bait.

speaker: Chief
content: Oh? For someone who claims her innocence, you seem awfully interested in the comings and goings of my room.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: No need for barbed remarks. Tell me, what do you make of this?
Yin Yansheng gives a cold snort. Producing a familiar small porcelain bottle, he hurls it to the ground before you.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: I doubt you realize, young friend, how valuable these medicinal ingredients are. Only someone with considerable means could afford such medicine...
She lets her gaze sweep across the manor, deliberately, before it catches on the elevated meeting hall, the very place where you meet the manor master for the first time.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Similar age. A conveniently frail constitution. A clear motive. Tell me, what are the odds of such a coincidence? We have both witness testimony and physical evidence. Surely you're not naive enough to ignore all that?

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not naive enough to ignore all the other convenient brandings and leap to conclusions based on one medicine bottle, either. I'd rather ask you. What did you do to her, and how exactly did you get your hands on that bottle?

speaker: Chief
content: As for your so-called culprit, Shuang'er has been by my side since before we even entered this manor. She had no opportunity.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: If she truly possesses such divine martial arts, long-distance communication and remote manipulation would be no difficult feat.

speaker: Chief
content: Oh? Then by that logic, the three of you working together could just as easily have accomplished everything you're accusing her of. General Invincible is still buried under that snow pile in the courtyard, by the way. Shall we go investigate that again together?

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Keep playing stubborn. Right now, you have two choices.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: One: Work with us to capture that witch and get to the bottom of these murders and the codex. Or two...

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: You admit you knew the truth all along, that you're that beggar girl's accomplice!
As they speak, the three of them are already shifting into an encircling formation. Even if you activate your shackles now, their coordinated close-range assault will seal your fate.

speaker: Chief
content: Why mince words? If I work with you, I help hunt down Shuang'er. If I'm her accomplice, I'm the first to be eliminated.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: You are a sharp one. Since Shuang'er trusts you most, surely you can help us locate her and put an end to this mess. How this plays out... depends entirely on you, young friend.
[Flashback]
[End of Flashback]
Can Shuang'er truly be trusted completely? On that point, you still cannot decide. But the true nature of the people before you? That you now understand perfectly well.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm hardly in a position to make enemies of all three of you over her.

speaker: Chief
content: But once we find Shuang... once we find the witch, what then?

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Then we make her talk. We find out where the codex is hidden, and the strong take all. Surely you didn't travel all the way to Northsnow Manor without an interest in that?

speaker: Chief
content: Naturally, I'd like to witness the secret that could overturn the entire Eastian martial world. However...
A sudden shock seizes you. Your pupils contract as your gaze locks on something behind them.

speaker: Chief
content: Manor Master?! Why are you here?!
Instantly, the three people's faces harden. They whip around as one, but the courtyard behind them stands completely empty.
They don't have time to turn back. You lash out, kicking the charcoal brazier. Blazing coals spray in every direction as smoke erupts with a roar, igniting the curtains and bamboo mats.
The thick smoke separates you. Seizing the moment, you spin, hurl yourself through the window, and disappear into the swirling snow.

The manor's brick paths are wet and slippery; you nearly fall several times, but you do not stop running. No matter how much truth lies in what those people said, you no longer have the luxury of playing it safe.
The only consolation is that Shuang'er should not yet have fallen into their hands. You have to find her before they do.
The snowstorm rages more fiercely than it has in days. Heaven and earth are caught in a vast, endless white vortex.
And inside the guest room, ignited by scattered coals, a piece of paper left sometime during the night is also consumed by the flames, its crooked, trembling handwriting turning to ash.

Red Plum Denunciation IV In darkness you reap lives like weeds, Building monuments to your heroic deeds. Ten thousand scrolls of glory earned, Yet innocent souls as payment burned. Where you contend for supremacy, No blade of grass grows free.
[Meeting Hall]
A thick ledger of crimes rests in your hands, its pages yellowed with age. Case after case, each word written in blood and tears, feels impossibly heavy.

You found it in a hidden compartment of the host's seat in the meeting hall. It silently denounces years of unknown oppression, murder, and ruthless exploitation within the Northwild martial world... and it also reveals the location of the smuggled Aurum Secretum you have been hunting.
Who could have compiled this? And why are they investigating all of this?
A growing suspicion forms in your mind. But the white curtains in the hall billow and fall in the wind, casting everything behind them in shifting, elusive shadows.

speaker: A Voice Somewhere
content: My divinations told me you would find your way to this hall. And lo, the fates deliver you straight to me.
Only moments after your arrival, someone shows up on your trail.

speaker: Chief
content: For a man your age, Doctor, you move like a weasel in a henhouse. Shame all that agility couldn't save you from a street urchin's hands.

speaker: Chief
content: What, here to collect on that debt with me?

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Sharp words from a dying tongue. This old man grants you the indulgence.
Pacing calmly, you reveal no emotion. You keep your distance, your eyes locked on him, waiting for him to make a move, all while your mind maps every possible way out.

speaker: Chief
content: You walk in alone? So much for that grand alliance. Fits what's written in here, though. Rats in a sack, each one chewing through the others.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Alliance? Hah! Shen Wanchou hoards his gold mountains, Ji Guining dreams of her empire's restoration... This old man wants none of that!

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: I want what is real. What I can hold, taste, swallow. Life! Long life, eternal life! Power? Power is nothing but a ladder for taking lives!

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: And you... your time has run out. That vigorous body, that surging vitality... perfect fuel for this old man's dying embers!

A sinister wind suddenly rises as a dark purple, reeking gust charges straight at you! But you stand ready. You retreat half a step and swing your scabbard, the impact deflecting the poison powder aside.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Oh? Barely a turn of the moon, and you've learned to dance away from death!

The black walking stick in his hands becomes a venomous snake striking from its lair. It thrusts, stabs, sweeps, and chops with vicious cunning. A cloud of poison smoke and colorful powder billows around you, thick and choking. You draw your sword, the clash of steel ringing out, when a sweet, cloying, familiar fragrance cuts through the acrid haze.

speaker: Chief
content: That scent... Purple Haze! Were you working with Ma Ling?

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Why dirty my hands with schemes? I merely... seasoned another's brew. A sprinkle of spice makes the dish far more interesting, don't you think?

speaker: Chief
content: You didn't just give the poison to Ma Ling. You stoked Xu Shen too, didn't you? Pushed him to move against Jiewubei!

As you speak, the stick strikes again. These murders are orchestrated from the very beginning, a web of instigation and collaboration. They are the ones who incited Ma Ling to violence; they are the ones who ultimately silenced her... Everyone here has blood on their hands, creating this deadly trap that consumes the manor.

speaker: Chief
content: When did this begin? At the manor? The inn? Or even earlier? You were never going to let anyone walk away with that codex, even if Xu Shen and Ma Ling didn't make a move!

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Too late to figure it out now!

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: True or false, what does it matter to a dying soul? Best you go dumb to your grave!
The head of the walking stick arcs around and connects with the back of your knee. Your leg gives way, folding uncontrollably as he knocks you sprawling to the ground.

You've already burned that feint; it won't work again. Certain that you have no other means of escape, the old man plants his foot on the hem of your robe, pinning you in place as he lets out a triumphant laugh.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Heh. Amateur skills, and yet you've clung to life this long. Such a fine young body and raw talent, wasted. A pity, truly.

He leaps into the air, his stick whistling as he brings it high overhead. You sense the danger and ready your shackles, power surging in your palm. The moment you prepare to counter his strike, a sharp click of a tongue sounds from above.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Tsk, tsk, tsk. All that huffing and puffing at your age. That's bad for your health, you know.

Like a meteor descending in wrath, the Mountain Lord's figure crashes into Yin Yansheng, catching him squarely in the side. The collision blasts out a tempest of energy, shockwaves ripping through the space around them. Yin Yansheng cries out in pain as the force hurls him and his stick away like debris.

speaker: Chief
content: Do you always have to make such a dramatic entrance... The manor's been in complete chaos. Why are you only showing up now? Where have you been?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: What, same question twice? I didn't go anywhere. Right up there on the roof. Had some liquor, watched the stars, slept like a log. Oh, and the stars last night were beautiful, but the show was even better. Little birdie got herself chased clean around the manor by a pack of mangy old cats.
Xiaofeng speaks in a conversational tone, casually waving her hand to swat away the poison-laced bone spikes Yin Yansheng fires in retaliation, as if she were brushing aside flies.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: That birdie's got a nose for hiding spots, I'll give her that. Been prowling these parts for days, never once noticed there was someone curled up under that rubble pile near the back mountain.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Looked like it. Curled up tight as a little snowball, not a twitch. Poor thing, honestly.

speaker: Chief
content: She's hurt...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Well... only one way to find out, yeah?
Without hesitation, you seize the moment as Xiaofeng forces Yin Yansheng back once more, swiftly darting toward the side window of the meeting hall.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Think you can flee?

Yin Yansheng has no intention of letting you escape so easily. Abandoning his fight with Xiaofeng, he whips his long stick forward. It shoots through the air like an arrow from a bow, aiming directly for your back.
Just as the blow is about to land, Xiaofeng's sharp claws flash. With a resounding thwack, she bats the stick away as if it were a child's toy.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hey, old-timer. He's off to see the birdie, so who's gonna keep me company now? Just you and me... let's make it a day to remember!
female_content: Hey, old-timer. She's off to see the birdie, so who's gonna keep me company now? Just you and me... let's make it a day to remember!

content: Yin Yansheng spins to face her, his face a mask of shock and fury, but his venomous skills are mere child's play against Xiaofeng's overwhelming power. She toys with him effortlessly, pinning him in place with no hope of escape.
As you turn to vanish into the swirling snow, Xiaofeng tosses something your way. You catch it, and your fingers close around a string of silver beast-taming bells.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Finding her won't save you! The Snowquell Arts belong to me! ME!
[In the Shadows]

The twisting pain inside Shuang'er offers no sign of easing. Her medicine bottles have long sat empty. Even if medicinal herbs still exist somewhere in the manor, those intruders will surely ransack and destroy them sooner or later.
Now, she must rely on herself alone to suppress the agonizing backlash pain wracking her body.
Deep within her mind, her five senses begin to sharpen. Her breath deepens, becoming slow and measured, as perceptions far beyond those of ordinary people awaken within her—

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Cheepy and Chirpy... are they looking for me? I'm fine. Just don't let anyone know you're connected to me. That's all I ask.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Fighting to the east... a staff hitting the ground. It's Yin Yansheng. And another one... a tiger's roar, loud and showy. Xiaofeng... She said she was just here to watch the show, didn't she? Look how that turned out.

Sweat beads on her forehead and vaporizes into white mist, seared by the heat of her churning internal energy. At the critical moment of her meditation, the air currents around her warp and shimmer with invisible force.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: The other side sounds like a mess... not like they're searching for anyone, though. The codex's right here with me. What are they tearing up my room for?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: And footsteps... light ones. Careful. Someone's trying really hard not to be heard... they're close, right...
She opens her eyes to the sound of footsteps crunching through snow just outside the stone crevice, perilously close.
Her breath regulation is only halfway complete. To forcibly end the meditation now would render all her efforts futile. She does not react, forcing her voice to remain steady and calm.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I would advise against approaching further. This place is layered with defensive traps. One misstep and you may find yourself unable to retreat.
The footsteps halt about ten feet away, hanging back rather than pressing forward.
A cautious type? But it isn't Ji Guining. Wheelchair wheels make a very distinct sound.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: You seek the codex, I presume. Then you have witnessed the chaos engulfing this manor. This text draws only endless covetous eyes and brings naught but calamity to whoever possesses it.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: If you take it from me and others discover this fact... the fates of Jiewubei and Xu Shen shall become your own. The entire Northwild martial world will not rest until you are destroyed.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: And if you must skulk in shadows, never daring to reveal what you carry... then pray tell, what meaning remains in standing at the pinnacle of the martial world?
The figure actually heeds her words, staying perfectly still. Her voice softens.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Since you appear to be someone who heeds reason, I propose an accord: you and I join forces to sweep away these intruders first. My cultivation has been perfected, and this codex... can be yours.
There is still no response. The silence only deepens her unease, and she tightens her grip on the long staff beside her.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: If you have terms to propose, speak them plainly. I have little patience for—

Her sentence trails off as the sound of footsteps fills the corridor, heading straight for the hidden chamber. The stone door swings open, and she reacts on instinct, breaking her meditation mid-breath, channeling power into a decisive strike—
The blow freezes an inch from your face. Through the doorway, you stand before her, travel-worn and glistening with unmelted snow.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You didn't even let me answer. I was about to say I came seeking the same thing. Cooperation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Manor Master Jichuan.
You study the pale face before you, and the crude wooden staff that still hangs in the air, refusing to fall.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Lonely peak casts its shadow, startling the dragon in the cold water... You used that very move to rescue me from the poison fog trap.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where are these inescapable traps you mentioned? And this "perfected cultivation" you claim... does it always leave you so pale, Manor Master? The blood on the ground... is that also part of your cultivation?
She stands paralyzed, her gaze averted from yours. The weapon lowers in her grip.
From a distance, the roar of angry voices and the whistle of hurtling weapons grow rapidly nearer. You wait, but no answer comes.

speaker: Chief
content: Manor Master, if you keep staying silent, how are we supposed to work together?
A flicker of shock crosses her face. She hadn't expected you to still cooperate. She opens her mouth to speak, but the words never come.
Instead, she doubles over, coughing a hot, thick stream of dark blood onto the bluestone floor. The sound of it hitting the stone is sickening.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: My... my internal energy is unstable. I need time to recover.

speaker: Chief
content: How long?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: One incense stick's time. You can't hold them off.
You steady her with a hand on her arm. Through your palm, you feel her distinct trembling and coldness. Any further questions die in your throat.

speaker: Chief
content: If I can hold them off, would I have a chance to hear the manor master explain everything that's happened here?

speaker: Chief
content: Forget it... I'm saving you because you remind me of a friend. I've only known her for a few days, and she can be quite a handful, but thanks to her help, I gained some insight into the martial world.

speaker: Chief
content: Her name is Shuang'er.
The sounds of battle creep closer to the cave. You pull out the silver bells Xiaofeng left you; their chime echoes through the mountain ravine, stirring the slumbering white tiger awake.

Inside the manor, Xiaofeng remains in the meeting hall, amusing herself by sparring with the Immortal Healer. But the tiger's roar erupts with such dominance that it shakes the entire estate, an impossible sound for anyone to ignore. The distant clash of weapons falters and falls silent, then the clamor shifts, surging toward the roar.

speaker: Chief
content: If someone like me could stumble onto this place, it was only a matter of time before they found it too. Meowy can keep them busy for a bit. We'll double back the other way.
Few undamaged areas remain within the manor. You use the rocky terrain for cover, locating a temporary hiding spot.

speaker: Chief
content: They're distracted for the moment, but that won't last. How're you holding up?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I didn't expect it to be you outside... I had to forcibly stop my meditation, and the energy backlash... ugh...
She clenches her teeth as fresh blood seeps from the corner of her mouth.

speaker: Chief
content: You're in no shape to fight anyone, even if you do manage to recover. What's the plan?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I have to try. I still have some... unfinished business...

speaker: Chief
content: Something you still can't tell me about?

speaker: Chief
content: Fine. Then I'll figure it out myself. Whatever you've been scheming this whole time, I'll get to the bottom of it. But first, we actually have to survive.

speaker: Chief
content: We're not winning this in a fair fight. The only chance is getting out of the manor. Any paths down the mountain still open?
Shuang'er coughs out a laugh.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: None... The back mountain path was crushed by an avalanche, and the front gate is sealed shut too... This whole place was designed as a trap from the start.
She closes her eyes, her silence radiating an almost stubborn resolve.
You stop pressing her for answers, focusing instead on the enemy's movements. In this brief silence, you feel her gaze on you.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: But there is a way... one that could at least save you.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Yeah, I know. Those other heroes already gave me the same offer.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Since you know... why haven't you?

speaker: Chief
content: Because I also know that even if I helped you right now, it wouldn't change much. We'd still be in the same mess.
Shuang'er freezes in shock.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Look, I'm not from Northwild. I don't have your fancy martial arts, and I don't know all the rules of your world.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I've got eyes. I saw the real evidence of what happened at the manor. I can tell right from wrong when I look at those charges. And I already know exactly what kind of people are making them. Even if I switched sides, they wouldn't exactly welcome me with open arms.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: More importantly, I know you're not behind those three incidents. Whatever you're actually after, you don't deserve to get handed over to them on false charges.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If something's right, and someone needs help, and I'm in a position to do something, I can't just walk away. Even if... all I can manage is buying you a few more minutes.
You hold yourself alert to outside dangers, your voice perfectly calm.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The only reason I keep asking about your plans is that I need to know: is helping you the right call? Behind all the lies and secrets, are you actually the kind of person Shuang'er wants to be, the kind with real honor?
A half-stick of incense passes as she regulates her breathing, yet Shuang'er still feels something inside her refuse to settle.
Ten years ago, beneath the candy shop at the town entrance, a similar fire once burned.
It surged through her, fierce and consuming.
[Memory Fragment]

speaker: Jichuan
content: Have they left...?

speaker: Mudling
content: Nope. Still circling up ahead... What'd you do to make 'em this mad?

speaker: Jichuan
content: They... they overturned Uncle Zhang's bun stall. Sent his buns rolling everywhere. Wouldn't pay, wouldn't apologize. Just threatened to beat him instead. I... I couldn't just stand there. I told them I'd cover the cost, but they had to apologize to Uncle Zhang first.

speaker: Mudling
content: I knew it! Scabby Wang and his pack. They bully this street like they own it. Someone oughta teach 'em a real lesson!

speaker: Jichuan
content: Don't! There are too many of them... You should go. I don't want you caught up in this because of me.

speaker: Mudling
content: What's there to be scared of? These fists don't know the meaning of the word! Hey, didn't I just haul you over here like it was nothing?

speaker: Jichuan
content: You're amazing... I'm not like you. All I did was run my mouth and nearly make things worse... My tutors always say I'm meant to take charge of the manor one day and help people. But I can't even help myself...

speaker: Mudling
content: Who says?! You stood up to them. Told 'em to apologize. In front of everyone! That takes guts. That's what they call... uh... speaking up for what's right! Me? I've just got muscle. Couldn't come up with words like that if I tried.

speaker: Mudling
content: And back there, if you hadn't spotted this broken basket pile, I'd still be running in circles, and they'd have caught me ages ago.

speaker: Jichuan
content: That's just a little cleverness. It doesn't really do anything...

speaker: Mudling
content: That's not true! I've got strength; I can chase off the bad guys. You've got a sharp mind; you can see the way out when no one else can. Big fist or little fist, a fist that protects someone is a good fist. That's all there is to it.

speaker: Mudling
content: You've got what you're good at. I've got what I'm good at. And if I'm gonna be Ping'an Town's number one hero, you can be number two!

speaker: Jichuan
content: You want to be a hero?

speaker: Mudling
content: Just a small goal, no big deal. You could be one too! Real strength doesn't come from fists, anyway. It comes from here—

speaker: Jichuan
content: Your heart?

speaker: Mudling
content: When there's a fire in here, people you wanna protect, things you wanna make right, that's when the strength shows up. You got people like that? Things you wanna do?

speaker: Jichuan
content: I'm... not sure yet. My tutors want me to lead Northsnow Manor. To make our name mean something again. To be the kind of manor master who helps people, the way my parents did.

speaker: Mudling
content: Well, I know what I'm for! Whenever I see someone in this town getting pushed around—don't matter why—I step in. Figure out the rest later.

speaker: Mudling
content: Then I'll just go "whoosh," jump right in front of 'em, and shout: "Bullying the helpless in broad daylight? No shame?!" And then wham, bam, down they go!

speaker: Mudling
content: Heh, I got a little carried away... They're coming. You should go first.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Wait, what's your name?

speaker: Mudling
content: No folks. No family. Nothing to lose. I'm scruffy, sure, but I don't break when I fall, and I don't stay down when I'm kicked. Folks around here just call me Mudling.

speaker: Jichuan
content: When will I see you again?

speaker: Mudling
content: Let's make it a deal. When I'm a real big hero, and you're a real great manor master!
[Back to Reality]
The half-incense meditation period comes to an end, and Jichuan opens her eyes.

speaker: Doctor
content: Remember, do not channel your internal force unless you have no other choice. These final treatments are fighting poison with poison, using fire to sustain a flame that's already guttering. Any strength you feel now is borrowed. When the oil runs dry, the lamp goes out... That much is certain.

speaker: Jichuan
content: How much time do I have?

speaker: Doctor
content: If you use this method to mask your condition and preserve your life force, three months, perhaps. But if you push further, if you force your exertion in combat... your meridians will crumble in as little as three days.

Jichuan turns her head. The pale winter sunlight does little to hide the anxious sweat on the other person's face, sweat earned while protecting her. She keeps count; in just a few short days, she has gone against the doctor's orders three times.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: The grand banquet... even with the illusion, I had to let a thread of internal force slip to fool those old foxes. That was the first.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: To escape from Doctor Yin's grasp... I had no choice but to use my martial arts again... That was another time.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: But that poison fog trap... I still don't know why I rushed in...

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Too many tales from down the mountain. Too many storytelling benches... Somewhere along the way, I started believing I was one of them, the fool who runs in to save people when no one else will.

But isn't the person before her committing the same foolish act? This is the other side of the martial world: not just schemes and slaughter, but the choice to intervene when witnessing injustice, the choice to do what must be done despite knowing it's impossible. Even when strength is lacking, the will to protect something, to prove something, still burns.
But at this moment, unlike him, she still has this withered branch in her hand—one that can cut through the wind in battle.
female_content: But at this moment, unlike her, she still has this withered branch in her hand—one that can cut through the wind in battle.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Young hero, they'll find this place soon enough. But I have a way out.

speaker: Chief
content: I thought you said the manor was completely sealed off?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: East cliff, in the mist, there's an old plum tree. Beneath it lies a passage, the last resort I saved. Activating it will take a moment... and it won't be quiet... Cough, cough...

speaker: Shuang'er
content: You're right. In my current state, if those three corner us, I can't guarantee we'll both make it. So I need you. Someone to execute the "big fist and little fist" move with me.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: That old friend of mine taught me... Mudling was a rare one in Northwild, born with the strength of a true hero. She used to say: fists big as clay pots and fists little as peas, each has its place.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Back when I had no martial arts to speak of, I'd step forward, bluff and bluster, lure the troublemakers right where we wanted them... and Mudling, hidden nearby, would spring out and catch them completely off guard.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: She told me weeds and plum blossoms grow from the same soil. No hierarchy between them. But once you've got the strength to break through frozen ground, taking root to stand guard isn't just a choice anymore. It's a responsibility.
You have heard her mention that old friend once before, but this is the first time you are learning that Northwild has such a natural-born hero.

speaker: Chief
content: So you want me to be the bait.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: No, not bait. I need you to be my eyes and voice. Not just to draw them out, but also to mislead, to maneuver. Use what you're good at: observation, judgment, and talking. Keep them busy and buy me a moment.
She reaches out and gently brushes the hair before your eyes, clearing your field of vision.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I know that most of what I've told you has been lies. My name. My identity. Even these martial arts I wield... they're wrapped in deception too.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I've exploited your kindness, dragged you into this mess, and put you in harm's way. I won't deny any of it.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: But one thing I never lied about.
With a tight grip on her stick, she uses it to lever herself up from the corner.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: For once, I want to be a real hero. I want to help the people of Northwild. I want the heavy snow on this land... to stop.

The wind howls like blades atop the mountain cliff. Shen Wanchou and Ji Guining stand at the precipice, their figures sealing off the narrow ground. But below, they see only an endless sea of clouds, no sign of their quarry.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Hidden here? Clever. But this spirit-guiding jade of mine is no bauble. If it can't sniff out a codex, it can certainly track two warm bodies.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Young Master Shen, flaunt any louder, and they might just drag you down with them out of desperation.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Even a fake phoenix dares to scold me? For the alliance's sake, I'll let it slide. You have a better idea, then?

The Princess points, her fingertip tracing the air toward the footprints. They are sharp and clear in the snow, a deliberate trail leading straight to the old plum tree at the cliff's edge. The tracks are too obvious; they mean only one thing: a trap.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Young friend, restrain yourself. It's not too late. You're no true villain. Why stake your future on that manor master, she who sets deadly snares and stains her hands with blood?
You lean back against the old plum tree, standing on the very edge of the cliff. The footprints are indeed a decoy to make them suspicious and keep them exactly where you want them.

"Beneath the plum tree's roots is a hollow. When wind passes through, it wails like a mourner, and its resonance can shatter one's internal force... but the effect requires three people positioned in a triangle." Jichuan's instruction echoes in your mind. You calculate the timing, waiting for the right moment.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: ${PlayerName}, young hero, the road ends here. Let's settle this once and for all.

options: How do you want to settle this?

speaker: Chief
content: Settle what? I don't recall owing you. Or have you simply decided everything in Northwild is yours, and now my life as well?

speaker: Chief
content: I'm just some ordinary nobody without a shred of martial arts skill, trying to make a quick profit from the chaos. That's all. I don't know any manor master, and I only met Shuang'er a few days ago. So please, take pity on a poor fool and let me scurry off?
As you speak these words, your shoulder shifts back in what appears to be an unconscious lean.
The movement is immediately detected. Shen Wanchou crouches low and advances half a step toward your left, while Ji Guining adjusts her position accordingly to maintain their coordinated containment.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Bold words for someone looking for an exit. Fine, here's my family's gold token. With it, you can draw from any Shen bank in Northwild. Just show yourself and hand over Jichuan. Profit with no risk. What say you?

options: That's too much for a nobody like me.

speaker: Chief
content: That's great! I've been thinking it's time I struck it rich. How about you toss that token over first? Let me see if it's real.

speaker: Chief
content: Hard to tell if you're after me giving up Jichuan, or just using me as bait to smoke her out. Either way, I'm not taking blood money.
As though she expects you to be the type who rejects the carrot and opts for the stick, Ji Guining displays no signs of anger.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Gold is dust, in the end. ${PlayerName}, you cannot shield her, nor that codex, the root of all this blood. Give it to me. I swear by the Ji name: this strife ends. You walk free, unburdened.
Their presence sharpens, but the third pressure has yet to make itself known.

speaker: Chief
content: Young Master Shen's gold, Lady Ji's vow of innocence... Back and forth, offering deals tainted and hollow. I can't play your righteous game. I'd only fumble it and end up like Jiewubei and the rest.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: That's their misfortune, their folly! But you... you still have a path. You still can choose survival.
The two have clearly lost their temper; their combined presence cuts off every possible escape route around you. But they are also moving closer, straight into the formation you planned.

speaker: Chief
content: Survival? I chose this morning, when you came for me. I won't be part of your rot.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Gold is gold. Power is power. Coin knows no right or wrong, and strength asks no leave. Since you're too ungrateful to see reason...

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Lady Ji, I hear your pipa can draw blood with enchanting notes? Once we've bound this one, I'd love a performance. Having the fool dangle upside down outside the manor gates could be a fine warning.
Just as Shen Wanchou begins to unfurl his folding fan, laughter rings out, arriving fashionably late.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: That codex is a curse. You two have years yet. Don't squander them. Hand it over, and this old man vows: your bodies intact, your graves serene. A kindness, truly.

speaker: Chief
content: Right now!

The moment the shout leaves your lips, a chorus of deep creaks echoes from the plum tree's roots, as if something slumbering beneath the earth stirs awake. Ancient vines clinging to the rock face snap taut, and the currents of air above the cliff, disturbed by these sudden obstacles, compress and accelerate into chaos.
A visible, spiraling vortex of violent wind materializes, completely engulfing the three figures who now stand exactly at the triangle's focal points!

Fierce winds crash down, sending robes and hair into a wild dance, while deep resonant tones from the plum tree's hollow roots thrum through the gale. The air thickens around them like mountain stone; their internal force stalls, and they find themselves utterly immobilized.

In the blink of an eye, the formation is sealed. The winds of heaven and earth, channeled through the ancient tree, hold the three firmly in place. An ethereal woman's voice, impossibly clear, cuts through the howling gale and the vortex's thunderous roar, reaching each ear with perfect clarity.
Shen Wanchou.

Last year, on the third day of the twelfth month, at River Luo's ferry crossing. The Shen family sought glory through disaster relief, yet substituted moldy grain for fresh supplies. An escort guard, Zhao Qian, discovered the truth.

That night, the Zhao family of seven perished. So did a pair of traveling singers, a father and daughter, who happened to be staying at the inn and overheard your silencing. Nine souls in total. All of them, tragically, "slipped" and drowned in the river.
When their bodies were recovered, the little girl's hand still clutched fragments of gold-painted peacock patterns torn from your fan.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Who are you?! Stop this charade and show yourself!
He bellows the demand, writhing desperately to break the formation's hold, yet with every thrash, its grip only tightens further.
Ji Guining. Tell me, does that fallen dynasty's blood you claim still serve you well?
You cloak yourself in "Eastian legitimacy," all the while building your own faction and betraying the state. How many who paved your path to ambition... have quietly "vanished" over the years?

That devoted musician of yours... did she truly die of illness? Or was it because she knew too much, so you served her tea yourself and watched as she bled from every orifice, dying in voiceless agony?

speaker: Ji Guining
content: My grievances are mine to settle. It is none of your concern!
The crushing force sends cracks spiderwebbing across her wheelchair, yet the obstinate Princess refuses to bow her head.
Yin Yansheng!
Do you still remember how many living souls you stripped to the bone, drained of marrow, their very essence extracted for your vile concoctions?

Seventy-three souls from Beihe Village. You claimed plague took them, but you imprisoned them as test subjects, poisoning them with every toxin until they withered away! And the herb-gatherers from Nanling, a brother and a sister. You lured them in and refined them alive into a batch of Yin-Yang Harmony Pills!

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: A descendant of those wretches? No... wait. You're that little apprentice who escaped all those years ago?!
His voice turns shrill, his withered fingers bristling with poison needles, though he has no idea where to aim them.
I am no one. I merely seized the chance to peel back your masks and see the rot festering beneath.

I gave you a chance. Using the codex, using this manor, I set this final trial. I wanted to see if this martial world, which preaches heroism for cultivation and recognition, held even a shred of benevolence.
But you... All I see in you is greed, suspicion, betrayal, and murder. You failed to seize your final chance to prove your worth. The trial is over.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: You... wh-who in the hell are you?!
This is nothing but a simple misdirection. You were deceived once at the banquet, and you fell for it again?

Beneath the ancient plum tree at the cliff's edge, the stillness of fallen petals and deep snow shatters as they erupt skyward. In an instant, blossoms and snow surge upward in a reverse torrent, a fierce dragon-like whirlwind of white and crimson that pierces the clouds.
Red petals dance in the air; shattered stones scatter. As the great wind column fades and the snow dust settles, a figure in white stands silent in the calm.
[Transformation Sequence - Animated]

speaker: Jichuan
content: Jichuan, Master of Northsnow Manor.

speaker: Jichuan
content: This body carries the Jiang bloodline, and with it, divine martial arts. I claim the north snow as my bones, the winter plum as my soul, to cleanse this corruption and purify Northwild.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Since you sailed here with greed as your vessel and sin as your oars... today, I shall make my body the scales and your lives the weights. Let us measure exactly how heavy this blood debt has become!

As her words fall, the wind and snow suddenly intensify. The white robes flutter as her staff sweeps through the air. Vital energy surges like a dragon, carving the first pure snow across Northwild's sky.
[End]
The formation barely grants her the upper hand. Shen Wanchou spots its weakness first, forcing his internal force through his feather fan to shatter its pattern in an instant.
The moment the formation breaks, the other two strike like starving tigers. Poison needles hail down as demonic notes shriek through the air; attack follows attack in a seamless flurry.
No sooner does Jichuan attempt to retreat and reposition herself than Shen Wanchou moves like a phantom to cut off her escape.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Still struggling! Let's see how long you can keep this up!
With a light tap of her weapon, Jichuan sends the accumulated snow swirling back like a dragon. She deflects the incoming wind with ease, her staff tip flowing smoothly to Shen Wanchou's chest.

speaker: Jichuan
content: When you walk the road to the underworld, ask those wronged souls whose mouths you sealed with gold. See how long they'll let you hold on!

Shen Wanchou reels in shock, but Jichuan's form has already scattered like smoke, coalescing in the next heartbeat before Doctor Yin. Before his poison needles can be loosed, Yin Yansheng is suddenly trapped within a web of staff shadows, all seeking his vital points.
What do you think? Sounds like a Mania-themed urban legend, right?

speaker: Jichuan
content: Dozens of coffins lie beneath your medicine furnace. Did you ever spare even one child?

Taking in the situation, the Princess urgently strums her pipa. The music suddenly shifts, the melody surging forth and transforming into tangible blade edges that cut through the air toward Jichuan. Using the momentum, she herself retreats swiftly.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: You two fools! Fighting her alone, how can we possibly match her?!

Without turning her head, Jichuan sweeps her staff backward, the blow shattering the sound blades. In one fluid motion, the staff rides the momentum up the strings, thrusting directly for the pipa's center.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Do the heroic souls of the martial world alliance ever visit you in your midnight dreams?

Jichuan fights three opponents alone, her plum branch a blur of deadly precision that forms an impenetrable wall. Her killing intent is a palpable force, keeping the trio at bay beyond ten feet. The staff shadows rupture the mountain rocks; snow and dust swirl, but through it all, her magnificent presence shines through like a rainbow, her robes billowing in the chaos.
You don't dare to breathe. Shuang'er isn't here to narrate this martial display, leaving you in silence with the clash of steel.

speaker: Chief
content: If Yin Yansheng is here... then where did Xiaofeng go?

You scan your surroundings, but no one else seems to be watching this spectacle. With no other choice, you remain hidden behind the plum tree. According to Jichuan, this place holds her final method of escaping the mountain, but despite your long search, you find no mechanisms or secret passages.
Meanwhile, Ji Guining coordinates the others as they begin to close in. Yet, Jichuan continues to use offense as her defense, driving them back with every move.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: The legendary codex does live up to its name! Truly something extraordinary! Even the three of us together can't handle you?

speaker: Jichuan
content: Before you lay eyes on that codex, I don't mind sending you all on your final journey first.

Even as the words leave Jichuan's mouth, she closes the distance. The tip of her branch halts a hair's breadth from Shen Wanchou's heart, but her internal force has already struck true. The Shen family's priceless heart-protecting jade shatters instantly.
Shen Wanchou staggers as if hit by a sledgehammer, a torrent of blood bursting from his lips. The same surge of energy flings both Yin and Ji backwards several feet.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Excellent... excellent! Such devastating power! This old man's desire for that codex grows more unbearable by the moment!

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Don't celebrate too early, Doctor Yin. You claimed she was at death's door before, but her current might... I fear we'll all perish here long before we ever see that codex.
Adopting flanking tactics, the two fight as they retreat. In their circling withdrawal, they unknowingly drift closer to your hiding place.

Your whole body tenses, frozen in place. Jichuan, noticing the danger, deliberately angles her attacks to redirect the battle, trying to lead them away. But you both underestimate Ji Guining's mastery of battlefield observation and manipulation.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Impressive skills, Manor Master. Three against one and still holding your ground. But what if this battlefield had one more person, someone you'd be distracted trying to protect...

Click! The mechanism snaps into action. The backrest of her polished-steel wheelchair flips open, revealing a dark-blue launcher that immediately fires. Needles as thin as hair, gleaming with an ominous purple light, fly straight toward your hiding spot!
You frantically duck, but you feel a sinister draft on the back of your neck. Somehow, Shen Wanchou, who you thought was down for the count, has silently appeared right behind you.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Kill him, then capture the girl. The codex will still be ours! Lady Ji, what masterful calculations!
female_content: Kill her, then capture the girl. The codex will still be ours! Lady Ji, what masterful calculations!

content: With the force of wind and thunder, the feathered fan's blade lashes out in an instant, aimed directly at your vitals. It is a moment of life or death; there is no room to hold back.
[Red Flash, Black Screen]
The expected clash of shackles against the fan never comes. When you open your eyes, Jichuan is already standing before you.

speaker: Doctor
content: Remember, do not channel your internal force unless you have no other choice...

She breathes in short, ragged gasps, her body trembling. In a single, desperate instant, she gathers her life's power to protect you. The fan's deadly edge is repelled by her internal force, but your shackles now lock tightly with her, holding her captive.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: How poetic... how tragic! Miss Jiang may possess world-surpassing divine skills, but this heart of flesh and blood... still has its weaknesses after all.

For the first time, you touch her power through the shackles. You delve into a body so frail it should have failed years ago. Inside, you find organs ravaged by years of Mania... held together and sustained only by the tenacious grip of that sinister force.

speaker: Chief
content: You... your body, your martial arts...

Blood seeps steadily from the corners of Jichuan's lips. You feel the delicate thread of her life force pulsing weakly beneath your palm, and it brings to mind Shuang'er's talk of chronic illnesses and the persistent rumors that the young manor master has always been sickly.

speaker: Jichuan
content: I'm sorry. I still ended up dragging you into this...
She wipes away the blood and gives you a gentle smile.

The three attackers, sensing her fading strength and shallow breath, pounce with cruel hunger blazing in their eyes. But Jichuan ignores their deadly strikes. With a sweep of her sleeves, the scattered plum petals in the air converge as if answering her call, wrapping you tightly in their sharp, cold fragrance.

speaker: Jichuan
content: See for me what the martial world should truly be.
With a palm strike, she shoves you into the void. Your body becomes weightless, a kite with a severed string, plunging end over end into the bottomless abyss.
Yin Yansheng is the first to leap after you, but a plum branch sweeps across his path, a sudden barrier that forcibly blocks him at the cliff's edge.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: You're asking for death, little brat!

speaker: Jichuan
content: You're the one who's going to die.

With a spin and a flick of her wrist, Jichuan sends the snowflakes dancing out as countless fragments of cold light. Her technique, "Northern Snow, Thousand Mountains," unleashes a force capable of shattering stone and monuments, sweeping the three attackers away in unison. She lets the momentum carry her back, steadying herself with her branch—

speaker: Jichuan
content: Your lives are but the first debt settled today. Where my plum branch falls, an old debt remains, and it will be collected to the very last!
[Mountain Path]
The last thing you see is the cliff edge rapidly shrinking away, where a lone white figure stands like a monument, three dark shadows descending on her like wolves.
She never once glances back, as if all her strength is poured into facing that final confrontation.
Your mind scatters, piece by piece, in the howling wind. Jichuan's figure dissolves into the churning clouds and mist. Then...
Thud!!!
Agony explodes across your back like splintering rock! Freezing snow chokes your mouth and nose as the impact consumes everything—sound, light, feeling—in an instant.
You slip from consciousness.
[Black Screen]

speaker: Schorl
content: Weightless environment detected... Activating emergency protocols... Deploying cushioning barrier...

speaker: Schorl
content: External support detected. Fall risk neutralized... Vital signs scan complete. Chief's vital indicators are within normal parameters.

speaker: Schorl
content: Projected time to regaining consciousness: three to five minutes.
Before your eyes are two large, furry heads: Meowy and Xiaofeng, flanking you on either side as they peer down at you.
Why are you two here...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hey, hey, hey. That's the thanks I get for saving your hide? Meowy here caught you clean as a whistle. You sure you didn't smack that pretty head of yours on the way down?
Dizziness still swirling, you slowly push yourself upright until you are sitting.
You find yourself in a snowdrift at the bottom of the cliff, the soft powder a cushion beneath you. Miraculously, your body remains unharmed, without a single scratch.
This is... the base of Mount Fuyun?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Bingo. Lucky I've got eyes in the back of my head. Had Meowy waiting in the hollow, just in case.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: So... what's that thing on you that won't stop beeping?
The Schorl you had almost forgotten peeks out from your collar.

speaker: Schorl
content: Pleased to reestablish contact. I've synchronized recent offline records and completed a preliminary analysis of the Northwild incident. Your performance was exemplary. The mission objective advanced efficiently without real-time assistance.

speaker: Schorl
content: The Aurum Secretum network has been fully traced. This investigation can be considered a complete success. Additionally, we've obtained critical leads regarding anomalous Sinner activity in Eastia. Overall, a flawless operation.
Schorl hovers in the air with a slow rotation as it delivers its report, while Meowy and Xiaofeng watch with unblinking fascination.

speaker: Schorl
content: Hmm... though I'm still detecting minor instability, likely originating from the feline entities behind me. Based on available intel, this incident appears isolated. The Eastian Alliance remains a reliable partner.

speaker: Schorl
content: Local signal strength is still poor. Uploading investigation data gradually. I suggest we return to the Northwild border and rendezvous with support.

options: Not yet. There's something I need to handle.

content: The situation at Northsnow Manor isn't resolved. The ones who gained power through Aurum Secretum are still on that mountain, and Jichuan is up there alone, facing them.

speaker: Schorl
content: Jichuan... Data confirms she is the Eastian who recently performed my duties under the alias "Shuang'er." I understand your concern. But I must emphasize: this is an internal Eastian matter.
Is that DisCity's stance? Take the intel and walk? That "Eastian" you mentioned, she's been helping me, guiding me toward the truth all this time. I'm not leaving her behind like this.

speaker: Schorl
content: I understand your position... but this individual has deceived you repeatedly. I must reiterate: this is an internal Eastian affair.
As the cold deepens, Schorl's voice suffers from the low-temperature interference, cutting in and out with bursts of static.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hey, the little gizmo's got a point. You're an outsider here. What's any of this got to do with you? Walk away now, save us both the headache.
You heard all that, saw Schorl, and you don't seem surprised... How long have you known?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Please. Saw right through you back at the inn. Now that little beggar of yours? She was a lot slicker. Didn't clock her until we crossed fists in the pine grove. Kid's got moves.
So you kept quiet... just to watch the drama unfold?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Obviously. Where's the fun in spoiling it early? Then I'd miss one of you playing the noble hero and the other the pitiful lamb, building up to that big tearjerker farewell? No thanks.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Look, quit sulking. That girl's tougher than she looks. Taking on those three leftovers? She's got it handled.

speaker: Schorl
content: This Eastian's manner may be... frivolous, but her judgment is sound. The mission objective has been met. I'll begin compiling your return report.

A flawless operation? A complete success? The more those words reach your ears, the deeper your unease grows. Glancing up, you see the mountain peak has disappeared into the clouds. All daylight is gone, and a bone-chilling cold settles over the wilderness.
In your mind, the memory of Jichuan pushing you off the cliff plays on an endless loop.

The harder she tries to push me away, the more it proves there's something she doesn't want me to see. If... if these people already understand Mania, if they've found ways to awaken Sinners, if their so-called "cultivation" all hinges on contamination deals...
Then why are they so certain Jichuan has something that can push them further?
Schorl falls silent. Out of contact with you for too long, it now needs to sift through all the information it has gathered during these days at the manor.

Everyone except Xiaofeng, who's just here for the show, believes some rumor about the "divine martial arts." That Mania will amplify their cultivation. But no one's actually seen it. No one can prove that Jichuan's practices are even part of them.
Unless what they believe in was never a codex. But a system. Something already tested. A truth no one dares speak aloud.

speaker: Schorl
content: Information gap confirmed. One critical element is missing from this incident:

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#fb9259>The codex.</color>
[Mountaintop Cliff]

speaker: Jichuan
content: Is this...what you've all come for... ?
Jichuan stands at the cliff's edge, her figure looking particularly fragile against the bitter wind.
As she produces a scroll, it instantly captures everyone's gaze. The cover bears the title "Snowquell Arts," two words that have, from the very first moment, held an irresistible allure.

speaker: Jichuan
content: The view from the summit is... quite expansive. A pity, though. Gaze too long, and all that's left is emptiness.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Plum trees that grow among mountain stones must always struggle, their roots breaking through rock for every drop of sustenance. Now... I suppose this will serve as premium fertilizer.

The fertilizer she speaks of is nothing more than the three people standing ten paces away. And yet, none of them dares move. Jichuan dangles the scroll over the cliff's edge, pulling it back and extending it out again—a relentless motion, like someone toying with trapped beasts.
After countless feints, watching greed and desperation ebb and flow across their faces, she finally breaks into laughter.

speaker: Jichuan
content: What's wrong? No one gives chase? Weren't you all so eager to head down the mountain and capture someone just moments ago?

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: That lad who fell... whether he's dashed on the rocks below or flown to the heavens, who can say? Why waste effort searching for him? But you, Manor Master...
female_content: That girl who fell... whether she's dashed on the rocks below or flown to the heavens, who can say? Why waste effort searching for her? But you, Manor Master...

content: His gaze lands on Jichuan's right hand, clenched tightly into a fist.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: ...That scroll in your hand holds a far greater weight than some lad of unknown origin.
female_content: ...That scroll in your hand holds a far greater weight than some girl of unknown origin.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Manor Master Jiang, let's not mince words. Your inner flame gutters like a candle in the wind. Hand over the codex, and I'll personally see to it you have a dignified burial, a plot worthy of the Shen family name.

Jichuan covers her mouth with her fingers and coughs softly. Droplets of blood fleck the snow, vivid crimson against the perfect white. Still, she smiles; that newly forged connection within her tempers the sharp anguish of the contamination.
It seems the young hero has been keeping secrets from her as well. Does that make them even? She lifts her gaze, meeting three pairs of murderous eyes with unruffled calm.

speaker: Jichuan
content: What you seek is indeed here.

speaker: Jichuan
content: But I wonder... this "ascension in one step"... which of you has the fate to claim it, and which of you... has the fate to enjoy it?

With that, the remaining blossoms at the cliff's edge shudder and ascend, bursting into bloom as a red mist that fills the sky. As the dazzling red overwhelms their sight and seizes their focus for a heartbeat, a fierce strike from a staff shatters the haze, hurtling directly toward them.
[Foot of the Mountain]

speaker: Schorl
content: What are you planning to do? The direction you're heading leads to the main mountain path, which is now completely blocked by snow and impassable.
Then we'll take a different route. We've also overlooked a crucial clue. The denunciations.
A red plum denunciation was left at every scene. For those people to be so convinced of the divine martial arts' power, Jichuan must've hidden some information inside them.

speaker: Schorl
content: Your hypothesis is logically sound. But it's not enough reason to continue our involvement.
It is. If contaminated relics from the farlands can draw people in like moths to flame, who's to say the codex doesn't hold something far worse?

speaker: Schorl
content: Current intelligence indicates that Sinners are engaged in combat on the mountain. The snowstorm is intensifying. The risk of ascent is critical. Compared to the "potential threat" you're citing, the projected cost-benefit ratio of this operation is far from favorable...
Wasn't it you who said we "can't afford to let any potential threat slip"? That's why we came all the way to Eastia, isn't it?

speaker: Schorl
content: That principle assumed you'd operate rationally within Eastia's trust framework. Right now, your heart rate, breathing, and decision-making patterns all indicate emotional instability—
You grab Schorl and shove it deep into the snow. Sure enough, unequipped for the extreme cold, it freezes instantly, falling silent.
Xiaofeng listens to your entire argument without uttering a word.
Don't worry. I'm calm. My status here as an outsider is... complicated. A lot of people have their eyes on me. I'll explain later.
She scratches at her ears, her expression unusually troubled.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Tch... She didn't warn me about someone this stubborn.
She?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Look. Coming down to get you? That was those two manor birdies asking me for a favor. I was in the middle of a decent scrap with that old timer when they came flapping over, saying there was something more fun down here.
...So the escape route by the cliffside plum tree was a lie too.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: She traded two jars of fine liquor for that request. I agreed to keep you safe and get you out 'cause I was planning to leave anyway. I never agreed to drag you back up.
Taking a moment to brush off the snow, you confirm that you're uninjured, then pivot and head the other way. The main path is blocked, so you'll have to find another way up the mountain.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hey, you still not getting it? She went through all that trouble to get you out. She doesn't want you to go back.
I know.
You press on without a pause, the snow rising past your knees. Xiaofeng watches your figure as it slowly vanishes into the whiteout, then lifts her voice and calls out:

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Going down's easy! Going up? Avalanches wiped out every path. You're not making it up there alone—
I know.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: And even if you did, you can't change anything. That girl's power burns through her own life... She doesn't have much time left.

options: That's exactly why I'm going back.

content: There's something I didn't get to tell Schorl. Another reason I have to go back.
The shackles in your palm throb, the connection to the other end clear and unwavering. Through them, you feel Jichuan draining her last reserves of strength, locked in an endless, grueling battle.
She never lied about being frail. If she hadn't pushed herself to wield that strength, maybe she could've lived longer, just as an ordinary person.
She still hasn't told me what drives her to pay that price. For the people, yes. But for herself... what's she really fighting for?
You don't look back. Your silhouette grows smaller and fainter against the vast curtain of snow.
[Foot of the Mountain]

speaker: Schorl
content: Chief, we've received a response from Eastia. They've declined to investigate the codex further. Officially, the mission is complete. My safety assessment remains unchanged: returning to the manor is not advised.
Upon waking, Schorl resumes the earlier conversation, yet the Chief is absent. Only Xiaofeng is there, perched lazily upon a mound of snow.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Quit your scanning. That Chief of yours is long gone. That one's set on finding out where that codex came from, and what that girl's really burning herself up for.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...The personal motivations of Northsnow Manor's master fall outside this investigation's operational parameters.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: He knows. That wasn't a request for input. That was a heads-up.
female_content: She knows. That wasn't a request for input. That was a heads-up.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Aww. Look at you, little black lump, all alone. Your master ran off and left you. How about you come with me instead? I bet you'd make a great new toy for Meowy to bat around.
Xiaofeng withholds your parting words from Schorl. There is no purpose in relaying them, as the outcome remains the same either way.

Northwild stands independent from Eastia, its foundation built on heroic ideals. Shuang'er told so many tales of the martial world and legendary heroes in Ping'an Town... If the townspeople knew what happened at Northsnow Manor, perhaps some of them might still harbor enough heroic spirit to offer their aid...
Xiaofeng knows, deep down, that you are embarking on a path both naive and doomed to fail. Yet it is also the last hope for aid you can count on in this place.
[Foot of the Mountain]

Deathly silence grips the town. Heavy snow has collapsed half the rooftops, and not a single soul stirs in the streets. You approach the nearest courtyard, one of the few that remains relatively intact, its wooden gate standing firmly shut.
After a long moment, a cloudy eye peers out from the crack in the door.
Excuse me, sir. I'm sorry to bother you. I need to get to Northsnow Manor. Is the path up the mountain still passable?

speaker: Old Man
content: Cough, cough... Northsnow Manor? Up on Mount Fuyun? That place is a block of ice this time of year... icicles hanging down like teeth. What in the blazes would you want up there for? Alone?
The door creaks open halfway, revealing an old person huddled behind it, arms crossed tight, hands rubbing together against the cold.

Do you know Shuang'er, the storyteller in town? She's actually Northsnow Manor's master. She's in trouble. There's fighting up there, and she has no one to help her. Please, if there's any way to get me up there, I have to try. For a neighbor.
You try to bow in the Eastian manner, but the elder stops you with a gentle hand.

speaker: Old Man
content: Oh, child... How young are you? Heroes, quests, the "martial world"... that's just stories for wide-eyed kids. This blizzard isn't a story. It's a killer. The roads won't last much longer. You should be heading home, not up a mountain.
It's not a story. I'm telling the truth. The martial world, it's... it's happening right now. Those heroes—
You hesitate mid-sentence, suddenly uncertain if you can still call those Sinners "heroes." The old man shakes his head slowly as the door closes.

speaker: Old Man
content: Heroes... Seen plenty of them come and go. Not a single one ever stayed to help us split firewood or patch roofs. Fairy tales, child. Just fairy tales...
[Mountaintop Cliff]

Having just swallowed a priceless Nine-Turn Yang Pill, Shen Wanchou feels its power course through him. His face flushes with vitality as internal force surges, making his presence even stronger than it was upon entering the manor. He snaps his folding fan open and seizes the initiative.

Jichuan's face, by contrast, is deathly pale. Each ragged breath scrapes like knives against her lungs. Unyielding, she grips the scroll in her left hand while her right wields the plum branch in rapid, flowing strikes. In the confined space, she weaves an impenetrable net of defense, deflecting his fan attacks one after another.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Quite the impressive showing. That fierce strength carries Ma Ling's signature. And that flowing motion... Xu Shen's technique? From whom... did you "acquire" such arts?

Malice flashes in Shen Wanchou's eyes. His fan snaps shut with a violent tremor and a sharp, metallic ring before instantly disintegrating into twelve gleaming blades that streak through the air like a sudden downpour.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Ask them yourself when you see them in hell, Manor Master!

Clink, clink, clink. Twelve sharp impacts ring out in rapid succession. Jichuan dodges through the flashing steel, her plum branch sweeping aside most of the blades, though several still graze her shoulder and waist. Fabric tears, and blood blooms on her skin.

Shen Wanchou grins, a malicious curl to his lips, as he gestures with his fingers. The twelve blades obey, whistling back through the air to reassemble into a steel whip with a series of clicks. This legendary weapon—forged at immeasurable cost—now strikes at her legs like a venomous serpent.

Knowing she cannot fully evade, Jichuan grits her teeth and lets the tip bite deep into bone. Then, with a violent twist of her waist, she uses the whip's own momentum to yank herself toward him. The fierce desperation in the move catches Shen Wanchou off guard, and in an instant, she closes the distance. Her plum branch darts out, finding the vital points on his chest and abdomen.
[Foot of the Mountain]
You approach the next house. The door soon flies open to reveal a woman with a sickly, pallid complexion, a baby clutched in her arms.
Hello, I—

speaker: Woman
