content: That's because Chief and many others helped me. And yet, I was still distracted by evil spirits.

speaker: Yanyan
content: There are many good people here too. If I fail, I'll let you all down as well...
Before you can say anything more, a faint foreign fragrance drifts by as Du Ruo walks past you and approaches Yanyan.
She gently takes Yanyan's injured hand that you're gripping. A smoke brushes over the wound and heals it.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Du Ruo? Ouch! Ouch...
Before Yanyan finishes her sentence, Du Ruo knocks her forehead hard with her knuckles, an elegant and charming smile still on her face. Watching this, you instinctively shut your mouth.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Oh dear, it seems like Yanyan's little brain is getting confused from too much sleep. Overthinking is an illness. I must help you cure it.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Having spent so much time in Sunset Town, I know for a fact that there wasn't any so-called flawless Great Seer. It's about time I expose her other side.
Du Ruo casually picks up the brush and ink on the desk...

speaker: Yanyan
content: W-what?! ...What is this?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The first attempt at the Almighty Bow by that Great Seer, but it's nowhere near as good as yours.

options: Or maybe you just can't draw?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Are you questioning a cultured scholar's art skills, Chief?
She gives you a smile, but the smoke around her cools by a few degrees.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: If you had seen her actual carvings, you would only marvel at how lifelike my drawing is. It's my personal touch that gave the Almighty Bow its elegant and majestic design.

options: Of course, the great scholar is always right.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Pfft.
Yanyan can't help but laugh at your banter, and then quickly tries to compose herself. Du Ruo bends down and hands over the comical drawing to Yanyan seriously.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Stop frowning. Yanyan, you did very well. You are not lesser than your predecessor.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Oh, and let me tell you a secret. "The Great Seer" couldn't even swim at your age, and she nearly drowned herself once.

speaker: Yanyan
content: No way! Really? Even I can...

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...No, I don't believe it. Chief said Du Ruo is a liar.
Before Du Ruo turns to you, you quickly look away to avoid her gaze.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I've seen the power of the Great Seer myself. That's the power that created the Almighty Bow and defeated the Sun Crow. She was not as weak as you made it sound like, unlike me...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: She was no different than you. That fool also had to work hard to look cool in front of you.
Though Du Ruo's tone is mocking, her expression softens a bit.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: She traveled, studied, practiced, faced doubts, asked stupid questions, and got back up every time she fell. That's how she became skillful in channeling, saw through the unknown, and lent her force to the people.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: To combat the aquatic dragon, she spent three months practicing in the lake. She finally learned how to swim when she choked on water for the umpteenth time.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Now, do you still think the Great Seer is untouchable?
Yanyan looks up at Du Ruo, her eyes filled with curiosity, surprise, and confusion.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Um, regardless, Yanyan's ultimate enemy is the Sun Crow. I know how terrifying that creature is. Can I really do it in so little time...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Of course not, if you try to do it all by yourself.
Yanyan looks puzzled as Du Ruo knocks her on the forehead again.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The Sun Shot wasn't the effort of a single person, but one with the support of many people. The seer gathered everyone's strength to accomplish the feat of shooting down the suns.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Where can I find these people?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Why don't you take a look behind you?
[Chief's portrait]
It's a bit sudden. Yanyan still seems confused when she looks at you, but Du Ruo's smile already tells you what to do.

options: Let me take you to meet them.

content: You take Yanyan's hand and walk out of the break room. In the MBCC's narrow corridor, Nightingale and the FAC soldiers are on standby.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: I... I'm looking for you guys! The FAC has roughly pinpointed the Apostle's location. We can soon proceed with the Sun Shot.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The MBCC is also done deploying the guards. They're ready to assist Chief and the envoys on the operation anytime.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: The research institute speculates that the Apostle is currently in a dormant state. If needed, we can dispatch unmanned armor to buy you some time... Ambassador Yanyan, why are your eyes so red?
He turns and punches his comrade on the helmet.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Didn't I tell you to treat her nicely? It must be you who made her cry. Apologize now!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I... I'm alright! Thank you so much, Mr. White Armor, and everyone in the Bureau! I...

speaker: Yanyan
content: I'm going to rest well, sleep hard, and eat properly, so I can complete the Sun Shot perfectly!
<size=40>One day later</size>

In the late night at the Bureau, Yanyan once again takes out that sketch of the original Almighty Bow and examines it carefully before tucking it back into her pocket. She takes a deep breath and stands in front of you and Du Ruo.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I'm ready! I've memorized the Sun Shot procedures Du Ruo has taught me! My belly is full, and I've had plenty of sleep! Compass, slingshot, magnifying glass all in place, and also...
She raises the Almighty Bow in her hands high in the air.

speaker: Yanyan
content: With you and everyone from DisCity by Yanyan's side, the Sun Shot must be a huge success tomorrow!
The new engravings on the Almighty Bow emit a faint golden light, shining upon the entire break room with its gentle warmth unlike the scorching sun.
You smile as you bid farewell to everyone, and return to your office by yourself.
The Almighty Bow and the myth are the child's most sincere beliefs. You trust Yanyan's intentions, but the elusive heat inside your body is still warning you.
The Sun Crow is a special and powerful Apostle of Ashes. Can it really be defeated... by such juvenile sorcery and a mere bow?
The Ring Research Institute's analysis report arrives at the MBCC.

BR-002 ruins, Fusang Branch. A substance in between Mania Crystal and Ash Crystal with a significant mental resonance effect. BR-001 ruins, String of East Sea. Another unique Mania creature parasitizing the body of the Sun Crow's kin. While it's virtually non-aggressive toward humans, it has a strong instinct to corrode the Sun Crow. BR-004 ruins, Mystic Fletching. Confirmed to possess some mental characteristics of Mania creatures. A mythological Wraith Spirit that resonates strongly with seers... Is it the Sun Crow's kin, or...

Compared to the Three Calamities seven years ago, the anomalies here are more pronounced. Is it the influence of the Black Rings? I need more information on the Black Rings to confirm the connection between them and the Apostle. I submitted an application through the MBCC, but as expected, it was rejected.
Time is running out...
Returning to this dream, you no longer feel surprised or afraid.

The familiar figure stands quietly in front of you, seemingly waiting for your arrival. Her figure coincides with that of the woman who became the Apostle. But stripped of the red feathers, she appears surprisingly human-like.
A narrow river flows between you two, its rushing waters emphasizing the silence in the air.
You step forward but fail to get closer after walking for a long while. The river and the woman maintain a fixed distance from you.
So you stop.

options: Is this a psychic dream of the Sun Crow?

content: Yanyan and I have both dreamed of you, and we've both made contact with the Sun Crow... Are you related to the Sun Crow?
When Yanyan was bewitched by the Sun Crow, why were you the one to alert me?

The woman on the opposite bank doesn't respond directly. You seem to see her lips move slightly, but the vague movements form no coherent sentences, or perhaps it's a foreign language you don't understand. You move closer to her.
Are you the previous seer who sealed the Sun Crow, according to Yanyan?
Where are you physically?
Why do you keep coming into my dreams? Are you trying to tell me something?
She tilts her head, clearly hearing your words. But the river's currents grow more intense, widening the gap between you, and the surging waters drown out her voice.
Finally, when you try to step forward again, you touch the river. The currents suddenly turn into flames of Mania. It's not water, but boiling lava swallowing you.
The heat is melting your perception, so you reach forward instinctively. The answer is right before you, but the figure is slowly blurring.
Stop pushing yourself too hard, you fool.
Once again, you see the familiar ceiling of the break room, drenched in cold sweat. Smoke curls by your bedside and the woman is staring at you. This time though, her gaze shows genuine concern.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Hello, for the third time.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Because I know how dangerous it is for the shackles to come into contact with the Sun Crow. I've been keeping an eye on you since you came back from the square.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: I'm more careful than a certain someone who never learns their lessons and insists on taking risks.
She reaches out to wipe the sweat from your forehead. The white smoke from the incense burner rises about you, quickly bringing your temperature back to normal.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: You looked like you were having a hard time. What happened?

options: ...I think I dreamed of the Great Seer.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is the fourth time, maybe more. Since the Sun Crow appeared and the shackles came into contact with it, I've been dreaming of that woman, in an inferno of Mania fire.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I thought it was a fever dream, a side effect of the Sun Crow's contamination. But when Yanyan got corrupted, it was the woman who alerted me in my dream.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She told me to act immediately, to protect Yanyan from that monster.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think it's more than just a dream. What exactly is this?
Du Ruo listens and falls into a long silence. Just as you're about to speak again, she shows a smile that seems somewhat forced.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Why did you tell me about your dream? I haven't been completely honest with you yet. Isn't it too early to trust me?
She reaches out to feel your forehead again to make sure you're not delirious from the fever.
You realize she's changing the subject.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't understand your myths and can't grasp any principles behind them. It makes me uneasy. I want answers from a scholar.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can see things I can't and understand their underlying meanings. If it's the great scholar's job to educate the public, then enlighten me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I want to know what exactly the Sun Shot is and what happened seven years ago.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: ...What you're prying into is Outland intelligence. As an affiliate of the 9th Agency, you should understand that some secrets are meant to be kept.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: That said, I can tell you a bedtime story from Eastia. It's a legend about a legend.
She's never sounded so gentle and sincere before. It could just be the illusion of comfort created by the incense, but you nod in agreement.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Not that long ago, in the faraway Eastia, natural disasters and evil spirits ran rampant. A seer with great psychic power was born in a small town.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: In Sinner terms, the nature of her Mania was likely very similar to that of the Apostle of Ashes and they resonated easily, so it looked like she was channeling the creature.
Why is she making theories about the plot of a story? Is this also a habit of scholars?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: But unlike Yanyan, her psychic power only made her see the cruel reality. The Sun Crow was so powerful and humanity so insignificant, and the disparity left no chance of victory. She couldn't escape from this fact, nor could she ignore the prayers sent her way by her believers.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: What on earth is happening? How should humanity move forward? Is there any hope of salvation ahead?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: She couldn't answer these questions, because the honest answers would crush the already suffering people. And a seer must bring people hope, a convincing hope.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: So she found the legends that had been passed down for millennia on the continent and modified them to fit the current disasters into the narrative... and made up a hopeful ending.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: She convinced everyone that the gods were merciful and a hero would be reborn into the world. If everyone just did their best and persevered a day longer, a year longer, as long as everyone had hope and acted accordingly, they would eventually see the dawn.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Just like you're good at pacifying kids with lies, she was also good at motivating people with her made-up fairy tales.
Why must she drag you into this? But you suppress the urge to retort and continue listening to her.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: But it was nothing more than a placebo. The real Sun Crow came fiercely and suddenly. There were no preordained omens from the myths, no poisonous trees, no floods or Wraith Spirits, only countless suns in the sky scorching the earth and terrorizing all living things.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: None of the magical rituals proved effective. The flimsy lies of hope were immediately exposed and the mythical fantasy collapsed. Everyone finally came to the realization that there was no Sun Shooter to save them.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: ...Except for the seer herself who witnessed the truth first.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Had she told the lies too many times that she convinced even herself of it? Or was she too stubborn to admit her failure? No one knows. But she held on to that ridiculous myth till the very end.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Alone, the seer stepped onto the charred earth, facing the Sun Crow and the countless suns behind it, and then...
She didn't continue. You see a rare sadness in the scholar's eyes.

options: The seer never came back, did she?

content: She shakes her head.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: After that, things changed.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: On the land covered by the Sun Crow's fire, poisonous trees sprouted in one place, floods rose in another, and Wraith Spirits appeared in yet another place.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The countless suns in the sky gradually disappeared and merged, turning into what the myth described. Nine suns, plus the Sun Crow. Ten in total.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: And some curious folks ventured deep into the Three Calamities following the myths, and actually retrieved three treasures. They crafted a bow and an arrow, and brought a person who had adamant faith in her. That person drew the bow and shot at the Sun Crow, and then...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The myth came true.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The disaster of the ten scorching suns ended, and the Sun Crow was sealed. The story made up by the seer spread across the whole Eastia and became everyone's belief. That's the myth of the Sun Shot.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The end. Do you like this story, Chief?

options: Is the person in our dreams the seer in the story?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yanyan's predecessor, the seer who stopped the natural disasters, left behind the bow-making instructions, and made the myth come true... She is still guiding her successor even now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She is the source of your confidence in the so-called myth. Both the seal and the Almighty Bow are related to her. Yanyan is also chasing after her. Even this disaster is echoing the myth...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The bow-crafting and the Sun Shot are both rituals to connect with her, or to gain her power. This powerful Sinner is the real key to sealing the Sun Crow, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: An S-Class Sinner... No, even an S-Class couldn't achieve this or directly confront an Apostle of Ashes. There's something more to this. Where is she now?
You're thinking seriously when you hear Du Ruo's usual teasing tone.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Come on, don't take it too seriously. It's just a story. You wouldn't believe in that kind of tale, would you?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: This is only a legend about a legend. Eastia is no land of barbaric superstitions. A single person's deeds couldn't possibly reshape the entire continent's way of thinking in just seven years.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: In fact, after the fall of the Perishing Star, the first psychics whose power awoke due to the disasters rose to power and held the sole right to interpret the calamities, using the myths as a political tool. They were only overthrown by seers of the following generations much later.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: You see, real history is boring and cruel. And myths are the dose of romantic comfort we need.

options: So you don't believe in myths and worship no gods.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you don't believe your own people can defeat the Sun Crow, why come with them?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Because I do.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Seven years ago, I was in Sunset Town. I fought in the battle and witnessed the Sun Crow being sealed with my own eyes. This is the truth, which I will forever remember.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: As for those truths buried by myths, and those discrepancies that still lack explanations... Well, scholars dedicate their lives to pursuing them.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: I should stop talking before I reveal actual secrets of my city. The envoys will be watching me.
She picks up the incense burner, and the calming exotic fragrance grows stronger. Powerful drowsiness overcomes you.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: It's getting late. Tomorrow is a big day, so let's get some sleep. Be patient. We'll all know the answer soon enough.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: What I failed to understand seven years ago, I'll see it through this time with you here...
Your eyelids struggle to stay open. Drowsy, you can still see Du Ruo sitting by your bed. You think she's holding your hand the whole time, stabilizing your body temperature with her soothing power.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Sleep now, I'll be here with you. Sweet dreams...
You hear the lingering sentence right before you fall into slumber.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: ...We'll know the answer tomorrow.
It's the same figure again. But this time there are no scorching flames, and the atmosphere is peaceful. You can see the woman in front of you more clearly than before.
You can't make out her face, but you can feel her smile.
Thank you... It's all up to you now.
...Everything will be fine...
Did she smile at you? You can't see clearly. All you know is that...
This has been one of the rare peaceful dreams in recent days.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: The Sun Crow has been driven to the designated coordinates. The armored units have finished clearing out the scattered Corruptors. The drones are retreating to a safe location. The vanguard troops are ready to move out at any time!

In the desert thirteen kilometers away from the DisSea, the FAC have set up a temporary base and are waiting for the next move. Next to them, the Eastian envoys have formed a circle. The Sinners known as sealers are gathering their power, patterned green light gradually falling into a sorcerous formation.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Are you still clear about our strategy?

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Sure. The FAC will corner the Sun Crow into the sorcery with firepower, then we will do our best to restrain it, opening up a chance for the seer to perform the Sun Shot.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Good. Just don't get cold feet and mess things up later. The FAC has poured a huge amount of resources into this operation, so your silly myth better be useful. Don't waste our Hypercubes.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Waste? You saw with your own eyes how effective the Eastian sorcery has been for suppressing the Sun Crow. How about you count how many Hypercubes we've saved you and send them back to us in Eastia?

The two sides seem to have grown more irritable with each other in the past few days. You seldom see that officer snap like that, and even the Eastian ambassador has lost his composure. You turn your head and whisper to Du Ruo.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Should we say something?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Heh, let them be. That's the conversation style they've acquired after quarreling through all the meetings. They're just having a friendly exchange now.
Mania intensification will stop completely in a shackled Sinner. Not even contact with contamination will result in corruption.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: How are the things I asked the FAC to do going?

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: You mean the rituals? It's all done. We've set up altars in the busiest places.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: But... will it work? Most passersby simply laugh at it.
According to the method used in Eastia seven years ago, the envoys requested to place the leftover bow materials in different corners of the city, calling it a "ritual of faith".

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Let's give it a try. Consider it a small experiment to verify my guess...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Next, I'll just count on you guys.
You and Yanyan observe the Sun Crow's movements from behind cover.
This is the best vantage point, the optimal location for the Sun Shot calculated by Yanyan with her compass.
In the distance, white armored units form a horizontal line under the huge wings of the dormant Apostle, poised to strike.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Once the FAC open fire and drive the Sun Crow Apostle into the sorcery, that's our chance. We've only got one arrow. You got this, just try to remember how much you've practiced!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Once the FAC open fire and draw the Sun Crow's attention, complete the Sun Shot immediately.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Roger that! Du Ruo has already made me learn everything by heart.
Arrow on string, the young Sun Shooter is ready to draw the bow. On the other end of the shackles, you can feel Yanyan's M-value fluttering.

speaker: Yanyan
content: You bet! I'm soooooo nervous!

speaker: Yanyan
content: But for those vanished cities, for my predecessors who sacrificed their lives, and for those who believe in the myth... I must do it no matter how nervous I am!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Breathe in, breathe out... You can do it, Yanyan... Du Ruo said I've worked hard, and I'm not alone. There are many others backing me up!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I must accomplish the mission the Great Seer entrusted to me. Never let the ten suns descend upon the world again!
She gives herself a pep talk, then turns and smiles at you. Under the blinding sun, for an instant, the way Yanyan turns her head back reminds you of the woman in your dreams.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We'll get things ready for you.
Immediately, you hear a distant chant. Patterned green light shines and covers the entire battlefield.
You turn back to find the sealers casting spells in a formation. Among them, Du Ruo signs to you: Good luck.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Sun Crow image confirmed. Operation begins. FAC, fire!
At the command, the FAC armored vehicles fire together, meeting the fiery bird head-on.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The Apostle is driven back to the target point. Eastia, now's your chance!

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...Begin the ritual. Let's end this!

speaker: Sun Crow Apostle
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Grrrr!!!</color>
The Apostle sweeps past the sorcery, briefly entangled in the rising green light, revealing its weakness momentarily.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I——got——it!

The girl exerts all her strength to draw the bow to its limit, entwined by the contamination overflowing from the bow. Hearing your shout, she lets go, and the arrow flies off the string instantly. Having fulfilled its task, the Almighty Bow loses all its flames and turns into ashes in Yanyan's hands.

The arrow turns into a beam of light in a split second. Its fletching becomes flames and propels it straight toward the Sun Crow's chest. At that moment, no one can doubt that this is indeed the blessed Almighty Bow.
The moment the arrow hits the Sun Crow, flames explode and a wave of heat sweeps up dust across the battlefield. You pull Yanyan into cover, but she's eager to peek outside.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Did it work?!
The battlefield is filled only with blazing flames. No one can see clearly what's happening in the center of the fire.
The FAC dare not stop firing, and the sorcery is holding out laboriously. Everyone is holding their breath, waiting for the changes after the Sun Crow is hit by the arrow.
The battlefield is eerily quiet despite the tens of thousands of people there... until a piercing scream penetrates everyone's eardrums.

speaker: Sun Crow Apostle
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Grrrr!!!</color>

The giant bird suddenly leaps up from the fire, flapping its wings. With a screech, a massive force gathers into a sound wave that instantly disperses the flames and knocks back several rows of soldiers beneath it.
You clearly see the bent arrow still stuck in the Apostle's body. It indeed briefly suppressed the Sun Crow, but it has been quickly consumed by the flames.
Enraged, the Sun Crow is seeking its attacker vindictively. Its body is swelling, and the distant DisSea rumbles in response. The surrounding temperature is rising continuously.

speaker: Yanyan
content: No, it shouldn't be like this... The Almighty Bow is supposed to seal the Sun Crow with a single arrow. That should have done it.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Am I not powerful enough?
She pauses for a moment, then stands up again.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Where's the bow? Let me try again! No, we need to make another one. Quick, I...

speaker: FAC Officer
content: You've done a good enough job. Now go take cover. We'll take over from here and eliminate this monster!

The Hypercube barrier's blue light covers the sorcery's green light, forming a shield that the monster fails to break through several times. It lands with a thunderous crash and curls its flames into a ball, then simply remains still like that as if gathering strength for the next attack.
To everyone's surprise, it suddenly lifts its head and caws. The flames leap up one last time before vanishing with its feathers and wings, and its enormous body begins to shrink.
...And gradually condenses into a figure covered with Mania at the center of the scorched earth.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: What?!

speaker: Shadow in the Fire
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Grrrr!!!</color>
The patterned green light and blue barrier quickly surround it. As soon as you see that person's appearance, your head suddenly throbs with pain.
Corruptor-like limbs, magma-cracked skin, body covered in fiery feathers, tainted mask, golden eye... You've seen her before.

speaker: Yanyan
content: <size=32>...Great Seer?</size>
You hear a soft call. The Eastian envoys seem stunned too. Du Ruo looks at the center of the battlefield, her expression dark and elusive.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Is that... a human? No, it's a Sinner, one fused with the Apostle of Ashes.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: No wonder none of the alarms was triggered. In this form...
The woman is easily bound by the sorcery. She makes a sound like a mournful cry, as if her power has been restrained.
Although she looks the same as in your dream, the groveling figure with the piercing gaze doesn't seem human at all now, the golden eye burning with fury and ferocity.
Just as everyone is shocked, a new troop enters from the rear in single file.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: From now on, we're temporarily taking over here.
They surround the envoys, and in the rear of the formation, a Schorl floats into the battlefield. The Sun Crow is suppressed with its true form revealed. They seem very satisfied with this outcome.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: That is neither the Apostle of Ashes nor the mythical Sun Crow in your legends. It is a Sinner, or one of your revered Eastian seers, if you will.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: Explain, ambassador. Why did your Great Seer bring the Apostle of Ashes into DisCity?

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: Explain, ambassador. Why did your Great Seer bring the Apostle of Ashes into DisCity?
The crowd splits into two factions, confronting each other. Among them, the Great Seer lying on the ground makes a timely wail, dragging traces of Mania contamination on the earth.
Her voice carries a chilling echo, not belonging to any language, but more like a monster's growl.
The Eastian sealer immediately turns away, face full of pity.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: She was the former seer with powerful psychic skills, capable of communicating with Wraith Spirits and all things. She recreated the Almighty Bow and was the greatest contributor in the Sun Shot battle seven years ago.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: But this right here... She is no longer herself.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Seven years ago, she invaded the Sun Crow's consciousness through channeling and suppressed the monster until others shot it and completed the sealing. But the Great Seer herself was also consumed by the Sun Crow after overexerting her power.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: She left the Ode to Sun as her last words... to remind us that her spirit would always be with us, always fighting against the Sun Crow.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Should the seal be broken and the Sun Crow returned, by heeding her advice, crafting the Almighty Bow, and having the most steadfast believer shoot at the sun, we could rouse the Great Seer's last sliver of power to complete the sealing again.
But the Great Seer before you clearly cannot fulfill this grand promise, for she seems to have lost all sense of self.
Du Ruo's expression is cold. She's focused on the sorcery at hand, seemingly lost in thought.
But some of the people here still refuse to sympathize with this tragic tale.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: The Great Seer of Eastia, she's a self-awakened Sinner, right?

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: You mean to say that a mere Sinner could suppress the Apostle of Ashes without the shackles?

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: It's true. The Great Seer indeed had such power, and she did it!

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: What are you doubting? We've committed no crime. You have no right to interrogate us.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: We may not have your Hypercubes, but Sunsink City, no... the East too has collectively stood firm under the calamity for a century. We rely on our own sorcery and have endured great sacrifices.
Schorl hovers quietly. After a long while, the flat synthetic voice speaks.

speaker: Schorl
content: You said before that until the Almighty Bow was made, the envoys would subdue the Sun Crow with Eastian sealing sorcery to delay its assault on the DisSea.

speaker: Schorl
content: Sealing sorcery... Sorcery... Mania manipulation...

speaker: Schorl
content: We have seen the Underground use similar forbidden technology as well.

speaker: Schorl
content: It's a dangerous theory that exists beyond science, in which specific Mania-infected humans manipulate Mania and the power of contamination. Our enemies use it to spread contamination and expand the Black Rings, constantly seeking to subvert this city.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...What are you implying?

speaker: Schorl
content: You claim it's a sorcery to weaken the Sun Crow, but is there any proof? Can you prove that your sorcery isn't meant to strengthen the Sun Crow and destroy our city?

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Nonsense! We have no connections with your enemies! Are you trying to extort Eastia's sorcery and steal our core technology with this pretext?

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: According to the border law, DisCity has no right to do this!

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: When the safety of the city is threatened, we have every right to take action.
You make to step forward, but one of your colleagues from the 9th Agency holds you back by the shoulder.

speaker: 9th Agency Operative
content: This is all normal, Chief. The conflict is inherent, otherwise, the envoys wouldn't have so many secrets.

speaker: 9th Agency Operative
content: DisCity is the only source of Hypercubes, and there are constant attempts to infiltrate and replace us. The spies targeted by the 9th Agency have already filled the archives. The tragic incidents they have led to in the past were way more intense.

speaker: 9th Agency Operative
content: You're an honest person, Chief, but honesty does not exist between two cities, especially after BR-002, with new mines and resources entering the game. In places you can't see, all major Outland forces lurking in the city have long been itching to move.

speaker: 9th Agency Operative
content: If you truly believe in Eastia, now is their chance to prove their innocence.
Yanyan has been protected by you since the Sun Shot. She's clearly startled by this sudden situation, instinctively clutching your sleeve and speaking with a trembling voice.

speaker: Yanyan
content: No, we really don't mean any harm. The failure of the Sun Shot wasn't intentional... It's Yanyan's fault. Yanyan didn't explain the myth clearly, and I'm not powerful enough to complete the Sun Shot.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Let me try again. I'll make sure to do it right this time.
Yanyan's eyes are red, to which the DisCity officials only respond with annoyance.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: Why is this child still here? Stop using her as a decoy. We've seen through your intentions long ago.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: The Sun Crow is a monster released by Eastia. You can't take on DisCity yourselves, so you fused the Apostle of Ashes into the Sinner to break through the FAC's Apostle monitoring network. You let this monster into the DisSea to cause disasters and wreck our city.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: All those foolish superstitious rituals are just smoke screens to distract us!
He raises his hand, and the guards all aim their guns at the delegation.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...We endured a long harsh journey to come here expecting the distrust, but not a despicable trap like this. Haha...

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: It's only natural for DisCity to doubt our good intentions... Knowing what you've done in the past, you must not be able to believe we would repay you with kindness.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Calm down, ambassador. Focus on maintaining the sorcery. Now is not the time to be distracted. Don't waste your energy on reasoning with them.
But her words have little effect. The heat, the Mania, and years of suppressed doubt and anger have overpowered the ambassador's rational thinking.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: The center of the world, the frontline against Mania, haha... Now that we're here, we finally understand what you are.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: In N.F. 106, BR-003 broke out, and the drought of the ten suns almost burned down Sunset Town. We exhausted our resources and sacrificed many lives to suppress the Sun Crow.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: In N.F. 112, BR-004 broke out. On the same day, Eastia was hit by catastrophic natural disasters. Haha, that's right, that's the Sinking of Eastia you guys like to joke about.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: We'd barely rebuilt Sunsink City when you brought the riots upon yourselves and triggered BR-002. That's why the Sun Crow suddenly broke its seal and went out of control.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: No wonder you always cover up the news about the Black Rings. Under the Perishing Star, every Black Ring is connected to the source of Mania, and each one could affect the whole world. It's all your fault.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Eastia sent the Sun Crow Apostle to invade DisCity? You are the ones forcing the whole world to suffer the consequences of your own deeds! And yet you're trying to smear us?!

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: And you dare probe for intelligence behind our back... This is blatant espionage. Arrest them!

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: You have all the time to explain yourselves in the interrogation room. You won't be leaving DisCity ever again!

The Eastian envoy is furious with indignation. The patterned light of the sorcery beside him flickers and shatters, and the temperature rises again. But besides you, the only person who notices this is...
That monster.

options: Stop it! The Sun Crow is still here...

content: You want to stop the infighting, but the situation escalates quickly. The Apostle, previously groveling and suppressed by the sorcery and the Hypercube field, seizes the opportunity to strike back.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Mmph...!

Yanyan clutches her head and falls to the ground. Just like a few days ago, the consciousness of the Sun Crow Apostle contaminates the girl's mind again. You and she are impacted almost at the same time.

speaker: Guard
content: The M-value is skyrocketing! A high-intensity Mania entity is activating!

It instantly sheds its weak and pitiful human disguise, inflating and spreading its massive wings of black flames. This time, it completely breaks through everything binding it, soaring and screeching. Contamination falls upon the entire battlefield like boiling rain.
And the only people left unscathed are...
A mass of dark flames envelops the Eastians, turning into broken wings that ward off the descending Mania contamination.
Strangely, this pitiful, barely human figure seems more like the person who invaded your dreams than the woman the Sun Crow just transformed into.

Even though protected by the black flames, Du Ruo's incense burner still cracks slowly, and the sorcerous formation has been broken. She opens her eyes slightly to see the blazing dark flames and the fierce fiery bird beside her.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Even though you've become like this, it's still in your instincts to protect your kin?
The Eastian sealers look at the atrocious Mania flames, then at the crumbling sorcery. Their faces turn pale.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: I let my anger get the better of me... Because of me, the sorcery...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: It can't be helped. You've journeyed far and have been staying up for nights to maintain the sorcery. Your mind has reached its limits and couldn't resist that kind of provocation.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: ...What's done is done. There's no need to blame yourself. Let's just say it was meant to be.

The dazed DisCity representative's expression is a mixture of emotions, looking both terrified and smugly satisfied that his suspicions were confirmed. Despite the impending danger, his gaze remains firmly on the envoys.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: ...That monster is protecting them.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: See, they are in league with that thing. How dare you try to destroy DisCity with the Apostle of Ashes?!

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: Your sorcery won't last long. Surrender immediately!
The scholar looks around at the guards encircling her, then at the haughty DisCity representative, and toward Schorl. Looking surprisingly serene, she smiles.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Let's not waste time on mind games when a disaster is about to end us. I'll explain in terms you DisCity gentlemen can understand.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Apostles of Ashes are products of concentrated Mania, a material projection of collective consciousness. They manifest themselves in this world, in the forms of disasters and Wraith Beasts.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Hypercubes don't exist in Eastia. Facing the Apostle, people could only rely on their faith in the Sun Shot legend. In other words, they were fighting the product of collective will with their collective will.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: When the Great Seer crafted the Almighty Bow, she was activating this immense spiritual power. No matter how many times she failed, she always had that faith. This, Yanyan is surely capable of.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Our problem is not that the Sun Shooter is not powerful enough, but that...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: A single droplet makes no ocean. A sole tree forms no forest. Here and now, in this foreign land, no one shares our belief.
Suddenly, the giant bird cries out in the sky, breaking through all defenses and heading straight for the DisSea.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: City-wide temperatures are rising quickly. M-values of the three major Black Ring ruins are surging. The defense forces have requested urgent reinforcements.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: The Apostle of Ashes is confirmed to be attacking the DisSea defense line. The range of fluctuations is expanding. The Black Rings are showing city-wide fluctuations.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: Level S+ crisis response initiated. I repeat, level S+ crisis response initiated!

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: ...What's happening? Is that Apostle really so powerful...?

Approaching the boundary of BR-000, at the end of the Broken Frontline, the Sun Crow's flames already cover nearly half the sky. It's attacking humanity's last barrier ceaselessly. The FAC grapple with it while regrouping.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...The DisSea is boiling. The Apostle of Ashes is resonating with the Black Rings and amplifying its power. Is this a result of the Eastian sorcery breaking?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Reinforce the Broken Frontline and stop the Sun Crow. We must hold on by ourselves this time! It must not enter the DisSea!
The DisSea boils in resonance with the Apostle of Ashes. The sky is dyed red and the temperature is rising continuously. The air is filled with uncontrollable Mania, distorting your vision.
You see the three major Black Ring ruins flare up simultaneously, fiery pollution spurting outward. Your body burns like never before, and in a daze, all you see is...
The crimson sky catches fire slowly. The sun casts huge halos, the overlapping part growing brighter, until... they become blazing new suns.

speaker: Indifferent Female Voice
content: The sun deformed, demise befell; hills burned and charred, lives ebbed and fell.

speaker: Indifferent Female Voice
content: Ten suns in sky, lest crops survived. O hero's soul, when shall thou show?
On the chaotic battlefield, a figure walks up to you reciting a poem, and takes Yanyan from your nearly exhausted embrace.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: This is all we can do. Next...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Since DisCity doesn't believe in myths, fight in your own way then.
She doesn't stop at your call. But before she goes, you see a wave of the delicate fabric leaving a wisp of protective smoke around you.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: BR-002's afterimage is expanding abnormally. Highly contaminated crystalline substances are occurring, producing a massive amount of Mania radiation confirmed to significantly affect the surrounding civilians.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: Currently, the civilian forces of West District are assisting in evacuating the population, but the threat remains.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: The Sun Crow Apostle is possibly reaching the crowd through radiation to gain power by absorbing Mania. Please stop it as soon as possible!
The sudden disaster has caught West District off guard. People who are mildly infected with Mania are subject to stronger radiation, which drags them into fear, despair, and even madness.
The Executive Committee is aiding the evacuation, but not enough Executive Officers can be deployed within such a short time, so the people are mostly left to their own devices.
And in this process, more and more people are affected.

speaker: Greta
content: ...Ugh, so hot. My head hurts... Why do I hear birds chirping in my head?

speaker: Greta
content: Our Black Ring is in trouble again? Have ${PlayerName} and Yanyan come back?
He supports himself with the wall and walks outside, then looks up to see the afterimage of the collapsed High Tower Black Ring gradually expanding and branching out.

speaker: Greta
content: Is that... a tree?
He can clearly see the branch producing a strange crystal, very similar to what Yanyan and ${PlayerName} were carefully collecting.
The entire afterimage of the Black Ring looks like a sky-reaching tree or a terrifying antenna, visible to every West District resident.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: Contamination is spilling out of the Rust. Native Corruptors are spreading out and constantly threatening the isolation belt of the Rust.

speaker: FAC Alert
content: They have inherited many traits of the Sun Crow Apostle and are highly aggressive. To ensure the safety of both sides of the city, please spread out the defenses and rescue those who are in danger.

speaker: Scavenger A
content: What, monsters again?! Quick, call that Chief of the M-B-... something. He said to tell him immediately if anything happens... Ah!
female_content: What, monsters again?! Quick, call that Chief of the M-B-... something. She said to tell her immediately if anything happens... Ah!

content: A fissure suddenly opens up in front of him and contamination gushes out toward his waist. If not for a companion pulling him back in time, he would have been  trapped in contamination.

speaker: Scavenger B
content: This is way worse than the first time! Forget about the phone call, hide quickly!

Scavengers gather at the FAC's makeshift evacuation point on a raised area. Their sight is filled with surging contamination spilling from the carnival ruins, from which grotesque creatures are emerging.
Advancing against the waves of monsters are FAC warriors in white armor. They aim to repair the base near BR-001, but facing them is a constant flow of the Apostle's kin.

speaker: Scavenger A
content: What about those soldiers... What about that little girl...
FAC Sun Crow Operation Temporary Command.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The conditions of BR-001 and BR-002 ruins have been confirmed. We must focus on stopping the Sun Crow at DisSea. We're out of men. Tell the garrisons to hold on.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: What about BR-004?

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Sir, BR-004 is showing severe contamination spillage and the temperature is abnormally high. Many devices are malfunctioning, and some soldiers at the garrison are experiencing severe mental contamination.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The whole city's temperature is abnormally high! Specifically, where? How many degrees? Rate of temperature increase? Any singularities?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Search for the Sun Crow's kin or any other weird signs. We need to locate the Sun Crow quickly!
The heat has the entire troop on edge. The rampaging Apostle is attacking the Broken Frontline while constantly switching locations. This makes the FAC's defense work even more challenging.
He must admit that a part of him misses the times when those patterned green lights were still around. But currently, the battlefield doesn't afford him the leisure to ponder various what-ifs.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: The condition of BR-004 is yet to be confirmed. But the MBCC's Chief is already heading there...

speaker: FAC Officer
content: What did you say?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Dammit! Chief's shackles haven't recovered yet. Who knows what might happen if Chief gets in contact with the Apostle again? Go help them now!
Inside the Statue of Keylan

The damaged stairs aren't fully restored yet, and neither is your body. The fever makes your steps unsteady. You have to stop occasionally for a breather before resuming the climb as quickly as possible.

Having broken free and being near the DisSea, the Sun Crow Apostle has gone completely berserk. The high heat within a radius of a hundred meters from it is almost devoid of any living things. You're physically unable to get close. Nor can any normal human.
Although the FAC hasn't said anything, you know that if this continues, they'll only receive one last order: Eliminate the Sun Crow at all costs.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Chief, please stop, don't push yourself anymore. Leave the inspection work to us. What would we do if something happened to you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, even if it's risky, I must verify some things... It's a job only I can do, I'm afraid.
If all of the Three Calamities are escalating, then the Wraith Spirit must be here too. Whether it's an enemy or an ally, it's what's closest to the Sun Crow Apostle.
With this thought, you reach out to grasp the scalding doorknob to push it open.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Chief, wait! Let me open the door. Let me do it...
You fling the door open. A wave of heat hits you as countless fiery birds flap their wings in the air, screeching. The soldiers guard before you swiftly.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Please step back. You're not fit for battle right now!

options: No... Now is exactly when I need to play my part.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: What?!

You look ahead. In the center of the rooftop's inferno, amid countless specters of the mythical bird, a mass of pitch-black flames burns. It's unlike any of the Wraith Spirits around. The figure within it watches you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you the Wraith Spirit who tested Yanyan? The remnant of the Sun Crow Apostle?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or should I call you... the former Great Seer of Eastia's Sunset Town, the Sinner who invaded my consciousness through the shackles?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's been a while... Since the Sun Crow was released, I've been having a 40-degree fever, yet I didn't dream of you again. You've been corrupted by the contamination too. Does it hurt?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But regardless, I need your guidance. So, I came to see you.
Amid the intense Mania field, you summon the shackles effortlessly and take a step forward. The shadow shrieks, and suddenly, all the specters of the Wraith Spirit on the rooftop rush toward you!

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: No! Chief, don't use the shackles, you'll...

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Chief! Watch out!

He wants to protect you, but the black flames pass through the soldier's body without physical collision. However, the heat inside the armor makes him feel like he's suffering from heatstroke, and he gradually loses consciousness.
You're also having a splitting headache, but you hold on to your last bit of clarity and keep away from your comrades, taking the black flames away from their vicinity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're here because you have something to say to us.
You see the familiar golden eye and hear the same mournful whisper. Unlike in the dream, her figure is elusive and engulfed in pitch-black flames, looking even more in pain.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, I can't understand what you're saying like Yanyan does.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But since you found me through the shackles, I must also be able to... find you, right?

speaker: The Great Seer
content: <color=#dg1f1f>■■■■■■■...</color>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think I can read your mind now, somehow.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Danger! Leave!</color>

You don't back down, and the shackles advance and penetrate through whatever is ahead. The moment they touch the specter, the black flames ignite your light spikes, quickly spreading and swallowing your entire existence...
After the searing flames burn out, a desolate wilderness unfolds before you, a scene you've never seen before. Mind still hazy, you start walking.

The riverbed is dry. The earth is cracked. The sparse huts from afar look like cracked charcoal. People scatter around in twos and threes, hanging their heads in despair like the withered grass underfoot.
The sun shines in the cloudless sky, but it only reveals a scene of desolation. Compared to DisCity, this place is even more ruined, and humans seem even more powerless here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Harbinger rose, seen in east sky... All lives perished, with ten suns high...
Unconsciously, you begin reciting the poem Du Ruo read to you before. The words taste strangely dry and bitter in your mouth.

Where are you? Is it Yanyan and Du Ruo's hometown? Is this the present, or seven years ago? You ended up here after touching that apparition of the Sun Crow. Is the Sun Crow here too? Whose memory is this? Whose dream?
You wander past the scattered groups of people and find yourself glancing at their faces, perhaps in an attempt to recognize them.
To your surprise, the moment your gaze meets theirs, these blurry faces respond to you.

speaker: Disaster Victim
content: ...Great Seer?

speaker: Disaster Victim
content: It's the Great Seer! She's back! We're safe!
You're taken aback and recoil instinctively, but your body defies your thought and goes even closer, opening your arms.
You hear a woman's voice, as bright as the sunshine.

speaker: Bright Female Voice
content: Oh dear, look at you, has something been troubling you while I was away? Come and tell me all about your worries.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Where sun sank low, came where we dwelt... I'm back.
The crowd cheers as they rush over to you, and only then does the sunlight gain warmth and color, enveloping and illuminating you.

speaker: Civilian A
content: Great Seer, 'bout that nightmare of a great flood I had last time, was it really a premonition? Did ya check on my hometown?

speaker: Civilian A
content: Goodness, I'm too worried! Our town has always been prone to disasters. Should I give more offerings? I've only managed to save up a bit of grain. That enough to stop the gods' anger?

speaker: The Great Seer
content: No need. I did visit your hometown. The disaster has been resolved, thanks to the stories passed down through generations among your townsfolk.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Grand scales clanking, vast bones rumbling. Ever heard of this poem and the tale behind it?

speaker: Civilian A
content: Ah, that legend from my childhood in the village. Take a dragon's vein as bowstring and one could become a great archer and expel evil and sickness. The poem goes back to hundreds of years ago. Ya hear that whenever a child falls ill.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Exactly, and it's no lie. During my visit to your hometown, I learned a lot while fighting Wraith Fiends underwater.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Dragon's vein... What a wonderful thing! It'll definitely come in handy when fighting the Sun Crow in the future. The legends from your hometown are an important piece of the myth!

speaker: Civilian A
content: Oh! I don't remember the details, but whatever ya say must be right!

speaker: Civilian A
content: That's great! It's all thanks to your knowledge. 'S long as we can defeat the Sun Crow, we'll all be safe again.
The elderly woman cries tears of joy. Following her, a frail young man comes over.

speaker: Civilian B
content: Great Seer, I have a favor to ask. The river in my village has dried up, and at night, monsters roam everywhere. The villagers have all left over the past two years. They told me to go with them, but I...

speaker: Civilian B
content: I can't leave! My great-grandfather found that piece of blessed land after half a lifetime's search. It's been passed down through four generations. I can't abandon it!

speaker: Civilian B
content: Could ya perform a ritual to expel the evil? I don't want to leave, even if it means dying on my own land.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: I see. Even in the face of a disaster, you're still attached to your homeland and wish to respect your ancestors... I'm touched by the sincerity of your emotions. I will certainly lend you a hand.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Blessed land is always protected by immortals. The changes now could be due to some issues with the guardian spirit. Let me seek out that immortal through divination and look into the matter...
The Great Seer begins gesturing with her fingers. Soon, she falls into a daze and starts muttering to herself.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: ...Hm? Where am I? These don't look like your fields. Have I lost my way? Could this immortal be... Ahhh!
The Great Seer's eyes are still closed, but her body jolts suddenly, then begins twitching unnaturally.

speaker: Civilian B
content: Oh my! Is a deity possessing ya? May, may I ask, which divine being are ya?

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Nonsense! Divine being? Don't ya recognize me no more? I'm your great-grandfather, speaking to ya through this lass.
She jumps up all of a sudden, her face taking on a terrifying expression, and she yells...

speaker: The Great Seer
content: My child! Listen to me with your ears perked! Just... how could ya be so dumb?! Is a piece of land more important than your life? I didn't find this land for ya to just sit around waiting to die!

speaker: The Great Seer
content: I've already scouted it out for ya. 1500 miles to the southeast is Goldionville, where the climate is mild and the seasons are distinct. Take your family and neighbors and leave before the disaster strikes. Remember, home is where the people are. Ya got it?

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Also! Stop calling her Great Seer. You should call her Miss Great Seer! The lass's younger than ya by a few years. Be a gentleman! ...Oh, my time here is over. Off I go!
The "possessed" Great Seer blurts out before her eyes roll back, her body falling backward. The next second, her gaze is normal again, looking somewhat stunned.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: ...Eh? What happened? I was in a trance for a while, and I saw an old man who looked just like you. He said he wanted to borrow my voice. Did he say anything to you?

speaker: Civilian B
content: Sob... That was my great-grandfather! I remember now. He used to talk to me like that when I was a child... Great-grandpa told me to take refuge in the south. I, I'm going to move right away. I must try my best to survive.

speaker: Civilian B
content: Thank you, Great... Miss Great Seer! Thank you, Sun Crow! I'll never forget your great kindness!

speaker: The Great Seer
content: You're right, you should thank the Sun Crow, your ancestors, and yourself. Me, I am merely a messenger.

speaker: Young Scholar
content: You're spreading lies, smooth talker.
In the empty space behind the altar, a young scholar crosses her arms and stares at the Great Seer who is taking a break.

speaker: Young Scholar
content: You speak of no true oracles. You're just swindling everyone using the name of the Sun Crow. Even your so-called search for divine truths is nothing but nonsense.

speaker: Young Scholar
content: It's one thing for the people to be superstitious, but as Sunsink City's official seer and the one appointed to fight the disasters, how can you not clarify the truth and even play along with those fabricated stories? Have you no shame?

speaker: Young Scholar
content: ...No comment? I dare you to tell me your fake myth again. I will expose all of your lies.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Well, I have nothing to add because everything you said is right!

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Of course, I'm not smart enough to fool everyone. I'm simply taking inspiration from the people and giving back to them. After all, myths are a collective creation of the masses over thousands of years. I'm just doing a bit of consolidation and retelling them to make them relevant and practical in our times.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: You see, last time during the drought, everyone was too scared to even leave their homes. But once I wove my advice into the legends and performed a ritual, everyone had the courage to step outside and get to work. It surely solved many problems. Pretty cool, right?
Without disturbing her elegant air, the young scholar rolls her eyes.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Don't use reassuring the public as an excuse. In the face of disasters, the real solution can only be found by confronting reality. Yet, you're depriving the people of the courage to face the truth.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Your psychic power is strong. You're the closest to the essence of the Sun Crow and the truth of the disasters, yet you only present these lies to the masses...

speaker: The Great Seer
content: The truth, huh... The truth is a blazing fire, a sharp knife. Only heroes dare to confront it directly, but not everyone is as brave as you. The world is mostly made up of ordinary people.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: But the choices of ordinary people... can be powerful too.
Someone comes laughing and jumping. You hear a faintly familiar laugh.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Great Seer, Great Seer! I dreamed of the Wraith Spirit, that fiery bird! And I'm not terrified of it anymore! I realized it was a sign as soon as I woke up, so I ran to the kitchen, and sure enough, the stove was on fire!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Guess what? I could suddenly work magic! I was able to control the small flames! Can Yanyan become a seer too and protect Grandma?

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Of course. You have the same power as mine, and you're so diligent and honest... You'll go places and protect more people in the future.
The suns are far hotter than the Sun Crow you saw in DisCity. Ten of them... No, even more blinding suns hang in the sky, the melting heat sweeping across the land with the Sun Crow's kin.

speaker: Sealer
content: The calamity has escalated. Several allied states in Eastia have been victimized by the ten suns as well and had to abandon their cities due to the extreme heat. Something major seemed to have happened in DisCity too, cutting off trade completely. We can't import Hypercubes anymore, and our reserves are...

speaker: Sealer
content: The Sun Crow's power has grown too strong. Our sorcery and defense equipment are all rendered useless. We're no match for it. We have no choice but to abandon the city...

speaker: Sealer
content: But how should we explain this to the people? Should we admit that all the apotropaic rituals have failed us? That even the myths... can't save us?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Sob... Why is it so angry... What did we do wrong to deserve such punishment from the Sun Crow? What can we do to appease its anger?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Great Seer, can't we find instructions in the myths? Are they all... fake?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The disaster came too suddenly, even the seers are doubting the power of sorcery, and the effectiveness of the sealing formation has weakened.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: I've found a new shelter. It's a bit small, but it will sustain us for a while. We have the knowledge to find another home where we can live in peace, no matter how far and unreachable it may be.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Good, take everyone with you. You speak nothing but the truth, and everyone believes what you say. Their safety is in your hands now.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: ...You're not coming with us?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Those myths can't hold out any longer. Are you really risking your life for this? What do you plan to do this time, Xu?!
The Great Seer smiles. Having been questioned too many times before, she can easily sidestep this one with a small lie.
The people left Sunset Town, but she has stayed behind.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: I want to... tell a lie.
Finally, she is left alone.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: I am the seer of Sunset Town, who channels Wraith Spirits, all living things, and the hearts of people. My people have turned to me, demanding an answer from the world itself.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: That's why I've long foreseen it. The calamities and evil spirits are the chaotic accumulation of human emotions. The real Sun Crow may have other names, be it fear, death, vengeance, hatred...

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Whatever it's called, I cannot defy it. I cannot communicate with it, for it's a merciless and unstoppable thing. It's the dark side of human hearts. We have no way to deny it, and thus we find no escape.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: The myths are fake. There are no gods in this world. Even I don't have the heart to keep telling those blatant lies after seeing the truth.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: ...The truth is, they come from the people themselves.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: They don't care about the truth, the insignificance of man, or the inevitable end... In the face of disasters, they simply want to live on and be happy again. What they believe in is not courage, wisdom, or the truth, but their own wishes.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: They believe there are miracles in this vast world, that they can always find another place to call home.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: They believe that there are rules that govern all things, that kindness will be rewarded while evil will be punished.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: They believe that when evil spirits are rampant, a hero will be born, and that all tales of suffering can have a hopeful ending.
To the Great Seer who can channel all things, the most precious thing in this chaotic and cruel world is this undying glimmer of hope.
This belief has given her the strength to confront reality countless times.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Since that's the case...

She steps steadily into the inferno, her opulent ceremonial robe torn and burned by the flames. The threads meticulously sewn and passed down through generations which once offered her protection and blessings are now turning into ashes.
What a waste. Had she known earlier, she would have taken it off and left it for the next seer. The seers must all have been envious to see her dance in these beautiful clothes.

The bright daylight is blinding her eyes. She can no longer see. Her sense of pain is numbed. With the shrieking in her ears as accompaniment, she dances to the rhythm, reminiscing about the cheerful music her folks once played for her.

The heat and Mania gnaw at her body, and her skin bursts open like new wings. The Great Seer feels that if she spreads her wings, she'll finally be able to soar high in the sky, next to the cruel gods she's spent her whole life serving and defying.

She embraces the claws of Mania, just like how she's let the Sun Crow invade and disturb her mind countless times before. This time, she will embrace all her fears and despair. And in return, she will be the one to undermine the calamity.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Oh, revered Sun Crow, I am your seer, the one who spun tales about you every day.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Would you be so kind and play along with me one last time? I want everyone to believe that the lie has come true.
Before her consciousness fully fuses with the massive Mania, the Great Seer draws her sword and points it at the Sun Crow, smiling radiantly at the last moment of her life.

Sunset Town is destroyed by the scorching heat. The disaster-stricken people have lost their homes. The Great Seer has gone missing, and the disasters are continuing. But people begin to notice changes.
The forest of crystal is spreading, and evil entities are gathering. Power awakens in the seer of the next generation. She hears the calls of Wraith Spirits in her dreams.
Amid the chaotic and unpredictable disasters, some strange yet familiar phenomena have occurred.

speaker: Disaster Victim
content: The sky tree stood, yet world lay waste. Vile dragon flew, the Sun Crow shone... The omens all correspond perfectly to the myth. Everything the Great Seer said was true. Everything in the myth is coming true!

speaker: Disaster Victim
content: Something is suppressing the Sun Crow's power! The sorcery left by the Great Seer is also starting to work!

speaker: Yanyan
content: The Great Seer is right about everything! The myth is true! And the Almighty Bow is now ready! But where did the Great Seer go? It's time for her to shoot the sun!

speaker: Sealer
content: ...The Great Seer has already set off to the battlefield. She's entrusted us with the Sun Shot. She told us to let the person with the most adamant faith draw the bow, for the belief of the archer will unleash the true power of the Almighty Bow.

speaker: Sealer
content: The archer must believe... that this arrow can settle the calamity.

speaker: Young Scholar
content: ...Give me the bow. I'll do it.

speaker: Young Scholar
content: No one has more faith in that liar than I do.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Seers chanted, demons reveled.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: The end was near, the way back long.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: With rite and bow, revered fate must hold.

speaker: The Great Seer
content: Where sun sank low, my heart finds home...
Opening your eyes, you return to reality. You find yourself surrounded by a crowd, their faces stiff with concern and worry.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Ah... You're finally awake... Chief, your bravery can be frightening sometimes. Please prioritize your safety. You're too important to suffer any mishap.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'm sorry.
Indeed, they have stressed this countless times before: Take care of yourself. The FAC will protect this city without you needing to risk your life.

You spread your palm that has reached out to that creature with the shackles. Quietly lying in your hand is an arrowhead burned with flames. This is the last trace that proves the person in the dream truly existed.
Meanwhile, the call connects.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the decoding is complete. Ambassador Du Ruo indeed left behind a considerable amount of research material, some of which seems to be... specially prepared for you.

options: Got it, I'll be right back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Du Ruo said she's waiting for a missing piece in DisCity. I have to find the final truth for her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Compile all the information Du Ruo accessed at the Bureau while Yanyan and I were away, including all the texts she left behind. I need all the clues.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The power of the Sun Shot first came from the myths believed by the people of the East. I'm sure there is something in DisCity that's worth everybody's faith.

In the uninhabited part of WhiteSands on the border of DisCity, the envoys are regrouping after evading all of their pursuers. From this position, they happen to be able to get a full view of DisCity.
Under the calamity, the most prosperous city is now enduring new trials.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Despite the despicable minority, most people there are innocent. They shouldn't have to suffer this kind of catastrophe... No one should.
But there's nothing more they can do now.
This is the third time they've witnessed the fall of a city. Perhaps they should have gotten used to these tragedies, to their own powerlessness and resignation, and to this grievance.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: The Almighty Bow is gone, and Xu has become that thing we saw... Since the people of DisCity don't believe in myths, the myths have no power to save them.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: We have no more reason to stay. It's time to go.
In the distance, they can see the densely packed army and armor gathering in the DisSea. This time, Paradeisos is utilizing firepower several times stronger than in the Sun Shot operation.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: ...Let's hear from the seer. Yanyan, shall we go?
She looks at the girl sitting with her arms around her knees gazing into the distance, but she doesn't look back at Du Ruo.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...You're a liar, Du Ruo.
Yanyan sits alone. Du Ruo has already used her ability to reduce her fever, but the girl still looks sullen with red eyes.

speaker: Yanyan
content: You knew all along that the Sun Shot would fail. If you had told us earlier...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: I'm sorry. I'll admit I tell lies pretty often, but when it comes to the truth about the myth and whether the Sun Shot is real... No one could be sure until the very last moment.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: If it weren't for your continuous efforts, I wouldn't have been able to weed out the obstruction and prove my guess.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Sorry it took me so long to decode everything. You see, I don't know all the things in the world after all. Will you forgive me?
She squats down, takes Yanyan's hand, and pats her head.
The girl's eyes turn red.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Will DisCity really be ruined by the Sun Crow? Just like Sunset Town... and many other cities in Eastia?

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Can't we do something more for them? Must we go now?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Even if this place isn't our homeland, even if many here mock you, you still want to help them?

speaker: Yanyan
content: I do! This place is also the home of those reliable big guys in white armor, those helpful folks at the Drifter Camp, the old man at the Rust who told me about the future of the amusement park, and Chief who accompanied me everywhere.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Not just them, there are so many people here striving to live, just like in Sunset Town and Eastia.

speaker: Yanyan
content: We've suffered that kind of torment ourselves, that's why we want to stop the Sun Crow, to prevent it from harming others! We came all this way here for this, didn't we?
Slowly, the girl stops crying, and her voice becomes more determined.

speaker: Yanyan
content: You said that the seer of the Sun Shot must have a strong faith to lead more people and wield greater power. Then...

speaker: Yanyan
content: I believe DisCity will not be burned down. There must be new sacred signs... No, there must still be something I can do!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I'm a full-fledged seer now. I will never run away from catastrophe, from those who need me!
Having heard Yanyan's speech, Du Ruo falls silent for a moment, then turns to look at the other envoys.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Oh, what do we do, Ambassador? Our little great seer here doesn't want to give up just yet. And I must say she's got a point.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...You've been the one reluctant to give up this whole time, scholar.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Haha, after all, we've all experienced that kind of desperate situation seven years ago. As long as there's a glimmer of hope, we'll cling to it and never let go.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...I don't get you.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: One moment you call the myth a placebo and a lie. The next, you're suddenly its believer and even hope for the elusive miracles. You knew the chance of success was slim, yet you still joined the delegation to come here.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...You used to be an open book, but now you're a mystery.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: I don't deny the power of the myth, and I haven't really changed.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Besides, you and I may have different views, but we've been fighting side by side for seven years now. What's a small disagreement to us?
The two old friends exchange a smile.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...You're right. Let's get started then. We have only ourselves to blame for always putting our faith in you.

speaker: Yanyan
content: The Sun Crow has invaded Yanyan's mind before, which means I can now catch its tail through channeling!

speaker: Yanyan
content: It won't be easy, but I'll conduct the sorcery and help everyone catch it again!
Yanyan retreats to Du Ruo's side and sits cross-legged, activating her ability.
The spell she's chanting tentatively is none other than the one that bolsters the Sun Shot sorcery.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...It was a long journey to come here. Of course, we can't give up so easily.
Du Ruo smiles and knows they need no more persuasion. She waves the incense burner, infusing powerful energy into the sorcery, connecting it to the Sun Crow.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Yes... No one could be sure until the very last moment.
The sorcery works. Paradeisos' armor has also spotted the Sun Crow's weakness, aiming and firing in unison.
The battle resumes...

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: The Sun Crow is drawing close to DisSea. Its power is growing stronger. The sorcery is barely holding up!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I... can still go on. Hold on, I can definitely catch it!

The green light of the sorcery flickers unsteadily, as if the distant heat binding the Sun Crow has traveled here. The casters all turn pale and are sweating profusely. Several sealers are about to collapse.

And what saves them at the critical moment is the scholar's gentle smoke. Du Ruo gives them a lukewarm smile. Bolstering the sorcery while healing the seers is no easy task and she can't afford to be distracted.
Yet she can't help but recall someone's question in her mind.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So you don't believe in myths and worship no gods.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why come with them?
After all these years, now is finally her turn to be questioned.

She knows their differences are hard to overcome, that the lies will eventually be exposed, and that no one can escape the truth and their suffering. Everything is hard. She finally begins to feel somewhat powerless, her strength being drained bit by bit.
The smoke has cleared. She's a bit unsteady on her feet, her body probably falling backward. Her vision is blurring and blacking out. Even at this moment, she doesn't panic.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: I do believe.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Since then, or even earlier, I've never stopped believing...
In places she can't see, there must still be someone...

speaker: Yanyan
content: You are...?
Something cold touches her forehead, and Du Ruo opens her eyes, feeling she hasn't fainted for long. She hasn't fallen to the ground but is carefully supported by someone.
She hears a familiar yet slightly tired voice behind her. Du Ruo doesn't need to look to know who it is.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Look at you. I don't think you'll get to tease me anymore. Why push yourself so hard?
Realizing this is not a dream, Du Ruo smiles.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: ...I mean, I've been under some bad influence.

Under the leadership of the MBCC's Chief, the medical team quickly arrived to support the Eastian delegation. The sorcery was temporarily lifted and the Sun Crow's power got stronger, but according to news from the FAC's DisSea frontline, losses have been within the manageable range so far.

The FAC seems to have given up on confronting the Sun Crow head-on and switched to a more roundabout tactic to wear it down. They seem to be trying to conserve resources, or waiting for some kind of turning point.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The FAC's strategy has changed. This isn't something that little triangle would order...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Dear Chief, what have you done?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Are you serious? Are you sure now is the best time to...
