speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: In eight hundred meters... cliff ahead!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We jump on my mark!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi & Kisugi Ai
content: Understood!
As the police closed the distance, the three sisters wrenched their throttles tighter, waiting with bated breath for the perfect moment to act.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Three... two... one...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: —Now!
The instant the countdown ended, the three sisters launched their motorcycles over the cliff's edge. In one fluid motion, they sprang from their bikes mid-air.

Propelled by the fiery blast from their cycles erupting below, they soared onto waiting hang gliders and rode the thermal updraft toward their far-off goal. Left behind, the stranded officers could merely stamp the ground in furious helplessness.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Rui, Hitomi, come on, come on! Open it up, let me see!
Back inside the Cat's Eye Café, having changed from her catsuit, Kisugi Ai eagerly beckoned to her sisters, urging them to hold their newly acquired painting under the light.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Don't rush. We have all the time in the world.

With a careful motion, Kisugi Rui unfolded the soft velvet swaddling the painting, unveiling an exquisite and heartwarming scene. To the sisters, every visible brushstroke seemed to radiate the artist's profound love.
It depicted three lovely, elegant angels, their faces beaming with contentment and joy as they gathered around a small, glittering pile of gems.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Three angels and their treasure... This must be how Dad saw us...
Another painting reclaimed meant the sisters were now a step closer to finding their father. Huddled together, they gazed at the piece with tear-filled eyes.
One drop, two drops, three drops...
Their warm, joyful tears fell quietly, but on the floor beneath their feet, each drop formed a strange, spreading ripple.
The rings spread slowly, persistently...
Then, with no warning, the ripple ripped apart into a yawning chasm and devoured the entire café. There was no time to react—only an immediate, total plunge into darkness.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Rui!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi! To me!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: ARGH—What is going on?!

An inexorable, boundless power from the eerie abyss dragged the sisters downward. As they were pulled deeper, the painting in Kisugi Hitomi's hands—the source of their joyful tears—began to fracture, webs of cracks spreading across its surface.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: No! The painting... It's being torn apart!

The moment the darkness consumed them, the cracks multiplied across the painting's surface. Kisugi Hitomi made a desperate, grasping reach, but it was too late. The three angels, once so peacefully nestled, were already torn violently apart.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: No... Don't!
Helpless, the three sisters watched as the cherished painting splintered into three separate pieces before their eyes.
When they opened their eyes again, the world was spinning.
With great effort, the three sisters pushed their impossibly heavy bodies up, sitting slowly until their minds could catch up and steady themselves.
Their surroundings came into focus: the familiar ceiling, the familiar counter, the familiar aroma of coffee filling the air.
However...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Wait... This place...?!
Leaning on each other for strength, the three sisters staggered toward the floor-to-ceiling window. A flood of blinding sunlight made them wince and raise their arms in defense.
As their eyes adjusted, they took in the view.
Everything—the people, the cityscape, the streets—looked precisely like the world they remembered. But it felt profoundly wrong.
Astonishment locked them in place, quickly smothered by a tide of dread. That same vertigo and pain, the terrible signature of the abyss, seized them once again without warning.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: How is this possible...? What happened?
Kisugi Rui rubbed her temples, then took a deep breath to calm herself.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We're still alive—for now, at least. A small mercy, all things considered.
Steadying her own nerves first, the eldest sister opened her arms to her younger siblings.
The two younger sisters rushed into her embrace in silence, throwing their arms around her and burying their faces in her chest.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We just need to think. Calmly. As long as we have each other, we can handle anything.
The magic of her words immediately soothed their panicked hearts.
Suddenly, Kisugi Ai rubbed her nose, her expression sharpening with an idea. She hurried toward the computer on the first floor.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: The computer...! I'll—I'll find out where we are!
Gathered beside the computer desk, the three sisters all wore grave, troubled expressions. Even Kisugi Ai, usually the most optimistic, found herself frowning deeply.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: According to the information we just found, we're in a place called <color=#fb9259>DisCity</color>. And our café is located in... "Eastside"?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Huh... And further west, there's a place called <color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color>. I feel like I've heard that name somewhere before...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: But the "why"... Why were we brought here?
No one had an answer.
In the heavy silence, Kisugi Ai clicked back to the homepage. Her fingers hovered over the keyboard, typing half-formed queries only to delete them, lost for a starting point.
At that moment, Kisugi Hitomi pointed to a link marked in red below the input field and gestures for her little sister to open it.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Here, try this one!
The link led to a news compilation page. A new browser window sprang open, dominated by the image of a gleaming, monumental structure flanked by a gray-haired man.
female_content: The link led to a news compilation page. A new browser window sprang open, dominated by the image of a gleaming, monumental structure flanked by a gray-haired woman.

content: "The Great Expo Successfully Held! Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control Led Sinners to Attend!"
"Humanity Will Triumph over Mania!"
"Black Rings and Sinners Can Be Artificially Created"
With each scroll, another strange term surfaced. Kisugi Ai began listing them, frantically opening new tabs to search for definitions.
Yet the more they investigated, the darker their faces grew. A chilling truth settled over them: this world was saturated with the recorded atrocities of beings called Sinners.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Let me get this straight... This world has a power called "Mania." It twists people into these... um... powered individuals called "Sinners"?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: And look at this part! "This power is inherently unstable. Exceeding a critical threshold may result in becoming a..." A Corruptor? What's that?

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Something that has lost all control, I'd imagine...
Kisugi Rui pointed to an entry detailing the formation and threat of Black Rings.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: No consciousness... highly aggressive... drawn to living flesh... consumption...

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: So these... these "Black Rings" are zones full of those things? My god... How do people live here?

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: It seems the police here bear a tremendous responsibility for the safety of all humanity...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: If that's the case, maybe this power is why we're here? Or at least one of the reasons.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Yeah, after all, that's the core difference between this world and ours.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Ugh, I've had enough… I just want to go home now, Rui… I can't believe we actually got sent to another world, just like in an anime!
With a frustrated sigh, Kisugi Ai dropped her head onto the desk. As she did, her puffed-out cheek pressed a key, accidentally scrolling to a new headline.
Viral Sensation Otherland Angels Sells for Record Price! Exhibition Scheduled for Next Week!
"Which Is the True Painting Not from This World?!"
And the featured image of the article...
It was the exact painting that had fractured into pieces before their eyes!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Rui, look! It's our painting!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Our painting made it through! We have to get it back!
Kisugi Rui's fingers reached out and traced the familiar painting on the screen. With a firm nod, she confirmed her choice.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Yes. The piece of Otherland Angels... With all three of us here, we will reclaim them. We will find every piece... Find the way home.

Late at night
The Fifth Avenue, Eastside
Several figures appeared on the rooftop of the exhibition center.
The center had become the eye of a storm, thanks to the paradoxical tagline, "a painting not from this world," which alone had sent the public into a frenzy.
The real catalyst, however, was a calling card from a notorious criminal group declaring their intent to steal it.

The public was in an uproar, terrified that these blood-chilling Sinners had turned into mere thrill-seekers. Yet the gallery owner paid no heed to the calling card, instead using it for publicity to attract even more visitors.
The man even boasted to the press, "Let them try. My system is impenetrable!"

speaker: Curator
content: "You know Fox and Rabbit? Even if those washed-up legends crawled out of retirement, they wouldn't get past my lobby!"
Recalling the man's smug face from the news, Kisugi Ai rolled her eyes.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: A guy like that? Can he really take proper care of those precious artworks?
The three sisters secured their ropes and slipped through a rooftop ventilation shaft. It wasn't long before they emerged outside the exhibition hall.
Their view inside revealed multiple encrypted doors and a blatantly visible infrared security grid, a sight that drew a wry smile from each of them.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Ai, this is your part. Can you handle it?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Leave it to me! I checked everything out when I came to visit earlier!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: There were way too many people back then. I wanted to see the painting, but I couldn't even squeeze through the crowd.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: But hey, it gave me the perfect chance to note all the cameras and security devices!
Kisugi Ai cracked all three encryption layers the moment the words were spoken. The doors swung open with a heavy thunk.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You've gotten much faster, Ai.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hehe, I don't know what it is lately. I've just been on fire!
Kisugi Rui gave Ai an affectionate pat on the head, then slipped into the exhibition hall with Kisugi Hitomi.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Ready, girls?

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Let's do this!
It was apparent that the curator had either ignored the calling card or vastly overestimated his defenses.

Methodically, Kisugi Rui and Hitomi disabled the cameras with targeted jammers. Next, leveraging Kisugi Ai's external connection, they rewrote the infrared security protocols, turning the lethal grids into inert, touchable decorations.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: It worked, Ai! You're amazing!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Of course! I've got everything covered!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: But just to be safe, I didn't touch the main terminal here. So the two devices closest to the painting are still active.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi, be careful.
Kisugi Rui handed her younger sister a hair tie. Hitomi then swept her beautiful long black hair up, with Rui looking on.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: I will! Leave this to me!
The infrared beams grew denser the nearer she got to the painting. But Hitomi moved with remarkable agility, slipping past the searing lines of defense with flawless precision.
After landing in the center, she even flashed a quick victory sign to her sisters outside.
However... the moment she got a clear look at the painting itself...

speaker: Host
content: Several days ago, the Jadox Exhibition Center on the Fifth Avenue received a calling card from the notorious serial offender known as "Cat's Eye." The gallery owner remained supremely confident that Cat's Eye could never breach his security and steal the Otherland Angels.

speaker: Host
content: But today, the Jadox Exhibition Center discovered clear signs of intrusion, all leading to the display of the Otherland Angels.

speaker: Host
content: While it is already clear that the security protecting the masterpiece Otherland Angels has been breached…

speaker: Host
content: The culprit left without taking the painting.

speaker: Host
content: Upon re-examination, the piece was confirmed to be a forgery.

speaker: Host
content: Following news of this Cat's Eye incident, the number of people claiming to own the real Otherland Angels continues to grow.
The three sisters were left puzzled by the unexpected public reaction.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Either way, we need to learn more about this world before deciding our next move.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We should focus on major exhibitions and reputable galleries first. Those private collectors making the loudest claims right now probably don't have the real thing.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Yeah, most of them are just like that exhibition center's curator, opportunists looking to profit.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Anyway, let's start sorting through the leads!
On the television, the news report continued. The camera panned across the exhibition hall, catching a gray-haired man as he stepped into the corner of the frame and flashed a badge at the police.
female_content: On the television, the news report continued. The camera panned across the exhibition hall, catching a gray-haired woman as she stepped into the corner of the frame and flashed a badge at the police.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Is that person... with the police? Doesn't really look like an officer...
Dodge! ...Jump over! ...You can do it! ...Take back the painting! ...Take it back!
Sitting by the counter, Kisugi Hitomi stares at her hands.
The leap she made in the gallery a few days ago appears to be a flawless escape from a tight spot. Yet she knows, with absolute certainty, that the distance was impossible for her alone.
That surge of power, that sudden heightening of her agility in a crisis... what is it?
And the sensation of her heart plummeting...
(Chief's portrait)

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Sinners... the power of Mania...

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: And that person... the "Chief" who oversees all the Sinners.
From the moment they arrived, the keywords Kisugi Ai pulled from the news have stayed with them.
She recalls the principle: this force can tap into a person's dormant potential, bestowing capabilities they never had. Given that, the fact she shattered her own limits must mean...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Is everything alright, Hitomi?
Rui's voice pulls Hitomi out of her thoughts. Catching her sister's worried look, Hitomi brushes it off with a wave.
Kisugi Rui's eyes drift to the collection room, and she considers for a moment.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You're right to be wary, Hitomi. But with no other leads at the moment, we follow this trail for now.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Though... I've been wondering about it myself.
Kisugi Rui takes a seat next to her sister, giving her arm a comforting pat.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: I can feel it too. A kind of... stirring within me. A new power.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: It's a power Ai and I don't easily notice, but Hitomi—you're the most agile among us, and your instincts have always been the sharpest.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: I'm sure you can feel it, right?
Kisugi Hitomi's smile is her admission. Her older sister sees right through her, so she simply nods.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: I should've known, Rui—you see through everything. You even saw what I've been worrying about.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: This power... it flares up whenever we're near that person—the Chief. Almost as if the Chief's influencing us somehow...

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Perhaps this world is governed by this power, and by that person. That's why I've been thinking... Simply gathering the pieces of the Otherland Angels might not... be enough.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: It's true. We still know so little about him, and about this world. But...
female_content: It's true. We still know so little about her, and about this world. But...

content: Kisugi Rui walks to the counter, brews a cup of coffee, and slides it over to Kisugi Hitomi.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: They know just as little about us. Let's use that to gather intel and retrieve all the paintings.
Warm, fragrant steam rises from the coffee, softening the air and soothing their nerves.
In the quiet of their whispered planning, the door chime suddenly cuts through. A customer has arrived.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Welcome—Eh?
Hi there! Sorry to drop in!
In the doorway stands a familiar girl in uniform. And just behind her, peeking out, is the café's youngest sister, Kisugi Ai.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hehe! Rui, Hitomi, look who I found!
With cheerful greetings to the sisters, Kisugi Ai and the girl step aside, swinging the door wide for the people behind them.

speaker: Wynn
content: Oh, come on, don't just stand there!
Wynn seizes Eugene, pulls him inside to stand behind her, and waves to the person trailing behind.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief, come on in!

speaker: Chief
content: I was hoping for another cup. Been thinking about it these days.
You scratch your cheek, sheepish, and accept Wynn and Kisugi Ai's invitation inside.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: My, my. When we said we looked forward to meeting again, I didn't expect it to be quite this soon.
With quiet composure, Kisugi Hitomi stands up and hands you the paper menu.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: The same as last time? I take it you're all in the area on business again?
You accept the menu, skim through the options, and tap your finger at the oat latte.

speaker: Chief
content: Something like that, though it's not as urgent as last time.

speaker: Chief
content: The leads we spent all night chasing ran cold around here, so I thought I'd come back today to see if I could find anything.

speaker: Chief
content: Your sister spotted us and kindly extended an invitation.

Freshly aproned, Kisugi Ai approaches the counter. She catches the words, props her chin thoughtfully in her hand, and leans forward with a knowing, cheeky grin, her gaze settling on all three of you.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Sure did! It felt like fate, so I dragged everyone over for a break!
Kisugi Ai winks at her two older sisters, her smug expression practically shouting, I nailed it, right?
Both older sisters pick up on her little scheme at once. Behind your back, Kisugi Hitomi returns a quiet thumbs-up.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm glad she did. The coffee here is amazing. Smells wonderful and tastes even better, so I'd love another cup.
You pass the menu to Eugene and Wynn, adding casually.

speaker: Chief
content: Besides, keeping coffee this good safe is practically part of the job.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Oh? Sounds like things are a little complicated this time?

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Ai, some things are better not to ask.
Kisugi Hitomi, at Ai's side, tousles her little sister's hair before turning an apologetic glance your way.

speaker: Eugene
content: It's alright. Actually, I was about to bring it up with you anyway.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Huh? With... us?
The three sisters exchanged startled glances, their heads tilting in quiet bewilderment.

speaker: Chief
content: The Otherland Angels. You've heard of that painting, right?

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: It's quite the sensation lately. With all the news and ads, it'd be hard not to know.

speaker: Chief
content: Then you've probably also heard that the so-called "Marauders" have it in their sights.

speaker: Chief
content: They've pulled off several heists already, each time slipping through tight security. Just recently, they made off with an original piece.
You take the coffee, drink from it, and look over the rim at the sisters across from you.

speaker: Chief
content: To be honest, if that were all, it wouldn't necessarily be our concern.

speaker: Chief
content: The problem is...

speaker: Chief
content: These thieves might be dangerous Sinners. The kind who who wouldn't hesitate to take a life.
Kisugi Hitomi's face grows serious, her demeanor shifting abruptly. Masking the change, she slides a plate of freshly baked cookies onto the table between you and Wynn.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: That's... terrible. But aren't Sinners... fairly common these days?

speaker: Chief
content: They are. But a Sinner's abilities are tied closely to their state of mind. If that mind isn't stable, their power can easily resonate with a Black Ring.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You mean...

speaker: Chief
content: If these vicious thieves continue unchecked, their actions could very well plunge this city into darkness.

speaker: Chief
content: Besides, there have been several minor Black Rings near Eastside acting up recently. It has me concerned.

speaker: Chief
content: So for now, please be careful when you're out. And since your café sees a lot of people, let me know immediately if you notice anything unusual.
Reaching into your coat pocket, you pull out a piece of paper the size of a flyer and hand it over to the sisters.

speaker: Chief
content: This is the local Public Security Bureau's hotline. It'd be good to scan the QR code here, too...

speaker: Chief
content: Don't worry, it's nothing invasive. It's a precaution. Helps prevent scams, and can reach us even without a signal in an emergency.
The three sisters nod.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You have our word. We'll certainly be cautious...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: With a guardian like you watching over the city, we believe it will remain safe from the darkness.

speaker: Chief
content: Guardian, huh... The work never really ends. Thank you for the excellent coffee. Let's go, Wynn, Eugene.
Wynn downs the last of her drink in a quick sip and nudges Eugene.

speaker: Eugene
content: Huh? ...Oh, and best of luck with your business.

speaker: Eugene
content: Between monitoring Black Ring activity and setting up the new exhibition at the <color=#fb9259>Central Gallery</color> to draw out those criminals... I'm afraid we really must be going. Apologies for the haste.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You're too kind. We're honored.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Take care, Wynn. Do your best.

speaker: Wynn
content: Huh? Oh, yes! I'll do everything I can to help Chief and Eugene!
As you guide your team to the exit, you continue chatting calmly with Wynn and Eugene, your tone steady and reassuring.

speaker: Chief
content: Try not to worry. We'll have additional support guarding the exhibition this time.

speaker: Chief
content: After all, even they are keen to meet the phantom thief group known as "Cat's Eye" in person.
Inside the tactical briefing room, a screen glows with dense, flashing data streams that frame three indistinct screenshots.
Off to one side, Pricilla flicks a dagger into the air, catching it as her eyes shift from the display to the figure typing intently.

speaker: Pricilla
content: So, sly fox, cracked it yet?

speaker: Pricilla
content: We're the legendary phantom robbers, after all. No way we're letting these guys show us up!

speaker: Tetra
content: I think we can afford to be a bit more confident in ourselves.
With the final keystroke entered, Tetra takes the cup of water her partner offers.

speaker: Tetra
content: Let's wait for the Chief. Belphegor's data has already been analyzed.
Upon reaching the meeting room, you see Pricilla and Tetra mid-conversation on tactical plans.
As you walk in, Tetra scrolls the projected document back to its first page.

speaker: Tetra
content: Chief, let's begin.
Data streams cascade across the screen. With a sweep of her laser pointer, Tetra begins the briefing.

speaker: Tetra
content: Based on gathered intelligence, this phantom thief group operates with three members, each fulfilling a distinct role.

speaker: Tetra
content: One handles <color=#fb9259>field operations</color>, another provides <color=#fb9259>technical support</color>—gadgets, machinery, system overrides—and the third manages <color=#fb9259>cleanup</color> and operational oversight.

speaker: Tetra
content: Our analysis suggests the last also acts as mission control.

speaker: Chief
content: To penetrate such high-security systems repeatedly... Their coordination must rival yours.

speaker: Tetra
content: Correct. From a data standpoint, their synchronization rate is remarkably high, nearly flawless in execution.
Tetra pulls up several data sets and displays them before you.

speaker: Chief
content: Any vulnerabilities?

speaker: Tetra
content: Oh, there are.
Pricilla queues up a series of images and video clips. In tandem, Tetra retrieves a separate data set.

speaker: Tetra
content: We initially suspected these Sinners might be copycats or affiliates of the Marauders from before, but after examining scene traces with Pricilla...

speaker: Chief
content: ...Oh. That theory no longer holds.

speaker: Chief
content: Their methods differ. And there's no intent to harm at all.

speaker: Chief
content: So the goal isn't money. It's the painting alone. And identifying forgeries means they've seen the original...
As the video starts, the figures are immediately visible. Despite the blurry quality, their reaction speeds and leaping abilities clearly surpass anything humanly possible.
But that's the extent of it.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Mania enhances the body. They should've awakened unusual abilities by now, but these three only use theirs for evasion and retreat.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Their offense and recon rely mostly on homemade tech. So...

speaker: Pricilla
content: If they're confirmed Sinners, Chief, once we engage them on our terms, with our abilities and the information advantage... I'm sure we can wrap this up clean.
Pricilla lifts her chin, wearing a proud, self-satisfied smile as she raises her hand to Tetra. After a brief acknowledging nod to you, Tetra turns and taps her palm lightly against Pricilla's.

speaker: Chief
content: Heh. I don't doubt your chemistry. It's every bit a match for theirs.

speaker: Chief
content: But... this operation's objective isn't to take them down. In fact... we should be helping them.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Helping them? What's the catch?
You point to another screen displaying a set of data readings that are constantly spiking.

speaker: Chief
content: Over the past few days, activity levels of the <color=#fb9259>dimensional rift</color> have been rising steadily.

speaker: Chief
content: In fact, it spiked sharply two weeks ago, dropped, but now it's climbing again.

speaker: Tetra
content: So... you're suspecting they passed through the dimensional rift… from a different world?

speaker: Chief
content: Given that these phantom thieves are unfamiliar with their own powers, unlike those ruthless criminals, it's plausible.

speaker: Tetra
content: But what if they simply haven't mastered their abilities yet, and are dangerous at heart?

speaker: Chief
content: During prior engagements, they could've used brute force to neutralize us...

speaker: Chief
content: But they didn't. You can even see they actively avoided conflict.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Put that way... they don't seem like just your average bad guys.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Makes me even more curious to meet them.
Anyway, I don't want this operation turning into a spectacle. The goal is to bring them home safely, without disturbing either side.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Just leave it to us, Chief!

Evening
7:15 PM
Central Gallery

speaker: Staff Member
content: Corridor all clear, over.

speaker: Staff Member
content: Main hall all clear, over.

speaker: Staff Member
content: Back area all clear, over.

In preparation for the upcoming exhibition of famous paintings, the Central Gallery has mobilized over eighty percent of its own staff and coordinated with the Public Security Bureau to maintain order and protect the works.
Magnetic shielding is in place on all equipment, with select areas reinforced by tactical arms.
The space around the Otherland Angels has been emptied of all other art. The stage is set, every precaution taken against the phantom thieves—who are not just expected, but awaited.
Uniformed patrols walk the halls, while plainclothes operatives watch silently from within the crowd.

speaker: Curator
content: Chief ${PlayerName}, will this be enough to take on Cat's Eye?

speaker: Chief
content: I wish I could guarantee that.

speaker: Chief
content: Cat's Eye is exceptionally skilled. I trust my team completely, but... there are always variables.
A long line of people has already wound its way outside the entrance. It's no wonder; the Central Gallery only displays certified, priceless masterpieces.
Topping the social feeds is the Otherland Angels. Visitors don't just want to see it. They need that selfie for the grid.
And then there's the real draw: the slim chance of witnessing the phantom thief group, Cat's Eye, pull off the heist live. Catching that on video would make anyone Eastside's overnight sensation.
No surprise, then, that the crowd keeps growing...

speaker: Chief
content: So many people...
So many people...!!
Amid the crowd, a small head pops up, glancing around.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Rui, Hitomi, do we need to adjust the plan?

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: No. If anything, this crowd is perfect cover.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: There are at least ten officers at the exits, with many more mingling in the crowd.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: So… it seems we really have to pull back from the rooftop, like I said?

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We are. We're counting on you, Ai.
Kisugi Ai shades her eyes with one hand, looking up at the Central Gallery building.
It isn't especially tall, but the surrounding high-rises create a jagged skyline. If one has the skill... and the nerve...
Those roofs could become a road. An escape is within reach.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hehe, leave it to me!
7:25 PM. The exhibition's opening draws ever closer.
Animated discussions ripple through the crowd while inside the venue, the final checks are made in quiet focus.

speaker: Curator
content: Chief ${PlayerName}, please... You have to stop Cat's Eye.
Clutched in the curator's hand is a small card, which reads:
"Ten minutes after the exhibition opens tonight, we will take the Otherland Angels."

speaker: Chief
content: We'll do everything we can. That's a promise.
Inside the Central Gallery, an antique clock ticks with a dull, heavy rhythm. It's 7:30 PM.
The doors swing wide, and the visitors surge forward in a single, restless tide.
They stream past the other halls—ignoring paintings, sculptures, photographs—all driven toward the Otherland Angels.
The venue hums with a deafening din. Faces glisten, chests tighten, yet the mass pushes relentlessly onward.
Five minutes in, the crowd has only thickened.
The curator's handkerchief dabs at a cold sweat.
At eight minutes, every guard's fingers tense around their weapon.
As the second hand nears its mark, the crowd's noise seems to dissolve, leaving only the clock's steady beat and the anxious thud of their own hearts.
Time's up. Ready?
Bong... Bong...
The clock's chimes lock the crowd in place. Every head tilts upward, every gaze drawn to the sound. For a breath, memory itself seems suspended—what were they doing? What were they thinking?
After the last, echoing note fades, a woman's voice erupts from the mass of people. It's sudden, clear, and startling as cold water hitting a sizzling surface.
Failure is not an option. Let's move!
The crowd surges into chaos—then, with a snap, the hall is swallowed by darkness.
Suddenly, screams and cries for help ring out as the crowd scrambles to escape. But before anyone realizes it, every door to the Otherland Angels exhibition hall is sealed shut!
But Kisugi Hitomi's mind locks onto the clues: the worn scuffs on the ceramic floor, the heavy, deliberate placement of the guards. Her instincts ring loud and clear.
What's going on?!
Through the earpiece, in that precise moment, comes the telltale static, then dead silence. The guard room's channels have just been severed from outside control.
There is no mistaking it. The Chief of Minos has sealed this building.
Kisugi Hitomi steels her resolve—
Rui... Ai... I'll complete the mission as planned.
Without hesitation, Kisugi Hitomi pulls back and moves for the guard room supply depot. Her older sister's hidden weapon is waiting there.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: ...Ai?! Can you hear me?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi! Your signal's back?! Rui! I've got Hitomi!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: What happened?

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Just a while ago, your signal flickered and vanished right next to the Otherland Angels. Comms went dead. You scared the life out of us.
Through her communicator, Hitomi hears her sisters breathe a collective sigh of relief.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: So what's really going on here?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: It's weird, Hitomi! I only cut the power lines; I didn't do anything else!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: You seemed to have teleported right out of the exhibition hall.
This is... unprecedented. Hitomi struggles to process it.
But the faces around her haven't changed. They're the same crowd from before the blackout. If she really had been teleported, wouldn't that mean all these people were moved along with her?

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: No… this doesn't make any sense!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi, calm down. Describe what you've seen so far.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: I followed the plan—28 steps east through the crowd. But... the fire escape was gone. Just a wall.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: It was too dark to be sure of anything. After all...
Her earpiece erupts with a sudden burst of static, as if another signal is cutting into the channel.

speaker: Chief
content: Attention, all guests: for your safety, access to the Otherland Angels exhibition is temporarily suspended due to crowd conditions. Please remain calm and follow the illuminated floor guides to the nearest exit immediately. Thank you for your cooperation.

speaker: Chief
content: You have been transferred to a secure hall. Please proceed forward in an orderly manner to safety.
As her vision adjusts to the darkness, Kisugi Hitomi takes in the space. She's definitely two exhibition halls away from the painting.

speaker: Chief
content: If you choose not to comply... please understand the gallery will activate necessary security measures.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Let's grab the painting and get out of here, quick.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Looks like they've gotten their eyes on us.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: In that case, there's no more need to hide, right, Rui?

While the crowd shuffles slowly toward the exit, one figure peels away. She slips off her coat, taps the floor lightly with her toes, and springs toward the middle of the hall like a cat—landing atop the crystal chandelier, as light as a feather.
She taps her earpiece gently, awaiting her sisters' next instructions.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Once the last visitor is clear, proceed southeast. That's your most direct path to the Otherland Angels.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Copy that.

The last visitor follows close behind the person ahead, leaving without a hint of reluctance, as if he wasn't the one who, while waiting in line, swore he had to see the "painting not from this world" with his own eyes.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Area's clear. Moving now! I'm going down!
My, my. Quite the nimble kitten, aren't you?
Kisugi Hitomi lifts her head and casts a wary glance toward the source of the voice.
No need for that. I only wish to talk.
Bathed in the faint light of the emergency lamps, the figure's form comes into focus:
A striking red miniskirt, a mysterious rabbit mask, sitting casually on a small suitcase, like a delicate, posed doll.
The Otherland Angels is only two halls away. About 500 meters.
Get past me into the first hall, and I'll tell you something you want to know. How does that sound?

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: You seem awfully sure I'll need to break a sweat just to clear your "first level."
I'm not making assumptions about your skill. Only stating my confidence in my own.
The little rabbit unfolds her legs, her elegant heels clicking sharply against the floor as she rises.
The air goes still. Instincts, already honed by the dark, lock onto the threat. Their eyes meet, and in the same moment, they move.

Countless daggers surge from some unknown space, hurtling toward Kisugi Hitomi, each aimed at a vital point. Yet even in this desperate moment, she feels her heart pounding wildly, an eerie sensation flooding through her entire body.
Under this baptism of blades, her senses grow ever sharper, her movement ever more nimble.
She raises her arm, spins, rolls, leaps...
The whirling attacks hurtling toward her seem to slow in Kisugi Hitomi's eyes.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi, now!
The attack hesitates, just a fraction of a second. It's the opening Kisugi Hitomi has been waiting for.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: It was fun, little rabbit.
One, two, three... The daggers flying out from the unknown space grow fewer. Kisugi Hitomi dodges each with feline grace, leaping lightly into the air.
With such elegant and nimble evasion, even Miss Rabbit fails to catch her in the end.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Ai!
Her little sister's voice comes through the comms, and as if in response, the security shutter Kisugi Ai had infiltrated earlier starts to slide down.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Little rabbit… you said you'd tell me one thing I wished to know.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: What's your name?
The shutter grinds downward, sealing the path. Miss Rabbit doesn't advance. Hearing Kisugi Hitomi's question, a low, amused chuckle escapes her.

speaker: Pricilla
content: You may call me Pricilla, dear phantom thieves.

speaker: Pricilla
content: And I can offer more than a name. Transporting you and the others to this hall... that was my "ability."
Pricilla stops. She simply watches, silent, as the lowering shutter slowly obscures Kisugi Hitomi from sight.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Ability? What do you mean? Is that related to Mania?

speaker: Pricilla
content: I wish you... continued success.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: What do you mean by that?!
The shutter seals shut without a gap. No response comes through. Her final question hangs, unanswered; it probably didn't make it across.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi, did something happen?

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: It's nothing serious. Perfect timing with the shutter. I managed to shake them off, thanks to you.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Well done, Hitomi.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: But that woman... she said some strange things. I don't understand what she meant...
Boom—!!
A sharp boom echoes through the line. On the other end of the comms, her sisters jolt. After a second of stunned silence, their voices rush in, calling for Kisugi Hitomi.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi, are you alright?! Did you trigger a device?
Smoke, thick and bitter, floods the hall. From under a fire safety panel, a shape emerges: Kisugi Hitomi.
She shrugs off the protective gear covering her—lightweight but sturdy as armor—fans the air clear, and switches her earpiece on.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Must have tripped an anti-theft countermeasure.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: But I'm alright. One of the gadgets Ai wove into my suit just saved my life.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hehe. I'm just glad I could be of help, Hitomi!
The smoke thins slightly. Through the pale white haze, something like a laser glimmers. The scattered dots connect, forming what looks like a mask floating in midair.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: What... is this...?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi, don't move! Those sensors are linked to the firewall! It's running high-level security protocols!
Through the earpiece comes the rapid clatter of keystrokes. Kisugi Ai sits atop a building, battling away against the howling wind.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Actually, there were traps all along the route, but those were just basic. If I had to guess, they were just to keep you busy with that rabbit girl.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: But these in the room... they're different.
A rhythm of light fills the exhibition space, blue and green fading in and out. But now and again, a sudden orange-red flash erupts, swallowing the softer colors.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Whoever we're dealing with now... they're for real.
The rhythm of typing sharpens, quickens. Inside a tight nest of monitors, a Sinner—her hair a light blue-purple—allows a faint, interested smile as her fingers dance over the keys.
Fast reactions, sharp instincts...
Finally, a worthy match.
With this... let's see what you do next.
The lights pulse, cycling through colors with increasing speed. Kisugi Hitomi holds her ground, tense and alert, cautious to approach.
Then, through her earpiece, her little sister's voice comes through—usually so bright and energetic, now hushed and completely earnest.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi, I think I've figured out their pattern.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Do you trust me? I'll clear the path for you.
A flicker of surprise crosses Kisugi Hitomi's face, yet she responds without a moment's hesitation.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: I trust you, Ai. Tell me what to do!
On the rooftop, Kisugi Ai sets her jaw and taps the keyboard again.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi, I'll guide you. My directions will also signal Ai which node to disable.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: After each command, you will have only 15 seconds, Ai. But we believe in you. You can do this.
A beat of silence fills the earpiece, followed by a resolute reply.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Let's begin. I'm ready.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Northwest, 20 meters.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Obstacle cleared.
The panel lights shift from blue-green to orange-red. Kisugi Hitomi steps forward without breaking stride.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Southeast, 20 meters.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Obstacle... cleared.

speaker: Tetra
content: Hm? The kitty cats are coming this way?

speaker: Tetra
content: Are you sure about this...?
With the countdown pulsing on the screen, the Sinner's hands are frozen above the keyboard, eyes unblinking.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Hey, Chief said not to "take them out."

speaker: Pricilla
content: Don't get carried away.

speaker: Tetra
content: Mm, fine, fine. It's just... it's been so long since I've had a real challenge. I might have gotten a little excited.

speaker: Tetra
content: See? She's already caught on.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi, stop right now! Go left! I repeat, don't go southeast!
The command cracks through her earpiece. Kisugi Hitomi yanks herself backward, pivots, and plants her foot in a new direction.

Behind her, the amber-lit corridor is engulfed by a sudden wash of cyan, sealing it off. Behind her, the corridor's warm orange light is violently consumed by a cold, cyan blaze, sealing the path she'd just fled.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Keep going, Hitomi. We're almost there.
Amid the echo of keystrokes, Kisugi Hitomi comes to a stop before the shutter. Then, one final, forceful strike rings out. It must be her little sister's victory.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: My head's spinning... Hitomi... Rui...

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: It's all up to you now.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: You've worked hard, Ai. You did an amazing job.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We're so proud of you, Ai.
A silence fills the earpiece, leaving only the sigh of wind and a steady breath.
The shutter slowly lifts, revealing the artwork depicting angels before Kisugi Hitomi's eyes.
Outside the exhibition hall, a dozen incapacitated guards lie scattered across the floor.
Right nearby, a woman in a violet catsuit with gentle wavy hair leans against the window. She observes the situation in the hall, calm and composed.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: One section for each of us, as if to test us through missions... Just what are you hoping to learn about us...?

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Chief of Minos.
Kisugi Rui shakes her head, trying in vain to shake off the dizziness caused by that eerie power.
Still, she pulls herself together and speaks into the communicator.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi, go. Leave the rest to me.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Retrieve the painting and rendezvous with Ai on the rooftop.

After issuing the instructions to her sisters, Kisugi Rui's eyes snap to her tracker. The red dots are approaching. In one fluid motion, she ducks to the side of an unconscious guard and plucks the keyring from his belt.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Sorry, I'll have to borrow this for now.
The gallery's security supply room is just ahead. Using the guard's keys, Kisugi Rui unlocks the depot door and slips inside.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Let's hope this little drone finds its way home.
As she cuts through the glass case, no alarm sounds. Kisugi Hitomi knows it must be her little sister who disabled the firewall.
When she takes the painting and checks the tracker again, the red dots remain where they were before. Kisugi Hitomi knows her older sister has kept them all at bay.
Realizing this, Kisugi Hitomi breaks into a full sprint.
With the piece of Otherland Angels in hand, she flings open the door to the rooftop.
The night sky arches above, and there, framed by the evening wind, are her sisters, their hands reaching out to her.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Sorry to keep you waiting! I've got the second piece of Otherland Angels!
Kisugi Hitomi gazes at the piece of Otherland Angels in her hand. A beautiful painting by her father from her original world comes to mind.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Rui! Ai! Look! With this, the painting is almost complete. Just one more piece to go!
Kisugi Hitomi rushes to her sisters. The three sisters simply gaze at the recovered piece of the Otherland Angels, their joy too vast for words.
Yet, in that very swell of triumph, something black emerges... something viscous... In the pooling shadows at their feet, a familiar and chilling rift silently yawns open.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Rui! Ai! Look out!!!
The eerie rift bursts open! A wave of black contaminants surges out, engulfing Hitomi's feet almost instantly.
Trapped, Hitomi gathers all her strength. In the last possible moment, she shoves her sisters to safety.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi!? Hold my hand! I've got you...!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: You... You two go first! I...
Thick and chaotic, the black contaminants surge endlessly, their nauseating squelch filling the air. They slither around Hitomi's limbs, pulling her inexorably toward the rift's depths.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Go... Hurry... Protect... the painting...
Don't you dare hurt them!
They coil tighter, tendrils of pure malice, but a flash of crimson light strikes down like lightning, severing the bindings in one swift, clean blow.

speaker: Chief
content: How were you planning to bring down EDGE-07 originally? Who were you working with before you came to me?
She stares at your outstretched hand but doesn't take it. She can't let you see her face, not now.
In that moment of hesitation, the eerie power inside her threatens to boil over. A wave of dizziness crashes through Hitomi. Her control is fraying, about to snap.

speaker: Chief
content: Forgive me, but this is for your safety.

Without waiting for her answer, you seize her hand. A heartbeat—maybe yours, maybe hers—pulses between your intertwined palms. Hitomi gasps as the cold, chaotic power inside her suddenly steadies into a warm, resonant flow.
Using that power, Kisugi Hitomi swiftly tumbles forward, dodging the black contaminants that coil toward her once again.
You rise and drive the last of the writhing contaminants back into the rift with Kisugi Hitomi.

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, we should be safe for now.

speaker: Chief
content: You had me pinned down back there for quite a while. Hope I made it in time.
You try to lighten the mood, brushing off your recent ordeal with a carefully casual tone.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you... Okay?
You take a single step forward, but the woman immediately shields her face and shrinks back.
You freeze, then slowly raise your open palms to show her you mean no harm, that you won't advance.

speaker: Chief
content: It's okay. I won't hurt you, and I won't come closer.

speaker: Chief
content: Just try to stay calm for me. You can't let your emotions run too high, okay?
Your voice holds a quiet weight, but you see she hasn't fled. So you press on, keeping your explanation patient and clear.

speaker: Chief
content: If your emotions spike, it draws those things out of the rift. They become more aggressive, more violent.

speaker: Chief
content: When I'm not around to help, you have to keep a cool head... or it could get dangerous.
The Central Gallery incident has caused quite a commotion. Police sirens wail all around as red lights flicker to life.
Under the multicolored glow, the woman's lips part slightly, but she remains silent.
A faint crackle of static reaches your ears. She glances at her companions nearby, then turns her gaze back to you.
But she offers no reply. Instead, she turns and runs toward her group.
You watch her released drone dwindle into the evening sky. In response, you conjure the crimson shackles in your palm and send them arcing gently over the path they fled.
The three power signatures feel intensely familiar, so familiar they carry the faint, addictive scent of coffee.

speaker: Chief
content: Now I'm sure of it.

speaker: Chief
content: The three ladies of Cat's Eye.
The distant building still stands bathed in spotlights, wailing sirens surrounding it well into the night.
From the flickering televisions in nearby buildings, emergency news broadcasts repeat their warning: stay away from the Central Gallery.
Huff... huff...
Through the neon glow, several figures dart and swiftly disappear into a building.
Soon after, a soft white light flickers on in a small Eastside café.
Having changed out of their catsuits, the three sisters gathered in the cafe, cradling the piece of the Otherland Angels they just reclaimed.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: With this... we have two pieces now.
As Kisugi Rui gently places the pieces of Otherland Angels on the table, they emit a faint glow and the fracture lines begin to connect.
A surge of emotion follows. After everything, the complete Otherland Angels is about to be restored before them.

Yet, doubt tempers their hope. Collecting every piece does not guarantee a return to their original world. They still don't understand the source of the mysterious power within them, or its consequences.
And then there's the "Chief"...
Kisugi Hitomi remembers the Central Gallery rooftop. It was a perfect chance for apprehension, yet he just helped her fend off the monsters instead.
female_content: Kisugi Hitomi remembers the Central Gallery rooftop. It was a perfect chance for apprehension, yet she helped her fend off the monsters instead.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: And... I noticed something. When he was helping me, that strange power inside me felt... less turbulent. Almost like it could be controlled.
female_content: And... I noticed something. When she was helping me, that strange power inside me felt... less turbulent. Almost like it could be controlled.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi's right... Earlier, my mind felt all hazy, and I was so frustrated I could hardly think straight...

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Especially when I saw you surrounded by those monsters, Hitomi. I was so desperate I wanted to charge in and take everything down with me...
Kisugi Ai scratches her cheek, a sheepish expression crossing her face.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: But then that "Chief" showed up, and after that flash of red light... it was like all that darkness just lifted.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Rui, you felt it too, right? That's when you calmed down enough to have me prep the drone so we could get Hitomi and leave.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Yes. Whether tonight, or when he visited the café before... he's been guiding us, intentionally or not. Hinting about Sinners, Mania, Black Rings...
female_content: Yes. Whether tonight, or when she visited the café before... she's been guiding us, intentionally or not. Hinting about Sinners, Mania, Black Rings...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Now that I've had time to think, I believe his goal isn't simply to capture us.
female_content: Now that I've had time to think, I believe her goal isn't simply to capture us.

content: Kisugi Rui reaches out and touches the pieces of Otherland Angels on the table. A faint, immediate glow wraps her fingers. Her own heartbeat pulses louder in response. Within her, the unsettling power stirs, rising toward the surface once more.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We crossed into this world through that rift. With every operation, we witness scenes connected to it… and gradually begin to harness a power unlike any we've used before.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: It makes me certain now. The way home is tied to the Chief, and to this power.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: I agree with Rui.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: And now that I think about it... both pieces of Otherland Angels we've reclaimed were taken from government-sponsored exhibitions.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: That means the last piece of Otherland Angels is almost certainly in their hands, too.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Then why don't we just reach out to him directly!
female_content: Then why don't we just reach out to her directly!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Wait... but wouldn't that be like turning ourselves in?
With a sharp motion, Kisugi Ai produces a slip of paper and lays it on the counter. It's the very note that person once handed her—the one bearing the hotline's direct number.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We can just say we got caught up in some trouble. It's not a lie, and it's not like we'd be turning ourselves in, right?
A gentle smile touches Kisugi Rui's lips. She then offers Ai some advice before Ai dials the number.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Alrighty! I'm calling now!

speaker: Chief
content: Hello.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Huh?! That was really fast!
After a few polite knocks, the café door opens.
Kisugi Rui greets you and guides you to your familiar spot at the bar.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: It seems... you really have been watching over us.

speaker: Chief
content: At this point, I think we can speak openly, ladies.

speaker: Chief
content: Even without your call, I was planning to stop by tonight.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: ...So you have already figured everything out, Chief.
A hint of tension hangs in the air. You turn, pick up the menu from the counter, and speak softly to the sisters.

speaker: Chief
content: It's getting late. Mind if I just have a glass of milk? Helps with sleep... and it's a comforting taste.
Kisugi Rui pauses for a moment, then smiles and steps behind the bar. She pours milk into a small pot and begins to warm it gently.
As the sweet, warm aroma fills the air, it dispels the lingering tension. You look at the three sisters and slowly begin to explain the situation.

speaker: Chief
content: You were right. I know who you really are: the art thieves known as Cat's Eye.

speaker: Chief
content: But don't worry. I'm not here to arrest you.
You take out the prepared photos and place them on the counter for the three sisters to see.
They show the familiar rift, along with those unsettling monsters that resemble black sludge.

speaker: Chief
content: You've been seeing these things a lot lately, haven't you?

speaker: Chief
content: In our world, that's called a dimensional rift. It was artificially created, a product of Mania energy released during a Black Ring outbreak. It can affect two worlds across different timelines.

speaker: Chief
content: A little over half a month ago, I detected one becoming active. Around the same time, a painting called the Otherland Angels started getting an unusual amount of attention.

speaker: Chief
content: Back then, I didn't connect it all. But when your heists became the talk of the town, two of my Sinners, Pricilla and Tetra...

speaker: Chief
content: Tetra, the one who crossed paths with Ai, mentioned that this didn't feel like an ordinary phantom thief's work. That's when I decided to look into it myself.
You take out a small object, place it on the table, and slide it toward Kisugi Ai.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Oh, that's my gadget!

speaker: Chief
content: Sorry, we accidentally broke it back then. Tried to fix it up. Take a look.

speaker: Chief
content: It's pretty clever, honestly. Those who specialize in inventing at our bureau couldn't stop praising the design.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: So... you were planning this from our very first meeting?

speaker: Chief
content: I had a plan, yes. But back then, I hadn't considered you might be from another world. I just wanted to gather intel so I could... handle everything neatly.

speaker: Chief
content: After all, the three originals of Otherland Angels were in official custody.

When the Otherland Angels sparked an abnormal obsession, all of Eastside fell into a frenzy. The city's M-value began to rise, putting you on high alert and prompting an immediate dispatch of agents to locate the originals.

Perhaps by luck, or because fate intended for you to cross paths with the three phantom thieves, all three pieces ended up in the hands of good-natured people. Upon hearing the paintings might be connected to Mania, they immediately turned them over to the authorities.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Then, Chief... if you're not here to arrest us, what are you here for?
Kisugi Rui steps out from behind the counter. She places a cup of warmed sweet milk beside you, then positions herself between you and her two younger sisters.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You're essentially the police here. Three phantom thieves are right in front of you. Shouldn't you be taking us into your bureau, as you did with Pricilla and Tetra?
The milk's sweetness is comforting. Almost without realizing it, you bring the cup to your lips for another sip.

speaker: Chief
content: I might be a little different from the "police" you're thinking of, Miss Rui.

speaker: Chief
content: By passing through the dimensional rift, you've been exposed to Mania, the energy that permeates this world. That makes you a type of person we call Sinners.

speaker: Chief
content: A Sinner's power is tied to their psyche. If they're not... well-intentioned to begin with, losing control can lead to serious incidents.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Like that serial criminal? The Marauders?

speaker: Chief
content: Exactly. But I know for certain you're not like that.

speaker: Chief
content: In our previous encounters, you had plenty of chances to harm us. You could've taken hostages.

speaker: Chief
content: But you never did. That's why I'm here talking to you now.
You raise your hand and carefully release the shackles. A small, crimson wisp—like a living flame—materializes in your palm. Inexplicably, a profound calm washes over everyone present.

speaker: Chief
content: I have a power known as the shackles. I'm the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, an organization that manages Mania and Sinners like yourselves.

speaker: Chief
content: At first, yes, I engaged with the intention of capturing you. But...

speaker: Chief
content: We analyzed your operations. Your skills as phantom thieves are exceptional; your coordination and teamwork are flawless. That doesn't come from following trends or acting on a whim. More importantly... in every heist under the name Cat's Eye, you've only ever targeted the original Otherland Angels. Nothing else.

speaker: Chief
content: If the painting originally belonged to you, then your actions make perfect sense.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You really are a kind person, Chief ${PlayerName}.
Kisugi Rui sits beside you, without blocking her sisters' view, and, as the eldest, addresses you with a question.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: In that case... what is your true purpose in coming here tonight?

speaker: Chief
content: I want to ensure your safety, to keep you untouched by the dangers of this world. Once we resolve the Otherland Angels case and apprehend the serial criminal... I intend to send you home.
Your words hang in the air. All three sisters stare, visibly taken aback.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Home? You can help us get back?!

speaker: Chief
content: I don't know the exact method yet, but I believe it will require gathering every last piece of the Otherland Angels.

speaker: Chief
content: That said… I can't simply return the last piece to you now. Not while the Marauders are still out there.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: How would you like us to cooperate?

speaker: Chief
content: To lure them out... I need you to continue sending your calling cards and carrying out your heists. I'm serious.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll provide you with intel on the third original piece's exhibition, while spreading word within my bureau that this is an operation to draw out the criminal.

speaker: Chief
content: It's the best solution I could devise, one that doesn't force either of us to compromise our principles.
Kisugi Rui falls silent. She rests her chin on her hand, deep in thought as she mulls over the proposal.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: But... how can we trust you? Our opponent is the Marauders, vicious thieves with no regard for life. Against people that dangerous... what if the power inside us spirals out of control?

speaker: Chief
content: The power of my shackles can stabilize a Sinner's abilities when they verge on berserk, maximize their potential, and even compel obedience if needed. You should've felt it before.

speaker: Chief
content: But to achieve that level of control, I would need to form a "bond" with a Sinner.

speaker: Chief
content: And that "bond"... doesn't actually require mutual consent. I could enforce it unilaterally, without issue.

speaker: Chief
content: With you three... I've had plenty of opportunities.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: ...Yet you never acted.

speaker: Chief
content: That's right. I don't want the shackles to be chains.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hehe...
By the counter, Kisugi Rui looks at you, her expression softening with a gentle smile.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: No matter which world I find myself in, it fills me with joy to be surrounded by such kind, wonderful people.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We accept your proposal, Chief ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Chief
content: Thank you for your cooperation.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You guessed correctly. We're not from this world, and neither is that painting. It was created by our dad.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Back in our world, we've been operating as phantom thieves, reclaiming his works in hopes of finding clues to his whereabouts.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: So when we came to this world and found out that Dad's painting had split into three pieces, each one a separate original, we decided to keep operating as Cat's Eye and set out to track down the paintings.

speaker: Chief
content: I see...

speaker: Chief
content: Why you became phantom thieves, why you continue your operations here... Those are choices born from your world and your lives. It's not my place to judge.

speaker: Chief
content: Which is why... I have no right to make things difficult for you, or to force you to stay.

speaker: Chief
content: Prepare yourselves. I'll inform you about the exhibition in a few days.
You rise, finish the last of your milk, and leave a bill tucked neatly under the cup.

speaker: Chief
content: Thanks for the milk.
Kisugi Rui sees you to the door. She watches you go, remaining in the doorway long after you've vanished from sight.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: So kind, so brave... and so gentle.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: But...
Her final words are lost to you. Instead, you simply raise your hand in one last, silent wave of goodbye.
A card comes flying into a small gallery on the city's outskirts.
Whoosh!
On its pure white paper, a red cat emblem gleams, its bewitching eye glinting with mischief.
In the blank space beside it, an elegant message declares:
Tonight at 12 PM, we will come to claim the final piece of the Otherland Angels.
Now, at nightfall, about a dozen sheriffs stand at attention inside that same gallery, awaiting your orders.

speaker: Chief
content: The plan is straightforward. They only have one way in and out. Lock it down, and we cut off their escape.

speaker: Chief
content: Each of you, cover a cardinal point. The moment you spot the suspects, pursue them immediately!

speaker: Sheriffs
content: Roger that!
The sheriffs fan out, moving silently to their assigned positions at strategic vantage points.
The minutes trickle past. Suddenly, a frigid gust of winter air invades the space, making you shiver involuntarily.

speaker: Chief
content: Feels like... snow is coming.
A sudden, cold speck lands on your nose. As you look up, a cascade of white, fluffy particles begins to descend, filling the air.

speaker: Sheriff
content: It's the vents! Chief, watch out!!
Countless white particles stream from the vents like a sudden, indoor snow squall, proving your earlier prediction of snow correct—just ahead of schedule.

speaker: Sheriff
content: This... This stuff... Something's not right...
A series of heavy thuds echoes as the sheriffs slump to the floor. The realization hits you: the drifting particles are a frozen chemical agent, a paralytic that activates when inhaled.
You press your sleeve against your mouth, fighting a sudden, swimming dizziness. Your gaze locks onto the ventilation shaft.
As the terminal blinks to 00:00, a violent crack sounds from the ceiling above you.
You think we'd come unprepared?

The ventilation duct flies open, blasting a new wave of frozen particles through the gallery. Other sheriffs charge in at the sound of the noise, only to breathe in the thawed agent and drop where they stand.
That vent wasn't originally set to blow in this direction. It doesn't take much to figure out who hijacked the gallery's central control system.
I've told you so many times, Chief. There are certain gadgets you need to carry, whether you like them or not.
You feel a simple mask being settled over your face. Through the messy veil of your hair, you see the rabbit-masked Sinner's wink. Then she bounces toward the ventilation duct, her arms thrown wide.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Well, well! Miss Phantom Kitty, fancy meeting you here!
The last of the frozen particles from the vent have fallen, though a cold wind continues to pour in. And descending along with that wind is a figure clad in blue.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: What a pleasant surprise, Miss Rabbit. It seems I'll be taking this painting right from under your nose. Again.

speaker: Pricilla
content: You're welcome to try!
Kisugi Hitomi pulls out a gadget her little sister gave her and hurls it toward Pricilla.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Oh my, you missed!
Pricilla sidesteps the attack with fluid grace. Coming to a rest, she shakes her head, her expression one of exaggerated pity.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: On the contrary. I hit exactly what I aimed for.

The small black ball bounces twice before snapping onto the glass protecting the painting. An ear-splitting sound then hits, pounding directly into your mind no matter how tightly you cover your ears.
Then, the entire security case fractures and dissolves into a shower of glittering fragments.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Alright, then! Time to get serious!
Pricilla moves in a flash, blocking Kisugi Hitomi's advance toward the artwork. She sweeps the floor, gathering broken glass, which she sends flying like a lethal spray.
Kisugi Hitomi staggers backward to escape the glittering onslaught.
With Cat's Eye pinned by Pricilla and Tetra, and everyone's attention momentarily scattered…
A deafening explosion tears through the venue.

The far wall collapses as if hit by a charge, opening into a pitch-black chasm. Figures in tactical black rip through the darkness, surging in like a torrent. Their movements are sharper, colder, and far more coordinated than any previous intruders. Here they come: the notorious Marauders.

speaker: Marauder
content: Ha! Excellent work, you nameless strays. And you, the self-righteous jailer! Let your lukewarm justice perish here, along with this priceless prize!

The heinous criminal raises a weapon unlike any standard firearm. It pulses with an ominous black glow, pushing the room's tension past its breaking point. Pricilla and Tetra snap into defensive stances, their movements pure instinct.

But the enemy's cold stare fixates on the prized painting, and on Cat's Eye. The gallery erupts into instant chaos, a storm of blood and smoke. Without a moment's hesitation, you step forward to shield everyone—
Suddenly, a pair of warm arms wrap around you from behind, accompanied by a soft, familiar scent. A gentle, melodic voice comes intimately close to your ear, the vibration of it almost tangible.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: I've always admired your hands, Chief. The way you hold a coffee cup... it's quite arresting.
Kisugi Rui's hands clamp down on your wrists, her fingers locking with surprising strength. You strain, but her hold barely yields.

speaker: Chief
content: Restraining me is pointless.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: How kind of you to worry. But we'll be just fine. Please... stay still for a moment.
The exhibition hall plunges into sudden, absolute blackness.
When your vision returns, an elegant ribbon bow holds your wrists together.

Your intervention proves unnecessary. Before the Marauder's gun can spit fire—or rather, at the very instant the muzzle flashes—Cat's Eye becomes a blur. A lightning-fast impact shatters the criminal's mind, sending his body slumping lifelessly to the floor.

Then, in the breath between the strike and the silence, a faint breeze stirs the empty air where the painting stood. The final prize is gone. Cat's Eye has concluded the performance, down to the last, perfect detail.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Nice work, Rui! Quick, take it away!

speaker: Pricilla
content: Don't you underestimate me!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Careful now! Pull any harder and these pointy ears of yours are coming right off!

speaker: Pricilla
content: Ah... F-fine! This mask is custom-made...

speaker: Pricilla
content: Hey, sly fox! Do something already!
Three seconds of heavy silence pass. Then, a sharp crackle of static breaks from the speakers.

speaker: Tetra
content: I've done plenty, little rabbit.

speaker: Tetra
content: That little kitty couldn't penetrate my updated firewall. I fortified the entire network after our last encounter. However, she physically breached the security system and infiltrated the exhibition hall.

speaker: Tetra
content: While she failed to breach my digital defenses, she probably deduced my countermeasures. So, as a professional phantom thief... she must have mustered considerable resolve to proceed with the physical gambit—
Before the words are fully out, a figure clad in orange blasts free from the duct, her disruptive power active. The entire venue's systems instantly fail.
The lights extinguish. The ventilation grates go quiet. Every shrill alarm that had been echoing since the breach is suddenly, utterly mute.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Our thanks for your spirited participation.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: The final piece of the Otherland Angels belongs to us now.

Clutching the canvas, Kisugi Rui releases a cluster of the small black balls. The same high-frequency shriek rips through the air, and in an instant, all the surrounding windows burst apart. The three sisters dive through the openings, melting into the cold, rushing darkness.
Pricilla flicks a few glittering fragments from her shoulder and approaches. Then, she begins to loosen the ribbon binding your hands.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Back in my prime, I never let a score slip away like that. A first-time failure!

speaker: Chief
content: Well... technically, you're a Bureau Sinner now. On the official payroll.

speaker: Chief
content: So you could consider tonight not a failure of the great Phantom Robber "Pricilla," but... an operational oversight by a Bureau employee.

speaker: Pricilla
content: You silver-tongued devil!

speaker: Chief
content: Ow! D-don't kick me...

speaker: Tetra
content: Chief, this isn't over yet, right? Rabbit and I can handle the mess here. You should probably head back to the café.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll leave it in your hands then. Thanks.

speaker: Chief
content: Oh, and... send those photos to Wynn. Tell her to run the "publicity stunt" cover story. She's got a knack for knowing just where to post to get people chatting.
Late at night, at the Cat's Eye Café.
You arrive to find the three sisters still in their catsuits. They have been waiting.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Chief.

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, let's begin.

Kisugi Rui takes out the last piece of the Otherland Angels. The painting disintegrates, its substance dissolving into Mania energy that fades into the air. Only a fragment depicting an angel remains.
The other sisters produce their matching fragments, drawing them together.
The pieces of Otherland Angels clatter against each other. At the same time, the familiar yet strange power writhes within the three sisters—a desperate, screaming force trying to claw its way out.
A crimson glow spills from your palm, wrapping everyone in a warm embrace.
The three pieces of Otherland Angels settle. They drift toward one another until they blur and merge into a single, seamless masterpiece.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Rui! It's... it's the complete painting! We actually did it!!!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Yes!! Does this mean we can finally go home?!
A wave of pure joy crashes over the sisters, and they cling to each other in hope, their eyes searching for the promised rift that will lead them home.
However, a faint, tearing sound makes them, and you, tense.

The black and white center of the painting is parting, forming a rift. Yet from the narrow opening, a tide of dark, contaminated creatures emerges. They writhe and force their way through, desperate, as if this was the moment they had been poised for.

speaker: Chief
content: Get away from there!!
You step in front of the sisters, a human shield. Your shackles flare to life. Their power slams into the monsters, shoving the contaminated horde back through the rift.

speaker: Chief
content: I knew you would make this choice.
You reach for them, and in that gesture, the crimson shackles slip from your form, moving toward the three sisters.

speaker: Chief
content: This should be the last hurdle on your way home.

speaker: Chief
content: But if I can help it, I'd rather you didn't have to face this risk alone.

speaker: Chief
content: So... if you're willing to trust me, let me use my shackles to connect myself, the three of you, and this painting.

speaker: Chief
content: You can use that new bond to clear the path home.
In silence, the sisters respond. One hand, then another, then a third—they rest their palms upon your own.
With a firm grip, you hold them and unleash the shackles.
A flash of crimson light erupts, and barbed tendrils of energy instantly coil around the sisters.
In that same moment, the rift exerts a violent, familiar pull—the same force that once tore the sisters from their world—and yanks all four of you into its churning void.
The same dizzying, world-turning sensation overwhelms you. When you open your eyes again, you find yourself engulfed in chaos.
Inside, corrupted forms swarm and jostle, a ravenous tide desperate to consume you.
But the power of the shackles flares, creating a barrier that forces the horde to keep its distance, circling hungrily just beyond reach.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: This place... is full of them?! There are too many...

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: And the exit... I can't get a fix on anything in this mess!

speaker: Chief
content: A rift reacts to strong emotions... desires. Try focusing on what you want most right now. It might... show you the way.
The three sisters exchange glances, then close their eyes.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: What we desire most... is to return to our world.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: With Dad's painting...

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: ...And all of us together!
A few seconds of silence pass. Then, the entire rift shudders with violent force. Every contaminant in the void surges forward, converging into a single, frantic mass before you.
They swell, expand, and devour one another, merging into a single, grotesque entity!
It grows and grows until, like an overfilled balloon, it ruptures. A wave of pure Mania explodes outward with an ear-splitting shriek.
As the ringing fades, you take in your surroundings again...
There, in the distance, a colossal, fox-like creature stands sentinel before a radiant, white light.

speaker: Chief
content: That's... a congealed mass of all this Mania contamination!
The Mania contamination born from the three sisters' longing has taken their form, blocking the path home.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: No matter who we face, we won't lose.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Agreed. Would you show us how to use this power, Chief?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: You're not stopping us, you big bully!

speaker: Chief
content: Alright. Then I promise... I'll see you all home safely.
A last, mournful wail escapes the creature as it tumbles down.
Its body unravels into smoke, dissolving into wisps of black mist, slowly swallowed by the brightening void of the rift.
Cleansed, the rift itself begins to reveal its true form.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Rui! Hitomi! Look! The white light... is still there!
With an excited bounce, Kisugi Ai grabs her sisters' hands and pulls them eagerly toward the light.
You make no move to follow, staying rooted in place.

speaker: Chief
content: Step into the light, and you should be able to return home.

speaker: Chief
content: Once you leave, the rift here will disappear… and I will return to DisCity.
Up ahead, the three sisters come to a halt. As one, they turn to look back at you.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm glad I got to meet you all. And thank you... for the wonderful coffee.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: The feeling is mutual. And please, accept our apologies for the trouble we've caused.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
