Another beast falls, and Horo faces her final enemy. As she launches what should be the finishing blow, her dagger fails under the strain, the blade snapping clean in half.
[Transition for 1 second, monster roaring sound effect]
Thud! A hammer tied to a rope plummets from above, striking the beast squarely on the head. It sways for a moment before collapsing completely, going still.
Horo looks up to see Lysandra at the edge of the pit, waving down at her.
The Legion leader gives a dismissive snort as she grabs the rope. But just as she is about to leap out of the pit, her foot slips. Lysandra instinctively reaches out...
Clang! In a flash, Horo knocks Lysandra's weapon away and pins her body in a counter hold.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Good reflex. You're better than I gave you credit for, shrimp.

speaker: Horo
content: And you're more shameless than I imagined, tomb raider.

Deftly, Horo snatches an identity document. Lysandra's archaeologist license. This is a pickpocketing trick she's learned from Hella. She carefully peels away the photo on the front, revealing a completely different name and face underneath.

speaker: Horo
content: Familiar with secret passage mechanisms, obsessed with ancient ruins, and now this fake license... Archaeologist? You have the nerve to call yourself that?

speaker: Lysandra
content: Self-taught archaeology is still archaeology. Hardly counts as lying.
As the broken dagger presses against her, Lysandra raises her hands in surrender.

speaker: Lysandra
content: ...Fine, at least I was dead honest about wanting to collaborate.
The woman doesn't seem to be lying. Horo slowly furrows her brow.

speaker: Lysandra
content: This place was probably built after the Outland war that happened over a decade ago. The war created one wave of refugees, and the disasters produced another.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Furor is a refugee settlement with no unified culture, no formal historical records, and not even a single ruin or artifact worth studying.

speaker: Lysandra
content: The only thing in common... is probably the rosary. Everyone here keeps a string of beads on them, which seems to represent some kind of blessing in their language.
She produces a string of beads made of different materials out of her pocket. Indeed, Horo has seen the same accessory on the people who took the Legionnaires prisoner.
Lysandra then points to the wall of the side passage, where intricate patterns are carved into the surface. These details will be easily missed in the darkness without close inspection.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Haven't you noticed? This passage is older than the dwellings above, yet its craftsmanship and engineering far surpass those crude stone caves. This couldn't possibly have been built by the Furorians. They don't even know these underground passages exist.

speaker: Lysandra
content: This place is by no means rich, yet information about it is kept tightly sealed. I'm searching for something special that might be hidden beneath Furor.

speaker: Horo
content: What's buried isn't always treasure. It could just as easily be a landmine waiting to explode.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Seeing is believing—but I need to see for myself to make that judgment.

speaker: Lysandra
content: You possess great strength, but lack the experience navigating traps and secret passages. Fighting your way through would take forever. I can help you, and we'll split the findings as is customary. We each get what we want. It's perfectly fair.

speaker: Horo
content: Horo. That's my name. Stop calling me shrimp!

speaker: Horo
content: And if you try anything suspicious, I'll be the first to throw you down to feed the dogs.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Now we've both laid out our terms. Sounds fair to me.

speaker: Lysandra
content: So, do we have a deal?
Lysandra raises a hand. After a moment, Horo lowers the knife she's been pressing against Lysandra's throat and lightly slaps her palm, signaling their deal is sealed.
Horo turns away first, ready to continue their exploration, when Lysandra's voice suddenly pipes up behind her with a belated realization.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Alright, I've explored this path before. There are quite a few more traps ahead besides the one we just passed. You'd better be careful and follow exactly in my footsteps...
Clack.

Before she can finish her sentence, the grinding of mechanical gears echoes through the corridor, followed by monsters' howls. The next second, more guardian beasts surge from the depths of the passage.
Horo turns around with a deadpan expression to face Lysandra, who's putting on her most innocent look.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Like this?

speaker: Lysandra
content: Yep, exactly like this.
Deep breaths fail to quell her rage, but Horo knows there's only one proper target for her anger—the enemy. Suppressing her frustration, she turns to face the beasts and prepares for battle.

Guardian beasts howl as they race through the passage outside, oblivious to what lies just beside them. Horo and Lysandra have tucked themselves into a small alcove branching off from the main tunnel, taking this moment to hide and recover their strength.

Horo's dagger has been completely ruined in the battle. She clicks her tongue in frustration and tosses the useless blade aside, resigning herself to fighting bare-handed, when suddenly a new dagger and a familiar-looking flashlight sail through the air toward her.
Horo looks up with a furrowed brow, just in time to see Lysandra withdrawing her hand.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Some spare equipment, in exchange for an answer. Fair enough?

speaker: Lysandra
content: You're no tomb raider, and probably not a mercenary either. Yet you're willing to risk getting blown to pieces by these traps to keep going deeper. What are you really looking for, Horo?
...For an inheritance, the cursed treasure. Who knows which lucky soul has received this precious burden this time.
Horo gives Lysandra a guarded look, weighing her next words carefully.

speaker: Horo
content: It's nothing good, that's for sure. If you value your life, stay away from it.

speaker: Lysandra
content: You think it's that thing waiting for us at the end of this path?

speaker: Horo
content: I hope not, but...
Outside, silence returns once more. The two leave their hiding spot and head back to the main passage.

speaker: Horo
content: Whatever's buried down there, inheritance or not, it's definitely nothing harmless.
A dangerously powerful energy permeates the air. As they descend deeper, the Mania grows thicker, coiling through the narrow passage, just like when Horo confronted the inheritance before.
Horo turns to find Lysandra with an unusual frown on her face, deep in thought.

speaker: Horo
content: What's wrong? Disappointed there's no treasure chest full of gold coins down there?
Meeting Horo's teasing gaze, Lysandra pauses momentarily.

speaker: Lysandra
content: No, it's better this way actually.

speaker: Lysandra
content: People here always claim Furor is the safest place as long as they have Fraser's protection. They put too much faith in others, which is dangerous. Tomb raiders who rely too heavily on external assistance usually end up dead. Always make sure your life is in your own hands.

speaker: Lysandra
content: ...Sadly, not everyone understands this truth.
The pair venture deeper into the secret tunnel. Strange metallic patterns are embedded in the rock walls, activated by Mania, forming unusual, almost eerie streaks along the passage.

The tunnel finally levels out, revealing a stone door at its end. Just as Horo moves to push it open, Lysandra holds her back. Frowning, she leans closer to the door and hears muffled movements from the other side...
[Background: Underground Laboratory - Dimly Lit]

Their view suddenly opens up into a cavernous chamber. The dome soars high overhead, from which hangs an enormous metal sphere. Something is seeping out through the cracks in the sphere's surface, trickling down into a pool below.
Meanwhile, two figures stand at the center of the room. The taller one examines the massive apparatus with apparent curiosity.

speaker: Synex
content: —Wow, you've already gotten this far? That's some solid progress indeed.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But the current yield isn't stable enough yet. We'll need to implement further optimizations.
Synex gives the report a cursory glance before changing the subject entirely.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, by the way, what's the story with those prisoners? Did they come here specifically from DisCity?

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Just some lost travelers. Furor has always harbored strong animosity toward DisCity, and these people were merely caught in the crossfire. They'll be released soon.

speaker: Synex
content: Hmm, I see...

Done flipping through the report, the woman reveals a hidden compartment in the wall and tucks the documents back inside. She appears to murmur something else, causing the girl beside her to frown. Hypatia ultimately sighs before leading Synex out through another exit.
After making sure the two have left, Horo carefully pushes open the stone door and enters the chamber.
There are no inheritance or sarcophagi here, and upon entering this chamber, the previously pervasive Mania has vanished as if it never existed at all.
At the center of the room, a metallic liquid flows from a massive sphere, dripping down slowly.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Aurum Secretum. The barrier surrounding Furor is made of this stuff. Apparently, it can substitute Hypercubes and block Mania completely.

speaker: Horo
content: Is it... being refined? Or...

The central sphere rotates continuously, emitting a soft hum. The liquid metal pools beneath it before flowing through carved channels in the floor, spreading in all directions and disappearing into the base of the walls.
Horo frowns. She pulls out the photo she's been carrying. The blurry image clearly shows this exact location. But there's no trace of the Deus Corpus here, nor anyone waiting to meet her.
...Who the hell sent this photo? And what exactly are they trying to accomplish?
Lysandra surveys the room and locates where the woman has stored her report. She disables the lock to reveal a narrow compartment, functioning merely as a small safe.
She turns the pages to reveal neatly printed text.

█ Fraser Institute - Furor Experiment Site

█ Research Report on Aurum Secretum Properties
█ Project Number: FRI-AS-07

■ Part One: Resonance Property Test
[Test Sample I-113] - Hypercube

█ Objective: Induce resonance between Aurum Secretum and Hypercubes to acquire anti-Mania properties and test potential resource substitution.
█ Procedure: Following resonance experiments with Sample 1, the surrounding Mania field temporarily stabilized, with no significant depletion observed in Sample 1. The Fraser Kardas barrier device designed based on this resonance effect has entered preliminary testing phase.

█ Results: According to observations at the Furor experiment site, while the Fraser Kardas demonstrates some degree of anti-Mania field effects, a continuous supply of highly pure Aurum Secretum is required, or its effectiveness will rapidly deteriorate.

█ Conclusion: Aurum Secretum cannot replace Hypercubes.

[Test Sample II-052] - Mania Crystal

█ Objective: Induce resonance between Aurum Secretum and Mania Crystals to amplify its offensive properties for mass destruction weapon development.

█ Procedure: Following resonance experiments with Sample 2, the induced Mania field was observed to instantly enter a polarized state.

█ Results: Mania weapons developed based on this resonance effect exhibit excessive side effects, rendering them unsuitable as conventional equipment.

█ Conclusion: Consider shifting research direction to develop self-destructive weapons based on this resonance effect.

speaker: Horo
content: This is also Aurum Secretum? Strange...
Turning to the next page, large black redaction blocks begin to appear. Someone has deliberately censored certain information.

[Test Sample III-871] - Ash Crystal

█ Objective: Use ████'s ███ to create directed resonance between Aurum Secretum and Ash Crystals, enhancing Sample 3's suppression of ███ power.

█ Procedure: Resonance experiments with Sample 3 proved extremely dangerous. After several failures, research approach was modified.

█ Results: Multiple experiments indicate that ███ Aurum Secretum devices can effectively restrict the power of ███, enabling users to acquire these abilities. By increasing resonance output, it is possible to ███.

█ Conclusion: Currently, test subjects can withstand a maximum output of 72%. Overloading may cause mental contamination, physical disintegration, ████ and other irreversible corruption effects.

[Test Sample IV-001] - ████ ███████. ██████████████. ██████████. Aurum Secretum was devoured by the sample during the experiment. Sample activation proved extremely dangerous. Further operation forbidden.
As the redacted sections multiply, unease grows in Horo's mind.
Ash Crystals? Mania resonance? If Aurum Secretum was simply a technology to counter Mania, why would they need to experiment on so many different samples?
The report isn't over yet. They continue turning the pages.

■ Part Two: Test Subject Compatibility Experiments

[Test Sample I-001-53] - Non-congenital Sinner
[Test Subject] - ███
Non-congenital Sinner and disaster survivor. Exhibits high resonance with base-level Mania properties of N-02 ██. Related files transferred from headquarters.
██/██: Subject successfully controlled target using the Aurum Secretum device.

[Test Sample I-003-21] - Non-congenital Sinner
[Test Subject] - ████
In a non-██ state, the Sinner was ordered to force-resonate with Ash Crystals using regular Aurum Secretum. Stabilization was done externally with protective equipment.
Test subject displayed high levels of Aurum Secretum corruption with a short use period, but could exert maximum power within extreme threshold limits.

[Test Sample II-001-115] - Self-mutating Sinner
[Test Subject] - ████ ███
Subject was infected by Mania and became a Sinner after prolonged exposure to Aurum Secretum-related products. Despite several resonance experiments, this test subject's resonance output has consistently remained at low levels.
Currently, the test subject's mental state is stable with no visible signs of corruption on the body surface.

[Test Sample III-045-1] - ███████
[Test Subject] - ███ resident
This type of subject is vulnerable to resonance and is easily influenced by Mania, with excessively rapid mutation rates.
Currently, this approach has been abandoned. Related experimental materials were transferred to ██.
At the end of the report are the signatures of the persons in charge. Two names rest side by side at the start of the list.
Project Leaders: Hypatia Campbell, Adelaide Campbell

speaker: Horo
content: If it wasn't to replace Hypercubes, then why produce so much Aurum Secretum... What was their real purpose?
Thoughts race through her mind as she grasps at pieces of flashbacks.
The secret passage we just came through had guardian beasts and Mania-suppressing Aurum Secretum devices... Were those really just meant to keep intruders out?

speaker: Guard
content: Hey! Who's there?!
Lysandra yanks Horo backward as they retreat. The sheets of paper in their hands scatter across the floor, instantly shredded by incoming laser fire.

speaker: Guard
content: Alert! Intruders detected! Secure all positions!
Footsteps echo from every direction. Guards pour through side doors from all around the room, training their weapons on the trespassers who dared enter this restricted area.
They're hopelessly outnumbered. Horo and Lysandra keep retreating until their backs press against the stone door they came through.

Behind them, faint tremors and savage roars reverberate through the door. Something is charging toward them at high speed. Lysandra frowns, attempting to pull Horo away from the stone entrance. But...
Suddenly, the entire chamber shakes violently. The tremors are coming from the city above. Horo's face pales with horror.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Hella?!
She's still up there. Furor is under attack. She's in danger!

speaker: Lysandra
content: Hey?! Where are you going?

speaker: Horo
content: Get out of my way. Furor is in danger. I have to go back and save my friend.

The woman frowns behind her sunglasses. They've just uncovered crucial evidence, but the guards are already on high alert. If they don't press on now, it would be nearly impossible to come back to continue their investigation later.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Calm down. We're just one step away from completing our investigation. Even if you go back now, there's really not much you can do... Hey!
Without a moment's hesitation, Horo shakes off Lysandra's hand and turns back toward the exit.
The tremors intensify, causing the tunnel entrance to shake violently. It could collapse and bury her alive at any moment. But Horo doesn't hesitate and runs straight into the tunnel.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Ugh, why they all gotta be so damn stubborn...
She falls silent for a moment. Then, once again, she takes out that coin she always carries and flips it into the air.
[Sound effect: coin spinning through the air]
Snap. She catches the coin before it completes its fall. Without even checking whether it's heads or tails, she's already made her decision.
[Background: Underground Tunnel]

Horo sprints through the quaking tunnel. While she has smashed through several mechanisms along the way with her brute force, even she has her limits. Suddenly, the ground beneath her feet gives way, and she nearly plunges into a trap.
At the critical moment, someone grabs her from behind and pulls her back to safety. Horo turns around to see the cold face of that woman who always sports a pair of sunglasses, even in the dark.

speaker: Horo
content: ...You're not staying behind to find the treasure?

speaker: Lysandra
content: I've already found everything worth finding. Weren't you rushing to save someone? Come on, I'll clear the path for you.
...Fine, I'll crawl through this stupid pipe!

Hella desperately wishes that when she had shouted those words, the tiny doll could have given her a warning: She wasn't about to crawl through just a short ventilation duct, but the entire Furor Mountain!

speaker: Hella
content: Huff... huff... Horo, I'm sorry... I'll never skip your training sessions again... Does... does this thing ever end......
The doll continues to hop forward dutifully, while deep in the darkness ahead, another faint speck of light appears.
As they move forward, the light grows brighter, and fragments of conversation begin to reach her ears.
[White transition] [Background: Hypatia's Room - Night]

speaker: Synex
content: Hmm! Well done, well done. I see you've got everything perfectly organized, my lady, from those DisCity outsiders to the institute's Aurum Secretum.

speaker: Synex
content: With talents like yours, it's no wonder the higher-ups entrusted the entire institute to you.
It's that dangerous woman from Fraser again. Speaking insincerely with exaggerated gestures, Synex leans over to peer at Hypatia, who stands by the operation station.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh? What's this?
Hypatia is manipulating something on the bench. With each gesture of her hands, the metal begins to melt, flow, and combine into entirely new structures.
They shimmer with Aurum Secretum's distinctive luster, yet appear different from what Hella has seen before. They're more refined, more perfect.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Just a personal side project, that's all.

speaker: Hypatia
content: They require minimal Aurum Secretum, yet can generate extensive protective formations. The strength issue of the first generation has already been solved. This new version has a shorter effective duration but vastly increased power. The protection it provides is already approaching that of Hypercube barriers.

speaker: Hypatia
content: All this data was collected with help from both the townspeople and researchers. But...

speaker: Hypatia
content: Never mind. You probably wouldn't be interested anyway.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Let's get to the main issue, Synex. Has the family approved sending more staff to assist with the lab's evacuation?

speaker: Synex
content: Hmm... What do you think?
The metal structure begins to stabilize. Hypatia sets down her experiment sample and calmly raises her head to meet Synex's disingenuous smile.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I don't see any issues with my proposal.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Of course, I'm not solely relying on the additional staff. The new Aurum Secretum barrier will last longer. Simply by using the same amount of Aurum Secretum as in the original plan, we can buy double the time for our researchers' evacuation.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Furorians aren't familiar with Aurum Secretum, so they wouldn't be particularly helpful even for transportation tasks. The lab has already begun the evacuation preparations, and we can manage the remaining equipment with our current staff.
Synex puts on an almost deliberately surprised expression, covering her mouth with theatrical exaggeration.

speaker: Synex
content: My goodness, you're nearly done preparing already? Furor's guardian is always so dependable!

speaker: Synex
content: But I'm afraid I must apologize, my lady. Despite all your hard work, well... plans rarely survive changing circumstances. You see, there's actually a slight modification to the evacuation plan...
A sense of foreboding washes over Hella, cold sweat breaking out across her back pressed against the stone wall. She hears the woman's soft, chilling laugh before the voice continues.

speaker: Synex
content: The diplomatic mission has been moved up, and the delegation is understaffed. All those who were originally reserved for you have been reassigned. There's far too much valuable equipment in Furor for just the few remaining researchers to transport, so...

speaker: Synex
content: The family has decided to continue with the previous plan, conscripting local residents as assistants who will remain in Furor to guard the Aurum Secretum until the recovery team arrives to retrieve them—<color=#fb9259>dead or alive</color>.

What does that mean? The Furorians have to stay until the Aurum Secretum is recovered... What about the damaged barrier outside? The Apostle? How are they supposed to protect themselves once the whole lab leaves?
Hella's thoughts race chaotically as she hears Hypatia speaking urgently outside.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The barrier's maintenance has already been suspended. It won't hold much longer, and the Apostle could return at any moment...

speaker: Synex
content: Exactly, time is of the essence, which is why we need everyone working together, right? The people of Furor are such good folks. The moment they heard they'd be helping Lady Hypatia, they agreed without a second thought!

speaker: Hypatia
content: But the residents here are just ordinary people. If they try to use Aurum Secretum to fight back...
The woman raises her index finger to her lips, casually silencing Hypatia's protests.

speaker: Synex
content: Miss Hypatia, they are to remain behind. This is the family's final say.

speaker: Synex
content: Don't forget our <color=#fb9259>mission</color>. Your research was never merely about protecting some small city nestled in the rocks. On the contrary, Furor was <color=#fb9259>built for Aurum Secretum and exists solely for it</color>.

speaker: Synex
content: This is merely a necessary choice for our progress. It's natural that you pity and sympathize with them. But Aurum Secretum is the Campbell family's critical plan for revitalizing all of Outlands. Its development and protection are so demanding that it requires these people to stay behind, toiling like beasts of burden until they're expended...

speaker: Synex
content: Of course, your research here has already earned high praise within the family. As for those people staying behind... Well, they are equipped with Aurum Secretum, aren't they? Perhaps they'll survive somehow, don't you think?
She leans in close to Hypatia, her voice a hypnotic whisper.

speaker: Synex
content: Now is the time to put them to use. This is for the greater good, and as a Campbell, it should be your ultimate mission.

speaker: Synex
content: We've come too far now. Can't let everyone's effort go to waste, can we?
Hypatia trembles from head to toe, her jaw clenched tight.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...The plan has never changed, has it?

speaker: Hypatia
content: You never intended to spare Furor from the very beginning...
The masked woman steps forward and yanks up Hypatia's sleeve to expose her arm, revealing winding trails of corruption that spiral from her palm upward, leaving the entire limb scarred.
The same marks were seen on the Furorians who got backfired by Aurum Secretum while using the weapons.

speaker: Synex
content: And what about you? You never told them the price of using Aurum Secretum either, did you?
Hypatia pulls back instantly. The woman releases her with a smirk, her tone growing more taunting.

speaker: Synex
content: How beautiful. How hard must you have worked on this Aurum Secretum barrier? I bet you've barely gotten any sleep in ten days.

speaker: Synex
content: What a shame they'll never know how much you've done for them, overworking yourself day and night... but all that work will now be mercilessly torn to shreds.

speaker: Synex
content: Aurum Secretum is such a great invention. It amplifies energy exponentially by resonating with it. Yes, there are some side effects, but from a strategic perspective, it far surpasses Hypercubes in value...

speaker: Synex
content: How could something this valuable be wasted on protecting some tiny refugee shelter?
She picks up the recently adjusted Aurum Secretum from the bench. Its soft fluorescent blue glow becomes engulfed by the Mania in her palm, transforming into an ominous black-purple hue.
Hypatia's expression darkens instantly as she lunges forward to seize the Aurum Secretum from her hand.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Give it back! The barrier still needs to be adjusted!

speaker: Synex
content: No, you no longer need it, not for the upcoming evacuation.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Stop... What are you doing...!
As she speaks, Synex opens her mouth and swallows the Aurum Secretum in her hand.
Mania surges through the room. The structure Hella is hiding behind creaks and groans, while the storm of Mania stings her eyes so much she can barely keep them open.

When the violent surge finally subsides, the room's furnishings lie in ruins, yet the two figures at its center still remain standing. The instigator appears completely unscathed, even licking her lips with lingering satisfaction.

speaker: Synex
content: Now, about our evacuation plan, you will cooperate, won't you?
Hypatia offers no response. Her head hangs low, and though her back remains straight, she looks so small and fragile, as if she might collapse at any moment.

speaker: Synex
content: Well then, consider yourself informed. Good night, my lady. Do get some rest.
Synex gives a knowing smile, then turns and walks away.

Silence finally returns to the room. Hypatia staggers forward, bracing herself against the bench with one hand. She takes several deep breaths, but ultimately crumples to the floor, trembling as she buries her face in the crook of her arm.
A noise breaks the silence. Someone jumps down from the overhead ventilation duct, meeting Hypatia's gaze as she looks up.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Hella?

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Did you hear everything just now?
Hella presses her lips together, her expression tense.

speaker: Hella
content: You gonna say yes to her?

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...I don't know.

speaker: Hella
content: Will you say no, then?

speaker: Hypatia
content: I don't know!

speaker: Hella
content: ...No, you do know. You know perfectly well. You've known all along, but you still let the townspeople use the Aurum Secretum weapons!
The girl across from her averts her gaze, her voice barely audible.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Here in WhiteSands... one must pay a price to protect oneself. This applies to everyone.

speaker: Hella
content: Ha, that sounds exactly like something a noble would say.
Hypatia looks up as if stung, her lips trembling, before finally bowing her head deeply.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...I'm sorry. I should have told you sooner.

speaker: Hypatia
content: She's right. Furor was never just a shelter from the beginning. The Campbells funded this place, supplied it with resources, and ultimately turned it into a testing ground for Aurum Secretum.

speaker: Hypatia
content: My research... it was supposed to protect Furor and all similar settlements across WhiteSands. But the Apostle keeps expanding its territory, and the barrier is already operating at maximum capacity. I can't find a way to improve it, and we're running out of time...

speaker: Hypatia
content: Please, Hella, trust me! I swear on the Campbell name, everything I've done has been for this city. I will get all of you out safely...!

speaker: Hypatia
content: But now, I've already... I'm sorry, please don't ask me any more questions...
Hypatia gently takes Hella's hand.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...When it's all over, I'll explain everything to you properly, okay?

speaker: Hella
content: So... this was all part of your plan from the beginning? Aurum Secretum, the Campbells, everything... There was never any real hope here...

speaker: Hella
content: Fine, if you want me to trust you, then tell me! Given everything you're capable of, if you just spoke up, everyone would believe you, so why...

speaker: Hella
content: Why not tell everyone the truth yourself? Why do you need help from someone from DisCity?
Hella's questions completely stun Hypatia, leaving her frozen in place.
[Transition for 1 second, dialogue box shakes, alarm sounds, impact sound effect]
The ground beneath them shakes violently as the alarm warning of another attack on the barrier blares again.

speaker: Hella
content: Is it the Apostle?! Crap, everyone in the city's in danger! We need to get down there...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Hypatia?
The girl remains frozen in place, head bowed, her voice so faint it's barely audible.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I... I can't show myself publicly. If my family found out, then the final plan would also...

speaker: Hella
content: ...To hell with the Campbells! To hell with your family! It's all bullshit!
Something gets thrown down at Hypatia's feet, rolling several times before stopping in her sight. It's a small Aurum Secretum doll, the very object she had given Hella to guide her way.

speaker: Hella
content: The greater good? That's just a pretty excuse for using them! How can you even call yourself a noble... if you can't even protect your own people, but instead suck them dry and use them as human shields! You're just a bunch of cowardly parasites hiding behind others!

speaker: Hella
content: The Campbells... how are they any different from the DisCity mice they despise?!
Hella pauses, her voice nearly breaking.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Do you really think a noble's life is worth more than a commoner's?

speaker: Hella
content: I thought you truly cared about them, that you were different from the others... I was wrong.

speaker: Hella
content: Fine. If you won't save them, I will!

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Hella! Wait!!
Hella turns away and rushes outside amid violent tremors.
Hella races out of the elevated lab and sprints downward, running straight into a dust-covered Horo who has just emerged from underground.

speaker: Horo
content: Hella! Why are you coming out of the lab?! That bunch of...

speaker: Hella
content: I know! We'll deal with them later... Whoa!
Another violent tremor shakes the ground, and a massive rift opens beneath Hella's feet. Horo grabs her from behind and pulls her back in time so she can regain her footing.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Furor's defenses won't hold much longer. We can't risk losing the entire Legion here. We should retreat for now.
Horo starts to walk away, but Hella grabs her arm.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait! Before we leave, there's something more important...!

Dense black sand assaults the city. The overhead barrier is on the verge of collapse. Cracks are spreading in the trembling rock structures. Sandy wind and Mania seep through these rifts into Furor, stinging exposed skin with every gust.
Hella races through the ruined city, searching for any remaining residents.

speaker: Hella
content: Taric! Zade! Old Rosse! Granny Nysa!
The streets are empty. They must have gone to the shelter, which has to be...
[Background: Cave Chamber]

The cave entrance is barricaded with layers of wooden planks and rubble. Furorians struggle to fend off vicious beasts trying to force their way through the rifts. Their defenses are fragile, but they continue to fight with grim determination.

Taric pulls wooden planks from a shelf, desperately reinforcing the cave's defenses. The outer barricades are being stripped away by the relentless sand beasts, forcing him to reapply layer after layer futilely.
The next moment, a sharp whoosh cuts through the air, and light suddenly streams through a rift that was completely blocked by sand beasts just now.

speaker: Taric
content: ...Hella?!

Hella is pulled into the chamber. The cave is in complete chaos, filled with painful moans and sobs. The wounded lie in the deepest part of the room, while every Furorian still able to stand forms a protective line in front of them, weapons in hand.

speaker: Taric
content: Where did you run off to? We still need to go and rescue the others. You should stay here with Granny and the rest. It's safer here...

speaker: Hella
content: No! Wrong! You got it all wrong!
Hella interrupts Taric, panting heavily.

speaker: Hella
content: The Apostle outside is growing stronger! It'll break through the barrier any minute now... Forget about the lab! We need to escape and get the hell out of here!

speaker: Taric
content: What are you talking about? With Hypatia on our side, there's no way they could so easily...
The defenses at the entrance are attacked again. Hella swings her pipe to repel sand beasts nearly bursting into the room, shouting at the top of her lungs.

speaker: Hella
content: Aurum Secretum can't protect Furor! It won't save anyone and can't truly block Mania... Don't you get it yet? The Campbells left you all here to die for them!
As Hella finishes speaking, she realizes the room has fallen completely silent.

speaker: Hella
content: Old Rosse? Taric? Hey... Just, say something?
Rosse and Taric exchange a knowing glance, then sigh with resignation.

speaker: Rosse
content: Actually, we've known all of that for some time now.

speaker: Rosse
content: Some strange horned woman dressed like a Fraser official told us in the marketplace today.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What?

speaker: Hella
content: If you all knew this already, then why are you still here...?
Hella looks around at everyone in bewilderment, seeing the same wry, knowing smile on all of their faces.

speaker: Taric
content: Hella, we have nowhere else to go... Our homes were all destroyed by disasters long ago.

speaker: Taric
content: You guys have got Hypercubes in DisCity. You don't have to worry about waking up to find your house buried in sand, or whether you'll survive until morning. Here, even if you do survive, you'd have to abandon your homeland and hide in shelters, living day by day...

speaker: Taric
content: Hypatia also offered to take us away, but where else could we go?
Hella is rendered speechless. As she scans the room, she sees children, the elderly, people who are sick, injured, or disabled... She can't even find a single person who she can call healthy.
Everyone here bears countless wounds and endless exhaustion. These are the marks that disasters and long-term suffering have carved into their bodies.

speaker: Hella
content: No... it shouldn't be like this...
Her eyes feel stung as her vision blurs.
She's seen it all. The powerless struggle desperately just to survive, only to end up merely existing rather than living.
The kind souls who suffer constantly and still yearn that one day hope might arrive.
And the cunning ones who live on the edges, sending off their fallen companions with songs of farewell.
The shadows from her memories begin to merge with the people before her. All of them so fragile, yet so resolute.

There are no more materials left in the chamber to reinforce the barricades. The growls outside the cave grow louder. The defensive line is about to collapse. The wooden boards are shaking, but a pair of firm hands steady them.
One by one, the Furorians move past Hella to the front, filling in the gaps in the defense line using their own bodies.

speaker: Taric
content: Hypatia is smarter than all of us. She has knowledge and influence, and is the genius of the Campbell family. She can accomplish things that none of us can do.

speaker: Hella
content: But if you stay... you'll all die...

speaker: Taric
content: If sacrificing one person can save a hundred, if leaving us behind will help Hypatia escape faster and further so she can save many more people in the future...

speaker: Taric
content: Then we'll stay willingly, without regret.
More people brush past Hella, walking forward without hesitation toward their mission.
Strings of rosaries get taken off and placed in Hella's palms. Children should always be protected. They're leaving their blessings to Hella.

speaker: Taric
content: Perhaps someday, she'll develop the perfect Aurum Secretum. It'll change the whole WhiteSands, helping our compatriots who were separated from us during the disasters, so...

speaker: Taric
content: It's okay if our Furor disappears. There will be more Furors in the future. They will live on in our place.
Another Growl. The chamber shakes as the barricade at the entrance collapses. A sharp claw reaches in and hooks onto Taric's clothes, nearly dragging him out of the cave, but...
[Background - City Center - Night] A tremendous boom echoes through the air. The sand beast at the cave entrance lets out a violent shriek of pain.

speaker: Hella
content: Is that...
A slender figure stands on the open ground outside the cave.
Her usually immaculate cloak is stained with dust. She's wounded, having dealt with countless invaders on her way here. Fallen corpses litter the ground outside the cave.
Unnatural protrusions can be seen in her hand. Bizarrely shaped metal penetrates her wrist, extending from the wound, climbing upward, deeply embedded in her flesh.
The two stand in silence. After a long while, Hella finally begins slowly.

speaker: Hella
content: You knew they wouldn't leave.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Yes.

speaker: Hella
content: You knew that they believed in your Aurum Secretum so much they were willing to die for it. You knew everything all along!

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...I'm sorry.
Hella's vision blurs. She roughly rubs her eyes, forcing back the tears threatening to fall.

speaker: Hella
content: They're all idiots... I mean, staying alive is what matters most. Why doesn't anyone get that? The Apostle is coming. We're running out of time...
A hand reaches out, gently pulling Hella's hand away from her face.

speaker: Hypatia
content: No, we still have a chance.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The Furorians won't follow me, but I'm sure you can find a way to make them go with you. Trick them, coax them, or even threaten them... no offense, but if you wanted to, you could do all these things, couldn't you?

speaker: Hella
content: I could indeed... No, that's not the point!

speaker: Hella
content: But what happens after we get out? The Aurum Secretum won't protect them. With a Sinner around, the Apostle will still catch up to us...

speaker: Hypatia
content: I will destroy it.
Hypatia's expression is resolute. She means every word.

speaker: Hella
content: No way! That's an Apostle of Ashes we're talking about. Even injured, it's not something you can take down alone!

speaker: Hella
content: And... and the Campbells value you so much, they won't just let you walk away! And what about your research? Without you, the Aurum Secretum will...
Hypatia shakes her head. She raises her arm, revealing shards of Aurum Secretum embedded in her flesh, as if erupting from beneath her skin.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The small doll you threw at me contained a piece of highly refined Aurum Secretum. It was part of my Aurum Secretum barrier research. Although Synex consumed all the other parts, fortunately, this piece remains.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Using Sinner power to control it is something only I, its inventor, can accomplish.

speaker: Hella
content: But still...
The girl's fingertips gently press against her chest, touching the cold insignia pinned above her heart.
Moonlight bathes the city, illuminating her profile. Her eyes are downcast, but her voice remains determined.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Being a Campbell means being exceptional, more formidable than ordinary people. Protected by Fraser City, drawing wisdom from our ancestors' knowledge, we must also bear the responsibility of returning this wisdom to our people.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Having received everyone's respect, I must live up to their trust. I must protect Furor and everyone. This time I won't run away. These should have been my promises all along, and they are my responsibility.
She pauses, her voice low and hoarse.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Not to mention that...

speaker: Hypatia
content: The Campbells have already failed them once. I cannot break my promise a second time.

speaker: Hella
content: You're an idiot too.

speaker: Hella
content: You're gonna face the Apostle alone? With what? If anyone could take that thing down solo, it wouldn't still be here today! You pigheaded idiot! You arrogant snob! You...
Running out of insults, Hella looks dejected suddenly.

speaker: Hella
content: One life versus a hundred... this should never be a choice we have to make...
Cold fingers brush against the back of Hella's hand. Hypatia gently takes hold of it, just as she did when they first met.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Help me, Hella. <color=#fb9259>He</color> told me I could depend on you.
female_content: Help me, Hella. <color=#fb9259>She</color> told me I could depend on you.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Go now. I must make my preparations.
A whistle sounds from above. Hella looks up to see Horo with the Legion gathered behind her.

speaker: Horo
content: ...We're out of time. Let's follow her plan for now.
Hella wants to say more, but Hypatia gently pushes her toward the Legion.
They part ways. As Hella walks toward Horo, she turns to look back, seeing only a thin, frail figure standing alone in the distance.
She waves goodbye until rocks obscure her silhouette and she vanishes from sight.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Goodbye, Hella.
The Aurum Secretum has long been removed from the room, leaving nothing but emptiness. Hypatia stands by the window, gazing at the winding queue of people far below.
At the front are several hooded figures and the girl known as Horo. Without farewells, they will escort the Furorians away from this place, never to return.

Boom! Black sand slams against the barrier in the sky above Furor once again. The rock beneath her feet trembles as cracks spread across the mountainside. Hypatia looks up, her keen eyes spotting fractures forming in the barrier above.

speaker: Hypatia
content: The barrier is reaching its limit...

speaker: Synex
content: Well, you got what you wanted.
Another voice suddenly rings out in the room. It's Synex. She leans against the doorway, her lips curled in contempt.

speaker: Synex
content: The lab's gone, the townspeople have fled, and even that DisCity kid didn't stick around for you. After all that trouble, is this really the outcome you wanted?

speaker: Hypatia
content: What about you? Are you going to stop me?

speaker: Synex
content: Hmm, there's no rush for that. They won't get far anyway. But I'm curious about something else...
Synex taps the corner of her lips, her smile unmistakably malicious.

speaker: Synex
content: Having been the perfect daughter all your life, has our goody-goody little lady suddenly hit her rebellious phase and decided to play the hero championing "justice"? Huh, how unexpected!

speaker: Synex
content: Just don't expect gratitude in return, even though you went through all that trouble to help them escape. Before long, they'll be so dazzled by their new lives that they'll forget all about you. Remember, it was that purple-haired girl who actually led them out, not you.

speaker: Synex
content: There's still time. Capture them and bring them back. You can still win back your family's trust.
Hypatia doesn't respond immediately. She continues gazing out the window, and only after several seconds does she begin softly.
[CG - Silhouette by the Window B]

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...No. Perhaps it would be best if they forgot about me entirely.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Furor has never been a paradise. These people didn't come here willingly. They only arrived after losing their homes to endless disasters, with nowhere else to go. This isn't their fault, and they shouldn't die for it.

She gazes into the distance from the window. The evacuation procession winds through Furor's streets, gradually disappearing behind distant rocks. One by one, the lights that have long illuminated the caverns go dark, leaving only sand beasts and Corruptors to roam the streets.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Hella will help them find a new home. Perhaps somewhere far from Fraser. Maybe somewhere in DisCity, even. There will certainly be help waiting for them there. <color=#fb9259>He</color> will find a way.
female_content: Hella will help them find a new home. Perhaps somewhere far from Fraser. Maybe somewhere in DisCity, even. There will certainly be help waiting for them there. <color=#fb9259>She</color> will find a way.

speaker: Hypatia
content: All the other researchers have already left the lab. It's at least a day's journey to return to Fraser from here. Furor has lost its value now, so my family won't bother tracking down the refugees.

speaker: Hypatia
content: They won't need to fear pursuers or worry about the Apostle anymore. Now, only the final step of the plan remains...
[Background - Hypatia's Room - Night]
Hypatia turns to face the intruder. Right now, Aurum Secretum is flowing through her arm, extending downward discreetly... reaching directly under Synex's feet.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Stay where you are. Don't go causing more trouble.
Whoosh! The Aurum Secretum instantly transforms into manacles, binding Synex and pinning her against the wall. After a stunned moment, the woman doesn't appear angry, but instead laughs.

speaker: Synex
content: Hahaha, caught me off guard! Impressive! So this is your game, you had it all planned out...

speaker: Synex
content: Have you told your cute little accomplice that your so-called perfect plan is to distract the Apostle using yourself as bait?

speaker: Synex
content: Everyone has gone, leaving you all alone to be slowly buried together with Furor, suffocating quietly beneath the sand... By then, it'll be too late to regret your decision.
The chain tightens, cutting deep into Synex's skin and leaving several angry red marks.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Or what? Get choked constantly by a collar like you until the day I die instead?

speaker: Hypatia
content: This is the best way out. The Apostle of Ashes will be drawn to the Sinner who controls the Aurum Secretum, while everyone else can make it out safely.
She looks down to see the last figures disappearing between the rocks. The shaking intensifies as the fractures in the barrier begin to deepen and expand. Time is running out.
The barrier suffers another impact. Behind the mountain, the Apostle is poised like a predator, each of its strikes shaking Furor violently like an earthquake.
She crouches down, her fingers gently brushing over the Aurum Secretum chain restraining Synex. It glows faintly as a crack forms.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But despite everything, I do not wish to endanger others as I take my own revenge.

speaker: Hypatia
content: These restraints will deactivate before the barrier crumbles completely. Time is of the essence... but it should be enough for you to slip away.
The bound woman struggles, forcing her lips into a mocking smile.

speaker: Synex
content: How touching! Such a shame my hands are tied up, or I'd give you a proper round of applause.

speaker: Synex
content: So... is this what you're after? To be a glorious, lonely hero that no one will remember?
Her question is left unanswered. The blonde girl rises to her feet and walks out of the room.
[City - Day]
The protective barrier suffers another attack, the cracks growing more visible.
The day is breaking as dawn pierces through the dark clouds above Furor, but the Apostle's miasma hangs too heavy. The first light stands alone, too feeble to illuminate the entire city.
Black sand rushes through cracks in the rocks into the city, dragging up the hem of a cape. She lifts her head, aiming the recording device in her hand forward.

speaker: Voice-over
content: ...Code FU-2109, Furor research site, final experiment.

speaker: Voice-over
content: Target: Apostle of Ashes N-05. Test Subject: Ash Crystal resonator—Hypatia Campbell.
She walks forward without hesitation as the camera faithfully records everything.

speaker: Voice-over
content: City evacuated. Ash Crystal activated. Aurum Secretum resonance limit unlocked. Experiment entering final phase.

speaker: Voice-over
content: Target Apostle exists in a fragmented state, making it difficult to capture. The plan is to use the spiritual energy of a high-ranking Sinner as bait to draw it into Furor for complete elimination.
Sand beasts and Corruptors assault ceaselessly, but she clears a path forward while maintaining a steady voice as she continues speaking.

speaker: Voice-over
content: Additionally, to facilitate the decoy, Furor's outer Aurum Secretum barrier must be deactivated, allowing the Apostle to precisely lock onto the Sinner's location.

speaker: Voice-over
content: The barrier will be completely destroyed in approximately fifteen minutes. Only one operator remains and repair requirements cannot be fulfilled. Once initiated, this plan cannot be interrupted. There is no turning back.

speaker: Voice-over
content: I will record the entire battle process. This will serve as valuable sample data. I hope this record will benefit those who follow this same path of Aurum Secretum research in the future.

speaker: Voice-over
content: As for the Furorians...
She stops in her tracks and sets down the recording device.
Aurum Secretum flows slowly across her arm as the emerald crystal in her palm resonates with the surrounding metal. Mania levels begin to rise.

speaker: Hypatia
content: They will survive. I will make sure of it. Someday they'll be able to leave Furor and their hatred behind, and embrace their new lives.

speaker: Hypatia
content: No matter what, no one should be trapped here. They deserve better lives...
The Aurum Secretum hums, poised for release. The girl prepares to step onto her battlefield.

speaker: Hypatia
content: This is my duty. I will give everything for this, no matter the cost.

speaker: Piercing Shriek
content: ...!
[Corruptor portrait,
portrait disappears]
Hypatia shatters the monster before her. The creature crumbles into black sand, flowing back into the dark magnetic vortex.

Above, the barrier has been torn open, leaving a gaping hole where black sand funnels into Furor. That's the Apostle of Ashes. It eyes its prey hungrily, yet cautiously refuses to fully take the bait.
The black sand accelerates its erosion of Furor's last defenses. The barrier grows increasingly unstable. It won't hold much longer.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Huff... huff...
The storm intensifies, carrying razor-sharp metal fragments that slice across Hypatia's exposed skin, leaving one deep cut after another.
A different sound is hidden within the howling gale.

speaker: Whispers in the Storm
content: Lady... Lady Hypatia...
Someone is left behind in Furor?!
No, that's not a real voice. Mania is contaminating her mind. This is the Apostle's trap.

She tries to drive the hallucinations out of her mind, but her vision only grows more disoriented. The ruined streets begin to blur with memories of Furor's once-bustling avenues, phantom figures seemingly standing right beside her, talking to her.

speaker: Whispers in the Storm
content: The Campbells' wish... We all understand... We chose to stay behind...
The metal fragments collide in the wind, creating faint noises. Through Mania's influence, these sounds transform into whispers that penetrate the ears of the last living soul in Furor.

speaker: Whispers in the Storm
content: Hypatia... Don't betray us... Never forget...

speaker: Whispers in the Storm
content: ...Hypatia! Don't betray the family! Never forget your duty!
The whispers suddenly amplify, transforming into a deafening explosion in her ears.
Seizing the opening, the Corruptor before Hypatia strikes with full force, sending her body flying into the heart of the black sandstorm.
[Black Screen]
Hypatia is ensnared by the Apostle's Mania field.

Something flies past her. Remnants of prey captured by the storm but not yet fully consumed. Aurum Secretum debris, broken Furorian rosaries, and countless unrecognizable relics from other fallen cities.

Deep inside the Apostle's bowels, her consciousness is getting torn apart. She struggles to resist, but is dragged deeper into the contamination. She hears whispers and resentful shrieks of the deceased.
But among them, there's another voice, childlike and innocent. It's...
[WHITE OUT, Dream Flashback]

speaker: Solemn Voice
content: ...Do you hereby swear that from this day forward, as a Campbell child of Fraser, you will dedicate yourself wholly to your family and this city, leading its people toward prosperity?
[CG - Flashback A]
Sunlight streams down. The girl stands bathed in its glow, her right hand resting gently over her chest, feeling the cold metal beneath her fingers and the rapid beating of her own heart.

speaker: Youthful Voice
content: Yes, I swear.

speaker: Solemn Voice
content: Do you hereby swear that you, as one of the revered Campbells, will do everything in your power to carry forward the guidance of your great predecessors and never dishonor the glory of your family?

speaker: Youthful Voice
content: Yes, I will be true to my word and deed, never forgetting the compassion and justice in my heart.

speaker: Solemn Voice
content: Do you swear before the Golden Rose that no matter the hardship, whatever the cost, you will never abandon your duty or betray your oath, and always put the greater interests before your own?
The childish voice answers without a moment's hesitation, resolute and unwavering.

speaker: Youthful Voice
content: Yes, I do.

speaker: Youthful Voice
content: I do. I will be forever faithful to my duty, my city, and its people.

speaker: Youthful Voice
content: Even if it means sacrificing everything I have, I shall not hesitate...
[The young Hypatia's spirited pledge continues, but as she raises her head to accept the honor, the illusion suddenly shatters.]

speaker: Solemn Voice
content: Liar! Traitor!
[CG - Flashback B]
Her memories shatter under the harsh voice. Countless fragments interweave and overlap as a symphony of voices echoes around Hypatia.

speaker: Close Whispers
content: The disaster is still intensifying. The Apostle's activity has exceeded the threshold. Lady Hypatia, the barrier won't hold much longer...

speaker: Hypatia
content: How naive I was. I once believed in Aurum Secretum, and that perhaps one day my research could conquer the calamity and save the world.

speaker: Close Whispers
content: If not for Furor, we'd have died in WhiteSands long ago... But our lives are worthless anyway. It's our honor to die for Aurum Secretum...

speaker: Hypatia
content: But one person's efforts are so feeble. People are dying for the hope that might never come... while I accomplished even less than the Aurum Secretum they died for.

speaker: Close Whispers
content: Hypatia, you've betrayed your oath!

speaker: Hypatia
content: No, the glory of the Campbells... true glory should never be something like this...
[Transition to Black Screen]
The contamination continues to intensify. Hypatia struggles to resist, yet escaping the corruption seems almost impossible.

speaker: Close Whispers
content: What more do you want? Your family believes in you and has invested so much in you, placing their highest hopes in you, and yet you betray them for some useless research site? What a fool!

speaker: Close Whispers
content: This is merely a small, inevitable sacrifice on the path to great victory... Accept it, and only then can you go further...
The whispers circle around her ears, seducing her to surrender and plunge together into the depths of darkness.

speaker: Hypatia
content: N-no, that's wrong... I...
The howling in the wind grows louder. Hands from the darkness seize Hypatia, dragging her down into the abyss, and then...

speaker: Clear Voice
content: I say to hell with them!
The sandy storm dances, devouring everything at an accelerating pace. But somewhere deeper, a rift opens in the chaotic void, allowing bits of light from the outside to shine through.
The darkness begins to crumble as the light draws closer, growing brighter and more distinct...

speaker: Clear Voice
content: You're a Campbell and the inventor of Aurum Secretum! What can't you do?

speaker: Clear Voice
content: Come on, Hypatia! Get back here. We're not done fighting yet!
[Background - City Center - Day]
Hypatia's eyes snap open.

She sees no researchers, no Furorians, no Campbell messengers here. And of course, she doesn't see Hella either. Everything just now was merely an illusion she saw after being swallowed by the Apostle's Mania field.
...I see. Individuals swallowed by an Apostle aren't immediately consumed. Instead, they're drawn into the Apostle's own spiritual domain and experience hallucinations.

speaker: Apostle of Ashes
content: ...!

speaker: Hypatia
content: You should work on your dream-crafting skills though. You won't catch much prey like that.
The Aurum Secretum emits a hum. Her power concentrates once more as she breaks free from the Apostle's tempest.

The wind transforms into piercing screams that sweep across the space. Everything around her shakes as the barrier teeters on the verge of collapse. Instead of countering immediately, Hypatia pulls out her recording device.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...The evacuation should be complete by now. It's time.
Another crack appears. The barrier stops shaking all of a sudden.

Hypatia looks up while her device records everything: The wind outside has suddenly stopped. A massive shadow is gathering in the air, hovering above Furor, blotting out the sky and nearly engulfing the tiny figure below.
She's still breathing heavily, and her hands tremble violently from pain, or perhaps something else.

speaker: Synex
content: So... is this what you're after? To be a glorious, lonely hero that no one will remember?
Just like all Furorians, she's nothing more than an ordinary person.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...See, even now I'm still frightened. How could someone like me ever be their hope?
The illusion mirrors her pain and longing. A solo fight is too lonely. Perhaps, somewhere deep in her heart, she does wish someone could stand beside her.
The recording device is still working dutifully. Hypatia steadies her breathing slowly before speaking again. This time, a trace of hesitation seeps into her otherwise composed voice.

speaker: Hypatia
content: When this is all over, if someone finds this recording... if anyone hears these words...

speaker: Hypatia
content: Then, perhaps it might still be possible to...
Her sentence is left unfinished. The Aurum Secretum barrier shatters completely, its fragments raining down like falling stars over the city.
Almost instantly, an invisible gaze locks onto her. In the next moment, Mania floods into Furor together with the sandy storm.
Dark debris rushes into Furor, gradually gathering into a solid form in the sky. The massive Apostle of Ashes has taken the bait. It fixes its attention on the feast before it.

speaker: Fragmented Whispers
content: Hypatia... Hypatia...

speaker: Fragmented Whispers
content: Come, stay, become one with us... You shall never leave...

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Of course. I alone should suffice to satisfy your hunger.

Wounds cover Hypatia's body. The crystallized Mania begins to turn against her, creeping up toward her shoulder blades. The crystal embedded in the metal trembles violently, as if about to shatter at any moment.
She tries to draw out even greater power from the Aurum Secretum, but the burden becomes too much, and the metal in her arm suddenly explodes.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ?! Cough, cough...

speaker: Hypatia
content: Has the Aurum Secretum reached its limit? No... Damn it, I'm running out of time...
There's never time for hesitation on the battlefield. Another attack comes howling toward her, and it's too late to dodge!
At the critical moment, an attack descends from above, interrupting the Apostle's assault.
Traffic control in progress! Everyone, <size=44>MAKE</size> <size=50>WAY</size> NOW!
Hypatia looks up in shock, seeing a silhouette standing high above against the light.

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Hella?!
Hella stands atop a jutting rock, an Aurum Secretum cannon on her shoulder aimed directly at the Apostle of Ashes.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Hella?!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey Hypa! How ya holding up? I'm back to help you kick some monsters' asses!

speaker: Hypatia
content: How did you...?! Hasn't everyone already retreated? Where are the others now? Don't tell me they also...

speaker: Hypatia
content: No! The barrier has already failed! I-I can't protect you on my own. You need to leave now!

speaker: Hella
content: Easy! You think the top fighter of Syndicate who's busted through Black Rings would sweat a small battle like this?

speaker: Hella
content: As for the Furorians... Hehe, don't worry. They've all run far, far away by now. Nobody needed convincing this time. They couldn't leave fast enough!
The cannon transforms into a heavy bludgeon in Hella's hands as she swings it with full force, sending a sand beast approaching from the side flying through the air.

speaker: Hella
content: Hypatia is fighting the Apostle to protect Furor, and she's in grave danger! The lab staff stole all the Aurum Secretum, but we can't just run away like cowards! Come on, let's catch up to them! We have to help our Lady Campbell...

speaker: Hella
content: I've learned a ton on my little adventure this time! A good lie needs to be mixed in with some truth. Uh, an old friend from WhiteSands taught me that. She's not the most trustworthy person per se, but her tricks sure work! See? Just put it to good use, didn't I?

speaker: Hella
content: Don't worry! Everyone's in a safe place now. Once we finish this fight, we'll go meet up with them together!
She pats the Aurum Secretum device at her side, then turns her attention back to the Apostle.
[Small CG - Confrontation A]

speaker: Hella
content: Mira

speaker: Hella
content: What kind of loser picks on a girl all on her own? If you've got any guts, come out and face my cannon like a real fighter!
The gale infused with Mania fails to knock her down. Hella stands tall, her eyes gleaming with determination.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But... it's too dangerous. This was only ever my responsibility... You shouldn't have to...

speaker: Hella
content: Oh stop that now!
[Small CG - Confrontation B]

speaker: Hella
content: We all feel we're not strong enough sometimes, that all we do is make mistakes, and we're scared to death when we're all alone. Happens to everyone, and that's okay!

speaker: Hella
content: That old friend from WhiteSands taught me another thing as well: You should grow a thicker skin and stop guilt-tripping yourself all the time. It never should have been a choice between sacrificing one person or a hundred...

speaker: Hella
content: Here's a Syndican trick: If you can't win a fight alone, get more guys to back you up! If one person can't finish a job, get everyone to help! If we put all 101 brains together, we can definitely think of a new solution!
[Small CG - Confrontation C]

speaker: Hella
content: So, I'll help you out and hit where you miss!

speaker: Hella
content: If you still feel guilty about it, just promise me you'll try your hardest. Come back alive and thank us later!
[Small CG - Confrontation D]

speaker: Hypatia
content: It's not that simple...

speaker: Hypatia
content: But... is that true? So... you all still want to see me...
If there are still people waiting for her, then she cannot let them down.
[Background - City Center - Day]

speaker: Hypatia
content: I have a plan. It's very risky... I couldn't have managed it before, but now, you're by my side.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Hella, will you help me?
Hella leaps down from above and seizes Hypatia's hand.

speaker: Hella
content: You bet I will!
[Scene Change] [Background - Downtown - Day]
Streets lie in ruins as the Apostle circles in the sky above Furor. The Sinner has suddenly masked her presence. The Apostle can no longer find its target.
As the wind dies down, the Apostle hesitates, ready to leave—until a flying stick catches its attention.
Hey! You big coward over there, watch this!
The tiny Sinner stands in the middle of the street, somehow emanating the presence of a one-person army ready to hold the line.

speaker: Hella
content: Aren't you hungry? Don't you want a midnight snack? Aren't you tired of hiding in the storm like a loser all the time?
Hella holds up an object high in the air. A crooked, almost disfigured tiny Aurum Secretum doll.

speaker: Hella
content: If you want it, come and get it yourself!
Activated by Mania, the doll erupts with tremendous energy.

speaker: Apostle of Ashes
content: ...!
Black sand takes on a solid form and chases after the girl. Hella runs at full speed, heading toward the rendezvous point Hypatia told her about just ahead...

speaker: Hella
content: ...But you never told me this thing could run so faaaaaaast!
She trips over something. Right behind her, the Apostle lunges forward aggressively, but the Sinner dodges out of the way with a quick roll.

speaker: Horo
content: Hella, get in!
Horo reaches out and pulls Hella into the vehicle. The Legion's thoroughly battered car speeds away, racing toward the final battleground.
[Background - Underground Experiment Site- Dim]
Hypatia enters the underground facility and sees a blue-haired woman standing beside a metal device.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Have they all left?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Yes...

speaker: Lysandra
content: ...I see. You look way more at ease now, compared to before.

speaker: Lysandra
content: I'm leaving too. There's nothing left here that I need. Whatever remains is yours.
The blue-haired woman turns and leaves without hesitation. Once again, Hypatia is left alone in the place.
The utter silence here is almost eerie. The Apostle's roars cannot penetrate this deep underground. Sunlight will never grace this subterranean space.

She used to hate this place. The future seemed much like the dark crypt before her, devoid of any light. Just like Furor's black sand-shrouded sky which only a faint glimmer of light could shine through at noon.
But...
Hypatia breathes deeply, feeling the pulsations beneath her palm. The Aurum Secretum hums and vibrates in resonance, like another person's heartbeat pressed against her side.
[Enter Flashback] [Background - Downtown - Day]

speaker: Hypatia
content: I will activate the underground mechanisms. That place is the core facility for Apostle research equipped with the most advanced Aurum Secretum instruments. It's also our last hope to defeat it.

speaker: Hypatia
content: But while I do that, someone has to lure the Apostle to a strategic position. The problem is, I've run out of Aurum Secretum...

Hypatia watches in surprise as Hella rummages through her pockets and pours out a jumble of small items. Various Aurum Secretum parts salvaged from the Furorians' gear. Numerous small pieces eventually form a decent pile.

speaker: Hella
content: When they heard I was coming back to help you, they shoved all the usable materials they had into my pockets. Think this is enough?
Hypatia's surprise melts into a genuine smile as she accepts the Aurum Secretum.

speaker: Hypatia
content: It's not the purest, but it should suffice. Aurum Secretum can temporarily amplify the resonance with the user's Mania. It'll serve as a moving target to the Apostle, which makes the perfect bait.
Her voice trails off, her hand still resting upon Hella's. Hella looks up questioningly, noticing the conflicted expression on Hypatia's face.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I can't guarantee this plan will succeed. Acting as bait will be extremely dangerous. Hella...

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Do you trust me?

speaker: Hella
content: Seems like the genius of the Campbell family doesn't know everything after all.
Hypatia looks up, meeting Hella's bright eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: You had my trust from the beginning, dummy.
[CG - Final Showdown A]

speaker: Hypatia
content: Furor was always shrouded by dark clouds. People couldn't see the light, so they mistook me for the sun. But I cannot save them, and the Campbell family never should have been their hope.
At some point, her hands have stopped trembling.

speaker: Hella
content: Hypa, now's your chance...!
The crystal shivers in her hand. Hypatia touches it, and then...
[CG - Final Showdown B]
Immense energy erupts from the crystal and surges through Hypatia's fingertips, converging into a beam of light that pierces straight through the ground at the Apostle!

All the Aurum Secretum is simmering with power for Hypatia, and in this moment, the whole Furor answers her call. This is her final battle, where she will reclaim with her own hands the radiance that was once stolen from the Furorians.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Now, it's time to take back what's ours!
The Apostle is gravely damaged, its body covered in burn marks from the Aurum Secretum's searing energy.
The underground Aurum Secretum has all been consumed, and now a violent storm engulfs Hypatia as Mania corrupts the resonant energy within her body.
Suddenly, the howling winds fall silent for a moment. Hypatia hears an agonized shriek pierce through the stillness.

speaker: Hypatia
content: Is that...
Above her, the barrier that should have been disabled is beginning to glow again!
[Background - WhiteSands]

The Furorians gather outside the rocky outcrop. Though the Aurum Secretum in their hands are all shattered pieces, together they form a continuous field, reactivating the external Aurum Secretum devices and reconnecting the system.
The Legionnaires stand right beside the Furorians, the two groups exchanging wary glances. Despite lingering tensions between them, they can still work together toward a common goal.
Part by part, the barrier lights up, gradually forming a starry sky in daylight above Furor. This shimmering galaxy will completely trap the Apostle within Furor's boundaries.

speaker: Hella
content: A good lie needs to be mixed in with some truth. Uh, an old friend from WhiteSands taught me that. She's not the most trustworthy person per se, but her tricks sure work! See? Just put it to good use, didn't I?
Indeed, her method worked. Hella has successfully deceived her once again. They've never really given up on Furor or Hypatia.

speaker: Furorian
content: Show that thing what you're made of, Lady Campbell!

The Apostle roars in fury, realizing it has no escape. It summons a surge of black sand, from which countless tormented souls who died in the disasters reach out toward Hypatia, attempting to drag her down into hell with them.

speaker: Anguished Shriek
content: You betrayed us... You couldn't save anyone... You just stood by and watched as we died...

speaker: Anguished Shriek
content: You're useless! Stop struggling!

Hypatia stands unwavering, even as Mania leaves its corrosive marks across her skin. The light surrounding her body keeps growing brighter, gradually overwhelming the dark swirling sand until she becomes the sole source of radiance in the darkness.
The Apostle begins to tremble, sensing the threat before it.

speaker: Anguished Shriek
content: What do you even want? Why, why won't you just give up?!
Hypatia's voice is hoarse. The burden of the Ash Crystal nearly crushes her, yet she drags her body forward with unwavering determination.
She takes one step, then another. As the resonance surpasses its limits, the Aurum Secretum begins to boil, merging into Hypatia's skin and forming golden patterns across her body.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I want courage and strength... I want to stand tall with a clear conscience, to set things right, to protect my people...

speaker: Hypatia
content: I want sunlight to pierce through the dark clouds and shine over Furor... I want...

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...That one day, all hopes in this place can become reality.
The world shakes violently as the Apostle's crystal core is exposed in the storm. The Apostle concentrates its energy, preparing to deliver one final strike.
But Hypatia... she chooses to remove all her defense. Her power gathers into a single point, poised to strike...

speaker: Hypatia
content: This is what I've been seeking all along, the TRUE GLORY.
—BOOM!
Light impales the sky like a second sun rising from the depths of Furor, completely tearing through the veil of sand and dust.
Hypatia falls back, ultimately swallowed by the aftershock of the energy. But just as her consciousness begins to fade, she hears someone calling out.
...Hypatia!
[White light, transition to background after 3s] [Background - City Center - Day]
The sand and dust gradually settle, revealing the city's appearance.
The caves and buildings have been destroyed in the intense battle, reduced to ruins and rubble. The explosion has created a massive crater leading to the underground at the city center.
When the Furorians are escorted back into the city by the Legion, they're greeted by this scene of complete devastation.

speaker: Horo
content: She just ran down there... Damn it! Hella? Hella, where are you?!

speaker: Zade
content: And Miss Campbell, she's gone too...
Horo races through the city, desperately searching for any sign of Hella. Other townsfolk join the search, their faces etched with worry.
Everyone searches frantically, calling out, but no response comes. Post-battle Furor lies in ruins, without a single soul in sight.
Finally, someone finds a damaged golden rose insignia at the edge of the massive crater.
The crowd parts, creating a path. Horo steps forward and notices several crushed, bloodstained beads next to the insignia. They're Hella's hair accessories.
A deathly silence falls over everyone. Only the soft sounds of stifled sobbing break the stillness.
Granny Nysa silently embraces Zade. Taric rubs his eyes, while Rosse hangs his head, face buried in his palms. A heavy gloom settles over everyone.
Only Zade continues to fidget restlessly beneath Granny Nysa's cloak.

speaker: Zade
content: Wait, wait! Look over there!
[CG - Supporting Each Other Post-Battle A]

speaker: Horo
content: Is that...
Two figures appear in the swirling dust, supporting each other as they stumble forward with determination, emerging step by step.
The two silhouettes are growing larger and clearer. They're...
[CG - Supporting Each Other Post-Battle B]

speaker: Hella
content: The one and only, incredibly amazing, totally unbeatable hero Hella is back—safe and sound!

speaker: Horo
content: Hella!

speaker: Zade
content: And Hypatia too! They're back!
Though covered in wounds, their steps grow quicker and lighter with each stride. Hella's face breaks into an enormous grin.
The crowd erupts in thunderous cheers as everyone rushes forward, surrounding Hella and Hypatia in a tight circle.

speaker: Zade
content: We won! We beat the big monster! We won!
[Background - City Center - Day]
Surrounded by the crowd, Hypatia appears flustered and overwhelmed, even stammering a little as she tries to speak.

speaker: Hypatia
content: I, ugh...

speaker: Hypatia
content: But logically, I shouldn't have been able to block that final attack... Someone else stepped in to defend me... Who was it?
Hypatia turns her head to find a mischievous grin on Hella's face.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehehe, actually...
[Flashback Filter]
Synex leaps down the rock face, intending to flee, but gets intercepted by two figures.

speaker: Horo
content: You came to recover the stuff hidden underground? So sorry, but we've already cleaned the place out.

speaker: Hella
content: And I'm sure you wouldn't want your lady to become the Apostle's sweet treat, would you? So, how about making a deal with us?
Voice trembling slightly, the woman can't help lifting the corners of her mouth into a smile.

speaker: Synex
content: Interesting. I like it. Care to elaborate?
[End of Flashback Filter]

speaker: Hella
content: We said we cleaned the place out. We never said we actually took anything. That didn't count as a lie.

speaker: Hella
content: But she disappeared right after landing the final blow... Oh well, doesn't matter! It's better she's gone!

speaker: Hella
content: Excuse us! Make way, everyone, Hypa has something to say!
Hella pushes Hypatia into the center of the crowd.

speaker: Hella
content: Go on! We went over this. What's your opening line again?

speaker: Hypatia
content: Guys... I'm sorry. I made many impulsive decisions without consulting you all first. You guys must have been really worried.
Hella clears her throat, gently prompting her to continue.

speaker: Hella
content: And...?

speaker: Hypatia
content: ...Thank you, everyone. I'm home.
At the highest point of the city, the blue-haired woman stands on a jutting rock. She flips the coin in her hand while watching the celebrating crowd far below.

speaker: Lysandra
content: If that girl hadn't turned back then, I might have actually dug up something else underground. But... what's done is done, so be it.
The threat outside Furor has been eliminated, and the underground treasures are likely mostly destroyed. She has no reason to stay here anymore.
The woman remains silent. After a moment, she lets out a soft sigh.

speaker: Lysandra
content: In the end, you're still choosing to put your lives in someone else's hands.
She flips the coin once more and catches it. Without looking at the result, she turns and leaves Furor without a moment's hesitation.

speaker: Lysandra
content: Farewell. I may not understand this hope you all speak of, but if this is what you want...

speaker: Lysandra
content: Then I wish you all the best in surviving the fate you've chosen to embrace.
